title: The One Where Monica Gets a Roommate

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Joey, Phoebe, and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There's nothing to tell! He's just some guy
I work with!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: C'mon, you're going out with the guy! There's
gotta be something wrong with him!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right Joey, be
nice. So does he have a hump? A hump and a hairpiece?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, does he eat chalk?
(They all stare, bemused.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just, 'cause, I don't want her to go through
what I went through with Carl- oh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, everybody relax. This is not even a
date. It's just two people going out to dinner and- not having sex.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sounds like a date to me.
[Time Lapse]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright, so I'm back in high school, I'm
standing in the middle of the cafeteria, and I realize I am totally naked.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Had that dream.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then I look down, and I realize there's a
phone... there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Instead of...?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Never had that dream.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All of a sudden, the phone starts to ring.
Now I don't know what to do, everybody starts looking at me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And they weren't looking at
you before?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Finally, I figure
I'd better answer it, and it turns out it's my mother,
which is very-very weird, because- she never calls me!
[Time Lapse, Ross has entered.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (mortified) Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This guy says hello, I wanna kill myself.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you okay, sweetie?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just feel like someone reached down my
throat, grabbed my small intestine, pulled it out of my mouth and tied it around my
neck...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Cookie?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (explaining to the others) Carol moved her
stuff out today.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Ross) Let me get you some coffee.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! Oh! (She starts to pluck at the air
just in front of Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no don't! Stop cleansing my aura! No, just
leave my aura alone, okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine! Be murky!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll be fine,
alright? Really, everyone. I hope she'll be very happy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No you don't.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No I don't, to hell with her, she left me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And you never knew she was a lesbian...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!! Okay?! Why does everyone keep fixating on
that? She didn't know, how should I know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sometimes I wish I was a lesbian... (They
all stare at him.) Did I say that out loud?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I told mom and dad last night,
they seemed to take it pretty well.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh really, so that
hysterical phone call I got from a woman at sobbing 3:00 A.M., "I'll never have
grandchildren, I'll never have grandchildren." was what? A wrong number?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright Ross, look. You're feeling a lot of
pain right now. You're angry. You're hurting. Can I tell you what the answer is?
(Ross gestures his consent.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Strip joint! C'mon, you're single! Have some
hormones!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't want to be single, okay? I just... I
just- I just wanna be married again!
(Rachel enters in a wet wedding dress and starts to search
the room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I just want a million dollars! (He
extends his hand hopefully.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God Monica hi! Thank God! I just went to
your building and you weren't there and then this guy with a big hammer said you might be
here and you are, you are!

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.text: Can I get you some coffee?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pointing at Rachel) De-caff. (to All) Okay,
everybody, this is Rachel, another Lincoln High survivor. (to Rachel) This is everybody,
this is Chandler, and Phoebe, and Joey, and- you remember my brother Ross?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, sure!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.
(They go to hug but Ross's umbrella opens. He sits
back down defeated again. A moment of silence follows as Rachel sits and the others
expect her to explain.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you wanna tell us now, or are we waiting
for four wet bridesmaids?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God... well, it started about a half hour
before the wedding. I was in the room where we were keeping all the presents, and I was
looking at this gravy boat. This really gorgeous Lamauge gravy boat. When all of a sudden-
(to the waitress that brought her coffee)Sweet 'n' Lo?- I realized that I was more turned
on by this gravy boat than by Barry! And then I got really freaked out, and that's when it
hit me: how much Barry looks like Mr. Potato Head. Y'know, I mean, I always knew looked
familiar, but... Anyway, I just had to get out of there, and I started wondering 'Why am I
doing this, and who am I doing this for?'. (to Monica) So anyway I just didn't know where
to go, and I know that you and I have kinda drifted apart, but you're the only person I
knew who lived here in the city.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who wasn't invited to the wedding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I was kinda hoping that wouldn't be an
issue... [Scene: Monica's Apartment, everyone is there and watching a Spanish Soap on TV
and are trying to figure out what is going on.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now I'm guessing that he bought her the big
pipe organ, and she's really not happy about it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (imitating the characters)
Tuna or egg salad? Decide!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in a deep voice) I'll have
whatever Christine is having.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) Daddy, I just... I can't marry
him! I'm sorry. I just don't love him. Well, it matters to me!
(The scene on TV has changed to show two
women, one is holding her hair.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If I let go of
my hair, my head will fall off.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (re TV) Ooh, she should not be wearing
those pants.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I say push her down the stairs.
Phoebe, Ross, Chandler, and Joey:
Push her down the stairs! Push her down the stairs! Push her down the stairs!
(She is pushed down the stairs and everyone cheers.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: C'mon Daddy, listen to me! It's like, it's
like, all of my life, everyone has always told me, 'You're a shoe! You're a shoe, you're a
shoe, you're a shoe!'. And today I just stopped and I said, 'What if I don't wanna be a
shoe? What if I wanna be a- a purse, y'know? Or a- or a hat! No, I'm not saying I want you
to buy me a hat, I'm saying I am a ha- It's a metaphor, Daddy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can see where he'd have trouble.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look Daddy, it's my life. Well maybe I'll
just stay here with Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I guess we've established who's
staying here with Monica...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, maybe that's my decision. Well, maybe
I don't need your money. Wait!! Wait, I said maybe!!
[Time Lapse, Rachel is breating into a paper bag.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just breathe, breathe.. that's it. Just try
to think of nice calm things...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sings) Raindrops on roses and rabbits and
kittens, (Rachel and Monica turn to look at her.) bluebells and sleighbells and- something
with mittens... La la la la...something and noodles with
string. These are a few...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm all better now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (grins and walks to the kitchen and says to
Chandler and Joey.) I helped!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, look, this is probably for the best,
y'know? Independence. Taking control of your life. The whole,
'hat' thing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (comforting her) And hey, you need anything,
you can always come to Joey. Me and Chandler live across the hall. And he's away a lot.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, stop hitting on her! It's her wedding
day!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What, like there's a rule or something?
(The door buzzer sounds and Chandler gets it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Please don't do that again, it's a
horrible sound.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (over the intercom) It's, uh,
it's Paul.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God, is it
6:30? Buzz him in!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who's Paul?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Paul the Wine Guy, Paul?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe. Joey: Wait. Your 'not a real
date' tonight is with Paul the Wine Guy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He finally asked you out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, this is a Dear Diary moment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, wait, I can cancel...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please, no, go, that'd be fine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Ross) Are, are you okay? I mean, do you
want me to stay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (choked voice) That'd be good...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (horrified) Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (normal voice) No, go on! It's Paul the Wine
Guy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What does that mean?
Does he sell it, drink it, or just complain a lot? (Chandler doesn't know.)
(There's a knock on the door and it's Paul.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, come in! Paul, this is.. (They are all
lined up next to the door.)... everybody, everybody, this is Paul.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey! Paul! Hi! The Wine Guy! Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name. Paul,
was it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, umm-umm, I'll
just--I'll be right back, I just gotta go ah, go ah...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A wandering?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Change! Okay,
sit down. (Shows Paul in) Two seconds.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, I just pulled out four eyelashes. That
can't be good.
(Monica goes to change.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Paul!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here's a little tip, she
really likes it when you rub her neck in the same spot over and over and over again until
it starts to get a little red.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (yelling from the bedroom)
Shut up, Joey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So Rachel, what're you, uh... what're you up
to tonight?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I was kinda supposed to be headed for
Aruba on my honeymoon, so nothing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right, you're not even getting your honeymoon,
God.. No, no, although, Aruba, this time of year... talk about your- (thinks) -big
lizards... Anyway, if you don't feel like being alone tonight, Joey and Chandler are
coming over to help me put together my new furniture.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (deadpan) Yes, and we're very excited
about it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well actually thanks, but I think I'm just
gonna hang out here tonight. It's been kinda a long day.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, sure.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, you wanna help?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I wish I could, but I don't want to.
Commercial Break
[Scene: The Subway, Phoebe is singing for
change.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Love is sweet as
summer showers, love is a wondrous work of art, but your love oh your love, your love...is
like a giant pigeon...crapping on my heart. La-la-la-la-la- (some guy gives her some
change and to that guy) Thank you. (sings) La-la-la-la...ohhh!
[Scene: Ross's Apartment, the guys are there assembling
furniture.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (squatting and reading the instructions) I'm
supposed to attach a brackety thing to the side things, using a bunch of these little worm
guys. I have no brackety thing, I see no whim guys whatsoever and- I cannot feel my legs.
(Joey and Chandler are finishing assembling
the bookcase.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm thinking we've got a
bookcase here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's a beautiful thing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (picking up a leftover part) What's this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I would have to
say that is an 'L'-shaped bracket.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Which goes where?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have no
idea.
(Joey checks that Ross is not looking and dumps it in a
plant.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Done with the bookcase!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All finished!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (clutching a beer can and sniffing) This was
Carol's favorite beer. She always drank it out of the can, I should have known.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey-hey, if you're
gonna start with that stuff we're outta here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, please don't spoil
all this fun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, let me ask you a question. She got the
furniture, the stereo, the good TV- what did you get?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, God.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got screwed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

scenes.location: A Restaurant, Monica and Paul are eating.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I know, I know, I'm such an idiot. I guess I
should have caught on when she started going to the dentist four and five times a week. I
mean, how clean can teeth get?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My brother's going through that right now,
he's such a mess. How did you get through it?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Well, you might try accidentally breaking
something valuable of hers, say her-

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: -leg?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (laughing) That's one way! Me, I- I went for
the watch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You actually broke her watch? Wow! The worst thing I ever did was, I-I shredded by
boyfriend's favorite bath towel.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Ooh, steer clear of you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's right.

scenes.location: Monica's Apartment, Rachel is talking on the phone and pacing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Barry, I'm sorry... I am so sorry... I know
you probably think that this is all about what I said the other day about you making love
with your socks on, but it isn't... it isn't, it's about me, and I ju- (She stops talking
and dials the phone.) Hi, machine cut me off again... anyway...look,
look, I know that some girl is going to be incredibly lucky to become Mrs. Barry Finkel,
but it isn't me, it's not me. And not that I have any idea who me is right now, but
you just have to give me a chance too... (The maching cuts her off again and she redials.)
[Scene: Ross's Apartment; Ross is pacing while Joey and
Chandler are working on some more furniture.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm divorced! I'm only
26 and I'm divorced!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shut up!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You must stop! (Chandler
hits what he is working on with a hammer and it collapses.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That only took me an hour.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, Ross, you gotta
understand, between us we haven't had a relationship that has lasted longer than a Mento.
You, however have had the love of a woman for four years.
Four years of closeness and sharing at the end of which she ripped your heart out, and
that is why we don't do it! I don't think that was my point!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what the scariest part is? What if
there's only one woman for everybody, y'know? I mean what if you get one woman- and that's
it? Unfortunately in my case, there was only one woman- for her...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you talking about? 'One woman'?
That's like saying there's only one flavor of ice cream for you. Lemme tell you something,
Ross. There's lots of flavors out there. There's Rocky Road, and Cookie Dough, and Bing!
Cherry Vanilla. You could get 'em with Jimmies, or nuts, or whipped cream! This is the
best thing that ever happened to you! You got married, you were, like, what, eight?
Welcome back to the world! Grab a spoon!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I honestly don't know if I'm hungry or horny.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stay out of my freezer! [Scene: A
Restaurant, Monica and Paul are still eating.]

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Ever since she walked out on me, I, uh...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?..... What, you wanna spell it out with
noodles?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: No, it's, it's more of a fifth date kinda
revelation.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, so there is gonna be a fifth date?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Isn't there?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah... yeah, I think there is. -What were
you gonna say?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Well, ever-ev-... ever since she left me, um,
I haven't been able to, uh, perform. (Monica takes a sip of her drink.) ...Sexually.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (spitting out her drink in shock) Oh God, oh
God, I am sorry... I am so sorry...

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: It's okay...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know being spit on is probably not what
you need right now. Um... how long?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Two years.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! I'm-I'm-I'm glad you smashed her watch!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: So you still think you, um... might want that
fifth date?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pause)...Yeah. Yeah, I do.
[Scene: Monica's Apartment, Rachel is watching Joanne
Loves Chaci.]
We are gathered here today to join Joanne Louise Cunningham and
Charles, Chachi-Chachi-Chachi, Arcola in the bound of holy matrimony.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh...see... but Joanne loved Chachi! That's
the difference!
[Scene: Ross's Apartment, they're all sitting around and
talking.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (scornful) Grab a spoon. Do you know how long
it's been since I've grabbed a spoon? Do the words 'Billy, don't be a hero' mean anything
to you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great story! But, I uh,
I gotta go, I got a date with Andrea--Angela--Andrea... Oh man, (looks to Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Angela's the screamer,
Andrea has cats.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right. Thanks.
It's June. I'm outta here. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know, here's the thing. Even if I could get
it together enough to- to ask a woman out,... who am I gonna ask? (He gazes out of the
window.)
[Cut to Rachel staring out of her window.]
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica's Apartment, Rachel is making coffee for
Joey and Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Isn't this amazing? I mean, I have never
made coffee before in my entire life.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is amazing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Congratulations.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know, I figure if I can
make coffee, there isn't anything I can't do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If can invade Poland,
there isn't anything I can't do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, while you're on a roll, if you feel
like you gotta make like a Western omelet or something... (Joey and Chandler taste the
coffee, grimace, and pour it into a plant pot.) Although actually I'm really not that
hungry...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering, to herself) Oh
good, Lenny and Squigy are here.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Morning. Good morning.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (entering from Monica's room)
Morning.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Morning, Paul.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello, Paul.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, Paul, is it?
(Monica and Paul walk to the door and talk in a low voice
so the others can't hear. The others move Monica's table closer to the door so that
they can.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Thank you! Thank you so
much!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Stop!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: No, I'm telling you last night
was like umm, all my birthdays, both graduations, plus the barn raising scene in Witness.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We'll talk later.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Yeah. (They kiss) Thank you. (Exits)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That wasn't a real date?! What the hell do you
do on a real date?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Shut up, and put my table back.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Okayyy! (They do so.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, kids, I gotta get to work. If I
don't input those numbers,... it doesn't make much of a difference...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, like, you guys all have jobs?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, we all have jobs. See, that's how we
buy stuff.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I'm an actor.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Would I have seen you in anything?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I doubt it. Mostly regional work.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh wait, wait, unless you happened to catch
the Reruns' production of Pinocchio, at the little theater in the
park.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, it was a job all right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: 'Look, Gippetto, I'm a real live boy.'

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I will not take this abuse. (Walks to the door
and opens it to leave.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're right, I'm sorry. (Burst into song
and dances out of the door.) "Once I was a wooden boy, a little wooden boy..."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You should both know,
that he's a dead man. Oh, Chandler? (Starts after Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So how you doing today? Did you sleep okay?
Talk to Barry? I can't stop smiling.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can see that. You look like you slept with
a hanger in your mouth.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, he's just so, so... Do you remember
you and Tony DeMarco?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it's like that. With feelings.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow. Are you in trouble.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Big time!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Want a wedding dress?
Hardly used.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think we are getting
a little ahead of selves here. Okay. Okay. I am just going to get up, go to work
and not think about him all day. Or else I'm just gonna get up and go to work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, look, wish me luck!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What for?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm gonna go get one of those (Thinks) job
things.
(Monica exits.)

scenes.location: Iridium, Monica is working as Frannie enters.

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: Hey, Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Frannie, welcome back! How was Florida?

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: You had sex, didn't you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How do you do that?

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: Oh, I hate you, I'm pushing my Aunt Roz through
Parrot Jungle and you're having sex! So? Who?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know Paul?

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: Paul the Wine Guy? Oh yeah, I know Paul.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You mean you know Paul like I know Paul?

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: Are you kidding? I take credit for Paul. Y'know before me, there was no
snap in his turtle for two years.

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone but Rachel is there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sitting on the arm of the couch)Of course it was a line!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?! Why? Why, why would anybody do something like that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I assume we're looking for an answer more sophisticated than 'to get you
into bed'.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I hate men! I hate men!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, don't hate, you don't
want to put that out into the universe.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is it me? Is it like I have some sort of
beacon that only dogs and men with severe emotional problems can hear?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, c'mere, gimme your feet. (She starts massaging them.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just thought he was nice, y'know?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (bursts out laughing again) I can't believe you didn't know it was a line!
(Monica pushes him off of the sofa as Rachel enters with a shopping bag.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Guess what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You got a job?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you kidding? I'm trained for nothing! I was laughed out of twelve
interviews today.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And yet you're surprisingly upbeat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You would be too if you found John and David boots on sale, fifty
percent off!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, how well you know me...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They're my new 'I don't need a job, I don't need my parents, I've got
great boots' boots!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How'd you pay for them?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, credit card.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And who pays for that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um... my... father.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is sitting around the kitchen table.
Rachel's credit cards are spread out on the table along with a pair of scissors.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, come on you
guys, is this really necessary? I mean, I can stop charging anytime I want.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: C'mon, you can't live off your parents your whole life.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know that. That's why I was getting married.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Give her a break, it's hard being on your own for the first time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're welcome. I remember when I first came to this city. I was
fourteen. My mom had just killed herself and my step-dad was back in prison, and I got
here, and I didn't know anybody. And I ended up living with this albino guy who was, like,
cleaning windshields outside port authority, and then he killed himself, and then I found
aromatherapy. So believe me, I know exactly how you feel.
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The word you're looking for is 'Anyway'...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, you ready?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. No, no, I'm not
ready! How can I be ready? "Hey, Rach! You ready to jump out the
airplane without your parachute?" Come on, I can't do this!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You can, I know you
can!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, you made
coffee! You can do anything! (Chandler slowly tries to hide the now dead plant from
that morning when he and Joey poured their coffee into it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mon, cut. Cut, cut, cut,...

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Cut, cut, cut, cut, cut, cut, cut... (She cuts one of them and they cheer.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know what? I think
we can just leave it at that. It's kinda like a symbolic gesture...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel!
That was a library card!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Cut, cut, cut, cut, cut, cut, cut..

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (as Rachel is cutting up
her cards) Y'know, if you listen closely, you can hear a thousand retailers scream.
(She finishes cutting them up and they all
cheer.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Welcome to the real world! It sucks. You're
gonna love it!
[Time Lapse, Rachel and Ross are watching a TV channel finishes it's broadcast day by
playing the national anthem.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, that's it (To Ross) You gonna crash on the couch?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No, I gotta go home sometime.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You be okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Mon, look what I just found on the floor. (Monica smiles.) What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's Paul's watch. You just put it back where you found it. Oh boy.
Alright. Goodnight, everybody.

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Goodnight.
(Monica stomps on Paul's watch and goes into her room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mmm. (They both reach for the last cookie) Oh, no-

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sorry-

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No no no, go-

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, you have it, really, I don't want it-

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Split it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (They split it.) You know you probably didn't know this, but back in
high school, I had a, um, major crush on you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I knew.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You did! Oh.... I always figured you just thought I was Monica's geeky
older brother.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Listen, do you think- and try not to let my intense vulnerability
become any kind of a factor here- but do you think it would be okay if I asked you out?
Sometime? Maybe?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, maybe...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay... okay, maybe I will...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Goodnight.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Goodnight.
(Rachel goes into her room and Monica enters the living room as Ross is leaving.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See ya.... Waitwait, what's with you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just grabbed a spoon. (Ross exits and Monica has no idea what that
means.)

title: The One with the Sonogram at the End

lines.text: [Scene Central Perk, everyone's there.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What you guys don't understand is, for us,
kissing is as important as any part of it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, right!.......Y'serious?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Everything you need to know is in that first kiss.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Absolutely.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I think for us, kissing is pretty much like an opening act,
y'know? I mean it's like the stand-up comedian you have to sit through before Pink Floyd
comes out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, and-and it's not that we don't like the comedian, it's that-that...
that's not why we bought the ticket.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The problem is, though, after the concert's over, no matter how great
the show was, you girls are always looking for the comedian again, y'know? I mean, we're
in the car, we're fighting traffic... basically just trying to stay awake.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, well, word of advice: Bring back the comedian. Otherwise next time
you're gonna find yourself sitting at home, listening to that album alone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause)....Are we still talking about sex?
Opening Credits
[Scene: Museum of Prehistoric History, Ross and a co-worker
(Marsha) are setting up an exhibit which includes some mannequins of cave people.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it's good, it is good, it's just that- mm- doesn't she seem a little
angry?

lines.speaker: Marsha
lines.text: Well, she has issues.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Does she.

lines.speaker: Marsha
lines.text: He's out banging other women over the head with a club, while she sits
at home trying to get the mastodon smell out of the carpet!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marsha, these are cave people. Okay? They have issues like 'Gee, that
glacier's getting kinda close.' See?

lines.speaker: Marsha
lines.text: Speaking of issues, isn't that your ex-wife?
(Carol, Ross's ex-wife, has entered behind them and is standing outstide the exhibit.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (trying to ignore her) No. No.

lines.speaker: Marsha
lines.text: Yes, it is. Carol! Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, yes, it is. (waves) How about I'll, uh, catch up with you in
the Ice Age.
(Marsha extis and Ross waves Carol into the exhibit.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: So.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You look great. I, uh... I hate that.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Sorry. You look good too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, well, in here, anyone who... stands erect... So what's new? Still,
uh...

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: A lesbian?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well... you never know. How's, um.. how's the family?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Marty's still totally paranoid. Oh, and, uh-

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why- why are you here, Carol?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: I'm pregnant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pregnant?!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler, Joey, Phoebe, and Monica are watching Three's
Company.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I think this is the episode of Three's
Company where there's some kind of misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ...Then I've already seen this one! (Turns off the TV.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (taking a drink from Joey) Are you through with that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, sorry, the swallowing slowed me down.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whose little ball of paper is this?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, uh, that would be mine. See, I wrote a note to myself, and then I
realised I didn't need it, so I balled it up and... (sees that Monica is glaring at him)
...now I wish I was dead.
(Monica starts to fluff a pillow.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She's already fluffed that pillow... Monica, you know, you've already
fluffed that- (Monica glares at her.) -but, it's fine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look , I'm sorry, guys, I just don't wanna give them any more ammunition
than they already have.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, and we all know how cruel a parent can be about the flatness of a
child's pillow.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica- Hi! Um, Monica, you're scaring me. I mean, you're like, you're
like all chaotic and twirly. And not-not in a good way.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, calm down. You don't see Ross getting all chaotic and twirly every
time they come.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's because as far as my parents are concerned, Ross can do no wrong.
Y'see, he's the Prince. Apparently they had some big ceremony before I was born.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking out the window) Ew, ew, ew, ew ew ew ew ew!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ugly Naked Guy got a Thighmaster!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Eeaagh!
(Rachel enters from her room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Has anybody seen my engagement ring?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, it's beautiful.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, oh God, oh God oh God oh God oh God.... (Starts to look under
the couch cushions.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, look, don't touch that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, like I wasn't dreading tomorrow enough, having to give it back to
him... 'Hi Barry! Remember me? I'm the girl in the veil who stomped on your heart in front
of your entire family!' Oh God and now I'm gonna have to return the ring, without the
ring, which makes it so much harder...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Easy Rach, we'll find it. (To all) Won't we!

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Oh! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, when'd'ya have it on last?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Doy! Probably right before she lost it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don't get a lot of 'doy' these days...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know I had it this morning, and I know I had it when I was in the
kitchen with...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...Dinah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looks at the lasagne and realizes something) Ohhhhh, don't be mad...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You didn't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I am sorry...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I gave you one job! (Starts to examin the lasagne through the bottom of
the glass pan.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, but look how straight those noodles are!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now, Monica, you know that's not how you look for an engagement ring
in a lasagne...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (puts down the lasagne) I just... can't do it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Boys? We're going in.
(Chandler, Joey, and Phoebe start to pick through the lasagne as there's a knock on the
door which Monica answers.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (standing outside the door).....Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow. That is not a happy hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Carol's pregnant.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (while everyone else is stunned) Ooh! I found it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Do that for another two hours, you might be where I am right about
now. (He enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kinda puts that whole pillow thing in perspective, huh, Mon?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well now, how-how do you fit into this whole thing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, Carol says she and Susan want me to be involved, but if I'm not
comfortable with it, I don't have to be involved.. basically it's entirely up to me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She is so great! I miss her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What does she mean by 'involved'?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I mean presumably, the biggest part of your job is done.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway, they want me to go down to this- sonogram thing with them
tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have no idea. No matter what I do, though, I'm still gonna be a father.
(Joey starts to eat the rest of the lasagne and everyone turns and stares at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: .....Well, this is still ruined, right?
[Scene, Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Ross are pouring wine for their
parents.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh, Martha Ludwin's daughter is gonna call you. (Tastes a snack)
Mmm! What's that curry taste?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Curry.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Mmmm!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I- I think they're great! I, I really do.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (To Ross) Do you remember the Ludwins? The big one had a thing for
you, didn't she?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: They all had a thing for him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aw, Mom...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry, why is this girl going to call me?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh, she just graduated, and she wants to be something in cooking,
or food, or.... I don't know. Anyway, I told her you had a restaurant-

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No Mom, I don't have a restaurant, I work in a restaurant.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Well, they don't have to know that... (She starts to fluff the same
pillow Monica fluffed multiple times earlier.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, could you come and help me with the spaghetti, please?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. (They go to the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh, we're having spaghetti! That's.... easy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know this is going to sound unbelievably selfish, but, were you
planning on bringing up the whole baby/lesbian thing? Because I think it might take some
of the heat off me.
[Time Lapse, everyone is now eating.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: What that Rachel did to her life.... We ran into her parents at the
club, they were not playing very well.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I'm not gonna tell you what they spent on that wedding... but forty
thousand dollars is a lot of money!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Well, at least she had the chance to leave a man at the altar...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What's that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Nothing! It's an expression.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No it's not.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Don't listen to your mother. You're independent, and you always have
been! Even when you were a kid... and you were chubby, and you had no friends, you were
just fine! And you would read alone in your room, and your puzzles...
[Time Lapse.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Look, there are people like Ross who
need to shoot for the stars, with his museum, and his papers getting published. Other
people are satisfied with staying where they are- I'm telling you, these are the people
who never get cancer.
[Time Lapse.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: ...And I read about these women trying to have it all, and I thank
God 'Our Little Harmonica' doesn't seem to have that problem.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (trying desperately to change the subject) So, Ross, what's going on
with you? Any stories? (Digs her elbow into his hand.) No news, no little anecdotes to
share with the folks?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pulls his hand away) Okay! Okay. (To his parents) Look, I, uh- I realise
you guys have been wondering what exactly happened between Carol and me, and, so, well,
here's the deal. Carol's a lesbian. She's living with a woman named Susan. She's pregnant
with my child, and she and Susan are going to raise the baby.
(Stunned silence ensues.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (To Monica) And you knew about this?!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Park, everyone's there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Your folks are really that bad, huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, y'know, these people are pros. They know what they're doing, they
take their time, they get the job done.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Boy, I know they say you can't change your parents,... boy, if you
could- (To Ross) -I'd want yours.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Must pee. (Goes to pee.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know, it's even worse when you're twins.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You're twins?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. We don't speak. She's like this high-powered, driven career type.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What does she do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She's a waitress.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, you guys, I kinda gotta clean up now. (They all start to
leave.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, you're an only child, right? You don't have any of this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, no, although I did have an imaginary friend, who... my parents
actually preferred.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The lights, please..
(Joey turns off the lights, and they all leave as Rachel starts to clean up. Ross
enters from the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...How long was I in there?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm just cleaning up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: D'ya.. uh.. d'ya need any help?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh.. okay, sure! Thanks! (She hands him the broom and sits down.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway.. um.. (Starts to sweep.) So, you- uh- you nervous about Barry
tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.. a little..

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mm-hmm..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A lot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, got any advice? Y'know, as someone who's recently been- dumped?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you may wanna steer clear of the word 'dumped'. Chances are he's
gonna be this, this broken shell of a man, y'know, so you should try not to look too
terrific, I know it'll be hard. Or, y'know, uh, hey!, I'll go down there, and I'll give
Barry back his ring, and you can go with Carol and Susan to the OB/GYN...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you've got Carol tomorrow.. When did it get so complicated?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Got me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Remember when we were in high school together?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean, didn't you think you were just gonna meet somone, fall in love-
and that'd be it? (Ross gazes at her.) ..Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, yes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Man, I never thought I'd be here.. (She leans back onto his hand.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Me either... (He pulls up a stool so that he doesn't have to move his
hand.)

scenes.location: Carol's OB/GYN, Carol is waiting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Sorry I'm late, I was stuck at work. There was this big
dinosaur.. thing.. anyway.
(Susan enters holding a drink.)

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ross, you remember Susan.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How could I forget?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (they shake hands) Hello, Susan. (To Carol) Good shake. Good shake. So,
uh, we're just waiting for...?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Dr. Oberman.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ..Dr. Oberman. Okay. And is he-

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: She.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: -she, of course, she- uh- familiar with our.. special situation?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Yes, and she's very supportive.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, that's great. (Susan gives her drink to Carol.) No, I'm- Oh.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (picks up a surgical instrament and mimes a duck with it) Quack, quack..

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ross? That opens my cervix. (He drops it in horror.)
[Scene Barry's office, Barry is working on patient, Robbie, as Rachel enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Barry?

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: C'mon in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (hesitates) Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Yeah! It's fine, it's fine. Robbie's gonna be here for hours.

lines.speaker: Robbie
lines.text: Huh?!

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: So, how ya doin?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm- uh- I'm okay... You look great!

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Yeah, well..

lines.speaker: Bernice
lines.text: (over intercom) Dr. Farber, Jason Greenstein's gagging.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: (answering the intercom) Be right there. (To Robbie and Rachel) Be back
in a sec.
(As Barry exits Robbie stares at Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I dumped him.

lines.speaker: Robbie
lines.text: Okay.

scenes.location: Carol's OB/GYN, they're talking about how this is going to work.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, um- so how's this, uh, how's this gonna work? Y'know, with us? Y'know,
when, like, important decisions have to be made?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Give me a 'for instance'.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, uh, uh, I don't know, okay, okay, how about with the, uh, with the
baby's name?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Marlon-

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marlon?!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: -if it's a boy, Minnie if it's a girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...As in Mouse?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: As in my grandmother.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Still, you- you say Minnie, you hear Mouse. Um, how about, um.. how about
Julia?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Julia..

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: We agreed on Minnie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 'S'funny, um, uh, we agreed we'd spend the rest of our lives together.
Things change, roll with the punches. I believe Julia's on the table..?
[Scene: Barry's office, Rachel is doing her makeup in the mirror on Barry's lamp as
Barry enters.]

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Sorry about that. So. What have you been up to?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, not much. I-I got a job.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Oh, that's great.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why are- why are you so tanned?

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Oh, I, uh- I went to Aruba.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no. You went on our honeymoon alone?

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: No. I went with, uh.. Now, this may hurt.

lines.speaker: Robbie
lines.text: Me?!

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: No! (To Rachel) I went with Mindy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mindy?! My maid of honour, Mindy?!

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Yeah, well, uh, we're kind of a thing now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Well, um.. (Grabs his forehand) You've got plugs!

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Careful! They haven't quite taken yet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you've got lenses! But you hate sticking your finger in your eye!

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Not for her. Listen, I really wanted to thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay..

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: See, about a month ago, I wanted to hurt you. More than I've ever wanted
to hurt anyone in my life. And I'm an orthodontist.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: You know, you were right? I mean, I thought we were happy. We weren't
happy. But with Mindy, now I'm happy. Spit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Robbie
lines.text: Me. (Spits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anyway, um, (Gets the ring out of her purse.) I guess this belongs to
you. And thank you for giving it to me.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Well, thank you for giving it back.
(Barry and Rachel look at each other.)

lines.speaker: Robbie
lines.text: Hello?!

scenes.location: Carol's OB/GYN, they're still arguing about what to name the baby.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh, please! What's wrong with Helen?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Helen Geller? I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Hello? It's not gonna be Helen Geller.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: No, I mean it's not Geller.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, it's gonna be Helen Willick?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: No, actually, um, we talked about Helen Willick-Bunch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, wait a minute, wha- why is she in the title?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: It's my baby too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, 's'funny, really? Um, I don't remember you making any sperm.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Yeah, and we all know what a challenge that is!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: All right, you two, stop it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No no no, she gets a credit, hey, I'm in there too.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ross. You're not actually suggesting Helen Willick-Bunch-Geller? 'Cause I
think that borders on child abuse.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course not, I'm... suggesting Geller-Willick-Bunch.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh, no, nonononono, you see what he's doing? He knows no-one's gonna say
all those names, so they'll wind up calling her Geller, then he gets his way!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My way?! You-you think this is my way? Believe me, of all the ways I ever
imagined this moment in my life being, this is not my way- y'know what? Uh, um, this is
too hard. I'm not, I can't do-

lines.speaker: Dr. Oberman
lines.text: (entering) Knock knock!How are we today? Any nausea?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah. A little.

lines.speaker: Dr. Oberman
lines.text: Well, I was just wondering about the mother-to-be, but.. thanks for
sharing. (To Carol) Uh, lie back..

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You- uh- y'know what, I'm gonna go. I don't- I don't think I can be
involved in this particular thing right now.
(He turns to go, but the sound of the sonogram catches hes ear. He returns and
stares at it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Look at that.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: I know.

title: The One with the Thumb

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone but Phoebe is there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hi guys!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs! Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. Oh, oh, how'd it go?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, not so good. He walked me to the subway and said 'We should do this
again!'

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh. Ouch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? He said 'we should do it again', that's good, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, no. Loosely translated 'We should do this again' means 'You will
never see me naked'.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Since when?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Since always. It's like dating language. Y'know, like 'It's not you' means
'It is you'.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Or 'You're such a nice guy' means 'I'm gonna be dating leather-wearing
alcoholics and complaining about them to you'.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or, or, y'know, um, 'I think we should see other people' means 'Ha, ha,
I already am'.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And everybody knows this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Cushions the blow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, it's like when you're a kid, and your parents put your dog to
sleep, and they tell you it went off to live on some farm.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's funny, that, no, because, uh, our parents actually did, uh, send
our dog off to live on a farm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Wh- hello? The Millners' farm in Connecticut? The Millners, they had
this unbelievable farm, they had horses, and, and rabbits that he could chase and it was-
it w- .....Oh my God, Chi Chi!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is helping Joey rehearse for a part.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: "So how does it feel knowing you're about to die?"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "Warden, in five minutes my pain will be over. But you'll have to
live with the knowledge that you sent an honest man to die."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, that was really good!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks! Let's keep going.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. "So. Whaddya want from me, Damone, huh?"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "I just wanna go back to my cell. 'Cause in my cell, I can
smoke."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: "Smoke away."
(Joey takes out a pack of cigarettes and a lighter. He fumbles and drops the
lighter. Then he lights a cigarett, takes a drag, and coughs.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think this is probably why Damone smokes in his cell alone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Relax your hand!
(Joey lets his wrist go limp.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not so much!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright, now try taking a puff.
(Joey tries and visibly winces.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright.. okay. No. Give it to me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No no no, I am not giving you a cigarette.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's fine, it's fine. Look, do you wanna get this part, or not? Here.
(Joey reluctantly gives him the cigarette.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don't think of it as a cigarette. Think of it as the thing that's been
missing from your hand. When you're holding it, you feel right. You feel complete.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'miss it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nah, not so much. Alright, now we smoke. (Takes a puff.) Oh.. my..
God. (He continues to smoke.)
[Scene, Central Perk, everyone except Phoebe and Rachel is there.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, no, no. They say it's the same as the distance from the tip of a
guy's thumb to the tip of his index finger.
(The guys stretch out their fingers.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's ridiculous!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can I use.. either thumb?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (carrying a tray of drinks) Alright, don't tell me, don't tell me!
(Starts handing them out.) Decaf cappucino for Joey.. Coffee black.. Late.. And an iced
tea. I'm getting pretty good at this!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, excellent.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (leaving to serve others) Good for me!
(The gang swaps all the drinks for what they ordered as Phoebe enters. She sits
down without saying hi.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'okay, Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah- no- I'm just- it's, I haven't worked- It's my bank.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What did they do to you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's nothing, it's just- Okay. I'm going through my mail, and I open up
their monthly, you know, STATEMENT-

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Easy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: - and there's five hundred extra dollars in my account.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, Satan's minions at work again...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, 'cause now I have to go down there, and deal with them.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you talking about? Keep it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's not mine, I didn't earn it, if I kept it, it would be like
stealing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but if you spent it, it would be like shopping!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Okay, let's say I bought a really great pair of shoes. Do you know
what I'd hear, with every step I took? 'Not-mine. Not-mine. Not-mine.' And even if I was
happy, okay, and, and skipping- 'Not-not-mine, not-not-mine, not-not-mine,
not-not-mine'...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're with you. We got it.
(Chandler leans over the back of the couch out of sight.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. I'd- just- I'd never be able to enjoy it. It would be like this
giant karmic debt.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (puling him up) Hey. Whaddya doing?
(Chandler tries to shrug nonchalantly but eventually he has to exhale a mouthful of
smoke.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh! Oh, God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What is this?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm smoking. I'm smoking, I'm smoking.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I can't believe you! You've been so good, for three years!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And this- is my reward!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hold on a second, alright? Just think about what you went through the last
time you quit.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so this time I won't quit!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohhh! Put it out!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right! I'm putting it out, I'm putting it out. (He drops it in
Phoebe's coffee.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, no! I- I can't drink this now!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright. I'm gonna go change, I've got a date.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This Alan again? How's it goin'?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: 'S'going pretty good, y'know? It's nice, and, we're having fun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So when do we get to meet the guy?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let's see, today's Monday... Never.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, come on! Come on!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. Not after what happened with Steve.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you talking about? We love Schhteve! Schhteve was schhexy!..
Sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, I don't even know how I feel about him yet. Just give me a chance
to figure that out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, then can we meet him?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nope. Schhorry.

scenes.location: Iridium, Monica and Paula are at work.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean, why should I let them meet him? I mean, I bring a guy home, and
within five minutes they're all over him. I mean, they're like- coyotes, picking off the
weak members of the herd.

lines.speaker: Paula
lines.text: Listen. As someone who's seen more than her fair share of bad beef, I'll
tell you: that is not such a terrible thing. I mean, they're your friends, they're just
looking out after you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know. I just wish that once, I'd bring a guy home that they actually
liked.

lines.speaker: Paula
lines.text: Well, you do realise the odds of that happening are a little slimmer if
they never get to meet the guy..

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler is smoking out on the balcony, Phoebe is absent.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let it go, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well, you didn't know Chi Chi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you all promise?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah! We promise! We'll be good!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shouts to Chandler) Chandler? Do you promise to be good?
(Chandler makes a 'Cross my heart' sign. It starts to rain and he taps on the
window.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You can come in, but your filter-tipped little buddy has to stay outside!
(Chandler sulkilty picks up a garbage can lid and uses it as an umbrella.)
(Phoebe enters, walks to the couch, sits down, and begins to read a letter without
saying hi.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: 'Dear Ms. Buffay. Thank you for calling attention to our error. We have
credited your account with five hundred dollars. We're sorry for the inconvenience, and
hope you'll accept this- (Searches in her purse) -football phone as our free gift.'
Do you believe this?! Now I have a thousand dollars, and a football phone!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What bank is this?
(The intercom buzzes.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. It's him. (On the intercom) Who is it?

lines.speaker: Alan
lines.text: (on the intercom) It's Alan.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shouting to Chandler) Chandler! He's here!
(Chandler comes in, dripping wet.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to all) Okay, please be good, please. Just remember how much you
all like me.
(She opens the door and Alan enters.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi. Alan, this is everybody. Everybody, this is Alan.

lines.speaker: Alan
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi, Alan.

lines.speaker: Alan
lines.text: I've heard schho much about all you guyschh!
(Everyone laughs.)
[Time lapse, Alan is leaving.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Alan) Thanks. I'll call you tomorrow. (Alan exits, to all) Okay.
Okay, let's let the Alan-bashing begin. Who's gonna take the first shot, hmm?
(Silence.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: C'mon!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...I'll go. Let's start with the way he kept picking at- no, I'm sorry, I
can't do this, can't do this. We loved him.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Loved him! Yeah! He's great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute! We're talking about someone that I'm going out
with?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And did you notice...? (She spreads her thumb and index finger.)

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: (reluctantly) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Know what was great? The way his smile was kinda crooked.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, yes! Like the man in the shoe!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...What shoe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: From the nursery rhyme. 'There was a crooked man, Who had a crooked
smile, Who lived in a shoe, For a... while...'
(Dubious pause.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...So I think Alan will become the yardstick against which all future
boyfriends will be measured.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What future boyfriends? Nono, I th- I think this could be, y'know, it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah. I'd marry him just for his David Hasselhof impression alone.
You know I'm gonna be doing that at parties, right? (Does the impression)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what I like most about him, though?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The way he makes me feel about myself.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah...
Commercial Break
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica is alone as Ross, Rachel, Chandler, and Joey enter
dejectedly in softball gear.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.. how was the game?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well..

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: WE WON!! Thank you! Yes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fantastic! I have one question: How is that possible?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alan.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He was unbelievable. He was like that-that-that Bugs Bunny cartoon where
Bugs is playing all the positions, right, but instead of Bugs it was first base-Alan,
second base-Alan, third base-...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean, it-it was like, it was like he made us into a team.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yep, we sure showed those Hassidic jewellers a thing or two about
softball..

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can I ask you guys a question? D'you ever think that Alan is maybe..
sometimes..

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ..I dunno, a little too Alan?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, no. That's impossible. You can never be too Alan.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it's his, uh, innate Alan-ness that-that-that we adore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I personally could have a gallon of Alan.

scenes.location: A street, Phoebe walks up to a homeless person (Lizzie) she knows.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, Lizzie.

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: Hey, Weird Girl.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I brought you alphabet soup.

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: Did you pick out the vowels?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. But I left in the Ys. 'Cause, y'know, "sometimes y". Uh,
I also have something else for you. (She searches in her purse.)

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: Saltines?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, but would you like a thousand dollars and a football phone?

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: What? (She opens the envelope Phoebe has given her.) Oh my God, there's
really money in here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: Weird Girl, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I want you to have it. I don't want it.

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: No, no, I ha-I have to give you something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, that's fine, no.

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: Would you like my tin-foil hat?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. 'Cause you need that. No, it's okay, thanks.

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: Please, let me do something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, alright, you buy me a soda, and then we're even. Okay?

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
[Scene: Chandler's office, Chandler looks around, opens his desk drawer, takes a puff
of a cigarette, sprays around some air freshener, and takes some breath spray. He
types for a little while, opens the drawer again, and takes another drag of the cigarette.
While not paying attention, he sprays the breath spray around the room, takes a
squirt of air freshener and gags.]

scenes.location: A Street, Phoebe and Lizzie are at a hot dog vendor.

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: Keep the change. (To Phoebe) Sure you don't wanna pretzel?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: Lizzie
lines.text: (leaves) See ya.
(Phoebe opens the can and reacts.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is telling everyone about her discovery.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A thumb?!
(Phoebe nods.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Eww!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know! I know, I opened it up and there it was, just floating in there,
like this tiny little hitch-hiker!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, maybe it's a contest, y'know? Like, collect all five?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Does, um, anyone wanna see?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Nooo!
(Chandler lights a cigarette.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, hey, don't do that! Cut it out!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's worse than the thumb!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, this is so unfair!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, why is it unfair?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So I have a flaw! Big deal! Like Joey's constant knuckle-cracking
isn't annoying? And Ross, with his over-pronouncing every single word? And Monica, with
that snort when she laughs? I mean, what the hell is that thing? ...I accept all those
flaws, why can't you accept me for this?
(An awkward silence ensues.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ...Does the knuckle-cracking bother everybody?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I-I could live without it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, is it, like, a little annoying, or is it like when Phoebe chews her
hair?
(Phoebe spits out her hair.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, now, don't listen to him, Pheebs, I think it's endearing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, (Imitating Ross) "you do, do you"?
(Monica laughs and snorts.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, there's nothing wrong with speaking correctly.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: "Indeed there isn't"... I should really get back to work.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, 'cause otherwise someone might get what they actually ordered.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh-ho-hooohhh. The hair comes out, and the gloves come on.
(They degenerate into bickering and Chandler happily starts to smoke, undisturbed.)

scenes.location: Iridium, Monica and Paula are working.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you ever go out with a guy your friends all really like?

lines.speaker: Paula
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.. Well, I'm going out with a guy my friends all really like.

lines.speaker: Paula
lines.text: Waitwait.. we talking about the coyotes here? All right, a cow got
through!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can you believe it? ...Y'know what? I just don't feel the thing.
I mean, they feel the thing, I don't feel the thing.

lines.speaker: Paula
lines.text: Honey.. you should always feel the thing. Listen, if that's how
you feel about the guy, Monica, dump him!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.. it's gonna be really hard.

lines.speaker: Paula
lines.text: Well, he's a big boy, he'll get over it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, he'll be fine. It's the other five I'm worried about.

scenes.location: Cental Perk, Joey and Ross are persecuting Chandler about his smoking.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you have any respect for your body?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don't you realise what you're-you're doing to yourself?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, y'know, I have had it with you guys and your cancer and your
emphysema and your heart disease. The bottom line is, smoking is cool, and you know it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (holding the phone out to Chandler) Chandler? It's Alan, he wants to
speak to you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? He does? (taking the phone) Hey, buddy, what's up! Oh, she
told you about that, huh. Well, yeah, I have one now and then. Well, yeah, now. Well, it's
not that big- ..well, that's true,.. Gee, y'know, no-one- no-one's ever put it like that
before. Well, okay, thanks! (He hands the phone back and stubs out his cigarette.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Ross, who has wandered up) God, he's good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: If only he were a woman.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.
(They give each other a dubious look.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, everyond except Monica and Joey is watching Lambchop.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, Lambchop. How old is that sock? If I had a sock on my hand for
thirty years it'd be talking too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. I think it's time to change somebody's nicotine patch. (Does so.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey. Where's Joey?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey ate my last stick of gum, so I killed him. Do you think that was
wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think he's across the hall.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks. (Goes to fetch him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (finishing changing Chandler's nicotine patch) There y'go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (deadpan) Ooh, I'm alive with pleasure now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, you gonna have the rest of that Pop-Tart?.. Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Does anyone want the rest of this Pop-Tart?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I might!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sorry. ..Y'know, those stupid soda people gave me seven thousand dollars
for the thumb.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: You're kidding. Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And on my way over here, I stepped in gum. ...What is up with the
universe?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (dragged in by Monica, he has just gotten out of the shower) What's going
on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing. I just think it's nice when we're all here together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Even nicer when everyone gets to wear their underwear..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, Joey..

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, God! (Hurriedly closes his legs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (turns off the TV) Okay..

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh! That was Lambchop!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please, guys, we have to talk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, wait, I'm getting a deja vu...no, I'm not.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, we have to talk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There it is!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. It's-it's about Alan. There's something that you should know. I
mean, there's really no easy way to say this.. uh.. I've decided to break up with Alan.
(They all gasp and clutch each other.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is there somebody else?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, nononono.. it's just.. things change. People change.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We didn't change..

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So that's it? It's over? Just like that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know.. you let your guard down, you start to really care about
someone, and I just- I- (starts chewing her hair)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, I- I could go on pretending-

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: -but that wouldn't be fair to me, it wouldn't be fair to Alan- It
wouldn't be fair to you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who-who wants fair? Y'know, I just want things back. Y'know, the way they
were.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry..

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh, she's sorry! I feel better!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (tearful) I just can't believe this! I mean, with the holidays coming
up- I wanted him to meet my family-

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll meet somone else. There'll be other Alans.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Right!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you guys gonna be okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey hey, we'll be fine. We're just gonna need a little time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (dubious) I understand.

scenes.location: A Restaurant, Monica is breaking the news to Alan.

lines.speaker: Alan
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm, I'm really sorry.

lines.speaker: Alan
lines.text: Yeah, I'm sorry too. But, I gotta tell you, I am a little relieved.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Relieved?

lines.speaker: Alan
lines.text: Yeah, well, I had a great time with you.. I just can't stand your friends.

title: The One with George Stephanopoulos

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there except Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright. Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, okay. If I were omnipotent for a day,
I would want, um, world peace, no more hunger, good things for the rain-forest...And
bigger boobs!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, see.. you took mine. Chandler, what
about you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, if I were omnipotent for a day, I'd..
make myself omnipotent forever.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: See, there's always one guy. (Mocking)
"If I had a wish, I'd wish for three more wishes." (Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey Joey. Hi. Hey, buddy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Joey, what would you do if you were
omnipotent?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Probably kill myself!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ..Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, if Little Joey's dead, then I got no
reason to live!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, uh- OMnipotent.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You are? Ross, I'm sorry..
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross and Monica are watching Phoebe
sleep.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How does she do that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I cannot sleep in a public place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Would you look at her? She is so peaceful.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (waking and startling them) Oh! What what
what! ...Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's okay, y'know, you just nodded off again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What's going on with you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I got no sleep last night!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My grandmother has this new boyfriend, and
they're both kind of insecure in bed. Oh, and deaf. So they're constantly, like, having to
reassure each other that they're having a good time. You have no idea how loud they are!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, if you want, you can stay with Rachel
and me tonight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks.
(Chandler and Joey enter. Joey is counting his
steps.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ...Ninety-five, ninety-six, ninety-seven. See,
I told you! Less than a hundred steps from our place to here.
