lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got waaaay too much free time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross) Hey! Here's the birthday boy! Ross,
check it out: hockey tickets, Rangers-Penguins, tonight at the Garden, and we're taking
you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Happy birthday, pal!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We love you, man. (Kisses Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Funny, my birthday was seven months ago.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, I'm guessing you had an extra ticket and
couldn't decide which one of you got to bring a date?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, aren't we Mr. "The glass is
half empty."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God, oh- is today the twentieth, October
twentieth?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I was hoping you wouldn't remember.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohhh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's wrong with the twentieth?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eleven days before Halloween.. all the
good costumes are gone?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Today's the day Carol and I first..
consummated our physical relationship. (Joey is puzzled.) Sex. ..You know what, I-I'd
better pass on the game. I think I'm just gonna go home and think about my ex-wife and her
lesbian lover.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The hell with hockey, let's all do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (trying to stop Ross leaving) C'mon, Ross!
You, me, Joey, ice, guys' night out, c'mon, whaddya say, big guy, (Pretending to punch him
in the stomach.) Huh? Huh? Huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stops) I have no idea.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: C'mon, Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, alright, maybe it'll take my mind off
it. Do you promise to buy me a big thumb finger?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got it.
(Rachel runs up cluching an envelope.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look-look-look-look-look, my first pay
check! Look at the window, there's my name! Hi, me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I remember the day I got my first pay check.
There was a cave in in one of the mines, and eight people were killed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, you worked in a mine?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I worked in a Dairy Queen, why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God, isn't this exciting? I earned this. I
wiped tables for it, I steamed milk for it, and it was totally—(opens
envelope)—not worth it. Who's FICA? Why's he getting all my money? I mean, what-
Chandler, look at that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking) Oh, this is not that bad.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you're fine, yeah, for a first job.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can totally, totally live on this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, by the way, great service
tonight.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh! Yeah!
(They all get their wallets out and give generous tips.)

lines.speaker: Guys
lines.text: Hockey! (They go to leave but are
blocked by three of Rachel's friends, Leslie, Kiki, and Joanne. The guys pause to
stare at them.) Hockey! Hockey. (The guys.)

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: (looking around) Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! (Rachel, Leslie, Kiki, and Joanne
all scream and hug each other.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Phoebe) I swear I've seen birds do this
on Wild Kingdom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you guys doing here?

lines.speaker: Kiki
lines.text: Well, we were in the city shopping,
and your mom said you work here, aaand it's true!

lines.speaker: Joanne
lines.text: Look at you in the apron.
You look like you're in a play.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to a pregnant Leslie) Look at you, you are
so big I can't believe it!

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: I know. I know! I'm a duplex.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Joanne) So what's going on with you?

lines.speaker: Joanne
lines.text: Well, guess who my dad's
making partner in his firm? (She points to herself and they all scream again.)

lines.speaker: Kiki
lines.text: And while we're on the subject of
news.. (She holds up here finger to show off her engagement ring and they all scream
again.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Monica) Look, look, I have elbows! (They
scream.)
[Scene: A Street, Chandler and Joey are kicking a can to
each other.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...Poulet passes it up to Leetch! (Passes
it to Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Leetch spots Messier in the crease- there's
the pass! (He kicks it to Ross, but Ross is staring into a shop window.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We'll take a brief time out while Messier
stops to look at some women's shoes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Carol was wearing boots just like those the
night that we- we first- y'know. Fact, she, uh- she never took'em off, 'cause we-we- (off
Chandler's look) Sorry. Sorry.
(They walk on. Chandler and Joey start to talk but
Ross stops and whines.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Peach pit.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, Bunny?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (points) Peach pit. That night we, uh- we had-

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: -Peaches?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually, nectarines, but basically...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) Could've been a peach.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then, uh, then we got dressed, and I-I... I
walked her to the- (looks up, realises, and points) -the bus stop... I'm fine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, that woman's got an ass like Carol's!
(They turn to stare at him.) What? Thought we were trying to find stuff.
[Scene: Central Perk, Rachel, Lesile, Kiki, and Joanne are
talking.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So c'mon, you guys, tell me all the dirt!

lines.speaker: Kiki
lines.text: Well, the biggest news is still you dumping
Barry at the altar!

lines.speaker: Joanne
lines.text: Alright. Let's talk reality for a second.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joanne
lines.text: When are you coming home?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Guys, I'm not.

lines.speaker: Joanne
lines.text: C'mon, this is us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm not! This is what I'm doing now. I've
got this job-

lines.speaker: Kiki
lines.text: Waitressing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I'm not just waitressing. I'm.. I,
um... I write the specials on the specials board, and, uh... and I, uh... I take the uh
dead flowers out of the vase... Oh, and, um, sometimes Artelle lets me put the little
chocolate blobbies on the cookies.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Well. Your mom didn't tell us
about the blobbies.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe and Monica are in
pajamas and Monica is making something in the blender as Rachel enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Rach. How was it with your friends?
(She and Phoebe scream.) Okay! How would you like some Tiki Death Punch? (She pours the
contents of the blender into some glasses.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What's that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Weeeell, it's rum, and-

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Grabs the blender and starts to
drink.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We thought since Phoebe was staying over
tonight we'd have kinda like a slumber party thing. We got some trashy magazines, we got
cookie dough, we got Twister... (The phone rings and Monica answers it.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! Ooh! And I brought Operation!
But, um, I lost the tweezers, so we can't operate. But we can prep the guy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, Rach, it's the Visa card
people.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, God, ask them what they want.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Could you please tell me what
this is in reference to? (Listens) Yes, hold on. (To Rachel) Um, they say there's been
some unusual activity on your account.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I haven't used my card in weeks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is the unusual
activity. Look, they just wanna see if you're okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They wanna know if I'm okay. Okay.. they
wanna know if I'm okay, okay, let's see. Well, let's see, the FICA guys took all my money,
everyone I know is either getting married, or getting promoted, or getting pregnant, and
I'm getting coffee! And it's not even for me! So if that sounds like I'm okay, okay, then
you can tell them I'm okay, okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pauses then on the phone) Uh- Rachel has
left the building, can you call back?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, c'mon! (Miserably) Let's play Twister!
[Scene: Madison Square Garden, the guys are trying
to find their seats.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (squeezing past people) Sorry, sorry... Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? There was ice there that night with
Carol? Plastic seats? Four thousand angry Pittsburgh fans?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, actually I was just saying it looks like
we're not sitting together. But now you mention it, there was ice there that
night... It was the first frost...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: C'mon, sit. Just sit down, sit.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, they're all hanging out in the
living room.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You should feel great about yourself! You're
doing this amazing independence thing!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, what is so amazing? I gave up, like,
everything. And for what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You are just like Jack.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...Jack from downstairs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, Jack and the Beanstalk.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ah, the other Jack.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, right! See, he gave up something, but
then he got those magic beans. And then he woke up, and there was this, this big plant
outside his window, full of possibilities and stuff.. And he lived in a village, and you
live in the Village..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, but Pheebs, Pheebs, Jack gave up a
cow, I gave up an orthodontist. Okay, I-I-I know, I know I didn't love him-

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, see, Jack did love the cow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But see, it was a plan. Y'know, it was
clear. It was figured out, and now everything's just kinda like...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Floopy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So what, you're not the only one. I mean,
half the time we don't know where we're going. You've just gotta figure at some point it's
all gonna come together, and it's just gonna be... un-floopy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, like that's a word.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, but Monica, what if- what if it
doesn't come together?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ...Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, well... 'cause.... you just... I don't
like this question.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, see, see, you guys, what if we don't
get magic beans? I mean, what if all we've got are.. beans?
[Scene: Madison Square Garden, the guys are
watching the game.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Get him! GET HIM! Get him! Get- YESSS! Not
laughing now, are ya pal!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) See buddy, that's all you need,
a bunch of toothless guys hitting each other with sticks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pass it! Pass it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He's open!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Shoot! Shoot! Shoot!
(The player shoots and the puck flies off the rink and hits
Ross in the face. Chandler looks concered until he notices...)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, look, we're on that TV thing!
(Chandler and Joey hold the puck and wave at the TV thing.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: An Emergency Room, Chandler and Joey are leading
Ross in.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to the receptionist)'Scuse me.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: (holds up her hand—she is on the
phone) It says to call this number if you're not completely satisfied with this candy bar.
Well, I'm not completely satisfied.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen, it's kind of an emergency. Well, I
guess you know that, or we'd be in the predicament room. (The receptionist glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: (on phone) Hold on. (To Chandler) Fill
these out, sit over there. (Tosses him some forms.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (jumping to his feet) Look, I don't wanna make
any trouble, okay, but I'm in a lot of pain here, alright? My face is dented.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Well, you'll have to wait your turn.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, how long do you think it'll be?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: (sarcastic) Any minute now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, this- (she gives him a look and the guys
back off) Heyy...

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the slumber party continues.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm so sorry, you guys. I didn't mean to
bring you down.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, you were right. I don't have a plan.
(There's a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Pizza Guy
lines.text: (yelling from outside) Pizza
guy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank God. Food. (She goes to answer the
door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you have a plan?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't even have a 'pl'.

lines.speaker: Pizza Guy
lines.text: Hi, one, uh, mushroom, green
pepper and onion?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (miserably) No, no, that's not what we
ordered... We ordered a fat-free crust with extra cheese.

lines.speaker: Pizza Guy
lines.text: Wait, you're not
'G.Stephanopoulos?' Man, my dad's gonna kill me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (leaping off of the couch and runs up) Wait!
Did you say 'G.Stephanopoulos?'

lines.speaker: Pizza Guy
lines.text: Yeah. This one goes across the
street, I must have given him yours. Oh, bonehead, bonehead!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, was this a-a small mediterranean guy
with curiously intelligent good looks?

lines.speaker: Pizza Guy
lines.text: Yeah, that sounds about right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Was he wearing a stunning blue suit?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And-and a power tie?

lines.speaker: Pizza Guy
lines.text: No, pretty much just a towel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (staggered) Oh God.

lines.speaker: Pizza Guy
lines.text: So you guys want me to take
this back?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you nuts?! We've got George
Stephanopoulos' pizza! (Rachel pays him, Monica grabs some binoculars, and runs to the
window.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, Pheebs? Who's George Snuffalopagus?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Big Bird's friend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I see pizza!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I wanna see! Lemme see! Lemme see! (She
runs up and takes the binoculars.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello? Who are we spying on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: White House adviser? Clinton's campaign guy?
The one with the great hair, sexy smile, really cute butt?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, him, the little guy? Oh, I love him!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, wait.. wait, I see a woman.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please tell me it's his mother.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Definitely not his mother.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, no...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, wait, she's walking across the floor..
she's walking.. she's walking.. she's going for the pizza- (Yelling) Hey, that's not for
you, bitch! (Phoebe covers her mouth with her hand walks away from the window.)
[Scene: The Emergency Room, Joey is miming hockey pucks
kitting foreheads. Chandler realises it's getting tense and goes to the receptionist
again.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Excuse me, look, we've been here for over
an hour, and a lot of people less sick than my friend have gone in. I mean, that guy with
the toe thing? Who's he sleeping with? (She slides the gladd panel over and Chandler talks
through it in a loud voice.) Oh, c'mon Dora, don't be mad... I know we both said some
things we didn't mean, but that doesn't mean we still don't love each other. (To the
waiting room.) Y'know, I feel like I've lost her.. (She slides the panel back, he turns,
and it takes him by surprise.) Ba-!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the girls are all out on the
balcony.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Light still out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. Maybe they're- napping.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh please, they're having sex.

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Shut up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, whaddya think George is like?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think he's shy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. I think you have to draw him out. And
then- when you do- he's a preppy animal.
[Scene: The Emergency Room, Ross is still going on about
his first night with Carol.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I remember the moonlight coming through the
window- and her face had the most incredible glow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, the moon, the glow, the magical
feeling, you did this part- Could I get some painkillers over here, please?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He's right, enough, already. What is the big
deal about today? So you slept with her for the first time, so what? You slept with her
for seven years after that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, it's just a little more complicated...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (leaving) I'm outta here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait. You want him, I want her. He likes you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. I'm thinking, if we put our heads together, between the two of us,
we can break them up.
[Time lapse, Monica accidentally spilled her drink on Bob's shirt and is wiping it off.
Joey is making eyes at Angela.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm so sorry, I can't believe I did this, but I couldn't stop laughing
at your Norman Mailer story.
(Angela is eating chicken wings and making the weasel-like noise Joey had told Bob
about.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, waiter, one more plate of chicken wings over here.
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler is still trying to ease things over with Janice, and
there are about a dozen empty Espresso cups in front of him. He is extremely wired.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here's the thing, Janice. You know, I mean, it's like we're different.
I'm like the bing, bing, bing. You're like the boom, boom, (Chandler flails his hand out
and hits Janice in the eye)... boom.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, my god, I'm so sorry. Are you ok?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Ow. Um, it's just my lens. It's just my lens. I'll be right back.
(She leaves.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Phoebe) I hit her in the eye! I hit her in the eye! This is the
worst break-up in the history of the world.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my god. (Chandler downs another espresso.) How many of those have you
had?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I don't know, a million?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler, easy, easy. Go to your happy place. La la la la la la la.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right.
(Janice returns from the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not fine. Here she comes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait here. Breathe.
(Phoebe goes over to speak to Janice. She talks to her for a few seconds, and then
Janice immediately smiles, hugs her, waves to Chandler, and leaves.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How do you do that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's like a gift.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We should always always break up together.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I'd like that.

scenes.location: The Launderama. Rachel is sorting her now-pink clothes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You got the clothes clean. Now that's the important part.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I guess. Except everything looks like jammies now.
(The same woman walks over and takes Rachel's laundry cart.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa, I'm sorry. Excuse me. We had this cart.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, well, I had a 24-inch waist. You lose things. Now come on, get
outta my way.
(Rachel looks at Ross, who motions to her to get the cart back.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm sorry, you know, maybe I wasn't being clear. Uh, this is our cart.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hey, hey, hey there aren't any clothes in it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, hey, hey, hey, quit making up rules!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let go!
(They struggle for the cart. Finally, Rachel climbs inside of it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, listen, missy. If you want this cart, you're gonna have to
take me with it!
(She thinks it over, and then walks away.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Ross) Yes! Did you see that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You were incredible! Brand new woman, ladies and gentlemen.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I could not have done this without you.
(Rachel stands up and kisses Ross. He is stunned. A moment of silence follows.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, um, uh, more clothes in the dryer? (Ross turns and bangs his head on
an open dryer door.) I'm fine, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

title: The One with the Butt

lines.text: [Scene: A Theater, the gang is in the audience wating for a play of Joey's to
start.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading the program) Ooh! Look! Look! Look! Look, there's Joey's
picture! This is so exciting!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can always spot someone who's never seen one of his plays before.
Notice, no fear, no sense of impending doom...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The exclamation point in the title scares me. (Gesturing) Y'know, it's
not just Freud, it's Freud!
(The lights dim.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, shhh, shh. Magic is about to happen.
(The lights go up on the stage, Joey, as Freud, is talking to a female patient.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Vell, Eva, ve've done some excellent vork here, and I vould have to say,
your pwoblem is qviiite clear. (He goes into a song and dance number.)
All you want is a dingle,
What you envy's a schwang,
A thing through which you can tinkle,
Or play with, or simply let hang...
Opening Credits
[Scene: The Theater, the play has ended and everyone is applauding. As soon as
the cast leaves, the gang all groan and sit down heavily.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God. I feel violated.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did anybody else feel they just wanted to peel the skin off their body,
to have something else to do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (staring at a woman across the room) Ross, ten o'clock.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is it? Feels like two.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, ten o'clock.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sighs and gestures to explain) There's a beautiful woman at eight,
nine, ten o'clock!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Hel-lo!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She's amazing! She makes the women that I dream about look like short,
fat, bald men!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, go over to her! She's not with anyone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, and what would my opening line be? 'Excuse me.
Blarrglarrghh.'

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, c'mon. She's a person, you can do it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh please, could she be more out of my league? Ross,
back me up here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He could never get a woman like that in a million years.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you, buddy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, oh, but y'know, you always see these really beautiful women with
these really nothing guys, you could be one of those guys.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You could do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'think?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh God, I can't believe I'm even considering this... I'm very very
aware of my tongue...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mon! C'mon!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here goes. (He walks over to her but just stands there.)

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: ...Yes?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi.... um... okay, next word... would be... Chandler! Chandler is my
name, and, uh...(He clears his throat noisily)...hi.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Yes, you said that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, yes I did, but what I didn't say was what I was about to say,
what I wanted to say was, uh... would you like to go out with me sometime, thankyou,
goodnight. (He walks back to the others but she calls him back.)

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Chandler?
(Joey enters from behind a curtain. The others all talk at once.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey! You're in a play! I didn't know you could dance! You had a beard!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whadja think?
(Pause)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: ...Hey! You're in a play! I didn't know you could dance! You had a beard!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: C'mon, you guys, it wasn't that bad. It was better than that thing I did
with the trolls, at least you got to see my head.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (admitting) Saw your head. Saw your head.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (running back) She said yes!! She said yes!! (To Joey) Awful play,
man. Whoah. (To All) Her name's Aurora, and she's Italian, and she pronounces my name
'Chand-lrr'. 'Chand-lrr'. I think I like it better that way. (To Joey) Oh, listen, the
usher gave me this to give to you. (He fishes a card out of his pocket.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The Estelle Leonard Talent Agency. Wow, an agency left me its card! Maybe
they wanna sign me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Based on this play? ...Based on this play!

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone else is there as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, kids.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading Monica's palm) No, 'cause this line is passion, and this is...
just a line.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I can't believe I've been here almost seven seconds and you
haven't asked me how my date went.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, right, right. How was your date, 'Chand-lrr'?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It was unbelievable. I-I've never met anyone like her. She's had the
most amazing life! She was in the Israeli army...
(A flashback of Aurora and Chandler on their date in Central Perk is denoted by
italics.)

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: ...Luckily none of the bullets hit the engine block. So, we made it
to the border, but just barely, and I- ...I've been talking about myself all night long,
I'm sorry. What about you? Tell me one of your stories.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright. Once I got on the subway, right, and it was at night, and I
rode it all the way to Brooklyn... just for the hell of it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We talked 'til like two. It was this perfect evening... more or
less.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: ...All of a sudden we realised we were in Yammon.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, so 'we' is?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: 'We' would be me and Rick.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who's Rick?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who's Rick?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: My husband.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ooooohhh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, so you're divorced?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, then you're widowed?...Hopefully?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: No, I'm still married.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So tell me, how do- how do you think your husband would feel about you
sitting here with me?...Sliding your foot so far up my pant leg you can count the change
in my pocket?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Don't worry. I imagine he'd be okay with you because really, he's okay
with Ethan.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ethan? There's, there's an Ethan?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Mmmm... Ethan is my... boyfriend.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So explain something to me here, uh, what kind of a relationship do
you imagine us having if you already have a husband and a boyfriend?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: I suppose mainly sexual.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. I'm sorry it didn't work out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What 'not work out'? I'm seeing her again on Thursday. Didn't you
listen to the story?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Didn't you listen to the story? I mean, this is twisted! How could you
get involved with a woman like this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, y'know, I had some trouble with it at first too, but the way I
look at it is, I get all the good stuff: all the fun, all the talking, all the sex; and none
of the responsibility. I mean, this is every guy's fantasy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah. That is not true. Ross, is this your fantasy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, of course not! (Thinks) ...Yeah, yeah, it is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? So you guys don't mind going out with someone else who's going out
with someone else?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I couldn't do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good for you, Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: When I'm with a woman, I need to know that I'm going out with
more people than she is.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, y'know, monogamy can be a, uh, tricky concept. I mean,
anthropologically speaking-
(They all pretend to fall asleep.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine. Fine, alright, now you'll never know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're kidding. C'mon, tell us!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah! C'mon!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright. There's a theory, put forth by Richard Leakey-
(They all fall asleep again.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is there as enter except Joey enter.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Tah-daaah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are we greeting each other this way now? 'Cause I like that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look! I cleaned! I did the windows, I did the floors... I even used all
the attachments on the vacuum, except that little round one with the bristles, I don't
know what that's for.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, nobody knows. And we're not supposed to ask.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, whaddya think?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Very clean! It looks great! Terrific!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ...Oh! I-I see you moved the green ottoman.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Uh-oh...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How-how did that happen?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I dunno.. I-I thought it looked better there. And I- and also, it's an
extra seat around the coffee table.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, it's interesting.. but y'know what? Just for fun, let's see
what it looked like in the old spot. (She moves it.) Alright, just to compare. Let's see.
Well, it looks good there too. Let's just leave it there for a while.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Rachel) I can't believe you tried to move the green ottoman.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank God you didn't try to fan out the magazines. I mean, she'll
scratch your eyes right out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You guys, I am not that bad!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you are, Monica. Remember when I lived with you? You were like, a
little, y'know, (psycho) Ree! Ree! Ree! Ree!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is so unfair!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh c'mon! When we were kids, yours was the only Raggedy Ann doll that
wasn't raggedy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, so I'm responsible, I'm organised. But hey, I can be a kook.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, you madcap gal. Try to imagine this. The phone bill arrives, but
you don't pay it right away.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because you're a kook! Instead you wait until they send you a notice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I could do that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, uh, you let me go grocery shopping, and I buy laundry detergent,
but it's not the one with the easy-pour spout.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why would someone do that?! ...One might wonder.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Someone's left a glass on the coffee table. There's no coaster. It's a
cold drink, it's a hot day. Little beads of condensation are inching their way closer and
closer to the surface of the wood...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: STOP IT!! ...Oh my God. It's true! Who am I?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica? You're Mom.
(Monica gasps.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ree! Ree! Ree! Ree! Ree!
(Joey enters and he's on the phone.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Uh huh.. uh huh... oh my God! Okay! Okay, I'll be there! (He
hangs up and to all.) That was my agent. (He tosses and catches the phone.) My agent has
just gotten me a job...in the new Al Pacino movie!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh my God! Whoah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, what's the part?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Can you believe this? Al Pacino! This guy's the reason I became an actor!
"I'm out of order? Pfeeeh. You're out of order! This whole courtroom's out of
order!"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Seriously, what-what's the part?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "Just when I thought I was out, they pull me back in!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mon, seriously, Joey, what's the part?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ...I'm his (mumbles)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ..You're, you're 'mah mah mah' what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ...I'm his butt double. 'Kay? I play Al Pacino's butt. Alright? He goes
into the shower, and then- I'm his butt.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (trying not to laugh) Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: C'mon, you guys. This is a real movie, and Al Pacino's in it, and that's
big!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no, it's terrific, it's... it's... y'know, you deserve this, after
all your years of struggling, you've finally been able to crack your way into
showbusiness.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, okay, fine! Make jokes, I don't care! This is a big break for me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're right, you're right, it is...So you gonna invite us all to the big
opening?
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the next morning, Monica is getting the door.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, alright, alright...
(Joey enters with Monica's paper and hands it to her.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here. I need to borrow some moisturizer.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: For what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whaddya think? Today's the big day!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God. Okay, go into the bathroom, use whatever you want, just don't
ever tell me what you did in there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you! (He goes into the bathroom.)
(Chandler enters with the phone.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where's Joey? His mom's on the phone.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He's in the bathroom. I don't think you wanna go in there!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: C'mon, we're roommates! (He goes into the bathroom, screams, and runs
back out.) My eyes!! My eyes!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I warned you...
(Rachel enters from her room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who is being loud?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that would be Monica. Hey, listen, I wanna borrow a coupla things,
Aurora spent the night, I really wanna make her breakfast.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you got the whole night, huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, I only have twenty minutes until Ethan, so, y'know.. (He
starts to raid the fridge.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, do I sense a little bit of resentment?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no resentment, believe me, it's worth it. 'Kay? Y'know in a
relationship you have these key moments that you know you'll remember for the rest of your
life? Well, every- single- second is like that with Aurora.. and I've just wasted about
thirty-five of them talking to you people, so, uh.. Monica, can you help me with the door?
(He has armloads of stuff.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure. Oh, um, Chandler? Y'know, the-the old Monica would-would remind
you to scrub that Teflon pan with a plastic brush...But I'm not gonna do that.
(She opens the door and he leaves.)

scenes.location: A Film Set, Joey is entering for his scene.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: (on phone)...Dammit, hire the girl! (He hangs up the phone.)
Okay, everybody ready?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, listen, I just wanna thank you for this great opportunity.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Lose the robe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: That would work.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right. Okay. Losing the robe. (He takes off the robe.) And the robe is
lost.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Okay, everybody, we'd like to get this in one take, please. Let's roll
it.. water's working (The shower starts).. and... action.
(Joey starts to the shower with a grim, determined look on his face.)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: And cut. Hey, Butt Guy, what the hell are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I'm- I'm showering.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: No, that was clenching.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Well, the way I see it, the guy's upset here, y'know? I mean, his
wife's dead, his brother's missing... I think his butt would be angry here.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: I think his butt would like to get this shot before lunch. Once again,
rolling... water working... and action....and cut. What was that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was going for quiet desperation. But if you have to ask...

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Aurora and Chandler are in bed in Chandler's room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: God, I love these fingers...

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, actually I meant my fingers. Look at 'em, look at how happy they
are.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: (moves Chandler's arm and look at his watch.) Oh my God, I'm late. (She
starts to get up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no nonononononnononono, don't go.. (He kisses her and pulls her
back down.)

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don't go.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Okay. Oh no, I have to.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to himself) Too bad, she's leaving.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: (getting up and dressing) I'm sorry. He'll be waiting for me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I thought- I thought you talked to Rick.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: It's not Rick.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What, Ethan? He got to spend the whole day with you!

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: No, it's-it's Andrew.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know there'll be many moments in the years to come when I'll regret
asking the following question, but- And Andrew is?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: He's... new.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, so what you're saying is you're not completely fulfilled by Rick,
Ethan and myself?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: No, that's not exactly what I was..

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, y'know, most women would kill for three guys like us.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: So what do you want?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: You have me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nono, just you.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Whaddyou mean?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Lose the other guys.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: ...Like, ...all of them?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: C'mon, we're great together, why not?

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Why can't we just have what we have now? Why can't we just talk, and
laugh, and make love, without feeling obligated to one another... and up until tonight I
thought that's what you wanted too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...Well, y'know, part of me wants that, but it's like I'm two guys,
y'know? I mean, one guy's going 'Shut up! This is great!' But there's this other guy.
Actually it's the same guy that wells up every time that Grinch's heart grows three sizes
and breaks that measuring device... And he's saying, y'know, 'This is too hard! Get out!
Get out!'

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: So... which one of the two guys will you listen to?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know, I-I have to listen to both of them, they don't exactly
let each other finish...

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...The second guy.

lines.speaker: Aurora
lines.text: (gets up to leave) Well, call me if you change your mind.
(She kisses him, he holds her, and kisses her passionately.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry, the first guy runs the lips.
(She leaves, Chandler sighs, and falls back on his bed.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is trying to comfort Chandler. Joey is absent.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look at it this way: you dumped her.
Right? I mean, this woman was unbelievably sexy, and beautiful, intelligent,
unattainable... Tell me why you did this again?
(Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, waitwait, aren't you the guy that plays the butt in the new Al
Pacino movie?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No? What happened, big guy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) "Big guy?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It felt like a 'big guy' moment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I got fired.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, they said I acted too much with it. I told everybody about this! Now
everybody's gonna go to the theatre, expecting to see me, and...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Joey, you know what, no-one is gonna be able to tell.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: My mom will.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Something so sweet and...disturbing about that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'know, I've done nothing but crappy plays for six years. And I finally
get my shot, and I blow it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe this wasn't your shot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I mean... I think when it's your shot, y'know, you-you know it's
your shot. Did it... feel like your shot..?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hard to tell, I was naked.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I don't think this was your shot. I mean, I don't even think you
just get one shot. I really believe big things are gonna happen for you, I do! You've
gotta just keep thinking about the day that some kid is gonna run up to his friends and go
'I got the part! I got the part! I'm gonna be Joey Tribbiani's ass!'.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah? That's so nice! (They hug.)
(Ross and Chandler look at each other and hug as well.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry, Joey. I'm gonna go to bed, guys.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, Mon, you-you gonna leave your shoes out here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (determined) Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? Just casually strewn about in that reckless haphazard manner?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Doesn't matter, I'll get 'em tomorrow. Or not. Whenever. (He goes to her
room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She is a kook.

title: The One with the Blackout

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Rachel is introducing Phoebe, who is playing her guitar for the
crowd.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Everybody? Shh, shhh. Uhhh... Central Perk is proud to present the music
of Miss Phoebe Buffay.
(applause)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi. Um, I want to start with a song thats about that moment when you
suddenly realize what life is all about. OK, here we go. (plays a chord, then the lights
go out) OK, thank you very much.
[Scene: The ATM vestibule of a bank, Chandler is inside. The lights go out, and he
realizes he is trapped inside.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, great. This is just...
(Chandler sees that there is a gorgeous model inside the vestibule with him. He makes a
gesture of quiet exuberance.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is on the phone with her mother. Phoebe, Rachel,
and Ross are there.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, this is so cool, you guys. The entire city is blacked out!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mom says it's all of Manhattan, parts of Brooklyn and Queens, and they
have no idea when it's coming back on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, you guys, this is big.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (into phone) Pants and a sweater? Why, mom? Who am I gonna meet in a
blackout? Power company guys? Eligible looters? Could we talk about this later? OK. (hangs
up)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Can I borrow the phone? I want to call my apartment and check on my
grandma. (to Monica) What's my number?
(Monica and Rachel look at Phoebe strangely.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I never call me.
[Scene: ATM vestibule, Jill Goodacre is on the cellular phone. Chandler's thoughts are
in italics.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God, it's that Victoria's Secret model. Something...
something Goodacre.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (on phone) Hi Mom, it's Jill.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She's right, it's Jill. Jill Goodacre. Oh my God. I am trapped in
an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre! (pause) Is it a vestibule? Maybe it's an
atrium. Oh, yeah, that is the part to focus on, you idiot!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (on phone) Yeah, I'm fine. I'm just stuck at the bank, in an ATM
vestibule.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Jill says vestibule... I'm going with vestibule.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (on phone) I'm fine. No, I'm not alone... I don't know, some guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Some guy. Some guy. 'Hey Jill, I saw you with some guy last
night. Yes, he was some guy.
(Chandler strides proudly across the vestibule and Jill stares at him.)

scenes.location: Monica's apartment, Joey enters with a menorah, the candles lit.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi everyone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And officiating at tonight's blackout, is Rabbi Tribbiani.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, Chandler's old roomate was Jewish, and these are the only candles we
have, so... Happy Chanukah, everyone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (at window) Eww, look. Ugly Naked Guy lit a bunch of candles.
(They all look at the window, grossed out, then flinch in pain.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That had to hurt!

scenes.location: ATM vestibule.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright, alright, alright. It's been fourteen and a half minutes
and you still have not said one word. Oh God, do something. Just make contact, smile!
(Chandler smiles at her, she smiles back sweetly.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There you go!
(He continues to smile like an idiot, and she looks frightened.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're definitely scaring here.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (awkwardly) Would you like to call somebody? (offering phone)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, about 300 guys I went to high school with. Yeah, thanks.
(takes phone)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, The phone rings; it's Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, it's me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to everyone) It's Chandler! (on phone) Are you OK?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I'm fine. (trying to cover up what he is saying) I'm trppd in an
ATM vstbl wth Jll Gdcr.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm trppd... in an ATM vstbl... wth Jll Gdcr!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I have no idea what you just said.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (angry) Put Joey on the phone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's up man?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm trppd... in an ATM vstbl... wth JLL GDCR.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to everyone) Oh my God! He's trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill
Goodacre! (on phone) Chandler, listen. (says something intentionally garbled)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, like that thought never entered my mind.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, time has passed. The five are sitting around the coffee
table talking.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, somebody.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: OK, I'll go. OK, senior year of college... on a pool table.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Whoooaa!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's my sister.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: OK... my weirdest place would have to be... the women's room on the second
floor of the New York CIty public library.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! What were you doing in a library?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, what about you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh... Milwaukee.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um... Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Disneyland, 1989, 'It's a Small World After All.'

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The ride broke down. So, Carol and I went behind a couple of those
mechanical Dutch children... then they fixed the ride, and we were asked never to return
to the Magic Kingdom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh come on, I already went.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You did not go!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Come on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, alright. The weirdest place would have to be... (sigh)... oh, the
foot of the bed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Step back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We have a winner!
[Time lapse, Ross and Rachel are talking, Joey is on the couch, and Monica and Phoebe
are out of the room.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just never had a relationship with that kind of passion, you know,
where you have to have somebody right there, in the middle of a theme park.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, it was the only thing to do there that didn't have a line.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: There, well, see? Barry wouldn't even kiss me on a miniature golf
course.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, he said we were holding up the people behind us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastically) And you didn't marry him because...?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean, do you think there are people who go through life never having
that kind of...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Probably. But you know, I'll tell you something. Passion is way overrated.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It is. Eventually, it kind of... burns out. But hopefully, what you're
left with is trust, and security, and... well, in the case of my ex-wife, lesbianism. So,
you know, for all of those people who miss out on that passion... thing, there's all that
other good stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sigh) OK.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But, um... I don't think that's going to be you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don't.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-uh. See, I see.... big passion in your future.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mmmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ross, you're so great. (she playfully rubs his head and gets up)
(Ross gets up, pleased with himself.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's never gonna happen.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (innocently) What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You and Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (acts surprised) What? (pause) Why not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because you waited too long to make your move, and now you're in the friend
zone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no. I'm not in the zone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, you're mayor of the zone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm taking my time, alright? I'm laying the groundwork. Yeah. I mean,
every day I get just a little bit closer to...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Priesthood! Look Ross, I'm telling you, she has no idea what you're
thinking. If you don't ask her out soon you're going to end up stuck in the zone forever.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I will, I will. See, I'm waiting for the right moment. (Joey looks at him)
What? What, now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeeeeaaaahhh! What's messing you up? The wine? The candles? The moonlight?
You've just got to go up to her and say, 'Rachel, I think that...' (Rachel comes into the
room behind them)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shhhh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you shushing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We're shushing... because... we're trying to hear something. Listen.
(everyone is silent) Don't you hear that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahhhh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh. (she agrees, but looks very confused)

scenes.location: ATM vestibule.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Would you like some gum?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Um, is it sugarless?

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (checks) Sorry, it's not.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, then no thanks. What the hell was that? Mental note: If Jill
Goodacre offers you gum, you take it. If she offers you mangled animal carcass, you take
it.

scenes.location: Monica's apartment, Phoebe is singing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) New York City has no power, and the milk is getting sour. But
to me it is not scary, 'cause I stay away from dairy.... la la la, la la, la la... (she
writes the lyrics down)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) OK, here goes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you going to do it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm going to do it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you want any help?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You come out there, you're a dead man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good luck, man.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. (Joey hugs him) OK.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: OK. (Ross goes out on the balcony to talk to Rachel)
(Monica walks in, starts to go out on the balcony.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, where are you going?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Outside.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You can't go out there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because of... the reason.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And that would be?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I, um, can't tell you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, what's going on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: OK, you've got to promise that you'll never, ever tell Ross that I told
you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He's planning your birthday party.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! I love him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (as Phoebe enters) You'd better act surprised.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My surprise party!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What surprise party?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh stop it. Joey already told me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, he didn't tell me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, don't look at me. This is Ross's thing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is so typical. I'm always the last one to know everything.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, you are not. We tell you stuff.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yuh-huh! I was the last one to know when Chandler got bitten by the
peacock at the zoo. I was the last one to know when you had a crush on Joey when he was
moving in. (Monica gestures at Phoebe to shut up; Joey looks surprised but pleased) Looks
like I was second to last.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's Balcony, Ross and Rachel are talking.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmmm... this is so nice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK, I have a question. Well, actually, it's not so much a question as..
more of a general wondering... ment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK. Here goes. For a while now, I've been wanting to, um....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh!!!! (looking at something behind Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, yes, that's right...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, look at the little cat! (a small kitten is on the roof behind Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (the cat jumps on his shoulders) Ow!
[Cut to inside. Monica, Joey and Phoebe are singing while outside, Ross and Rachel are
trying to get the cat off of Ross' shoulder.]
Monica, Joey, and Phoebe: (singing) I'm on top of the world,
looking down on creation and the only explanation I can find, is the wonders I've found
ever since...
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is holding the cat, Monica is treating the
scratches on Ross' back. Joey is holding the menorah over the wound.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Ross) This is just Bactine. It won't hurt.
(Ross flinches in pain.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sorry, that was wax.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, poor little Tooty is scared to death. We should find his owner.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why don't we just put 'poor little Tooty' out in the hall?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: During a blackout? He'd get trampled!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (nonchalantly) Yeah?

scenes.location: ATM vestibule.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, on second thought, gum would be perfection. (Jill gives him
a stick of gum, and a strange look) 'Gum would be perfection'? 'Gum would be
perfection.' Could have said 'gum would be nice,' or 'I'll have a stick,' but no, no, no,
no. For me, gum is perfection. I loathe myself.
[Scene: The hallway of Monica's building. Phoebe and Rachel are trying to find the
cat's owner.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (stops at a door) Oh no, the Mendels, they hate all living things,
right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. (they knock at the next door, Mr. Heckles answers) Hi. We just found
this cat and we're looking for the owner.

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: Er, yeah, it's mine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (trying to hold back the struggling cat) He seems to hate you. Are you
sure?

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: Yeah, it's my cat. Give me my cat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait a minute. What's his name?

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: Ehhhh... B-Buttons.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bob Buttons?

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: Mmm. Bob Buttons. Here, Bob Buttons.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (the cat runs away from her) Oooh! You are a very bad man!

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: (as Phoebe and Rachel leave) You owe me a cat.

scenes.location: Rachel has gone off on her own to look for the cat's owner.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Here, kitty-kitty. Here kitty-kitty. Where did you go, little
kitty-kitty-kitty? Here kitty-kitty-kitty-kitty...
(While looking at the floor for the cat, Rachel runs into a pair of legs. She slowly
gets up and sees a gorgeous Italian hunk holding the cat. Who, by the way, you'll hate
very, very soon. The man. Not the cat.)

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: (something Italian)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow. (she exhales in amazement, blowing the candle out)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross, Monica, and Joey are playing Monopoly.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (rolling) Lucky sixes....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering with Paolo, arm in arm) Everybody, this is Paolo. Paolo, I
want you to meet my friends. This is Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (smitten) Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And Joey....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And Ross.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: (something in Italian)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (proudly) He doesn't speak much English.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: (pointing at game) Monopoly!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look at that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (jealous) So, um... where did Paolo come from?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... Italy, I think.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I mean tonight, in the building. Suddenly. Into our lives.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, the cat... the cat turned out to be Paolo's cat!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That, that is funny... (to Joey).... and Rachel keeps touching him.
(Phoebe enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright. I looked all over the building and I couldn't find the kitty
anywhere.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I found him. He was Paolo's cat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah! Well! There you go! Last to know again! And I'm guessing... since
nobody told me... this is Paolo.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, Paolo, this is Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: (something in Italian, he is apparently attracted to Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (smiling) You betcha!

scenes.location: ATM vestibule.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (chewing gum) Ah, let's see. What next? Blow a bubble. A bubble's
good. It's got a... boyish charm, it's impish. Here we go.
(Chandler waits until Jill is looking, then starts to blow a bubble. But instead of
blow one, he accidentally spits the gum out of his mouth and hits the wall.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nice going, imp. OK, it's OK. All I need to do is reach over and
put it in my mouth. (Chandler slyly grabs the gum from the wall and slides it back in
his mouth.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good save! We're back on track, and I'm... (grimacing) ..chewing
someone else's gum. This is not my gum. Oh my God! Oh my God! And now you're
choking.
(Chandler starts to choke.)

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Are you alright?
(Chandler tries to save face and makes the 'OK' sign with his hands, while obviously
unable to breathe.)

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: My God, you're choking! (she runs over and gives him the Heimlich, the gum
flies from his mouth) That better?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (gasping) Yes... thank you. That was... that was....

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Perfection?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel and Paolo are at the window. Ross and Joey are
watching disgustedly.]

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: (something romantic in Italian about Rachel and the stars)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (mocking Paolo) Blah blah blah, blah blah blah... blah blaaaaaah....
(Rachel walks away from Paolo, laughing.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha-What did he say that was so funny?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I have absolutely no idea.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's... that's classic.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica and Phoebe) Oh my God, you guys, what am I doing? What am I
doing? This is so un-me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: If you want, I'll do it.
(Ross looks at Joey.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, I just want to bite his bottom lip. (Rachel looks at her) But I
won't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God, the first time he smiled at me... those three seconds were more
exciting than three weeks in Bermuda with Barry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, did you ride mopeds? 'Cause I've heard... (they stare at
her)... oh, I see... it's not about that right now. OK.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know, I know it's totally superficial and we have absolutely nothing
in common, and we don't even speak the same language but Goooooooddddddd....
[Cut to the other side of the apartment, Ross has gone over to straighten things out
with Paolo.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Paolo. Hi.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Ross!
(Ross notices that Paolo is standing on a step, which makes him taller. Ross gets up on
the same step so he can look down at Paolo.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen. Um, listen. Something you should... know... um, Rachel and I...
we're kind of a thing.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Thing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thing, yes. Thing.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Ah, you... have the sex?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no. Technically the... sex is not... being had, but that's... see,
that's not the point. See, um, the point is that... Rachel and I should be, er, together.
You know, and if you get in the.... um...

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Bed?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, that's not where I was going. Er, if you get in the... way,
of us becoming a thing, then I would be, well, very sad.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Se vice?

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Si.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So you do know a little English.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Poco... a leetle.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you know the word crapweasel?

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's funny, because you know, you are a huge crapweasel!
(They hug.)
[Scene: ATM vestibule, Chandler and Jill are sitting below the counter with two pens
dangling from their chains in front of them. Jill is showing Chandler how to swing the pen
around his head.]

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Chandler, we've been here for an hour doing this! Now watch, it's easy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Ready? (she swings the pen around her head in a circle)
(Chandler tries to do the same thing but the pen hits him in the head.)

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: No, you've got to whip it.
(He swings the pen hard, and it snaps back and almost hits him again.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the gang is all sitting around the table.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, look look look. The last candle's about to burn out. 10, 9, 8, 7...
(time lapse)... negative 46, negative 47, negative 48.... (someone blows it out, the room
gets completely dark)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Kinda... spooky without any lights.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (does a maniacal laugh) Bwah-hah-hah!
(Everyone starts to imitate him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK, guys, guys? I have the definitive one. Mwwwooooo-hah-hah...
(The lights come back on, and Rachel and Paolo are making out. Ross clutches his
chest.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.. oh... oh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross. This probably isn't the best time to bring it up, but you have
to throw a party for Monica.

title: The One Where Nana Dies Twice

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler's Office, Chandler is on a coffee break.
Shelley enters.)

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: Hey gorgeous, how's it going?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dehydrated Japanese noodles under fluorescent lights... does it get
better than this?

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: Question. You're not dating anybody, are you, because I met somebody
who would be perfect for you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, y'see, perfect might be a problem. Had you said 'co-dependent', or
'self-destructive'...

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: Do you want a date Saturday?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes please.

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: Okay. He's cute, he's funny, he's-

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He's a he?

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: Well yeah! ...Oh God. I- just- I thought- Good, Shelley. I'm just gonna
go flush myself down the toilet now...(backs out of the room) Okay, goodbye...
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is there.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...Couldn't enjoy a cup of noodles after that. I mean, is that
ridiculous? Can you believe she actually thought that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um... yeah. Well, I mean, when I first met you, y'know, I thought maybe,
possibly, you might be...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You did?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but then you spent Phoebe's entire birthday party talking to my
breasts, so then I figured maybe not.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Huh. Did, uh... any of the rest of you guys think that when you first
met me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I think so, yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nono, me neither. Although, uh, y'know, back in college, Susan Sallidor
did.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're kidding! Did you tell her I wasn't?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No, it's just 'cause, uh, I kinda wanted to go out with her too, so I
told her, actually, you were seeing Bernie Spellman... who also liked her, so...
(Joey congratulates Ross, sees Chandler's look and abruptly stops.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, this is fascinating. So, uh, what is it about me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I dunno, 'cause you're smart, you're funny...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross is smart and funny, d'you ever think that about him?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah! Right!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: WHAT IS IT?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I-I d'know, you-you just- you have a quality.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yes. Absolutely. A quality.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, oh, a quality, good, because I was worried you guys were gonna be
vague about this.
(Phone rings; Monica gets it)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello? Hello? Oh! Rachel, it's Paolo calling from Rome.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Calling from Rome! (Takes phone) Bon giorno, caro mio.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) So he's calling from Rome. I could do that. Just gotta go to
Rome.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, your dad just beeped in, but can you make it quick? Talking to
Rome. (Showing off to Phoebe and Chandler) I'm talking to Rome.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey dad, what's up? (Listens) Oh God. Ross, it's Nana.
[Scene: The Hospital, Mr. and Mrs. Geller are there, along with Aunt Lillian. Ross and
Monica enter and everyone says hi and kisses.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, uh, how's she doing?

lines.speaker: Aunt Lillian
lines.text: The doctor says it's a matter of hours.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How-how are you, Mom?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Me? I'm fine, fine. I'm glad you're here. ...What's with your hair?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: What's different?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh, maybe that's it.
(Monica strides over to Ross, who is making coffee, and talks to him aside.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She is unbelievable, our mother is...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, relax, relax. We are gonna be here for a while, it looks like, and
we still have boyfriends and your career to cover.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God!
(They hug.)
[Cut to the hospital, later. Everyone is talking about Nana.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The fuzzy little mints at the bottom of her purse.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! ...Yeah, they were gross. Oh, you know what I loved? Her Sweet 'n'
Los. How she was always stealing them from- from restaurants.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Not just restaurants, from our house.
(The nurse comes out of Nana's room.)

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Mrs. Geller?
(Everyone stands up. Cut to Ross and Monica in Nana's room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She looks so small.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, at least she's with Pop-Pop and Aunt Phyllis now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: G'bye, Nana. (She kisses her on the forehead.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye, Nana.
(He goes to kiss her but she moves. Monica screams. Ross shouts and stares in
disbelief. Monica runs out of the room.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross!
(Ross runs out too.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: What is going on?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know how-how the nurse said that-that Nana had passed? Well, she's not,
quite..

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She's not- past, she's present, she's back.

lines.speaker: Aunt Lillian
lines.text: (reentering) What's going on?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: She may have died.

lines.speaker: Aunt Lillian
lines.text: She may have died?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: We're looking into it.
(Monica returns with the nurse and they go into Nana's room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I, uh, I'll go see. (He goes in)

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: This almost never happens!
(Nana passes for the second time and the nurse pulls the blanket over her. Ross and
Monica go to tell the family)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now she's passed.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Phoebe, Joey, and Rachel are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I just have to know, okay. Is it my hair?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (exasperated) Yes, Chandler, that's exactly what it is. It's your hair.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you have homosexual hair.
(Monica and Ross enter.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, um, did she...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Twice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Twice?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, that sucks!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You guys okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I dunno, it's weird. I mean, I know she's gone, but I just don't feel,
uh...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe that's 'cause she's not really gone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nono, she's gone.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We checked. A lot.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hm, I mean maybe no-one ever really goes. Ever since my mom died, every
now and then, I get the feeling that she's like right here, y'know? (She circles her hand
around her right shoulder. Chandler, sitting on her right, draws back nervously) Oh! And
Debbie, my best friend from junior high- got struck by lightning on a miniature golf
course- I always get this really strong Debbie vibe whenever I use one of those little
yellow pencils, y'know? ...I miss her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw. Hey, Pheebs, want this? (Gives her a pencil)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure. I just sharpened her this morning.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now, see, I don't believe any of that. I think once you're dead, you're
dead! You're gone! You're worm food! (realises his tactlessness) ...So Chandler looks gay,
huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know, I dunno who this is, but it's not Debbie. (Hands back the
pencil)

scenes.location: Nana's house, Ross, Mrs. Geller and Aunt Lillian are going through clothes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I thought it was gonna be a closed casket.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Well, that doesn't mean she can't look nice!
(They open a cupboard which, amongst other things, contains a chest of drawers)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Sweetie, you think you can get in there?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastic) I don't see why not.
(He tries pushing against the chest of drawers. Then he opens one of the drawers and
climbs into the closet using that; he falls behind the chest of drawers with a shout.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here's my retainer!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is talking to her father.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I was just thinking. When my time comes-

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Dad!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Listen to me! When my time comes, I wanna be buried at sea.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You what?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I wanna be buried at sea, it looks like fun.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Define fun.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: C'mon, you'll make a day of it! You'll rent a boat, pack a lunch...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ...And then we throw your body in the water... Gee, that does sound fun.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Everyone thinks they know me. Everyone says 'Jack Geller, so
predictable'. Maybe after I'm gone, they'll say 'Buried at sea! Huh!'.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's probably what they'll say.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I'd like that.

scenes.location: Chandler's Office, Shelley is drinking coffee; Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, gorgeous.

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: (sheepish) Hey. Look, I'm sorry about yesterday, I, um-

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, nono, don't- don't worry about it. Believe me, apparently other
people have made the same mistake.

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: Oh! Okay! Phew!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, uh... what do you think it is about me?

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: I dunno, uh... you just have a-a...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...Quality, right, great.

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: Y'know, it's a shame, because you and Lowell would've made a great
couple.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Lowell? Financial Services' Lowell, that's who you saw me with?

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: What? He's cute!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, yeah... 's'no Brian in Payroll.
