lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: Is Brian...?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! Uh, I d'know! The point is, if you were gonna set me up with
someone, I'd like to think you'd set me up with someone like him.

lines.speaker: Shelley
lines.text: Well, I think Brian's a little out of your league.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Excuse me? You don't think I could get a Brian? Because I could get
a Brian. Believe you me. ...I'm really not.

scenes.location: Nana's Bedroom, Ross is holding a dress out from inside the closet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (holding a dress out from inside the closet) This one?

lines.speaker: Aunt Lillian
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have shown you everything we have. Unless you want your mother to spend
eternity in a lemon yellow pant-suit, go with the burgundy.

lines.speaker: Aunt Lillian
lines.text: You know, whatever we pick, she would've told us it's the wrong
one.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: You're right. We'll go with the burgundy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! A fine choice. I'm coming out. (Starts to climb over the furniture)

lines.speaker: Aunt Lillian
lines.text: Wait! We need shoes!
(Ross falls back inside)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Um, how about these? (Holds out a pair)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: That's really a day shoe.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And where she's going everyone else'll be dressier?

lines.speaker: Aunt Lillian
lines.text: Could we see something in a slimmer heel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (forages around) Okay, I have nothing in an evening shoe in the burgundy.
I can show you something in a silver that may work.

lines.speaker: Aunt Lillian
lines.text: No, it really should be burgundy.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Mm. Unless we go with a different dress?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Nonono, wait a sec. I may have something in the back.
(He finds a shoebox (out of shot), pulls it down and opens it. It is full of Sweet
'n' Lo's.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God..

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Is everything all right, dear?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, just... just Nana stuff.
(He reaches up higher and knocks down another shoebox lid. Sweet 'n' Lo's rain
down on him)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are preparing to leave for the funeral.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) How we doing, you guys ready?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mom already called this morning to remind me not to wear my hair up. Did
you know my ears are not my best feature?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Some days it's all I can think about.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hi, sorry I'm late, I couldn't find my bearings.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you-you mean your earrings?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What'd I say?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sticking her foot out) Hm-m.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are these the shoes?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes. Paolo sent them from Italy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, we-uh- we don't have shoes here, or...?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering with Chandler) Morning. We ready to go?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, don't we look nice all dressed up?...It's stuff like that, isn't
it?
(They all leave.)

scenes.location: The cemetary, after the funeral.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was a really beautiful service.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: It really was. Oh, c'mere, sweetheart. (Hugs her) Y'know, I think
it might be time for you to start using night cream.
(Joey listens to his overcoat for a second and sighs, then notices Chandler watching)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing, just your overcoat sounds remarkably like Brent Mussberger.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Check it out, Giants-Cowboys. (He has a pocket TV)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're watching a football game at a funeral?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, it's the pre-game. I'm gonna watch it at the reception.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You are a frightening, frightening man.
(Rachel steps in a patch of mud)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no! My new Paolo shoes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I hope they're not ruined.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God, what a great day. ...What? Weather-wise!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, uh, the air, the-the trees... even though Nana's gone there's,
there's something almost, uh- I dunno, almost life-aff- (Not looking where he is going he
falls into an open grave)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: God! Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm fine. Just-just... having my worst fear realised...
[Scene: The Wake, at the Gellers' house. Ross is lying on his back, with Phoebe
squatting over him, checking to see if he's injured.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, don't worry, I'm just checking to see if the muscle's in
spasm...huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, what is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You missed a belt loop.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! No-n-

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, it's in spasm.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Here, sweetie, here. I took these when I had my golfing accident.
(Hands Ross a bottle of pills. Then turns to Monica and pats her hair over her ears)
(Cut to Chandler and a woman, Andrea, reaching for the same slice of meat)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, no-

lines.speaker: Andrea
lines.text: Sorry- Hi, I'm Dorothy's daughter.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, I'm Chandler, and I have no idea who Dorothy is.
(They shake hands. Cut to Ross emerging from a hallway, grinning inanely. He is
obviously very stoned)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, look who's up! How do you feel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I feel great. I feel- great, I fleel great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, those pills really worked, huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not the first two, but the second two- woooo! ...I love you guys. You guys
are the greatest. I love my sister (Kisses Monica), I love Pheebs... (Hugs her)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! That's so nice...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (hugs him) And listen, man, if you wanna be gay, be gay. Doesn't matter to
me.

lines.speaker: Andrea
lines.text: (turns to a friend) You were right. (They walk off and leave Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel. Rachel Rachel. (Sits down beside her) I love you the most.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (humouring him) Oh, well you know who I love the most?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.. you don't get it! (Passes out and slumps across her)
(Cut to Joey watching TV in the corner. He makes an extravagant gesture of
disappointment.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Whaddya got there?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (hides the TV, but he still has an earphone) Just a, uh... hearing
disability.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: What's the score?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Seventeen-fourteen Giants... three minutes to go in the third.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Beautiful! (Turns to watch with him)
(Time lapse. A large crowd of men are now watching the game)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (still trapped under Ross) Pheebs, could you maybe hand me a cracker?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (to Monica) Your grandmother would have hated this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, sure, what with it being her funeral and all.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: No, I'd be hearing about 'Why didn't I get the honey-glazed ham?',
I didn't spend enough on flowers, and if I spent more she'd be saying 'Why are you wasting
your money? I don't need flowers, I'm dead'.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That sounds like Nana.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Do you know what it's like to grow up with someone who is critical
of every single thing you say?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ...I can imagine.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: I'm telling you, it's a wonder your mother turned out to be the
positive, life-affirming person that she is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is a wonder. So tell me something, Mom. If you had to do it all
over again, I mean, if she was here right now, would you tell her?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Tell her what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How she drove you crazy, picking on every little detail, like your
hair... for example.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: I'm not sure I know what you're getting at.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you think things would have been better if you'd just told her the
truth?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: ...No. I think some things are better left unsaid. I think it's
nicer when people just get along.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: More wine, dear?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I think so.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (reaches out to fiddle with Monica's hair again, and realises)
Those earrings look really lovely on you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you. They're yours.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Actually they were Nana's.
(There is a cry of disappointment from the crowd of men.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Now I'm depressed! ...(To everyone) Even more than I was.

scenes.location: Central Perk, the gang are looking at old photos.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, who's this little naked guy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That little naked guy would be me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aww, look at the little thing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, yes, fine, that is my penis. Can we be grown-ups now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who are those people?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Got me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, that's Nana, right there in the middle. (Reads the back) 'Me and the
gang at Java Joe's'.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, Monica, you look just like your grandmother. How old was she there?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let's see, 1939... yeah, 24, 25?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Looks like a fun gang. (They all look at each other and smile)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, look-look-look-look-look! I got Monica naked!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking) Nono, that would be me again. I'm, uh, just trying something.

title: The One Where Underdog Gets Away

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is confronting her boss, Terry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Terry, I, I, I know that I haven't worked here very long, but I was
wondering, do you think it would be possible if I got a $100 advance in my salary?

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: An advance?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's so that I can spend Thanksgiving with my family. See, every year we
go skiing in Vail, and normally my father pays for my ticket, but I sort of started the
whole independence thing, you know, which is actually why I took this job.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Rachel, Rachel, sweetheart. You're a terrible, terrible waitress. Really,
really awful.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, I, I hear what you're sayin'. I'm with you. Um, but I, but I'm
trying really hard. And I think I'm doing better. I really do. Does anybody need coffee?
(everyone in the place raises their hand) Oh, look at that.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is approaching a customer.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me, sir. Hi, you come in here all time. I was just wondering, do
you think there's a possibility that you could give me an advance on my tips?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, ok, that's fine. Fine. Hey, I'm sorry about that spill before.
(picks up the tip he leaves) Only $98.50 to go.
(Monica enters.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. Ross, did you know Mom and Dad are going to Puerto Rico for
Thanksgiving?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, they're not.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, they are. The Blymens invited them.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're wrong.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am not wrong.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're wrong.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I just talked to them.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (getting up, upset) I'm calling Mom.
(Joey enters. His face looks abnormally colorful.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And this from the cry-for-help department. Are you wearing makeup?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes, I am. As of today, I am officially Joey Tribbiani, actor slash model.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's so funny, 'cause I was thinking you look more like Joey
Tribbiani, man slash woman.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What were you modeling for?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know those posters for the city free clinic?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, wow, so you're gonna be one of those "healthy, healthy, healthy
guys"?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, the asthma guy was really cute.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you know which one you're gonna be?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, but I hear lyme disease is open, so... (crosses fingers)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good luck, man. I hope you get it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks.
(Ross comes back to the couch.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Monica) Well, you were right. How can they do this to us, huh? It's
Thanksgiving.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, I'll tell you what. How about I cook dinner at my place? I'll make
it just like Mom's.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Will you make the mashed potatoes with the lumps?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know, they're not actually supposed to have... (Ross looks at her
sheepishly) I'll work on the lumps. Joey, you're going home, right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And I assume, Chandler, you are still boycotting all the pilgrim
holidays.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, every single one of them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, you're gonna be with your grandma?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, and her boyfriend. But we're celebrating Thanksgiving in December
'cause he is lunar.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you're free Thursday, then.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Oh, can I come?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. Rach, are you thinking you're gonna make it to Vail?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Absolutely. Shoop, shoop, shoop. Only a hundred and two dollars to go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I thought it was $98.50.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, well it was. I, I broke a cup.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I'm off to Carol's.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, ooh! Why don't we invite her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (mimicking) Ooh, ooh. Because she's my ex-wife, and will probably want to
bring her, ooh, ooh, lesbian life partner.

scenes.location: Carol and Susan's apartment, Susan is there. Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi, is uh, is Carol here?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: No, she's at a faculty meeting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I uh, just came by to pick up my skull. Well, not mine, but...Susan:
Come in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. Yeah, Carol borrowed it for a class, and I have to get it back to
the museum.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: What's it look like?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Kinda like a big face without skin.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Yes, I'm familiar with the concept. We can just look for it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok. (browsing the apartment) Wow, you guys sure have a lot of books about
bein' a lesbian.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Well, you know, you have to take a course. Otherwise, they don't let you
do it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (picking up a book) Hey, hey, Yertle the Turtle. A classic.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Actually, I'm reading it to the baby.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The uh, the baby that hasn't been born yet? Wouldn't that mean you're...
crazy?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: What, you don't think they can hear sounds in there?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're not serious, I mean, you really... you really talk to it?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Yeah, all the time. I want the baby to know my voice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you uh, do you talk about me?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, all the time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: But um, we just refer to you as Bobo the Sperm Guy.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is there but Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, if she's talking to it, I just think that I should get some belly
time too. Not that I believe any of this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I believe it. I think the baby can totally hear everything. I can
show you. Look, this will seem a little weird, but you put your head inside this turkey,
and then we'll all talk, and you'll hear everything we say.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'd just like to say that I'm totally behind this experiment. In fact,
I'd very much like to butter your head.
(Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Rach, did you make your money?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, not even close. Forget Vail, forget seeing my family, forget shoop,
shoop, shoop.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, here's your mail.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks, you can just put it on the table.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (insistently) No, here's your mail.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks, you can just put it on the table.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (gives her an envelope) Would you just open it?
(Rachel opens it. Inside is the money she needed.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my god, oh, you guys are great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We all chipped in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Monica) We did?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Joey) You owe me 20 bucks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (hands Chandler a bag) Chandler, here you go, got your traditional
Thanksgiving feast, you got your tomato soup, your grilled cheese fixin's, and your family
size bag of Funyuns.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, wait, Chandler, this is what you're havin' for Thanksgiving
dinner? What, what, what is it with you and this holiday?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, I'm nine years old.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I hate this story.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We just finished this magnificent Thanksgiving dinner. I have--and I
remember this part vividly--a mouthful of pumpkin pie, and this is the moment my parents
choose to tell me they're getting divorced.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my god.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes. It's very difficult to appreciate a Thanksgiving dinner once
you've seen it in reverse.

scenes.location: The subway, Joey spots a gorgeous woman waiting. He goes up to her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, hi. We uh, we used to work together.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: We did?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, at Macy's. You were the Obsession girl, right? I was the Aramis guy.
(pretends to spray cologne) Aramis? Aramis?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Yeah, right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I gotta tell you. You're the best in the business.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Get out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm serious. You're amazing. You know when to spritz, when to lay back.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Really? You don't know what that means to me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, you smell great tonight. What're you wearing?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: (provocatively) Nothing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, uh, you wanna go get a drink or something?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Yeah. (she gets up, notices something behind Joey) Oh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: I just remembered, I have to do something.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. What?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Um, leave.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait!
(Joey turns around and sees his face on a poster in the subway. The poster says: What
Mario isn't telling you...V.D., you never know who might have it. A variety of scenes are
shown with the poster displayed all over New York City.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey enters, amongst snickers from the gang.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So I guess you all saw it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Saw what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, we were just laughing. You know, how laughter can be infectious.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Joey enters, upset.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Set another place for Thanksgiving. My entire family thinks I have VD.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tonight, on a very special Blossom.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is cooking Thanksgiving dinner. Chandler is
standing in the doorway, not wanting to participate in the festivities.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mmm, looking good. Ok, cider's mulling, turkey's turking, yams are
yamming. (notices Ross is depressed) What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know. It's just not the same without Mom in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, that's it. You know what? Just get out of my way and stop
moping.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's closer.
(Rachel enters, excited.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I got the tickets! I got the tickets! Five hours from now, shoop, shoop,
shoop.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, you must stop shooping.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, I'm gonna get my stuff.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, will you just come in already?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I prefer to keep a safe distance from all this merriment.
(Phoebe takes a slice of pumpkin pie and waves it in front of Chandler's face.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look out, incoming pumpkin pie!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, we all laughed when you did it with the stuffing, but that's not
funny anymore.
(Chandler leaves.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Monica, I got a question. I don't see any tater tots.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's not a question.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But my mom always makes them. It's like a tradition. You get a little
piece of turkey on your fork, a little cranberry sauce, and a tot! It's bad enough I can't
be with my family because of my disease.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, fine. Tonight's potatoes will be both mashed with lumps, and
in the form of tots.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, I'm off to talk to my unborn child.
(Ross grabs for some food, Monica slaps his hand away.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, Mom never hit.
(Ross exits.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (stirring pot) Ok, all done.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What, Phoebe, did you whip the potatoes? Ross needs lumps!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, oh, I just, I thought we could have them whipped and then
add some peas and onions.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why would we do that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, 'cause then they'd be like my mom used to make them, you know,
before she died.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, three kinds of potatoes coming up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, good-bye you guys. Thanks for everything. (she starts to leave, and
hits everyone with her skis) Oh, sorry! Oh, sorry!
(Chandler enters, running.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The most unbelievable thing has happened. Underdog has just gotten
away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The balloon?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, the actual cartoon character. Of course the balloon. It's all
over the news. Right before he reached Macy's, he broke free and was spotted
flying over Washington Square Park. I'm goin' to the roof, who's with me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't, I gotta go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on. An 80-foot inflatable dog let loose over the city. How often
does that happen?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Almost never.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Got the keys? or Got the keys!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok.
(Everyone leaves the apartment.)

scenes.location: Carol and Susan's, Ross is preparing to talk to her belly.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Anytime you're ready.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, ok, here we go. (he crouches down near her stomach) Ok, where am I
talking to, here? I mean, uh, well, there is one way that seems to offer a certain
acoustical advantage, but...

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Just aim for the bump.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, ok, ok, ok, here goes. You know, I, you know, can't do this. Uh, this
is too weird. I feel stupid.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: So don't do it, it's fine. You don't have to do it just because Susan
does it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (quickly talking) Hello, baby. Hello, hello.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the group is coming back from the roof.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I loved the moment when you first saw the giant dog shadow all over the
park.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but did they have to shoot him down? I mean, that was just mean.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, right about now the turkey should be crispy on the outside, juicy on
the inside. Why are we standing here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We're waiting for you to open the door. You got the keys.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No I don't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, you do. When we left, you said, "got the keys."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No I didn't. I asked, "got the ke-eys?"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, no, you said, "got the keys".

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do either of you have the keys?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (panicked) The oven is on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I gotta get my ticket!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait, wait, we have a copy of your key.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well then get it, get it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That tone will not make me go any faster.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (angry) Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That one will.
(Joey leaves to get the copy of the key.)

scenes.location: Carol and Susan's, Carol is reading, Ross is talking to her stomach.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And everyone's telling me, you gotta pick a major, you gotta pick a major.
So, on a dare, I picked paleontology. And you have no idea what I'm saying, because, let's
face it, you're a fetus. You're just happy you don't have gills anymore.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Look, you don't have to talk to it. You can sing to it if you want.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, please. I am not singing to your stomach, ok?
(Susan enters.)

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Hi, how's it goin?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shh! (singing) Here we come, walkin' down the street, get the funniest
looks from, everyone we meet. Hey, hey! (to Carol) Hey, uh, did you just feel that?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Does it always, uh--?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: No, no that was the first.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Keep singing! Keep singing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (singing) Hey, hey, you're my baby, and I can't wait to meet you. When
you come out I'll buy you a bagel, and then we'll go to the zoo.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: I felt it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (singin) Hey, hey, I'm your daddy. I'm the one without any breasts.

scenes.location: The Hallway, Joey has a tray full of keys, and is trying each one in the lock.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope, not that one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can you go any faster with that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I got one keyhole and about a zillion keys. You do the math.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why do you guys have so many keys in there anyway?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastic) For an emergency just like this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (grabs Chandler by the shirt) All right, listen, smirky. If it wasn't
for you and your stupid balloon, I would be on a plane watching a woman do this (makes a
gesture like a stewardess pointing out exits) right now. But I'm not.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I swear you said you had the keys.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I didn't. I wouldn't say I had the keys unless I had the keys, and I
obviously didn't have the keys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, ok, that's it. Enough with the keys. No one say keys.
(Short pause.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why would I have the keys?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aside from the fact that you said you had them?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But I didn't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you should have.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why? Because everything is my responsibility? Isn't it enough that I'm
making Thanksgiving dinner for everyone? You know, everyone wants a different kind of
potatoes, so I'm making different kinds of potatoes. Does anybody care what kind of
potatoes I want? Nooooo, no, no! (starting to cry) Just as long as Phoebe gets her peas
and onions, and Mario gets his tots, and it's my first Thanksgiving, and it's all burned,
and, and I... I...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, Monica, only dogs can hear you now, so, look, the door's open.
Here we go.
(They walk in. Smoke fills the apartment.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, the turkey's burnt. (checking pots) Potatoes are ruined, potatoes
are ruined, potatoes are ruined.
(Ross enters, singing.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here we come, walkin' down the—this doesn't smell like Mom's.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it doesn't, does it? But you wanted lumps, Ross? (picks up the pan
of badly burnt potatoes) Well, here you go, buddy, ya got one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, god, this is great! The plane is gone, so it looks like I'm stuck
here with you guys.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, we all had better plans. This was nobody's first choice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, really? So why was I busting my ass to make this delicious
Thanksgiving dinner?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You call that delicious?
(all shouting)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Stop it, stop it, stop it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now this feels like Thanksgiving.
[Time lapse. Everyone is upset with each other. Phoebe is at the window.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugly Naked Guy's taking his turkey out of the oven. Oh my god. He's not
alone. Ugly Naked Guy's having Thanksgiving dinner with Ugly Naked Gal.
(They all run to the window.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I've gotta see this. All right Ugly Naked Guy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooh, Ugly Naked Dancing!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's nice that he has someone.
[Time lapse. The gang is around the table, eating grilled cheese sandwiches.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Shall I carve?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: By all means.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, who wants light cheese, and who wants dark cheese?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't even wanna know about the dark cheese.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (holding sandwich) Does anybody wanna split this with me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I will.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, you guys have to make a wish.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Make a wish?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, you know, Thanksgiving. Ooh, you got the bigger half. What'd
you wish for?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The bigger half.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'd like to propose a toast. Little toast here, ding ding. I know this
isn't the kind of Thanksgiving that all of you all planned, but for me, this has been
really great, you know, I think because it didn't involve divorce or projectile vomiting.
Anyway, I was just thinking, I mean, if you'd gone to Vail, and if you guys'd been with
your family, if you didn't have syphilis and stuff, we wouldn't be all together, you know?
So I guess what I'm trying to say is that I'm very thankful that all of your Thanksgivings
sucked.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: That's so sweet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And hey, here's to a lousy Christmas.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And a crappy New Year.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here, here!

title: The One with the Monkey

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Guys? There's a somebody I'd like you to meet.
(A monkey jumps on to his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oooh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: W-wait. What is that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 'That' would be Marcel. You wanna say hi?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, no, I don't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, he is precious! Where did you get him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My friend Bethel rescued him from some lab.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is so cruel! Why? Why would a parent name their child Bethel?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, that monkey's got a Ross on its ass!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, is he gonna live with you, like, in your apartment?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. I mean, it's been kinda quiet since Carol left, so...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don't you just get a roommate?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nah, I dunno... I think you reach a certain age, having a roommate is
kinda pathe- (Realises) ....sorry, that's, that's 'pathet', which is Sanskrit for 'really
cool way to live'.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is getting ready to sing. Joey is not there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you guys, I'm doing all new material tonight. I have twelve new songs
about my mother's suicide, and one about a snowman.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Might wanna open with the snowman.
(Enter Joey)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey, Joey. Hey, buddy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, how'd it go?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahhhhhh, I didn't get the job.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How could you not get it? You were Santa last year.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I dunno. Some fat guy's sleeping with the store manager. He's not even
jolly, it's all political.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So what are you gonna be?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, I'm gonna be one of his helpers. It's just such a slap in the face,
y'know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, do you guys know what you're doing for New Year's? (They all
protest and hit her with cushions) Gee, what?! What is wrong with New Year's?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing for you, you have Paolo. You don't have to face the horrible
pressures of this holiday: desperate scramble to find anything with lips just so you can
have someone to kiss when the ball drops!! Man, I'm talking loud!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, for your information, Paolo is gonna be in Rome this New Year, so
I'll be just as pathetic as the rest of you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you wish!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's just that I'm sick of being a victim of this Dick Clark holiday.
I say this year, no dates, we make a pact. Just the six of us- dinner.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah, okay. Alright.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I was hoping for a little more enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Woooo! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, you're on.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, oh, good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Into microphone) Okay, hi. Ladies and gentlemen, back by popular
demand, Miss Phoebe Buffay. Wooh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Takes mike) Thanks, hi. Um, I wanna start with a song that means a lot
to me this time of year. (Shakes bell as an introduction) (Sung:)
I made a man with eyes of coal
And a smile so bewitchin',
How was I supposed to know
That my mom was dead in the kitchen?
(shakes bell) La lalala la la la la lalala la la...
(Cut to later. Everyone is totally depressed by now.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Sung)
...My mother's ashes
Even her eyelashes
Are resting in a little yellow jar,
And sometimes when it's breezy...
(Over the sound of Phoebe singing we hear two scientists, Max and David, having a noisy
discussion)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Sung)
...I feel a little sneezy
And now I- (abruptly stops)
Excuse me, excuse me! Yeah, noisy boys! (They stop talking and look up) Is
it something that you would like to share with the entire group?

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: No. No, that's- that's okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, c'mon, if it's important enough to discuss while I'm playing, then
I assume it's important enough for everyone else to hear!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Quietly, to the others) That guy's going home with a note!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Noth- I was- I was just saying to my-

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Could you speak up please?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: (Stands up and speaks more loudly) Sorry, I wa- I was just saying to my
friend that I thought you were the most beautiful woman that I'd ever seen in my- in my
life. And then he said that- you said you thought

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: Daryl Hannah.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Daryl Hannah was the most beautiful woman that he'd ever seen in his life
and I said yeah, I liked her in Splash, a lot, but not so much in- in Wall Street, I
thought she had kind of a

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: Hard quality.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: -hard quality. And uh, while Daryl Hannah is beautiful in a conventional
way, you are luminous with a kind of a delicate grace. Then, uh, that-that-that's when you
started yelling. (Sits down)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, we're gonna take a short break. (Goes over to their table)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, that guy's going home with more than a note!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, everyone except Joey is decorating for Christmas.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come here, Marcel. Sit here. (Marcel wanders off)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, I can't believe he hasn't kissed you yet. I mean God, by my
sixth date with Paolo, I mean he had already named both my breasts! ...Ooh. Did I just
share too much?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just a smidge.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: David's like, y'know, Scientist Guy. He's very methodical.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think it's romantic.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too! Oh! Did you ever see An Officer and a Gentleman?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, he's kinda like the guy I went to see that with. Except, except
he-he's smarter, and gentler, and sweeter... I just- I just wanna be with him all the
time. Day and night, and night and day... and special occasions...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait a minute, wait a minute, I see where this is going, you're gonna
ask him to New Year's, aren't you. You're gonna break the pact. She's gonna break the
pact.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no, no. Yeah, could I just?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, 'cause I already asked Janice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mon, this was a pact! This was your pact!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I snapped, okay? I couldn't handle the pressure and I snapped.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but Janice? That-that was like the worst breakup in history!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not saying it was a good idea, I'm saying I snapped!
[Joey enters, his shoes have bells on, which jingle as he walks. He is wearing a long
coat.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi. Hi, sorry I'm late.
(He removes the coat to reveal an elf costume)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Too many jokes... must mock Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice shoes, huh? (He wiggles his foot and the bells tinkle)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aah, y'killing me!
(Marcel knocks over some kitchen tools)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross! He's playing with my spatulas again!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, look, he's not gonna hurt them, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you always have to bring him here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I didn't wanna leave him alone. Alright? We- we had our first fight this
morning. I think it has to do with my working late. I said some things that I didn't mean,
and he- he threw some faeces...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, if you're gonna work late, I could look in on him for you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, that'd be great! Okay, but if you do, make sure it seems like you're
there to see him, okay, and you're not like doing it as a favour to me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but if he asks, I'm not going to lie.
[Scene: Max and David's lab, David is explaining something to Phoebe with the aid of a
whiteboard.]

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: ...But, you can't actually test this theory, because today's particle
accelerators are nowhere near powerful enough to simulate these conditions.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, alright, I have a question, then.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Yuh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, were you planning on kissing me ever?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Uh, that's definitely a, uh, valid question. And, uh, the answer would be
(Writes YES on the board) yes. Yes I was. But, see, I wanted it to be this phenomenal kiss
that happened at this phenomenal moment, because, well, 'cause it's you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Right. But, see, the longer I waited, the more phenomenal the kiss had to
be, and now we've reached a place where it's just gotta be one of those things where I
just like... sweep everything off the table and throw you down on it. And, uh, I'm not
really a, uh, sweeping sorta fella.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, David, I, I think you are a sweeping sorta fella. I mean, you're a
sweeper! ...trapped inside a physicist's body.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Rrrreally.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, oh, I'm sure of it. You should just do it, just sweep and
throw me.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: ...Now? Now?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, right now.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay. (Gets ready to sweep, and then picks up a laptop
computer) Y'know what, this was just really expensive. (Puts it down elsewhere. Then picks
up a microscope) And I'll take- this was a gift. (Moves it)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, now you're just kinda tidying.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Okay, what the hell, what the hell. (Sweeps the remaining papers off the
desk and grabs Phoebe) You want me to actually throw you or you-you wanna just hop?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can hop. (She hops onto the table)
(They kiss, finally)

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So tell me something. What does the phrase 'no date pact' mean to you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry, okay. It's just that Chandler has somebody, and Phoebe has
somebody- I thought I'd ask Fun Bobby.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fun Bobby? Your ex-boyfriend Fun Bobby?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know more than one Fun Bobby?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I happen to know a Fun Bob.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Brings Joey a mug of coffee) Okay, here we go...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh ooh ooh ooh, there's no room for milk!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Glances at Joey and then sips his coffee) There. Now there is.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, so on our no-date evening, three of you now have dates.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, four.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Four.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Five.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Five. (Buries his head in his hands)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sorry. Paolo's catching an earlier flight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, and I met this really hot single mom at the store. What's an elf to
do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, so I'm gonna be the only one standing there alone when the ball
drops?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, c'mon. We'll have, we'll have a big party, and no-one'll know who's
with who.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, y'know, this is so not what I needed right now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, it's-it's Marcel. He keeps shutting me out, y'know? He's walking
around all the time dragging his hands...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's so weird, I had such a blast with him the other night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we played, we watched TV.. that juggling thing is amazing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, uh... what juggling thing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: With the balled-up socks? I figured you taught him that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, it wasn't that big a deal. He just balled up socks... and a
melon...
(Max runs in)

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: Phoebe. Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hi Max! Hey, do you know everybody?

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: No. Have you seen David?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, he hasn't been around.

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: Well, if you see him, tell him to pack his bags. We are going to Minsk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Minsk?

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: Minsk. It's in Russia.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know where Minsk is.

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: We got the grant. Three years, all expenses paid.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So when, when do you leave?

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: January first.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Max and David's lab, they are working. Phoebe knocks on the door

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Hi! (Kisses her) What-what're you doing here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, well, Max told me about Minsk, so (Puts on a fake cheery voice)
congratulations! This is so exciting!

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: It'd be even more exciting if we were going.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you're not going? (Fake disappointed voice) Oh, why?

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: Tell her, David. 'I don't wanna go to Minsk and work with Lifson and
Yamaguchi and Flench, on nonononononono. I wanna stay here and make out with my
girlfriend!!' (Storms out)

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Thank you, Max. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So-so you're really not going?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I don't know. I don't know what I'm gonna do. I just- you decide.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh don't do that.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no no.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: No, but I'm asking-

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, but I can't do that-

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: No, but I can't-

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's your thing, and-

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: -make the decision-

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, um, stay.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Stay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Stay.
(He thinks for a moment and sweeps the stuff off the table)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Getting so good at that! (She hops on)

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: It was Max's stuff. (They kiss)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the party has started.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I love this artichoke thing! Oh, don't tell me what's in it, the diet
starts tomorrow! (Laughs her Janice laugh)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You remember Janice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Vividly.
(Someone knocks on the door; Monica gets it)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Hi, I'm Sandy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sandy! Hi! C'mon in! (She enters, followed by a young boy and a younger
girl)...You brought your kids.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Yeah. That's okay, right?
(Joey and Monica look at each other and shrug. Ross enters with Marcel on his shoulder)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Par-tay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That thing is not coming in here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 'That thing'? This is how you greet guests at a party? Let me ask you
something, if I showed up here with my new girlfriend, she wouldn't be welcome in your
home?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm guessing your new girlfriend wouldn't urinate on my coffee table.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. He was more embarrassed about that than anyone. Okay? And for him to
have the courage to walk back in here like nothing happened...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright. Just keep him away from me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you. (She walks off) C'mon, Marcel, whaddya say you and I do a
little mingling? (Marcel runs off) Alright, I'll, uh... catch up with you later.
(The door opens. Rachel is standing there. Her coat is muddy and torn, her hair is
dishevelled and her face is bruised. Everyone turns to look)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my gosh! Rachel, honey.. are you okay? Where-where's Paolo?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Rome. Jerk missed his flight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And then... your face is bloated?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. Okay. I was at the airport, getting into a cab, when this woman-
this blonde planet with a pocketbook- starts yelling at me. Something about how it was her
cab first. And then the next thing I know she just starts- starts pulling me out by my
hair! So I'm blowing my attack whistle thingy and three more cabs show up, and as I'm
going to get into a cab she tackles me. And I hit my head on the kerb and cut my lip on my
whistle...oh...everybody having fun at the party? (To Monica) Are people eating my dip?
[Time lapse. Monica and Rachel, fixed up somewhat, emerge from a bedroom]

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Y'know, when I saw you at the store last week, it was probably the first
time I ever mentally undressed an elf.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow, that's, uh, dirty.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Yeah.
(They almost kiss and then Joey realises her kids are staring at them)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, kids...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Watching Marcel play with Phoebe. To Chandler) Look at him. I'm not
saying he has to spend the whole evening with me, but at least check in.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (Startles them) There you are! Haaah, you got away from me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Imitating) But you found me!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Here, Ross, take our picture. (Hands him a camera and he starts
snapping) Smile! You're on Janice Camera!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kill me. Kill me now.
(Someone else knocks on the door. Monica looks through the spyhole)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey everybody! It's Fun Bobby!
(Everyone cheers. Monica opens the door. Bobby is obviously very depressed)

lines.speaker: Fun Bobby
lines.text: Hey, sorry I'm late. But my, uh, grandfather, he- died about two
hours ago. But I-I-I couldn't get a flight out 'til tomorrow, so here I am!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Approaching) Hey Fun Bobby! Whoah! Who died?
(Monica gestures wildly behind Fun Bobby's back)
[Time lapse. Bobby is talking about his grandfather. Everyone else is virtually in
tears]

lines.speaker: Fun Bobby
lines.text: It's gonna be an open casket, y'know, so at least I'll- I get to see
him again.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (Ross is still taking their photo) Oh, I'm gonna blow this one up, and
I'm gonna write 'Reunited' in glitter.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright, Janice, that's it! Janice... Janice... Hey, Janice, when I
invited you to this party I didn't necessarily think that it meant that we-

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, no. Oh, no.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry you misunderstood...

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh my God. You listen to me, Chandler, you listen to me. One of these
times is just gonna be your last chance with me. (She runs off)
(Ross is still taking photos)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, will you give me the thing. (Snatches the camera)
(David is feeding Phoebe popcorn. Max walks up)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi, Max!

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: Yoko. (To David) I've decided to go to Minsk without you.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Max
lines.text: It won't be the same- but it'll still be Minsk. Happy New Year.(Walks off)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you alright?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Yeah, I'm fine, I'm fine.
(Phoebe leads David into a bedroom)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're going to Minsk.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: No, I'm... not going to Minsk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you are so going to Minsk. You belong in Minsk. You can't stay here
just 'cause of me.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Yes I can. Because if I go it means I have to break up with you, and I
can't break up with you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yes, yes, yes you can. Just say, um, 'Phoebe, my work is my life and
that's what I have to do right now'. And I say 'your work?! Your work?! How can you say
that?!'. And then you say, um, 'it's tearing me apart, but I have no choice. Can't you
understand that?'. And I say (Hits him) 'no! No! I can't understand that!'.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Uh, ow.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, sorry. Um, and, and then you put your arms around me. And then you
put your arms around me. (He does so) And, um, and then you tell me that you love me and
you'll never forget me.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I'll never forget you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And then you say that it's almost midnight and you have to go because
you don't wanna start the new year with me if you can't finish it. (They kiss) I'm gonna
miss you. You scientist guy.

lines.speaker: Dick Clark
lines.text: (on TV) Hi, this is Dick Clark, live in Times Square. We're in a
virtual snowstorm of confetti here in Times Square...
(Joey puts a blanket over Sandy's kids)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There y'go, kids.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To a woman who he has clearly just met) And then the peacock bit me.
(Laughs) Please kiss me at midnight. (She leaves)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You seen Sandy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh. Uh, I don't know how to tell you this, but she's in Monica's
bedroom, getting it on with Max, that scientist geek. Ooh, look at that, I did know how to
tell you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Vrrbddy, the bll is drrbing.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (in the kitchen) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The bll is drrbing!

lines.speaker: Dick Clark
lines.text: (on TV) In twenty seconds it'll be midnight...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And the moment of joy is upon us.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Looks like that no date pact thing worked out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Everybody looks so happy. I hate that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not everybody's happy. Hey Bobby!
(Bobby waves and then bursts into tears. Midnight comes and everyone at the party
except for the gang cheers and kisses)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I uh.. just thought I'd throw this out here. I'm no math whiz,
but I do believe there are three girls and three guys right here. (Makes kiss noise)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I dunno. I don't feel like kissing anyone tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't kiss anyone.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So I'm kissing everyone?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nonono, you can't kiss Ross, that's your brother.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Perfect. Perfect. So now everybody's getting kissed but me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright, somebody kiss me. Somebody kiss me, it's midnight! Somebody
kiss me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alrightalrightalright. (Kisses him. Ross takes a photo) There.

title: The One with Mrs. Bing

scenes.location: A Street: Monica and Phoebe are walking to a newsstand.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do you think they have yesterday's daily news?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just wanna check my horoscope, see if it was right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God. (Grabs Phoebe and turns her away) Phoebe. Don't look now, but
behind us is a guy who has the potential to break our hearts and plunge us into a pit of
depression.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where? (Turns to face him) Ooh, come to Momma.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He's coming. Be cool, be cool, be cool.
(The guy walks past them)

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Nice hat.

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: (in unison) Thanks.
(The guy walks on)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We should do something. Whistle.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We are not going to whistle.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do it do it do it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Shouts to the guy) Woo-woo!
(The guy turns round, startled. Monica points to Phoebe. The guy gets hit by a truck)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can't believe you did that!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Hospital, the guy is in a coma and Mon and Pheebs are visiting.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why did I 'woo-hoo'? I mean, what was I hoping would happen? That-that
he'd turn round and say 'I love that sound, I must have you now'?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just wish there was something we could do. (Bends down and talks to
him) Hello. Hello, Coma Guy. GET UP, YOU GIRL SCOUT! UP! UP! UP!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe nobody's tried this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wish we at least knew his name... Look at that face. I mean, even
sleeping, he looks smart. I bet he's a lawyer.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but did you see the dents in his knuckles? That means he's
artistic.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, he's a lawyer, who teaches sculpting on the side. And- he can
dance!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! And, he's the kinda guy who, when you're talking, he's listening,
y'know, and not saying 'Yeah, I understand' but really wondering what you look like naked.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wish all guys could be like him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Phoebe are telling everyone about their coma
guy.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are there no conscious men in the city for you two?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He doesn't have anyone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, we-we feel kinda responsible.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't believe you said woowoo. I don't even say woowoo.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, she's coming up! She's coming up! (Turns on the TV)

lines.speaker: Jay Leno
lines.text: (on TV) Folks, when we come back we'll be talking about her new book,
'Euphoria Unbound': the always interesting Nora Tyler Bing. You might wanna put the kids
to bed for this one.
(Everyone has settled down to watch, except Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, we don't have to watch this. Weekend At Bernie's is
on Showtime, HBO, and Cinemax.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No way, forget it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: C'mon, she's your mom!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Exactly. Weekend At Bernie's! Dead guy getting hit in the
groin twenty, thirty times! No?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, I gotta tell you, I love your mom's books! I love her books! I
cannot get on a plane without one! I mean, this is so cool!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, you wouldn't think it was cool if you're eleven years old
and all your friends are passing around page 79 of 'Mistress Bitch.'

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mon, Chandler, I love your mom. I think she's a blast.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can say that because she's not your mom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, please...
(Rachel opens the door to Paolo)

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Bona sera.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi sweetie. (They kiss)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: When did Rigatoni get back from Rome?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Last night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, so then his plane didn't explode in a big ball of fire?... Just a
dream I had- but, phew.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey hey hey! She's on!

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Ah! Nora Bing!

lines.speaker: Jay Leno
lines.text: (on TV) ...Now what is this about you-you being arrested i-in London?
What is that all about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Your mom was arrested?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Shhh, busy beaming with pride.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: (on TV) ...This is kind of embarrassing, but occasionally after I've
been intimate with a man...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now why would she say that's embarrassing?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Shhh.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: (on TV) ...I just get this craving for Kung Pow Chicken.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: THAT'S TOO MUCH INFORMATION!!

lines.speaker: Jay Leno
lines.text: (on TV) Alright, so now you're doing this whole book tour thing, how
is that going?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: (on TV) Oh, fine. I'm leaving for New York tomorrow, which I hate-
but I get to see my son, who I love...

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Awww!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is the way that I find out. Most moms use the phone.

lines.speaker: Jay Leno
lines.text: (on TV) Y'know, don't take this wrong, I-I just don't see you a-as a
mom, somehow.. I don't mean that, I don't mean that bad...

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: (on TV) Oh no, I am a fabulous mom! I bought my son his first
condoms.
(The gang turn to look at Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...And then he burst into flames.
[Scene: The Hospital, it's a montage of Monica and Phoebe's visit to the hospital with My
Guy playing in the background. It starts with Monica reading a newspaper to
him.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let's see. Congress is debating a new deficit reduction bill... the
mayor wants to raise subway fares again... the high today was forty-five... and- oh, teams
played sports.
[Next is a shot of them dragging an enormous plant into the room, then Monica knitting
a sweater, then Phoebe singing, then Phoebe shaving him and chatting to Monica]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What about Glen? He could be a Glen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nah... not-not special enough.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! How about Agamemnon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Waaay too special.

scenes.location: A Mexican Restaurant, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler and his mom are there.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: I am famished. What do I want... (Looks at Chandler's menu)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Please God don't let it be Kung Pow Chicken.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Oh, you watched the show! What'd you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I think you need to come out of your shell just a little.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Entering) What is this dive? Only you could've picked this place.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Oooh, c'mon, shut up, it's fun. Gimme a hug. (They both sit down)
Well, I think we're ready for some tequila.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know I am.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Who's doing shots?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm in.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: There y'go. Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, I'm not really a shot drinking kinda guy.
(Enter Rachel and Paolo. They are both somewhat flustered)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Sorry- sorry we're late, we, uh, kinda just, y'know, lost track of
time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...But a man can change. (Downs a shot)
[Time lapse. Ross is now clearly drunk. He is holding up a shot glass to his eye like a
jeweller's eye.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyone want me to appraise anything?
(Rachel feeds something to Paolo. He eats it and licks her hand)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mrs. Bing, I have to tell you, I've read everything you've ever written.
No, I mean it! I mean, when I read Euphoria at Midnight, all I wanted to do was become a
writer.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Oh, please, honey, listen, if I can do it, anybody can. You just
start with half a dozen European cities, throw in thirty euphemisms for male genitalia,
and bam! You have got yourself a book.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Myyy mother, ladies and gentlemen.
[Cut to Mrs. Bing on the telephone.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Yeah, any messages for room 226?
(Ross emerges from a toilet marked 'Chicas')

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: You okay there, slugger?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I'm fine, I'm fine. (A woman emerges from the toilet behind him and
he tries to pretend he was in the other one)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: What is with you tonight?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing. Nothing nothing nothing.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: (To phone) Okay, thank you. (To Ross) It's the Italian Hand-Licker,
isn't it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. It's the one he's licking.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: She's supposed to be with you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're good.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Oh, Ross, listen to me. I have sold a hundred million copies of my
books, and y'know why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The girl on the cover with her nipples showing?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: No. Because I know how to write men that women fall in love with.
Believe me, I cannot sell a Paolo. People will not turn three hundred twenty-five pages
for a Paolo. C'mon, the guy's a secondary character, a, y'know, complication you
eventually kill off.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: When?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: He's not a hero. ...You know who our hero is.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The guy on the cover with his nipples showing?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: No, it's you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: No, really, c'mon. You're smart, you're sexy...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: You are gonna be fine, believe me.
(She kisses him on the cheek)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-oh...
(...Then full on the mouth)
(Enter Joey)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhhhh.... I'll just pee in the street.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, the next morning. Joey is getting the door in his dressing
gown—it's Ross.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, is Chandler here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
(Ross drags Joey into the hall and slams the door)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, uh, about last night, um, Chandler.. you didn't tell... (Joey shakes
his head) Okay, 'cause I'm thinking- we don't need to tell Chandler, I mean, it was just a
kiss, right? One kiss? No big deal? Right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right. No big deal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: In Bizarro World!! You broke the code!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What code?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don't kiss your friend's mom! Sisters are okay, maybe a hot-lookin'
aunt... but not a mom, never a mom!
(Chandler opens the door and startles them. He picks up the paper)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you guys doing out here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh.. uh.. Well, Joey and I had discussed getting in an early morning
racquetball game. But, um, apparently, somebody overslept.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, well, you don't have your racket.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no I don't, because it's being restrung, somebody was supposed to
bring me one.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, well you didn't call and leave your grip size.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, you guys spend waaaay too much time together. (Goes back inside
and shuts the door)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I'm scum, I'm scum.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, how could you let this happen?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know, God, I... well, it's not like she's a regular mom, y'know?
She's, she's sexy, she's...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don't think my mom's sexy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well... not in the same way...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'll have you know that Gloria Tribbiani was a handsome woman in her day,
alright? You think it's easy giving birth to seven children?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I think we're getting into a weird area here...
(Monica and Rachel's door opens and Rachel and Paolo emerge)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What're you guys doing out here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, not playing raquetball!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He forgot to leave his grip size!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He didn't get the goggles!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well,sounds like you two have issues.
(She and Paolo walk a little way down the hall)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Goodbye, baby.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Ciao, bela.
(They kiss. Ross is watching them)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do they wait for me to do this?
(Joey and Ross go into Monica and Rachel's apartment)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So are you gonna tell him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why would I tell him?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How about 'cause if you don't, his mother might.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Entering) What are you guys doing here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhhhh.... he's not even wearing a jockstrap!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ...What did I ask?
[Scene: Hospital. Phoebe is there stroking Coma Guy's hair, when Monica enters with a
bunch of balloons.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing, I just thought I'd stop by.. y'know, after the uh... that I..
y'know, so what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm not really here. Just thought I'd drop these off...on the way.. my
way... Do you come here a lot? Without me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. (Monica brushes Coma Guy's hair in the other direction) No! No!
...So, um, do you think he's doing any better than he was this morning?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How would I know? I-I wasn't here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? Not even to, um, change his PAJAMAS?! (Whips back the sheet to
reveal him wearing new pajamas.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Ross is talking to Chandler. Joey is making a snack at the
bar.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're my friend. I-I had to tell you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe it. Paolo kissed my mom?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, um, I don't know if you noticed, but he had a lot to drink, and you
know how he gets when he's drun..uh... (He has caught sight of Joey scowling at him) I
can't do this, I did it, it was me, I'm sorry, I kissed your mom.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was really upset about Rachel and Paolo, and I think I had too much
tequila, and Nora- um, Mrs. Mom- your Bing- was just being nice, y'know, and- But nothing
happened, nothing- Ask Joey, Joey, uh, came in-

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Joey) You knew about this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh... y'know, knowledge is a tricky thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I spent the entire day with you, why didn't you tell me?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, hey, hey, you're lucky I caught them when I did, or else who knows
what woulda happened.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks, man, big help.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) I can't believe this! What the hell were you thinking?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I wasn't- I mean, I-

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, of all my friends, no-one knows the crap I go through with my
mom more than you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know-

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe you did this. (Walks toward the door)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler-

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me neither, y'know what-

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm still mad at you for not telling me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you mad at me for?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler-

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You gotta let me slam the door! (Leaves; slams the door)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Shouting after him) Chandler, I didn't kiss her, he did! (To Ross) See
what happens when you break the code?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey-

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah! (Points to door) Huh? (Leaves and slams the door)
[Scene: Central Perk, everyone is there except for Chandler. Rachel is writing
something and Monica walks up.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Reading) 'A Woman Undone, by Rachel Karen Green'.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Thought I'd give it a shot. I'm still on the first chapter. Now,
do you think his 'love stick can be liberated from its denim prison'?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Reads) Yeah, I'd say so. And there's no 'j' in 'engorged'.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Walks up with her guitar) Hey Rach.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Going to the hospital tonight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You just asked me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, maybe it was a trick question. (Plays a few chords) Um, Rachel can
we do this now?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Writes a little more) I am so hot!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Ross, on the couch) Now, here's a picture of my mother and father on
their wedding day. Now you tell me she's not a knockout.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I cannot believe we're having this conversation.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: C'mon! Just try to picture her not pregnant, that's all.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Into microphone) Central Perk is proud to present Miss Phoebe Buffay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks. Hi, um, 'kay. I'd like to start with a song that's about a man
that I recently met, who's, um, come to be very important to me. (Monica gives her a look)
'Kay. (Sung:)
You don't have to be awake to be my man,
As long as you have brainwaves I'll be there to hold your hand.
Though we just met the other day,
There's something I have got to say...
(She sees Monica sneaking out) Okay, thank you very much, I'm gonna take a
short break! (Runs out, knocking over the mike stand)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Into mike) Okay, that was Phoebe Buffay, everybody. Woo!
(Enter Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, uh, Phoebe just started a...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I believe I was talking to Joey, alright there, Mother-Kisser?
(Goes to the counter)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Laughing) Mother-Kisser... (Sees Ross's look) I'll shut up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler, can I just say something? I-I know you're still mad at me, I
just wanna say that there were two people there that night. Okay? Two sets of lips.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, well, I expect this from her. Okay? She's always been a Freudian
nightmare.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, well, if she always behaves like this, why don't you say something?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because it's complicated, it's complex- Hey, you kissed my mom!
(People turn to look)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To the rest of Central Perk) We're rehearsing a Greek play.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's very funny. We done now?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Okay, you mean, you're not gonna talk to her, you're not gonna tell
her how you feel?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That would be no. Look, just because you played tonsil tennis with my
mom doesn't mean you know her. Alright? Trust me, you can't talk to her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, 'you' can't, or (Points to Chandler) you can't? (Chandler grabs his
finger) Okay, that's my finger. (Chandler twists it and Ross goes down on one knee)
