That's, that's my knee. (To Central Perk) Still doing the play. Aaah!
[Scene: The Coma Guy's Room, Monica bursts in, closely followed by Phoebe. There is no
sign of Coma Guy. His bed is empty.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, whadyou do with him?
(There is the sound of a flushing toilet and Coma Guy emerges from the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! You're awake!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look at you! How, how do you feel?

lines.speaker: Coma Guy
lines.text: Uh, a little woozy, but basically okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You look good!

lines.speaker: Coma Guy
lines.text: I feel good! ...Who are you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm Phoebe Buffay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm Monica Geller. I've been taking care of you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, we both have.

lines.speaker: Coma Guy
lines.text: So, the Etch-a-Sketch is from you guys?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, actually it's just from me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I got you the foot massager.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know who shaved you? That was me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I read to you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I sang. (To Monica) Hah!

lines.speaker: Coma Guy
lines.text: Well,... thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, my pleasure.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: Coma Guy
lines.text: So. I guess I'll see you around.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What, that's it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: "See you around?"

lines.speaker: Coma Guy
lines.text: Well, what do you want me to say?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I don't know. Maybe, um, "That was nice?" Admit something
to me? "I'll call you?"

lines.speaker: Coma Guy
lines.text: Alright, I'll call you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't think you mean that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is so typical. Y'know, we give, and we give, and we give. And then-
we just get nothing back! And then one day, y'know, it's just, you wake up, and "See
you around!" Let's go, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know what? We thought you were different. But I guess it was just the
coma.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's Chandler is talking with his mom.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Car's waiting downstairs, I just wanted to drop off these copies of
my book for your friends. Anything you want from Lisbon?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, just knowing you're gonna be there is enough.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Alright, well, be good, I love you. (Kisses him and goes to leave)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You kissed my best Ross! ...Or something to that effect.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: (Reentering) O-kay. Look, it, it was stupid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really stupid.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Really stupid. And I don't even know how it happened. I'm sorry,
honey, I promise it will never happen again. Are we okay now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. No. No...
[Cut to the hallway, Joey is listening to Chandler and his mom's conversation through
the door as Ross walks up.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, the forbidden love of a man and his door.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shh. He did it. He told her off, and not just about the kiss, about
everything.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're kidding.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no. He said "When are you gonna grow up and start being a
mom?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then she came back with "The question is, when are you gonna grow up
and realise I have a bomb?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 'Kay, wait a minute, are you sure she didn't say "When are you gonna
grow up and realise I am your mom?"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That makes more sense.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, what's going on now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I dunno, I've been standing here spelling it out for you! (Goes back to
the door) I don't hear anything. Oh, wait, wait, wait. (Looks through the spyhole)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whaddya see?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hard to tell, they're so tiny and upside-down. Wait, wait. They're walking
away... they're walking away... No, no they're not, they're coming right at us! Run! Run!
(Joey runs off down the hall. Ross tries Monica and Rachel's apartment, but it is
locked so he has to stand in the hall and pretend he wasn't listening. Chandler and his
mom come out)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: You okay, kiddo?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Alright. (Kisses him)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nice save.
(She walks down the hall)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Very politely) Mrs. Bing.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Mr. Geller.
(She leaves)
(Ross knocks on Monica and Rachel's door)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You mean that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, why not. (They shake hands) So I told her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? How'd it go?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Awful. Awful. Couldn'ta gone worse.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, howdya feel?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pretty good! I told her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, see? So, maybe it wasn't such a bad idea, y'know, me kissing your
mom, uh? Huh? (Wags his finger at Chandler, then puts it down) But.. we don't have to go
down that road.

title: The One with the Dozen Lasagnas

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, everyone is there. Ross working on
crossword puzzle, starts humming theme from The Odd Couple. Chandler joins in,
followed by Monica and Phoebe, then the whole gang. Ross starts humming theme from I
Dream Of Jeannie.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no, we're done.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is on the phone in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aunt Syl, stop yelling! All I'm saying is that if you had told
me vegetarian lasagna, I would have made vegetarian lasagna. (pauses, listens to person on
phone) Well, the meat's only every third layer, maybe you could scrape.
(Camera moves to Chandler, Phoebe, Ross, and Joey sitting in living room)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, did you really read all these baby books?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yup! You could plunk me down in the middle of any woman's uterus, no
compass, and I can find my way out of there like that! (snaps fingers)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, this is cool...it says in some parts of the world, people actually
eat the placenta. (Joey grimaces)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And, we're done with the yogurt. (Sets yogurt down on table)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (softly) Sorry. (Camera pans back to Monica, still on phone)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aunt Syl, I did this as a favor, I am not a caterer. What do you want me
to do with a dozen lasagnas? (listens to Aunt Syl on phone, looks shocked) Nice talk, Aunt
Syl. (in New York accent) You kiss Uncle Freddie with that mouth?
(Camera pans back to group in living room)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross, listen, you know that right now, your baby's only this big?
(measures about 2 inches with his thumb and index finger) This is your baby. (in baby-like
voice) Hi Daddy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (waves) Hello!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in baby-like voice) How come you don't live with Mommy? (pause;
shows Ross less than amused) How come Mommy lives with that other lady? (pause; Ross still
looks less than amused; Joey smiling) What's a lesbian? (playfully hits Ross)
(Rachel enters with Paolo, speaking Italian. Ross looks annoyed)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, you can say it, Poconos, Poconos, it's like Poc-o-nos (touching
Paolo's nose with forefinger with each syllable)

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Ah, poke (Paolo touches Rachel's nose) a (touches nose again)
nose, mmm (they rub noses, then kisses her)
Joey, Chandler, and Ross: (sitting in living room, imitating Paolo)
Mma, Mma, Mmaah
(Camera pans to Rachel, Monica, and Phoebe in the kitchen)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, did I hear Poconos?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, my sister's giving us her place for the weekend.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Woo-hoo, first weekend away together!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, that's a big step.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know...
(Camera pans to Ross, looking dejected)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) Ah, it's just a weekend, big deal!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wasn't this supposed to be just a fling, huh? Shouldn't it be...(makes
flinging motions with hands) flung by now?
(Camera pans back to Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean, we are way past the fling thing, I mean, I am feeling things
that I've only read about in Danielle Steele books, you know? I mean, when I'm with him,
I'm totally, totally...
(Camera pans to Ross, holding his stomach)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...nauseous, I'm physically nauseous. What am I supposed to do, huh? Call
immigration? (pauses, looks suddenly inspired) I could call immigration!

scenes.location: The Hallway, Chandler and Joey leaving girls' apartment, carrying lasagna.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I love babies, with their little baby shoes, and their little baby toes,
and their little baby hands...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, you're going to have to stop that, forever!
(Joey opens door, throws keys on kitchen table, table falls over)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Need a new table.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You think?

scenes.location: Carol and Susan's, there's a knock on the door and Carol answers it to Ross.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Hey hey, come on in!
(Ross enters, carrying lasagna)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, hello! mmwa! (kisses Carol) I brought all the books, and Monica sends
her love, along with this lasagna.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh great! Is it vegetarian, 'cause Susan doesn't eat meat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pauses) I'm pretty sure that it is...

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: So, I got the results of the amnio today.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (making flinging gestures with hands) Oh, tell me, tell me, is
everything, uhh....?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Totally and completely healthy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, that's great, that is great! (Hugs and kisses Carol. Then picks up a
picture frame)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, when did you and Susan meet Huey Lewis?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Uh, that's our friend Tanya.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (surprised, chuckling nervously) Of course it's your friend
Tanya. (looks up frightenedly)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Don't you want to know about the sex?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (chuckles nervously) The sex? (chuckles) Um, I'm having enough
trouble with the image of you and Susan together, when you throw in Tanya (miming washing
hair, that's the best I could think of), yaw...

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: The sex of the baby, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you know the sex of the baby? Oh, oh-oh-oh!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Do you want to know?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no, I don't want to know, absolutely not. I think, you
know, I think you should know until you look down there, and say, oop, there it is!
(pauses) Or isn't...
(Susan enters)

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh, hello Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Susan...

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: So, so, did you hear?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, we did, everything's A-OK!

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh, that's so... (Susan hugs Carol, they giggle, Ross steps away) It
really is...do we know...?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Yes, we certainly do, it's going to be...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (flailing arms in protest) Oh, hey hey hey, ho ho ho, hello, guy
who doesn't want to know, standing right here!

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh, well, is it what we thought it would be?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Mm-hmmm (Susan and Carol hug, giggling. Ross stands back, reaches out and
lightly taps Susan's shoulder)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, what, what...ok, what did we think it was going to be?

lines.speaker: Carol and Susan
lines.text: It's a...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupts) No, no, no I don't want to know, don't want to
know. Ok, you know, I should probably, I should probably just go.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Well, thanks for the books.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No problem, ok, mmmwa (kisses Carol) oh, mmmwa (kisses Carol's stomach,
then punches Susan's shoulder) Susan... (Ross leaves.)

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: All right, who should we call first, your folks, or Deb and Rona?
(intercom buzzer rings)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on intercom) Uh, never mind, I don't want to know. (Carol and
Susan laugh)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey and Chandler use their knees as a table to
support the lasagna.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, so it's just because it was my table, I have to buy a new one?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's the rule.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What rule? There's no rule, if anything, you owe me a table!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How'd you get to that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I believe the piece of furniture was fine until your little
breakfast adventure with Angela Delvecchio

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You knew about that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, let's just say the impressions you made in the butter left
little to the imagination.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, ok, How about if we split it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What do you mean, like, buy it together?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You think we're ready for something like that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it's a pretty big commitment, I mean, what if one of us wants to
move out?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why, are you moving out?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not moving out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You'd tell me if you were moving out right

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, it's just that with my last roommate Kip...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aw, I know all about Kip!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's just that we bought a hibachi together, and then he ran off and
got married, and things got pretty ugly.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, let me ask you something, was Kip a better roommate than me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aw, don't do that
[Scene: Phoebe's Massage Parlor, Phoebe's assistant is telling her about the changes to
her schedule.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe's Assistant
lines.text: We've got a couple changes in your schedule. Your
4:00 herbal massage has been pushed back to 4:30 and Miss Somerfield canceled her 5:30
shiatsu.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, thanks. (assistant leaves, then walks back in)

lines.speaker: Phoebe's Assistant
lines.text: Oh, here comes your 3:00. I don't mean to sound
unprofessional, but, yum (walks out, Paolo enters)

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Buon Giorno, Bella Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Paolo, hi, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Uh, Racquela tell me you massage, eh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, Racquela's right, yeah!
(Paolo speaks Italian)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, I don't know what you just said, so let's get started.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Uh, I am, uh, being naked?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, that's really your decision, I mean, some people prefer, you know,
to take off...oh whoops! You're being naked!

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone but Phoebe is there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Ross) I can't believe you don't want to know. I mean, I
couldn't not know, I mean, if, if the doctor knows, and Carol knows, and Susan knows....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And Monica knows...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha, heh, how could you know, I don't even know!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Carol called me to thank me for the lasagna, I asked, she told me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what's it gonna be? (Monica whispers in Joey's ear. Ross gets up and
waves arms frantically in protest)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait—oh—hey—huh, oh great now he knows, and I don't know!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm just excited about being an aunt!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or an uncle...
(Phoebe enters)

lines.speaker: Joey and Chandler
lines.text: Hey Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, what's the matter?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing, I'm sorry, I'm just, I'm out of sorts.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Hey, can we get some cappuccino over here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, right, that's me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Chandler, that table place closes at 7, come on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine. (Joey and Chandler walk towards the door)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, what is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, you know Paolo?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm familiar with his work, yes...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, he made a move on me.
(Joey and Chandler come back)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, store will be open tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: More coffee over here, please!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, what happened?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, he came in for a massage, and everything was fine until.
(A flashback starts Paolo, lying on massage table, moving his hands up Phoebe's legs.)
[Cut back to Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Joey and Chandler
lines.text: Ooooohh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you sure?
(The flashback resumes with Paolo grabbing her butt.)
[Cut back to Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, I'm sure. (Flashback resumes with Phoebe doing a voiceover.)
And all of a sudden his hands weren't the problem anymore. (Flashback continues: Paolo
rolls over, Phoebe looks down, then quickly looks up, bites lip, shakes her head)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Was it...?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, boy scouts could have camped under there.

lines.speaker: Guys
lines.text: Oooooo....
(Rachel runs over)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: "Ooo," what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uma Thurman.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The actress!
(all talking indistinctly, high-fiving)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks Rach.
(Rachel walks away)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So what are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You have to tell her! You have to tell her! It's your moral obligation, as
a friend, as a woman, I think it's a feminist issue! Guys? Guys? (waiting for guys to
chime in)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah, you have to tell her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Feminist issue. That's where I went!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She is gonna hate me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sympathetic yet...) Yeah, well...

scenes.location: The Table Store, Joey and Chandler and looking for their new table.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Will you pick one, just pick one! Here, how about that one? (points to a
table)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's patio furniture!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what, like people are gonna come in and think, "Uh-oh, I'm outside
again?" Of course!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (gesturing towards another table) What about the birds?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know, birds just don't say, "Hello, sit here, eat
something."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You pick one.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, how about the ladybugs?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, so, forget about the birds, but big red insects suggest fine
dining!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine, you want to get the birds, get the birds!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not like that, I won't! (pauses) Kip would have liked the birds! (Joey
turns and gives Chandler a dirty look)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel folding and packing clothes in suitcases as Phoebe
enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you moving out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, these aren't all my suitcases. (picks up small blue suitcase and
shows to Phoebe) This one's Paolo's.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, um, Rachel can we talk for a sec?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, sure...just a sec, though, 'cause Paolo's on his way over.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! (sits down) Ok, um, ok, um,

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Pheebs, Pheebs...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, um, (clears throat) we haven't known each other for that long a
time, and, um, there are three things that you should know about me. One, my friends are
the most important thing in my life, two, I never lie, and three, I make the best oatmeal
raisin cookies in the world. (Phoebe opens a tin and offers Rachel a cookie)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (taking cookie) Ok, thanks Pheebs (takes bite of cookie,
overwhelmed) Oh my God, why have I never tasted these before?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I don't make them a lot because I don't think it's fair to the other
cookies

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, well, you're right, these are the best oatmeal cookies I've
ever had.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Which proves that I never lie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I guess you don't.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Paolo made a pass at me.
(Rachel looks stunned)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Ross, Chandler, Joey, and Monica admiring their new
table.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, what do you think?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think It's the most beautiful table I've ever seen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know!
(The camera pans back to reveal Joey and Chandler's new foosball table.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So how does this work, you going to balance the plates on these little
guys' heads?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who cares, we'll eat at the sink! Come on, let's play!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Heads up Ross! (Monica scores on Chandler and Joey) Score! (points at
Chandler) You suck!
(Chandler looks at Joey in amazement)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is recovering from the shock.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I need some milk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, I've got milk (takes thermos from her bag and starts to pour a cup)
Here you go... (Rachel drinks straight from thermos) Oh!(Rachel finishes thermos) Better?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No...oh, I feel so stupid! Oh, I think about the other
day with you guys and I was all "Oh, Paolo, he's so great, he makes me feel
so..." Oh, God, I'm so embarrassed!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm so embarrassed, I'm the one he hit on!
(Phoebe's and Rachel's lines overlap)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, if I had never met him this never would have happened!

lines.speaker: Rachel and Phoebe
lines.text: I'm so sorry! No I'm sorry! No I'm sorry! No
I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, wait, oh, what are we sorry about?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know...right, he's the pig!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Such a pig!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, God, he's such a pig,

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh he's like a...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He's like a big disgusting...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ...like a...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...pig...pig man!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, good! Ok...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (voice wavers) Oh, but he was my pig man...how did I not see this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (raises hand) Oh! I know! (Rachel startled) It's because... he's
gorgeous, and he's charming, and when he looks at you...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, Ok, Pheebs...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The end.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, God...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Should I not have told you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, trust, me, it's, it's, it's much better that I know. Uh, I just
liked it better before it was better...
(Phoebe scoots her chair over to Rachel and hugs her)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Phoebe is telling everyone how it went across the hall as
the foosball game continues.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think she took it pretty well. You know Paolo's over there right now,
so...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We should get over there and see if she's okay. (switching
places with Ross) Just one...second! Score! (Monica scores, high-fives with Ross) Game!
Come on. (Monica and Phoebe leave)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (wiping his brow) Ah...ooh! Well, looks like, uh, we kicked your
butts.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, she kicked our butts. You could be on the Olympic standing-there
team.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, two on one.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you still doing here? She just broke up with the guy, it's
time for you to swoop in!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes, now is when you swoop! You gotta make sure that when Paolo walks out
of there, the first guy Rachel sees is you, She's gotta know that you're everything he's
not! You're like, like the anti-Paolo!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: My Catholic friend is right. She's distraught. You're there for her.
You pick up the pieces, and then you usher in the age of Ross! (Ross and Chandler look off
into the distance. Joey, wondering what they are looking at, looks in the same direction)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's Balcony, Rachel is throwing Paolo's clothes over the side.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: No, that's cold, that's cold, that's...
[Cut to inside the apartment.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) How's it going?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't stare. Now she just finished throwing his clothes off the balcony,
now there's just a lot of gesturing and arm-waving, (shows Rachel gesturing with hands in
front of her chest), Ok, that is either, "How could you?" or, "Enormous
breasts!" Here he comes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh!
(Paolo enters. Ross, Phoebe, and Monica scatter)

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Uh, I am, uh, to say good-bye.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, ok bye-bye.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Paolo, I really hate you for what you did to Rachel, (hands him a
lasagna) but I still have five of these, so heat it at 375 until the cheese bubbles.

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Grazie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Paolo, I-I just want to tell you and I think I speak for everyone when I
say... (shuts door in his face and walks away)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, just look at her... (girls move toward Rachel on the balcony)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh you guys, I-I really think just one of us should go out there so she's
not overwhelmed...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you're right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pulls Monica back) ...and I really think it should be me.
[Cut to the balcony, Ross has just climbed through the window.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You all right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I've been better...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come here. (he hugs Rachel) Listen, you deserve so much better than
him...you know, I mean, you, you, you should be with a guy who knows what he has when he
has you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Ross...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am so sick of guys. I don't want to look at another guy, I don't want
to think about another guy, I don't even want to be near another guy. (Ross crosses arms)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ross, you're so great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohhhh (Hugs her and sighs)
[Cut to inside the apartment, Rachel and Ross are entering.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooh...hey honey, are you all right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You ok?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...medium...hmm...any cookies left?

lines.speaker: Phoebe

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you talked to your dad, huh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. He's gonna keep cheating on my ma like she wanted, she's gonna keep
pretending she doesn't know even though she does, and my little sister Tina can't see her
husband any more because he got a restraining order...which has nothing to do with
anything except that I found out today.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Things sure have changed here on Waltons mountain.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So Joey, you okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I guess. It's just parents, after a certain point, you gotta let go.
Even if you know better, you've gotta let them make their own mistakes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just think, in a couple of years we get to turn into them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If I turn into my parents, I'll either be an alcoholic blond chasing
after twenty-year-old boys, or... I'll end up like my mom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How's it going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, except I broke up with Roger.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Awww.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, right.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Aaawwwwww!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't know, I mean, he's a good person, and he can be really sweet,
and in some ways I think he is so right for me, it's just... I hate that guy!

title: The One with the Candy Hearts

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Ross is eyeing a beautiful woman at the counter, and Joey and
Chandler are egging him on to go talk to her. No pun intended. I mean it.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm tellin' you Ross, she wants you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She barely knows me. We just live in the same building.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Any contact?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She lent me an egg once.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're in!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aw, right.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. (stutters something incoherent)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on, Ross, you gotta get back in the game here, ok? The Rachel
thing's not happening, your ex-wife is a lesbian—I don't think we need a third...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Excuse me, could we get an egg over here, still in the shell? Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: An egg?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you're gonna go up to her and say, "Here's your egg back, I'm
returning your egg."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think it's winning.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think it's insane.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She'll love it. Go with the egg, my friend.
(Ross walks over to the woman, egg in hand.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Think it'll work?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it's suicide. The man's got an egg.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica, Rachel, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler are there. Ross is still
talking to the beautiful woman.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You can not do this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do what, do what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Roger wants to take her out tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Phoebes! Don't you remember why you dumped the guy?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: 'Cause he was creepy, and mean, and a little frightening... alright,
still, it's nice to have a date on Valentine's Day!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But Phoebe, you can go out with a creepy guy any night of the year. I
know I do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what are you guys doing tomorrow night?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Actually, tomorrow night kinda depends on how tonight goes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, uh, listen, about tonight...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no, don't you dare bail on me. The only reason she's goin' out
with me is because I said I could bring a friend for her friend.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, I know, but her friend sounds like such a...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pathetic mess? I know, but—come on, man, she's needy, she's
vulnerable. I'm thinkin', cha-ching! (Rachel throws a roll at Joey. He picks it up and
eats it.) Thanks. Look, you have not been out with a woman since Janice. You're doin'
this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi. She said yes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Way to go, man! (Chandler and Ross hug. Something crunches in
Ross' shirt pocket.) Still got the egg, huh?

scenes.location: A Restaurant, Joey and Chandler are there, waiting for their dates to show up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Looking at himself in the reflection on a knife) How do I look?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, uh, I... don't... care. (Joey's date shows up) Ok, now, remember,
no trading. You get the pretty one, I get the mess.

lines.speaker: Lorraine
lines.text: Hi, Joey. Well well, look what you brought. Very nice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...And what did you bring?

lines.speaker: Lorraine
lines.text: She's checking the coats. Joey, I'm gonna go wash the cab smell off my
hands. Will you get me a white Zinfandel, and a glass of red for Janice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Janice?
(Lorraine leaves. Joey shakes his head as though to say, 'It can't be the same Janice.'
Janice enters.)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh.... my.... God.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (angrily) Hey, it's Janice.

scenes.location: The bathroom at the restaurant, Chandler and Joey are talking.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, I'm makin' a break for it, I'm goin' out the window.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no, don't! I've been waitin' for like, forever to go out with
Lorraine. Just calm down.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Calm down? Calm down? You set me up with the woman that I've dumped
twice in the last five months!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (at the urinal) Can you stop yellin'? You're makin' me nervous, and I
can't go when I'm nervous.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, you're right. (gets up right behind Joey and
yells in his ear) Come on, do it, do it, go, come on!!!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the girls are all there, discussing their bad luck with
men.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, ok, Roger was creepy, but he was nothing compared to Pete Carney.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Which one was Pete Carney?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pete the Weeper? Remember that guy who used to cry every time we had
sex. (imitating) "Was it good for you?"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, well, I'll take a little crying any day over
Howard-the-"I-win"-guy. (imitating) "I win! I win!" I went out with
the guy for two months—I didn't get to win once.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How did we end up with these jerks? We're good people!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know. Maybe we're some kinda magnets.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know I am. That's why I can't wear a digital watch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There's more beer, right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! You know my friend Abby who shaves her head? She said that if you
want to break the bad boyfriend cycle, you can do like a cleansing ritual.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebes, this woman is voluntarily bald.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. So, we can do it tomorrow night, you guys. It's Valentine's Day.
It's perfect.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, well, what kind of ritual?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok. We can, um, we can burn the stuff they gave us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Or?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or...or we can chant and dance around naked, you know, with sticks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Burning's good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Burning's good. Yeah, I got stuff to burn.
[Scene: The Restaurant, Joey, Lorraine, Chandler, and Janice are at the table. Joey and
Lorraine are seated very close, Chandler and Janice have backed their chairs away from one
another.]

lines.speaker: Lorraine
lines.text: You know, ever since I was little, I've been able to pick up quarters
with my toes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good for you. (jumps suddenly) Uh, quarters or rolls of quarters?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: By the way, Chandler. I cut you out of all my pictures. So if you want,
I have a bag with just your heads.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's OK.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, are you sure? Really? Because you know, you could make little
puppets out of them, and you could use them in your theater of cruelty.
(Lorraine whispers into Joey's ear.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Lorraine) We can't do that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (disgusted) What? What can't you do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, can I talk to you for a second, over there?
(Chandler and Joey leave the table.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, we might be leaving now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tell me it's "you and me" we.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She said she wants to slather my body with stuff and then lick it off. I'm
not even sure what slathering is, but I definitely want to be a part of it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, you can not do this to me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're right, I'm sorry. You're right.

lines.speaker: Lorraine
lines.text: (to waiter) Uh, can we have three chocolate mousses to go please?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm outta here. Here's my credit card. Dinner's on me. I'm sorry,
Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I hope she throws up on you.
(Joey leaves with Lorraine. Chandler sits back down with Janice.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Just us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, what a crappy night!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Although, I have enjoyed the fact that, uh your shirt's been stickin'
outta your zipper ever since you came back from the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Excuse me. (gets up, jumps up and down while he zips his zipper up...
other patrons look at him) How ya doin'?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: So, do we have the best friends or what?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey's not a friend. He's...a stupid man who left us his credit card.
Another drink? Some dessert? A big screen TV?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I will go for that drink.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got it. Good woman! (the waiter turns around, it's a man) Could we
get a bottle of your most overpriced champagne?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Each.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's right, each. Oh, and a uh Rob Roy. (to Janice) I've always
wanted to know...
[Scene: Chandler's bedroom, Chandler wakes up, and finds someone else's hand on his
chest. He rolls over and is shocked to see Janice there.]

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Happy Valentine's Day!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The Hallway, Chandler is trying to get Janice out of his apartment.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, I miss you already. Can you believe this happened?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No... no! And yet it did. Good-bye, Janice.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Kiss me!
(Janice kisses him. Monica comes out for the newspaper.}

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Chandler, sorry.
(Janice turns around, Monica sees who it is.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohhh, Chandler, sorry! Hey, Janice.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Hi, Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, well, this was very special.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, come see who's out here!
(Rachel comes out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my god. Janice, hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Janice is gonna go away now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll be right back.
(Joey enters from the stairs.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Joey, look who it is.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in disbelief) Whoa.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, good, Joey's home now.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: This is so fun. This is like a reunion in the hall.
(Monica comes out with her cordless phone.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, hi, Ross. Yeah. There's someone I want you to say hi to. (to
Chandler) He just happened to call.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Hi, Ross. Yes, it's me. How did you know? (she laughs obnoxiously)

scenes.location: A Chinese Restaurant, Ross is there with his date.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm just sayin' if dogs do experience jet lag, then, because of the whole
um, seven dog years to one human year thing, then, when a dog flies from New York to Los
Angeles, he doesn't just lose three hours, he loses like a week and a half.
(Ross starts to laugh, and then makes a face like 'Why did I just say that?' Ross'
ex-wife, Carol, and her lesbian lover, Susan, enter the restaurant. Ross stares at them.)

lines.speaker: Kristin
lines.text: That's funny. Who are they?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The blond woman is my ex-wife, and the woman touching her is her... close,
personal friend.

lines.speaker: Kristin
lines.text: You mean they're lovers.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: If you wanna put a label on it.

lines.speaker: Kristin
lines.text: Wow, uh, anything else I should know?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nope, nope, that's it.
(Carol takes off her jacket, her pregnant belly is exposed.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, and she's pregnant with my baby. I always forget that part. (to Carol
and Susan) Helloo!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the girls are holding their boyfriend bonfire.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, so now we need, um sage branches and the sacramental wine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All I have is, is oregano and a Fresca.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, that's ok! (throws it in fire) Ok. All right. Now we need the semen
of a righteous man.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, Pheebs, you know what, if we had that, we wouldn't be doing the
ritual in the first place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can we just start throwing things in?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, yeah, ok. (she throws the directions in) Oh, OK.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (tossing things in the fire) Ok, Barry's letters. Adam Ritter's boxer
shorts.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, and I have the, uh receipt for my dinner with Nokululu Oon Ah Ah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, here's a picture of Scotty Jared naked.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at picture) Hey he's wearing a sweater.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel and Phoebe
lines.text: Eww!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And here we have the last of Paulo's grappa.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Rachel, isn't that stuff almost pure...
(Rachel throws the alcohol in the fire. A burst of flames shoots up from it.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Joey are there. Chandler is preparing to dump Janice
again.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How can I dump this woman on Valentine's day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know. You dumped her on New Year's.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, man. In my next life, I'm coming back as a toilet brush.
(Janice enters.)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Hello, funny Valentine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, Just Janice.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Hello, Joey, our little matchmaker. I could just kiss you all over, and
I'm gonna!
(Janice kisses Joey all over. Chandler smiles.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Chandler) If you don't do it, I will.

scenes.location: The Chinese Restaurant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, um, what do you do for a living?

lines.speaker: Kristin
lines.text: Well, um, for the past few years I've been working..(Ross is watching
Carol and Susan, not listening to Kristin. Susan gets up, and has to go. Carol is left
stranded)...which is funny because, that wasn't even my major.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh no. I thought you said they could shoot the spot without you.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: I thought they could...I'll try to get back as soon as I can. I'm sorry.
(Ross realizes Kristin was expecting him to laugh, so he starts to laugh hysterically.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now that is funny. Hey, do you think...would it be too weird if I invited
Carol over to join us? 'Cause she's, she's alone now, and pregnant, and, and sad.

lines.speaker: Kristin
lines.text: (reluctantly) I guess.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you sure? Great. Carol? Wanna come over and join us?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh, no no no. I'm fine. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on. These people'll scooch down. You guys'll scooch, won't you? Let's
try scooching! Come on. Come on. Uh, Kristen Riggs, this is Carol Willick. Carol, Kristin.
Uh, Carol teaches sixth grade. And, Kristin, Kristin...(struggling)...does something that,
funnily enough, wasn't even her major!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, firemen are there to handle the bonfire that got out of
control.]
Fireman No. 1: What do we got there?
Fireman No. 2: A piece of something: boxer shorts, greeting cards, and what
looks like a half-charred picture—Wow, that guy's hairier than the Chief!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know, it's a really funny story how this happened.
Fireman No. 3: It's all right. It's all right. You don't have to explain. This
isn't the first boyfriend bonfire that we've seen get out of control.
Fireman No. 1: You're our third call tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?
Fireman No. 2: Oh, sure, Valentine's is our busiest night of the year.

scenes.location: Central Perk.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I brought you something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is it loaded? Oh, little candy hearts. (reading the candy) Chan and
Jan Forever.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I had them made special.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, Janice. Janice. Hey, Janice. Look, there's no way for me to tell
you this. At least there's no new way for me to tell you this. I just don't things
are gonna work out.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: That's fine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (surprised) It is?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Mmm-hmm. Because I know that this isn't the end.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no, you see, actually it is.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: No, it isn't, because you won't let that happen. Don't you know it yet?
You love me, Chandler Bing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, no I don't.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Well then ask yourself this. Why do you think we keep ending up
together? New Year's? Who invited who? Valentine's? Who asked who into whose bed?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I did, but...

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: You seek me out. Something deep in your soul calls out to me like a
foghorn. Janice, Janice. You want me. You need me. You can't live without me. And you know
it. You just don't know you know it. See ya.
(She kisses him passionately,then leaves.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Call me!

scenes.location: The Chinese Restaurant, Ross and Carol are talking. Kristin is not there.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: It's not true. I never called your mother a wolverine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You did so. I swear, I swear—(noticing Kristin's absence) How long
has she been in the bathroom?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Uh, I don't think she's in the bathroom. Her coat is gone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well maybe it's cold in there. Or maybe I screwed up the first date I had
in 9 years.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: That could be it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, god. (He puts his head down on the grill) You know, this is still
pretty hot. (He picks his head up, and a mushroom sticks to his head. Carol picks it off
and eats it.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Mushroom. Smile. They won't all be like this. Some women might even stay
through dinner. Sorry, that's not funny

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it's just...you know the whole "getting on with your life"
thing. Well, do I have to? I mean, I'm sitting here with this cute woman, and, and, and
she's perfectly nice, and, but that there's, that's it. And um, and then I'm here talkin'
to you, and, and it's easy, and it's fun, and, and I don't, I don't have to...You know,
here's a wacky thought. Um, what's say you and I give it another shot? No no no, I know
what you're gonna say, you're a lesbian. But what do you say we just put that aside for
now you know? Let's just stick a pin in it, ok? Because, we're great together, you know.
You can't deny it. Besides, you're carrying my baby. I mean, how perfect is that? But see,
you know, you keep sayin' that, but there's somethin' right here. I love you.
(They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh, I love you too. But...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No but, no but.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: You know that thing you put over here with the pin in it? It's time to
take the pin out. You'll find someone, I know you will. The right woman is just waiting
for you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's easy for you to say, you found one already.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: All you need is a woman who likes men and you'll be set.
(A beautiful woman walks by Ross, he stares at her.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Not her.

title: The One with the Stoned Guy

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is serving Joey, Ross, and Monica their drinks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Joey) Coffee. (Hands it to him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Ross) Cappuccino. (Hands it to him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Grazie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And a nice hot cider for Monica. (Hands it to her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aww, thank you. (Notices something.) Uh Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why does my cinamon stick have an eraser?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! That's why. (Rachel checks behind her ear, and finds a cinamon
stick.) I'm sorry!
(She takes the pencil out of Monica's coffee and Monica puts her cup down in disgust.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Chandler's job, Chandler is typing data into his computer, he keeps typing even
while taking a drink of coffee with one hand. One of his co-workers walks by.]

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mrs. Tedlock. You're looking lovely today. And may I say, that is a very
flattering sleeve length on you.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Tedlock
lines.text: Yes. Well, Mr. Kostelick wants you to stop by his office at the
end of the day.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, listen. If this is about those prank memos, I had nothing to do
with them. Really. Nothing at all. Really. (Chandler tries to hide a rubber chicken from
the woman.) Nothing.

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there but Chandler. Phoebe runs in, excitedly.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey you guys! Chandler's coming and he says he has, like, this
incredible news, so when he gets here, we could all act like, you know...
(Chandler comes in.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Never mind. But it was going to be really good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, it's a typical day at work. I'm inputting my numbers, and big Al
calls me into his office and tells me he wants to make me processing supervisor.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So.... I quit.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why? This was supposed to be a temp job!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, Chandler... you've been there for five years.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If I took this promotion, it'd be like admitting that this is what I
actually do.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So was it a lot more money?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It doesn't matter. I just don't want to be one of those guys that's in
his office until twelve o'clock at night worrying about the WENUS.
(Everyone looks at him, confused.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ... the WENUS?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Weekly Estimated Net Usage Systems. A processing term.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh. That WENUS.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what're you going to do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know. That's the thing. I don't know what I want to do. I just
know I'm not going to figure it out working there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oooh! I have something you can do! I have this new massage client...
Steve? (pause) Anyway, he's opening up a restaurant and he's looking for a head chef.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (taps Phoebe on her shoulder) Um... hi there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi! (turns back to Chandler, then to Monica) Oh, yeah, no, I know.
You're a chef. I know, and I thought of you first, but um, Chandler's the one who needs a
job right now, so....

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah... I just don't have that much cheffing experience. Unless it's
an all-toast restaurant.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Monica's tapping) Yeah, yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, what kind of food is he looking for?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, he wants to do some ecclectic, so he's looking for someone who
can, you know, create the entire menu.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (excited) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I know! (turns to Chandler) So, what do you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks, Phoebe. But I just don't really see myself in a big white hat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: OK. (pause) Oh Monica! Guess what!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler walks in, wearing a suit.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can you see my nipples through this shirt?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. But don't worry, I'm sure they're still there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where are you going, Mr. Suity-Man?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I have an appointment to see Dr. Robert Pillman, career
counselor a-gogo. (pause) I added the "a-gogo."

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Career counselor?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you guys all know what you want to do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you guys in the living room all know what you want to do.
You know, you have goals. You have dreams. I don't have a dream.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, the lesser-known "I don't have a dream" speech.
(Monica enters, excited.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I love my life, I love my life!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! Brian's Song!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The meeting with the guy went great?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So great! He showed me where the restaurant's going to be. It's this,
it's this cute little place on 10th Street. Not too big, not too small. Just right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Was it formerly owned by a blonde woman and some bears?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So anyway, I'm cooking dinner for him Monday night. You know, kind of
like an audition. And Phoebe, he really wants you to be here, which will be great for me
because then you can 'ooh' and 'ahh' and make yummy noises.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you going to make?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as though Rachel wasn't paying attention) Yummy noises.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause) And Monica, what are you going to make?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know. I don't know. It's just going to be so great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! I know what you could make! (runs over to join Monica and Rachel in
the kitchen) I know! Oh, you should definitely make that thing... you know, with the
stuff? (Monica doesn't know.) You know, that thing... with the stuff...? OK, I don't know.
(sits down)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey guys, does anybody know a good date place in the neighborhood?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How about Tony's? If you can finish a 32-ounce steak, it's free.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK, ahem, hey, does anybody know a good place if you're not dating a puma?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who are you going out with?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, is this the bug lady?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (trying to sound like a bug) Bzzzz.... I love you, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Her name is Celia. She's not a bug lady. She's curator of insects at the
museum.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what are you guys going to do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I just thought we could go out to dinner, and then maybe bring her
back to my place and I'd introduce her to my monkey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And he's not speaking metaphorically.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (aside to Ross) So.... back to your place...you thinking, maybe...
(gestures with hands, back and forth) huh-huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I don't know.... (gestures) huh-huh.... but I'm hoping (gestures)
huh-huh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm telling you, that monkey is a chick magnet! She's going to take one
look at his furry, cute little face and it'll seal the deal.
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Marcel is hanging from Celia's hair, and she is screaming,
trying to get him off.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Celia, don't worry! Don't scream! He's not going to hurt you!
Soothing tones, Celia. Soothing tones! Marcel...

lines.speaker: Celia
lines.text: I can't stand this! He's got his claws in my...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright... (lifts Marcel away)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is there but Ross and Chandler. Monica is making
food, and having everyone try it.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Joey) OK, try this salmon mousse.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (tasting) Mmmm. Good.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is it better than the other salmon mousse?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's creamier.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, well, is that better?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know. We're talking about whipped fish, Monica. I'm just happy I'm
keeping it down, y'know?
(Chandler kicks the door closed, angrily. His clothes are askew, he looks beat.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My God! What happened to you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eight and a half hours of aptitude tests, intelligence tests,
personality tests... and what do I learn? (he taps the results and reads them) "You
are ideally suited for a career in data processing for a large multinational
corporation."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's so great! 'Cause you already know how to do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can you believe it? I mean, don't I seem like somebody who should be
doing something really cool? You know, I just always pictured myself doing
something...something.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (comes up and rubs him on the chest) Oh Chandler, I know, I know... oh,
hey! You can see your nipples through this shirt!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (brings a plate of tiny appetizers over) Here you go, maybe this'll
cheer you up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, you know, I had a grape about five hours ago, so I'd better split
this with you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's supposed to be that small. It's a pre-appetizer. The French call it
an amouz-bouche.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (tastes it) Well.... it is amouz-ing...
(Phone rings. Monica answers it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? (Listens) Oh, hi Wendy! (Listens) Yeah, eight o'clock.
(Listens) What did we say? Ten dollars an hour?... (Listens) OK, great. (Listens) All
right, I'll see you then. Bye. (hangs up)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ten dollars an hour for what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I asked one of the waitresses at work if she'd help me out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (hurt) Waitressing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well... of course I thought of you! But... but...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But, but?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But, you see, it's just... this night has to go just perfect, you know?
And, well, Wendy's more of a... professional waitress.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! I see. And I've sort of been maintaining my amateur status so that I
can waitress in the Olympics.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, I don't mean to brag, but I waited tables at Innsbruck in
'76. (dead silence) Amouz-bouche? (holds out tray)
[Scene: Ross' apartment, Girl, You'll Be A Woman Soon (the original, not that
cruddy Urge Overkill version) is playing. Ross and Celia are kissing passionately.]

lines.speaker: Celia
lines.text: Talk to me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK.... um, a weird thing happened to me on the train this morning...

lines.speaker: Celia
lines.text: No no no. Talk... dirty.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (embarrassed) Wha... what, here?

lines.speaker: Celia
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: Celia
lines.text: Say something..... hot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (panicked) Er.... um.....

lines.speaker: Celia
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Um... uh.... vulva.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey and Ross are there, discussing what happened last
night.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in disbelief) Vulva?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, I panicked, alright? She took me by surprise. You know, but it
wasn't a total loss. I mean, we ended up cuddling.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sarcastic) Whoaa!! You cuddled? How many times??

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shut up! It was nice. I just... I don't think I'm the dirty-talking kind
of guy, you know?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's the big deal? You just say what you want to do to her. Or what you
want her to do to you. Or what you think other people might be doing to each other. I'll
tell you what. Just try something on me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (deadpan) Please be kidding.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not? Come on! Just, just close your eyes and tell me what you'd like
to be doing right now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK. (closes eyes) I'm in my apartment...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ....yeah... what else?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's it. I'm in my apartment, you're not there, we're not having this
conversation. (gets up, walks across room)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (walks to catch up to him) Alright, look, I'll start, OK?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, please.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on. Come on. Alright, ready, look! (in a low voice) Oh... Ross....
you get me so hot. I want your lips on me now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (impressed) Wow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, now you say something.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I... ahem... I really don't think so.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! You like this woman, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You want to see her again, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well if you can't talk dirty to me, how're you going to talk dirty to her?
Now tell me you want to caress my butt!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK, turn around. (Joey looks taken aback) I just don't want you staring at
me when I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (turning around) Alright, alright. I'm around. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahem... I want.... OK, I want to... feel your... hot, soft skin with my
lips.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There you go! Keep going. Keep going!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I, er...
(At this point, Chandler walks into the living room from his bedroom. Ross and Joey
both have their backs to him, so they don't notice. Chandler sees the situation and
remains quiet, watching.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I want to take my tongue... and...
(Chandler is completely astounded.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Say it... say it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...run it all over your body until you're... trembling with... with...
(Chandler leans back against the wall and Ross and Joey hear him. Ross and Joey both
notice at the same time. They slowly stop, and then very slowly turn around to see
Chandler staring at them.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiling)....with??

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (rushing to explain) Funny story!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're not going to believe this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's OK. It's OK. I was always rooting for you two kids to get
together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Chandler, while you were sleeping that guy from your old job called
again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Again?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And again, and again, and again... (phone rings, he answers) Hello? (hands
phone to Chandler) And again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on phone) Hey Mr. Kostelic! How's life on the fifteenth floor?
(Listens) Yeah, I miss you too. (Listens) Yeah, it's a lot less satisfying to steal pens
from your own home, you know? (Listens) Well, that's very generous (Listens) er, but look,
this isn't about the money. I need something that's more than a job. I need something I
can really care about.... (Listens) And that's on top of the yearly bonus structure you
mentioned earlier? (Listens) Look, Al, Al... I'm not playing hardball here, OK? This is
not a negotiation, this is a rejection! (Listens) No! No! No, stop saying numbers! I'm
telling you, you've got the wrong guy! You've got the wrong guy! (Listens) I'll see you on
Monday! (slams the phone down)

scenes.location: Chandler's new window office, he is showing Phoebe around.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (excited) Wow! It's huge! It's so much bigger than the cubicle. Oh, this
is a cube.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look at this! (he opens the curtain to a view of New York City)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! You have a window!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes indeedy! (they look outside) With a beautiful view of...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh look! That guy's peeing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (walks away from window) OK, that's enough of the view. Check this
out, look at this. Sit down, sit down.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sitting) OK.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is great! (he presses a button on his intercom) Helen, could you
come in here for a moment?
(An unamused woman walks into the office.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you Helen, that'll be all.
(She leaves, obviously perturbed.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Last time I do that, I promise.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is on the phone. Rachel walks in and overhears the
conversation.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shouting on phone) Wendy, we had a deal! (Listens) Yeah, you promised!
Wendy! Wendy! Wendy! (hangs up)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who was that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wendy bailed. I have no waitress.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... that's too bad. Bye bye. (she walks away towards the door)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ten dollars an hour.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Twelve dollars an hour.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mon. I wish I could, but I've made plans to walk around.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know, Rachel, when you ran out of your wedding, I was there for you.
I put a roof over your head, and if that means nothing to you... (Rachel isn't buying it,
desperate) twenty dollars an hour.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Done.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, later. Rachel is waitressing, Monica is cooking. Phoebe
walks in with Steve (Crystal Duck winner Jon Lovitz).]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well hello! Welcome to Monica's. May I take your coat?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi Steve!

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Hello, Monica. (to Rachel) Hello, greeter girl.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Steve) This is Rachel.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: (unconcerned) Yeah, OK.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (overemphasizing) Mmmmmm! Everything smells so delicious! You know, I
can't remember a time I smelt such a delicious combination of (Monica signals her to stop)
of, OK, smells.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: It's a lovely apartment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, thank you. Would you like a tour?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: I was just being polite, but, alright.
(They leave on the tour and Rachel goes to follow them but Phoebe stops her and drags
her into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What's up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (whispers) In the cab, on the way over, Steve blazed up a doobie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Smoked a joint? You know, lit a bone? Weed? Hemp? Ganja?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK, OK. I'm with you, Cheech. OK.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: (from the living room) Is it dry in here? (licks his lips)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let me, let me get you some wine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I think we're ready for our first course. (Steve sits, Monica
brings over a tray) OK, um, these are rot-shrimp ravioli, and celantro pondou sauce...
(Steve starts to eat them one by one, quickly)... with just a touch of mints... and... (he
finishes)... ginger.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Well, smack my ass and call me Judy! These are fantastic!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm so glad you liked them!

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Like 'em? I could eat a hundred of them!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, well... um, that's all there are of these. But in about eight and a
half minutes, we'll be serving some delicious onion tartlets.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Tartlets. Tartlets. Tartlets. The word has lost all meaning. (he gets up
and goes into the kitchen)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me? Can I help you with anything?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: You know, I don't know what I'm looking for.
(Rachel tries to get Monica's attention to tell her Steve is stoned. She pretends to
drag on a joint, and Monica thinks she's giving her the 'OK' signal. Then Rachel does it
again, inhaling deeply this time. Monica waves it off as though she doesn't believe it.)

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: (from kitchen) Ah, cool! Taco shells! (Rachel motions, "You
see!") You know, these are... they're like a little corn envelope.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (joining him and taking the taco shells) You know that? You don't want
to spoil your appetite.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: (looking in cabinets) Hey! Sugar-O's! (grabs the cereal box)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know, if you just wait another... six and a half minutes...

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Macaroni and cheese! We gotta make this!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, we don't. (reaches for box)

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Oh, OK. (he drops the box on the floor) Oh, sorry. (When she bends down
to pick it up he grabs a package of Gummi-bears from the cabinet.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don't you just have a seat here? (he sits at the table, then tries
to secretly eat the Gummi-bears. Monica spots him.) OK... give me the Gummi-bears.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: (childishly) No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Give them to me.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Alright, we'll share.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, give me the...

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Well then you can't have any. (she grabs for the package, and it breaks
open. Gummi-bears fly everywhere, some into the punch bowl on the table.) Bear overboard!
I think he's drowning. (he throws some Sugar-O's into the punch bowl) Hey fellows! Grab on
a Sugar-O... save yourself! (Mimicking the bears) "Help! I'm drowning!
Help!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (furious) That's it! Dinner is over!

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why? It's just that I've waited seven years for an opportunity like
this, and you can't even wait four and a half minutes for a stupid onion tartlet?
(The oven goes off.)

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: (excited) Hey!

scenes.location: Central Perk, all are there except Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What a tool!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don't want to work for a guy like that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know... it's just... I thought this was, you know... it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, you'll get there. You're an amazing chef.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! You know all those yummy noises? I wasn't faking.
(Ross gets up and goes over to the counter and Joey follows him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross) So, er... how did it go with Celia?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I was unbelievable.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was the James Michener of dirty talk. It was the most elaborate filth
you have ever heard. I mean, there were characters, plot lines, themes, a motif...
at one point there were villagers.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa! And the... (gestures with hands) huh-huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, ahem... you know, by the time we'd finished with all the dirty talk,
it was kinda late... and we were both kind of exhausted, so uh...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You cuddled.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, which was nice.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys wanna try and catch a late movie or something?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Maybe, but shouldn't we wait for Chandler?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, where the hell is he?

scenes.location: Chandler's office, he's on the phone, agitated.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on phone) Yes, Fran. I know what time it is, but I'm looking at the
WENUS and I'm not happy!... (Listens) Oh, really, really, really? Well, let me tell you
something... you will care about it, because I care about it! You got it? Good! (slams
phone down, then leans back and realizes what just happened) Whooooaaaa....

title: The One with Two Parts, Part 1

lines.text: [Scene: Rift’s Restaurant, as seen in Mad About You, Joey and Chandler are
there.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is unbelievable. It’s been like a half an hour. If this was a
cartoon, you’d be looking like a ham right about now.
(Ursula Buffay, Phoebe’s identical twin sister, is waiting on tables in her
inimitable manner.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There’s the waitress. Excuse me, Miss. Hello, Miss?
(Ursula spins around looking puzzled, quite unable to tell where the sound is coming
from.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s Phoebe! Hi!
(Ursula notices Joey waving his hand, and comes over.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Hi. Okay, will that be all?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait, wait! Wh-what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah, um, I was over there, then you said, "Excuse me, hello
Miss," so now I’m here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no... how come you are working here?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Right, yeah, ’cause its close to where I live, and the aprons are
really cute.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can we start over?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah. Okay great. I’m gonna be over here. (She wanders away.)

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: No, no, no!
Opening Credits
[Scene: A wintry February day in New York City, snowplows are clearing the streets.
Inside Central Perk, all three girls are paying court to Ross.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know whether he’s testing me, or just acting out, but my
monkey is out of control. But, he keeps erasing the messages on my machine,
"supposedly" by accident.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, yeah, I’ve done that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And then, like three days in a row he got to the newspaper before I did, and
peed all over the crossword.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ve never done that.
(Outside in the street, Joey and Chandler arrive, to peer through the window at Phoebe,
by bending down to look underneath the shop’s sign—a large steaming cup of
coffee.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, now look at her and tell me she doesn’t look exactly like
her sister.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sayin’ I see a difference.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They’re twins!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t care. Phoebe’s Phoebe. Ursula’s... hot!
(Joey and Chandler come indoors.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know that thing, when you and I talk to each other about things?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
