lines.text: Let’s not do that any more.
(They hang up their coats and scarves, then approach their friends on the main sofa.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey guys! Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, guess who we saw today.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, ooh, fun! Okay... um, Liam Neeson.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Morly Safer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The woman who cuts my hair!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, look, this could be a really long game.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Your sister Ursula.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Her face dropping) Oh, really.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, she works over at that place, uh...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rift’s. Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, you do? Because she said you guys haven’t talked in like years.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmmm? Yeah. So, um, is she fat?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not from where I was standin’.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Turning to Chandler) where were you standing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um, Pheebs, so, you guys just don’t get along?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s mostly just dumb sister stuff, you know, I mean, like, everyone
always thought of her as the pretty one, you know... Oh, oh, she was the first one to
start walking, even though I did it... later that same day. But, to my parents, by then it
was like "yeah, right, well what else is new?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, Pheebs, I’m sorry, I’ve got to go. I’ve got Lamaze class.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, and I’ve got Earth Science, but I'll catch you in Gym.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, is this just gonna be you and Carol?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, Susan’s gonna be there too. We’ve got dads, we’ve got
lesbians, the whole parenting team.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, isn’t, isn’t that gonna be weird?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no. (Distractedly putting on a jacket to go out) I mean, it mighta been
at first, but by now I, I think I’m pretty comfortable with the whole situation.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, that’s my jacket.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know.
(Rachel grins as Ross removes the girlie jacket, grabs his own, and rushes out.)
[Scene: The Lamaze class, several couples and one trio sit on the floor, introducing
themselves to the teacher, who’s got as far as a woman sitting next to Ross, Carol,
and Susan.]

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, we’re the Rostins. Err, I’m J.C., and he’s Michael, and
we’re having a boy, and a girl.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Good for you. Alrighty, next?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi, um, I’m err, (has to clear his throat) I’m Ross Geller, and err
ah... (pats Carol’s bulge) ..that’s, that’s my boy in there, and uh,
(points) this is Carol Willick, and this... is Susan Bunch. Susan is um Carol’s,
just, com... (embarrassment finally overwhelms the poor fellow, who becomes incoherent
until) ..who’s next?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: I’m sorry, I didn’t get... Susan is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Susan is Carol’s, Carol’s, Carol’s, friend...

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Life partner.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Like buddies.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Like lovers.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know how close women can get.
(The teacher smiles, but her eyebrows go up. Susan and Carol pat each other
affectionately.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Susan and I live together.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Although I was married to her.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Carol, not me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Err, right.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: It’s a little complicated.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A little.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: But we’re fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Absolutely. (Turns back to the woman next to him.) So, twins... hah!
That’s like two births. (He struggles again.) Ouch.
[Scene : Chandler's Office, Chandler is working.]
(Helen’s buzzer is heard on the intercom, so Chandler presses his button, too.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And (he imitates the buzzer) to you too, Helen.

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.text: (Over the intercom) Nina Bookbinder is here to see you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, okay. Send her in.
(He hurriedly checks his hair in his computer screen, before taking a sporting trophy
from a drawer to place ostentatiously on his desk. An attractive young woman opens the
door.)

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, Nina. Come on in.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: You wanted to see me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, Yes. Yes. I’ve just been going over your data here, and little
thing, you’ve been post-dating your Friday numbers.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Which is bad, because?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it throws my WENUS out of whack.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Your... excuse me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: WENUS. (Coughs) Weekly Estimated Net...

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Oh, Net Usage Statistics, right. Gotcha, gotcha. Won’t happen again. I
wouldn’t want to do anything to hurt your... "wenus."
(Nina beams flirtatiously at Chandler, who catches her drift, but for once he’s
lost for something to say – so she nods her head to tell him that he’s
thinking correctly...)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Ross, Chandler, and the girls are dividing some Chinese
takeout, while the sitcom Family Matters is playing on the TV.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s not just that she’s cute, okay. It’s just that...
she’s really really cute.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It doesn’t matter. You don’t dip your pen in the company ink.
(Marcel scampers about, interfering with the neatness.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, your little creature’s got the remote again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel, Marcel, give Rossie the remote. Marcel. Marcel, you give Rossie the
remote right now... Marce... you give Rossie the remote...
(Marcel points the remote at Monica’s television, pressing a particular
combination of keys. The logo SAP appears on the screen, and suddenly the dialogue is
dubbed into Spanish.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Relax, I’ll fix it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Looking at the television) Cool... "Urkel" in Spanish is
"Urkel."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking at the remote) How did he do this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Looking out at the balcony) So tell me something, is leaving the
Christmas lights up part of your plan to keep us merry all year long?
(Rachel slowly spins around, finally noticing that the lights have outstayed their
welcome.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ah no, you see, someone was supposed to take them down around New
Year’s... but obviously someone forgot.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, someone was supposed to write "Rach, take down the
lights" and put it on the re... frigerate... (finally noticing Monica’s note
stuck to the refrigerator) How long has that been there?
(Joey enters, looking extremely pleased with himself.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, where you been?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I went back to Riff’s. I think Ursula likes me. All I ordered was
coffee, she brought me a tuna meltt and four
plates of curly fries.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Score.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She is so hot!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, listen. Okay, before you do anything Joey-like, you might wanna run
it by err... (he indicates Phoebe, who is helping Ross understand the remote control.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Jumping up) Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You think it would be okay if I asked out your sister?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why? Why would you wanna... do that? Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So that if we went out on a date, she’d be there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I mean, I’m not my sister’s, you know, whatever, and um...
I mean, it’s true, we were one egg, once, but err, you know, we’ve grown apart,
so, um... I don’t know, why not? Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Cool, thanks.
(He happily gestures at Chandler that there was nothing to worry about, then exits.
Rachel and Monica are concerned for poor Phoebe, who slides back down next to Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah I’m fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You wanna watch Laverne y Shirley?
(The sitcom begins with its familiar refrain, yet with a Latin lilt. Rachel and Monica
do a little dance with their chopsticks, and Phoebe has to grin as Ross joins in the
rhythm.)
[Scene: Lamaze class. Susan is there. Each couple has a doll, for they have just
finished learning how to change a diaper. As Ross rushes in, stepping on the Rostins’
pretend baby, squashing its head flat. It bleats, in protest. He performs emergency
surgery, then hands the doll back to J.C.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi. Sorry I’m late. Where’s, where’s Carol?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Stuck at school. Some parent-teacher thing. You can go. I’ll get the
information.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No... No... No. I think I should stay, I think we should both know
what’s going on.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh, good. This’ll be fun.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Alrighty. We’re gonna start with some basic third stage breathing
exercises, so Mummies, why don’t you get on your back? And... coaches, you should be
supporting Mummy’s head.
(Ross and Susan each gesture for the other to lie down.)

lines.speaker: Ross and Susan
lines.text: What? What? What?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: I am supposed to be the mommy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I’m gonna play my sperm card one more time.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Look, I don’t see why I should have to miss out on the coaching
training just because I’m a woman.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I see. So what do you propose to do?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: I will flip you for it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Flip me for it? No, no, no... heads, heads, heads!

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: (Triumphantly) On your back... Mom.
(Ross gets down like all the other mothers, cradled in Susan’s lap like all the
other fathers.)

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Alright, Mommies, take a nice deep cleansing breath.
(Forgetting herself, Susan does the "Mommy" action with Ross.)

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Good. Now imagine your vagina is opening like a flower.
(Ross comes out of character to glare into the distance.)
[Scene: Chandler's Office. Chandler is playing with a toy as his boss Mr. Douglas
knocks and opens the door.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mr. D, how’s it going, sir?

lines.speaker: Mr. Douglas
lines.text: Ohh, it’s been better. The Annual Net Usage Statistics are in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Mr. Douglas
lines.text: It’s pretty ugly. We haven’t seen an ANUS this bad since the
seventies.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So what does this mean?

lines.speaker: Mr. Douglas
lines.text: Well, we’re gonna be layin’ off people in every department.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, listen, I know I came in late last week, but I slept funny, and my
hair was very very –

lines.speaker: Mr. Douglas
lines.text: Not you. Relax. Ever have to fire anyone?

scenes.location: Chandler's Office, later that day, Nina is in his office.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nina? Nina. (He goes around his desk to where she is sitting.) Nina. (In
pain) Nina.
(She sympathetically reaches out to fondle the inner thigh of his left leg.)

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Looking down at her hand) Yes, yes I am. Err, listen, the reason that I
called you in here today was, err... please don’t hate me.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: (Taking her hand away) What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Suddenly bright) Would you like to have dinner sometime?
(Nina gasps in surprise and relief.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is at the counter, serving coffee to Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So Pheebs, what do you want for your birthday?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, what I really want is for my mom to be alive and enjoy it with me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay... Let me put it this way. Anything from Crabtree and Evelyn?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! Bath salts would be nice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, okay... good.
(Jamie Buchman and Fran Devanow enter the coffee house. They look about them as Jamie
removes her coat and scarf.)

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: What is this place?

lines.speaker: Fran
lines.text: Look, you’re cold, I have to pee, and... (indicating the sign)
..there’s a cup of coffee on the window. How bad could it be?
(Jamie notices Phoebe sitting at the counter.)

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: I think we have an answer.

lines.speaker: Fran
lines.text: What’s she doing here?

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: This could be God’s way of telling us to eat at home.

lines.speaker: Fran
lines.text: Think she got fired at Riff’s?

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: No, no, no. We were there last night. She kept... (shuddering at the memory)
..bringing swordfish. (Indicating the ladies’ bathroom) are you gonna go to the, um?

lines.speaker: Fran
lines.text: I’m gonna wait till after we order. It’s her, right.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: It looks like her.
(Phoebe walks by, ignoring the two strangers.)

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Um, excuse me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Hi, it’s us.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Smiling blankly) Right, and it’s me.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: So, so you’re here too?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Much as you are.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: (Without moving her lips) Your turn.

lines.speaker: Fran
lines.text: Err... we know what we want.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Philosophically) Oh, that’s good.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: All we want is two Caffe Lattes.

lines.speaker: Fran
lines.text: And some biscottie cookies.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good choice.
(Phoebe turns away so that the two weird women won’t see the face she pulls, and
sits down.)

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Definitely her.

lines.speaker: Fran
lines.text: Yeah.
Commercial break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel’s, Phoebe is watching a Spanish version
of The Waltons. At a nearby table sit Monica knitting, Rachel winding a ball of wool, and
Chandler supplying them both from a skein which is spread between his hands.]
(Phoebe uses the remote to stop the Spanish by turning off the television.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t believe you. You still haven’t told that girl she
doesn’t have a job yet?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you still haven’t taken down the Christmas lights.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Congratulations, I think you’ve found the world’s thinnest
argument.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m just trying to find the right moment, you know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well, that shouldn’t be so hard, now that you’re dating.
(Imitating men at their worst) "Sweetheart, you’re fired, but how ’bout a
quickie before I go to work?"
(Joey lets himself in, carrying a large paper shopping bag.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel and Chandler
lines.text: Hey.
(There is a loud knocking at the door through which Joey has just entered.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, once you’re inside, you don’t have to knock any more.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’ll get it.
(She rises, dragging Chandler along by the wool. Rachel has to leap over a chair to
follow them. Monica opens the door to find Mr. Heckles standing there.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. Hi, Mr.Heckles.

lines.speaker: Mr.Heckles
lines.text: You’re doing it again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re not doing anything. We’re just sitting around talking,
quietly.

lines.speaker: Mr.Heckles
lines.text: I can hear you through the ceiling. My cats can’t sleep.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don’t even have cats.

lines.speaker: Mr.Heckles
lines.text: I could have cats.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Closing the door) Goodbye Mr.Heckles.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’ll try to keep it down.
(The wool-bound trio returns to the table. Rachel has to rush ahead to avoid becoming
tangled. Joey brings the shopping bag over to Phoebe, and takes out a nice cardigan.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phoebe, could you do me a favour? Could you try this on? I just wanna make
sure it fits.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, my first birthday present... (delightedly examining the cardigan in
her lap) ..oh, this is really...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, no no no. It’s for Ursula. I just figured, you know, size-wise.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohhh... Sure, yeah... (disgustedly dropping the cardigan back into the bag)
..okay, it fits.
(The others have been taking all this in.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you seein’ her again tonight?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yep. Ice Capades.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow, this is serious. I’ve never known you to pay money for any kind
of capade.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know. I like her, you know. She’s different. There’s
uh, somethin’ about her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That you like, (snappily confronting Joey over the heads of the knitting
circle) we get it. You like her. Great!
(The circle freezes in apprehension.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Phoebe, I asked you, and you said it was okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, well, maybe now it’s not okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay... Well maybe now I’m not okay with it not being okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
(An embarrassed silence... finally broken by)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Knit, good woman, knit, knit!
(Monica frantically bursts into action as Rachel resumes winding, tangling
Chandler’s wool.)
[Scene: Chandler's Office, Chandler & Nina are locked in a passionate embrace.
Someone knocks, so they hurriedly separate to stare out of the window. Chandler’s
boss opens the door.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And that’s the Chrysler Building right there.

lines.speaker: Mr. Douglas
lines.text: Nina.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Mr.Douglas... (flirting defensively) ..cool tie.
(She escapes, fortunately so distracting Mr. Douglas, that he misses Chandler’s
expression of alarm & guilt.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Douglas
lines.text: (Shutting the door, then pointing vaguely at Nina’s shapely
departure) She’s still here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, yes she is. Didn’t I memo you on this? See, after I let her go,
err, I got a call from her psychiatrist, Dr. Flanen-nen, Dr. Flanen, Dr. Flan.
(Thinking quickly, Chandler desperately tries to remember anything to do with
schizophrenia....)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And err, he informed me that uh, she took the news rather badly, in fact,
he uh, mentioned the word frenzy.

lines.speaker: Mr. Douglas
lines.text: You’re kidding? She seems so...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, no, no. Nina... (miming fairies twinkling around his head) ..she is
whooo wewee-woo whoo whoo! In fact, if you asked her right now, she would have no
recollection of being fired at all, none at all.

lines.speaker: Mr. Douglas
lines.text: That’s unbelievable.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And yet, believable. So I decided not to fire her again until I can be
assured that she will be no threat to herself, or others.

lines.speaker: Mr. Douglas
lines.text: I see. I guess you never really know what’s goin’ on inside
a person’s head.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I guess that’s why they call it psychology, sir.
(Mr. Douglas screws up his eyes, trying to credit what Bing has just said, but turning
to follow Nina down the corridor, he realises Bing must be telling the truth, since he
would not have any personal interest in the girl, would he?)
[Scene: Lamaze class, Ross is again on the floor, cradled in Susan’s lap, but now
Carol is cradled in his lap, and she has a pretend baby, on her lap. The teacher is
showing her class a video, which is about to end.]

lines.speaker: Soothing male voice
lines.text: ..a sound Mom and Dad never forget. For this after all, is the
miracle of birth.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Lights please? And that’s having a baby. Next week is our final
class.
(People start getting up. Ross grabs Carol’s doll to hold it upside down like a
football, slapping it with his other hand.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Susan, go deep.
(Susan just glares back, as Ross’s inappropriate joke falls flat. Meanwhile, a
bubble is about to burst...)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: This is impossible. It’s just impossible.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: What is, honey?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: What that woman... did. I am not doin’ that. It’s just
gonna have to stay in, that’s all, everything will be the same, it’ll just stay in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Carol, honey, shhh, shhh, everything’s gonna be alright.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (screaming at Ross) Oh, what do you know? No one's going up to you and
saying, "Hi, is that your nostril? Mind if we push this pot roast
through it?"

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Carol, Carol, sweetie. Cleansing breath.
(Both women gulp in air. Ross looks at his "football," then manipulates the
head & limbs back into place, until it resembles what it represents.)

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: I know it’s frightening, but, big picture. The birth part is just one
day, and when it’s over, we’re all gonna be parents for the rest of our lives.
(Ross is staring blankly into space.)

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: I mean, that’s what this is all about, right? Ross? Ross?
[Scene 13: Central Perk, the gang is gathered around Monica comforting her brother, who
in a slight state of shock is cuddling a cushion for security.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m gonna be a father.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This is just occurring to you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I always knew I was havin’ a baby, I just never realised the baby was
having me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (She comforts him too) Oh, you’re gonna be great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aw, how can you say that? I can’t even get Marcel to stop eating the
bath mat. How am I gonna raise a kid?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, Ross, some scientists are now saying that, that monkeys and
babies are actually different.
(Joey tires of this, so he gets up to leave.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where’re you going?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: With?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Spreading his arms wide) Yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, could I just ask you one question?
(Joey nods his head.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Have you two, you know... like... you know... you know... yet?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, not that it’s any of your business, but, no, we haven’t,
okay?
(Joey walks toward the door, then hesitates and turns back.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You meant sex, right?
(Phoebe buttons her lip, while the rest of the gang pretend they’re not there.)

scenes.location: Chandler's Office, Chandler is working as Nina knocks, then opens the door.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Do you have a sec?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, sure, Nina. What’s up?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I don’t know. For the past couple days, people have been avoiding
me and giving me these really strange looks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, well, ah... maybe that’s because they’re ah... jealous, of
us.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Maybe. But that doesn’t explain why they keep taking my scissors.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, well, maybe that’s, ah, because you’re getting a big raise.

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I am?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure, why not?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Oh my god! (Rushing over to give him a big hug) You’re amazing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, you don’t know. (Presses a button.) Helen, could you make sure
we put through the paperwork on Miss Bookbinder’s raise?

lines.speaker: Helen
lines.text: (Over the intercom) So you still want me to send her psychological profile
to Personnel?

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Helen drinks. (Insincerely) Will you marry me?
(Nina puts her hands on her hips, then gives Chandler a quizzical look.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel’s, Ross, Rachel, Chandler, and Phoebe are sharing a bowl
of popcorn, while Monica carefully reads the instruction manual for her television set.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I ended up telling her everything.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, how’d she take it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pretty well. Except for the stapler thing. (He holds up a bandaged hand.)

lines.speaker: Little tip
lines.text: if you’re ever in a similar situation, never ever leave your
hand... (he mimes Nina taking her revenge) ..on the desk.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I think I get how to do this.
(Monica points the remote at her TV, and punches out a key combination from the book,
but the dreaded SAP logo remains and Spanish still comes forth.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, so, can we turn this off? Can we just make it... make them go
away? Because I can’t, I can’t watch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Remotely turning off the television) okay, Pheebs, they’re gone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you alright?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. It’s just, you know, it’s this whole stupid Ursula
thing, it’s...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, Pheebs, can I ask? So, he’s going out with her. I mean, is it
really so terrible?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, yeah. Look, I mean, I’m not saying she’s like evil or
anything. She just, you know, she’s always breaking my stuff. When I was
eight, and I wouldn’t let her have my Judy Jetson thermos, so she threw it under the
bus. And then, oh, and then there was Randy Brown, who was like... Have you ever had a
boyfriend who was like your best friend?

lines.speaker: Monica and Rachel
lines.text: (Wistfully, shaking their heads) No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, but that’s what he was for me. And she you know, kind of stole
him away, and then... broke his heart... and then he wouldn’t even talk to me
any more. Because he said he didn’t wanna be around... anything that looked
like either one of us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... Oh, Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I mean, I know Joey is not my boyfriend, or my thermos, or anything, but...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re not gonna lose him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hon, you gotta talk to Joey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, come on, he doesn’t know this stuff. If he knew how you felt.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But he’s falling in love with her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh please, they’ve been going out a week. They haven’t even slept
together yet, I mean, that’s not serious.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay... Okay.
(Monica and Ross indicate that they mean right now.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, oh.
(Phoebe gets up and walks across the hallway, but the door to Chandler and Joey’s
apartment is shut. She knocks, and anxiously waits for Joey to come, but instead her
identical twin sister emerges wearing one of Joey’s shirts.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: (Surprised) Oh.
(Phoebe reels back in shock, while Ursula defiantly leans against the doorpost as
though she owns the place.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah, um, may we help you?

title: The One with Two Parts, Part 2

lines.text: Opening Credits
[Scene: An Emergency Room, Rachel and Monica enter. Rachel is limping and leaning
on Monica for support.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow ow ow. Ow ow ow ow. Ow ow ow. Ow. Ow. Ow. Ow.
(They reach the desk. The bored nurse thinks she's heard it all before.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi. Uh, my friend here was taking down our Christmas lights, and and she
fell off the balcony and may have broken her foot or or ankle or something.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: My god. You still have your Christmas lights up?
(Rachel glares at the nurse, who gives Monica a form attached to a clipboard.)

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Fill this out and bring it back to me.
(Monica helps Rachel over to a vacant seat.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow ow ow. Ow ow ow. Ow ow ow.
(Monica starts on the form, while Rachel catches her breath and massages her ankle.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, ooh, alright. Name, address... Okay, in case of emergency, call?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, that is so sweet. (Touched, she puts an arm around her friend and
kisses her.) Oh gosh, love you. Insurance?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah, check it. Definitely, I want some of that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (No longer touched) you don't have insurance?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why, how much is this gonna cost?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I have no idea, but X-rays alone could be a couple hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wel-wel-well what are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well there's not much we can do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Like a big baby) Um... unless, unless I use yours.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hah, no no no no no no no no no no.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Tapping the clipboard) well, now, wait a second, who did I just put as
my "In case of emergency" person?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Looking around to check that no-one's listening, then lowering her
voice anyway) That's insurance fraud.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, alright, then, forget it. (Getting up to go) Might as well just go
home. Ow ow ow ow!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Jumping up to make Rachel sit down) Okay, okay. I hate this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you. I love you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the nurse) Hi, (tiny laugh) um, I'm gonna need a new set of (tiny
laugh) these forms (tiny laugh).

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Tiny laugh) I am really an idiot. (Tiny laugh) you see, I was filling
out my friend's form, and instead of putting her information, (tiny laugh) I put mine.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: You are an idiot. (She hands over a blank form).

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Tiny laugh) yep, that's me, (tiny laugh) I am that stupid (tiny
laugh).
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler, has split up his newspaper so Joey can look at the
funnies, while Ross's inappropriate joke at Lamaze class has come back to haunt him.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I had a dream last night where I was playing football with my kid.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: That's nice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, with him. (He mimes holding the baby like a football.) I'm
on this field, and they, they hike me the baby... and I, I know I've gotta do
something 'cause the Tampa Bay defence is comin' right at me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Tampa Bay's got a terrible team.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right, but, it is just me and the baby, so I'm thinkin' they can take us.
And so I uh, hah-hah, I just heave it down field.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you crazy? That's a baby!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He should take the sack?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway, suddenly I'm down field, and I realise that I'm the one
who's supposed to catch him, right? Only I know there is no way I'm gonna get there in
time, so I am running, and running, and that, that is when I woke up. See I, I am so
not ready to be a father.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you're gonna be fine. You're one of the most caring, most
responsible men in North America. You're gonna make a great dad.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, Ross. You and the baby just need better blocking.
(Feeling a little better, Ross fetches more coffee.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, have either one of you guys ever been to the Rainbow Room? Is it real
expensive?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, only if you order stuff.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm takin' Ursula tonight. It's her birthday.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wo-wo-whoa. What about Phoebe's birthday?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: When's that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, man. What're the odds of that happening?
(Joey begins to contemplate his ill fortune.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You take your time.
(Joey looks at his friends, thinks a bit more, then realises.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There it is! So what're you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What can I do? Look, I don't want to do anything to screw it up with
Ursula.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And your friend Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, if she's my friend, hopefully she'll understand. I mean, wouldn't
you guys?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Man, if you tried something like that on my birthday, you'd be
starin' at the business end of a hissy fit.
(Joey gestures to show that he wouldn't dare...)
[Scene: The Hospital, Monica and Rachel are waiting for the doctors to arrive.
They enter and are played by Noah Wyle and George Clooney.]

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: ..you add a pinch of saffron, it makes all the difference.
(They approach the young ladies. Dr. Mitchell consults Ms.Geller's admissions form.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: Okay, errrr, Monica?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes? (jumping as Rachel punches her arm) ..yes, she is.
Rachel (as Monica): Hi, this is my friend Rachel.
Monica (as Rachel): Hi.

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: (Smiling) Hi, err Rachel. I'm Dr.Mitchell.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: (Smiling even more and attempting to take over) And I'm his friend,
Dr.Rosen.
(Monica and Rachel smile back prettily.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aren't you a little cute to be a doctor?

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I meant er, (struggling to concentrate) young, young, I meant young,
young to be a doctor. Oh good, Rach.
Monica (as Rachel): Thank you.
Rachel (as Monica): Right.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, everyone but Joey is waiting for Phoebe to arrive for her
surprise birthday party. Rachel and Monica is telling Chandler about Rachel's
incident.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ..so, he said it was just a sprain, and that was it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, you left out the stupid part.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Not stupid. The very cute, cute, cute doctors asked us out for tomorrow
night, and I said "yes."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think it's totally insane, I mean, they work for the hospital. It's
like returning to the scene of the crime. You know, I say we blow off the dates.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Monica, they are cute, they are doctors, (spelling it out in the
air for her slow friend) cute doctors, doctors who are cute!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright, what have we learned so far?
(There is a knock at the door. Someone turns the music off, then the whole party runs
and hides, except for Monica and Rachel who answer their door. Ross stands in the doorway,
holding a box, but everyone is too keyed up to notice that it's him.)

lines.speaker: The Whole Party
lines.text: (Jumping up) SURPRISE!!!
(Ross is so startled that he throws his arms up to defend himself. The box takes off,
then lands with a squishy thud, its contents oozing out onto the floor. Ross is not
pleased.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What the hell are you doing? You scared the crap outta me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Was that the cake?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. I got a lemon schmush.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on, she'll be here any minute.
(The whole party gathers round as Ross puts the box on the coffee table.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I hope it's okay.
(As Ross opens the lid, everybody looks at the mess inside.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Reading) "Happy Birthday Peehe."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well maybe we can make a, a, a 'B' out of one of those roses.
(Phoebe quietly wanders in, to join the tableau.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Still annoyed) Yeah, we'll just use our special cake tools.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, what's going on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, we just...

lines.speaker: Phoebe's Friends
lines.text: (Finally noticing the guest of honour) Surprise!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Delighted) oh, oh, oh! This is so great! Oh my god! This was not at all
scary. Hi everybody. Hi Betty! Betty, Hi! (Thrilled) You found Betty! Oh my god! (Hugging
people) This is great. Everybody I love is in the same room, (still happy) Where's Joey?
(The party falls flat. Chandler tries to think of a witticism, but even he can't
help...)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did you see Betty?
(Betty waggles her fingers to say "Hi", but Phoebe feels her birthday has
been ruined by her twin.)
[Scene: A Restaurant, Ross is having lunch with his father who is examining his next
forkful.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I tell you one thing, I wouldn't mind having a piece of
this sun-dried tomato business. Five years ago, if somebody had said to me, here's a
tomato that looks like a prune, I'd say "get out of my office!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad, before I was born, did you freak out at all?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I'm not freaking out, I'm just saying, if somebody had
come to me with the idea andndash;

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad, dad, dad, I'm talkin' about the whole uh, baby thing. Did you uh,
ever get this sort of... panicky, "Oh my god I'm gonna be a father" kind of a
thing?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: No. Your mother really did the work. I was busy with the
business. I wasn't around that much. Is that what this is about?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, Dad, I was just wondering.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: 'Cause there's time to make up for that. We can do stuff
together. You always wanted to go to that Colonial Williamsburg. How 'bout we do that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks, Dad, really, I ju... you know, I just, I just needed to know,
um... when did you start to feel like a father?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Oh, well, I, I guess it musta been the day after you were
born. We were in the hospital room, your mother was asleep, and they brought you in and
gave you to me. You were this ugly little red thing, and all of a sudden you grabbed my
finger with your whole fist. And you squeezed it, so tight. And that's when I knew.
(Ross is so moved by his father's charming story, that he stops eating.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: So you don't wanna go to Williamsburg?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, we can go to Williamsburg.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Eat your fish.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is just getting off of the intercom and turns off
the TV which is still in the SAP mode.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, the cute doctors are here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her room) Okay, coming!
(Monica opens the door for Dr. Mitchell and Dr. Geoffrey.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, come on in.

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, Geoffrey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: Ah here, we brought wine.

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: Look at this, it's from the cellars of Ernest and Tova Borgnine,
so how could we resist?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that's great. Look at that.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: So, Monica, how's the ankle?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's uh...
(Rachel discreetly coughs to warn her.)
Monica (as Rachel): ..well, why don't you tell them? After all it, is
your ankle.
Rachel (as Monica): You know what, it's feeling a lot better, thank you, um...
Well, listen, why don't you two sit down and, and we'll get you some glasses... okay...
(They don't know what to do with their coats and Monica points to the living room) STAT!
(Rachel joins Monica who is in the kitchen area, opening the wine bottle. Rachel checks
that the doctors aren't listening, then lowers her voice anyway.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, listen, I'm thinking, why don't we just tell them who we really
are? I mean, it'll be fine, I really think it'll be fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It will not be fine. We'll get in trouble.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Monica! Would you stop being such a wuss?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A wuss? Excuse me for living in the real world, okay?
(Back at the couch, Dr. Mitchell and Dr. Rosen have concerns of their own.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: So... they sss-still seem normal.

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: That's because they are.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: (Nervously) okay, but you have to admit that every time we go out...
Women we meet at the hospital... It turns into...

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: Willya relax? Look around. No pagan altars, no piles of bones in
the corners, they're fine. (Baring his teeth to clean them with his finger) Go like this.
(Dr. Rosen obeys.)
(Meanwhile, back at the sink.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I said we are not going to do it, okay? Sometimes you can be such a, a
big baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Resenting the truth) I am not a baby! You know what? I swear to
god, just because you get so uptight every time we...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure, every time, you're such a princess...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What!?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (getting angry) What!!?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Every day, you are becoming more and more like your mother.
(Rachel brightly limps back across the apartment with glasses of wine for the cute
doctors, leaving an open-mouthed Monica in her wake.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello! Here we go!

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: This is a great place. How long have you lived here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) Thanks! I've been here about six years, and Rachel moved in
a few months ago.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) Yeah... (joining the others) ..see, I was supposed to get
married, but, um, I left the guy at the altar.
(Rachel tries to hide her alarm, but she squirms in her chair.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) Yeah... Yeah, I know it's pretty selfish, but haha, hey,
that's me. (Indicating a dish on the table) Why don't you try the hummus?

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: So, Monica, what do you do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) Aahh, I'm a... chef at a restaurant uptown.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: Good for you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) Yeah it is, mostly because I get to boss people
around, which I just love to do.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rosen
lines.text: This hummus is great.

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: God bless the chickpea.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) (Suddenly laughing) Oh, god, I am so spoiled... That's it!
(The doctors don't know what to make of all this.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) And by the way, have I mentioned that back in high school, I
was a cow?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) I used to wet my bed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) I use my breasts to get other people's attention.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) (Revealing her anger to point at her best friend) We both
do that!
(Rachel lets her anger show too. Hideously embarrassed, the doctors drain their glasses
in the vicious pause which follows. The telephone rings, but the girls just glower at each
other, silently daring the other to move first. Finally both guys jump up, and Michael
wins.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: (on the phone) Monica and Rachel's apartment. Err yeh, aayah, yeh,
just one second... (handing it to Monica) ..ah, Rachel, it's your dad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) Hi, Dad. No, no, it's me. (Getting up to move further away
from Rachel) li-listen, Dad, I can't talk right now, um, but there's something, um...
there's something that I've been meaning to tell you...
(Monica glares triumphantly across the room, scaring Rachel who also stands up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Would you excuse me for a second?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) Remember back in freshman year? (Talking fast before Rachel
can catch her) Well, Billy Dreskin and I had sex on your bed.
(Completely undone by Monica's verbal destruction, Rachel almost loses her balance as
she staggers backwards, eyes agog, gasping for breath, and literally not knowing which way
to turn. Finally, she escapes into the bathroom while a resigned Dr. Mitchell looks
philosophically at Dr. Rosen who seems about remind him of the good old days at the pagan
altar.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the next morning, Ross, Phoebe, Chandler and Monica sit
round the coffee table, playing Scrabble. Rachel, still in her dressing gown, is pleading
on the phone, her free hand shaking with agitation.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) Daddy... Daddy... Daddy, why whyyy would I sleep with Billy
Dreskin? His father tried to put you out of business! (Rachel turns to Monica, clasping
the receiver to her bosom so Dr.Green can't hear, while mouthing "You are...")
...dead!
(Monica smiles a sweet apology of regret, until she's distracted by Marcel as he
clambers all over her nice furniture.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, he's got the remote again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good. Maybe he can switch it back.
(Marcel changes channel to Bugs Bunny, who is speaking in Spanish.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe not.
(Meanwhile, Rachel has taken another call, from a nurse she'd hoped never to hear from
again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello? (Listens) Um, yeah, uh, (snapping her fingers at Ross who takes
the remote from Marcel, then turns off the TV) Okay ah, hold on a second, lemme lemme just
check and see if see if she's here.
(All animosity forgotten, Rachel holds the receiver out as she limps quickly over to
her friend, who stands up in concern.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's the woman from the hospital admissions office. She says there's a
problem with the form. Oh, god, oh god...

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: Oh god, waddawe do, waddawe do, waddawe do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know! Why don't you just explain? What do they want? Find out
what they want!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay (desperately hands the receiver over) no, you do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (taking the phone) Hello, this is Monica... Yeah??? Oh... (Smiles at
Rachel to reassure her) Okay, yes, we'll be right, we'll be right down.(Listens) Thank
you. (Hangs up)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We forgot to sign one of the admissions forms.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh... (slumping in relief) Okay, you were right. You were right! This
was just not worth it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, let me just change.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes.
(Rachel goes to her room.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering quietly) Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross and Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Trouble?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Your sister stood me up the other night.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, no. Don't you hate it when people aren't there for
you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well did you try calling her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I've been trying for two days. When I called the restaurant, they said she
was too busy to talk. I can't believe she's blowin' me off.
(Phoebe wants to be angry with Joey, but as she watches him shaking his head in pain
and disbelief, she knows that it isn't his fault.)
[Scene: Riff's, Phoebe is entering. Ursula returns with two plates of chicken, but she
only has time to set one on the table, when...]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.
(Ursula turns in surprise.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um you, you got a minute?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Um, yeah, I'm just... (waving dismissively at the concept) ..working.
(Ursula points out a vacant table, so the twins walk over, side by side, to sit down.
Departing customers walk right past the pair. Sitting at the back, a hungry gentleman
looks most annoyed as Ursula sets his meal down in front of her. The girls sit.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Uh-huh.
(Ursula is genuinely pleased that her sister has visited her, after so many years.
Phoebe hesitates over how best to begin.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, oh, I got you a birthday present.
(Ursula picks up a fork and begins eating the meat, while Phoebe removes a present from
her bag.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Oh, wow! You remembered! (Opening it) Oh! It's a Judy Jetson thermos!
(She laughs at the childhood memory. Phoebe smiles at being able to make her point.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Right, like the kind you...

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Right... Oh, I got something for you, too.
(Ursula gets up to fetch a box from her bag by the counter.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How'd you know I was coming?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Um, yeah, um, twin thing.
(Ursula puts the box directly into Phoebe's hand. Phoebe brightens.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can't believe you did this.
(Phoebe opens the box, to find something familiar inside.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can't believe you... (holding up Joey's cardigan) ..did this.
(Phoebe's smile hardens as she packs the cardigan away.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So... What's the deal with umm, you and Joey?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Oh, right. He is so great. But that's over.
(Ursula resumes eating her lunch..)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Does he know?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey. You know, um, he's really nutsy about you.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: He is? Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You got me.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Right.
(A waiter comes over for the stolen chicken. Ursula turns to him.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Excuse me. Doesn't this come with a side salad?
(The man gives up, shaking his head.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, um, are you gonna call him?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: What? (Indicating the departing waiter) Do you think he likes me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, Joey.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Oh. No, no, he is so smart. He'll figure it out. (Offering to share her
food) Do you want some chicken?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. No food with a face.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: You have not changed!
(Ursula's eyes dance as she laughs and smiles, simply glad to be back with her sister.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you too.
(Trying not to wrinkle her nose, Phoebe smiles back realising it's down to her to make
up for her negligent sister. Meanwhile, Ursula still hasn't received her side salad, but
when she attempts to attract the waiter's attention, he ignores her.)
[Scene: The Emergency Room. The officious admissions nurse is again on duty. Rachel and
Monica enter, looking worried. As they approach the desk, Rachel adopts a winning smile,
while Monica struggles to smile at all.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) Hi, remember us?

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: (Grimacing) Mmm hmmm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) Um, okay. You just called a little while ago about needing a
signature on the admissions form. Well, it turns out we need a whole new one
(little laugh) because uh, you see, I-I, I put the wrong name again. (Little laugh) 'cause
um...

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: You're that stupid.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) I am. I'm that stupid. (Little laugh.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) Yeah, and and, I'm just gonna pay for this with a check.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Well, you know your insurance will cover that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) Yeah, I know... (mirroring her friend) ..I'm I'm just not
that bright either.
(The girls escape with a new form.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler is neglecting the game of Scrabble, for
he's busily drawing on his own childhood in an attempt to help Ross. Marcel chitters
about.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, worst case scenario. Say you never feel like a father.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Say your son never feels connected to you, as one. Say all of his
relationships are affected by this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you have a point?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, you think I would.
(Instead of scampering, Marcel stretches his neck as much as possible, and makes an
unvoiced noise from his throat.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What's up with the simian?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's just a fur ball.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay... (returning to the board) ..whose turn is it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yours, I just got 43 points for 'KIDNEY'.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, you got zero points for 'IDNEY'.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I had a 'K'. Where's where's my 'K'?
(The unvoiced hissing continues. In alarm, Ross and Chandler look at the monkey, who is
now in some distress.)
[Scene: The Emergency Room, Monica sits with Rachel, who is filling out an honest form
at last. Ross and Chandler hurtle in. Little Marcel, wrapped in a fluffy towel, is cradled
in Ross's arms. They dash up to the admissions desk. Ross is frantic.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You've got to help me my monkey swallowed a 'K'!
(Hearing her brother's voice, Monica gets up to stand behind Chandler, followed by
Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: (angrily) You go get that animal outta here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no you don't understand the animal hospital is way across town he's
choking I don't know what else to do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What's goin' on?
(Ross and Chandler turn at the voice...)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Marcel swallowed a Scrabble tile.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.
(..then turn back to the desk when the surprise hits them, and Ross and Chandler whip
around once more. Monica and Rachel recoil slightly.)

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Excuse me... This hospital is for people!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Lady, he is people. He has a name, okay? He watches Jeopardy!
He he touches himself when nobody's watching. Please, please have a heart!
(Ross's vigorous protest is attracting attention.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: I'll take a look at him.
(Rachel, Monica, Ross and Chandler whip around for a second time, in formation.)

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: Oh, thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Michael.

lines.speaker: Dr. Mitchell
lines.text: Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) Monica.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (as Rachel) Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Monica) Hi.
(Monica smiles to cover her embarrassment, but Rachel sadly looks away...)
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey is playing "She Loves Me, She Loves Me Not" with
the petals of a flower, alternately looking hopeful and annoyed. Phoebe enters, but not as
herself, for she has changed the style of her hair and make-up to match that of her twin
sister. She hangs up her coat, revealing her new cardigan. Nervously, she smooths out the
identifying garment, approaching Joey who sits next to the main sofa.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as Ursula) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Urse...
(Phoebe nods as he stands up in delight.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ..ah, what're you doing here? I've been trying to call you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as Ursula) Listen, um...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no, don't say "listen." I know that "listen."
I've said that "listen."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as Ursula) I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't get it. What happened? What about everything you said under the
bridge?
(Phoebe is almost thrown by this.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as Ursula): Yeah, um... (nervously clears her throat) You know you, you
should just forget about what I said under the bridge, I was talkin' crazy that
night, I was so drunk!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don't drink.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as Ursula) That's right, I don't... But I was, I was drunk on you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, Urse... (He tries to take her in his arms, but she fends him off.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as Ursula) Okay, yeah, so it's not gonna work.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why? Is it because I'm friends with Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as Ursula) If it was, would you stop hanging out with her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Thinking carefully) no. No, I, I couldn't do that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as Ursula) Um, then yes, it's 'cause of Phoebe! So, you know, it's
either her or me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then, uh, then I'm sorry.
(He sinks to the sofa, saddened by Ursula's ultimatum, while Phoebe follows, touched by
Joey's good heart.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (as Ursula) You know... (unconsciously putting a hand on his knee)
You're gonna be really, really hard to get over.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know...
(He looks up at her face and Phoebe, slipping out of character, smiles back at him.
Joey's voice becomes soft and warm.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know whether it's just 'cause we're breakin' up or... what, but
you have never looked so beautiful.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?
(Phoebe smiles, when Joey takes her face in his hands and kisses her. Joey gets up to
leave but stops suddenly. Phoebe silently shouts "Oh, whoa!!" to herself, and
leans back in the sofa to recover, a hand to her tingling lips. A thoughtful Joey is also
feeling his lips, so he hesitates for a moment, then returns for a better view, he
thinks again, cocking his head from side to side to regard her profile from various
angles, then...)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Automatically) Yeah. Oooh... (she's sprung.)
[Scene: The Hospital, Marcel lies on the operating table while recovering from the
anaesthetic, tucked up under a sheet like an infant in a huge bed. Ross sits beside him,
as a smiling Chandler, Monica and Rachel look on.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He looks so tiny.
(The door bursts open, and Joey and Phoebe rush in.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We just got the message.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Is he alright?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. The doctor got the 'K' out. He also found an 'M' and an 'O'.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We think he was trying to spell out 'MONKEY.'
(Ross does not approve of Chandler's daft theory.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, the doctor says he's gonna be fine, he's just sleeping now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Tapping Ross on his shoulder) So, you feel like a dad yet?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, come on, you came through, you did what you had to do. That is
very dad.
(Ross does approve of this, but he's still not sure. The tiny figure stirs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, look, he's waking up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Quietly) hey, fella! How you doing?
(All of a sudden, Marcel grabs Ross's finger with his whole fist, and he squeezes it,
so tight, that Ross finally knows what it is to be a father. He looks up at his friends,
who smile encouragingly, Rachel tenderly resting her chin upon Monica's shoulder. Ross
realises that Chandler was right and he's gonna make a great dad!)

title: The One with All the Poker

lines.text: (The whole gang is helping Rachel mail out resumes while whistling the theme from The
Bridge on the River Kwai.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, Rach, we're running low on resumes over here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you really want a job with Popular Mechanics?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, if you're gonna work for mechanics, those are the ones to work
for.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, look, you guys, I'm going for anything here, OK? I cannot be a
waitress anymore, I mean it. I'm sick of the lousy tips, I'm sick of being called 'Excuse

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, did you proofread these?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh... yeah, why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, nothing, I'm sure they'll be impressed with your excellent compuper
skills.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (upset) Oh my Goood! Oh, do you think it's on all of them?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no, I'm sure the Xerox machine caught a few.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross and Chandler are sitting at a table. Rachel is working.
Monica and Phoebe enter.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey... hi, ladies... uh, can I get you anything? (to Monica, quietly):
Did you bring the mail?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Lots of responses.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica): Really? (out loud): Sure, we have scones left! (to Monica):
OK, read them to me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading): Dear Ms. Green, thank you for your inquiry, however... oh...
(crumples up letter)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (out loud): We have apple cinnamon...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (reading): OK... Dear Ms. Green... yeah... yeah... yeah... No. (crumpes
up letter)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading): Your Visa bill is huge!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (grabs the bill) Give me that!
(Camera cuts to Chandler and Ross at table.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, I can't believe you. Linda is so great! Why won't you go out
with her again?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is this still about her whole 'The Flintstones could've really
happened' thing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it's not just that. It's just—I want someone who... who does
something for me, y'know? Who gets my heart pounding, who... who makes me, uh... (begins
to stare lovingly at Rachel)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...little playthings with yarn?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Could you want her more?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastically) Dee, the sarcastic sister from Whats Happening.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I am totally, totally over her, OK, I just... (Rachel comes over,
Ross lays head on table): Hiiii!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! How are you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We're fine, we're fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK. (walks away)
(Ross keeps staring at her, head on table. Chandler smacks him with a newspaper. Joey
enters, Ross and Chandler laugh at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shut up!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We're not—we're not saying anything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhhhh... Joey cried last night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to the girls) We were playing poker, alright...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There was chocolate on the three. It looked like an eight, alright?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, guys, you should've seen him. 'Read 'em and weep.'

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And then he did.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, now, how come you guys have never played poker with us?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, what is that? Like, some kind of guy thing? Like, some kind of
sexist guy thing? Like it's poker, so only guys can play?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, women are welcome to play.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, OK, so then what is it? Some kind of... you know, like, like... some
kind of, y'know, like... alright, what is it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There just don't happen to be any women in our games.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, we just don't happen to know any women that know how to play poker.

lines.speaker: Girls
lines.text: Oh, yeah, right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, please, that is such a lame excuse!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean, that's a typical guy response.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excuse me, do any of you know how to play?

lines.speaker: Girls
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But you could teach us.

lines.speaker: Guys
lines.text: No.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the guys are teaching the girls how to play poker.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (teaching) OK, so now we draw cards.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So I wouldn't need any, right? Cause I have a straight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, good for you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Congratulations!
(Microwave timer goes off. Monica gets up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: OK Phoebs, how many do you want?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: OK, I just need two... the, um, ten of spades and the six of clubs.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No, uh, Phoebs? You can't—you can't do...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wait, I have the ten of spades! Here! (gives it to Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no. Uh... no, see, uh, you-you can't do that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no-no-no-no-no-no, that's OK, I don't need them. I'm going for
fours.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you're... (gives up)
(Monica comes back to the table with plates of food.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, here we go. We've got salmon roulettes and assorted crudites.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: OOooooo!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, Monica, what're you doin'? This is a poker game. You
can't serve food with more than one syllable. It's gotta be like chips, or dip, or
pretz...(look of realization)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (changing subject) OK, so at this point, the dealer...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, you know, we got it, we got it. Let's play for real. High
stakes... big bucks...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, now, you sure? Phoebe just threw away two jacks because they
didn't look happy...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But... I'm ready, so, just deal.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: OK, alright, last minute lesson, last minute lesson. (holds up two
cards) Joey... three... eight. Eight... three. (Joey is unamused) Alright babe, deal the
cards.
(Time lapse.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (throws down her cards) Dammit, dammit, dammit!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Joey): Oh I see, so then, you were lying.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: About how good your cards were.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Heh... I was bluffing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A-ha! And... what is bluffing? Is it not another word for... lying?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK, sorry to break up this party, but I've got resumes to fax before
work tomorrow... (gets up to leave)

lines.speaker: Guys
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Rach, Rach, we gotta settle.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Settle what?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The... Jamestown colony of Virginia. You see, King George is giving us
the land, so...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The game, Rachel, the game. You owe us money for the game.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know what, you guys? It's their first time, why don't we just forget
about the money, alright?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hell no, we'll pay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: OK, Monica? I had another answer all ready.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And you know what? We want a rematch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well that's fine with me. Could use the money.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Ross): So basically, you get your ya-yas by taking money from all of
your friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pause)...Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, and I get my ya-yas from Ikea. You have to put them
together yourself, but they cost a little less.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, Rachel, this is poker. I play to win, alright? In order for me to
win, other people have to lose. So if you're gonna play poker with me, don't expect me to
be a 'nice guy,' OK? Cause once those cards are dealt... (claps hands three times)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause)...Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm not a nice guy.

scenes.location: Ross' apartment. Chandler and Joey are there. Ross enters with a pizza.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright boys, let's eat.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, did you get that from the 'I Love Rachel' pizzeria?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You still on that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, come on. What was with that whole Black Bart speech? (mimicking):
"When I play poker, I'm not a nice guy!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You are way off, pal.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I don't think so, see Ross, because I think you love her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Um.... no. See, I might've had feelings for her at one time—not any
more. I just—I...
(Marcel makes a screeching noise in background.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel! Where are you going with that disc?
(Marcel puts a CD in the player.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You are not putting that on again! Marcel, OK—if you press that
button, you are in very, very big trouble.
(The Lion Sleeps Tonight starts to play. Marcel starts to dance.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel, Monica, and Phoebe are there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (opening mail) Can you believe what a jerk Ross was being?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I know. He can get really competitive.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ha. Ha, ha.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hello, kettle? This is Monica. You're black.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please! I am not as bad as Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I beg to differ. The Pictionary incident?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was not an incident! I-I was gesturing, a-and the plate
slipped out of my hand.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oooooh. (reads letter) (surprised): Oh! I got an interview! I got an
interview!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're kidding! Where? Where?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (in disbelief): Sak's... Fifth... Avenue.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Rachel!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it's like the mother ship is calling you home.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, what's the job?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Assistant buyer. Oh! I would be shopping... for a living!
(Knock on door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: OK, look. That is Aunt Iris. This woman has been playing poker since she
was five. You gotta listen to every word she says. (opens door) Hi!

lines.speaker: Aunt Iris
lines.text: Is Tony Randall dead?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Aunt Iris
lines.text: Well, he may be now, because I think I hit him with my car.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Aunt Iris
lines.text: No! That's bluffing. Lesson number one. (walks into kitchen) Let me
tell you something... everything you hear at a poker game is pure crap. (to Phoebe): Nice
earrings.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank y... (thinks about it)

lines.speaker: Aunt Iris
lines.text: Girls, sit down.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, Aunt Iris? This is Phoebe, and that's Rachel...

lines.speaker: Aunt Iris
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, listen, I am parked at a meter. Let's
do it.
[Scene: Ross's apartment, everyone but Rachel is seated around his table. The Lion
Sleep Tonight plays in the background.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, could we please, please, please listen to anything else?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright.
(Ross shuts off the CD player. Marcel runs into the bedroom and slams the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm gonna pay for that tonight.
(Knock on door. Ross opens it. Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Guys! Guess what, guess what, guess what, guess what!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Um, ok... the... the fifth dentist caved and now they're all
recommending Trident?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noooo... the interview! She loved me! She absolutely loved me. We talked
for like two and a half hours, we have the same taste in clothes, and—oh, I went to
camp with her cousin... And, oh, the job is perfect. I can do this. I can do this well!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: That's great! That's wonderful!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, oh, and then she told the funniest story...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: OK, great. You'll tell us and we'll laugh. Let's play poker.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright now listen, you guys, we talked about it, and if you don't want to
play, we completely understand.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes, yes, we could play some other game... like, uh, I don't
know... Pictionary?
(The guys all duck under the table.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ha, ha, very funny, very funny. But I think we'd like to give poker
another try. Shall we, ladies?

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Yes, we should. I think we should.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, Rach, do you want me to shuffle those?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, thats OK. Y'know, I think I'm gonna give it a go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright... (shuffles cards expertly, all the guys stare in amazement)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Ross's Apartment, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, Phoebs owes $7.50, Monica, you owe $10, and Rachel, you owe fifteen
big ones.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But hey, thanks for teachin' us Cross-Eyed Mary. You guys, we gotta play
that at our regular game.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, here's my $7.50. (Hands them the money) But I think you should
know that this money is cursed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I cursed it. So now bad things will happen to he who spends it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's alright, I'll take it. Bad things happen to me anyway. This way
I can break 'em up with a movie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, that just leaves the big Green poker machine, who owes fifteen...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mmm-hmmm. Oh, so typical. Ooo, I'm a man. Ooo, I have a penis. Ooo, I
have to win money to exert my power over women. (hands over her money)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what? This is not over. We will play you again, and we will
win, and you will lose, and you will beg, and we will laugh, and we will take every last
dime you have, and you will hate yourselves forever.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmm. Kinda stepped on my point there, Mon.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is there ready for another poker game.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, you gals wanna hand over your money now? That way, we don't have to go
through the formality of actually playing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooooh, that's fine. We'll see who has the last laugh there, monkey boy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: OK, we done with the chit-chat? Are we ready to play some serious poker?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (holding a card and waving it in front of her face) Hey you guys, look,
the one-eyed jack follows me wherever I go. (they look at her) Right, OK, serious poker.
(Ross gets up from the table.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Excuse me, where are you going?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh... to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you want to go to the bathroom, or do you wanna play poker?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I want to go to the bathroom. (exits)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, well, I'm gonna order a pizza. (gets up)

lines.speaker: Rachel
