lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no-no, I'm still waiting to hear from that job and the store
closes at nine, so you can eat then.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's fine. I'll just have a Tic-Tac to hold me over.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, Cincinnati, no blinds, everybody ante. (deals cards)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looks at her cards) Yes! (everyone looks at her) .... or no.
(Ross comes back from bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright. (to Rachel): Your money's mine, Green.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Your fly is open, Geller. (he checks it, and zips up)
(Time lapse.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys, you know what I just realized? 'Joker' is 'poker' with a 'J.'
Coincidence?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, that's... that's 'joincidence' with a 'C'!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh... Phoebe? Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Um... I'm out. (throws in cards)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm in.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too. Alright, whattaya got.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you better hop outta the shower, cause... I gotta flush. (lays down
cards)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, well, well, hop back in bucko, cause I got four sixes! (lays down
cards) I won! I actually won! Oh my God! Y'know what? (collects chips) I think I'm gonna
make a little Ross pile. (holds up a chip) I think that one was Ross's, and I
think—oh—that one was Ross's. Yes! (Starts singing): Well, I have got your
money, and you'll never see it...
(Ross stands up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And your fly's still open...
(Ross looks down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ha, I made you look....
(Time lapse.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I couldn't be inner. Monica?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica, in or out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (slams down cards) I hate this game!
(Joey slides a plate away from Monica towards Chandler, who hides it under the table.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: OK Joey, your bet.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahhh, I fold like a cheap hooker who got hit in the stomach by a fat guy
with sores on his face. (the girls look at him, confused) Oh, I'm out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I am very in.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Couldn't be more out. (throws in cards)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too. Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, I will see you... and I'll raise you. (throws chips in pot) What do
you say... want to waste another buck?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, not this time. (he folds) So... what'd you have?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm not telling. (collects chips)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, show them to me. (reaches for her cards, Rachel covers them up)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No..!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Show them to me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Get your hands out of there! No!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let me see! Show them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I've had dates like this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (deals new hand) Boy, you really can't stand to lose, can you? Your
whole face is getting red... little veins popping out on your temple...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Plus that shirt doesn't really match those pants.
(Ross is visibly upset.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: First of all, I'm not losing...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you are losing. Definitely losing. (phone rings)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let's not talk about losing. Just deal the...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (answering phone) Hel-lo, Rachel Green.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (mimicking Rachel) Mee mee, mee-mee mee.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) Excuse me. (covers up phone; to Ross) It's about the job.
(Rachel walks into kitchen to talk on the phone.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Barbara! Hi, how are you? (Listens) Uh-huh. (Listens) No, I understand.
Yeah. Oh, oh, come on, no, I'm fine. Don't be silly. Yeah... oh, but you know, if-if
anything else opens up, plea—Hello? Hello? (hangs up phone, very depressed)
(Rachel goes back and sits down. The rest don't know what to say.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sorry, Rach.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know, there's gonna be lots of other stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah...(sigh)....OK. Where were we? Oh, OK... five card draw, uh...
jacks or better... nothing wild, everybody ante.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, Rachel, we don't have to do this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, we do. (pause)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, check.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Check.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm in for fifty cents. (throws it in)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Call.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I see your fifty cents... and I raise you... five dollars. (throws it
in)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I thought, uh... it was a fifty cent limit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I just lost a job, and I'd like to raise the bet five bucks. Does
anybody have a problem with that?
(Everyone says no and folds, except for Ross, who thinks about it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Ross): Loser?
(Chandler, Monica, Joey, and Phoebe back their chairs away from the table.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I fold. (lays cards down, and gets up)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What do you mean, you fold? Hey, come on! What is this? I thought that
'once the cards were dealt, I'm not a nice guy.' I mean, what, were you just full of it?
(Ross thinks it over, finally sits down and picks up his cards.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm in. (throws in chips)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How many you want?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: One. (Rachel gives him the card.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Dealer takes two. (she deals herself two cards) What do you bet?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I bet two dollars. (throws it in)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK... see your two... and I raise you twenty. (throws it in)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I see your twenty, raise you twenty-five. (throws it in)
(The other four look amazed at the large pot.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: See your twenty-five...and...uh, Monica, get my purse.
(Monica gets up, looks in Rachel's purse.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, there's nothing in it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK, then get me your purse.
(Monica gets Rachel her purse.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: OK, here you go. Good luck.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica): Thank you. (to Ross): I saw your twenty-five, and I raise
you... seven.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ...teen! (throws in a ten-dollar bill)
(Ross looks in his wallet, pulls out two dollars.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey): Joey, I'm a little shy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's OK, Ross, you can ask me. What?
(Ross looks at Joey, dumbfounded at his stupidity.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross): What do you need, what do you need?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fifteen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright, here's ten. (gives it to him)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here, I got five, I got five. (Ross takes the money)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel): OK, I am calling your seventeen. What do you got?
(Long pause as they both look at each other.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (lays down cards) Full house.
(Ross stares at her. Thinks about it. Puts cards on table, face down.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You got me.
(Monica and Phoebe get up and start celebrating in the kitchen, pouring wine and
singing. Rachel, shocked, goes to join them.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross): Ahhh, that's alright. Y'know, that's a tough hand to beat.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross): I thought we had them!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, well, when you don't have the cards, you don't have the cards, you
know. (looks at Rachel) But, uh... look how happy she is. (smiles)
(Chandler and Joey look at her, and then look back at him. They dive for Ross's hand to
see what he had, and he tries to stop them from looking.)

title: The One Where the Monkey Gets Away

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is talking to a customer.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, okay, I checked. We have: Earl Grey, English Breakfast, Cinnamon
Stick, Camomile, Mint Medley, Blackberry, and.. oh, wait, there's one more, um.. Lemon
Soother. You're not the guy that asked for the tea, are you? (Guy shakes his head) Okay.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica enters with some mail.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mail call, Rachel Green, bunk seven.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (Examines it) Oh, cool! Free sample of coffee!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh good! 'Cause where else would we get any?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Right. ...Oh great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Country club newsletter. My mother sends me the engagement notices for
'inspiration.' Oh my God! Oh my God, it's Barry and Mindy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Barry who you almost...?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Barry who I almost.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And Mindy, your maid of...?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mindy, my maid of. Oh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Takes it) That's Mindy? Wow, she is pretty. (Sees Rachel's look) Lucky.
To have had a friend like you.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel and Ross are eating Chinese.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel. Bring me the rice, c'mon. Bring me the rice, c'mon. Good boy. Good
boy. C'mere, gimme the rice. (Marcel brings the rice) Thank you, good boy. Well, I see
he's finally mastered the difference between 'bring me the' and 'pee in the'. (Rachel
ignores him) 'Bring me the' and- Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Oh, this is so stupid! I mean, I gave Barry up, right? I
should be happy for them! I am, I'm happy for them.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. Oh, oh, I guess it would be different if I were- with somebody.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoah, uh, what happened to, uh, 'Forget relationships! I'm done with
men!' The whole, uh, penis embargo?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I don't know. I guess it's not about no guys, it's about the right
guy, y'know? I mean, with Barry, it was safe and it was easy, but there was no heat. With
Paolo, that's all there was, was heat! And it was just this raw, animal, sexual...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait-wait. I, I got it. I was there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I mean, do you think you can ever have both? Y'know? Someone who's
like, who's like your best friend, but then also can make your toes curl?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. Yes. Yes! Yes, I really do! In fact, it's funny, very often, someone
who you wouldn't think could-could curl your toes, might just be the one who...
(Enter the other four)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...Gets interrupted. Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, how was the movie?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wonderful!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So good!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Suck-fest.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Toootal chick-flick.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I'm sorry it wasn't one of those movies with, like, y'know, guns and
bombs and, like, buses going really fast...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I don't need violence to enjoy a movie. Just so long as there's a
little nudity.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There was nudity!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I meant female nudity. Alright? I don't need to see Lou
Grant frolicking.

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Hugh! Hugh Grant!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, I've gotta go. C'mon, Marcel! C'mon! We're gonna go take a bath.
Yes we are, aren't we? Yes, we are.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They're still just friends, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Marcel) And I will see you tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's right, you're gonna spend tomorrow at Aunt Rachel's, aren't you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, hang on, hang on. Does Aunt Monica get a say in this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 'Pwease, Aunt Monica, pwease?' Oh, unclench. You're not even gonna be
there.

scenes.location: Joe-G's Pizza, the guys are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe we are even having this discussion.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I agree. I'm, like, in disbelief.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I mean, don't you think if things were gonna happen with Rachel, they
would've happened already?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm telling you, she said she's looking for a relationship with someone
exactly like me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She really said that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I added the 'exactly like me' part... But she said she's looking for
someone, and someone is gonna be there tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: 'Tonight' tonight?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I think it's perfect. Y'know, it's just gonna be the two of us, she
spent all day taking care of my monkey...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't remember the last time I got a girl to take care of my monkey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway, I figured after work I'd go pick up a bottle of wine, go over
there and, uh, try to woo her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, y'know what you should do? You should take her back to the
1890's, when that phrase was last used.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is taking care of Marcel and they are watching a
soap opera.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now, now the one in the feather boa, that's Dr. Francis. Now, she used
to be a man. Okay, now look, see, there's Raven. We hate her. We're glad she's dying.
Okay- (Marcel pushes down a cushion to reveal a shoe) Wh- wh- Marcel, are you playing with
Monica's shoes? You know you're not supposed to pl- whoah. Marcel, did you poo in the
shoe? (Takes the shoe into the kitchen) Marcel, bad monkey! Oh! Oh! (She notices the
newsletter and taps the contents of the shoes onto it, then folds it shut) Sorry, Barry.
Little engagement gift. I'm sure you didn't register for that. (She leaves the apartment
holding the newsletter at arm's length. However, she leaves the door open. Marcel runs out
in the opposite direction. There is a shot from the TV and Rachel runs back in) Who died?
Who died? Roll him over! Oh, c'mon, roll him over! Oh...! Well, we know it wasn't Dexter,
right Marcel? Because- (Looks down and notices he is missing) Marcel? Marc- (Notices the
open door)
[Time lapse. Now everyone but Ross and Phoebe is back at Monica and Rachel's.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How could you lose him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know. We were watching TV, and then he pooped in Monica's shoe-

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait. He pooped in my shoe? Which one?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know. The left one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Which ones?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Oh, those little clunky Amish things you think go with everything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whoah, ooh, why is the air in here so negative?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Rachel lost Marcel.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, how?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He- he pooped in my shoe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Those cute little black ones I wear all the time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, which one? The right or left? 'Cause the left one
is lucky...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: C'mon, you guys, what're we gonna do, what're we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright alright. You're a monkey. You're loose in the city. Where do you
go?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, it's his first time out, so he's probably gonna wanna do some of
the touristy things. I'll go to Cats, you go to the Russian Tea Room.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, my, God, c'mon, you guys! He's gonna be home any minute! He's gonna
kill me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, we'll start with the building. You guys take the first and second
floor, Phoebe and I'll take third and fourth.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what'm I gonna do? What'm I gonna do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, you stay here, and just wait by the phone. Spray Lysol in
my shoe, and wait for Ross to kill you.
(They all leave)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anybody wanna trade? Oh...
[Cut to a hallway in the building, Monica and Phoebe are knocking on a door. Mr.
Heckles emerges.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: Whaddyou want?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mr. Heckles, our friend lost a monkey. Have you seen it?

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: I left a Belgian waffle out here, did you take it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why would you leave your Belgian waffle in the hall?

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: I wasn't ready for it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A monkey. Have you seen a monkey?

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: Saw Regis Philbin once...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, thank you, Mr. Heckles. (They move off)

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: You owe me a waffle.
[Cut to Monica and Rachel's.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (On the phone) Okay, he's a, he's a black capuchian monkey with a white
face... (Enter Ross) ...with, with Russian dressing and, and pickles on the side. Okay.
Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. How did, uh, how'd it go today?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Great! It went great. Really great. Hey, is that wine?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. You, uh, you want some?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I would love some. But y'know what? Y'know what? Let's not drink it
here. I'm feeling kinda crazy. You wanna go to Newark?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, okay, yeah, we could do that, but before we head off to the murder
capital of the North-East, I was, uh, kinda wanting to run something by you. Y'know how we
were, uh, y'know, talking before about, uh, relationships and stuff? (Uncorks the wine)
Well-

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, Ross, I cannot do this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, quick and painful. (Starts to cork the wine)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God... Okay. Alright. Alright. Okay. Ross, please don't hate me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, what? What-what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know Marcel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I kind of... I kind of lost him.
[Cut to outside the window, with Ross reacting with disbelief. The shot pans back until
we see Marcel sitting on the window ledge.]
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Angry) I- I- I ca- I can't believe this. I mean, all I asked you to do
was keep him in the apartment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I know, I'm sorry-

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, y'know what, I guess it's partially my fault. Y'know, I shouldn't've,
uh, asked you to start off with a monkey. I should've started you off with like a pen or a
pencil.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Tearfully) Ross, I'm doing everything that I can, I've got everybody
looking for him, and I- (Door buzzer goes and she runs to get it) Oh! Who is it?

lines.speaker: Intercom
lines.text: Animal Control.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: See? I've even called Animal Control!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You called Animal Control?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh... why... do you not like them?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel is an illegal exotic animal. I'm not allowed to
have him in the city. If they find him, they'll take him away from me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: O-okay, now see, you never ever ever told us that...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's right, I.. 'cause I didn't expect you were gonna invite them to the
apartment!
(A knock on the door. Rachel swiftly opens it)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, thanks for coming.

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: (Animal Control) Somebody called about a monkey?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, y'know what? That was a complete misunderstanding! (Ross puts his
arms around her and they act all sweetness and light)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, we thought we had a monkey, but we-we didn't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Turned out it was a hat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Cat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Cat! What'm I saying? Cat!
(Luisa nods, but then Monica and Phoebe run in)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi. We checked the third and fourth floor, no-one's seen Marcel.

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My uncle Marcel.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, is that who the monkey's named after?

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Oookay. Are you aware that possession of an illegal exotic is, uh,
punishable by up to two years in prison and confiscation of the animal?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God. You'd put that poor little creature in jail?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pheebs, you remember how we talked about saying things quietly to
yourself first?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, but there isn't always time!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look. I'm sure there's some friendly way to reconcile this! Um, have a
seat. First of all, we haven't been introduced, I'm Monica Geller.

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Oh my God, you are! And you're Rachel Green!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Luisa Gianetti! Lincoln High? I sat behind you guys in home room!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Luisa? Oh my God! Monica! It's Luisa!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The Luisa from home room!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: You have no idea who I am, do you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, none at all.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: None.

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Well, maybe that's because you spent four years ignoring me. I mean,
would it have been so hard to say 'Morning, Luisa'? Or 'Nice overalls'?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I'm- I'm so sorry!

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Ah, it's not so much you, you were fat, you had your own problems. (To
Rachel) But you? What a bitch!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Be that as it may, d'you think you could just help us out here on that
monkey thing? Y'know, just for old times' sake? Go Bobcats?

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: I could... but I won't. If I find that monkey, he's mine. (Leaves)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Dun-dun-duuuur! Sorry.
[Cut to another part of the building. We see Marcel jump in through a window and run
down some stairs, then Chandler and Joey come down from the upper floor without noticing.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Marcel?
(They come to a door and silently agree to try it. A very sweaty woman emerges)
Woman No. 1: Hi, can I help you?
(Chandler and Joey are dumbstruck for a moment)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Um, we're kind of having an emergency and we-we were looking for
something...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A monkey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes have you seen any?
Woman No. 1: No. No, haven't seen a monkey. Do you know anything about fixing
radiators?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Um, sure! Did you, uh, did you try turning the knob back the other way?
Woman No. 1: Of course.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Then, no.
(Another sweaty woman comes to the door and speaks to her friend)
Woman No. 2: Did I put too much rum in here?
(Joey and Chandler shoot each other glances)
Woman No. 1: Just a sec. (To Chandler and Joey) Hope you find your monkey. (She
starts to shut the door)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, nononowaitwaitwaitnono! Uh... we may not know anything about
radiators per se, but we do have a certain amount of expertise in the heating and
cooling... mileu.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, aren't we kind of in the middle of something here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but these women are very hot, and they need our help! And they're
very hot.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We can't, alright? (To the women) We're sorry. You have no idea how sorry,
but... We promised we'd find this monkey. If you see him, he's about yea high and answers
to the name Marcel, so if we could get some pictures of you, you'd really be helping us
out.
(The women quickly shut the door)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, from now on, you don't get to talk to other people.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Marcel?!
[Cut to Monica and Phoebe searching the basement.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh-my-God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whaaat!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Something just brushed up against my right leg!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it's okay, it was just my left leg.
(Marcel makes a monkeyish noise. He is sitting in the corner)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Oh, c'mere, Marcel! Oh, Marcel, c'mere!
(Luisa appears on the stairs)

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Step aside, ladies! (She loads a gun)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What're you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Just a small tranquiliser.
(In slow motion we see Phoebe look at Marcel, then at Luisa. She jumps toward Marcel
just as Luisa fires the gun.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Run, Marcel, run! Run, Marcel! (Marcel runs off and Luisa runs after
him. Monica goes to check up on Phoebe) Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, think so. Oh! (She notices the tranquiliser dart has hit her in
the butt and removes it) Huh. (Sways back) Whoah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh gosh.
[Cut to Marcel walking along a hallway. He notices a banana on the floor and picks it
up. The hand of an unseen person grabs him and carries him away. Then cut to Ross and
Rachel on the street outside.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Marcel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marc- oh, this is ridiculous! We've been all over the neighbourhood. He's
gone, he's-he's just gone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, you don't know that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh come on. It's cold, it's dark, he doesn't know the Village. (Kicks a
sign in frustration) And now I have a broken foot. I have no monkey, and a broken foot!
Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I said I'm sorry like a million times. What do you want me to do?
You want me to break my foot too? Okay, I'm gonna break my foot, right here. (Kicks the
sign) Ow!! Oh! Oh my God, oh my God! There, are you happy now?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Y'know, now that you kicked the sign, hey! I don't miss Marcel
any more!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know, it is not like I did this on purpose.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no no no. Nono, this is just vintage Rachel. I mean, things just sort
of happen around you. I mean, you're off in Rachel-land, doing your Rachel-thing, totally
oblivious to people's monkeys, or to people's feelings...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't even wanna hear it, you're just...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, forget it, okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What?
(A man carrying a box of bananas walks past them. They stare for a minute and then
hobble after him)

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: Hey! Hey, Bananaman!
(Scene 4: Everyone in the hall outside Mr. Heckles' door. Ross is carrying the box of
bananas. He bangs on the door)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, this is so intense. One side of my butt is totally asleep, and the
other side has no idea.
(Mr. Heckles opens the door)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi, did you order some bananas?

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: What about it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Gimme back my monkey.

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: I don't have a monkey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Then what's with all the bananas?

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: Potassium.
(There is a monkey-like noise from within and Ross pushes past Mr. Heckles and enters
his apartment)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel? Marcel? Okay, where is he? Where is he? Marcel? Marcel?
(Marcel jumps into view wearing a pink dress. Everybody gasps)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel! What've you done to him?

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: That's my monkey. That's Patti, Patti the monkey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you insane? C'mere, Marcel, c'mon. (Marcel starts to go to him)

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: C'mere, Patti. (Marcel turns round)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mere, Marcel. (Turns to Ross)

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: C'mere, Patti. (Turns to Mr. Heckles)

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: (Out of shot) Here, monkey. Here, monkey! Here, monkey! (Marcel runs to
the door and into Luisa's cage, which she slams shut) Gotcha.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, gimme my monkey back.

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: That's my monkey.

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: You're both gonna have to take this up with the judge.

lines.speaker: Mr. Heckles
lines.text: That's not my monkey. Just the dress is mine, you can send that
back whenever.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, I want my monkey.

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, c'mon, Luisa!

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Sorry, prom queen.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) You had to be a bitch in high school, you couldn't've been
fat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright. In high school I was the prom queen and I was the homecoming
queen and the class president and you... were also there! But if you take this monkey, I
will lose one of the most important people in my life. You can hate me if you want, but
please do not punish him. C'mon, Luisa, you have a chance to be the bigger person here!
Take it!

lines.speaker: Luisa
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright. Well then how about I call your supervisor, and I tell her that
you shot my friend in the ass with a dart?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's. Rachel and Ross are there. Ross is trying to get the dress
off Marcel.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It'll be nice to get this off finally, won't it? Yes it will. (Marcel
resists) Or we can leave it on for now, that's fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know, with the right pair of pumps, that would be a great little
outfit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, I'm- I'm sorry I was so hard on you before, it's just I...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Ross, c'mon. It's my fault, I almost lost your...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but you were the one who got him back, y'know? You, you were great.
...Hey, we uh, we still have that, uh, that bottle of wine. You in the mood for, uh,
something grape?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That'd be good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright. (He goes to get the glasses. Then he hesitates and turns off the
main light. Rachel looks round and he acts surprised) The, uh, the neighbours must be
vacuuming. (He sits down and starts to pour the wine) Well, so long as we're here and, uh,
not on the subject, I was thinking about, uh, how mad we got at each other before, and,
um, I was thinking maybe it was partially because of how we, um...
(Barry bursts in)

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Barry?!

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: I can't. I can't do it, I can't marry Mindy. I think I'm still
in love with you.

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We have got to start locking that door!

title: The One with the Evil Orthodontist

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe you would actually say that. I would much
rather be Mr.Peanut than Mr.Salty.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No way! Mr.Salty is a sailor, all right, he's got to be, like, thetoughest
snack there is.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know, you don't wanna mess with corn nuts. They're craaazy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking out of the window) Oh my God. You guys! You gotta come see
this! There's some creep out there with a telescope!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe it! He's looking right at us!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that is so sick.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I feel violated. And not in a good way.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How can people do that?... (All but Phoebe walk away from the window in
disgust.) Oh, you guys, look! Ugly Naked Guy got gravity boots!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone but Rachel is there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am telling you, years from now, schoolchildren will study it as one
of the greatest first dates of all time. It was unbelievable! We could totally be
ourselves, we didn't have to play any games...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So have you called her yet?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let her know I like her? What are you, insane? (The girls make
disgusted noises.) It's the next day! How needy do I want to seem? (To the guys) I'm
right, right?

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Yeah. Let her dangle.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe my parents are actually pressuring me to find one of you
people.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, God, just do it! (Grabbing the phone.) Call her! Stop being so
testosteroney!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Which, by the way, is the real San Francisco treat. (Calls her, then
hurriedly hangs up.) I got her machine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Her answer machine?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, interestingly enough her leaf blower picked up.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, uh, why didn't you say anything?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, no-no-no-no. Last time I left a spontaneous message I ended up
using the phrase "Yes indeedy-o."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look look! It's Rachel and Barry. No, don't everybody look at once!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, what's going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, they're just talking...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well, does he look upset? Does he look like he was just told to
shove anything?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no actually, he's smiling.. and... Oh my God, don't do that!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What? What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That man across the street just kicked that pigeon! (Rachel enters.) Oh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (bluffing) And basically, that's how a bill becomes a law.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh!... Right!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Rach!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How'd it go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know, it was, uh.. it was actually really great. He took me to lunch
at the Russian Tea Room, and I had that chicken, where y'know you poke it and all
the butter squirts out...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not a good day for birds...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Then we took a walk down to Bendall's, and I told him not to,
but he got me a little bottle of Chanel...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's nice... now, was that before or after you told him to stop calling,
stop sending you flowers and to generally leave you alone, hmm?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right,.. well,.. we never actually got to that... Oh, it was just so
nice to see him again, y'know? It was comfortable, it was familiar... it was just nice!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's, that's nice twice!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, what's going on? I mean isn't this the same Barry who you left
at the altar?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Duh, where've you been?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but it was different with him today! And he wasn't, like,
Orthodontist Guy, y'know? I mean, we had fun! Is there anything wrong with that?
(Ross 'prompts' Chandler by hitting him on the arm.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have my reasons.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, how about the fact that he's engaged to another woman, who just
happens to be your ex-best friend?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. All right, all right, all right, all right, I know it's
stupid! I will go see him this afternoon, and I will just put an end to it!

scenes.location: Barry's Office, the post-coital Barry and Rachel are recovering on the chair.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow... Wow!

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm not crazy, right? I mean, it was never like that.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Nooo, it wasn't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, and it's so nice having this little sink here...

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is there except Rachel.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on phone, reading from a script) Oh, Danielle! I wasn't expecting the
machine... Give me a call when you get a chance. (Rattles some dishes) Bye-bye. (Hangs
up.) Oh God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's what you've been working on for the past two
hours?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, I've been honing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What was with the dishes?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, uh.. I want her to think I might be in a restaurant.. y'know? I
might have some kind of life, like I haven't been sitting around here honing for the past
few hours.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking out the window) Look look! He's doing it again, the guy with
the telescope!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! (Walks to the window) Go away! (Gesturing.) Stop looking in
here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great, now he's waving back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, we gotta do something about that guy. This morning, I caught him
looking into our apartment. It creeps me out! I feel like I can't do stuff!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What kinda stuff?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Will you grow up? I'm not talking about sexy stuff, but, like, when I'm
cooking naked.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You cook naked?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, toast, oatmeal... nothing that spatters.
(A pause as they look at Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you looking at me for? I didn't know that.

scenes.location: Barry's Office, Rachel and Barry are getting dressed.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it's just... Oh, Barry, this was not good.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: No, it was. It was very very good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what about Mindy?

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Oh, way, way better than Mindy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, not that, I mean, what about you and Mindy?

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Well, if you want, I'll just—I'll just break it off with her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. No-no-no-no, no. I mean, don't do that. Not, I mean not for me.

lines.speaker: Bernice
lines.text: (over intercom) Dr. Farber, Bobby Rush is here for his adjustment.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: (into intercom) Thanks, Bernice. (To Rachel) Let's go away this weekend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Barry..! Come on, this is all way too..

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: We can, we can go to Aruba! When I went there on what would have been our
honeymoon, it was, uh... it was really nice. You would've liked it.
(Pause as Rachel realises...)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I had a bra.
(Barry finds it draped on a cupboard and gives it to Rachel, they kiss as Bobby
enters.)

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.text: Hey, Dr. Farber.
(Rachel and Barry quickly split and pretend Barry is examining Rachel's mouth.)

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: All right Miss Green, everything looks fine... Yep, I think we're
starting to see some real progress here.
(Bobby looks on, deadpan.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.text: I'm twelve, I'm not stupid.
(Rachel glares at him.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler enters clutching his phone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can I use your phone?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.. uh, but for future reference, that thing in your hand can also be
used as a phone.
(Chandler dials his own phone and it rings.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, it's working! Why isn't she calling me back?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe she never got your message.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know, if you want, you can call her machine, and if she has a lot of
beeps, that means she probably didn't get her messages yet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'don't think that makes me seem a little...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...desperate, needy, pathetic?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, you obviously saw my personal ad.
(He calls and quickly hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How many beeps?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She answered.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'see, this is where you'd use that 'hello' word we talked about.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not gonna talk to her, she obviously got my message and is
choosing not to call me. Now I'm needy and snubbed. God, I miss just being needy.
(Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey! Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How'd he take it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pretty well, actually... (Wandering into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (wandering in after her) Uh, Rach... how come you have dental floss in
your hair?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, do I?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (in a low voice) We ended up having sex in his chair.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You had sex in his chair?!... I said
that a little too loudly, didn't I?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You-you had what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sex in his chair.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, uh... what were you thinking?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know! I mean, we still care about each other. There's a history
there. 'S'like you and Carol.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No no, it is nothing like me and Carol!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please. If she said to you, "Ross, I want you on this couch, right
here, right now," what would you say?
(Ross flounders.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If it helps, I could slide over.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's, it's, it's, uh, a totally diferent situation! It's, it's apples and
oranges, it's, it's orthodontists and lesbi- I gotta go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (leaving) I just have to go, all right? Do I need a reason? Huh? I mean I
have things to do with my life, I have a jam packed schedule, and I am late- for keeping
up with it. Okay?
(Ross exits, a phone rings, and Chandler dives for his phone.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello? Hello?
(Rachel picks up their phone and the ringing stops. As she talks on the phone, an
elaborate visual gag is spun out which is too difficult to describe in words.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) Hello?(Listens) Mindy! Hi! Hey, how are you? (Listens) Yes,
yes, I've heard, congratulations, that is so great. (Listens) Really? (Listens) Oh.
(Listens) Okay. Okay, well I'm working tomorrow, but if you want you can, you can, you can
come by and... (Listens) Okay... (Listens) Great... (Listens) Great... (Listens) All
right, so I'll, so I'll see you tomorrow! (Listens) Okay.. (Listens) Okay... (Listens)
Bye. (Hangs up and sits down heavily.) Oh God. Oh God. Oh God.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So how's Mindy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, she wants to see me tomorrow...Oh, she sounded really weird, I gotta
call Barry... (Does so, on phone) Hi, it's me, I just.. Mindy!! Mindy! Hi! No, I figured
that's where you'd be!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the next morning. Chandler is sitting and staring at
his phone. Monica enters and creeps up next to Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Brrrrrrr!
(Chandler clutches at his phone before realising.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hell is filled with people like you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) He's back! The peeper's back!
(Rachel enters from her room.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (ducking) Get down!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Get down?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...And boogie!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks, but I gotta go to work and get my eyes scratched out by Mindy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Relax. Y'know, she may not even know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please. I haven't heard from her in seven months, and now she calls me?
I mean, what else is it about? Oh! She was my best friend, you guys! We went to camp
together... she taught me how to kiss..

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (intrigued) Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And now, y'know, I'm like... I'm like the other woman! I feel so..

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ..Naughty!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right, I'll see you guys later...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hold up, I'll walk out with you. Now, Rach, when she taught you to
kiss, you were at camp, and.. were you wearing any kinda little uniform, or- (Rachel exits
and slams the door in his face.) That's fine, yeah...
(Joey exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I'm gonna go to the bathroom. Will you watch my phone?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don't you just take it with you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, we haven't been on a second date, she needs to hear me pee?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don't you just call her?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't call her, I left a message! I have some pride.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! (Calls) Danielle, hi! It's, uh, it's Chandler! (Listens) I'm fine.
Uh, listen, I don't know if you tried to call me, because, uh, idiot that I am, I
accidentally shut off my phone. (Listens) Oh, uh, okay, that's fine, that's great.
(Listens) Okay. (Puts down the phone.) (to Monica) She's on the other line, she's gonna
call me back. (He starts doing a little jig.) She's on the other line, she's gonna call me
back, she's on the other line, gonna call me back...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't you have to pee?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: 'S'why I'm dancing...

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is serving coffee as Mindy enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mindy.

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Hey, you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, you.... So, what's up?

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Um.. we should really be sitting for this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure we should... So.

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Now, I know things've been weird lately, but you're like my oldest friend
in the world... Except for maybe Laurie Schaffer, who I don't talk to anywhere, 'cause
she's all bitter now that she lost the weight and it turns out she doesn't have a pretty
face. ....Okay, I'm just gonna ask you this once, and I want a straight answer.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Will you be my maid of honour?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Oh that's so great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Was that all you wanted to ask me?

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: That's all!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhhh!! (Mindy starts to sob.) ...What? What?

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: That's not all.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh sure it is!

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Oh no, it isn't! No! I think Barry is seeing someone in the city.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um, what- what would make you think that?

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Well, ever since we announced the engagement, he's been acting really
weird, and then last night, he came home smelling like Chanel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (draws back) Really. Mindy, if it'll make you feel any better, when I
was engaged to him he went through a whole weird thing too.

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Oh God! You see, that's what I was afraid of!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What's what you were afraid of?

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Okay, okay... when Barry was engaged to you, he and I...kind of... had a
little thing on the side.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: I know. I know, and when he proposed to me, everyone said "Don't do
it, he's just gonna do to you what he did to Rachel," and now I feel so stupid.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh... Oh, Mindy, you are so stupid. Oh, we are both so stupid.

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (offers her arm to Mindy and she sniffs) Smell familiar?

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I am so sorry.

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: No me, I am so sorry...
(They hug and Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (watches them for a while) Oh my.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe and Ross are doing a crossword, Monica is cooking,
and Chandler is still staring at his phone.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Four letters: "Circle or hoop".

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ring dammit, ring!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey, you know our phone's not working?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I tried to call you from the coffee shop, and there was no answer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (investigating) I turned it off. Mother of God, I turned it off!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just like you told her you did! (Chandler glares at her.) ... Just
pointing out the irony.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, so listen, I went across the street and talked to the doorman- I got
the peeper's name! Can I use the phone?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nngghhh!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Monica) Can I use your phone? (On phone) Yeah, the number for a Sidney
Marks, please.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: "Heating device."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Radiator.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Five letters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rdtor.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Yeah, is Sidney there? (Listens) Oh, this is? (To the gang)
Sidney's a woman.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So she's a woman! So what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, so what? (On phone) Look, I live across the street, (walking
to the window) and I know all about you and your little telescope, and I don't appreciate
it, okay? (Listens) Yeah, I can see you right now! (Listens) Hello! (Listens) If I wanna
walk around my apartment in my underwear, I shouldn't have to feel
like—(Listens)—Thank you, but... that's not really the point... (Listens) The
point is that... (Listens) Mostly free weights, but occasionally..

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Yeah, my neighbor... (Listens) Yeah, the brunette... (to
Monica) She says you looked very pretty the other day in the green dress.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The green dress? Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, she said you looked like Ingrid Bergman that day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (waves dismissively to Sidney) Nooo!

scenes.location: Barry's Office, Barry is preparing his tools alone as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey. Got a second?

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Sure, sure. Come on... (Mindy enters) ...in...

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Hello, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Uh... uh... what're'you... what're'you guys doing here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, we are here to break up with you.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Both of you?

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Basically, we think you're a horrible human being, and bad things should
happen to you.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: I'm sorry... I'm sorry, God, I am so sorry, I'm an idiot, I was weak, I
couldn't help myself! Whatever I did, I only did because I love you so much!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh- which one of us are you talking to there, Barr?

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: ....Mindy. Mindy, of course Mindy, it was always Mindy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Even when we were having sex in that chair?

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: (to Mindy) I swear, whatever I was doing, I was always thinking of you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please! During that second time you couldn't have picked her out of a
lineup!

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: (to Rachel) You did it twice?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, the first time didn't really count... I mean, y'know, 's'Barry.

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: (to Mindy) Sweetheart, just gimme- gimme another chance, okay, we'll
start all over again. We'll go back to Aruba.

lines.speaker: Bernice
lines.text: (over intercom) Dr. Farber, we've got a bit of an emergency
here...Jason Costalano is choking on his retainer.

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: Oh God... (Into intercom) I'll be right there, Bernice. (to Mindy) Look,
please, please don't go anywhere, okay? I'll be, I'll be right back.
(Barry exits)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay, we'll be here! Hating you! Did you see how he was sweating
when he walked out of there? Listen honey, if I'm hogging the ball too much you just jump
right in there and take a couple punches because I'm telling you, this feels great.

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Yeah... I'm pretty sure I'm still gonna marry him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you talking about?! Mindy, the guy is the devil! He's Satan in
a smock!

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: Look, I know he's not perfect, but the truth is, at the end of the day, I
still really wanna be Mrs. Dr. Barry Farber, D.D.S.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God.

lines.speaker: Mindy
lines.text: I hope you can find some way to be happy for me. And I hope you'll still
be my maid of honor...?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I hope Barry doesn't kill you and eat you in Aruba.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Y'know, ever since I ran out on Barry at the wedding, I have
wondered whether I made the right choice. And now I know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aww... (They hug)
(Joey enters and looks on approvingly.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Big day.

title: The One with the Fake Monica

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is looking at papers.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How could someone get a hold of your credit card number?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I have no idea. But look how much they spent!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, would you calm down? The credit card people said that you only
have to pay for the stuff that you bought.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know. It's just such reckless spending.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think when someone steals your credit card, they've kind of already
thrown caution to the wind.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow, what a geek. They spent $69.95 on a Wonder Mop.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! The yuk! Ross, he's doing it again! (Points to a lamp which is
shaking behind the sofa)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel, stop humping the lamp! Stop humping! Now Marcel, come back-
(Marcel runs toward Rachel's room) come here, Marcel-

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, not in my room! I'll get him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, you've got to do something about the humping.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? It's, it's just a phase.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, that's what we said about Joey...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Would you all relax? It's not that big a deal.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Out of shot) Stop it! Marcel! Bad monkey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let's just say my Curious George doll is no longer curious.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, late at night Monica is still examining her bill as Rachel
emerges from her room.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Monica. You are not still going over that thing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This woman's living my life.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's living my life, and she's doing it better than me! Look at this,
look. She buys tickets for plays that I wanna see. She, she buys clothes from stores that
I'm intimidated by the sales people. She spent three hundred dollars on art supplies.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You're not an artist.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, well I might be if I had the supplies! I mean, I could do all this
stuff. Only I don't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Monica, c'mon, you do cool things.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh really? Okay, let's compare, shall we.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Yawning) Oh, it's so late for 'Shall we'...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do I go horseback riding in the park? Do I take classes at the New
School?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Yawning) Nooo...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is so unfair! She's got everything I want, and she doesn't have my
mother.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Chandler are discussing stage names.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How about Joey... Pepponi?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, still too ethnic. My agent thinks I should have a name that's more
neutral.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey... Switzerland?
(The waitress brings their coffee.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Plus, y'know, I think it should be Joe. Y'know, Joey makes me sound like
I'm, I dunno, this big. (Waitress looks at him funny) Which I'm not.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joe...Joe...Joe...Stalin?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Stalin...Stalin...do I know that name? It sounds familiar.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it does not ring a bell with me...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Writes it down) Joe Stalin. Y'know, that's pretty good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Might wanna try Joseph.
(Joey visibly thinks 'Of course!' and writes it down.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Joseph Stalin. I think you'd remember that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes! Bye Bye Birdie, starring Joseph Stalin. Joseph Stalin is the
Fiddler on the Roof.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is there as Phoebe and Rachel enter.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi. (On the phone) Hi, uh, yes, this is Monica Geller. Um, I believe I'm
taking some classes with you and I was wondering what they were.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Hushes her) Alright, great. Thanks a lot. (Hangs up) I'm going to tap
class.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What, what, so that you can dance with the woman that stole your credit
card?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This woman's got my life, I should get to see who she is.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Go to the post office! I'm sure her picture's up! ...Okay, Monica,
y'know what, honey, you're kinda losing it here! I mean, this is really becoming like a
weird obsession thing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is madness. It's madness, I tell you, for the love of God,
Monica, don't do it!! ...Thank you.

scenes.location: A Tap Class, the girls are standing at the door.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What d'you think?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Lotsa things.
(They go in and sit down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Which one do you think she is?
(The teacher comes up to them.)

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: May I help you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, no thanks, we're just here to observe.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: You don't observe a dance class. You dance a dance class. Spare shoes are over there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What does she mean?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think she means (Imitates) 'You dance a dance class'. Oh, c'mon, c'mon. (They put on some spare
shoes)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, d'y'see anybody you think could be me?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: (To the class) People! Last time there were some empty yoghurt
containers lying around after class. Let's not have that happen again!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She could be you.
(Music starts)

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Let's get started. Five, six, a-five six seven eight...
(Everyone starts to dance in unison. Monica flounders)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I'm not getting this!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Dancing in a swirly, Phoebe kind of way) I'm totally getting it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you ever feel like sometimes you are just so unbelievably
uncoordinated?
(Rachel taps into view; she is in perfect sync with the rest of the class)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? You just click when they click.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Alright people, now everyone grab a partner.
(The girls are unsure how to pair off. Phoebe settles it)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. And, my, dead, mother, says, you, are, it. I'm with Rachel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great. It's gym class all over again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Aww.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Well that's all right, you can come up to the front and dance with me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don't I just take off my clothes and have a nightmare.
(She starts to walk very slowly toward the front of the room. The teacher grabs her
hand and pulls her. Suddenly a woman bursts in)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It's okay, it's okay, I'm here, I'm here. Sorry I'm late, okay, here I
am. Who's the new tense girl?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: She's your partner.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi. I'm Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. Monica! ...Hi. I'm Mo- ...nana.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (Fake Monica) Monana?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. It's Dutch.

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: You're kidding! I-I spent three years in Amsterdam. (Asks her
something in Dutch)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Um, Pennsylvania Dutch.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: And we're dancing. A-five, six, seven, eight...

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Mortified) Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where've you been?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: At the vet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She's not gonna make you wear one of those big plastic cones, is she?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She says Marcel's humping thing's not a phase. Apparently he's reached
sexual maturity.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) Hey! He beat ya.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She says as time goes on, he's gonna start getting agressive and violent.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So what does this mean?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm gonna have to give him up.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Central Perk, scene continued from earlier. They guys are sitting there
like the Three Monkeys.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't believe it, Ross. This sucks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't get it, I mean, you just got him. How can he be an adult
already?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know. I know. I mean, one day, he's this little thing, and before you
know it, he's this little thing I can't get off my leg.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Isn't there any way you can keep him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no. The vet says unless he's in a place where he has regular access to
some... monkey lovin,' he's just gonna get vicious. I've just gotta get him into a zoo.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How do you get a monkey into a zoo?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know that one! ...No, that's Popes into a Volkswagen.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, we're applying to a lot of them. Naturally our first choice would be
one of the bigger state zoos, y'know, like, uh, San Diego... right? But that might just be
a pipe dream, because, y'know, he's out of state. Uh, my vet, uh, knows someone at Miami,
so that's a possibility.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, but that's like two blocks away from the beach. I mean, it's a
total party zoo.
(Phoebe, Monica, and Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey. We found her, we found the girl.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Did you call the cops?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nope. We took her to lunch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah. Your own brand of vigilante justice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! Are you insane? This woman stole from you. She stole. She's a
stealer.

lines.speaker: Monica

forget all that. I mean, she is this astounding person, with this, with this amazing
spirit.

lines.text: Yeah, which she probably stole from some cheerleader.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...Take off their hats!

lines.speaker: Phoebe

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica, Rachel and Fake Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No way. No way did you do this.

lines.text: Monana was very brave.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was so wild. We told them we were the Gunnersens in room six fifteen.
Only to find out the Boston Celtics had taken over the entire sixth floor!

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: So once they caught on to the fact that we're, y'know, short and
have breasts...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ...They threw us out! I was thrown out of a hotel! Me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Go Monana! Well, you ladies are not the only ones living the dream. I
get to go pour coffee for people I don't know. Don't wait up. (Exits)

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: Oh, by the way, tomorrow we're auditioning for a Broadway show.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: 'Scuse me?

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: There's an open call for Cats. I'm thinking we go down there, sing
Memories and make complete fools of ourselves. Whaddya say?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nononononono. Think who you're dealing with here. I mean, I'm not like
you. I-I can't even stand in front of a tap class.

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: Well, that's just probably 'cause of your Amish background.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: Well, you're Pennsylvania Dutch, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Right. Till I bought a blow dryer, then I was shunned.

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: I-I used to be just like you. And then one day I saw a movie that
changed my life. Did you ever see Dead Poets' Society?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: I thought that movie was so incredibly... boring.
I mean, that thing at the end where the kid kills himself because he can't be in the play?
What was that?! It's like, kid, wait a year, leave home, do some community theatre. I
walked out of there and I thought, 'Now, that's two hours of my life that I'm never
getting back.' And that thought scared me more than all the other crap I was afraid to do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow. Then I would definitely not recommend Mrs. Doubtfire.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, tiem lapse. Everyone but Joey and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Reading letters) Oh God. (To Marcel) We didn't get into Scranton. (To the
others) That was like our safety zoo. They take like dogs and cows. See? I don't know who
this is harder on, me or him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'd say that chair's taking the brunt.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel! Marcel! Marcel, no! Good boy. See, how can nobody want him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, somebody will.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) You know there already is a Joseph Stalin?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're kidding.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Apparently he was this Russian dictator who slaughtered all these people.
You'd think you would've known that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, you'd think I would've.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phoebe. Whaddyou think a good stage name for me would be?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ...Flame Boy.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is talking to Dr. Baldhara, a zookeeper.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Where exactly is your zoo?

lines.speaker: Dr. Baldhara
lines.text: Well, it's technically not a zoo per se, it's more of an
interactive wildlife experience. Let me ask you some questions about, is it, uh, Marcel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Dr. Baldhara
lines.text: Does he, uh, fight with other animals?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no, he's, he's very docile.

lines.speaker: Dr. Baldhara
lines.text: Even if he were... cornered?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I, I don't know. Why?

lines.speaker: Dr. Baldhara
lines.text: Uh, how is he at handling small objects?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He can hold a banana, if that's whatcha mean...

lines.speaker: Dr. Baldhara
lines.text: How about a hammer, or a small blade?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why- why- why would he need a blade?

lines.speaker: Dr. Baldhara
lines.text: Well, if he's up against a jungle cat or an animal with horns,
you've got to give the little guy something. Otherwise it's just cruel.
(Chandler and Joey burst in, with Marcel)

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: He- he- he got in, he- he got in to San
Diego.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We, we come back from our walk and the- the phone was ringing...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...He's in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He's in! Oh, did you hear that, Marcel? San Diego. San Diego!

lines.speaker: Dr. Baldhara
lines.text: You're making a big mistake here. I mean, San Diego's all well and
good, but if you give him to me, I'll start him off against a blind rabbit and give you
twenty percent of the gains.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is dusting. She comes to the table, lifts all the
magazines and wipes under them, then just puts them down again. Monica bursts in,
obviously drunk.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yo- hooo!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Where the hell've you been?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Monica and I just crashed an embassy party.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you drunk?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Noooo! (Comes closer and whispers) I'm lying. I am so drunk.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, oh. Great, Monica, y'know what, you could've called, I have been
up here, I've been worried...
(Monica is drinking from the tap)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica? Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Water rules!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, yes, it does. Okay, look, the restaurant called, they wanna know if
you're gonna be showing up for work?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nope. Going to the Big Apple Circus today.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Monica, what are you doing? You're gonna lose your job! This is not
you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it is me! Y'know, I'm not just the person who needs to fluff the
pillows and pay the bills as soon as they come in! Y'know, when I'm with her, I am so much
more than that. I'm- I'm Monana!
(The phone rings and Rachel answers)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello? Yes, she is, hold on a second, please. Monana, it's for you, the
credit card people.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Helloooo? Yeah. Oh my God. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They've arrested Monica.

scenes.location: New York City Department of Correction, Monica is visiting Fake Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How are you?

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: I'm not too bad. Fortunately, blue's my colour. How-how did you
know I was here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because... I'm Monica Geller. It was my credit card you were using.

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: That I was not expecting.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I want you to know, it wasn't me who turned you in.

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: Oh. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, thank you! You have given me so much! I mean, if it wasn't for you,
I would never have gotten to sing Memories on the stage at the Wintergarden
Theater!

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: Well, actually, you only got to sing 'Memo-'.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just can't believe you're in here. I mean, what am I gonna do without
you? Who's gonna crash the embassy parties with me? Who's gonna take me to the Big
Apple Circus?

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: Monica, I started my day by peeing in front of twenty-five other
women, and you're worried about who's gonna take you to the Big Apple Circus?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, not... worried, just... wondering.

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: There's nothing to wonder about, Monica. You're gonna go back to
being exactly who you were, because that's who you are.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not necessarily...

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: Yes necessarily! I mean, I dunno what it is, maybe it's the Amish
thing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Um, I'm not actually Amish.

lines.speaker: Fake Monica
lines.text: Really? Then why are you like that?

scenes.location: Tap Class, Monica is standing by the door.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: You by the door. In or out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: In. (She joins in the dancing. She still flounders)

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: You in the back, you're getting it all wrong!

lines.speaker: Monica
