lines.speaker: PA
lines.text: This is the final boarding call for flight 67 to San Diego,
boarding at gate 42A.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Good-bye, little monkey guy. Alright, I wrote you this poem. Okay,
but don't eat it 'till you get on the plane.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aww. Thank you, Aunt Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, bye, champ. Now, I know there's gonna be a lot of babes in San
Diego, but remember, there's also a lot to learn.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I dunno what to say, Ross. Uh, it's a monkey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just, just say what you feel.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Marcel, I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That was good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Brings Marcel a teddy bear) Marcel, this is for you. It's, uh, just,
y'know, something to, um, do on the plane.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, if you guys don't mind, I'd like to take a moment, just me and him.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, sure. Sure, absolutely. (They just stand there, then realise
what he means and go to the other end of the room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Marcel, c'mere, c'mere. (He sits down and Marcel jumps down and sits
beside him) Well buddy, this is it. There's just a coupla things I want to say. I'm really
gonna miss you, and I'm never gonna forget about you. You've been more than just a pet to
me, you've been more like a be- (Marcel climbs down and starts humping his leg) Okay,
Marcel, please, could you leave my leg alone? Could you just stop humping me for two
seconds?! Marcel, would- okay, just take him away. Just take him.
(Marcel is put in a cage and taken away.)

title: The One with the Ick Factor

lines.text: (Scene: Central Perk. Everyone is there.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Tell him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Tell him, tell him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just...please tell him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shut up!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tell me what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look at you, you won't even look at him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastically) Oh, come on tell me. I could use another reason why
women won't look at me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, all right, all right. Last night, I had a dream that, uh, you
and I, were...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Doing it on this table. (points at the table)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Exellent dream score.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why, why, why would you dream that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: More importantly, was I any good?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you were pretty damn good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Interesting, cause in my dreams, I'm allways surprisingly inadequate.
(Monica pats him on his lap)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, last night you seemed to know your way around the table.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I love it, when we share.
(Ross goes over to the counter. Chandler follows him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're okay there?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't belive you two had sex in her dream.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry, it was a one-time-thing. I was very drunk and i was
somebody else's subconscious.

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier, Chandler is sitting on the table.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Get off.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (points at Joey's pen) Uh, uh, gimme. Can you see me operating a drill
press?

lines.text: I don't know. What are you wearing?

lines.text: Pheebs, why would you want to operate a drill press?

lines.text: What... I could, I could do it. What is it?

lines.text: Well, my secretary is gonna be out for a couple of weeks. She is

lines.text: I could be a secretary.

lines.text: Well, you know Phoebs. I don't know if it's your kinda thing, because

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I could do that.
(Ross's beeper goes off)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you playing with?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, it's my new beeper.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What the hell does a paleontologist need a beeper for?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is it like for dinosaur emergencies. 'Help, come quick, they're still
extinct.'

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it's for when Carol goes into labor. She can get me wherever I am. I

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A cool phone number, and a possible name for the kid.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I'll see you guys later. (raises)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Off to see young Ethan?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How young is young Ethan? Young?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He's... our age.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When we were?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, he's a senior in college.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: College?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa! And this manchild has no problem with how old you are?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, of course not. It's not even an issue. Cause I told him I was 22.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I can't pass for 22?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, maybe 25-26.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am 26.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There you go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can you hear that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (plays with a thumbtack remover) Yeah?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See that'll stop when you pick up the phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Uh, I'm on. (picks up the phone)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (with a deep voice) Mr. Bing's office. (Listens) No I'm sorry, he's in a
meeting right now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not in a meeting. I'm right... Whoops.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Will he know what this is in reference to? (Listens) And he has your
number? (Listens) All right, I'll see that he gets the message. Bye bye.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross says hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is so fun. All right, what do we do now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, now, I actually have to get to work.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Most likely. (raises and goes toward the door) Okay, I'm gonna be out
there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. Bye bye.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye bye.
(The intercom buzzes)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (answering it) Yes?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whatcha doin'?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh. (leans against the desk)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are there. Monica is just finishing
cleaning the windows.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Windows are clean, candels are lit. Uh, belt's to tight, gotta change
the belt. Did I turn the fish? (goes over to the kitchen to check on the dinner) No, cause
I made lasagne. (to Rachel) Am I out of control?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just a touch. Mon, I don't understand. I mean, you've been dating this
guy since like, what... his midterms? I mean, why all the sudden are you so... Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Could tonight be the Night?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know. Look he's a great guy and I love being with him but... you
know. Things happen, and they happen. You don't plan these things.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, did you shave your legs?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A-ha!

scenes.location: Central Perk. Joey and Ross are there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Would you let it go Ross. It was just a dream. It doesn't mean...
(Ross's beeper goes off)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, oh. Oh, oh. Oh this is it. Oh my god it's baby time. Baby time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, relax, relax. Just relax, just relax. Be cool, be cool.
(Ross dials a number on his cellular phone)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) Yeah, hi, I was just beeped. (pause) No, Andr� is not here.
(to Joey) Third time today. (on phone) Yes, I'm sure... No, sir. I don't perform those
kind of services.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Services? (Ross looks at him) Oh, services.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) Yeah, you want 55-JUMBO. Yeah, that's right. That's right,
JUMBO with a U, sir. (pause) No, belive me, you don't want me. Judging by his number, I'd
be a huge disappointment. (pause) All rightie, bye bye.
(Phoebe and Chandler enter)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, hey. How was the first day?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, exellent. Everyone was so, so nice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See, it pays to know the man who wears my shoes. (Joey and Ross wonder
what he means) Me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I didn't tell anybody that I knew you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, because, you know... they don't like you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I thought you knew that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Noho. Who doesn't they like me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Everyone. Except for uh... no everyone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don't feel bad. You know they used to like you a lot. But then you got
promoted, and, you know, now you're like "Mr. Boss Man". You know, Mr. Bing. Mr.
Bing, "Boss Man Bing".
(Joey and Ross laughs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't belive it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. They even do you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They do me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know like... uh okay... uh... 'Could that report be any
later?'
(Joey and Ross laughs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't sound like that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, oh Chandler...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh... Yeah, you do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 'The hills were alive with the sound of music.'
(Phoebe, Joey and Ross laughs)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (reaches for hi scones) My scones.
Phoebe, Joey, and Ross: 'My scones.'
(Phoebe, Joey and Ross laughs again)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I don't sound like that. That is so not true.
(Joey and Chandler laughs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is so not... That is so not...
That... Oh, shut up!
(Phoebe, Joey and Ross laugh)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Young Ethan are sitting in the couch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did not.

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: I am telling you, up until I was, like nine, I thought that
gunpoint was an actual place where crimes happen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How was that possible?

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Well, think about it. It's always on the news. 'A man is being held
up, at gunpoint.' 'Tourists are being terrorised, at gunpoint.' And I just kept thinking:
why does people continue to go there? (He checks his watch.) Oh, ah. I should go.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
(They kiss)

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Unless...

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, ah. Unless you wanna stay over? I mean, I'm going to, so...

lines.text: Yeah, I'd really like that.
(They kiss)

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Uuh, before we get into any staying-over-stuff, there is something

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, is this like 'I have an early class tomorrow' or 'I'm secretly

lines.text: Well it's somewhere in between. You see, in a strictly technical

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ethan?

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.text: Are you a virgin?

lines.text: Well, if that's what you kids are calling it these days then, yes I

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Yeah. You do know I was talking about you, right?
(They kiss)
[Time lapse. They are now in Monica's bedroom, on the bed.]

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You keep saying that.

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: You know, you read about it, you see it in the movies. Even when
you practice it at home, man oh man, it is nothing like that.
(They kiss)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Listen, uh, you told me something that was really difficult for you. And
I, I-I figured if you could be honest, then I can to.

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Oh god, don't tell me, I did it wrong.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no. Nothing wrong about that.

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Um, okay, here it goes. I'm not 22. I'm, I'm 25... and thirteen months.

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Huh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But I figured, you know, that shouldn't change anything. I mean, what
the hell does it matter how old we are.
(They kiss)

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Uh, listen um, as long as we're telling stuff, uh, I have another
one for you. I'm a little younger than I said.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're not a senior?

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Oh, I'm a senior... in High School.

lines.text: I wasn't thinking. I was too busy fallin'...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't say it. (closes Ethan's mouth with her hand)

lines.text: ...in love with you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: (nods) Sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well,fall out of it. You know, you shouldn't even be here, it's a school
night. Oh god, oh god. I'm like those women that you see with shiny guys named Chad. I'm
Joan Collins.

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Who?

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, everyone exept Monica is there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) Okay, Andr� should be there in like 45 minutes. All rightie,
bye bye. (to Phoebe) Just easier that way.

lines.text: Oh, come on. You told me about the last dream.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, fine. Um, you were not the only one there. (Camera fades to

lines.text: All right. (Moves closer.)

lines.text: Was there...uh, huh, huh, huh... andybody, anybody else there.

lines.speaker: Ross

lines.text: No, it was just the three of us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, tell me. Was it like you and Chandler, and then you and me, or you and

lines.text: (laughs) You know what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel

(Monica enters, wearing a walkman, so she doesn't hear what the others say)
Ross, Rachel, and Phoebe: Hey, Mon.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mon, Ethan called again. Mon?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (shouting) Mon!
(Monica takes of her walkman)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ethan called again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you not seeing him anymore?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. You know, sometimes just things doesn't work out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And this has nothing to do with the fact that he needs a note to get
out of gym.
(Monica stares at Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I, I didn't say any... I sw... I did not say anything, I swear. He
stopped by.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, the next time you talk to him, can you ask him which one the
strongest Power Ranger is?
(Ross and Chandler laughs)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ha,ha, ha, oh my life is just so amusing. Could we drop it now?

lines.text: It's morphin time!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Stegosaurus!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tyrannosaurus!
(They all cross they're arms like the Power Rangers do)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, oh, I've gotta go. (raises) Whoa, oh, head rush. One more, and then
I have to go. (sits down, and then raises again) Cool!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, oh, I've got a birthday party, with some work people.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Work people? Nobody told me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I know. That's a part of the whole, you know,
them-not-liking-you-extravaganza.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, I don't get this. A month ago, these people were my friends.
You know, just because I'm in charge doesn't mean I'm a different person.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, then you should come tonight. You know, just hang out with them.
Let them see what a great guy you still are.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You think I should?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I really do, yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, but, could we not go together? I,I don't wanna be the geek that
invited the boss.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I Think last night was great. You know, the Karaoke thing. Tracy and I
doing Ebony and Ivory.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You were great. But they still made fun of you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, now you're more like, you know like, "Mr. Caring
Boss," "Mr.", you know, "I'm one of you, Boss," "Mr., I
wanna be your buddy, Boss Man Bing!"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then, I don't get it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, you know what Chandler? I think you've gotta face it. You're like,
the guy in the big office, you know. You're the one that hires them, that fires them...
They still say you're a great boss.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh huh. But they're not your friends anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I just wan't to...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, but you can't.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But I just wa...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh uh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aren't you gonna...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, Carol and I have a new system. If she punches in 911, it means she's
having a baby, otherwise I just ignore it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What about Andr�?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, well this morning he got a call from who I think was our cousin
Nathan, and frankly, it was a little more than I needed to know.
(Ethan enters)

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was gonna be my opener.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (understands that Monica and Ethan wanna be alone) Hey, did you guys
check out those new hand-dryers in the bathroom?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I thought that was just a rumour.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: True story.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They're here already?
(Rachel, Ross and Ross go to the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: All right, look. I've gotta tell you something. I'm not 17. I only
said so that you'd think I was cute and vunerable. I'm actually 30, I have a wife, I have
a job, I'm your Congressman. Monica, this is ridiculous, we're great together. We can
talk, we make each other laugh, and the sex. Oh, man, okay i have no frame of graft, but I
thought that was great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was.

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Then, what's the problem?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ethan, it's um... it's icky.

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: Icky? You're actually gonna throw this away because it's icky?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This isn't easy for me either. I wish things were different, I... If you
were a few years older, or if I was a few years younger, or if we lived in biblical times,
I would really...

lines.speaker: Young Ethan
lines.text: No, don't say it. (closes Monica's mouth with his hand)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ...love you.
(Ross, Rachel and Joey come back from the bathroom. They discover that Monica and Ethan
aren't finished talking to each other yet.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you're hands still wet?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, moist, yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let's dry 'em again.
(They go to the bathroom again)
[Scene: A hall on the floor where Chandler works. Chandler and Phoebe enters, and
overhears some employees's conversation. One of them is doing Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Gerston
lines.text: Uh, like, could these margaritas be any stronger?
(They discover that Chandler is listening) Hey, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Hello, Mr. Bing.

lines.speaker: Petrie
lines.text: Loved your Stevie Wonder last night.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks. Listen, about the weekly numbers, I'm gonna need them on my
desk by nine o'clock.

lines.speaker: Santos
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Gerston
lines.text: No problem.
(They go away, trying very hard not to laugh at Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You have to give 'em something, you know. Okay, now that was Gerston,
Santos, and who's the guy with the moustache?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Petrie.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Petrie, right, right. Okay, some people gonna be working this weekend.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is watching TV, but turns it off, and Rachel is
sleeping on the couch. Ross puts a blanket over her.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (talking in her sleep) Oooooooooh. (Rachel strokes her hand over the
pillow. Ross mimicks her silently) Oh, that's nice. Oh, oh. Huh, Ross!
(Ross gets all excited and starts to dance on the coffee table, but slips allmost
immediatly, and falls onto the couch. Rachel wakes up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are. Well, um... We, we, we were just... Wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (his beeper goes off) Great, now I'm having a baby.

lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ooh, Ooh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.text: I'm having... I'm having a baby. (jumps back onto the table again) I'm
having a... Where's the phone? The phone?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know where the phone is.
(Ross runs from the table, over the couch but slips and falls onto the floor)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm hurt.

title: The One with the Birth

lines.text: [Scene: The hospital, Ross, Rachel, Chandler, Joey, and Monica are in the waiting room,
waiting for Carol and Susan to arrive.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She's not here yet. She's not here. She's having my baby and she's not
here.

lines.text: I'm sure everything's fine. Has her water broke yet?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know, but when I spoke to her, she said she had already passed the

(Joey makes a sound of absolute disgust.)

lines.text: Did I miss it, did I miss it?

lines.text: We stopped at the gift shop.

lines.text: Susan wanted a Chunky. We're having a baby, ok, a baby, you don't

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Stopped for a Chunky.

lines.text: So, I understand you're thinking of having a baby? Well, I see

lines.text: Oh, that's funny!

lines.text: Oh, ok, 'cause we never do that.

lines.text: Knick fan?

lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.text: Oh, boy, do they suck.

lines.speaker: Joey

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: Look, look at your man, Ewing. Nice shot. You know what, he couldn't hit

lines.text: Oh yeah? And who do you like?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: Ok.

lines.text: (singing)
They're tiny and chubby and so sweet to touch,
and soon they'll grow up and resent you so much.
Now they're yelling at you and you don't know why,
you cry and you cry and you cry.

lines.text: Ok.

lines.text: No, no, no.

lines.text: Hey.

lines.text: Hey. Ooh, look at you, dressy-dress.

lines.text: Did you go home and change?

lines.text: Yeah, well, it's an important day. I wanna look nice. Um, has uh Dr.

lines.text: No, I haven't seen him.

lines.text: Well, where is he? He is supposed to be here. (Pause) What if the baby

lines.text: Rachel, what is the deal with you and doctors, anyway? Was, like, your

lines.text: Yeah, why?

lines.text: No reason. (turns around, makes an 'Oh my God' gesture with his eyes)

lines.text: Maybe you should.

lines.text: Good luck, and uh, take care, huh?

lines.text: You know what the Celtics problem is? They let the players run the team.

lines.text: Oh, that is so not true.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it is.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: It isn't.

lines.text: It is.

lines.text: Breathe.

lines.text: I got it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please. This is so your fault.

lines.text: How, how is this my fault?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, Carol never threw me out of a room before you came along.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Yeah? Well, there's a lot of things Carol never did before I came along.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You tryin' to be clever? A funny lady?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: You know what your problem is? You're threatened by me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I'm threatened by you?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Yes.
(Phoebe has heard them arguing and comes down the hall, taking them into a broom
closet.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, hey, ok, all right, that's it! Get in here. Come on. My god, you
guys, I don't believe you. There are children coming into the world in this very building
and your negative fighting noises are not the first thing they should be hearing. So just
stop all the yelling, just stop it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, Susan.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don't make me do this again, I don't like my voice like this.
(Phoebe goes to leave the room, but the door is locked.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, who wants to hear something ironic?
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The Broom Closet, Ross and Susan are trying to get out.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Help!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm having a baby in here! Ok, everyone stand back. (Walks backwards as if
he is going to break down the door, but steps in a bucket and falls) Ow.

scenes.location: Carol's room, Rachel and Dr. Franzblau are there with her.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Are they here yet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, honey, they're not, but don't worry, because we are going to find
them, and until we do, we are all here for you, ok?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Dr. Franzblau) Ok, so anyway, you were telling me about Paris, it
sounds fascinating.

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: It really was. There was this great little pastry shop right by
my hotel. (Carol sits up in pain, Rachel and Dr. Franzblau casually lay her back down)
There you go, dear.

scenes.location: Lydia's Room, Joey is helping her deliver.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on, Lydia, you can do it. Push! Push 'em out, push 'em out, harder,
harder. Push 'em out, push 'em out, way out! Let's get that ball and really move, hey,
hey, ho, ho. Let's— (notices the nurse looking at him strangely) I was
just—yeah, right. Push! Push!

scenes.location: The Broom Closet, Ross has picked up a vacuum and is holding it at the door.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: What're you gonna do, suck the door open?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Help! Help!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) They found their bodies the very next day, they found their
bodies the very next...(sees Ross and Susan staring at her) la la la la la la.

lines.speaker: Susan and Ross
lines.text: (even louder) Help!
[Scene: The Waiting Room, Monica is on the phone with her mother, Chandler is standing
behind her.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now, Mom, everything's going fine, really. (Listens) Yeah, Ross is
great. He's uh, he's in a whole other place. (Listens) No, he's gone. (Listens) No no, you
don't have to fly back, really. (Listens) What do you mean this might be your only chance?
(Listens) Would you stop? I'm only 26, I'm not even thinking about babies yet.
(Monica sees a woman pass by with a baby, puts the phone to her chest, and starts to
cry. Chandler takes the phone, makes a noise in it resembling static, and hangs up. Joey
enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where have you been?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, just had a baby.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mazel tov!

scenes.location: The Waiting Room, Rachel and Dr. Franzblau have gone to get coffee.

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: I don't know, could be an hour, could be three, but relax, she's
doing great. So, uh, tell me, are you currently involved with anyone?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (anxiously) No, no, not at the moment, no, I'm not. Are you?

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: No, it's hard enough to get women to go out with me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right, yeah, I've heard that about cute doctors.

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: No, no, really. I suppose it's because I spend so much time, you
know, where I do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: I try not to let my work affect my personal life, but it's hard,
when you... do what I do. It's like uh...Well, for instance, what do you do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm a waitress.

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: Ok, all right, well aren't there times when you come home at the
end of the day, and you're just like, 'if I see one more cup of coffee'...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (getting the point) Yeah. Gotcha.

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: I'm gonna go check up on your friend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok. That's fine. (takes her earrings out)
[Scene: The Hall Outside Lydia's Room, Joey is walking up to Lydia's room with
balloons, but before he enters he sees that the baby's father has arrived. He listens at
the door.]

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: So how did you know I was even here?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Your mom called me. So is this her?

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: No, this is a loaner.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: I'm sorry you had to do this by yourself.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: I wasn't by myself. I had a doctor, a nurse, and a helper guy. (Joey
smiles) So, did you see who won the game?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Yeah, the Knicks by 10. They suck.

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: Yeah, they're not so bad.
(Joey closes the door and ties the balloons to the knob. Then he walks away, holding
the hand of an inflated balloon animal he had brought.)
[Scene: The Broom Closet, Ross is trying to open the door with a credit card, with no
success.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, come on. Damnit, damnit, damnit, damnit. (to Susan) This is all
your fault. This is supposed to be, like, the greatest day of my life, y'know? My son is
being born, and I should be in there, you know, instead of stuck in a closet with you.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: The woman I love is having a baby today. I've been waiting for this just
as much as you have.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No no no, believe me. No one has been waiting for this as much as I have,
ok? And you know what the funny thing is? When this day is over, you get to go home with
the baby, ok? Where does that leave me?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: You get to be the baby's father. Everyone knows who you are. Who am I?
There's Mother's Day, there's Father's Day, there's no... Lesbian Lover Day.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Every day is Lesbian Lover Day.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is so great.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You wanna explain that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I mean, well, 'cause when I was growing up, you know my dad left, and my
mother died, and my stepfather went to jail, so I barely had enough pieces of parents to
make one whole one. And here's this little baby who has like three whole parents who care
about it so much that they're fighting over who gets to love it the most. And it's not
even born yet. It's just, it's just the luckiest baby in the whole world. (pause) I'm
sorry, you were fighting.
[Scene: Carol's Room, she is ready to give birth. Everyone is there except for Phoebe,
Ross, and Susan, who are in the broom closet.]

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Where are they?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sure they'll be here soon.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, honey, they wouldn't miss this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Relax. You're only at nine centimeters. And the baby's at zero station.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) You are really frightening me.
(Carol suddenly screams in pain and grabs Chandler by the shirt.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Somebody wanna help me, tryin' to rip out my heart. (they pull her
hand off of him) Uh, that's great. (looking around) Anybody seen a nipple?

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: All right, ten centimeters, here we go.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: All right, honey, time to start pushing.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: But they're not here yet!

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: I'm sorry, I can't tell the baby to wait for them.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh, god.
[Scene: The Broom Closet, Ross has used a broom to open the air vent in the ceiling.
Phoebe is wearing a janitor's uniform, ready to go up in the vent.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, got the vent open.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading the nametag on the uniform) Hi, I'm Ben. I'm hospital worker
Ben. It's Ben... to the rescue!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ben, you ready? All right, gimme your foot. Ok, on three, Ben. One, two,
three. Ok, That's it, Ben.
(Ross and Susan lift Phoebe up into the vent.)

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: What do you see?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, Susan, I see what appears to be a dark vent. Wait. Yes, it is in
fact a dark vent.
(A janitor opens the closet door from the outside.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebs, It's open! It's open!
(Ross and Susan run to the delivery room, leaving Phoebe dangling from the vent.)

lines.speaker: Janitor
lines.text: (to Ross and Susan) Wait! You forgot your legs!

scenes.location: Carol's Room, Ross and Susan rush in.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Push, push!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We're here!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (irked) Where have you been?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Long story, honey.

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: All right, Carol, I need you to keep pushing. I
need—(reaches for an instrument, Rachel's hand is on it) Excuse me, could I have
this?

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: All right, all right, there's a few too many people in this room, and
there's about to be one more, so anybody who's not an ex-husband or a lesbian life
partner, out you go!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Good luck!
(Everyone heads for the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to nurse) Let me ask you, do you have to be Carol's lesbian life
partner?

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Out!

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: All right, he's crowning. Here he comes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let me see, I gotta see, I gotta see. Oh, a head. Oh, it's, it's huge.
Carol, how are you doing this?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (straining) Not.... helping!

lines.speaker: Dr. Franzblau
lines.text: You're doing great, you're doing fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (puts his head near the baby) Hello! (to Dr. Franzblau) Oh, sorry.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: What do you see? What do you see?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We got a head, we got shoulders, we got arms, we got, oh, look at the
little fingers, oh, and a chest, and a stomach. It's a boy, definitely a boy! All right!
Ok, legs, knees, and feet. Oh, oh. He's here. He's a person.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh, look at that.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: What does he look like?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Kinda like my uncle Ed, covered in Jell-o.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (from the air vent overhead) You guys, he's beautiful!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thanks, Pheebs!
(They look up towards the vent and wave at Phoebe.)

scenes.location: The Delivery Room, Carol is holding the infant.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: No shouting, but we still need a name for this little guy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (thinking) How 'bout Ben?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: I like Ben.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ben. Ben. Ben's good. How come you never mentioned Ben before?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We uh, we just cooked it up.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: That's what we were off doing.
(Monica opens the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can we come in?
(The whole gang enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Ben) I know, I know. Everybody, there's someone I'd like you to meet.
Yeah. This is Ben. Ben, this is everybody.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Susan, he looks just like you.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, god, I can't believe one of us actually has one of these.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, I still am one of these.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, can I?
(Monica holds Ben.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The head, the head. You gotta...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (getting choked up) Hi, Ben. Hi. I'm your Aunt Monica. Yes I am. I'm
your Aunt Monica. I...I will always have gum.

title: The One Where Rachel Finds Out

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, the whole gang is there, Ross is showing pictures of his new baby
boy, Ben, to the group.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And here's little Ben nodding off...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Awww, look at Aunt Monica's little boy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, look, he's got Ross's haircut!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, let me see! (grabs picture) Oh, God, is he just the sweetest thing?
You must just want to kiss him all over!
(Ross is practically drooling over Rachel at this point.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (quietly) That would be nice.
(Chandler, annoyed with Ross's fawning, makes a 'pfft' noise.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing, just a little extra air in my mouth. Pffft. Pffffffft. (walks
over to where Joey is seated)
(Joey is looking at his check.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Chan, can you help me out here? I promise I'll pay you back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah, right, OK... inlcuding the waffles last week, you now owe
me... 17 jillion dollars.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I will, really. I'll pay you back this time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sigh)... And where's this money coming from? (gives money to Joey)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well... I'm helping out down at the N.Y.U. Med School with some...
research.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (overhearing) What kind of research?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, just, y'know.... science.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Science. Yeah, I think I've heard of that. (everyone's interest is piqued,
they all look over)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sigh)... It's a fertility study.
(Rachel laughs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Joey, please tell me you're only donating your time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, come on you guys, it's not that big a deal. Really... I mean, I
just go down there every other day and... make my contribution to the project. Hey, hey,
but at the end of two weeks, I get seven hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, ooh, you're gonna be making money hand over fist!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Phoebe are preparing for a barbecue for
Rachel's birthday.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: OK, we got the cole slaw, we got the buns...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We've got the ground-up flesh of formerly cute cows and turkeys, ew...
(hands meat to Monica)
(Chandler and Joey enter with charcoal.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (in a deep voice) Men are here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We make fire. Cook meat.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then put out fire by peeing, no get invited back.

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Ewww!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh Joey, Melanie called, said she's gonna be late.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, OK.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So how are things going with you two? Is she becoming your
(provocatively) special someone?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know, she's, uh.... she's pretty great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah? What does she think of your little science project?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What, you think I'm gonna tell a girl I like that I'm also seeing a cup?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Man's got a point.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, the tough thing is, she really wants to have sex with me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Crazy bitch.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, well, I still got a week left to go in the program, and according to
the rules, if I want to get the money I'm not allowed to conduct any... ersonal
experiments, if you know what I mean.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey... we always know what you mean.
[Time lapse. Chandler and Joey are making the fire, Monica and Phoebe are inside. Ross
enters, carrying luggage.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. (Phoebe sees his bags)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How long did you think this barbecue was gonna last?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm going to China.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Jeez, you say one thing, and...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're going to China?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, i-it's for the museum. Someone found a bone, we want the bone, but
they don't want us to have the bone, so I'm going over there to try to persuade them to
give us the bo—it's—it's a whole big bone thing. Anyway, I'm gonna be gone for
like, uh... like a week, so, uh, if you wanna reach me, y-you can't. So here's my
itinerary (hands a sheet of paper to Monica). Um... here's a picture of me... (hands it to
Monica)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, let me see! (takes the picture)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Monica): Could you take it to Carol's every now and then, and show it
to Ben, just so he doesn't forget me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.
(Phoebe puts the picture of Ross up to her face.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi, Ben. I'm your father. I am... the head. Aaaaaahhhh.... (puts picture
down, sees Ross staring at her) Alright, this barbecue is gonna be very fun.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, is Rachel here? Um, I wanted to wish her a happy birthday before I
left.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no, she's out having drinks with Carl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. (pause) Hey, who's Carl?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know, that guy she met at the coffeehouse.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, well, see, there's this guy she met at the...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: At the coffeehouse, right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you do know who he is! (laughs, Ross stares at her) Sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK, I'm gonna go say goodbye to the guys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hey, y'know what? Tell them that bone story.
(Ross goes outisde on the balcony.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sigh)....I have to go to China.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The country?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No no, this big pile of dishes in my mom's breakfront. Do you guys know
who Carl is?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, let's see... Alvin... Simon... Theodore.... no.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, Rachel's having drinks with him tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no! How can she do that when she's never shown any interest in you?!?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Forget about her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He's right, man. Please. Move on. Go to China. Eat Chinese food.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Course there, they just call it food.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah... I guess. I don't—I don't know. Alright, just... just give her
this for me, OK? (gives Chandler a gift for Rachel)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, buddy, we're just looking out for you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We want you to be happy. And I may only have a couple beers in me, but...
I love you, man. (Joey gives Ross a hug)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm still on my first. I just think you're nice.
[Time lapse. Melanie, Joey's girlfriend, is there with Joey, Chandler, Monica, Phoebe,
and Rachel. Ross is gone.]

lines.speaker: Melanie
lines.text: Anyway, that's when me and my friends started this whole fruit basket
business. We call ourselves 'The Three Basketeers.'

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Like the three musketeers, only with fruit.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastic) Ooooh. (looks dumbfounded at Joey's stupidity)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (gets up) OK, how does everybody like their burgers?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no. Presents first. Food later. (walks into living room)
(Everyone follows Rachel to the living room. Monica pulls Joey aside.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, hold on there, tiger. How's it going? How you holding up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, not so good. She definitely thinks tonight is the night we're
gonna... complete the transaction, if you know what I...
(Monica rolls her eyes.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then you do. Heh, heh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, uh, have you ever thought about being there for her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know, just be there for her.
(Long pause... Joey looks confused.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not following you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Think about it.
(They both walk over to where Rachel is opening her gifts. Rachel sees her first gift
is a fruit basket.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK, I'm guessing this is from...
(Melanie smiles.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, thank you, Melanie.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pointing out a gift) OK, this one right here is from me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (picks it up) OK... ah, it's light... (shakes it)...it rattles...
it's... (opens it) Travel Scrabble! Oooohhh, thank you! (she gives it back to him)
(Chandler looks dejected. Rachel picks up another gift.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This one's from Joey... feels like a book. Thinks it's a book... feels
like a book. And...(opens it)...it's a book!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it's Dr. Seuss!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Rachel): That book got me through some tough times.

lines.speaker: Melanie
lines.text: There is a little child inside this man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, the doctors say if they remove it, he'll die.
(Rachel picks up the next gift.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who's this from?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that's Ross's.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... (opens it)... (sees it is a pin) Oh my God. He remembered.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Remembered what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It was like months ago. We were walking by this antique store, and I saw
this pin in the window, and I told him it was just like one my grandmother had when I was
a little girl. Oh! I can't believe he remembered!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, sure, but can you play it on a plane? (pats his Travel
Scrabble game)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it's so pretty. This must have cost him a fortune.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe he did this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on, Ross? Remember back in college, when he fell in love with
Carol and bought her that ridiculously expensive crystal duck?
(Everyone looks at him. He realizes he just spilled the beans about Ross's crush on
Rachel. You can hear this entire classic scene by clicking here.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (panicked) ahem... um... Crystal duck.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, no.... the, um, the... 'love' part?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stuttering incoherently) F-hah.... flennin....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.... my God.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (rubbing his temples) Oh, no-no-no-no-no....

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pats Chandler on the leg) That's good, just keep rubbing your head.
That'll turn back time.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean, this is unbelievable.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. This is really, really huge.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No it's not. It's small. It's tiny. It's petite. It's wee.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nuh-uh. I don't think any of our lives are ever gonna be the same ever
again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: OK, is there a mute button on this woman?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think this is so great! I mean, you and Ross! D-did you have any idea?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! None! I mean, my first night in the city, he mentioned something
about asking me out, but nothing ever happened, so I just... (to Joey): W-well, what else
did he say? I mean, does he, like, want to go out with me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, given that he's desperately in love with you, he probably wouldn't
mind getting a cup of coffee or something.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross? All this time? Well, I've got to talk to him. (gets up to leave)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (quickly) H-He's in China!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The country.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, no, wait. (checks Ross's itinerary) His flight doesn't leave for
another forty-five more minutes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What about the time difference?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: From here to the airport?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! (Rachel walks towards door) You're never gonna make it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, what're you gonna say to him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I-I-I don't know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well then maybe you shouldn't go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He's right, cause if you're just gonna, like, break his heart, that's the
kind of thing that can wait.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but if it's good news, you should tell him now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know. Maybe I'll know when I see him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Here, look, alright, does this help?
(Phoebe gets up, holds the picture of Ross up to her face.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noooo... look, all I know is that I cannot wait a week until I see him.
I mean, this is just too big. Y'know, I just, I've just gotta talk to him. I... I gotta...
OK, I'll see you later. (opens door)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Rachel, I love you! Deal with me first! (she leaves)
[Scene: Airport, Ross has headphones on, and is listening to a 'How To Speak Chinese'
tape. Occasionally, he makes an outburst in Chinese in accordance with the tape. He is
getting on the jetway. The flight attendant is there.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (something in Chinese)

lines.speaker: Flight Attendant
lines.text: Alright!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ni-chou chi-ma! (walks onto jetway)
(Rachel runs into the airport, trying to catch Ross, moving people out of the way.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! Excuse me, pardon me, excuse me....
(Rachel gets up to the jetway.)

lines.speaker: Flight Attendant
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Flight Attendant
lines.text: May I see your boarding pass?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no, no, I don't have one. I just need to talk to my friend.

lines.speaker: Flight Attendant
lines.text: Oh, oooh. I'm sorry. You are not allowed on the jetway unless
you have a boarding pass.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I know, but I—he just went on. He's right there, he's got the
blue jacket on, I... can I j-just...

lines.speaker: Flight Attendant
lines.text: No no no! Federal regulations!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK, alright, OK, um... then could you please, uh... just give him a
message for me? Please? This is very important.

lines.speaker: Flight Attendant
lines.text: Alright. What's the message?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh... I don't know.
[Cut to the Jetway, the flight attendant enters, walks past Ross, and approaches an
older man with his wife who is also wearing a blue jacket.]

lines.speaker: Flight Attendant
lines.text: Sir? Sir? Excuse me, sir? Uh... I have a message for you.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: (confused) What?

lines.speaker: Flight Attendant
lines.text: It's from Rachel. She said that she loved the present, and she
will see you when you get back.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: (to wife): Toby... Oh, for God's sake, I don't know what she's talking
about! There's no Rachel! Don't give me that deep freeze.

scenes.location: Joey's Bedroom, he and Melanie are in bed together.

lines.speaker: Melanie
lines.text: Mmmmmm... Oh, Joey, Joey, Joey... I think I blacked out there for a
minute!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Heh, heh. It was nothin'.

lines.speaker: Melanie
lines.text: Well, now we've gotta find something fun for you! (she starts kissing
his chest)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (panicked) Uhhh.. y'know what? Forget about me. Let's, uh... let's give
you another turn.

lines.speaker: Melanie
lines.text: (surprised) M-Me again?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure! Why not?

lines.speaker: Melanie
lines.text: Boy, somebody's gonna get a big fruit basket tomorrow.
(Joey starts to kiss her.)

lines.speaker: Melanie
lines.text: Oooh, I gotta tell you... you are nothing like I thought you would be.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How do you mean?

lines.speaker: Melanie
lines.text: I don't know, I-I guess I just had you pegged as one of those guys
who're always 'me, me, me.' But you... you're a giver. You're like the most generous man I
ever met. I mean... you're practically a woman.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica, Phoebe, and Rachel are there. Monica is holding
the wrapping paper from one of Rachel's gifts.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, so, uh, Rach, uh... do you wanna save this wrapping paper, I mean,
it's only a little bit torn... so are you gonna go for it with Ross or should I just throw
it out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know. I don't know... I thought about it all the way there, and
I thought about it all the way back... and, uh, oh, you guys, y'know, it's Ross.
Y'know what I mean? I mean, it's Ross.

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know, I mean, this is just my initial gut feeling... but I'm
thinking... oh, I'm thinking it'd be really great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, me too! Oh! Oh, we'd be like friends-in-law! Y'know what the
best part is? The best part is that you already know everything about him! I mean, it's
like starting on the fifteenth date!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but, y'know, it's... it would be like starting on the fifteenth
date.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Another good point.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I mean, I mean, when you're at the fifteenth date, y'know, you're
already in a very relationshippy place. Y'know, it's... you're committed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (confused) Huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I mean, then what happens if it doesn't work out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why isn't it working out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know... sometimes it doesn't.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is he not cute enough for you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Does he not make enough money?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I'm just....

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe there's someone else.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wha...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is there? Is there someone else?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! There is.. there is noone else!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then why the hell are you dumping my brother?!?
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is eating breakfast, Joey quietly opens his
bedroom door.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, big...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shhhh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (quietly) ...spender.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She's still asleep.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So how'd it go?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it was amazing. You know how you always think you're great in bed?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The fact that you'd even ask that question shows how little you know
me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it's like, last night, I couldn't do the thing that usually makes me
great. So I had to do all this other stuff. And the response I got... man, oh man, it was
like a ticker tape parade!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, I know, as it happens my room is very very close to the parade
route.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It was amazing! And not just for her... uh-uh. For me, too. It's like, all
of a sudden, I'm blind. But all my other senses are heightened, y'know? It's like... I was
able to appreciate it on another level.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn't know you had another level.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! Neither did I!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, one week later. Monica is seated, Rachel comes out of her
bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, great skirt! Birthday present?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, from who?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: From you. I exchanged the blouse you got me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it's the thought. Hey, doesn't Ross's flight get in in a couple
hours? At gate 27-B?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, yeah. Uh, Monica, y'know, honey, I've been thinking about it and
I've decided this—this whole Ross thing, it's just not a good idea.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because, I feel like I wouldn't just be going out with him. I would be
going out with all of you. Oh, and there would just be all this pressure, and I don't
wanna...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (gets up) No, no, no, no, no, no pressure, no pressure!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, nothing has even happened yet, and you're already so...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am not 'so'! OK, I was a teensy bit weird at first, but... I'll be
good. I promise.
(Door buzzer goes off. Rachel answers it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Intercom
lines.text: It's me, Carl.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: C'mon up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Behind my brother's back? (Rachel glares at her) ... is exactly the kind
of crazy thing you won't be hearing from me.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is seated, and the apartment is filled with
baskets of fruit. Joey enters, check in hand.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Seven hundred bucks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright, you did it! Do we have any fruit?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, hell of a two weeks, huh? Y'know what, though? I really feel like I
learned something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? So, you're gonna stick with this 'it's all for her' thing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What, are you crazy? When a blind man gets his sight back, does he walk
around like this? (Joey closes his eyes and walks around with arms spread.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's Balcony, Rachel is having drinks with her date, Carl.

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.text: I'm just sayin', if I see one more picture of Ed Begley, Jr. in that stupid
electric car, I'm gonna shoot myself! I mean, don't get me wrong... I'm not against
environmental issues per se.... it's just that guy!
(Rachel looks bored. At this point, Ross—a figment of Rachel's imagination—
shows up on the balcony and starts talking to her.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe you'd rather go out with him than me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Would you excuse me, please? I'm trying to have a date here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, just stop thinking about me.
(She tries, and Ross disappears momentarily. He reappears, standing closer to her.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can't do it, can you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So I'm thinking about you. So what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't get it. What do you see in this guy, anyway?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well... he happens to be a very nice... guy....

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.text: I mean, come on, buddy, get a real car!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel, come on. Give us a chance.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, it's too hard.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no... why, because it might get weird for everyone else? Who cares
about them. This is about us. Look, I-I've been in love with you since, like, the ninth
grade.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, you're like my best friend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: If we broke up, and I lost you...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. What makes you think we're gonna break up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, have you been involved with someone where you haven't broken up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pause) No. But... it only has to happen once. Look, you and I both
know we are perfect for each other, right? I mean... so, the only question is... are you
attracted to me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know... I mean, I've never looked at you that way before.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, start looking.
(They kiss. Ross walks away, and then fades out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.text: Exactly! And you just know I'm gonna be the guy caught behind this
hammerhead in traffic!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right! You're right!

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.text: Heh... y'know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what?

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I forgot... I am supposed to pick up a friend at the airport. I am so
sorry! I'm so... if you want to stay, and finish your drinks, please do.... (gives him her
drink) I mean—I'm sorry. I-I-I gotta go. I'm sorry.
(Rachel leaves.)

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.text: But...
[Scene: Airport. Madonna's Take A Bow plays in the background as Rachel waits at
the gate with flowers.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sifting through crowd) Excuse me, pardon me, excuse me, excuse me,
sorry. Hi.
[Cut to the jetway, the old man who the flight attendant delivered Rachel's message to
gets off the plane, his wife still upset with him.]

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: For God's sake, will you let it go? There's no Rachel!
(A Chinese woman getting off the plane drops one of her bags. Ross gets off next.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, hey, hey, I got that.
(Ross picks up the bag... then he and the woman kiss.)

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: Oh, thanks, sweetie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No problem. I cannot wait for you to meet my friends.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: You don't think they'll judge and ridicule me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, they will. I just... uh...

lines.speaker: Ross and Julie
lines.text: Can't wait.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, they're gonna love you.
[Cut to a close-up of Rachel, eagerly awaiting Ross's arrival... not
knowing he is getting off the plane with another woman.]

title: The One with Ross's New Girlfriend

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe is recapping last season, and as she talks we see a
montague of scenes from Ross and Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, so this is pretty much what's happened so far. Ross was in love with
Rachel since, you know, forever, but every time he tried to tell her, something kind of
got in the way, like cats, and Italian guys. Finally Chandler was like "forget about
her" but when Ross was in China on his dig, Chandler let it slip that Ross was in
love with Rachel. She was like, "Oh my god." So she went to the airport to meet
him when he came back, but what she didn't know was, that Ross was getting off the plane
with another woman. Uh-Oh! So, that's pretty much everything you need to know. But, enough
about us. So, how've you been?
Opening Credits
[Scene, The Airport, continued from last season, Rachel is waiting for
Ross to come of the plane, when she sees he's coming off with another woman.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my god. Oh my god. (She decides to make a break for it.) Excuse me.
Move! Move! Emergency! Excuse me! (She tries climbing over a bench and falls down.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (seeing her) Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, there you are! Hi! Oh, so, so, how was China, you? (Hits him with
the flowers.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was, it was great. Oh, what happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're bleeding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am? Oh, look at that, yes I am. Enough about me, enough about me, Mr.
Back from the Orient. Come on. I wanna hear everything! Everything. (Looks at Julie)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, where do I start? This is Julie. Julie, this is Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: These are, these aren't for you. (to Julie) These are for you. (Loudly,
thinking she can't speak English.) Welcome to our country.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: (Loudly, proving she can speak English.) Thank you. I'm from New York.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, well, not a problem. We'll just use them to stop the bleeding. Ok.
Baggage claim? Ok.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the gang is waiting for Rachel to return from the airport
with Ross.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm telling you, she went to the airport, and she's gonna go for it with
Ross!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my god. This is huge. This is bigger than huge. This is like, all
right, what's bigger than huge?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Um, this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys, you got your hair cut.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, yes, we did, thanks to Vidal Buffay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: 'Cause, you know, (in that voice) if you don't look good, we don't look
good. I love that voice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, out of breath) Airport, airport. Ross, not alone, Julie, arm
around her. Cramp, cramp.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, I think she's trying to tell us something. Quick, get the verbs.
(She hits Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Chandler) You, you, you said he liked me. (Ross and Julie enter)
You, you slowpokes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's all right, Rach, we got the bags. Hi, hello. Julie, this is my
sister Monica. This is Chandler. Phoebe. Joey, what up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What up?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Everyone, this is Julie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (out of breath) Julie.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh. (Happily) Hi!

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: Hi, but I'm not here, you haven't met me. I'll make a much better first
impression tomorrow when I don't have 20 hours of cab and plane on me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And bus.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: Oh my god.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The screaming guy?

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: And the spitting?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You gotta hear this story.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: We're on this bus, that's easily 200 years old...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 200 at least.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: ...and this guy...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And the chicken pooped in her lap. Oh, I'm so sorry. I just gave away
the ending, didn't I? Oh! It's just, I just heard this story in the cab, and it is all I
can think about.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is amazing. I mean, how, how did this happen?

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: Well, Ross and I were in grad school together.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But we haven't seen each other since then. Well I land in China, guess
who's in charge of the dig.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Julie! Julie, isn't that great? I mean, isn't that just
kick-you-in-the-crotch, spit-on-your-neck fantastic?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Julie) It's an expression.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, we just wanted to say a quick hi, and then we're gonna go see the
baby.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: And then we've gotta get some sleep.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it's really 6:00 tomorrow night our time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, listen, don't tell us what's gonna happen though, 'cause I like
to be surprised.
(Ross and Julie exit)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye. (She closes the door and everyone tries to sympathize with her.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross and Chandler enter.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, Rach, can I get some coffee?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, sure.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, Rach, can I get...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did you talk to him?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Then, no.
(He goes to sit down next to Ross.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So what the hell happened to you in China? I mean, when last we left
you, you were totally in love with, you know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, I know I was, but there was always this little voice inside that
kept saying it's never gonna happen, move on. You know whose voice that was?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: God?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was you, pal.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, maybe it was God, doing me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, you were right. She looks at me and sees a friend, that's all. But
then I met Julie, and I don't know, we're havin' a great time. And I have to say, I never
would've gone for it with her if it hadn't been for you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you owe me one, big guy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Ross) Here's your lemonade.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I didn't order lemonade.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Well then, you better go take that back because they're gonna charge
you for that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Go-go-go-go, come on! (Ross goes over to the counte) (to Chandler) So
uh, what did you find out?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He said...he said, he said that they're having a great time. I'm
sorry. But, the silver lining, if you wanna see it, is that he made the decision all by
himself! Without any outside help whatsoever.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How is that the silver lining?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You have to really wanna see it.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross and the gang is watching Sumo wrestling on TV.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ironically, these are the guys who were picked last in gym.
[Cut to Phoebe and Monica in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pheebes, you know what I'm thinking?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, ok. How, it's been so long since you've had sex, you're wondering if
they've changed it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, although now that's what I'm thinking.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, so what were you thinking?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I was thinking, that you gave the guys such great haircuts, I
thought, maybe you'd like to do mine?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because, I'm just, I'm incredibly anal and an unbelievable control
freak.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No you're not.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know I'm not, but you are, and I was trying to spare your feelings.
(The phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (answering the phone) Hello? Oh, hi. Yeah, hold on a second. Ross, it's
Julie, for you. (Throws him the phone.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hi. Anybody know a good tailor?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Needs some clothes altered?
