lines.text: Yeah, but not very well, unless 14-across, 'Gershwin musical' actually is
bitemebitemebitemebiteme.
OPENING TITLES
[Scene: Central Perk. Monica, Chandler, and Joey are seated at couches. Rachel is
working behind the counter.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I can't believe it's Christmas already. Ya know, I mean, one day your eatin' turkey,
the next thing ya know, your lords are a-leapin' and you geese are a-layin'.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Which is why geese are so relaxed this time of year.
[Ross enters with several bags from shopping.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey guys.
CHANDLER, MONICA, and JOEY: Hey.
[Ross approaches Rachel at counter.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey Rach. I, uh, got you a little present. [Rachel is not impressed]. . I'll open
it. It's a Slinky! Remember, huh. [sings] Walks down stairs, alone or in pairs,
everyone knows it's. . . just a big spring. Alright, you still mad at me becuase of
the whole. . .

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Horrible and degrading list of reasons not to be with me?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: How 'bout from now on we just call it the 'unfortunate incident'? [Rachel walks off]
Hey Gunther, you got stairs in your place?

lines.speaker: GUNTHER
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Here, go nuts. [gives him the Slinky and goes and sits with others at the couches]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey guys.
CHANDLER, MONICA, and JOEY: Hey.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: What's in the bag?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Um, just some presents.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: C'mon show us what you bought. . . You know you want to.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [childishly] OK. OK, this is a picture frame from Ben to my parents, huh.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Cute.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I got some, uh, hers and hers towels for Susan and Carol. And, uh, I got this blouse
for mom.
[Ross holds up the blouse. It is extremely tacky, with sewn-on medals hanging off of it.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ross, that is gorgeous!

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Look at these authentic fake medals. I tell ya, mom's gonna be voted best dressed
at the make-believe military academy.
[Phoebe enters.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: GANG
lines.text: Hey. Hi Phoebe.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Happy Christmas Eve Eve. [sees Ross's picture frame] Oh my God, where did you get
this?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Uh, Macy's, third floor, home furnishings.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: This is my father, this is a picture of my dad.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Nah, Phoebs, that's the guy that comes in the frame.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No it isn't, this is my dad, alright, I'll show you.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Phoebe, I thought your dad was in prison.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No, that's my stepdad. My real dad's the one that ran out on us before I was born.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: How have you never been on Oprah?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [showing her pictures] OK, look, see, this is him. My mother gave me this picture
before she died, same guy.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Honey, uh, this is a picture of the frame guy posing in front of a bright blue
screen with a collie.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: It's not a blue screen... it's just, maybe it was just really clear that day. OK,
I have to talk to my grandmother. [turns to leave]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh, wait a minute honey.

lines.speaker: GANG
lines.text: Phoebs. [Phoebe leaves]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: So anyway, I'm trying to get my boss's ex-wife to sleep with me. . .

lines.speaker: GANG
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh, but when Phoebe has a problem, everyone's all ears!
[Scene: Phoebe's grandmother's place. Phoebe's grandmother is sitting at the table,
reading the obituaries, and crossing out names in the phonebook.]

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Esther Livingston. [scratches out name] Gone.
[Phoebe enters.]

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Hi, Phoe.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hi Gram. Whatcha doin'?

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Oh, just updating the phonebook.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Um, gram, um, can I see the pictures of my dad again?

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: [nervously] Oh. Oh, sure, sure, uh, uh, how come?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Just, you know, to see... um.

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Oh, sure, yeah. [gets a box with the pictures] This is the one of you father
in a meadow, and, uh, helping a little boy fly a kite, and here he is at a graduation. . .
another graduation. . . another graduation.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, is this really my father?

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Is it really your fa--I can't... well of course it is.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, I smell smoke. Maybe that's 'cause someone's pants are on fire.

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Look, I. . .

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ya know, in all the years that we have been grandmother and granddaughter, you
have never lied to me.

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Alright, that is not your father, that's just a picture of a guy in a frame.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh God.

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: It was your mother's idea. Ya know, she didn't want you to know your real
father because it hurt her so much when he left, and, I didn't want to go along with it,
but, well then she died and, and it was harder to argue with her. Not impossible, but
harder.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Alright, so, what, he's not a famous tree surgeon? And then, I guess, OK, he
doesn't live in a hut in Burma where there's no phones?

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Last I heard, he was a pharmacist somewhere upstate.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, that makes no sense. Why would the villagers worship a pharmacist?

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Honey.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [realizes] Oh.

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Anyway, that's all I know. That, and this. [pulls apart a frame and pulls a
picture out] This is the real him.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Rachel, Chandler, and Joey are decorating the
Christmas tree.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ya know I remember my father, all dressed up in the red suit, the big black
boots, and the patent leather belt, sneakin around downstairs. He didn't want anybody to
see him but he'd be drunk so he'd stumble, crash into something and wake everybody up.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well, that doesn't sound like a very merry Christmas.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Who said anything about Christmas?
[Monica and Ross enter.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, anyone hear from Phoebe yet?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No, nothin'.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I hope she's OK.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, I know exactly what she's goin' through.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: How do you know exactly what she's going through?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: She told us.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: So whaddya got there Monica?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Just some stuff for the party.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, what're you guys doin' here, aren't you supposed to be Christmas shopping?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You guys haven't gotten your presents yet? Tomorrow's Christmas Eve, what're ya
gonna do?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Don't you have to be Claymation to say stuff like that?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, by the way Mon, I don't think the mailman liked your cookies. Here are the
ornaments your mom sent. [hands her a smashed box]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, maybe the mailman liked the cookies, we just didn't give him enough.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Monica, pigeons learn faster that you.
[Ross approaches Rachel, away from everyone else.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, Rach, you know what? I think, I think I know what'll make you feel better.
How 'bout you make a list about me.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Wha... forget it Ross, no, I am not gonna stand here and make a list of. . .

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: C'mon Rachel.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: OK, you're whiney, you are, you're obsessive, you are insecure, you're, you're
gutless, you know, you don't ever, you don't just sort of seize the day, you know. You
like me for what, a year, you didn't do anything about it. And, uh, oh, you wear too much
of that gel in your hair.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: See there, you uhh, alright, ya, you did what I said.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yeah, and you know what? You're right, I do feel better, thank you Ross. [she
walks off and Ross puts his hand to his hair]

scenes.location: Back at Phoebe's. She is on the phone

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, um, in Albany, can I have the number of Frank Buffay. . . OK, um, in Ithica.
. . alright, um, Saratoga. . . Oneonta. Alright, you know what, you shouldn't call youself
information. [hangs up]
[Phoebe's grandmother enters]

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hello grandma, if that is in fact your real name.

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: C'mon now Phoe, don't still be mad at me. How's it going?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Well, not so good. Upstate's pretty big, he's pretty small, you do the math.

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Well, I think you're better off without him. Oh honey, I know he's your daddy
but, but to me he's still the irresponsible creep who knocked up your mom and stole her
Gremlin.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No I just, just wanted to know who he was, ya know.

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: I know. OK, I wasn't completely honest with you when I told you that, uh, I
didn't know exactly where he lived.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Whattaya mean?

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: He lives at 74 Laurel Drive in Middletown. If you hit the Dairy Queen, you've
gone too far. You can take my cab.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Wow. Thank you.

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.text: Now, remember, nobody else drives that cab.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Uh-huh, got it. Ooh, I'm gonna see my dad. Wish me luck, Grandpa! [blows a kiss to
a picture of Einstein]
Commercial
[Scene: Chandler is standing on a street corner waiting for Phoebe in the cab. Joey
walks up.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Phoebe here with the cab yet?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, she, she brought the invisible cab. . . hop in.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well she better get here soon, the outlet stores close at 7.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey, don't worry. I figure it'll be 2 hours to Phoebe's dad's house, they'll
meet, they'll chat, they'll swap life stories, we'll still have plenty of time.
[Phoebe drives up in the cab]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, here she comes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey.
[Phoebe runs over the curb. Joey gets in the back seat, Chandler in the front]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Can you believe this. In, like, two hours I'm gonna have a dad. Eeeshk.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Eeeshk.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, big stuff.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, let's go.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Alright, here, you have to hold this. [hands Chandler a piece of paper]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: OK. [reads paper] Brake left, gas right?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Uh-huh, yeah, that's my cheat sheet.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [grabs for seat belt] Where's my seat belt?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, no no, that side doesn't have one, the paramedics had to cut through it.
[Chandler jumps out of the car]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [Chandler gets in the back seat] Hey!

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey. [Phoebe takes off, Joey and Chandler are thrown back in the seat]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica is preparing for the party with Ross
questioning her.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: C'mon, just tell me, please, please.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: For the sixteenth time, no... I do not think you're obsessive.
[Rachel enters from her room]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, gosh, it's hot in here.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Rach, get the heat. [Rachel holds up her hand with wet fingernail polish] Ross,
could you turn the heat down please?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Sure. By the way, there's a difference between being obsessive and. . .

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ross, the heat!

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Fine, OK! Heat, heat, heat, and I'm the obsessive one. [goes to the radiator and
starts turning the knob] OK, this way is on, so this is. . . [breaks off the knob] off.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Did you just break the radiator?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No, no, I was turnin' the knob and, and. . . here it is.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well put it back.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: It uhh, it won't go back.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I'll call the super.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Here, let me try.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh, oh that's right, I forgot about your ability to fuse metal.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hey, it's Funny's cousin, Not Funny.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: [on phone] Hi, Mr. Treeger. Hi, it's Rachel Green from upstairs. Yes, somebody,
uh, broke our knob on the radiator and it's really hot in here. Yes, it's, it's hot enough
to bake cookies. Well, do you think we could have a new one by 6? Wha t, no, no, Tuesday,
we can't wait until Tuesday, we're having a party tonight.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: OK, tip the man.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No, if he doesn't like our cookies, too bad, I am not gonna be blackmailed. Look
if worse comes to worse, it gets a little warm, we'll call it a theme party.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, here's a theme: Come on in, live like bacon.

scenes.location: Outside Phoebe's dad's house. The cab pulls up.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ooh, this is it, 74. [screeches to a halt, Joey and Chandler are thrown into the
plexiglass wall in the cab]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh, so that's what this is for.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Wow, this is it, I'm gonna meet my dad. This is like the biggest thing ever, huh.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Sure is.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, here I go. I'm goin' in.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Alright.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Good luck Phoebs.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, here I go. . . here I go. . . I'm goin'. [she just sits in the cab]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. They are having their party. All the guests are
stripped down because of the heat.]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: [answers door] Hi, welcome to our tropical Christmas party. You can put your coats
and sweaters and pants and shirts in the bedroom.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [sitting at table talking to a girl] It's hard to tell because I'm sweating, but I
use exactly what the gel bottle says, an amount about the size of a pea. How, how can that
be too much?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [carrying an ice cube tray] Ice, ice, ice squares anyone? Take a napkin. Alright.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Monica, Monica, your guest are turning into jerky, OK.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Really? I'm perfectly comfortable. [one of the guest opens the refrigerator] Hey,
hey, hey, get in line buddy, I was next. [she opens the refrigerator and leans into it]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: [answering the door] Mr. Treeger.

lines.speaker: MR. TREEGER
lines.text: Uhh, you said there was a party.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, yeah, well hey, welcome to our sauna.

lines.speaker: MR. TREEGER
lines.text: Ahh, is it hot? My body always stays cool, probably 'cause I have so much
skin. Hey, cheese!
[Ross is speaking to Monica and Rachel about tipping the super.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Alright, alright, here's the chance. Monica give him cash, Rachel give him your
earrings. Something, now, anything.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No, I will not cave.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yeah, I'm with Mon.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Alright, alright, you know how you say I never seize the day? Well, alright, even
though he's your super, I'm seizing. [approaches Mr. Treeger] Mr. Treeger, here is 50
bucks, merry Christmas.
[Gives him the cash.]

lines.speaker: MR. TREEGER
lines.text: Oh wow, I didn't get you anything. Here's five back.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No no, no, that, that's your Christmas tip, alright. Oh, hey, do you think there's a
chance you could fix that radiator now?

lines.speaker: MR. TREEGER
lines.text: No can do, like I told the girl, I can't get a new knob until Thursday.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ross.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [to Ross] Looks like he's playin' baseball.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: You mean hardball?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Whatever.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What'cha gonna' do?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Excuse me, I'm seizing. Mr. Treeger, here's another 50, happy Hanukkah. Will uh,
will this help with the knob getting?

lines.speaker: MR. TREEGER
lines.text: No, the place is not open 'till Tuesday. Am I not saying it right.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So, wait, you really did like my cookies?

lines.speaker: MR. TREEGER
lines.text: Oh, yeah, they were so personal, really showed you cared.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Nice seizing. . . gel boy.

lines.speaker: MR. TREEGER
lines.text: [to Rachel who is standing under mistletoe] So, uh, is this, uh, mistletoe?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Huh-huh, no act--no, uhh, that, that is basil.

lines.speaker: MR. TREEGER
lines.text: Ahh, if it was mistletoe, I was gonna kiss ya.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Huh-hoo, yeah, no, it's still basil.

scenes.location: Outside Phoebe's dad's house. Phoebe is running back to the cab.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: How far'd ya get?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Mailbox.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Alright, we're gettin' closer.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Phoebs, what's goin' on?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No, it's just like, ya know, it's a whole mess of stuff, ya know. It's like,
yesterday, ya know, my dad was this, like, famous Burma tree surgeon guy and, ya know, now
he's a, a pharmacist guy and. . .

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, maybe he's, maybe he's this really cool pharmacist guy.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, maybe, yeah. You know, and, and I'll knock on the door and, and he'll hug me
and I'll have a dad. Ya know and I'll, I'll go to his pharmacy and everyone will be really
nice to me 'cause, you know, I'm Franks daughter.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, so why not go knock?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Well, 'cause, I mean, what if, what if he's not this great dad guy? I mean, what
if, what if he's just still the dirtbag who ran out on my mom and us? You know what? I've
already lost a fake dad this week and I don't think I'm ready to lose a real one.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Phoebs, that's OK. You took a big step today.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, and someday when you're ready, you'll make it past the hedges.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, and when you do, he'll be lucky to have you.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: You guys. I'm sorry about your shopping.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh, that's OK, we'll figure something out.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Uh, listen Phoebs, I know you're not goin' in there but do you think it'd be alright
if I went in and used his bathroom? Oh, that's fine, never mind. Cool, snow, kinda like a
blank canvas.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Ross, Monica, and Rachel are sitting around after
the party. Chandler, Joey, and Phoebe enter.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ho, ho, ho, holy crap is it hot in here!

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Really, hey, you mind if I turn the heat down?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hey, we could have used that kind of thinkin' earlier.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, Phoebs, how'd it go.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, I couldn't go in.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Honey, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Are you OK?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, no it's OK 'cause, I mean, I know he's there, so, that's enough for
now.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey, guys, it's after midnight, merry Christmas everyone. [Ross and Phoebe hug,
Monica and Rachel hug, Chandler is left standing]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, Monica, the knob was broken so I just turned it off from underneath, I hope
that's alright.
CLOSING TITLES
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Joey and Chandler are giving out their Christmas
presents out of a cardboard box from a case of motor oil.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Rach, these are for you.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Wiper blades. I don't even have a car.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No, but with this new car smell, you'll think you do.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: OK, Phoebs, your turn.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ahh, toilet seat covers! Is that what you were doing while I was getting gas?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: You guuuyys.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: And for Ross, Mr. Sweet-tooth.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: You got me a cola drink?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: And, a lemon lime.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well this, this is too much, I feel like I should get you another sweater.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: And last but not least.
[Chandler and Joey give Monica a pack of condoms.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: They're ribbed for your pleasure.
[Ross and Monica trade their gifts.]
END

title: The One with Russ

lines.text: [The gang is walking to a newsstand late at night. Joey is anxiously in the lead.]

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Joey, would you slow down? They're not gonna be sold out of papers at one o'clock
in the morning.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I'm excited! I've never gotten reviewed before.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: You were so amazing as the king. I was really impressed, I was.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Although, you know what? You might want to consider wearing underwear next time.
Yeah, cause when you sat down on your throne you could kind of see your... royal subject.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Here it is, here it is. [reading from newspaper] The only thing worse than the
mindless, adolescent direction was Joseph Tribbiani's disturbingly unskilled portrayal of
the king.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: OK, look, that is one guy's opinion, alright. Phoebs, read yours.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: OK. [reading] The only thing worse than the mindless, adolescent direction...

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Does anyone have one from a different paper? Ross, read yours.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I don't want to.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Joey, honey, they don't know what they're talking about.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Maybe they do. I've been doin' this ten years and I haven't gotten anywhere.
There's gotta be a reason.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh c'mon. Maybe you're just, uhhh... paying your dues.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No, no, no, it.. it's too hard. It's not worth it. I quit.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait one minute. Wait a minute. I believe this
will change your mind. [Reads from paper] In a mediocre play, Joseph Tribbiana was able
to achieve brilliant new levels of... continued on page 153...[turns it] sucking.
Credits
[Scene: Chandler, Phoebe, Rachel, Monica comforting Joey at Monica and Rachel's
apartment.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: When I was little, I wanted to be a veteranarian, but then I found out you had to
put your hands into cows and stuff.
[Ross enters, depressed.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [sullenly] Hiiiiii.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Are... are you OK?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, just a tough day at work. A stegosaurus fell over and trapped a kid.
Whoa, whoa, I know this jacket, this is, th--Fun Bobby's jacket! Where is he, what. He,
he's here, isn't he?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Don't toy with me.
[Fun Bobby (FBOB) enters from Monica's bedroom.]

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Geller!

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, Fun Bobby!

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Hey. Whoa, hey, you've been working out, huh?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Not at all! I love this guy. Hey, I was so psyched to hear you're back with my
sister!

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: You and me both.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Hey, so what'd I miss, what'd I miss, c'mon?

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Oh, we were just trying to make Joey feel better.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Hey, do you need me to pick you up?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No, I'm alright man. Really.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: No, I'm picking you up.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey no, seriously, I don't need you to pick me... [Fun Bobby picks Joey up off
the ground, bounces him. Joey laughs.] Alright! It still works.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: OK, now before I go, does anybody else need to be picked up? [everyone raises
their hands] I'm still gonna go.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: OK, I'll see you later babe.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Uh, public display of affection coming up. You can avert your eyes. [kisses
Monica]
[Chandler and Joey are watching, Rachel turns their heads away from Monica.]

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: See ya. [exits]

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: Bye! See you later!

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Fun Bobby is so great.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Oh, isn't he? Oh, you know, I really think this time it may work with him. I
mean, he just makes me feel so good and I've been feeling so lousy this last couple of
months, no job, no boyfriend. Well, at least my cup is half full.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Half full of looooovvvvve.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: And for our two-week anniversary, he's gonna take me to his cousin's cabin for
the weekend.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Cabin of loooooovvvvve.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: We went through a lot of wine tonight, you guys. [walks over to table,
holding five empty wine bottles]

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Really? I only had two glasses.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I just had a glass.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Two.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: I had one glass.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: I had about a mugful in this lovely 'I got boned at the Museum of Natural
History' mug.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: OK, so that's... that's what, two bottles? And yet somehow we went through five?
[All look towards door Fun Bobby left through.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oooooh.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: [realizing what everyone else did a minute ago] Ooooooh.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: So what. So he drank a lot tonight.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah but, you know, now that I think about it, I don't think I've ever seen Fun
Bobby without a... a drink in his hand.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Yeah. Oh, OOOH, yeah, you know, did you notice how he always starts his stories
with, um, OK, 'I was soooo wasted,' or, 'Oh, we were soooo bombed,' or, ummm, ooh, ooh,
'So I wake up, and I'm in this dumpster in Connecticut.'

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Monica, have you ever been with him when he wasn't drinking?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Well, we just happen to go to alot of places where you might drink. I mean, how
do you go to a wine tasting without having a drink? Or... or to a club, or to the... zoo.
[Scene: Monica, Fun Bobby, and Phoebe sitting in Central Perk Rachel is serving
them. She brings a mug to Monica.]

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Rach, does this have nonfat milk?

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Ehhhummmm, I don't know, why don't you taste it.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: [takes a sip] Mmmm, no.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Oh well, too late, sorry, you already had some.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: [pulls out a flask] Whattaya say we make these, uh, coffees Irish?
[Phoebe and Rachel look uncomfortable.]

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Um, cake.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Yeah, we're gonna... we're gonna get some cake. [Phoebe and Rachel go to
counter.]

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: You know what? It seems like you've been making an awful lot of stuff Irish
lately.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Well, I would make them Belgian, but the waffles are hard to get into that flask.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Bobby.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Yeah, OK.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Look, maybe this is none of my business, or maybe it is, I don't know... but, uh,
I'm kind of worried about you.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: OK, look, this isn't the first time somebody's said something to me about this,
but, I don't know... I always made excuses about it, like... uhhh... 'I'm just a social
drinker,' or, 'C'mon, it's Flag Day.'

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: So, what are you saying now?

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: I guess I'm saying, I'll try and quit. I kinda like that you worry about me.
[they hug]

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: [comes back to couch, with cake] Sooo, what's goin' on, huh?

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: I am gonna try and quit drinking.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: [sad] Ooohh, why?
[Chandler and Joey enter.]

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Guess who's back in show business.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Ohh, ohh, Lorne Green?

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: No, no, Phoebs. You know why? Cause he's dead.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Oh, no.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: OK, I guess this is gonna seem kinda bittersweet now, but... Joey, that's who.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, my agent just called me with an audition for Days of Our Lives!

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Oh, well, we have to celebrate. You know what we should do? We should do, like, a
soap opera theme.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Hey, yeah... we could all sleep together and then one of us could get amnesia.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Hey Rach, what time do you get off? We're all gonna do something tonight.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Ummmm.... well, actually I'm already done, but I...I kinda got plans.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: [gasps] You have other friends?

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Yeah... I, uhh... I have a... I have a date.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: With a man?

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: What? What is so strange about me having a date?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: What about Ross? I mean, are you still mad at him cause he made that list about
you?

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Noooo, no, I'm not mad at him. I'm.. I'm not really anything at him
anymore.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: I don't know. Whatever I was feeling, I'm... not.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: But you guys came so close.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Oh, I know, I'm sorry you guys. You're just gonna have to get used to the fact
that I will not be dating Ross.
[Russ enters Central Perk. He looks like Ross, except for his chin and hair (it
is David Schwimmer in a dual role).]

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Here he is. Hi. Guys, this is Russ.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: [sounding like Ross] Hhhhiiiii.
[Everyone looks at each other in amazement.]

scenes.location: Estelle Leonard Talent Agency. Estelle (ESTL) is speaking on the phone.

lines.speaker: ESTL
lines.text: Stop saying you're not talented, you're very talented. It's just with the bird
dead and all, there's very little act left. Oh, honey, give me a break, will ya? [a knock
on the door] Oooh, ooh, I'll talk to you later.
[Joey enters.]

lines.speaker: ESTL
lines.text: Well, there's my favorite client. So tell me darling, how was the audition?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, I think it went pretty well. I.. I got a callback for Thursday.

lines.speaker: ESTL
lines.text: Joey, have you ever seen me ecstatic?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: ESTL
lines.text: Well, here it is. [She almost smiles.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: OK, uh.... listen, there's something I want to talk to you about. The network
casting lady...

lines.speaker: ESTL
lines.text: Oh, isn't Lori a doll?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh yeah, yeah, she's great, but... I kinda got the feeling that she was sort
of... coming on to me. And I definitely would get the part if I would've... you know... if
I would have sent the Little General in.

lines.speaker: ESTL
lines.text: Oh, I see. Well, I'm just gonna put in a call here and we'll find out what's
goin' on and straighten it out. [picks up the phone] Yeah, hi, Lori please. [pause] Hi
darling. So how 'bout Joey Tribbiani for the part of the cab driver, isn't he terrific?
[pause] Uh-huuuuh. [pause] Uh-huuuuh. OK, doll. Talk to you later. [hangs up] [to Joey]
Yeah, you're gonna have to sleep with her.
[Scene: Central Perk. Monica and Rachel at counter, Phoebe, Chandler, and Fun
Bobby at the couch.]

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: It's Fun Bobby.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: What, isn't he sober?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Oh, he's sober alright. Just turns out that Fun Bobby was fun for a reason.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Ohhh, OK.
[Monica returns to couch next to Fun Bobby.]

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Alright, here you go, sweetie. [hands Fun Bobby his coffee]

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Thanks. You wanna hear something funny?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Oh God, yes!

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: There are no hardware stores open past midnight in the Village.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: That is funny.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: I needed to buy a hammer the other night, and I'm out walkin' around the
neighborhood but apparently there are no hardware stores open past midnight in the
Village.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Ahhh, hey honey? Don't you have to be at your interview now?

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Oh yeah. See you guys. [leaves]

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Bye..... ridiculously dull Bobby.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Oh.... my... God.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: It's not that bad.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Not that bad? Did you hear the hammer story?

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: OK, OK, don't get all squinky.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Maybe it was just the kind of story where you have to be there.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: But I'm gonna be there... for the rest of my life. I mean, I can't break up with
him. I'm the one who made him quit drinking. He's dull because of me.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Alright, don't say that. He's probably always been dull. You just, you know, set
it free.
[Russ enters, walking in behind Chandler.]

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: [turning around] Hey Ross.... bahhhh!

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Hi Russ, I've just got two more tables to clean and then we'll go, OK?

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: OK, I'll just sit here and... uh... chat with your, uh.... friend-type....people.
[Phoebe walks up to Rachel, cleaning tables.]

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Rachel? Um, hi.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: OK, so, you know what you're doing, right?

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Uhh.... waitressing?

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Well, yeah, but... no. I mean, umm... doesn't.... doesn't Russ just remind you of
someone?

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: [looks at him] Huh, Bob Saget?

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: [looks at Russ] Oh, yeah! No, no, no, no, oh, oh.
[Phoebe turns back around but Rachel is gone. Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Oh, my, oh!

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: She's just upset because she, uh, she buttered a spider into her toast this
morning.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Alright.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: [to Phoebe] Listen, Phoebs, this is gonna be OK. [introducing Russ and Ross]
Ross, Russ. Russ, Ross.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Are you a, uh, friend of Rachel's?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yes, yes I am. Are you a, uh, a friend of Rachel's?

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Actually, I'm a... kind of a.... you know, a... date-type... thing... of
Rachel's.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: A date.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Yeah, I'm her date.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh, oh, you're... uh... you're, oh you're the date.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: You know, this is actually good, because if we ever lose Ross, we have a spare.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Oh, you are the, uh... paleontologist.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yes, yes I am. And you are a....

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Periodontist.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: See? They're as different as night and... later that night.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, I am going to, uh... get a beverage. It was nice, nice... uh... meeting
you.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Ditto.
[ROss approaches Rachel at counter.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I, uh, well... I... I met Russ.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, I didn't know we were, uh, seeing other people.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Well, we're not seeing each other, so....

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, uh, for your information, there's a woman at the museum, who's curator of
moths and other... uh... winged things... who's, uh, let it be known that she is drawn to
me much like a... well, you know. But so far I've been keeping her at bay, but, uh, if
this is the deal...

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Well, yeah, this is the deal.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: OK, well, um, have a nice evening.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Um, Russ, you ready?

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Bye.
[Russ and Rachel leave together.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [upset] She's dating. She's dating.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Yes, yes, but did you see who she was dating?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Do you not see it?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: See what? I don't know what she sees in... innn that goober. And it takes him,
what? Like... like... I don't know, uhh... uhhh, hello.... a... week, to get out a
sentence.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Yeah, it's annoying, isn't it?
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. Joey is making marinara sauce and filling every
container in sight. Chandler enters.]

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, so I'm guessing you didn't get the part, or... uh, Italy called and
said it was hungry.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, the part's mine if I want it.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, if I'm willing to sleep with the casting lady.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: [not knowing how to react] Oh my... God?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ten years I've been waiting for a break like this Chandler, ten years! I mean, Days
of Our Lives. That's actually on television.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: So, what're you gonna do?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, I guess I could sleep with her... I mean, how could I do that?

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Well, I... I've got a pop-up book that told me everything I need to know.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I've never slept with someone for a part.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Well is she... [reaches into the cookie jar for a cookie, takes his hand out,
covered with pasta sauce]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: It's alright. Is she good-looking?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, she's totally good looking. I mean, if I met her in a bar, or something,
I'd be buying her breakfast. [pause] You know, after having slept with her.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Y'know, maybe this isn't such a big deal. Y'know, I mean, the way that I see it
is you get a great job and you get to have sex. Y'know, I mean, throw in a tree and
a fat guy and you've got Christmas.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I just... I just don't think that I want it that way though, y'know? I mean,
let's say I do make it, alright? I'm always gonna look back and wonder if it was because
of my talent or because of.. y'know, the Little General.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Didn't you used to call it the Little Major?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, but after Denise DeMarco, I had to promote it.

scenes.location: A restaurant. Fun Bobby and Monica are ordering.

lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.text: Can I get you something from the bar?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Yes, I would like something. [looks at Fun Bobby, changes her mind] No, no thank
you.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: If... if you want to drink, it's OK with me, I've got to get used to it.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: No, no really. I.. I wouldn't feel right about it. [to waiter] Just some water.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: So the light went out in my refrigerator...

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: [grabs waiter as he's leaving] I'd like a scotch on the rocks with a twist.
[Scene: Central Perk. Chandler is sitting on the couch between Russ and Ross,
doing a crossword puzzle.]

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Hey, we're having some fun now, huh, Ross? Wanna do another one, huh Russ? OK...
eleven letters, atomic element number 101... ends in ium.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Dysprosium.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [condescendingly] Dysprosium? Try mendelevium.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: And weenie number two has it. Unless, of course, nine-down, Knights in White
Satin was sung by the Doody Blues.
[Phoebe and Rachel are at the counter talking.]

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: You don't see it? You actually don't see it?

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: OK honey, you're dating Ross.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: No, Phoebs. I'm dating Russ.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Russ is Ross. Russ... Ross!

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Steve... sleeve!

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: OK, noone is named Sleeve.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Phoebe, what the hell are you talking about? Other than their names being
similar, I'm sorry, I do not see what you're seeing.
[They look over at Russ and Ross.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [to Russ] For your information, it's a card sharp, not a card shark.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: You could not be more wrong. You could try... but you would not be successful.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: OK, I'm gonna get some more coffee before the pinching and eye-poking begins.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: I know what your problem is.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh you do, do you?

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Um-hum, you're jealous.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Of... of what?

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: You're jealous because I'm a real doctor.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, you're a doctor of gums. That's the smallest body part you can major
in. It's like day one, floss. Day two, here's your diploma.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Hey, you listen.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No, no, let me finish.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: No, let me finish.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No, you let me fini...
[Rachel walks up behind them.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Ewww, ewww, ewww, ewww! [turns away]

scenes.location: Ross, Phoebe, Rachel, and Chandler at Monica and Rachel's apartment.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Did Joey say what he was gonna go when he left?

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: No, I don't even think he knew. Hey, would you sleep with somebody to get a great
job?

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: I don't know. Who would I have to sleep with?

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Me.

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Why would I have to sleep with you?

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: It's my game. You want the job or not?
[Monica enters from her bedroom.]

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Morning.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Where ya goin'?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Bobby and I are going away for the weekend, remember?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ooooohhhh.
[Monica pulls out a bag full of airline bottles of liquor.]

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: What's with all the bottles of liquor?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What's going on, is... uh, Bobby drinking again?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Oh no no, this is not for him, this is for me. That way he's still sober but I
find his stories about shoelaces much more amusing.
[Three slow knocks on the door.]

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: Oh God, even his knock is boring.
[Monica answers the door. Its Fun Bobby.]

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Hi. I'll be ready in just a second.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Uh, can I talk to you a minute?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Sure.
[They both step out into the hall.]

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: This is really hard for me to say.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Oh God, you fell off the wagon.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Oh, no, no, it's about you.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: What about me?

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: I think you may have a drinking problem.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: What these? [holding up liquor bottles] Oh, these are, um, for.. cuts and
scrapes.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Look, I am just not strong enough to be in a codependent relationship right now,
OK?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Oh... shoot.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: Well, anyway, I hope we can be friends.

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: OK.
[They hug and kiss.]

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Take care.

lines.speaker: FBOB
lines.text: You too.
[Fun Bobby leaves and Monica goes back inside.]

lines.speaker: RACH
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: Well we... we kinda broke up.

lines.speaker: GANG
lines.text: Awwwwwwww.
[Ross, Phoebe, Chandler, and Rachel all exchange money.]

lines.speaker: MNCA
lines.text: [holding bottles] Does anybody want these?

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: I'll take one. Sometimes I like to hold stuff like this and pretend I'm a giant.
[Joey enters.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: GANG
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: How'd the callback go?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: It was unbelievable! I walked in there and she was all over me.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: So what'd you do?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, I couldn't do it. I told her I didn't want to get the part that way.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Good for you.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: But wait, wait, wait. Then, after I left her office, she caught up with me at the
elevator and offered me an even bigger part.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: So... and?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Soooooo... you are now looking at Dr. Drake Ramore, neurosurgeon, recurring in at
least four episodes!

lines.speaker: GANG
lines.text: Allright!

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Alright... I've got to go shower. [leaves]
[Phoebe, Ross, Rachel, Chandler exchange money again.]
Credits [Scene: Central Perk. Russ enters. Chandler and
Phoebe are sitting on the couch.]

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Oh, hey.

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: I guess you guys heard, Rachel dumped me.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Yeah, I'm sorry man.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Oh, all she said was that I remind her too much of somebody. You have any idea
who she's talking about?
[Chandler and Phoebe feign ignorance.]

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Oh I do, it's.... it's Bob Saget. She hates him.

lines.speaker: RUSS
lines.text: Oh.
[Julie... Ross's ex-girlfriend... enters.]

lines.speaker: JULIE
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: CHAN
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: PHOE
lines.text: Hey, Julie! Hey, how are you doing?

lines.speaker: JULIE
lines.text: Um, oh, I don't know. I mean, it's definitely weird not being with Ross, but I
guess I'm doing OK. Actually I've got some of his stuff that he, um....
[Russ and Julie look at each other with love in their eyes. The music builds...]
END

title: The One with the Lesbian Wedding

lines.text: [at Ross's. Carol and Susan are picking Ben up]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok. Here's his diaper bag, and his uh, Mr. Winky, and uh...oh, him. Hi!

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: So how did everything go?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh, great. Great. There was a projectile, uh, throwing up incident, but he
started it.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Well, we've gotta go.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: [clears her throat]

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Oh, right. Um, I've got some news. It's about us.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh, you and me?

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Uh, no, Susan and me.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: The other us.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: We're uh, we're getting married.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: As in, "I now pronounce you wife and wife" married?

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Anyway, we'd like you to come, but we totally understand if you don't want to.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Why wouldn't I want to come? I had fun at the first wedding.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Look I just thought that...

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No no no, I mean, hey, why shouldn't I be happy for you? What would it say about
me if I couldn't revel in your joy? I'm revelling baby, believe me!

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Is your finger caught in that chair?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Mmm hmmm.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Want us to go?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Uh-huh.
[at Rachel and Monica's]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: This is so cool. You're actually gonna be on television.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: It really hit me last night. I'm gonna be on Days of our Lives. And then I
started thinkin' about all of u, and how these are the days of our lives..

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yes! Carol and Susan's caterer had a mountain bike accident this weekend, and
she's in a full body cast.
ROSS, CHANDLER & JOEY: Yes!

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: They want me to do it, which is really cool, seeing as I've never catered
before, and I really need the money, and this isn't a problem for you, is it?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Would it matter?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh, you are so great! [kisses him] Thank you!

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Are you really not going?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I am really not going. I don't get it. They already live together, why do they
need to get married?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: They love each other, and they wanna celebrate that love with the people that
are close with them.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: If you wanna call that a reason.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [singing to the tune of Mister Rogers' Neighborhood] Who's the
bitterest man in the living room, the bitterest man in the living room? Hi, neighbor.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ross, I thought you were over this.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Look, that has nothing to do with this, ok? She's my ex-wife. If she were
marrying a guy, none of you'd expect me to be there.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, if she were marrying a guy, she'd be like the worst lesbian ever.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: [entering hurriedly] Did I miss it? Did I miss it?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No, I'm on right after this guy shoots himself.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Whoa, she's pretty.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, and she's really nice too. She taught me all about how to work the cameras,
and smell-the-fart acting.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I'm sorry, what?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: It's like, you got so many lines to learn so fast, that sometimes you need a
minute to remember your next one. So while you're thinkin' of it, you take this big pause
where you look all intense, you know, like this.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh, ok.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: There's my scene, there's my scene. [Joey on tv] "Mrs. Wallace, I'm
Dr. Drake Ramoray, your sister's neurosurgeon.

lines.speaker: MRS. WALLACE
lines.text: Is she gonna be all right?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I'm afraid the situation is much worse than we expected. Your sister is suffering
from a..subcranial hematoma. Perhaps we can discuss this over coffee.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Nice!

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Excellent!

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: For a minute there I thought you were actually tryin' to smell something.
[Monica and Rachel's]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: That is so good! Do it again!

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: All right, all right. "Damnit Braverman, it's right there on the
chart!"

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That's great. All right, I gotta get to work, I got a big dinosaur bone to
inspect.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No no, that's me.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh, hello.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, thanks. I couldn't uh...

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Is everything ok?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Um, no, huh-uh. One of my clients died on the massage table today.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh my god.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That's a little more relaxed than you want them to get.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, um, she was 82 years old. Her name was um, Mrs. Adelman.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh, honey.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, it's just so strange. I mean, she probably woke up today and thought,
"ok, I'll have some breakfast, and then I'll take a little walk, and then I'll have
my massage." Little did she know God was thinking, "Ok, but that's it." Oh,
but the weirdest thing was, ok, I was cleansing her aura when she died, and when the
spirit left her body, I don't think it went very far.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I think it went into me.
[Everyone takes a step back from Phoebe]
[Central Perk]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: God, this is so hard. I can't decide between lamb or duck.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, of course, lambs are scarier. Otherwise the movie would've been called
Silence of the Ducks.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, who ordered what?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh, I believe I had the half-drunk cappuccino with the lipstick on the rim.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yes, and this with the cigarette butt in it, is that decaf?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh god.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I can't believe you're so uptight about your mom comin'.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I know, but it's just it's the first time, and I just don't want her to think
that because I didn't marry Barry, that my life is total crap, you know?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [Mrs. Adelman's voice] Talk about crap. Try listening to Stella Niedman
tell the story of her and Rod Steiger for the hundredth time.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Uh, Pheebs, how long do you think this lady'll be with us?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I don't know. I mean, she obviously has some kind of unfinished business. [Mrs.
Adelman's voice] Sit up!

lines.speaker: MRS. GREEN
lines.text: [entering] There she is.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Mom!

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: Sweetie! So this is where you work? Oh, it's wonderful! Is it a living room?
Is it a restaurant? Who can tell? But I guess that's the fun.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Pretty much.

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: Monica! You look gorgeous! Last time I saw you, it was eat or be eaten.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: This is Joey, and Phoebe, and this is Chandler, and you remember Ross.

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: Oh hello, Ross.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hi, Mrs. Green. [He gets up to shake her hand, but she ignores him.]

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: So, what do you think of my daughter in the apron with the big job?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh Mom!

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: If you didn't pour the coffee, no one would have anything to drink.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Believe me, sometimes that happens.

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: This is just so exciting. You know, I never worked. I went straight from my
father's house to the sorority house to my husband's house. I am just so proud of you.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I know who it is you remind me of. Evelyn Dermer. 'Course, that's before she
got the lousy face lift. Now she looks like Soupy Sales.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Pheebs, who's Evelyn Dermer?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I don't know. Who's Soupy Sales?
[at Rachel and Monica's

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: Oh my god, there's an unattractive nude man playing the cello.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yeah, well just be glad he's not playing a smaller instrument.

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: [laughing] You have some life here, sweetie.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I know. And Mom, I realize you and Daddy were upset when I didn't marry Barry
and get the big house in the suburbs with all the security and everything, but this is
just so much better for me, you know?

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: I do. You didn't love Barry. And I've never seen you this happy. I look at
you and I think, oh, this is what I want.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: For...me.

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: Well, not just for you.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: I'm uh, considering leaving your father.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [entering] All right. Tell me if this is too cute. Lesbian wedding,
chicken breasts.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh god. I think I'm gonna be sick.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Why? It's not like I'm putting little nipples on them.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: And you had no idea they weren't getting along?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: None.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: They didn't fight a lot?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No! They didn't even talk to each other. God, how was I supposed to know they
were having problems?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [Mrs. Adelman's voice] In my day, divorce was not an option.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, look who's up.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I just can't believe this is happening. I mean, when I was little, everybody's
parents were getting divorced. I just figured as a grownup I wouldn't have to worry about
this.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Is there any chance that you can look at this as flattering? I mean, she's
doing it because she wants to be more like you.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well, then, you know, couldn't she have just copied my haircut?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: You know, it's funny when my parents got divorced, they sent me to this
shrink, and she told me that all kids have a tendency to blame themselves. But in your
case it's actually kinda true.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: That's him.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Damn. My mail order grandfather hasn't come yet.

lines.speaker: MR A
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yes, hi, Mr. Adelman. Thanks for meeting me.

lines.speaker: MR A
lines.text: Oh, that's all right, although you did cut into my busy day of sitting.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Um, do you wanna sit?

lines.speaker: MR A
lines.text: Oh, no, please, I spent most of mid-morning trying to stand up. Now uh, what can
I do for you, my dear?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I don't know how to say this, but I think when your wife's spirit left her
body, it um, kind of stuck around in me.

lines.speaker: MR A
lines.text: You're saying, my wife is in you?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah. Ok, you don't have to believe me but um, can you think of any unfinished
business she might have had, like any reason she'd be hanging around?

lines.speaker: MR A
lines.text: Well, I don't know what to tell you dear. The only thing I can think of is that
she always used to say that before she died, she wanted to see everything.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Everything?

lines.speaker: MR A
lines.text: Everything.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Whoa, that's a lot of stuff.

lines.speaker: MR A
lines.text: Oh, wait, I remember, she also said she wanted to sleep with me one last time.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I'm sorry, there's laughing in my head.

lines.speaker: MR A
lines.text: [to Joey] Worth a shot, huh?
[Joey nods and shrugs.]

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: Look at this.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: These are from Halloween three years ago.

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: Oh, look, here's Barry. Did he have to come straight from the office?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No, that was his costume. See, he's actually an orthodontist, but he came as a
regular dentist.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Um, you guys, you know when I said before, "thank you, but I don't really
need your help"?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Actually, what I think you said was, "don't touch that, and get the hell
out of my kitchen."

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Really? Weird. Anyway, see, I planned everything really well. I planned and I
planned and I planned. It just turns out, I don't think I planned enough time to actually
do it.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hey, Mon, you want some help?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: If you want.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [enters] Hey. What a day. I took her everywhere. The Museum of Modern
Art, Rockefeller Center, Statue of Liberty.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: She's still with you?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah. I guess she hasn't seen everything yet. I'll be right back, she has to go
to the bathroom again. [Takes Mrs. Green's chin in her hand and says, in Mrs. Adelman's
voice] Oh, such a pretty face.

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: This is so much fun, just the girls. You know what we should do? Does
anybody have any marijuana?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: God!

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: All right, look, nobody's smoking pot around all this food.

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: That's fine. I never did it. I just thought I might. So, what's new in sex?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh! What's new in sex?

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: The only man I've ever been with is your father.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I'm dicing, I'm dicing, I don't hear anything.

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: I mean, this is no offense to your dad, sweetie, but I was thinking there
might be more.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. You know what? I cannot have this conversation with you. I mean,
god, you just come in here, and drop this bomb on me, before you even tell Daddy. What?
What do you want? Do you want my blessing?

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: You want me to talk you out of it?

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Then what? What do you want?

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: I guess I just figured of all people you would understand this.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Why on earth would I understand this?

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: You didn't marry your Barry. I did.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: All right people, we're in trouble here. We've only got 12 hours and 36 minutes
left. Move, move, move!

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Monica, I feel like you should have German subtitles.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Joey, speed it up!

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I'm sorry, it's the pigs. they're reluctant to get in the blankets!

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Monica, how did this happen? I thought you had this all planned out.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Do you want me to cry? Is that what you want? Do you wanna see me cry?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Sir! No sir!

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [to Ross] All right, you!

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No. Look, I told you I am not a part of this thing.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: All right, look, Ross. I realize that you have issues with Carol and Susan, and
I feel for you, I do. But if you don't help me cook, I'm gonna take a bunch of those
little hot dogs, and I'm gonna create a new appetizer called "pigs in Ross". All
right, ball the melon.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey! How come I'm stuck dicing, when he gets to ball the melon.
[knock at the door]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: How's it going?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: It's goin' great. Right on schedule. Got my little happy helpers.[everyone
groans]

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Fine, whatever.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Nothing. Ok, everything. I think we're calling off the wedding.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You're still gonna pay me, right? Or something a little less selfish.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Carol, what's the matter? What happened?

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: My parents called this afternoon to say they weren't coming.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh my god.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: I mean, I knew they were having trouble with this whole thing, but they're my
parents. They're supposed to give me away and everything.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: It's ok. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: And then Susan and I got in this big fight because I said maybe we should call
off the wedding, and she said we weren't doing it for them, we were doing it for us, and
if I couldn't see that, then maybe we should call off the wedding. I don't know what to
do.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I uh can't believe I'm gonna say this, but I think Susan's right.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Look, do you love her? And you don't have to be too emphatic about this.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Of course I do.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well then that's it. And if George and Adelaide can't accept that, then the hell
with them. Look, if my parents didn't want me to marry you, no way that would have stopped
me. Look, this is your wedding. Do it.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: You're right. Of course you're right.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So we're back on?

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: We're back on.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You heard the woman. Peel, chop, devil! I can't believe I lost 2 minutes.
[at the wedding]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: It just seems so futile, you know ? All these women, and nothing. I feel like
Superman without my powers, you know? I have the cape, and yet I cannot fly.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well now you understand how I feel every single day, ok? The world is my
lesbian wedding.
[Wedding music starts, Phoebe noisily unwraps a piece of candy.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [Mrs. Adelman's voice] Butterscotch? No one? All right, you'll be sorry
later.
[Monica pushes Ben down the aisle in a stroller. Susan is escorted by both her
parents. Carol is escorted by Ross.]

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Any time. [He doesn't want to let her go]

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Ross. [He lets her go]

lines.speaker: MINISTER
lines.text: You know, nothing makes God happier than when two people, any two people,
come together in love. Friends, family, we're gathered here today to join Carol and Susan
in holy matrimony.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [Mrs. Adelman's voice] Oh my god. Now I've seen everything! [Phoebe's
voice] Whoa, she's gone. She's gone. She's gone! Go ahead, get married. Go, go.
[At the reception, Monica and Ross watch Carol and Susan getting their picture
taken.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Would you look at them?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, can't help but.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: [to a wedding guest] How's that pig-in-the-blanket workin' out for you? [the
guy nods] I wrapped those bad boys.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I miss Rose.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh, yeah?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I know it's kind of weird, but I mean, she was a big part of my life there, you
know, and now I just feel kind of alone.

lines.speaker: WOMAN
lines.text: You know, I uh, I couldn't help but overhear what you just said, and I think
it's time for you to forget about Rose, move on with your life...how 'bout we go get you a
drink?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok, that's so nice.
[Chandler tries to warn Phoebe that the woman is coming on to her, but Phoebe
doesn't see him.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [to an attractive woman] I shouldn't even bother coming up with a
line, right? [The woman walks away]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hey, Mom? Having fun?

lines.speaker: MRS GREEN
lines.text: Oh, am I! I just danced with a wonderfully large woman. And three other
girls made eyes at me over the buffet. Oh, I'm not saying it's something I wanna pursue,
but it's nice to know I have options.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: There's more alcohol, right?
[Susan approaches Ross, who's looking lonely]

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: How you doin'?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: You did a good thing today.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: You wanna dance?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No, that's fine.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Come on. I'll let you lead.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok.
[They dance; Carol looks on lovingly.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [to the woman who just rejected him] All right look. Penis schmenis.
We're all people. [She walks away again.]
[at Monica and Rachel's]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ok, which one of us do you think is gonna be the first one to get married?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, Mon, I was married.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, me, too, technically.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I had a wedding.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: All right, just trying to start an interesting discussion.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I got one. Which one of us do you think will be the last to get married? [They
all look at Chandler]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Isn't Ben in this?

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: Oh, yeah!
END

title: The One After the Superbowl

lines.text: [Scene: In a TV commercial that the gang is watching at Monica and
Rachel's.]
[A guy is sitting at his desk and his boss comes in and drops a huge pile of papers on
his desk. The guy looks dejected.]

lines.speaker: COMMERCIAL VOICEOVER
lines.text: Can't get the monkey off your back? Then put it in your mouth...
[A monkey jumps on the desk and hands the guy a beer. He opens the beer and is suddenly on
the beach, in a hammock, with beautiful women all around.]

lines.speaker: COMMERCIAL VOICEOVER
lines.text: ...With MonkeyShine Beer. [MonkeyShine theme] MonkeyShine Beer,
'cause it's a jungle out there.]
[Camera pans back from the TV to show the gang watching.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: That commercial always makes me so sad.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, but then the guy opens his beer and those girls run at him, so, everything
seems to work out OK.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I meant because the monkey in it reminds me of Marcel.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I can see that, 'cause they both have those big brown eyes and, ya know, the
little pouty chin.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: And the fact that they're both monkeys.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Sometimes I wonder if I did the right thing, ya know, giving him away.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, Ross, you had to, I mean, he was humping everything in sight. I mean, I have a
Malibu Barbi that will no longer be wearing white to her wedding.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Remember when sometimes he'd borrow your hat, and, and when you got it back there'd
be little monkey raisins in it.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, well sure, when he did it, it was funny. When I did it to my boss's hat. .
. all of the sudden I have this big attitude problem.
OPENING TITLES

scenes.location: Central Perk. Chandler, Monica, Rachel, and Phoebe are at the couch.

lines.text: [Joey enters holding a letter]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, hey, check it out, guess what I got.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Rhythm?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No, my first fan mail.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: Alright!

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [reading] 'Dear Dr. Remore, know that I love you and would do anything to have
you.' Gosh. 'Your not-so-secretive admirer, Erica Ford.' Ooh wait, 'PS enclosed please
find 14 of my eyelashes.'

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ya know, in crazy world, that means you're married.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: This wasn't addressed to Days of Our Lives, this is, this came to your
apartment. There's no stamp on it, this woman was in our building.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh my god, I got my very own stalker.
[Ross enters with a suitcase]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey guys.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ooh, where are you off to, Travelin' Jake?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, there's this, uh, paleontology conference in L.A. so I figured I'd go and then
drive down to the zoo and surprise Marcel.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: You know I think he will be surprised, 'till he realizes he's a monkey, and uh,
you know, isn't capable of that emotion.
[Rob (Chris Isaac) enters]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, Phoebe, that really cute guy is here again.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, oh, OK, so everyone, pretend like I'm telling you a story, OK. And, and it's
really funny. So everyone just laugh, now.
[Everyone laughs]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I know, I know. [to Rob] Hello.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: Hi. I'm Rob Dohnen.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hi Rob Dohnen.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: I don't know anything about music, but I think you're really, really great.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, wow.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: Anyway, I schedule performers for the childrens libraries around the city and I was
just thinking, have you ever thought about playing your songs for kids?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, I would love to have kids. . . you're, you're the, you're, me play the songs
that I will write for them.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. Chandler and Joey are standing around in the
kitchen.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, whaddya wanna do for dinner?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well we could just stay in and cook for ourselves. [both laugh hysterically]
[door buzzer goes off]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: It's Erica.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ah, the stalker.

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: Never mind, it's open.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [Joey grabs a frying pan] Yes, hitting her with a frying pan's a good idea. We
might wanna have a backup plan, though, just in case she isn't a cartoon.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Let's get out of here.
[They run out and knock on Monica and Rachel's door]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: The one time they're not home.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: OK, we'll just leave, and when we pass her on the stairs, she won't know it's me
'cause we've never met.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That's how radio stars escape stalkers.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: She's comin'.
[Both run back in their apartment. There's a knock at the door.]

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: It's me.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Uhh, this is it, this is how we're gonna die. Ready?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait. [Opens the top of the dish soap he's holding]
[Joey opens the door and sees Erica (Brooke Shields). Joey gets a huge smile and Chandler
squeezed the dish soap in the air.]

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Erica.

scenes.location: San Diego Zoo. Ross is at the Monkey cages.

lines.speaker: LIPSON
lines.text: Hi, Dean Lipson, zoo administrator. I was told you had a question.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, I uh, I can't seem to find the monkey I donated last year. He's a capuchan,
answers to the name Marcel.
