lines.speaker: LIPSON
lines.text: Ahh, I'm afraid I have some bad news. Marcel has passed on.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh my God, what happened?

lines.speaker: LIPSON
lines.text: Well he got sick, and then he got sicker, and then he got a little better but then
he died.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I can't believe this.

lines.speaker: LIPSON
lines.text: I'm sorry Mr. Geller. But ya know, there's an old saying, 'Sometimes monkeys die.'
It's not a great saying but it certainly is fitting today.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, ya know, someone should have called me.

lines.speaker: LIPSON
lines.text: I'm sorry. Look, I know this can't bring him back but here, it's just a gesture.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Zoo dollars?

lines.speaker: LIPSON
lines.text: Yes, and come see the bird show at 4. The macaws wear hats. Well it's a lot cuter
if your monkey hasn't just died.
[Scene: Library. Phoebe is getting ready to sing for the kids. Chandler, Monica, and
Rachel are there.]
[Phoebe pulls out her guitar]

lines.speaker: KIDS
lines.text: Ooohhh.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I can't believe Joey's having lunch with his stalker. What i-, what is she like.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, you remember Cathy Bates in Misery?

lines.speaker: RACHEL AND MONICA
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, she looks the exact opposite of that.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: And she's not crazy?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh no no no, she's a total wack job. Yeah, she thinks that Joey is actually Dr.
Drake Remore.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ah, and I mean, he's going out with her? He can not persue this.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey, just because this woman thinks she can actually see Joey through the
magical box in her living room doesn't mean she's not a person. I mean, does she not
deserve happiness, does she not deserve love? What're you lookin' at me for? He's the one
who wants to boff the maniac.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: You OK?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No, uh-uh, I'm just, I'm nervous. So, you know what, maybe if I just, if I picture
them all in their underwear.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: That's not a good idea, that's kinda the reason the last guy got fired.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I'm just, I'm, I'm, I'm used to playing for grown-ups. Ya know, they just,
grown-ups drink their coffee and do their grown-up thing, ya know, and kids listen. This
is a huge responsibility. What? Are you gonna kiss me?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I was thinkin' about it.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK. [they kiss] OK, alrighty, let's play some tunes. Hi everybody, I'm Phoebe

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: Hi Phoebe.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, um, I'm gonna play, um, some songs about grandparents, OK. [singing]
Now, grandma's a person who everyone likes,
she bought you a train and a bright, shiny bike.
But lately she hasn't been coming to dinner,
And last time you saw her she looked so much thinner.
Now, your mom and your dad said she moved to Peru,
but the truth is she died and some day you will too.
La-la-la la la-la-la la la-la-la la...

scenes.location: A nice restraunt. Joey and Erica are dining.

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: Oh, Drake, isn't it amazing?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah it is. . . what?

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: Well, here we sit, devil may care, just a little while ago you were reattaching
someone's spinal cord.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, that was a tricky one. In reality, that operation takes like, over 10 hours,
but they only showed it for 2 minites.

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: Who's they?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No one.

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: Oh Drake, you are so talented, let me see those hands. Oh these hands, these
beautiful hands, oh I could just eat them. . . but I won't.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Good, otherwise my watch would fall off. [laughs hysterically]

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: No, seriously. These hands. These miracle, magical, life-giving hands. Oh, just to
be near them, touch them, maybe even lick one?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Alright, just one. [she licks his hands rather emphatically] Wow, you're good at
that.
[Some guy at another table starts choking]

lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.text: Oh my God! Someone, he's choking. Is anyone here a doctor?

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: Well, yes, yes, the best doctor in all of Salem, Dr. Drake Remore.

scenes.location: San Diege Zoo. Ross is still at the monkey cages. A janitor is sweeping.

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: Meet me in the nocturnal house in 15 minutes.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Uhh, hey look, I don't really enjoy being with other men that way. But, um,
zoo dollars?

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: It's about your monkey. It's alive.

scenes.location: Restraunt. Joey and Erica are still there.

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: I don't understand, why didn't you help that man?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Uhh, cause, uhh, I'm a neurosurgeon and that was clearly a case of, uh, uh, foodal
chokage. Alright, look, I got to tell you something.

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: No, no no no, you don't have to tell me anything. You don't have to explain
yourself to me. Ooh, who am I to question the great Dr. Drake Remore?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: But that's what...

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: I should just be happy to be near you.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey I- [she cuts him off with a kiss]

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: Hey what?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: That's it, just hey. Like at the end of a dance, HEY! [she starts nibbling his hand]
Hey. He-hey.

scenes.location: Library. Phoebe is singing.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [singing] There'll be times when you get older
when you'll want to sleep with people
just to make them like you. . .
But don't.
Cause that's another thing that you don't wanna do, everybody
That's another thing that you don't wanna do.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Excellent!

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Very informative!

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Not at all inappropriate!

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Thank you for coming everybody. There're cookies in the back.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: That was great, the kids loved you.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yay, I rock.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: And you know why? Because you told the truth, and nobody ever tells kids the
truth.You were incredible.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: But.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: How did you know there was a but?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I sense these things. It was either but or butter.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: The thing is, I think some of the parents, they were kinda hopin' that you'd play
more songs about like, barnyard animals.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I can do that.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: ROB
lines.text: Because that would be fantastic. What? You wanna kiss me?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Thinkin' about it.

scenes.location: San Diego Zoo. Ross and the janitor are in the nocturnal house.

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: Ahh, the bat. Ambassador of darkness, flitting out of his cave like a winged
messenger, sightless spectre of the macabe.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Buddy, my monkey?

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: Oh, yeah, right. There was a break-in, few months back, inside job. Your monkey
was taken.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh my God. But the zoo told me that my monkey was dead.

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: The zoo! Do you believe everything the zoo tells ya?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: That, that's the only thing the zoo's ever told me.

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: Of course they're gonna say he's dead. They don't want the bad publicity. It's
all a great big cover-up. Do you have any idea how high up this thing goes?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: That guy Lipson?

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: Lipson knows. Do you have any idea who else knows?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No, I, I only know Lipson.

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: Hmm, Lipson knows huh? Ahh, hello Mr. Opossum, enigma of the trees, upside-down
denizen of the night, taunting gravity with...

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Buddy, my monkey, my monkey.

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: Word on the street - well, when I say street, I mean those little pretend streets
they have here at the zoo.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: Your monkey found a new career, in the entertainment field. That's all I know.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: This is unbelievable.

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: So, what is this information worth to you, my friend?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Are you trying to get me to bribe you?

lines.speaker: JANITOR
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: But you already told me everything.

scenes.location: Library. Ross show up with a MonkeyShine Beer poster.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Check it out, he actually is the MonkeyShine monkey.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well, so what're you gonna do?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, I guess I'm gonna call the beer company and try to find out where he is.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That's what I did when I lost my Clydesdales.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, hi again.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: Hi Phoebe.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Today we're gonna start with some songs about barnyard animals.
[singing] Oh, the cow in the meadow goes moo,
Oh, the cow in the meadow goes moo.
Then the farmer hits him on the head and grinds him up,
And that's how we get hamburgers.
Nooowww, chickens!
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. Monica, Rachel, and the guys are watching Days
of Our Lives.]

lines.speaker: TV DOCTOR
lines.text: You're the only one who can save her Drake.

lines.speaker: JOEY ON TV
lines.text: Damnit, I'm a doctor, I'm not God.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, there goes my whole belief system.
[knock at the door]

lines.speaker: ERICA
lines.text: It's Erica.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh my God, quick turn off the TV.

lines.speaker: RACHEL

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: I'm going to look into your eyes now.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: Yeah, that's my job. Alright, look up. . . look down, now open your eyes, now
look down. That's right, look into the light. Now look at me. . . OK. Your eyes look good.
Those are good eyes.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Good, they feel good, in my head.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: So, it's great to see ya.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You too.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: You too.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: OK, um. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: Drops!

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: Drops. Here, they're free.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Thanks. So, I guess I better be going.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: Oh, OK, yeah. I'll see ya later.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Thanks again.
[He kisses her on the cheek, she returns the kiss, then they embrace in a full on kiss]
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. They're still watching TV. Phoebe stands in front
of the TV.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: We have got to get you lazy boys out of these chairs.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER and JOEY
lines.text: Hey, woah, hey, woah.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: You know you should go outside and be with the three-dimensional people.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No, inside good, outside bad.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: You guys are so pathetic, I, oh, OH, XANADU! OH.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: She's one of us now.
[Rachel and Ross enter]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hi you guys.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey.
CHANDLER, JOEY, and PHOEBE: Hey.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well we just wanted to stop by and uh, say goodnight.
CHANDLER, JOEY, and PHOEBE: Goodnight.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Look at that, they won't even turn their heads.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Alright you guys, I'm takin' off my shirt.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: [uses a dentist mirror to see] Naa, she's lyin'.
[Monica enters carrying food that's been delivered]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Stop sending food to our apartment.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, why're you all dressed up?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: You're not the only one who has a date tonight.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What? You have a date? Who with?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No one.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: C'mon, what's his name?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Come on, tell me.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Alright, but I'm very excited about this OK, so you gotta promise you won't get
all big-brothery and judgmental.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh, I promise, what.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: It's Richard Burke.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Who's Richard Burke? Doc, Doctor Burke? You have a date with Doctor Burke? Why, why,
why should that bother me? I, I love that man, he's like a uh, brother to dad.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well for your information he happens to be one of the brightest, most
sophisticated, sexiest men I've ever been with.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Doctor Burke is sexy?

lines.speaker: RACHEL and PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh God, absolutely.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [his beeper goes off] It's the museum again, can I, oh.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ya know, Dr. Burke kissed me once.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: When?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: When I was um, 7, I crashed my bike right out in front of his house and to stop me
from crying he kissed me right here. [points to the tip of her nose]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh you are so lucky.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [on the phone] Woah, woah, woah australopithicus isn't supposed to be in that
display. No. No. No, n, homo-habilus was erect, australopithicus was never fully erect.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well maybe he was nervous.

scenes.location: Museum of Natural History. Ross is fixing a display, Rachel is waiting patiently.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh look, I can't believe this. Look, homo-habilus hasn't even learned how to use
tools yet and they've got him here wi, with clay pots. Why don't, why don't they just give
him a microwave? I'm sorry, I'm sorry this is taking so long, ya know, I, I, it's just
it's longer than I expected, we will have dinner.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: It's OK, it's fine.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: KARL!
[Ross leaves to find Karl. Rachel takes a peek under the loincloth of one of the display
models.]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica and Dr. Burke are sitting on the couch. He's
showing her the pictures in his wallet.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Wow, is that Michelle?

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I've not seen her since high school graduation. Oh my God, that night she got so
dru. . . motional.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: Ya know, she's having another baby.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I thought she just had one.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: No no. Henry's almost two and he's talking and everyting. Here. You know, the
other day he told me he liked me better than his other grandpa. Now in all fairness his
other grandpa's a drunk but still. . .

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh, you're a grandpa.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: Yeah. Are we nuts here?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I don't know, maybe. I mean I'm dating a man who's pool I once peed in.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: I didn't need to know that. I guess 21 years is a lot. I mean, hell, I'm a
whole person who can drink older than you.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: So.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So maybe we should just. . .

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, maybe.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Wow, this really sucks.

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: Yeah, it sure does. [they hug and it turns into a passionate kiss]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, we don't really have to decide anything right now, do we?

lines.speaker: DR. BURKE
lines.text: No, no, there's no rush or anything.
[knock at the door]

lines.speaker: DELIVERY GUY
lines.text: Pizza delivery.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh, I'm gonna kill those guys.

scenes.location: Museum of Natural History. Ross enters the display where Rachel is waiting.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Rach.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I'm done.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yeah well, you know what, so is uh, Sorentino's.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Wha, OK, I'm sorry, let's uh, why don't we find someplace else.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No, you know what, it's late, everything's gonna be closed. Why don't we just do
it another night?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No, no, we won't.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: We won't?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [grabs a fur pelt] C'mon.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: OK, that's dead right?

scenes.location: The museum planetarium. Ross and Rachel enter on stage.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What is this? What are we doing?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Shh. Do you want cran-apple or cran-grape?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Grape.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [spreads the pelt on the floor] OK, now, sit. OK. [he starts the music system]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, God.
[The stereo system booms out 'Billions of years ago. . .'. Ross gets up and changes it to
music.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ah, so what are we looking at?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well uh, you see that, that little cluster of stars next to the big one? That is
Ursa Major.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I've no idea, could be. Listen, I'm sorry I had to work tonight.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh it's OK. You were worth the wait, and I don't just mean tonight. [they kiss]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: You're not laughing.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: This time it's not so funny.
[They kiss and start undressing. As Rachel tries to pull off Ross's tie she catches it in
his mouth. Then they roll across the fur rug.]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ah, oh God. Oh, honey, oh that's OK.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What. Oh no, you just rolled over the juice box.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, thank God.
[Scene: Museum of Natural History. The next morning Rachel and Ross are sleeping in the
display under a fur.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hi you. I can't believe I'm waking up next to you.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I know it is pretty unbelievaaaaah.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: We're not alone. [A church youth group is outside the display watching them]
CLOSING CREDITS
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. They are still in their chairs, watching Beavis
and Butthead.]
[they're laughing along with the show when an alarm goes off]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Is that the fire alarm?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah. [feels the floor] Oh it's not warm yet, we still have time.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Cool.
END

title: The One Where Joey Moves Out

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. Chandler and Joey are sitting
at the bar, in their bathrobes, eating cereal]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Man this is weird. You ever realize Captain Crunch's eyebrows are actually on his
hat?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That's what's weird? Joey, the man's been captain of a cereal for the
last 40 years.
[Joey finishes his cereal, licks his spoon, and puts it back in the silverware drawer.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Waaa-aaah.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: The spoon. You licked and-and you put. You licked and you put.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, so.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well don't you see how gross that is? I mean that's like you using my
toothbrush. [Joey gets a sheepish look] You used my toothbrush?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, that was only 'cause I used the red one to unclog the drain.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Mine is the red one! Oh God. Can open, worms everywhere.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, why can't we use the same toothbrush, but we can use the same soap?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Because soap is soap. It's self-cleaning.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Alright, well next time you take a shower, think about the last thing I wash and the
first thing you wash.
OPENING TITLES
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica and Phoebe are sitting at the table, Joey
and Chandler enter.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: MONICA and PHOEBE
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ooh, look at you fancy lads. What's the occasion?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, you know that guy that's on my show that's in a coma? He's havin' a brunch.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ahh.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: [enters from her room] OK, ready when you are.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Okey-doke.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I can't believe you guys are actually getting tattoos.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Excuse me, you guys are getting tattoos?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yes, but you can not tell Ross 'cause I want to surprise him.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Wow, this is wild. What're you gonna get?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Um, I'm getting a lily for my Mom. 'Cause her name's Lily.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Wow, that's lucky. What if her name was Big Ugly Splotch?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: So where you gettin' it?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I think on my shoulder. [Ross enters]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What? What's on your shoulder?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Um, a chip. A tattoo, I'm getting a tattoo.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: A tattoo? Why, why would you want to do that? [to Rachel] Hi.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hi. Well hey, you don't - you don't think they're kind of cool?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No, sorry I don't. Tell me why would anyone pay someone to scar their body for life?
What if it doesn't come out right Phoebe? Then it's like, I don't know, havin' a bad hair
cut all the time. Why's everyone staring at me?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ross, come sign this birthday card for dad. Rich is gonna be here any minute.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oooh, Rich is goin' to the party too, huh?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, he's my parents' best friend, he has to be there.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh, is today the day you're gonna tell them about you two?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yeah. It's my dad's birthday, I decided to give him a stroke.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No, I think you should tell them.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No, I don't even know how serious he is about me. Until I do, I'm not telling them
anything.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I don't know, I don't think mom and dad would mind. Remember when you were 9 and
Richard was 30, how dad used to say, 'God I hope they get together.'
[Scene: The Gellers' house. Monica, Ross, and Richard are arriving to Mr. Gellers
birthday party.]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Alright, shall we?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: OK, wait, wait, wait, wait. You know what? Ross, let's - let's switch places. You
get in the middle. No un-, ya know, unless this looks like we're trying to cover something
up.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Monica, Monica, you could come in straddling him, they still wouldn't believe it.
[opens door] We're here.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Oh hi kids. Hi darling.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Happy birthday dad.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: Oh thank you.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hi ma.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Happy birthday.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Well, you kids thank Dr. Burke for the ride?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Uh, actually mom, I think Monica thanked him for the both of us.
[Scene: The Gellers' kitchen. Monica, Mrs. Geller and one of Mrs. Geller's friends are
preparing the cake.]

lines.speaker: FRIEND
lines.text: Well, you kids take the train in?

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: No, Richard Burke gave them a ride.

lines.speaker: FRIEND
lines.text: Oh. Speaking of whom, I hear he's got some 20-year-old twinkie in the city.
[Monica sprays whipped cream all over the place]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Finger cramp. Oh God, sorry. Here, let me get that mom.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Sooo, Richard's shopping in the junior section.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Are we still on that?

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: We just know she's got the IQ of a napkin.

lines.speaker: FRIEND
lines.text: She's probably not even very pretty, just young enough so that everything is still
pointing up. [Monica folds her arms over her breasts]

scenes.location: Joey's co-star's apartment. Chandler and Joey are at the brunch.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Can you believe this place?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I know, this is a great apartment.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ah, I was just in the bathroom, and there's mirrors on both sides of you. So when

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Wow, there's my fantasy come true. No, seriously.
JOEY'S CO-STAR: Hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey! We were just sayin', great apartment man.
JOEY'S CO-STAR: Thanks. You want it?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Huh?
JOEY'S CO-STAR: Yeah, I'm movin' to a bigger place. You should definitely take this one.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, can you see me in a place like this?
JOEY'S CO-STAR: Why not? You hate park views and high ceilings? C'mon I'll show you the

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [being left behind] Oh that's all right fellas, I saw a kitchen this morning -
on TV. Stop talking. OK.
[Scene: Mr. Geller's party. Mr. Geller and a friend are questioning Richard while Ross
observes.]

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: C'mon, tell us.

lines.speaker: FRIEND
lines.text: Yeah, is she really 20.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: I am not telling you guys anything.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: C'mon Rich, it's my birthday, let me live vicariously.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Dad, you really don't want to do that.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: Ahh, what's a little mid-life crisis between friends?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Jack, would you let it go?

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: Look, I know what you're going through. When I turned 50 I got the Porsche.
You... you got your own little speedster.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Guys. Seriously, it is not like that.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: Tell you what, maybe one of these weekends you can borrow the car and I cou. .

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Dad, I beg you not to finish that sentence.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: What? I'm kidding. You know I'd never let him touch the Porsche.

scenes.location: Tattoo parlor. Phoebe and Rachel are deciding on tattoos.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK Rach, which, which lily? This lily or that lily?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well I. . .

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I like this lily. It's more open, ya know, and that's like my mom. She had a more

lines.text: Alright, blonde girl, you're in room two, not so blonde girl, you're with

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Here we go.

lines.text: [reluctantly] Uh-huh.

lines.text: You're not going?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: What? Is it - is this 'cause of what Ross said?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No. Well, yeah, maybe.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I don't believe this. Is this how this relationship's gonna work? Ross equals
boss. I mean, c'mon what is this, 1922?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What's 1922?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Just, you know, long time ago. Well, when men used to tell women what to do - a
lot. And then there was suffrage, which is a good thing but is sounds horrible. Do you
want to get this tattoo?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yes I do, it's just that Ross is. . .

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, hey, HEY. Is your boyfriend the boss of you?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, who is the boss of you?!!

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: You?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No. You are the boss of you. Now you march your heinie in there and get that heart

scenes.location: Mr. Geller's birthday party. Monica is in the bathroom and Richard comes in.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: How ya doin'?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I'm a twinkie.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Really? I'm a hero.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh, this is so hard.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Yeah, I know. I hate it too. Look, maybe we should just tell them.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Maybe we should just tell your parents first.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: My parents are dead.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: God, you are so lucky. I mean, I mean. . . you know what I mean.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: I know, I know. Just hang in there, OK. OK, I'll go out first, alright.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Alright.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: [walks out of the bathroom and runs into Mrs. Geller who is going to the
bathroom] Judy, going to the bathroom, good for you.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Thank you Richard, I appreciate the support.
[Monica jumps in the shower. Right after Mrs. Geller enters the bathroom, Mr. Geller peeks
his head in.]

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: Honey. Honey, have you seen my Harmon Kilerbrew bat? Bob doesn't believe I
have one.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: I have no idea. Did you know Richard has a twinkie in the city?

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: I know. He's like a new man. It's like a scene from Cocoon.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: I just never would have pictured Richard with a bimbo.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: Apparently, he told Johnny Shapiro that she's quite a girl. In fact, he told
Johnny that he thinks he's falling in love with her.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: I tell you, I've never seen him this happy.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: So Jack, you ever think about trading me in for a younger model?

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: Of course not. With you it's like I've got two 25-year-olds.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: [they start kissing] Oh Jack stop.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: C'mon, it's my birthday.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. Chandler and Joey are returning from their
brunch.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Can we drop this? I am not interested in the guy's apartment.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh please, I saw the way you were checking out his mouldings. You want it.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Why would I want another apartment, huh? I've already got an apartment that I love.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well it wouldn't kill you to say it once in a while.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Alright, you want the truth? I'm thinkin' about it.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'm 28 years old, I've never lived alone, and I'm finally at a place
where I've got enough money that I don't need a roommate anymore.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Woah, woah, woah. I don't need a roommate either, OK? I can afford to live here
by myself. Ya know, I may have to bring in somebody once a week to lick the silverware.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: What're you gettin' so bent out of shape for, huh? It's not like we agreed to live
together forever. We're not Bert and Ernie.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Look, you know what? If this is the way you feel, then maybe you should take it.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well that's how I feel.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well then maybe you should take it.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well then maybe I will.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Fine with me.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Great. Then you'll be able to spend more quality time with your real friends, the
spoons.
[Scene: Mr. Geller's birthday party. Mr. and Mrs. Geller enter looking particularly
refreshed. Monica follows looking rather pale.]

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: Who's drink can I freshen?

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Almost time for cake.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Mon, Mon, are you OK?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You remember that video I found of mom and dad?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, I just caught the live show.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Eww.

scenes.location: Mr. Geller's birthday party. Monica and Richard are alone in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hey there.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Nothing, I just heard something nice about you.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Humm, really?
[Mrs. Geller and Ross both enter]

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Richard. Richard. Your son isn't seeing anyone is he?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Uhh, not that I know of.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Well, I was thinking, why doesn't he give Monica a call?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: That - that's an idea.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, actually, I'm already seeing someone.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: She never tells us anything. Ross, did you know Monica's seeing someone?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Mom, there are so many people in my life. Some of them are seeing people and some of
them aren't. Is that crystal?

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: So, who's the mystery man?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, uh, he's a doctor.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: A real doctor?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No, a doctor of meat. Of course he's a real doctor. And he's handsome, and he's
sweet, and know you'd like him. [she puts her arm around Richard]

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Well that's wonderful. . . I

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Mom, it's OK.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: It is Judy.

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Jack. Could you come in here for a moment? NOW!

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: [enters with his bat] Found it.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I'll take that dad. [grabs the bat]

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: It seems your daughter and Richard are something of an item.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: That's impossible, he's got a twinkie in the city.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Dad, I'm the twinkie.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: You're the twinkie?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: She's not a twinkie.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Al-alright, l-look you guys, this is the best relationship I've been in. . .

lines.speaker: MRS. GELLER
lines.text: Oh please, a relationship.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yes, a relationship. For your information I am crazy about this man.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: Am I supposed to stand here and listen to this on my birthday?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Dad, dad this is a good thing for me. Ya know, and you even said yourself, you've
never seen Richard happier.

lines.speaker: MR. GELLER
lines.text: When did I say that?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Upstairs in the bathroom right before you felt up mom.
[Everyone else enters and all start singing Happy Birthday.]

scenes.location: Tattoo parlor. Rachel is showing Phoebe her tattoo.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh that looks so good, oh I love it.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I know, so do I. Oh Phoebe, I'm so glad you made me do this. OK, lemme se yours.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ahh. OK, let's see yours again.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Phoebe we just saw mine, let me see yours.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh OK. [pulls over her shirt and shows a bare shoulder] Oh no, oh it's gone,
that's so weird, I don't know how-where it went.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: You didn't get it?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Why didn't you get it?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Phoebe, how would you do this to me? This was all your idea.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I know, I know, and I was gonna get it but then he came in with this needle and
uh, di-, did you know they do this with needles?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Really? You don't say, because mine was licked on by kittens.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's apartment. Chandler is at the bar and Joey enters.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey listen, I'm sorry about what happened. . .

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah me too.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I know. Yeah.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah. So do we need to hug here or. . .

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No, we're alright.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: So I got ya something. [tosses Joey a bag of plastic spoons]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Plastic spoons. Great.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Lick away my man.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: These'll go great in my new place. You know, 'till I get real ones.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, I can't use these forever. I mean, let's face it, they're no friend to the
environment.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No-no, I mean what, what's this about your new place?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I'm movin' out like we talked about.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well I didn't think that was serious. [grabs the spoons back] Ya know I thought
that was just a fight.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, it was a fight. . . based on serious stuff, remember. About how I never lived
alone or anything. I just think it would be good for me, ya know, help me to grow or. . .
whatever.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, there you go.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, are you cool with this. I mean, I don't want to leave you high and dry.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey, no, I've never been lower or wetter. I'll be fine. I'll just turn your, uh,
bedroom into a game room or somethin', you know, put the foosball table in there.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Woah. Why do you get to keep the table?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I did pay for half of it.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah. And uh, I paid for the other half.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Alright I'll tell you what, I'll play you for it.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Alright, you're on. I can take two minutes out of my day to kick your ass.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Your little men are gonna get scored on more times than your sister.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Woah, woah, woah, woah. Which sister?

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica and Richard are setting the table.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So, are you sorry that I told them?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: No, it's been a long time since your dad and I went running.
[Rachel and Phoebe enter]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh. Well did you get it? Let me see.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Is Ross here?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No he went out to get pizza.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh really, OK. [shows Monica her tattoo]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: That's great.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Very tasteful.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Wanna see mine, wanna see mine?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What? You didn't get one.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, well then what is this? [shows her bare shoulder]

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: What're we looking at? That blue freckle?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, that's my tattoo.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: That is not a tattoo, that is a nothing. I finally got her back in the chair,
bairly touched her with a needle, she jumped up screaming, and that was it.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK, hi. For your information this is exactly what I wanted. This is a tattoo of
the earth as seen from a great distance. It's the way my mother sees me from heaven.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, what a load of crap. That is a dot. Your mother is up in heaven going, 'Where
the hell is my lily, you wuss?' OK, Phoebe, that is not a tattoo, this is a tattoo. [she
bends over and bears her tattoo right when Ross returns]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: You got a tattoo?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Maybe. But just a little one. Phoebe got the whole world.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Lemme see. [looks]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well it's really. . . sexy. I wouldn't have thought it would be but. . . wow.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, so uh, is it sore or can you do stuff?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, save us some pizza. [they go off to Rachel's room]

scenes.location: Chandler's apartment. Chandler and Joey are playing foosball for the table.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Get out of the corner. Pass it, pass it.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Stop talkin' to your men. [Joey scores]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yes! And the table is mine.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Congratulations. [Chandler leaves]

scenes.location: Chandler's apartment. The whole gang is helping Joey pack.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, you guys are still gonna come visit me, right?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh yeah, you got the big TV. We'll be over there all the time. . . [Chandler
gives him a look] except when we are here.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I know you're just moving uptown but I'm really gonna miss you.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I know, how can you not be accross the hall anymore.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yeah, who's gonna eat all our food, and tie up our phone lines, and - is that my
bra? What the hell you doin' with my bra?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh no-no, it's uh, it's not what you think. We uh, we used it to, you know, fling
water balloons off the roof. Remember that, those junior high kids couldn't even get
theirs accross the street.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [quietly] Yeah, I remember.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, let's bring the rest of these down to the truck.
[Everyone except Joey and Chandler leave.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: So, uhh, em, you want me to uh, give you a hand with the foosball table?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Naa, you keep it, you need the practice.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: So, I guess this is it.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, right, yeah, I guess so.
[Joey walks to the door. He stops, turns around.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Listen, uh, I don't know when I'm gonna see you again.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, I'm guessing uh, tonight at the coffee house.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Right, yeah. OK. Um, take care.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah.
[Joey walks out and after a few seconds comes back in and gives Chandler a big hug. He
then leaves for good and Chandler is left alone in his apartment.]
CLOSING CREDITS
END

title: The One Where Eddie Moves In

lines.text: [Scene: Joey's new apartment. Everyone but Chandler is there. Joey has
decorated the place with tons of tacky stuff.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Huh? So whaddya think? Casa de Joey. Huh? I decorated it myself.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Get out.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [looking at some kind of glass sculpture thing] Wow Joey, this is, uhh...

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Art.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Art it is.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [looking at a glass table with a panther shaped base] Look, check this out. Is it a
coffee table, is it a panther? There's no need to decide.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: [holding a pillow made out of 4 inch red fur] Hey, nice pillow. So now tell me, is
this genuine Muppet skin?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [looking at a water sculpture that looks like a window with rain running down it]
Hey, excellent, excellent water-table thing.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Thanks, yeah. I love this but ya know what, it makes me wanna pee.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, well me too, yeah. I think that's the challenge.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, how come, uhh, Chandler didn't come?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well uh, it's cause he had a thing with, wi-, with the thing.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Right, I go-, I got it.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: So why don't ya show us the rest of your casa?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah. Uh, oh, OH, the best part, c'mon. [leads them to the bathroom, gestures
towards toilet, everyone stares, uncomprehending] Heh?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hey, nice toilet.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No no no, behind it.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Wha-, you have a phone in here?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: That's right, I have a phone in here.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Joey, promise me something.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Never call me from that phone.
OPENING TITLES
[Scene: Central Perk. Monica, Chandler, and Ross are seated. Rachel is walking over
with coffee and a piece of pie.]
[Someone bumps into Rachel and she drops the pie in a guy's hood that's seated at the
table. She improvises by using the plate as a saucer for the coffee.]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: OK, here we go. Honey, I'm sorry, they were all out of apple pie, someone just got
the last piece.
[Phoebe enters]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh my God, oh my God, oh my God, oh my God. You are not gonna believe this. I have
just been discovered.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Now wait a minute, I claimed you in the name of France four years ago.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Anyway, OK, now promise you won't like, freak out and say how great this is until
I'm done, OK.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK. I just met this producer of this like, teeny record company, who said that I
have a very fresh, offbeat sound and she wants to do a demo of Smelly Cat.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: [congradulating her and celebrating]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I told you not to do that yet. And, she wants to do a video.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: [celebrating more]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I'm not done yet, OK. God. OK, if that goes well, they may even want to make an
album.
[everyone is quiet, unsure if she's done or not]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I'm done now.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: [celebrating]
[the guy with the pie in his hood get up to leave]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh God. Ross, OK, if you care about me at all, you will get the pie out of the
man's hood.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Get the what?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Pie in the hood, pie in the hood. Go.
[Ross goes over behind the guy and grabs the pie out of his hood as he leaves]

lines.speaker: GUY
lines.text: What're you doing?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I'm sorry, my pie was, was in your hood. Now I just have to get the coffee out of
that guy's pants and I'll be back in the hospital by 7. [swats at an imaginary insect by
his head, guy leaves promptly]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica is outside the bathroom yelling at Ross
who's in the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Damnit Ross, get your butt out of the bathroom.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Calm down, I'm blow drying.
[Rachel enters with laundry and starts folding]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Blow drying what, you have no hair.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What's goin' on?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Your boyfriend has been in there for over an hour. I can't believe it, it's like
I'm living with him again. He's here when I go to sleep, he's here when I wake up, he's
here when I want to use the shower, ughh. It's like I'm sixteen all over again .

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well, you're not sixteen, you're both adults now.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: GET OUT YOU DUFUS!!

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Or ya know, he's rubber and you're glue.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [comes out] All yours.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I hope you cleaned your hair out of the drain.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [in a childish voice] I hope you cleaned your hair out of the drain.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Shut up.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [childish voice] Shut up.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Cut it out.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [childish voice] Mi-mi-mii.
[Monica goes in the bathroom]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: [sarcastically] I've never wanted you more.

scenes.location: Chandler's apartment. Chandler is sitting on the bar wearing huge dog-slippers

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: So, whaddya say boys, should I call him? [squeezes the ear of one of the
slippers and it barks] Well, ya know what they say. Ask your slippers a question... you're
going crazy.
[Joey's apartment, phone rings]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Listen, I'm, I'm sorry I didn't make it over there today.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh, that's OK. You uh, you had a thing.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah well, I hear the place looks great.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ahh, forget about it, I'm havin' a ball. How's the apartment doin'

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh hey, it's, it's terriffic. I mean it's a regular space... fest.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh, well great.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah I just... wanted to call and say hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well OK then. [oven timer goes off behind Chandler] Was that the oven timer?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That's right my friend. It's time for...

lines.speaker: BOTH
lines.text: Baywatch!! [both turn on TV's]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh, can you believe they gave Stephanie skin cancer?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I still can't believe they promoted her to lieutenant.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Naa, you're just sayin' that 'cause you're in love with Yasmine Blepe.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, how could anyone not be in love with Yasmine Blepe?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, hey, they're runnin'

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: See, this is the brilliance of the show. I say always keep them running. All the
time, running. Run. Run Yasmine, run like the wind.

scenes.location: Central Perk. Joey is sitting between Monica and Phoebe.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: But I thought you wanted to live by yourself.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I did. I thought it'd be great. I figured I'd have like, time alone with my thoughts
but, ya know, it turns out I don't have as many thoughts as you'd think.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Joey, why don't you talk to Chandler about moving back?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: You really think he'd take me? I mean, we had a pretty good talk last night but,
when I moved out, I hurt him bad.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I promise you, he would definitely want you back.

scenes.location: Chandler's apartment. Chandler is sitting between Rachel and Ross.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I'm telling you, there's no way he's moving back.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: But we had one of the greatest talks we ever had last night. I mean it was, it
was like when we first started living together.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Look, I know you don't want to hear this right now but, we've seen him in his new
place, alright. And he's happy, he's, he's decorated.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Look, Chandler, he has moved on, OK, you have to too.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No. You're just gonna have to accept the fact that you're just friends now, OK,
you're not... rommmates anymore.

scenes.location: Recording studio. Phoebe is getting ready to record Smelly Cat.

lines.speaker: PRODUCER
lines.text: OK Phoebe, you ready to try one?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK. [singing] Smelly cat, smell-ly cat, what are they feeding you? Smelly cat
[back up singers start singing smelly, smelly, smelly, smelly behind her] Oh woah,
oh my God. I mean like, who was that?

lines.speaker: PRODUCER
lines.text: They're your backup singers... beind you.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OH!! Oh I thought they were just watching me. You know, like at, like at an
aquarium, ya know.

lines.speaker: PRODUCER
lines.text: Alrighty. From the top.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: OK. [singing] Smelly cat, smell-ly cat, what are they feeding you? Smelly cat
[back up singers - smelly, smelly, smelly, really bad smelly cat, it's not your fault]
OK, sorry. I'm just, I'm just not getting that everyone um, gets how smelly this cat
acually is. I just think that maybe if we could talk about this, 'cause I need to feel
that you really care about the cat.

lines.speaker: PRODUCER
lines.text: Honey, uh we, we can talk about this. It's just that it's costing about a
hundred dollars a minute to be in here.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh OK. So, um, the cat stinks but you love it, let's go.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Ross is on the phone.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No, there is no way he was a velociraptor. No Tony, look at the cranial ridge, OK.
If Dino was a velociraptor, he would have eaten the Flintstones. Yeah, yeah. [Monica comes
out of her room] Oh, were you takin' a nap?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I was.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh I-, Oh wait, Tony can you hang on? That's the other line. [gets the other line]
Hello. Oh yeah she's here but uh, can she call you back? OK thanks. [hangs up the other
line] Call Joanna. [back on with Tony] Hi.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Did she leave a number?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Did you see me write one down?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I don't have her number, butt-munch.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, she'll call back, don't be such a baby.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I'm not a baby, you're the baby.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Look, you wanna get off my back?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You wanna get out of my face?

lines.text: Well yeah, in that it's not being used and I... have it to spare.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well I uh, got what I came for. [puts on moose hat] I'll uh, I'll see you guys.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER

lines.text: [cheer]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I sound amazing. I, I, I've never heard myself sing before. I mean, except in my

lines.text: Hi Joey, what's goin' on man?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Eddie.

lines.text: Morning.

lines.text: Morning. I just uh, came by to pick up my mail. [looks for the mail on the table by

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh it's uh, over there on the table.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: You don't keep it over here on this table any more?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No, Eddie likes to keep it over there.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Alright, here you go my friend. Eggs a-la Eddie, huh?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh, ooh.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No I just uh, thought you liked your eggs with the bread with the hole in the
middle, a-la me.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well I do, but uh, Eddie makes them this way and, well they're pretty darn good.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Well you guys, I'm outta here. See ya pals.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: See ya. [Eddie leaves]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: So how you two gettin' along?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh, I couldn't be happier.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Great, well, I'm happy for ya. [picks up the orange juice carton and it's empty]

mail and his, his 'see ya pals'. And now there's no juice. There's no juice f or the

lines.text: There's another carton right over there.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, this isn't about juice anymore, alright man.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Alright, so what's it about?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Eggs. Who's eggs do you like better, his or mine, huh?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well I like both eggs equally.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh come on. Nobody likes two different kinds of eggs equally. You like one better
than the other and I wanna know which.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well what's the difference? Your eggs aren't here anymore, are they? You took

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Ross and Monica are fighting over the remote.

lines.text: I wanna watch Entertainment Tonight.

lines.text: Tough noogies, we're watching Predators of the Serengetti.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Would you guys stop.

lines.text: It's my TV.

lines.text: Wha-, oh, quit it.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Bite me.

lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.text: Not that, this, US. Oh my God, Ross, you-re, you're, it's jus-, you-, ever sin-

lines.text: Fun? Fun, you think this is fun?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, c'mon I mean I though, you know, I thought we're just foolin' around. Like

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ross, I hated you when we were kids.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: You hated me when we were kids?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yes. I hated you. I mean I, I, loved you in a 'you're my brother so I have to'
kind of way, but basically, yeah, I hated your guts.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Why did you hate me?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Because, you were mean to me and you, you teased me and you always, always got
your way.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: And that wasn't fun for you?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Duh-huh!

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I can't believe you hated me.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Now I love you. And not just 'cause I have to.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yeah. You're just gonna have to stop pissing me off.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I can do that.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Then I won't have to kill you.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: So you wanna watch uh, Entertainment Tonight?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yeah, thanks. You know what?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: If you really want to watch that Serengetti thing, you can.

lines.speaker: ROSS

lines.text: [Phoebe enters]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Listen. You are not going to believe this but, that is not me singing on the

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yes.

lines.text: Well, how did you find out?

lines.text: Well, OK, the record company sent over this piece of paper for me to sign, saying

lines.text: Well I have a video, you have to pay attention. No this, this voice woman, she's

the pound who like nobody wants 'cause they're not pretty enough or you know. Like, like
some old dog who's just kind of like stinky and. Huuuuh, oh my God, she's smelly cat. Oh,
oh that song has so many levels.

lines.text: Hey Eddie, you uh, wanna play some foosball?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: No thanks man, I'm not uh, I'm not really into sports.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [stares in disbeliefe] Yeah o-, OK, alright. [oven timer goes off] Doesn't

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: I tell ya, I-, I'm gonna go read in my room for a little while.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh o-, OK man.

title: The One Where Dr. Ramoray Dies

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Everyone except Ross is there

lines.text: Oh Drake.

lines.text: I'm sorry I'm late, what happened?

lines.text: We, we just wanna see the end.

lines.text: I want you Drake.

lines.text: I know you do but you and I can never be together that way.

lines.text: What?

lines.text: There's something I never told you Amber. I'm actually your half- brother.

lines.text: So what happens next?

lines.text: Well, I get the medical award for separating the siamese

lines.text: God that is good TV.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Phoebs, play with meeee.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No. This game is grotesque. Twenty armless guys joined at the waist by a steel

lines.text: Ya know Phoebs, don't feel so bad for 'em. After they're

lines.text: Why don't you play with your roommate?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ah he's a, he's not a big fan of foosball.

lines.text: Uh oh, ooh, are we not getting along with the new boy?

lines.text: No he's, he's alright, just uh, he spends most of his time in his room.

lines.text: Maybe that's because you haven't taken the time to get to know him. Let's remedy

lines.text: We don't need to remedy that.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh yeah, it'll be fun. [throws a tennis ball at Eddie's bedroom door]

lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hi, um, I just thought that it would be fun if the three of
us had some beers and got to know each other.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Yeah alright, that sounds alright.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh good, ok. Oh nooo, I have to go because I'm late for my um, Green Eggs and Ham

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That was so lame.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I know, yeah. Ok, talk to him. [leaves]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: So, you uh, you think that Speed Racer guy gets a lot of tickets er?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: That's good, that's good. So, so, so who broke up with who?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: What're you kidding? I broke up with her. She actually
thought that Sean Penn was the capital of Cambodia.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: That's good man, when everybody knows that the uh, the capital of Cambodia is uh...

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well it's not Sean Penn.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Not Sean Penn. Alright, I, I've got a funny one, alright. My

says, 'Eddie.' I say, 'yeah,' she says, 'Eddie, I don't want to see you anymore.' And it
was literally like she had reached into my chest, ripped out my heart, and smeared it all
over my life, ya know. And now there's like this incredible abyss, ya know, and I'm
falling and I keep falling and I don't think I'm ever gonna stop. [finishes laughing] That
uh, wasn't such a funny story, was it?
[Scene: Central Perk. Phoebe is singing. Monica, Richard, Ross, and Rachel are

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: And a crusty old man said I'll do what I can and the rest
of the rats played moroccas. That's it, thanks, good night.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Phoebe's got another job, right?

lines.text: Great set tonight Phoebs.

lines.text: I know.

lines.text: Well, we should probably get going.

lines.text: Um, we should go too, I got patients at 8 in the moring.

lines.text: Ya know, I was thinking. Ya know how we always stay at your

lines.text: I don't know, I don't have my jammies.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, maybe you don't need them.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: My baby sister, ladies and gentlemen.

lines.text: Shut up, I'm happy.

lines.text: Oh, this is so nice. Alright I have to make a speech. I just wanna say that of all

lines.text: Oh, thank you Phoebs. That's very sweet.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Hear that? She likes me best, and apparently there've been
a lot.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Not a lot, Phoebe's kidding, Phoebe's crazy.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Phoebe's dead.

lines.speaker: TILLY
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: TILLY
lines.text: I'm looking for Eddie Minowick.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh, uh, he's not here right now, uh, I'm Chandler, can I take a message, or, or

lines.speaker: TILLY
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh, oh, c'mon in.

lines.text: I'm Tilly.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh.

lines.text: I gather by that oh that he told you about me.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh yeah, your uh, name came up in a uh, conversation that terrified me to my

lines.text: He's kind of intense huh?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yes. Hey, can I ask you, is Eddie a little...

lines.text: [walks around corner] A little what?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Bit country? C'mon in here you roomie.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Hello Tilly.

lines.speaker: TILLY
lines.text: Eddie, I just came by to drop off your tank.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: That's very thoughtful of you. It's very thougtful.

lines.text: Well, ok then. I'm gonna go. Bye.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Bye-bye.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: So, we gettin' a fish?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: You had sex with her didn't you?

scenes.location: Central Perk. Joey enters with several magazines and runs up to Phoebe.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Phoebs, check it out, check it out, check it out, check it out.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, ooh, Soap Opera Digest, oh that's one of my favorite digests.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Page 42, page 42, page 42.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok, ok, ok. Ooh, hey 'new doc on the block, Days of Our Lives' Joey Tribbiani.'

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ooh, I look good.

lines.text: Huh? Never really thought about the writers. The scripts just kinda come to my

lines.text: Makes up most of his lines. Son-of-a-. Yeah, well, write this jerkweed.

lines.text: Uhh, I don't know, I just bring the scripts.

lines.text: They can't kill me, I'm Francesca's long lost son.

lines.text: Right. Could you sign this?

lines.text: No. No way, I'm not signing that.

lines.text: I don't think that's gonna affect the plot of the show.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: How can they do this to me?

lines.speaker: DELIVERY GUY
lines.text: Er, uh, I'm just gonna go. Sorry.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica, Richard, Ross, and Rachel are

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well it wasn't that many guys. I mean, if you consider how
many guys there actually are, it's a very small percentage.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hey, it's not that big a deal, I was just curious.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: G'night.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Night Richard. Good luck Mon.

lines.text: Alright, before I tell you, uh, why don't you tell me how

lines.text: Two.

lines.text: Two? TWO? How is that possible? I mean, have you seen you?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Well, I mean what can I say? I, I was married to Barbara for 30 years. She was my

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Two it is. Ok, time for bed, I'm gonna go brush my teeth. [goes in the bathroom]

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Woah, woah, no wait a minute now. C'mon it's your turn. Oh
