lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Look, I'm not being any of those things, ok, I'm just being realistic.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well knock it off, you're supposed to be my friend.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I am your friend.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well then tell me things like, 'Joey you'll be fine,' and,
'Hang in there,' and, and, 'Somethin' big's fonna come along, I know it.'

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: But I don't know it. What I do know is that you owe $2300 at Isn't it Chromantic.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey Ross, I'm aware of what I owe.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok, well then get some sense. I mean it took you what, 10 years to get that job, who
knows how long it's gonna be till you get another.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Look, I don't wanna hear this right now.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Huh, I'm just saying...

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well don't just say.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ya know, maybe, maybe I should just go.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok. I'll see ya later. Just think about it, ok.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I don't need to think about it. I was Dr. Drake Remoray. That was huge. Big things
are gonna happen, you'll see. Ross, you still there?
[Scene: Chandler's apartment. Chandler peeks in the door. He doesn't see Eddie so he
enters, breathing a sigh of relief. Eddie pops up from behind the bar.]

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Hey pal.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ahhhh-gaaaahhh. Eddie what're you still doin' here?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Ah, just some basic dehydrating of a few fruits and vegetables. MAN ALIVE this
thing's fantastic!

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Look Eddie, aren't you forgetting anything?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Oh yeah, that's right, look I got us a new goldfish. He's a
lot fiestier that the last one.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Maybe 'cause the last one was made by Pepperidge Farm. Look Eddie, isn't there
something else you're supposed to be doing right now?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Well, not unless it's got something to do with dehydrating my man because right now
I'm a dehydrating maniac!

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Look you have to help me out here. I thought we had a deal. I thought by the
time...

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Ah-ah-ah, you know what that is?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Your last roommate's kidney?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: That's a tomato. This one definitely goes in the display.

scenes.location: Central Perk. Joey goes up to the bar to order.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey Gunther, let me get a lemonade to go.

lines.speaker: GUNTHER
lines.text: Lemonade? You ok man?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ah, it's career stuff. I don't know if you heard but they killed off my character on
the show.

lines.speaker: GUNTHER
lines.text: Oh, that's too bad. How'd they do it?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I fell down an elevator shaft.

lines.speaker: GUNTHER
lines.text: That sucks. I was buried in an avalanche.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: GUNTHER
lines.text: I used to be Bryce on All My Children.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Chandler is sleeping on the couch. Monica walks
by and starts watching him.]
[Chandler wakes up]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Daaahhhh!

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Aaahhhhhhh! Aaahhhh!

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Why must everybody watch me sleep? There'll be no more watching me sleep, no
more watching.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I wa-

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Uuuh.
[Scene: Chandler's apartment. Chandler is returning from Monica and Rachel's with his
bedding. Eddie is standing at the bar with his dehydrator and loads of fruit.]

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Hey man, check it out, I got some great stuff to dehydrate
here. I got some grapes, got some apricots, I thought it would be really cool to see what
happens with these water balloons.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Get out. Get out, get out, get out, get out, get out, get out.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: You, move out. Take your fruit, your stupid small fruit
and GET OUT!

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: You, you want, you want me to move out?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: I uh, I gotta tell you man, I mean, that's uh, it's kinda out of the blue, I mean
don't you think?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: This is not out of the blue, this is smack dab in the middle of the blue.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Ohhhh. Relax, take it easy buddy. Tell me twice, you want me to go? Alright,
alright, guess I'll be back for my stuff. [walks out the door and after a pause comes back
in] But if you think for one second I'm leaving you alone with my fish, you're insane
Jack!

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: You want some help.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: No help required Chico. [reaches into the tank and grabs the fish and puts it in
his pocket]

scenes.location: Joey is at the cab driver interview.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: All the way to the airport huh? You know that's over 30 miles, that's gonna cost
you about so bucks.

lines.speaker: CASTING GUY
lines.text: Excuse me, that's 50 bucks.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: CASTING GUY
lines.text: Five oh dollars.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ohh, you know what it is? It's smudgy 'cause they're fax pages. Now when I was on Days
of Our Lives as Dr. Drake Remoray, they'd send over the whole script on real paper and
everything.

lines.speaker: CASTING GUY
lines.text: That's great.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: And, and just so you know, if you wanted to expand this scene
like, like have the cab crash or somethin', I could attend to the victims 'cause I have a
background in medical acting.

lines.speaker: CASTING GUY
lines.text: Ok, listen, thanks for coming in.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No no, uh, don't thank me for comin' in. Uh, at least let me finish. Uh, we could
take the expressway but uh, this time of day you're better off taking the budge. You
were goin' for the word bridge there weren't ya. I'll have a good day. [gets up and
leaves]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica, Rachel, and Phoebe are sitting around
the coffee table.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok, question number 28, have you ever allowed a lighning
bearer to take your wind? I would have to say no.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: And I would have to say pah-huh.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Do you not remember the puppet guy?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yeah you like totally let him wash his feet in the pool of your inner power.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: And his puppet too.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah ok, well at least I didn't let some guy into the forest
of my righteous truth on the first date.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Paul.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, ok, ok, moving on, moving on, next question. Ok number
29, have you ever betrayed another goddess for a lightning bearer? Ok, number 30.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Woah, woah, woah, let's go back to 29.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Not uh, not to my recollection.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Huuh, alright, Danny Arshak, ninth grade. Oh, c'mon Rach, you know the bottle was
totally pointing at me.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Only 'cause you took up half the circle.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Listen to you two. It's so sad. Looks like I'm gonna be
going to the goddess meetings alone.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well not when they find out you slept with Jason Hurley an hour after he broke up
with Monica.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: One hour? You are such a leaf blower.
[Monica goes into her room and slams the door. Rachel does the same. Phoebe, without a
door to slam, opens a small chest and slams the lid.]

scenes.location: Joey's apartment. Joey is watching movers take all his stuff away.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh hey uh, be careful with that 3-D last supper, Judas is a little loose.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [enters] Oh my God, what's goin' on?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: They're takin all my stuff back. I guess you were right.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No look I wasn''t right, that's what I came here to tell you.
I was totally hung up on, on my own stuff. Listen, I'm someone who needs the whole
security thing, ya know. To know exactly where my next paycheck is coming from buy you,
you don't need that and that's amazing to me. I could never do what you do Joey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Thanks Ross.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah. And you should hold out for something bigger. I can't tell you how much
respect I have for you not going to that stupid cab driver audition.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I went.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Great, how did it go?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I didn't get it.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Good for you.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: You're livin' the dream.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: All right then.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: [movers removing a glass parrot] Oh, not my parrot.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I can't watch this.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [approaching the mover holding the parrot] Hey hold on, hold on. How much for the
uh, how much to save the bird?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Dollars? You spent $1200 dollars on a plastic bird?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Uhhh, I was an impulse buyer, near the register.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Go ahead, go ahead with the bird. Ok, do you have anything for around 200?

lines.speaker: MOVER
lines.text: Uh, the dog. [points to a big poecelain greyhound]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: MOVER
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I'll take it. My gift to you man.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Thanks Ross. I really like that bird though...I'll take the dog though.
[Scene: Central Perk. Monica and Phoebe are sitting ignoring each other. Rachel walks
up with two pieces of cake.]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Here are your cakes.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: We didn't order cake.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No, I know, they're from me. Look you guys this is not good. I mean we have enough
trouble with guys stealing our wind without taking it from each other.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: You know.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I love you goddesses. I don't ever want to suck your wind again.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Thank you. So are we good?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: We're good.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: We're good?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, let me take these cakes back 'cause they're gonna take
that out of my paycheck.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [enters] Ding dong, the psycho's gone.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Are you sure this time?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yes, yes I actually saw him leave. I mean that guy is
standing in the window holding a human head. He is STANDING IN THE WINDOW HOLDING A HUMAN
HEAD!

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: [enters] Check it out man, I tore it off some mannaquin in
the alley behind Macy's.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: There is no alley behind Macy's.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: So I got it in the junior miss department, big diff. Anyway check it out man, it's
gonna make a hell of a conversation piece at out next cocktail party, huh pal?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Our next cocktail party?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Yeah, you know, put chips in it, we'll make like a chip chick.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Eddie, do you remember yesterday?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Uh yes, I think I vaguely recall it.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Do you remember talking to me yesterday?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Uh, yes.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: So what happened?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: We took a road trip to Las Vegas man.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh sweet Moses.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So on this road trip, did you guys win any money?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Naah, I crapped out, but Mr. 21 over here he cleans up, 300 bucks, check it out he
buys me these new shoes, sweet huh?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Nice.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Yeah. Well see ya upstairs. See ya pals.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Is anyone else starting to really like him?

scenes.location: Hallway outside Chandler and Joey's apartment. Eddie walks up.

lines.text: [Eddie tries his key and it won't work. He knocks and Chandler answers the door. He's got
the door chained.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: May I help you?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Why doesn't my key work and what's all my stuff doin' downstairs?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, I'm, I'm sorry...[Eddie forces his head in the door] Ahhh. Have we met?

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: It's Eddie you freak, your roommate.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I, I'm sorry, I uh [unchains the door and opens it all the way] I already have a
roommate. [Joey turns around in the leather recliner]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, he's lived here for years, I don't, I don't know what you're talking about
man.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: No he, he moved out and I moved in.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well I, I think we'd remember something like that.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I know I would.

lines.speaker: EDDIE
lines.text: Well that's uh, that's a good point. Um ok, well, uh, I guess I got the wrong
apartment then. I, I'm, look, I'm, ya know, I'm sorry, I'm terriably sorry.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey no problem.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: See ya. [shuts the door] Goodbuy you fruit drying
psychopath. So you want me to help you unpack your stuff?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Na, na I'm ok. Oh and uh, just so you know, I'm not movin' back in 'cause I have to.
Well, I mean, I do have to. It's just that that place wasn't really, I mean, this is...

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Welcome home man. [they hug and jump around]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: A little foos?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Absolutely.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: What happened to the foosball?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ah that's a cantelope.
CLOSING CREDITS
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. They are hauling out the porcelain dog from
Joey's room. Chandler is holding the dog by the rear in a rather interesting position.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey look, are we gonna have to bring this out every time Ross comes over?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: He paid a lot of money for it.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I'm gonna hold him a different way. Look I don't
understand, if you hated it so much, why did you buy it in the first place?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, I had a whole ceramic zoo thing goin' over there but now, without the other
ones, it just looks tacky.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: So is he housetrained or is he gonna leave little bathroom
tiles all over the place? Stay. Good, STAY! Good fake dog.
END

title: The One Where Old Yeller Dies

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Phoebe enters to see Monica,
Richard, Ross, and Rachel tearfully watching TV.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hey. Watcha guys doin?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Monica's making us watch Old Yeller.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Why are you guys so upset? It's Old Yeller, it's a happy movie.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What're you talkin' about?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: C'mon, happy family gets a dog, frontier fun.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah but Phoebs, what about the end?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: What when Yeller saves saves the family from the wolf and everyone's happy?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: That's not the end.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yu-huh. That's when my mother would shut off the TV and say 'The end'.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: What about the part where he has rabies?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: He doesn't have rabies, he has babies. That's what my mom said.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Uh, Phoebe, I don't think your mom would want you to see what's about to happen.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: What, what's about to happen? [starts watching] I've never
seen this part before. Hey, Travis, watcha doin' with that gun? Oh no, no no Travis, put
down the gun. No no no no, he he's your buddy, he's your Yeller, no, no no, the end, THE
END. [hear the gunshot from the TV]
[Scene:Monica and Rachel's apartment. Richard is on the balcony smoking and Monica is
on the phone.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hey, have you guys eaten, because uh, Richard and I just
finished and we've got leftovers... Chicken and potatoes... What am I wearing?...Actually,
nothing but rubber gloves.
[Chandler and Joey come sprinting in]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ya know, one of these times you're gonna really be naked and we're not gonna come
over.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Alright, I've got a leg, three breasts and a wing.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, how do you find clothes that fit?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh, hey, Monica, we've got a question.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Alright, for the bizillionth time, yes I see other women in shower at the gym, and
no I don't look.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No, not that one. We're trying to figure out who to bring to the Knicks game
tonight, we have an extra ticket.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, Ross can't go so it's between my friend Eric Prower who has breath issues
and Dan with the poking. [starts poking Monica in the shoulder] 'Did you see that play? Do
you want some more beer? Is that Spike Lee?'

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ok. [Richard walks in] Hey, why don't you ask Richard?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ok, uh, hey Richard, if you had an extra ticket to the Knicks game and you had to
choose between a friend who smells and one who bruises you who would you pick?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Wow. Well being a huge Knicks fan myself, I think you
should take someone who's a huge Knicks fan.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ok, that's Eric.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Glad to be of help. Matches. [walks out to the balcony]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I meant, why don't you take Richard to the game? What?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: C'mon. Keeps his fingers to himself and he's always minty fresh.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I don't know, Richard's really nice and everything, uh,
it's just that we don't know him really well, ya know, and plus he's, ya know, old [Monica
gives him a glare] -er than some people, but, uh, younger than some buildings.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So what, he's a little older, big deal, I mean he's important to me. Ya know if
you ask him, he might take you on his Jag. [walks off]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: How do we say yes now and make it seem like we're not doin' it
just to ride in the cool car?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ok, this could be tough.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: [Monica walks back in the kitchen] Ok ok ok ok. Monica, we'll bring him, but only if
he takes the Jaguar.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ooh, you almost had it.

scenes.location: Ross's apartment. Ross is holding Ben.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [smells Ben's butt] No no, you're fine, you're fine.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: [enters with Susan] Hello

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Hi honey.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh you guys are not gonna believe what happened.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok, we were sitting over there playing on the floor and he
grabs the table and he pulls himself up. He pulled himself up. Standing man. I'm sorry you
guys missed it but I did tape it so it you guys want to see it.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Uhh, we know, he already did it last week.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: You can watch our tape if you want.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I don't believe this. I miss, I miss the first time of everything. I missed, what,
the first time he rolled over, the first time he crawled. What else did I miss? Has he
spoken yet, is he driving, does he have a favorite liquour?

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Actually, he is getting closer on the talking thing. He can't quite say mama yet,
but once he said yumen.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ooh, I, I'm so sick of missing stuff. Ya know, I want him for
more than, than a day, I want him for a whole weekend. No listen , I mean, I feel like-

lines.speaker: CAROL and SUSAN
lines.text: Great. That would be fine.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Really? I mean, I, I had a whole speach prepared.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Oh shout, that would have been fun.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh look, did, did you just see that? Did you see? He just waved, he just waved, he's
never waved before, you've never waved before. Yes he has. Very good.

scenes.location: Central Perk. Monica and Rachel are there. Phoebe enters carrying video tapes.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hey Phoebs, whatcha got there?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok, Love Story, Brian's Song, and Terms of Endearment.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Wow, all you need now is The Killing Fields and some guacamole and you've
got yourself a part-ay.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, I talked to my grandma about the Old Yeller
incident, and she told me that my mom used to not show us the ends of sad movies to shield
us from the pain and sadness. You know, before she killed herself.
[Chandler and Joey enter]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hey. Where is he, where's Richard? Did you ditch him?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah right after we stole his lunch money and gave him a wedgie. What's the matter
with you, he's parking the car.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So'd you guys have fun?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Your boyfriend is so cool.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, he let us drive his Jaguar. Joey for 12 blocks, me
for 15.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Wow, he must like you the best.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh, what about that thing he did when he tipped the guy who
showed us to our seats. You never even saw the money, it was like this. [With money in his
palm] Hey Chandler, thanks for showing us to our seats [shakes his had and passes the
dollar].

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: You're welcome. Hey Joey, thanks for parking the car [passes the dollar back].

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No problem. Hey Chandler

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I think they get it.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ok.
[Richard enters]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: There's the man.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: He-he-eyy. [Shakes his had and passes the dollar]

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Hey, you're gettin' better. I'm gonna keep this by the way.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ok. He kept my dollar.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Carol and Susan are dropping off Ben.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So your first whole weekend without Ben, what're you guys gonna do?

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Uh, we're going down to Colonial Williamsburg.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Yeah, a woman I went to college with just became the first female blacksmith down
there.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, ya know, they're a little behind the times in Colonial Williamsburg.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Think I better go before mommy starts weeping.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Buy mommy.

lines.speaker: CAROL and SUSAN
lines.text: We love you. Buy.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Have a good time. Ok, Ben.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ross.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Look. [they look at Joey in the kitchen with a cigar in his
mouth, looking at his reflection in a spatula] Joey, do you know we can see you from here?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: How come Richard looks so much cooler with one of these than
me?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well for starters, you may want to light it and lose the spatula.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You know what, I think it's cute, you trying to be more like Richard.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Not like him, per-se, just not un-like him.
[Chandler enters with his hair full of mousse and a cheesy moustache]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Look it's the artist formerly known as Chandler.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Just tryin' somethin' here, ya know.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So Joey, why didn't you grow a moustache?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh we flipped for it. I got the cigar, he got the moustache. Figured if we both grew
it, we'd look like dorks.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, you really sidestepped that land mine.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey listen, we've gotta go, I promised Richard we'd meet him downstairs.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You're meeting Richard?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, we're goin' to a Ranger game.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, didn't he tell ya?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, he told me he was going out with the guys, I just didn't know that you were
the guys.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: You hear that? We're the guys.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: We're the guys.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: With that moustache doesn't Chandler remind you of Aunt Sylvia?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Thank you.

scenes.location: Central Perk. Rachel is working. Ross enters with Ben.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hi, we're visitiing. It's Ben and his da-da. Da-da. Can you
say da-da? Look, I'm gonna tell your momies you said it anyway so you might as well try.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No luck huh?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Naa. A while ago I got a sah out of him, which I thought, ya know, might turn into
sah-condary caregiver but... Hey, would you uh, would you hold him for a sec, 'cause I, I
gotta take this off.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, yeah sure, Ok. [she takes Ben and holds him at arms length]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What're you doing?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Uh, I'm holding Ben.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, well, he's a baby not a bomb.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well just hold him like you'd hold a football.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: This is how I would hold a football.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok, here, here. There we go.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, I'm sorry, I'm just not very good with babies. I mean I haven't been around
them, I mean, you know, since I was one.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: It's alright, it's no big deal.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, definitely, I'm sure you'll feel totally different when it's our baby.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: You think about stuff like that?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Uhh, yeah. I mean, actually I kinda think that we'll have, we'll have two babies.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Two, two babies?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah. Ya know, a boy and a girl. Hopefully the girl will come first so Ben here
won't feel too competitive.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Then what's gonna happen?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, we won't wanna raise kids in the city so we'll probably move to uh, Scarsdale.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, that way I figure, ya know, we'll be far enough away from our parents that we
don't have to see them all the time but close enough that they can come over and babysit
whenever we want. And yes, I know, the taxes are a little higher than, let's say, Nassau
county but the school system's supposedly great.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Wow. Wow, that's great. Great. Ok, wow, you know what.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I'm off my break now so uh, um here you take this [hands back Ben] and um, I am
gonna go pour these very nice people some coffee. Ok. Oh look at that, I don't have a pot.
I don't have a pot. Well, hey, maybe I've got one at home, or in Scarsdale. Hey is that a
door? [leaves]

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica and Richard are there. Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Hey Phoebs, what's happening?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, ok, murder, cancer, soccer teams eating each other in the Andes.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So you watched the movies huh?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Uh huh, what is happening to the world? I mean, no no no, 'cause ET leaves, and
and Rocky loses, Charlotte dies.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Charlotte who?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: With the web, the spider she dies, she does. She has babies and dies. It's like ya
know, hey welcome home from the hospital, thud.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Alright, you wanna feel better?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ok, here, watch this.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: It's a Wonderful Life. Yes I've heard of this.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: So you can't lose, it's there in the title. Wonderfullness is baked right in.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Please, I almost fell for that with, uh, Pride of the Yankees, I thought I
was gonna see a film about Yankee pride and then, boom, the guy gets Lou Gehrig's disease.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Uh, the guy was Lou Gehrig. Didn't you kinda see it coming?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Phoebe, just watch that, I promise it will resotre all your faith in humanity.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: [runs in] Hey, big guy, game time.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Hey, be right there.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: There's a game?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Uh, yeah, I just got my pick-up sticks back from the shop. Bring your nerves of
steel.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: It's the basketball playoffs.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Listen, um honey, I appreciate this but you don't have to keep hanging out with
them for me, I mean, they have each other.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Oh, no, honey, I mean, don't worry, I like hanging out with
those guys. It's fun for me. They're different than my other friends, they don't start
sentences with, 'You know who just died shoveling snow?'

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Alright that's great, then just go. Go Knicks.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Uh, it's the college playoffs.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh, then go Vassar.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Uh, they're not in it.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ok, then just go.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Ok. [leaves]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh, why does this bother me so much? I mean I don't wanna be one of those people
who tells their boyfriend they wanna spend 24 hours a day with them.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: It's just that he doesn't have that much free time, ya know,
and I don't know, what do I do?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Does it matter? You're ultimately just gonna die or get divorced or have to blow
your pets head off.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: [enters] Aghh.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Me too. [leaves]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I've got a question. Richard made plans again with the guys.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yeah well, Ross just made plans for the whole century.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ya know what, I think I'm gonna go to my room and read
Cosmo, maybe there's something helpful in there. Know what, at least maybe I can learn how
to do an at home bikini wax with leftover Cristmas candles.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [enters] Ok, what the hell happened back there?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I don't know, you tell me. One minute I'm holding Ben like a football, the next
thing I know, I've got two kids, I'm living in Scarsdale complaining about the taxes.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well I'm sorry, I think about stuff. Ya know, I mean, you're
at work, you're assembling bones, your mind wanders.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ross, you have planned out the next 20 years of our lives, we've been dating for
six weeks.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: C'mon, what, you never think about our future?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yes, but I, I think about who's apartment we're gonna sleep
at tomorrow night and, and where we're gonna have dinner next Saturday night. I do not
think about what our childrens' names are gonna be. You know what our childrens names are
gonna be.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No, no, I mean, ya know, I, I read a book and there was a girl named Emily and I
thought, I thought that might be good.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What was the book?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: The big book of childrens' names.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, Ross, Ross, ok listen, what we have is amazing.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: But I do not want to have everything decided for me. I spent my whole life like
that. It's what I had with Barry, that was one of the reasons I left. I, I like not
knowing right now and I'm sorry if that scares you but if you want to be with me you are
gonna have to deal with that.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok fine.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: We're not done.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I didn't know that.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok, then you're gonna have to understand that you're with a
guy who's not gonna stop planning his future with you because he knows that we're gonna
end up together and if that scares you, tough, 'cause you're gonna have to deal with that.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Fine, I will.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Good, 'cause I love you.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well I love you too.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well that's the first time we've said that.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yes it is.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, I'm gonna kiss you.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well you better.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica is in the kitchen, Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hey. Oh thanks for the great movie tip.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Did you like it?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh yeah. You know, I don't know if I was happier when um George Bailey destroyed
the family business or um, Donna Reid cried, or when the mean pharmacist made his ear
bleed.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Alright, I'll give you the ear thing but don't you think the ending was pretty
wonderful?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I didn't watch the ending, I was too depressed. It just kept
getting worse and worse, it should have been called, "It's a sucky life and just when
you think it can't suck any more it does."
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. Chandler and Joey are playing Richard at
foosball.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Kick save and... denied.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: But... he gets it back, pass to the middle, lines it up
and... BAM! Yes! Could that shot BE any prettier?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Man you are incredible.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Well, we had a table in college.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh really, I didn't know they had foosball in the 1800's.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Nice moustache by the way. When puberty hits that thing's
really gonna kick in.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [enters] Honey. Uh, not to sound too Florence Henderson but, dinner's on the
table.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Ok, just one more point.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [grabs the other two bars on Richard's side and scores] Score! Now can we go?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: See, that's why we don't let her play.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Is everything all right?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh hey listen, don't be mad at him, it's our fault. I'm sorry we've been hoggin
so much of his time.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, he's just really great to hang around with.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Well.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: No no, seriously, Chandler and I were just talkin about this.
He is so much cooler than our dads. [Chandler starts kicking him below the table] I mean,
you know, our dad's are ok, ya know, but Richard is just- ow, ow. What are you kickin me
for? Huh? I'm tryin to talk here.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Uh, you guys see me as a dad?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Nooooo.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Your just, your just clearly not familiar with our young
persons vernacular. See, when we say dad, we mean buddy. We mean pal.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Uh-huh, yeah.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No no, seriously, Joey's my dad, Monica's my dad. I've even got some dads down
at work.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: That's fine. Well, your other dad and I are gonna go have a romantic evening and
I guess I'll just see you kids around.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Nighty-nite.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: You're not a dad. You're not a dad.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Not a dad.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I can't believe you got us into trouble. [slaps Joey on the arm. Joey takes
exception and slaps him back]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [her and Richard return to her place] So are you ok?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Yeah, just, I feel like I'm about a hundred. I thought I was just one of the
guys.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Come here. I'll make you feel like one of the guys. You know for a really cool
guy, you suck at foosball.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: What're you talkin' about, I was killin' 'em.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yeah, well they suck too.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok, and then you take the poopie diaper and you put it in the
poopie diaper pail.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok Ross, just so you know, calling it a poopie diaper doesn't make this process

lines.text: [doorbell buzzes] Hello.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: It's us.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Come on up. I'm gonna get the rest of his stuff together. [walks in his room]

lines.text: Ok, we can do this now, can't we Ben? Yes we can, yes we can. [finishes the

lines.text: I'm sorry, what did you just say? Did you just say hi? Oh my God, Ross, Ross, Ben
just said 'Hi'.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Wha, what?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ben just said hi.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What, the word hi?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ye-, no, my Uncle Hi.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Great, great, and I miss that too, I miss everything.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I guess I just bring it out in him.

lines.speaker: CAROL and SUSAN
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Guess what. Ben just said his first word.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: What did he say?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Something about hi.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: That's so exciting.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Mommy is so proud of you. Hi. Hi.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: You know, actually it's more like, hi.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Ok, this could go on for a while.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: We've got a cab waiting downstairs.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, this was fun. Uh, we should really do it again sometime, wha'dya say? Ok.
Alright so I've got him.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Tuesday.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Tuesday right. Ok, bye you guys.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Take care.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Bye Ben.

lines.speaker: BEN
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Did, did he just, did he, did he just say, he said bye. He said bye. You said, you
said bye to me. You said bye to me.

lines.speaker: SUSAN
lines.text: Suddenly I'm seeing him go off to college.

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: We've gotta go, we've got that cab waiting.

lines.text: Bye.

lines.text: Bye.

lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Bye.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Phoebe is watching Bert and Ernie with Ben.

lines.speaker: ERNIE
lines.text: Oh wow, look at this nice deep hole I've been digging. Hey Bert, isn't this a
nice hole here. Hey.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [pauses the tape] Ok, Ben, this is the part where Ernie
buries Bert in the sand and can't find him. Now, I've looked ahead on the tape and he does
find him again. But, ok, before that happens, there's some pretty rough goin' for a while
but I think we can handle it. And, there's just the alphabet but we know that ends well
so. Ok, here we go. [starts the tape again]

lines.speaker: ERNIE
lines.text: Bert, Bert. Bert. Hey, what happened to my friend Bert? He was here just a

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, I'm so glad you're here.

title: The One with the Bullies

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Everyone is there. Monica is
watching stock prices on a business channel.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey Monica, why are we watchin' the business channel?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: 'Cause I was going by it the other day and I saw that there was a stock with my
initials, MEG, on it and, well, sometimes I have to watch for two or three hours before it
comes up again but when it does, it's pretty exciting.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok honey, you really need a job.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Mon, speaking of which, dad says he knows someone you can call for an interview.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok, right there. That, that's the third sign today. Right
there.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: On behalf of everyone, I'd just like to say behuh.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No, 'cause you just said dad and everywhere I go today I
keep getting signs telling me to go see my father. Like when I was walking over here and I
passed a buffet...which is my father's last name.

lines.speaker: EVERYONE
lines.text: Ahh.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: And they were serving franks which is his first name minus the s at the end. And
there was a rotisserie with spinning chicken.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: His indian name?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No because I chickened out the last time when I tried to meet him. So I mean
coincidences? I don't think so.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Freakish.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Freaky.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Weird, weird.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, so uh, who wants the last hamburger?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, alright, that's it, now I have to go see him.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hamburger. McDonald's. Old MacDonald had a farm, my dad is a pharmacist.
OPENING TITLES

scenes.location: Central Perk. Chandler and Ross enter in sweats carrying rackets.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Man, I am so beat.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey, you just wanna forget about raquetball and hang out here?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah alright.
[they sit at the couch]

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: [walks back from the counter] Hey you're in our seats.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh, sorry we didn't know.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: [walks back from the counter] Hey, we were sitting there.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ok, there is one more way to say it, who knows it?

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Is that supposed to be funny?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No actually, I was just going for colorful.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: What's with this guy?

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: What's with you?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Uh, nothing, nothing's with him. Enjoy your coffee.
[as they're walking off, little bully grabs Chandlers hat from
behind and puts it on himself]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: What just happened?

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: I just took your hat. See, I can be funny too. My, my joke is that I, I took
your hat.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That, that is funny. Can I have it back?

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok, ok, you know what? I think you're very funny. Kudos on that hat joke. But, come
on guy just, just give him back the hat.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Why should we?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Because it's a special hat. [Chandler looks at Ross funny] See
he bought it 'cause he was feeling really down one day so he got the hat to cheer himself
up, ya know. Now Chandler...

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Stop talking, stop talking now. Let me just get this straight. You're actually
stealing my hat?

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: You got a problem with that?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No, just wanna make sure we're on the same page.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Joey and Rachel are sitting there and Monica
walks in.]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hey, how'd the interview go?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: It bit. It was a 50's theme restraunt. I have to cook in a costume and dance on
the counter. I mean I was a chef at Cafe des Artistes. I mean how
could I take a job where I have to make something called Laverne and Curly Fries?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: So don't do it.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: How can I not do it? I have $127 in the bank.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Monica, relax, go get a beer.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I don't want a beer.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Who said it was for you?

lines.speaker: ROSS and CHANDLER
lines.text: [both enter looking down] Hhhiiii.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What's the matter with you?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: The mean guys at the coffee house took my hat.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Noo.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: You're kiddin'.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: It was ridiculous. Ya know, these guys, they were bullies, actual bullies, ya know. We're grown ups, this kinda stuff isn't supposed to happen anymore.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oohhh.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hi. [Ross turns to Rachel and they hug]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ohhh [turns as if to hug someone] Oh no, wait a minute, I have no one.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, woah, let's go down there and get your hat back.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Na, forget it, it's probably stripped and sold for parts by now.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [seeing TV] Hey, I went up.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: My stock, MEG, it went up 2 points. Hey guys, do you realize that if I had
invested my $127 in myself yesterday that I'd like have...a lot more than that today. Ya
know what, I'm gonna do it.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Do what?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Put all my money in me.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Monica, what are you talking about? You don't know the first thing about the stock
market.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: What's to know? Buy sell, high low, bears bulls...[on the
phone] Yes Manhattan...yeah telephone number of the stock...selling store.
[Scene: Phoebe's dad's house. Phoebe pulls up in the cab with Rachel and Joey in the
back.]
[Phoebe slams on the breaks. Joey and Rachel are thrown forward into the pillows in their
laps.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: See, didn't I tell ya these pillows would be a good idea?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh God, here we go. For the first time in my life I'm gonna say 'Hi birthfather'.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: We love you, we're here for you.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah good luck, good luck.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Thanks. [gets out of the cab]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey Rach, you uh, you want some sandwich?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ohh, what is in that?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Olive loaf and ham spread, no mayo.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No no, 'cause mayo, that would make it gross.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [a little dog starts attacking her leg] Hey, hey, no, oh oh.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Run Phoebe run.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No no no, doggie please. Oh, I do so wanna love all animals,
please no.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Get him a bone, get a bone. You gotta bone?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Are you kidding me?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Look kibbles, bits. Oh God, alright, get the hell off my leg you yippity piece of
crap. [Flings the dog off and jumps in the cab. The dog keeps jumping up to the window.]
Ok, alright, we have a problem.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well why don't you just reach out and take his trampoline.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, here, I know what we can do. [grabs Joey's sadwich and throws it out the
window]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, hey, hey no.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, doggie get the- aahhh. Ok go get the sandwich, get the
sandwich doggie. [dog ignores the sandwich] Good doggie get the sandwich, get the...ok,
Joey, the dog will lick himself but he will not touch your sandwich, what does that say?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well if he's not gonna eat it, I will.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Are you crazy?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Phoebs, he's just a little dog. [turns back to the car window and the dog is halfway
through it.] Ahhh.

scenes.location: Central Perk. Chandler and Ross are sitting at the couch.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Do you have to be a Century 21 real-estate agent to get to
wear those really cool jackets?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Do you say this stuff to girls?

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Hehehehey, isn't that the guy who used to wear your hat?

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: And look where they're sitting.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: You're joking, right? You guys just walked through the door.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Maybe we didn't make it clear enough.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: This couch belongs to us.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Alright, I'll tell you what, you call the couch and then, and then we'll call
the couch, and we'll see who it comes to.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: You know what I keep wondering? Why you two are still sitting here.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Alright, that's it. I've had enough of this, alright. Gunther,
these guys are trying to take our seat.

lines.speaker: GUNTHER
lines.text: Fellas, these guys were here first.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Oh, sorry, I didn't realize.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: GUNTHER
lines.text: There you go.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Thank you Gunther. We didn't want to have to go and do that.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: He told on us?

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: You told on us?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well pal, you didn't give me much of a choice. [flicks the ends of the big bully's
tie]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Don't play with his things.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Alright, let's take this outside.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Let's, let's take this outside? Who talks like that?

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: The guy that's about to kick your ass talks like that.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: You had to ask.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah.
[the bullies grab the back of the couch that Ross and Chandler are sitting in and tip
back]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok, ok look, see, the thing is we're, we're not gonna fight
you guys.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Well then here's the deal, you won't have to so long as never ever show your
faces in this coffee house ever again.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I think you played the Gunther card too soon.

scenes.location: Back in the cab in front of Phoebe's dad's house.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey Phoeb's, I think you're good to go.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, I don't know.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I just think that this was a really bad sign, ya know. I mean, like the beast at
the threshold, you know. It's just like, I have no family left, ya know. I mean except for
my grandmother, you know, but let's face it, she's not gonna be around forever, despite
what she says. And I have a sister who I've barely spoken to since we like shared a womb.
I don't know, this is my real father and I just, I want things to be like just right.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Yeah Phoebe, I completely understand.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, whatever you need. Hey, you wanna go home?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok, thanks. Sorry, again
[She starts the cab and pulls forward. We hear a squish and a dog yelp.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [innocently] What was that?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Uhh, I'm guessing the threshold's clear now.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Joey is eating breakfast, Rachel has just gotten
up, and Monica is on the phone.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I wanna buy 5 shares of SGJ and I wanna buy them now. C'mon
time is money my friend. Thank you. Wooo.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Time is money my friend?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, you missed, 'Takes money to make money,' and uh, 'Don't make me come down
there and kick your wall street butt.'

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hey, I made $17 before breakfast, what have you done?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well uh, I had breakfast here so technically I saved $3.50.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: How did you make $17.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, my financially challenged friends, I split my money
and I bought some shares of CHP and ZXY.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: How come those?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Well, CHP because I used to have a crush on Eric Estrada. And ZXY becuase I think
it sounds zexy.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What happened to uh, MEG.?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: MEG was good for me but I dumped her. Ya know, my motto is
get out before they go down.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: That is so not my motto.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [enters] Hey.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Hey Phoebs. Oh hey, how's the dog?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok, I talked to the vet, people are so nice upstate. Anyway, he said that the
little fella's gonna be ok and I can pick him up tomorrow.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, thank God.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, but he did have to have a bunch of stitches and he
said that only once in a blue moon does a dog's ear grow back so...still hoping.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, so Phoebe, now are you gonna call your dad and let him know that his dog is
ok?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I, I don't wanna meet my father over the phone. What am I
gonna say, like 'Hi, I'm Phoebe, the daughter you abandoned. Oh, by the way, I broke your
dog.'

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey Phoebs, if you want, I'll do it.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok. Listen, just don't say anything about me, ok. [goes over and grabs the phone
that's sitting by Monica]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: DON'T...be too long with the phone.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: She'll be a much better friend when the market closes.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: [dials the phone] It's a woman.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: So talk to her.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: [in a fake voice] Uhh, hello Miss Buffay. I know where your
dog is. I want you to know that he'll be returned to you, almost as good as new, within,
within 24 hours. Uh, goodbye. [hangs up]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Why the voice.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: [in the voice] Hard to say.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's apartment. Ross is sitting at the bar, Chandler serves up
two mugs of hot water.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Your cappucino sir.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Thank you.
[they both pour in packets of cappucino mix]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ya know I think this is much better than the coffee house.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Absolutely.
[they both stir thier coffee and proceed to stare into the mugs]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: How come it's not mixing with the water?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well the package says you have to uh, constantly keep it moving. Stir and drink,
stir and drink, never let it settle.
[they both try to drink while continuously stirring]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: [walks out of his room] Hey, this is ridiculous. I'll tell you what. After I get
back from my neice's christening, I'll go down to the coffee house with you and we'll all
have a nice cup of coffee alright. No problem, Joey's there.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No. Man I don't wanna have to have Joey with me every time I
wanna descent cup of coffee. Ya know, and I don't wanna spend the rest of my life drinking
cappucino with a 'K'. I say you and I go back down there and stand up to those guys.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Alright, hang on a second there Custer.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah really, Ross, have you ever been beaten up before?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, sure.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: By someone besides Monica?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: No. So what. So what if we get beaten up, maybe that's just
something every man has to go through once in his life. Ya know, like a, like a right of
passage or somethin'.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, couldn't we just lose our virginities again? Ya know, because I think
actually mine's growing back.

scenes.location: Outside Monica and Rachel's apartment. Rachel is returning.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [Opens the door] I need to borrow a hundred bucks.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hi, welcome home. [pulls Rachel inside] I need to borrow a hundred bucks.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: For what?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I've gotta get back in the game.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Why, when did you get out of the game?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I don't know, I lost it all ok. I lost it.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Hey, I've come to terms with it, you have to too.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok. Look uhh, Mon I'm, I'm really sorry.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah, where are we on the hundred bucks?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I, I don't have it.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: But I need it. Otherwords I'm gonna have to take that
horrible diner job. You know, with the dancing and the costumes. I don't wanna have to
wear flame retardant boobs.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Nobody does honey.
[Scene: Phoebe's dad's house. Phoebe is returning the dog who is bandaged up and has a
plastic cone around it's neck.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: MRS BUFFAY
lines.text: Schnoodle. Oh my God, what the hell happened to my dog?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: It was an accident, and, and the woman who did this would never ever hurt a dog on
purpose. She's a vegetarian.

lines.speaker: MRS BUFFAY
lines.text: What are these, stitches?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, eight of them. That's 56 to him. You know also, if, if it's raining, you
can't let him look up too long 'cause that cone'll fill up really really fast.

lines.speaker: MRS BUFFAY
lines.text: Yeah well, thanks for bringing back what's left of him.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Sure, oh, is, is Frank home.

lines.speaker: MRS BUFFAY
lines.text: How do you know Frank?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Just from a, from a long time ago. Is he here?

lines.speaker: MRS BUFFAY
lines.text: Yeah. Frank.

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Yeah. What? [a young guy comes around the corner]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh, ok, um, I mean Frank senior.

lines.speaker: MRS BUFFAY
lines.text: He went out for groceries.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok so will he be back soon?

lines.speaker: MRS BUFFAY
lines.text: Well he left four years ago so we're expecting him back any minute now.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Alright, I'm, I'm gonna go. I'm sorry about the dog, everything. I'm sorry.
[she turns to leave, Frank follows]

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Hey lady. Hey wait up. How do you know my dad?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Um well I don't really. Just genetically. He's kinda my dad too.

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Heavy.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah. So um, did he ever talk about me, Phoebe?

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: No but he didn't really talk about anything.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Except stilts.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Stilts?

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Yeah, he loved stilts. One time I was upstairs, I was stealing cigarettes out of my
mom's purse, and uh, all of a sudden I look over and there's my dad's head bobbing past
the window. He just had this big smile on his face and he was waving 'cause he was always
happiest when he was on his stilts.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I don't know what to do with that.

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Me neither. So you're like my big sister.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: This is huge, you can buy me beer.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I'm not gonna. But you know what's cool though? Ok, if you had a friend named
Pete, then I could say, 'Oh yeah, I know Pete, he's friends with my brother.'

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: I gotta friend named Mark.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: That'll work too.

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Cool, alright. So maybe, ya know, I could give you a call sometime, we could talk
or somethin'.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, that'd be ok.

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Alright.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok, I'm in the book.

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Ok, yeah.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Alright. So um, stilts huh?

lines.speaker: FRANK
lines.text: Yeah hey, you know if you want I can take you around back and show you where he hit
his head on the rain gutter.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok.

scenes.location: Central Perk. Chandler and Ross are sitting on the couch nervously.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well we did it, we're here. We are standing our ground. How
long does a cup of coffee take?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Would you come on! Come on! [waitress brings their coffee] Thank you.
[They rush to put the cream and sugar in their cups and gulp down a few drinks]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ah, there we go.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I think we proved our point.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: You burn your mouth?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Cannot feel my tounge.
[They leave. As they're walking out, the bullies are walking in.]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Bullies, big bullies.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Oh, look who's here, it's the weenies.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Did we not make ourselves clear the other day.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yes, and that's why we're here.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yes, we're standing out ground...apparently.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Let's do this alright.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Woah, ho-ho, whad'ya got there, a weapon?

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: It's a nice watch, I don't wanna break it on your ribs.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Alright, let's do this.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Alright.
[they all put up their fists and prepare to fight]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Question. If I don't care about my watch, can I use it as a weapon?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Whad'ya mean?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, it's sharp, it's metal, I think I can do some, you know, serious damage
with it.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: No, you can't use your watch.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ok. [reaches in his pocket]

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Or your keys.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Look, here's what we'll do. We'll put all keys and watches in the hat over
there. Alright. [they all put their keys and watches in the hat and put it on a mail box]
Alright, c'mon man, let's do this.
[they all jump in the street and prepare to fight]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Before I forget, are we hitting faces?

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Of course we're hitting faces, why wouldn't you hit faces?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well because I have to work on Monday, I have a big presentation.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Actually, you know, uh, I gotta show this apartment tomorrow and uh, you
know, this no faces thing might not be a bad idea.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Ok, nothing from the neck up. [everyone gets ready for the fight] Or the waist
down. Dana's ovulating.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Oh really, you guys tryin' again?

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ok, so let me just get this straight. So we're uh, strictly talking about the
middle?

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: C'MON!

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey, hey, woah, you want some of this, huh? You want a piece of this, huh? I'm
standin here, huh.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey, hey, those guys are takin our stuff! [some guy runs off with the hat]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Hey.
[they all run off after the guy]

scenes.location: Central Perk. The four guys are returning after getting the hat back.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: God, that was, that was amazing, that was incredible. You
guys, you guys kicked butt.

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
lines.text: Us, what about you guys? Man you really, bing, gave it to old Mr. Clean back
there. He was a big guy.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah he was wasn't he.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, I wouldn't know having missed everything.

lines.speaker: BIG BULLY
lines.text: Don't do that to yourself. Any one of us could have tripped over that little
girls jump-rope.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: So, listen guys, are we uh, are we ok here?

lines.speaker: LITTLE BULLY
