door forcing him back in then holds onto the door knob.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ahh, you drive safe.

lines.speaker: MRS. GREENE
lines.text: Ross, what're you doing.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: I'm getting ready for the water skiing. [Mr. Greene opens the door which pulls Ross
in] How are you doing?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, uh, Dr. Greene, where are you going?

lines.speaker: MR. GREENE
lines.text: To get my coat.

lines.speaker: GUYS
lines.text: No no no.

lines.speaker: MR. GREENE
lines.text: Alright, alright, I can get my own coat.
[the guys form a wall between Mrs Geller and Mr Geller and dance across the hall as he
walks across]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Sorry, we're on a major flan high.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh no, you're not supposed to be here. This is the staging area, you should, it's
all wrong, you should leave, ya know, get out. [opens the door, the guys are right there]
Or perhaps you'd like a creme d'menthe.

lines.speaker: MR. GREENE
lines.text: I have to be heading to my chateau, thank you.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh all right, then I guess we're going back into the hallway.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Thanks for coming Mrs. Greene. [grabs her and kisses her to distract her. She goes
limp in his arms. Mr. Greene leaves.] Well, ok, you take care.

lines.speaker: MRS. GREENE
lines.text: Oh, you kids [she caresses his face and chest] Well, this is the best party
I've been to in years.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Thank you.
CLOSING CREDITS
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Close up of the flan on the table with birthday
candles.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ok everybody, it's time for flan.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yup, get ready for the gelatenous fun.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Kinda looks like that stuff you get when you get a bad infection.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ok, that's enough.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok Rachel, make a special flan wish.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, I've got one. [blows out the candles. Somebody calls out 'heads up' and the
volleyball lands in the flan] Wow, those things almost never come true.
END

title: The One with the Chicken Pox

scenes.location: Central Perk. Rachel, Monica, Joey, and Chandler are there.

lines.text: [Rachel brings a muffin to Chandler and Monica who are sitting on the couch.]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Ok, Chandler, Mon, there's only one bananna nut muffin left.
[Rachel holds the tray between them. Chandler grabs the muffin before Monica can.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh, I ordered mine first.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, but I'm, I'm so much faster...

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Give it to me.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Give it to me.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ok, you can have it. [He licks it and offers it to her.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [She grabs the coffee cup on the table and licks the rim.]
There you go, enjoy your coffee.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That was there when I got here. [Takes a bite of his muffin.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: [enters] Hey you guys, you will never guess who's coming to New York.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: [Chandler tries to come back with a smart-ass remark but can't swallow the
muffin.] Quick, Phoebe, tell us before he can swallow.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh ok, Ryan, that guy I went out with, who's in the Navy.
[Chandler is visibly upset]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: You went out with a guy in the Navy?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, I met him when I was playing guitar in Washington Square Park. Ryan threw in
salt water taffy 'cause he didn't have any change.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, is that when you wrote salt water taffy man?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No. No, he is my submaring guy. He resurfaces like every couple years and we have
the most amazing three days together. Only this time he's coming for two weeks. Two whole
weeks, which means yay.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: So wait, this guy goes down for like two years at a time?
[Once again, Chandler has a bite in his mouth and can't come back.]

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: That'll teach you to lick my muffin.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: [enters] Hiii.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh no, what happened?

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Well, I just spoke to Carol. Ben's got the chicken pox.

lines.speaker: ALL
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Yeah, so if you haven't already had it, chances are you're gonna get it.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Well I've had it.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, I've had it.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Had it.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Had it.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Well, I've never had it, I feel so left out. [Sees a red bump on her arm.] Oh
look!
OPENING TITLES

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica and Richard are in her bedroom.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Honey, you made the bed again. I told you, you don't have to
do that. This isn't camp.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Ooh, then I guess the panty raid last night was totally uncalled for. Ok, I am
going to take a shower and today I will be singing Jim Crochee's Leroy Brown.
[He walks out of the bedroom and Monica starts to remake the bed.]

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Monica... [He re-enters the bedroom and Monica jumps on the bed, trying to cover
it.] Hey Mon, I have a question. Is Leroy the baddest man in the whole damn town or the
fattest man in the whole damn town?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Baddest. Otherwise the song would be Fat Fat Leroy Brown.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: What're you doing?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Just waiting for you sweetie.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Are you remaking the bed?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry. You know what, the way you did it was just fine.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Then, you're redoing it because...

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: If I tell you, you'll think I'm crazy.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: You're pretty much running that risk either way.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Ok, you see, the tag shouldn't be at the top left corner, it should be at the
bottom right corner.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Oh, well that's not so crazy.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I'm just easing you in.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Oh, alright.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Alright, you see these little flower blossoms? They should be facing up, not down,
because, well, the head of the bed is where the sun would be. You don't love me any more
do you.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Actually, if it's possible, I love you more.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Really? Wow, well then come on, I wanna show you how to fold
the toilet paper into a point.

scenes.location: Chandler's office. Joey is there.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey, look Joey, I'm just saying if you need something to hold you over, I can
get you a job right here as an entry level processor.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: But don't you need experience for a job like that?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: It's not that hard to learn. And as for people realizing you have no idea what
you're doing, hey, you're an actor. Act like a processor, people will think you're a
processor.

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: [enters] Hey Chandler, here's this morning's projections.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey thanks. Scott Alexander, Joey Tribbianni. Joey is a uh, fellow processor.

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: No kidding.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh yeah yeah. I process. People want the processing, I'm the
one they call.

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: Where do you work?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Uhh, well, right now I'm in between things. You know how it is. One day you're
processing, the next day you're not so much... processing any more.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I was just telling Joey about the opening in Fleischman's group.

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: Fleischman's group. Whatever you do, don't touch his sandwiches. Ha-ha-ha...

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ha-ha. [Scott leaves] Are all you processors dorks?

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica and Rachel are doing Phoebe's makeup.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, this lipstick looks just great on you.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You look fabulous honey, you really do.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah? Are you sure, really. [She picks up a mirror and sees the white splotches
all over her face.]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: You see, you look beautiful. For god sakes, dim the lights.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I, I, I'm hideous.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: It's gonna be ok. Ryan's been under water. He's just gonna
be so glad that you don't have barnicles on your butt.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Ryan is walks up to the door and knocks.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Come in.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Hey baby, I'm back... [Phoebe is sitting by the window in a veil.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Hey Ryan, what's up?

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: What's goin' on?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Well, no no, you have to stay back. I, I have the pox.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Chicken or small?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Chicken. Which is so ironic considering I'm a vegetarian.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Why aren't you at home in bed?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: 'Cause my, my grandmother's never had chicken pox. Please, please tell me you
have, 'cause oh my God, I forgot how cute you are.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: I'm sorry, I never had 'em.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ohh, ohh.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: If I had one wish, it would be to build a time machine, go
back to when I was 7, when Jimmy Hauser had the chicken pox. I would grab that kid and rub
him all over my face.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, or you know, you could just wish that I didn't have them now.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Can I please see your face?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Nope. You don't want to see a face covered with pox.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Your face could be covered with lochs, I wouldn't care.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: And you hate fish. Oh. That's so sweet, alright. Ok, alright, you can see. This is
me... [she unveils herself right as a huge lightning bolt crashes outside. Ryan screams in
terror.] Oh, I am scary.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Sorry, the lightning. Lightning was an unfortunate incidence. You look lovely,
lovely.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I hate this. 'Cause I tell you, I had the most amazing two
weeks planned for us, and almost everything I had in mind, we had to be a lot closer than
this.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Phoebe, I have spent the last eight months in a steel tube with men, thinking about
this moment. I am not gonna let a bunch of itchy spots stand between us. [He walks to her
and kisses her.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Ok, this is the most romantic disease I've ever had.

scenes.location: Chandler's office. Joey enters.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey, how's the first day goin'?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Pretty good. It's like you said. It's mostly just putting numbers from one column
into another column.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well there you go.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey and everbody is so nice. I just had a good talk with that lady with the red
hair, Jeannie.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Jeannie, the head of east coast operations Jeannie?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, turns out our kids go to the same school. Small world
huh?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Weird world. Your kids?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I figure my character has kids.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Ya know there isn't a part of that sentence I don't need explained.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Well, see when you're acting you need to think about stuff
like that. My character, Joseph the processor guy, has two little girls, Ashley and
Brittany. Ashley copies everything Brittany does.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, invisible kids can be that way sometimes.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah. Joseph and his wife, Karen, are thinking of having a
third kid... Ya know what? Just did.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Really? Wow. That's some pretty powerful imaginary sperm you must have there.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Phoebe and Ryan are playing Monopoly.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: You know what makes the itching even worse?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: That you don't stop talking about it.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Let's just play, ok. Good, ok. [She picks up the dice.] Here we go, double sixes,
here we go... [She starts to rub the dice all over herself.] Here we go, come to mama,
just getting ready to roll the dice...

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: What're you doing? Are you scratching?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No. This is what I do for luck, ok.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: You're scratching. Give me the dice.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Give me the dice.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: No. Here. [Throws them on the table.] There. Ooh, double sixes.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: We can't scratch. You know we can't, we'll scar.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Uhh, I can't stop thinking about it. It's just so hard. I just wanna grab all
these houses and rub 'em all over my body. [Grabs a handful of the houses.]

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Give it.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Yeah, come on. You know you want it, you know you want it too, come on. Let's just
be bad, it'll feel so good. [She starts scratching him.]

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Oh God help me.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Now do me, do my back. Oh come on, harder.
[They get back to back and start rubbing against each other. Ross and Rachel enter.]

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh, stop that, stop that right now.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: You know, I might have expected this of you Phoebe, but Ryan, you're a military man.

scenes.location: Chandler's office building. Joey and Jeannie are talking.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: You and Milton have to join us on the boat. Karen'll pack a lunch, you'll bring the
kids, we'll make a day of it.

lines.speaker: JEANNIE
lines.text: Oh, that sounds lovely. We're gonna have to set that up. Oh, I better get back.
Hope the baby feels better.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh, thanks, thanks. Bye bye Jeannie.

lines.speaker: JEANNIE
lines.text: Bye bye Joey.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: What a phony.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, I'm sure you'll teach her a lesson when she steps off the dock onto
nothing. Hey Mr. Douglas.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Sir.

lines.speaker: MR. DOUGLAS
lines.text: Uh, listen Bing, I received your memo. So, we're not gonna receive the
systems report until next Friday?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well the people in my group wanna spend the holiday weekend with their families.

lines.speaker: MR. DOUGLAS
lines.text: I have a family, I'm gonna be here.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah Bing, what's that about?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: It's about cutting my people a little slack, ya know, for morale. Look, if you
wanna see some rough numbers, I can get them to you by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: MR. DOUGLAS
lines.text: Rough numbers?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: This company was not built on rough numbers. Am I right Mr. Douglas.

lines.speaker: MR. DOUGLAS
lines.text: Have the final numbers on my desk by Tuesday.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Uh, if you say so sir.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Joseph's good, isn't he?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Well, I'm going to kill you.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey, hey, I just figure Joseph's the kinda guy that likes to mix it up. Ya know, get
in there, ruffle some feathers.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Look, I'm sorry but that's what Joseph does, ok. If you try to pull somethin', he'll
call you on it. 'What're you tryin' to pull,' he'll say.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Monica enters her bedroom with a roll of duct
tape. Richard is sitting on the bed.]

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Ooh, duct tape. Was I supposed to bring something too?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: This is for the scratchy twins out there. I taped oven mits to their hands.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: You're strict.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: It's for their own good.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: You know, I like the way you have efficiently folded this
tab under. See in a tape emergency you could shave valuable seconds off your time.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Exactly. Oh, I love that I can be totally neurotic around
you now. Tell me the truth. Don't you like it better now that
everything on your desk is perpendicular?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: If it's not a right angle, it is a wrong angle.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Very good.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You know what. Tomorrow I'm gonna do your clocks.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: You're gonna do what to my clocks.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I'm gonna set them to my time.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Well, I'm confused. I thought we shared time.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No no. See, in my bedroom I set my clock six minutes fast.
You wanna know why?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Because it's in a slightly different time zone than the kitchen.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No forget it, I'm not gonna tell you now.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: No come on. Come on tell me.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No. See you don't understand.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Come on.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No. You don't have any of these cute little obsessive things.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: No that's not true. That is not true.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Alright, well tell me one of yours.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Ok. Ahh. One of my things is, I always separate my sweat socks from my dress
socks.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: What if they get mixed up?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Boy I would just uh, I would freak out.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You would not. I can't believe this. I hate this, you're too
normal. I can't believe my boyfriend doesn't have a thing. My boyfriend doesn't have a
thing.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: See, if anyone overheard that, I didn't come off well.
[Scene: Chandler's office. Chandler is asleep in his chair holding a paper in one hand
and a pen in the other. Joey walks in, waking up Chandler who covers by pretending to
write on the paper.]

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Hey. Mr. Douglas is looking for you.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Why? Wh- wh- why is Mr. Douglas looking for me?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: 'Cause he has a strong suspicion that you dropped the ball on the Lender project.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Wha- wh- why, why, why does he suspect that?

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Becasue at first he thought it was Joseph. But after he asked Joseph about it, turns
out it was you. Anyway, I just thought you should know.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Alright, that's it. Look Joey, I'm sorry, I realize this is the role of a
lifetime for ya, and if I could just fire Joseph, I would, but unfortunately that's not
possible so I'm gonna have to let both of you go.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: What're you talking about, everybody loves Joseph.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: I don't, I hate Joseph, ok. I think he's a brown-nosing suck up.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Oh yeah. Well you can't fire Joseph. You know why, 'cause he's not in your
department.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Alright, ok, alright. So I can't fire Joseph but uh, I can sleep with his wife.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Karen.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Yeah, Karen. I'm thinking about having an affair with her.
Oh, you know what? I just did.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Ahh. What the hell are you doing to me man.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh well it's not me, it's my character, Chandy. Yeah the
rogue processor who seduces his co-worker's wives for sport and then laughs about it the
next day at the water cooler. In fact, I have her panties right there in my drawer.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: No freakshow, she's fictional.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Take it easy. If it means that much to you, I'll uh, I'll go find something else.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: It's just that, I, I'm gonna miss Joseph. I liked him. His wife, she was hot.
[Chadler pushes him out the door by the face.]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Rachel and Ross are in the kitchen. Phoebe is
sitting at the couch with oven mits on her hands.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Can I please take these off? I swear I won't scratch.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: No sorry hon, Monica's orders.

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: [Comes out of the bathroom, also with oven mits on his hands.] Well that wasn't
easy.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Ok, dinner's on.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: And there's a peach cobbler warming in the oven so the plate's gonna be hot but
that shouldn't be a problem for you.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Alright you kids, bye now.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE and RYAN
lines.text: Bye. [waving]

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Oh look, a low budget puppet show.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: It's such a shame you can't see which finger I'm holding up.
[Ross and Rachel leave.]

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Wine?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Please. [Ryan pulls the cork with his teeth and spits it into Phoebe's mits.]

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Oh, I spilled some.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: I got it. [Wipes it up with her mits.]

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: [Puts his hands over Phoebe's ears.] I must tell you, you look beautiful tonight.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: RYAN
lines.text: Sorry. You look beautiful.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Oh.
[They start to kiss. They try to get each other's shirts off but can't get the buttons
undone.]

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: You know what, that's it, that's it. [She rips off the mits, Ryan follows her
lead.]
[They keep kissing and start scratching each other. Ross enters, takes one look, and goes
right back out the door.]

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's apartment. Richard and Monica are in bed.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Monica, wake up. Monica.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: What's up?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: I thought of a thing.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Yeah. I have to sleep, have to, on this side of the bed.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: No honey. You have to sleep on this side of the bed because I have to sleep on
this side of the bed.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Or so I would have you believe.

lines.speaker: MONICA

lines.text: At the Copa, Copa Cabana (everyone joins in) The hottest spot north of Havana. At
the Copa, Coo-pa Ca-ban-a, music and fashion were always the passion, at the Copa....

scenes.location: later, Richard and Monica are dancing

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Okay, I'll do it.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You'll do what?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: If kids is what I takes to be with you then kids it is.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: If I have to I'll, I'll do all again , I'll do the 4 o'clock feeding thing, I'll
go to the P.T.A. meetings, I'll coach the soccer team.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: Yeah, if I have to. Monica, I don't wanna lose you, so if I have to do it all
over again, then I will.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: You're the most wonderful man. And if you hadn't of said 'if I have to' like
seventeen times, then I'd be saying 'okay, let's do it.'

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: But you're not.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: Oh my God, I can't believe what I'm getting ready to say. I wanna have a baby, but
I don't wanna have one with someone who doesn't really wanna have one.

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: God. I love you.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I know you do. Me too. (pause) So what now?

lines.speaker: RICHARD
lines.text: I guess we just keep dancing.
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler, Rachel, Ross, Joey, and Phoebe are there waiting for
Chandler's cyberchick to arrive]

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Where is she, Where is she? (grabs Rachel) Oh, hey, I have a question, where is
she?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Chandler, relax, Chandler, she'll be here.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: (noticing a beautiful blond walking in) Ooh, oh, oh, that's her.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: (seeing her also) Yeah, 'cause life's just that kind.

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Chandler, you gotta stop staring at the door. It's like a watched pot, you know if
you keep looking at it then the door is to, never gonna boil. I think what you have to do
is try not to...
(Chandler's date walks in)

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Oh my God! (it's Janice)

lines.speaker: JANICE
lines.text: OH.....MY.....GAWD!! (Chandler rushes over and kisses her)
CLOSING CREDITS

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is reading a script as Ross enters

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: All right I've been feeling incredibly guilty about this, because I wanna be a good
friend, and dammit I am a good friend. So just, just shut up and close your eyes (kisses
Joey).

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Wow, you are a good friend, 'course the audition was this morning, and I didn't get
it. But that was a hell of a kiss. Rachel is a very lucky girl.
END

title: The One with the Princess Leia Fantasy

lines.text: [Scene Central Perk, the whole gang is entering]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm tellin' ya that girl totally winked at me.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Did not, she did not wink at you...(sees that their sacred couch is
occupied by strangers).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Huh. (They all leave, dejected)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Rachel and Monica's, Phoebe, Ross, and Rachel are eating breakfast.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have to say Tupolo Honey by Van Morrison.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nooo Way! The most romantic song ever is The Way We Were.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: See, I-I think that one that Elton John wrote for, um, that guy on Who's
The Boss.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What song was that, Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Hold me close, young Tony Dan-za.
(Monica enters from her bedroom)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi Monica!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Mon!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Mon!
(she just walks straight into the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, has she slept at all?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it's been three nights in a row.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, she finally stopped crying yesterday, but then she found one of
Richard's cigar butts out on the terrace, so.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay that explains it. I got a call at two in the morning, but all I
could hear was, like, this high squeaky sound, so I thought okay its like a mouse or a
opossum. But then I realized where would a mouse or a opossum get the money to make the
phone call.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is coming in from the bedroom

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Morning.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Morning, hey, you made pancakes?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, like there's any way I could ever do that.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (entering and singing) Monica and Rachel had syrup, now I can get my man
to cheer up. (laughs hysterically) Good morning Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sarcastically) Good morning.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you know what, here's a thought. Why don't you stay home from
work today and just hang out with me.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, I wish. Look, honey, you have that report to finish, and I gotta go
see my lawyer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can not believe that I am going out with someone that is getting
divorced. I'm such a grown up.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (laughs) I-I-I gotta go, I gotta go. Okay, not without a kiss.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, maybe I won't kiss you, and then you'll have to stay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (under his breath) Kiss her! Kiss her!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I'll see you later, sweetie. Bye Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: B-bye Janice. So when ya' dumpin' her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nope, not this time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on, quite yankin' me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not yanking you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is Janice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I know. She makes me happy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. All right. You look me in the eye and tell me, without blinking,
that you're not breaking up with her. No blinking.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks him in the eye) I'm not breaking up with her! (they stare at
each other for a while, then Joey blows in his face)

scenes.location: Rachel and Monica's, Monica is entering from the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God, look what I found in the drain.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's some of Richard's hair! (holds it close to Ross) What do I do with
this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Getting it away from me would be job one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's weird, but you know what I don't wanna throw this away. I mean this
is like all I have left of him, gross, drain hair. Ooh! (drops it in Ross's cereal)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh. Oh. It looks like, like a tiny little person drowning in your
cereal. (Ross gives her this look, like 'Yeah, doesn't it', and gets up to dump it down
the drain.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God, what is wrong with me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You need to get some sleep.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I need to get some Richard.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, you broke up with him for a reason.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, I know. I'm just so tired of-of missing him. I'm tired of
wondering why hasn't he called. Why hasn't he called!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe, because you told him not to.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you the memory woman?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Their not breaking up. Chandler and Janice. Their not breaking
up. He didn't blink or anything.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you know I'm not surprised. I mean have you seen them together,
they're really cute.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Cute! This is Janice! You remember Janice?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, Joey, I remember, she's annoying, but you know what she's-she's his
girlfriend now. I mean what can we do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There you go! That's the spirit I'm looking for! What can we do? Huh? All
right who's first? Huh? Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I'm thinking that Chandler's our friend and Janice makes him happy,
so I say we just all be adult about it and accept her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, we'll call that Plan B. All right?

scenes.location: Ross's bedroom, Ross is working and Rachel is reading a book in bed

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she leans over and kisses him on the cheek) Honey, I was wondering....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you still have that, um, Navy uniform?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nooo, I had to return it to the costume place.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think I have an old band uniform from high school.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You remember not having sex in high school, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well honey, what about you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean do you have any fun, you know, fantasy type things?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on you gotta have one!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, you know what...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...if you tell me, I might do it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, umm. Did you ever see, um, Return Of The Jedi?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you remember the scene with, um, Jabba the Hut? Well Jabba had as, as
his prisoner, um, Princess Leia.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oooh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Princess Leia, was wearing this, um, gold bikini thing. It was pretty
cool.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Rachel are there

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, oh, Princess Leia and the gold bikini, every guy our age loved
that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, um. It's huge. Yeah, that's the moment, when-when, you know she
stopped being a princess, and became, like, a woman, you know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did you ever do the-the Leia thing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, um-mm. Oh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really! That-that great huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No it's just that I got this new pager and I have it on vibrate. See ya!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering with Monica in tow) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi you guys!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look who I found standing outside of the Szechwan Dragon staring at a
parking meter.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mon. Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why aren't you at work?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, they-they sent me home.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because I don't work at the Szechwan Dragon.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You really, really need to get some sleep, honey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know I do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Guess what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They published my paper.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, really, let me see, let me see.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rach, look! (she holds two buns up to her ears to make her hair look
like the Princess Leia 'do.) Oh, hi! Where is my strong Ross Skywalker to come rescue me.
(Ross stands up horrified) There he is.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is watching Wheel of Fortune, the puzzle is showing
_oun_ Rush_ore.]
[Chandler enters]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wheel!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Of!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fortune! This guy is so stupid. (yelling) It's Count Rushmore!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, you should really go on this show. All right, listen, I got
three tickets to the Rangers tonight. What'd ya' say?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I say, 'I am there!' Cool! Aw, is Ross going to?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, Janice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Jan-ice. 'Cause I, just, I feel bad for Ross, you know, we-we always go
together, we're like the three hocke-teers.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, I may be way out on a limb here, but do you, do you, have a
problem with Janice?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, Yeeees. God, how do I say this. (walks into the kitchen, Chandler
follows closely, he turns around and gets startled). Oh, hi, you know that girl from the
Greek restaurant with the hair (holds his hands up to signify she has big hair)?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, that girl that I hate, eww, drives me crazy, eww, eww, oh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I don't hate Janice, she's-she's just a lot to take, you know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, there you go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey. Come on man, don't look at me like that, she used to drive you
nuts before too, remember?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I'm crazy about her now. I think this could be the real thing.
Capital 'R'! Capital 'T'! (Joey stares at him) Don't worry, those are the right letters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, what do you want me to say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I want you to say that you like her!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't. It's like this chemical thing, you know. Every time she starts
laughing, I just wanna (grimaces and tenses up) pull my arm off just so that I can have
something to throw at her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks for trying. (grabs the ticket and starts to leave) Oh, and by
the way there is no Count Rushmore!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, then-then who's the guy that painted the faces on the mountain?
(Chandler gives him a look like 'You stupid idiot!')
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel and Ross are entering

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How could you have told her?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I didn't think it would that big of a deal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, she didn't think it would be that big of deal.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, who are you talking to when you do that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, that was supposed to be like a private, personal thing between us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, Ross, Phoebe is my girlfriend, okay, we tell each other
everything. You know, I mean, come on, guys do the same thing, I mean, what about all that
locker room stuff.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's different, okay. That's like, uh 'Who dated a stripper?' or 'Who
did it on the back of the Staton Island Ferry?'.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Were both of those Joey?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Look, you don't, you don't talk about like, you know, your
girlfriend and the intimate stuff you, you do with her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Not even with your best friend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Noo!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is so sad. Your missing out on so much, Ross. I mean, the bonding
and the sharing, you know. And-and knowing that someone else is going through the same
thing you are.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmph. So what you, you tell each other everything?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pretty much.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did you talk about the night of five times? Do you tell people about the
night of five times?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, honey, yeah that was with Carol.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, but it's still worth mentioning, I think.

scenes.location: Monica's bedroom, Phoebe is trying to relax her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ( in a soothing voice) Relax every muscle in your body. Listen to the
plinky-plunky music. Okay, now close you eyes, and think of a happy place. Okay, tell me
your happy place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Richard's living room, drinking wine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. No, no, no, not a Richard thing, just put down the glass. And
get out!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry, but that's my happy place.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, okay, fine, use my happy place. Okay, I'm just gonna, I have to
ask that you don't move anything.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I'll try not to.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, all right, so, your in a meadow, millions of stars in the sky....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you think breaking up with him was a huge mistake?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, there are no questions in the happy place. Okay, just, the
warm breeze, and the moonlight flowing through the trees....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll bet he's totally over me, I'll bet he's fine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, betting and wagering of any kind, are, I'm sure, not
permitted in the happy place. Okay. Just-just, you know, the-the lovely waterfalls, and
the, the trickling fountains. And the-the calming sounds of the babbling brook....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, this isn't working. I'm still awake and now I have to pee.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: So, I hear, you hate me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I, ah, I never said hate, I was very careful about that.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: A little birdie told me something about you wanting to rip your arm off
and throw it at me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And you got a 'hate' from that?! Your taking a big leap there...

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: All right, fine, fine, fine, fine, fine, we've got to do something about
our little situation here Joey. So, this is my idea: you and me spending some quality time
together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But what does that gonna do...

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: For Chandler!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. I'm in.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Okay. All right. This is what we're gonna call it: 'Joey and Janice's DAY
OF FUN!'

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Does it have to be a whole day?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Yes, because that's how long it takes to love me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I know, I sleep in the next room.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel and Monica are entering

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (crying) So, I went down to the post office, and it turns out it was
those videos that I ordered for Richard about the Civil War. He loved the Civil War.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica, do you want us to take you home?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, huh. (to Ross) Or maybe to a galaxy far, far away. (Rachel, Monica,
and Phoebe leave)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Women tell each other everything. Did you know that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Umm, yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No Chandler, everything! Like stuff you like, stuff she likes, technique,
stamina, girth....

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Girth? Why, why, why, wh-why, why, why, why would they do this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel says sharing's great and supposedly, you know, we outta be doing
it. Do you wanna?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We're not gonna talk about girth are we?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nooo!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! All right! You go first.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, I'll go first.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, uh, the other night Rachel and I are in bed talking about fantasies,
and I happened to describe a particular Star Wars thing....

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Princess Leia in the gold bikini.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! Wow, well, that-that was easy. Okay, you-you go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, you know, you know when your in bed, with a woman.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmph.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And, ah, you know, your fooling around with her. And you get all these
like, mental images in your brain, you know, like Elle MacPherson, or that girl at the
Xerox place....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: With the belly-button ring? Oh, muhawa!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, And then all of the sudden your Mom pops into your head. And
your like 'Mom, get outta here!' You know, but of course, like, after that you can't
possibly think of anything else, and you can't, you know, stop what your doing. So it's
kinda like, you're, you know. You know...(Ross just stares at him). You don't know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Your Mom, your telling me, your telling me, about your Mom, what is the
matter with you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You said...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I said 'share' not 'scare'. Go sit over there! (Chandler
goes over and sits at a table and puts his head down).

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey and Janice are returning from their DAY OF FUN!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: We're baack!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you guys doing together?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Joey and Janice's DAY OF FUN!!! (laughs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. We went to a Mets game, we got Chinese food, and you know, I
love this woman. You have got competition buddy.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I just came by to give you a kiss, I have to go pick up the baby, so.
I'll see you later sweetheart, you too Chandler. (laughs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You still can't stand her can you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm sorry man, I tired, I really did.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you know, I appreciate you giving it a shot.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But, hey, look, you know the good thing is, is that we spent the whole day
together and I survived, and what's even more amazing, so did she. It was bat day at Shea
Stadium.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I guess that's something.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No man, that's huge! Now, I know I can stand to be around her, which means
I get to hang out with you, which is kinda the whole point, anyway.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey, Chandler, we, ah, we stopped by the coffee shop and ran into
Ross.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, if it makes you feel any better, I do it too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, I always picture your Mom when I'm having sex.

scenes.location: Rachel and Monica's, Monica is watching the Civil War videos

lines.speaker: Video
lines.text: April Twelve, Eighteen hundred, Sixty-One (Monica lights
Richard's cigar butt), 4:30 A.M. on Tuesday, the United States garrison at Fort Sumter was
fired upon (knock on door) it is now under bombardment by....
(Monica answers the door)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, Dad, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well, it's your mother's bridge night so I thought that I would come
into the city for a little Monicuddle. (hugs her) Since when did you start smoking cigars?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't, I just, I just like the smell of them. So, uh, what are you
really doing here Dad?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well, I just wanted to make sure you were okay.

lines.text: Hi, welcome, to an adult conversation.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, no, now wait, wa, wa, waa-it a minute, wait a minute, wait a
minute, wait a minute. That actually, uh, that sounds interesting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think you should drink the fat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yaaaay!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay. If that is what it takes to show you how much you mean to me, and
how much I want you there. Then that's what I'll do.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, wait, let me get you another glass. That's been sitting out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think this will be fine. Okay, vanilla milkshake, just a vanilla milkshake,
with chicken bits floating in it. Cheers. (starts to drink, but Rachel stops him just
before he starts drinking)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, no, wait! Okay, okay. Don't! I'll go, I'll go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You will?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You were really gonna do that, weren't you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You were gonna drink the fat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let's see what else he'll do!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) How 'bout instead you, go get changed! (to Chandler) You, give him
back his underwear! I'm gonna go get a cab, and I want everyone down stairs in two
minutes! Monica!
(Joey and Chandler start to leave, Joey is lunging as he is walking)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stop it. Stop it!
(Monica runs into the living room, and starts dialing the phone)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, went to get a cab so we can all... No, wh-what are you doing! No,
Monica, no!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: (on machine) Hi, this is Richard.

lines.speaker: Machine
lines.text: You have three new messages.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not any more!

lines.speaker: Machine
lines.text: Message erased. To record a message begin speaking at the tone.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, uh, Richard it's Monica, um, listen I did something kind of crazy
tonight, um, maybe I'm getting my period or something, I don't know. Um, anyway, I, I, I
beeped into your machine and I heard a message that, that freaked me out, and um, you know
what Michelle will tell you the rest. I, I, um, I'm sorry, okay, I, I hope that we can
forget the whole thing. Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: Machine
lines.text: Your outgoing message has now been changed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Outgoing! Did that say outgoing?! Not, outgoing!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on machine) "Hi, uh, Richard it's Monica, um, listen I did something
kind of crazy tonight, um, maybe I'm getting my period or something, I don't know."
Nooo!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How did you do that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know!

lines.speaker: Machine
lines.text: Good-bye.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Noooo!!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Okay, okay, okay, I've got two cabs and no people. Go! Go! Go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe we could call the phone company. Maybe they could change the message.
Maybe they can change his number.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, after this, I think he'll be doing that himself.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel!! (she enters) Wow! You, uh, you look, wow!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I still have about five seconds to spare. (kisses him) Okay, that was
about seven seconds.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So we're a little late.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on. (they start to leave) Oh! And, uh, by the way....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm going commando, too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Awwww!!!

title: The One with the Jam

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is sitting reading a book and hears the bed in
Joey's room creaking, and does a 'Oh no, not again' look on his face.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (from bedroom) WHOAA!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (going to the bedroom) See Joe, that's why your parents told you not
to jump on the bed.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross and Rachel are entering

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, look at me. I'm making jam, been at it since 4 o'clock this
morning.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Where'd you get fruit at four in the morning?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Went down to the docks. Bet ya didn't know you could get it wholesale.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I didn't know there were docks.
[Joey and Chandler enter]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aww, is it broken?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I gotta wear this thing for a couple weeks. (points to the sling he is
wearing)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did you tell the doctor you did it jumping up and down on your bed?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nooo. I had a story all worked out but then Chandler sold me out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I'm sorry Joe. I didn't think the doctor was gonna buy that it
just *fell* out of the socket.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What is this? Fruit?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica's making jam.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, jam! I love jam! (to Chandler) Hey, how come we never have jam at
our place?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because the kids need new shoes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm going into business people. I'm sick and tired of being depressed
about Richard. I needed a plan, a plan to get over my man. What's the opposite of man?
Jam. (sees Joey trying some jam from the pot) Oh Joey don't! It's way to hot. (Joey
realizes this and spits what he had in his mouth back into the pot.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This will just be my batch.
[Scene: Street, Phoebe is being followed by some guy, as they pass a flower vendor.
Phoebe turns around and the guy quickly picks up some flowers and continues following
her.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (turns around) Um, that's it. No. Hey! You! J. Crew guy. Yeah. Why have
you been following me? I mean, all week long everywhere I look there's you.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: You wouldn't return my calls, you sent back my letters....

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: One more chance Ursula, please?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oooh. Oh, well this is awkward.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Wh..

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, yeah, you want Ursula, and I'm Phoebe. Twin sisters! Seriously.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Oh, that's great. I'm stalking the wrong woman. I am such a dingus!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you're not a dingus.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: I just, I want you to know I didn't used to be like this. Before I meet
your sister I was like this normal guy who sold beepers and cellular phones.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I mean look it's, it's not your fault, you know. I mean this is
just what, what she does to guys, okay.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Well thanks. (starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, (grabs him) you know what, I got a little story. When I was in
Junior High School I went through this period where I thought I was a witch. And there was
this guidance counselor who said something to me, that I think will help you a lot. He
said okay, 'you're not a witch you're just an average student.' See what I'm saying?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, well, get over it. So, I mean you, you just seem to be a really nice
guy, you know. Don't be so hard on yourself okay.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Wait. You're right. I know you're right. And, thanks for being so nice.
Here (gives her the flowers he bought.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, thanks a lot. Do you want to get a cup of coffee?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (they start to leave, he is still following her) Okay, you don't
have to walk behind me any more.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Sorry.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross and Rachel are entering

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mon?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mon?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading) 'Gone for more jars. Back later. Monica Geller.'

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, look.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, look, look.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What, what, what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's an empty apartment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oooh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We're all alone in an empty apartment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, come on, I have to be at work in like ten minutes (Ross starts
kissing her neck) Oh, all right, well it's not like I'm employee of the year or anything.
(they fall onto the couch)
(Chandler enters and they both jump up and pretend that Ross is showing her something
in the couch.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There it is.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, oh, that's what you're talking about. (to Chandler) Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do I look fat?

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Noo.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I accept that. When Janice asked me and I said no, she took that
to mean that I was calling her a cow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, walk us through it, honey, walk us through it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, well. Janice said 'Hi, do I look fat today?' And I, I looked at
her....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. You looked at her. You never look. You just answer, it's
just a reflex. Do I look fat? Nooo! Is she prettier than I am? Noo! Does size matter?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nooo!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And it works both ways.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so you both just know this stuff?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well you know, after about thirty or forty fights, you kinda catch on.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, for instance. Let's say, Janice is coming back from a trip and she
gives you two options. Option number 1 she'll take a cab home from the airport. Option 2
is you can meet her at baggage claim. Which do you do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's easy, baggage claim.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (buzzes) Wrong! Now you're single. It's actually secret option number
three, you meet her at the gate. That way she knows you love her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, this is good, this is good. All right listen, I have one. Janice
likes to cuddle, at night, which, you know I'm all for. But, uh, you know when you want to
go to sleep, you want some space. So, uh, how do I tell her that without, you know,
accidentally calling her fat or something.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh honey, I'm sorry we can't help you there, 'cause we're cuddlily
sleepers. (Chandler makes an 'Ewww' face) Okay, I'm late for work.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right are you guys gonna come down?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, yeah, yeah I'll, I'm right behind you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good luck Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye sweetie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye hon.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (blows her a kiss) Okay the sleeping thing. Very tricky business, but
there is something you can do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I thought you guys were cuddlily sleepers.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Noo! No, not cuddlily, not me, just her. I'm like you, I need the room.
Okay, come here. (they sit on the couch and Ross puts his hands on Chandler's shoulder and
thigh.) Okay, you're in bed...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. (they both notice where his hands are)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm gonna use the cushion.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, you're in bed. She's over on your side, cuddling. Now you wait for
her to drift off, and then you hug her (demonstrates on the cushion) and roll her back
over to her side of the bed. And then you rollll a-way. Hug for her! Roll for you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, the old hug and roll.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, one question.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shoot.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're pretending the pillow's a girl right?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is putting jam on his muffin, lots of jam

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Remember when you where a kid and your Mom would drop you off at the
movies with a jar of jam and a little spoon?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Looks at him) You're so pretty.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, oh, you know that guy who's been following me? I talked to him
today.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (with food in his mouth) You talked to him. Are you crazy?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, first I'm not crazy. And second, say it don't spray it. Anyway his
name is Malcom, and he wasn't following me, I mean he was, but 'cause he thought I was
Ursula, ick. And, that's why, that's why he couldn't just come up and talk to me. 'Cause
of the restraining order.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Umm, not feeling better 'bout Malcom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! No, no, no, no, he's not like a kook, no. He's just like this, this
very passionate, incredibly romantic guy, that got like a tinsy bit carried away, you
know. And we just get along really well, and he's so cute.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God, you've got a crush on your sister's stalker.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I'm just gonna help him, you know, get 'de-Ursula-ized', like you
know, like I did for Joey after he went out with her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (with his mouthful) Hey, I didn't stalk her. I mean (he sprays Phoebe with
crumbs)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I asked for the news, not the weather.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey Mon.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, this is for you. (gives him a jar of jam) It's blackberry curin.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aww. (tastes it) Ohh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, Joe, I gotta ask. The girl from the Xerox place buck naked (holds
up one hand), or, or a big tub of jam. (holds up the other hand)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Put your hands together.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, take your time with that. That's my last batch.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No more jam?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what happened to your jam plan?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I figured out I need to charge seventeen bucks a jar just to break even.
So, I've got a new plan now. Babies.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, your gonna need much bigger jars.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm talking about me having a baby.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. The great thing about the jam plan was, I was taking control of my
life. So I asked myself, what is the most important thing to me in the world and that's
when I came up with the baby plan.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, aren't you forgetin' something? What, what, what is uh, what is that
guy's name? Dad!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It took me 28 years to find one man that I wanna spend my life with, if
I have to wait another 28 years then, I'll be 56 before I can have a baby, and that's just
stupid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That, that's what's stupid.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't need an actual man, just a couple of his best swimmers. And
there, there are places you can go to get that stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Down at the docks again?

scenes.location: Chandler's bedroom, Janice and him are cuddling

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Night-night Bing-a-ling.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Night-night.....Janice. (he starts thinking to him self) 'Look at
all that room on her side, you good fit a giant penguin over there. That would be weird
though. Okay, hug and roll time. I'm huggin', I'm huggin', your rollin', and....yes!
Freedom! (his one arm is still under her) Except for this arm! I'm stuck. Stuck arm! Okay,
time for the old table cloth trick, one fluid motion. Quick like a cat, quick like a cat!
And 1...2...3!' (Pulls his arm out from under her and she is spun off of the bed.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, Malcom is giving Phoebe all of his spy stuff

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: Here's my binoculars.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, great. Great. You're doing great, you know real strong. Going
strong. Keep going.

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: These are my night vision goggles. This is the book I pretend to read
when I'm watching her in the park. And these are Mad Lips, they're just for fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah. What's this? (picks up a book)

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: Oh, this is log I kept, recording her every movement. Do you wanna here
something from it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, not even a little bit.

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: It's about you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay then.

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: (reading) I met Phoebe today. She was really nice to me eventhough I'm
such a loser. And, then when I was walking home I thought about her a lot, it was weird,
but kinda cool.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good. So what were you thinking?

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: I was thinking what it would be like to kiss you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: See that's just something I said now, so that maybe I could kiss you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay. (he kisses her)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Joey is eating jam straight out of the jar, and Chandler
is staring at him in amazement. Joey offers him some.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, that's all right. I just had a jar of mustard.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from her bedroom) Okay, sperm donor number 03815, come on
down! Okay, he's 6'2", 170 pounds, and he describes himself as a male Geena Davis.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean there's more than one of us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, you can't do this Mon. All right, if you do this, I'm, I'm gonna,
I'm, I'm gonna.....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're gonna what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm gonna tell Mom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, I'm sorry, but he's right. I love you, but you're crazy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Crazy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! Why? Why is this crazy? So this isn't the ideal way to
something....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupting her) Oh, it's not the ideal way...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Lips moving, still talking. I mean it may not be ideal, but I'm so
ready. No, I-I-I see the way Ben looks at you. It makes me ache, you know?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Check it out!! Jam crackers!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, all right, how's this? 27. Italian-American guy. He's an actor,
born in Queens. Wow, big family, seven sisters, and he's the only....boy. (they all turn
and look at Joey) Oh my God, under personal comments: 'New York Knicks, rule!'

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, the Knicks rule!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, this is you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let me see. (goes over and looks at the form) Oh, right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: When did you go to a sperm bank?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, right after I did that sex study down at NYU. (to Chandler) Hey,
Remember that sweater I gave you for your birthday?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And that's how you bought it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Noooo, that's what I was wearing when I donated. I'm kinda surprised
there's any of my boys left.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, honey, it is pretty competitive. I mean I've got an actual rocket
scientist here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe, I should call this place and get them to put my 'Days of Our Lives'
on here. You know, juice this puppy up a little.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hellooo!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How's the maniac?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, well he's yummy. We did a little kissin'.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no, no. You know what, he's not into that stuff anymore. He
quit for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, this guy has been obsessed with your sister, for God knows how
long, okay, you don't just give up something like that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, he gave me his night vision goggles and everything.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're taking the word of a guy who has night vision goggles?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What, he's not still following her. Do you think he is still following
her?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs, wake up and smell the restraining order.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you saying I should do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think, that if you really like this guy, you should just trust him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you, Monica.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Orrr, you could follow him and see where he goes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, that's what I would do, forget mine.

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, what happened? (points to the cast on Janice's wrist)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh. God, crazy Chandler. He spun me...off...the...bed!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Spinning that sounds like fun.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, (laughs) I wish. No, you know he was just trying Ross's Hug and Roll
thing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (turns around, not amused) Ross's what?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: You know what, where he hugs you and kinda rolls you away and... Oh...
my....God.
[Scene: Subway station, Phoebe is following Malcom by finding behind the pillars until
she comes up to one with a wire mesh garbage can next to it. Malcom stops and starts
walking the other way and passes Phoebe, who quick tries to hide behind the garbage can.
But, Malcom sees her.]

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes? Yes! Oh.

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I was just here looking for, um, my um, my part of an old sandwich.
Oh, here it is! Oh. (picks one up out of the garbage can.)

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: Were you following me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, perhaps. Yes! Yes, I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I was just afraid that you
were still hung up on my sister.

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: So you spied on me. I can't believe you don't trust me. (Ursula walks
past, and Malcom finds behind the pillar)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh well, what do you know, there goes my identical twin sister. Just
walkin' along looking like me. What, is this just like a freakish coincidence, or did you
know she takes this train?

lines.speaker: Malcom
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I tried to stop, but I couldn't. I'm so pathetic.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, it's not your fault. You know it's partly my fault, 'cause I
made you quit cold turkey. Sorry, no. Okay, well, I mean, I can't date you anymore, 'cause
your, you know (in a high pitched voice) Wow! But um, but I will definitely, definitely

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you have any beers? We’re out of beers.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (all depressed) Help yourself.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe moved out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t understand, I mean am I so hard to live, is this why I
don’t have a boyfriend?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Noo!! You don’t have a boyfriend because....I don’t, I
don’t know why you don’t have a boyfriend. You should have a boyfriend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I think so.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-ho, come here. (goes and hugs her) Listen, you are one of my
favourite people and the most beautiful woman I’ve ever known in real life.
[Scene: the bar, Ross is entering, Phoebe is at the bar, they are the only two in the
place.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (all depressed) Hi. Where is everybody?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it’s already closed, Chris gave me the keys to lock up-what is
wrong?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My marriage, I think my marriage is um, is kinda over.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ‘Cause Carol’s a lesbian. (Phoebe is shocked) And, and I’m
not one. And apparently it’s not a mix and match situation.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! I don’t believe it! Oh, you poor bunny.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sets out a bunch of shot glasses and starts to poor himself a drink, many
drinks) I’m an idiot. I mean shoulda seen it, I mean Carol and I’d be out and
she’d, she’d see some beautiful woman, and, and she’d be Ross y'know look
at her, and I’d think, God, my wife is cool!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Aw! Hey, do you think that Susan person is her lover?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, now I do!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Seven years. I mean we’ve been together seven years, she’s the
only woman who’s ever loved me, and the only woman I’ve-I’ve ever....

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Aw, God Ross. Oh.(goes over and hugs him)

scenes.location: Monica’s, Chandler and Monica are still hugging each other.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Umm, this is nice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, it is isn’t it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I mean it, this feels really good. Is it a hundred percent cotton?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! And I got it on sale, too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Anyway, I should go, one of the lifeguards was just about to dismantle
a nuclear device.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, if you wanna get a drink later we can.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, that sounds great. (starts to leave) Oh, and listen,
it’s, it’s gonna be....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know. Thanks. (Chandler leaves)

scenes.location: the bar, Phoebe is still hugging Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe this would’ve happened if I’d been more nurturing, or
I’d paid more attention, or I... had a uterus. I can’t believe this!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know no, no, y'know you don’t deserve this, you don’t Ross.
You’re, you’re really, you’re so good. (kisses him on the cheek)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And you’re so sweet. (kisses him on the other cheek) And
you’re kind (kisses him on the lips)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. (kisses her on the lips)
(They pause, and they the start kissing passionately, and taking off each others
clothes, and they start to lie down on the pool table.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh?
(Ross tries to clear off the pool table by knocking the balls to the other end of the
table, but they all bounce back, and he frantically starts to throw them into the
pockets.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, it’s okay.
(Phoebe jumps on to the table and lays down, Ross follows her and hits his head on the
light hanging over the pool table.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. (they start kissing again)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My foot is stuck in the pocket.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I can’t get it out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, that’s not something a girl wants to hear.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, come on don’t start. (they start kissing again) Ouch!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Stupid balls are in the way. (holds up two balls)
(They both look at each other and start laughing (Lisa almost lost it there), and sit
up. Ross hits his head on the lamp again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh well. It probably would’ve been the most constructive solution.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You have chalk on your face.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh? (the rest of the gang enters)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Ross you’re right, I don’t know why I always thought this
was real grass.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My wife’s a lesbian.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Cool!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross-Joey, Joey-Ross. (they shake hands)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

title: The One with the Race Car Bed

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, the whole gang is there, Ross is telling a story about what
happened at work and the rest of the gang are thinking to themselves, denoted by italics.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So I told Carl, ‘Nobody, no matter how famous their parents are,
nobody is allowed to climb on the dinosaur.’ But of course this went in one ear and

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I love how he cares so much about stuff. If I squint I can pretend
he’s Alan Alda.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh good, another dinosaur story. When are those gonna become extinct?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If I was a superhero who could fly and be invisible, that
would be the best.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: What does Rachel see in this guy? I love Rachel. I wish she was my
wife.
