(Joey is singing in his head.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who’s singing?
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the whole gang is there including Janice, they’re
watching Happy Days.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. When you guys were kids and you played Happy Days, who were
you? I was always Richie.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was always Joanne.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Question. Was ah, ‘Egg the Gellers!’ the war cry of your
neighbourhood?
(A commercial for the Mattress King, Janice’s ex-husband, comes on TV.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ewww! Oh! It’s the Mattress King!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Booo!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Janice) Don’t look honey. Change the channel! Change the
channel!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Wait! Wait! I wanna see this. After I divorce him, half of that kingdom
is gonna be mine.

lines.speaker: Matress King
lines.text: (on TV) ‘Despair fills the mattress showroom. My kingdom
is suddenly without a queen. I’m so depressed I’m going to slash... my prices!!
Check it out! Four ninety-nine for a pillow top queen set! I’m going medieval on
prices!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What a wank!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, I cannot believe he’s using our divorce to sell mattresses.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! And four ninety-nine for a pillow top queen set, who cares about
the divorce, those babies will sell themselves. (they all stare at her) And I’m
appalled for you by the way.

lines.speaker: Matress King
lines.text: (on TV) I’m close. I’m cheap. I’m the king.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is on the phone, everyone else is there except Joey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ‘Okay. (listens) Okay, daddy we’ll see you tomorrow night.
(listens) Okay bye-bye.’ (hangs up)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are ah, having dinner with my Dad tomorrow night, I hope that’s
okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh shoot, tomorrow’s not so good, I’m supposed to um, fall off
the Empire State building and land on a bicycle with no seat. Sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, my father doesn’t hate you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please, he refers to me as ‘wethead’.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But honey he calls everybody by a nickname! Okay, look, I know, all
right, just one dinner, please, just one night for me, please. I just want him to love you
like I do. (Ross looks at her) All right, well not exactly like I do, but, but, if you do
come to dinner, I’ll love you like I do in that black thing that you like.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (leaning in) I’ll go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi Gunther.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Yeah, we’ll see!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey, you guys!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Guess what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I got a gig!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yay!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See, that’s why I could never be an actor. Because I can’t
say gig.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I can’t say croissant. (realises) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s the part?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it’s not a part, no. I’m teaching acting for soap operas
down at the Learning Extension.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on! That’s great.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. It’s like my chance to give something back to the acting
community.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know your probably not allowed to sleep with any of your students.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (glares at him) I know!

scenes.location: Mattress King, Monica and Phoebe are shopping for a new mattress.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh! I don’t know Monica. It feels funny just being here. I mean if
you buy a bed from Janice’s ex-husband, that’s like betraying Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not at these prices.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sees a little kid playing with a race car bed) (to kid) Hi. Y'know in
England this car would be on the other side of the store. (the kid just stares at her, and
she makes the ‘that went right over your head’ motion) Woo!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (lying down on a mattress) Oh! Ohhhhh! Oh! Phoebe, come here. Aw, this
is my new bed. You gotta feel this bad boy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Eh, Monica it, it feels so weird, y'know, Chandler’s your friend...
(hops onto the bed) Oh! Oh my God! Aw, all right take this bed, you can make other
friends.
[Scene: Classroom. Joey is writing his name on the board, but turns around before
he’s done which causes him to write his name with a downward curve, and he then
underlines it, and draws the line right through his name.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good evening. I’m Mr. Tribbiani. And I will be teaching acting for
soap operas. Now um, on my first day as (proudly) Dr. Drake Remoray on Days of Our
Lives, (looks for a reaction from his students, and gets none.) I learned that one of
the most important things in soap opera acting is reacting, this does not mean acting
again, it means, you don’t have a line, but someone else just did. And it goes like
this. (looks all intense for a moment and then gasps, the students cheer him) Thanks,
thanks, a lot. Oh, by the way, before I forget to work in soap operas some of you will
have to become much more attractive. All right, moving right along.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Joey is entering, Phoebe is already there waiting for the
delievery guy.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Ooh! How was teaching last night?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh it was great. Yeah, you get to say stuff like, ’Hey, the bell
doesn’t dismiss you, I dismiss you.’

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooooh, nice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, and guess what, I got an audition for All My Children.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it’s this great part, this boxer named Nick. And I’m so,
so right for it, y'know, he’s just like me. Except he’s a boxer, and has an evil
twin.
(There is a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. (goes and answers the door and there is this huge black
delievery guy.)

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Dom da-da dom! Here ye! Here ye! Delivery from the Mattress King. (to
Phoebe) You Miss Geller?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Sign here. (hands her a clipboard)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, do I have a middle name. All right Monica Velula Geller. It’s
that bedroom there. (points to Monica’s room)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Monica bought a bed from the Mattress King?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, so please, please, please, don’t say anything to Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You want me to lie to Chandler?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Is that a problem?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hey, hey Nick the boxer let’s see what you got. All right ya,
put ‘em up. Come on. (they start shadow boxing)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you’re ah, pretty good at this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, well I had to learn, I was staying at the Y and some off the young
men weren’t acting Christian enough.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahh!
(Joey throws a punch and just lightly taps her on the shoulder, Phoebe counters with a
jab to the nose.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey now!
(Phoebe throws another jab, and lands it on Joey’s nose, causing it to bleed.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!!! Oww!! And I’m bleeding.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Oh! Oh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! And I’m a vegetarian! All right, all right, well I’m
sorry, we’ll put some ice on it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ‘Kay, put your head back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. I can’t see.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I have ya. Oh God.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Which bedroom do ya want it in Miss Geller?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it’s the compulsively neat one by the window, okay.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Gotcha. (he and his helper walk in carrying the racecar bed.)

scenes.location: Restaurant, Rachel and Ross and Dr. Green are having dinner.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Daddy!

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: This where they put it? What, there no table available in the
kitchen! Hello, baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You remember Ross.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nice to see you again Dr. Green.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: So! (they both try to sit next to Rachel but Dr. Green is
successful.) (to Ross) How’s the library?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ugh, museum.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: What happened to the library?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There never was a library. I mean there are libraries, its just that I ah,
I never worked at one.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: You know what’s really good here, the lobster. What do you say
shall I just order three.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, if you’re really hungry. (Dr. Green stares at him) It was a
joke, I made a joke.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, actually Daddy Ross is allergic to lobster.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: What kind of person is allergic to lobster? I guess the kind of
person that works at a library.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s not a library...

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: (interrupting him) I know!! It’s a museum! What, you’re the
only one around here who can make a joke! At least mine was funny. Ah, waiter, we will
have two lobsters and a menu. (nods at Ross, and mouths I don’t know to the waiter.)

scenes.location: After dinner.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, Dr. Green, how’s the old boat.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: They found rust. You know what rust does to a boat?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It gives it a nice antiquey look.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: (he stares at Ross) Rust, is boat cancer, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow. I’m sorry, when I was a kid I lost a bike to that. (Rachel
giggles at that)

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Excuse me for a moment, will you please, I want to say good night to
the Levines, before we go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! (picks up a knife and pretends to stab his heart.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw honey stop! It’s not that bad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. (sees the bill) Op! Uh-oh! I think your Dad must’ve added
wrong. He only tipped like four percent.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. That’s Daddy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s Daddy?! But doesn’t it bother you? You’re a
waitress.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, it bothers me Ross, but y'know if he was a regular at the coffee
house, I’d be serving him sneezers.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So. Ross, I’ve bugged him about this a million times, he’s not
gonna change.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You really serve people sneezers?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well um, I don’t.

lines.speaker: Dr Green
lines.text: You kids ready?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks again, Dr. Green.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: All right.
(Ross takes a twenty and slips it underneath the bill when Dr. Green isn’t
looking.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Oh, wait, wait, wait, wait, I think I forgot my receipt.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, ah, you don’t need that.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The carbon, it’s messy, I mean it gets on your fingers and causes,
the, the ah, night blindness.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: (gets his receipt and notices the twenty) What is this? Who put a
twenty down here? Huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah, that would be me, um, I have, I have a problem I-I tip way too
much, way, way, too much, it’s a sickness really.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah it is, it is. (to Ross) We really, really have to do something
about that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Excuse me, you think I’m cheap?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Daddy, no he didn’t mean anything by that, he really
didn’t.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing I do means anything, really.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: This is nice. I pay two hundred dollars for dinner, you put down
twenty, and you come out looking like Mr. Big Shot. You really want to be Mr. Big Shot?
Here, I’ll tell you what, you pay the whole bill, Mr. Big Shot, all right. (rips up
the bill, and throws it at Ross, then leaves)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well Mr. Big Shot is better than ‘wethead’.

scenes.location: Classroom, Joey is lecturing on facial expressions.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, some tricks of the trade. Now, I’ve never been able to cry as
an actor, so if I’m in a scene where I have to cry, I cut a hole in my pocket, take a
pair of tweezers, and just start pulling. Or ah, or, let’s say I wanna convey that
I’ve just done something evil. That would be the basic ‘I have a fishhook in my
eyebrow and I like it’ (Does it by raising one eyebrow, and showing off the pretend
fishhook.) Okay, let’s say I’ve just gotten bad news, well all I do there is try
and divide 232 by 13. (looks all confused) And that’s how it’s done. Great soap
opera acting tonight everybody, class dismissed.

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Hey, Mr. Trib.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey.

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Guess what, I got an audition!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Awww, one of my students got an audition. I’m so proud.

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: I was wondering if you would consider coaching me for it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You bet! What’s the part?

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Oh it’s great, it’s a role on All My Children, Nick
the boxer.
(Joey does the ‘232 divided by 13 bad news’ look.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Hallway, Ross and Rachel are returning from dinner.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You had to do it, didn’t you? You couldn’t just leave it
alone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Four percent. Okay. I tip more than that when there’s a bug in my
food.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, tonight was about the two of you getting along. (Ross groans and
rubs his neck) Oh, would you just see my chiropractor, already.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I’m gonna go to a doctor who went to school in a mini-mall.
(they go into Monica and Rachel’s, and see Phoebe hopping around.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m, I’m freaking out! Monica kinda trusted me with something
and she shouldn’t have! All right, I haven’t lived here in a while, so I have to
ask you something. Does Monica still turn on the lights in her bedroom?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um. yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I am soo dead. (goes to Monica’s room)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, look, here’s the bottom line Ross, this is fixable, if
we act fast, okay. So, I’ll invite him to brunch tomorrow and you can make nice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, honey, I have tried to make nice, it doesn’t work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, look, Ross, I realise that my Father is difficult, but that’s
why you have got to be the bigger man here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look sweetie, I could be the bigger man, I could be the biggest man, I
could be a big, huge, giant man, and it still wouldn’t make any difference, except
that I could pick your Father up and say ‘Like me! Like me tiny doctor!’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well can’t you just try it one more time Ross? For me? For
me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel one brunch is not gonna solve anything. You gotta face it, okay
we’re never gonna get along.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well you are just gonna have too, okay. Because I already got a
Mother and a Father who cannot stay in the same room together, okay, I don’t wanna
have to have a separate room for you too!! (starts to cry)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay. (hugs her) I’ll get the bagels.

scenes.location: Monica’s bedroom, Phoebe is trying to hide the bed from Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sees the bed) What’s this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Isn’t it cool! Varoom! Varoom!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is not the bed I ordered!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, you must’ve won like a contest or something!
(Phoebe starts to make a sound like a car accelerating)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe!
(Phoebe makes a sound like a car screeching to a halt.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why is this car in my bedroom?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry, okay, I-I wasn’t looking, and the store says that
they won’t take it back because you signed for it...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When did I sign for it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: When I was you! Y'know what, it’s all Joey’s fault,
‘cause he left his nose open!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you make brownies today?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Knock, knock.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Quick, take off your dress, he won’t notice the bed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, I’m going for sushi does anybody want.. (enters and sees the
bed) Whoa-whoa, somebody missed the off ramp.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s Monica’s bed. What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (to Monica) It’s a racecar.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So. This has always been Monica’s bed, what you’re just
noticing now, how self-involved are you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, well it this bed isn’t new, how come there is plastic on
the mattress?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sometimes I have bad dreams. (starts to break down, and Phoebe offers
her, her hand to comfort her.)

scenes.location: Classroom, Joey is coaching his student.

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Look, I just saw my best friends brains smeared across the canvas,
that’s not gonna be me, not me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! That was good. That was...(points to his pocket) Tweezers?

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa. That was really good.

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Thanks, any suggestions?
(Joey gets the evil look on his face.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Monica, and Phoebe are there, yelling at Joey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You told him to play the boxer gay!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I-I might’ve said supergay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You totally screwed him over.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, you’re this guy’s teacher. I mean how could you do this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because, Monica, the guy’s so good, and I really, really want this
part.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if you really, really want it, then it’s okay.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is greeting her Father for their brunch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (opening the door) Hi Daddy.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Baby. Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dr. Green. How are you? (offers his hand, and Dr. Green puts his scarf on
it.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Thanks for dinner last night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you for teaching me a valuable lesson.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Nice hair. What’d ya do? Swim here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) Okay, that’s it, I can’t take it anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What? He’s interested in you. He-he likes your hair, he just
wants to know how you got here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, please. Sweetie it’s hopeless, okay, I’m just gonna go.
(starts to leave rubbing his neck)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, look I’m sorry. It’s just that....

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Ross? What’s with the neck?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He’s got this thing. And I keep telling him to go to my
chiropractor...

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: You’re still going to that chiropractor, that man couldn’t
get into medical school in Extapa!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you! That’s what I keep saying.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me, Dr. Bobby happens to be an excellent doctor.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Wait a minute, his name is Dr. Bobby?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well that’s his last name.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And his first name.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: He’s Bobby Bobby?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s Robert Bobby.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And um, excuse me, he helps me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-ho please. Ask her how?

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: What do you need help for?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: With my alignment. I’ve got one leg shorter than the other.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Oh God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Argue with that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? It’s true, my right leg is two inches shorter.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Come on! You’re just titling! (to Ross) Her legs are fine!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know that!

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: So, why do you let her go to a chiropractor for?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry, let her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What can I do, she doesn’t listen to me about renter’s insurance
either.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Wait a minute, you don’t have renter’s insurance?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Well what if somebody steals something? How are you gonna run after
him with one leg shorter than the other?!
(Both he and Ross start laughing)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, would you ah, would you like some juice?

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: I’d love some juice. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (to Rachel) Wow! This is going so well. Did you see us? Did you see?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah honey, I’m standing right there! Why didn’t you just tell
him about the mole I haven’t got checked yet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excellent!

scenes.location: Classroom, Joey is talking to his students.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sadly) There will come a time in each of your careers when you’ll
have a chance to screw over another soap opera actor. I had such an opportunity in the
recent, present. And I’m ashamed to say that I took it, I advised a fellow actor to
play a role, homosexually. Yeah, we both auditioned for the part, and uh, as it turned
out, they ah, they liked the stupid gay thing and cast him. And now, he’s got a two
year contract opposite Susan Luchhi, the first lady of daytime television, and me, me
I’m stuck here teaching a bunch of people, most of whom are too ugly to even be on
TV. I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry. (he gets a huge round of applause from
his students.) Thank you.

scenes.location: Mattress King, Monica is trying to return her bed.

lines.speaker: Jester
lines.text: Uh, may I help you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I talked to you on the phone, I’m the lady that got stuck
with the racecar bed.

lines.speaker: Jester
lines.text: Look, it’s like I told you, there’s nothing I can do. You
signed for it, Monica Velula Geller.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, Jester man, look we wanna see the king.

lines.speaker: Jester
lines.text: Nobody sees the king!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-ho-kay, I’m talking to the king. (starts to go to a back room)

lines.speaker: Jester
lines.text: Hey! You can’t go back there!
(Joey goes to the door, but stops and looks through the window at Janice and the
Mattress King, her ex-husband, kissing.)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh my God.
(Joey fakes a scream.)

title: The One with the Giant Poking Device

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe, Chandler, and Ross are there, Rachel
is serving brownies.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Here you go Pheebs. Who else wants one of my special homemade brownies?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I will have one. (Ross and him both take one.)
(Phoebe takes a bite and spits it out and screams.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I’m not gonna have one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Neither will I. (they both put back the brownies.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, it’s just my tooth.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right I’ll have one. (he and Ross take another brownie,)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So what’s a matter, you need a dentist? I’ve got a good one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No thanks, I have a good one too. I just, I, I can’t see him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See that is the problem with invisible dentists.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why? Why can’t you go to him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because, every time I go to the dentist, somebody dies.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is so weird, because every time I go to the dentist, I look down
the hygienist’s blouse.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, what? Umm...what?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, first there was my aunt Mary, and then there was umm, John,
my mailman, and then my, my cowboy friend ‘Albino Bob’.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And all these people actually died?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, while I was in the chair! That’s why I take such good care of
my teeth now, y'know, it’s not about oral hygiene, I floss to save lives!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, come on, you didn’t kill anybody, these people just happened
to die when you went to the dentist. It’s, it’s, it’s just ah, a
coincidence.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well tell that to them. Oh! You can’t, their dead.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross, Rachel, and Phoebe are there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks, Gunther. (takes the plate Gunther serves him and Rachel comes up
and kisses him) (to Rachel) Hey! (to Gunther) Umm, can I get a napkin too?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Oh, like you don’t already have everything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (trying to bite into an apple) Ow! Ow! (drops the apple in disgust.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, your in pain, would you just go to the dentist, just go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, fine, fine, but if you’re my next victim, don’t
come back as a poltergeist and like suck me into the TV set.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Although, don’t feel like you can’t visit.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering with Monica) Hey, is, is, is Chandler here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (patting his clothes like he is looking for his wallet) No, no he’s
not.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You guys, Joey just saw Janice kissing her ex-husband.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (to Joey) So what are you going to do? I mean how, how are you going
to tell Chandler?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I was thinking about that and I, I think the best way would be, to
not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, you can’t keep this to yourself, if you know about this, you
have to tell him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’ll kill him. I mean it’ll, it’ll just kill him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, you could wait ‘til I go to the dentist, maybe I’ll
kill him.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, All are there except for Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking out the window) Ewww! Ugly Naked Guy is using his new hammock.
It’s like a Play-Doo Fat Factory.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I’m going to the dentist, so listen, okay, just be on the
look out for anything that, that, that you can fall into, or, or that can fall on you,
or... All right, just look out! Okay, And um, I also just wanna, I just wanna tell you all
that um...... (starts to cry and runs out)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I have a problem I have to go into work for a few hours, some kids
messed up the Homo Sapien display.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What did they do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, they painted over the word ‘Sapien’ for one thing, then
they rearranged the figures, let’s just leave it at that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, do you want me to watch Ben for you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, that’s what I was going to ask, thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa! Wait! Hello! What about me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You? You! Want to watch Ben? (in the background Monica mouths
‘Don’t worry, I’ll be here the whole time.’ to Ross.) Yes! That’d
be great, no, I just wanted to ask Monica, because I know how empty her life is. (Monica
sarcastically mouths ‘Yeah!’ and holds up her thumb.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey, Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’ve got a science question.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If the Homo Sapiens, were in fact ‘Homo-sapien’, is that why
there extinct?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, Homo Sapiens are people.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey, I’m not judging.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are babysitting Ben.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (holding Ben) Look Benny, spoon. (moves it back and forth) Spoon. Come
on! All right, y'know what I think he’s bored.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here. Ben, do you wanna play the airplane game, do you wanna show
Rachel? Come here. (takes Ben) We’re gonna do something fun. Okay. (throws Ben up in
the air a little bit and catches him) Weee!! (moves into the living room and does it
again) Weee!! (starts to walk back into the kitchen as she does it again, and hits
Ben’s head on that wooden beam across the ceiling.)
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Ben) Who’s so brave, you’re so brave, yes you are,
you’re so brave.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay honey, he’s fine, he’s fine, let’s just put
him down. Come here, Ben. (sets him on the couch) See that’s a good boy. (to Monica)
How could you do that to him!! Ross trusted me, what is he going to say?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He’s not gonna say anything, because we’re not gonna tell him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’re not?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No we’re not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I like that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So we’re okay, we’re okay, we’re okay, (starts to exam
Ben) aren’t we? No, we’re not okay, we’re not okay, there’s a bump,
there’s a bump.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Well push it in! Push it in!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I cannot push it in!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, we’re gonna need a distraction.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I got it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The second that Ross walks in that door, I want you take him back to
your bedroom and do whatever it is that you do that makes him go, (high pitched) rweee!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Or. We could put a hat on his head.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A hat! Yes! We need a hat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We need a hat..

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Where are we gonna find a tiny little hat?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, oh, oh, I’ll get ‘Rainy Day Bear’!! (runs to get him)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because he’ll know what to do? (Rachel comes out of her room with a
bear that’s dressed in a rain suit.) Oh my God, you’re a genius!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, oh God, it’s sowed on though.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Give it. Give it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(Monica takes the bear, grabs his hat, and rips off his head.)

lines.speaker: Monica and Rachel
lines.text: Oh!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s just like a bloodbath in here today.

scenes.location: The street, Chandler and Joey are walking past a jewelery store.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Hold on a minute, hold on a second. Do you think these pearls are
nice?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’d really prefer a mountain bike.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Janice’s birthday is coming up, I want to get her something
speacial. Come in here with me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, wait, whoa. Do you ah, want to get her something
speacial, get her flowers, get her candy, get her gum, girls love gum.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s a good idea, ‘Dear Janice have a Hubba-Bubba
birthday’. I would like to get her something serious.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you want something serious. Y'know what you should do, you should get
her one of those um, barium enemas. Those are dead serious.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right. Look, I’m gonna go in here, and you don’t buy me
anything ever. (starts to go into the store)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (stopping him) No, no, you can’t, you can’t, okay, you
can’t, you can’t buy her pearls, you just can’t, you can’t, you

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh God. Uh, okay, here’s the thing, this is the thing, okay, the
thing is...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is the thing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. I went down to the ‘Mattress King’ showroom and, and I saw
Janice, kissing her ex-husband.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They were in his office.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well she, she wouldn’t do that, she’s with, she’s with
me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m telling you man, I saw it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, you’re wrong! Okay, you’re wrong.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m not wrong! I wish I was. I’m sorry. Bet that barium enema
doesn’t sound so bad now, huh?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are dressing up Ben in the entire rain
suit from Rainy Day Bear.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It just makes more sense as an ensemble.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Besides, it takes the focus off the hat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (running through the door) No! Oh! You’re alive! You’re alive!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: See Pheebs, I promised you no one would die, didn’t I?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, well, we’ll see about that. Can I use your phone? I just
wanna call everyone I know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure, we have no money, go ahead.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (on phone) ‘Hey! You’re not dead! Okay, see ya!’

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! He just said my name! Did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Monica bang!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I heard that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did he just say ‘Monica bang’?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! He’s gonna rat me out!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Monica bang!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho, sweetie, sweetie, you gotta stop saying that, now. It’s
no big deal, it’s not even worth mentioning, you see we all do it all the time. See
watch this, Ben, Ben, Ben. (goes over and starts hitting her head on the post) Ow, Monica
bang! (does it again) Everybody bang. (repeats) Ben bang. (repeats) Rachel bang. (repeats)
Bang, Rachel bang! Oh, isn’t that fun?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (goes over and hits her head on the post) Look at that! (repeats) Look
at that! (repeats) We all do it. (repeats) Okay, I’m stopping now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! Y'know, if it’s not a headboard, it’s just not worth
it.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is waiting for Janice to arrive, and is angrily
fllipping through a magazine.]

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (entering) How’s my Bing-a-ling?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, I don’t know, you tell me. Anything you ah, wanna tell me,
because, if you ah, you should, if you, you would, tell me.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Why are your eyes so white?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You tell me! Maybe, it’s because I was just fooling with my ex!
Oh no-no-no-no, no-no-no-no, that was you!!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey told me, he saw you two kissing.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: In the park?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! In his office! How many kisses were there?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Just those two!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wh-wh-why, wh-why, why, why was there kissing!? There should be no
kissing!!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry honey, I’m so, so, (nasally) haaaaa! I’m
so, so sorry, I just (nasally) haaaaaa! But I, oh what happened was, I-I-I can’t
breathe. Can you get me a bag, or something?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (giving her a bag) Here.
(Janice starts to breath into it and sucks in the reciept, and then spits it out.)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: The receipt.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll take it! All right look, I gotta know. Are you finished with
me? (Janice shakes her head no) Are you finished with him? (Janice shakes her head no) Do
you still love him? (Janice shakes her head yes) Do you still love me? (Janice shakes her
head yes) All right look, (grabs the bag) I’m gonna need an actual answer here okay,
so which is it, him or me? (his phone starts to ring)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (rushing in) Okay. If you’re alive you answer your phone!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica, Rachel, Phoebe, and Joey are there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Ben, I won’t tell your daddy that you had ice cream for
dinner, if you don’t tell about our little bonking incident.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, number one, I don’t think Ben understands the concept of
bribery, and number two, I... (Joey starts laughing in the background) (to Joey) What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You said number two.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I also said number one.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know. (giggles harder)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Everyone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How’s my little boy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He’s perfect, he’s never been better.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (noticing the outfit he is wearing) What’d you do, take him whaling?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Monica.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God, he just said your name, that’s great! Good job Ben.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Monica bang!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that’s right, that’s what I’d sound like if I
exploded.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Woo-Hoo! The curse is broken! I called everybody I know, and everyone is
alive.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ugly Naked Guy looks awfully still. (Phoebe runs to the window and gasps.)
[Cut to later, all except Chandler are staring out the window at Ugly Naked Guy.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! I killed him! I killed another one! And this curse is getting
stronger too, to bring down something that big.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well maybe he’s just taking a nap.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m tellin’ ya, he hasn’t moved since this morning.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, we should call somebody.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And tell them what? The naked guy we stare at all the time isn’t
moving.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, we have gotta find out if he’s alive.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How are we gonna do that? There’s no way.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, there is one way. His window’s open, I say, we poke him.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is throwing darts, as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Y'know how we ah, save all those chopsticks for no reason we get when
we get Chinese food?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, now we got a reason.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, we’re fashioning a very long poking device.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey uh, what’s a matter?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I talked to Janice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God, is she going back to him?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She doesn’t know. Says she loves us both. Y'know I woke up this
morning and I was in love, well I was happy. Y'know it serves me right for buying that
twelve pack of condoms. And now I can’t even return them, because she choked on the
reciept!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you ah, what are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know, y'know. What, what, would you do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it doesn’t matter what I would do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on, tell me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, you’re probably not gonna want to hear this but ah, if it
was me, and this is just me, (Chandler gets ready to throw another dart) I would ah, I
would bow out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? (turns around quickly still ready to throw the dart and Joey
quickly ducks and hides behind the chair) What are you, what are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They have a kid together, y'know. They’re like, they’re like a
family, and if, I don’t know, there’s chance they could make that work, I know I
wouldn’t want to be the guy who stood in the way of that. Are you okay? Do you wanna
ah, come poke a nude guy?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Ross has just finished putting Ben to sleep, and is
entering from Rachel’s room.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, he’s finally alseep. About that ah, bump on his head?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you, are you, are you sure it’s ah, a new bump? I mean, no
offense, I’ve always thought of Ben as a fairly bumpy headed child.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s okay if he bumps his head, kids bump their heads all the time,
y'know, it was your first time babysitting, I figured you did the best you could.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (confidently) I did!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know! I’m saying you have to watch them all the time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did!! I watched! I watched! I watched Monica bang his head against
that thing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica did it?
(Monica runs into the kitchen from the terrace.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, did you notice anything wierd about Ben today?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I was just playing with him, and y'know we were doing the alphabet
song, which he used to be really good at, but suddenly he’s leaving out ‘e’
and ‘f.’ It’s like they just ah, I don’t know, fell out of his head.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, and also, he’s, he’s walkin’ kind of funny, his left
leg is moving a lot faster than his right leg, and he’s in there just sort of
y'know... (walks around in a circle)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, I wrecked your baby!! (runs into the bedroom)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I hope it’s still funny when you’re in hell.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (coming out of the bedroom) You jerk! You know how much I love that kid!
(starts to chase Ross around the living room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica bang! Monica bang! (runs into one of the posts) Ow!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ll get the hat.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler and Janice are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Janice, I have something I need to tell you, and I want you to let me
get through it, because it’s, it’s, it’s not gonna be easy.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think you should go back with Gary. I don’t wanna be the guy
that breaks up a family, y'know when my parents split up, it was because of that guy.
Whenever I would see him I was always think y'know ‘You’re the reason, you are
the reason why their not together.’ and I hated that guy. And it didn’t matter
how nice he was, or how happy he made my Dad.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well. It’s the right thing to do.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh! You’re right. Oh God. But, before I can say
‘good-bye’, there’s something I really need you to know, Chandler. The way
I feel about you, it’s like, I finally understand what Lionel Richie’s been
singing about. Y'know, I mean what we have, it’s like movie love, you’re my
soulmate, and I can’t believe we’re not going to be spending the rest of our
lives together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then don’t leave me!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Forget what I said, I was babbling! Pick me!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: No, you were right, you were right. I mean, I-I-I’ve got to give my
marriage another chance.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No you don’t! No, no, no, I say you have to give your divorce
another chance.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (standing up) I’m sorry. (hugs him)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohhh. Don’t go.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: No, I-I-I gotta go. (she starts to walk away, but Chandler doesn’t
let her go.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. No! No! No!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Honey, honey, people are looking.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t care! (turns around and to the people watching them) I
don’t care!!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Yeah, um, I’m, I’m leaving now. (tries to get her leg out of
Chandler’s grasp, she finally does, but Chandler takes off her shoe.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can’t leave! I have your shoe!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Good-bye Chandler Bing. (walks out with one shoe)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Rachel has those in burgendy.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Joey, Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, and Ross are holding the
giant poking device.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right now remember, something this big and long is going to be
difficult to manuver, fortunately I have a lot of experience in that area.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can we please focus here, a naked man’s life hangs in the balance!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m telling you he’s dead. What we are about to have here is a
dead fat guy on a stick.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, ladies and gentlemen, let’s poke. (they start to advance
the giant poking device) Steady. Steady. Okay, a little higher. Careful of the angle.
Okay, okay, we’re approaching the window (as he says this the camera cuts to their
view of Ugly Naked Guy, so that we actually see him!) Thread the needle. Thread the
needle.
(They thread the needle and start poking him, he then stirs.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He’s alive! He’s a-live!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And yet, we’re still poking him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, retract the device, retract the device.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He does not look happy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey-hey, now he’s showing us his poking device.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, that’s never gonna make it all the way over here, buddy!

title: The One with the Football

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the whole gang is there, the guys are
watching football, the girls are cooking Thanksgiving dinner.]

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: (reacting to a play) Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Awww!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, it’s your Thanksgiving too, y'know, instead of watching
football, you could help.

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: We will. (they don’t move)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Rachel, you wanna put the marshmellows in concentric circles.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Mon, you want to put them in concentric circles. I want
to do this.
(Rachel sticks a marshmellow into Monica’s nose. Monica takes it out of her nose
by closing one nostril, and blowing.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Every year.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know, for once, I am going to sit down and try to watch one of these
things. (just as she sits down).

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Halftime.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, who wants to ah, throw the ball around a little, maybe get a little
three on three going?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! That would be sooo much fun!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, can I play too? I’ve never played football, like ever.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great, you can cover Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no, I don’t, I don’t really wanna play.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on man! You never want to do anything since you and Janice broke up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s not true! I wanted to wear my bathrobe and eat peanut
clusters all day. I wanted to start drinking in the morning. Don’t say that I
don’t have goals!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, you have to start getting over her. All right, if you play, you
get some fresh air, maybe it’ll take your mind off Janice, and if you don’t
play, everyone will be mad at you ‘cause the teams won’t be even. Come on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, all right, I’ll play.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yay!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let’s do it! Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you wanna play football?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Um, Monica and I aren’t supposed to play football.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Says who? Your mom?

lines.speaker: Monica and Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, every, every Thanksgiving um, we used to have a touch football
game called the ‘Geller Bowl.’

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no, you say that proudly.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Anyway, Ross and I were always captains, and um, it got kind’ve
competitive and one year, Geller Bowl VI, I accidentally broke Ross’s nose.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was soo not an accident. She saw I was about to tag her, so she
threw her big fat grandma arm elbow right into my face. And just keep running.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: To score the winning touchdown, by the way.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, ho, ho, ho, you did not win the game, the touchdown
didn’t count, because of the spectacularly illegal, oh and by the way savage nose
breaking.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Chandler and Joey) I won the game.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah! Then how come you didn’t get the Geller Cup?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um, there was a Geller Cup?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, it was the trophy you got if you won the game. But our Dad said,
‘nobody won that game, ‘ and he was sick of our fighting, so he took the trophy
and.... (pauses to collect himself, as he is on the verge of tears saying this) threw it
in the lake.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And was the curse lifted?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway. That’s when our Mom said we were not to play football ever
again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what, I think we should play a game. I mean come on, it’s
been twelve years.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can I see you for a second?
(they walk over to the sink and discuss it for a moment)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shouting) Once!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, we’re gonna play.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But wait a minute though, how are we gonna get there, though, because
my Mom won’t let me cross the street.

scenes.location: The Park, the gang is warming up for their football game.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Let’s bring it in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait no, honey, honey throw it to me, throw it to me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here you go. (throws her the ball)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (knocking it down instead of catching it) That almost hit me in the
face.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, we have to pick captains.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And then Tineals.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so how do we decide that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, why don’t we just bunny up.
Rachel, Chandler, and Joey: What?

lines.speaker: Monica and Ross
lines.text: (holding both of their hands above their heads making rabbit
ears with their fingers.) Bunny!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, looks like Ross and I are captains. Okay, so um, I bunnied first
so that means I get to pick first. Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, I’m your best friend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sweetie, don’t worry you’ll get picked. Chandler.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe.
(Phoebe kisses Rachel on the cheek, then joins her team.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sweetie, now I pick you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don’t pick me! You’re stuck with me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. All right. So let’s see, let’s play from the trash can, to
the lightpost. Right. Two hand touch, we’ll kick off.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right people listen, I’ve got exactly twenty-eight minutes
before I have to baste again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! Just like in the pros.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Huddle up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to his team) All right, huddle up, right over here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait for me! Wait for me! Wait for me! Oh cool, this is my first huddle.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so what do you guys really think of Chandler?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Phoebe you know what you’re doing right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Joey’s gonna catch it, and you and I are gonna block.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s block?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, I thought you said you know what you’re doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I thought you meant in life.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Break.
(Chandler is getting ready to kick off, Ross is holding the ball between his foot and
finger.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The ball is Janice. The ball is Janice. (goes to kick the ball but
kicks Ross’s foot instead.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oww!! Son of a...!! Ow! Come on!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry. I’m sorry. Y'know what, we’re just gonna throw it.
(Chandler throws the ball to kick-off.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I got it. (catches the ball)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Go! Go! Go!
(Joey runs up field and fakes out Ross and scores a touchdown. His team all celebrates
the touchdown.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Score!! 7 to nothing!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (coming over to Ross, who is just getting up) Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, let’s go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Losers walk!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, losers talk!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no, actually losers rhyme.
[cut to later, Ross’s team has the ball.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (coming up under center, just like a real quarterback does, and puts
his hands between Ross’s legs.) Twenty-three!! Seventy-four!! (Ross stands up and
looks at him) You wanna go shotgun?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (from the shotgun) Hike!

lines.speaker: Monica and Joey
lines.text: One-Mississippi. Two-Mississippi. Three-Mississippi.
(Rachel runs a quick slant.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Over here!
(Chandler throws her the ball, which she drops.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (proud of her self) I almost caught that one!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great! Now, the score is 7 to almost 7.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, (to Chandler) this play, I want you to do a down and out to the
right. Okay. Break!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, what am I gonna do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You, you go long.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, how long?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Until we start to look very small.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Break!!
[cut to later, Monica’s team has the ball.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Set....hike!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: One-Mississippi, two-Mississippi, switch! Switch! Switch!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no!
(Monica throws the ball over Joey’s head, it’s stopped from rolling away by a
very beautiful woman.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Haaaaa! Hey-hey, thanks for stopping our ball.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (in a foreign accent) You are playing American football?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Wow, your like from a whole other country.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m Dutch.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi-hi, I’m Joey.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m Margha.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sorry Dutch, I didn’t get that last little bit.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (running up) Hey Joey, do you wanna play football or you wanna.. (sees
Marhan) Hi, I’m Chandler.

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: Hello, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Her name is Dutch, and also Marklan.

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: Margha.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mar-klan.

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: Mar-gha.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mar-haaaan.
[cut to Ross and Monica.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on guys! Let’s go! Come on, it’s second down.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, hello, it’s third down.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No it’s not, it’s second.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It just amazes me that your still pulling stuff like this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pulling what? It’s second down.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, it’s second down. (turns away) Take all the second downs you
need.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I heard that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I said it loud.
[cut to Chandler, Joey, and Margha.]

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: It is okay, if I stay and watch?

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Why don’t you stick around. You can sit right
there.
(she goes and sits down)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, that went well.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I was thinking about ah, asking her for her number.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks man, but I think it makes a stronger statement if I ask for it
myself, y'know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa-ho, whoa! No, I was thinking about y'know for me, as a part of
that whole getting over Janice thing you were talking about.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah, that. All right, means that much to ya, I’ll let you have
her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks. What, let me have her?! What do mean? Like if you didn’t
I wouldn’t have a shot?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well I don’t like to say it out loud, but, yeah! Don’t feel bad
man, we all have our strengths. You’re better with numbers and stuff.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Math!! You’re giving me math! All right, look y'know what, forget
about it, you go for the girl, we’ll see who gets her.
[cut to later, in Ross’s huddle.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler, I want you to run a post pattern to the left, okay. And
sweetie..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I know, go long. Y'know, it’s like all I’m doing is
running back and forth from the huddle.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well ah, you wanna just stay out there?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can I see that for second.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.
(Rachel takes the ball from his hands and bounces it off of Ross’s forehead and
Chandler catches the rebound.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Hut! Hike!
(Chandler runs around behind Ross, who pitches him the ball. Chandler runs upfield, and
Joey knocks the ball out of his hands.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fumble!
(Joey starts to return the fumble and Chandler grabs Joey’s shirt and rips it off
of his back.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What the hell’s the matter with you?! This is my favourite jersey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well now you have two. Hey, I am good at math.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, that’s it. Y'know I was still gonna let you have her. But
now, forget about it. Prepare to feel very bad about yourself.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Well, I’ve been preparing for that my entire life! Or
something about you that’s mean!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, come on guys, let’s go! Tie score, and we’re
runnin’ out of time. Forty-two!! Thirty-eight!! Hike! (the timer sounds as Monica
throws the ball to Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh I got it!! (catches the ball) Oh! Ew! Broken boob! Ow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs, run!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Run, Phoebe, run!
(Phoebe runs and scores a touchdown.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Touchdown!! Touchdown!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, hello, the buzzer buzzed. It doesn’t count.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: After the snap!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Before the snap!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: After!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Before!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now, does it really matter?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, okay, I made a touchdown. It was my first touchdown. So?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh Pheebs, that’s great. It doesn’t count.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Does so count!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Cheater, cheater, compulsive eater.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what, that’s fine, maybe you haven’t grown up, but I
have.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-ho, okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Dead leg!! (kicks him in the thigh.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ow! Ow! Okay, okay, fine, fine! All right, you wanna win by cheating, go
ahead, all right. Phoebe the touchdown does count, you win.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Woo-yay!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Listen, I’m not gonna go through this with you again, okay.
Just once I wanna beat when you can’t blame it on the broken nose, the buzzer, or the
fact that you thought you were getting mono. Let’s just call this, tie score and
it’s halftime.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, first of all, I don’t play with cheaters, and second of all,
you know I had swollen glands!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what? I’ll think you’ll play.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh really! Why is that?
[cut to Monica and Rachel’s.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because the winner gets this!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The Geller Cup.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is everybody else seeing a troll doll nailed to a two by four?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, good.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The park, the gang is returning to play the second half of the game.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, where in the hell did you get that?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When Mom and Dad drove you to the hospital to get your nose fixed, I
swam into the lake and fished it out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That cup is mine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No it’s not! You want it, you’re gonna have to win it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, so are we not having dinner at all?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on Phoebe, let’s go! Come on, it’s time to get serious,
huddle up. Joey, keep your head in the game.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s hard, y'know, his huddle is closer to Dutch girl.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right look, if I take Chandler out of the running will you be able
to focus?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, you just make sure that Chandler catches the ball, I’ll
take care of the rest.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Break!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here you go!
(Joey throws the ball to Chandler)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler! Chandler!
(Chandler catches the ball and starts to run upfield.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Margha) Hi.
(just as he gets in front of Margha, Monica comes up and tackles him)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whoa! Whoa!! Tackled by a girl! Bet ya don’t see that everyday, do
ya?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! What’s with the tackling?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! I just touched him and he went over.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, you wanna play rough, we can play rough.
(They both stare each other down as we hear ‘Let’s get ready to
(A long football sequence follows.)
[Sequence 1: Monica throws the ball over Chandler’s head to Joey who catches it
for a touchdown, and starts to dance in celebration. Chandler then tackles him, and he
starts to dance in celebration.]
[Sequence 2: Monica runs upfield and stops, waiting for a pass. Ross runs over and
pulls her pants down, steps in front of her and intercepts the pass.]
[Sequence 3: Chandler throws a pass to Ross, who catches it. Phoebe starts screaming
and runs up to him and tries to tackle him. But all she ends up doing is running around
his waist and screaming.]
[Sequence 4: Ross hikes the ball to Chandler, and the camera pans down to show Rachel
standing deep in the end zone, playing with her gum. Something hits her on the head and
she looks up to see where it came from.]
[Sequence 5: Monica hands the ball off to Phoebe, who runs up field and delivers a
fore-arm shiver to Chandler, knocking him over and scores the touchdown, and she yells...]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I love this game!!
[cut to Ross who walks up to Rachel who is eating a baked pretzel.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, where’d you get that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I went really long.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Forty-two to twenty-one! Like the turkey, Ross is done!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s no surprise that your winning, ‘cause you got to pick
first, so you got the better team.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re so pathetic! Why can’t you just accept it, we’re
winning because I’m better than you.
(Ross makes a ‘Yeah. Right.’ sound.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, what a great argument, exhaling! All right, y'know what, I’ll
prove it to you, okay. I’ll trade you Joey for Rachel, and I’ll still win the
game.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! The guys against the girls? See, that’s ridiculous Monica,
because I’m only down by three touchdowns.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, then bring it on! Oh, unless of course your afraid you might lose to
a bunch of girls.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, fine, Rachel your with Monica, Joey you’re with me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can not believe your trading me!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on Rach, come on. Let’s see what’s it like to be on a
winning team for a change.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you gonna let me play?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right then.
[cut to the guys’ team.]

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: (coming over) The game is over, we eat now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no, the game’s not over, we’re just switching
teams.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, Chandler finds me so intimdating that it’s better if we’re
on the same team.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right. Okay, let’s play. Let’s go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No ah, hold on a second Joe, where do Dutch people come from?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah well, the ah, Pennsylvania Dutch, come from Pennsylvania.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And the other ah, Dutch people, they come on from somewhere near the
Netherlands, right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice try. (to Margha) See the Netherlands is this make believe place where
Peter Pan and Tinker Bell come from.

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: Oh, my.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Enough with geography for the insane, okay? Let’s play some ball,
guys.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, no, no, I-I’m not playing with this guy, now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine with me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, y'know what, let’s just cut to the chase here. Okay? Heidi,
which of my boys do you like?

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: What are you doing? What are you doing? What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: Which do I like?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, y'know for dating, general merriment, taking back to your
windmill...

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: Well, if I had to chose right now, which by the way I find really weird,
I would have to say, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait a minute! Wait a minute! She obviously didn’t understand the
question.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you don’t you have Captain Hook explain it to her.

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: I’m sorry, Joey, that is my chose.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You hear that! That is her chose, mister I’ll let you have her! I
win! You suck! I rule all! A mini-wave in celebration of me!! (does the wave.)

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: I’m now thinking I would like to change my answer to, no one.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: Margha
lines.text: I now find you shallow and um, a dork. All right, bye.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice going. You just saved yourself a couple months of sex.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what, it doesn’t matter, ‘cause she picked me. Me!
From now on I get the dates and you have to stay home on Saturday nights watching Ready,
Set, Cook!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Save the breakthroughs for therapy, okay. The clock is ticking. We have no
time, and we are losing, we are losing to girls.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’re not gonna lose to girls.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This sucks, I was just up by that much!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are we playing football or what? Come on you hairy-backed Marries.
[cut to the girls huddle.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We have to do this. We are playing for women everywhere. Okay, just
think about every lousy date that you ever had, okay, every guy who kept on the TV while
you’re making out...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! You dated someone with a glass eye too?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on, okay, come on this is for all womankind. Let’s kill

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!!! Kill ‘um!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, no, well I want to kill them to, but their boys, y'know how
are we gonna beat three boys?
(Another football sequence follows)
[Sequence 1: Chandler is running past Phoebe with the ball, Phoebe flashes him, he
stops and stares dumbfounded at her. Phoebe then runs up and takes the ball away.]
[Sequence 2: Phoebe throws the ball, and it’s intercepted by Joey, who starts to
run up field. Rachel jumps on his back in order to try and tackle him, but she
doesn’t slow him down. Monica and Phoebe then both grab her legs in order to stop
Joey, who still manages to fight through the tackle and score the touchdown.]
[Sequence 3: Chandler is running with the ball, Phoebe flashes him again, but Chandler
covers his eyes, and keeps running. He then runs into a tree at the end of the field.]
[cut to the girls huddle]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, we still have a minute and a half to go, and we’re down
by two points. Two points.... (she gets interrupted by the guys, who are doing a
slow-motion high five.) Phoebe you do a button-hook again. Rachel, you go long.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Come on! Don’t make me go long. Use me. They never cover me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, there’s a reason.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God, I’m not lame, okay. I can do something. I can throw, would you
let me throw, come on this is my game too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on Mon, let her throw the ball.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right Rachel, you sweep behind, I’ll pitch it to you, you throw
it down field to Phoebe. All right. Break.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you! Break!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thirty-two! Seventy-one! Hike!
(Phoebe snaps the ball to Monica, who pitches back to Rachel.)

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: One-Mississippi! Two-Mississippi! Three-Mississippi!
(They all rush toward Rachel, who panics and runs away. She runs out of the park and up
along the fence, she then comes back into the park and runs past Monica, as she gets to
Monica, she throws the ball at Monica, and it hits her in the eye.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m so sorry! Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! I’m not okay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry, they were just all coming at me, and I didn’t know
what to do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking at the timer) Thirty seconds left on the timer!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, okay, so we get to take that stupid troll thing home!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on! Come on! Hurry! We’re running out of time! Huddle up!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Oooh! Oh, this is our last huddle, yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, Phoebe get open. Rachel, go long.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the verge of tears) Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Break!
(In slow motion, Phoebe snaps the ball, Rachel goes long. Joey and Chandler and all
over Phoebe, leaving Rachel wide open. Ross starts to rush Monica, who sees Phoebe is
double covered, in desperation she throws to Rachel. We see flying through the air, and
then Rachel running underneath it, then the ball, then Rachel again, then the ball, then
Phoebe, Chandler, and Joey staring at it in shock. Then with the grace of Jerry Rice (no
offense to Jerry Rice), Rachel catches the ball, and she stops and spikes the ball. Both
Phoebe and Monica erupt in celebration.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (in triumph) I got a touchdown! We did it!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey Rachel, funny thing. Actually, the ah, end zone starts at
that pole, so you’re five feet short, so we win!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait-wait-wait-wait! So, explain something to me though, if, if nobody
tagged Rachel, then isn’t the play still going.
(they all start to dive for the ball and Monica and Ross grab it at the same time.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let go! Let go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let go! I’m a tiny little woman!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Guys! Guys! Come on! It’s Thanksgiving, it’s not important
who wins or loses. The important thing is, (to Joey) the Dutch girl picked me! Me! Not
you! Holland loves Chandler! Thank you, Amsterdam! Good night!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ow!!

title: The One Where Rachel Quits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler and Rachel are sitting on the couch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reading the comics) Eh..., I don’t, I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, as old as he is in dog years, do you think Snoopy should still
be allowed to fly this thing?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Do you remember when you first came here, how you spent two weeks
getting trained by another waitress?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, sure! Do you need me to train somebody new?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (laughs) Good one. Actually, ah, Terry wants you to take the training
again, whenever.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Chandler) Eh, do you believe that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (thinks about it) Yeah?
Opening Credits
[Scene: The hallway of Ross’s building, there is a Brown Bird girl selling
cookies, as Ross and Chandler come up the stairs.]

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: So that’s two boxes of the Holiday Macaroons. On behalf of the Brown
Birds of America, I salute you. (Does the Brown Bird salute, she blows on a bird call,
then holds her hand, palm facing out, next to her face, and then waves it like a bird
flapping it’s wings.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just admit it Chandler, you have no backhand.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Excuse me little one, I have a very solid backhand.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shielding your face and shrieking like a girl... is not a backhand.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was shrieking... like a Marine.
(they both start up the stairs.)
