lines.text: Oh! Since tomorrow. I met this really cute guy in the park and he like
y'know, jogs, and blades, and swims, and so y'know we made a deal that’s he’s
going to teach me all sorts of jock stuff.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And what are you going to do for him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m going to let him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Cool.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from her bedroom) Morning.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Somebody got in late last night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah well, I ran into Richard.
(They all gasp)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: When did this happen?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, um, around 8:02. We ah, talked for a little while, and then um, we
went out for an innocent burger.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, there’s no such thing as an innocent burger.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, are you gonna see him again?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, she spent the last six months getting over him, and now
she’s celebrating that by going on a date with him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s not a date, okay. I’m just gonna teach him how to make
lasagne for some pot luck dinner he has.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, you might wanna make a little extra, y'know you’ll probably be
hungry after the sex.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re not gonna have sex! Okay, nothing’s changed here. He
still doesn’t want children and I still do, so that’s why we’re just gonna
be friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Naked friends.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is watching TV.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you have any ice?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Check the freezer. If there’s none in there, then we’re probably
out. Are you just getting in from work? It’s late.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I know. I had the greatest day though, I got to sit in on the
meeting with the reps from Calvin Klien. I told my boss I liked this line of
lingerie, she ordered a ton of it. How was your day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I discovered I’m able to count all of my teeth using just my tongue.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmm. (she opens the freezer) Umm, why do you have a copy of The
Shining in your freezer?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I was reading it last night, and I got scared, so.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But ah, you’re safe from it if it’s in the freezer?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, safer. Y'know, I mean I never start reading The Shining,
without making sure we’ve got plenty of room in the freezer, y'know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How often do you read it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Haven’t you ever read the same book over and over again?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, umm, I guess I read Little Women more than once. But I mean
that’s a classic, what’s so great about The Shining?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The question should be Rach, what is not so great about The
Shining. Okay? And the answer would be: nothing. All right? This is like the scariest
book ever. I bet it’s way better than that classic of yours.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Ah, well we’ll just see about that, okay. I will read The
Shining, (she tries to take the book away from him but he doesn’t want to let it
go) and you will read Little Women.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, you got it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, now Rach, these ah, these little women.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How little are they? I mean, are they like scary little?
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Ross are there, Phoebe is entering with her date
Robert.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um, Chandler, Ross, this is Robert.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, hey.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Robert) You’ve have lipstick right here (points to her cheek).
That’s okay, it’s mine, we just kissed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Robert) So ah, isn’t a bit cold out for shorts?

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Well, I’m from California.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right, right. Sometimes you guys just burst into flames.
(Robert leans back on the arm of the chair and allows Chandler to see up his shorts and
sees ‘little Robert.’ Chandler is horrified by this view.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (standing up) I’m up! I’m up, I’ve gotten up now!
Anybody ah, want anything?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’ll have coffee.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Yeah, me too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, make that three.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay Ross, why don’t you come with me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (goes over to the counter) (to Chandler) What ah, what is the matter
with you? What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Robert’s coming out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, what do you mean, what? Is he gay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. He.....he’s coming out of his shorts.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The man is showing brain.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you sure? (Chandler nods: Yes!) Hold on. (walks over behind the couch)
I’m sorry you guys, that was a coffee and a....

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Coffee.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: We could write it down for you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, that won’t be ah, that won’t be necessary (leans down
and looks up Robert’s shorts, seeing Robert’s package.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) Wellll?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What do we do? What do we do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I suppose we just try to not look directly at it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Like an eclipse.
(Ross nods his head.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is teaching Richard how to make lasagne.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: So when people complement me on my cooking should I, what do I say?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You say ‘Thank you very much,’ and then you buy me something
pretty. Come on, we’re gonna put are hands in this bowl, and we’re gonna start
squishing the tomatoes.
(They both start squishing the tomatoes.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Ew, this feels very weird.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You touch people’s eyeballs every day and this feels weird.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Yeah, well, sure I touch them, but I spent years learning not to squish
them. (Monica grabs his hand in the tomatoes.) That’s my hand.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oops.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Gotta keep squishing.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Tomatoes are squishing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
(Richard squishes a little too hard and some lands on his shirt.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Op.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, gosh, you got some on your shirt.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hold on a second, just put a little club soda on it (does so) and it
should umm, be.....
(She is rubbing his chest and her voice trails off into silence, a long pause follows.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, you’ve got some on your pants.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I’ll just throw them out.
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler is watching Joey read Little Women, Ross is also
there.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: These little women. Wow!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Your liking it, huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah! Amy just burned Jo’s manuscript. I don’t see how he
could ever forgive her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, Jo’s a girl, it’s short for Josephine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But Jo’s got a crush on Laurie. (Ross nods his head) Oh. You mean
it’s like a girl-girl thing? ‘Cause that is the one thing missing from The
Shining.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, actually Laurie’s a boy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No wonder Rachel had to read this so many times.
(Enter Phoebe and Robert)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! How’d the ah, basketball go?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, I learned how to shoot a lay-up, a foul shot, and a
twenty-three pointer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean a three pointer?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I get more because I’m dainty.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: So um, is there a phone here, I can check my messages?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, in the back. You want a quarter?

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Oh, no thanks. I always carry one in my sock.
(He puts his leg up on the couch to get the quarter, once again exposing himself to
Chandler and Ross. In horror, Chandler, slides over and leans against Joey on the couch.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (noticing Chandler) What are you doing? (he pushes Chandler back to his
side of the couch) Get back over on your side of the... (sees Robert in all his glory)
Hello!! (to Robert) Hi, I’m Joey, we haven’t met.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Ah, good to meet you. Robert.
(Robert walks away and the guys all start laughing in front of Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? (the guys keep laughing.) What? You guys, what is going on? You
not like Robert? (the guys keep laughing.) Why are you laughing?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Calm down. There’s no reason to get testy.
(The guys start laughing harder.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys!! Come on!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry, I’m sorry, it just seems that Robert isn’t
as concealed in the shorts area, as ah, one may have hoped.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Hey. (sits down)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Robert, could you ah, ha, pass me those cookies?

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Sure.
(He puts his leg up on the table to pass Joey the cookies, and Phoebe sees what the
guys are laughing at, and gasps.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is talking to Richard on the phone.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, how’d the lasagne go over? (listens) Really?! Good. So you owe
me three pretty things. (listens) Yeah, I’ve been thinking a lot about you too.
(listens) I know. It’s hard this whole platonic thing. (listens) It’s a word!
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I do think it’s better this way. (listens) Yeah, we’re
being smart. (gets up to answer the door) (listens) Yes, I’m sure.(she opens the door
and it’s Richard)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: You really sure?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’ll call you back. (starts kissing him)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica’s bedroom, she’s in bed with Richard.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So we can be friends who sleep together.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Absolutely, this will just be something we do, like racquetball.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sounds smart and healthy to me. So um, just out of curiosity, um, do you
currently have any other racquetball buddies?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Just your dad. (pause) Although that’s actually racquetball. You
know I-I do have a blind date with my sister’s neighbour next Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: You want me to cancel it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! (pushes him) No!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ‘Cause if you do that means you’d be cancelling it for me, and
we’re just friends.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Exactly. (pushes her back)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Robert is picking up Phoebe for a date.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey. Ooh! Don’t sit down!

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: You ready to go to the batting cage?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. And, first here’s a gift.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Oh! Wow! Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stretchy pants! Why, those are the greatest things in the world! If I
were you I would wear them every day, every day!

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Jeez, thank you really that is so nice. But um, to be honest, I
don’t think I can wear these, they’re so tight, I feel like I’m on display.
I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s all right, that’s well, I figured.... (they start to
leave as Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: (to Joey) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! (starts to laugh.) How’s it going?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Rach, how you doing with The Shining?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Danny just went into room 217.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oooh, the next part’s the best, when that dead lady in the bathtub...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no, meh-nah-nah-nah, come on you’re gonna ruin it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right I’ll talk in code. (to Ross and Chandler) Remember when the
kid sees those two blanks in the hallway?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hmmm, that’s very cool.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, all blank, and no blank, make’s blank a blank blank. Oh no-no-no,
no, the end when Jack almost kills them all with that blank, but then at last second they
get away. Aww!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! I can’t believe you just did that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t believe she cracked your code!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, okay, Laurie proposes to Jo, and she says no, even though
she’s still in love with him, and then he ends up marring Amy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Mine was by accident! All right, the boiler explodes and destroys the
hotel, and kills the dad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Eh. Beth dies.
(Joey recoils and gasps in horror.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Beth, Beth dies?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is that true? If I keep reading is Beth gonna die?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, Beth doesn’t die, she doesn’t die. Does she Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey’s asking if you’ve just ruined the first book he’s
ever loved that didn’t star Jack Nicholson?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. She doesn’t die.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then why would you say that?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because, I wanted to hurt you.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: (running in) Oh, there they are! I-I dropped my keys.
(He bends over to pick them up, right in front of Rachel, who then gets a free peep
show.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Oh my....

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Got ‘em.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is reading The Shining, as Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (screams and grabs a potato masher to defend herself) Sorry. I’m
sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You would not believe my day! I had to work two shifts, and then to top
it off, I lost one of my fake boobs, (opens her coat revealing a large burn mark over her
left breast.) in a grill fire.
(Rachel starts laughing.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you smiling at?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry, I was just thinking you’re day could still pick up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, right.
(She goes into her bedroom, and sees Richard who has covered the room in roses and has
two glasses of wine and a rose between his lips.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love this friend thing!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe, Chandler, and Ross are there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Listen, Robert’s gonna be here any second so, will one of you just
tell him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Please, right now, no, every time I see him it’s like ‘Is it
on the lose?’ ‘Is it watching me?’

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We can’t tell him, you can’t go up to a guy you barely know
and talk about his.... stuff.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He’s right, even if it’s to say something complementary. (He
stops and thinks about what he just said.)

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: (to Phoebe) So are ready for the gym? They’ve got this new rock
climbing wall, we can spot each other.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I can spot you from here.

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, listen Robert...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Chandler) Hey, don’t we have to...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we got, um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, I think you’re really, really great...

lines.speaker: Robert
lines.text: Oh God! Here we go again. Why does this keep happening to me? (spreads
his legs) Is it something I’m putting out there? Is this my fault? Or am I just nuts?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I-I-I-I don’t know, I don’t know what to say.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (cleaning up the table) (to Robert) Hey buddy, this is a family place,
put the mouse back in the house.
(Robert looks down and realises the problem.)
[Scene: Richard’s bedroom, Monica has covered it in rose pedals and candles. We
hear Richard come in to the apartment, and Monica frantically throws the rest of the
pedals on the bed, and jumps onto the bed and puts a rose in her mouth, and bites a
thorn.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: (outside the bedroom) Really?! Well, it’s just like everyone
else’s apartment. It’s got rooms, walls, and ceilings.
Richard’s Date: Well, I just wanted to see where you lived. Now, give me
the tour.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God! (She frantically tries to clean up the bedroom as
Richard starts the tour.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Ah well, this is the living room.
Richard’s Date: Impressive.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: All right. This is the kitchen.
Richard’s Date: Oh, that’s real pretty. Wait a minute, don’t I
get to see the bedroom?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: The bedroom. Well it’s pretty much your typical... (opens the door
as Monica hides under the covers, and quickly closes the door before his date can see the
room.) bedroom.
Richard’s Date: We’re still on this side of the door.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Um-hmm.
Richard’s Date: Yeah, but I didn’t get to see it.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh shoot! Maybe next time. (yawns) Thanks for a lovely evening. (shows
her out)
[Cut to into the bedroom, with Monica still hiding under the covers. Richard enters and
sits down next to her.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (still hiding under the blankets) So um, who was she?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh, (laughs) that was the blind date that I told you about, she called
and switched it to today.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (still hiding under the blankets) Did you like her? And I’m just
asking as a friend, because I am totally fine with this.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well, you seem fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (gets up) Okay, y'know what, I’m not fine, I’m not. I mean how
can I be fine, hearing you come in with her, she wants to see your bedroom.... (pause)
Y'know what, what if we’re friends who don’t see other people?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: You mean like exclusive friends?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?! I mean this has been the most amazing week. Would it be so
terrible? Even if we were friends who lived together. Or, maybe someday friends who stood
up in front of their other friends, and vowed to be friends forever.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Wow. Y'know we’re back where we were. Honey, I would love to do
all that, but nothing’s changed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s not true, you don’t have a moustache.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Okay, okay, one thing’s changed. But we still want different
things and we know how this is gonna end.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what, I’ve got to walk out of here right now, ‘cause
getting over you is the hardest thing that I have ever had to do. I don’t think I
could do it again.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I know I couldn’t. So....
(Monica kisses him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How ‘bout one last game of racquetball?
(They both kiss, and Richard picks her up and goes over to the bed and starts to lie
down.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Watch the thorns!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: (lying down) Ow!!

title: The One with Phoebe's Ex-Partner

scenes.location: Central Perk, the gang, except Rachel, is watching a new singer.

lines.speaker: Singer
lines.text: (singing) ‘Cause every time I see your face, I can’t help but
fall from grace. I know.....

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! This girl is good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh-ho yeah! A song with rhyming words. Oo, I never thought of that
before.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I like her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Chandler) Why? Because she can sing and play guitar and do both at
the same time?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, that’s pretty much all I’m looking for from these
people.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Look at you. All jealous.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah Pheebs, come on, you two have completely different styles. Y'know,
she’s more..(shakes his shoulders, like he’s dancing) y'know, and you’re
more (sees the look from Phoebe and stops)

lines.speaker: Singer
lines.text: (singing) beside meeeee-eeee-ee. (everyone applauds her).

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, see, see, everyone else is happy she’s done.

lines.speaker: Singer
lines.text: Okay, my next song’s called: Phoebe Buffay, What Can I Say. I
Really Loved When We Were Singing Partners, And I Shouldn’t Have Left You That Way.
(The gang all looks at Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, one of those ‘look for the hidden meaning’ songs.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, later.

lines.speaker: Singer
lines.text: Hey Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Leslie, how’d you know I’d be here?

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: I ran into Vlad at the place where they sell the big fish, and he said
you played here a lot, so umm....

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) All right listen, I have to go to the bathroom, but if the
place with the big fish comes up again. I’d like know whether that’s several big
fish or just one big fish.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Leslie) So ah, Phoebe tells us you write jingles.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Actually I said she abandoned me to write jingles.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Leslie) Ah, anything we might of heard of?

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Ah, yeah, umm. (singing) Home is never far away..
Monica, Ross, and Joey: (joining in) Home is Home Star stew.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Yeah, but, I don’t do that anymore. I got kinda sick of it, and
then I couldn’t come up with anything good, so they fired me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm, bummer.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Well, I y'know, I was just, umm, I was just thinking and hoping, that
umm, maybe you’d want to get back together?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. But thanks.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Aw come on Phoebe would you just think about it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. No. But thanks.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Okay, ah, see ya Pheebs. (leaves)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Wow, that was kinda brutal.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well okay, let this be a lesson to all of you, all right. Once you, once
you betray me, I become like the ice woman, y’know. Very cold, hard, unyielding,
y'know nothing, nothing can penetrate this icy exterior. (to Monica) Can I have a
tissue, please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, sure.

scenes.location: Outside the bathroom, Chandler is pacing back and fourth, waiting is use it.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (to Chandler) Someone in there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. This is just part of a dare devil game that I play called
‘wait until the last moment before I burst and die.’
(The door opens.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Jeez, man did you fall..(sees it’s a beautiful woman coming out
of the men’s room) Hi! So ah, did ya, did-did-did ya fall high?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Someone was in the lady's room, I couldn’t wait. I left the lid up
for ya though.
(Gunther walks up)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Gunther) Y'know what Gunther, go ah, go ahead, I’m-I’m
talking to ah, (tries to get her to say her name). (to her) This is the part where you say
your name.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Ginger.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ginger. I’m talking to Ginger, so....

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Don’t you have to use the bathroom?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nope, nope, I’d just ah, I’d rather talk to you. (pause)
Yes, I do. Yes, I do have to go to the bathroom. (knocks on the door)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Someone in here.

scenes.location: Central Perk, the gang’s putting their coats on to leave.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where’s Chandler?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, he can’t make it, he said he had to his... (sees Ginger) Whoa-oh!
(hides behind the coat rack.)

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Joey? Joey Tribbiani?
(She walks over behind the coat rack, but Joey picks it up and moves it so that
he’s still behind it, and she can’t see him.)

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Joey I can see you okay? You’re hiding behind the coats.
(Joey puts his finger over his mouth to tell Ross to keep quiet. Ginger looks at Monica
who looks away and leave.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phew, close one.

scenes.location: Rachel’s office, Mark is packing his stuff into a box.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, sweetie!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Hi, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ve got some bad news.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can get a quick bite to eat, but then I have to come back up here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on sweetie! You’ve had to work late every night for the past two
weeks, what is it this time?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Actually, it’s kinda my fault. I-I quit today.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) But work comes first! (to Mark) Oh hey, but that’s sad
about you though, what happened? Burn out? Burn all out, did ya?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nooo, he’s leaving for a better job.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh well that’s great, so I guess this is ah, this is good bye then.
Huh? (picks a pad up off Rachel’s desk and tosses it into his box) Good bye.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Okay, then.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well we’re gonna miss you around here.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yeah, me too.
(Rachel goes to hug him but Ross is holding one of her hands and doesn’t let go,
so she can only put one arm around him.)

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: So, see ya on Saturday.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, you bet.
(Ross is shocked, but Rachel drags him out of the office.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe and Monica are playing with a Ouija board,
Phoebe’s beeper goes off and Monica screams.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. (takes her beeper puts in a pot, covers it, and puts the pot in the
oven)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know those are a delicacy in India.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, that was Leslie calling again to see if we can get back together.
That’s the twentieth time today! And good luck Leslie!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, she must have hurt you pretty bad, huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, yeah. Y'know, we were best friends, ever since we were little, our
Moms worked on the barge together.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you two must have been so cute running around on a barge.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You never run on a barge!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is ah, is Chandler around?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, umm, he met some girl at the coffee house.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oooh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, Ginger something.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nooo. No, no, ah, are you sure it wasn’t something that sounded like
Ginger, like ah, Gingeer?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it was Ginger. I remember, because when he told me, I said,
(singing) ‘the movie star.’

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aww, man. That’s the girl I was hiding from. When she finds out
he’s my roommate, she’s gonna tell him what I did.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, what did you do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What, oh, oh, oh, no, no, I can’t, I can’t tell you that,
it’s like the most awful, horrible thing I’ve ever done my whole life.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what, don’t tell us. We’ll just wait until Chandler
gets home, (to Phoebe) because it’ll be more fun that way.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right!! Okay, it was like four years ago. Okay, Ginger and I had gone
out a few times, and then this one weekend, we went up to her Dad’s cabin. Just me,
her, and her annoying little dog Pepper. Well that night, I cooked this really romantic
dinner....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You gave her food poisoning!?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I wish. No. After dinner, me, her, and Pepper all fell asleep in front of
the fire. Well I woke up in the middle of the night and I saw that the fire was dying out.
So, I picked up a log and threw it on. Or, at least what I thought was a log.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!! You threw Pepper on the fire!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I wish. See, I guess another thing I probably should’ve told you
about Ginger is that she kinda has a ah, artificial leg.
(Phoebe and Monica both stand up and gasp.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Joey, what did you do after you threw her leg on the fire?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I ran!!

scenes.location: A street, Chandler is kissing Ginger.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, that’s the best kiss I’ve had with anyone I’ve
ever met in a men’s room.

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Actually, me too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sees her foot is in a slush puddle) Op, foot in a puddle, foot all in
a puddle.

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Oh damn, I hate that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we’re gonna have to get you out of those shoes.

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Oh, don’t worry about it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, really you’re gonna freeze.

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: No, I’m not.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re not, what do you, what do you got a bionic foot?

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Some day, maybe.

scenes.location: Ross’s bedroom, Rachel getting into bed while Ross is reading and laughs.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Funny book?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmmm. Oh, no, no, I just thinking about something funny I heard today.
Umm, Mark, Mark saying ‘I’ll see you Saturday.’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, at the lecture, I told you that last week, you said you
didn’t mind.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no, it’s-it’s not the lecture ah, I mind, umm....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, please tell me it’s not because I’m going with Mark.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!!! Ross!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’m sorry, but ah, look if you’re not working with him
anymore, why do you have to still do stuff with him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because, he’s my friend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, but do you really need another friend? I mean...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well if I stop playing with Joey and Chandler, can I play with
Mark?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is that funny? Am I supposed to be laughing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, you thought ‘See you Saturday’ was funny.
Look honey, Mark is in fashion okay, I like having a friend that I can share this stuff
with. You guys would never want to go to a lecture with me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pa-haa!! I would love to go with you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really!?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, hey I-I have clothes, I even pick them out. I mean for, for all you
know I could be a fashion..... monger.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Honey, I would love for you to go with me. (Ross has a worried
look on his face) What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What should I wear, now I’m all nervous.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is looking at her beeper still in the pot. She
takes it out, shakes it, and puts it back in.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know they say a watched pot never beeps.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s just y'know, been a couple of hours, and she hasn’t
called. Not that I even care, y'know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe why don’t you just call her? You obviously want to.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You think you know me so well.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, don’t ‘cha wanna?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, well I do know you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s what I said.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well so?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t. I can’t. She dumped me, I mean I totally trusted her
and then one day it was ‘Okay, bye Pheebs’ gone. Y'know what the saddest part
is, when we were playing together, that was like the most fun I’ve ever had in like
all my lives.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Leslie is singing.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: (singing) My best shoes, so good to me. I wear them everyday. Down at
the heel, holes in the toes. Don’t care what people say. My feet’s best friends,
pals to the end. With them I’m one hot chicky. Though late one night, not much light,
(Phoebe runs in and joins her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) I stepped in something icky.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Leslie
lines.text: (singing) Sticky shoes, sticky shoes, always make me smile.
Sticky shoes, sticky shoes, next time I’ll.... avoid the..... pillleeeee.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The lecture, Rachel is listening closely, Ross is bored out of his mind.

lines.speaker: Lecturer
lines.text: We’re beginning to see a lot of layering of sheer fabrics and
colours. For instance a sheer navy blouse over a pink....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) I’m really glad we came. (Rachel smiles and rubs his arm)
You’re so pretty. I love you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. (puts her hand over his mouth)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is teaching Leslie how to sing Smelly Cat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Smelly cat, smelly cat, what are they feeding you? Smelly cat,
smelly cat, it’s not your fault.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Wow, that’s great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah!

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Y'know you could totally sell this. It’d be perfect for like umm, a
kitty litter campaign.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I..., a jingle? No, no-no-no, no.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: What? Why not? You could make a ton of money.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well if I was in this for the money, I’d be a millionaire by
now, y'know. You just got to get out of that jingle head sweetie.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Aw, you’re right, you’re right. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s okay. All right, I’m gonna play song that’s
really, really sad. It’s called Magician Box Mix Up. (she turns her guitar upside
down to play it.)

scenes.location: The lecture, Ross is passed out against Rachel’s shoulder.

lines.speaker: Lecturer
lines.text: ....oversized bracelets, oversized earrings, oversizing of accessories
in general are very popular now.
(Ross wakes up with a start and startles Rachel. The guy next to him starts laughing,
which starts Ross laughing, Rachel gives him a look and he stops.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is reading the newspaper.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, can I borrow this? (points to his milk) My milk’s gone bad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I hate that. I once had a thing of half and half, stole my car.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So umm, how was your date with Ginger?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great. It was great. She’s ah, she’s great, great looking,
great personality, she’s greatness.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sounds like she’s got the ah, whole package.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey told you about the leg, huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh God, it freaked me out. Okay, I know it shouldn’t have, but it
did. I mean I like her, I don’t want to stop seeing her, but every so often it’s
like ‘Hey, y'know what, where’s your leg?’ I mean I’m the smallest
person in the world aren’t I? I’m the smallest person in the world.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering from his bedroom) Morning.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Monica) Actually he’s the smallest person in the world.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Chandler) Heard about the leg burnin’ huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It came up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, I ah, I know it’s a longshot. But, by any chance did she find
that funny?
(Both Chandler and Monica walk away in disgust.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross and Rachel are getting back from the lecture.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) So I nodded off a little.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nodded off!! Ross you were snoring. My father’s boat didn’t
make that much noise when it hit rocks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on! Forty-five minutes! Forty-five minutes the man talked about
strappy backed dresses.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well okay, how about four hours in a freezing museum auditorium
listening to Professor Pitstains and he’s ‘Hey everybody! Remember that thing
that’s been dead for a gazillion years. Well there’s this little bone we
didn’t know it had!’

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: First of all it’s Professor Pittain! And second of all, that little
bone, proved that, that particular dinosaur had wings, but didn’t fly.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, see now, what I just heard: blah-blah-blah,
blah-blah-blah-blah-blah, blah-blah-blah, blah, blah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know what, 100 million people went to see a movie about what I do, I
wonder how many people would go see a movie called, Jurassic Parka.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that is so...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no-no, a bunch of out of control jackets take over an island. (Makes an
unusual sound, then he realises that he still has his jacket on and quickly tries to shake
it off, thinking it’s alive and attacking him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know if what I do is so lame, then why did you insist on coming with
me this morning? Huh? Was it so I just wouldn’t go with Mark?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. I... I wanted to be with you. I don’t know, I feel like lately, I
feel like you’re slipping away from me, y'know. With this new job, and all these new
people, and you’ve got this whole other life going on. I-I-I know it’s dumb, but
I hate that I’m not a part of it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s not dumb. But, maybe it’s okay that you’re not a
part of it. Y'know what I mean? (Ross looks confused) I mean it’s like, I-I-I like
that you’re not involved in that part of my life.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s a little clearer.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey see, it doesn’t mean that I don’t love you. Because I
do. I love you, I love you so much. But my work it’s-it’s for me y'know,
I’m out there, on my own, and I’m doing it and it’s scary but I love it,
because it’s mine. I, but, I mean is that okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, I-I-I... (hugs her and mouths No!!)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler and Ginger are eating dinner.

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Your thinking about my leg aren’t you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. No. Actually I forgot, what is the deal with that again?

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: It’s okay if it bothers you. Really. I mean the only thing I need
to know is: ‘How much it bothers you?’ because I don’t like wasting my
time. Am I wasting my time?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. No. I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Okay. It’s just like anything else, you just have to get used to
it.
(They start making out. She opens his shirt and feels inside and stops.)

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: What’s that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s-that’s my nubbin.

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: What’s a nubbin?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s kinda a ah, a third nipple kinda thing.

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: You have three nipples?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, y'know two regulars. And ah one that barely qualifies as...
(starts to kiss her again, but she gets up.) Ahh, what?

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Nothing. I, I just remembered I have to leave.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You ah, you have, you have to leave, now? How come?

lines.speaker: Ginger
lines.text: Ah well, it’s nubbin. Nothing! Umm. Y'know what, I’ll see you
later. Okay. (She leaves and in the hall we see her shake her shoulders like when someone
runs their fingernails across a blackboard.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is getting ready to sing as Leslie enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Leslie) Oh, I thought you weren’t coming. What? Where were you?

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: Come here, come here. (they go to the side of the stage) Okay,
don’t get mad, okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, don’t give me a reason to get mad, okay

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: I played Smelly Cat for the people at my old ad agency, they went nuts.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, look, I told you that I didn’t want you to try and sell it, and
you just, you big fat did it anyway. God, y'know what, I think five years ago I probably
would’ve done anything to play with you but, I can do it by myself. And if I
can’t trust you then just forget it.

lines.speaker: Leslie
lines.text: No, no, I don’t want to forget it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay y'know what you have to choose. All right, if-if the most important
thing on the planet to you is this cat poopy thing then, okay you can have Smelly Cat, but
we won’t be partners. So what’s it gonna be?

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe, Monica, and Joey are watching TV.

lines.speaker: Commercial
lines.text: (in the background their singing Smelly Cat) Problem odour in the
litter box? Don’t change your kitty, change your kitty litter.
(Monica gets up and shuts off the TV.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sorry, Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. You okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. I actually am, yeah. Y'know life-life’s gonna had you all
kinds of stuff, y'know you learn your little lessons and hopefully you grow. Wanna hear a
new song?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’d love too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (singing) ‘Jingle bitch screwed me over! Go to hell jingle
whore! Go to hell Go to hell. Go to hell-hell-hell.’ That’s all I have so far.

title: The One Where Ross and Rachel Take a Break

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Joey is taking a jar of olives out of the
fridge.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Monica) Hey, how much will you give me to eat this whole jar of
olives?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I won’t give you anything, but you’ll owe me 2.95.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Done.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey. I need an atlas! I need an atlas!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why? (in a motherlike tone) Do you have a report due?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I have a date with this diplomat I met while I was giving free massages
outside the UN and, I don’t know where his country is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, let’s start with the free messages outside the UN.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!! That’s my new thing. I figure bodies at peace, make peace.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! You might just get the first Nobel prize in rubbing. So what
country is this guy from?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ick-neck-tree-anis..... There’s a ‘g’ in there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Where’s that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: In your atlas!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t have an atlas.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, but wait I do have a globe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hold on.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So Pheebs what’s this guy like?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, well he’s very dashing, y'know, and umm, very, very
sophisticated, and he doesn’t speak any English, but according to his translator, he
totally gets me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ‘Kay, here you go. (Hands her this tiny little globe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s a globe and, a pencil sharpener.
(Phoebe puts the globe right up next to her eye to try and find the country.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey, does anybody need anything copied? I’m going down
to the Xerox place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, no thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay listen, just give me anything I can make two of.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, if you don’t have anything to copy, why are you going down
there?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, are you just going down there to gawk at that hot girl with the
belly button ring again?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! You wanna come?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: The Xerox place, Chandler and Joey are waiting in line.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on Chloe! Finish up with your customer first. Come on Chloe! Come
on Chloe!!

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: (to Chandler and Joey) Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, y'know what, we’re having second thoughts about our copying
needs. And we’ll need a little more time to think about it.

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: Chloe, switch with me, there’s some guys here that got a crush on
you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) Okay, that hurt us.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Hi guys. I haven’t seen you since this morning.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well ah, ........y'know.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Hey, what are you guys doing tomorrow night?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Both of us? (points to Chandler and himself)

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Maybe. Does that scare ya?
(They both start laughing. They look at each other, stop and step apart a little bit.)

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Relax. It’s just Issac’s D.J.-ing at the Philly. You should
come.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We’ll be there.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Great. I’ll ah, see ya then.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, rock on. (Does the ‘Hang 10’ sign, then hides his
face in shame.)
[Scene: A Street, Phoebe is walking along with the diplomat (Sergei) and his translator
(Mischa).]

lines.speaker: Sergei
lines.text: (something in Russian or Polish)

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: He’s says, ‘Walking with you makes this strange city, feel
like home.’

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too. Although this city is my home, so. So that’s dumb what I
said, don’t tell him I said that. Umm, you make something up. (Mischa does so and
Sergei kisses her hand.) Nice, (to Mischa) thank you. This is me. Here.
(Sergei goes up to her at her door and says something.)

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: (leaning in) Your eyes are very pretty.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Mischa) Thank you, very much! Oh! (to Sergei) Thank you!
(Sergei says something and leans in to kiss her, but just as he’s about to....)

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: (leaning in) He would like to kiss you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Mischa) Okay, y'know what, you don’t have to do that now.
(Mischa translates that to Sergei) No-no-no-no!! Not him, you don’t! (Mischa tells
Sergei he can proceed and steps away) Well the moment’s over.
(Sergei says something and kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: Oy!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is showing Monica where Sergei’s country is.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (pointing to the globe) See there it is right there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! It’s small.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. But Sergei said it took the Germans six weeks to get all the way
across it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you had fun, huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Except for, y'know when you’re on a date and you’re
getting along really great but the guy’s translator keeps getting in the way.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What is ah, Rach in her room?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no, she’s still at work, but she told me to tell you to call
her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh what?! Is she gonna cancel on me again?! How can she do this?
Doesn’t she know it’s our anniversary?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right ah, Ross, this is the extent of my knowledge on the subject.
(holds up a notepad) Call Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s that on the bottom?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that’s my doodle of a ladybug, with a top hat. (to Phoebe)
She’s fancy.
(Ross calls Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (answering her phone at work) Hello.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, honey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, there was a disaster in shipping and I’ve got to get this
order in. Honey, I’m so sorry, but it looks like I’m gonna be here all night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, do you, well umm, oh how about I come up there?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no-no, no, honey please, I’ve got, I’ve just have so much
to deal with.
[Cut to kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Monica) Anyway, I’m going out with Sergei again tonight, and
um, could you come and be the translator’s date? So that when we, it’s time for
our alone time, you two could split off. Y'know, he’s really, he’s kinda cute.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, well kinda cute, like really kinda cute, or kinda cute like your
friend Spackel Back Larry?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, don’t call him that! His name is Spackel Back Harry!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler and Joey are sitting on the big couch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, y'know what, maybe we should get going. I mean what time did
Chloe say we should be there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What time is it now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah all right, so we’ll hang out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Hey, remember when she brought up that thing about the three of us?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes. Vividly.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She was kidding about that right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I-I-I think so. (Pauses and thinks about it for a second) Yeah,
I-I think so...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: God, that would be weird it that situation presented itself tonight, huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, I mean what, what would we do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She was kidding.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She was.... But y'know what, just in case, maybe we should come up
with a set of ground rules.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, for sure. Okay. Probably want the first thing to be, never open your
eyes. Y'know, because you don’t want to be doing something and then look up and see
something you don’t want to be seeing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Good call, nice one. Hold it!! Hold it! What if me eyes are
closed, and, and my hand is out there.... (holds his arm out and pretends to grab
something with his hand.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah!! Okay! Eyes open at all times! Oh, hey, how do we decide where we...
(clears throat) y'know each would, (clears throat again) y'know (pause) be?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right. Right. Well ah, y'know we could flip for it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I guess, but what’s like heads and what’s tails?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well it you don’t know that, then I don’t want to do this
with you.
[Scene: Rachel’s office, Rachel and a co-worker (Sophie) are dealing with the
crisis.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the phone) No, no, no, I’m looking at a purchase order right
here and it clearly states that we ordered the Rivera bikini in a variety of sizes and
colours. And.... (listens) What does it matter, what I’m wearing?! Can I please speak
to your supervisor? (listens) Thank you. (to Sophie) We’re holding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering, carrying a basket) Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (startled) Oh!! My God, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well you said you couldn’t go out so.... (pulls the cover off of the
basket)

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: You brought a picnic, oh, what a boyfriend. That’s it, on Monday I
start wearing make-up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross honey, this is very nice, but, but I-I got a crisis.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but I got cous-cous!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, honey, I’m sorry, I know it’s our anniversary but I
told you on the phone I don’t have time to stop.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, you don’t have to stop, I’m invisible, I’m not here.
(lights a candle)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I don’t, hmm... (on phone) Oh, who approved that order?!
(listens) Well there is no Mark Robbinson in this office. (to Sophie) Get me Mark on the
phone!

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: I love Mark. (to Ross) Do you know Mark?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, let me just check that with what I got here, all right see 038 is
not the number for (Ross starts making a lot of noise with a handheld pepper grinder) this
store, 038 is Atlanta. And I...(stops and looks at Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stopping grinding) Pepper?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (angrily) None for me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay sorry, whew.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry, as I was saying the store number is wrong, and I’m
sorry but that’s... (notices a fire that Ross’s candle has started) Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (putting out the fire with a squeeze bottle of water) Okay, that’s a
fire. Oh yeah. Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) Excuse me, I’m sorry, I’m gonna have to call you
back, I’ve got a Schemp in my office. (hangs up) (to Ross) What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry. But ah, hey, oh, somebody’s off the phone, how
‘bout a glass of wine by the fire, I could get it going again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross you’re not listening to me, I don’t have time to stop.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on Rach, you don’t have what, ten minutes?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t have ten minutes!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (to Sophie) Sophie, does she have ten minutes?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, Ross!!! I told you I don’t!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don’t yell at me okay, this is the most I’ve seen you all week.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, I cannot do this right now, okay, I’ve got a deadline, would
you just go home, I’ll talk to you later. (storms out)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but wait...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good bye!
(Ross starts to pack up the picnic in anger, and throws a three hole punch in the
basket.)

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Actually, that’s our three hole punch.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is eating the picnic as Rachel comes home from work.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. Look um, about what happened earlier...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, hey, well, I-I completely understand. You were, you were stressed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (throws her stuff down) I was gonna give you a chance to apologise to
me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: For what? For letting you throw me out of your office?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You had no right coming down to my office Ross. You do not bring
a picnic basket to somebody’s work! Unless maybe they were a park ranger!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well excuse me for wanting to be with my girlfriend on our
anniversary, boy what an ass am I.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I told you, I didn’t have the time!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well you never have the time. I mean, I don’t feel like I even
have a girlfriend anymore, Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh, Ross what do you want from me? You want me, you want me to quit my
job so you can feel like you have a girlfriend?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, but it’d be nice if you realised, it’s just a job!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just a job!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross do you realise this is the first time in my life I’m doing
something I actually care about. This is the first time in my life I’m doing
something that I’m actually good at. I mean. if you don’t get that...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, hey, I get that, okay, I get that big time. And I’m happy for ya,
but I’m tired of having a relationship with your answering machine! Okay, I
don’t know what to do anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well neither do I!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is this about Mark?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, it’s not, it’s not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God. I cannot keep having this same fight over and over again,
Ross, no, you’re, you’re, you’re making this too hard.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh I’m, I’m making this too hard. Okay, what do you want me to
do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, I don’t know. Urrrgh! Look, maybe we should take
a break.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, fine, you’re right. Let’s ah, let’s take a
break, (goes to the door) let’s cool off, okay, let’s get some frozen yogart, or
something.. (opens the door)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. (Ross is standing in the doorway.) A break from us.
(Ross looks at her, then leaves slamming the door behind him.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The Philly, Chandler and Joey are talking to Chloe.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: And the advances in collating in the past five years, I mean we just got
in an X-5000, y'know. The X-5000 makes the X-50 look like a T-71.
(Chandler agrees in an absolutely bored way.)

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: (seeing Ross enter) Hey, it’s the dinosaur guy. (runs over to Ross)
Hi, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, hi Chloe.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: I want you to met some friends of mine. (Introduces him to Chandler and
Joey) This guy is my hero, he comes in with some stuff he wants it blown up 400%, we said
we don’t do that, and he says you gotta. And y'know what, we did it. And now anytime
anybody wants 400, we just say ‘let’s Ross it!’

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And that’s the only colour that comes in.

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: Yo, Chloe, do you have a quarter for the condom machine?

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Oh! (storms off)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, what are you doing here? I thought tonight was your big
anniversary dinner.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, little change in plans. Ahh, we’re gonna break-up instead.
(Chandler and Joey stare at each other in shock.)

scenes.location: A Restaurant, Monica and Phoebe are on their dates with Sergei and Mischa.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, and I can also speak a little French. Voulez-vous coucher avec moi
ce soir? (Mischa laughs) Why? What did I say?

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: Well, you just asked if I wanted to go to bed with you tonight.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! No wonder I get such great service at Cafe Maurice.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (laughing and banging her spoon on the table) Knock, knock, knock,
knock, hi. Um, could you please tell Sergei that um, I was fascinated by what Boutros
Boutros Gali said in the New York Times.
(Mischa does so.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You didn’t say Boutros Boutros Gali.

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: (to Sergei) Boutros Boutros Gali.
(Sergei responds.)

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: He says he was too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Interesting.

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: (to Monica) So I was wondering....

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, ah, before you get all talky again, umm, could you also please
tell Sergei that I really like his suit.
(Mischa does so, and Sergei complements Phoebe, and says it slowly)

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: (to Phoebe, very quickly) Eh, he said, thank you very much, he thinks
you look very pretty tonight, your hair, golden like the sun. (to Monica) So you're a
chef?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m also thinking about opening up my own restaurant.

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: Oh, really.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica, can I talk to you behind my menu, please. (Behind the menu) What
are you doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I was having a conversation.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah but, Mischa is so interested in you, that Sergei and I haven’t
been able to say two words to each other.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you want me to do? Just sit here silently while you three have a
conversation?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That would be great. Thank you.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is lying in front of the bay window, and the phone
rings.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (jumping up to answer the phone) Hello!

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Oh, hi. It’s Mark.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (disappointed) Oh.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: What? Is it my breath?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Sorry, I just thought you were somebody else. Hi!

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Hi. Well, look, I was just gonna leave a message, isn’t tonight your,
your big anniversary dinner?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Well, umm.....

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Rach, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the verge of tears) Yeah, I’m fine.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: You wanna talk, I mean I can come over?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Really, no, please, please, that’s, that’s okay.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: All right, all right, I’m coming over, and I’m bringing Chinese
food.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah, I’m not, I’m not hungry.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: It’s for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Okay, bye.

scenes.location: The Philly.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What can I do? One person wants to break-up, you break-up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, no way! Come on, this is you guys, call her and work it out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh come on, we just had this huge fight, all right, don’t I have to
wait a while?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, this isn’t like swimming after you eat, pick up the phone!!
(Ross goes to call her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know that whole swimming thing is a myth.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, tell that to my Uncle Lenny.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why? What happened to him?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing, he’s just really believes in that.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Mark is there, opening Chinese food boxes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, and then, we got into this big, stupid fight. I just, it was awful.
I told him he treats me like a park ranger, or something, oh and then I told him I wanted
to take a break, I don’t want to take a break.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Wow. I’m sorry. Eggroll?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. (grabs an eggroll) And then I called him, and he wasn’t there.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Well, then he’s, he’s probably just, out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, thank you that’s very helpful, I’m glad you came over.
(The phone rings and Rachel answers it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi! It’s me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Oh, I’m so glad you called.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? I’ve been thinking, this is crazy, I mean don’t,
don’t you think we can work on this?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Hey, what do you want to drink?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who’s that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nobody.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Is it okay if I finish the apple juice?
(Rachel mouths ‘Shoot!’ or something similar.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is that Mark?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, honey, look he just came over to....
[Cut to The Philly.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Got it! (slams the phone down, and walks back to the bar.)

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Hey, dinosaur guy, look at you, so sad. Come dance.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, that’s okay, thanks.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Hey, you don’t have to smile. You just have to dance.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I don’t feel like dancing, I feel like having a drink. Okay?

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Oh, okay. (to the bartender) Hey, two beers. (sits down next to him)

scenes.location: The Restaurant, after dinner.

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: (to Monica) And the vet said it was time. And so from half a world away,
while my Mother held the phone to his ear, I said good bye to my dog,. In seven languages.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. (to Phoebe) Can I have a tissue?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, sure. I just hope you, hope you don’t accidentally suck
it up through your nose and choke on it.
(Sergei says something to Mischa.)

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Sergei, would like to apologise for my behaviour tonight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, tell him, apology accepted.
(Mischa does so.)

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: (to Monica) Oh, he’s unbelievable. I mean for the first time in
three years somebody wants to actually want to talk to me, but do you think he would let
me enjoy that, no!! (to Sergei) You silly diplomat, why don’t you learn some English,
Sergei?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Excuse me, but umm, isn’t he paying for your dinner?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, the man’s dog just died.
(Sergei insults Mischa, and they get into a huge fight, in Russian.)

lines.speaker: Mischa
lines.text: (to Monica) I have just resigned my post. Would you care to accompany me
to the Rainbow Room? I have diplomatic coupons.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It will be my pleasure. (to Phoebe) My guy has diplomatic coupons. Your
guy can’t even say coupons. (they leave)

lines.speaker: Sergei
lines.text: Uh, (picks up a plate) plate?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Plate! Yes, plate.

lines.speaker: Sergei
lines.text: Plate. Plate. Plate.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: See, we don’t need them.

lines.speaker: Sergei
lines.text: (picking up a cup) Plate?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.
[Scene: The Philly, With or Without You is playing. (Which is the same song Ross
played for Rachel in TOW the List.)]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Chloe) I like this song.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Well, you’re practically dancing already. Why don’t you just do
it over here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no, no.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: What? Are you married? ‘Cause that’s okay.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is next to the bay window again, Mark has left.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (picks up the phone and calls Ross) Oh, be home, be home, be home, be
home, be home, be home. Be home. Be home, be home, be home. Oh, you’re not home.

scenes.location: The Philly, Ross is dancing with Chloe.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Still no smile?
(She kisses him. Ross leans back for a second, and then they both kiss, more
passionately this time as U2's With or Without You plays in the background.)
To Be Continued......

title: The One the Morning After

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Voice Over) Previously on Friends.
[A montage of scenes from The One Where Ross and Rachel
Take A Break follows.]

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is eating the picnic as Rachel comes home from work.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I mean, I don’t feel like I even have a girlfriend anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You want me to just quit my job so that you can feel like you’ve
got a girlfriend?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is this about Mark?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, it’s not, it’s not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God. I cannot keep having this same fight with you Ross! Look,
urrgh, maybe we should take a break.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, you’re right. Let’s ah, let’s take a break, (goes to
the door) let’s cool off, okay, let’s get some frozen yoghurt, or something..
(opens the door)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. A break from us.
(Ross looks at her, then leaves slamming the door behind him.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Mark is there, opening Chinese food boxes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Then, we had this big, stupid fight, and I said I wanted to take a
break, I don’t want to take a break.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on the phone) I’ve been thinking, this is crazy, I mean don’t,
don’t you think we can work on this?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Hey, what do you want to drink?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who’s that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nobody.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is that Mark?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, honey, look he just came over to....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Got it! (slams down the phone)

scenes.location: The Philly.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Hey, come dance. What? Are you married? ‘Cause that’s okay.
[Cut to Chloe and Ross dancing, and their kiss.]
The Next Morning
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is making a fruit drink in the blender, Rachel has
just finished her shower and is coming out of the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How’s the big anniversary dinner?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, we never actually got to dinner.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohhh, nice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, we kinda broke up instead.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! (She accidentally starts the blender without the lid on it and
fruit flies everywhere.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking up at the ceiling) God, Monica it’s on the ceiling.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s okay, this is more important than fruit (pause) (angrily) on
my ceiling! You broke up?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but it’s okay, because when Ross left Mark came over.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, you and Mark?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no-no, it’s okay, calm down. Mark and I talked, and I realised
how much I love your stupid brother, and, yeah, we got our problems, but I really want to
make it work.
[Scene: Ross’s Bedroom, Ross is waking up. He straightens himself out on the bed
and puts the covers over his head.]

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: (entering from bathroom) Morning!
(Ross sits bolt upright, without moving the covers.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Ross’s Kitchen, Ross is taking some aspirin and checking his messages.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on answering machine) Hi, it’s me. I’ve been trying to reach
you all night. I feel awful. Please, Ross, you gotta know there is nothing between me and
Mark. This whole break-up thing is just stupid.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Eh, I’m just so sorry I put you through it. And, I y'know, I
don’t want to get back together over a machine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Na-huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, I love you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And y'know what, I’m gonna, I’m gonna go to bed now, but ah,
on my way to work tomorrow morning, I’m gonna stop by around 8:30.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (Ross starts frantically looking for a clock.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye.
(Ross finds a clock, sees it’s almost 8:30, and silently screams.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chloe, Chloe how’s it coming?!!

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: (entering from bedroom) Hey, what kind of puppy do you think I should
get?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, oh, hey, I don’t know. How about a big one?

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: But my apartment is so...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well then a small one!! Listen, let’s, we kinda have to get going!

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Wait! Where’s my shoes?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You, you sure you need shoes? (Chloe nods her head) Okay. (reaches down
and picks up a shoe)

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Do I know why we’re rushing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, y'know the ah, the girlfriend I told you about last night?
(He’s frantically throwing the cushions off of the couch looking for her other shoe)
Well it turns out she ah, she wants to get back together with me. Oh, I found it!!

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: That’s so great for you guys!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: You must be so happy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, yes I am, one of the many things I’m feeling. Well.... (picks up
her coat)

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Good luck, with your girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thank you. (She goes to kiss him, but he holds her coat up between
their faces to stop her.) Hey, hey. (opens the door, sees Rachel, and hides Chloe behind
the door) Rachel!!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. Ohhh, you got my message.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, oh hey, you are right on time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what do you say? Can I be your girlfriend again?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, you can, very much.
(Chloe gives Ross the thumbs up while still standing behind the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (seeing the thumbs up) Ahhhh!! (Hugs Rachel tighter.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is entering carry a large box, Monica is mopping
the ceiling.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, why are you mopping your ceiling?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, there’s banana on it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, I have the spirit of an old Indian women living in mine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So then you know? (Phoebe nods her head)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The mailman was downstairs, so I brought up your mail.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, good. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now what is Fabutec?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, all right don’t judge me to much. Okay? Um, but I saw this
info-mercial, and um, I swear to you I have never-ever bought anything on TV before,
except for this mop. But there was this stuff on leg waxing, it just, it looked so
amazing....

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Waxine!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! Have you seen it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it’s incredible! I so want to be a Waxine girl.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God. Do think it really doesn’t hurt? ‘Cause how can they do
that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello! Organic substances recently discovered in the depths of the rain
forest!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They have the best stuff in there.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Ross has told Chandler and Joey his terrible act.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
