lines.text: Yeah. We figured when we couldn’t find you, you’d gone home to
make up with Rachel. Which is probably what you shoulda done. Huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You think?! God, I, ah, I’m in hell. I mean what, what am I gonna do?
Rachel’s all like, ‘I love you and, and let’s work on this.’ And all I
can think about is, ‘What is she gonna do? What is she gonna say?’ when I tell
her what I did.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, before we answer that, I think we should address the more
important question. How dumb are you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! Look, we’re trying to rebuild a relationship here, right. How
am I supposed to do that here, without being totally honest with each other?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, Ross look, I’m on board about this totally honesty thing, I am,
just not about stuff that’s gonna get you in trouble.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He’s right. Nobody’s gonna benefit, and you’re just
gonna hurt her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, and there won’t be a relationship left to rebuild.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but don’t you think....

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right look, if you absolutely have to tell her, at least wait
until the timing’s right. And that’s what deathbeds are for.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, okay. (he plops down into one of the leather chairs, with the
footrest extended.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, okay, now, we just have to make sure she doesn’t find out
some other way. (spins the chair around so that Ross is facing him) Did you think about
the trail?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What trail?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (stomps on the footrest which pops Ross up into a sitting position) The
trail from the woman you did it with to the woman you hope never finds out who did it!
(slapping his hands with each word) You always have to think about the trail!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I-I don’t think there’s any trail.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, okay-okay, ah, Chloe works with that guy Issac. Issac’s
sister is Jasmine. And Jasmine works at that message place with Phoebe. And Phoebe’s
friends with Rachel. And that’s the trail, I did it!

scenes.location: Monica's Bedroom, Monica and Phoebe are waxing their legs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading from the instructions) After applying the Waxine and linen
strips to leg number one,

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did that!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Grasp one of the linen strips by its ‘easy grab tab’ and pull
it off in one quick pain free motion.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (Does so.) Ow!!!!! Ow-oh-oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Was it not pain-free?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. It was painful. Oh my God , they should call it Pain-zine, now with
a little wax.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh, well, the girls in the satin nighties on the commercial don’t
seem to think it’s that bad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s because their nerves are probably deadened from being so
stupid. But hey, y'know if you don’t believe me, please, by my guest.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Removing one of the strips) Ow-ow-ow-ow! Oh my God!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now, are you glad we didn’t start with the bikini strips?

scenes.location: The Xerox Place, Ross is trying to break the trail.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Chloe? Hi..

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Is this about me taking your watch?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You took my watch?

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: I’m sorry, I do that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just you keep it, listen did you, did you tell anyone about us?

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Oh no. I feel it isn’t really anybody’s business, y'know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Exactly. So you didn’t, didn’t mention anything to Issac right?

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Oh, well I tell Issac everything.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You tell, of course you do. Issac. Issac. Hey, Issac. Issac, hi! Y'know we
haven’t actually met...

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: You dog!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, I suppose I am a dog. But Issac, see I-I happen to have a girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: Oh right, that Rachel chick from the coffee place.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, that’s the one. Listen, I don’t want to hurt her.

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: Oh, hey, man I know, doesn’t matter how much we love ‘em,
monogamy is too cruel a rule.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Listen, can you keep this information to yourself?

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: Aw, no problem dude. Y'know we got to look out for each other. We’re
the same, you and me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually, no, we’re not.

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: Yeah, we are.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, we’re not.

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: Yeah, we are.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, we’re not!!

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: Okay, we’re not.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: But, we are.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine. I just need to know that you’re not gonna tell your sister.

lines.speaker: Issac
lines.text: I can promise not to tell her again.

scenes.location: Phoebe’s Work, Ross is now trying to stop Jasmine from telling Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering out of breath) Jasmine?

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We met at Phoebe’s birthday party, I’m, I’m Ross Geller.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.text: You did a bad thing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, I did.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.text: Very bad!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Very bad.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.text: Very, very bad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m agreeing with you. Did you, listen, did you happen to tell Phoebe
yet?

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, Jasmine, please, please don’t. I love my girlfriend very much,
and I want more than anything to just work it out with her. Okay?

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you, thank you.

lines.speaker: Jasmine
lines.text: But you should probably talk to my roommate, because I told him and he
knows Phoebe too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (angrily) Who’s your roommate?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Gunther is wiping down the counter as Ross rushes in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Gunther! Gunther. Gunther, please tell me you didn’t say anything to
Rachel about me and the girl from the Xerox place.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I’m sorry. Was I not supposed to?
(Ross turns around and sees Rachel sitting by the window. She is just glaring at him.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica’s Bedroom, Monica and Phoebe are removing the rest of their wax
strips.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ow!! Ow!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ow!!!

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Ow!!!!!!! Ow-ow-ow-ow!
(Hearing the screaming Chandler and Joey rush in. Joey has a pan, Chandler has a tea
kettle.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We’re all right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s okay, it’s okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We’re all right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We were just waxing our legs.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Off?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: For your information, this happens to be a pain like no man will ever
experience.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well I don’t think you can make that statement, unless
you’ve been kicked in an area that God only meant to be treated nicely.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I-I think that women just have a lower threshold of pain than men,
that’s all. I mean, come on, it’s just a little wax.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, come here. (Puts a little wax on Joey’s arm and puts a
strip on it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that’s mature.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, fine, so now what, I just pull it off?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right.
(Joey laughs, pulls it off, then does a high-pitched whine.)
[Cut to Living Room, Rachel is trying to close the door on Ross.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (forcing the door open) Come on, Rachel, come on! Talk to me! Please!!
[Cut to Monica's bedroom, Chandler slowly closes the door, and we hear Rachel from the
living room.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can’t talk to you. I can’t even look at you right now!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing, nothing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (going over to listen at the door) Rachel said everything was okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Joey) What, what are they talking about?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel?
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just get away from me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it was a mistake! I made a mistake! Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A mistake?! What were you trying to put it in? Her purse?!
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whe-where did he put it?!
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, you had sex with another woman!
[Cut to Monica's bedroom, both Monica and Phoebe gasp.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I knew something had to be wrong, because my fingernails did not
grow at all yesterday.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, I guess they had a fight, and he got drunk....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh!! (hits Chandler and Joey in the head) You guys knew about this and
you didn’t tell us?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) He has sex, and we get hit in our heads.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (opening the door) Y'know what, I want you to leave! Get outta here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just get out! Now!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!! No!! I wanna stay. I wanna talk about this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! All right! How was she?
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-oh.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Was she good?
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t answer that.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on Ross! You said you wanted to talk about it, let’s talk
about it!! How was she?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She was...
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Awful! Horrible!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She was not good. Not good.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She was nothing compared to you.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She, she was different.
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ewwwww!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-oh.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good different?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nobody likes change.
(Rachel picks up a newspaper and starts beating him with it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Okay, okay, okay, okay.
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Should we do something?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, never cheat on Rachel.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry, okay, I’m sorry. I wa-I was disgusted with myself,
and this morning I was so, I was so upset and then I got your message and I was so happy,
and all I wanted was to get her out of my apartment as fast as possible.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa!! Whoa, whoa, wait a minute. What time did your little friend
leave? (Ross can’t answer that) Oh my God. She was there? She was still there? She
was in there, when I was in there?!
(Ross hands Rachel back the newspaper, and she starts beating him with it again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen. Oh hey, hey, the important thing was that she meant, she meant
nothing to me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And yet she was worth jeopardising our relationship!!
(She throws the paper at him, misses and hits Monica’s door, they all jump back at
the sound.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I didn’t think there was a relationship to jeopardise. I
thought we were broken up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We were on a break!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That, for all I knew would, could last forever. That to me is a break-up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You think you’re gonna get out of this on a technicality?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I’m not trying to get out of anything, okay. I thought our
relationship was dead!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you sure had a hell of a time at the wake!
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'know what, I don’t think we should listen to this anymore. (Goes to
open the door)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (stopping him) What, what are you doing? You can’t go out there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?! (to Chandler) I’m hungry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because they’ll know we’ve been listening.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God! And to have to hear about it from Gunther!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on! Like I wanted him to tell you, I ran all over the place trying to
make sure that didn’t happen!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that is so sweet. I think I’m falling in love with you all over
again.
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what, I think we can go out there. I mean they have more
important things to worry about.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, we’ll be fine.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look Rachel, I wanted to tell you, I thought I should, I-I did, and then
Chandler and Joey convinced me not to.
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (handing Monica the wax) Wax the door shut, we’re never leaving,
ever.
[Later, Phoebe is on the phone, they’re all still trapped in Monica’s
bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi, it’s Phoebe. Listen someone’s gonna have to take my 9:00
with Mr. Rehack, ‘cause it’s like 9:15 now, and I’m not there.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don’t you realise none of this would’ve ever happened if I
didn’t think at that same moment you weren’t having sex with Mark?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. Let’s say I had slept with Mark. Would you have been
able to forgive me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pause) Yes I would.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’d be okay if you knew that Mark had kissed me, and been naked
with me, and made love to me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (less sure) Yes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You knew that our hot, sweaty, writhing bodies were....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (covering his ears and screaming) La-la-la-la-la-la-la-la-la-la! Okay,
okay, yeah, I would have been devastated but, I would still want to be with you. Because
it’s, I mean it’s you.
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohhhhh!
[Later, Ross and Rachel are sitting in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Come on Rach, tell me what you’re thinking?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m thinking, I’m gonna order a pizza.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Order a pizza like, ‘I forgive you?’
(She turns around and glares at him, he turns away.)
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh man, pizza? I like pizza. (makes like he is trying to send a telepathic
message to Rachel) Put olives on the pizza.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We could eat the wax! It’s organic.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh great, food with hair on it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, not the used wax.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because that would be crazy?
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, can I, can I get in on that? Because I’m kinda hungry myself.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine. (on phone) Hi! Yes, I’d like to order a large pizza.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No anchovies.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: With ah, extra anchovies.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s okay, I’ll just pick ‘em off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and could you please chop some up and just put it right there in
the sauce?
[Cut to later, they are finishing up the pizza, there’s one piece left.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can have the last piece, if you want.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I should think so. You slept with someone.
[Cut to Monica's bedroom, they’re all eating the wax, Chandler and Phoebe,
don’t like it. Joey tries some and makes a face like: ‘Hey, that’s not so

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They’re gonna get through this, aren’t they?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, come on, it’s Ross and Rachel, they’ve got too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What if they don’t?
(Long pause.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You think I need a new walk?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well y'know, I’ve been walking the same way since high school.
Y'know, y'know how some guys they walk into a room and everybody takes notice. I think I
need a ‘take notice’ walk.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you actually saying these words?
[Later, in the living room, Rachel is sitting on the couch, Ross is on the chair.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, now you’re not even taking to me? (moves over to the coffee
table) Look Rachel, I-I’m sorry, okay, I’m sorry, I was out of my mind. I
thought I’d lost you, I didn’t know what to do. Come on! Come on, how insane
must I have been to do something like this? Huh? I-I don’t cheat right, I,
that’s not me, I’m not Joey!
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-ho-ho! (He looks at Chandler, who gives him a ‘come on’
look.) Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. It’s three in the morning. They don’t know that I’ve
come home yet. You notice how neither one of them are wondering where I am.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, y'know, people can be so self-involved.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know what, y'know what, I’m-I’m not the one that wanted that,
that break, okay. You’re the one that bailed on us. You’re the one that, that
ran when things got just a little rough!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s what?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is neither here nor there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, well here we are. Now we’re in a tough spot again, Rach. What
do you want to do? How do you want to handle it? Huh? Do you wanna fight for us? Or, do
you wanna bail? (sits down next to her) Look, I, (on the verge of tears) I did a terrible,
stupid, stupid thing. Okay? And I’m sorry, I wish I could take it back, but I
can’t. (We see Monica and Phoebe are almost in tears.) I just can’t see us
throwing away something we know is so damn good. Rachel, I love you so much.
(He kisses her on her shoulder, then her neck, then the side of her face, then just
before he kisses her on the lips....)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Ross!! (stands up and moves away from him) Don’t! You can’t
just kiss me and think you’re gonna make it all go away, okay? It doesn’t work
that way. It doesn’t just make it better. Okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (softly) I think you should go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (softly) I really think you need to go now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (moving over to stand in front of her) Okay, okay. This morning you said
there was nothing so big that we couldn’t work past it together...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, what the hell did I know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, look, there’s got to be a way we can work past this. Okay,
(takes a hold of one of her arms.) I can’t imagine, I can’t imagine my life
without you. (Both of them are starting to cry.) Without, without these arms, and your
face, and this heart. Your good heart Rach, (drops to his knees and hugs her around her
waist) and, and....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (crying) No. I can’t, you’re a totally different person to me
now. I used to think of you as somebody that would never, ever hurt me, ever. God, and now
I just can’t stop picturing with her, I can’t, (Ross stands up and backs away)
it doesn’t matter what you say, or what you do, Ross. It’s just changed,
everything. Forever.
[We see the rest of them are now crying.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (crying) Yeah, but this can’t be it, I mean.
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Then how come it is?

title: The One with the Ski Trip

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler and Joey are sitting on the couch reading.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Can I see the comics?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is the New York Times.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, may I see the comics?
[Monica and Phoebe enter.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys. I thought you were taking Ross to the game?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We are. He’s meeting us here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Rachel is meeting us here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh come on, they can be in the same room.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you shoulda been there last night.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why? What happened now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well Ross was hangin’ out over at our place, Rachel comes over to
borrow some moisturiser from Chandler....

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah y-you, how hard is it to say something? Rachel came over to
borrow something.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Anyway! Her and Ross just started yelling at each other.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait. Why was he yelling at her? He’s the one who slept with
someone else.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I guess he says that because they were on a break when it happened,
that she should of forgiven him by now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whoa!! He is soo unreasonable! God, although I think I understand what
he means. Oh my God, this is like 60 Minutes, okay, when, when, at first
you’re really mad at that pharmaceutical company for making the drug and then y'know
you just feel bad for the people because they needed to make their hair grow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what this is like? This is like when my parents got divorced.
Man, I hope Ross doesn’t try to kidnap me after Cub Scouts.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know I had a dream where Ross and Rachel were still together, they
never broke up. And we were all just like hanging out, and everyone was happy....

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I had the same dream!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and nobody slept with that Xerox girl.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I had the opposite dream.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what maybe it’s gonna be okay, I mean it’s been a
week.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I mean it’s never taken me a week to get over a relationship.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s never taken you more than a shower to get over a
relationship.
[Rachel enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (seeing her) Okay, let’s go!! Let’s hit the road!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let’s get the show on it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, let me just get a cup of coffee.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh Rachel, I know the best coffee house and it’s sooo close.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Closer than here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (turning around and picking a cup off of a table) Oh, hey, look, I found
coffee! (handing her the cup) Okay, let’s skedaddle.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, I’m not just gonna drink somebody’s old coffee.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, your highness.
[Ross enters behind Rachel, and look at each other for a moment.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (in a deep voice, imitating Ross) Um, Rachel I’m really sorry.
(imitating Rachel) That’s okay, do you wanna get back together? (imitating Ross)
Yeah, okay. (in her normal voice) Did anyone else hear that?!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, the whole gang is there, except for Ross and Rachel. Joey
is trying to eat Chinese with chopsticks and fails miserably. There’s a knock on the
door, and Chandler answers it to reveal Rachel]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (softly) Is he here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. (smiles) Here’s your moisturiser. Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys are gonna love meee! Okay, check it out, Thursday night, five
tickets, Calvin Klein lingerie show, and you guys are coming with me. (they’re
all silent and look away) Okay, I said that out loud right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, yes, it’s just that we ah, we kinda all ready, made plans
with Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well okay. Well, there you go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it’s just that he got this new like home theater dealie, and he
wants y'know, us to check it out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hm-mm.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, he’s really excited about it too, he even recorded show
times on his answering machine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re sorry honey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s okay. (starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach, it’s, it’s ah, it’s not that we don’t want to,
really. (quietly) Are we talking models in their underwear?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And heels.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (He turns around to Chandler looking for approval to go with Rachel,
Chandler mouths ‘Come on!’) (turning back to Rachel) Ross, did ask us first, and
we set that night aside.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, hey, come on, if he asked you first, that’s only fair. (leaves)
[Chandler makes a noise of absolute disgust and heads into the living room.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohhh boy, do I feel bad.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Very bad.
[We see Chandler lighting up a cigarette.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (jumps back and points at the cigarette) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re smoking again?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, actually, yesterday I was smoking again. Today, I’m,
I’m smoking still.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why would you start again after chewing all that quitting gum?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I’m telling you this is just like my parents divorce, which
is when I started smoking in the first place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Weren’t you nine?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeahhh. I’m tellin’ ya something, that ah, first smoke after
nap time....
[There’s a knock on the door.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s great, with my luck, that’s gonna be him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Him? Him, Ross?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nope, hymn 253, His Eyes Are On The Sparrow! When my parents got
divorced is when I started using humour as a defence mechanism. (answers the door and
it’s Rachel again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Uhh, do you guys have plans for the weekend? Because I have my
sister on hold, and she said that we could use her cabin for the weekend and go skiing.
Huh? I’m asking you first, right?!. I mean I’m playing by the rules.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Absolutely, yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler! You’re smoking? What are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, shut up!! You’re not my real Mom!!
[Scene: Ross’s, the gang, minus Rachel of course, is there. Chandler is forced to
smoke by an open window.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (obviously cold) Hey, can you close that window Chandler? My nipples can
cut glass over here!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait. Really?! ‘Cause mine get me out of tickets.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, you guys I just wanna say, I really, really appreciate you spending
this time with me. It’s been a pretty hard time right now, so I just wanna say
thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can somebody else hug him? I have to stay by the window.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh hey, hey, huh, how about this weekend we have a laser disc marathon
okay, and maybe a tournament on my new dart board? Huh, huh, what do you think? (in an
Irish accent) Two days of darts, it’ll be great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’ll be great for next weekend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no, this weekend guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’ll be great for next weekend. I mean, (in an Irish accent)
it’ll be grrreat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, we were um, sorta invited to go skiing, y'know Rachel’s
sister’s cabin. (Chandler goes back to the window to smoke again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, for the whole weekend?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re really sorry, but um, she did ask us first.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, that’s okay, I mean if you guys all have to go away for
the first weekend I’m alone by myself, y'know then I totally, totally understand.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know what, I can stay, I’m gonna stay. ‘Cause the last time
I went skiing I was to afraid to jump off the chair lift, I just went around and around.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, Pheebs we kinda need you to drive us all up there in your
grandmother’s cab, but y'know what, I’ll stay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Noo! I’ll stay. He’s my brother.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What a pity stay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! We’re gonna have fun. We can make fudge!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pity food? Y'know what that’s okay, all right, I don’t need any
of you to stay, okay nobody stays.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, then, I might as well offer to stay.
[Scene: In Phoebe’s Grandmother’s cab, driving up to the cabin. Phoebe’s
driving, Rachel’s sitting shotgun, Chandler, Monica, and Joey are in the back seat.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Chandler and Monica) Hey, does anybody else feel bad about Ross?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why? Do you think he’s still mad at us?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) Well he’s probably mad after you called him this
morning to borrow his goggles.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? Mine aren’t tinted.
[Chandler starts to light a cigarette.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What does the sign say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Beam me up Jesus.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, the ‘No Smoking’ sign. There’s no smoking in my
Grandmother’s cab.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, well, then, I-I have to go to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Please!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No Chandler no! No unscheduled stops. You can go when we stop for gas.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, come on, there’s a rest stop right up there! Come on, I
really have to goooooooooo.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, now I have to go!!

scenes.location: The rest stop, Phoebe’s pulling in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here we go. Okay, brace yourselves.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?
[Both Chandler and Joey put their feet up against the glass, Monica doesn’t and
gets thrown up against the glass.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ow!
[Joey gets out and sprints to the bathroom and Chandler follows with a cigarette in his
hands.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Rachel, who’s staying in the cab.) Aren’t you gonna go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (getting out) No, Rachel never pees in public restrooms.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, they never have any paper in there y'know. So my rule is ‘no
tissue, no tuschy.’ (Phoebe laughs and gets out.) Well, if everybody’s going.
(She gets out and starts to close the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, y'know what don’t close it (Rachel slams the door shut locking
themselves out.) ‘cause the... keys...are in there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, no-no-no-no-no-no!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) My lighter’s in there! (points to the cab)
Commercial Break
[Scene: The rest stop, the gang is still stuck, Chandler is kneeling at the rear
bumper.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Damn! (stands up) The tailpipe’s not hot enough to light this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Relax okay, I-I-I can get this open. Anybody have a coat hanger?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh I do! Op, no, wait a minute, I took it out of my shirt when I put
it on this morning.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, if you’re parents hadn’t got divorced, you’d be able
to answer a question like a normal person?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I just need a wire something to jimmy it. Oh hey, one of you guys
give me the underwire from your bra!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! Who has the biggest boobs?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoever has the biggest boobs, has the biggest bra, therefore has the
biggest wire.

lines.speaker: The Girls
lines.text: No, not getting my bra!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If you wanna get back in the car, we need the wire, your call.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, Monica’s are the biggest.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: These tiny, little non-breasts?! Please, it’s gotta be Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What, no, no, no, mine are deceptively small I mean, I-I-I actually
sometimes, st-stuff my bra.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right then, your bra would still be big.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I stuff outside the bra.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ladies, ladies, let’s just compromise okay? Phoebe, Rachel take
off Monica’s bra.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, forget it, nevermind, you can have mine.
[Chandler crumples up his cigarette pack and throws it on the ground.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing him) Chandler, what are you doing? There is a trash can right
there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I thought if I littered, that crying Indian might come by and
save us.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (finishing removing her bra) Okay, there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you Phoebe, that is very, very generous.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, now let’s decide who has the nicest ass.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (opening the door) And there you go!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, yeahhhhh!!!
[They all run to get in the cab, and Chandler pulls out a smoke.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: At least let me smoke it to the good part.
[Phoebe puts the car in gear and starts to back out.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (The car moves a few feet and sputters to a stop.) Oh, no!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What, what’s it, what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, this has happened before.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So you know how to fix it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yep. Put more gas in.
[Scene: Carol and Susan’s, Carol is setting a romantic dinner for Susan as there
is a knock on the door.]

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (answering the door) Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Hey, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, oh just ah, I was just wondering, when you and I split up, did you
get the tape that was half the last episode of M*A*S*H and half the hostages
coming home?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ah yeah, but now it’s Susan and me in Mexico and the hostages coming
home.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Where’s Ben?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: He’s sleeping.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahh. (notices the table) Ooh, is this a ah, is this a bad time?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Umm, yeah, actually, Susan’s gonna be home any minute, it’s
kinda an anniversary.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! I thought you guys got married in uh, January?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: It’s not that kind of anniversary.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah! (realises) Oh.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Sooo!! Anyway...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, candles, champagne, yeah anniversaries are great. ‘Cause you
know love lasts forever, y'know. Nothing like it in this lifetime, money in the bank, so
Rachel and I broke up.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh God, Ross I am so sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Y'know what, I want to talk to you about this so much, but we should
probably do it when we could really get into it, are you free for dinner tomorrow night?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, I’d love that.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh, great! Me too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I guess it all started when Rachel got this new job. (he sits down at the
table.)

scenes.location: The rest stop, Phoebe is on the phone to the motor club.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, yeah. (to Monica and Rachel) Triple A can pick us up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, what town are we near?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Freemont. West-Westmont, ah Westburg?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Monica) Then why are you answering? Do you at least know what route
we’re on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, we are definitely on Route 27.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (on phone) We are at a rest stop on Route 27. Okay. (to Rachel)
There is no Route 27. (listens) (to Rachel) Okay, either 93 or 76?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, I’m sorry, I always slept in the back when we
drove up here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (on phone) Hey, can you send somebody up and down 76 and check
every rest stop, and, and also 93? (listens) Okay! (hangs up) Yeah, no they don’t do
that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, okay, well somebody will come and save us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who? I mean have you seen a car come by here in the last hour and a
half? I think we should call Ross, maybe he can get a car and come pick us up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No, I am not getting in a car with Ross, we will just have to live
here!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But if...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No you guys, I am not getting in a car with him, you’ll have to
think of something else.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh good, oh Joey and Chandler are back.
[Joey walks up helping Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So the going for help went well?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, Smokey Joe here got half way to the highway and collapsed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have the lung capacity of a two year old. (starts to light another
cigarette.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then why are you smoking?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well it’s very unsettling.

scenes.location: Carol and Susan’s, Ross is eating the dinner Carol made for Susan.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ....right? Right? I mean it’s pretty unbelievable y'know, I mean they
just took off, took off without even looking back. Y'know I don’t, I don’t need
them, huh, I’ve got you guys now as friends, you and Susan.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ah, Susan will be so pleased.
[Ross’s beeper goes off.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking at the page) 717? (to Carol) Where’s 717? (He gets up to
return the page, Carol starts to take the last of the food into the kitchen, but Ross
grabs the last piece.) Hey, you’ve have more of these for Susan right?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: No. But it’s okay, I’ll just put out pickles or something.
[Cut to the rest stop, Monica and Phoebe are waiting anxiously by the phone as it
rings.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (answering the phone) (whispering) Ross, thank God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs? What, why are you whispering?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I ate a bug.
[Rachel starts to walk up.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (running over to stop Rachel) Hey Rach, the tampons here are only a
penny. Let’s stock up. (takes her into the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Listen Ross, we ran out of gas, and we don’t know where we are, so
we can’t get a tow truck.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, now you want a favour?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, oh, I’m sorry your car broke down Pheebs, but I’m a little
too busy with some of my real friends right now, but please call to let me know you got
home safely okay?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (running over and grabbing the phone away from Ross) (on phone) Phoebe,
hang on a second. (Hands Ross her keys) Here, take my car, go pick up your friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I’m not gonna pick them up.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Listen, we both know you’re gonna do it ‘cause you’re not
a jerk. Okay? So you can either sulk here for a half hour and then go pick them up, or
save us both time and sulk in the car.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, Rachel doesn’t want me to....

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Look, I-I-I am sorry that Rachel dumped you ‘cause she fell in love
with that Mark guy, and you are the innocent victim in all of this, but don’t punish
your friends for what Rachel did to you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, you’re right.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (on phone) Phoebe hang on a second Ross wants to say something. (listens)
What? (listens) (to Ross) You slept with someone else?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We were on a break!!! Okay!! (grabs the phone) We were, we were..., (calms
down) yeah. Where are you? I’ll find you. (hangs up)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: You slept with another woman?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you-you’re-you’re one to talk.

scenes.location: The rest stop, Joey is making a sign.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, done.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (reading the sign) What’s ‘pleh’?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s ‘help’ spelled backwards so that the helicopters can
read it from the air!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Huh. What’s doofus spelled backwards?
[Ross drives up.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (all excited) Op, op, car! Car!! (sees it’s Ross) Ugh!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it’s Ross on one of his drives!

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Hey!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is he doing here?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He is saving your butt, ah, unless of course I’m stepping on
some toes here, in which case I can just mosey on, I’ve got plenty of people to help
on the Interstate.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: No! Come on!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right!! Fine! Fine.
[Ross grabs the gas can he brought along, and walks through Joey’s sign destroying
it.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Arrrghh!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no, now it’s not gonna make any sense!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Chandler and Monica) You guys, what, what do we do about Ross who
drove all the way up here? What do we do? Just like send him back and we’re then
gonna go skiing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, this is horrible, it’s just horrible.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Guys, do you think we should ask Ross to come along?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, what about Rachel? I mean how are we even gonna ask her?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ask me what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, if ah, it might be okay if Ross came skiing?
Chandler, Phoebe, and Joey: No, I wasn’t gonna ask you that, no.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys are unbelievable. No! He cannot come.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s horrible.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh please, can’t I come to your special, magical cabin?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why would you even want to come Ross? You’re a horrible skier.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh, hitting me where it hurts, my ski skills.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here we go again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I-I can’t handle this, you guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what, I can handle it, handle’s my middle name. Actually
it’s the ah, middle part of my first name.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right Pheebs, your cab’s ready.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, let’s go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re welcome.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry, were you speaking to me or sleeping with someone
else?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We were on a break!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know Ross why don’t you put that on your answering
machine!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey-hey, it’s valid okay? And I’m not the only one who thinks
so, Monica agrees with me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica) What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shyly) I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s what you said last night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What I said was, was that I understood. Joey’s the one who agreed
with you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really Joey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause) What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know what, but there is, there is no right or wrong, here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I think it’s very obvious who’s wrong here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Obviously not to Joey.
[They all turn around and look at Joey.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause) What?
[They all start fighting with each other.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) Look both, Joey and Monica feel the same way that I do.
No-no-no-no.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Guys, guys, guess who I am?! (starts dancing around in an effort to
stop the fighting.)
[They stop briefly to look at Chandler, but then start fighting again.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Hey! Hey! Hey!! Hey!!! (they all stop fighting, Chandler continues
to dance.) Look what you’re doing to Chandler!! (Chandler finally stops) (to Ross and
Rachel) Yeah, look, we know this is really, really hard for you guys. Okay? (Ross starts
to leave) You don’t, all right you don’t have to love each other, okay? You
don’t, you don’t even have to like each other much right now. But please, you
have to figure out a way to be around each other.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, and not put us in the middle.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, otherwise, I mean that’s, that’s, that’s just it
for us hanging out together. Y'know is that what you want? (they both look away) Can you
be civil?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Good, all right, let’s get back in the car, ‘cause
it’s freezing, and my chest is unsupported.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh what, wait, wait a second, I mean, what are we doing? Who’s going
with who?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, you guys, you guys should go. (Joey tries to say something, but Ross
cuts him off.) No, I’m, you, you planned this all out, and I don’t want to ruin
it, so you guys should just go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on man, you drove all the way up here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, really, I’ve got to take the car back anyway, I’m
spending all day tomorrow with Ben, It’s fine, no guilt I promise.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, we’ll call you when we get back.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe we can like go to a movie or something.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or, or the rodeo!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That would be great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was being Shelly Winters from The Poseidon Adventure.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know!
[They all get in the cab and drive away.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bye!!!
[Ross tries to start the truck, and discovers the battery’s dead.]

title: The One with the Hypnosis Tape

scenes.location: Central Perk, all but Chandler are there, Joey laughs for no apparent reason.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Joey) What’s so funny?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, nothing, no. It’s an acting exercise, I’m practising my fake
laugh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. (she laughs)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What-what’s so funny?
(Chandler enters with a cigarette.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (to Chandler) Oh, no-no, no-no-no, there’s none of that in here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh come on man! At least let me finish this last one.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Okay, but only if you give me a drag.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(Chandler hands him the cigarette, and he takes a long drag.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Oh dark mother, once again I suckle at your smokey tit. (hands Chandler
back the cigarette.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no, why don’t you hang on to that one.
(He goes and sits down next to Rachel and puts a cigarette in his mouth, which Rachel
takes away from him. He puts another cigarette in his mouth, and Rachel takes it away
again.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, that’s like the least fun game ever.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I’m really sick of your smoking, so I brought something that
is going to help you quit. (hands him an audio cassette)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh. (takes the cassette and puts it on his arm like the stop smoking
patch, and it falls off.) Nope, that patch is no good. (Joey and Monica both do their fake
laughs.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on, it’s a hypnosis tape. This woman at work used it for two
weeks straight and she hasn’t smoked since.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pffhah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Ross) What’s your problem?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing, it’s just that hypnosis is beyond crap.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I watched you get hypnotised in Atlantic City.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, that guy did not hypnotise me! Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh right, ‘cause you always pull your pants down at the count of
three and play Wipe-out on your butt cheeks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, y'know forget hypnosis. The way to quit smoking is you have
to dance naked in a field of heather, and then bath in the sweat of six healthy young men.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Or what my Father called Thursday night.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier, Ross is handing Rachel a cup of coffee.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here you go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, y'know what, I didn’t want cinnamon on this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry. (To remedy that, Ross scoops the cinnamon off of the top with his
hand.)

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Frank! Hi!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: How are you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh, well y'know, I would’ve called but I lost your phone number and
then ah, my Mom locked me out of the house so I couldn’t find it. And then, I tried
to find a pay phone, and ah, the receiver was cut off. So...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Ah, oh, the ah, vandalism.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But, also, what happened between you and your Mom?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Well, we got into a fight ‘cause ah, she said I was to immature to
get married.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Your getting married?!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh, yeah!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My little brother’s getting married!!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh, I knew you’d be so cool about this. All right, ah, hey, do you
want to meet her?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do I?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Do you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I do, yeah.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Okay, cool, all right, she just ah, parking the truck. (to Joey) I’m
gonna, I’m gonna get my ah, my fianc�e man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I would’ve bet good money that he’d be the first one
of us to get married.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, isn’t it fantastic?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, ah, but Pheebs don’t you think he’s a little young to
get married?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What, he’s 18.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Exactly, it’ll be illegal for him to drink at his own bachelor party.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, or-or to get a hooker.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Always illegal Joe.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: (entering with his fianc�e Alice, who is obviously much, much older than
he is) Hey! Hey! This is ah, my fianc�e, Mrs. Knight. (he points out Phoebe to her)

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Y'know it-it’s funny, um, Frank told me so much about you, but your
not how I pictured you at all.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I’m a big surprise.
(Ross lets them both sit in his chair.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, um, how-how did you guys meet?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Well um, I was in ah Mrs. Knight’s ah, I mean Alice, sorry, Alice, I
always do that. I was in her ah, Home Ec class.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: And he was my best student.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah, she was my best teacher.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Ohhh. (They embrace in a very passionate kiss.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If that doesn’t keep kids in school, what will?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And so now you guys are gonna be married?

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Yeah. Y'know we-we talked about just living together, but um, we want to
have kids right away.
(Both Chandler and Phoebe have shocked looks on their faces.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!! Great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, kids. Frank, are you sure you’re ready for that?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: I mean, how hard can it be? Y'know, I mean, y'know, babies, y'know who
doesn’t want babies right? And besides y'know, I never had a Dad around, and ah,
now-now I always will, ‘cause y'know, it’ll be me. Right?

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Y'know, I mean, really we do realise that there’s an age difference
between us.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh good! Okay. ‘Cause you were acting like you didn’t.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Oh no, but when it comes to love, what does age matter?
(They both growl and hiss at each other and then kiss passionately again.)

scenes.location: Chandler’s bedroom, Chandler is listening to the hypnosis tape.

lines.speaker: Hypnosis Tape
lines.text: You are falling fast asleep. Deeper. Deeper. Deeper. You are now
completely asleep. You don’t need to smoke. Cigarettes don’t control you. You
are a strong, confident woman, who does not need to smoke. A strong, confident woman.

scenes.location: The Moondance Diner, Monica is working, Rachel is having lunch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And y'know what, I just realised, in the last year I’ve only gone
out with two guys, Richard and Julio. You gotta help me out here, you gotta set me up, you
gotta get me back in the game.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, that shouldn’t be a problem. I mean I work in fashion and all
I meet are eligible straight men.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to a customer) Pete, can I get you something else?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Yeah, a slice of cheesecake and-and a date if you’re given’
‘em out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Haven’t you and I covered that topic?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Hmm, come on, you just said to her that you….

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aww, the only reason you want to go out with me because my blond wig,
and the big boobs, and the fact that I serve you food.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Well, if that were true, I’d dating my Aunt Ruth. And the two times
we went out were just plain awkward. (to Rachel) Come on, you think she should go out with
me, don’t you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Well, I mean, are you sure you want to go out with her? I mean
that ain’t a pretty picture in the morning, y’know what I mean. That wig all in
disarray, and boobs flung over the night stand, y'know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean really, think about it.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Ho-ho, I will.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Ross and Joey are being lectured by Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I know, I know, that this is Frank’s life, (walks behind them,
they turn around in the leather chairs to face her) y'know. Y'know, I don’t want to
be all judgmental, y'know, but this is sick, it’s sick and wrong!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, what, is it the age thing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no, oh, I’m fine with the age thing y'know, until it starts
sticking it’s tongue down my little brother’s throat!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs, he seems to enjoy it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But, I mean, do you think he’s gonna enjoy it when he’s up to
his elbows in the diapers from all the babies they have to have right away?! This is not
fair to Frank, (she walks behind them again, and hey again turn to follow her) and
it-it’s not fair to the babies, and y'know what, it’s not good home economics.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, have-have you told him how you feel?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. Not out loud.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, if you don’t tell him, soon he’s gonna be married, and
then you’re gonna hate yourself.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but if I do tell him, then he’s gonna hate myself. I mean
look at him and his Mom, I can’t. (pause) But, you guys can, please you gotta talk
him out of it.

lines.speaker: Ross and Joey
lines.text: No-no-no-no-no. (They start to turn away, but Phoebe stops them,
and turns them back to face her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, you guys, you have nothing to lose, I have everything to lose.
Do you want me to lose everything? Everything?!

lines.speaker: Ross and Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I’m gonna go get Frank. (exits)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, we’re walking down the street and I turn to you and I say,
“Hey, let’s go hang out at Totally Nude Nudes,” remember? And then, and
then, you turn to me and say, “Nah, let’s just hang out at your place.”
Well, that was a nice move dumb ass.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think you should definitely go out with this guy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nah, he doesn’t do anything for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, last Saturday night, what happened on Walker: Texas Ranger?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, umm, Walker was looking for this big bus load of kids….

lines.text: All right.

lines.text: (entering, carrying a briefcase) Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.text: Y'know, I forgot the combination to this about a year ago? I just

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, how are those tapes working out for ya?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what, pretty good.

lines.text: Yeah?

lines.text: Good! I haven’t smoked yet today, I feel great, and-and-and

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here you go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Mon, let’s give Pete a chance Come on, he was funny, he seems

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What check thing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: As a joke, this customer at work who has a crush on me gave me a $20,000

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reading the check) Pete Becker. Pete… (quickly grabs a magazine

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s Bill Clinton.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who’s he huggin’?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! That’s Pete! But why is Bill huggin’ Pete?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This guy invented Moss 865! Every office in the world uses that

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We use it!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There you go!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, Monica’s gonna go out with a millionaire.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m not gonna go out with him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, I can’t believe this is a real $20,000 check, oh this is

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Or incredibly offensive.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, sure, that too.
(Chandler is putting on the Chap Stick the same way that women put on lipstick,
including the bit with the piece of tissue.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to the girls who are staring at him) What?

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Ross and Joey are talking to Frank.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All we’re saying is don’t rush into anything.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, come on, think about it. You’re 18, okay, she’s 44, when

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: What, you don’t think I know that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, the point is, there’s a lot of women out there you haven’t

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, he-he’s right, he’s right. This is your time y'know, yeah,

lines.text: Okay, but isn’t sex better when it’s with one person that you

lines.text: Yeah, in a poem maybe.

lines.text: No, I ah, I slept with someone else.

lines.text: Okay, so wait, all right, so how does that make things better?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Okay, so what you used to have with Rachel, is what I’ve got with
Alice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now, wh-what, what is that like?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: It’s so cool man, it’s so, it’s just ‘cause being
with her is so much better than like not being with her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross) Why can’t I find that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don’t ask me, I had it and I blew it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I want it!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: You can have it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know, maybe I can’t. I mean, maybe there’s
something wrong with me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no! No!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: It’s out there man! I’ve seen it! I got it!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then you hold on to it!!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: All right, man!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, congratulations you lucky bastard! (hugs him)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, it’s after Ross and Joey’s talk with Frank, and
Phoebe’s is finding out what happened.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Joey) You’re Frank’s best man?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I couldn’t help it, there love is so pure.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well then, (to Ross) what about you?! Huh?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m the ring bearer.
(As Phoebe stands there in shock and disbelief, Chandler comes out of the bathroom and
walks to his bedroom. He’s just got out of the shower and has the towel wrapped

Commercial Break

scenes.location: Phoebe’s, Phoebe is opening the door.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi! Oh, Alice, hi! Thanks. I’m so glad you could come, ‘cause
I’ve got a real umm, Home Ec emergency. (Points to the table cloth, which has a huge
mustard stain on it.)

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Oh my God, who died on this?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I know. It’s a real mustard-tastrophe. Can you help me?

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Absolutely. Okay, first we’ll start with a little club soda and
salt, and then if that doesn’t work we can go back to…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know what, forget it. It’s ruined.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Oh no-no, never say that. If we can’t get it out then we can cut
around the stain, add a little lace, you make a stylish throw.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or instead, maybe you could just not marry my brother Frank.
[Scene: Pete’s office, he is participating in a conference call with three other
employees, each of whom are on a different TV screen that he controls with a remote.]

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Okay, that’s great, but can we make it smaller? Can we make it fit on
the head of a pin? I love when we make things fit on the head of a pin.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Got it. Yeah all right. Yeah, okay.
(The intercom buzzes.)

lines.speaker: Secretary
lines.text: You have a Miss Monica Geller here.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Uh, absolutely, yeah, sEnd her in. (Monica enters) Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What the hell is this? (holding up the check)

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Hang on a second. (to the employees) I’ll-I’ll talk to you in
the morning. (turns two of the three off) I’m sorry what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Seriously, what is this supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Well, y’know, I never know how much to tip.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re supposed to double the tax. Not double the tax of Romania. I
mean, what’s-what’s the deal? Are you, are you trying to buy me? Is this the way
you get girls to go out with you?

lines.speaker: Employee
lines.text: Umm, I’m still here.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: (turns off the TV) You’re taking this all wrong. Because, if I
didn’t leave you that tip, you wouldn’t of come down here, we wouldn’t be
having this argument, and there wouldn’t be this ah, heat between us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Come on, you gotta admit that our relationship is ah, is hitting a new
level now. ‘Cause you used to be like the chef, and I was the customer, and now
we’re like this-this couple that fights.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, umm, you’re a loon.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Look, forget the check, okay. (rips up the check) I like you. I think
you’re great. Come on, what do you say?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ‘Cause I don’t want to encourage this kind of behaviour.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: One meal! That’s all I’m asking for. Please? We go out, we eat,
and if you don’t have a good time, I give you ten grand, we call it even.
[Scene: Phoebe’s, she is coming home. She turns on the lights, and sits down on
the couch.]

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: (hiding under a pile of clothes) Hi. (She jumps up screaming.) Wait, no!
Just put the mail down. It’s-it’s me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Whoa, sorry. Why were you just like all in the dark?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh well, um, your, your laundry just smelled so good, that I thought
I’d curl up in it. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, sure. So, how was your day?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh, well just probably the worst one since I’ve been alive.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What umm, what happened?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Umm, Alice ah, she ah, called it off.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no. Did umm, did she say why?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Uh, no, not really, just that I was too young, y'know, but I don’t
see how I could all of the sudden be too young, ‘cause I’m older than I was when
we first got together.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, no, I don’t, I don’t know. But, y'know what, maybe
it’s just all for the best?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah, if the best is like unbelievable pain!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, sweetie, oh. (hugs him)

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Y'know, I just was finally happy y'know. For the first time in my life!
After my Dad left me, and then, and then getting arrested for stealing those birds, and
then, and then the whole punctured lung thing! I can, it’s still really hard to take
deep breaths in cold weather, but with Alice all that stuff kinda went away. And now
it’s, and now it’s gone and I don’t know why!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh, well I can tell you why. It’s, it’s because of me. But,
y'know what, I only did it because I love you. Okay?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, well I, I kinda had a little chat with Alice, and I sort of made
her see why you two shouldn’t be together, y'know. And you’re gonna see it to,
one day, you really, really will.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Wait a minute, wait, this is because of you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Well, you, wait no, my Mother didn’t want us to be together, but the
worst thing she ever did was tie me to the porch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, but.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Wait, y'know what, I-I came to you because I thought you’d
understand! Oh no!! Y'know, I would storm out of here right now if-if I had some money, or
a place to go…
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is getting Monica ready for her date. The guys are
also there. The door buzzes.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! The millionaire’s here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (in a feminine way) Oh my God! (and he jumps all around)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys, please, I’m just gonna have dinner with him. Okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, okay, just because he buys you dinner, does not mean you owe him
anything.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, then get the lobster!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (opening the door) (to Pete) Hey!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!
(They’re all staring at him, with big, huge smiles on their faces.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, how much cash do you got in your pocket right now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And that’s why, I’m not inviting you in for a drink. (starts
to leave) Bye.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh-no-no-no-no….

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just one drink?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (in the hallway) So, where do you want to go?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Hey, you like pizza?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, that’s sounds great.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I know a great little place.
[Cut to a shot of the coliseum in Rome, Italy.]

scenes.location: A restaurant in Rome, Monica is paying for the pizza.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: You’re, hey, you’re not paying for the pizza!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh come on, it’s only fair, you paid for the flight. Now is, is
that enough lire?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Ahh, I’d throw another thousand on that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why, how much is that?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: That’s about 60 cents.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, it’s the middle of the night. Joey is walking into
the living room, and runs into the entertainment centre.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Every night!!
(He starts to walk to the bathroom and hears the hypnosis tape from Chandler’s
bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Hypnosis Tape
lines.text: You do not need to smoke. Cigarettes don’t control you. You
are a strong, confident woman, who does not need to smoke. A strong, confident woman, who
does not need to smoke. (Joey walks out smiling to himself.)
[Scene: Phoebe’s, Frank is watching TV, and he’s very depressed as Phoebe
enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, Frank. Look, okay, I know that you think I did like this totally
evil thing, but I so didn’t. There’s someone here who can explain this better
than I can.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Hi Frank.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Hi, Mrs. Knight.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Phoebe’s right Frank. I know it’s hard to hear, but it
would’ve been wrong to go through with it. I-I-I was being selfish, even though we,
we want the same things now, in the future we may not. (to Phoebe) Is that it, is that
what it is?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but not just that.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Right, not just that. Umm, even though we love each other as much as we
do, none the less…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: None the less.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: None the less. Umm, you’re too young to, to really know what you
want. (They embrace in a passionate kiss.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s right, exactly. (sees them) All right, it’s a good bye
kiss, that’s good. (Frank picks Alice up and they move to the couch) Bye-bye. (They
both lie down on the couch and start to make out.) Okay, no, the important thing is that
you see what I’m saying, y'know, just y'know, this is clearly wrong. (They ignore
her) Okay, I’ve decided I’m gonna let this happen! Okay, can I just get my
purse? (She reaches in and Alice moans) Okay, all right, good. (leaves).

title: The One with the Tiny T-Shirt

scenes.location: Central Perk, Gunther is pouring Rachel coffee.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Here you go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (In his head) Say Rachel, I was wondering if you’d like to go
to a movie with me sometime. As my lover! Nnnsch, to out there. Maybe you’d just like
to ah, get something to eat with me sometime? As my lover.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! All right, let’s go shoppin’!!

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Um, y'know, before we go ah, there’s something I need to say.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: I’ve kinda of had this ah, this crush on you. (Rachel is shocked) But
since you were with Ross, I-I didn’t do anything about it. But, now that you’re
not, I’d really like to ask you out sometime. So-so that’s-that’s what
I’m doing, now.
(Gunther gets this hurt expression on his face and goes into the back room)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Umm....
(She’s interrupted by a loud crash and the sound of braking dishes. Followed
quickly by another crash. Everyone turns and looks at the back room, as Gunther emerges.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I dropped a cup.
Opening Credits
[Scene: The hallway between the two apartments, Pete and Monica are returning from
their date.]

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: ...so y'know, that’s why, within a few years, that voice recognition
is gonna be pretty much standard on any computer you buy. Y'know, so you could be
like-like, ‘Wash my car.’ ‘Clean my room.’ It’s not gonna be able
to do any of those things, but it’ll understand what you’re saying.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, this is so great.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Yeah, it was.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right then. (He leans in to kiss her goodnight, but she quickly
kisses him on the cheek and pats his shoulder.) Bye.
(She goes into her apartment and sees Chandler, Phoebe, and Ross sitting there.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello, people who do not live here.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi! Hello!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I gave you a key for emergencies!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We were out of Doritos.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, how’d the date go with Mr. Millionaire?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mr. Millionaire, new from Snooty Playthings! Third wife sold
separately.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He’s great! I mean we have such a good time together! He’s so
funny, and sooo sweet, and I’m not attracted to him at all!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Still?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Noo!! It’s driving me crazy. I mean every other way he’s like
the perfect guy, he has everything. Plus! He actually has everything.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Life-sized Imperial Storm Troopers from Sharper Image?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Two.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow!! Can Joey and I put them on and fight?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, dancing and singing) Oh mommie, oh daddie, I am a big old
baddie! Oh mommie, oh daddie, I am a big old baddie! (He dances around the dinner table
and exits)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I guess he musta gotten the part in that play.

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, either that, or Gloria Estefan was right, eventually, the rhythm
is going to get you.

scenes.location: A Theatre, Joey is arriving to rehearse the play he’s in.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Joe. How’s it going?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good. (He sets his stuff down and starts talking to Kate, another cast
member.) Hey.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, so you’re playing Adrienne, huh?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Yes. Are you one of the retarded cousins?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, no. Ah, I playing your husband, Victor. I’m Joey Tribianni.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Hi, nice to meet you. Kate Miller.
(She goes over to the snack table, and Joey quickly runs over and pours her a cup of
coffee.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So the ah, play’s pretty great, huh?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Oh, yeah. I love Jennifer Van Murray’s work. She’s so
