brilliantly incisive when it comes to deconstructing the psyche of the American middle
class.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, forget about it. She rocks!

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Where do I know you from?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dr. Drake Remoray. Days of Our Lives. Voted most datable
neurosurgeon by Teen Beat.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: No, that’s not it. So, you’re a soap actor? Well this must be
pretty exciting for you to be in a real play, hmm?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I’ve done plays before. I’m a serious actor.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: That info-mercial! For the milk carton spout thing!
You’re-you’re-you’re the guy that doesn’t know how to pour milk!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See, I actually can pour milk, but I got you believing that I
couldn’t. Now, see, that’s acting.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Right, at the end, you choked on a cookie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, that was real.
[Scene: Central Perk, Rachel is telling Phoebe about Mark, as Gunther eavesdrops behind
them.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! I cannot believe Mark asked you out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What, so what are you gonna tell him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I told him I would think about it, but I’m gonna tell him no.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh.
(Gunther tries to swoop in to ask Rachel out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean I think I’d say no to anybody right now. (Hearing this
Gunther swoops back to cleaning tables.) Oh, but it was so strange. I mean I’m
standing there with this charming, cute guy, who’s asking me to go out with him,
which I’m allowed to do, and I felt guilty. Y'know, like I’d be cheating on Ross
or something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow. So, okay, maybe that means that, you’re not over Ross yet and
you have issues with your father.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t have any issues with my Father.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so it’s probably just the Ross thing then.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is telling Chandler about Kate.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I hate this woman!! I hate her! She told everyone in the company about
that info-mercial, and now they all keep asking me to open their drinks. Okay, and
whenever I can’t do it, they’re all like-like laughing at me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hello.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So Rachel called. Wants to see me. Going over in a minute.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow, what-what do you think she wants?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, maybe the crazy fog has lifted and she realises that life without
me.... a-sucks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s possible. You are very loveable, I’d miss you if I
broke up with you. (Ross glares at him) I was just trying to be supportive.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then be supportive like a guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (in a deep voice) If I broke up with you, I’d miss you.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is there as Ross enters, walking very confidently.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You ah, wanted to see me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Ahh, here’s a box of your stuff. (hands him a box)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, y'know, it’s just like hats, and a shirt, and CD’s, just
sort of stuff that you’ve left here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you doing? Are you trying to hurt me? Or something?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. Ross, it, it just seems that y'know it’s time we-we y'know,
move on. I mean, I mean don’t’ you think?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I-I really do. (takes a dinosaur mug out of the box) Hey! This-this
was a gift?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, you got that for free from the museum gift shop.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s still a gift! I got it from the gift shop!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, all right, give me the mug! I’ll keep the mug.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!! Y'know-y'know don’t do me any favours. In fact, where,
where’s the rest of my stuff?! Huh? Like-like my umm, (picks up a book) Hey, this
book is mine!! And-and-and, and that T-shirt you sleep in? I’d like that back too.
Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know how much I love that T-shirt! You never even where that
T-shirt!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m just trying to help you, move on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you are a petty man. You are a petty, petty....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Petty...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Petty... (goes into her room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Petty...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Petty...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Petty...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Small...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Small... (Rachel comes back into the living room and catches Ross mocking
her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are so just doing this out of spite.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Awwwahuh, no, no, no!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m-I’m gonna wear this all the time! I love this shirt!! (he
kisses the shirt)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You have not worn that T-shirt since you were 15!! It doesn’t even
fit you anymore!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah-yeah-yeah-yeah...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (imitating him) yeah-yeah-yeah!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh, okay, okay! (He quickly takes off his sweater in order to put on
the T-shirt. It’s an old ‘Frankie says relax’ T-shirt, that barely fits
him. Rachel nods her head in approval of the new look.) If you don’t mind I’m
gonna the rest of my stuff, and relax, in my favourite shirt. (Starts to leave) You have a
pleasant evening. (He exits and leaves the door open.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, the gang minus Rachel and Ross are talking to Pete.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, you’re like a zillionaire? (Pete smiles and nods)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And you’re our age. You’re our age.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know what, you should like, you should buy a state and then just name
it after yourself.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: What like Pete Dakota?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, or, or, or, Mississ-Pete.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, oh, I got it! Pete-Chicago.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s not a state Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, and Mississ-Pete is?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I got to go, so ah, I’ll see you guys later.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re our age!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: (to Monica, by the door) So ah, we on for tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Absolutely! (He goes to kiss her, but she stops him and rubs his head
and says...) Now get out of here you!! (Pete leaves) (to the gang) Okay, I’m running
out of places I can touch him! Look, is there something wrong with me? I mean why am I
only attracted to guys where there’s no future? Either they’re too old, or
they’re too young, and then there’s Pete who’s-who’s crazy about me,
and who’s absolutely perfect for me, and there’s like zip going on! I mean,
seriously, does it sound like something’s wrong with me?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, kinda.

scenes.location: The Theatre, Joey and Kate are rehearsing for the play.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Happy?! Is that what I’m supposed to be Vic? Happy?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, why don’t you tell me what you’re supposed to be! Huh?
Because I sure as hell can’t figure it out! I talk to you and nothin’. You look
at me, and it’s nothin’. (He kisses her) Nothing.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Tasty! I’m really starting to feel like you guys have a
history, it’s-it’s nice.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: I have a question about this scene.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Well, I don’t understand why Adrienne’s attracted to Victor.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Peel the onion. First of all, he’s good looking.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: I think my character’s gonna need a little bit more of reason than
that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey, how about this one. Ah, it’s says so in the script! Y'know
ah, I-I don’t know why my character likes you either, I mean it says in the script
here that you’re a bitch.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: It doesn’t say that in the script.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It does in mine!

scenes.location: The Hallway, Chandler and Ross are returning from working out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can blow dry it. I can put gel on it. It doesn’t matter, I
still wind up with this little (pats the flat spot on the back of his head) cowlicky thing
on the middle part of my head. It’s so annoying. Does it bug you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You bug me.
[Rachel comes out of her apartment, followed by Mark, and they leave on their date,
without saying a word to Ross. Ross is stunned.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is there any chance you didn’t see that?
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is watching a basketball game, Ross is staring
out the peephole.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross! You gotta stop! Okay?! You can’t just stare through the
peep hole for three hours! You’re gonna get peep eye!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I knew it! I knew it! I always knew she liked him! Y'know, she’d say
no, but here we are! Right? We just broke up, first thing she does!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You didn’t just break up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, it’s been like three weeks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You slept with somebody three hours after you thought you broke up. I
mean bullets have left guns slower!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here they come, here they come. Oh-ho, if she kisses him goodnight,
I’m gonna kill myself, I swear. I can’t, I can’t watch this. (turns away,
then quickly turns to look again) Come on, date over! Date over! Uh-oh, here we go,
she’s going in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She’s going in. Wait! He’s going in! He’s going in!! The
door’s closed! I, I can’t see anything but the door closed!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And the inventor of the door rests happily in his grave.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I have to do something. I mean, I have, I have to stop it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stop what?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know, but I ah, I have the feeling that my being there will
do it. I’ll go over and I will borrow something. Juice!! I need juice!!
(He starts to exit, but Chandler tries to stop him by climbing on his back and grabbing
hold of the foosball table.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!! You can’t!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, they must be stopped!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am your friend, and I am not gonna let you do this!!
(Ross is now dragging Chandler and the foosball table to the door) You are surprisingly
strong!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I need juice! People need juice!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look man!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: People need juice!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen to me!! (Chandler turns him around and closes and holds the
door shut with his feet.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Juice, I need...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She’s moving on! Okay, if it’s not this guy, it’s gonna
be somebody else! And unless you’re thinking about subletting my peep hole, you
are going to have to get used to the fact that the relationship is over! Okay, man?
It’s over.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s just I miss her so much.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know. (He rubs Ross’s head)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is pouring Mark some coffee.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Why do all you’re coffee mugs have numbers on the bottom?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. That’s so Monica can keep track. That way if one on them is
missing, she can be like, ‘Where’s number 27?!’
(She sits down, and Mark leans over and kisses her. Rachel doesn’t react. He tries
it again, and Rachel jumps back quickly.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know what?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: No. And I don’t think I’m gonna want to.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can’t do this.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yep. Yep, that’s what I didn’t want to know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, oh, Mark, I’m doing this for the wrong reasons, y'know?
I’m just doing it to get back at Ross. I’m sorry, it’s not very fair to
you.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Ahh! Fair, schmair! Y'know? Look, if you want to get back at Ross, I am
here for you. Really? No-no, I say-I say, I say we get back at him right on this couch.
Right here!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God. I’m sorry about this.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: That’s okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You sure?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yeah. I can just go home and get back at him by myself.

scenes.location: A Hospital Reception, Monica and Pete are there.

lines.speaker: Spokeswoman
lines.text: ...has become the penicillin of the twenty-first century. And so
today, this hospital is about to take major steps toward leading that revolution. It is
truly ironic, on one hand consider the size...

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: (to Monica) Hey, can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Where are we?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looks around) Well, with all these doctors and nurses, I’m gonna
say, midget rodeo.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Just tell me the truth.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Umm, y'know, I don’t think, I don’t think I told you
this, but umm, I just got out of a really serious relationship.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Wasn’t that like a year ago?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So I did tell you. Okay, y'know, that really isn’t the thing. Umm,
the thing is that, right now I’m just in a place in my life where I need to focus on
me. Y'know what I mean?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Oh, yeah. I know that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I so wanna be attracted to you.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: But you’re not. Okay, good.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Y'know what, don’t be. This is not, don’t be, ‘cause
it’s not so bad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s not?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I know I’m no John Bon Jovi, (Monica laughs) or someone
who find attractive, I’m just, I think, y'know, that you might end up feeling
differently.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, um, look I-I don’t want this to come our wrong, but ah, you
seem awfully confident for a guy I just told I wasn’t attracted too.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Yeah, stupidly charming isn’t’ it? Well listen let’s, you
wanna get something to eat? ‘Cause this place is kinda depressing. (they start
to leave)

lines.speaker: Spokeswoman
lines.text: And the man who made all this possible... Mr. Peter Becker.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: (to Monica) One second.
(He takes the scissors, cuts the ribbon, shakes her hand, posses for the picture, and
leaves.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is sitting in one of the black chairs, and turns
to face the other one.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t think this town is big enough for both of us to relax in.
(He blows on his hand) Draw!! (He quickly pulls the lever to raise the foot rest, like a
gunfighter in a Western.)
(Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) I wasn’t doing anything. (Joey starts angrily throwing
his stuff down.) Uh-oh, what did she do now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just because she went to Yale drama, she thinks she’s like the
greatest actress since, since, sliced bread!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, Sliced Bread, a wonderful Lady MacBeth.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: God, I just, I hate her! I hate her!! With her, ‘Oh, I’m so
talented.’ and ‘Oh, I’m so pretty,’ and ‘Ooh, I smell so

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think somebody has a crush on somebody.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Chandler, can we please stay focused on my problem here?! Y'know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m talking about you. You big, big freak.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. (realises) Ohh. Ohh, you’re out of your mind.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you have nothing but talk about her for the last 48 hours! If you
were in a school yard you’d be pulling her pigtails and pushing her down now!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah?! Then how come I keep thinking about her in all these sexual
scenarios and stuff huh?!

scenes.location: The Theatre, Kate and Joey are rehearsing the same scene as before.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Happy?! Is that what I’m supposed to be Vic? Happy?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, why don’t you tell me what you’re supposed to be! Huh?
Because I sure as hell can’t figure it out! I talk to you and it’s nothin’.
You look at me, and nothin’. (He kisses her, more passionately this time) Nothing.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: You guys make me fly! High! Okay, we’re gonna pick it up
here, tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Well, that was ah...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Better?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah, it was definitely an improvement. G’night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, Kate?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You ah, you forgot your shoes.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: (she giggles) I’m probably gonna need those. Huh? (she giggles some
more)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, listen you ah....

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ...feel like getting a cup of coffee?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Umm.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: (leaning in) Kate?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: You ready to go?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: (to Joey) Very nice. Very nice. (he walks away)

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: So umm, I’ll see you tomorrow, huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah sure, goodnight.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is in the kitchen chopping vegetables. Chandler and
Phoebe are sitting in the living room.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Chandler) Hey! (Chandler looks up, startled) Why isn’t it
Spiderman? Y’know like Goldman, Silverman...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ‘Cause it’s-it’s not his last name.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It isn’t?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it’s not like, like Phil Spiderman. He’s a spider, man.
Y'know like ah, like Goldman is a last name, but there’s no Gold Man.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay. There should be Gold Man!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Rach, how was work?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, great. Although I did sit down where there wasn’t a chair.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: By the way, Ross dropped by a box of your stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well, I guess I had that one coming. I’m just gonna throw it
out, it’s probably just a bunch of shampoo and... (she opens the box and stops)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Something wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (She takes the T-shirt out of the box and holds it to her chest and take
a deep breath.) No. Nothing. (She smiles and goes into her room.)

title: The One with the Dollhouse

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler, Monica, Phoebe, and Joey are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait a minute, wait. You’re telling me this actress person is the
only woman you ever wanted who didn’t want you back?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Oh my God! (to Chandler) Is this what it’s like to be you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, you’re really crazy about her, huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you have no idea. And-and when we’re on stage I get to-to kiss
her and-and touch her, but then she goes home with the director, and it’s like
somebody’s ripping out my heart!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it’s so great to see you feeling like this!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica, uh Dad called this morning and ah, Aunt Silvia passed away.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!! Yes! Yeah, yeah, yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We were all pretty shaken up about it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, am I missing something though? ‘Cause I thought death was
something that’s supposed to be sad, in a way.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well ah, Aunt Silvia was, well not a nice person.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, she was a cruel, cranky, old bitch! (Ross gives her a look) (to
Ross) And I’m sorry she died. Did Dad say I get the dollhouse?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You get the dollhouse.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I get the dollhouse!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, a house for dolls, that is so cool! When I was kid, I had a barrel.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, Pheebs, you had a barrel for a dollhouse?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, just a barrel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what, you can play with my dollhouse.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?! Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Any time you want. Y'know, when I was younger, all I wanted to do was to
play with this dollhouse, but no!! It was to be looked at, but never played with.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: My Grandmother used to say that exact same thing to me.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Rachel’s office, Chandler and her are coming back from lunch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, Sophie!

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Hey, Rach!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks for lunch, Chandler. Y'know, you didn’t have to walk me all
the way back up here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that’s-that’s okay, no problem. (He starts to look
around her office.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey um, honey, you do realise that we don’t keep the women’s
lingerie here in the office?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, I realise that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Summer catalogue! (hands him the catalogue)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s the stuff! (quickly grabs it)
[Rachel’s boss, Joanna, enters]

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Rachel, I need the Versachi invoice. (to Chandler) Hello! You
don’t work for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (introduces them) Joanna, this is my friend Chandler Bing (to Chandler)
Joanna.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Bing! That’s a great name.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks, it’s ah, Gaelic, for ‘Thy turkey’s done.’
So ah, I’m gonna go, nice, nice meeting you.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: (to Rachel) So ah, what’s wrong with him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, nothing, he’s just goofy like that, I actually, hardly notice
it anymore.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh no, no-no-no, is he ah, married, or involved with anyone?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!! No! He’s not married, or involved, with anyone!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh, Rachel, (pause) actually, y'know what, forget it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I’ll ask him for you, if you want me too?

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Would you? Or, is it just to sad and desperate, and y'know something
that Sophie would do?

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Uh, uh, uh, I am here.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: I know that.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is showing off her new dollhouse. It’s a huge
dollhouse, that takes up the entire living room table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look at it! Ohhh! Wallpaper’s a little faded, that’s okay.
Carpet’s a little loose. Hardwood floors!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Ooh! Oh Monica! It’s so beautiful.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, I’m here, ready to play.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I brought a bunch of stuff for the house, so check it out. Ha-ha. (She
removes this large ceramic dog that comes up to the second floor and places it next to the
house.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s a dog, every house should have a dog.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not one that can pee on the roof.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, maybe it’s so big because the house was built on radioactive
waste.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (holding a tissue) And is this in case the house sneezes?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, that’s the ghost for the attic.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t want a ghost.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, nobody wants a ghost. But you’ve got one, because the house
is sitting on an ancient Indian burial ground.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, the house was built on radioactive waste, and an ancient
Indian burial ground? That would never happen.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, obviously you don’t know much about the U.S. government.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I need to talk to you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, what’s up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I meant Chandler.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I-I know. Well if something comes up... (walks away)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I'm glad you guys are past that little awkward phase.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, my boss, Joanna, when you left, she started asking questions about
you...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-ho, liked what she saw, huh? Dug my action, did she? Checkin’
out the Chan-Chan man!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looks at him) That was (pause) surreal. Okay, what do think? Are you
interested at all?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, she seemed cool, attractive. I’ll do it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh thank you, Chandler, this is so great, she’s gonna love me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (holding a dinosaur) Okay, dinosaur attack!! Quick, everybody into the
house!! Ahh-ahh! (the dinosaur starts attacking the house. She starts to bark like a dog.)
Roof! Rrroof-roof-roof!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Phoebe, y'know what? That-that’s it, that’s it, all
right? No dinosaurs, no ghosts, no giant dogs, okay? They’re not the right size,
they’re not Victorian, and they just don’t go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, (starts to pack up her stuff) fine. Come dinosaur, we’re not
welcome in the house of no imagination.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, Pheebs, while we’re hovering around the subject. I just have to
say dinosaurs, they-they don’t go, rrroof!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The little ones do.

scenes.location: The Theatre, Joey and Kate are getting ready to rehearse the play.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Kate!

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Morning.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, I ah, went to that restaurant that you were talking about last
week...

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Hey, lovely! Come, talk to me a minute! (she goes over to him)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to himself) And I ate the food, I had the fish, it was good, yeah. It was
good, yeah...

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, oh, I’m Lauren, Kate’s understudy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey! Joey Tribbiani.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: I know! I-I’m a big fan of yours.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looks at her, shocked) What?!

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: I used to umm, schedule my classes so I could watch Dr. Drake Remoray on
Days of Our Lives.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Get out of here, really?!

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: Absolutely!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: Oh but then, they went and dropped you down that elevator shaft.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They gave me the shaft all right.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: (laughing) Oh, you’re so funny. Listen, umm, what are you doing
after rehearsals? Do you want to get a drink, or something?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well Ahh, (he sees Kate and the director kissing) yeah! Yeah, sure, a
drink sounds great.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: Cool! I-I’ll see you then.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: All right, it’s time to act, my talking props. (Both Joey and
Kate just look at each other.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is entering with her own dollhouse, that she made
herself.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look everybody, look at my new dollhouse!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, look! (She lifts up the roof, and the front panel falls revealing
the interior.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what’s this?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, it’s the slide instead of stairs. Watch this. (She slides
a doll down the slide)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s very interesting, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’s this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The Licorice Room, you can eat all the furniture. And, when guests come
over, they can stay on the tootsie roll-away bed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is the coolest house ever!!
(Monica is looking on with a hurt expression on her face.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, does anybody want to join me in the aroma room? (lights some
incense)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I would!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, guys, guys, did you see my new, china cabinet?!

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Watch, watch. (She turns a strand of Christmas lights strung around the
house.)

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Ooohhhh!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And, and! (She turns on a bubble maker.)

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Ahhhh!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey, my Father’s house does that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Chandler) O-o-o-okay, how did it go? Tell me everything.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, the movie was great, dinner was great, and there’s nothing
like a cool, crisp New York evening.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Of course, I didn’t get to enjoy any of that, because
Joanna’s such a big, dull dud!

scenes.location: Rachel’s office, Joanna’s telling Rachel, her side of the story.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Chandler is fantastic!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh God, we just clicked! Y’know how people just click? Like he came
by to pick me up, and I opened the door, and it was just like, click! Did he tell you?

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh, and he’s got such a good heart! Doesn’t he have a good
heart?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I know...

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh, I know and he’s soo sweet! Listen, he said he was going to
call, so put him straight through.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Isn’t this great?!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Don’t spoil it.

scenes.location: The Theatre, Joey and Kate are rehearsing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on baby, don’t go. Please? What do you say?
[A phone rings.]

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: (answering the phone) Hello. Oh! It’s you. Just ah, just
one-one sec. (to Joey and Kate) I am going to take this call. When I continue, I hope that
there will appear on stage this magical thing that in the theatre we call, committing
to the moment! (He goes to take the call.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Kate) That guy’s like a cartoon. What do you see in him anyway?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: He happens to be brilliant. Which is more than I can say for that sweater
you’re dating.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I’m not interested in her sweater! It’s what’s
underneath her sweater that counts. And besides, since ah, since when do you care who
I’m going out with?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: I don’t care. Why, do you want me to care?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you want me to want you to care?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Do you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: (returning) Okay, I’m afraid to say this, but let’s pick
it up where we left off.
[They resume rehearsing.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on baby, don’t go. Please? What do you say?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: I’ve got no reason to stay.
(Joey grabs her and kisses her.)

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Stop!! Stop it! You must stop! You are bad actors! This is a
terrible play! I’ll see you in the morning. (exits)

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: I can’t believe we go on in, in a week.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, it’s gonna be all right.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: (to Joey) Hey! So since we’re getting off early, do you want to go
and paint mugs?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: You know! At the place I told you about last night?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah, with the mug painting. Yeah. I was so listening to that. But ah,
y'know what, I think I kinda need to work on my stuff tonight.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (he gives her a peck on the cheek)

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: I’ll see you tomorrow. (she kisses him full on the mouth.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: G’night. (exits)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Kate) Ah, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Yeah, I guess. Look, what are we gonna do about this scene, huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Well umm, maybe if it had more heat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How do you mean?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Well, Adrian’s looking for a reason to stay, right? Victor can’t
just kiss her, he’s gotta, gotta really give her a reason, y'know?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe he could slip her the tongue.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Or maybe, maybe he could grab her, and, and, and, and lift her up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, and then Adrian, she maybe she could wrap her legs around his
waist.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: And then she could rip off his shirt and kiss his chest, and, and his
stomach!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And then, then he could use his teeth, his teeth to undo her dress, and,
and, and bite her!

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: And then right, right when the scene ends, he could take her with this
raw, animal....
[cut to Joey’s bedroom, Joey and Kate are emerging from under the covers.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Something like that?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Yeah, that’s pretty much what I had in mind.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Ross and Monica are eating breakfast as Joey enters, very
happily.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross) Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Monica) Hey.
(He walks up behind Monica and gives her a big hug and a kiss on the neck.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.
(He walks over behind Ross, thinks about it for a moment, and gives him a big hug.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s a little early to be drinkin’.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, things ah, finally happened with Kate.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohhhhh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re kidding?! That’s great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it was so amazing. After the (pause) love making...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yep. I just, I just watched her sleep for like hours, just breathing in
and breathing out. And then I knew she was dreaming ‘cause, ‘cause her eyes keep
going like this. (He closes his eyes and moves them around, kinda like he’s been
processed by the devil, or something.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering with Rachel) I’m telling ya, Joanna’s got it all
wrong. Okay? All I said was, ‘This was fun. Let’s do it again sometime.
I’ll give you a call.’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, gee. I wonder why she thinks you’re going to call her?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s what you say at the end of a date.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You can’t just say, ‘Nice to meet you, good night?’

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: To her face? Look it’s the end of the date, I’m standing
there, I know all she’s waiting for is for me to say ‘I’ll call her’
and it’s just y'know, comes out. I can’t help it, it’s a compulsion.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on Rach, when a guy says he’s going to call, it doesn’t
mean he’s going to call. Hasn’t it ever happened to you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, they always called.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hmm, bite me.

scenes.location: Rachel’s office.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: (entering) Did he call?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. Sorry.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Why?! Why?! He said he’d call. Why hasn’t he called?

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Maybe he’s intimated by really smart, strong, successful women.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Sophie, would you please climb out of my butt. Why hasn’t he
called, Rachel? Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, okay. Umm, well ah, maybe he, maybe he feels awkward because you
are my boss.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Awkward? Why should he feel awkward?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: The only person that should feel awkward is you, and you didn’t
tell him not to call me, did you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. I...

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Because if you feel uncomfortable with your friend dating someone you
work for, there are always ways to fix...that.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler is reading a magazine as Rachel approaches.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (grabbing the magazine out of his hands) Call her! Call her now!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Multiple, so many paper cuts.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why hasn’t he called Rachel? Why? Why? I don’t understand.
Why? He said he’ll call. Why? Why? Chandler I’m telling you she has flipped out,
she’s gone crazy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh, well give me the phone then.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on, this isn’t funny. She thinks it’s my fault that you
haven’t called her. You have to call her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, you can’t call somebody after this long just to say,
‘In case you didn’t notice, I don’t like you!’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well then you’re going to have to take her out again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nooo!! She’s really dull! And she gets this gross mascara goop
thing in the corner of her eye!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t care! I don’t care! You are going to have to take her
out again and end it, and end it in way that she knows it’s actually ended. And, I
don’t care how hard it is for you, do not tell her that you will call her again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right! Fine! But it’s just a lunch date, no more than an
hour! And from now on I get my own dates, I don’t want you setting me up with anybody
ever again!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s fine!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s just a lot of big talk, y'know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (from the bathroom) I’m in the shower!
[He closes the door and walks over to get something from the fridge. He starts to smell
something and turns around to see Phoebe’s dollhouse smoking. He runs over and takes
off the roof to reveal that the dollhouse fire.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, fire! There, there’s a fire! Fire!!
[He tries to blow it out, and obviously, it doesn’t work. He runs over to the sink
to get a glass of water to put out the fire, but since Monica is in the shower the water
pressure is very low and takes a long time to fill the glass. In desperation he takes the
half full glass over and dumps it on the fire, it doesn’t work. He then picks up the
dollhouse and considers bringing it over to the sink, but decides to take it into the
bathroom and use the shower to put it out. He kicks open the door and we hear Monica
scream at the top of her lungs.]

scenes.location: The Theatre, Kate is arriving for rehearsal.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So I ah, talked to Lauren, kinda told her how things were with us. Did you
ah, did you talk to Marshall?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'know, about what happened with us.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Nooo. And there’s really no reason he should find out, so ah
let’s not make a big deal about it, okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you talking about? It was a big deal. I mean, come on you
can’t tell me last night didn’t mean something to you. I-I was there,
you’re not that good an actress.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Look umm, I, I was, I was just caught up in the moment. That’s all it
was. Joey, I’m-I’m sorry you feel bad, but haven’t you ever sleep with a
women where it meant more to her than it did to you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nooo.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: (entering) Hi, Kate!

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Hi, Lauren.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi, Lauren.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: Hi, pig!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Ross are inspecting the damage to the
dollhouse.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry I ah, I scared you in there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, that’s okay. By the way, I was just checking the shower
massager.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (runs over to her) I tried to reach you at work. There’s....been a
fire.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! Oh my... (sees the remains of the house) Oh my God!! What
happened?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, we believe it originated here. (He uses a pointer and points to the
point of origin.) In the Aroma Room.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. Did everyone get out okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, the giraffe’s okay. And so is the pirate.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh. What is this? (She sees a tissue covering something, and moves to
remove it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No Phoebe, don’t look! You don’t want to see what’s under
there!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (She pauses to ready herself, and removes the tissue.) Ohh, the-the
Foster puppets!
(She picks up a charred piece of plastic that once was the Foster puppets, and starts
to break down. Monica goes over and comforts her.)
[Scene: Rachel’s office, Chandler and Joanna are returning from their lunch date.
He is telling her about her mascara problem. Rachel is already there.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s not a big deal. It’s, just it’s right here,
(points to his eye) and it’s all the time.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Well, thanks again for lunch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (He looks over at Rachel, who nods her head) Yes, this, this was
pleasant.
(Rachel is slowing trying to leave and let them talk.)

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: It was, wasn’t it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The food there was, was great.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Wasn’t it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So take care.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: You too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, this was great. I’ll give you a call. We should do it again
sometime. (Rachel is disappointed)

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Great! I’m looking forward to it. Rachel, any messages?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sophie’s desk.
(Chandler starts to leave ashamed of himself, but Rachel stops him in the hallway.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (whispering) Chandler!! Are you gonna call her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Noo!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I’m sorry. Okay? I’m weak, and pathetic, and sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you are going to tell her and you’re going to tell her now.
(She grabs his nipple and starts to twist it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahhhh—I’m not going to call you.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry. I’m-I’m-I’m sorry that I said I was
going to when I’m not. Look, this has nothing to do with you, y'know? And this
isn’t Rachel’s fault. It’s me. I have serious, serious problems when it
comes to women. I have issues with commitment, intimacy, (pause) mascara goop. And
I’m really sorry, it’s just that this is not, this isn’t going to work out.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Well, this isn’t how I was hoping how this would end, but I guess I
have to appreciate your honesty.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, o-okay.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well this is great! I’ll give you a call! We should do it again
sometime!
(Rachel is shocked, and holds her arms out in disbelief.)

title: The One with a Chick and a Duck

lines.text: [Scene: Outside Central Perk, Rachel and Phoebe are helping Monica learn
how to roller skate by rolling her between themselves.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So who’s idea was it to put everybody in the diner on skates?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, some idiot customer put a suggestion in the suggestion box.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, they took my idea!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was you?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Okay, here you go. (rolls her back to Rachel)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (bringing Rachel a mug) Rachel, I made you a cocoa.
[He distracts her from catching Monica and Monica slams into her, knocking her down.
Monica then falls on top of her.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, are you guys okay?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (leaving Central Perk and seeing Monica laying on top of Rachel who is
moaning in pain.) Oh my.
(They both turn and give him a dirty look.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is watching Quincy M.E. as Chandler is
walking into the living room from his bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sporting a goatee) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey. Y'know with that goatee you kinda look like Satan.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, so that’s why the priest threw holy water on me.
(there’s no reaction from Joey) Okay, listen, you have to cheer up! Okay? You
should come out with Ross and me, I mean anything is better than sitting around here
crying all day about Kate.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey I was crying because, because nobody believed Quincy’s theory.
Okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (triumphantly) I’m gonna be on TV!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! They’re putting together this panel to talk about these fossils
they just found in Peru and The Discovery Channel’s gonna film it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God! Who’s gonna watch that?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. You ready to go?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. (they start to leave)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Saw a girl with that vest.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks. (He takes off the vest and throws it on the floor.)

lines.speaker: Anchorwoman
lines.text: (on TV) While most of us think of chocolate bunnies and baskets as
traditional Easter gifts. Some people insist on giving live chicks as presents. (Joey is
intrigued by the idea) Unfortunately, the sad fact remains that most of these little guys
won’t live to see the fourth of July. (Joey starts to call a place to buy a little
baby chick) Because of as a result of improper care, they will be dead.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Yeah, hi. You guys got any of those baby chicks? ‘Cause I
was watching this ah, commercial on TV and man, those guys are cute!

scenes.location: The Moondance Diner, Pete is entering, Monica is on roller skates.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi! Hey, Pete you’re back! Hey, check this out. (She starts to
skate over to him)

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Wow! Skates!
(She gets just about all the way over to him and falls into his arms.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! You’re a lot sturdier that Chandler. He crumpled like a piece
of paper. So how was you’re trip?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Well... (he holds up a gift he brought her)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, what’d ya bring me?! (She opens the gift) Awww, hotel
toiletries from Japan. Oh, these are gonna go in my permanent collection. You want some
coffee?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Yeah, sure, that’d be great.
(She starts to go and get the coffee and falls behind the counter.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (popping back up) Regular or decaf?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Ah, which ever is closest.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (hands him a cup)

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: So ask me what I did today.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So what did you do today Pete?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I bought a restaurant and I would like you to be the head chef.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! Oh.(She turns around quickly and falls)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is telling Rachel about Pete’s offer.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can you believe he just offered me a restaurant?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What a jerk! You want me to kick his ass?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean this has been like my dream since I got my first Easy Bake Oven
and opened Easy Monica’s Bakery. I mean I would kill for this job. I mean I can
totally do this job, and God knows I paid my dues. (She removes her fake breasts) But
Pete’s just doing this because he has a crush on me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you’re still not attracted to him at all?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hmm, no. I mean how can I accept a restaurant from him? I-I-I-I
can’t. I couldn’t even accept a necklace from Stu Vincent in the seventh grade.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but Mon that’s totally different. He was you’re health
teacher.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, please.
(She slaps Rachel’s side and Rachel screams in pain.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? Honey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I am, my side still hurts from when you crashed into me yesterday.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God, I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.
(Monica hugs her goes and hugs her)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering, wearing a white suit with a little red bow tie) Hey, you guys!
Guess what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at the outfit) Got a job on a river boat?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know what I didn’t wear this suit for a year because you hated it.
Well, guess what? You’re not my girlfriend anymore so...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh I see, so this suit is making a point.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now that you’re on you’re own, you’re free to look as
stupid as you like.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Monica) You like it right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh absolutely. I like it even more on you than I did on Colonel Sanders.
(Ross starts to leave) Ross! Ross! I’m kidding!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, come here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What-what was it you were gonna tell us?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Oh! Was how you invented the cotton gin?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, good bye! (leaves)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is talking to Phoebe about her suggestion.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So um, after you put the suggestion in the box, how long did it take
for the roller skating thing to happen.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, oh, about three months.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so I guess that’s about ah, two weeks before the topless
thing kicks in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering carrying a box) Hey!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I got you something! Open it! Open it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (He opens it and it’s a baby chick) It’s a chicken.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s cute, huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa, you guys, do you know anything about chicks?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fowl? No. Women? Nooo.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well they are a huge responsibility, especially at this age. They
require constant care. They-they need just the right food, and lot’s and lot’s
of love.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, well no problem there. (He picks up the chick, hugs it really tight,
and talks to it like it’s a little baby.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Easy Lenny.

scenes.location: The Moondance Diner, Pete is talking to Monica about the restaurant.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: So? I mean have you thought about it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Here’s the thing.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Oh no, not the thing. I hate the thing. What’s the thing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t do it. I’m sorry, I wish I could, but umm, see you
have these feelings for me....

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait, wait, that’s-that’s what you’re worried
about? If that’s the problem, we’ve got no problem.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: No! Look, I was gonna tell you this over dinner, but I met somebody else.
On my trip.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Her name’s Ann, she’s a journalist. Ahh, we met on the plane.
She asked me if she could finish off my peanuts, I thought she said something else, we had
a big laugh. Yeah, I just, I mean I got, I got tired of waiting.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, that’s great! I mean I’m-I’m sorry, but I’m so
happy for you. And now I can work for you!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I guess you can.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh, this is incredible! Ohh! (she rolls over and kisses him
on the cheek) All right, y'know what? I’m just gonna roll right into that office
and-and quit!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (she gets ready to go) Can you give me a little push?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Yeah, sure. Good luck!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (rolling towards the office) I’m quitting!! Woo-hoo! (She rolls
through a doorway and out of sight. We then hear a big crash, and see Monica roll past the
door the other way.) I’m okay!! I’m all right!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Pete) Wow! That’s exciting, you went to Japan, made up a woman.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m just saying, this woman, I mean she’s fictitious. No?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Why would you say that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ‘Cause you’re still into Monica. So you told her there was
somebody else so she would agree to work with you, so ‘cause you figure oh if you
spent a lot of time together, maybe something might happen, and...

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: You’re good. You’re good!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, no, I’m fairly intuitive and psychic. It’s a substantial
gift.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Listen, can you promise me that you won’t tell her though?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Absolutely, oh I promise. Tell her what?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Thanks a lot.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No I’m serious. I mean I’m intuitive, but my memory sucks.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is baby-chick sitting.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but this is the last time. (singing) With a chick-chick here,
and a chick-chick there. Here a chick, there a chick, everywhere a chick-chick-(Joey
enters)-chickeeeen.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How’s she doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well yeah, don’t-don’t you think it’s a she?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know. (He picks the chick up and turns it over, trying to
determine the sex of the chick, and blows on it.) I can’t tell, what ever it was went
back in too quickly.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, anyway, I got to go change, I’m ah, meeting some of the cast
for drinks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I stayed home from work today while you were at rehearsal so somebody
could be here with our chick!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Who was up from 2 o’clock this morning until 5 o’clock this
morning trying to get her back to sleep?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t think I get up when you get up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohhh, here it comes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, here it comes! I’m stuck here all day, and then you come in
and spend two seconds with us and then expect to go off gallivanting with your friends?
Well I don’t think so mister!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!! I need to relax! Okay? I was working all day!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And you don’t think taking care of our chick is work?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s not what I said. Okay, I just meant...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know what you meant!! (pause) You notice that ever since we got this
chick, we’ve been fighting a lot more than we used too?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know, maybe we weren’t ready to have a chick.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll take her back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you think we’ll get our three bucks back?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering carrying a garment bag) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sees the chick) Ohhh, hey! All right, listen, I-I have that TV thing in
like two hours, and I need your help, okay? What do you think? (takes out two suits) This
blue suit, or this brown one?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, the brown one brings out your eyes, but your butt looks great in the
blue one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? (Joey gives him a ‘Like I would know’ look)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is trying to take some aspirin.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she reaches for the bottle) Oww! (She grabs the bottle, but has trouble
opening it. She pops the top off and aspirins fly all over the place as Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! That aspirin dance really works!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (She bends over to try and pick up the aspirin) Oww!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God, is that still...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m fine, I’m fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No you’re not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes I am!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, I’m fine. Watch. (She picks up an aspirin between her toes)
Look at that. (She lifts her leg to grab the aspirin with her hand and almost falls over.)
Whoa-whoa!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stopping her from falling) Okay, okay. Look, you have got to go to a
doctor! Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. I have got to get ready and go to a dinner at my bosses
house. It’s a very big deal, there’s a lot of people there I have to meet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And I’m sure you’re gonna make a big impression. Hi! I’m
Rachel Green. It’s nice to meet you. (He lifts his leg and imitates shaking hands
with it, just like how Rachel was trying to pick up the aspirin with her feet.) Come on,
you probably have a broken rib!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I will go to the hospital tomorrow, it’ll still be broken
then.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But y'know, I could use a hand getting ready.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, either help me or go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine. I’ll go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (with a hurt expression on her face) Okay, but before you go, could you
help me first?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (He checks his watch) Sure. I’ll help you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (rushing in) Oh, good! Good! Do you guys know how to get a chick out
of a VCR?!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Rachel’s bedroom, Rachel is trying to put on eye liner with her left
hand, as Ross is setting out her shoes.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (She drops the brush) Y'know what? I cannot do this with my left hand!
Would you please, help me with this too?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh. (He drops the shoes, takes the brush from her, and licks the tip. He
doesn’t like how it tastes.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (taking the brush back) Okay. Let’s use this brush. (Hands him
another one.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. This stuff?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Careful. Light. Okay, do you know how, just sweep it across the lid.
Okay? Just sweep it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oke-dokey. (He pokes her in the eye with the brush.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-ho!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! That’s just poking me in the eye!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry, I’m sorry. Close, close, close...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, just sweep it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sweeping...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sweep, sweep....(He starts to paint it on her eye, making it look like she
has a black eye.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, now make it even, ‘cause we don’t...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We don’t want it-it to be too much, we want it to be subtle.
(Of course it’s too late for that.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No, y'know you don’t, you don’t wear enough of this. (Rachel
is shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Since when, since when do you think I don’t wear enough of this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I, close your eyes, I just think you’re gonna like this a little
better, ‘cause, close-close... (He gets some more on the brush)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Blow it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (blows it) Sorry. ‘Cause umm, I think this will make you a little
more sophisticated.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sophisticated like a hooker?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica is entering, Phoebe is already there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, guess what I’m doing tonight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m checking out the restaurant with Pete.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, Monica, I am so excited for you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, I have to tell you something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But I can’t tell you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, but wouldn’t it be easier if you had to tell me something
that you could tell me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, sure in a perfect world. But, no, I promised I wouldn’t tell,
and I swore to like all my gods.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Does it have to do with Ross and Rachel?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Does it have to do with Joey?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Does it have to do with-with Chandler and that sock that he keeps by his
bed?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, but let’s come back to that later!

scenes.location: Rachel’s Bedroom, Ross is finishing up her make-up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There you go! Good enough for your party, huh?
(She turns and looks in the mirror, and it’s way, way over done. She looks like
she has two black eyes.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yep?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure, I’ll just sit next to the trans-sexual from purchasing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, come on! All right, I gotta go! So good luck at the party. Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wait, Ross, would you just stay and help me get dressed?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (checks his watch) Sure, okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay, great! Umm, okay, just turn around.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t want you to see me naked!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel, I’ve seen you naked a million times. I ate hot fudge off you
naked. Remember, I-I sucked that mini-marshmallow out of your belly button?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but that was different. Y’know? I mean, we were, we were
going out then, now I think it’s weird.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, y'know I can see you naked any time I want.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All I have to do is close my eyes. See? (closes his eyes) Woo-hoo!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! Stop that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on! I don’t want you thinking of me like that any more!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahh, sorry, nothing you can do about it. It’s one of my ah, rights as
the ex-boyfriend. (closes his eyes again) Oop, oh yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Stop it! Cut it out! Cut it out!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, I’m sorry, it will never happen... (closes eyes) Uh-oh!
Wait a minute! Wait-wait, now there are a hundred of you and I’m the king.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Rosss...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, would you grow up? It’s no big deal.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. (She starts to take off her robe) Fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yowzah!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: O-kay!! See what you did, I’m gonna be doing it by myself now.
Okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aww, come on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s it. (She crawls onto the bed) Ow!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-ow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow! Ow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Easy. Easy. You have to go to the hospital. Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I really do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I’m gonna get your coat and then I’ll-I’ll put you in
a cab.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Oh wait, wait-wait, you’re not gonna come with me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (He thinks about it) Of course I am. I just have to make a call.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay? (goes into the living room)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (She goes to take off her make-up and screams in pain)
Oww!!!! God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (rushing back in) What?! I wh-, what’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry, I just can’t go to the hospital lookin’ like
this.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica is trying to find out what Phoebe won’t tell her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Does it involve travel?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Noo!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Does it involve clogs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, wait, wait. Clogs, or claws?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Clogs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Claws?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, so it doesn’t involve Ross or Rachel or Chandler or Joey.
But, what about Pete?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Shaking her head yes) No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is it?! What about Pete?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know! (frantically points at Monica)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I feel like I’m talking to Lassie. All right, Phoebe would
you just tell me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I gotta go. (gets up)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I, but you’re so close! No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, does it involve something to do with Pete’s computer company?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, just go. You’re never gonna get it!
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is watching Baywatch with the baby chick.
He’s on one leather chair, the chick is on the other. It’s watching Yasmine
Bleeth run and is chirping.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know. See, yes. That’s Yasmine Bleeth, she’s a completely
different kind of chick. I love you both. But in very different ways.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sees he’s watching Baywatch) Ohhh. (sees he still has the
chick) Ahh! What are you doing?! I thought you were gonna take her back to the store
today.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I did! But the store wouldn’t take her back! So then I took her
to the shelter, and you know what I found out?
(Joey wants to know, but Chandler doesn’t want to discuss it by the chick, so he
and Joey move over to the windows and away from the chick.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If they can’t find a home for her, they kill her! And I’m
not gonna let that happen to little Yasmine!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, good, good, good, ‘cause, good, ‘cause I was kinda having
second thoughts too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. And it’s not just chicks y'know? It’s all kinds of
other animals!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s horrible! Well, you did the right thing man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks, I’m glad you see it that way.
(He hear a duck start quacking, and see it waddle into the living room from the
bathroom. Joey wants to know what’s with the duck.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohhh-hoo, funny story!
[Scene: Pete’s Restaurant’s Kitchen, Pete is showing Monica around the
kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t believe this! Wow, look at this refrigerator! It’s
gigantic! I mean I could live in this thing! I’d be cold, but I’m always cold.
Oh my God, look at these spider burners! I love spider burners.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: So you like it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, it is sooo perfect. Thank you so much. (runs over and hugs him)

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Oh, you’re welcome. (He takes a deep breath)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you just smell my hair?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Nooo. Uh-huh, no way. What? No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You still have feelings for me don’t you?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Now, nooo! I’m just excited about the restaurant, that’s all.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pete.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Okay, I love you. Is that so bad?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it’s not bad. It’s not bad at all. It’s-it’s
really nice.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Look, the only who stands to get hurt is me. And I’m okay with that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You may be okay about getting hurt, but I am not okay with being the one
who hurts you. That’s why I can’t take this job.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And well, we probably shouldn’t see each other anymore. I’m
sorry.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Okay, yeah. I mean... If that’s, if that’s really what you want,
okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, bye.
(She kisses him on the cheek, and he kisses her back on the mouth.)

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I’m sorry things didn’t work out...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right shut up for a second and let me just see something. (She
kisses him back on the lips) Oh, wow! (They then hug and kiss, very passionately.)
[Scene: The Hallway Between The Apartments, Ross and Rachel are coming back from the
hospital. Ross is helping her up the stairs.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you’d tell me the truth. Right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, you can’t look fat in an x-ray.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(As they approach the door, Chandler comes out carrying his duck.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! Now you stay out here, and you think about what you did!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Chandler) That’s a duck.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s a bad duck!!! (to Ross) How’d the thing go tonight,
Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, it was, nah, well....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What thing? What thing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing, ah there was this thing at the museum. Come on. (they go into her
apartment) Easy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to the duck) Okay, now when you come back I hope you remember that,
that chick is not a toy! (He goes back into the apartment)
[cut to inside Monica and Rachel’s]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What thing? What is this thing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was kinda, supposed to be on TV tonight for The Discovery Channel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, why didn’t you tell me that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Eh, ‘cause I knew that if I told you, you’d make me go, and I
knew you needed someone to be with you tonight. Come on. Come on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I cannot believe you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is the sweetest thing, I just....
(They both look at each other for a while)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (breaking the silence) You should get some sleep.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, I’ll umm...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry I spoiled you’re evening.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, that’s, no, as long as you’re okay. So I’ll ah,
I’ll see you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um-hmm, yeah.
(He leaves)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (After he closes the door) See ya.
(In the hallway, Ross all dejected, sits down on the step.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (coming out of his apartment and seeing Ross) What did you do?

title: The One with the Screamer

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is on the phone, Chandler and Monica are sitting in
the living room, and Ross is in the kitchen as Rachel enters from her bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Phoebe, are you still on hold? I was supposed to call my Dad back
like two hours ago.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, he clipped on, he said call him as soon as you get a chance,
he’s at Flimby’s.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’s Flimby’s?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, that’s the word I use when I can’t remember the real
thing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Hang up! That’s it! Come on!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Rachel, that’s what they want me to do. My warranty expires
tomorrow, if I don’t get through, they’re not gonna fix my crappy, broken phone
for free! We cannot let them win! It’s us versus them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ye-e-es!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, listen I gotta double check for tickets tonight. Who-who got what?
Chandler, Phoebe, and Rachel: I had one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I need two. I’m bringing Pete. My boyfriend. I have a boyfriend
now!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Two it is. Ross, how about you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, yeah, I ah, I also need two.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? Who’s number two?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who’s number two? One of the more difficult games sewer workers
play.

lines.speaker: Ross
