lines.text: Uh, no, it’s-it’s just this person.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Like a date type (looks at Rachel) person?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, kinda. It’s this woman from work. I hope that won’t be too
weird. Will it, Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. No, not at all, not at all. I actually was gonna bring someone
myself, so…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But you said one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I meant, me plus one!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (to Phoebe and Chandler) Did ah, you guys mean you plus one?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, I’ll see you tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, bye-bye!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye-bye!
(Ross exits)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I need a date! (runs to her bedroom)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey, you guys are finally gonna get to meet Kate!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Chandler) And I ah, borrowed some of your cologne. I hope she likes
it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, what are you doing?! It’s never gonna happen, she’s
seeing somebody.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, and I don’t have any cologne.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The green bottle next to the shaving cream.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Worm medicine for the duck.
(In horror, Joey wipes his neck and smells it.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is getting ready to go to Joey’s premiere and
Phoebe is still on hold.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Here you go. You can wear this. (hands her a sweater)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (on phone) Ooh, I’m setting the phone down. (does so) But
I’m still here! Just don’t go anywhere I’m still here. (starts to put on
the sweater) Don’t-don’t switch or anything, ‘cause I’m, I’m
right here. (She has pulled the sweater over her head, but her head is stuck in a sleeve.)
Just one sec. One sec! One second!! (She is now frantically trying to get the sweater on,
as Monica returns from the bathroom.) Wait! One second! Just…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! Monica, I’m scared!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. Honey, that’s-that’s a sleeve. Okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And! We also have speaker phone. (She turns on the speaker phone.)

lines.speaker: Hold Voice
lines.text: Please, stay on the line. Your call is important to us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, wait, you gotta hang up ‘cause we’re gonna be late.
(Phoebe starts to hang up the phone, but…)

lines.speaker: Hold Voice
lines.text: Thank you for your patience, you’re the next caller.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes!! Yes!! I’m the next caller! You were gonna have me hang up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, carrying the chick and duck) Hey! Can you take a duck and a
chick to the theatre?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course not.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. I just wanted them to hear it from somebody else.
[Scene: Joey’s Premiere, Rachel is already there with her date, Tommy who's played
by Ben Stiller who will be in There's Something About Mary and Meet The
Parents, as Ross and his date, Cailin, arrive.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, hey Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How are you? (She goes to kiss him on the cheek, but stops because of
the dates and pats him on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So it’s looks like we’re the first ones here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, looks that way. First ones here! Wooo!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yay!!
(An awkward silence follows.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Tommy, this is Ross. Ross, Tommy.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. Oh, I’m sorry, this is Cailin.
(They all try and shake hands at once. They end up criss-crossing they’re arms to
shake each other’s hand, and Ross says…)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And! Break!!
(Awkward laughter follows.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, uhh, I think I’m going to run to the ladies room.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Cailin
lines.text: I’ll join you.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: I’ll get our seats.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (The girls leave.) (to Tommy) So uh, well, this-this is uh, this is
awkward.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well y'know ‘cause Rachel and I used to go out.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Oh, I didn’t, I didn’t know that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! Well then this is awkward. So what do you uh…

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: I think we’re here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! Yeah.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (sees two people sitting in their seats.) Uh, huh. Excuse me,
I’m sorry, I-I think you may be in our seats.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Umm, no, I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Can-can we take a look at your ticket?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sure. (Hands him the ticket.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking at ticket) Yep! Yeah, see this says D-13, and uh…

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, well I thought that ah…

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Oh, you thought, huh? Yeah, well that didn’t really work out too
well for you did it you idiot!! What are you?! A moron!! Huh?! It says D-13! Okay?!
Look you’re surrounded by even numbers!! Did that give you some clue?!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Uh, the usher told us to come…

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Oh! Oh! The usher must be right! What, with all that training they go
through! Get out!! (They start to leave.) Here! (He throws him back his ticket.) (to Ross,
calmly) Hey man, you want the aisle?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I’m good. (He sits down, stunned.)
[Scene: The Theatre, at the post premiere party. The gang is already there, except
Phoebe. Joey runs in.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (seeing Joey) There he is!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There’s our star!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, so, what’d ya think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Almost as good as that play with the two naked girls on the see-saw.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I-I wasn’t in that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sees Kate) Oh-oh, hey-hey, Kate! Listen I want you to meet everybody.
Everybody, this is Kate.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: (stepping in) Excuse me. Excuse me. (to Kate) Sweetheart! (Kisses
her.) Come! (They leave.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So that’s the girl you like.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (drags Chandler over to buffet table) I’m telling you, this guy
Rachel is with is crazy! Okay? He viscously screamed at total strangers! I think he’s
baaad news!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait a minute, wait a minute, you don’t like the guy
Rachel’s dating? Well, that’s odd.
[cut to Joey, Rachel, and Tommy.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey, Lauren. Uh, you guys this is, this is Kate’s understudy,
Lauren.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi!

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey. Gosh, you look soo familiar.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: Oh, yeah! I-I ran into you in the hallway in your building. It was right
after I slept with Joey. He dumped me the next day.
[cut to Monica, Pete, and Cailin]

lines.speaker: Cailin
lines.text: So. How’d you guys meet?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Well ah, the short version is, I ah pursued her for a couple of months,
then I gave her a check for 20,000 dollars, and she was mine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, and in the long version, I dump him for telling people the short
version.
[cut to Joey as Estelle, Joey’s agent, approaches]

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Joey, sweetheart, you were fabulous!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey you guys, this is my agent, Estelle.

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: How do you do. (to Rachel and Monica) Ooh, you two girls were
outstanding! (to Joey) Did they have representation?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, they-they weren’t in the play.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’re not actors.

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Ooh, what a shame! Because with her face (points to Monica) and her
chest (points to Rachel) I could really put something together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Could I borrow it?
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Cailin
lines.text: (to Ross) Hi! Remember me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi! Yeah! Tommy’s in line for the bathroom and someone just cut in
front of him, I think he’s gonna snap. (He’s watching very intently)

lines.speaker: Cailin
lines.text: Ross, I’m gonna go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Go? Why?

lines.speaker: Cailin
lines.text: I don’t know. Could be because I don’t feel like standing
around all night waiting for some guy who may or may not scream.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But-but Cailin, he definitely will scream.

lines.speaker: Cailin
lines.text: Good bye Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, oh-ho bye.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: (entering carrying a newspaper) Here we go people! (starts reading
the review) Boxing Day! The Lucille Lortel Theatre, blah-la-la-la… Ah-ha! Joey
Tribianni, gives an uneven performance, but Mr. Tribianni is not the worst thing in this
production.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes!!! Ha-ha-ha!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Kate Miller’s awkward and mannered portrayal is laughable.
(Kate walks away depressed.) Badda-badda-badda. Ah-ha! Here it is! The direction by
Marshal Talmant is… (stops, reads it again, and throws down the paper in disgust)
Thank you, boys and girls, you’ve ruined my life. Please, stuff your talentless faces
with my Mother’s crab cakes! (starts to leave) Excuse me!!
(Joey steps in a picks up the paper, the gang all look at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Anyone mind if I save this?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are returning. Phoebe is still on
hold.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, is the play over?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. Where were you?

lines.speaker: Hold Voice
lines.text: Thank you for your patience, you’re the next caller.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You were the next caller five hours ago. You must be going crazy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nah. I kept myself busy.
(Both Rachel and Monica walk into their bedrooms, stop, and come back into the living
room with confused looks on their faces.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, yeah. (to Monica) I put your stuff in her room, and her stuff
in your room.
(They both look at each other, nod their heads ‘All right’ and follow their
stuff into their new rooms.)

scenes.location: The Theatre, after the party. Joey is trying to comfort Kate.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Fabulous.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, drama critics they’re nothing but, but people who
couldn’t make it as actors. You know what you should do?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Become a drama critic!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: (entering, drunk) I am hurt! (to Joey and Kate) A plague on both
your houses! (walks away)

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: By the way, he dumped me tonight after he read my review.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, classy.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Yep! I sure know how to pick ‘em, huh? Y'know I gave up a part on a
soap for this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! Yeah I ah, I gave up a job too.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Really. What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, de-clawing cats. Hey, tell ya what. Let me walk you home. We’ll
stop by every news stand and burn every copy of their Times and the Post.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Why the Post?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you didn’t see the Post?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: No. You?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. Why?
[Scene: Kate’s Apartment, Joey and Kate are returning from a night out on the
town.]

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: (drunk) So you really think those newspapers are just jealous of me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, absolutely! You’re talented and you’re good looking.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Oh, you’re sweet and cute.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! That’s why they trashed me!
(They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa. Wait a minute, wait a minute.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I, I don’t get you. I mean first, you hate me. Then you sleep with
me. Then you want nothing to do with me, now you want me again.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: What? So you never went out with an actress before?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Kate, do you even like me?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Of course I do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well so, how come you blew me off? Y'know? How come you were with him?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: I don’t know! I just, just do this! I-I always have to pick the like
the smartest guy, or-or the most talented guy… Why can’t I just pick someone
like you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: You know what I mean. I mean like the sweetest guy. Joey, you’re just
so, you’re so, so… (She passes out and slumps against his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Checks to see if she’s drooling on his shirt.) Okay. Okay, okay,
hey. (Lays her down and covers her with a blanket.) There we go, let’s get your feet
up there. (Looks at her) Good night, Kate. Sweet dreams. (Picks up a garbage can) I’m
gonna put this can right here in case you have to hurl.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the next morning, Phoebe is STILL on hold.

lines.speaker: Hold Voice
lines.text: Please stay on the line. You’re call is very important to us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from her bedroom) Pheebs, you’ve been up for 24 hours! Go
to sleep, honey. Th-this isn’t healthy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, I’m fine, and y’know why? ‘Cause of all the
riboflavin.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, happily) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Didn’t you have that outfit on last night?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! I stayed at Kate’s, but ah, nothing happened. Hey, Pheebs,
where were ya?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m so, so, so sorry, Joey. I definitely am gonna see you’re
play. I swear you’re play is very important to us, thank you for your patience.
You’re play is the next play is the next play I’m gonna see.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Anyway, how did it go with Kate?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it was great! Yeah, I-I walked her home, and it was amazing how much
we connected, y'know? Then ah, then she passed out, but then she woke up. Yeah? And we
stayed up all night talking, and now we’re like totally crazy about each other!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, you had the night!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When two people finally realise their feelings for each other, and-and
they talk for hours, and they-they learn all about the other person!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You-you think?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you like learn about her family?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Two brothers, one died!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! (They hug, triumphantly.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Monica are sitting on the couch, Rachel is on the
chair.]

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (bringing Chandler a cup) This is from the woman at the bar.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho-ho.
(He turns and looks at her. The woman whispers something to Gunther; who comes back and
takes the mug away from Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Sorry. She thought you were somebody else.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What time is it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: One.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: One.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: 7:15. (Monica looks at him) Watch doesn’t work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Tommy’s supposed to be here soon, we’re going to lunch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look. Look, I wasn’t going to say anything to you, but... All right,
I don’t think you should be seeing Tommy anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don’t?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! The guy is mean. I mean really mean. I think you should stay away from
him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, or, maybe, I should stay away from all men.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it’s not just ‘cause I’m jealous. (Both Monica and
Chandler give him a ‘Come on’ look) I mean I’m not, I’m not, I’m
not jealous, okay? It’s… Look, the guy, he screamed, he actually screamed at
this couple sitting in our seats.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, and at the end of the play, he, he got up y'know, and he just
started like, (claps his hands) banging his hands together!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, fine, fine. You don’t want to believe me? No, that’s fine.
(starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re kidding!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross, don’t. Ross!
Monica; Ross!
[cut to outside of Central Perk]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You don’t want to believe me, I’m Mr. Funny to you. Mr.
Funny… (turns around and almost spills his coffee on Tommy)

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Whoa!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa, sorry Tommy.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: What’s in the cup, Ross?

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: What is in the cup?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, it’s coffee.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Ice coffee? Tell me it’s ice coffee!

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Hot coffee!!! You idiot!! You were gonna spill hot coffee all over me,
huh?!! What are you just some big, dumb, stupid, doofy idiot, with a doofy idiot hairdo,
huh?! Huh?!
[cut to inside Central Perk, we see Ross quietly tapping on the window, desperately
trying to get the gang’s attention, while Tommy is still screaming at him]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (not seeing Ross) What’s your favourite thing about summertime?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, going to the beach. When it stays light real late.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah…

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: (entering, finished with yelling at Ross, who follows him in shell
shocked) (happily) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Tommyyyy! Say, what’s your favourite thing about summer?

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Ooh, I don’t know. Probably the smell of freshly cut grass.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh, that’s a good one.
(Ross is having a fit, about how calm Tommy is now)

scenes.location: Backstage at Joey’s play, Joey is arriving, late.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sorry! Sorry, I’m late; sorry, I’m late! My duck and my chick
and a fight, it-it was ugly.

lines.speaker: Stage Manager
lines.text: Look, we held the curtain for you buddy. Come on, let’s go!
Let’s go!
[cut to onstage with Lauren standing in for Kate, the doorbell rings.]

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: (answering the door) Vic! Where have you been, baby?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (surprised it’s Lauren) (hugs her) (whispering) Where’s Kate?

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: (whispering) She got a job in L.A.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (stunned) What?!

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: I’ve been waiting up all night for ya. Where have you been? (Joey
doesn’t answer) Where have you been? Vic?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, ahh, go to the window. I’m wanna run down to the truck and show
you something.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: (at the window, she’s looking down out of the window) What do you
got down there, Vic? What do you got under that tarp?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (grabs the window from the outside and sticks his head in) (whispering)
When is she leaving?

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: (whispering) Tonight. What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (making like he is yelling up to the second floor) I’m coming up!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler and Ross are in the kitchen, Rachel and Monica
are sitting in the living room, and Phoebe is, you guessed it, still on hold.]

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Hey, mind if I use the phone?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I… (starts jabbering incoherently)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why don’t you use ours across the hall, ‘cause
she…has…problems.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (coming out of the kitchen with a cup of coffee, almost running into
Tommy) Oh-ho, whoa! Sorry, Tommy. I almost spilled this hot coffee on you.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Yeah, but you didn’t.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, but it’s-it’s-it’s hot!
(We see Tommy go into Joey and Chandler’s apartment)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, would you just stop it! It’s getting really old.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t believe no one believes me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I do, I believe you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You do Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. But I also believed her (points to the phone) when she said I was
next.
[cut to Chandler and Joey’s apartment, Tommy is using the phone]

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: (noticing the chick) Ooh, hey! Hey, there little fella. (picks up the
chick) Mr. Fuzzy-Man, how are you doing? (starts to pet him) Aww. (The chick poops on his
hand.) Eww! Oh! Eww! Gross! Idiot!! Stupid little, fuzzy, yellow creature!! Oh look at me,
I’m so cute, I’m a little chick who’s disgusting! God, you’re so
stupid, how are you not yet extinct!! (the duck wattles behind him and quacks) (to the
duck) Quack-quack, quack-quack!! What are you quacking about?! Dumb Donald Doo-Doo!!
(We see the gang staring at him through the doorways.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Step away from the duck.

lines.speaker: Tommy
lines.text: Ooh, sorry little Mr. Chic-A-Dee, sorry you went doody in my hand!
(starts to walk out and stops) (to Rachel) Well, I guess we’re not going out anymore.
Whaa!!!
(He leaves the gang in stunned silence.)
[Scene: Backstage at Joey’s play, Joey is changing for the next scene as Kate
arrives, carrying her bags.]

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: I’m soo glad I caught you, I couldn’t find you before.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wh-wh-what’s going on? Wh-what’s this about L.A.?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: They still want me for General Hospital.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But, but wh-what about us?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Last night was wonderful. But I-I can’t stay here just for you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, so, stay for the museums!

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Stage Manager
lines.text: Joey, onstage!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well can you at least stay to the end of the play? I mean, I’ll go to
the airport with ya, I-I wanna say good bye.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: (yelling from onstage) Where are you Vic?

lines.speaker: Kate
lines.text: Flight’s in an hour. I-I gotta go.

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: Vic! Vic! Vic!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Lauren) In a minute!!
[cut to the end of the play]

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: So this is it? Victor?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I guess it is. (sees Kate is watching, he turns Lauren so that he
can talk directly to Kate, but still look like he is talking to Lauren) Listen, I ah, I
gotta say good bye, and-and I gotta say it quick ‘cause this is killing me. One thing
you gotta know, is that I will never forget you. But, you’ve got things you have to
do now, and so do I. And so… I’m gonna get on this spaceship, (smoke starts
pouring in from the ceiling, and a ladder comes down, with flashing, colored lights on the
side of it) and I’m gonna go to Blargon 7 in search of alternative fuels. But when I
return, 200 years from now, you’ll be long gone. But I won’t have aged at all.
(gets on the ladder) So you tell your great-great-granddaughter to look me up, because
Adrienne, baby, I’m gonna want to meet her.
(The ladder retracts, taking Joey up into the spaceship for his voyage to Blargon 7,
and Kate waves good bye.)

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: So long, Vic! (waving good bye as the ladder retracts)

title: The One with Ross's Thing

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler and Joey are playing with the duck and the
chick.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, wouldn't be cool if our duck and chick had a little baby? We could
call it Chuck.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Or... Dick.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, I-I need a favor. Umm, I was in the shower, and as I was cleansing
myself, I ah, I-I, well I felt something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Was it like a sneeze only better?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, I mean, I mean a thing on my body.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (with a disgusted look) What was it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I don't know, it's-it's kinda in a place that's not... It's not
visually accessible to me, and I was hoping maybe you guys could-could help me out.
(starts to take off his pants)

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Whoa!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on you guys, it's no big deal! (He turns around and shows him his
thing.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa-heeeiiiiii-iiiii-ah!! (sees it) Huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well what is it? Is it a mole? (He moves closer to them, and they jump
back.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, it's too wrinkly to be a mole.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, eww. What? Is it a pimple?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it's... fancier than a pimple. Look Ross, why don't you just go
see a…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, interrupting them) Hey guys! What's... (sees what they're
doing and stops, the guys are stunned)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, well, it's definite, two more weeks of winter.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahhh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, right.
(Rachel backs out with a confused look on her face.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler, Joey, and Rachel are there, as Phoebe enters with her
date.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to her date) Okay, and then this is the coffee house. This is where I
play my music. (points to the stage)

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: Good deal.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and these are my friends. People. This is Vince, Vince the people.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Vince is a fireman.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Have you ever rescued anyone from a burning building before?

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: 98 hot saves, highest in the force.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, y'know if Joey and I played with matches we could get you up to
an even hundred.

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: (dead serious) Fire safety is not a joke, son.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're right, I know.

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Look, I gotta go. I'm on call tonight. (kisses her) See you
Saturday. (leaves)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (watches him leave)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, he's cute, Pheebs! But I thought you just started dating that
Kindergarten teacher.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Jason? Yeah, uh-huh, we're seeing each other tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What-Pheebs?! Two dates in one day? That's so unlike you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, I know! I'm like playing the field. Y'know? Like, juggling two
guys, I'm sowing my wild oats. Y'know? Y'know, this kind've like y'know oat-sowin',
field-playin' juggler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So Pheebs, do they know about each other?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Does a dog's lips move when he reads? (Joey makes an `I don't know'
face, and looks to Chandler and Rachel, who're also stumped) Okay, no they don't.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!
(He goes over and sits down at the counter, all depressed.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (going over to him) Well?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (joining them) Okay, how'd it go at the doctor's?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, he said there's definitely nothing to worry about, it's totally
benign.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well what is it?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He couldn't even tell me! He said it was just some sort of skin...
abnormality. And the worst thing is he-he-he said, he said, without being able to identify
it, he was reluctant to remove it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what? You should go to my guy, because when I went in there
with my third nipple. He just lopped it right off. Y'know? So I guess I'm lucky. I mean
not as lucky as people who were born with two nipples.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: At least they knew what yours was. Y'know, yours had a name.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Maybe they'll name yours after you! Y'know, they'll call it, The Ross.
And then people would be like, "Awww, he's got a Ross."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastic) Yeah, that'd be cool!
[cut to Phoebe and Rachel as Monica returns from the bathroom]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pete's breaking up with me.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just checked my messages, and he said that when he gets back from
Atlanta, we need to talk.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well that's it. People never say `We need to talk' unless it's something
bad.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, that doesn't necessarily mean that he's breaking up with you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, maybe he just cheated on you.

scenes.location: A Street, Phoebe is walking with her second date, Jason.

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: ...and I know I'll never miss doing it, but I gotta tell you, it's pretty
cool knowing that you're making a difference in a kid's life.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is so great! Oh, I... (sees that a parked car near them has caught
on fire) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (the fire has worsened) Oh my God!!!

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: Ahh-ahh, we'd better call the fire department!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (stopping him) No! No!

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: No, no?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, we don't n-n-n-n-need a fireman, we'd, we'd like a good mechanic.
(hears the sound of approaching sirens) Oh my God, here they come! Well, we gotta get out
of here!

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: W-w-w-wait! Why?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well look, if I wanted to see a fireman, I would date one. Okay? (she
drags him away)

scenes.location: A Doctor's Office, Ross is having his thing looked at by Dr. Rhodes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Th-th-that's all it is, a third nipple. Y'know? Just your run-of-the-mill
third nipple. Y'know? You can take it off. Just slice that baby right off!

lines.speaker: Dr. Rhodes
lines.text: Take your shirt off, and let's see what we're dealing with here.
(Ross starts to take off his pants) What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just showing you my run-of-the-mill-slice-it-right-off third nipple.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rhodes
lines.text: Well that's not a third nipple.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: Dr. Rhodes
lines.text: First of all, it's on your ass.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well then, what is it?!

lines.speaker: Dr. Rhodes
lines.text: Wait a minute, hold it. (He goes to the door and opens it.) Johnson!
Will you come in here a moment?

lines.speaker: Dr. Johnson
lines.text: I'm with Hamilton!

lines.speaker: Dr. Rhodes
lines.text: He's good with rear things, bring him in too.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Monica, and Joey are there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (starting to get up) I gotta go water Pete's plants. (stops) Y'know
what, if he's gonna break up with me, maybe I won't water his plants.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, if he's gonna break up with you, maybe Joey and I should water
his plants. If y'know what I mean.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or ha-ha, we could go over there and pee on them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering with Rachel) …and I-I can't take it! Y'know? I'm just,
always afraid one of them is gonna catch me with the other one. It's making me crazy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well honey, then why don't you break up with one of them?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (disgusted) Uh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa. What ah, what happened to playing the field?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it just, it doesn't feel like playing anymore, it feels like work.
It's like I'm working in the field.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So Pheebs, pick one of them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. Which one do you like more?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, Vince is great, y'know `cause, he's like a guy, guy. Y'know? He's
so burly, he's sooo very burly. (giggles)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, good, so there you go. Go with Vince.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but Jason's really sensitive.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well sensitive is important, pick him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh sure, go with the sissy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Jason is not a sissy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no, I meant Chandler.
[Scene: Dr. Rhodes's Office, a rather large group of doctors has now gathered to take a
look at Ross's thing. Ross is none too pleased with the developments, he has a disgusted
look on his face.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know I have dinner plans!!

lines.speaker: Dr. Rhodes
lines.text: Thank you soo much for coming on such a short notice. Ladies and
gentlemen, I've-I've-I've been practicing medicine for twenty-three years, and I'm
stumped.
(He removes the blanket covering the thing.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Whoa. (they all lean in to get a closer look, Ross isn't pleased)
[Scene: Pete's apartment, Monica is there to water the plants, and is showing the gang
around.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, this is the den. All right, check this out. Lights! (the lights
turn on automatically, but are very bright) Whoa! All right. Less lights! Bad lights!
Lights go away! (they dim) Oh, see you just need to find the right command.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, and the dimmer switch.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa! For a rich guy he's got, that's a pretty small TV.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no-no, that's a video-phone. But hey guys you're not supposed to be
here, so please, do not touch anything.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sitting down on the couch) I-kea! This is comfortable.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering with Phoebe) This place is amazing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God, that is the nicest kitchen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! But it's the nicest kitchen, the refrigerator told me to have a
great day.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look at this! A millionaire's checkbook.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, put that down! (the phone rings) Oh my God! It's Pete. Okay, get
out!! How the hell do you answer a video-phone! (steps in front of it, and automatically
answers it)

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Monica? (the gang ducks and hides)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess that's how.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Hey Monica, how's it going.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh it’s umm, good! It's umm, it’s good, just here watering the
plants.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Well don't forget that fiches over there by Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (standing up) Ahh... Chandler's on the couch!!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I see him, you guys are just the worst hiders ever.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (standing up) Hey Pete.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi, how ya doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ahh, Pete, the other day when you said you needed to talk, umm, just so
I know, is it good news or bad news.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Oh, it's good news. No, it's definitely good news. Hold on a second, I
have another call. (clicks his remote) (to his other call) Hey, how's it going?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, it's still me.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Ah, no it's not. I've got picture-in-picture here. (to other caller) Yeah.
(listens) Yeah, okay. I'm gonna have to call you back later. (pause) Monica? You. I'm
gonna have to call you back.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, oh, okay umm, so I'll see you soon.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Okay, I love you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: I love you, love you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Well, it's good news. It's good news.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, what do you thing the good news is?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking at the checkbook) Wow! Look at this! He wrote a check for 50,000
dollars to Hugo Ligrens Ring Design. (Monica is stunned) Oh, sorry, what do you think the
good news is?
[pause]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica's gonna marry a millionaire!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, you gotta get Mom on the phone. Call Mom! Call Mom!
(Pete's computer automatically calls Mom, Pete's Mom.)

lines.speaker: Pete's Mom
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And that's Pete's Mom.
(The gang quickly hides again.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the gang is returning from Pete’s.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mon you definitely have to make it a theme wedding, and the theme could
be, “Look how much money we’ve got!” Y'know, I mean you could put, you
could put money in-in the invitations! You-you could have like little money place
settings. And ah, you could start with a money salad! I mean it’ll be dry, but people
will like it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Would you stop? We’ve only been going out a couple of weeks, I mean
we don’t even know if he’s gonna propose.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but this is Pete. Okay? He’s not like other people, on your
first date he took you to Rome. For most guys that’s like a third or fourth date
kinda thing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well if-if that’s what it is, then it’s-it’s crazy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica’s right. We’re talking about getting married here. Okay?
She-she can’t just rush into this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh please, what do you know! You married a lesbian!
(Joey laughs, Ross glares at him, and Joey stops.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. I gotta go. I have break up with Vince.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, so you’re going with the teacher, huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I like Vince a lot, y'know? But, it’s just Jason’s so
sensitive, y'know? And in the long run, I think sensitive it’s just better than
having just like a really, really, really nice (pause) butt. (Her eyes glaze over thinking
about the butt.) (pause) Jason! Definitely Jason! Okay, wish me luck!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Good luck!
(pause)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OH MY GOD!!! (She holds her hands up in triumph and the gang all look at
her.) Sorry, I was just imagining what it’d be like to catch the money bouquet.

scenes.location: A Fire House, Phoebe has gone to break up with Vince.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Excuse me. Umm, is Vince here?

lines.speaker: Fireman
lines.text: Oh sure. Vince?!

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: Yo!! (slides down that pole that fire station’s have)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! I didn’t know you guys actually used those.

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: So, what’s up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, wow. This-this isn’t gonna be easy. Umm, I don’t think we
should see each other anymore.

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: Uh-huh. G-good deal.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: No-no it’s okay. It’s just that ah, I thought we had something
pretty special here. And y'know I-I felt like you were someone I could finally open up to,
and… (starts choking up) That there’s so much in me I have to share with you
yet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, I didn’t…

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: (starting to cry) I’m sorry, I can’t talk. I’m gonna go
write in my journal. (walks away)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (running after him) Wait-wait-wait! Wait!!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe, Ross, and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Ross) I’m telling you, if you want to take care of that thing,
you should go to my herbal guy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you, but I want to remove it Pheebs. I don’t want to make it
savory.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know when girls sleep with guys with weird things on their body, they
tell their friends about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Gimme this. (Grabs the herbalist’s card and leaves.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi! Okay, don’t be mad at me, but I couldn’t
resist.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Brides magazines?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, and I know that you’d say no if he asked you, but I’m
sorry; how great would you look walking down the aisle in this Donna Carin. (shows her the
picture.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) Oh, you so would! Oh, you should get that anyway. (They both
look at her.) Like for clubbing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It is so weird, I know what I said, but uh, this morning, I was lying in
bed I was, I was imagining what it would be like to say yes. (Rachel slams the magazine
shut in amazement.) I know it’s a little sudden, and it’s a little rushed, and
it’s totally not like me to do something like this, but that doesn’t mean I
can’t. Right? I mean I’m-I’m crazy about Pete, and I know that we want the
same things, and when I thought about saying yes, it made me really happy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God. (starting to cry)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know. (pause) I need more pie. (goes and gets some)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Mon umm, if you do get married, can I bring two guests?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You didn’t break up with that fireman?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, that was my way of telling you. Well, it turns out he’s
incredibly sensitive, he keeps a journal and he paints. He even showed me charcoal
drawings that he drew of me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, well he’d prefer water colors, but y'know, he has easy access
to a lot of charcoal.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So then, are you going to dump Jason?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, yeah, because I have to break up with someone, and… Okay so
Jason is sensitive, (holds up one finger) but now so’s Vince (holds up one finger on
her other hand) Plus, Vince has the body y'know? (holds up two more fingers on the Vince
side) So… It’s really just about the math.

scenes.location: Jason’s apartment, Phoebe has gone to break up with Jason.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (knocks on the door) Jason?

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: Yeah, come on in.
(She goes in, and sees Jason without his shirt. It turns out that he has a great body
too, and is at a loss for words.)

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: So Phoebe, you ah, sounded kinda serious on the phone, is ah, is anything
wrong?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nah-ha!
[Scene: Phoebe’s Herbal Guy’s office, Ross is there about his thing. Ross is
looking around the exam room, and he goes over to a large bank of drawers, pulls one out
and almost spills it as the herbalist, Guru Saj, enters.]

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: You must be Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: I am Guru Saj. (takes the drawer back and replaces)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, I got to tell you I’ve-I’ve never been to a guru before,
so...

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: Well, relax. If it makes you feel better, I’ve attended some of
the finest medical schools in Central America. Well then, let’s take a look at this
skin abnormality of yours. (motions to the table) Come on, have a seat. (looks at it) Eeh,
huh. As I suspected, it’s a koondis!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s a koondis?

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: I don’t know, what’s a koondis with you? (starts laughing as
if that joke was funny, Ross only looks at him, and he stops) Please, lie down! I’ve
got a sav that oughta shrink that right up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I guess it’s worth a try.

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: Oh sure, we should see results—Whoa!! Clearly not the way to go!!
(quickly wipes it off)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! What?!

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: We appear to have angered it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We?! We angered it?!

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: Oh, I think I see the problem. And I’m afraid we’re gonna
have to use a much stronger tool. (Ross gives him a ‘What?’ look) Love.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh God!

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: (He starts moving his hands around in circles above the thing.) Ross,
there is absolutely no way this is going to come off unless you start to…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ow!!

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: Oops.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What was, what was that?

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: Well it’s gone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! How’s that?

lines.speaker: Guru Saj
lines.text: It got caught on my watch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! (congratulates him)

scenes.location: Pete’s apartment, Pete and Monica are coming back from a date.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Lights. (The lights turn on, once again they’re too bright.) Uh,
romantic lights. (The lights dim.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooh, nice.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: So ah, there was this thing I wanted to talk to you about.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, right! I completely forgot about that.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Well ah, I’ve been doing a lot of thinking, and I look at my
life…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: And I feel like I’ve conquered the business world, and I feel like
I’ve conquered the intellectual world, and now I-I have the most beautiful woman in
the world.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: There’s one thing missing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s that?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: It’s time for me to conquer the physical world.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (not sure of herself)

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Monica, I want to become (pause) the Ultimate Fighting Champion.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You wanna what?!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I want to become the Ultimate Fighting Champion! It’s the most
intense physical competition in the world, it’s banned in 49 states!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Okay, my trainer, Ho Chi, is teaching me a combination of Gee Koon Doe and
Brazilian street fighting, I’ve even had my own octagon training ring designed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And I suppose you used a ring designer for that.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Yeah. Monica, I want you there in the front row when I win. I want you
close enough to smell the blood. What do you think?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My parents will be so happy.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe’s singing, Vince is also there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) “Crazy underwear, creepin’ up my butt. (Jason
enters) Crazy underwear, always in a rut. Crazy under-(sees Jason)-wear…” (In
her head) Oh No! What is he doing here? All right, just keep playing, just keep
playing. You’ll get through this; you’ll be fine. (She tries to continue the
song, but she has lost the ability to pronounce words, and the lyrics come out as
gibberish.) (giving up on the song) Okay, thank you. And, as always no one talk to me
after the show.
(They all applaud her.)

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: (going up to her) Hey. I was…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: I was passin’ by and I saw that you were playing tonight, it’s
kinda cool seeing you up there. (kisses her)

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: (running over) Whoa! Hey-hey! What’s going on here? Who is this guy?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know, he just started kissing me. Get him! Get him, Vince!

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, okay, I’ve-I’ve been dating both of you, and it’s
been really horrible. ‘Cause y'know it’s been a lot of fun, for me. Umm, but I-I
like you both, and I, and I didn’t know how to chose, so... I’m sorry, I’m
just, I’m terrible, I’m a terrible person. I’m terrible.

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: Phoebe, Phoebe relax, it’s okay. I mean we never said this was
exclusive.

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: Yeah, and neither did we. Give yourself a break.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: Yeah. I mean y'know, we haven’t been going out that long.
Come on, we haven’t even slept together yet. Huh.

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: You haven’t?

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: You have?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, this is none of my business. (starts to walk away)

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: (to Phoebe) I-I can’t believe this! You-you’ve slept with him?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I made you a candle light dinner in the park.

lines.speaker: Jason
lines.text: Y'know Phoebe, I’m gonna make this real easy for you. (walks out)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Vince) Well, that could’ve been really awkward.

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: You made him a candle light dinner in the park?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but I-I-I-I can do that for you, I’m gonna do that for you.

lines.speaker: Vince
lines.text: Uh yeah, I can’t believe I ever went out with somebody who would
actually have an open flame in the middle of a wooden area. (walks out)

title: The One with the Ultimate Fighting Champion

scenes.location: Central Perk, the whole gang minus Monica is there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you think that there’s a town in Missouri or some place called
Sample? And ah, as you’re driving into town there’s-there’s like a sign,
and it says “You’re in Sample.” (He says it like urine sample.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How’d it go with Pete?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Tell us!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re not gonna believe this. Okay, so I go over...
[Two guys walk over and interrupt her. They’re both names you’ve already
heard. One’s Billy Crystal. Yes, that Billy Crystal from City Slickers.
The other one is Robin Williams. Yes, that Robin Williams from Mrs. Doubtfire.]

lines.speaker: Billy Crystal
lines.text: I’m sorry. Ex-excuse us. I’m sorry, it’s a little
crowded. Do you mind if we... (motions to the couch)

lines.speaker: Robin Williams
lines.text: Yeah, could you scooch?

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: Yeah, move over just a little bit.
(Rachel, Chandler, Phoebe, and Joey all scooch over to let them sit down.)

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: Keep on scooching.
[cut to Monica telling the gang about what happened at Pete’s]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So guys, listen, I go over there, and umm...
(Robin interrupts her again by complaining loudly to Billy as the camera cuts to them.)

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: Why? Why?! What’s wrong with me?!

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: I have a feelin’... I, my wife is sleeping with her gynaecologist.
(The gang is now eaves dropping in on the conversation, and is shocked.)

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: How do you know?

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: Well y'know, he’s got access.

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: Y'know it’s that feeling you get, y'know?

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: Like when you go bowling and you know you’re in somebody else’s
shoes?

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: That’s the one.
[cut back to the gang.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, so, so you went to Pete’s...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Robin is speaking loudly again) I...
[cut to Billy and Robin]

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: Why is this happening to me?! I don’t know, maybe it’s my
wound.
[cut to the gang]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Forget it. (they all turn and listen to Billy and Robin)

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: So it’s-it’s not heeled yet?

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: No-no, it’s ooozing, oozing. (to Rachel) Could you pass me the
cream? Is there any—Oh, there’s the cream.

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: Thomas, this is gonna be hard, but I wanted it to come from me, and
nobody else.

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: What is it, Tim?

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: It’s me, I’ve been sleeping with your wife.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Billy) So you’re the gynaecologist?

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: (to Joey) Hey, I’m trying to have a private conversation! Is that
okay?!

lines.speaker: Robin
lines.text: (starting to cry) Ooh, (to Rachel) Can I have a napkin, please? Could you
please hand me a napkin? (Rachel tries to grab one, but is to slow for his tastes.) Would
you--Give me this thing (grabs the napkin holder from her.) all right!! Enough! (to Billy)
And you are no longer my friend! We are finished! (gets up to leave) Nada!! No more! You
are a bastard for doing this!! (Billy follows him) Get away from me!!

lines.speaker: Billy
lines.text: Thomas, come back here! (they both leave)
[cut to the gang, they’re all stunned]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So Monica, what were you gonna tell us?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pause) I have no idea.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, come on, what was the big news Pete wanted to tell you Mon?! Or
should I say Mrs. Monica Becker?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no-no oh, keep your name, don’t take his name.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He didn’t ask me to marry him.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well then definately don’t take his name.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He wanted to tell me he’s gonna compete is some ultimate fighting
competition thingy.

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: Pete?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why?! What is it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know exactly. It’s-it’s sorta like wrestling.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (intrigued) Oh?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but without the costumes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (disappointed) Oh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And it’s not fake, it’s totally brutal.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, it’s two guys in a ring, and the rules are:
“They’re are no rules.”

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you can like, bite, and pull people’s hair and stuff?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, anything goes, except ah, eye gouging and fish hooking.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s fish hooking?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh, what’s fish hooking... (Joey sticks his finger in Ross’s
mouth and pulls on his cheek, y'know like when you hook a fish.) (to Joey, sarcastic)
Thanks man, that would have been really hard to describe. What is that taste?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? My hands are totally clean, I just gave the duck a bath.

scenes.location: Chandler’s office, he is just finishing a meeting with his boss.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: So thanks for the warm welcome. It’s good to have you guys on my
team, and I come to play. I hope you do too. Now, let’s go out there and get
‘em! Huh? And remember, there is no ‘I’ in team.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but there’s two in martini, soo everybody back to my
office.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: (to Chandler) You! Chuckles! What’s your name?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh it’s Bing, sir. I’m sorry , I was just ah...

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: No-no, I heard what you said, funny. I like funny. (Chandler starts to
leave) This team is about hard work, but it’s also about having fun. Good to have you
aboard Bing! (smacks him on the butt, and Chandler leaves shocked.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is making reservations.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) That’s right, Ryder. Wynona Ryder for six. (listens) Thank
you. (hangs up) (to the gang) Yeah, we have the reservations.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right buddy, way to go! (smacks him on the butt)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stunned) Dude, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you! Today, my boss keep slapping my butt and he was acting like
it was no big deal.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeesh, what’d you do about it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I didn’t do anything. I didn’t want to be the guy who
has a problem with his boss slapping his bottom.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I gotta tell ya, I think it’s okay to be that guy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, maybe it’s like y'know, that jock thing. Y'know how football
players pat each other after touchdowns. (pats Ross on the butt)
(Ross throws his hands out in a “What are you doing?” gesture)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know I don’t, I don’t understand guys, I mean I-I would
never congratulate Monica on a great stew by y'know, grabbin’ her boob.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I know, for a really great stew you just y'know, stick your head
in between ‘em.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, can we please go eat?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. What are we getting?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Chandler) Anything but stew.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right so, Chandler, from now on, don’t give your boss a chance to
get you. Y'know just ah, don’t turn your back to him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, or you can teach him a lesson. Y'know? What you could do is you
could rub something that really smells on your butt, all right? Then, when he goes to
smack ya, his hand will smell. (thinking aloud) Now what could you rub on your butt that
would smell bad?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross and Monica) What if Joey were president?
(Monica, Ross, Chandler, and Joey exit.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, hey Rach, can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, you can totally say no, but umm, would it be okay with you if I
set Ross up on a date?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, ah with who?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, my friend, Bonnie. She just always thought Ross was really cute,
and now that you two aren’t together, she asked if I could set it up, but if
you’re not cool with it...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-oh-oh, which one is Bonnie again?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You remember her from my birthday party two years ago. She’s yeah,
like, average height, medium build, bald...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! (laughs) That’s fine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great! Okay, good for you! (as they leave she slaps Rachel on the butt)
[Scene: A Gym, Pete is training for the Ultimate Fighting Championship, with his
trainer, Hoshi.]

lines.speaker: Hoshi
lines.text: You are iron. You are steel! Let me ask you something, how come when I
call your computer support line, I have to wait an hour and a half?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I told you, we’re adding new operators all the time. Could we
concentrate on my training?

lines.speaker: Hoshi
lines.text: It’s just hard when I know I have e-mail I can’t get!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Monica! (runs over and kisses her) Hi honey.

lines.speaker: Hoshi
lines.text: All right, on the table. (Pete gets on the table for his rubdown)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, umm, so listen umm, my friends were telling me a little about this
ah, ultimate fighting thing and it, well it sounds really dangerous. I-I don’t want
you to get hurt, ‘cause I kinda like you.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Oh, believe me, I don’t want to get hurt either. I’m being smart
about this. See these guys? They’re the best trainers in the world, and Hoshi here
used to be a paid assassin. (Hoshi yells at him in Chinese) A house painter! He used to be
a house painter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Promise me you’ll be careful.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, are we still on for tonight?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, good, ‘cause umm, well maybe we could have a little workout
of our own...

lines.speaker: Hoshi
lines.text: No! No boom-boom before big fight!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How ‘bout just a boom?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is there with Bonnie, as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Well that was depressing, I think I just bought a soft
pretzel from one of the kids from Fame. Ready to go to the movies?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um-hmm. Oh wait! This is Bonnie. (who has hair by the way)

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This is Bonnie? (to Phoebe) This is Bonnie? (to Bonnie) You’re
Bonnie?

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: I can show you an ID if you want?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, I’m sorry, you look a lot different from the last time I-I
saw you.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Oh yeah, well I just started wearing bras again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that must be it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Bonnie) Well I hope you have fun tonight.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Thanks! You too.
(Phoebe starts to leave, Rachel slowly follows, shocked about how good Bonnie looks
now.)
[cut to outside of Central Perk]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Phoebe) You said she was bald.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, she was bald, she’s not now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How could you not tell me that she has hair?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know, I hardly ever say that about people.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looks in the window) Ohh, well, this is just perfect!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well I’m sorry, I thought you said it was okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I said what was okay when I thought she was some weird bald chick.
I mean, y'know, that girl has hair got all over head!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, maybe it won’t work out. Maybe Ross won’t like her
personality.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why, does she have a bad personality?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, Bonnie’s the best!
[Scene: Chandler’s office, Chandler is bent over getting some water as his boss
approaches.]

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Bing! (Chandler stands bolt upright and turns around to face him.) Read
your Computech proposal, a real homerun. (He goes to slap his butt, but Chandler slides
over making him miss.) Ooh. Barely got ya that time, get over here. Come on. (Chandler
goes over) Wham! (slaps him on the butt) Good one. That was a good one. (to a couple of
Chandler’s co-workers) Keep at it team. (goes into his office)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to his co-workers) What is with him?

lines.speaker: Phil
lines.text: With him? You’re is favourite, you’re his guy!

lines.speaker: Stevens
lines.text: We never get smacked.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, that’s not true, he-he smacked you once.

lines.speaker: Phil
lines.text: Not on purpose, he ricocheted of you and got me.

lines.speaker: Stevens
lines.text: I’m telling you, I need some smacks. I got a kid starting
Dartmouth in the fall.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: (coming out of his office) Dartmouth? Who went to Dartmouth? Dartmouth
sucks. Did you go to Dartmouth Bing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No sir.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: There you go. (smacks him on the butt)

scenes.location: The Ultimate Fighting Championship, Ross and Monica are there watching Pete.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (walking up with this huge tub-o-popcorn and drink) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God Ross, what is that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it’s the Ultimate Fighting Combo. Yeah, I saved thirty cents,
plus I get to keep the cup. Yay!!

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: From New York City, New York! Appearing in his Ultimate Fighting
Championship debut! He’s known for his confrontational business style. Ladies and
Gentlemen, introducing Pete Beck-errrr!!
[Pete enters with his entourage all pumped up, and Ross and Monica are the only ones
who stand up and cheer.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you, Pete!!!

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: And his opponent, from Hunnington Beach, California! He’s a 300
pound street fighter, Tank Abbottttttt!!!!
(The crowd goes wild, and Ross is the only one boo-ing him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (going up to the ring) Pete! Pete!! That guy’s pretty huge!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Don’t worry, Hoshi taught me how to use an opponent’s strength
and weight against him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, then that guy is in serious, serious trouble.
(Pete and Monica kiss, and Monica mouths “I love you.” to him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right! You go get him! Let’s go!

lines.speaker: Referee
lines.text: Here we go gentlemen, here we go! (to Tank Abbott) Are you ready? (He
nods, and takes out his teeth) (to Pete) Are you ready? (Pete nods, “Yes.”)
Let’s get it on!!
(They both rush each other. Tank picks Pete up and carries him over and slams him into
the fence surrounding the ring.)

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Uh-oh.
(Tank carries Pete over to the other side of the ring, and we see both Ross and Monica
wince in pain.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The Arena, after the fight. Monica is walking up to a defeated Pete.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! (she sits down next to him) It’s me. Mon-i-ca! Can I just tell
you how proud I am of you.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: It would be nice after hearing 20,000 people chant “You suck!”

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean I-I thought you were nuts at first, but you-you did it. And now
you can just look back at this thing with no regrets.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: What, look back?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you’re not gonna get going are you?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Well let me ask you a question. Am I the Ultimate Fighting Champion?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, no. But...

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Well I’m not gonna stop until I’m the Ultimate Fighting
Champion.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That guy stood on your neck until you passed out!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Let me tell you a story. When I set out to create Moss 865, do you think
it just happened overnight? No. There was Moss 1, that burnt down my Dad’s garage,
there was Moss 2 that would only schedule appointments in January, and 862 others that I
learned from, just like I learned from this fight, never to let a guy stand on my neck.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You didn’t know that already?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Look, I’m gonna get better. Okay? I promise you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, just get a lot better. (pause) Fast.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Oh, one other thing. Hoshi thinks that you being ringside may have
affected my concentration.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. That-that was the problem.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's balcony, Ross and Phoebe are grilling some burgers and hot
dogs.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (joining them) Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! How long until Pete’s fight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, about five minutes. Right now they’re interviewing his
opponent. Apparently he trains by going to Iran and pulling the arms off thieves.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hot dog?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Four, please. (Ross looks at her) I’m really nervous. (Ross gives
her the four dogs) Thank you. (she grabs four buns, and heads back inside)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So Ross, how umm, how did it go with Bonnie?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Oh! I gotta tell you, I-I wasn’t expecting to like her at all,
I mean I actually wasn’t expecting to like anyone right now, but she’s really
terrific.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, that’s too bad!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I-I’m saying I liked her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, y'know what, there are other fish in the sea.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, I think she’s great. Okay? We’re going out again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I hear you! Are you capable of talking about any thing else?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (joining them) Hey! Which one’s my turkey burger?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahh, the one next to my foot. Sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sticking his head out the window) Hey, the fight’s starting!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, we’ll be right in. (to Chandler) So ah, did your boss try to
slap you again today?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nine times! Okay, I had to put on lotion! But, it’s gonna be
okay, because as of tomorrow I’m conducting an experiment, and if all goes as
planned, my butt will be smack free.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sticking his head out the window) Fight’s over!
(Chandler, Ross, and Phoebe all stop dead in their tracks at the news.)
[Scene: Chandler’s office, Chandler is confronting his boss about the butt
smacking thing. His boss is writing on a white board.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Excuse me, Doug? (no reaction) Hey there sports fan!!

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: (turning around) Bing! You got those numbers for me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I ah, I didn’t do them.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Oh, you forgot?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no I just ah, didn’t do them. Instead, I ah, hung out with a
couple of friends and had a couple of beers so I certainly don’t deserve any praise,
verbal or otherwise.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Well, I got tanked myself last night. Pretty dicey drive home, Tapanzi
Bridge never looked smaller. (laughs) That’s okay, you’re still my number one
guy! (slaps him on the butt) Bing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Doug!!

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m a little bit uncomfortable with the that way you express
yourself.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Oh, is it the swearing? I mean is it the constant swearing? Because I
gotta tell ya, if it is, you can just... kiss my ass!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no. It-it’s not about the swearing, it’s more about ah,
the way, that you ah, occasionally, concentrate, your enthusiasm on my buttock.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, and don’t get me wrong, I appreciate the sentiment. It’s
just that I, I have a rather, sensitive posterior, and ah, besides, it’s making all
the other guys jealous.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Well, say no more. Y'know it takes guts to bring this up. Bing!
You’re okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (he starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Ha! (goes to smack him on the butt, but stops, faking Chandler out)
Ahhhhhhh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahhhhh! (walks out, imitating shooting himself in the head)

scenes.location: The street outside Central Perk, Rachel and Phoebe are talking and walking.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Would you rather live in the shirt pocket of a sweaty giant, or
inside his shower drain?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing Ross and Bonnie inside Central Perk) Oh my God! Phoebe look,
it’s Ross and that girl.
(We see Ross and Bonnie laughing and having a good time.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No! Look at that! (drags her away from the window) It’s a line
of ants! They’re working as a team!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe! (goes back to the window)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looking in the window) Right, oh yeah. Wow, oh, it looks like Ross is
breaking up with her. Uff, I hope he lets her down easy. Let’s go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on Phoebe, look at that! They are not breaking up, look at them.
Okay that’s, you know what that is? That is a, that is a second date, that’s
what that is! Look at that, she just put her hand on his thigh...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! That really is nothing, she is very sexually aggressive.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! (walking away from the window) Phoebe, this is all your fault! Now
he loves her, he’s gonna marry her, and this is all your fault.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You said it was okay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You said she was bald!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! What-what-what-what-what?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, we can’t, we just can’t just let it happen! Okay, we
have to do something! We have to break them up! Okay? Just go in there and like, shave her
head! You owe me one bald girl!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, first of all, breathe. Second of all, I don’t get it.
Aren’t you the one that decided that you didn’t want to be with Ross?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (quietly) Yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well isn’t he your friend? Don’t you want him to be happy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just y'know, I didn’t expect him to be this happy so soon. Ufff.
Ooo-ooh! (sits down on the curb)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sits down next to her and hugs her) Oh no.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, we killed them all.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!
(They both jump up and wipe off their butts.)
[Scene: A locker room, Pete is in a full upper-body cast. Monica enters, sees him, and
gasps. Pete tries to turn around, and winces in pain.]

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: It’s okay, it’s not as bad as it looks, it’s a precaution.
Ah, I’m not supposed to move my spine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please tell me you’re stopping now.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I’m fine! I’d fight tonight, if they’d let me. (stands up
and starts swinging his arms) See this circle I’m marking off here? This is my zone
of terror.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You are insane! You-you gotta give this up!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: I can’t until I’m the ultimate fighter. I will do it. I’m
telling you, the day will come when children will argue over who will win a fight, me or
Superman. Now, I’m not saying I could beat Superman, but y'know, kids are stupid.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sit down. All right? Please, just listen to me. You are terrible at
this! Okay? You are the worst ultimate fighter ever! Ever!!

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Y'know I have a torn rotator cuff, a hairline fracture in my right
forearm, and a severely bruised Adam’s Apple, but that really hurt.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well then, y'know what? I care about you to much to watch you hurt
yourself like this. So if you have to do this, then you’re gonna have to do it
without me.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Well if you’re asking me to quit, then you’re asking me to be
someone I’m not. I’ve got to do this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then I’ve gotta go. Bye. (kisses him and starts to walk out)

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Mon-Monica?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Could you leave a note? ‘Cause I’m on a lot of pain killers now,
and I don’t know if I’ll remember this tomorrow. (She leaves.)
[Scene: Chandler’s office, he is just finishing up a meeting with his boss and the
rest of his team.]

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: So, in conclusion, the lines all go up (points to the chart), so I’m
happy. Great job team! Tomorrow at 8:30. (They start to leave) Phil! Nice job. (smacks him
on the butt) Stevens! Way to go! (smacks him on the butt) Joel-burg, you maniac! I love
ya! (smacks him on the butt) (Chandler walks up) Bing! Good job, couldn’t have done
it without ya. (he shakes his hand)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you, sir.

lines.speaker: Stevens
lines.text: (coming back in) Oh, excuse me. I forgot my briefcase y'know, by
accident.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Of course, you did. Forgot something else too ya bastard! (smacks him on
the butt) (to Chandler) Well, what about you? You’re not feeling left out or anything
are ya?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. No, not at all, that’s-that’s ridiculous.

lines.speaker: Doug
