lines.text: Everybody else got one, and you want one too. Don’t you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ye-ye-yeah, yes I do!

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Now get on out of here, you! (smacks him on the butt)

title: The One at the Beach

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, everyone except Phoebe is there. Bonnie is telling them of her
sex-capades.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Bonnie) So ah, your first sexual experience was with a woman?!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: All right, I was 15, it was my best friend, Ruth, and we got drunk on
that hard cider, and then suddenly, I don’t know, we were, we were making out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tell it again. (pause, we see Rachel is not amused.) Seriously.
[cut to Rachel and Monica at the counter.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica) I mean is that woman capable of talking about anything else
but sex?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, sure. Well y'know, earlier she was talking about geography.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, she was listing the countries she’s done it in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I think we all learned something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering, hurridly) Hey, you guys! Look what I found! Look at this!
(She hands Chandler a picture) That’s my Mom’s writing! Look.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reading the back of the picture) Me and Frank and Phoebe, Graduation

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know what that means?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That you’re actually 50?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no, that’s not, that’s not me Phoebe, that’s
her pal Phoebe. According to her high school yearbook, they were like B.F.F. (Ross and
Bonnie look at her quizzically) Best Friends Forever.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is so cool.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know! So this woman probably could like have all kinds of stories
about my parents, and she might even know like where my Dad is. So I looked her up, and
she lives out by the beach. So maybe this weekend we could go to the beach?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah, we can!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: (to Ross) Shoot! I can’t go, I have to work!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s too bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastic) Ohh, big, fat bummerrr.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So great! Okay! Tomorrow we’re gonna drive out to Montauk.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Bonnie had sex there!
(Rachel turns and gives him a look, and Joey quickly apologises.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Outside Central Perk, Chandler and Monica are waiting for Phoebe to arrive with
the cab.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (watching a happy couple walk by, arm in arm) Would you look at them. Am
I ever gonna find a boyfriend again? I gonna die an old maid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re not gonna die an old maid, maybe an old spinster cook.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sarcastic) Thanks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey now besides, if worst comes to worst, I’ll be your boyfriend.
(At that suggestion Monica starts laughing.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why is that so funny?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You made a joke right? So I laughed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ha-ha-ha. A little to hard. What am I not ah, boyfriend material?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, no. You’re Chandler. Y'know, Chandler! (hits him on the arm)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so we’ve established my name, and hit me. But theoretically
y'know, I mean say we weren’t friends, say it’s a blind date. I show up at your
door, and I’m like (in a fake voice) “Hey, nice to meet, ya. Hey, oh-hey.”

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well I’d probably be scared of a guy using a fake voice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (walking up carrying a brown paper bag) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, hey! Oh good, you brought food!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, it’s just my luggage.
(Phoebe drives up.)
Chandler, Monica, and Joey: Hey!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Woo-hoo! All right! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I am having the best karma this week. First, I find this woman who
knew my parents, and then my client with the fuzzy back gives me his beach house.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? What about ah, that bike messenger you hit?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I wasn’t talking about his karma.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (approaching) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey, check out the hat!
(She is wearing this giant straw hat, the brim on it must be at least, least
foot wide.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What a minute, I know that hat! I was taken aboard that hat! They did
experiments on me! I can’t have children!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Seriously, where did you get the hat?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross gave it to me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I think she looks good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Buy it for ya, or win it for ya?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well excuse me, my fashion-impaired friends, I am here to tell you that
hats are back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And this time, they’ve ganged up to form one giant, super hat.
[Scene: At the Beach, it’s raining cats and dogs as the gang arrives. Chandler and
Monica are taking shelter under Rachel’s hat.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Go, go, go!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, now everybody wants to be under this hat!
(They get inside and notice on small problem.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oy!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s with all this sand? (picking a handful of sand off of the
floor, which is covered in sand)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, Bob said there might be flood damage.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, either that, or he has a really big cat.
[Scene: Phoebe Sr. house, she is a real estate agent and is trying to sell a house over
the phone. By the way, it’s still raining outside.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Well, yes, it’s kind’ve an unusual house. It has umm, three
beautiful bedrooms and ah, no baths. But y'know, the ocean is right there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (at the door) Knock, knock, knock.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: (on phone) Ah, oh, hang on a second. (to Phoebe) Come in, come in.
(on phone) All right, so think about it, and call me back. (hangs up)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Are you ah, Phoebe Abott?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Ahh, yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi Phoebe Abott, I’m your best friends daughter!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: You’re Erwin’s daughter?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I-I mean your-your old best friend, here. (hands her the picture)
Lily, from high school. Remember?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Oh gosh, Lily, yes. Of course I remember Lily. I... Then you must be?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (points to herself) Phoebe. (points to her) Phoebe. Phoebe, yeah. She
named me after you I guess.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Uh-huh. Wow! Well, look! There’s Frank. (points to the picture.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes!! Yes! Yes! Yes!! That’s my Dad, that’s Frank! Yeah!
I’m sorry I’m getting all flingy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Take it easy--if you want, there’s cookies on the counter, or,
or--sangria! (jumps up) I can make sangria!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no, sorry. Cookies are good, thanks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (goes and gets some cookies) Well, so, umm, anyway umm, I’ve been,
I’ve been looking for my Father, and umm, have you heard from him, or seen him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Oh no, I-I’m sorry, I guess we lost track of everybody after
high school.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (disappointed) Oh, okay. Well, so tell me everything about my parents.
Everything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Ohh, well. Y'know we were always together, in fact the had a nickname
for the three of us.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, what? What was it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: The three losers. Oh, poor Lily. (Phoebe notices a picture on the
fridge, takes it, and puts it in her pocket.) Ohh, y'know I-I heard about what happened,
that must have been just terrible for you, losing your mother that way.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (happily) Yeah, no, it was great.
[Scene: The beach house, it’s still raining. Chandler is building a sand castle,
Rachel is doing Monica’s nails, and they’re all drinking margaritas, obviously
bored.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (getting an idea) Hey, y'know what a really good rainy day game is?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I mean naked game. Strip poker, we should totally play strip poker.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: No, no!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you crazy?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! When you go away, you-you have to play, it’s like a law!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica) Allll done!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aww, thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, who’s next?! (She looks around the room, and stops when she
comes to Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-o-o! (Rachel gives him a “Please?” look.) No way!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on, please?! I’m boredddd! You let me do it once before.
(Ross shoots Joey a look, who shoots Chandler a look, who gives Joey an “Oh my
God.” look back.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah well, if ah, if that’s the rule this weekend... (She gets up)
No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! (she starts creeping up on him)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Get away!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just once!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Stay away!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Take it like a man, Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he gets up and starts to run away from her) No! (in his escape attempt he
crushes Chandler’s sand castle) No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Big bullies!!
(Ross dives over the couch, Rachel goes the other way, and lands up top of him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ow! Ow! Oh, no-no-no!
(They get into a wrestling match, that ends with Ross making Rachel paint her forehead
with the nail polish. They both end up lying next to each other, stop, and look at each
other for a moment.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Oh, hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, so, how are we doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bored and bored!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you know what naked card game is never boring?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Noo!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Phoebe) So what’s Phoebe like?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m kind, caring, and sweet. What’s Monica like?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ah no, the other Phoebe, the one you went to go see.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, I think she knows where my Dad is.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh well, where is he?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She was acting, she was pretending like she hasn’t heard from him
on years, but I found this picture on her fridge, and look (shows Monica)! Isn’t this
what he would look like now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (gasps) Totally familiar. (Phoebe shows the rest of them.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, why would she lie to you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know, but we’re having dinner tomorrow night, so I
figured, she’s gonna tell me then. Y'know maybe she just wanted to give him time to,
buy me presents, I don’t know! So, you’re all bored?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I’m gonna close my eyes and point to someone, and you,
whoever I point has to come up with something fun for us to do, and we have to do
it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, all right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fan out! Fan out!
(They do so, and Phoebe gets in the middle, closes her eyes, and starts spinning in a
circle.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Starts to spin) Ooh, y'know we could just do this. (She stops at
Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, umm, we all have to play strip poker.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (jumping in triumph) OH YES!!!!!
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Strip Happy Days Game?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, well, I couldn’t find any cards, so it was either this or Strip
Bag Of Old Knitting Stuff.
(Monica rolls, and Ross goes first.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, (reading the card) Fonzy gives you two thumbs up, collect two cool
points. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica, if you get five cool points, you get to make somebody take off
one item of clothing. It hasn’t happened yet, but we’re all very excited.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, come on! (blows on the dice) Daddy needs a new pair of
electromagnetic microscopes for the Prehistoric Forensics Department! (They all look at
him, and he shuts up and rolls the dice.) (he moves his piece) Okay. (reading a card) Take
Pinky Tuscadero up to Inspiration Point, collect three cool points!! Yeah! Which gives me
five, and let’s see who is gonna lose their clothes. Ummmm, I think I pick our strip
poker sponsor Mr. Joey Tribianni.

lines.speaker: The Girls
lines.text: Woo-hooooo!!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, relax. It’s just a shoe.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Wooooo!!!!
[cut to later in the game]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading a card) Okay, your band is playing at Arnold’s, collect
three cool points. Which means, I have five, and that means I get Joey’s boxers!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine. Gang up on me! I got you all right where I want you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, take ‘em off!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Actually, y'know it’s kinda cold, so how about I keep my boxers on,
and give you all a peek at the good stuff?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (getting up) All right, I’m gonna make more margaritas! (She pours
the rest of the pitcher into Ross’s glass.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa, hey! What are doing? Trying to get me drunk?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m just making margaritas.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think I’ll help her out. (She gets up to go over and help Rachel,
and reveals she has no pants.) (to Rachel) What is going on here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You painting his toenails?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chasing him all around the room?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He’s totally flirting with you too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause) He is, isn’t he? I don’t know, I don’t know, I
mean maybe it’s just being here at the beach together or, I don’t know. But
it’s like something... (she’s interrupted by the sound of Bonnie entering)

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! (Rachel is shocked) Hi Bonnie!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Hi! My boss let me off early, so I took the train.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: What are you guys doing?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We’re playing Strip Happy Days Game!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Cool! I’ll catch up! (She takes off her sweater.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: The beach house, the next morning. Chandler and Monica are in the kitchen
eating breakfast.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, you still don’t think I’m boyfriend material?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I saw you checking me out during the game last night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You didn’t even take off your pants.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, lucky for you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Well! Is everybody else having just the best time?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shhh! Shhhh! Joey’s asleep.
(Joey is sleeping on the floor and is buried in sand that has been carved into a
mermaid complete with breasts.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: After he passed out, we put the sand around him to keep him warm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well I assume the ah, happy couple isn’t up yet. Did you guys hear
them last night?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah, I don’t know what they were doing, but at one point sea
turtles actually came up to the house.
(Ross and Bonnie enter)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good morning.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Hey! How did everybody sleep?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Like a log.

lines.speaker: Ross and Bonnie
lines.text: Us too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m going for a walk.
(Joey finally wakes up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) Good morning. Nice breasts by the way.
(Joey looks down and his look turns from shock to satisfaction.)

scenes.location: The porch, Bonnie is coming back from swimming, Rachel is reading.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Hey, what happened to you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, ah nothin’. I just felt like hangin’ out here and reading.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Oh, the water was sooo great! We jumped off this pier and my suit came
off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhhh, sorry I missed that.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Yeah, Joey and Chandler sure are funny.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh-ha-ha!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: I think I brought back half of the beach in my hair. It was so much
easier when I used to shave my head.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know, I gotta tell ya, I just loved your look when you were
bald.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Because I think about shaving it all off again sometime.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean you definitely should do that.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Y'know what, I should do it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Yeah, thank you Rachel, you are soo cool.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Awww, stop. Come on. Now go shave that head!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: All right.
(As Bonnie goes to do just that, Rachel smiles to herself, proud of what she’s
done.)
[Scene: The beach house, at night. Phoebe is hangs up the phone, and gently pushes one
of the stools over.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s the matter, Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She cancelled! My namesake cancelled on me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, she clamed she had to go out of town suddenly. She’s avoiding
me, she doesn’t want to tell me where my Father is. She knows, and she won’t
tell me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aww Pheebs, that sucks!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, well, don’t “Aww Pheebs, that sucks!” me yet. (she
starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where ya going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, she’s out of town so, there’s gotta be something in her
house that tells me where my Father is.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, Pheebs, some people call that breaking and entering.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, are any of those people here?!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, no!! No, no!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, look I-I-I do something nice, okay? I’ll-I’ll fill her
ice trays.
(She exits just as Bonnie comes down the stairs, as bald as Michael Jordan.)

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Hey, everybody!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Wow!! (they all recoil in shock and horror)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wh-haa-haa! Look what ‘cha did! (Rachel has her hand over her mouth
to keep from laughing.)

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: You wanna touch it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nooo, but it, but it’s great.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Come on, touch it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (He gently touches it.) You can feel all the bones in your skull.

scenes.location: Outside the beach house, Ross is coming out to talk to Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was having a little chat with ah, Bonnie, and ah, guess what, she-she
happened to bring up y'know, who was behind the um, whole head shaving idea, and now, who
was it? Oh, that’s right, that’s right, it was you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That was her idea, I just gave her a nudge.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She said you gave her the razor!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: (joining them) Hey guys.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: So, anyone up for a midnight dip in the ocean?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahh, no, I’m good.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Okay, I’ll see you in a bit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, have fun! Wooo!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on see, she doesn’t look that bad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can see the moonlight bouncing off her head! What the hell were you
thinking?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You don’t know?! Rach, you balded my girlfriend!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right! Ross, do you think it’s easy for me to see you with
somebody else?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know, hey! You’re the one who ended it, remember?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, because I was mad at you, not because I stopped loving you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You still love me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noo.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You still love me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, y-yeah, so, you-you love me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Noo, nnnnn. What does this mean? What do you, I mean do you wanna, get
back together?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noo! Maybe! I, I don’t know. Ross, I still can’t forgive you
for what you did, I can’t, I just, but sometimes when I’m with you I just, I
feel so...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just, I feel, I-I just...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I feel...
(Ross leans in and kisses her. They both look at each other for a moment, and then
embrace in a more passionate kiss, only to be interrupted by Joey and Chandler coming
outside.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) Noo!! I don’t care! I’m not, I’m not gonna
playing one-on-one strip poker with you for practice!
(Rachel and Ross both stop kissing, and quickly step back from each other.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But I made cards!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well! Good night. (to Ross) I’m going upstairs.

lines.speaker: Joey and Chandler
lines.text: G’night.
(Rachel walks inside, stops, and turns back to look at Ross for a moment then goes
upstairs.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross) Wanna play strip poker for practice?

scenes.location: Phoebe Sr.’s house, Phoebe is breaking in through a window.

lines.text: (She throws her bag inside, and starts to climb through the window. She gets halfway in
and the window slams shut on her butt.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ow! My ass. Okay. Okay. (She manages to climb completely inside and the
window slams shut.) Oh, shhh!
(She starts walking across the darkened room and hits her head on a wind chime hanging
from the ceiling, to stop it from making a noise she grabs it and “Shhh’s”
it. She goes into the kitchen and finds Phoebe Sr.’s appointment book, to read it she
opens the freezer. Just as she starts to read, Phoebe Sr. jumps out from her bedroom with
a coat hanger, startling Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No!! It’s me! It’s me! I-I didn’t want to make any
noise!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Then don't break in!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: What are you doing here?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I, came to fill your ice cube trays.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, okay, okay, look. I took this picture from your fridge. Okay,
because I know that this is my Father. Yeah, this is Frank Buffay and you are standing
right there next to him. Now, look I deserve to know where I came from. All right? So if
you can help me find my Father then you should! Otherwise, you’re just mean! (pause)
So, just tell me the truth!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: All right, the man in the picture is Chuck Magioni.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My Father is Chuck Magioni?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: No, no, that’s just Chuck Magioni, I-I sold him a house last
year! And I’m very sorry, but I don’t know where your Father is, and that’s
the truth.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: But umm, you’re right. I think that a person should know where
they come from. Wh-which is why I ah, (pause) ahh, (pause) okay. I’m your mother.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Heh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Y'know I wanted to tell you yesterday, but I just, I kinda felt all
floopy, and...
(At that Phoebe’s eyes open in shock.)
[Scene: Outside the beach house, Ross is telling Joey and Chandler what happened with
Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m telling ya, you guys are totally getting back together!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s not true! Her, she doesn’t even know what she wants!
Rachel’s still mad about the whole thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, then you gotta back away, all right? You don’t need that
kind’ve hurt. Take it from a guy who’s never had a long term relationship......

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, but ahhhhhh!! I really wanna go up there and finish that kiss!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: (coming back from her swim) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahhhh! (Steps away from her.)

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: You guys, the water’s great. You should really go in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, ahh, no thanks, I just had an M&M.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Okay, well g’night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good night.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: (kisses Ross) Don’t be too long.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okey-dokey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There is not one hair on that head.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, it’ll grow back, right? And she-she’s really fun, and
she’s cool, and-and I’m finally moving on. Y'know? I mean getting over Rachel
was so (makes an incoherent nasal sound), y'know? Y'know, and I’m finally feeling
sane again. And now if I go up there, and-and I kiss her, and, Gooood I wanna kiss her,
and-and-and it doesn’t work out, right? Do I really wanna put myself through that
again?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So let me get this straight. If you go with Bonnie tonight, you’re
doing the smart, healthy thing and moving on.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right, and you go with Rachel, Bonnie’s free tonight?
[Scene: The hallway between the bedrooms. Ross is coming upstairs and stops between two
doors. He looks at the one on the right, then he looks at the one on his left, thinks
about it, and goes in the one on his right.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering the bedroom) Hi. (closes the door)

title: The One with the Jellyfish

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (lying on a beach towel, recapping what happened in the last episode)
Okay, so we went to the beach, because Phoebe found out about this lady who knew her mom
and dad, and I don’t really know what happened with that.
[cut to Phoebe Sr.’s house, from the last episode]

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: (to Phoebe) I’m your mother.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ehh?
[cut to Monica opening the door of the beach house, with Chandler trying to pick her up
for a date.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (voice-over) Oh, and then Monica joked that she wouldn’t go out with
a guy like Chandler...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Monica) (in a funny voice) Hi there. (Monica turns her head away
in disgust)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (voice-over) ...and he couldn’t let it go, and... I don’t really
know what happened with that either.
[cut to a montage of scenes involving Bonnie, Ross, and Rachel from the last episode.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (voice-over) Oh-oh! And then Ross’s new girlfriend, Bonnie, shows up
and Rachel convinced her to save her head. And then Ross and Rachel kiss, and now Ross has
to choose between Rachel and the bald girl and I don’t know what happened there
either...
[cut back to Joey on the beach towel]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'know what, hold on, let me go get Chandler. (gets up and leaves.)
[Scene: The beach house, it’s the same scene from the end of last year, with Ross
in front of the two doors of Rachel’s and Bonnie’s rooms, trying to decide which
door to choose. He finally chooses the one his right and goes in.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (surprised) Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel and Bonnie
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: Rachel was just helping me out. My head got all sunburned.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Awww.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: (to Rachel) Thanks a million.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you’re welcome a million.

lines.speaker: Bonnie
lines.text: (getting up and leaving) (to Ross) Okay, I’ll see you in our room.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. (closes the door, and goes over and kisses Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (softly) Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know.
(They both kiss again and fall onto the bed.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stopping suddenly and getting up) Okay, I gotta go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa! What?! Why?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I-I gotta go break up with Bonnie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Here?! Now?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, yeah. I can’t-I can’t stay here all night, and if I go in
there she’s-she’s gonna wanna... do stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, can’t you tell her that you are not in the mood?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, she likes that. Yeah. Faking sleep doesn’t work either, I
can’t tell you how many mornings I woke up with her...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting) Whoa-ho.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa-oh, okay! Yeah, why am I telling you that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know.
(they kiss again)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. (opens the door) It wasn’t every morning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, making it worse!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Phoebe Sr.’s house, it’s right after she told Phoebe that she’s
her birth mother.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: So I guess you’d like to know how it all happened.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I mean I, well I think I can figure it out. I guess y'know I was born,
and everyone started lying their asses off!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Noo! No! It wasn’t like that I... Remember how I told you how
Lily, Frank, and I we were, we were close. Well, we were, we were very close.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How close?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Well, the-the three of us we were, kind of umm, a couple.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t even know how that would work!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Well, we were...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting) I’m not asking!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Well, any how, some how I got pregnant, and, and I was scared. I was
stupid and sellfish, and I was 18 years old. I mean, you remember what it’s like to
be eighteen years old?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Let’s see, my had Mom killed herself, and my Dad had run off,
and I was living in a Gremlin with a guy named Cindy who talked to his hand.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Well, I’m so sorry. I thought I was leaving you with the best
parents in the world, I didn’t even hear about your Mom and Dad til a couple of years
ago, and by then you were already grown up. I don’t know, you’re here, and I
would, I would really, I would like to get to know you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, well, everybody does! I’m a really cool person. And y'know
you had 29 years to find that out, but you didn’t even try! Y'know what, you walked
out on me, and I’m just, I’m gonna do the same thing to you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Wait!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t ever want to see you again!
(She walks out and slams the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (walking back in with her hand over her eyes.) Umm, where’s my
purse?
[Scene: The beach house, Joey and Chandler are sitting at the dinner table, Monica is
looking in the fridge.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (closing the fridge in disgust) Shoot! We’re out of soda.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (jumping up) Oh, I’ll go out and get you some.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nope! Because I’m not your boyfriend. (to Phoebe, who’s
entering) Hey Pheebs, how did it go?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, umm, my Mom’s friend, Phoebe, is actually my birth Mom.
(The gang is shocked.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I found a dried up seashores.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sweety, what are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, my new Mom, who-who’s a big, fat abandoner! (starts to go
upstairs)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, wait, Pheebs, wait a second! Don’t you wanna stay here and talk
about it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. I’m just, I wanna, I need to be alone.
(She starts to go upstairs.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (turning around, insistently) Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh.
[Scene: The beach house, Rachel’s bedroom. She is finishing up writing something
as Ross walks through the door.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s over.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, was it awful?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, it was loong. I didn’t even realise how late it was, until I
noticed the 5 o’clock shadow on her head. (They both start to laugh, then stop
themselves quickly.) Anyway, she didn’t want to stay. I called a cab; she just left.
(They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I wrote you a letter.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh! Thank you! I like mail. (He goes to kiss her again, but she turns
away.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (handing him the letter) It’s just some things I’ve been
thinking about. Some things about us, and before we can even think about the two of us
getting back together, I just need to know how you feel about this stuff.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (He leans in to kiss her again, but she leans back preventing him
from making contact.) Wow, it’s-it’s 5:30 in the morning. (Rachel laughs) So,
I’d better get cracking on this baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I’ll be waiting for you, just come up when you’re done.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I’ll be up in, (looks at the letter) 18 pages. Front and back.
Very exciting.
[Scene: The beach house, the next morning. Ross is passed out on the kitchen counter.
He wakes up with a start and has one of the pages of the letter stuck to his face.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. (looks at his watch) Oh-oh. (takes a drink of coffee and resumes
reading the letter)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (coming down the stairs) Hey! (Ross jumps up, and quickly puts the
letter back together, pretending like he has just finished it.) What happened to you? Why
didn’t you come up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Done!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You just finished?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I wanted to be thorough. I mean this-this is clearly very, very
important to you, to us! And so I wanted to read every word carefully, twice!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So umm, does it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Does it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Does it? Does it? Yeah, I wanted to give that whole ‘Does it?’
part just another glance.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you talking about, Ross, you just said that you read it twice!
Look, y'know what, either it does or it doesn’t, and if you have to even think
about it...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupting) No, Rach, no. I don’t, I don’t, I don’t have
to think about it, in fact, I’ve decided, I’ve decided that, that it.......does.
(Rachel stands there for a moment, starting to cry. Then gasps and runs over and hugs
him. While hugging her, Ross tries to find the ‘Does it?’ part in the letter.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, sure! I’m sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. (Hugs him more violently this time and pushes him back away from
the letter.)

scenes.location: The beach. Chandler and Monica are out getting some sun.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, there’s a nuclear holocaust, I’m the last man on
Earth. Would you go out with me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ennnh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ve got canned goods.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (jumping up in a hole that he is digging, he is shoulder deep) Hey, you
guys! Take a look at this! (Chandler and Monica jump up and go over to the hole.) Check
this baby out, dug me a hole!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Excellent hole, Joe.
(A wave crashes on the beach and partially fills up his hole.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no! No!! My hole!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (screaming in pain) Ow!! Ow!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (climbing out of the hole) What?! What?!! What is it?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Jellyfish sting! Oh, it hurts! It hurts!! It hurts!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, can we help?! You want us to take you back to the house?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s like two miles!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, and I’m a little tired from digging the hole.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh damn the jellyfish. Damn all the jellyfish!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’ve got to do something!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, there’s really only one thing you can do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! What is it?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re gonna have to pee on it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!! Gross!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t blame me, I saw it on The Discovery Channel.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what, he’s right. There’s something like uh, ammonia
in that, that like kills the pain.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well forget it! It doesn’t hurt that (tries to take a step) baaad!!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If you want some privacy you can use my hole.

scenes.location: The beach house, Phoebe is coming down the stairs all packed and ready to go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I’m ready to get the hell out of here! (Sees Ross and Rachel
cuddling on the couch.) Oh. Are you? Are you?!! (they nod ‘Yes.’) Ohh!
That’s so great!! Ooh, not for Bonnie. (they nod ‘No.’) But for you, yay!
Ohh.
(The rest of the gang arrives with their heads down in shame.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How was the beach?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing, I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing. I’m gonna take a shower.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me too!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I’m gonna put this (her suitcase) in the car.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I have to go pack. (Gets up to do so.) It really does?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It does. It really and truly does.
(Rachel kisses him, and goes upstairs. After she’s gone, Ross frantically tries to
find and read the ‘Does it?’ part.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (finding the part) (looks up in disgust) It so does not!!!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is telling Joey and Chandler about the letter.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She wants me to take responsibility for everything that went wrong
in our relationship. I mean she goes on for five pages about, about how I was unfaithful
to her! (Both Joey and Chandler shrug their shoulders as to say ”Well...”)
(yelling) WE WERE ON A BREAK!!!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God! If you say that one more time, I’m gonna break
up with you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine! Fine! But this break-up was not all my fault, and she, she says
here, (reading from the letter) “If you accept full responsibility...” (to
Chandler and Joey) Full responsibility! “...I can begin to trust you again. Does that
seem like something you can do. (yells at Joey) Does it?!!”

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, Ross, you have what you want, you’re back with Rachel. If
you bring this up now you’re gonna wreck the best thing that even happened to you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (calming down) Yeah, I know. I mean, no, you’re right. Yeah I guess
I’ll let it go. But you-you understand how-how hard it is to forget about this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, it’s hard to forget! But that doesn’t mean you have to
talk about it! A lot of things happened on that trip that we should never, (to Chandler)
ever talk about.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What the hell happened on that beach?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s between us and the sea, Ross!
(Ross laughs and has a ‘Come on...’ look on his face as he looks and Chandler
who nods his head in agreement with Joey. Ross is stunned.)

scenes.location: A hallway in an apartment building. Phoebe is knocks on a door and it opens.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to the person that answered the door) Hi, Ursula.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well umm, I know that we haven’t talked in a long time, but
umm okay, our Mom is not our birth Mom. This-this other lady is our birth Mom.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Right, okay, the one that lives in Montuak, umm-hmm.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (shocked) You know her?!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: No, I umm, I read about her in Mom’s suicide note.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There-there was a suicide note?! (Ursula nods ‘Yes.’) Well, do
you still have it?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: (disgusted) Hang on. (She goes into her apartment and slams the door in
Phoebe’s face.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t believe you didn’t tell me there was a suicide note!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah. So how have you been doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I, umm, shut up!
(Ursula opens the door and hands her the note.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading from the note) “Good-bye Phoebe and Ursula. I’ll miss
you. P.S. Your Mom lives in Montauk.” You just wrote this!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Well, it’s pretty much the gist. Well, except for the poem. You
read the poem, right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Noooo!!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: All right, hang on! (She takes the note, goes back into her apartment
and slams the door shut.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler, Monica, and Joey are sitting at the table eating
dinner and not talking. Ross and Rachel are outside cuddling on the balcony.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pass the cheese, please.
(Joey hands her the cheese without looking at her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My God, you can’t even look at me! Can you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope.
(Phoebe enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (jumping up) Hey! Phoebe! We can talk to Phoebe!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. I’m-I’m to depressed to talk.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll give you a thousand dollars to talk to us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (coming back in with Rachel) Hey, you guys! What do you, what do you think
about making that beach trip an annual thing?
Chandler, Monica, and Joey: NO!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, that’s it, you guys! What happened out there?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? We took a walk, nothing happened. I can back with nothing all over
me.

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What happened? Joey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. (gets up)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (stopping him) No! Joey, we swore we’d never tell!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (running over and joining Monica) They’ll never understand!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, we have to say something! We have to get it out! It’s eating me
alive!! Monica got stung by a jellyfish.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) All right!! All right. (walks slowly into the living
room) I got stung. Stung bad. I couldn’t stand. I-I couldn’t walk.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (following Monica) We were two miles from the house. Scared and alone.
We didn’t think we could make it. (He goes to put his hands on Monica’s
shoulders but for some reason can quite complete the action and pulls back.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was in too much pain.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And I was tired from digging the huge hole!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And then Joey remembered something.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’d seen this thing on The Discovery Channel...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute! I saw that! On The Discovery Channel, yeah! About
jellyfish and how if you... (stops suddenly and turns to look at Monica) Ewwww!! You peed
on yourself?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Ewwww!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You can’t say that!! You-you don’t know!! I mean I thought I
was gonna pass out from the pain! Anyway I-I tried, but I-I couldn’t...bend that way.
So... (looks at Joey.)
Phoebe, Ross, and Rachel: (turning to look at Joey) Ewwww!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right I stepped up! She’s my friend and she needed help!
And if I had too, I’d pee on anyone of you! Only, uhh, I couldn’t. I got the
stage fright. I wanted to help, but there was too much pressure. So-so I uh, I turned to
Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (wails loudly into his hands) Joey kept screaming at me, “Do it
now! Do it!! Do it! Do it now!!” Sometimes late at night I can still here the
screaming.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) That’s ‘cause sometimes I just do it through my wall to
freak you out.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is finishing up a song.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) “...fuchsia and mauvvve. Those are the 66 colours of my
bedroommmm.” (applause) Thank you, thank you. Ohh, and I invite you to count the
colours in your bedroom. (Sees that Phoebe Sr. has entered, and to her) Except for you.
You go away.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: I’ll go in a second, I-I just wanted to tell you that there
hasn’t been a day where I didn’t regret giving you up.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: No, I’m not done. I-I-I just want you to know that I, the
reason I didn’t look you up was, well I was afraid that you’d react, just well
like, the way, the way you’re reacting right now, and can’t we just, y'know,
start from here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Sorry. But just one last thing. Y'know you came looking for family.
I’m family, I’m it. Now, now I’m done. (starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But, it’s not like we’re losing anything. Y'know?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Yeah, I guess you’re right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s not like we-we know each other or anything. Or that have anything
in common.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Well, I don’t know. I mean it’s not like we don’t
have anything in common. I mean I like uh, pizza.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I like pizza!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: You do?! Wait, I like umm, the Beetles.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, so do I!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: I knew it, wow!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait-wait-wait, wait! Puppies. Cute or ugly?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Ohh, so cute.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh, well! But umm, still I’m-I’m mad at you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: I know. I’m mad at me too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well umm, do you wanna get something to eat? I’m kinda hungry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr.
lines.text: Hey! Me too!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, stop it. Now you’re just doing it to freak me out.
[Scene: Rachel’s bedroom. Ross and Rachel have just finished consummating the new
relationship.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-hooo, I missed you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I missed you too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I was soo nervous about that letter. But the way you owned up to
everything, it just showed me how much you’ve grown. Y'know?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (getting miffed) I suppose.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You have! Ross, you should give yourself credit. I mean my Mom never
thought this would work out. It was all, “Once a cheater, always a cheater.”

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (getting angry) Umm-hmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I just wish we hadn’t lost those four months, but if time was
what you needed just to gain a little perspective...
[cut to Monica cleaning the floor in the kitchen]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (yelling from the bedroom) WE WERE ON A BREAK!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering with Joey) (to Monica) Coffee house?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You bet.
[cut back to Rachel’s bedroom with both of them hurriedly getting dressed]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And for the record, it took two people to break up this
relationship!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! You and that girl from that copy place, which yesterday you took
full responsibility for!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I didn’t know what I was taking full responsibility for! Okay?! I
didn’t finish the whole letter!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I fell asleep!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You fell asleep?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was 5:30 in the morning, and you had rambled on for 18 pages. Front and
back!! (they go into the living room, trapping Monica, Chandler, and Joey in the kitchen)
(to Rachel) Oh-oh-oh, and by the way, Y-O-U-apostrophe-R-E means ‘you are,’
Y-O-U-R means ‘your!’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know I can’t believe I even thought about getting back
together again! We are so over!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (starts to cry) FINE BY ME!! (he opens the door and traps Chandler behind
it)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, oh, and hey-hey-hey, those little spelling tips will come in handy
when you’re at home on Saturday nights playing Scrabble with Monica!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica) Sorry!! (to Ross) I just feel bad about all that sleep
you’re gonna miss wishing you were with me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no-no-no don’t you worry about me falling asleep. I still have
your letter!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And hey! Just so you know, it’s not that common! It doesn’t
happen to every guy! And it is a big deal!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I KNEW IT!!!!

title: The One with the Cat

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is eating breakfast as Chandler comes out of his
bedroom, ripping his coat in the process.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! That ripped! That ripped real nice!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How many times do I have to tell you! Ya, turn and sliiiide! Y'know, turn
and slide.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t turn and slide, you throw it out! I’m tired of
having to get a tetanus shot every time I get dressed!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, we’re not throwing it out! I built this thing with my own
hands!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, how about we, how ‘bout we sell it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. But, you’re gonna have to tell them. (He opens the cabinet
to reveal the chick and the duck living inside with Christmas lights and a disco ball as
decorations.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (nods his head) Do you mind if we stick you in another cabinet? (to
Joey) They seem all right with it!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Ross are there. Monica is
checking the messages.]

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: (on machine) Hey Monica, it’s Chip.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yesss!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who’s Chip?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Shhh!

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: (on machine) Good runnin’ into you at the bank today, so ah,
here’s my number, 555-9323. Give me a call. Later.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chip, is Chip Matthews.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The guy who took Rachel to the prom? Why is he calling you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ‘Cause I ran into him at the bank, he is still soo cute.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica, you’re so lucky! He’s like the most popular guy in
school!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!! (calls him) (on phone) Chip? Hi! It’s Monica. (listens)
‘Kay. (listens) ‘Kay. (listens) Okay. (listens) Okay, good-bye. (hangs up) Oh my
God, we just had the best conversation!! (goes into her room as Rachel enters)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) I was just leaving.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good! ‘Cause I’ve got a product report to read, it’s like
eight pages, I hope I don’t fall asleep.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why? Did you write it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sees Chip’s phone number) Wow! Look at that, Chip Matthews called.
I wonder what he wants?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well ah, actually...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting) I bet he sensed that I was ready to have sex with another
guy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, umm, why don’t you give him a call?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (picks up phone) Are you sure you wanna hear this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I’m sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) Chip! Hi, it’s Rachel. (listens) Rachel Green. Yeah,
umm, you left me a message. (listens) Yes you did, my roommate wrote it down. (listens)
Monica Geller. (listens) Ohh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (whispering in her ear) Oh, that’s right! He called to ask out
Monica! That-that’s gotta be embarrassing!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is finishing up a song.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (screaming, angrily) ...DUMB, DRUNKEN, BITCH!!! (applause) (happily)
Thank you, thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (reading the newspaper) Hey, here’s a question; where did you guys
get the finest oak East of the Mississippi?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-huh, first you tell us where you got the prettiest lace in all the
land.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m reading your ad.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Looks good, uh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reading the ad) Stunning entertainment center. Fine, (pause) fine
Italian craftsmanship. (Joey is very proud of himself)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, you guys are selling the entertainment center?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why? I love that thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You want it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahh, Gepeto, $5,000 dollars? Are you insane?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, the ad alone cost 300 bucks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right look, I’m changing it to 50 bucks, or your best offer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What kind of profit is that?! And you call yourself an accountant.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks at him) Nooo.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. What do you do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t believe you don’t know what I do for a living!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I actually don’t know...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good, so do I

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Something to do with numbers?
[Cut to someone entering Central Perk which lets a cat in. The cat then runs over to
Phoebe’s guitar case and starts sniffing around.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! No! Shoo! Kitty! No! No-no-no! Shoo! Come on, you! (goes over
and picks up the cat) Come on. Crazy. (looks into the cat’s eyes) Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing. Nothing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? What’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just, I just have this really strong feeling that this cat is my
Mother.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You mean the mom you met in Montauk. She was a cat?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no-no, she was a human lady. This is the spirit of my Mom
Lily, the one who killed herself.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you sure she’s in the cat, or have you been taking your
grandma’s glycoma medicine again?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No Dr. Skeptismo! I’m sure. First of all, okay, there’s the
feeling. (Chandler shrugs) Okay, and for another, how about the fact that she went into my
guitar case which is lined with orange felt. (Rachel nods her head in unsure agreement) My
Mother’s favourite fish is Orange Roughy... (Joey thinks he understands, but then
nods that he has no clue.) Cats....like....fish! (Ross and Rachel are totally lost) (to
the cat) Hi, Mommy. (Rachel covers her mouth, in an “Oh my God.” gesture) Oh, I
haven’t seen this smile in 17 years!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Chandler) Dude, Phoebe’s mom has got a huge peni...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting) Let it go!!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is working as Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, when were you gonna tell me that you’re going out with Chip
Matthews?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now? Is it okay if I go out with Chip Matthews?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nooo! It’s not okay! I can’t believe you would want to after
what he did to me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What, that little thing at the prom?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica! I couldn’t find him for two hours! He was having sex with
Amy Welch!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on, that was back in high school! How could that still bother you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean why, of all people would you want to go out with Chip?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, you and I went to different high schools...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, that doesn’t help me, because we went to the same high
school.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You went to one where you were popular, and you got to ride off
Chip’s motorcycle, and wear his letterman jacket. I went to one where I wore a band
uniform they had to have specially made.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) They had to have that specially made?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was a project for one of the Home Ec classes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stunned) Oh my God, they told us that was for the mascot!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Back then, I thought that I would never, ever get the chance to go out
with a Chip Matthews, and now he’s-he’s called me up and asked me out. And the
fat girl inside of me really wants to go. I-I owe her this. I never let her eat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you go out with him. (goes over and hugs her)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, really?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Just, if it’s possible, could you leave him somewhere and go
have sex with another guy?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’ll try.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the next morning, they are all there eating breakfast.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So you guys having any luck getting rid of the entertainment center?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, there were a couple of calls last night, but ah, I don’t think
any of them are gonna work out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, Joey has a very careful screening process. Apparently, not
everyone is qualified to own wood and nails.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (is struggling with the cat) Stop it! Stop it! She keeps squirming,
trying to get away! Just like when she was alive.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So Pheebs, how long is your mom gonna be with us?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I’m not sure. I mean, I guess until she y'know, gets used to
the fact that there’s y'know, a new mom. Y'know, I think she’s worried that
y'know, she’s gonna, she’s gonna be replaced. (to the cat, in a funny voice)
Well, that’s not gonna happen is it? Noo. (gets up) Okay, I have to return a call in
the other room.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why can’t you use the phone in here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I’m returning a call from a certain mom at the B-E-A-C-H. I
just spelled the wrong word. (goes into Monica’s room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, guys, am I crazy, or does Phoebe’s mom remind anyone of a cat?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, don’t start.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, you-you can’t tell me you actually believe that-that
there’s a woman inside that cat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I believe it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No you don’t.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No you do—y'know what, you’re not gonna suck me into this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh sure I am, because you always have to be right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I do not always have to be—okay, okay. (starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Jurassic Park could happen.
(Ross wants to say something, but just smiles and leaves.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey and Chandler are showing a couple of guys (Tony and
Peter) the entertainment center.]

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.text: Wow! That’s ah, that’s pretty nice!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pretty nice?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’ll have to pardon my roommate, he wanted to marry this.

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.text: We don’t have 50 bucks, but would you be willing to trade for it?
We’ve got a canoe.
(Joey jumps up in excitement and without turning around Chandler holds out his hand
stopping him, and ushering him back into his seat. Joey sits down, dejected.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I, I really don’t think we need a canoe.

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.text: You gotta take the canoe!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, just, just take the entertainment center, and then when you
get home, throw the canoe away!

lines.speaker: Peter
lines.text: We’re not throwing it away! I built that canoe! (starts to leave as
Tony chases after him)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Peter) Good for you!!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Joey, Monica, and Ross are there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) You guys, you’re never gonna believe what I just found
tacked up on a telephone pole! (She’s holding a flyer.) Look kinda familiar?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (taking the flyer) Apparently Phoebe’s mother also goes by the name
Julio.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys, there’s a little girl in Soho looking for this cat. I
mean, you know what that means?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking at the flyer) Yeah-eah! 200 dollar reward, split five ways!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do we have to tell her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, we have to tell her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, but it’s made her so happy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (holds up a hand) Little girl misses her cat. (hold up the other hand)
Crazy lady thinks her mother is in a cat. (gets up) Okay, y'know what, I have to go have
dinner with my son, can I trust that when you see Phoebe, you will tell her.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (disappointed) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I hate when Ross is right!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He is right, isn’t he?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what, I think this might be one of the times he’s wrong.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: You think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-no, he’s right.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Central Perk, the same scene is continued from before the break.
With Joey, Monica, Rachel, and Chandler sitting on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering, with Julio) Hi. (sits down in the chair)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, Pheebs, about your mom...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause) How’s that going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So great. Oh, we took a nap today and my Mom fell asleep on my tummy and
purred.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s so sweet. (pause) I’m gonna get some coffee. (gets up and
leaves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sliding into Joey’s place on the couch to try and talk to Phoebe)
Huh? What’d ya say Joe? I’ll be right there. (gets up and joins Joey)
(Rachel and Chandler slide into position.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just feel so, uhh.....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m coming already!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Jeez!
(They both get up and leave Phoebe alone.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is reading at the kitchen table as there is a knock
on the door.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (running from the bathroom to her room, wearing only a towel) Not yet!
Not yet! Not yet! Not yet! Not yet! Not yet! Not yet! Not yet! (gets to her room and
closes the door, as Rachel gets up to answer the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello, Chip.

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: Hey, Rach! How ya doin’?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m great! I’m great. I’ve got a great job at Bloomingdale’s,
have wonderful friends, and eventhough I’m not seeing anyone right now, I’ve
never felt better about myself.

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: So ah, Monica ready yet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She’ll be out in a second. So, Chip, how’s umm, Amy Welch?

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: Amy Welch? Wow! I haven’t seen her since... So, Monica about ready?

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is showing off the entertainment center.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is the unit for you my friend. Sturdy construction, tons of storage
compartments, some big enough to fit a grown man.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah! I got in there myself once. My roommate bet me five bucks that I
couldn’t, and then he stuck a board through the handles that locked me in. Yeah. It
was funny ‘til I started feeling like I was in a coffin.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: No, you, you can’t fit in that thing. That’s not deep enough.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah? (opens up the center and takes out the stereo) If I can’t,
I’ll knock five bucks off the price off the unit.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: All right, you have yourself a deal. (shakes his hand)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (he gets in the unit and closes the door) See?! I told ya!
(The guys takes a hockey stick and slips it through the handles then proceeds to take
the stereo and Chandler’s computer and walk out.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sometimes I get in here just to get away from it! Hey, a nickel!!

scenes.location: A street, Chip is walking Monica to his motorcycle.

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: Here, we are.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! You still have the Chipper!

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: The what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s what we used to call your ah, your motorcycle in high
school. Y'know how a motorcycle is a Chopper, and you’re Chip. Nevermind.

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: No, I think it’s cute. (kisses her)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! A lipper from Chipper.

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: So you still in touch with anyone from high school?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm. Well, there’s Rachel, and umm, I think that’s it. How
bout you?

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: Oh yeah, I still hang with Simmons and Zana, y'know. I see Spindler a lot.
Devane, Kelly, and I run into Goldie from time to time. Steve Brown, Zuchoff, McGwire,
J.T., Breadsly.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is that all?

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: Ehh, y'know after high school, you just kinda lose touch. Oh yeah! I ran
into Richard Dorfman.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, how is he?

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: Not so good, Simmons and I gave him a wedgie.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Isn’t he an architect now?

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: Yeah, they still wear underwear.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is coming home. As we walks through the door, and
without looking up, he goes to throw his keys on the foosball table, only, it’s gone
and the keys it the floor. He then looks up at an empty apartment; everything is gone
except for the entertainment center and that ceramic dog. Even the food in the fridge!]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: OH MY GOD!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (still trapped in the entertainment center) WHAT?!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you all right?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (lets him out) What happened?!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (getting out) Awww, man! He promised he wouldn’t take the chairs!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What the hell happened?!! How were you locked in?!! And where the hell
is all of our stuff?!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, this guy came by to look at the unit and-and he said he didn’t
think big enough to fit a grown man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So—You got in voluntarily?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was tryin’ to make a sale!! Oh, man, if I ever run into that guy
again, do you know what I’m gonna do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: BEND OVER?!!!
[Scene: Dot’s Spot, Chip and Monica are on there date, eating dinner. Chip is
telling a story.]

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: ...and then Zana, just let one rip!! (laughs histerically)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, not that I enjoy talking about people who I went to high school
with, ‘cause I do, but umm, maybe we could talk about something else? Like you, I
don’t even know where you work?

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: You know where I work!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I do?

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: The movie theatre, you used to come in all the time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You still work at the multiplex?

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: Oh, like I’d give up that job! Free popcorn and candy, anytime I
want. I can get you free posters for your room.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks, I’m set. Do you still live with your parents?

lines.speaker: Chip
lines.text: Oh yeah, but I can stay out as late as I want.
(Monica takes a big swig of her martini.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Rachel, Phoebe, and Julio are consoling Joey and
Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! They really got you guys. Your T.V. The chairs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, your microwave. The stereo.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking through a deck of cards) Aww, man, he took the five of spades!!
Oh, no-no-no, here it is!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Oh my God! What happened?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, umm, Joey was born, and then 28 years later, I was robbed!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica) So, how was your date?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, y'know how I always wanted to go out with Chip Matthews in high
school?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, tonight, I actually went out with Chip Matthews in high school.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh honey, I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it’s okay, not only did I get to go out with Chip Matthews, I
got to dump Chip Matthews.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! That’s so great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey! So ah, what did the insurance company say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, they said uh, “You don’t have insurance here, so stop
calling us.”

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (seeing Phoebe still with cat) You didn’t tell her?! (They all kinda
shy away.) Okay, fine! Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah? (sees Ross) Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi! Listen uhh, this cat belongs to a little girl. There are flyers all
over the place.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry, sweetie. (shows her the flyer)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, we can take her back with you if you want.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh. Um-hmm. But y'know, she choose to find me. I mean, I have to
respect her decision. Right?
Chandler, Monica, Joey, and Rachel: That’s a good call. Right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! Look—Hey, enough is enough! Look, I am sorry that you feel
guilty or whatever about spending time with your new mom, but this is not your old mom.
This is a cat! Okay, Julio the cat! Not mom! Cat!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (she turns around and puts the cat on the entertainment center) Ross,
how many parents have you lost?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: None.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, then you don’t know what it feels like when one of them comes
back. Do you? I believe this is my Mother. Even if I’m wrong, who cares? Just be a
friend. Okay? Be supportive.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know what to say.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You could.... say you’re sorry to her mom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think she would like that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (goes over to Julio) Come here, here, come here, come here, (pause) Mrs.
Buffay. Sorry, about what I said, umm, it was, it was insensitive of me to say that you
were just a cat. When clearly you are also the reincarnated spirit, of my friend’s
mother.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you. We both forgive you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So honey, what are you gonna do about the little girl?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, okay, listen, umm, Mom, I hope you know you still mean a lot to
me. And you’re welcome to come back anytime.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs, if she could come back as a couch, we’d really appreciate
it. (Joey nods in agreement)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, Mom, I’ll take you home.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ll go with you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Me too. (they all leave)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! Y'know, I’ve got an extra futon.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, you don’t have to brag! We got nothing here!!

title: The One with the Cuffs

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is sitting in the canoe as Joey runs through the
door carrying an outdoor patio table.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!! We are so in luck! Treeger said that we
could have all this cool stuff from the basement. Wait right there. (Goes back into the
hall)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, I’m, I’m paddling away!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Returning carrying a couple of rusted lawn chairs) Huh?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! Really?! We get all this rusty crap for free?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-huh. This and a bunch of bubble wrap. And,
some of it is not even popped!
(They both sit down at the table and the chick and the duck enter from Joey’s
bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Could we be more white trash?
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica, Ross, Phoebe, and Rachel are eating breakfast.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Entering from her bedroom) How desperate am I?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Good thing Chandler’s not here, he always wins at
this game.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just told my Mom I’d cater a party for her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How come?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because I need the money, and I thought that it’d be a
great way to get rid of that last little schmidgen of self-respect.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, I think this is a good thing. I don’t think Mom
would’ve hired you if she didn’t think you were good at what you do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You don’t have to stick up for her. She can’t here
you.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is reading the paper and Chandler is getting ready
for work.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Umm, do you guys have any juice?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just pickle.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey uh, Rach, funny story. I ah, bumped into Joanna on the
street yesterday.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My boss, Joanna? Wow, that must’ve been awkward.

lines.speaker: Chandler
