lines.text: Well, no, actually she uh, asked me if I wanted to get a
drink.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) You ah, you didn’t say ‘Yes’ to that
did you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughs) No. No!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: (Coming out of the shower wearing nothing but a towel) Hello,
Rachel. (She goes into Chandler’s bedroom)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, not at first.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is she doing here?
(Joey makes a sound like a creaking bed.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t understand! Last time you went out with her you
said she was a ‘big, dull dud.’

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I think I judged her too quickly, and this time we
were able to take the relationship to the next level.
(Joey creaks louder)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, last time I almost got fired. You must end it, you must
end it now!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, come on! It’s not like this is an everyday
occurrence for me! I mean usually I’m pretty much just in there by myself.
(Joey makes a sound imitating one person making a bed creak and Chandler turns and
glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler!! (He turns around quickly) Promise me, you will end
it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I promise, I’ll end it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I hope you know what I’m giving up for ya, because
she’s not just the boss in your office, if you know what I mean.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-eh-eah! (Rachel glares at him) Oh-oh, sorry, I-I knew what
he meant.
[Scene: The Geller household kitchen, Monica and Phoebe are cooking for Mrs.
Geller’s party.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (entering) How’s the hired help?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Doing great, the quiches are coming along.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: What’s this? Blue nail polish?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I thought it was cute.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Ahh, that’s what your Grandmother’s hands
looked like when we found her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let me ask you a question.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why did you hire me?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh, well Richard raved about the food at his party, of
course you were sleeping with him. Then I heard the food at that lesbian wedding was very
nice, I assume you weren’t sleeping with anybody there. Though, at least that would
be something. (Leaves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Oh my God! Did you hear that? She hired me because
she thinks I’m good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I didn’t hear that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah, she didn’t hire me out of pity, it wasn’t
so she could pick on me in front of her friends, she actually thinks I’m good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! And hey, it’s cool if you’re a lesbian! (Gives
her a thumbs up)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is scrapping gum off the table as there is a knock on
the door. He goes over and opens it.]

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: (Entering before Joey can say anything) Good afternoon,
are you the decision maker of the house?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhhhh. (He’s not sure)

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Do you ah, currently own a set of encyclopedias?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No. But ah, try the classifieds, people sell everything in
there.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Actually, I’m not buying. I’m selling. Let me
ask you one question. Do your friends ever have a conversation and you just nod along even
though you’re not really sure what they’re talking about?
(We go into a flashback sequence with Joey remembering some of those times.)
[Cut to Monica and Rachel’s apartment, all are there.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …I’m telling you it’s totally unconstituional.
Monica, Chandler, Phoebe, and Rachel: Oh yeah, I totally agree.
(Joey just nods his head.)
[Cut to Central Perk, the entire gang is there.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: …I think he deserves a Nobel Prize. (Joey starts to nod

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Nooo!! (Joey quickly stops nodding his head.)
[Cut to Monica and Rachel’s, they’re all there playing cards.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: …it was like the Algonquin kids table. (They all laugh,
but Joey only laughs not to be left out.)
[Cut back to the present day.]

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: (Interrupting the flashback) Excuse me, I’m sorry,
you haven’t said anything for about two and a half minutes, are you at all
interested?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-well-yeah! Yeah-oh-yeah. Come on in.

scenes.location: The Geller’s Kitchen, Monica and Phoebe are still cooking.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s weird.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Your nails.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I know, I never wear fake ones. I just did it so my Mom
wouldn’t give me grief about me biting them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, no, I meant that it’s weird that you only have nine
now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Looks at her nails) Oh my God. Wait a minute, I had them
put… (realises) Oh my God! It’s in the quiche! Oh My God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, don’t panic. I’m gonna go to the store,
I’m gonna get you another set of nails, no one’s gonna know, and you’re
gonna look great. (She runs over to get her coat.) Oh! Oh, it’s ‘cause
they’re gonna eat—that’s the problem.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (entering) (to Monica) Honey, don’t bite your nails.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay ah, please don’t freak out. Umm, but ah,
there’s a blue fingernail in one of the quiche cups, and there’s no way to know
which one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And! Whoever finds it wins the prize!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (laughs) I’m not freaking out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then why are you laughing?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: It’s nothing, it’s just that now your Father
owes me five dollars.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? You bet I’d lose a nail?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh no, don’t be silly. I just bet I’d need
these. (Opens the freezer to reveal…)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Frozen lasagnas?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You bet that I’d screw up?! So all that stuff about
hiring me because I was good was…

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: No-no-no, that was all true. This was just in case you
pulled a Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You promised Dr. Weinburg, you’d never use that phrase.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh honey, come on, have a sense of humour, you’ve
never been able to laugh at yourself.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) That’s right. My Mom doesn’t have any faith
in me! Oh, that’s hilarious! Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t get it.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: No, I have faith…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) No! You have lasagnas! (Storms out and an
awkward silence follows.)

lines.speaker: Oven
lines.text: Ding!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Op, the ruined quiches are ready.
[Scene: Joanna’s office, Joanna and Chandler are making out on her chair. Chandler
isn’t wearing any pants.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It just doesn’t…feel like we’re breaking up.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: No, we are. I’m sad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(They start kissing again, but are interrupted by the phone.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: (answering the phone) Yes. (listens) Uh, can’t you wait
until tomorrow? (listens) All right. (hangs up) Unbelievable!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: No, no, that was my boss. I have to go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Starts to button up his shirt)

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m getting dressed.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When I walk outside naked people throw garbage at me.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Wait. I wanna show you something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Just a little gag gift somebody gave me. (She’s holding a
pair of handcuffs) Put your hands together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah-ha, you’re not the boss of me. (She kisses him)
Yeah, you are! (She handcuffs him to the chair) Ooh, saucy.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: (kisses him) I’ll be back in ten minutes. (Starts to
leave)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You are, you’re gonna leave me like this?

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Knowing you’re here, waiting for me I think it’s
kinda exciting.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. But if you don’t come back soon, (She leaves and
closes the door) there’s pretty much nothing I can do about it!
[Cut to Joanna’s outer office, where Rachel and Sophie work. They are both coming
back from lunch.]

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: (locking her door) Oh.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Hi! I brought you back a macaroon!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh great! I’ll keep it in my butt with your nose. (She
grabs the cookie and walks out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s weird, she locked the door.

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Y’know why? She’s got the Christmas bonus list in
there. I saw her working on it this morning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, swear you won’t tell, but when Mark left he gave me
a key to Joanna’s office. Do you wanna see the list?

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: Yeah!
(Rachel unlocks and opens the door to reveal a half-naked Chandler handcuffed to the
chair. They both gasp and Chandler stares at them in shock and surprise.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi! (to Sophie) How are you?
(Rachel and Sophie both back out and close the door without saying anything.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Joanna’s office, Chandler, still handcuffed to the chair, is looking
through the lingerie catalogue by turning the pages with his teeth. The phone rings and
Chandler answers it with his nose.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello, Joanna…(Realises he doesn’t know her last
name)…’s office.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: (on speaker phone) I’m really sorry but I may be a little
while longer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How little?!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: A couple of hours, I feel awful.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, this isn’t funny! You get back here right now!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: I’m in my boss’s car!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Uh-oh, tunnel. (The phone gets cut off)
(Chandler gets an idea)
[Cut to Rachel’s office as her intercom buzzes.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (answering it) (angrily) What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (in a serious, businesslike tone) Rachel, could I see you
for a moment?
(Rachel goes into talk to Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, here’s the situation. The keys to the cuffs are
on the back of the door. Could you be a doll and grab them and scoot on over and unlock
me? And on a totally different subject, that is a lovely pantsuit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You promised you would break up with her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I did break up with her! She just took it really, really
well!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And the fact that you were jeopardising my career never
entered your mind?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It did enter my mind! But then something happened that made
it, shoot right out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know what Chandler, you got yourself into those cuffs, you
get yourself out of them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no-no-no-no!! I can’t get myself right out of
them! You must have me confused with the Amazing Chandler!! Come on, you have to unlock
me, she could be gone for hours, and I’m cold, and (Stops and looks up the skirt on a
statue behind Joanna’s desk.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Chandler!! All right, this is it! (Grabs the key) You
never see Joanna again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Never!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You never come into this office again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You give me back my Walkman!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I—never borrowed your Walkman.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, then I lost it. You buy me one!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got it! Here we go! Come on! This is great! (Rachel goes
over and unlocks the handcuffs) Ahhh! (He starts rubbing his wrist)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Does it hurt?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I just always see guys doing this when they get
handcuffs taken off them. (He runs over to where his pants are hanging) Hello sweet pants!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait a minute! What are you gonna tell Joanna?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: When she sees that you’re gone, she’s gonna know
that I let you out, and that I was in here, and I’m gonna get fired!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll make something up! I’m good at lying, I
actually did borrow your Walkman!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, there’s nothing to make up, she’s gonna know
that I have a key to her office, I’ve got to get you locked up back the way you were!
(She tries to drag him over to the chair, but Chandler stops her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho, I don’t think so!
(He starts to put his pants on, but Rachel manages to drag him to the chair. When they
get to the chair, Chandler drops his pants and knocks the chair away. Rachel then backs
him up and locks him to the top drawer of a filing cabinet.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, this is much better.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, The salesman is trying to sell Joey the encyclopedias.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: So, here’s somebody interesting, Joey. What do you
know about Van Gogh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He cut off his ear.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m out.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: He painted that. (Points to one of his paintings in the
book)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! That’s pretty nice. I thought he cut off his ear
‘cause he sucked. What else you got in there?

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Let’s see, ahhh… Where does the Pope live?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: In the woods. No wait-wait, that’s the joke answer.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Actually its, Vatican City. Now ahh, what do you know
about vulcanised rubber?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Spock’s birth control.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: (laughs) You need these books.
[Scene: Monica’s childhood bedroom (which has been turned into a gym), Monica is
lying on the treadmill as Phoebe enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This used to be your room? (She nods ‘Yes’) Wow! You
must’ve been in really good shape as a kid.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, I’m such an idiot. I can’t believe I actually
thought she could change.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, who cares what your Mom thinks? So you pulled a Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh good, I’m glad that’s catching on.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No but, why does that have to be a bad thing. Just change what
it means. Y'know? Go down there and prove your Mother wrong. Finish the job you were hired
to do, and we’ll call that pulling a Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, umm, if a kid gets straight A’s, his parents would
say, "Yeah, he pulled a Monica." Y'know? Or a fireman saves a baby, and they go,
"Yeah I know, he pulled a Monica." Or someone hits a homerun and the announcer
says, "Yeah, that one’s outta here." Though some things don’t change.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (getting up) All right, I’ll go down there. But, I’m
not gonna serve the lasagna. I’m gonna serve something I make.
(She exits and Phoebe goes over and sits down at the machine that works your shoulders
and tries to do one, which she does, easily.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! My breasts are really strong. (She goes and joins
Monica.)
[Scene: Joanna’s office, Rachel and Chandler are having a little tug-of-war with
his pants.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler! Chandler, please, I have to get you locked up back
the way you were, I am sooo gonna lose my job, she’s very private about her office.
Now I know why.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, look, you’re in trouble either way! Okay? If she
comes back and sees me locked to this instead of the chair, she’s gonna know you were
in here. So you might as well just let me go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What if I clean your bathroom for a month?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It still wouldn’t be clean. (Rachel makes an ‘Eww,
disgusting!’ face) All I want is my freedom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Foot rubs for a month!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Freedom!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ll take all of your photos and put them into photo
albums!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Freedom! I want my freedom! Why won’t you here me?!
(Opens the door) Sophie, help me! Help me!! (Sophie stands up)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sophie sit!!
(She closes the door and puts his tie into his mouth as a gag.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! God, would you just calm down!
(Chandler screams a little bit, then realises that he can spit out his gag. He does so
with a ‘Pouff!’)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m gonna say this for the last time. Would you please
just… (He moves his arm which opens the drawer and hits in the back of the head,
which proves his point.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is now reading the ‘V’ book, with the
salesman watching.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! There’s a lot I didn’t know about vomit. (The
duck comes to the door of the bathroom, quacking.) (To the duck) In a minute. (The duck
goes back into the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: So, what do you say, Joey? You get the whole set of
encyclopedias for twelve hundred dollars, which works out to just 50 bucks a book!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Twelve hundred dollars? You think I have $1200? I’m home in
the middle of the day, and I got patio furniture in my living room. I guess there’s a
few things you don’t get from book learnin’.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Well ah, what can you swing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How about zero down and zero a month for a long, long time?

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: You don’t have, anything?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You wanna see what I got? (He gets up to empty out his pockets)
Okay? I’ve got a baby Tootsie Roll, a movie stub, keys, a Kleenex, a rock, and an
army man. Hey!

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Okay, I-I get the picture. Uh, thanks, for your time.
(Starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And a 50. (The salesman stops suddenly) Huh, these must be
Chandler’s pants.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: For 50 bucks, you can get one book! What will it be? A?
B? C?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I-I think I’m gonna stick with the V, I wanna see how
this bad boy turns out.

scenes.location: Joanna’s office, Rachel and Chandler are still negotiating.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I ah, will buy and wrap all of your Christmas gifts.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I ah… Oh! I’ll squeeze you fresh orange juice every
morning!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: With extra pulp?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (happily) Yeah!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: D’oh!! (pause) I’ve got it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t have it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I have so got it. There’s gonna be
rumours about this, there’s no way to stop it. Sophie knows, Monica and Phoebe know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How do Monica and Phoebe know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I called them. And when they ask me what I saw, I can be
very generous (Holds her hands far apart) or very (In a high pitched voice) stingy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (intrigued) Go on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can make you a legend. I can make you this generation’s
Milton Berle.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And Milton Berle has a…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, not compared to you. (Chandler nods in agreement)

scenes.location: The Geller’s kitchen, Phoebe is bringing in some dirty dishes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They’re not even touching the lasagna!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, they love your casserole.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s hard to believe that just a little while ago this
was nothing but ingredients.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (entering) Well, everyone seems to be enjoying your dish.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And you?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: I thought it was… quite tasty.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So if everyone liked it, and you liked it, that would make
this a success. Which would make you…

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (interrupting) A bitch?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I was going for wrong, but we can use your word.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Yes, well I was wrong, and I have to say you really
impressed me today.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, you might even say that she pulled a Monica. (They both
look at her) (to Monica) She doesn’t know we switched it. (Monica nods her head

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: And the next time you cater for me, there will be nothing
but ice in the freezer. (She starts to bite her nails)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That really means a lot. Oh, and Mom, don’t bite your
nails.

scenes.location: Central Perk, all except Chandler, are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (hello) Hello.
Joey, Rachel, and Ross: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (in a sexy voice) Hello, Chandler. (Phoebe has a huge smile on
her face.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Rachel) I love you. (Kisses her on the forehead)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wh-what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.
(She motions for them to come closer, they lean in and she whispers what Rachel told
her. The guys both lean back laughing.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No he doesn’t!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (checks his watch) Two hours, that lasted!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So did you break up with Joanna?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it’s good thing you got out when you did, before she
blew up like that Vesuvius.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The volcano?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. And speaking of volcanoes, man are they a violent igneous
rock formation.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, lava spewing, hot ash, of course some are dormant.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why are you talking about volcanoes all of the sudden?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, we can talk about something else. What do you want to talk
about? Vivisection? The Vasdeferens? The Vietnam War?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! Did anybody see that-that documentary on the Korean War?
(Joey is pissed)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh God, Korea is such a beautiful country.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: With such a sad history.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Could there be more Kims?
(They all laugh and Joey joins them, not to be left out. When the laughing dies down,
he has a depressed look on his face.)

title: The One with the Ballroom Dancing

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the gang is there eating breakfast. Chandler is cleaning
out his wallet.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! New wallet, huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, it was time. The old condom ring in the leather just
doesn’t say ‘cool’ anymore.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You just put an empty carton back in the fridge!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, I know, but the garbage was full.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have you ever taken out the trash? (Hands her the garbage.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I thought you liked doing it. (Rachel starts out the door
and stops.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Third door on the left.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right!

scenes.location: Garbage room: Mr. Treeger is unclogging the trash chute as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Hey, Mr. Treeger.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Hey.
(Rachel opens the trash chute, winces at the smell, and throws the garbage bag in. She
then tries to throw the pizza box in, but since it’s so big she jams it into the
opening and it prevents the door from closing. She then turns around too see Mr. Treeger
watching her.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ummm. Oh! I’m sorry. (She grabs the box and offers him a piece.)
It’s a little old but…

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : No! You’re clogging up the chute that I spent a half-hour
unclogging!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry. I didn’t—I don’t come in here a lot.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Oh yeah, of course you don’t!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : ‘Cause you’re a little princess! "Daddy, buy me a
pizza. Daddy, buy me a candy factory. Daddy, make the cast of Cats sing Happy
Birthday to me…"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I didn’t… I never said that.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : You think you could make a mess and the big man in coveralls will
come in here and clean it up, huh? Well, why don’t think of someone else for a
change?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starting to cry) Okay, I’m sorry. (Runs out still carrying the
pizza box.)
[Cut to Monica and Rachel’s apartment as Rachel returns in tears.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God! If you’re gonna cry about it! (She grabs the box and goes to
through it out.]
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Continued from earlier, Rachel is now telling everyone of
her experience in the garbage room.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa, Treeger made you cry?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! And he said really mean things that were only partly true.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m gonna go down there and teach that guy a lesson.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, please don’t do that. I think it’s best that we just
forget about it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s easy for you to say, you weren’t almost just killed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right that’s it, school is in session! (Exits and slams the
door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Picking up a card from Chandler’s wallet.) My God! Is this a gym
card?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, gym member. I try to go four times a week, but I’ve
missed the last 1200 times.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So why don’t you quit?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t think I’ve tried? You think I like having
50 dollars taken out of my bank account every month? No, they make you go all the way down
there! Then they use all of these phrases and peppiness to try and confuse you! Then they
bring out Maria.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who is Maria?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh Maria. You can’t say no to her, she’s like this lycra
spandex covered gym…treat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You need me to go down there with you and hold your hand?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So you’re strong enough to face her on your own?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no, you’ll have to come.

scenes.location: Treeger’s apartment, Joey knocks on the door and Treeger opens it.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Tribbiani! Hold on, I’ll get the plunger.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! You hold on pal! Now you made my friend, Rachel, cry. So now,
you’re gonna go up there and apologize to her, unless you want me to call the
landlord.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : And tell him what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Have you heard about a little something called, Not Making Girls Cry.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Yeah. Well maybe you have heard about the Rent Stabilization Act

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I have actually not heard of that.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Yeah, well your friends are in violation of it. I’ve been a
nice guy up until now, but uh, I don’t need this grief. I’m gonna call the
landlord and tell him that Monica is illegally subletting here grandmother’s
apartment. Your friends are outta here pal.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why don’t you tell me something I don’t know! (He storms out,
and once Treeger closes the door behind him, Joey makes an ‘Oops!’ have.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier, everyone is still eating
breakfast.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh please, somebody tell me I don’t have to go to work today!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, my first massage today is this incredibly gorgeous guy, and every
time I see him I just want to do things to him that I’m not allowed to charge for.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So do them for free.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, it is forbidden! No-no, Mrs. Potter fires people for fooling
around with clients. And it’s against my oath as a masseuse.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They make you take an oath?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I made myself take an oath. Yeah, no fooling around with clients and
umm, always be prepared. Yeah, that one’s actually from the Boy Scouts, but it just
makes good sense.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why don’t you just give him to somebody else?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I can handle it. No, I’m a professional. (She starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Pheebs, is that a new ankle bracelet?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! And you got a petticure. Your feet are all dressed up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because that’s the only part of you he can see when he’s on
the table!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re gonna do some feet flirtin’!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t what your talking about. (Laughs nervously and continues to
leaqve)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then how do you explain the toe ring?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because it’s Arabian princess day at work! Okay?! Leave me alone!
[Cut to later, Joey is returning from talking to Mr. Treeger.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! My hero! What happened?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well uh, I went down there and told him that no one treats my friends like
that and that he’d better come up here and apologize. I’ll see you later.
(Starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What a minute, what did he say?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He said that he wasn’t gonna apologize because you guys are living
here illegally, so instead what he’s gonna do is have you evicted—I’ll see
you later.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! You got us evicted!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I told you not to go down there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well he made Rachel cry!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel always cries!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s not true! (Starts to cry.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now Joey, you go down there and you suck up to him. I mean you suck like
you’ve never sucked before!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! I’ll try! But if I can’t, you can stay with Chandler
and I until you get settled.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Go!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, all right, all right. (Starts to leave, stops, and turns
around) I mean I’ll have to check with him first, but I’ll think he’ll be
cool with it. (Monica shoos him out.)

scenes.location: Chandler’s gym, He and Ross are there to cancel his membership.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa, hey! Now remember what we talked about, you gotta be
strong.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes. (In a stronger voice) Yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: One more time, "Hey, don’t you want a washboard stomach and rock
hard pecs?"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! I want a flabby gut and saggy man breasts!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good! That’s good!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (They go inside) (To the guy at the desk) I wanna quit the gym.

lines.speaker: Gym Employee
lines.text: You wanna quit?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I wanna quit the gym.

lines.speaker: Gym Employee
lines.text: You do realize that you won’t have access to our new full
service Swedish spa.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (He turns to Ross and Ross makes a ‘Be strong’ sound.) I
wanna quit the gym.

lines.speaker: Gym Employee
lines.text: Okay, Dave in the membership office, handles quitters. (Both
Chandler and Ross start to make their way to the membership office.) Uh, excuse me, (to
Ross) are you a member?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Me? No.

lines.speaker: Gym Employee
lines.text: Sorry, members only.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (horrified at the prospect of trying to quit alone and unsure about
himself) I wanna quit the gym.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s okay man, be strong. (Chandler goes into the office.)

lines.speaker: Gym Employee
lines.text: (to Ross) So, are you a member of any gym.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! And I’m not gonna be, so you can save you little speech.

lines.speaker: Gym Employee
lines.text: Okay, no problem. (To someone out of the picture) Could you come
here for a second?
(This gorgeous woman in spandex walks up)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I’m Maria.
(Ross is at a loss for words.)
[Scene: Heeling Hands Inc., Phoebe’s work, she is giving a massage to the guy,
Rick, she likes.]

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: (looking at her feet) Wow, you have really pretty feet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: These old things.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Would you mind spending some time on my siadic area, it’s been
killing me today.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You mean the—Okay by siadic, you mean the towel covered portion.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure, yeah, no I can do that, yeah, because umm, y'know, the muscles in
the siadic area can get y’know, real (lifts up the towel) nice and tight. So umm,
tell me Rick, how umm, how did you injure the area.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Oh, a 16-hour sit-in for Greenpeace.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. (She goes to work, and her head slowly drops out of view.)

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Ow! Did you just bite me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No!

scenes.location: Mr. Treeger’s apartment, Joey is there to suck up.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Please don’t kick Monica and Rachel out, this wasn’t there
fault, it was mine.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : You want me to kick you guys out instead?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No you can’t do that, where would the chick and the duck live?

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : You have pets!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Noo-no-no, no, those are nicknames. I’m the chick and Chandler is the
duck.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Huh, I would’ve thought it was the other way around.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on man, just-just let the girls stay, I’ll do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Really? You’ll do anything?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, absolutely.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Yeah, I’ve got something you can do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What, what is it?

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Can you be my dancing partner?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s not, prison lingo, is it?
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is telling Monica and Rachel what he has to do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: His dancing partner?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, there’s this superintendent’s dance, the Super Ball. I
don’t know, and he wants to impress Marge, this lady super that he’s a crush on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, why doesn’t he practice with a girl?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, he’s too shy, he doesn’t thing he’s good enough to
dance with girls yet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, right, he almost danced me right down that…garbage chute.
(Starts to cry)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, would you let it go already?! You’re fine!
(Chandler and Ross enter)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! So, did you quit?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I almost did, couldn’t leave Ross there without a spotter!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, now so you joined the gym?
(Rachel starts to laugh.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And that’s funny, why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, umm, I was just y’know working out and umm… Oh,
that’s it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’re doomed. Okay, they’re gonna take 50 bucks out of our
accounts for the rest of our lives. What are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you could actually go to the gym.
(Chandler and Ross both laugh)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Or! Or, we could go to the bank, close our accounts and cut them off at
the source.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re a genius!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aww, man, now we won’t be bank buddies!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now, there’s two reasons.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, you guys, remember that cute client I told you about? I bit him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Where?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: On the touchy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And that’s not against your oath?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I know! I-I’m sorry, but the moment I touch him, I just wanna
throw out my old oath and take a new, dirty one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, next time your massaging him, you should try and distract
yourself.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! Like-like when I’m doing something exciting and I
don’t wanna get too excited, I just ahh, y’know try to thing of other
things like ah sandwiches, and ah baseball, and ah Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you, Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, thank you.

scenes.location: Treeger’s apartment, Joey knocks and Mr. Treeger opens the door.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I’m here, let’s ahh, get this over with.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Okay ahh, well, just ahh, follow my lead. (Turns on some music)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa, don’t we need to do some kinda preparation first? Like
ahh, get really drunk?

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Look come on, eh, just ah, just ah, put your arms around me, eh.
(Joey does so, and they both start dancing. Treeger tries to spin Joey, but ends up
throwing him into the door.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Ahhhh! I’m sorry!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, it’s okay, but if I’m Marge, my breasts are coming out my
back.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Ahh, forget it! I’ll never be any good at this, my mom was
right, I’m just a big potato with arms, and legs, and a head.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on man, you’re not a potato.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : I’m sure as hell a dancer, it’s no use Marge will never
go for me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on Treeger, don’t say that. You just ahh, you just need more
practice. Here, come on, let’s ahh, let’s try it again. Come on. (they start
dancing again) Plus, it was, it was probably mostly my fault, anyway. I mean, y’know,
I’m not really that comfortable dancing with a—(Treeger throws him) We-he!! Hey!

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Yeah!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel and Monica are sitting at the table as Joey
enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey-hey, how goes the dancing? Gay yet?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah-ha-ha, you guys owe me big time. (He walks into the kitchen and does a
little dance step on the way.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughing) What was that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You just did a little dancy thing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No I didn’t.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes you did! You did like a little hop.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are soo enjoying this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I’m not! And it wasn’t a hop it was a pademarie.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughing harder) You know the words! You are so into this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, well maybe I’m enjoying it a little bit. I mean I’m
getting pretty good at it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, this is soo sweet, Joey our little twinkle-toes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey, hold on, this isn’t some kind of like girly dance. All
right, it’s like a sport, it’s manly!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, then show me some manly moves.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right.
(They both get up and Monica expects Joey to take the lead, but he doesn’t, and
they fumble around for a little bit.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know how to lead.

scenes.location: Ross and Chandler’s bank, they are there to close their accounts.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We’d like to close our accounts.

lines.speaker: Bank Officer
lines.text: Close your accounts? Is there some kind of problem?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, we’d just like to close them.

lines.speaker: Bank Officer
lines.text: Okay, Ms. Lambert handles all our closures. (to a beautiful woman)
Would you come over here please?

lines.speaker: Ms. Lambert
lines.text: Hi, I’m Karen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I wanna quit the bank!

scenes.location: Healing Hands, Inc., Phoebe is giving Rick a massage.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (thinking to herself) Okay, baseball. Rick, playing baseball. Okay,
slides into second, maybe even his pants come down a little… Oh no—wait no, no!
No! Okay, all right, sandwiches, sandwiches. Umm, okay, on a plate, maybe Rick’s
pants come down a little. No! No! Okay, Chandler! Okay Chandler, ooh, that’s working.
(The camera zooms in on the clock on the wall and it reads a quarter after one. Time
lapse. The clock now reads 3:30, and Phoebe is still giving Rick his massage.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (thinking to herself) Chandler’s knees. Chandler’s…
ankles. Chandler’s ankle hair. (notices the clock) Oh no. (to Rick) Okay, you’re
all set.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Oh wow! That was amazing, was that really just an hour?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! In… really long hour world.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh, okay, I have an enormous crush on you. But because you’re a
client, I can’t ask you out, even though you give me y’know, the feeling.

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Wow! I had no idea! But you know, I could always find another masseuse.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Yeah, really.
(They start to kiss, then Rick stops suddenly.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rick
lines.text: Suddenly, I very aware that I’m naked.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (laughs) Okay, quit down. (they start to kiss again)
(Suddenly, Phoebe’s boss, Mrs. Potter, and a client, Mr. Simon, enters.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Potter
lines.text: Mr. Simon’s been waiting for—(sees Phoebe and Rick) Oh my
God!

lines.speaker: Mr. Simon
lines.text: Why wasn’t I offered that? I’d definitely pay more for
that.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Potter
lines.text: Phoebe, we have rules here, this isn’t that kind of place.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, oh and I know, but this isn’t what it looks like,
‘cause Rick is my ahh, husband.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Potter
lines.text: Oh really? Well, then you’d better tell his other wife,
‘cause she called three times asking where he is.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, I will tell her.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler and Ross are telling Joey, Rachel, and Monica of
their bank woes.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you didn’t leave the bank?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! And somehow, we ended up with a joint checking account.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you ever gonna use that for?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: To pay for the gym.
(Phoebe enters)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! So I had a great day, Rick and I really hit it off, and we started
making out, and then my boss walked in and fired me for being a whore.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You got fired?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my Gosh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s so weird, I have never been fired from anything before!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sweety...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just-I just started walking around not knowing what to do next,
y’know? I-I started asking people on the street if they wanted massages. Then these
policemen, thought I was a whore too. It’s been a really bad day, whore wise.
(There’s a knock on the door and Chandler answers it.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Hey Duck, is Chick here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah… Bunny-rabbit.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Mr. Treeger) So you ah, ready for our last practice?

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Yeah, but y’know, I think the reason we’re not getting
that spin right is because my apartment’s too small.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, you wanna use our place?

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : No, I ahh, had another idea.
[Cut to the roof, where Joey and Mr. Treeger are dancing happily to ^Night and Day^.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We did it!!

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : I know, we did it!! Hey, that was incredible, huh?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, it was amazing! I mean, we totally nailed it, it was beautiful.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Thank you, listen, thanks a lot Tribbiani, (checks watch). Oh my
God, look at the time, I gotta catch the bus to the ball.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well, okay, good luck.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Unless you wanna practice the Foxtrot again? Or-or the Tango?

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Ahh, thanks but no. You see I-I think I’m ready to dance with
girls.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Go get ‘em Treeger.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Right. (Starts to leave) Hey, ahh, you wanna come? Marge has a
girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (intrigued) Really?

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: : Yeah, you could dance real good with her, she’s the same size
as me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I’m good.
(Treeger leaves, and Joey’s dances off.)

title: The One with Joey's New Girlfriend

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, the gang's all there. Ross has a slip of paper that he throws on
the ground tying to get Rachel's attention.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (picking up the slip of paper) Hello! What's this? Oh right its that
girl's phone number. (Rachel ignores him) Yeah-yeah, there it is, just a phone number a
really hot girl gave me. (He holds it so that Rachel can see it, she continues to ignore
him) It's no big deal, I mean it is her home phone number, but...(Rachel still ignores
him) Whoa! (Throws it in her lap) Whoa-whoops, I almost lost this baby! Yeah, the lovely
Amanda gives me her number and I-I go and drop it. (He waves it in front of Rachel's face.
Then suddenly Phoebe has to sneeze and Rachel quickly grabs the slip of paper and gives it
to Phoebe for her to sneeze into.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, the next morning. Chandler, Monica, Ross, and Rachel are there.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: When's your birthday?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: May fifth, why?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Oh, I-I'm just making a list of people's birthdays.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, mine's December...

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Yeah, whatever. (Walks away)
(Chandler is talking to Monica and notices a beautiful woman.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh, she's pretty. Pretty ahh, pretty girl, the pretty--she's pretty.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just go up to her and ask her out. (Chandler laughs) Oh, what's the
worst thing that could happen?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I could die.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it's-it's tough being single. That's why I'm so glad I found Amanda.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, you guys went out once. You took your kids to Chucky Cheese,
and you didn't even kiss her.
(Ross glares at Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I tell people secrets. It makes them like me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! (Phoebe sneezes)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe! You're sick, you shouldn't play. You should just go home, get in
bed, and stay there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (in a nasally voice, from her cold) But I'm unemployed, my music is all
I really have now. Well music, and making my own shoes. (She puts her shoe on the table,
and it's horribly decorated) Pretty, huh? (Sneezes)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, I'm gonna do it! I'm gonna get shot down. Any advice?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just be yourself. But, not too much.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (gets up) (softly) Wish me luck.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (loudly) Good luck!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wish it! (To the woman, Kathy, he likes) Hi. Hi, I-I was just sitting
over there, and uhh, Chandler. My name is Chandler. Did I say that?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: No, you didn't. Hi, I'm Kathy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh Kathy, with K or a C?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: With a K.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-oh-hey!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Wow! You are really good at this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, come on, give me a break, I'm out on a limb here.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: I'm sorry, you're right, I apologize, but I should tell you that I'm
waiting for a date. (Joey enters) Oh, and there he is now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Hey, hey-hey, hey. (Joey kisses Kathy.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I see you guys already met, huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes-yes, I was just trying to figure out a way to uh, demonstrate how
I could get my exceptionally large feet into my even bigger mouth.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Didn't I tell ya? Always showin' off.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Before I start, I just wanna say that umm, I have a cold, so if I sneeze
in the middle of song, it's not on purpose. Oh, except the last verse of Pepper People.
(Starts to sing) Smelly cat, smelly cat. What are they feeding you? (Stops
singing) This chick sounds good. (Singing) Smelly cat, smelly--(stops singing)
Hey Gunther, be a good little boy and bring me a whiskey.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is walking into the living room having just
gotten up in the middle of the night.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sees Kathy is up watching TV) Hi!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Jeez, at 2:30 in the morning, I didn't expect to have to fight over
the remote.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: I'm sorry, it's just this Ernie Cofax thing on in a few minutes I wanted
to watch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God! That's why I got up too!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: You're kidding! Oh, I love him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, listen, I'm sorry about this afternoon, y'know, if I would've
known you guys were... I never would've...

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Oh please!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So ah, Joey tells me you two met in acting class.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Yeah, they teamed us up as partners. Joey picked three scenes for us to
do; all of them had us making out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's a good thing actually, because ah, he used to have me rehearse
with him.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (laughs) Oh-oh-oh-oh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is it on?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: No, but this wonder broom is amazing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! (Runs over and gets his wonder broom)

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! It's on! It's on!
(Chandler jumps into the canoe and sits down. The chick starts chirping and Chandler
reaches down to pick him up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There we go little fella.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (laughs) What about the duck?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well the duck can swim.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Oh, jeez. (Hits him)

scenes.location: Central Perk, the next night, Phoebe is finishing up her set.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing, drunk) My sticky shoes, my sticky-sticky shoes, why do you
stick on me, ba-a-by! Thanks for the lights honey.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Way to go, Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That cold makes you sound so great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's fun, God I love how sexy I am. (Coughs really loudly.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, Kath, we should get going. We're going to by hamsters.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ooh, that's great, I love those little guys.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: No, no, it's not like that. I, I work for a medical researcher.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, have fun!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I think it's great that the medical community is finally trying to
help sick hamsters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what, I like Kathy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, me too, she's so cool and pretty.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, she's...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She's smart and funny, y'know? We were up all last night talking, she
said the funniest thing about--what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You love her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I don't.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, you do. Chandler loves Kathy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, Pheebs lay off him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, he's a little sensitive right now, `cause he's so in love.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (turning around and doing that, "I'm making out with someone,"
thing with her hands) Ooh, umm, oh Kathy! Kathy, I love you! Oh! (She turns around and
sees Gunther staring at her and stops suddenly.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, I need to write some depressing stuff to go along with my new floozy
voice, but nothing that sad has ever really happened to me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh umm, how about your mom dying, or having to live on the streets when
you were 14?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh. Oh, yeah, I could write about the time my hair did that
"Woo-hoo" thing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (loudly) So I'm going over to Amanda's tonight!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel's not here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How's it going with her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great, actually. I'm thinking tonight, maybe the night. Yeah, I mean ah,
the kids are gonna play together and then when they're asleep, I'm thinking Amanda and I
break open a bottle of wine, and do a little "playing" ourselves.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, with a guy) Hi guys! This is Josh. Josh, these are my
friends, and that's Ross.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, Josh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Josh
lines.text: Dudes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, did you play in college? (She points to his NYU Soccer (football for
the rest of the world) sweatshirt he's wearing.)

lines.speaker: Josh
lines.text: Oh, I still do. Next year, I hope to make varsity though.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, didn't you ah, play soccer in High School? Oh no wait, that's
right. You just organized their game schedules on your Commodore 64.

lines.speaker: Josh
lines.text: Well, it's getting late, I've got to get to the game, so I'm gonna...
head.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (He starts to leave, and Rachel grabs him and gives him a
passionate kiss.) I'll miss you.

lines.speaker: Josh
lines.text: Dope! (exits)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, cute one!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Very!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, isn't he great? It's so nice to finally be in a fun
relationship, y'know? There's nothing boring about him, and ah, I bet he's never set foot
in a museum.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well maybe he'll get to go soon, like on a class trip or something.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know what else is really great about him, oh, what is the word for the
adult that doesn't have dinosaur toys in their bedroom?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! (He bangs his fists together.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica knows.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's this dumb thing that Ross made up `cause he was trying to fool our
parents. It's a way of giving the finger, without actually having to give it. I remember I
cried the night you made it up, `cause it was the first time that I realized that I was
actually cooler than my older brother.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I'm gonna go get ready, (Gives Monica the fist thing.) for my date
tonight, so ah, I'll just_ head.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I should go to, `cause I'm playing in one hour. Hey, (clears her
voice and in her normal voice) you guys should come hear me, ooh hear me. Ooh, (tries to
sing) My sticky shoes--eww! Eww! I lost my sexy phlegm!

scenes.location: Amanda's apartment, Ross is arriving with Ben.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: (opening the door) Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Hi Ben!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! You-you look great!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (she lets him in) Okay! (to her son) Hey Tommy.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: I am so glad that you could come over tonight.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, it's my pleasure.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Okay, well, my cell phone number is right here on the counter, please
help yourself to anything in the fridge.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: I appreciate this soo much, I've been trying to go out with this guy for
like a month.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: (noticing the bottle of wine he has) Oh, I don't mean to be a square,
but I'd really appreciate it if you wait and drink your wine after the kids are asleep? Oh
uh, thanks for this, I hope I can do the same for you sometime. (She leaves)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who wants to make some long distance calls?

scenes.location: A street, Chandler is buying a newspaper and notices Kathy running by.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kathy! Kathy! Hi!! Kathy! Kathy! (She doesn't hear him and keeps
running, Chandler starts chasing her as the theme to The Mod Squad starts to
play. First, a car almost hits him and then gets mustard splashed on him as he runs by a
hot dog vendor.) Kathy! (He keeps running and gets tangled up in the leashes of five dogs,
in desperation he throws his paper.) Fetch! Fetch it! (He frees himself and resumes the
chase) Kathy! Kathy! Kathy! (He now trips and falls into a pile of garbage, he tries to
get up and scream her name again but he has a piece of spinach in his mouth. He gets out
of the garbage and starts crossing the street by running over the hoods of a couple of
cabs.) Kathy! (He jumps in front of her and out of breath he says) Kathy.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Hey, Chandler! What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I just wanted to say, "Hey!"

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (He walks away disgusted with himself.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is telling Monica about his new baby sitting job.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh come on! You're making it sound worse than it actually was.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Her date tipped me ten dollars. (Monica laughs)
(Phoebe runs into the kitchen with wet hair, opens the window, and sticks her head
outside.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I wanna be sexy again so I'm trying to catch a cold. It should be
easy, supposedly they're pretty common.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, you'll catch pneumonia.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Okay. You were right. I'm in love with Joey's girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, how-how-how is that possible? You barely know her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know. I can't--I just, I can't get her out of my head. Y'know?
I mean, I'm a very bad person. I'm a very, very bad person. I'm a horrible person. (he
waits for a reaction, when he doesn't get one) No you're not Chandler! We still love you
Chandler!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sneezes) Oh gosh, Phoebe, I think I caught your cold.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You mean you stole it! (Monica sneezes again) Don't cover your mouth
when you do that!
(Joey and Kathy enter, laughing)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (to Chandler) We were just talking about you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, I told her about the time you got drunk and fell asleep with
your head in the toilet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughs) Right in there!
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is playing Hide-and-Go-Seek with the chick and
the duck.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: 99...100! Ready or not, here I come! (He opens his eyes and sees that
the chick and the duck are still sitting in front of him) All right, let's go over the
concept one more time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey guys. (to Chandler) Listen uh, you wanna get some dinner with me and
Kathy tonight?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh, umm, y'know what, I already ate.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know I had a big meal on Monday, y'know. So that's just gonna get me
straight through the week.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, I see what's going on here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You-you do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! You don't like Kathy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you've been avoiding her ever since we started going out. Look, I
made an effort to like Janice, now I think it's your turn to make an
effort to like Kathy by going out to dinner with us. Right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good, and hey! My treat. (He turns to go into his bedroom then stops.) But
that's only because you're not eating anything, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is returning from a date with Josh, and when they
get the door open, Rachel turns and passionately kisses Josh.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (lying on the couch suffering from her cold) Ross isn't here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. (She tries to walk away from Josh, by he keeps holding her) Stop it!

lines.speaker: Josh
lines.text: So I'll see you at the party? Beer's beer man, 24, 7!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! (Monica gives a sarcastic thumbs up) (Josh leaves) I am soo gonna
marry that guy. (looking in her wallet) Ohhh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think he's stealing from me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because he's stealing from me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hi! It's me. And soup. (to Rachel) Hey, I just saw Josh, he
looks so yummy in your leather jacket.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ughh! (Storms out after him)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Monica) Here, now I don't eat chicken, so it's just noodle soup. And
there's no chicken in the broth either, so it's really just... noodle water.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you so much Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (picking up Monica's used Kleenex and putting some in her pocket.) Sure.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing with those?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But, I need your germs! I want my cold back! I miss my sexy voice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sorry, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's okay. How's the soup?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm. (nodding her head, "Good.")
(Monica sets the soup down and Phoebe picks it up and licks the rim.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohhhh!! Gross!!

scenes.location: A nightclub, Chandler is having dinner with Kathy and Joey.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Ohh, God, guys, check it out, you can see that girl's underwear!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is she great or what?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (to Chandler) So? Huh? What do you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh, she's-she's not really my type.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Not your type?! She's gorgeous!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what I think it is? It's the fishnet stockings. Y'know?
Whenever I see a girl in fishnet stockings it reminds me of my father in fishnet
stockings.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Okay. Understanding a little more why you're single. Ohh! Y'know, I have
a friend you would like, she's really pretty. And then we could double date!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh, no-no thanks.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Okay, I've got some ugly friends, and they're all available too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen, I-I'm gonna grab a beer. (Leaves)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Kathy) I'll be right back. (to Chandler) What was that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Kathy was being really nice and you just walked away. I thought we had a
deal.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, look, what do you want from me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I want you to like her! But if that's too damned difficult for you, then
the least you can do is pretend.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am pretending.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well then, do it better!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, what do you saw I go over there and say how much I like her?
(Joey gives him a thumbs up) No-no it'll be good, I can tell her much I've been thinking
about her. That I haven't stopped thinking about her since the moment I met her. That I'm
so fantastically, over-the-top, wanna-slit-my-own-throat in love with her, that for every
minute of every hour of every day I can't believe my own damn bad luck that you met her
first!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, that's pretty good. But you might wanna tone it down a little.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey! So, uhh, Amanda just-just dropped me off. Yeah, that's one
of the things I love about her, she's...uh, she's old enough to drive. (to Monica) So uhh,
I guess you're not going to mom and dad's tonight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well where's Amanda?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Rach, could you get me some cough drops?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean y'know, I'm thinking. You could bring her, and you guys could go
up to your old room, and not make out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, cough drops, please?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: At least I know she's not going out with me to get into R rated movies.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why don't you just marry her? Oh no, wait a minute you can't, I'm sorry
I forgot, she's not a lesbian.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You see Amanda and I have a very special...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) You have nothing! You're not even going out! You're her
baby sitter! You have a 12-year-old girl's job!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughing) Ohh, that is soo sad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And what are you laughing at, Miss
`My-keg-sucking-boyfriend-is-stealing-from-me!'
(Ross starts laughing)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, so he stole a couple bucks from me! At least he bought me something
with it! (Shows her, her ring)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's mine!! Now, would you both please start acting like adults? And
get me my cough drops!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here. (Hands her, her cough drops) (to Rachel) At least I made ten bucks
in my relationship.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know...
(She does Ross's little gesture. In response Ross puts his hands behind his neck with
his arms sticking straight out and starts flapping them together.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is there with her guitar.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Platting goats are platting. Platting down the street.
Platting goats are platting, leaving little treats. (to Gunther) Does it even work
without my sexy voice?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I like it. (sneezes)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Gunther, kiss me.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: What?
(Phoebe grabs Gunther and kisses him. He then falls to the couch in shock.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is watching TV as Joey and Kathy are laughing in
Joey's bedroom. They get to be pretty loud so Chandler turns the TV way up.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (opening the door wearing nothing but a sock, and holding a dart board
over the `Little General.') Hey! (Chandler turns down the TV) Now, we're not actually
gonna be sleeping in her, but do you mind?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica, with a blanket draped over her shoulders, opens
the door to a similarly clad Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can I sleep on your couch?
(Monica nods `Yes.' And they both walk to the couch looking all depressed.)

title: The One with the Dirty Girl

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Ross and a beautiful blonde (Cheryl) are standing outside. The
rest of the gang is watching from inside.]

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: So, thank you for the delicious dinner.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're welcome for a delicious dinner.
[inside]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey what are you guys looking at?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross and the most beautiful girl in the world.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, come to papa.
[Cheryl walks away and Ross walks inside. Everyone stares at him in disbelief.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Probably the only time I'll ever say this, but did you see the ass
on her?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where did you, when did you, how did you... (Joey hits the back of
Chandler's head) How did you get a girl like that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, so what is she, like a... like a spokesmodel, or an aerobics
instructor, what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually she's a paleontology doctoral candidate, specializing in the
centazoic era.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but that's, like, the easiest era.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I've seen her at work, but I always figured, ah-huh? But, uh, I made her
dinner. We had a great time. And we're going out again tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well maybe she and her friends are just having a contest to see who can
bring home the biggest geek.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine by me; hope she wins.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's. Ross, Rachel, and Phoebe are there. Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi. You guys have any wrapping paper?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oo! Is it for my birthday present?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phebes, it was your birthday, like, months ago.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but remember you said you ordered something special, and it just
hasn't come yet?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I have a call in about that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: 'Kay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually, this is for Kathy's birthday. It's an early edition of her
favorite book.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, The Velveteen Rabbit! Oh my God, when the boy's love makes the
rabbit real!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but don't touch it, because you fingers have destructive oils.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh. Well, then you'd better keep it away from Ross's hair. So this
is pretty rare. How did you get that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it wasn't a big deal. I just went to a couple of bookstores, talked
to a couple of dealers... called a couple of the author's grandchildren.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, honey, that's so sweet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and what a great way to say, "I secretly love you, roommate's
girlfriend!"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It doesn't say that. Does it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How do you think it's gonna look when you get her something incredibly
meaningful and expensive and her boyfriend Joey gives her an orange?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, all right, I'll just uh, make sure that uh, Joey gets her something
really great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's gotta be better than that book. Oo! Like a crossbow!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Entering from her bedroom, talking on the phone) Yeah, once again, I am
sorry. Thank you. Bye. (To the gang) I just had to turn down a job catering a funeral for
sixty people.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! What happened?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sixty guests.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, uh, why did you have to turn it down?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because I don't have the money or the equipment to handle something that
big on such short notice. I mean there's no way.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, what is with all the negativity? You sound like Monican't , not
Monican... (Monica looks almost puzzled) ...Monica. Look, you know, you have been playing
around with this catering thing for over three years. Do you want to be a caterer or not?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There you go, that's the spirit! Okay! Now, if you need money, I will lend
you money, but just get moving!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? Cause I'd need like $500 for all the food and the supplies and
stuff.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! It's worth it, if it will get you moving. You haven't worked in
months.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you're not working either.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, but I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, that'd be great! Thank you!
[Joey enters]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Everyone
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Can I borrow the keys to your apartment?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?
[Kathy whispers something in Joey's ear]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You can pee here!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Ahahaha... haha.. yes I can, of course. Excuse me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's okay, the duck's using our bathroom anyway. (Kathy goes into the
bathroom.) Hey Joe! What are you getting Kathy for her birthday?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We've only been going out for a couple of weeks, do you think I gotta get her
something?

lines.speaker: Everyone
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, you have to get her something, and it should be something really nice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I know...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And not one of your coupons for an hour of "Joey Love."
