[cut to a new scene, also in Monica and Rachel's apartment. Rachel is sitting, Phoebe
is nearby.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooo, a crossword! Can I help?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! I'm sorry, honey, it's just that last week I got all but three answers
and I really want to finish a whole one without any help.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine. But you can't help me develop my new universal language.
[Monica enters]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, how'd it go?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, it was the best funeral ever! I mean, everyone loved the food,
and guess what? I even got another funeral for tomorrow—the dead-guy-from-today's
best friend. I mean, it is like I am the official caterer for that accident!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mon! I'm so happy for you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks. Like, check out my new catering stuff. (Picks up two frying
pans) Look at this! I'm an omelet station! Omelet? Made to order!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'll have one, please. Plus my money.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. Well, I didn't realize that you needed it back right away. I mean, you
told me to go and be a caterer. So I went. I beed. I mean, I... I used it to buy all this
stuff. But look—I've got another job tomorrow, so I'll pay you back with the money I
make from that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Okay. Oo, sorry I acted like a bank.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

scenes.location: Outside Cheryl's apartment, Ross and Cheryl are kissing

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (moved by the kiss) Huh...

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: Um, would you like to come in?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did homo-erectus hunt with wooden tools?

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: According to recent findings!
[They go into the apartment. Inside the apartment it looks like a sewage dump exploded
and landed in her living room. There are clothes and food and junk covering every square
inch of space. I mean pigs have nicer pens. Ross is completely shocked.]

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: (throwing food around the room) Here Mitzi! Here Mitzi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mitzi is.....

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: My hamster. I hope she's okay, I haven't seen her in a while. Have a seat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (mouths "where?") Uh... Oh hey, do you, uh (steps on some garbage
and falters) ...do you have any, um, Cinnamon Fruit Toasties?

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I do! Why don't we go back to my place, light a couple of candles,
break open a box of Cinnamon Fruit Toasties, uh...

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: I'd rather not.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah, why not?

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: Okay, um, don't take this the wrong way, but your place kinda has a weird
smell.

scenes.location: A kitchen where Phoebe and Monica are finishing up a catering job

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, is everything in the car?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. Did you settle the bill?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. I hate this part.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, look what we almost left. (Picks up a coffee maker)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, that's not mine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, all right. Oh! Look what we almost took!
[cut to the living room of the same dwelling, where the funeral guests are mingling.
Monica enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Excuse me, Mrs. Burkart? Well, we're all cleaned up in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burkart
lines.text: Oh, good. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Um, and, well there's the.. the the small matter of...

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burkart
lines.text: Dear?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just the matter of ...payment?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burkart
lines.text: (in grief) Jack used to handle the finances! (Breaks into tears)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is on the couch still doing the crossword. Chandler
is in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what we should all do? Go see a musical.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (confused) Sure...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you know which one we should see? The 1996 Tony award winner. Do you
happen to know the name of that one?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know... um, Grease?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Rent?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! Rent!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so when do you want to go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Oh, I'm sorry, I can't, I'm busy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering the apartment) Hey. Man, it is so hard to shop for girls.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, it is, at Office Max.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What did you get her? (Joey opens up a rectangular black box and holds up a
pen.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A pen.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's two gifts in one. It's a pen that's also a clock! Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Huh-huh! You can't give her that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because she's not eleven! And it's not the seventh night of Hanukkah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, honey, what he means by that, is ...while this is a very nice gift,
maybe it's just not something a boyfriend gives?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure it is! She needs a pen for work, she's writing, she turns it over....
"Whoa! It's time for my date with Joey!"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, look, look. What did... what did you get for Angela Delveccio
for her birthday?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She didn't have a birthday while we were going out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: For three years?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (whining and heading toward the door) Look, it's too late, and I got an
audition. I can't shop anymore! I...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right. I will go out and I will try to find something for her, okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks, man. And oh, while you're at it, could you get her a card?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Would you like me to write her a little poem as well?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or... just get a card that has a poem already in it.

scenes.location: Back in the kitchen at the funeral. Phoebe is there, Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But Mon, you have to get our money!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Phoebe, she couldn't stop crying! With those thick glasses, her tears
looked giant.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, it's tough. You know what the first thing I did after my mother's
funeral was?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Pay the caterer! Look, I've had a lot of jobs, okay, and there are some
people who just always try to get out of paying. It's either, you know, "that massage
wasn't long enough, or, "I don't recognize any of those songs," or, you know,
"these sombreros aren't big enough. Bad little white girl!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. So what do you.... you think she's faking?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it seems like there weren't any tears 'til you showed her the bill.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, she sounded pretty upset to me.
[cut to the living room where Mrs. Burkart is now performing.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burkart
lines.text: (singing) You're a grand ol' flag, you're a high-flying flag, and
forever in peace may you wave....

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She seems fine now.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burkart
lines.text: (singing) ...emblem of the land I love. The home of....
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Ross and Joey are standing and talking, Ross is tying a
tie.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, you just left? Her place was really that bad?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know how you throw your jacket on a chair at the end of the day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, like that, only instead of a chair, it's a pile of garbage. And instead
of a jacket, it's a pile of garbage. And instead of the end of the day, it's the end of
time, and garbage is all that has survived! (Ross takes the loosely tied tie off and hands
it to Joey who puts it on.) Here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow. Thanks. So, uh, what happened?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do you mean? Nothing happened! I had to get out of there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, so... next time, you take her to your place.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I tried that. She says it has a weird smell.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What kind of smell?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know. Soap?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, listen, Ross... you like this girl, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You wanna see her again, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you're gonna have to do it in the mess!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, okay you're right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I mean, uh, who... who cares about a little sloppiness?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's, uh... it's endearing, really.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Now you go get that beautiful pig! (Ross hesitates, looks unsure)
Oink!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel, Rachel is there, Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, all right. I just spent the entire afternoon looking for a present
for Kathy that would be better than the rabbit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Any luck?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Yeah, I found this great place called "Invisible things
for Kathy." (Motions to an imaginary pile of presents next to him.) Can you give me a
hand with all this stuff?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, look. Why don't you just return the book, let Joey give her the
clock pen, and you give her something worse than that. Like... a regular pen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She's really going to love this, you know? The bottom line is I want her
to have it, even if I don't get to be the one who gives it to her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw, honey, that's so sweet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah? You don't think it's just pathetic?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Pathetic! (Grabs the crossword puzzle and starts writing.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey! I'm meeting Kathy in ten minutes! I've been looking all over
for you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Our place, the hall! I...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I got something for her. (Joey picks up the package, shakes it next to
his ear, can't hear anything, switches ears, shakes it again.) It's a book!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Unimpressed) A book? (Suddenly interested) Is it like a book that's also a
safe?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it's a book that's just a book, okay? It's an early edition of the Velveteen
Rabbit. It was her favorite book as a kid. So, uh, just... let me know if she likes
it, okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got it. Thanks man. Thanks for doing this, I owe you one. (Joey leaves,
comes back in.) Oh, hey! There wasn't any change from that twenty, was there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it came out to an even twenty.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow. That's almost as much as a new book.

scenes.location: In the living room at the funeral

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burkart
lines.text: (singing) Jeepers, creepers, where'd you get those peepers? Jeepers,
creepers, where'd you get those eyes?
[cut to Monica and Phoebe in the kitchen]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You didn't get the money, did you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe I can try at intermission? Phoebe, come on... you know what? Let's
just go!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Hey, we're not leaving until we get paid! I don't know who she thinks
she is! Enough is enough! (Phoebe goes into the living room.) Hey, widow?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burkart
lines.text: (Singing) Come on along and listen to...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, Widow!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burkart
lines.text: (Singing) ...the lullabye of...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Excuse me. Excuse me! (Mrs. Bukart stops singing) Thanks. Um, clearly this
is a very, very hard time for you. Um, but, um, we provided a service, and we deserve to
be paid because you ate that service, and, um, we are not leaving here until we're paid
every penny. 'Cause you know what, lady? We're part time caterers, and we have no place
else to go.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burkart
lines.text: All right. I'll get my bag.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good. (Phoebe and Mrs. Burkart go into the other room, leaving Monica with
everyone staring at her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm gonna leave some cards here. Please think of us for you next event.

scenes.location: Outside Cheryl's apartment.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: So you want to come inside?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (mustering up courage) Yes. Yes I do. (They go inside.)

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: I'll be right back. Make yourself comfortable. (Ross attempts to clear a
place for his coat and fold it small enough to fit. Then hit sits on the couch. Something
falls on him from above and he brushes his neck off frantically.)

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: (sneaking up behind Ross) Guess who?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Department of Sanitation?

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: It's me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! (She kisses him) Ah. (They kiss more, and move down onto the couch.
Ross's hand moves under some garbage) Aw! (His hand is covered with something brown and
gooey.)

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (trying to make his disgust into lust) Ah, Cheryl!

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: Oh, Ross!
[They sit up, moaning in excitement, and Cheryl straddles Ross. Ross finds a slice of
bologna and moans higher and louder, then a bag of potato chips on the coffee table starts
to move. Ross throws Cheryl off his lap, grabs a tennis racket and a toilet brush and
starts pounding the bag.]

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: Wait! No! No! It's my hamster! It's Mitzi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my god! I'm so sorry, Cheryl. I must have freaked out.

lines.speaker: Cheryl
lines.text: (looking in the bag) Oh, thank god, it's not Mitzi. It's just a rat.
[Scene: Central Perk. Rachel is sitting on the couch alone working on a crossword
puzzle. Gunther is there, going into the back room.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did it! Oh! I finished it! I did it all by myself! And there's nobody to
hug!
[From the background we hear a crash and Gunther comes running out of the back room,
pushing people aside, reaching for Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Move!
[Gunther slips and falls just before reaching the back of the couch. Monica and Phoebe
come into Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Hey, you guys, I finished the crossword all by myself! Hug me!
[Gunther gets up slowly from behind the couch and walks away sadly]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh... yay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, that's great! Congratulations!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you! Hey, how'd the catering go?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, it was great! The widow wouldn't pay, so Phoebe yelled at her 'til she
did.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. I'm a hard ass.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And I'm a wuss. And we should be partners.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Hard Ass and Wuss. We could fight crime!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute, Phoebe! We should be partners. We should be
catering partners. I mean, think about it! You're not working right now, and we have such
a great time together!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can cook and you can take care of the money.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Oh! It'll be like I have a wife in the fifties!

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: (screaming with excitement) Aah!

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is there, Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, how'd it go? How'd she like the gift?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, man, she loved it! She's over there showing Monica and Rachel right now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah? That's great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, listen, I gotta tell ya, I feel kinda bad taking credit for this,
because man, am I gonna get a lot of credit for this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: [nodding, with mixed feelings] Aahhuuhhh....
[Kathy enters]

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Happy birthday.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know, uh... [Joey moves the pen case out onto the counter.] Chandler got
you a gift, too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No he didn't. [Moving it back.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, he did, look... look, it's right there on the counter! Ha-ho-ho!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Happy birthday! I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: You really didn't have to. (Opens the box) Wow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See, you think it's just a pen, but then you turn it over and it's also a
clock.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Yeah. No, this is great. Thank you, Chandler. (They hug).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah... yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah. Hm. (To Kathy) Wanna go to bed?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: I'll be in in a minute.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, uh... don't forget your coupon. (Tries to strike a sexy pose up against
the doorway to his room. Then goes inside).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: [to Kathy] Goodnight.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Um, thank you for the gift.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, uh, yeah... I just knew that sometimes when you're writing, you...
you don't always know the exact time.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: No, I... I didn't mean the pen. Thank you for the book.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, the book?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: The Velveteen Rabbit. I kinda have the feeling you had something to
do with it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Well, uh, when Joey gave it to me, he said, "This is 'cause I know ya
like Rabbits, and I know ya like cheese." Thanks. I love it. And I know how hard it
must have been for you to find.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (tongue-tied) Uhl..ell. By the way, in case you missed that, that sound
was, "Uhl, ell."

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: You must really like... Joey... to go to all that trouble for him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah, he's my... he's my best friend.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Well....

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Goodnight. (Goes to his room.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (opening bedroom door) Hey, that coupon expires, you know.

title: The One Where Chandler Crosses the Line

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, everyone except Joey and Chandler are there eating
breakfast.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering in a bathrobe) I just walked in the bathroom and saw Kathy
naked! It was like torture!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know if we ever go to war and you’re captured, you’re in for a
big surprise.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It just keeps getting worse and worse! Y'know? I mean it’s bad
enough that I’m in love with my roommates girlfriend—which by the way, I think
she knows. Because every time we’re in the room together there’s this weird like
energy between us. And call me crazy, but I think she likes me too. And now I have seen
her naked. I mean at least when I’ve seen her with clothes on, I could imagine her
body was like covered in boles or something. But there are no boles, she’s smooth!
Smooth! (leaves)
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! Could everyone totally see up his robe?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah! Oh my God!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey is getting a phone number from a woman (Casey) as Chandler
watches from the doorway.]

lines.speaker: Casey
lines.text: Here you go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! All right, so I’ll call you later.

lines.speaker: Casey
lines.text: Great! (leaves)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (rushing up) Hey-Hey-Hey! Who was that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That would be Casey. We’re going out tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Goin’ out, huh? Wow! Wow! (Does a little celebration dance) So
things didn’t work out with Kathy, huh? Bummer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, things are fine with Kathy. I’m having a late dinner with her
tonight, right after my early dinner with Casey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah. And the craziest thing is that I just ate a whole pizza by
myself! (Laughs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait! You’re going out with Kathy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Why are you getting so upset?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I’m upset—for you. I mean, having sex with an endless
line of beautiful women must be very unfulfilling for you. (He can’t believe he just
sad that.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What is the big deal? It’s not like we’re exclusive.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, Joey, Kathy is clearly not fulfilling your emotional needs. But
Casey, I mean granted I only saw the back of her head, but I got this sense that
she’s-she’s smart, and funny, and gets you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got all that from the back of her head?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right look, I think it’s time for you to settle down. Y'know?
Make a choice, pick a lane.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who’s Elaine?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Ross and Monica are sitting on the couch playing cards,
and Phoebe is working on a new song.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) "Little, tiny Tarzan, swinging on a nose hair.
Swinging with the greatest of ease…" Darn it! Now, I don’t know who to
get to the next verse.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you could just go uh, "greatest of ease… (plays air
guitar) BAH-bah-bha-bhannn." Then go right into it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, ooh, I like that! Yeah. Wait! How do you know about
‘bah-bah-bha-bhan?’

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well umm, y’know, I used to play.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, that’s right, the keyboards, huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, just a little in high school, but then I really got into it in
college. I mean that’s-that’s when I really found my sound.
(Monica is taking a drink as Ross says that, laughs, and snorts her drink.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God! Orange juice just came out of my nose, but it was totally worth
it. Oh my God, I completely forgot about your sound.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He used to lock himself in the basement for hours. No one was every
allowed to hear, "The Sound."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I wanna hear "The Sound."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? No. I mean, nah, I haven’t played in so long, and-and, well
it’s-it’s really personal stuff, y’know?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, play that funky music white boy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, you guys, I mean my keyboards are all the way up in—No, yeah,
okay. (Runs out.)
[Cut to later that same day, Ross has retrieved his keyboard and is about to debut,
"The Sound."]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right! Bring it on, you…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here we go. (Plays one note) Y’know, I’ve-I’ve never played
my stuff for anyone before, so it’s important that-that you understand it’s
about communicating very private emotions. (Plays another note) Y’know, umm, you
should-you should think of umm, my work as wordless sound poems. That’s what

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting) Oh my God! Play!
(Ross starts to play. He plays a key that has a back beat sound attached to it. Over
the background music he plays the sound of a barking dog, a mooing cow, a laser beam,
someone coughing, a jackhammer, a doorbell, a police siren, a ray gun, breaking dishes,
and for a closer he plays the sound of a loud crash. Basically, the music sucks.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (At a loss for words) Boy, that was-that was, umm… terrific.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really, bitchin’!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, it was so—wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?! I mean, really?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I mean, you should play in public!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! Thanks, you guys. That’s uh—ohhh, I wanna, I wanna play you
another piece! Umm! Uh-oh! I left my uh, helicopter sounds on another disk. I’ll be
right back! Okay? (Runs to fetch them) This is so nice, I’m—I am so…
(starts to break up and leaves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God bless my dad sound proofing the basement!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I can’t believe I ever let him touch me with those fingers.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you guys talking about, I loved it! It was soo moving. Oh, plus
it’s just, it’s so different from the stuff you usually hear.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean like, music?
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is watching Yasmein Bleeth running on TV, and the
duck starts quacking.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I know what you’re thinkin’! Yes, yes, your breasts
are just as firm and juicy.
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come in!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (entering) Hey! (sees what’s on TV) Oh God, is that Baywatch?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh yes, but uh, I just watch it for the articles.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: So is Joey around?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no, he’s not back yet, but he’ll be here any minute. So
uh, come on in. Have a seat. Bow or stern?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: I uh, don’t really have a preference. You?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I like it in the stern. (Realizes what he just said.) …of the
boat. (The phone rings, and he answers it.) (on phone) Hello.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on the other end at a pay phone) Hey, it’s me. Listen Casey and I
were on our way back and had a little car trouble.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We broke down on the Parkway, so I have to walk back and get some
transmission fluid. And hey, listen could you please tell Kathy that I’ll be there as
soon as I can.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why can’t you tell her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ‘Cause I only have one quarter, and I think my time is about
to—(he stops talking suddenly)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey! Joey!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I thought your time ran out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too, but I guess I do have a couple of more—(his time runs out for
real)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Kathy) Uhh, that was Joey. He’s running a little late, he
says he’s sorry.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So I guess it’s just uh, you and me then.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I think it is!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: So what did you do today?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I had an appointment to get my haircut…

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (interrupting) Oh, it looks great!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: …and then it got canceled.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Well, I could cut it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?! You do that?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Yeah, I do. Of course, I learned at my aunt’s dog grooming shop, but
hey, what do you say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dog grooming huh? Okay, just don’t make my tail too poofy.
[Cut to later, Kathy is cutting Chandler’s hair.]

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: You have really great hair.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, thanks. I grow it myself. (Kathy is running her fingers through
his hair, and Chandler catches himself enjoying it too much.) Y’know who also has
great hair is Joey!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Yes! Yeah! Joey has great hair! Umm, I’m basically done here. Just
let me get this off your neck.
(Kathy leans in really close and Chandler mouths "Oh my God." She moves
around in front of him and kneels at his feet.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What-what ‘cha doin’?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Checking to see if it’s even.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Looks good.
(They lean in to kiss and are interrupted by the phone.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (jumping up to answer the phone) Oh the phone! The phone’s making
sounds! (On phone) Hello!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Hey dude, it’s me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey it’s Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen uh, I’m really sorry, it looks like I’m gonna be stuck
here for a while. I got the transmission fluid, but when I went to put it in the car, the
transmission wasn’t there!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it must’ve fallen out a few blocks back. I just figured we hit
a dog.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen uh, could you put Kathy on, I wanna apologize.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah man. (to Kathy) Joey. (Hands her the phone.)

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (on phone) Hey. (listens) Oh no it’s fine, don’t worry about
it. (listens) Yeah-no, stop apologizing, it’s okay. (listens) Yeah! I’ll talk to
you tomorrow. (hangs up) (to Chandler) I should uh, probably go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Yes! Yeah.
(Kathy leaves and Chandler groans in agony. Kathy knocks on the door and Chandler opens
it.)

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: I forgot my purse.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh.
(They kiss, passionately.)

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: No, I really did forget my purse.
(They kiss again.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, continued from earlier. Chandler and Kathy are still
kissing, then they stop suddenly.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no, this is bad! It’s bad! This is bad!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Horrible!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait the uh, the kiss or the situation?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: No-no-no, the kiss was good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: No, but that’s bad!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh! Yes! Okay! Here’s what we do, we-we forget it happened.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, we-we swallow our feelings. Even if it means we’re unhappy
forever. Sound good?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Can you really do that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have to; he’s my best friend, and you’re seeing him.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Chandler, I like Joey a lot, but with you…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting) Oh-no-no-no! Don’t! Don’t! See-see,
you’re getting me confused, I’m starting to urn.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: I’m sorry. If you wanna pretend that nothing happened, I can try.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I-I think we have too.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Okay. Bye.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye. (Kathy leaves and Chandler wonders over to and leans up against
the door.) Are you still out there?

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (outside the door) No. (Chandler opens the door and they kiss again.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is performing, his music hasn’t improved.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (His voice is altered to sound like a computer.) Electrifying. (He plays
the sound of a ticking clock.) Emphatic time-time-time…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Rachel and Phoebe) Y'know, there’s a Starbucks about
three blocks down.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (pushing Monica back onto the couch) It’s so inspired! Look at him!
Look at him go!
[cut back to Ross who finally finishes his so-called song with the same crash from
before. He gets some applause, mainly ‘cause he’s done.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (with the altered voice) Thank you guys-guys-guys…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Hey, aren’t you up next?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, I’m not playing tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t follow Ross! It’d be like those bicycle ridding chimps
that followed The Beetles. No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, Ross sucks!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, the place has emptied because of him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, he’s not even appreciated in his own time. I would give
anything to not be appreciated in my own time!
(Rachel and Monica look at each other, and agree on something without saying anything.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Umm, Phoebe, you suck too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, Phoebe you’re… awful!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys. You suck too. (She hugs them both.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is opening the door, but Chandler has the chain on
it.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aww man! I can’t believe I locked myself out again! (He knocks on the
door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hang on buddy! (He goes over and unlocks the door and opens it to
reveal a fully furnished apartment.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (rushing in) Oh my God! What happened here? Did you do all this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I sure did.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I just thought it’d make me feel good to do something nice
for my friend.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, you’re amazing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no. This is amazing. (He goes over and
presses a button on a remote control that opens the entertainment center doors revealing
the TV.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (very excited) A TV as if it appears from nowhere! That’s the dream!
Man, how did you afford this stuff?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, y’know I’m 29. I mean who needs a savings account.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you are the best friends anyone has ever had.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-no-no-no, you are! You do this, you give me the great advice, and hey
listen, I was thinking about what you said yesterday about focusing on one woman, I’m
gonna do that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean with Casey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no, I think I’m gonna see how things go with Kathy. She’s
pretty cool.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Or Casey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, Kathy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Could be Casey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. No, Kathy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Consider Casey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what I think? I think somebody’s got a little crush on
Casey. How ‘bout I fix you two up? What do you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That all the pieces of my life are falling right into place!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross has just finished playing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! You were really great! You were really, really great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thanks, thanks. So Monica tells me that uh, you don’t want to
play anymore because me and y'know my talent. Is that true?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, kinda. Yeah. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I-I can’t—I mean y’know I was trying to be really
y'know okay and upbeat about it, I just—I feel so dwarfed by your musical gift.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: See but, Pheebs that-that is the exact opposite intent of my music.
Y’know my music is-is meant to inspire, and if it bothers you this much, then I…
I won’t play anymore.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no. No-no-no, don’t do that! How could I live with myself if I
knew I was depriving the world of your music.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, okay.
[Scene: Central Perk, Rachel and Monica are sitting on the couch and Phoebe is getting
coffee as Chandler enters. Ross is also there.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Chandler! Saw the new furniture. Very nice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! Joey has the best boyfriend ever!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I kissed Kathy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Does Joey know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. Is there anyway, anyway you think he’ll
understand this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You obviously haven’t screwed over a lot of your friends. (They all
look at her) Which we all appreciate.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No the-the sad thing is, if you had told him how you felt before you
kissed her, knowing Joey, he probably just would’ve just stepped aside.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, don’t say that! Don’t say that. That’s not true. Is
it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think maybe, yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He loves you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then why didn’t you tell me to do that?!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I said-I said something to Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! No, that’s right. And I thought it was a really good idea.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I remember that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I remember you did.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: God!! (Sits down in disgust.) What am I gonna do?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Chandler, you’re gonna have to tell him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?! Why do I have to tell him?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because you do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, would it be okay if I wrote a song about this.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is watching TV as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Samboucha Margarita?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is that a real thing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, we only had samboucha, so it is now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen ah, Joe, I-I need to, I need to talk to you about something.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s-it’s about Kathy. Umm, uh, I like her. I like her a lot
actually.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, you’re timing couldn’t be better. She’s not my
girlfriend anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, she broke up with me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh uh, when?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just now, after acting class. At first I thought she was doing some kind
of scene, that’s why I let people watch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh man, I am so sorry. Are, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I’ve been better. But, I’m all right. So you like her huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but I-I uh, don’t have too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no, no it’s uh, it’s okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. You know why? ‘Cause you came to me first.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I thought that would be the best thing to do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But hey, listen just so you know, you might have you’re work cut out
for you. ‘Cause when I talked to her, I kinda got the feeling that she’s into
some other guy. So…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See uh, that’s-that’s actually what I wanted to talk to you
about. I-I think I know who the other guy is.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s me. I’m the other guy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I mean when you were late last night, Kathy and I got to
talking, and one thing to another and…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And what?! Did you sleep with her?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No! No! I just kissed her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!! That’s even worse!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How is that worse?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know! But it’s the same!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I’m sorry! But there’s nothing I can do, I think
I’m in love with her!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who cares?! You went behind my back! I would never do that to you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re right, I have no excuses! I was totally over the line.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Over the line?! You-you’re-you’re so far past the line, that
you-you can’t even see the line! The line is a dot to you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes. Yes! Right! And I feel horrible. You have to believe me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is that why you bought all this stuff?! (Chandler makes a face like
"Well, kinda.") Well, y’know what I will not watch your TV, I will not
listen to your stereo, and there’s a cinnamon raisin loaf in the new bread maker that
I’m not gonna eat! You know why?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Probably because…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because it’s all tainted with your betrayal. From now on this
apartment is empty for me! And I’m not happy about you either. (The bread maker
dings) Oh, and just so you know, I made that bread for you. (Joey walks into his bedroom
and slams the door.)

title: The One Where Chandler in a Box

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is sitting at the counter reading a magazine as the
phone rings.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (answering phone) Hello.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on phone) Hey, it’s me. I know you can’t stand to be in the
same room as me, so I just thought I’d try and apologize over the phone. All I…
(Joey hangs up the phone in disgust.)
(Pause)
(The phone rings again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (answering phone) Hello.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look I never should have kissed your girlfriend, but I’m…
(Joey hangs up the phone again.)
(Pause)
(The phone rings yet again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (answering phone) Stop callin’!!

lines.speaker: Voice
lines.text: (on phone) Hey! Hey! Hey! This is 92.3, WXRK, K-Rock for our $1,000 daily
challenge.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Voice
lines.text: What is the name of your roommate who is very, very sorry and would do
anything… (Joey realizes it’s Chandler and hangs up the phone in anger.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, everyone but Joey and Chandler are there getting ready for
Thanksgiving.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Aww, turkey! Aww, giving thanks! Aww!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look everyone, it’s the spirit of Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So are things with you and Joey any better?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They couldn’t be worse. I spent eight hours calling him last
night, just trying to get him to talk to me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow, eight hours? So you could probably really use one of those
plug-in telephone headsets huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Should we all expect Christmas gifts that can be stolen
from your office?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You shouldn’t.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Speaking of Christmas, umm since Monica and I are starting a new
business and have like no money, umm, this year maybe we could do secret Santa, and then
we each only buy one gift. And-and there’s the added mystery of who gets who.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who gets whom. (They all look at him.) I don’t know why I do that.
[Cut to later, the gang, minus Joey, is watching the Thanksgiving Day parade.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I’m gonna take a nap, turkey makes me sleepy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We haven’t eaten yet!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, but all that work you’re doing to get it ready, I
just… (goes into her bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, by any chance did either of pick uh Rachel for your secret Santa,
‘cause I wanna trade for her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I picked her! Oh thank God you want her! Ooh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! Why do you want to get rid of her so badly?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because she exchanges every gift she ever gets, it’s like
impossible to get her something she likes. Come on, let’s trade!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s not true! That’s not true! I got her that backpack
and she loved it! I remember how much she was crying the day when that big dog ran off
with it… (notices the look on Monica and Phoebe’s faces.) Oh, there was no big
dog. All right this sucks! I already got her this briefcase, and I had R.G. put on
it… (Phoebe looks confused.) Her initials…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, maybe you could give to somebody else. Ooh, like Ross Geller.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Op, y'know what though, it’s kind’ve a girlie briefcase.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who cares? He works in a museum!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, what time is it? The big game is about to start!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You don’t have to do that, Ross and Joey aren’t here, you can
watch the parade if you want.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is wrong with this freezer?! (She jabs her arm into the freezer and
a piece of ice flies into her eye.) Ow! Ow!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God, what happened?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, ice just got in my eye!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (standing in her doorway) People are trying to sleep in here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica got ice in her eye, and it hurts.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Open it up, let me see.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, y’know what, I can’t, it really kills.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well maybe you should put some ice on it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, God it looks bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, maybe we should take you to a doctor.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, my eye doctor is Richard! I can’t go to him when I don’t
have a boyfriend!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He’s really picky about his patients.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Honey, you’ve got to go. What’s his office number?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Like I remember his office number! (Pause) Speed dial 7.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (on phone) Hi! Yeah, I’m calling on behalf of Monica Geller’s
eye, and is um, is Richard Burke in today. (Listens) (to Monica) He’s out of town,
but does she want to see the on-call doctor?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! She’s very excited about that.
[Cut to later, Phoebe is adding butter to something and Ross is watching.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is so cool, ‘til Monica gets back, it’s like I’m
head chef and I get to make all the decisions. (She looks at the remaining butter, and
then decides to add it to the dish.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey-hey, I thought she told you to follow the recipe exactly!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, get out of my kitchen!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) All right! Okay! I think I am making some progress with
Joey, when I went into the apartment he went straight into his bedroom but he only slammed
the door once! (Ross is pleased.) I mean yeah, he gave me the finger while doing it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right I… I gotta call my mom and ask her a left handed cooking
question.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So listen ah, I picked Monica for secret Santa, but I’m already
getting her something for Chanukah, I was wondering if you wanna switch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh y’know what, I was already trying to trade for ah, well, you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?! Wow! That’s-that’s so nice, what are you gonna get me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know R.G., I was thinking something girlie for your
office.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well maybe Phoebe will switch with me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, you don’t want to do that, then you’re gonna
get stuck with Rachel and she exchanges every gift she ever gets.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, that’s not true! I’ve got her lots of stuff she never took
back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Like?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Like uh, that gold necklace I got her last year.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When was the last time you saw her wear it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, she wore it all Christmas day, and then uh…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Big dog?

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is repacking the furniture into boxes to return it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sending back all this stuff that Chandler bought out of guilt.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Everything? Even the TV?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! I’m putting that in my room.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, Joey, I know what he did was wrong but don’t you think you
could at least hear the guy out?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Back when you and Rachel were together, if Chandler had kissed her, would
you hear him out?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s a good point. So uh, how long are you gonna punish him?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Five years.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’ve sentenced him?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Don’t do the crime if you can’t do the time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, the guy’s your best friend.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, was my best friend. Anyway, I don’t know why
you’re pushing for him so hard. With him out of the way as my best friend,
there’s a spot open.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, who? Me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! I’m honored! And y’know what I’m gonna do as my first
act as your best friend?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m gonna get you to talk to Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. But if you weren’t my best friend.
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Kathy are sitting at a table and talking about
Joey.]

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Oh my God, is it really that bad?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I walk into a room and he won’t even talk to me, he just mumbles
something in Italian. And I know he only knows the bad words.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey Gunther, have you uh, have you seen Chandler?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I thought you were Chandler. But umm, one of who is over
there.
(Joey turns around and sees them kissing.)

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Something in Italian.) (Storms out.)

scenes.location: Dr. Burke’s office, Rachel and Monica are waiting as the doctor arrives.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: I’ll be right with you. Okay? (to the nurse) Thanks, Wendy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! How cute is the on-call doctor?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, so cute, that I’m thinking about jamming this pen in my eye.
(The intercom buzzes.)

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Dr. Burke will see you know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, not Dr. Burke. Dr. Burke is out of town. The-the on-call
doctor will see me now.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Dr. Richard Burke is out of town. Dr. Timothy Burke, his son, will see
you now.

lines.speaker: Dr. Timothy Burke
lines.text: Ready?
(Monica looks at Rachel, who gives her the thumbs up.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is packing as Chandler rushes in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! I’m sorry! That—(sees that Joey is about to leave)
where are you going?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: My folks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, uh, when-when are you coming back?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know. I might stay there for a few days while I look for an
apartment.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, y’know at first I thought we could talk about this y’know,
work it out, but uh, seeing you two together I don’t think I…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, look, what do you want me to say? Do you want me to say that
I’ll stop seeing her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, it’s not about her. Okay? But seeing you two together just
reminds me of what you did. And I don’t want to live with some one who doesn’t
know what it is to be a friend. So, I’ll see ya. (He starts to leave, but Chandler
grabs his bag and stops him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, look, I know what it is to be a friend, I just-I just screwed up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! You did! And that’s why I’m leaving.
(The chick and the duck walk into the living room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right look, if you’re not gonna stay for me, then at least
stay for them! Okay, they have had a very difficult year! What with the
robbery and all!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: When that guy was robbing us, and I was locked in the entertainment unit
for like six hours, you know what I was doing in there all that time? I was thinking about
how I let you down!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! But if would’ve know what kind of friend you were gonna turn
out to be, I wouldn’t have worried about it so much! See you around!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, wait! Come on! Just wait one second! There has to be
something that I can do! Something! If we still had that entertainment unit I would get in
it for six hours and think about how I let you down. (Joey looks intrigued) What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We’ve got a box. (Motions to a large wooden box next to him.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Dr. Burke’s office, Tim is examining Monica.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Last time I saw you, it was the morning I left for college. And you were
just standing outside The Dairy Queen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was probably waiting for it to open.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: I gotta tell you, you look great now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You look great too.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: You’re an excellent patient!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So how does it look?

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Well, you’ve got a little scratch on your cornea, your gonna have to
wear a patch for a couple of days.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Like a pirate?!

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: If that helps you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, so how long have you been working with your dad? (He looks at her)
Come on, one of us had to mention him.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: I moved back here a couple of months ago.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. Big family dinner tonight?

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Uh. (He holds up a brown lunch bag.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: I was gonna have Thanksgiving at my girlfriend’s.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (disappointed) Oh.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: But we broke up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (happy) Oh.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: She-she wasn’t ready for a serious commitment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sympathetic) Oh. (in a pirate’s voice) So you made her walk the
plank? Aye, matie?

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: You’re not wearing the patch yet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, It’s closer to dinner. Monica has just told everyone
that Tim is coming to dinner.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He’s coming here for Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, it’s sick.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why is it sick?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because it’s Richard’s son! It’s like inviting Greek
tragedy over for dinner!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, come on, Phoebe, you understand don’t you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I can see where I’d be your best shot but, no. I’m
sorry, but I think it’s twisted.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (coming out of the bathroom) What’s twisted?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Me going out with Richard’s son.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ewwwww!! Ew! Ew! Ew!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (He is now in the box, in their living room.) Sounds like a really bad
idea to me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is he okay in there?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He’s fine!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, y'know, Mon, if things wrong out between you and Richard’s son,
you’d be able to tell your kids, that you slept with their grandfather.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine! Judge all you want to but, (points to Ross) married a lesbian,
(points to Rachel) left a man at the altar, (points to Phoebe) fell in love with a gay ice
dancer, (points to Joey) threw a girl’s wooden leg in a fire, (points to Chandler)
livin’ in a box!! (goes to her room)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So now, what exactly is the point of the box?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The meaning of the box is three fold. One (holds a finger up through
the air hole), it gives me the time to think about what I did. Two (holds up another
finger), it proves how much I care about my friendship with Joey. And three (holds up a
third finger), it hurts!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) Oh hey! Hey uh, you remember the necklace I gave you last
year? Can I see it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (worried) Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just wanna check something.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (She goes into her bedroom)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (He puts his hand over the hole on the box.) (to Chandler) Now, we’ll
see.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Air hole! Air hole!! (Ross retracts his hand quickly.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (coming out of her bedroom with a necklace) Here it is! I love it. I
wear it all the time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (grabbing the necklace) The necklace I got you was gold, this one is
silver.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh, well maybe it uh, it changed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! You actually exchanged it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well isn’t it better that I exchanged it for something that I enjoy
and that I can get a lot of use out of?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What did you get?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Credit.
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (running in from her bedroom) I’ll get it! I’ll get it!
I’ll get it! I’ll get it! I’ll get it! I’ll get it! I’ll get it!
I’ll get it! I’ll get it! I’ll get it! I’ll get it! I’ll get it!
I’ll get it! I’ll get it! (opens the door) Hi, Tim.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Hi. (gives her a bottle of wine)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you. Come meet my friends. This is uh, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Hi, nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Hi, Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My brother, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And Rachel. (Chandler clears his voice loudly) And that’s Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How do ya do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, well, he’s…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He’s doin’ some thinkin’!
[cut to later, Joey, Rachel, Ross, and Tim are watching the football game, and they all
cheer loudly.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What happened? What happened?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You kissed my girlfriend!
(A commercial for sunglasses comes on.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I like those sunglasses.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Like ‘em, like ‘em? Or, I’d like to get store credit for
that amount like ‘em?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Swears in Italian, it’s the same term used by Joey earlier and
Joey nods his approval.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right everybody, this turkey is ready!

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Where can I wash up?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here, let me show you. Okay, the towels are hanging next to the sink,
and umm, you can use the fancy soap.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fancy soap? I thought we were savin’ that for the Pope!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See he’s nice. Right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but Monica, do you actually want to be in a relationship where you
can actually use the phrase, "That’s not how your dad used to do it."

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Wow! Everything looks great! Where should I sit?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I saved you a seat. (Motions to the one next to her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pouring the wine) Sick-sick-sick-sick.
(There’s a loud knocking.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I’ll get it. (goes over to the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Gotcha! (laughs)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That doesn’t sound like thinking to me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know I don’t think you should be talking at all in there! I
think you’ve got to much thinking to do to be talking and making jokes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, okay, you got it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, can you pass me the yams?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure! Oh, and Joey’s got the mashed potatoes if you want to exchange
them.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Would you stop?! What is the matter with you?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho, we’ve got company.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There’s nothing the matter with me. See, I’m not completely
devoid of sentiment, see I have feelings.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, fine. (She gets up and walks into her bedroom)
(an awkward silence follows)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can’t tell, but I’m trying to break the tension by
mooning you guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, look! If this is just a big joke to you, then forget about it,
all right?! This means something to me! And if it doesn’t mean anything to you, then
you should get out of there, otherwise you’re just an idiot in a box!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re right, and I’m sorry! This means a lot to me! I want
you to be my friend again! I swear, I won’t say another word tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So are you gonna start taking this thing seriously?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Absolutely!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That sounds like another word to me! Are you gonna take this seriously?
(There’s no response from Chandler.) Okay.
(Rachel comes back carrying a shoe box.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don’t say that I have no sentiment! (Starts to show Ross
what’s in the box.) This is a movie stub from our first date! This is an eggshell
from the first time you made me breakfast in bed! (Holds up a bone) This is from the
museum from the first time we… were together. Okay, maybe I exchange gifts sometimes,
but I keep the things that matter!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know what to say, I’m sorry. Though, you’re not
supposed to take these. (Points to the bone) It’s like a million years old, we, we
actually, we had people looking for that.
(Rachel glares at him.)
[Cut to the balcony with Monica and Tim.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (putting off her coat) Ooh, this always happens. (Her coat gets stuck.)

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Here, let me help. (Does so.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: You-you have a very beautiful… eye.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know all my friends think this is weird.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Y’know I-I thought it was gonna be weird, I mean I almost called and
canceled, but it really isn’t.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! I mean it’s like me and your dad, that’s a totally
separate thing.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Oh, I totally agree.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re just two people who find each other very attractive. Right?
(Tim leans in to kiss her. They stop, and when he tries to kiss her again, Monica pulls
away.)

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing. Nothing.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: No-no really, was-was that not okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no-no that was good, it was, that was uh, that was a goood kiss…

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Oh my God! It didn’t remind you of…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) Don’t say it!

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: No, but it did! Didn’t it?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Oh man!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!
(They both shiver in horror.)
[cut to later, Tim has left. Monica is still shivering. There’s a knock on the
door.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’ll get it. (It’s Kathy.)

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (sees it’s Joey) Oh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Hey. Listen, I want you to know how sorry I am…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s okay. Chandler’s the one I’m mad at.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Well, I’m still sorry. Is he here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: In the box.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: (going over to the box) Chandler?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, he-he can’t talk right now.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Why not? What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He’s just trying to show Joey how much he means to him.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: By being in a box?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, had reasons.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They were threefold.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Oh. Well uh, (to Chandler) you not being able to talk may make
this easier. Listen umm… (She looks at the gang who are watching, they take the hint
and leave them alone.) Listen I don’t wanna be someone who comes between two best
friends. I just, I can’t stand seeing what this is doing to you guys, and I
don’t wanna be the cause of that. So, I don’t think we can see each other
anymore. I’m gonna go to my mom’s in Chicago, I’m gonna stay there for
awhile. I think this could’ve be something really amazing, but y’know this is
probably for the best. Y’know? I’m gonna miss you. Good-bye, Chandler.
(She gets up and leaves, Chandler waves good-bye with one finger extended through the
air hole. Ross glares at Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (starting to cry) Open the box!! (Runs over to do so.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He can still catch her! Come on, get out of there! (He opens the box) Get
out of there!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, we’re gonna be fine! Get out!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you did some real good thinkin’ in there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Man, this is…
(Joey says something unintelligible and they hug.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now go! ‘Cause you can still catch her! And Merry Christmas from
you’re secret Santa! (Chandler runs out and closes the door.)
(After he’s gone.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, who got Chandler? ‘Cause I uh, need to trade.

title: The One Where They're Going to Party!

lines.text: [Scene: Outside Central Perk, Monica and Phoebe are showing everyone the van they
bought for the catering business. It’s an old Dodge van, that has a cartoon woman
riding on a dragon painted on the side of it.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on, no peeking! (They are leading the gang out with there hands
over their eyes.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Our eyes are closed and we’re about to cross the street. Very
good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okayyyyy, open up!
(They open their eyes and are stunned at the van.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What did you want to show us? Because all I can see is this bitchin'
van!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, it’s for our catering business!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think I know that girl.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, umm, we’re not gonna really keep it this way though.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, we’re gonna paint over the sword, and replace it with a
baguette.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And also, we don’t know what to do with this. (She turns on a
switch and the girl’s nipples light up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, I definitely know her.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the gang is all there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Remember that guy from cooking school I told you about that
put cilantro with everything?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh sure, Cilantro Larry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I’m gonna fill in for him as food critic for the Chelsea
Reporter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, Monica! What an amazing opportunity to influence… dozens of
people.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How could you say yes, what about our catering business?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, it’s only one night a week, and plus I get to take all
of you out for a lot of free dinners.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yay!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, in that case—(hops up and down in joy)—Yay! (Monica looks
confused) That was me hopping on board.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey, you guys! Hey, Ross, quick question for ya. Are you
ready to party?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know, I could maybe go out for a couple of beers, but
there’s this thing about bumblebees on The Discovery Channel that I was
planning to watch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no, I don’t think you heard me. Are you ready to party?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nooo!! Gandolf?! Gandolf is coming to town?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kathy’s with her parents, I have nothing to do, so tomorrow we
are partying with Gandolf dude!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude, we are sooo gonna party!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! Okay, dude alert! And who is this guy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mike "Gandolf" Ganderson, only like the funest guy in the world.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m gonna call and get off work tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m gonna call after you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is gonna be soo cool, dude, we never party anymore!

lines.speaker: Chandler and Ross
lines.text: Woooo!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, were you guys smoking something in the back of our van?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really. And what do you mean you never have fun anymore? You have fun with
me, remember that time we saw those strippers and you paid me 50 bucks to eat that book?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, you are gonna love this guy. Gandolf is like the party wizard!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, why do you call him Gandolf?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Gandolf the wizard. (Joey is still confused) Hello! Didn’t you read Lord
of the Rings in high school?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I had sex in high school.
[Scene: Rachel’s office, Rachel and Sophie are sitting at their desks working as
Joanna walks in.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, uh, Joanna I was wondering if I could ask you something.
There’s an opening for an assistant buyer in Junior Miss…

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: (interrupting) Okay, but that would actually be a big step down for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, actually, I meant for me. The hiring committee is meeting people
all day and…

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh. Well, I wish I could say no, but you can’t stay my assistant
forever. Neither can you Sophie, but for different reasons.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God, I am so glad you don’t have a problem with this, because if
you did, I wouldn’t even consider applying.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Really? Well, in that case…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting) And that’s I’m so glad… there’s no
problem.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: That’s fine, actually I’m on the hiring committee, so
there’ll be at least one friendly face.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! That’s great!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: You know, Junior Miss is where I started. Oh, I had to sleep with the ugliest
guy to get that job.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: No-ho-ho! (pause) Yeah. (pause) I mean, no-no-no-no-no, don’t you
worry, I’m sure with your qualifications you won’t need to sleep with some guy
to get that job. Although, I might need some convincing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I, umm…

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Kidding! God, I feel wild today!

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is getting ready to party.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh man! I am so excited—I may vomit!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Will you calm down, he’s just a human guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look you don’t understand, Gandolf is amazing. Y’know
you’re never know what’s gonna end up happening, you go out for a couple of
beers and end up on a fishing boat to Nova Scotia!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, it’s beautiful country up there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Okay! I got my passport, fresh socks, and a snake bite
kit!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s not gonna be exactly like last time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I’ll see you guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Ross
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa-wh-wh-whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I have an audition, but I’ll definitely hook up with you later. Where
are you gonna be around noon?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Somewhere maybe along the equator?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (leaves as the phone rings)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (answering it) Hello. (listens) (to Ross) It’s Gandolf!!! (on
phone) So, are you in town? (listens) (disappointed) Oh, well, well maybe next time then.
(Hangs up)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He’s not gonna make it, he’s stuck in Chicago.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, man! Chicago, is sooo lucky!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stupid, useless Canadian money!
[Scene: Bloomingdale’s, Rachel is meeting with Mr. Posner, Mrs. Lynch,
and Joanna the hiring committee.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Posner
lines.text: You have a very impressive resume, Ms. Green. I especially like what
I see here about implementing a new filing system.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Filing system? Oh-oh! You mean those-those little colored labels you put
on all the folders? (to the committee) It certainly did brighten up the inside of the
filing cabinets.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, they uh, they-they do more than that.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Lynch
lines.text: I notice that you’ve been trusted with a lot of rather
important responsibilities.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, Joanna really has been an incredible mentor to me.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh. And Rachel has been really incredible in getting my morning bagel
for me. It’s amazing how she gets it right almost every time!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I-I-I of course, I have more responsibilities than that.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh yes, well there’s the coffee too. (to the committee) Rachel can
carry two things at once!

lines.speaker: Mr. Posner
lines.text: Yes, that’s very good. Now a uh, big part of this job is
cultivating personal relationships, especially with designers.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, I realize that…

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: (interrupting) And Rachel shouldn’t have any problem with that. The
only problem might be getting a little too friendly, if you know what I mean.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I love working with designers!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: With them, under them, what’s the difference? Eh, Rach?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is there as Monica enters carrying a huge stack of
newspapers.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! My first review is out!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! Oh, the Chelsea Reporter, ohh, this used to keep me so warm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, look at my on the back page.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay! (reading) "Would I go back to Allesandro’s? Sure,
but I’d have to order two meals, one for me and one for the guy pointing the gun to
my head." (to Monica) Wow! You really laid into this place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, they don’t pay me a penny a word to make friends.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
