lines.text: Ooh, I gotta go. I found a guy that who could fix up the van for
catering.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! Do you need me to go with you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no, it’s okay. But are we sure we don’t want the waterbed?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Haven’t we made this decision?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, all right. (starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bye!
(The intercom buzzes.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (answering it) Who is it?

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: It’s Allesandro, from Allesandro’s.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: I want to talk to you about your review.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, oh my God. (on intercom) Call me on the phone!

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: Why? So you could hang up on me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, I-I’m never gonna let you up so you may as well just go away.

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: Just give me a chance too…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (on intercom) Hey, do you need to get in? Here you go.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, Monica!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: (entering) I want a retraction! Our food is not
inedible swill!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I couldn’t eat it! I had five friends who couldn’t eat it, and
one of them eats books.

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: Well our service is not grossly incompetent.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The waiter carried the breadsticks in his pants!

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: Well, you said that we except the Discover Card, which we
do not!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, that I’ll retract. But I stand by my review, I know food
and that wasn’t it. You’re marinara sauce tasted like tomato juice! You should
serve it with vodka and a piece of celery.

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: Hey! I’m proud of that sauce, it’s delicious.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! You own an Italian restaurant and you think that tastes
good?! Where are you even from?

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: (shyly) Lebanon.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hand me those tomatoes, I’m gonna show you what it should taste
like! Come on, hand me them.

lines.speaker: Allesandro
lines.text: How long is this gonna take? ‘Cause I got another critic to go
yell at.

scenes.location: Rachel’s office, Rachel is confronting Joanna about her interview.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering Joanna’s office) Umm, Joanna? I wanna talk about that
interview.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: I thought it went very well.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! It didn’t! That’s what I want to talk to you about.
(starts to break up) Now, just to brief you… (starts to cry) I may cry, but they are
not tears of sadness or of anger, but just of me having this discussion with you.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Rachel, please, don’t make a scene.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: There’s nobody here!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Sophie, get in here! (Sophie enters) You see! Now you’re making
Sophie uncomfortable!

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: She’s not making me uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Congratulations! You now just crossed the line into completely useless.
Get out. (Sophie starts to cry and leaves)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you want me to quit?

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: What?! What would make you think that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well of those things that you said in the interview, I mean if you
believe any of them, I must not be a very good assistant. Y’know what? I
am just gonna pack up my desk, (She goes over to get all of her belongings from the desk,
which amount to a muffin and a pen) and I will be gone by the end of the day! (Realizes
she has nothing.) Well, I guess there’s no use to me sticking around ‘til the
end of the day! (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Wait-wait-wait-wait! You can put your sad little muffin back in
it’s drawer. If you must know the truth, I didn’t want to lose a perfectly good
assistant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: That’s why I said all those things about your flirting and your
drinking…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My drinking?

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Oh, I must’ve said that after you left.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Said what? Exactly.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: That you enjoyed the occasional drink…ing binge.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!! Ohh, that is it! I’m leaving! You are just a horrible
person!

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Wait-wait-wait-wait-wait-wait-wait-wait!! If you’re gonna get all
sensitive about it! I don’t want to lose you. What if I, create a position for you?
I’ll make you an assistant buyer in this department.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Say more things like that.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: You can have your own office, and a raise! Effective tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’d need an expense account.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Done!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And an assistant.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Sophie, get in here! (Sophie peeks in around the corner)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Ross and Chandler are watching TV as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! What are you guys doing here? I thought you’d be out partying
with Gandel-worf.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s Gandolf, and he’s not coming.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you’ve been sittin’ around here all mornin’?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! I balanced my checkbook.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, and I-I gave first names to all of the foosball players.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t believe he didn’t come!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what if he didn’t come! We can still go out and party ourselves!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-no, y’know with Gandolf we’d be out all
night!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! We’d meet, we’d meet total strangers, and hang out with
them!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, we could do that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There’s other stuff too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We’ll do it all, and better! Look, after tonight, Gandolf will want
to party with us, dude! Come on!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s not like we don’t know how to party!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! All right? Let’s go!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And may-maybe we could end up on a boat again?

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: Yeah!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Chandler) Hey-hey-hey, when uh, when were we on a boat?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Remember that really cold morning, you woke up and those dogs were
licking your face?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, those were seals, man.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is entering, excited.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Mon, little question for ya! How do you think this suit will look on
an assistant buyer?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, the owner of Allesandro’s came over to yell at me, but
instead I made him some sauce, and he offered me the job as head chef!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!! You just ruined the thing I was practicing the whole way
home, but I’m soo happy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can you believe it? I finally get to run my own kitchen!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, you’ve waited soo long.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs, quick question for ya.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How do you think this suit would look on an assistant buyer at Bloomingdale’s?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know, it would totally depend on her coloring and…
(realizes) You got the job!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You got the job?! Why didn’t you tell me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, it’s gonna be so great! I’m gonna get to help decide what
we sell, I’m gonna have an office with walls and everything. (turns to Monica)
I’m gonna have walls!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, is this the day of good news or what? I got us a job! The wedding
reception.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh! Umm, Phoebe, I kinda need to talk to you about that. (Rachel
excuses herself) Umm, well I-I-I think it might be time for me to take a step back from
catering.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But we’ve only had one job.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, but now we have this second one and it just, it feels like
it’s snowballing, y’know?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! What are you saying?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I got offered the head chef job at Allesandro’s.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s okay, ‘cause y'know what? You don’t really need me
for the business.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re the cook! With out you it’s just me driving up to
people’s houses with empty trays and asking for money!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. But umm, I-I-I’ll pay you back all the money you
invested, and you can keep the van.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: For what? I can’t believe this! I gotta get out of here. (leaves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, wait a minute! (runs after her, leaving Rachel alone)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m an assistant buyer!!
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey, Ross, and Chandler are making a pit stop on their party
tour.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, so we’ll get a little coffee, and get energized, and
we’ll head back out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, all right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, we’re having fun, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler and Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We don’t need that wizard guy. We hit a couple of clubs, talked to
some strangers, and uh, after this, we’ll head down to the docks and see about that
boat thing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m kinda beat.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually, me too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you serious?!

lines.speaker: Chandler and Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank God! I’m exhausted!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: So you guys want coffees?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but uh, I don’t want to be up too late, so uh, I’ll have a
decaf.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, me too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually, can I get some hot water with a little lemon? I think I
strained my voice screaming in there. Does it have to be so loud?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can’t hear a word you’re saying, my ears are ringing so bad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m just glad I brought that extra pair of socks, y’know? I used
them as mittens, I didn’t want to touch a thing in that last place.
(pause)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How sad are we?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what? We’re not sad, we’re not sad, we’re
just not 21 anymore. Y’know? I’m 29 years old, damnit! And I want to sit in a
comfortable chair, and watch television and go to bed at a reasonable hour!

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! And I like to hang out in a quiet place where I can talk to my
friends.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And so what if I like to go home, throw on some Kenny G, and take a bath!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We’re 29, we’re not women.

scenes.location: Central Perk, the next day, Phoebe is there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Ohh, here you are. Y’know, I’m-I’m glad you
decided to hear me out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I’m hearing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’ve been doing a lot of thinking. A lot! And umm, well, I came up
with a whole bunch of businesses you can do with your van. Okay umm, you could be flower
delivery person.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Or! A bakery delivery person.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I wa-I wa-I wa…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pizza?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I’ve got a whole bunch of uh-uh, stuff in this area, but
umm, I’m getting the feeling that you don’t want to deliver.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. I’m guessing that if you don’t want to deliver, you
probably don’t want to pick stuff up either.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what, let’s do the catering business.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?! Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, y'know I-I made a commitment to you. Y’know what, it’d
be, it’d be fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! It will be fun! Ohh! Yay! Oh! Okay, ooh, let’s
plan the wedding reception. (She grabs the notebook which Monica used for her ideas and
starts flipping page after page after page after page after page to find a blank one.)
Wow! You really wanted me to do something with this van. (pause)
Y’know what, I want you to take the chef job.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. That’s what you really want. Yeah, I don’t want to be
the reason you’re unhappy, that would just make me unhappy, and I really
don’t want to be the reason I’m unhappy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Besides, it might be kinda fun to form the new A-Team.
[Scene: Rachel’s office, she is coming in for the day carrying a picture for her
new office. Mrs. Lynch is coming out of Joanna’s office, carrying a box.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi Mrs. Lynch! Is Joanna in already?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Lynch
lines.text: Oh my goodness! You haven’t heard!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Heard what?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Lynch
lines.text: Joanna passed away last night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! How?!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Lynch
lines.text: Well, she was leaving work and she was hit by a cab.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh, I cannot believe it!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Lynch
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, God. Oh, God. (gets worried) Oh God.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Lynch
lines.text: I didn’t realize that she was so close.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, so close. Mrs. Lynch, I know that this is an
emotional and difficult time, for all of us. But by any chance did Joanna send any
paperwork your way before… it happened.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Lynch
lines.text: No. Nothing. Imagine, if she had just stepped off that curb a few
seconds later.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes-yes, just a few seconds and she’d still be with us—nothing
about an assistant buyer?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Lynch
lines.text: (starting to cry) No, I’m sorry. I have to go. (She leaves as
Sophie arrives.)

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: (happily) Good morning!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Sophie, I guess you didn’t hear about Joanna…

lines.speaker: Sophie
lines.text: I sure did! (smiles)

title: The One with the Girl from Poughkeepsie

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey, Chandler, and Phoebe are there as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!
Chandler, Joey, and Phoebe: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry I’m late, did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey stuffing 15 Oreos in his mouth. (Joey, with an obvious
mouth full, nods yes.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 15? (Joey nods again) Your personal best! (Ross takes an Oreo and
Joey mumbles, no!)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where were you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, on a date. Yeah, I met this girl on the train going to a museum
upstate.
(simultaneously)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah! How did you meet her?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, which museum?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (just Phoebe) No, answer his.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, it was just me and her at the back of the train, and I sat near the
door, so she’d have to pass by me if she wanted to switch cars. She was totally at my
mercy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Were you so late because you were burring this woman?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I’m getting back down ‘cause she lives in Poughkeepsie. She
seems really great, but she’s like totally great, but she lives two and a half hours
away.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How can she be great if she’s from Poughkeepsie? (laughs, at they
all look at him) That joke would’ve killed in Albany.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Done! I did it! Heh, who’s stupid now? (He smiles and has cookie
remains all over his teeth.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Joey, Rachel, and Phoebe are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, look at this! (Holding a newspaper) They’re lighting the big
Christmas tree tonight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, that paper’s two weeks old.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, who keeps leaving old newspapers in the trash?! I really
wanted to take Kathy to this, I can’t believe I missed it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, y’know, at least you have somebody to miss that stuff with! I hate
being alone this time of year! Next thing you know it’ll be Valentine’s Day,
then my birthday, then bang!—before you know it, they’re lighting that damn tree
again. Ohh, I want somebody! (hearing this, Gunther moves in)
Y’know, I want a man!! (Gunther leaves depressed) I mean, it
doesn’t even have to be a big relationship, y’know, just like a fling would be
great.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?! I didn’t think girls ever just wanted a fling.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, believe me, it’s been a long time since I’ve been flung.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I know what I’m giving you for Christmas.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what? There’s some nice guys at my office, do you
want me to set you up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Wait a minute, it’s been a long time that I’ve been
single. How come you never offered this before?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I have a girlfriend, I’m-I’m happy. So, I no longer
feel the need to go out of my way to stop others from being happy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! No accountants. Oh, and no one from like legal. I don’t like
guys with boring jobs.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh and Ross was like what? A lion tamer?
(Monica enters)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s wrong Mon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, everybody at the restaurant still hates me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I thought I was making headway, everyone was smiling at me all day, I
get off work and I find out that they wrote this (puts on her chef hat) on my chef’s
hat. (The hat says ‘Quit, bitch’)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, maybe they meant to write, ‘Quiet, bitch.’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, honey! What’s the matter? (Monica shows her, her hat.) Fine, I
was just trying to be nice! Whoa!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean I have not been picked on this much since kindergarten and they
had to bring in someone from junior high to do the see-saw with me. (Joey laughs and
Monica glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohhh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean they’re trying to do everything they can to make me quit,
and if there were any other job, I would. But this is something I’ve been waiting for
my whole life.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, wait a minute, you’re the boss! Why don’t you just yell
at them? Or, fire them?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I would love too, but I can’t! I mean I just can’t, you know
that I’m not good at confrontation.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you know what you can do? I remember reading about this director,
I think it was Orson Wells, who at the beginning of the movie would hire somebody, just so
he could fire them in front of everybody. Then they would all know, who’s boss.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Mon! I’m not doing anything, why don’t you fire me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s a good idea! Wait, do you know how to waiter?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good enough to get fired.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, you’re hired!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! That must be why I got fired last week! Does this Orson Wells guy
direct Burger King commercials?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (he glares at him for a while) Yes.

scenes.location: Chandler’s office, he is trying to find Rachel a date.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I say, Drew! Are you seeing anybody right now? (Drew looks at him)
Og-ee-op, I’m not asking for me, I’m… I mean… No, I’m-I’m
not gay, I’m not asking you out. I’m not-I’m not-I’m not gay!

lines.speaker: Drew
lines.text: I didn’t think you were gay. I do now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See my friend-my friend, Rachel, she wants to be set up.

lines.speaker: Drew
lines.text: Ahh, I just got out of a big relationship, I’m not looking for any
thing serious.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, y’know what, that might be okay even if it was just kind of a
fling, that might be all right with Rachel.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa! Is this, hot Rachel, that you took to the Christmas
party, Rachel?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Drew) Oh, by the way, that is her full name.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh wow! I’m free for her!

lines.speaker: Drew
lines.text: Oh, wait a second! I didn’t say I wasn’t free!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey, Chandler, why don’t we talk this over at the Ranger game
tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Drew
lines.text: Hold on, y’know I just got a box of Cubans, maybe I
bring them by your office around uh, five?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh well, that’s uh, a little later than I uh, generally care to
stay, but sure!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Maybe, before the game we could enjoy some eight year old some small batch
Basel Hadens.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I don’t really know what that is, but let’s!!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is working on a new song.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! You guys, I’m writing a holiday song for everyone. Do you want
to hear it?
Monica, Rachel, and Joey: Yes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Happy Chanukah, Monica! May your Christmas be snowy, Joey!
Happy New Year, Chandler and Ross. Spin the draddle, Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, that’s great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But y’know umm, Rachel doesn’t rhyme with draddle.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know but it’s so hard! Nothing rhymes with your stupid name!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you talking about? Lots of things rhyme with Rachel. Bagel. Mail.
Jail. Bail. Able. May-pole.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All good, thanks. (to Rachel) Do you maybe have a nickname have like a
nickname that’s easier to rhyme?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Didn’t your dad used to call you Pumpkin?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Pumpkin? Yeah. But did he ever call you like, Budolph?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hello, children!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Rachel) Have I got the 50 guys for you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, I just showed this a picture of you and guys were throwing
themselves at me! They’re buying me drinks! They’re giving me stuff! (to Joey)
Knicks tonight?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure! Where are the seats?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wherever! I’ve got like 20!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, will I like any of these guys?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what, I’m gonna uh, play the field just a little
more.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Guys are signing over their 401-K’s to me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (shocked) You work with robots!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pause) Yes. (to Rachel) Okay, there’s this one guy, Patrick, I
think you’re gonna like him, he’s really nice, he’s funny, he’s a
swimmer.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, I like swimmer’s bodies!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, and his father invented that magnetic strip on the back of credit
cards.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Op, I like credit cards!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See, I’m not bad at this fixing up thing, huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, so what does he do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, he works in the Fine Foods division.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Your company has a fine foods division?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s a big company, I don’t—if you—I…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now, wait a second! You make food and robots?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No, the robots just work for them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (getting up) All right, I’m gonna go to work. Does anybody have a
problem with that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, lady, I do! I got a problem with that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You want a problem? I’ll give you a problem!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, what are you gonna do? You’re gonna fire me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You bet your ass, I’m gonna fire you! Thank you.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross, Phoebe, and Chandler are there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, wow! I should get going. I-I got a date tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah! With who?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know that girl I told you about who lives up in Poughkeepsie?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not her. Yeah, this is someone else I meet, and I-I can’t decide
between the two of them. Y’know the one from Poughkeepsie, even though she’s a
two hour train ride away, is really pretty, really smart, and-and a lot of fun. But this
other girl, well, she lives right uptown. Y’know she’s, well
she’s-she’s just as pretty, I guess she’s smart, she’s not
fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If she’s no fun, why do you want to date her at all?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I-I want to give her another chance, y’know? She lives so
close. And, at the end of the date, the other time, she-she said something that
was—if she was kidding was very funny. On the other hand, if she wasn’t kidding,
she’s not fun, she’s stupid, and kind of a racist.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, man!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Ooh, how was your first day working at the restaurant?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (checks his watch) Damn! (runs out to work)

scenes.location: Allesandro’s, Monica is cooking.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering from the dining room) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what happened to your fancy chef’s jacket? (sees there’s a
burn spot on it)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They baked it. I can’t take this anymore. I’m gonna call a
meeting tonight, I’m gonna fire you tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got it! Oh-oh! (He starts patting the burned spot, which just happens
to be over her breast.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s still a tiny bit on fire there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks. (Joey’s still patting the burn spot) I think you got it!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler is there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Chandler!! You have the best taste in men!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, like father, like son.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Patrick and I had such a great time last night! I mean I think this
could maybe turn into something serious.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?! I-I thought you weren’t looking for something serious? I
thought you were looking for some kind of a fling.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y'know, possibly. (pause) You didn’t tell him that, though?
Right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ummmmmmmm, no.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You told this guy that I was looking for a fling?! You don’t tell
the guy that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?! I’d be thrilled if I heard that some hot girl was just
looking to get—oh I see.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, between you telling him that I wanted to have a fling and me putting
out on the first date—oh, he’s so gonna get the wrong idea.

scenes.location: Allesandro’s, Joey is eating some cheese.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Joey, could you pass the cheese?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Listen uh, I’d prefer it if you didn’t call me Joey. Since
I don’t know anyone here, I thought it’d be cool to try out a cool work
nickname.

lines.speaker: A Waiter
lines.text: (entering) Hey, dragon! Here’s your tips from Monday and Tuesday.
(hands him two envelopes)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (opening an envelope) There’s like-there’s like 300 bucks in
this one!

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Yeah, people get pretty generous around the holidays. And it never
hurts to wear tight trousers.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Could the waiters gather around to hear tonight’s specials?
Okay, first there is a Chilean Sea Bass prepared with a Mango relish on a bag—Why is
nobody writing these down?

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Because we can remember them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because your all gonna make up fake specials and make me cook them like
you did the other night?

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Well, sure, that too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, forget the specials for a minute. Umm, all right here’s the
thing, for the last two weeks I have umm, (quietly) tried really hard to create a positive
atmosphere…

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Can’t hear you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (louder) A positive atmosphere! But I-I-I have had it up to here. (She
holds her hand over her head as an afterthought.) From now on, it is gonna be my
way, or the highway! All right? Does anybody have a problem with that?!! (Joey looks at
the money he’s holding, and doesn’t speak up.) Hey new guy! I said, does anybody
have a problem with that?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No ma’am.

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Hey! He has a name, it’s Dragon. Do you wanna know your name?
Check your hat. (to another waiter) We did the hat right? (The other waiter nods yes.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Allesandro’s, continued from earlier. The other waiters are gone and
Monica is confronting Joey about his not speaking up.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What the hell happened?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I am so-so-so sorry. I was gonna do it! Really! But I was standing there
with 327 dollars in one hand and 238 dollars in the other hand, and I was thinking,
"Wow! It’s been a long time since I had… (tries to do the math in his head,
but can’t) 327 + 238 dollars!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, we had a deal. That-that’s why you’re here! I’ve
got to fire you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And I gotta pay rent! Look, how-how about this? You don’t fire me,
instead I stay here, I gain their trust, and they’ll start listening to all the nice
things I’ve been saying about you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What kinda things have you been saying?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well nothing yet, they really hate you and I want to fit in.
[Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe is working on her holiday song, Chandler is sitting on the
couch reading a magazine, and Ross is sleeping on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Happy, happy Chanukah, Chandler and Monica. Very merry…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting) Oh, y’know, y’know what Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not Jewish, so…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So! Ross doesn’t really decorate his tree with
floss, but you don’t hear him complaining do you? God! (Phoebe hits her guitar which
wakes up Ross with a start.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bad dream?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I wasn’t sleeping.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, then uh, what was Phoebe’s song about?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The one with the cat. I gotta go, I’ve got another date.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, did you pick one yet?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it turns out that the one from uptown was making a joke. But it was a
different joke than I thought—it wasn’t that funny. So I’m still torn.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well look, you don’t really like the one from uptown and
you’re too exhausted from dating the one up in Poughkeepsie, so I say you just end
them both. Okay? You take a train up to Poughkeepsie and break up with her, and on your
way back you break up with uptown. And then by the time you get home tonight, you’re
done!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know, you’re right. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, well I had a similar problem when I lived in Prague.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Prague?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There’s sooo much you don’t know.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is playing living room golf as Rachel enters.
Rachel sees this and holds the door open until Chandler is ready to start his swing, when
he is, she slams the door shut which causes the club to fly from his hands. He turns
around, shocked.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler! Patrick just uh, ended things with me. Did you or did you not
tell him that I was looking for a serious relationship?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I did! I absolutely did!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You idiot!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sure you’re right, but why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don’t tell a guy that you’re looking for a serious
relationship! You don’t tell the guy that! Now you scared him away!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, man. I’m sorry, I’m so-so sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know, you should never be allowed to talk to
people!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know! I know!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! See just I’m right back where I started! Aww, this sucks! Being
alone, sucks! (She sits down heavily in one of the new chairs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, y’know, you’re-you’re gonna meet somebody!
You’re a great catch! Y’know when I was telling all those guys about you, I
didn’t have to lie once. (He sits down on the arm of her chair)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! You graduated Magma Ku Laude, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it doesn’t matter. (Kisses her on the top of her head.) Hey,
y’know what, I’ve got two tickets to tonight’s Rangers game, you wanna come
with me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Cute guys in little shorts? Sure.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, actually it’s a hockey team, so it’s angry Canadians
with no teeth.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well that sounds fun too. (They hug.)
(pause)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Have you ever been with a woman?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! Chandler, what is the matter with you?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So there is no good time to ask that question.

scenes.location: A train to Poughkeepsie, Ross is asleep against the window.

lines.speaker: The Conductor
lines.text: The next station is Poughkeepsie. Poughkeepsie!

lines.speaker: The Woman From Poughkeepsie
lines.text: (outside Ross’s window) Ross? Ross!
(she knocks on the window) Wake up! Ross! (the train starts moving) Ross! Ross!! Ross!!!
Ross!!!!

scenes.location: Allesandro’s, Monica is cooking.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I need more swordfish. (to one of the assistant chefs) Can you get me
some more swordfish?

lines.speaker: Kitchen Worker
lines.text: I don’t speak English.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You did a minute ago!

lines.speaker: Kitchen Worker
lines.text: Well, I don’t know what to tell ya!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine!
(She goes into the freezer to get it herself, and leaves the door open. The waiter from
earlier comes by and closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! Very funny! Somebody let me out please?! Come on, I’m cold!
(She spills something.) And covered in marinara sauce! Come on! Let me out! (the door
opens)

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: You found that handle, did ya?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s not funny.

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Well that’s not true.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (starting to cry) I’m a good person. And I’m a good chef, and
I don’t deserve to have marinara sauce all over me! Y’know what, if you want me
to quit this bad, then all you have to do is…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (interrupting) Hey! Chef Geller! Y’know that little speech you made
the other day? Well I got a problem with it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You bet I do! I just ah, wasn’t listening then, that’s all.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well if you want a problem? I’ll give you a problem!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you gonna do? You’re gonna fire me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You bet your ass I’m gonna fire you! Get out of my kitchen! Get
out!! (Joey leaves) All right! Anybody else got a problem? How ‘bout you Chuckles?
You think this is funny now?

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How about if I dance around all covered in sauce? Huh?
You think it’s funny now?

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: No, it’s really good.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good! Now, take those salads to table 4, (to the kitchen worker from
earlier) And you! Get the swordfish! (to another assistant chef) And you! Get a haircut!

scenes.location: The train, it’s pulling into a station.

lines.speaker: The Conductor
lines.text: Last stop, Montreal. This stop is Montreal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (waking up) What? (notices that there is now a beautiful woman sitting
next to him)

lines.speaker: Woman On Train
lines.text: I made a bet with myself that you have beautiful eyes. Now that
I see them, I win.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Woman On Train
lines.text: We’re at my stop. But would you like to have coffee?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (now fully awake) Are we really in Montreal?!

lines.speaker: Woman On Train
lines.text: Yes we are. So, coffee?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Coffee sounds great. (They get up) Wait, so, so you live in Montreal?

lines.speaker: Woman On Train
lines.text: Oh, no. But it’s just a two hour ferry ride to Nova Scotia.

scenes.location: Allesandro’s, Joey is coming back in with his coat on.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well I guess I should’ve thought about my wife and kids before I
talked back to chef Geller!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yep! Looks like it’s gonna be a leeeeean Christmas at the Dragon
house this year.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Enough!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (leaving) Lean-lean-lean!

title: The One with Phoebe's Uterus

scenes.location: Central Perk, Frank and Alice are there talking with Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! I can’t believe my little brother is married!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh I know!! (Both he and Alice squeal hysterically)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys, why didn’t you tell me you were eloping?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: ‘Cause it just sorta happened, y’know we were at the
courthouse, we were having lunch…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, wait, why were you at the courthouse?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: We were having lunch. Yeah and then all of the sudden we were like,
"Hey! Y'know, we’re here, having lunch let’s get married!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, a year and a half ago I didn’t even know I had a brother, and
now I have a sister too. (They all hug, and Frank and Alice start kissing.) Okay. Okay.
Stop it, don’t. So, I gotta get you a gift now. Is there anything you need?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Uhh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: We’ve been trying to get pregnant, uh pretty much ever since we got
engaged, we thought we’d get a jump on things, y’know no one’s getting any
younger.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: See the thing is umm, we’re not able to y’know, uh, conceive.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: And we’ve tried everything, we’ve seen a bunch of doctors.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah, and they-and they say that our-that our only chance to have a baby
is that if they take my sperm, her egg and put it together in a dish and then put it into
another girl. So we were wondering if you could be the girl that we could put it into.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (shocked) That’s a really nice gift. I was thinking of like a gravy
boat.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica, Rachel, and Chandler are trying to throw cards
into a vase.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering with Ross) Hey! You guys! Check it out, check it out! (He’s
wearing a blue blazer) Guess which job I got.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know, but Donald Trump wants his blue blazer black.
(The gang is stunned.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Blue blazer back. He-he wants it back.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But you-you said black. Why would he want his blue blazer black?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you-you know what I meant.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, you messed it up. You’re stupid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So what job did you get Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, ah, tour guide at the museum. Yeah, Ross got it for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, how can you be a tour guide, don’t you have to be a dinosaur
expert or something?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, not really. They give you all the information, it’s uh, it’s
like memorizing a script. (Making like a tour guide) "And on your left, you have
Tyrannosaurus Rex, a carnivore from the Jurassic period.
Chandler, Monica, and Rachel: Great!! That’s great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh actually Joey, it’s the Cretasous period.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah but, I can pronounce Jurassic.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Guess what. Frank Jr., and Alice got married!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And! And, they’re gonna have a baby! (The gang is shocked.) And!
And, they want me to grow it for them in my uterus. (The gang is stunned into silence.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re really thinking about having sex with your brother?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ewww! And "Oh no!" It’s—they just want me to be the
surrogate. It’s her-it’s her egg and her sperm, and I’m-I’m just the
oven, it’s totally their bun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What did you tell them?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, they said that I had to think about it first, but what is there to
think about? I’m gonna be giving them the greatest gift you can possibly give.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re gonna be carrying their baby and give them a Sony Play
Station?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, this really is an incredible thing to do for them, but there are
things to think about.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, like you’re gonna be pregnant. I mean pregnant.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, you’re talking about putting your body through an awful lot,
I mean morning sickness, uhh, labour, and it’s all for somebody else!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, what’s your point?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, the stuff I just mentioned.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! I don’t know if I could ever do that. I always figured the
first time I had a baby was with somebody I love and that baby would be a…keeper.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know you guys were a lot more supportive when I wanted to make denim
furniture.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, Pheebs, listen, if you decide to do this, we’ll be supportive
like crazy.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We just want you to think it through.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, honey, maybe you can talk to somebody who’s had a baby. Like
your mom?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My mom never gave birth. Oh! But my birth mom did.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler and Kathy are kissing.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Umm, (moves her hand’s down to his butt) I love this touchy. Can I
take it to work with me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah, sure, it’s not mine anyway. It can with the pants.

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Oh! (They kiss and she leaves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am so jealous.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys are really right…there aren’t you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes. Right where?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: In the beginning where y’know it’s all sex and talking and sex
and talking and…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, you-you gotta love the talking.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And the sex?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, we haven’t had sex yet. Okay, what’s the big
deal? Y’know? This is special, and I want our love to grow until we move on to the
next level.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Chandler that is so nice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That is really nice…lying! No way is that the reason!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why? Just because you’re not mature enough to understand something
like that?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, he’s right, I’m totally lying.
(Ross makes an "I was right, and you weren’t face." And Rachel does
Ross’s little I’m-flicking-you-off-but-I’m-not-giving-you-the-finger
banging of the fists.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then what is it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, Kathy’s last boyfriend was Joey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And you’re afraid you won’t be able to…fill his shoes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I’m afraid I won’t be able to make love as well as him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I was going for the metaphor.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, and I was saying the actual words.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So big deal, so Joey’s had a lot of girlfriends, it doesn’t
mean he’s great in bed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We share a wall! So either he’s great in bed, or she just likes
to agree with him a lot.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sweetie, with you it’s gonna be different. The sex is gonna be
great, ‘cause you-you guys are in love.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just go for it Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, you should.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, you should, really.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, all right, I’ll go sleep with my girlfriend. But
I’m just doing it for you guys.

scenes.location: The museum, Joey is giving a tour to a bunch of school kids.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, now the Mastodon is from the semi-late Jurassic period.

lines.speaker: Smart Kid
lines.text: Isn’t the Mastodon from the Pliocene Epic?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shhh! This is a museum, no talking. Right down here, (Motions to a
fossilised dinosaur foot.) we have a large foot. (Sees Ross working in one of the display
cases.) Uhh, and over here we have Ross Geller. (Knocks on the glass) Everyone wave
‘Hi’ to Ross. Ross is one of our most important scientists, look at him, hard at
work. (Ross does the old "Putting a cigarette in your ear and pulling it out of your
mouth trick.") Okay, moving right along. Come on.

scenes.location: Phoebe Sr.’s house, there’s a knock on the door.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: It’s open! Come in!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry, I’m late.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Oh, that’s okay, it gave me time to finish glazing my nipples.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! You really go all out when you’re expecting company.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: No, I was working on my pottery.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Ooh! Oh, I didn’t know that you did…pot.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Well, yeah, mostly nudes. It combines my two passions, pottery and
erotica.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, erotiery!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Hey! Okay! Well thanks for coming out to see me. I just-I just
thought it would be a very good idea to talk about this baby stuff in person.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: I really don’t think it’s a very good idea, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Well, because you’d be giving up a baby, and I-I really
don’t—I don’t know if there’s anything I can say that could make you
understand the pain of giving up a baby. So, umm, (Picks up a puppy in the box next to the
couch.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! No-no! I understand the pain! Don’t-don’t hurt the
puppy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: No-no-no, the-the puppy’s yours.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I get a puppy!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Well, yeah! I mean yeah, but only for three days.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: I realise I don’t have any right to start get all parenty on you
and everything now, but umm, (Sees that Phoebe isn’t paying attention and is busy
mimicking the puppy.) uhh… Phoebe, would you please look at me and not the puppy,
it’s very important.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: I mean, I know what I’m talking about. I gave up two babies, and
I only wish I had someone there that had given up babies, that could tell me how terrible
it is to give up babies. I just think that, it would be something you will regret every
single day for the rest of your life. So, how ever hard it is to give up this puppy, it
would be like a million times harder to give up a child. (Phoebe is playing with the puppy
again, and not listening) I really shouldn’t have given you the puppy first.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I’m sorry.
[Scene: The museum’s worker cafeteria, Joey is eating lunch with the rest of the
tour guides. Another tour guide tries to sit down in a seat Joey saved for Ross.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, do you mind sitting there. I’m-I’m saving this for my
friend Ross.

lines.speaker: Tour Guide
lines.text: You mean Dr. Geller?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Doctor? Wow! I didn’t know he had a nickname.

lines.speaker: Tour Guide
lines.text: Oh, he won’t sit here. Only the people in the white coats sit
over there, (Points to there table) and only the people in the blue blazers sit here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, how-how come?

lines.speaker: Tour Guide
lines.text: That’s just the way it is.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s crazy.

lines.speaker: Tour Guide
lines.text: Maybe it’s crazy in a perfect world, a world without lab coats
and blazers, but you not in a perfect world, you in a museum now. See that scientist in
the classes, he and I used to play together all the time in grade school, but
now…(Turns around) Peter! Hey, Peter! It’s me Rhonda! From PS-129! I shared my
puddin’ which you man! I gave you my Snack Pack! (to Joey) See, he pretend
he don’t even here me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I-I think everybody’s pretending they don’t hear you. Anyway,
look, I don’t know about you and your jackets and your separate tables, but Ross is
one of my best friends, and if I save him a seat, I’m telling you, he will sit
in it! (Ross enters and goes over to the white table) Ross! Ross! Over here, man! I-I
saved you seat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s okay, I’m cool over here. I’ll catch up with you
later, Joey. (Joey is shocked.)
(Another woman enters without a coat or blazer and tries to sit at the ‘blue’
table.)

lines.speaker: Tour Guide
lines.text: Op, this is saved. (Joey wonders why) Gift shop.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Joey is eating dinner, Monica and Rachel are sitting on
the couch.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey, uh, I’m really, really sorry about what happened in
the cafeteria today.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s no big deal. Hey, y’know, you do what you gotta do. Right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But hey, it’s not just me, I mean the scientists and the tour guides never
sit together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whatever.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s like that everywhere, Joey! Okay, Mon, back me up here. Where
you work the uh, waiters eat with the waiters, right? And the chefs eat with the other
chefs, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I eat by myself in the alley because everybody hates me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, Ross, really it’s-it’s no big deal. Y’know you wear a
white coat, I wear a blue blazer, if that means we can’t be friends at work, then so
be it. Y’know, hey I understand. Y’know? Hey, when I’m in a play and
you’re in the audience, I don’t talk to you, right? So it’s y’know,
it’s uh, it’s cool. I’ll see you tomorrow. (Leaves)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, when we’re in the audience he doesn’t talk to us, but he
does wave.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the next morning, Phoebe is there with her puppy and is
trying to sing it to sleep as Chandler enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why is Phoebe singing to Carl Mulden?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, y’know what, I think it’s time for puppy to go out again.
Come on, let’s go to the balcony.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, the street. Come on, let’s go to the street. Ooh, listen,
don’t go onto the balcony until after I get back. (Leaves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Chandler) So, did you do it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, yes, we had the sex.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-oh, it was bad?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It was fine, y’know? But she didn’t agree with me as
strongly as she agreed with Joey. She was more like, "I see you point, I’m all
right with it."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it was the first time. Y’know, there’s not always a lot
of agreement the first time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, not girls anyway, guys agree (snaps her fingers) like that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, you have to help me! Okay? I mean, I know what to do with a
woman, y’know, I know where everything goes, it’s always nice. But I need to
know what makes it go from nice to, "My God! Somebody’s killing her in
there!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I’m gonna show you something a lot of guys don’t
know. Rach, give me that pad, please? (She does so and Monica starts drawing on it) All
right. Now…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, you don’t have to draw an actual wo—whoa! She’s
hot!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now everybody knows the basic erogenous zones. (She starts labelling
them) You got one, two three, four (Chandler is shocked to find out there’s more than
three), five, six, and seven!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (shocked) There are seven?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let me see that. (Monica shows her) Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Points to one) That’s one?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s kind of an important one!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, y’know-y’know what, I was looking at it upside down.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know, sometimes that helps. (She realises what that
could’ve meant.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (continuing) Now, most guys will hit uh, 1-2-3 and then go to 7 and set
up camp.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That-that’s bad?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well if you go to Disneyland, you don’t spend the whole
day on the Materhorn.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well you might if it were anything like 7!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right uh, the important thing is to take your time, you want to hit
‘em all, and you mix ‘em up. You gotta keep them on their toes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oo, toes!! Well, for some people. (Chandler eyes her and her toes.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. Umm, you could uh start out with a little 1, a 2, a 1-2-3, 3,
5, a 4, a 3-2, 2, a 2-4-6, 2-4-6, 4, (Rachel starts getting worked up) 2, 2, 4-7, 5-7,
back on the couch satisfied.)

scenes.location: The museum cafeteria, Joey is eating with the tour guides as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Older Scientist
lines.text: Dr. Geller, there’s a seat over here. (Motions to
an empty chair at the ‘white’ table.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you, Dr. Phillips, but I’m having my lunch at this table, here
in the middle. I’m having lunch right here, with my good friend Joey, if he’ll
sit with me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (standing up) I will sit with you Dr. Geller. (He goes over to his table
and they shake hands.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know, we work in a museum of natural history, and yet there is something
unnatural about the way we eat lunch. Now, I look around this cafeteria, and y’know
what I see, I see-I see division. Division, between people in white coats and people in
blue blazers, and I ask myself, "My God why?!" Now, I say we shed these-these
coats that separate us, and we get to know the people underneath. (He takes off his coat
and throws it down.) I’m Ross! I’m divorced, and I have a kid!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (stands up, and throws his coat on the floor) I’m Joey! I’m an
actor! I don’t know squat about dinosaurs!

lines.speaker: Another Tour Guide
lines.text: (standing up and removing his coat) I’m Ted, and I just
moved here a month ago, and New York really scares me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, there you go!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you hang in there Teddy!

lines.speaker: Older Scientist
lines.text: I’m Andrew, and I didn’t pay for this pear.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, good-good for you.

lines.speaker: Tour Guide
lines.text: I’m Rhonda, (motions to her breasts) and these aren’t
real! (Joey and Ross look at each other, shocked)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, Rhonda.

lines.speaker: Another Scientist
lines.text: I’m Scott.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, okay, Scott!

lines.speaker: Another Scientist
lines.text: And I need to flip the light switch on and off 17 times
before I leave a room or my family will die.
[Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe, with the puppy, Monica, and Rachel are sitting on the
couch.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My mom’s gonna be here any minute. I can’t do this, I
can’t give him up. Yes—no, I can. I don’t want to. But I can. No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oo, I can’t watch this, it’s like Sophie’s Choice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, I never saw that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, it was only okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, I can’t do this. My mom was right. If I can’t-if I
can’t give him up, then there’s no way I can give up a baby. Ohh, God, Frank and
Alice are gonna be so crushed. What-what else, what else can I give ‘em—a
kidney!

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: (entering with Frank) Hi!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Uhh, we were just in the neighbourhood, so…

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah, so we just thought we’d stop by and let you know there’s
still no pressure.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: None. But if there was something you wanted to tell us, we’re just
gonna be right over there (points to the counter) having coffee.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: (noticing the puppy) Oh, who’s this little guy?! (Grabs the puppy)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Ooh! Umm!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh, he’s so cute, he reminds me of my old dog, Tumour.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: You are so precious, I could just take you home.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, why don’t you?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh, yeah!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh, thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I’m really okay with this. Y’know why? ‘Cause look at
them, and I made that, so… I know it’s gonna be like a million times harder to
give up a baby but, oh my God, it’s gonna feel like a million times better, right? I
wanna do this. (To Frank and Alice) I wanna carry your baby.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: (shocked) Oh! Oh! Oh! Thank you so much! You don’t know what this
means to us! Oh!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh my God, I think I’m gonna cry!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s gonna be so great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: (entering) Hi! What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I-I gave them the puppy and it made them so happy that I decided
I’m gonna carry their baby.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: But Phoebe…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no-no, I know, but you and I are different people though, and this is
a totally different situation, and I know that I am not gonna regret this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe Sr
lines.text: Oh, I-I-I understand all that, but it’s just—that was my
puppy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

title: The One with the Embryos

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, it’s 0-Dark:30, in other words it’s really,
really early. Everyone’s asleep, and all through the apartments not a creature was
stirring, not even a mouse. That is except for the chick, who turns out to be a rooster
and is crowing in the sun. Needless to say, this awakens Monica and Rachel who rush into
their living room, searching for the cause of the sound.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What the hell is that?!! (to Monica) What the hell is that? Is
that you? (Monica nods her head no, and Rachel realizes what is making that sound.)
Ohhhhhhh! (storms over to Chandler and Joey’s with Monica in trail.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Boy, you are really not a morning person.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (angrily) BACK OFF!!! (She starts banging on their door.) Get up! Get
up! Get up! God damn it! Get up, get up, get up, get up, get up!!
(Chandler opens the door, finally.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is that noise?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s the chick! She’s…going through some changes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What kind of changes?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well the vet seems to think that’s she’s becoming a rooster.
(The rooster crows.) We’re getting a second opinion.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, it’s later that morning, everybody has gotten up and
Ross and Phoebe has joined them for breakfast. Rachel is returning from shopping.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what are you doing shopping at eight in the morning?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I’ve been up since six. Thanks to somebody’s
dumb-ass rooster.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys you really should get rid of those animals. They shouldn’t
be living in an apartment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Especially not with all of these knives and cookbooks around…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. I’m gonna go to the fertility doctor and um, see if
I’m ready to have Frank and Alice’s embryo transferred into my uterus.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now, how will they know if you’re ready?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, they’re just gonna umm, look to see if my endometria layer is
thick.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I can uh, check that for ya.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay everyone, think thick.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Good-bye! Good luck! (She opens the door to reveal Monica and Joey.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi! Wish me luck!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, good luck.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good luck. (to Monica) And I’m still right!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is sooo not true!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She’s mad because I know today’s her laundry day and that means
she’s wearing her old lady underpants.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can check that for ya.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just—I can’t believe that you think that you and Chandler
know me and Rachel better than we know you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well… we-we do. You can only eat Tic Tacks in even
numbers.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, what’s that about?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Rachel) And you… Ross, I believe, if you check Rachel’s
bag you will find a half-eaten box of cookies in there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (He does so, and finds a half-eaten box of cookies.) You’re good.
(Tries a cookie.) These are not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m so not impressed. Everybody snacks when they shop.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah? Ross, how many items left in that bag?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Five.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, ten bucks says that we can name every item in that bag.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How many guesses do you get?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Six.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Challenge extended.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Deal!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Challenge excepted.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, we’ll start with…apples.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We’ll be starting with apples.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) Stop that now!
(Ross reveals a bag of apples.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Uhh, tortilla chips, yogurt.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Diet soda.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. Yes. Yes. (They’re perfect so far.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Orange juice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! There’s no orange juice in there! We win!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ha-ha!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They have another guess.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well, we won that one.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, the last thing…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-oh, oh, oh-oh! (Whispers something in Joey’s ear.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, not for like another two weeks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I got it! Scotch… tape. (They’re right.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How did you know she would buy scotch tape?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, we used there’s up last night making scary faces.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aww, man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right! Ten buck! Fork it over! Cough it up! Pay the piper! Gimme
it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That does not mean you know us better, I-I want a rematch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and none of these stupid grocery questions, real personal
questions.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! And the winner gets a hundred bucks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Serious?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you scared?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! All right, who-who makes up the questions?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross will do it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh sure, "Ross will do it!" It’s not like he has a job, or
a child, or a life of his own.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine! We’ll ask Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no-no, I-I wanna play.
[Scene: The Doctor’s office, Dr. Zane is examining Phoebe as Frank and Alice
watch.]

lines.speaker: Dr. Zane
lines.text: It looks like your uterus is ready for implantation.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! I knew it! I knew it! I felt really thick this morning.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Well, okay, so what’s now—go get, go get the eggs, put ‘em
in there.

lines.speaker: Dr. Zane
lines.text: Okay, it’ll take just a little while to prepare the embryos.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Embryossss? As in, "More than one?"

lines.speaker: Dr. Zane
lines.text: Um-hmm, five actually.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Five? Okay, where am I giving birth, a hospital or a big box under the
stairs?

lines.speaker: Dr. Zane
lines.text: We do five because that gives you a 25% chance that at least one will
attach.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s it! 25 percent? That means that’s it’s like 75
percent chance of no baby at all!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Hey, y’know I was thinking, what are the odds like if-if, if you
stuff like 200 of them in there?

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Sweety, now, she’s a woman, not a gumball machine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well y’know what, don’t worry you guys, ‘cause
I’m-I’m gonna do this as many times as it takes to get it right.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Well, you see, the-the thing is, we-we only got, we kinda have one shot
to make it right.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Umm, it costs $16,000 each time you do this. So, umm, we’re kinda
using all the money we have to do it just this one time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whoa!! That—okay, that’s a lot of pressure on me and my
uterus. (to Dr. Zane) So, well okay, so is there—is maybe is there something that I
can do y’know just to like help make sure I get pregnant?

lines.speaker: Dr. Zane
lines.text: No, I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! You guys really don’t know anything!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: I know! Why don’t you get drunk! That worked for a lot of girls in
my high school.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the game is about to begin.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You guys! Do you realize that any minute now, Phoebe can be pregnant?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know! I know, it’s such a huge, life-altering thing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know.
(They all pause and think about it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The test is ready.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah! Yes! (They all right into the living room, all excited.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, each team will answer ten questions. The first team that answers the
most questions wins. Okay, the categories are, Fears and Pet Peeves, Ancient History,
Literature, and It’s All Relative. Now, the coin toss to see who goes first. (He

lines.text: Oh, hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! You were so right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, what you said, about us being in a place where we could finally be
happy for each other.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hmm.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I mean, I, I-I admit I-I wasn’t quite there. Y’know, I mean the
thought of you and that-that Josh guy…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joshua.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joshua…guy at that club, dancing and having a good time, the thought
of it kinda…y’know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But now! I’m there! I’m totally there! I’m-I’m finally
where you are!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, thank goodness!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, and-and thank you for Emily.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no problem. I’m so glad I could help. Happy for you. (She
playfully punches him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Happy for you. (He punches her back.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, happy for you! (Hits him harder.)

title: The One with All the Rugby

lines.text: [Scene: A beauty parlour, Rachel is getting a manicure while Chandler, yes Chandler, is
getting a petticure (Does that scare you that I know those terms? Well, it scares

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I can't believe I'm getting my nails done! And you
said it was gonna be fun! (pause) Which it kinda is. Also, you said there would be
other guys here. There are no other guys here!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, there’s a guy right over there. (Points to the counter)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s a mailman! That’s our mailman! (Waves to the
mailman) (Sarcastic) Hi. How are ya?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, don’t worry! This doesn’t make you any less of a
guy! (Chandler starts blowing on his fingernails like women do.) That does!
(Chandler stops blowing.) What am I sitting on? (She looks and finds a huge nail.) I hate
to think what this woman was scratching when this broke off.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you know who used to have nails like that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: OH…MY…GAWD!! (Yep, you guessed it. It’s Janice.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's erm, Monica and Rachel's, Rachel and Joey are standing at
the counter. Monica is flipping a light switch on and off next to the door.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey let me ask you a question. What does this light switch do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, Nothing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Didn’t it drive you crazy to have a switch and not know what it
did?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know what it did! Nothing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They wouldn’t have put it there if it didn’t do something! How
can you not care?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Like this. (Shrugs)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, here’s another question for ya. Uhh, do you know what that
silver knob on the toilet does?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure! It flushes it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, good. Now that since you know, when you come over would you mind
actually using it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, with Janice in tow) Hello!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! (Sees Janice.) Ah!! (Janice screams in surprise.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Guess who we ran into today?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Janice?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Isn’t this amazing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh well, I’m divorced.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohhh, wow.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Yeah, I’m riding the alimony pony. (Does the now famous laugh.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And there it is.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I just came up to say, "Hi!" Hi! (to Chandler) And you,
sweetie, I’ll see you tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Bye.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: B-bye!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Bye-bye.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye. (Finally closes the door on her.) (After it’s closed) I
can’t stand the woman! (Phoebe is shocked, Joey is relieved.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! I thought you were crazy about her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I know, but all of those little annoying things she did before
we fell in love? Like her voice, her laugh, her personality—Well, they’re all
back! Y’know? And she’s picked up like nine new ones!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what are you doing bringing her here?! There’s people here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don’t worry about it. I’m taking care of it tonight.
(Chandler opens the fridge and grabs something to drink.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are not. You have never been able to break up with her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (standing in the door of the fridge) Well, I don’t have to break
up with her this time. We’re not involved! I’m going to do a pre-emptive strike!
I’m going to end it with her before it starts. My ass is like frozen! (Closes the
fridge.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, try sticking it in the freezer for 20 minutes. (They all look around
and then back at Joey.) I’m tellin’ ya!

scenes.location: A street, Ross and Emily are walking home from a date.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I can’t believe you really walk alone here! I mean, you hear such
stories about New York.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it’s really not that bad. I mean, I-I for one, feel perfectly
safe.
(At that moment two very large men start screaming and running towards Emily and
picking her up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Help! Help!! Help! Help!!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: No, no, no Ross! Ross, these are friends of mine from home. (Introducing
them) Liam, Devon, this is Ross.

lines.speaker: Devon
lines.text: Hey, mate.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: How are ya man?

lines.speaker: Ross
