lines.text: Oh hey, that was a good one, huh? (Imitating himself) Help! Help!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: So how are you? I’ve been meaning to ring you ever since I arrived
but umm, well, I’ve been rather busy.

lines.speaker: Devon
lines.text: Do you realise that we have not seen each other since the night of that
U2 concert?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh my God. I think you’re right.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: (puts his arm around her) Well, actually the last time you and I saw each
other was that morning.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh, Liam. (Ross laughs and takes her back.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, Liam. So uh, what, were you guys playing soccer or something—or
should I call it (In an English accent) football?

lines.speaker: Devon
lines.text: We were playing rugby.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: In fact we’re playing a game at the park tomorrow. You’re
welcome to play too if you want.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (laughs) Ross play rugby? I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s ah, what’s so funny about that?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Well I mean, you’re American to start with. You don’t even have
rugby here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, we didn’t have freedom here until 1776, either so…

lines.speaker: Devon
lines.text: So good then! We’ll see you at Riverside Park at 2:00! Cheers!

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Cheers!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Cheers!
(Liam and Devon both take a swig of their beers, while Ross takes a swig of his coffee.
The Brits both crush their cans, and not to be out done, Ross crushes his coffee cup,
spilling its contents.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler is attempting his pre-emptive strike.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh boy, I just love to sing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, I-I know that you do, but I think one of the reasons people were
complaining though, was that they paid to hear the actor sing Old Man River.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, look at us! Who would’ve thought that Cupid had a station at
14th Street Nails. (Does the laugh)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughs) Okay, we have to talk. I’m just getting out of a very
serious relationship…

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I know! And I’m just getting out of a marriage, I mean talk about
meant to be!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right! I just think that this is happening too soon.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, too soon, too schmoon. Face it honey, I am not letting you get away
this time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I hear ya. (Pause) But! Unfortunately, my company is transferring me
overseas!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh no! Where to? (Gasps) Too Paris?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No! Not, Paris.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Too London? No-no, Rome? Vienna? Ooh-ooh, Barcelona?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, could you just stop talking for a second? (Thinks) Yemen.
That’s right, yes, I’m being transferred to Yemen!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: When?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know exactly.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Ugh, well I will just have to soak up every once of Chandler Bing until
that moment comes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But I do know that it’s some time tomorrow.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's erm, Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe and Monica are plugging in
a bunch of electronics.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Done?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, with Joey) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! What’s up?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This switch thing has been driving me crazy. So I turned it off and
checked every outlet. Now, four of them don’t work. Which means, one of them
has to be controlled by the switch. So, I plugged in things in all four of the outlets
that-that make noise, so that way, when I turn it on I just follow the noise and find out
which one it is.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Rachel) I bet I stopped listening before you did.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know, you-you also could’ve used uh, lamps and then
followed the light.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, well, I’m using noise. Okay. All right! So, is everybody
ready? Here we go. (She flips on the switch and a hum starts.) I hear something! I hear
something! Where is it? (They all start looking until Rachel realises it’s Joey.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s coming from Joey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, that’s so freaky! Turn him off!!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Ross, Joey, and Rachel are
watching rugby on TV as Phoebe enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, hey, could we put on the news? I think it might be raining.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, just hold on a second. I’m watching this rugby thing on ESPN.
I don’t know what the big deal is. I’m man enough to play this sport.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, you’re not even man enough to order the channel that
carries the sport.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (entering) Hey there Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (whispering to Ross) Janice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know uh, you didn’t really have to help me pack.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Ohh, well when you said all you were going to be doing between now and
the time you leave is packing, you didn’t really leave me much choice. Did you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I-I thought I did but, I-I guess I did not!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey, what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I’m packing. Y’know I’m-I’m packing
‘cause I’m moving to Yemen tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks for telling me!
(Janice runs into the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m only going to pretend I’m moving to Yemen, it’s the
only way I can get rid off her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohhhh, good one! And Yemen that actually sounds like a real country.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (leaning in from the bedroom) Chandler! Come on, I’m gonna show how
to roll up your underwear and stuff it in your shoes. It’s a real space saver.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I know, I do that ‘cause it makes me look taller.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Okay, Chandler, come on!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Janice) Okay. (to Joey) Joey, trade lives with me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope. (To Ross) Man look at this! Ross, I can’t believe you said
you’d play rugby. I mean look how brutal this is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I can handle it! All right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please, Ross, you-you got hurt playing badminton with my dad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s ‘cause-‘cause you’re mom’s dog kept-kept
looking at me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pointing to the TV) Okay, Ross, look-look-look-look, look right here.
That’s called a scrum, okay? It’s kinda like a huddle.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And is a hum, kinda like a scruddle?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross! (Laughs) They’re gonna kill you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, why are you doing this anyway?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you should’ve seen the guy that she used to go out with. I
mean, he’s like Joe Rugby.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re kidding! And he plays rugby?! That’s so funny.
(Realises) Ohh! I see how you did that. All right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway, she thought the very idea of me playing rugby with him was
like hilarious. So I’m gonna show her how tough I really am!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starts laughing, Ross stares at her) I’m sorry. I’m sorry.
You’re right, you are a tough guy. You’re the toughest palaeontologist I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, come on look, Ross can take care of himself! It’s not like
he’s…Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (from his bedroom) Thanks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, don’t worry about me. Okay? I’ll just stay real energetic
and stay away from the ball. I’ll uh, I’ll be that guy right out of the circle.
(He points to a player who starts running and then gets viscously tackled from behind.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well maybe there was a dog lookin’ at him.
(Ross turns and wants to attack Rachel, but Joey stops him.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: The park, everyone is warming up for the rugby game. Only Joey and Phoebe came
to support Ross.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross-Ross-Ross-Ross! Stay away from that guy (Points), and that guy
(Points). And that one—Dude! They’re all huge!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They don’t look any bigger than me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, maybe that’s because you’re closer to you. So you look
bigger to you from where you are.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I’m just going to say hi to the lads. All right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Okay. (Goes to say hi to the lads.)
(A player comes over and picks up a ball in front of Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to the player) Hi.
(The player stands up and smiles. Showing that he has no front teeth.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whoa! (The player leaves and to Joey) I kinda liked it.
(The referee blows the whistle and the players gather to start the game.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I know what I have to do. I’ve got to go Red Ross. (Joey and
Phoebe don’t know what he’s talking about.) Y’know, Red Ross!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I totally don’t know what you’re talking about.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on! The time we were all waiting in line for Dances With Wolves and
that one guy cut in line in front of us and I just lost it?! Screamed at him! Turned all
red! Red Ross!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’ll see.
[Cut to Emily, Devon, and Liam]

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Liam, do me a favour. Tell the lads to go easy on Ross, it’s his
first time.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: You don’t say! (We see Ross who is hopping about with the ball and
spikes it in his face.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (to Ross) Good luck, babe.
(The scrum forms and the game is underway.)

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Ross! Ross! Come on! Get in here! (Ross gets pumped up.) Ross! Come on!
(Ross walks over to the scrum, walks around a bit looking for a way to get into the
scrum.)

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Ross, come on! Get in the bloody scrum! Ross, get in!
(Ross, urged on by his team-mates, jumps on top of the scrum and falls headfirst into
the middle, leaving his feet sticking straight up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: JOEY!!!!!!
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's erm, Monica and Rachel’s, Monica is going over some
plans as Rachel enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You…are…not going to believe it! Joshua came into work today,
and guess what happened?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He asked you out?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. But I was showing him some cufflinks and I felt his pulse.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Saucy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (refers to the table) What are these?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Electrical plans for the building.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay should I be scared?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know that switch does something, okay? So-so I went down to city hall
and got these. All I had to do was pay $25 and wait in line for three hours.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! If only more people knew.
[Scene: The airport, the Yemen Express counter, Chandler is still trying to get rid of
Janice.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know you, really didn’t have to take me to the airport.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh please. Every moment is precious. Y’know? Besides, somebody had
to ride in that other taxi with the rest of your luggage, and your friends don’t
really seem to care too much that you’re leaving.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, we’re really not that close. (Pause) Okay, so I guess this
is uh, good-bye then.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: On no! No! It’s not good-bye, I’m not leaving until you get on
that plane.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Then I guess it’s just, wait here then. (Hands her the sign
that says, Wait Here.") (To the ticket agent) Hi. I need one fake ticket to Yemen.

lines.speaker: Ticket Counter Attendant
lines.text: One ticket to Yemen?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, no. No, no, no, I just, I just need a pretend ticket.

lines.speaker: Ticket Counter Attendant
lines.text: I’m sorry sir, I don’t understand.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What would you give to a kid if he wanted a ticket to play with?

lines.speaker: Ticket Counter Attendant
lines.text: Are you travelling with a child?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. All right, y’know what, she’s (Points to Janice) gonna
think that I’m handing you a credit card, but what I’m really gonna do is hand
you a library card.

lines.speaker: Ticket Counter Attendant
lines.text: Ah, sir a ticket to Yemen is $2,100 and we don’t
take library cards.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: What’s the matter? Is something wrong? Do you have to stay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to the ticket agent) American Express?

scenes.location: The rugby game, Ross is getting killed.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I can’t believe they’re doing that to him! I told them to go
easy on him!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No offence but, y’know sometimes it’s hard to understand you,
y’know with the accent, so…
(The whistle blows.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: That’s just halftime, there’s more of this.
(Ross limps over all covered in mud.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did you see me? I was pretty good, huh? That is one fun game!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Emily) Hey, could you do me a favour? Could you just grab me a bottle
of water?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. (When she’s gone he collapses into Joey.) I-I think I’m
dying. I really do.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, poor baby.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Tell my son that I love him. (Emily returns with the water.)
Excellent! Well, okay, I gotta have some more fun!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ross, they are killing you out there!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (whines "No.") That’s not true!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She’s right! You have to stop!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? No! No, I’m not stopping. I’m Red Ross!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, if you go back out there, you’re gonna be Dead Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t care! I am not quitting! I insist on finishing this game!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: All right, all right, if you insist on doing this, at least let me help
you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, God no! That is no place for a woman. Those guys will grab anything.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: No. That’s not what I’m saying. I just may know a few things
that might help you inflict some pain.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I like that.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Yeah? Listen closely, Devon has got a weak ankle.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: One swift kick and he’ll back off.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, bad ankle, got it!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: And that big bloke with the beard, he has got a trick hip. Yeah. And uh,
and David over there, I heard he doesn’t wear a cup.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? I can use that, trick hip, no cup, okay! Okay!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: And uh, Liam, Liam’s got bad knees. You hit him right and he’ll
go down like a lamp.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But-but, Liam’s on my team.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I don’t care! You just get him!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m gonna go get him! Okay, I am going back in! (Squeals like a
madman.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The Red Ross! Okay.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's erm, Monica and Rachel’s, Monica is reading a book as
Rachel returns.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (noticing a bunch of pictures around the door that weren’t there
originally.) What-what are-what are these?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, just some pictures I made and hung up. I thought they’d
brighten up the place. They do don’t you think?
(Rachel rips one of the wall and finds a huge hole underneath.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no-no, no!
(Rachel rips off another one, revealing another hole. Rachel then moves onto a third
one, but this one doesn’t have a hole underneath it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know that there’s no hole there, I just really liked that
picture.
(Rachel looks at it and then throws it away. She then removes a fourth one, revealing a
third hole.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Look at this!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, but there is a wire back there! I mean that switch is
connected to something!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t care! The wires have come loose in your head!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just thought that if I could follow the wire I could find out what it
did.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And did you?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. It disappears back there behind that baseboard. For a minute there,
I thought it went downstairs.
(Rachel removes a paper on the floor which is covering a hole and gasps.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But it didn’t. Say hello to Mrs. Chatracus.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Chatracus
lines.text: Hello darling.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello, Mrs. Chatracus.
[Scene: Central Perk, They are returning from the rugby game, Joey and Emily are
carrying Ross.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now, are you sure you don’t want to go see a doctor?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no! That-that’ll just bring me down! This was great! I mean I-I-I
was great! This is a great day! Y’know what? I’m buying everyone coffee. All
right? If someone would just grab my wallet, it’s in my pocket.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, sure.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, not you. (Emily gets it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, look, your eye’s still popping out a little, I’m gonna go
get some ice.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, ice! I am so in the mood for ice! (They go and get the coffee and
the ice leaving Ross and Emily alone.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: You were amazing out there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I kinda was, wasn’t I?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I made a man twice my size cry. I mean, I haven’t done that since I
was four and I washed my dad’s Porsche with rocks.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: You really enjoyed yourself didn’t you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please! Are you kidding? I-I hurt three huge men, I gave a guy a bloody
nose—I mean I-I’m not proud of it but, I really am. And it’s all because of
you, wonderful, amazing you.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I think you’ve got concussion.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, I’m serious. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: You’re welcome. (She hugs him tightly and he winces.) I’m
sorry. Did I hurt you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s worth the pain. (She goes to hug him again.) Y’know what,
you know what? It’s not.

scenes.location: The airport, the flight to Yemen is being called.

lines.speaker: Ticket Counter Attendant
lines.text: (on the P.A.) This is the final boarding call for
Flight 664 to Yemen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I-I guess I gotta go.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, my Bing-a-ling. I’ll wait for you. Do you even know how long
you’re going to be gone?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, just until we find an energy source to replace fuel.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh. Well, I’ll right you everyday. (Reading the address) 15 Yemen
Road, Yemen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, good-bye. Good-bye.
(He gives the agent his ticket and walks onto the jetway. Janice walks over and looks
out the window. Chandler walks back into the terminal and tries to walk right past Janice,
but she sees him.)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Janice! There you are! There you are! I had to have one last kiss, and
also-also you said that you were going to leave right after I got on the plane!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: No! No! I wanna see you take-off.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I then guess I’m going to Yemen! I’m going to Yemen!
(To this old woman also going to Yemen.) When we get to Yemen, can I stay with you?

title: The One with the Fake Party

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Chandler, Monica, and Phoebe are
there. Phoebe is stressing out about something.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is it hon?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I can’t find anything that I want to eat! Everything I eat makes
me nauseous! I’m telling you, being pregnant is no piece of cake—ooh! Cake!
(Chandler shrugs, and Phoebe grimaces.) No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aww, honey I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God! Ooh! What is that smell? It’s coming from the bathroom. Ooh!
(She goes to the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! Pregnancy does give you some weird cravings.
[Cut to the bathroom, Joey is taking a shower and Phoebe knocks on the door.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s me. It’s Phoebe. Listen there’s something in here I
want to eat, what-what smells so good?
(Joey sticks his head out of the shower curtain.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is it the shampoo? It’s guava.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (she smells his head) No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Wait-wait! (Reaches inside the shower.) Is it my bologna sandwich?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. Yes. Yes. I can’t believe it! The baby wants bologna! Maybe he
wants me to eat meat? I can’t eat meat!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, wait-wait! (Reaches into the shower again.) Maybe it’s a pickle?!
(Phoebe grimaces at the smell.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler, Monica, Joey and Rachel are there. Rachel is writing
something on a pad, and then crumples it up and throws it on the floor.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you writing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Joshua’s coming in tomorrow and since I don’t have the
guts to ask him out, I’m going to sell him a coat and put this note in the pocket.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah? (He grabs the pad and starts reading it.) Joshua, give me a
call sometime, guys like you (Pause) never go out of style—what did you throw away?
(Ross and Emily enter.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi guys!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what have you guys been up too?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, we went to see a collection of Victorian doorknobs and the
Cupert-Hewitt museum.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Without me?!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: My uncle dragged us there. But, it actually it turned out to be really
interesting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: They were so ornate and beautiful, I mean look at that! (Shows them a
doorknob she has.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know how museums work in England but, here, you’re not
supposed to take stuff.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I uh, I got it from the gift shop. They have really lax security there.
(Chandler is shocked.) It’s a joke. (They all laugh.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Right, I’ve got to be off, I’ll see ya. Buh-bye then. (She
leaves.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! You guys seem to be having a good time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, she’s-she’s amazing. And-and she’s so much fun.
And! Y’know what? When I’m with her, I’m fun! I even signed up for
helicopter classes. (Chandler is shocked.) She’s leaving in two days, I don’t
have to do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no, two days, you must be bummed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, she’s got to go back to London. But you know what? I’ve
been prepared for this from the start. We both knew we had two weeks together, and
that’s it. Y’know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey that’s what all my relationships are like.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but in Ross’s case, they both know in two weeks
that’s it.
(Phoebe enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (starts rubbing her belly) Hello! Hello!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (angered by the rubbing) Yes! I know! I know! Yeah! So the baby is
totally craving meat. This afternoon I tried tricking it, I made it a soy-burger to make
it think it was getting meat, y’know? And I got nauseous.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe that’s because soy-burgers suck!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Being pregnant is tough on your tummy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, but at least you got that cool, pregnant lady glow.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s sweat. You throw up all morning, you’ll have that glow
too.

scenes.location: Bloomingdale’s, Rachel is preparing to slip Joshua the note.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: (coming in from a changing room) Okay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, here’s that trench-coat that you wanted.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Oh great! (He tries on the coat.) Wow! Yeah, it’s comfortable.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Man, I could really flash somebody in this thing. (He goes to put his
hands in his pockets.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stopping him) Oh no-no, no-no, they don’t want you to put your
hands in the pockets until you are out of the store.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, that’s because of a lot of…(She imitates someone picking
their nose and placing the treasure found in the pockets.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Y’know, they ruin it for everybody.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Y’know, I wore that cashmere sweater on a date last night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Yeah, it was my first date since the uh, since the divorce.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, congratulations, so do you love her?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: No, no, no, she’s nice but, y’know, it just it made me realize
that I’m just not, I’m just not ready to be dating, y’know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh. Well, uh, that’s uh, that’s interesting. (She goes over
and retrieves her note.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: (noticing her) Hey-whoa-hey-hey, what was that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s just an anti-theft device.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Then uh, what’s-what’s this? (Shows her the real anti-theft
device.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You need that, you need that too ‘cause obviously, a thief could
just tear this up. (Rips up the note.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Ross is writing on the Magna-Doodle
as Rachel enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oops, sorry. Listen, we-we have to have a party tonight! Actually, we
have to have one in five minutes, so everybody cancel your plans.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, what’ going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We have to have a surprise Bon Voyage party for Emily. But it’s
actually for Joshua. (Starts handing out party hats.) Look, he said he’s not ready to
date, so I had to invite him to a party if I wanted to see him outside of work, and now I
have the perfect opportunity to seduce him! (Hands Ross a party hat.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, as much as I’d like to meet Josh and warn him, Emily and I
aren’t going to be here. All right? I mean, she’s going to come by first to say
good-bye, and then I’ve got a whole special evening planned. So I’m sorry, no
party.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Awwww!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (entering) Hello?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Surprise!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Surprise!!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: No one’s ever thrown me a surprise party before!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it was all Ross’s idea.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: You’re so sweet! And I’m so surprised!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You really didn’t know?
[Cut to later, the party is in full swing. Rachel is in the kitchen and Chandler goes
over to talk to her.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why are you in here if Joshua is all the way over there? (Points to
the living room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uhh, because I’m trying to play hard to get. Oh, quick he’s
looking over here, say something funny.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Like what?
(Rachel laughs hysterically.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What-what-what is so funny?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I said, "Like what?"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now that’s a thinker.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y’know what, y’know what? This playing hard to get thing
is not working. Umm, hand-hand me those cherries. (Chandler does so.) Okay. Okay. (She
does a little sexy walk over to where Joshua is standing.) Hi!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Care for a cherry?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Oh, no thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No? Y’know, I can tie one of these into a knot using just my
tongue.
(She tries to demonstrate this unique ability, but only succeeds in choking on it.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: You okay? (Rachel swallowed it whole and is not hacking like a heavy
smoker in the morning.) You all right? (Rachel walks away, coughing.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupting Monica and Emily) So we should probably get going soon.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh, but the party’s only just getting started!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but we-we have to be at the Four Seasons for drinks in 15
minutes and then y’know, then The Plaza for dinner.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: So why did you plan a party at the same time?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no-no, no, umm, actually American surprise parties are-are-are very
short. It’s usually, "Surprise!" And then, "Oh my God, I’m so
surprised—good-bye!"

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: But Ross, I’m such having a great time! Your sister has just been
telling me that you used to dress up like little, old ladies and hold make-believe tea
parties.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica said that did she? (He squeezes Monica’s knee really hardly
and Monica winces in pain.)
[Cut to Joey and Phoebe in the kitchen. Phoebe is watching Joey make a sandwich.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, yeah. Then what are you going to put on top of that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A little salami.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh yeah! Then umm, what goes on top of the salami?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pastrami.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oooh, yeah. You’re a genius.
(Rachel enters, she has changed clothes.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, could somebody give me a hand with this zipper?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. (He goes over to her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Up!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You changed?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I did. I needed my lucky dress.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And lucky means, more cleavage?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Does for me.
(Joey starts wiping lint off of her back, but goes at little too far and Rachel just
glares at him. He stops, gives her the ‘okay’ symbol and walks away.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, God! Look at him, he’s so cute. I wanna go over there, grab
him, and kiss him! How can I kiss him and not letting him know that I like him?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! I know how you can get him, take off your bra.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There was a seen in Footloose...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Flashdance.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, yeah, with that-that uh, plumber girl…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She was a welder.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? Were you like in the movie, or… Anyway, she takes off
her bra under her shirt and pulls it out the sleeve. Very sexy, and classy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Or if you want to kiss him, umm, you could use mistletoe.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s not Christmas!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Or Spin the Bottle?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He’s not 11!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (with her coat on, she’s leaving with Ross) Thank you so much for
this. It was really so thoughtful of you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? You’re leaving?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, we have something we have to get to.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Uhh, yeah, I think I’m going to take-off too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! You guys can’t leave yet! You have to stay, we-we got the whole
big thing planned!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What big thing?
[Cut to later, the whole group is seated on the floor and Rachel is explaining the
rules of Spin the Bottle.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (spinning the bottle) So, Spin the Bottle works like this: I spin the
bottle, it lands on Gunther, so I would have to kiss Gunther. (She crawls over to where
Gunther is sitting and sees the look of anticipation on Gunther’s face and decides
not to kiss him.) All right. Who wants to go first?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I’ll go.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yay!
(Emily spins the bottle and it lands on Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Welcome to America. (They both kiss.)
(Joey spins the bottle and it lands on Emily.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Two in a row! You’ve got to use your tongues now! (They kiss
again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yay! Emily!
(Emily spins the bottle and once again, it lands on Joey.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are the odds? What are the odds?
(They both move to kiss again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stopping them) Okay, that-that’s enough! Y’know, let’s,
let’s let someone else play.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If you didn’t want to play, why did you come to the party?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, my turn!!
(Rachel spins the bottle and it lands on….wait for it….Joshua. (You thought I
was going to say Ross, didn’t you?) Rachel squeals in delight and starts a slow sexy
crawl over to Joshua, making sure he and everyone else watching gets a good look at her
cleavage.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!! The baby just kicked!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s okay! It’s okay! It kicked once, it’ll kick again!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh my God!
(They all stand up and go over to Phoebe to feel the baby, preventing Rachel from
kissing Joshua.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, well, everybody just remember where they were sitting.
(She crawls over to Joshua and kisses the back of his knee. He feels it and looks down,
Rachel pretends she’s knocking a bug off his leg.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just a bug.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, it is later in the party. The
Spin the Bottle game is over and Chandler is making a sandwich as Phoebe watches.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know it doesn’t matter how much I’m craving it.
Y’know why I’m never gonna eat meat? Because it’s murder, cold blooded
murder.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(He takes a bite out of the sandwich and as he does so, Phoebe attacks the other end
and starts devouring the sandwich.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There’s a Phoebe on my sandwich! (He walks away, giving the
sandwich to Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phoebe, what-what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t help it. I need the meat. The baby needs the meat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right look, y’know how-y’know how when you’re dating
someone and you don’t want to cheat on them, unless it’s with someone really
hot?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, totally!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. Okay. Well this is the same kind of deal. If you’re going
to do something wrong, (He grabs two steaks from the freezer) do it right!
[Cut to later, Phoebe is finishing off her steak.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Feel better now?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but at what cost? Six more months, three meals a day, I’m
gonna eat like, y’know millions of cows.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what if I said, I could even things out for ya, meatwise.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I eat a lot of meat right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, suppose until the baby’s born I laid off it. No extra animals
would die, you-you’d just be eating my animals.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, I can’t believe you would do that for me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Absolutely! I could be a vegetarian. There’s no meat in beer, right?
[Cut to Ross and Emily standing by the foosball table.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, we could still make dinner if we skipped the appetisers and asked
for our check right away.
(Rachel enters, she has changed once again. This time into her high school cheerleading
uniform.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: But, we can’t go now. It looks like Rachel’s gonna put on a
skit.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Have you lost your mind?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-n-n-n-no! I am finally thinking clearly. My lucky dress
wasn’t working out to well for me, but for four years, this baby never missed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel-Rachel-Rachel I-I cannot, I can’t let—(pause), actually
I kinda want to see what happens.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Nice uh, costume.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, yeah, well I wanted to give Emily a big American good-bye
cheer. So okay! (Runs into the living room) Ready! Okay! Gimme an ‘E!’

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: E!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: M!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: I!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: L!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Y!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What do you get? (She throws her pom-poms to Joey and Phoebe and
performs a cartwheel.) Emily!! (Tries to do another one.) Emil—Whoa!! (She falls in
Chandler’s room.) Okay! So that’s me as a cheerleader! Ta-dum! (Gunther’s
the only one that claps.)
(Joey and Monica rush over to her.)

lines.speaker: Joey and Monica
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m fine! I’m fine! I’m just losing a tooth, it’s no
big deal. I have a dentist! Y’know. I’m gonna go put some ice on it. Excuse me.
(She goes over to the ice and Joey and Monica follow her.) What do I do now? What do I do
now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think you’re done.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, time to take off the bra. (She glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Umm, that was really great, but I-I gotta take-off actually.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (trying not to be obvious) Take the bra off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, come on, let’s go get your coat.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Okay.
(They both go to Chandler’s bedroom to get his coat.)
[Cut to Gunther and Emily.]

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Rachel is my girlfriend.
[Cut to Chandler’s bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: So, this was uh, really fun.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Real fun. (She makes a decision.) Y’know, this bra…
Really, bothers me. (She starts taking off her bra.) Y’know, this used to be my
bedroom. Yeah. A lot of memories in here, a lot of memories. If these walls could
talk, y’know what they’d say? Wanna hear some memories? (She is now violently
pulling on her bra in order to remove it, but it isn’t co-operating.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Need uh, need a little hand there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no-no-no! No, I got this all under control.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: You really don’t seem like you do. That’s…
(She is still yanking on the bra, but it is stuck in her sleeve. Finally, she gives
up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ughhhh!! Forget it! (Sits down heavily on the bed.) This is, this is not
how this is supposed to happen.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Well, what was supposed to happen?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can you not look at me when I say this? (He turns around) I thought that
if I could get you here, I could seduce you.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Huh. Oh, boy! (Sits down next to her.) Uhh, I-I don’t wear suits to
work, and I bought six of them from you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I’m sorry, I thought you needed them!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: No, no-no, no-no, my point is that I kept coming back because, I wanted
to see you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Because I-I like you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You like me?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Yeah! I mean you’re-you’re beautiful and smart and
sophisticated—a lot of this isn’t based on tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah but-but-but you liked me! Oh my God, I can’t believe this, all
this time, I liked you and you liked me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no-no-no don’t say but! No-no, but’s never good! Let’s
just leave it at, you like me and I like you.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Okay uh, however…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, now see that’s a fancy but.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: My marriage like just ended, and I’m really not ready to get
into anything yet.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: I’m sorry, I, I just need a little time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
[Scene: The hallway, Ross is sitting on the step drinking a beer as Rachel comes out of
the guys apartment.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, here you are. I was looking for you before. Joshua’s gone so
you and Emily are free to go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s okay. She’s still in there enjoying her fake party and
uh, it’s too late to do any of the things I had planned, so…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Ross, I’m sorry. I completely ruined your evening.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, if it makes you feel any better, I made a fool out of myself.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Helps a little.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is there room on that step for a pathetic loser?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, have a seat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s okay, I mean it was just two-week thing anyway, I just
didn’t want it to end this way, y’know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, maybe you didn’t want it to end?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You seem to really like her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I really do. Yeah, but what am I gonna do, I mean we-we both agreed
that it was gonna be a two-week thing, y’know no commitment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, that girl just spent the entire evening talking to your friends,
asking to hear stories about you, looking through Monica’s photo albums, I mean you
don’t do that if you’re just in it for two weeks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You think?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, you got like 14 hours until she has to be at the airport, and
you’re sitting here in the hallway with a 28-year-old cheerleader with a fat lip.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, you’re right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. (He starts to go inside and stops.) What photo album was it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, it was you and a bunch of albino kids.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! Those weren’t albino kids, that was computer camp! Rach!
(He hurries inside and Chandler is taking out the garbage.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re a pathetic loser, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-ho, yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sit!
(He does so, and immediately starts looking pathetic.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Hi. (He has just returned.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my gosh, Joshua!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: All those things I said about not being ready…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They’re not true?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: No, they’re-they’re all true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Oh, I love that but.
(They move to kiss, but realise that Chandler is staring at them. Chandler urges them
on.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You wanna go inside and have some coffee?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Joshua goes inside and to Chandler.) Every time.

title: The One with the Free Porn

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is watching TV, and we
hear Mr. Treeger in the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: Ohhh, man!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (coming in from his bedroom) What is that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Treeger’s snaking the shower drain.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: What in the name of hell?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe he found you flip-flop.
(Joey sits down and changes the channel, and we see two people making out.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa! Is this porn? What did I do? I must’ve hit something on the
remote.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do we pay for this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, we didn’t even pay our cable bill—maybe this is how they
punish us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe we shouldn’t pay our phone bill—free phone sex.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe we shouldn’t pay our gas bill? (Stops and thinks about what he
just said.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: (coming in from the bathroom) Whoa, hey, that lady’s all kinds
of naked.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, Joey just pressed something on the remote and it just, came on!

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: Yeah, it happened to me once. I was just flipping through the
channels and bam! It was like finding money.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Like finding money with naked people on it!

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: Then I made the mistake of turning off the TV, I never got it back
again. And I’m sad. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Chandler) Why would he turn off the TV? (Chandler shrugs.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, later that morning. The porn is
still on, there are three women getting ready to shave the chest of some guy. Joey and
Chandler are wondering why that guy is letting them shave his chest, and Monica and Rachel
are eating breakfast at the foosball table.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, y’know what, come on, do we really have to watch this
while we eat? (She makes a move for the remote.)

lines.speaker: Joey and Chandler
lines.text: (stopping her) Oh no-no-no-no!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We don’t know what could make this go away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, so no one touches the remote. And no one touches the TV!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And no one touches the air around the TV!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Imagine a protective porn bubble if you will, okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well at least, I’m going to mute it.

lines.speaker: Joey and Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no! (Monica mutes the TV and they tentatively look
behind them)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We still have porn.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering, carrying her massage table) Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, what are you doing? That’s too heavy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Give it here. (She takes the table.) Oh, God. (And gives it to Monica
right away.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, I’m getting too pregnant for this, lugging around a stupid
massage table. Y’know, I have to find a job where I carrying a smaller table. (She
goes over and stands in front of the TV.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Or a job where you don’t have to carry a table.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You mean like a doctor?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs! You’re blocking the porn! Look out!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! (She moves.) Oh my. Oh, that reminds me, I have to see my OB-GYN
today.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's erm, Monica and Rachel's, Ross is entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh, Emily just went to the airport.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. Why didn’t you take her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Eh, her-her uncle already had planned on doing it. And y’know, we-we
said our good-byes this morning, so…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You must feel horrible. Hey! The guys have free porn!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Thinks about it.) Nah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, cheer up! You’re gonna see her again, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I, that’s the thing, I don’t know! I mean, whenever I
brought it up with her she said, (In a British accent.) "This is so fantastic! Why do
we have to talk about the future? Let’s just enjoy…"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting him) No-no-no, don’t-don’t do the accent.
You’ve got to see her again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And why do you care so much?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because! You could get to live out my fantasy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You had fantasies about Emily?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Y’know, the fantasy! Meet someone from a strange land,
fall in madly love, and spend the rest of your lives together.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is that why in junior high you were the only one that hung out with that
Ukrainian kid?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah that, plus his mom used to put sour cream on everything!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you love her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We said it was only going to be two weeks, y’know?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You love her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What-what is love really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohhh, I knew you loved her! Then you need to go to the airport
and tell her. You’re probably just gonna catch her just as she’s about to go to
the gate. You’re gonna call out her name and say, "I love you!" And
she’s gonna say, "I love you, too!" And you guys are going to have the most
amazing kiss, everyone at the gate will applaud.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am a good kisser.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then you two can, can sneak into the cockpit, and things will start to
heat up, and then a stewardess comes in… (Ross looks at her.) I’ve been watching
too much porn.
[Scene: Beth Israel Medical Center, Phoebe is at her OB-GYN doing an ultrasound, Rachel
is with her. We here the baby’s heartbeat.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is that the heartbeat?

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: That’s it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow! This is so cool.
(The heartbeat changes, and we hear a different one.)

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: Have we talked about the possibility of multiple births?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why don’t take care of this one, and should I get pregnant again,
I’ll hold onto your card, okay?

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: No, I’m getting three separate heartbeats.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Three? You guys were worried I wouldn’t even have one!

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: Doctors are wrong all the time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, so, are-are you sure that there are three?!

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: Definitely. (Points out each head on the ultrasound.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God! Oh my God!! So I-I mean so in a few months
I’m going to have three full grown babies just walkin’ around inside me?! Oh!
Oh! And it’s gonna be one of those log rides where they just come shooting out!

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: Actually, giving birth to three babies isn’t that different
from giving birth to one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What do you know?!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is there, waiting to tell Frank and Alice the news.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: (entering) Oh-oh, Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! Hi!

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Hi! (She runs over and hugs Phoebe’s stomach.) So, how did it go at
the doctors?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh well, okay, hey, y’know how when you’re umm, you’re
walking down the street and you see three people in a row, and you say, "Oh,
that’s nice?"

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, yeah well, good news, you’re going to have three babies.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Three babies?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: I finally got my band!

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: We’re gonna have a big family, I’ve always wanted a big family!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh God, I’m so glad you guys are happy, I was so afraid you were
going to be all freaked.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Why would we be freaked?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no maybe ‘cause it’s harder to raise them, and the added
expense, and…

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: (They’re less than happy now) Oh.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, back to happy. Back to happy!

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: No-no-no, no, it’s going to be fine. Because umm, because I teach
Home Ec, and uh, I can have 30 kids making baby clothes all year long. Y’know
it’ll-it’ll be like my very own little sweatshop.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah, I’ve been thinking ever since you said we were having
triplets, the best thing for me to do is to drop out of college and get a job.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: No, Frank.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No you can’t quit college! No! You’re in college? Really?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah, refrigerator college.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah, y’know when we found out we were going to have a baby,
y’know I figured y’know like I should y’know have like a career—and I
love refrigerators!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You can’t give up on your dream.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: No, it’s okay. We’re-we’re gonna have three kids! And
that’s-that’s a different kind of dream. Three kids and no money.

scenes.location: The airport, Emily is getting ready to board her flight to London.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: (On the P.A.) This is the boarding call for Flight 009.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emily! (Runs up.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh my God! What are you doing here? (They hug)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just, I had to see you one more time before you took-off.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: You are so sweet. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s, that’s, that’s a big candy bar. (She’s holding
one of those huge Toblerone bars.) I had the most amazing time with you.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: This is the final boarding call for Flight 009.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Well, that’ me. (They kiss again.) Here, have this. (She gives him
the candy bar.) I’m only allowed one piece of carryon anyway. (She starts towards the
jetway.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stops her) Wait uh, listen. I-I, I have to tell you something. Umm,
I’ve been thinking, I’m just gonna come out and say it. Okay? I-I-I ah, I-I
think I love you.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh. (She’s shocked and hugs him.) Thank you. (She boards the plane.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s no problem.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Rachel is singing some kind of
song.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’s that song? It has been in my head all day long.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s the theme from Good Will Humping.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know who doesn’t even like dirty movies? My new boyfriend
Joshua.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, he told me. He prefers to leave certain things to the imagination.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-oh, yeah, and did he also say that ah, some of the dialogue was
corny and that he actually found it was funny and not sexy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, he likes porn.
(Rachel starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Where ya going?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m going to find out if he really thinks supermodels are too
skinny. (As she exits, Phoebe enters.) Hey, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How did it go with Frank and Alice?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, Frank has to quit college because his super fertile sister is
having three babies! I need to make a lot of money really fast, and I had an idea that I
want to talk to you (Points to Chandler) about, ‘cause you work for a big company.
Okay, insider trading, what information is there that you can give me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They don’t really talk to us about that kind of stuff. I can get
you some free white out though.
(Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh! Did you do what I said? Did-did-did you tell her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And well, what did she say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you’re totally welcome! What’d she say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She said, "Thank you." I said, "I love you." And she
said, "Thank you."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa-whoa, wait a minute, did you say, you love her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, what were you trying to get her to do?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do I do now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You play hard to get.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She already lives in London.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then you go to Tokyo.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right look, forget it, forget it. You told her you love her,
it’s over.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It is not over! You’re over!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Pause) Good one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It is not over because she is going to call you and tell you she loves
you. And the reason why she couldn’t, is because her feelings were so strong, it
scared her. Now you go home and wait for her call, she could be calling you from the
plane! Come on now go! Go! (Tries to push Ross out the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! Okay! But if she doesn’t call, it is definitely over! No, wait.
Wait. Unless, eventually, I call her, y’know just to she what’s going on, and,
and she says she’ll call me back, but then she doesn’t. Then it’s
over.
(Joey holds his fist up, and Chandler gives him two thumbs up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Way to be strong, man!
(Ross leaves, and after the door closes, Joey gives him the loser sign.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's erm, Monica and Rachel's, Chandler and Joey enter having
just woken up.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi! Listen, can we watch cartoons on your television? We need a porn
break. We spent the last two hours watching In & Out & In, Again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, so, why don’t you just turn it off?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because then we would be the guys who turned off free porn.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering carrying a case) Ooh, good, you’re hear! Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what-what ‘cha got there?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh this, well I’m glad you asked. (She opens the case and removes a
knife and an soda can.) Now, don’t you hate it when you have to cut a tin can with an
ordinary steak knife? (She efficiently cuts it in half.) Ahh! Now, I know what you’re
thinking…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pregnant Woman Slays Four?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, they didn’t make you pay for those knives, did they?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, you’re not gonna make enough money to help Frank and Alice
just by selling knives.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no, I know that, but I just have to make enough money for the second
part of my plan.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s the second part of your plan?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My Saturn dealership.
[Scene: Ross’s bedroom, he has fallen asleep waiting for Emily to call. He is
awaken by the phone.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Answers the phone.) Hello?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emily, hi! Uh, how-how was you flight?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: It was dreadful. I felt terrible about how I acted when you said those
wonderful things.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, that-that, that’s all right. Umm, I’m just glad you
called.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ross umm, there’s something that I’ve got to tell you,
there’s-there’s someone else.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Does that mean the same thing in England as it does in America?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Ross is relating his recent
conversation with Emily to the gang.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She doesn’t know which one of us she wants, me or this Colin guy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This isn’t how it’s supposed to go, there can’t be
another guy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course there’s another guy!! This is even more perfect! Now you
have to prove your love!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m not proving anything. Okay, I’m done listening to you. If I
hadn’t let you talk me into going to the airport in the first place, I never
would’ve put my fist through the wall!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You put your fist through the wall?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I missed and hit the door. But, it opened really hard!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You have to go to London!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, you have to go fight for her!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, sure, that makes sense. Yeah. ‘Cause you already told her
you love her and she didn’t say it back, then she called you and told you that
there’s another guy, so yeah, go to London that’ll scare her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When Rachel was with Paulo, what did you do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I made fun of his accent.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You sat back and let him have her, you didn’t fight at all. Am I
right? Do you want the same thing to happen with Emily?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right then, go fight for her! Go to London! I mean, that could be
you and Emily! (Points to the TV.) That, but-but nicer. Just, go to London!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on! Surprise her! Show up at her doorstep! Don’t let her go
without a fight!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. All right, I’m gonna do it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m gonna, I’m gonna go to London and I’m going to fight
for her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, good luck!
(Ross starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross! Ross! If you’re going to the airport, could you pick me up
another one of those Toblerone bars? (Chandler nods his head no.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's erm, Monica and Rachel's, Monica, Joey, and Chandler are
sitting and talking as Phoebe and Rachel enter.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh-Ooh! I did it! I did it! I figured out a way to make money! I’m
gonna open up my own massage place and Frank’s gonna help me! And! We can work it
around his schedule so he doesn’t have to quit school!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s sounds great, but how are you going to afford it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, we were walking down the street and we saw that van that you guys
used for catering and we realised…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m telling it! I’m telling it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. You know how people need transportation, but they also need
massages to help them relax so I just figured we could combine the two, okay, I give the
massages and Frank drives! I can fix up the van, bolt the table in the back, and you know
what I’ve got?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A place where no one will ever get out alive?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Think about it, it’s a taxi that people take when they need to

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting) Relaxi-Taxi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The name was my favourite part!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, well I can up with it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: YOU DID NOT!!!! Oh! No! You came up with Relaxi Cab! That’s
not good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I…
(The phone rings and Monica answers it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Ross, are you in England? Was Emily surprised?
[Cut to Ross in one of those British phone booths.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, because she hasn’t come home yet. And she hasn’t been home
all night! She’s obviously staying with that other guy, and I’m the stupid moron
who spent the whole night outside her apartment!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. When is, when is the next flight out?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: About four hours.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, just stay there a couple more hours and if she doesn’t show
up by then, then just come on home.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, tell him about Relaxi-Taxi, and-and ask him if he thinks
that’s better than Relaxi Cab.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, it’s not Relaxi Cab. It’s Relaxicab, like taxicab.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, that is better.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, later that same night. There is a
knock on the door and Chandler answers it to reveal Emily standing behind it.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are we in London?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing here? You can’t be here!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I’ve uh, I’ve come to talk to Ross.
(She sets her bag down on the foosball table and Joey sees the Toblerone bar
sticking out of it and gazes longingly at it.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause) Nothing. No, nothing.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I was going to call him, but…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you came to tell him you love him! I knew it! (Points at Chandler) I
was right! (Points to Emily) I’m right, right?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I’d really rather talk to him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I uh, I’ve been to his apartment and he wasn’t there, and uh. I
need to talk to him, so do you have any idea where he is?
[Cut to London, we sit Ross sitting outside Emily’s apartment. We hear
Emily’s phone ring with amazing clarity. Apparently, sound travels quite
easily through the walls of British buildings. Anyhoo, Ross looks around for the ringing
phone and in the meantime Emily’s answering machine picks up and once again with
amazing clarity we hear Emily say…]

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ross, are you there? Ross, I don’t know if you can hear this
but… (Ross has moved to the window, apparently so that he can hear better.) I’m
gonna talk anyway, uh, I’m in the States with you sister and your friends and
it’s all over with Colin. I came here to tell you that, and to tell you—Yes,
Joey you can have all the chocolate you want, just take it! Uh, I came here to tell you
that I love you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (yelling, thinking Emily can hear him through the answering machine all
the way to New York.) I love you too! I’m, I’m gonna call you right now from the
phone booth! (Realises) You can’t hear me. (Goes to make his call.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I wish I could know if you’d heard any of that. I suppose I’ve
either just told you I love you or given my neighbours a good laugh. Mrs. Newman if
you’re listening, bugger off this in none of your business. I suppose there’s
not much chance you did heard that, and there’s the call waiting so, I should go. Oh
well. (Answers the call waiting.) Hello.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ross, I love you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh! Thank you.

title: The One with Rachel's New Dress

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Chandler are there as Phoebe enters carrying a drum.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Wow, it is true what they say, pregnant bellies look like
a drum.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (not amused) Ha-ha. (She sits down on the couch.) No, it’s just
I’m so pregnant that I—my guitar doesn’t fit anymore. So I thought
‘til I’m not, I’m just gonna play all my songs on this drum. It sounds really
cool!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Listen. Listen. (She starts to play and sing.) Smelly cat, smelly
cat, what are they feeding you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow, Pheebs! That sounds great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know! I know, and I’ve only been playing for like an hour!

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: (entering) Phoebe! Phoebe! Hi! Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Umm, actually, I came down to ask you a big favour.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, well, don’t tell me you want to keep more of your stuff in my
uterus.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: (laughs) No. No. No. (Sits down.) Okay, now, see, I wanna name the girl
baby Leslie, and Frank wants to name one of the boy babies Frank JR. JR.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wouldn’t that be Frank the III?

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Don’t get me started. (To Phoebe) Anyway, umm, since there are three
babies and umm, we both got to put our names in, we would be truly honoured if you named
the other boy baby.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! That’s so great! Oh! Oh! Cougar.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: You think about it. (Leaves)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Ross’s apartment, he and Emily are getting ready to go to the airport.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I left a bra drying on the shower rod, you don’t think your son will
think it’s yours and be horribly traumatised?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, if mommy can have a wife, daddy can have a bra.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (checks the clock) Ohh, it’s time to go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no-no-no, see, that-that clock’s a little fast, uh, we have 17
minutes. Huh, what can we do in 17 minutes? Twice?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Well that’s ambitious.
(They kiss but are interrupted by a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, uh, you can ignore that.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: That’s Carol with your son!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhh, believe me when he’s older, he’ll understand.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (knocking on the door) Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’ll be right there. (He goes over and opens the door to Carol,
Susan, and Ben.) (To Ben.) Hello! (To Carol.) Hello! (To Susan.) Hey. Uhh, Emily, this is
Carol and Susan.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Hey, it’s so nice to finally meet you!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ohh, y’know, Susan’s gonna be shooting a commercial in London
next week.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh yeah, I’m so excited, I’ve never been there.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh, well, I’ll show you around.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: That would be great! Also, uh, I was hoping to catch a show so if you can
make any suggestions…

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh, there’s tonnes of terrific stuff—I’ll go with you!

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Ahh!
(Ross accidentally, on purpose, bumps into Susan.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look at you two, bonding, making us late for the airport so…

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh, he’s fine. He’s fine. It’s just that us getting along
is difficult for him, because he doesn’t like me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh come on! That’s-that’s… true.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Joey and Chandler are playing
foosball as Phoebe enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Do we have a baby name yet?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh! No! This is so hard! I went through this whole book (Holds up a
book) and found nothing! I want a name that’s really like, y’know strong and
confident, y’know? Like-like Exxon.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it certainly worked for that Valdez kid.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh-ooh, Pheebs, you want a strong name? How about, The Hulk?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I’m-I’m not sure about Hulk, but I like the idea of a name
starting with "The."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, want a good name, go with Joey. Joey’s your pal. Joey’s your
buddy. "Where is everybody?" "Well, they’re hanging out with
Joey."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, y’know what, if you’re gonna do that, if you’re
gonna name him Joey, you should name him Chandler. (Phoebe doesn’t think so.) Oh,
come on! Chandler’s funny, sophisticated, and he’s very loveable, once you get
to know him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well, hey, Joey’s loveable too! But the thing about Joey is, if
you need him, he’ll be there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, Chandler will be there for you too. I mean, well, he might be a
little late, but-but, he’ll be there. And he’ll bring you some cold soda, if
want you need him for is that you’re really hot.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What do ya say? What do ya say?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I, I like the idea of naming him after someone I love, and Joey
and Chandler are great names. (They both stare at her.) But, all right, I
don’t—maybe I’ll just name him The Hulk.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I knew I shouldn’t have mentioned it! That’s what I wanted to
name my kid!
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's erm, Monica and Rachel's, Monica is cooking and Rachel is
getting ready for a date with Joshua.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, Mon, if you were hoping to sleep with Joshua the first time
tonight, which one of these would you want to be wearing. (She’s holding two frilly,
lace nighties.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what? It really creeps me out choosing other
people’s sex clothes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sorry. I’m so exited! I’ve been waiting for this for months! I
got my hair coloured! I got new sheets! I’m making him a very fancy meal.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What am I making him by the way?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you’re making him a frieze salad with goat cheese and pine
nuts, wild nuts, wild rice, roast asparagus, and salmon au croup.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I thought I was making him filet mignon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, you were, but you decided to make salmon because you had some left
over at the restaurant. And then you realised if you (Points at Rachel) bitched about it,
then you (Points to herself) would stop cooking, and you (Points at Rachel) would have to
make your famous baked potato and Diet Coke.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, I really get crabby when I cook.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Joey, Chandler, and Phoebe are
there as Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh, Emily called last night…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And now you’re giving me the message!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Turns out them Emily is just crazy about Susan. Yeah, they’re
going to the theatre together! They’re going to dinner! They’re going horseback
riding!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God, Susan is so fun!
