lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, this is just a little too familiar, okay? For like, for like six
months before Carol and I spilt up, all I heard was: "My friend Susan is so smart. My
friend Susan is so funny. My friend Susan is so great."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You actually think that something can happen between Emily and Susan?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, they’re going to the gym together! Two women! Stretching!
Y’know they-they take a steam together! Things get a little playful—didn’t
you see Personal Best?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, but I’m gonna!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi! Hi! You’re crazy! Okay? This is Emily. Emily is straight.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How do you know? I mean we thought Carol was straight before I married
her!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I definitely. I don’t like the name Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What a weird way to kick me when I’m down.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No! I-I meant for the baby!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. What’s wrong with Ross?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it’s just y’know that something like this would never to
like The Hulk, y’know…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually that-that’s not true, in The Incredible Hulk uh, No.
72, Dr. Bruce Banner found… (Sees everyone staring at him and stops.) Y’know,
ugh, nevermind, my girlfriend’s a lesbian. (Leaves.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, I decided I’m definitely going to go with either Joey or
Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Oh-oh, you gotta pick Joey! I mean, name one famous person named
Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Raymond Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Someone you didn’t make up!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, there are no famous Joey’s. Except for, huh, Joey
Buttafucco.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, that guy really hurt us.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, how about a compromise then, okay? What if it’s like
y’know, Chanoey?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, look, Joey! Come on, think about it, first of all, he’ll
never be President. There’s never gonna be a President Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right look man, I didn’t want to bring this up, but Chandler, is
the stupidest name I ever heard in my life! It’s not even a name; it’s barely
even a word. Okay? It’s kinda like chandelier, but it’s not! All right?
It’s a stupid, stupid non-name!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow, you’re, you’re right. I have a horrible, horrible name.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sorry man, I didn’t—I’m-I’m sorry. I’m
sorry. (Goes over and comforts him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So I guess it’s Joey then!
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's erm, Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is on her dinner date with
Joshua.]

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: This is so nice. Thank you for doing this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, please! Cooking soothes me. (They kiss.) Ahh. So, dig in!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Great! Oh, it all looks sooo good!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (taking a bite) Hmmm!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh I know, my God, this is so—this rice is so—I am so good.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Behind you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sees the chick and the duck) Oh, yeah, I’m sorry. They used to
live here; sometimes they migrate back over.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: (getting up and backing away from they.) Is there ah, is there some way
they can not be here. It’s just ah, farm birds really kinda freak me out!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, sure, okay. Okay.
(Rachel gets up and ushers them into the hall, as they pass Joshua, he leaps onto the
counter to avoid them. Rachel drops them off in the hall, and knocks on Joey’s door.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (answering the door.) Hey, how did you do that?! Come on in. (He brings
them inside.)
[Cut back to Rachel’s date.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All gone! So, farm birds, huh?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Yeah, it’s-it’s my only weird thing, I swear. And I-I-I
would’ve told you about it, but I didn’t know they would be here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: So, all right.
(They both sit back down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. So, can I serve you a little of—What? What? What? (She sees
that Joshua isn’t relaxed.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Nothing I uh, it’s just that I know that they’re still out
there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But, they’re across the hall! I mean that’s two doors away, it
would take them a long time to peck their way back over here.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Okay, that’s-that’s not funny. Uhh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y’know, would you feel better if we went someplace else? I
mean we could pack all this stuff up and y’know go to your apartment.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Oh, they’re working on this week, it’s a total mess. But uh,
I’m staying at my parents’ house, we could go there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Your parents’?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Yeah, they’re out of town.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, it’s this huge place, and-and it’s got this
gorgeous view of the park, and very, very romantic. What do you say?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah that works.
(He moves to kiss her, but stops when he hears the duck.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: They-they-they can smell fear.

scenes.location: Ross’s apartment, Carol has come to pick up Ben.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (opening the door.) Hey!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Hey! How’s Ben?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I asked him if he wanted to eat, he said, "No." I asked
him if he wanted to sleep, he said, "No." I asked him what he wanted to do, he
said, "No." So, he’s sweeping. (We see Ben playing with a broom and a
dustpan.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Hey, Ben! Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So umm, any word from Susan?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ooh, yeah! She said she’s having sooo much fun with Emily.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh, by the by, did it uh, did it ever occur to you that, I
don’t know, maybe they might be having a little too much fun?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: What’s too much fun?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know, the kind of fun, you and Susan had when we were married.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh my God, you are so paranoid!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Am I?!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Am I?!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: I can’t speak for Emily, but Susan is in a loving, committed
relationship.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh, Carol, so were we. All right, just-just imagine for a moment,
Susan meets someone and-and they really hit it off. Y’know? Say-say they’re
coming back from the theatre, and they-they stop at a pub for a couple of drinks,
they’re laughing, y’know, someone innocently touches someone else…
There’s electricity, it’s new. It’s exciting. Are you telling me there
isn’t even the slightest possibility of something happening?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OH MY GOD!! I didn’t really believe it until you just said it!!

scenes.location: Joshua’s parents’ apartment, Rachel and Joshua are entering.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: …and even though none of the other kids believed me, I swear to
God, that duck pushed me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! This place is fabulous!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, let me show you around. This is the uh, downstairs living
room.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa-whoa, there’s two living rooms? God, growing up here, this
place must’ve been a real babe magnet.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Yeah, well, it would’ve been, but uh, my parents just moved here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, you should know, this place is a real babe magnet. Wanna make out?
(They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Hey, here’s an idea. Why don’t uh, I put the food in the
fridge and we can eat it later?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That sounds like a plan. Umm, is there a place I can go freshen up?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Oh yeah, yeah uh, it’s down the hall and uh, second door to your
left.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah.
(She goes down the hall. Joshua goes to put the food away when his parents walk in.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burgin
lines.text: Oh, hi, darling!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Mom, Dad, what are you guys doing here?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burgin
lines.text: Oh, well we cut the trip short.

lines.speaker: Mr. Burgin
lines.text: France sucks!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Umm, this may be a little weird, but I-I-I got a date here.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burgin
lines.text: Oh, say no more!

lines.speaker: Mr. Burgin
lines.text: We’ll just grab some food and take it with us right upstairs,
and we’ll be right out of you hair.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Oh, that-that would be great. So you didn’t even get to Italy?

lines.speaker: Mr. Burgin
lines.text: Yep, sucks!
(They all go into the kitchen. Just then, Rachel comes back from the bathroom; she had
removed her dress and is wearing nothing but a lace nightie. She tries to find someplace
seductive to wait for Joshua. She tries to sit on the piano, but it makes too much noise.
So she goes over to the couch and kinda half lays down to wait for Joshua. Joshua comes in
from the kitchen, sees Rachel, and freezes.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi you!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I can do more than cook.
(Just then, his parents enter. Rachel gasps.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Burgin
lines.text: I like her. She sees smart.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Joshua’s parents’ apartment, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Uhh, Rachel, my parents…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! It’s so nice to meet you. (She goes over and shakes their
hands.) Hello.

lines.speaker: Mr. Burgin
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burgin
lines.text: Hello. Well, Joshua, that $500 was for groceries.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? This-this, no, oh no, no-no-no, this is
not—that’s-that’s not what it is. See, see, okay, I work in fashion, see
and-and, this is a real dress actually. It’s-it’s, they’re-they’re
wearing it in Milan, so part of my job is too wear the clothes, and then I see how people
respond, and then I report back to my superiors at Bloomingdale’s, so…
And obviously in uh, in-in this case, (She grabs a pen and paper) I am going to report
back, "USA not ready."

lines.speaker: Mrs. Burgin
lines.text: Maybe in L.A?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: There you go.

lines.speaker: Mr. Burgin
lines.text: So, have you kids eaten yet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, we were going to do that after—I mean umm, next.

lines.speaker: Mr. Burgin
lines.text: Well, we’re starving, why don’t we all go get something to
eat?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah, well… Yeah, no use wasting this baby, just lyin’
around the house.

lines.speaker: Mr. Burgin
lines.text: So… We go eat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Mr. Burgin
lines.text: You’ll wear that. We’ll be eating, and of course,
you’ll be wearing that.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is looking for a new
name in Phoebe’s book of names.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, I am sorry about what I said!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, you’re right, it is a ridiculous name!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s not that bad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes it is! From now on, I have no first name.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, you’re just Bing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have no name.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, so, what are we supposed to call you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay uh, for now, temporarily, you can call me, Clint.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No way are you cool enough to pull of Clint.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so what name am I cool enough to pull off?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, Gene.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s Clint. It’s Clint! (He heads for his bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See you later, Gene.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bye, Gene.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s Clint! Clint!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s up with Gene?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is telling Phoebe and Monica of her date.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, you wore your nightie to dinner?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah. And uh, the best part though, when the uh, waiter spilled
water down my back, I jumped up, and my boob popped out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, no!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it’s all right. I got nice boobs. (Phoebe and Monica nod there
heads in agreement.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (returning from the phone.) So, I just picked up a message from Emily, she
and Susan are going to a poetry reading together!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So! Poetry? Susan’s gay! They’re being gay together!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Emily’s straight.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, wake up!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, Carol really messed you up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, she turned you into this-this-this untrusting, crazy, jealous,
sycophant. (They all look at her.) All right, so I don’t know what sycophant means,
but the rest is right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I don’t know what you’re talking about, I am not a crazy,
jealous person.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She’s totally right! When we were together, you got all freaked out
about Mark and there was nothing going on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This totally makes sense!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It does not!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, sure it does! In high school, you weren’t jealous at all even
though all your girlfriends were cheating on you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, all right, so up until ‘92-93 he was very trusting, then
’94 hit, Carol left him and bamn! Paranoid city!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Absolutely! Absolutely!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is so much fun!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is not fun!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, all we’re trying to say is, don’t let what happened with
Carol ruin what you got with Emily.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. The ’92 Ross wouldn’t.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I still think I was right about that whole Mark thing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What—yeah—what, y’know what? I hope Emily is a
lesbian.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Phoebe is showing off more of her
drum skills to Joey by rubbing one of the sticks back and forth across the drum.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Drum roll.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Okay. Okay. All right. Help! Am I a Mark, or a John?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nah, you’re not tall enough to be a Mark, but you might make a good
Barney.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right look, am I serious, okay? Tomorrow at 3:30 I am going down
to the courthouse.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re actually going through with this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, look, this name has been holding me back my entire life. Okay,
it’s probably why kids picked on me in school, and why I never do well with
women… So, as of 4 o’clock tomorrow, I’m either gonna be Mark Johnson or
John Markson.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You got problems because of you! Not your name! All right, this has got
to stop! Chandler is a great name! In fact—yes, (To Joey) I’m, I’m sorry. I
know you really wanted me to name the baby Joey, but eh, so, I’m-I’m, I’m
gonna, I’m gonna name the baby Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pleased) Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but you have to keep the name too!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You wanna hug it out?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!
(They both hug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yay—oh—yay! Okay, I gotta go tell Frank and Alice! Right now!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, uh… (She grabs her coat and runs out.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, bye!
(She exits, and after the door is closed, Chandler turns to Joey and…)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ha! Ha! Ha!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh! (Realises it was all a trick to get Phoebe to name the baby
Chandler.)

title: The One with All the Haste

lines.text: [Scene: Rachel’s bedroom; Rachel is awoken by a man singing in the next
apartment.]

lines.speaker: The Singing Man
lines.text: (singing, duh) Morning’s here! Sunshine is here! The sky
is clear, the morning’s here! The morning’s here!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: HEY!! Do you have to do that? It’s Saturday!

lines.speaker: The Singing Man
lines.text: Oh come on! Morning’s here! (Starts singing)
Morning’s here! The morning is here! Sunshine is here!
(Rachel slams shut her window and storms into the living room, where Joey and Monica
are eating breakfast.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I hate this apartment! I hate the color of these walls! I hate
the fact that this place still smells like bird! I hate that singing guy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you kidding? I love that guy! (Starts singing) Morning’s here!
Morning is here—

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Stop it! I will kill you. I hate the fact that my room is so small.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, I have all the space I need. Just do what I did.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, you don’t even have a bed, you sleep in a ball on the
floor!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what? I am really tired of your bellyaching! Okay,
I-I worked really hard at making this a nice place for us to live!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry. I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See, this is a great apartment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Shut up! This place is a hole!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Ross’s bedroom; Ross and Emily are making out. Ross as a new feature.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh, blimey, I still can’t believe you’ve got an earring!
(Yep, it’s a little gold loop.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh? I know, I know. Who am I? David Bowe? (Shakes his head around,
pretending like he’s jamming.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: He does that?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, I don’t know, whatever.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I think it makes you look really dangerous.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I know. Y’know what, I never would’ve gotten this if it
weren’t for you. No really, when I’m with you I’m-I’m like this whole
other guy, I love that guy! I mean, I love you too, a lot, but that guy! I-I love
that guy!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I love both of you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?
(They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I wish I didn’t have to go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then don’t. Stay here. Just don’t go so soon to London, just one
more day.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ohh, Ross, please!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: One more day, seriously/

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Don’t do this to me, again. You’d know I’d stay here in a
minute, but I’d really miss so much work, they’ll fire me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, then you can stay as long as you want.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I wish I could.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no. Don’t, don’t, don’t start packing. Come on! (She
puts some clothes into her bag, and Ross throws them out.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I don’t think you understand packing. Look, I just don’t want
to leave it to the last minute. Last time I left in such a rush, I left my knickers here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I know, I uh, I tried them on.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: You didn’t!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No, I didn’t. I didn’t want to be that guy.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, Joey and Chandler are watching
one of those Kung Fu movies and imitating the moves.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering, wearing Santa pants) Hello!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ho! Ho! Ho!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Excuse me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Your pants!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah! You like ‘em? I just, I went to a used clothes store and
got a bunch of maternity stuff. These are sooo comfortable!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, Pheebs, those are uh, those are Santa pants.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Santa pants. (Phoebe still doesn’t get it.) Santa Claus’s
pants.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nuh-uh! They’re maternity pants. They even came with a list of baby
names. (Pulls out a sheet of paper which lists who’s been naughty and who’s been
nice.) See, these names are good, and these names are bad. (Finally, she figures it out.)
Ohh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So—Hey, Pheebs! So, how are the elves?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know! How are the-the-the-the, y’know—You’re
clothes aren’t funny.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, guys, what-what should I wear to a Knicks game?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh, a T-shirt that says, "I don’t belong here."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You have Knicks tickets?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, my mom got my dad’s season tickets in the divorce, so she
just gave them to me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, apparently, they’re pretty good seats.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (examining the tickets) Oh my God! Those are almost right on the floor!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you guys want these?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah we do!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, well you got ‘em.

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just give us our apartment back!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Boy! I didn’t see that coming!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on! We know what these are worth.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, what, do you think we’re stupid?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re not stupid. You’re meaner than I thought.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Forget it! Okay, I’m not giving up my bachelor pad for some
basketball seats!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re bachelor pad?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have you even had a girl up here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. But uh, Joey has, and I usually talk to them in the morning time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you do!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is whining to Chandler about the tickets.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (ignoring him) Yes, Gunther, can I get two cups of chino, please?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Good one.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on, season tickets! Season tickets, do you know what that means?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Forget it! Okay, I’m not giving up the apartment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh come—look, when I was a kid my dad’s company gave season
tickets to the number one salesman every year, all right? My dad never won! Of
course, he wasn’t in the sales division, but still, I never ever, ever forgot that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey, guys! (They both notice his new little friend)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We don’t make enough fun of you already?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, Emily convinced me to do it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You do know that Wham broke up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I like it, and Emily likes it, and that’s what counts. So uh, how are
you guys doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-no, don’t try and talk all normal with that thing in your ear.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where is Emily?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ugh, she’s saying good-bye to her uncle.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Man, didn’t she like just get here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Easy tiger.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just, I hate this so much! I mean, every time I go pick her up at the
airport, it’s-it’s so great. But at the same time I’m thinking, "Well,
I’m gonna be right back there in a couple of days, dropping her off."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing! There’s nothing to do! I mean, she lives there, I live here.
I mean, she-she’d have to uh, move here. She should move here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I could ask her to live with me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I mean, why not! I mean, I mean why not?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because you’ve only known her for six weeks! Okay, I’ve got
a carton of milk in my fridge I’ve had a longer relationship with!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look guys, when I’m with her it’s-it’s-it’s like she
brings this-this-this great side out of me. I mean I-I-I love her, y’know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I love the milk! But, I’m not gonna some British girl to move
in with me! (Realizes that made no sense.) Joey, you say things now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right look, Ross, he’s right. Emily’s great, she’s
great! But this way too soon, you’re only gonna scare her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t want to do that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! You don’t want to wreck it, you don’t want to go to fast!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, no, you’re right, I know, you’re right, I’m not,
I’m not gonna do it. All right, thanks guys. (Gets up to leave.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, no problem, just remember to wake us up before you go-go.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's erm, Chandler and Joey's, later that same day. Joey and
Chandler are eating pizza, and Phoebe is trying to knit something.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s too hard. Too hard!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering with Rachel) All right boys, last chance for the tickets!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Or I’ll give them to my new boyfriend, Joshua.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait-wait-wait-wait! (To Chandler) Come on! Come on, let’s trade! The
timing’s perfect, I just clogged the toilet!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I want those basketball seats as much as you do! Okay, but we
can’t leave in the small apartment after we’ve lived here! Didn’t you ever
read Flowers for Algernon?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes! Didn’t you ever read Sports Illustrated?! No! I
didn’t read yours! But come on, we can go to the game tonight!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, the only way I will even consider this is if they offer a lot
more than just season seats.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s the Knicks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Screw the Knicks!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn’t mean that. I just meant that the apartment is worth so
much more.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And the Knicks rule all.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, the Knicks rule all!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, so? Are you gonna do it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. No. We’re not gonna do that, y’know why? Because its not
an even trade.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, okay, look, what if you could keep the apartment and get the
tickets?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Done!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let me finish.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m talking about a bet, winner takes all.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, we could end up with nothing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or you could end up with everything.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, I like that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, so what do you say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, just do it!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Op, op, I’m convinced!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on man, you know I’d do it for you! Because, you’re my best
friend.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, but you can’t use that again for a whole year.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, this is so exciting! Ooh, God, what are you going to bet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, okay, well, I think we should let Phoebe decide, because she’s
the only who’s impartial, and she’s so pretty.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Umm, ooh, ooh—oh, I have a game!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s the game?! What’s the game?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, well, it doesn’t have a name—oh, okay, Phoebeball! No, it
doesn’t have a name. Umm, okay, Monica, what is your favourite thing about trees?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They’re green?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good! Good! Five points!
(They both rejoice; Chandler is totally confused.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, Joey, same question.
(He looks to Chandler, who doesn’t have a clue.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, they’re tall.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, three points. Both fine answers, but we were looking for leafy,
leafy.
(Joey turns and is angry that Chandler didn’t come up with the answer.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s not even a game!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Shut up! We’re winning!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You wanna finish this right now? All right, we get a deck of cards, high
card wins. What do you say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine, let’s do it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I have cards!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Here! (She grabs a deck out of her purse) Oh no, these are the
trick deck. Okay. Here yes. Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, you guys uh, you guys pick first

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (She picks a card.) Four.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s a low one!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Okay. (Joey picks a card.) Phoebe, you look, I can’t.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What make you think I can?! (Shields her eyes from it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Okay. (He looks at the card.) Ace!
(Both Joey and Chandler and Monica and Rachel jump up and down for joy.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why are you screaming and hugging?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because we won our apartment back!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? Ace is high! Jack, queen, king, ace!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Ace is low! Ace, two, three, four!
(They all look to Phoebe to settle this.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know. Ooh! Ooh! Look it! (She fans out the trick deck.)
Ah-ha!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, cut, let’s pick again, pick again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on apartment! Come on apartment! (Picks a card.) Oh! I know queen
is high!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-huh, not as high as…(picks a card) It worked! King!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah baby!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But, we pick again! We pick again!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tickets please! (Rachel hands over the tickets) That’s courtside
baby!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Seriously, good game though. Good game. (He tries to congratulate them,
but they pull away.) (To Chandler) What are they so mad about? They get the apartment
back!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No they didn’t!

scenes.location: Ross’s apartment, Emily has packed as Ross returns.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I packed while you were gone. I left some knickers under your pillow.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (laughs) Move in with me.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don’t be scared, I-I know it sounds crazy and-and people will say
it’s too soon, but just-just think, think how great it will be.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ohh, no. Ugh. Oh, leaving London, my whole family lives there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: My job!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, so, you-you’ll get a job here! I mean, I’m always hearing
about uh, them foreigners coming in here and stealing American jobs; that could be you!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Yeah, but it-it-it’s my whole life—you come to England.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I can’t. I would, I really would, but my son is here; I
can’t leave him. Isn’t—you don’t think there’s any way?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ohh, I don’t think so. I mean it would be different if it was way
into the future –and-and-and we were getting married or something.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh no, no, right I shouldn’t have said married. Uh, please
don’t go freaky on me. I didn’t mean it. Well, I didn’t say it; I take it
back!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, don’t. Why don’t we?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Why don’t we what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Get married.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: You are mad!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! I’m not! It’s-it’s-it’s perfect! I mean
it’s better than you just-just moving here, ‘cause it’s us together
forever, and that’s-that’s what I want.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: We’ve only known each other for six weeks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I know, so what? I mean, who’s-who’s to say? Does that me
we-we can’t do it? Look, huh, I was with Carol for four years before we got married
and I wound up divorced from a pregnant lesbian. I mean, this, this makes sense for us.
Come on! I mean, on our first date we ended up spending the whole weekend in Vermont! I
mean, last night I got my ear pierced! Me! This feels right. Doesn’t it?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: My parents are going to be really mad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is that—are you saying yes? Is that yes?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Yes.
(They kiss and hug.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! We’re getting married?!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: We’re getting married!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come here, come here. Uh, (He takes the earring out.) ow! Emily, will you
marry me?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Yes.
(He tries to put it on her finger.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ohh, it’s a bit small.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damn! I thought that was going to be romantic as hell!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: It was.
(They kiss.)
Commerical Break

scenes.location: The hallway, Joey and Chandler are coming back from the game.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Those were like the best seats ever.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah. Hey! Should we give these shirts to the girls? Y’know, kinda
like a peace offering.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, that’s very nice. Plus, y’know they were free and
they’re too small.
(He knocks on the girls’ door and walks in. Surprise! The girls, obviously using Star
Trek technology, have completely moved everything in both apartments back to their
original positions, all in the time it took for the guys to go to a basketball game. Wow!
Anyhoo, Chandler is stunned, and Joey doesn’t even realise it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh. Oh, God! (He starts running around like a chicken with his head
cut off.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, want a beer? (Hands him a beer and sits down in one of the chairs.)
(Jumping up.) WHOA!!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I KNOW!!!
(They both sprint to what used to be their apartment.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Open up! Open up! Open up!
(A very angry Monica opens the door with the security chain still on.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’ll discuss it, in the morning! (Slams the door shut.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What the hell is going on?!
(It’s Rachel’s turn to open the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We took our apartment back!! (Slams the door shut.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (opening the door) I had nothing to do with it. (Closes the door.)
(Opens the door.) Okay, it was my idea, but I don’t feel good about it.
(She goes to close the door, but Chandler puts his foot it in.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We are switching back, right now!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, we’re not! We’re not leaving!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you’re gonna have to leave sometime, because you both have
jobs, and as soon as you do, we’re switching it back! There’s nothing you can do
to stop us! Right, Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t want to move again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t care, this is our apartment! And they stole—you
stole it—our apartment, and we won that apartment fair and square, twice! And I am
getting it back right now. I’m getting back right now!
(They open the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. We figured you might respond this way, so we have a backup
offer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, no more offers. You can’t offer anything to us!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let us keep the apartment and…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: As a thank you, Rachel and I will kiss for one minute.
[Time lapse. The guys are entering their apartment.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Totally worth it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That was one good minute!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good night.
(They both go back into their old rooms and shut the doors. Of course, Chandler has to
close both sections of his door.)
[Cut to the girls apartment.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Men are such idiots.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Can you believe that something that stupid actually got us our
apartment back?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s so funny to think if you’d just done that right after
the last contest, no one would have had to move at all.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, let-let-let’s pretend that’s not true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, scarf’s done. (It’s not really a scarf, it’s just a
bunch of yarn that Phoebe has tied together. Just then, Ross and Emily enter dragging with
them Joey and Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on! Come on. Come on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What-what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross has some big thing to tell everyone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhh, okay, it’s uh, Emily and I, we decided to uh, to get married.
(The gang is stunned.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? Oh, are you pregnant too?!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Umm, no.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When, when did—how, how did you…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We, we just decided to uh, to go for it.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I mean, we know it’s a bit hasty but, uh, it just feels so right,
(Rachel slowly walks in from her bedroom. She is stunned speechless.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (turning around.) Umm, uh, I was just telling the guys…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I-I heard. (Pause, everyone looks at each other, waiting for
Rachel’s reaction.) I think it’s great! (Hugs Ross.) Ohh, I’m so happy for
you!
(Seeing Rachel’s apparently okay with this, the rest of the gang jumps up to
congratulate Ross and Emily on their pending nuptials.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, well, that’s great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Ross) I can’t believe you’re getting married!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. (They hug again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica and Rachel made out. (Giggles like a schoolboy and Monica glares at
him.)

title: The One with All the Wedding Dresses

lines.text: [Scene: Joey’s bedroom, he is asleep and snoring loudly. Chandler enters wondering
who left their engine running.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you kidding me?! Joey. Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey! Joey!
Joey! Joey!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (joining in, in his sleep) Joey. Joey. Joey. Joey! Joey!!
(Chandler acts disgusted, but is happy that Joey has stopped snoring. However, just as
he is about to leave, Joey starts snoring again. So to get him to stop, he slams the door
shut, waking Joey.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh. Oh, did-did-did I wake you?
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler is getting another cup of coffee.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Gunther, can I get another cup of coffee, please? (Gunther starts to
pour him another cup.) So uh, what do you do when you’re not working here?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: You don’t need to fill these silences.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, okay, thanks. (He goes back to the couch and rejoins Monica, Joey,
and Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, that’s like your fourth cup of coffee!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I am drinking lots of cups of coffee because I’m exhausted!
Because Joey started snoring!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He’s in a different room! He’s really that loud?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (proudly) Oh, you should here me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s not something to be proud of, okay? You have to go to a
sleep clinic!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I told ya, I’m not going to any clinic! I don’t have a
problem, you’re the one with the problem! You should go to a "Quit being a baby
and leave me alone" clinic!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They don’t have those.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, they do! Quit being a baby and leave me alone! There, you’ve
just had your first class!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know I used to go out with this guy that was a really light
sleeper, and whenever I started to snore, he would just roll me over…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohhh, yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He would just roll me over and I would stop snoring.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Next time you snore, I’m rolling ya over!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I gotta do what I gotta do, you gotta do what you gotta do, you just do
it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, all right!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!
(Joey starts humming Here Come the Bride.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, the Olympics.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have you guys picked a date yet?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no, not yet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I still cannot believe you’re engaged! (Ross looks at her)
Just ‘cause its happening so fast; not ‘cause you’re such a loser.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Thanks. Uh, has anyone seen Rach?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ugh, she’s upstairs not doing the dishes! And I tell ya
something! I’m not doing them this time! I don’t care if those dishes sit in the
sink until they’re all covered with—I’ll do them when I get home!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah—oh! Hey listen umm, Emily found this wedding dress in
London…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Already?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but it didn’t fit. Well, luckily there’s a store here that
has one left in her size, but I’m the groom, I’m not supposed to see the
dress…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’ll pick it up for you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, she’s got you running errands, y’know, picking up
wedding dresses… (Laughs and makes like Indiana Jones and his whip) Wah-pah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s wah-pah?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know, whipped! Wah-pah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s not whipped! Whipped is wh-tcssh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s what I did. Wah-pah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You can’t do anything!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is not doing the dishes. She hears someone coming
up the stairs and quickly puts down her magazine and pretends like she’s actually
doing the dishes.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, Mon, I was just doing the dishes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! It’s you. (She stops doing the dishes.) Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, do uh, do you have a minute?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I was just about to take a break anyways, so…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So listen uh, I know you and I haven’t really had a chance to talk
since uh, Emily and I decided to get married, and uh, I was just wondering how you were.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know if you were getting married I’d feel, kinda…..
y’know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah. Definitely, well it definitely took me by surprise, but
I’m okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, I just wanted to check.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that’s sweet.
(He goes over to hug her.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re great. And I-I know someday this will happen for you too. You
just hang in there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (breaking the hug) Uhh, hang in there?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no, I didn’t mean, uh…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean maybe you didn’t hear about a serious relationship called me
and Joshua?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I thought you guys had just been on like four dates, I didn’t
realise that had become anything, yet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no-no-no, no-no-no, it has become, it has—yeah. Oh no, those
were four great dates.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Oh, yeah. And I mean, the connection, I mean y’know,
emotionally, mentally, physically…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, that’s-that’s-that’s incredible.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know isn’t it? It’s like I’m right there with Joshua.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are right there with Emily. And it’s y’know, it’s
kinda like…. it’s a tie! Well, I gotta get, I gotta get back to the dishes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I gotta get to work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah? Fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, y’know, y’know what would make me really happy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, no, what’s that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: If like the four of us could all y’know, hang out together. Uh, in
fact Emily’s coming into town this weekend, why don’t you say we all have
dinner? Say, Sunday night?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That would be great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, all right, it’s a date. (He leaves)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to the closed door) Hang in there. You hang in there. (Gives him the
raspberry.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (coming back in) Did you say something?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, just singing. (Does a little song.)
[Scene: Beatrice Bridal Shop, Monica and Phoebe are there to pick up Emily’s
dress.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Ohh! Look at this one! It’s so beautiful!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but y’know, about have of these are gonna end up getting
divorced.

lines.speaker: The Saleslady
lines.text: May I help you ladies?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, yes, umm, I’m here to pick up a dress that you have on hold.

lines.speaker: The Saleslady
lines.text: Yes, what’s the name, please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Emily Waltham.

lines.speaker: The Saleslady
lines.text: Yes! I have it right here. (Phoebe and Monica both gasp at the
dress.) Would you like to try it on Ms. Waltham?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) Okay.
[Time lapse. Monica is wearing the dress and starring at herself in the mirror.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re the most beautiful bride I’ve ever seen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am, aren’t I?

lines.speaker: The Saleslady
lines.text: Ms. Waltham?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: The Saleslady
lines.text: We’re closing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. (Goes to take off the dress.)

lines.speaker: The Saleslady
lines.text: And could I get my ring back?
(She disgustedly takes the ring off and gives it back.)
[Scene: Joey’s bedroom, he’s snoring again and Chandler is there to roll him
over.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right buddy, time to roll over. (Rolls him over, and discovers a
surprise) (Looking down) No-no! (Covers his eyes) No, no-n-n-n-no!! You are going to a
clinic! You’re going to a clinic, and a pyjama store!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is doing the dishes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Does she use the cups? Yes! I believe she does. Does she use the plates?
Yes! I believe she does. (Looks at the wedding dress and stops.)
[Time lapse, Monica is now wearing the dress while doing the dishes and is
making like she is thanking her guests for coming to her wedding. Paging Dr. Crane. Dr.
Fraiser Crane!]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. Thank you. Ohhh, thank you very much. Oh, thank you for coming.
(There’s a knock on the door.) Uh, just a second!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no, let me in!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can you just hold on for one minute?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, you have to let me in right now!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you alone?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right.
(She goes over and lets Phoebe bounce in wearing her own wedding dress.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is complaining about going to the clinic.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This sucks! I didn’t know I had to stay up all night before I went to
this stupid sleep clinic! I’m so tired!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, well…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, I hear that you and Joshua are going out to dinner with Ross and
Emily, and I think that’s, I think that’s really cool.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, Rach, I think you’re handling that really well.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Handling it? What do you mean, handling it? There’s nothing to
handle. Now, maybe I would have a problem with this if it wasn’t for me and Joshua.
Y’know, they’re not gonna get married anyway!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on! They rushed into this thing so fast it’s ridiculous! I
mean, they’re gonna be engaged for like what? A year? And somewhere along the way,
one of them is gonna realise what they’ve done and they’re call the whole thing
off. I’m telling ya, you’re gonna be dancing at my wedding before you’re
dancing at there’s.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, I don’t dance at weddings.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because weddings are a great place to meet women, and when I dance, I
look like this… (Starts to dancing really, really, really badly. Ross enters behind
him and he stops.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, what are you guys doing four weeks from today?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I am… (Looks in his date book.) free!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great! Because Emily and I are getting married in a month!

lines.speaker: Joey and Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: In a month?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You mean, you mean 30 days?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: From now?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, that’s great.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah, Emily always wanted to get married in this beautiful place
that her parents got married, but it’s going to be torn down, so… I mean, I-I
know it’s crazy, but everything up ‘til now has been so crazy, and I don’t
know, this just feels right. Y’know?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (still looking in date book) Hey! That’s the day after I stop
menstruating! (They all look at him.) This isn’t mine.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is waiting impatiently for Joshua.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: (entering) Hey, Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: What’s up? You’re voice sounded all squeaky on the phone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, nothing, I just wanted to see you. See you and hug you. (Hugs him)
See you.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! (She sits down) Sit!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: (sitting) You okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m more than okay, I am really, really happy! Wanna know why?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Do I?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ‘Cause I am really happy about us. I think we are, I think we are
so on the right track! Y’know? I mean, I think we are working, I think we are
clicking. Y’know?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Yeah, sure-sure, yeah,
we’re-we’re-we’re-we’re-we’re clicking.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, y’know if-if there was just like one little area where
I—that I think we need—we would need to work on; I-I would think it was
we’re just not crazy enough!

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: I-I gotta say, I-I-I-I’m not too sure I agree with that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, yeah, right, y’know what? Yeah, you’re right, I mean, we
no, we have our fun. Yeah! But if (Grunts uncomprehensively)……I mean, I mean
like craaaazy! Y’know? Okay, all right. This is gonna, this is gonna sound
y’know, a little umm, hasty, but uh, just go with it. Umm. Ugh. What if we got
married?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: What?! (Gunther is listening in.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I know, I know, it’s-it’s so, it’s so totally like,
"Whoa! Can we do this?" Y’know, I mean, but I mean it just feels right!
Don’t you think? It does! I mean, it just feels right, don’t you think?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Wow! Uhh, Rachel uhh, you’re a real special lady, but my divorce
isn’t final yet and, and, and we’ve been on four days, so I’m thinking
"No, but thanks."

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: YOU IDIOT!!!!!

scenes.location: The Sleep Clinic, Joey is having trouble staying awake.

lines.speaker: Sleep Clinic Worker
lines.text: Your name, please?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Joey Tribbiani.

lines.speaker: Sleep Clinic Worker
lines.text: Um-hmm, and did you stay up all night in preparation for
your sleep study. (Joey doesn’t answer) Uh, sir? (Joey starts snoring)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (answering for him) Yes he did.

lines.speaker: Sleep Clinic Worker
lines.text: Alll right, we’ll call you in a few minutes.
(As she leaves, a beautiful woman enters and sits down across from the boys.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (waking Joey) Hey, check out that girl! She is really hot!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sleepily) Yeah, she is. Wow! (Falls back asleep, loudly) How you
(Chandler wakes him up, again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re coming on to the entire room! (He goes over to pick up a
stack of magazines next to her, and to get her attention, he throws them back down.)
I’m Chandler.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m Marjorie.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Marjorie
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mind if I…

lines.speaker: Marjorie
lines.text: No, please.
(He sits down next to her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So uh, what are you in for?

lines.speaker: Marjorie
lines.text: I talk in my sleep.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What a coincidence, I listen in my sleep.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (asleep) So why don’t you give me your number?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Phoebe, still defying reality, are now throwing
a bouquet at each other, pretending to catch the actual bouquet at an actual
wedding.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, ready?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
(She turns around and throws the bouquet to Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (catching it) I got it! Mine! (They both hug)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! My turn! My turn!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! (Gets into position) Okay, ready?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (cocking her head from side to side in some pre-bouquet-catching ritual)
Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Phoebe turns and throws it on the couch.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (upset) That was a terrible throw!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m not gonna right to you! That’s not real!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look at me! My big concern is what’s real?! (Finally realises) Oh
my God. We’re really sad, aren’t we?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I think we are.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This isn’t even my dress.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, at least you didn’t rent yours from a store called,
"It’s Not Too Late."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m changing out of this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: In like a half-hour?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, throw it straight this time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
(She throws it straight, and Monica makes a big deal about catching it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m getting married next!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yay!
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica and Phoebe, back to reality, are sitting in normal
clothes.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I hate my regular clothes now! Y’know? I look down and-and I
know that this isn’t gonna be the most special day of my life.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. I mean it was kinda fun for a while, but didn’t you start
feeling silly?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I guess.
(Monica crosses her legs and is still wearing the garter belt.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you’re such a cheater!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hello! Little ones.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, is Joey gonna stop snoring?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yep! And! A beautiful woman agreed to go out with me. (They’re
stunned.) Joey wanted to ask her out, but uh, she picked me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, how’d that happen?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because I’m cooler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, seriously.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well she’s, she’s the kinda girl—Joey was unconscious.
(Joey enters, wearing a mouth guard like boxers wear.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (muffled by the mouth guard) Hey you guys! What’s happening?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (muffled) Oh, they gave it to me at the sleep clinic, and it’s gonna
help me not to snore.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, are you asleep right now, Joe? ‘Cause I don’t think you
have to wear it unless you are!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (takes out the mouth guard) I know I don’t have too! It tastes good.
(Puts it back in.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Plus, you look cool.
(Joey totally agrees with this statement and kicks his feet up.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is putting away the wedding dress, finally.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her bedroom) Well, I just called Joshua…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, how did it go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I did my best to convince him that I’m not some crazy girl
who is dying to get married—I’m just going through a hard time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What did he say?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well uh, his answering machine was very understanding. Ugh. I
feel blue.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, sweetie! (Goes to comfort her.) Hey, I bet you anything that
he’s gonna call you again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, maybe, but I don’t think I even care. I don’t think
he’s the one I’m sad about. Y’know, I know that I said that I am totally
okay with Ross getting married, but as it turns out, I don’t think I’m handling
it all that well.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, maybe.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I-I am just trying to figure out why.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Any luck?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, yeah, y’know how Ross and I were on again, off again, on
again, off again? I guess I just figured that somewhere down the road, we would be on
again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Again. Y’know what? I think we all did.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! (She jumps up and throws Emily’s wedding dress into
Rachel’s room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, I got us some reservations for Sunday night, okay? How about,
Ernie’s at 9 o’clock?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, well, you uh, better make it for three.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, see I-I don’t know if we’re gonna be hungry at three.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Three people. Joshua’s not gonna be there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, well, I think, I think he broke up with me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Noo. Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, apparently he scares easy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, Rachel, I’m-I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s okay. Sometimes, things don’t work out the way you’d
thought they would.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come here.
(They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (breaking the hug) Oh, hey, don’t you have to go pick up Emily?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! I got my girls.
(He leaves.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh. (She goes over and lays her head on Phoebe’s lap.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looks at Monica) Hey, y’know what might cheer you up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?
[Time lapse, all three girls are now wearing wedding dresses, eating popcorn, drinking
beer, and watching TV.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know, I gotta tell ya, this really does put in a better mood.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I wish there was a job where I could wear this all the time. (Pause)
Maybe someday, there will be.
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God! He’s gonna come by and borrow some candles for his big
date!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, okay! (She goes to answer the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no, Rachel, don’t get it! He can’t see us!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, yeah! The groom cannot see the bride!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not gonna marry Chandler!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not after this!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you guys, just relax. (She goes over to open the door, and as she
does, she says.) I doooo. (Sees that it’s Joshua, not Chandler that knocked on the
door.)

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: I gotta go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, wait, Joshua! Joshua! (Pause) (Comes back inside) Yeah, well, that
oughta do it.

title: The One with the Invitation

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Chandler are sitting and talking.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what? It seems like all of the sudden; so much has
happened.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know. Ross is getting married.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe is, making people.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Everybody’s doing stuff!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And we just sit here. I mean if I die the only way people would even
know I was here, would be by the ass print on this chair! Look, we have to do something.
Okay? Something huge!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (snaps his fingers) We could climb Mt. Everest!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no, not something stupid, something huge.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no-no-no, I saw an ad for this video, people climb that thing
everyday! We could totally do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?! I mean it’s just, it’s just climbing! It’s
just, it’s just steep!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’re going to Everest! Okay, it would be nice to leave an ass
print on Everest!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What-what’s up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We’re gonna climb Mt. Everest!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah baby!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?! I looked into that. Yeah, but, I mean it costs like $60,000 and
y’know you can die. And, you would die!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (dejected) Yeah, well…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We could get that Everest video though.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we could do that without y’know risking our lives at all!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And while we’re down at the video store, you know what else we could
rent? Die Hard! (Chandler’s excited.) Oh, y’know what? I just remembered,
that Everest thing is only available through mail order.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (dejected) Oh, well…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you guys’ll stay here and hang out with me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeeeeahhhh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But I’ll tell you something. One of these days we’re get off
of our buts and rent Die Hard again!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah we are!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Ross’s apartment, he and Emily are addressing their invitations.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: So what did he decide? Does your Uncle Nathan get an invite or not?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, God, nobody likes him, and he’s so cheap, he’d never fly to
London in a million years. Yeah, invite him? Hey, did I do these neat enough? (Hands her
some envelopes.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Yeah, they’re fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: If anyone asks, we’ll just say Ben addressed them. (Looking through
the envelopes.) Oh! So you invited Rachel then?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure. Why not?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I don’t think I’d be comfortable with any of my old lovers
there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait-wait-wait, do you, do you think, maybe we shouldn’t invite her?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh, no-no, y’know I absolutely adore Rachel it’s just that,
well it might be a awkward for you. But it’s absolutely your decision. (Gets up.)
More tea?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah sure.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Earl Grey?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh? Yeah, fine, invite whoever you want.
[And with that we start off on a series of clips from the entire history of Ross and
Rachel, from Ross’s point of view. The first clip is from The Pilot.]

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is complaining about Carol.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't want to be single, okay? I just... I just- I just wanna be married
again!
(A woman enters wearing a wet wedding dress and frantically starts to look around.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I just want a million dollars! (He extends his hand hopefully.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God Monica hi! I just went to your building and you weren't there and
then this guy with a big hammer said you might be here and you are, you are!
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, everybody, this is Rachel, another Lincoln High survivor. (To
Rachel) This is everybody, this is Chandler, and Phoebe, and Joey, and- you remember my
brother Ross?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, sure!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.
(They go to hug but Ross' umbrella opens. He sits, defeated again.)
[cut to later]

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross and Rachel are finishing up some cookies.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know you probably didn't know this, but back in high school, I had a,
um, major crush on you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I knew.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You did! Oh.... I always figured you just thought I was Monica's geeky
older brother.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Listen, do you think- and try not to let my intense vulnerability
become any kind of a factor here—but do you think it would be okay if I asked you
out? Sometime? Maybe?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, maybe...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay... okay, maybe I will...
[The next clip is from The One With The Blackout.]

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross and Rachel are talking about passion.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: See, I see.... big passion in your future.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ross, you're so great. [she playfully rubs his head and gets up]
[Ross gets up, pleased with himself and starts to walk past Joey.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's never gonna happen.
[cut to later]

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's balcony, Ross is about to be attacked by Paulo's cat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I have a question. Well, actually, it's not so much a question as..
more of a general wondering... ment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Umm, for a while now, I've been wanting to, um....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh!!!! [looking at something behind Ross]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, yes, that's right...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, look at the little cat! [a small kitten is on the roof behind Ross]
Look at it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? [the cat jumps on his shoulders] Ow!
[Cut to inside, Monica, Joey and Phoebe are singing while outside, Ross and Rachel are
trying to get the cat off of Ross' shoulder.]
Monica, Joey, and Phoebe: [singing] I'm on top of the world,
looking down on creation and the only explanation I can find...
[The next clip is from The One With The East German Laundry Detergent.]

scenes.location: The Laundromat, Rachel is fighting with that old, annoying woman for a cart.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, listen, missy. If you want this cart, you're gonna have to
take me with it!
(She thinks it over, and then walks away.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Ross) Yes! Did you see that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You were incredible! Brand new woman, ladies and gentlemen.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I could not have done this without you.
(Rachel stands up and kisses Ross. He is stunned. A moment of silence follows.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, um, uh, more clothes in the dryer? (Ross turns and bangs his head on
an open dryer door.) I'm fine, I'm fine.
[The next clip is from The One Where Ross Finds Out]
[Scene: Central Perk, I'm sure you've guessed, it's the famous fight scene between Ross
and Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You had no right to tell me you ever had feelings for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (hurt) What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was doing great with Julie before I found out about you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, I was doin' great before I found out about you. You think it's easy
for me to see you with Julie?
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The point is I... I don't need this right now, OK. It, it's too late, I'm
with somebody else, I'm happy. This ship has sailed.
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, fine, you go ahead and you do that, alright Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: 'Cause I don't need your stupid ship.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good. (Ross leaves)
[cut to later]
(Rachel slams the door and locks it. She sits down, visibly upset. She puts her head in
her hands and begins to cry. Ross comes back and is standing outside the window. When
Rachel regroups and gets back up to finish closing, she sees him.)
[cut to later]
(She opens the door and they kiss.)
[The next clip is the second famous fight in The One Where Ross and Rachel Take A
Break.]

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross and Rachel are arguing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross do you realise this is the first time in my life I’m doing
something I actually care about. This is the first time in my life I’m doing
something that I’m actually good at. I mean. if you don’t get that...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, hey, I get that, okay, I get that big time. And I’m happy for ya,
but I’m tired of having a relationship with your answering machine! Okay, I
don’t know what to do anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well neither do I!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is this about Mark?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, it’s not, it’s not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God. I cannot keep having this same fight over and over again,
Ross, no, you’re, you’re, you’re making this too hard.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh I’m, I’m making this too hard. Okay, what do you want me to
do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, I don’t know. Urrrgh! Look, maybe we should take
a break.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, fine, you’re right. Let’s ah, let’s take a
break, (goes to the door) let’s cool off, okay, let’s get some frozen yogart, or
something.. (opens the door)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. (Ross is standing in the doorway.) A break from us.
(Ross looks at her, then leaves slamming the door behind him.)
[The next clip is from The One The Morning After]

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, Ross is hurrying Chloe out the door.

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Do I know why we’re rushing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, y'know the ah, the girlfriend I told you about last night?
(He’s frantically throwing the cushions off of the couch looking for her other shoe)
Well it turns out she ah, she wants to get back together with me. Oh, I found it!!

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: That’s so great for you guys!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Chloe
lines.text: Good luck, with your girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thank you. (She goes to kiss him, but he holds her coat up between
their faces to stop her.) Hey, hey. (opens the door, sees Rachel, and hides Chloe behind
the door) Rachel!!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. Ohhh, you got my message.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, oh hey, you are right on time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what do you say? Can I be your girlfriend again?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, you can, very much.
(Chloe gives Ross the thumbs up while still standing behind the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (seeing the thumbs up) Ahhhh!! (Hugs Rachel tighter.)
[cut to later]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel has just found out about Chloe and is screaming at
Ross. The rest of the gang is trapped in Monica's bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (opening the door) Y'know what, I want you to leave! Get outta here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
