lines.text: Just get out! Now!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!! No!! I wanna stay. I wanna talk about this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! All right! How was she?
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-oh.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Was she good?
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t answer that.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on Ross! You said you wanted to talk about it, let’s talk
about it!! How was she?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She was...
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Awful! Horrible!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She was not good. Not good.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She was nothing compared to you.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She, she was different.
[Cut to Monica's bedroom]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ewwwww!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-oh.
[Cut to Living Room]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good different?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nobody likes change.
(Rachel picks up a newspaper and starts beating him with it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Okay, okay, okay, okay.
[The next clip is from The One With The Jellyfish.]
[Scene: Rachel's bedroom, Rachel, entering selfish mode, is thanking Ross for wrongly
taking the entire blame of the breakup; as if she had absolutely nothing to do with it.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...the way you owned up to everything, it just showed me how much
you’ve grown. Y'know? I mean my Mom never thought this would work out.
It was all, “Once a cheater, always a cheater.” Ooh, I just wish we
hadn’t lost those four months, but if time was what you needed just to gain a little
perspective...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: WE WERE ON A BREAK!!!!!!!
[Cut back to the present.]
[Scene: A mailbox, Ross is mailing the invitations. He throws a bunch into the
mailbox, but pauses with Rachel's. And it starts another round of clips.]
[The One With The Fake Party]

scenes.location: The hallway, Rachel is convincing Ross that Emily is good for him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You seem to really like her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I really do. Yeah, but what am I gonna do, I mean we-we both agreed
that it was gonna be a two-week thing, y’know no commitment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, that girl just spent the entire evening talking to your friends,
asking to hear stories about you, looking through Monica’s photo albums, I mean you
don’t do that if you’re just in it for two weeks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You think?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, you got like 14 hours until she has to be at the airport, and
you’re sitting here in the hallway with a 28-year-old cheerleader with a fat lip.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, you’re right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.
[Cut back to the present, Ross is still looking at Rachel's invitation. Finally,
he makes up his mind and mails it.]
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Joey, Monica, and Phoebe are opening their invitations.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, this is soo amazing! I can’t believe my brother’s getting
married! And in London! It’s so romantic!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (taking apart the invitation) Hey, pretty smart! Tissue paper! You’re
at the wedding, you have to cry, "Handkerchief?" "No-no, I got my
invitation."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oooh look! Isn’t this adorable, Ross let Ben address mine!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hello!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Hey, did you get your invitation to Ross’s wedding?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastic) Noo.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t worry man, I get to bring a guest. We’ll show him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m so jealous you’re all going! I can’t believe I never
knew that you can’t fly in your third trimester!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn’t know that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I never knew that either.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I knew that! (They all look at him) I sooo didn’t know that, but you
should see your faces.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys! What’s up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Heyyy. (They all try and hide their invitations.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re hanging out.
(Rachel starts going through her mail, and come across her invitation.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’s this? Is this Ross’s wedding invitation?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See, maybe that’s the one we should’ve actually hidden.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no! No you guys! Come on, you don’t have to do that! I’m
happy for him! I am! I really—I’m-I’m happ—I’ll work on it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sorry honey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, you’re gonna come though aren’t you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, honey, I don’t know. I…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This isn’t one of those uh, y’know "If she doesn’t
come, we-we don’t, we don’t come?" Right? Because I already bought my
ticket…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what would be real weird? Is if you weren’t there. Just
say you’ll think about it, okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I’ll think about it. Yeah.
[And with that, we go into another set of clips, this time from Rachel’s point of
view.]
[The first clip is from The One Where Rachel Finds Out.]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, it's Rachel birthday party and Chandler is about to spill
the beans.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who's this from?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that's Ross's.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... (opens it and sees it is a pin) Oh my God. He remembered.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Remembered what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It was like months ago. We were walking by this antique store, and I saw
this pin in the window, and I told him that it was just like one my grandmother had when I
was a little girl. Oh! I can't believe he remembered!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it's so pretty. This must have cost him a fortune.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe he did this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on, Ross? Remember back in college, when he fell in love with
Carol and bought her that ridiculously expensive crystal duck?
(Everyone looks at him. He realizes he just spilled the beans about Ross's crush on
Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stuttering incoherently) F-hah.... flennin....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.... my God.
[The next clip is from The One With Ross's New Girlfriend.]

scenes.location: The airport, Ross is about to walk off of the plane with Julie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing Ross come off the plane with another woman.) Oh my God.
[cut to later]

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is introducing Julie to the gang.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: Well, Ross and I were in grad school together.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But we haven't seen each other since then. Well I land in China, guess
who's in charge of the dig.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Julie! Julie, isn't that great? I mean, isn't that just kick-
you-in-the-crotch, spit-on-your-neck fantastic?
[cut to later]

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is trying to hang up on Julie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, that is so sweet.(listens) No, no, ok, you hang up. Ok, ok, one, two,
three.(He doesn't hang up and motions for Rachel to be quiet.) Well you didn't hang up
either.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She didn't hang up either...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, no, no, you hang up. You, you, y—(Rachel grabs the phone
and hangs it up for him.)
[The next clip is from The One Where Ross Finds Out.]
[Scene, A Restaurant, Rachel is on her date, drunk, and is leaving that answering
machine message.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) Ross, hi, it's Rachel. I'm just calling to say that um,
everything's fine and I'm really happy for you and your cat...(cut)...I
am over you. I am over you and that, my friend, is what they call closure. (She hangs up
and tosses phone in the ice bucket.)
[cut to later]
[Scene, Monica and Rachel's, the next morning, Ross is checking his messages.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, I got a message from you.
(Rachel comes out of her room, suddenly she remembers leaving the message.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God. Oh my God Ross, no, hang up the phone, give me the phone
Ross, give me the phone, give me the phone, give me the. . . (She jumps the couch and
lands on Ross's back, finally getting the phone from him. Ross has a confused expression
on his face.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're over me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhhhhhhh God. (climbs off his back)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha... you're uh, you're, you're over me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, ohh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: When, when were you... under me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, basically, lately, I've uh, I've uh, sort of had feelings for you.
[cut to later in the same scene]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK, I need to lie down.
[The next clip is from The One With The List.]
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Ross has just broken up with Julie and is about to get
with Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He broke up with Julie. Well, go hug her, for god's sakes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really. It's always been you, Rach.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, god.
(Ross and Rachel hug.)

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Ohhh.
[The next clip is from The One Where Ross and Rachel.... You Know.]

scenes.location: The Auditorium, Ross and Rachel are about to... you know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I've no idea, could be. Listen, I'm sorry I had to work tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh it's OK. You were worth the wait, and I don't just mean tonight.
(They kiss and start undressing. As Rachel tries to pull off Ross's tie she catches it
in his mouth. Then they roll across the fur rug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, oh God. Oh, honey, oh that's OK.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What. Oh no, you just rolled over the juice box.
[The next clip is from The One The Morning After.]

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is trying to prevent Gunther from spilling the beans.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Gunther! Gunther. Gunther, please tell me you didn’t say anything to
Rachel about me and the girl from the Xerox place.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I’m sorry. Was I not supposed to?
(Ross turns around and sees Rachel sitting by the window. She is just glaring at him.)
[The next clip is from The One At The Beach.]

scenes.location: The beachhouse, Ross and Rachel are argueing about the breakup.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know, hey! You’re the one who ended it, remember?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, because I was mad at you, not because I stopped loving you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You still love me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noo.
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What does this mean? What do you, I mean do you wanna, get back together?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noo! Maybe! I, I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just, I feel, I-I just...
(Ross leans in and kisses her. They both look at each other for a moment, and then
embrace in a more passionate kiss.)
[The next clip is from The One With The Jellyfish.]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel and Ross are finally breaking up for good, or is
it?]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know I can’t believe I even thought about getting back
together again! We are so over!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (starts to cry) FINE BY ME!! (he opens the door and traps Chandler behind
it)
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And hey! Just so you know, it’s not that common! It doesn’t
happen to every guy! And it is a big deal!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I KNEW IT!!!!
[cut back to the present.]

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is deciding on whether or not to go to the wedding.

lines.text: [cut to another clip, this one is from The One With The Prom Video]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the gang is watching the Prom Video and Rachel is about to
make her entrance on the video. The italics are portions of the prom video.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Rachel's coming up the path. Doesn't she look
pretty. Jack... (Rachel enters with a huge nose)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what this is, this is us getting ready for the prom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what, you guys, we don't have to watch this.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh yeah we do. C'mon.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Get a shot of Monica. Where's Monica.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Wait, how do you zoom out? (zooms out and we see an
extremely overweight Monica eating a big sandwich) There she is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Shut up, the camera adds ten pounds.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahh, so how many cameras are actually on you?
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, dad, turn it off.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: It is off. Right Ross? (pans over to see Ross with
an afro and moustache)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Lookin' good Mr. Cotter.
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't go to my own prom without a date, I can't, it's too
late.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: If you're not going then I don't want to go either.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (to Ross on the stairs) I have a wonderful idea. You
should take Rachel to the prom.
[cut to later]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know what? I think we've seen enough, let's turn it off.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: No, no, no.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OK, fine, well I'm not gonna watch, alright.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: C'mon kid, let's go.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Ahh, are you hadsome.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Let's show 'em.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (walks down the stairs and grabs the flowers out of the vase on
the endtable) Okay dad.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (going downstairs) Rachel, ready or not, here comes your
knight in shining—Oh no. (Chip has shown up and the four are leaving.)
Rachel, Monica, Roy, and Chip: Bye.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh, dear. Jack, how do I turn this off?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Ross) I can't believe you did that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well.
[Rachel, seeing what he did for her, gets up, walks across the room, and kisses Ross]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: See, he's her lobster.
[Cut back to the present, Rachel has made her decision.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (seeing the decision) Nooooo. You’re really not going?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. It’s just gonna be too hard. Y’know? I mean, it’s
Ross. How can I watch him get married? Y’know it’s just, it’s for the best,
y’know it is, it’s… Y’know, plus, somebody’s got to stay here
with Phoebe! Y’know she’s gonna be pretty big by then, and she needs someone to
help her tie her shoes; drive her to the hospital in case she goes into labour.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You don’t have a car. And your license expired.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. (Starts to cry) Yeah, see, there’s so much to do and I have
so little time to do it in.

title: The One with the Worst Best Man Ever

scenes.location: Central Perk, the gang is there, Phoebe is returning from the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (angrily) That’s like the tenth time I’ve peed since I’ve
been here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s also like the tenth time you told us.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, oh I’m sorry, it must be really hard to hear! I tell ya,
it’s a lot easier having three babies play Bringing in the Noise, Bringing in da Funk
on your bladder! I’m so sick of being pregnant! The only happiness I get is from a
cup of coffee, which of course is decaf, ‘cause—Oh! I’m pregnant!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, did…you want a cookie?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (starting to cry) Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So uh, Pheebs, honey, how are those mood swings coming?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I haven’t really had any yet.
(Monica, Joey, and Chandler all shake their heads.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey and Chandler are there as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, here’s the ring. (Shows Chandler the wedding ring he plans
on giving Emily)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (shocked) Yes! Yes! A thousand times, yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh, any ideas for the bachelor party yet?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa! Before you start handing out wedding rings and planning
bachelor parties, don’t you have to decide who your best man is gonna be?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it’s awkward. It’s awkward. It’s awkward.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I sort’ve already asked Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! He got to do it at your first wedding!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, I figured you’d understand. I mean, I-I’ve known him a lot
longer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on Ross! Look, I-I don’t have any brothers; I’ll never get
to be a best man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can be the best man when I get married.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause) I’ll never get to be a best man!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Chandler) Wait-wait, so, you get to be my best man twice and I never
get to be yours at all?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, you—yeah, of course you get to be my best man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (impatiently tapping Chandler on the shoulder) What about me?! You-you
just said I could!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not even getting married! Okay, this is a question for
science fiction writers!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can’t believe you’re not picking me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, how can it not be me?!HeyHey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not even… I’m not even…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, y’know what, that’s it. From now on, Joey, I want you to
be my best man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes! (to Chandler) Shame about you man.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica, Rachel, and Phoebe are eating breakfast.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to her babies) Stop it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: One of the babies is kicking.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I thought that was a good thing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s not kicking me, it’s kicking one of the other babies. Oh
(looks down her dress)! Don’t make me come in there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you guys have like a big bowl I can borrow?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, there’s one right under the cabinet.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (grabs it) Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why do you need it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, we’re having a big party tomorrow night. Later! (Starts for the
door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa! Hey-hey, you planning on inviting us?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nooo, later. (Walks out the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!! Get your ass back here, Tribbiani!! (Joey walks back in, scared.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hormones!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What Phoebe meant to say was umm, how come you’re having a party
and we’re not invited?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it’s Ross’s bachelor party.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sooo?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you bachelors?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nooo!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you strippers?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nooo!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then you’re not invited. (Starts for the door again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right fine! You’re not invited to the party we’re gonna
have either.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-whoa, what party?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well umm…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The baby shower for Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Baby shower. Wow! That sounds sooo like something I don’t want to do!
Later! (Finally, he makes his exit.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t believe I’m gonna have a party! This is so great!
(Really excited) A party! (Really, really excited) Yay!! (Suddenly, she starts crying and
Rachel moves to comfort her.) I don’t know why.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Ross are talking over party plans.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is what I’ve got going for the party so far, liquor wise. Get a
lot of liquor.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great. Great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, now uh, in terms of the invite list, I’ve got you, me, and
Chandler and I’m gonna invite Gunther ‘cause, well, we’ve been talking
about this pretty loud.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I’ll be there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right—oh! Listen, I know this is your party, but I’d really
like to the number of museum geeks that are gonna be there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Tell ya what, let’s not invite any of the anthropologists, only
the dinosaur dudes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay! We’ll need a six-pack of Zima.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, just planning my bachelor party with my best man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, good luck trying to top the last one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, see, I don’t think it’s gonna that difficult considering
this one won’t be taking place in the basement of a Pizza Hut.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I’m Ross. I’m Ross. I’m too good for the Hut;
I’m too good for the Hut.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I gotta go pick up Ben. Everything so far sounds great Joey, just
remember to keep it on the mellow side, okay? Just a couple of guys hanging out playing
poker, no-no strippers or anything okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, see ya later.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See ya. (Ross exits, and Chandler moves over next to Joey, laughing.)
Have fun planning your mellow bachelor party.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, there’s gonna be strippers there. He didn’t say anything
about no strippers.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He just said, "No strippers."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I chose not to hear that.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is returning from shopping and Rachel is there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look what I got! Look what I got! Look what I got! (She shows Rachel
what she bought. She bought a little leather jacket and a little cowboy outfit for the
babies.) Can you believe they make these for little people?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Little village people.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, look at this one. This is my favourite. (It’s a little pink
and white dress for the girl baby.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that is so sweet!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! Phoebe is gonna love dressing them in these!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh. Except, Phoebe’s not gonna be the one that gets to dress them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because she’s not gonna get to keep the babies.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! We are throwing the most depressing baby shower ever!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute! Unless, we give her all gifts she can use after
she’s done being pregnant. Like-like umm, regular coffee, Tequila.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, and somebody can get those leather pants she’s always wanted!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, she’s gonna love that!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe’s baby shower, she is holding those leather
pants, and isn’t happy about it.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What the hell is this?! What, did you actually thought it would make me
feel better to give me stuff that I can’t use for another two months?! This sucks!
All right, what’s my next present?!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: I don’t have anything. (All of the rest of the women there hide their
gifts behind their backs.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Ross’s bachelor party. Ross is thanking Joey for the
party.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey listen man, about the stripper…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good call!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (banging a spoon against his beer bottle) Okay, a little announcement,
a little announcement. I’ve decided that my best man is, my best friend Gunther!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: What’s my last name?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Central Perk?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (to Ross) Thanks for not marrying Rachel. (He starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-whoa-wait, Gunther don’t-don’t forget your shirt. (He gives
Gunther his shirt and Gunther leaves.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey-hey, what are those?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, little party favours, check it out! (It’s a shirt that reads,
"Ross Geller, Bachelor Bash 1998")

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-oh! (Shows him what’s on the back, "Best Man Joey Tribbiani,
with a huge picture of him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (banging on the bottle again) Okay, okay, a little announcement, I
just want everyone to know that the position of my best man is still open! And uh, (to the
stripper) so is the position of the bride.

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Smooth man. Yeah, you got some chilie on your neck. (Chandler checks and
runs into the bathroom.) Well, I just want to say, thanks everyone, this-this was great.
And hey! See you guys Monday morning. (They museum geeks wave at him.) Thanks Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey, don’t forget your shirt.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thanks! (Takes it and throws it back into the box and leaves.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, hey, museum geeks, party’s over. Okay. Wave bye-bye to the nice
lady. There you go. Back to your parent’s basement. All right. (The museum geeks exit
and Joey unlocks his door and lets the chick and the duck out.) Come on boys, come on out!
Here you go. All right.

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: Ohhh, look at the little birdies! Are those yours?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: Wow, I didn’t know they let you keep chickens and ducks as
pets.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah-yeah. And I got the duck totally trained. Watch this. Stare at the
wall. (The duck complies.) Hardly move. (The duck complies.) Be white. (The duck
complies.)

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: You are really good at that. So uh, I had fun tonight, you throw
one hell of a party.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh thanks. Thanks. It was great meetin’ ya. And listen if any of my
friends gets married, or have a birthday, or a Tuesday…

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: Yeah, that would be great. So I guess umm, good night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh unless you uh, you wanna hang around.

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. I’ll let you play with my duck.
[Scene: Joey’s bedroom, it’s the middle of the night, he’s waking up and
discovers he’s alone in bed.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, (realises he doesn’t know her name.) stripper! (He notices that
the ring box is open, so he picks it up, sees it’s empty and starts to panic.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, it’s continued from earlier. Joey is now waking
Chandler and telling him the news.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (running and banging on Chandler’s door) The stripper stole the
ring!! The stripper stole the ring!! Chandler! Chandler, get up! Get up! The stripper
stole the ring!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (opening the door) What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The ring is gone!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ugh. Just a sec, give me a minute to wake up for this—Ah-ha-ha!!
You lost the ring! You’re the worst best man ever!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, this isn’t funny! What am I gonna do?! I go to bed last night,
everything’s cool! I wake up this morning, the stripper’s gone and the ring is
gone!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You slept with the stripper?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course!! (Shrugs.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is entering, Monica and Rachel are talking on the couch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi, guys.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Phoebe. (Both Monica and her try to move out of Phoebe’s way.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I wanted to apologise if I—y’know seemed a tad edgy
yesterday at my shower. Y’know it’s just the hormones, y’know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No we…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hormones.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …hormones, yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Anyway, I just wanted to say thank you, it was just, it was so sweet.
(She goes to hug them and they both flinch, thinking that Phoebe is about to attack them.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, you seem to be doing so much better. That’s great. So how-how
are things going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good. Y’know—no-no, okay, it’s-it feels like
everything’s been about me lately, so what’s happening with you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well, actually we were just talking about me not going to
Ross’s wedding.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It just might be too hard, given the history and all that…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! This reminds me of the time when I was umm, living on the street
and this guy offered to buy me food if I slept with him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, h-how is this like that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, let’s see, it’s not. Really, like that. Because, you see
that was an actual problem, and uh, yours is just like y’know a bunch of
y’know high school crap that nobody really gives y’know…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starting to cry) I’m-I’m sorry, I just thought that…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alrighty, here come the water works. (Rachel starts crying harder.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is trying to figure out what to do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ugh! I don’t know what I’m going to do! I called the company
that sent and th-they don’t care! Then I called 9-1-1 and they laughed at me, if this
isn’t an emergency, then what is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just wanted to thank you again for last night, what a great party! And
the guys from work had a blast. Y’know, one of them had never been to a bachelor
party before. Yeah! And-and another one had never been to a party before, so…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So uh, hey, that uh, that wedding ring, huh? Man, that’s nice!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, right!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was uh, I was thinking I might want to pick one of those babies up for
myself, I might want to get one of those…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That ring? When my grandmother first came to this country, that ring and
the clothes on her back were all she had with her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you might say, the ring is irreplaceable? (Gives Joey a little
squeeze.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh absolutely! It has been in my family for generations, and every bride
who has worn it has had a long and happy life.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you might say, it’s a magic ring.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs, softly) Yeah, the stripper stole it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My-my ring? My-my wedding ring? The-the stripper stole my wedding ring?!
H-how?! How could this all happen?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I think it all started when you said, "Hey Joey, why
don’t you be my best man."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (dialling the phone) All right-all right, fine! I-I’m gonna call the
cops!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, I screwed up, you don’t have to turn me in!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not on you! On the stripper!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah, well I already did that! They said they’re gonna look into
it right after they solved all the murders.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, well, we’ll call the company that sent her!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I did that too! They wouldn’t give me her real name or her number.
They said, "If I bothered them again they’d call the police." I said,
"If you talk to the police, you tell them I’m missing a ring!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So what, Joey? Wh-wh-what? What are you telling me? That there’s
nothing we can do? Well, how could this happen?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look Ross, I am so-so sorry. I-I-I…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, what if we just ah, called her, used a fake name, and had her
come to my office?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, that sounds like fun, but we’ve got a ring to find!!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are cautiously serving Phoebe some tea.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here’s your tea Phoebe. (They give it to her and quickly take a
step back.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sips it) It’s so good. (Monica and Rachel breath a sigh of
relief.) Oh, thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m so glad you liked it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sets the cup down) Oh! (Grabs her stomach in pain.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! She made the tea! (Points to Monica.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! No, I-I think I just had a contraction.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I thought I had one a couple of minutes ago, and now I know that
was definitely one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, you can’t have the baby here! I mean I haven’t
sterilised it since the guys moved out!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. It’s okay. We’re gonna be okay. Y’know what?
It’s okay. I’m gonna, I’m gonna, I’m gonna boil some water and just
rip up some sheets!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. It’s all right; it’s probably false labour. They said
that, that can happen near the end, just somebody get the book.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, get the book! The book!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! (Runs and grabs a book and hands it to Monica.) Okay! Here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The Bible?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know!

scenes.location: Chandler’s office, the guys are there waiting to ambush the stripper.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, okay, this is great, uh, Chandler, you get behind the desk.
And-and when she comes in hopefully, she won’t recognise you because, well, why would
she? Uh, okay, and then you buzz Ross and I. (to Ross) You be Mr. Gonzalez, and I’ll
be uh, Mr. Wong.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Diverse.
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: Did anybody call for security?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) You be cool. (He opens the door and lets her in as they all
turn there backs on her.)

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: Okay, which one of you guys is Gunther Central-Perk? (Sees Joey.)
Hey, Joey?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Where’s my ring? My dead grandmother’s wedding ring? Where is
it? Where is it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Way to be cool, man.

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: What’s he talking about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There was a ring, in a box, on my nightstand, after you left, it was gone!

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: Wait, you guys think I stole some ring?

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We know you took so just-just save yourself the time and confess!

lines.speaker: The Stripper
lines.text: Okay, who are you? The Hardy boys? Look, I don’t need to
steal some stupid ring, all right? I make $1,600 a week doing what I do; any of you guys
make that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Marry me. (Both Ross and Chandler hit him.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, the guys are now trying to figure out what next to do,
since their plan with the stripper backfired on them.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t get it! It was in my room all night! And if she didn’t
take it, and I didn’t take it; and you (Chandler) didn’t take it, then who did?
(The duck quacks.) Shh! We’re trying to think! (Ross and Chandler realise it at the
same moment and stare at Joey, who doesn’t get it. After a short pause, with the duck
still quacking, Joey figures it out and starts pointing at the duck.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is recovering from her false labour.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I still don’t get how you know when it’s false labour.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, do you see any babies?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How do you feel?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I guess. I mean… I don’t know, it’s just, I guess I
know it’s going to be over soon.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, isn’t that a good thing? You said you were sick of this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. It’s just y’know usually when you’re, when
you’re done with the pregnant thing, y’know, then you get to do the mom thing.
I’m gonna be y’know, sitting around in my leather pants, drinking Tequila.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Some moms do that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay that’s even sadder. Look, I know, I know what I got myself
into, it’s just that now that they’re in me it’s like, it’s like I
know them y’know, I mean-I mean, it’s just not gonna be easy when these little
babies have to go away.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aww, sweetie, but it’s not like you’re not gonna have
anything. You’re gonna have nieces and nephews, and some ways that’s even
better.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, really. Really, Pheebs, you’re not gonna be the one worrying
about saving for college, or yelling at them when they’re bad, y’know, or
deciding to put them on Ritalin when they just won’t calm down. Y’know?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean, you’re the one they’re gonna come to when they wanna
run away from home, and the one they talk to about sex.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you just get to be cool Aunt Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Cool Aunt Phoebe. I am pretty cool!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And y’know what else, oh my God, are they gonna love you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They are gonna love me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks you guys! Again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, sweetie! (They all hug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re the best. Thanks. Oh!

lines.speaker: Monica and Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just kidding. Ahh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Got cha again, you guys are so easy.
[Scene: The Animal Hospital, the guys have taken the duck in to remove the ring. Joey
is pacing around like an expectant father.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If anything should happen to him…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey! The vet said it’s a simple procedure.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So! Things can go wrong! You don’t know! What if he doesn’t make
it?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He will, Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but what if he doesn’t? He’s such a good duck.
(With that we go into a little flashback about the guys’ memories of the duck. The
first one is Joey playing with him in the bathtub and drying him off. Then it’s
Chandler sitting on his couch after they moved into the girls apartment, and Chandler
reading to him in bed, and him watching Baywatch when all they had was the canoe
and the duck was in a bucket of water. Then we see Ross eating some cereal and the duck
watching him. He takes a lamp and moves the duck off of the table. Then it’s Chandler
shooing them out of the bathroom in the girls’ apartment, Joey revealing their disco
cubby hole in the entertainment-center, then Chandler playing Hide-and-Go-Seek with them,
and it’s concluded with various scenes with the duck flapping it’s wings. And
the guys staring into the distance in remembrance of the duck.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m so worried about him, y’know?

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: (coming in from surgery) Somebody lose a ring?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! Thank you! Thank you so much! (He grabs the ring, kisses it,
and then does a double-take realising where it’s been.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: H-h-h-how’s the duck?

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: He’s doing just fine, he’s resting now, but you can see
him in a little bit.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, great! Oh hey, listen Ross, thanks for being so cool about this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, that’s all right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, it’s not. I mean you-you made me your best man and I totally let
you down!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, come on, it’s not your fault.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it is! You wouldn’t have lost the ring, right? Y’know
what, Ross you were right from the start, he (Chandler) should be your best man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, you should.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now, don’t argue with me…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Hey! Hey! I get to choose my best man, and I want both you
guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, both you guys should be up there with me. I mean, you two are-are
my… I mean, I’m lucky to have just one good… (They all start getting
emotional.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (starting to cry) I gotta go check something over here. (He walks away so
that they can’t see him cry.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What a baby.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Total wuss!
(They both turn and wipe their eyes.)

title: The One with Ross's Wedding

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey and Chandler are getting ready for the flight to
London and Monica comes running in.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys, hurry up! The flight leaves in four hours! It could take time to
get a taxi! There could be traffic! The plane could leave early! When we get to London,
there could be a line at customs! Come on!! (She runs back to her apartment.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Six-hour trip to London. That’s a lot of Monica.
[Cut to the girls’ apartment, Monica is putting things into her purse as Phoebe
and Rachel watch.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Passport, check! (As she puts away each item, she says check.) Camera,
check! Traveller’s cheques, check!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who are you saying "check" too?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Myself. Y’know for remembering to pack a thing. Yeah, you do a good
thing, you get a check! (pause) My mom does it, I never realized it was weird.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, my mom used to put her head in the oven. Well, actually, she only
did it the one time. But it was pretty weird.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Are you ready yet?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yep! You got the tickets?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! Got ‘em right here, (Pats his coat pocket) check!
[Cut to the guys’ apartment.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s all London, baby! Here we go. (He takes a picture of a less than
enthused Chandler and starts towards the girls’ apartment.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got your passport?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, in my third drawer on my dresser. You don’t want to lose that.
(Chandler glares at him. At first Joey doesn’t know why, it takes him a little bit
to figure it out.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh!! (Runs to his room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There it is.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier, Monica is telling Phoebe where
everything is.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, if you need the vacuum, it’s in my closet on the left-hand
side. Ah, the garbage bags are next to the refrigerator…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, okay, but Rachel’s gonna be here too, can’t I just ask
her this stuff?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, okay, give that a try!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, with Joey) All right! Let’s do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Woo-hoo!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, cheerie-o!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: London baby!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, ‘cause that’s not gonna get annoying.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (louder) London baby!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, y’know what? I was wrong.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, we’re all here! I guess we should get going!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohhh, I wanna come over there and give you a hug and wish you luck on
your wedding, but I don’t—can’t get up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I’ll-I’ll come hug you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great! Yeah, could you bring me the newspaper?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. (He does so and Phoebe hugs him.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, have a great wedding!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hey, Chandler I wanna hug you too!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! (Trots over)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, and great! You might as well bring me my book, it’s on the
counter in your apartment.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh. (Goes and gets Phoebe’s book as Rachel comes in from her
room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) So, we’re off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Have fun!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks! (They hug.) Ugh, I can’t believe you’re not gonna be
there!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So-so come! Why don’t you come?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: To London! Come to London. Please? It’ll mean so much to me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, well, I gotta work, I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why-why can’t you take a couple of days off?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because, I can’t! Ross, I told you, no. I can’t.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is my wedding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, y’know what? We really are late! Let’s go!
Let’s go! Let’s go!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine. You’ll-you’ll watch it on video when we get back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, with Phoebe’s book.) Here you go Phoebe! Here you go
Phobo! Phewbedo! Phaybobo.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (laughs) Thank you.
(Chandler kneels down with his arms spread waiting for his hug.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you. (She pats him on his head.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, let’s go! Bye, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bye, Pheebs!
(They all start out, Rachel gives each one a kiss, and says "bye." In the
hall, Joey says…)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: London baby!! (And Rachel slowly closes the door, sadly.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, do you need a hug? You don’t have to bring me anything!
(And with that, television history is made as, for the first time ever, an entire show
moves it’s entire production to an entirely different country to make a single
episode. We get shots of Buckingham Palace, London Bridge, Big Ben, and the London
Marriott as Joey and Chandler exit.)
[Scene: Street in front of the London Marriott, Joey and Chandler exit. Joey is
carrying a video camera and is shooting Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! Do something!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am, I’m ignoring you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, here! (Gives him the camera.) I wanna be the on camera guy. All
right, first stop, Westminster Abbey. (Joey folds out his "pop-up" map of
London. All of the major landmarks pop-up like in a pop-up book.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, what the hell is that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s London, baby! All right, the hotel’s here. (Points to the
map.) Wait. No, we wanna go… No. I know. (Sets the map down.) I’m gonna have to
go into the map. (So Joey literally steps into the map.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, if you see a little version of me in there? Kill it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I got it! (Picks up the map and starts walking.) Here we go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Listen-listen, we’re not gonna have to walk this way the
entire time are we?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shhh! (Pause) Man, you made me lose it! (He goes into the map again.)
[Scene: Another street, somewhere along the River Themes, Ross, Emily, and Monica are
walking to where they’re gonna get married. Emily is relating the troubles with the
caterer.]

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: …and that was all before 10 o’clock. The caterer rang and said
it was going to be Chicken Kiev instead of Chicken Tarragon. And then the florist phoned
to say there aren’t any tulips. Oh, and the chilliest has carpel-tunel syndrome.
We’re not gonna be…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa! Emily, (Gives her the time-out signal.) honey, okay?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Well, up yours too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! No! No! That’s-that’s time-out!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sweetie, you gotta relax. Everything’s gonna be great, okay? Come on.
Come on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chicken Kiev?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Um-hmm! Doesn’t that sound delicious at the last minute?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, y’know, but something like salmon which would be so much more
elegant than the chicken. And, you wouldn’t have to worry about the salmonella. (Ross
pushes her.) So, I can’t wait to see this place you’re getting married!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah. Yes, this place is beautiful. Emily’s parents got married
here.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I still can’t believe they’re tearing it down. It really is the
most lovely building you’ll ever see. I mean it’s over… (She stops
suddenly, when she sees that demolition has already started.) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s nice.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh. Oh. (She starts running towards the building.)
[Cut to inside.]

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (running in, with Ross) Oh. Oh my God. How can this be happening? What
are we going to do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s all right! Everything’s gonna be all right.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: How’s it gonna be all right?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh, I see that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Okay, I talked to the guy with the shovel and I found out
what happened.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They torn it down a few days early.
[Scene: Westminster Abbey, Joey and Chandler have successfully navigated the streets of
London and are approaching the Abbey.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Westminster Abbey! Hands down, best Abbey I’ve ever seen.
Hey! (Pushes Chandler in front of the camera.) Okay. What do you think of the Abbey,
Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think it’s great. It’s great. Y’know, they’re
thinking of changing the name of this place.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? To what?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: To Put the Camera Away!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, you are Westminster Crabby. (He starts chasing Chandler
towards the Abbey.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is trying to move off of the couch as Rachel
enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, honey! Don’t get up! What do you need?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, no. Oh, nothing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on! I am here to take care of you! What do you need? Anything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I have a wedgie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, that is all you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So-so, what do you want for lunch?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I don’t know. I guess we have to eat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I do. What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m just bummed about the way I left things with Ross. I
shouldn’t have lied to him about having to work. He seemed so mad at me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Eh, don’t be so hard on yourself. If someone I was still in love
with was getting married…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting) Still in love with?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not in love with Ross!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. No. No. Good! Yeah, me neither.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, I’m going to Ross’s wedding because he is my
ex-boyfriend and that would be really uncomfortable. Not because, I’m still in
love with him! I mean, hey, y’know, I like Ross as much as the next guy, y’know?
Clearly I have feelings for him, but feelings don’t mean love! I mean, I still
have loving feelings for Ross. Yeah! But, I have, I have continuing feelings of love, but
that doesn’t mean that-that I’m still in love with him. Y’know? I-I have
sexual feelings for him, but I do love him—Ohh! Oh my God! Oh my—why
didn’t you tell me?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We thought you knew!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, we all know! We talk about it all the time!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You all know? Does Ross know?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, Ross doesn’t know anything.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I can not believe you didn’t tell me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, because we thought you knew!! It’s so obvious! God, that
would be like telling Monica, "Hey, you like things clean."

scenes.location: A park in London, Joey and Chandler walk up to a souvenir stand.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: The Vendor
lines.text: So, what are you guys in the market for? We’ve got uh, scarves,
tulip post cards...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Check this out? Huh? (Joey has this big tall hat with a British flag on
the front of it.) Yeah. That’s the stuff. What do you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I don’t have to buy that, "I’m with stupid"
T-shirt anymore.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I like it. Here you go. (He pays for the hat.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, look, you’re not really gonna buy that are you?
Don’t you think you’ve embarrassed me enough for one day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I embarrass you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How can I answer that when I’m pretending I don’t know you?

lines.speaker: The Vendor
lines.text: He’s just jealous. You’ll fit right in; all Londoners wear
them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh really? Then how come no one here is wearing them?

lines.speaker: The Vendor
lines.text: (looks around) They’re all tourists.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, look, if you insist on wearing that, in public,
y’know, you’re gonna spend the rest of the afternoon all by yourself.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah? (Puts the hat on.) If you’re gonna make me choose between
you and the hat? I choose the hat.

lines.speaker: The Vendor
lines.text: Good choice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, wait. All right, that’s it, okay, I’m out of here. I
am not going to be embarrassed anymore! (He trips over a box, falls into a flower stand
and walks away trying to be cool.)

scenes.location: The hotel, Ross’s room, Emily is entering.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! I just spoke to your dad, and you know what? He seems to think
we’ll be able to find a new place for the wedding.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: We don’t have to.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-what? You found a place?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: No. But, Monica and I were talking, and-and I was so upset about the hall
being knocked down, and she suggested that we put the wedding off for a bit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She said what?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: She said, "If I’m not gonna be happy getting married somewhere
that we find in a day, well then we should just postpone it."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Postpone it? Emily, do you think Monica realises how much our parents
spent on this wedding? Do you my sister’s teeny-tiny little brain comprehends that
people took time out of their lives to fly thousands of miles to be here, huh? (He puts
his pants on backwards.) This isn’t right.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I realize that people are going to be disappointed. But, I’m sure
they’ll come back when we can do it right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t ask people to do that? Would you ask people to do that?
(Holds out his pants)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Don’t you point your pants at me! (She throws them on the floor.) We
have no choice! Anywhere that’s half-decent would’ve be booked months ago, Ross
don’t you understand? This is our wedding I’m talking about.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The only thing I understand is; postponing it is not an option. This is
when we’re getting married.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: So what are you saying? It’s now or never?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. I’m saying it’s now. (He starts putting on his pants,
backwards again.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Or?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There’s no ‘or’ in mind. What is wrong with these pants?!!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: It’s not the pants. It’s you that is backwards. And if, and if
you don’t understand how important this is to me, well then, perhaps we
shouldn’t get married at all! (She storms out.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (chasing her, trying to zip up his pants. His got them on right now.) No,
wait! Emily! No, wait, stop! Emily, please—(He catches something important in the
zipper and howls like a little boy and falls to the floor.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is on the couch as Rachel returns carrying a bunch
of shopping bags.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (depressed) Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, did shopping make you feel any better about Ross?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Manhattan does not have enough stores.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I think I can help you get over him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You can?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. I just need you to bring me some photos of Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And a small piece of chocolate.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And a glass of tepid water. (She gathers up all of these things.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, is this one of those things where you throw it in a bag with some
graveyard dirt and hang it from a north-facing tree?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh, only if you have the hiccups too. Yeah, the pictures are for you,
the water and the chocolate is for me. I just didn’t feel like getting up. Okay,
I’m gonna show you a picture of Ross. Okay? And you’re going to remember all of
the bad things about him. All right? Really focus on his flaws.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can do that. I certainly did it when we were going out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Umm, before we get started, I just wanna say for the record that I
love Ross, I think he’s such a great guy. Here. (Hands her the picture, Rachel grabs
it out of her hand.) Okay, now, close your eyes. And imagine that you’re with Ross
okay and imagine that you’re kissing him. And you’re-you’re running your
hands all over his body. And then you run your hands through his hair, but eew-oh gross
it’s some kind of grease, it’s—uck! Hah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, his uh, his hair never really bothered me that much,
and y’know it was always more crunchy than it was greasy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, this is going to be harder than I thought. Umm, let’s try
some uh, aversion therapy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So uh, now look at the picture…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, and umm… (She grabs the picture and smacks her in the
head.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, how do you feel now?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I like you less!
[Scene: Chandler and Joey’s hotel room. Chandler is watching TV as Joey returns,
still wearing his hat.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey. (He nods at the hat.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. (Takes off the hat.) Sorry!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no, y’know what? I really shouldn’t have said that you
were embarrassing me, I mean that really wasn’t cool. And if it makes you feel any
better, I’ve had a really lousy day.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Noo!! I’ve had the best day ever! Dude, check this out!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sh-shh-shh! (He motions for her to watch something he has taped.)
[Cut to the tape Joey made in front of some famous place in London with a rather famous
English-type person.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on tape) Okay, so say hi to my friend and tell him that you like the hat.

lines.speaker: Fergie
lines.text: (Yep, Sarah, the Duchess of York) Okay, so umm, what’s your
friend’s name?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on tape) Oh, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Fergie
lines.text: Hi Chandler! (Waves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s Fergie baby!!

lines.speaker: Fergie
lines.text: Joey says you don’t really like his hat, but I think it’s
kinda dashing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How did you? How? How?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I was trying to figure out how to get to Buckingham Palace, right?
So, I’m in my map and-and…(Ross enters) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi. I understand you had a little talk with Emily.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) Yes, I did! And you are welcome!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Am I?! And was it your idea to postpone the wedding?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m gonna go to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait up! (They both run to the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey-hey, since you’re the ‘fix-it’ lady, here’s a
pickle, what do you do when the bride says she doesn’t want to have the wedding at
all?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She said that?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know, I told her it was stupid to put off the wedding just
because the hall was gone and she liked flipped out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God. You’re even dumber than I am!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, how long have you been planning this wedding?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know. A month?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Emily has probably been planning it since she was five! Ever since the
first time she took a pillowcase and hung it off the back of her head. That’s what we
did! We dreamed about the perfect wedding, and the perfect place, with the perfect
four-tiered wedding cake (Starting to cry), with the little people on top. (Ross gets
thrown a box of Kleenex from the bathroom and he gives her one.) Thanks. But the most
important part is that we had the perfect guy who understood just how important all that
other stuff was.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I had no idea. And that-that pillowcase thing, I thought you guys were
just doing the flying nun.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sometimes we were.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on. You gotta help me figure out what to do. Okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on. (They leave and Chandler sticks his head out.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was pretty intense huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. (Pause) Hey, I hope Ross didn’t think that we just went in
there because we were uncomfortable being out here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (glares at him) I hope he did!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the phone rings and Phoebe answers it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Hey, Pheebs! It’s Joey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, Joey! Hey! Ooh! Ooh! I just say someone on the—that looks just
like you on the subway. And I was gonna go over and say ‘hi!’ but then I
figured, he doesn’t care if he looks like you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That just cost me four bucks. But uh listen, I just called to see how the
chick and the duck are doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, they’re having a great time with their Aunt Phoebe!
Aunt Rachel hasn’t been helpful at all. So, do you miss me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Kinda, but I’ve just been having way too much fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you’re not homesick yet?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, the seven of us miss you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who’s seven?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know, me, Rachel, the birds, the babies…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahh, the babies miss me?
(There is a knock on Rachel and Phoebe’s door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, the pizza guy’s here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? You ordered pizza without me?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. But y’know we were thinking about you, y’know we ordered
the Joey Special.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Two pizzas?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yep! Okay, gotta go, talk to you later.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait, well, where did you get it from?!
(Phoebe has already hung up, leaving Joey in the dark. So Joey decides to watch some TV
and turns on a rerun of Cheers, with the theme song playing. At first, he’s
happy, but as the song progresses Joey gets depressed and homesick.)

scenes.location: Ross and Emily’s planned wedding place, Monica is dragging Emily in.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Monica, why have you brought me here of all places?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’ll see.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I tell you, this wedding is not going to happen.
(At that Ross plugs in some Christmas lights to light the place up.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Oh God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay? But-but imagine a lot more lights, okay? And-and y’know fewer
bricks, and-and-and flowers, and candles…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And the musicians, look, they can go over here (Points to a little
alcove), okay? And the chairs can face this way (Points), and… (Points to Ross) You
go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But-but, if you don’t love this, we’ll do it in any other place
at any other time. Really, it’s fine, whatever you want.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: It’s perfect.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And, I don’t know, if it starts to rain…

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Well then we’ll get wet. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh. And I don’t even have a date.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is in her bedroom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you remember where the duck food is?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, it’s in the guys’ apartment under the sink. Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (enters with a bag packed) Because I’m going to London.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! What do you mean you’re going to London?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I have to tell Ross that I love him. Now honey, you take care, you
don’t have those babies until I get back. (Kisses her stomach.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I—Rachel, you can’t go! Ross loves Emily!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I know, I know, I know he does. But I have to tell him how I feel!
He deserves to have all the information and then he can make an informed decision.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s not why you’re going! You’re going because you
hope he’s gonna say, "Yeah, I love you too, Rach. Forget that British
chippy."

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh—Do you think he will?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Because he’s in love with the British chippy! Look, Rachel, if
you go, you’re just gonna mess with his head and ruin his wedding! Y’know,
it’s too late! You missed you’re chance! I’m sorry, I know this must be
really hard, it’s over.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know what? No. It’s not over until someone says, "I
do." (Exits)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I do! I do! I do! (Chases her into the hall, but Rachel doesn’t
stop.) I do! (Gives up.) Ugh, like I can really chase you. I’m carrying a litter.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Moving Shot towards The Waltham House. A phone is ringing.

lines.speaker: Housekeeper
lines.text: The Waltham Residence.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh...yes..is this..umm..Emily’s Parents’ house.

lines.speaker: Housekeeper
lines.text: This is the housekeeper speaking. And by the way, young lady, that is
not how one addresses oneself on the telephone. First one identifies oneself and then asks
for the person with whom one wishes to speak.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (In a British accent) This is Phoebe Buffay. I was wondering, please, if-if
it’s not too much trouble, please, umm, might I speak to Miss Emily Waltham, please?

lines.speaker: Housekeeper
lines.text: Miss Waltham, is at the rehearsal dinner and it’s not polite
to make fun of people. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No no no, I’ll be nice, I swear!!! Could you just give me the
number for where they are?

lines.speaker: Housekeeper
lines.text: I’m afraid, I’m not at liberty to divulge that information.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, somebody is on their way to ruin wedding okay. And I have to warn
somebody, alright. So if you don’t give me that number then I’m going to come
over there and kick your snooty ass all the way to New Glocken..shire.

lines.speaker: Housekeeper
lines.text: Hangs up.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hello, Hello. Ohh, OHH, she knew I could kick her ass.
[Scene: Rehearsal dinner hall. Ross and Emily are standing in the reception area.
Monica arrives with her parents.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Ross hugs his mom and dad)Hi. Mom. Dad.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Sweetheart. Oh sorry were late, my fault, I insisted on riding the
tube.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (embarrassed) Judy, the kids..

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Jack, that’s what they call the subway.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Ohh, I thought that you....

lines.speaker: Ross and Monica
lines.text: Dad, dad. We got it!! We Got It!!!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ohh, here comes my dad and stepmum. Mister and Misses Geller, this is Steven
and Andrea Waltham.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: (Shaking everyone's hand.) Hello. Hello. How do you do? How do you do?
Very nice to meet you. (Looking over at his wife.) Darling it’s the Gellers. (She
pays no attention she’s talking on a cellular phone.) (Louder) Darling, it’s the
Gellers. (She’s still not responding.) She’s very self-absorbed, you know. I
should never have married her.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: (Looking evilly at her husband) Sorry, what?

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: It’s the Gellers!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: Well there’s one (pointing towards Jack) and there’s another
(pointing towards Judy).

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Lovely to meet you.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: Terribly nice of you to offer to pay for half the wedding. (He hand a
multipage bill to Jack.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Ohh forget it. Too hell with tradition, we’re happy to do it.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: We know how expensive weddings can be, besides this may be the only
wedding we get to throw (patting Monica on the shoulder.).

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ha ha, a joke that’s funny in all countries.
(Ross quickly directs the families to their tables.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey are standing by the kitchen entrance. A waiter comes out.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Sir? (Looking at Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s in it?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Goat cheese, water chestnuts, and panchetta. (Joey Looks down disgustingly
at the food.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Looking up at the waiter)That’s not food...No, I don’t, no...(Taps
Chandler on the shoulder.) Everything's different here...I want to go home. I...I miss my
family. I miss the coffee house. I can’t even remember what Phoebe looks like.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey, it’s been three days, okay.. Your just a little homesick,
Okay. Would you just try to relax. Just, just try to enjoy yourself.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Pointing at Chandler.) Your different here too. Your mean in England.
(Chandler throws his hands up to his head in frustration. They walk away from each other.)
[Camera pans to the Geller family table. Ross, Rachel, Mr. and Mrs. Geller are there.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (Looking at ht wedding bill.) What the hell!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: what’s up, Dad?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: This bill for my half of the wedding. it’s insane.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: How could it be so much? The receptions at their house.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (Pointing items out on the bill.) Flowers, liquor, recarpet first
floor. New guest bath, landscaping. I’m paying to remodel this guys house. (Angrily
gets up.) I’m going to give that son on a bitch, a piece of my mind.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Holding him back.)Dad, dad, please. Look I don’t want anything to upset
Emily tonight. Alright, she's had a hard enough couple of days as it is. (Picks up the
bill.) Now here, here, let me go talk to him, okay?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: And you tell him no one takes advantage of the Gellers.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Ooh, Jack....(He looks over to her) Sometimes I forget how powerful
you can be. (They embrace and kiss passionately.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Looking nauseous from her parents kissing.) And I’m going to go get
drunk. (Gets up to get a drink.)

scenes.location: An airport in New York.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Running to the ticket counter) Ooh, ooh, ooh,ooh,ooh. (Slightly out of
breath) Hi.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: (Cheerfully.) Hello.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Faking cheerfulness.) Hello. Umm, when is your next flight to London?

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: (looking at her computer terminal) There’s one leaving in thirty
minutes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, good.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: And I do have one seat left.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, thank you, thank you, thank you.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: The last minute fare on this ticket is twenty seven hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking through her wallet.) Ohh, I just don’t think I have enough
left on my credit card.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: Well you can split it with another credit card.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, okay, how about five. (She hands her all the credit cards.) Ohh, thank
you.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: I’m just going to need to see your passport.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Looking through her purse.) Okay, you know what? I don’t have it, but
I can tell you exactly where it is on my night stand, and...okay. But you know what? I
have my drivers license and I have a twenty. (She slides it across the counter.)

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: (Slides the twenty back and tosses her credit card onto the counter.)
[Scene: The Rehearsal dinner hall. Ross is at the Walthams’ table discussing the
bill.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, face it, my father is not going to pay for the build-in barbecue and
believe me you can kiss you gazebo goodbye. Now I might be able to get you the new lawn.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
