lines.text: Ahh, then you have to give us the lawn ornaments.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I go back there with lawn ornaments, he’s going to laugh in my face.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: This is ridiculous. I mean we had an agreement. (Ross looks
frustrated. She begins to scream at her husband.) Will you say something, Steven?!
Please!!!

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: Don’t take that tone with me. (She looks evilly at him.) All-all
right you can. (He looks over at Ross and Shrugs.)

scenes.location: The Girls apartment. Phoebe is dialing the phone and Rachel runs in the door.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Running to her room.) Hi, Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Looking relieved. She puts down the phone.) Oh thank god. Oh, you changed
your mind. Oh, look I know you probably want to be alone, and you don’t want to talk
about it, that’s fine. I just want you to know, I think you are doing the right thing
and...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Running back out the door with her passport.) Bye, Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Trying to get up.) Wait!! Where are you going?! What are you doing?! No!!
Wait!! (Not able to get up.) God!! Why am I always pregnant when she does that?!
[Scene: The Rehearsal Dinner Hall. Chandler, Joey, Ross, Emily, Monica, and all the
bridal party are seated at the table. Chandler gets up to make a toast.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’d like to toast, Ross and Emily. Of course, my big toast will be
tomorrow at the wedding, so this is kind of my little toast or Melba toast, if you will.
(No one in the room laughs. He starts to get flustered.) Okay. I known Ross for a long
time. In fact, I knew him when he was going out with his first girlfriend. (Ross looks
embarrassed.) And I thought things were going to work out for him..Until the day he over
inflated her. (He laughs. Jack looks at Judy and no one in the room laughs.) Ohh, Dear
God.. (A cellular phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Hello, Waltham Interiors.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hi, Mrs. Waltham. I need to speak with ether one of the best men, or
Ross’s sister Monica.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Who is this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I’m Phoebe Buffay. I’m one of Ross’s best friends.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Well, if you’re on e of Ross’s best friends, why
aren’t you here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, um, I can’t fly. I’m having my brother’s babies.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Oh, am I on the radio?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No..umm, could I talk to one of them? It’s very very important.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: No, I’m bored with you now. I’m going to cut you off. (She
hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! Okay, I’m going to have to kick her ass too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Continuing his toast.) And I’m sure we’re all very excited
that Ross and Emily are getting married at Montgomery Hall. I mean to think, my friend
getting married in Monty Hall. (No reaction from the people.) Ohh, come on!! Monty Hall!!
Lets make a Deal!! Come on, you people!! All right, forget it!! Congratulations, Ross and
Emily. (He sits down.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, best man number two, Joey Tribbiani. Now I’m not good with the
jokes like Chandler here. Boy...but ahh, I just want to say congratulation to the happy
couple. I first met Ross in this coffee house back home...Home...New York City...Where
everybody knows my name. Well anyway, I love you guys. (pointing at everyone.) But not as
much as I love America. (Looking at Chandler.) Could we please..go home now?
(One of the bridesmaids, Felicity, puts her arm around Joey.)

lines.speaker: Felicity
lines.text: (Putting her arm around Joey.) Are you going home? I was hoping to get to
know you better.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Putting his arm around her.) I’m not going anywhere, sweetheart.
[Scene: Later that evening at the rehearsal dinner. Chandler and Monica are sitting on
a sofa. Chandler is covering his face in embarrassment because of the toast.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was laughing. (Patting him on the knee.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Out loud?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well I didn’t want everyone to think I was stupid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So how are you doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My mother’s driving me crazy, but Ross is getting married. I’m
happy. (A drunken man approaches.) I’m not going to let anything spoil that.

lines.speaker: Drunk Man
lines.text: I just want to say that Ross is a wonderful young man.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, thanks, we like him.

lines.speaker: Drunk Man
lines.text: My god!! You must have been a teenage when you had him. (Monica stares
straight forward after the comment. Chandler tries to console her by patting her on the
shoulder.)
(Ross and Emily’s parents are seated at a table. Ross is between them and they are
discussing the wedding bill.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: There’s no way in hell, I’m paying for it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, were down to just one point. Could we please, maybe just settle it
after the wedding.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: All-right fine, but I just want to say, I’m not paying for your
wine cellar. You thieving, would be speaking German if it weren’t for us, cheap
little man. (Emily’s stepmum looks shocked. Jack and Judy get up and leave.)
(Chandler’s trying to console Monica.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The guy was hammered, okay? There’s no way, you look like
Ross’s mother.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then why would he say it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because he’s crazy. Okay? He came up to me earlier and thanked me
for my very moving performance in Titanic.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, my mother’s right. I’m never going to get married.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahh, you know what? That is....Who wouldn’t want you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, Please?! I’m a single mom, with a thirty year old son!!

scenes.location: The airport. Rachel runs up to the ticket counter.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, I’m back. Listen, I need to...

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello. I need to get on the 11 o'clock flight.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: Oh I’m afraid that plane has already pulled away from the gate.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you know what/ You’re going to have to call that plane and tell
them to swing around and come and pick me up.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: I can’t do that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure, you know what? Come on, we’ll just tell them that there was like
a problem with like the "engine".

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: I’m afraid I’m going to have to ask you to step aside,
Miss.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, If I don’t get to London!! He is going to marry that other
girl!!!

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: I can’t imagine why.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, you know what? I am not leaving here, until you call that plane
back!! (She pounds her hand on the counter twice. The ticket agent counters by placing the
closed sign on the counter and tapping it twice.)

scenes.location: Chandlers hotel room. Ross bursts into the room.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Screaming) I’m getting married today!! Whoo-hoo!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (With the covers pulled up to his chin.) Morning, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m getting married, to..day!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah you are!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahh, whoo-hoo!!(He runs back out the door.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Comes up for below the covers and looks concerned.) Do you think he knew I
was here? (Chandler quickly looks at Monica not knowing what to say.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandlers hotel room. Chandler and Monica are lying in the bed together
talking. There’s an awkward air between them. They are both clutching the covers in
from of them.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well I’ve-I’ve never done that with you before.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (In am uneasy voice.) Nope. (She chuckles uneasily.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, ahh, how are ya? How ya...How ya... You okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yep, yep...You?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes...Yes..Uh-huh, You?(Looking over at her. She looks back.) We did you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well...I’d better get going.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yea yea, absolutely.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Scoots towards the side of the bed.) Could you not look?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t want to look.

scenes.location: The Virgin Atlantic flight to London that Rachel is on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh.(she rhythmically taps her hands on the magazine on her lap.)

lines.speaker: Passenger
lines.text: Ahh, ahh, excuse me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Passenger
lines.text: If you’re planning on doing that throughout the entire flight.
Please tell me now. So that I could that a sedative...or perhaps slip you one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. I’m sorry. I’m very sorry. Sorry. (She hums and sighs
happily.) It’s just, I’m ahh, I’m kinda excited. I’m, ahh, going to
London to ahh, tell this guy that I love him and... (He puts his headphones on to ignore
her.)

scenes.location: Joey enters his hotel room. The phone is ringing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Angrily.) Hey, were the hell have you been?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey. I spent the night out. I met this cute bridesmaid. She is so...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t want to hear about her!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahh Pheebs, you know you’re still my number one girl.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No, we have an emergency. Okay? Rachel’s coming to London.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh great!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No it’s not great. No, she’s coming to tell Ross that she loves
him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Confused.) But, he loves Emily?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I KNOW THAT!!! You have to stop her!! She’s going to ruin the
wedding!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, so, okay...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hold on. Hold on. (Picking up a note pad and writing and reading the message
aloud.) Rachel coming. Do...Something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so I’m done my part, okay. It’s your responsibility now,
okay. The burden is off me, right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So tell me about this girl?
(The guys hotel room. Joey’s there. Chandler comes out of the bathroom in a robe.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Have you seen Monica?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Very defensive.) I’m not seeing Monica.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (With a confused look on his face.) What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look we’ve got to find her. Phoebe just called!! Rachel’s coming to
tell Ross she loves him!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my god!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! That’s why we got to find Monica!! You know where she is?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!! Okay!! What’s with the third degree?! Why don’t you just
shine a light in my eyes?! (Joey looks totally confused.)
[Scene: The plane. Rachel's telling her story to the passenger on her left. The one on
her left is still wearing his headphones.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...And so then I realized. All this stuff I had been doing. proposing to
Joshua, lying to Ross about why I couldn’t come to the wedding. Was all just a way
of...

lines.speaker: Passenger
lines.text: (Frustrated he takes his headphones off.) Oh, oh oh!! I’m sorry,
can I interrupt? You know I just want to say..That you are a horrible, horrible person.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ehh, pardon me?

lines.speaker: Passenger
lines.text: You say you love this man, yet you’re about to ruin the happiest
day of his life. I’m afraid I have to agree with you friend Pheebs.. This is a..this
is a...terrible, terrible plan.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But he has to know how I feel!

lines.speaker: Passenger
lines.text: But why? He loves this...this Emily person. No good can come of this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Sighing) Well I-I think your wrong.

lines.speaker: Passenger
lines.text: Oh-no.(He bites his fist at her.)And by the way, it seems to be
perfectly clear that you were on a break. (Rachel gasps and doesn’t know what to say.
He puts his headphones back on.)
[Scene: The church where Ross and Emily are to be married. Judy, Andrea, and Monica
enter together.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (Looking around at the chapel.) Oh my God! It’s like a fairyland.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: I know, it’s horrible isn’t it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I love it. I only hope my wedding looks this good.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: I just hope...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Angrily.) You can let some of them go by!(Judy and Andrea go to the front
of the chapel. Joey approaches Monica.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Whispering.) Pisst, Monica. Alright, we really need to start looking out for
Rachel. I’ll cover the front door. You watch that big hole at the back of the
building and I got Chandler covering Ross.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Awkwardly.) Why would I care where Chandler is? You know uhh...You know
sometimes I don’t even like Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (They both walk off to watch for Rachel.)
(Ross and chandler are standing next to the alter. Ross is practicing for the wedding.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Using a slightly different inflection for each.) I do. I do. I do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yea, your right. It’s the second one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Very Nervous)Really?
[Scene: Joey’s in the front entrance watching for Rachel. The bridesmaid he met at
the rehearsal dinner come in.)

lines.speaker: Felicity
lines.text: (In a sexy voice.)Hello Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Felicity.

lines.speaker: Felicity
lines.text: Umm, I thought about you all day.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Felicity
lines.text: Um-hum. Talk New York to me again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (In a New York accent.) Fuggetaboutit. (She giggles.) How you doin?

lines.speaker: Felicity
lines.text: Mmm. (She pushes him up against the wall and they begin to kiss.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah.
(Back in the chapel. The parents are still fighting over the bill. Ross is refereeing.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: There’s nothing to discuss. We’re not paying for your wine
cellar.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: (Pleading.) You-you have to meet me in the middle here.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (Forcefully.) Hey, you keep pushing me on this, my foots going to meet
the middle of your ass.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad!! (Emily comes running in.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: What-what’s going on?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing, nothing. Everything's under control.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: You want a piece of me, sir? Is that what your saying? (Pointing at
Jack and poking him) You want a piece of me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Stepping in between them.)Okay! Okay! That’s it!! Parents!! Parents!!
Back away!! All right, this is our wedding day! From now on everyone gets along,
and if I hear one more word. NO GRANDCHILDREN! (Pointing at his mother.) That’s
right!!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Okay, okay.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: Sorry old boy, sorry. Sorry. Sorry. (Them all walk away. As he leaves
he mutters to Jack.) I could kill you with my thumb, you know.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: What was all that about?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Sighing.) It was...This disagreement over...(She sighs. Ross notices her in
her wedding dress.) My god. You...you look beautiful.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (Giggles.) Ohh...(She realizes that she’s in her gown.) Oh! You were
not meant to see me before the wedding. It’s bad luck.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what, I think we’ve had all the bad luck we’re going to
have. (He hugs her.)
(The front entrance. Joey and the bridesmaid are up against the wall kissing. Rachel
comes in the door and walks by Joey unnoticed. She walks into the chapel and sees Ross and
Emily kissing. She looks as though she wants to cry. Emily walks away and Ross turns and
sees Rachel standing there.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My God. Rachel! (He walks towards her, grasps her hands and kisses her on the
cheek.) Your here. I can’t believe it. (She giggles.) What happen? Why are you here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well I just came...(She touches him near his heart. She’s almost in
tears.) I just needed to tell you...(Looking into his eyes. She takes a deep breath.)
Congratulations. (He hugs her. She can barely hold back the tears.)
[Scene: Camera fades to one of the band members playing guitar at the wedding. The
chapel is full of guest. A groomsmen escorts a bridesmaid down the isle. Joey is waiting
with Mrs. Waltham to escort he down the isle. A cellular phone rings.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: (Answering the phone.) Hello, Waltham Interiors.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mrs. Waltham. Hi. It’s Phoebe again.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: (Throws her head back in disgust.) Why?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yea. Can I please, please, please talk to one of the best men? This is
going to be the last time I promise.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: (Slapping the phone into Joey’s chest.) Joey there’s a girl
on the phone for you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Smiling.) Ohh great!! (Putting the phone to his ear.) Hello. (He begins to
escort her down the aisle.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Did you stop Rachel?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, but it’s okay. She just came in and gave him a hug, that it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So nothing got ruined?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’s so great! Ohh, so what’s going on now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, I’m-I’m walking down the aisle...Still walking. (Mrs. Waltham
takes her place.) I’m about to pass the bridesmaid I hooked up with last night.
(Looking at the bridesmaid.) Hey! (Talking to Phoebe.) I told her "Hey." And now
I’m at the front with Ross. It’s Phoebe. (He shows Ross the phone.) He looks
pretty mad. Uh...I’d better go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No!! wait, wait, wait!! Oh please, hold it up so I can listen. (Joey looks
at Ross and holds the phone above Ross’s shoulder.)
(Chandler escorts Monica down the aisle.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What we did last night was....

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Stupid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Totally crazy stupid. (He nods his head at the people seated.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What were we thinking?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m coming over tonight though, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah. Definitely.
(They quickly take their places and Here Comes the Bride Begins to play. Everyone
seated looks back. Emily is being escorted up the aisle by her father. She kisses him on
the cheek and takes her place by Ross’s side.)

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: Friends. Family. We are gathered to celebrate here today the joyous union
of Ross and Emily. May the happiness we share with them today be with them always. Now
Emily, repeat after me. I, Emily...

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I, Emily...

lines.speaker: Minster
lines.text: Take thee Ross...

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Take thee Ross...

lines.speaker: Minster
lines.text: As my lawfully wedded husband, in sickness and in health, till death parts
us.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: As my lawfully wedded husband, in sickness and in health, until death parts
us.

lines.speaker: Minster
lines.text: Now Ross, repeat after me. I Ross...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I Ross...

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: Take thee, Emily...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Take thee, Rachel...(All his friends have looks of shock on their faces. He
realizes what he said. Quickly he says.) Emily. (A slight chuckle.) Emily.

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: (Looking and feeling awkward. he looks towards Emily.) Uhh...Shall I go
on?
(Rachel looks all around as if all the eyes in the chapel were looking at her as the
picture fades to black.)

title: The One with All the Resolutions

lines.text: [Scene: Ross’s Wedding, continued from last season, the Minister is about to marry
Ross and Emily.]

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: Friends. Family. We are gathered to celebrate here today the joyous
union of Ross and Emily. (Time lapse) Now Ross, repeat after me. I Ross...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I Ross...

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: Take thee, Emily...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Take thee, Rachel...(All his friends have looks of shock on their faces.
He realizes what he said. Quickly he says.) Emily. (A slight chuckle.) Emily.

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: (Looking and feeling awkward. he looks towards Emily.) Uhh...Shall I
go on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To the woman sitting in front of her) He-he said Rachel, right? Do you
think I should go up there?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Yes, yes, do go on.

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: I think we’d better start again. Ross, repeat after me. I,
Ross…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I, Ross…

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: Take thee, EM-I-LY…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Take thee, (Glares at the Minister) Emily. (Chuckles) Like
there’d be anybody else. (Emily is glaring at him.)

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: As my lawfully wedded wife, in sickness and in health, till death
parts us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: As my lawfully wedded wife, in sickness and in health, until death parts
us. Really, I do. Emily. (Points at her.)

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: May I have the rings? (He is given the rings) Emily, place this ring
on Ross’s finger as a symbol of your bond everlasting. (She jams the ring onto his
finger) Ross, place this ring in Emily’s hand as a symbol of the love that encircles
you forever.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Happy too.

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: Ross and Emily have made their declarations and it gives me great
pleasure to declare them husband and wife.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yay!

lines.speaker: Minister
lines.text: You may kiss the bride.
(He goes to kiss her, but she isn’t very receptive of the kiss. She keeps avoiding
him, until Ross finally gets to kiss her on her cheek.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (To Mr. Geller) This is worse than when he married the lesbian.
(The band starts to play, and the recessional starts. Ross tries to take Emily’s
hand, but she snatches it away from him.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Just keep smiling.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, that went well. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It could’ve been worse, he could’ve shot her.
(Ross and Emily make it to the lobby.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (laughs) That uh, that was pretty funny. Wasn’t it?
(Emily gives him a forearm shot across the stomach.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: The Wedding reception, Ross and Emily are in the bathroom and Emily is yelling
at him. Rachel, Chandler, Joey, and Monica are standing outside the doorway.]

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (Yelling from inside the bathroom) You’ve spoiled everything!
It’s like a nightmare! My friends and family are out there! How can I face them?! How
can you do this to me?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To the gang) Hey, no matter what happens with Ross and Emily, we still
get cake right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (exiting the bathroom) That-that-that’s all right, no honey, you take
your time sweetie. I’ll be right out here. (She slams the door in his face, to the
gang) She’s just fixing her makeup.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I hate you!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And, I love you!! (He walks into the living room)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Boy, bad time to say the wrong name, huh Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s true, thanks dad. (To All) People should be dancing! Huh? Hey,
this is a party! Come on! Joey, dance!! (He starts to dance but stops when no one else
joins him.)
(Mrs. Waltham’s phone rings and she answers it.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Yes, Waltham interiors.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (On the phone, in New York) Uh, hello, this is Ross Geller’s
personal physician, Dr. Philange.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I’ve discovered that Ross forgot to take his brain medicine,
uh, now without it, uh, in the brain of Ross, uh women’s names are interchangeable,
through-through no fault of his own.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Oh my God, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, not Phoebe, Dr. Philange. Oh no! You have it too!
(Mrs. Waltham hangs up on her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hello?
(Cut to Chandler and Monica at the buffet table.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh wow, I hope you don’t take this the wrong way but, I know we
had plans to meet up tonight and, ugh, I’m just kinda worried about what it might do
to our friendship.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know. How could we have let this happen?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Seven times!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ugh! Well, y’know, we were away…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: In a foreign, romantic country…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I blame London.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bad London! (Takes a spoon and smacks the turkey.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So look umm, while we’re st-still in London, I mean, we can keep
doing it right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I don’t see that we have a choice. But, when we’re
back home, we don’t do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Only here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know, I saw a wine cellar downstairs…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’ll meet you there in two minutes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!
(He throws down his plate and runs to the wine cellar, Monica is about to follow him
but is intercepted by Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mon, honey, I gotta ask you something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (impatiently) Now?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross said my name up there, I mean, come on, I just can’t pretend
that didn’t happen can I?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I-I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, what should I do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just uh, do the right thing. (Uses some breath spray)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Toe the line. Thread the needle. Think outside the box! (Tries to leave,
but is stopped by Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa, wait, listen, I think I’m just gonna talk to Ross about what
he think it meant.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait. Rachel, no, he’s married. Married! If you don’t realize
that, I can’t help you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you’re right. You’re right. You can’t help me.
(Cut to Mr. and Mrs. Geller.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Jack, is it all our fault? Were we bad parents?

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: (walking by) Yes.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Oh yeah, well who serves steak when there’s no place to sit, I
mean how are you supposed to eat this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what’s up? (He has solved the problem of eating the steak,
he’s eating it with his hands.)
(Cut to Monica and Chandler, Monica is running up to him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Where were you? We were supposed to meet in the wine cellar?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Forget it, that’s off.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: (drunkenly) The next tour of the wine cellar will plan in two in-in
minutes…
(Joey walks up to them.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, what are you doing? You promised Phoebe you wouldn’t eat meat
until she has the babies!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I figured we’re in another country, so it doesn’t count.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s true.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The man’s got a point.
(Cut to Rachel and Ross.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. Sorry, things aren’t working out so well.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no! It could be better, but it’s gonna be okay, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! Of course, I mean, she’s gonna get over this, y’know?
I mean, so you said my name! Y’know you just said it ‘cause you saw me there, if
you’d have seen a circus freak, you would’ve said, "I take thee circus
freak." Y’know, it didn’t mean anything, it’s just a mistake. It
didn’t mean anything. Right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! Of course it didn’t mean anything! I mean, uh well, I can
understand why Emily would think it meant something, y’know, because-because it was

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But it absolutely didn’t. (Yelling towards the bathroom) It
didn’t!! It didn’t!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (approaching) Ross, hey, the band’s ready outside for your first
dance with Emily, so…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh! Oh-oh, the band’s ready! Well, I-I-we gotta do what
the band says—I don’t care about the stupid band!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You spit on me man! (Wipes his face.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Emily is kinda taking a long time, huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Y’know when I locked myself in the bathroom at my wedding,
it was because I was trying to pop the window out of the frame.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Get the hell out of there, y’know?
(They all start laughing, and quickly stop when they realize what she just said and run
over to the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Bangs on the bathroom door) Emily? Emily? I’m coming in. (He opens
the door to reveal that the window is gone, along with Emily.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, look at that, same thing.

scenes.location: London Marriott, Monica and Chandler are walking to her room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen, in the middle of everything if I scream the word,
"Yippee!" just ignore me.
(She laughs and opens the door to reveal Rachel sitting on the bed.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, Rachel! Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, hello Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross said my name. Okay? My name. Ross said my name up there that
obviously means that he still loves me! (They both just stare at her.) Okay, don’t
believe me, I know I’m right—do you guys want to go downstairs and get a drink?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, we do. But, we have to change first.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, I want to change. And why-why don’t you go down and get us a
table?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we’ll be down in like five minutes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (elbows him) Fifteen minutes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(The phone rings and Rachel answers it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello? Oh, Pheebs! (To them) It’s Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yay…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi, so what happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Ross said my name.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I know, but I don’t think that means anything.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, Pheebs, y’know what, let’s look at this objectively all
right? Ninth grade, right? The obsession starts. All right? The summer after ninth grade
he sees me in a two-piece for the first time, his obsession begins to grow. So then…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Hey, listen, why don’t we go change in my room?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But my clothes are—ohh! (They both leave.)
(Cut to Chandler’s room, he opens the door slowly to see if Joey is there and
after seeing that he isn’t, ushers Monica into the room, closes the door, and the
security bar.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow, you look…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No time for that!
(They both start to frantically rip each other’s clothes off, but are interrupted
when Joey tries to open the door.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, dude, let me in. I got a girl out here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I’ve got a girl in here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No you don’t, I just saw you go in there with Monica!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, we’re-we’re hanging out in here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, which one of us is gonna be having sex in there, me or you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I suppose I’d have to say you!! But, what if we’re
watching a movie in here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Which we are, and-and we already paid for it. It’s My Giant!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: My Giant? I love that movie!
[Scene: Ross and Emily’s room, Chandler and Monica are still looking for a place
to do the deed.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You really think this is okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, Ross and Emily aren’t gonna use it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, it’s so beautiful. Ohh! Y’know, I-I don’t know if I
feel right about this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh Mon-Mon-Mon-Mon-look, this is the honeymoon suite. The room
expects sex. The room would be disappointed if it didn’t get sex. All of the
other honeymoon suites would think it was a loser.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!
(They both run to rip the covers off the bed, but are interrupted by Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Emily?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nope, not under here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You didn’t find her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I’ve looked everywhere!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you couldn’t have looked everywhere or else you
would’ve found her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I think you should keep looking!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, for about 30 minutes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Or 45.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow, in 45 minutes you can find her twice. (Monica smiles at that.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! For all I know, she’s trying to find me but couldn’t because
I kept moving around. No, from now on, I’m staying in one place. (He sits down on the
bed.) Right here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it’s getting late.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we’re gonna go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually, do you guys mind staying here for a while?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ugh, y’know, umm we gotta get up early and catch that plane for New
York.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, it’s a very large plane.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (disappointed) That’s cool.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But, we’ll stay here with you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks guys! (They both sit down on either side of him.) I really
appreciate this, y’know, but you don’t have to rub my butt.
(Chandler slowly takes his hand away.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Ross and Emily’s room, the next morning. Ross is now asleep and has his
head in Monica’s lap and his feet on Chandler’s lap. Monica and Chandler are
both still awake and depressed.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We have to leave for New York in an hour.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, I’ve been looking at those doors, they look pretty sound
proof, don’t you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We can’t do that that’s insane. I mean ‘A’ he
could wake up and ‘B’ y’know, let’s go for it.
(They both try to slowly extricate themselves from Ross, but there’s a knock on
the door that awakens him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Em-Emily? (Looking around for her.) Em-Emily? (He runs to the door.)
Emily! (He opens the door to reveal the Walthams standing outside.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: You can forget about Emily, she’s not with us.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: We’ve come for her things.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait, well wh-wh-wh-where is she?

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: She’s in hiding. She’s utterly humiliated. She
doesn’t want to see you ever again.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: We’re very sad that it didn’t work out between you and
Emily, monkey. But, I think you’re absolutely delicious.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: Excuse me, I’m standing right here!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: Oh yes, there you are.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, carrying an armful of those little soaps.) Hey-hey, you guys
oh hurry up, get some, there’s a whole cart outside… (Sees the Walthams and
stops.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: Goodbye Geller.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now, hold on! Hold on! (Stops him) Look, look, your daughter and I are
supposed to leave tonight for our honeymoon, now-now you-you tell her that I’m gonna
be at that airport and I hope that she’ll be there too! Oh yeah, I said Rachel’s
name, but it didn’t mean anything, Okay? She’s-she’s just a friend and
that’s all! (Rachel sits down, depressed.) That’s all! Now just tell Emily that
I love her and that I can’t imagine spending my life with anyone else. Please,
promise me that you’ll tell her that.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: All right, I’ll tell her. (To his wife) Come on bugger face!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Waltham
lines.text: (As she walks pass Ross, she pats his but.) Call me.

lines.speaker: Mr. Waltham
lines.text: You spend half your life in the bathroom, why don’t you ever
go out the bloody window!
[Scene: A 747 somewhere over the North Atlantic, Monica and Chandler are sitting in
first class, depressed.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, maybe it’s best that we never got to do it again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, it kinda makes that-that one night special. (Realizes something)
Y’know, technically we still are over international waters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m gonna go to the bathroom, maybe I’ll see you there in a
bit?
(Monica gets up and heads for the bathroom, Chandler turns to watch her go and is
startled to see Joey sitting in Monica’s seat.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh, no.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Felicity and I, we’re watching My Giant, and I was thinking,
"I’m never gonna be as good an actor as that giant." Do you think I’m
just wasting my life with this acting thing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I mean, the giant is like five years younger than me, y’know, you
think I’ll ever get there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay man. (Chandler starts to get up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But what about how much taller he is than me?
(Time lapse, Chandler is finishing his third little bottle of booze.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I mean, there’s no way I can make myself taller now, y’know? And
who knows what science will come up with in the future, but Chandler, what if I die an
unsuccessful, regular sized man?
(Monica returns.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Monica, wow you’ve been in the bathroom for like a half-hour.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Had the beef-tips, huh?
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is eating cereal from a bowl she has balanced on
her stomach as Joey, Chandler, and Monica return.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!
(They all hug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Joey) You ate meat! (Joey is shocked) (To Chandler and Monica) You
had sex! (They’re shocked.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No we didn’t!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know you didn’t, I was talking about Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, I did not have sex.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This pregnancy is throwing me all off.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I’m gonna go say hi the chick and the duck.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, me too!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why would you need to say hi to them, you’ve been feeding them for
four days?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh right, maybe I’ll just go home.
(She grabs her bag and leaves, Joey moves a little quicker to his apartment, leaving
Monica and Chandler alone.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, we certainly are alone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Good thing we have that, ‘Not in New York’ rule.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Right. Umm, listen since we’re-we-re on that subject, umm, I just
wanted to tell you that uh, well, I-I was going through a really hard time in London, what
with my brother getting married and that guy thinking I was Ross’s mother…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, an-anyway, I just—that night meant a lot to me, I guess
I’m just trying to say thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh. Y’know, that night meant a lot to me too, and it wasn’t
because I was in a bad place or anything, it just meant a lot to me ‘cause,
you’re really hot! Is that okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) That’s okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I’m cute too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And you’re cute too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you! (They hug.) All right, I gotta go unpack.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye.
(After he closes the door, Monica starts to follow him, but thinks better of it and
stops.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) I’m still on London time, does that count?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That counts!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, good! (They start kissing.)
[Scene: An airport in London, Ross is waiting for Emily to show up to go on their
honeymoon and sees Rachel walking past.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach! Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she stops and turns) Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi! What are you, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I-I-I’ve been on Standby for a flight home for hours.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, so no sign of Emily huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So umm, what time are you supposed to leave?

lines.speaker: Gate Agent
lines.text: (On the P.A.) This is the last call for Flight 1066 to
Athens. The last call.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pretty soon I guess.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just, I don’t understand, I mean, how-how can she do this?
Y’know, what, am I, am I like a complete idiot for thinking that she’d actually
show up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, you’re not an idiot, Ross. You’re a guy very much in love.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Same difference.

lines.speaker: Gate Agent
lines.text: (On the P.A.) All ticketed passengers for Flight 1066 to
Athens should now be on board.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I get it! Well, that’s that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, you know what, I think you should go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I do. I think you should go, by yourself, get some distance, clear
your head, I think it’d be really good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I don’t, I don’t, I don’t know…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on Ross! I think it would be really good for you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I could, yeah, I can do that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t, I can’t even believe her! No, y’know what, I am, I
am gonna go!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, why not?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know—thanks! (They hug)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I’ll see you back at home, if I ever get a flight out of
here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well…nah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Wait, what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why don’t you come, I mean, I-I have two tickets, why not?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well-well, I don’t know Ross—really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, it’ll be great! You can, you can lay on the beach and I
can cry over my failed marriage. See-see how I make jokes?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No really, I mean, I mean, God, I could use a friend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow, uh okay, uh maybe. Umm, yes, I can do that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Cool!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on! (They go to the jetway, Ross hands the tickets to the gate
agent.) Here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, okay, we’re going. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah! Ah! I forgot my jacket!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, wait-wait-wait…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You tell them to wait!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Wait! Wait!
(Ross retrieves his jacket and sees that not only has Emily arrived, but she as seen
Rachel take her place on the plane.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emily.
(She stares at him and Ross realizes what she’s thinking.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no-no-no! Oh-no! (Emily starts to run out and Ross chases her.) No! No!
Emily!
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Flight 1066 to Athens, Rachel is ordering a drink for Ross and herself.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahh, yes, I will have a glass of the Merlot and uh, (points to
Ross’s seat.) he will have a white wine spritzer. Woo! (Looks out the window.) Hey,
look at that, the airport’s moving. (Realizes that that’s not how it works.)
Hey, are we moving?! Are we moving? Why are we moving? Hey, time-out, umm, yeah, does the
captain know that we’re moving? (Sits back in defeat.) Oh my God. Oh, my gosh.

title: The One with All the Kissing

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's Bathroom, Chandler and Monica are sharing a candlelight
bubble bath while drinking champagne and they clink their glasses.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You look cute in bubbles.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ehh, you're just liquored up.
(They move into kiss but are interrupted by Joey knocking on the door.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, it's me! I'm comin' in!
(Monica quickly dives under the water as Joey enters. He looks a little shocked at what
Chandler's doing.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I've had a very long, hard day.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahh, I'm gonna go get some chicken. Want some?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahh, no thanks. No chicken, bye-bye then.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.
(Joey turns to leave but stops at the door.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You sure? Some extra crispy? Dirty rice? Beans?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: For the last time no! Get out! Get out, Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right!
(Joey leaves and Monica comes up for air.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you okay? I'm so sorry, he wouldn't leave. He kept asking me about
chicken.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chicken? I could eat some chicken.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Joe!
(Monica goes back underwater as Joey re-enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, can I get a 3-piece, some cole slaw, some beans, and a
Coke-(Yelps in
pain as Monica grabs him underwater)-Diet Coke.
(Joey gives him a thumbs up and heads for the chicken.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler, Joey, and Monica are eating breakfast.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mornin' Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I have to tell you this story. Okay, I was coming over here and this
driver…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (interrupting) Was his name Angus? (Monica and Chandler laugh.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, he was this cab driver we had in London.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Ha-ha-ha. All right, anyway…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, what that place, that pub he took us too?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, The Wheatsheaf.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah-yeah, and they had that beer! That uh…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bodington's!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Bodington's! Woohoo! (And they all high-five each other.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh! Ahh, Pheebs, was gonna tell a story.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, so, he had a really funny hat—I don't want to talk about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Ross, Bodington's!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! (They high-five.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That was good beer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'know, I'd walk back to London for another frosty one of those bad
boys.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know, I think they have those at that British pub near the trade center.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Later! (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Isn't Rachel supposed to be back by now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but her plane got delayed in Athens. But actually, (Checks watch)
she should be here by now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, so-so you talked to her. Did she, did she sound mad?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, but she likes me. You abandoned her on a plane to Greece.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I did not abandon Rachel! Okay? Emily showed up at the
airport! I had to go after her! I mean, I-I did what I had to do! She's my wife!
Rachel is my wife! Y'know—Emily! Emily, is my wife! Man, what is that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you still hadn't heard from Emily?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, not since I lost her at the airport.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe she can out run you man!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: HEY, SHE'S FAST!! OKAY?!! (Chandler is so shocked at Ross's
outburst that he drops his spoon and backs up) Oh! You-you think you can be beat
me? Let's go! Outside!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey! (They all go hug her, except for Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, Rach, I am so sorry. I am so-so sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ross, come on! You just did what you had to do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's it? You're not mad? I mean, it must've been terrible.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Terrible? Hell, I was in Greece! That was a nice hotel! Nice beach, met
the nice people. Not to shabby for Rachel. (Goes and puts her luggage away.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, what? That's it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, yeah! We're cool. Totally cool.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thanks. Oh, you're the best. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, you're the best.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (breaking the hug) Ohh, I gotta go to the flower store! (Runs to the
door.) Check it out, no one will tell me where Emily is, so I'm gonna send 72 long-stem,
red roses to Emily's parent's house, one for each day that I've known and loved her. That
oughta get her talking to me again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, Ross, when you make out card; be sure to make it out to, EM-I-LY.
(Ross bangs his fists together to tell Chandler off, like what was learned last season.
Read about it here.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, that's great! It's so good that you had a good time in Greece!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! I didn't have a good time in Greece! Ross abandoned me! Okay, I
couldn't get a plane out, so I had to stay in their honeymoon suite with people coming up
to me all the time going, "Oh, Mrs. Geller, why are you crying?" I mean, it was
sooo humiliating. I felt like such an idiot! I mean, it's all my fault! And you know why,
because I make very bad decisions.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that's not true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes it is! It is true! I went, I went after Ross in stupid London.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: London is stupid! Stupid!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, you were right. I should've never gone to London, and from now
on you make all of my decisions for me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh… No, I did that for someone once and I'm not comfortable having
that kind of power and control over someone's life.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll do it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's fine. So Monica, you are now in control of my love life.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I gotta go to work.
(He gets up and gives Monica a rather passionate kiss as Rachel and Phoebe look on in
amazement. After the kiss ends, Chandler suddenly realizes what he just did, so he decides
to do something rather rash.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And uh, Rachel, glad to have you back.
(He goes over and gives Rachel the same treatment he gave Monica, only Rachel is
shocked.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs! (He goes over and kisses Phoebe, who is also stunned.) Always
a pleasure. (And he struts out leaving the girls to stare at each other.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica, Rachel, Chandler and Joey are there looking at pictures
from the trip to London.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Rachel, sweetie, look, here's a really cute picture of Joey and you
at the reception.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, he's married! Ross is married. I can't—I still can't believe
it. (Rachel grabs the picture from Monica)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, sweetie, by the edges.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean, y'know I'm just gonna have to accept it (She grabs the rest of
the pictures)…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh. (Monica covers her eyes in horror.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …I mean it's my fault.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sweetie! Edges! Fingers! Smudgey! Pictures!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! (She licks the top picture and hands them back.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. That's okay. I-I know that you're very upset right now. I know, I
know that wasn't about me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) I bet it was about her a little.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: If you would stop thinking about Ross for one minute you would notice
that there are great guys everywhere! I mean, look! Look, Gunther! (Gunther turns to
listen in.) I mean, he's nice, he's cute.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I guess Gunther is kinda…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Interrupting) Oh, what about that guy over there? (She points at
another guy and Gunther is deflated.) Remember? That is the guy you flirted with at
the counter that time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I don't know. I don't know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're going to talk to him! Y'know what? We made a deal, I make your
decisions and I say you're going to talk to him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, you're the boss. I guess I gotta do what you tell me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Say that to him and you're golden. (She just glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We got out pictures back from London. (Shows her one.) Here's all of us
at the Tower of London.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Grabs the pictures) Oh! Here we all are! Yeah, there's Ross and
Joey and you and me. (She picks up a magic marker and draws herself in. Monica can't
watch.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, y'know what, we've been talking about London too much
haven't we?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. I'm sorry. It's just 'cause I couldn't be there. 'Cause all I ever
get to do now is pregnant stuff, it just bums me out.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Sorry.
(Rachel returns.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y'know, a little of this, a little of that. Got myself a date
tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See, didn't I tell you?! You're getting over Ross already!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well…
(Gunther goes up to the guy and holds a sign that reads, "We reserve the right to
refuse service to anyone.")

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (To the guy) Get out!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler enters to find Monica waiting patiently for him.
He closes the door and they start kissing.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What took you so long?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I got caught up and work, but I'm quitting tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, good.
(They start kissing and turn around so that Chandler is facing the door. And Chandler
sees Rachel, Phoebe, and Joey walk in and quickly ends the kiss with Monica.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, thanks for having me over! Rach. (Goes over, grabs her, and kisses
her.) Pheebs. (After a moment while he decides how to kiss her around her belly, grabs her
and kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Jumping out of his way) See ya!! (To the girls.) What the hell was that?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Probably some y'know, European good-bye thing he picked up in London.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's not European!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it felt French.
(Joey is intrigued.)
[Scene: The hallway between the apartments, Rachel is returning from her date with
Dave.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, I really had a good time!

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: Yeah, me too. (They reach her door.) So, I guess this is it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Umm, unless you wanna come inside?

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Oh, uh, wait a minute, y'know what? I uh, I can't decide this.
Umm, okay, just hold on a second.

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: Okay, yeah!
(She enters the apartment, leaving Dave in the hallway, to find Ross sitting on the
couch with a big box.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is Monica around? I-I have to ask her something.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She's doing her laundry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What's that? (Points to the box.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It came in the mail today, it's uh, 72 long-stemmed red roses, one for
each day that I've known and loved Emily, cut up into mulch!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, honey that's awful.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, it's not so bad. Monica's gonna make potpourri! I think I'm gonna go
wander out in the rain for a while.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But, it's not raining.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't catch a break!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know what Ross? You're not going anywhere. You're gonna sit right
here. I'm gonna make you a cup of tea and we're gonna talk this thing whole out. All
right? (She goes out to talk to Dave) Hey, Dave!

lines.speaker: Dave
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, listen, I'm gonna need to take a rain check, my roommate is just
really sick. Okay? Bye! (She goes back in to talk to Ross.) Honey, listen, I know, I know
things seem so bad right now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Poking her head in) Rach? Can I talk to for just a minute? I-I dropped
some socks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. (She goes out to join her in the hall and starts looking for the
dropped socks.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is the matter with you?! Do you want to fall into the trap? Do you
want to fall into the trap?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! You did not drop any socks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just ran into Dave and he told me that you blew him off! I mean, you
listen to me! Now, I'm calling the shots! I say you leave Ross alone and go get Dave! What
the hell were you trying to do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, ultimately, I was trying y'know, I-I wanted…tell him y'know,
that I'm still in love with him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Gasps) What?!! You cannot tell him that!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why? Why not?! People love to hear that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I make the decisions, and I say no.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y'know what, no, you do not make my decisions because y'know what,
you're fired.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You can't fire me. I make your decisions and I say,
"I'm not fired!" Ha!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well… (At a loss for words, she grabs some of Monica's laundry and
throws it on the floor as a diversion to allow Rachel to run back inside and close the
door. Monica chases her to find that Rachel had locked the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel!! Come on! Let me in!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Poking his head out.) Havin' some trouble?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel locked the door.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'll kick that door in if you give me a little sugar.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The hallway, continued from earlier. Monica is still locked out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel! Let me in! Rachel!
[Cut to inside the apartment, Ross decides to let Monica in and goes over and opens the
door in mid-pound.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you. Rachel, can I talk to you outside for a sec?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I really need to talk to you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, then talk!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I will. Remember that thing that we just discussed that you wanted
to do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What thing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, Rachel wants to take swing dance lessons. Which I think is a
really stupid idea! It's dangerous, she's never gonna get what she wants, and who knows
who she might (Turns to look at Ross) end up hurting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica's right, swing dancing can be tricky. I'm gonna use the phone. I
gotta cancel those five giant teddy bears I sent to Emily. (Looks at the rose mulch.) My
God, think of the massacre.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm gonna do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, Rachel, I know-I know you think I'm crazy, please, before you
tell him you love him, just-just try to find one person who thinks this is a good idea.
Because I bet you, you can't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, fine.
(There's a loud bang on the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, I'm in!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (In tremendous pain) All right. Good deal.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey, Chandler, Monica, and Rachel are there as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Pheebs! Hey Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, okay, Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm, y'know how the other day you were talking about how you didn't get to
go to London and how you were kinda feeling left out?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, well, we felt really bad about that so we decided we should all
take a little trip together!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, that's so nice! How great! Well, where? Where's the trip?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, we thought we would all go to a picnic (Phoebe gasps), in Central
Park!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (excited) Central…(not so excited) Park!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, all of us! All day!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That sucks! That's not a trip! I just came from the park! What are we
gonna high five about at the stupid Central Park? "Well, it's right by my house, all
right!"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I'm gonna go home and bask in the triumph of my Central Park
idea. (Gets up to leave.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stopping him) Hey-whoa-whoa-whoa!! Ho-ho-hold on a sec there, Mr.
Kissey! Y'know, I've been meaning to talk to you about this whole, little, new European
thing you got going on, and I just need to tell you that it makes me very uncomfortable
and I just—y'know—stop it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was just trying to bring a little culture to the group.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's fine, just don't bring it in my mouth.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Makes me wanna puke! (Chandler looks at her, quizzically.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Rachel, Monica, Chandler, and Joey are there as Ross enters with
Phoebe.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey everybody, Pheebs is here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, woo!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, woo! Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, Pheebs, we decided the picnic idea was a little… Y'know, it
didn't have any… It-it, well it blew. So, we thought, that this afternoon that we
would all go away for the whole weekend to, Atlantic City!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, Atlantic City! Oh, that's a great plan! Who's plan was that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mine!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait! It was my plan.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nooo, I said we needed a new plan.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And, I came up with Atlantic City.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Which, is the new plan!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, well, why don't we all meet upstairs in an hour?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! Ooh-ahh, I'm gonna go pack. I'm gonna go pack my ass off!
(They all go pack except for Ross.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on Rach, let's go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, y'know what? I'm-I'm gonna meet you upstairs in a minute.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Rachel, you didn't find anyone so you can't tell him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y'know what, that doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Rachel, do you have any idea how painful it is to tell someone
that you love them and not have them say it back?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I-I don't care.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. I-I can't watch. (Leaves as sits down to read the paper.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What 'cha readin'?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The paper.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, what's it about?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Events from around the globe.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Uhh, Ross, y'know what, there's something that I-that I have to
talk to you about and everybody's saying that I shouldn't tell you, but I think they're
wrong. I mean, and you know how people can be wrong.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure. Once, at work I-I thought carbon dating was fossilized…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, Ross, I'm really trying to tell you something here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, okay, I think I'm-I'm just gonna-just gonna say it. Just gonna say
it. Uhh, (pause) I'm still in love with you Ross.
(Ross is stunned.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow. Umm… Huh… I'm-I'm not sure what to do with that right now.
(Rachel starts laughing hysterically.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What? Was that a joke? 'Cause it's mean.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Laughing) I'm so dead serious. I'm totally serious.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why are you laughing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because (laughs), because, I just heard it. I heard it, and it's
ridiculous! I mean, you're married. You're-you're married and it's just ridiculous, and
it's like, it's like when said it, I sort of like, I floated up out of my body, y'know?
And, and-and then I heard myself say it and then the floating Rachel (laughs) was like,
"You are such an idiot!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, well I am married. Even though I haven't spoken to my wife
since the wedding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) I'm sorry, that's not funny.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually, it kinda is. My wife won't return my calls. I don't know where
my wife is. (Laughs) "Hey Ross, where's the Mrs.?" Don't know!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, ohh, okay, y'know what, do you think ah, do you think that you
just forget that I told you this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I kinda half to. I mean, because the thing is…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The thing is y'know, that you're married to Emily.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That is what the thing is.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, things aren't gonna be weird between us, right? I mean was that
just the stupidest thing, me telling you that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No. No, I'm-I'm glad you did. Look, if nothing else, it's-it's always
great when someone tells you they love you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's what I said! Thank you for being so nice. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No thank you for… Thank you.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the gang is about ready to leave for Atlantic City.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, let's go!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Atlantic City!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Atlantic City, baby! Let's roll some bones! Hey Joey, high-five for
rolling bones!
(They high-five and howl, but Phoebe suddenly stops and the guys gasp and retreat in
shock.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, Pheebs, you're leaking?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! You're water broke!

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. Well, don't worry, I call shotgun! (She starts out the door.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa! Wait-wait!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs! We have to take you to the hospital now!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, Pheebs, the babies are coming now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: High-five, the babies are coming! (They all high-five.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, wait, remember when my water broke? (They all high-five again.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: The hallway between the apartments, they are taking Phoebe to the hospital but
Chandler and Monica hold back.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe Phoebe's gonna have her babies!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, it's beautiful. Amazing.
(They both kiss.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what else I can't believe? I had to kiss Phoebe and Rachel
every time I left a room, I mean it's too bad they didn't see us having sex.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you know anything about women?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's all right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (They kiss again.)

title: The One Hundredth

scenes.location: The Hospital, Phoebe is arriving with Ross, Joey, and Rachel in tow.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to the nurse) Hi.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi, yeah, hi! I'm umm, Phoebe Buffay, and I have babies coming out of
me.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Okay. Have you started having contractions?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not yet. Umm, I heard they really hurt, do they hurt?

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Well…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Now, which of you is the father? (Points to Joey and Ross)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, none of them are the father. The father is my brother.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: (not sure what to do with that) Okay…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am so gonna miss watching you freak people out like that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, uh Pheebs, quick. Look! This (His video camera) is for the babies to
look at someday, so is-is there anything you want to say? Y'know before it all starts?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, umm, hi kids! Um, it's me, Aunt Phoebe. I can't wait to see
you. Please don't hurt me!
(Monica and Chandler come running in.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what took you guys so long? Your cab left when ours did!
(There's a pause as they figure out what to say.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, we-we had to go back because I forget my jacket.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's right.
(Both Rachel and Ross stare at her for a moment.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You-you're not wearing a jacket.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh man! I did it again!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (standing up) Okay, so umm, somebody has to call Frank and Alice. (As
she is talking Joey is sticking the camera under her skirt.) And then my mom wants to
know-(notices Joey)-Joey, what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I gotta get the before shot!
(She shakes her head no.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: The delivery room, Rachel and Ross are entering.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, Pheebs? Okay, so just spoke to the nurse and the reason that your
doctor is late is because uh, she's not coming.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Apparently she fell in the shower and hit her head.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, she's so stupid!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, Pheebs-Pheebs, it's gonna be okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's easy for you to say, I don't see three kids coming out your
vagina!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, listen, y'know what? The nurse said the doctor is wonderful.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, he's head of the department.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right—Ooh! Oh dead God, save me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm having my first contraction!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, it's not bad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! (In an announcer type voice) And so the miracle of life begins, and
aaiiyyyeeee! (He grabs his side and doubles over in pain.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! You okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, something hurts!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, it's sympathy pains. Ohh, that's so sweet!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are they? I didn't know I cared that much.
(The doctor, Dr. Harad, enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Hi! Phoebe, I'm Dr. Harad, I'm going to be delivering your babies. I
want you to know, you're gonna be in good hands. I've been doing this for a long time.
I'll be back in a minute to do your internal, in the meantime, just relax because
everything here looks great. And also, I love Fonzie. (Exits)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did he just say, he loves Fonzie?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's what it sounded like.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right…

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Hey! Am I late? Am I late? Nobody came out yet, right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no-no! We haven't started yet. Where's Alice?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Uh, Delaware. She's on her way though, so until she gets here, I'm gonna
be your coach. But don't worry, she told me all about the la-Mazada stuff.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, that's when if you get the babies out by the end of the month,
they give you 2% financing.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah.

scenes.location: The waiting room, Monica and Joey are sitting there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Monica? You gonna be very proud of me. I just got us dates
with two unbelievably cute nurses.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They're male nurses.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not in my head.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anyway, they want to take us out Saturday night! What do you say?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm. (Looks at Chandler who is using the phone.) Umm. Umm. I don't think
so.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What are you talking about?! You-you're the one who's been telling
me to get over Ross and move on. I'm moving on, and you're moving on with me. Come on,
give me one good reason why you don't wanna go.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, why don't you give me something that would be a good reason
and-and then I'll tell you if it's true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Harder than it sounds. Isn't it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
