lines.text: Okay, you're coming with me, and I also told them that if we're still
here when they get off that we'll go down to the cafeteria and have some Jell-O
with them.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in a sexy voice) Yep! There's always room for Jell-O…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, how do you make that dirty?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it's easy. Yeah, I-I can do it with anything. Watch uh, (snaps his
fingers and in a sexy voice) Grandma's chicken salad…

scenes.location: The delivery room, Chandler, Frank, and Ross are with Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Ross! Get a shot of this. (He's carrying an issue of the USA
Today and hands Ross the camera.) Hey babies! These are the headlines on the day you
were born! Okay, now girl baby turn away and boy babies… (Throws the paper away to
reveal a copy of Playpen, which is the TV version of Playboy Magazine.) Check it
out, huh?! This is what naked women looked like the month you were born. All right, now
let's dive right into the good stuff. (Joey opens the magazine and Ross sticks the camera
in it.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, I'm having another one! This one doesn't hurt either—Ooh,
yes it does! Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow! Ooh! (Checks under the blanket.) Oh, I was kinda hoping that
was it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, where are Monica and Rachel anyway?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, a couple of nurses asked them out. Maybe they're with them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? Male nurses?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I was bummed too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So they're going on dates? When?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think Saturday—(groans in pain again).

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: (To Phoebe) What's with him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, sympathy pains. I thought it was really sweet at first, but now I
think he's just trying to steal my thunder.

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: (entering) Okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Let's see what we got here. Ohh, y'know, Fonzie dated triplets.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This-this Fonzie person you keep referring too, is that uh, is that
another doctor?

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Oh no-no-no. Fonzie is the nickname of Arthur Fonzerelli. The Fonz.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right.
(Dr. Harad exits.)

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: It's not that weird, is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's very weird! I don't want some guy down there telling me, I'm
y'know, dilatedamundo!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: To be fair, he doesn’t seem to be impersonating Fonzie…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting) What are you doing?!! Why are you defending him?! Just
get me another doctor! One who is not crazy and who is not Fonzie!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Again, it's not that he…
(Phoebe fakes pain to get Ross looking for another doctor.)

scenes.location: The waiting room, Chandler is looking for Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (spotting her) Oh-hey-hey-hey! There you are!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, listen there's something I think you should know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, is this about you-you dating the nurse? Yeah, Joey already told
me, and I am so-so fine. I mean, you and I we're just, y'know, we're nothing, we're
goofin' around.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, actually I was about to tell you that I was, I was going to get out
of it, but hey, if we're just goofing around then uh, maybe I will go out with him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine! Maybe I will too!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering from the elevator caring gifts for the kids) Hey, you guys! Look
what I found in the giiiiiiift shop. (He doubles over in pain in front an old man in a
wheel chair.) Get up! Get up! Get up! (The old man waves him away.)
[Scene: The delivery room, Ross has returned with another doctor. This one, is well,
younger.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, Phoebe, this Dr. Oberman. He has no strong feelings about Fonzie or
any of the Happy Days gang.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi! And you're going into what grade?

lines.speaker: Dr. Oberman
lines.text: Umm, I'm actually a first year resident, but I get that a lot, you
see, I-I graduated early…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting) Uh-huh, me too. Ross, maybe I should've specified that
I'd be needing a grown up doctor.

lines.speaker: Dr. Oberman
lines.text: Oh no, I'm fully qualified to…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shh! Doogie, shh! Doesn't anybody understand that I'm gonna be having
babies soon? Huh? Go! Go little boy, go!
(He runs out and Frank watches him go.)

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Oh cool! You made him cry!
[Scene: Another hospital room, Joey has now been admitted and his doctor is about to
break the bad news to him, Monica, and Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Joey's Doctor
lines.text: Mr. Tribbiani, I'm afraid you've got kidney stones.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm, well, what else could it be?

lines.speaker: Joey's Doctor
lines.text: It's kidney stones.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or?

lines.speaker: Joey's Doctor
lines.text: Kidney stones!

scenes.location: The delivery room, Dr. Harad is back and checking on Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: All right, you're getting there. Oh, and y'know, these babies are
very, very lucky.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They are. Why?

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: They have the honor of being born on The Fonz's half-birthday.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Happy birthday!

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Just-just to clarify, I'm not Fonzie. (Phoebe nods in agreement as he
leaves.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, y'know I just gotta tell you, I think this is such a terrific
thing you're having these babies for Frank and Alice.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, it is.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Can I tell you a little secret?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I want to keep one. (Giggles in excitement.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, I'm gonna be on the news!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The delivery room, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, Phoebe, honey, you gotta be kidding. I mean, you know you
cannot keep one of these babies!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why not?! Maybe I can, you don't know!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! Yes! Yes, I do! I do know! Frank and Alice are gonna want to keep all
of their children!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe not! Y'know? Seriously, three babies are a handful maybe they're
y'know, looking for a chance to unload one of them. Listen, I-I hate to miss an
opportunity just because I didn't ask! Y'know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, no! This is, this is insane.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, just ask him!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Me?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can't ask him! Do you have any idea how inappropriate that
would be?! All I'm saying is just talk to Frank. Okay? Just, y'know, feel him out!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Forget it! I am not gonna ask Frank to give you one of his
kids!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're right.
(There's an awkward silence then suddenly Phoebe gets an idea.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Tell him it's for you.

scenes.location: Joey's room, his doctor, Chandler, and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Feeling a little better sweetie?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, maybe a little. I wish you hadn't seen me throw up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey! I just heard. What's up?

lines.speaker: Joey's Doctor
lines.text: Kidney stones! Now, ordinarily Mr. Tribbiani, we try to break up
the stones up with shock waves, but they're to close to the bladder now. Which means we
can either wait for you to pass them or else go up the urethra…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (interrupting) Whoa-whoa! No-no-no-no-no, nothing is going up! Okay? Up,
up is not an option—what's a urethra? (Monica whispers what it is in his ear.) Are
you crazy?!

scenes.location: The delivery room, Rachel and Frank are there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) So did you ask him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I haven't had a chance to be alone with him yet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I'm kinda on a clock here.

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: (laughing) Oh Fonzie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know who I always liked? Mork.
(Dr. Harad drops what he's doing and stares at her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Undo it. Undo it. Undo it.

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Fonzie met Mork. Mork froze Fonzie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but umm… Yes, but, Fonzie was already cool, so he wasn't
hurt, right?

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Yeah, that's right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering with Chandler) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Phoebe) How are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, doctor says any minute now.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Hey, y'know, Alice is gonna be here so soon, you couldn't just like do me
a favor and like, like hold them in?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sorry Frank, I'm kinda in the middle of the last favor you asked me to
do.
(A male nurse enters.)

lines.speaker: Male Nurse
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Male Nurse
lines.text: Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, this is Dan (points to him), one of the guys that we're gonna be
going out with on Saturday. (Mouths "He's yours." to her.) Uh Dan, Monica.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello Dan! I'm really looking forward to Saturday night! Really,
really!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So Dan, nurse not a doctor huh? Kinda girlie isn't it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler!

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Nah that's okay. I'm just doing this to put myself through medical school.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: And it didn't feel so girlie during the Gulf War.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure. (Pause) And listen, thanks for doing that for us, by the way.
(Retreats in defeat.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, why wait 'til Saturday, are you free tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Sure! I'll get somebody to cover my shift.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, great!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to another female nurse) Hey, how 'bout it? You, me, Saturday night?

lines.speaker: Delivery Room Nurse
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right. Very good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oo, this is a big one. Eww! Arghhhh!!
[Cut to Joey's room, who's going throw his own contractions. Plus, he has Ross in a
headlock.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, get these things out of me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Breathe! Breathe! Breathe throw the pain.
(Joey starts breathing hard)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I want the drugs Ross, I want the drugs! (He starts rocking back and
forth, taking Ross with him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I do too! I do too!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Argh!

scenes.location: The waiting room, Frank is on the phone as Rachel approaches.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah, I love you. Okay, bye! (To Rachel) Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: That was Alice's mom, she said she left five hours ago. She should be
here by now!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, honey, don’t worry. She's gonna make it on time.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. So Frank, three babies. Whew, that just seems like a lot, huh?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: (laughs) Not to me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, fair enough.
[Scene: The delivery room, later on, Rachel, Chandler, Monica, and Frank are there as
Dr. Harad is checking out Phoebe.]

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Okay, you're at ten centimeters. Time to start having some babies.
All right, I want only the father in here please.
(They all kiss her and wish her luck.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye Dan!

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Uh, bye Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye, momi-moo.
(Everyone except Frank leaves.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: All right, I need a clamp, sterile towel, and channel 31.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What is that?
(Dan turns on the TV and the Happy Days theme song comes on.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Oh, no-no-no, it's a good one! Fonzie plays the bongos. All right,
are you ready? It's time to start pushing.
[Cut to Joey's room, his doctor and Ross are there.]

lines.speaker: Joey's Doctor
lines.text: Are you ready? It's time to try peeing. (Joey makes a face like
he is trying to pee.) Wait-wait-wait-wait-wait! It's almost time to try peeing.
(Points at the bottle Joey is to pee into.)
[Cut to the delivery room.]

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Okay, now push! That's it push! Just concentrate on pushing! Yeah,
here we go!

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I see the head.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yes, it has a head!

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: All right. Keep pushing! Come on!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: I can't believe there's somebody coming out of you right now. There's
somebody coming out of you! Is it? Is it? It's my son.

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: All right. Here's your first baby.
[Cut to the waiting room, a triumphant Frank rushes in.]

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: YESSSSS!!!!! We got a baby boy!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Frank Jr. Jr.!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, how does he look? How does he look?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: So gross! (He runs back to the delivery room.)
[Cut to the delivery room, Phoebe is about to give birth to the middle kid.]

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: Okay. You ready to push again?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I already had a baby. Leave me alone.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Okay, okay, come on, you can do it. You can do it!
(Phoebe screams in pain, and Frank screams with her.)
[Cut to the waiting room, a twice triumphant Frank returns.]

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah!! Little Leslie is here! We got another one! Oh my God, I can't
believe I have two-two children. How scary is that? (He returns to the delivery room.)
[Cut to the delivery room, Phoebe is at it for the last time.]

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Come on little Chandler, it's time to be born. Come on little Chandler!
Come on!

lines.speaker: Dr. Harad
lines.text: All right, he's coming. He's coming!
(They both stare at the newborn.)

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Hey, where's his thing?
[Cut to the waiting room, a thrice triumphant Frank returns again.]

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Chandler's a girl!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh God, kindergarten flashback.

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: They musta read the sonogram wrong. 'Cause they, 'cause they thought it
was a boy, but Chandler's a girl! Chandler's a girl!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, keep saying it!

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: (running in from the elevator) Am I too late?!

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: No-no ah, everything's okay. Everybody's healthy there's 30 fingers and
30 toes.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: We have our babies?

lines.speaker: Frank
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: (Starting to cry) Oh, we have our babies.
(They hug. And quickly that hug turns into a heated make out session, right there on
the waiting room couch. Chandler, Rachel, and Monica quickly make their exits.)

scenes.location: Joey's room, he is recovering from his birth.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You did it, man.

lines.speaker: Joey's Doctor
lines.text: Would you like to see them? (He hands Joey a little jar.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They're so small! (Both he and Ross look at them with satisfied looks on
their faces.)

scenes.location: A hallway, Monica and Dan are talking.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: So, I'll call you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great!
(Dan leaves as Chandler enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, are you really gonna go out with that nurse man?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well uh, you and I are just goofing around, I thought, why not goof
around with him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I don't know if you've ever looked up the term goofing around
in the dictionary… Well, I have, and the technical definition is, two friends who
care a lot about each other and have amazing sex and just wanna spend more time together.
But if you have this new fangled dictionary that gets you made at me, then we have to,
y'know, get you my original dictionary. I am so bad at this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think you're better than you think you are.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? Okay, so…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) Know when to stop.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I sensed that I should stop. So we're okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. All right, I'm gonna go tell Dan that it's not gonna happen. (They
kiss and as she starts to leave, Chandler starts to dance. Without turning around.) Don't
do the dance.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right!
[Scene: The delivery room, everyone except Rachel is there. Phoebe, Monica, and Ross
are holding the babies.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think you're my favorite.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Which one do you have?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't care.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi. (To Phoebe) Hey, hi! So uh, Frank and Alice wanted me to
tell you that they're still outside making phone calls.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But umm, I mean, did you talk to them about, y'know…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, umm, no honey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. It was a long shot. Hey, you guys can I just like have a second
alone with the babies.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah, sure yeah. Yeah.
(They hand her the babies and leave them alone.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, here you are. It seems like yesterday I was talking to you in that
little petri dish. Everyone said labor was the hardest thing I'd ever have to do, but they
were wrong this is. Oh, I had the most fun with you guys! I wish I could take you home and
see you everyday. Okay, I'll settle for being your favorite Aunt. I know Alice's sister
has a pool, but you lived in me. Okay, so we're cool. Yeah, we're gonna be great. Little
high fives! (Imitates the high fives.) Ahh! Ahh! Ahh! (One of the babies begins to cry.)
Well, if you're gonna cry. (She starts crying.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: The delivery room, everyone is hanging out with Phoebe. Frank, Alice, and the
kids aren't there.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, we are so proud of you! You're amazing!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So does it really hurt as bad as they say?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. You won't be able to take it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So uh, now that little Chandler turned out to be a girl, what are they
gonna name her?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They're gonna call her Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's kind of a masculine name, don't you think?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Works on you.

title: The One Where Phoebe Hates PBS

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel has just gotten home and is going through the mail.
She finds something that's Monica's and goes over and knocks on her closed bedroom door.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (In a sexy voice) Come in. I've been waiting for you.
(Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! I just wanna-(sees Monica)-Ahhh!!! Oh my God! (She runs out in
horror.) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pulling on a robe) Okay, I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I-I-I was um, I was
taking a nap.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Since when do take naps in that position. Oh God Monica, tell me
you were waiting for a guy! Please tell me you were waiting for a guy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes. Yes, I was. A guy. From work. (Thinks) I'm seeing a guy from work!
Ha!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Gasps) That cute waiter guy from your restaurant, the one that looks
like a non-threatening Ray Liotta?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-huh, that one!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know what, just give me a second and I'll be out of your hair. I'm
just gonna grab a jacket. When I get back, I want every little detail. (There's a knock on
the door.) Maybe that's him. (Goes to answer the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Panicking) Okay, umm, okay, umm… (Rachel opens the door.) It's
just Joey and Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why aren't you guys at the movie?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, we were! But Ross was talking so loud on his phone they threw us
out!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I had to talk loud because the movie was loud!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Monica and Rachel) He's talking to London!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But why?! Did he get in touch with Emily?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well no, not yet. He's calling everyone on her side of the family hoping
that someone will help him get in touch with her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) I-I-I don't care if I said some other girl's name you prissy,
old twit!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross! Way to suck up to the family.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, happily, with a bottle of champagne, thinking that Monica
is the only one there) Ha-ha-ha-(sees everyone)-enh-enh. I'm so glad you guys are all
here! My office finally got wrinkle free fax paper!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the next morning, Phoebe, Chandler, Ross, and Monica are
eating breakfast.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, wearing a tux) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no-no-no, vomit tux! No-no, vomit tux!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don't worry, I had it dry-cleaned.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Vomit tux? Who vomited on—y'know what, what you up to Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I'm doing this telethon thing on TV and my agent got me a job as
co-host!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that's great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A little uh, good deed for PBS and a little TV exposure, now that's the
kind of math Joey likes to do!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh, PBS!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What's wrong with PBS?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh, what's right with them?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why don’t you like PBS, Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, 'cause right after my mom killed herself, I was just in this
really bad place, y'know personally. So, I just thought that it'd make me feel better if I
wrote to Sesame Street, 'cause they were so nice when I was a little kid! No one
ever wrote back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well y'know a lot of those Muppets don't have thumbs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All I got was a lousy key chain! And by that time I was living in a box.
I didn't have keys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm sorry Pheebs, I just, y'know, I just wanted to do a good deed.
Like-like you did with the babies.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This isn't a good deed, you just wanted to get on TV! This is totally
selfish.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! What about you, having those babies for your brother?
Talk about selfish!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What-what are you talking about?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, yeah, it was a really nice thing and all, but it made you feel
really good right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. So?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It made you feel good, so that makes it selfish. Look, there's no
unselfish good deeds, sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes there are! There are totally good deeds that are selfless.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, may I ask for one example?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, it's… Y'know there's—no you may not!
(They are standing on either side of Chandler as they discuss the point. Chandler,
meanwhile, is disgusted with the whole argument.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's because all people are selfish.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you calling me selfish?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you calling you people? (Chandler rolls his eyes.) Yeah, well sorry to
burst that bubble, Pheebs, but selfless good deeds don't exist. Okay? And you the deal on
Santa Clause right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm gonna find a selfless good dead. I'm gonna beat you, you evil
genius.
(Ross's phone rings and he answers it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) Hello.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (on phone from London) Hello, Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emily? Emily! Oh my God! Oh my God, it's Emily! (He picks up a lamp and
hands it to Chandler, for no reason.) It's Emily everyone! Shush-shush-shhst! (to Emily)
Hi!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ross, I'm only ringing to say stop harassing my relatives. Good-bye!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No wait! Look, wait! Okay, you can hang up, but I'm gonna keep calling!
I'm gonna, I'm gonna call everyone in England if that's what it takes to get you to talk
to me!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Really? About what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look you're my wife. We're-we're married. Y'know? I-I love you. I-I really
miss you.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I miss you to. Well, at least I think I do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the gang, whispering) She's talking.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (subdued) Yay! (He motions for them to keep quiet, including Chandler who
is still holding the lamp Ross handed him, before he goes off to talk to Emily in
private.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, Joey, when you said the deal with Santa Clause, you meant?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That he doesn't exist.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Right. (She turns and opens her eyes in shock.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Monica, and Rachel are there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So Chandler, have you heard about Monica's secret boyfriend?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh, yeah. She uh, she uh, she uh might've mentioned him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So Mon, when are we gonna meet this new secret waiter man?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, he's really shy. I-I don’t think he's up to meeting everyone
yet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I don't think he's up to meeting everyone yet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t care! I wanna meet this guy who's the best sex she ever
had!
(Chandler is quite pleased with that statement.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?! That's what you heard? (To Monica) You said that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I might've said that. (Chandler laughs.) Why is that funny?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because I'm very happy for him! (To Monica) And you, you lucky
dog!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, Emily's willing to work on the relationship.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: In London!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She wants me to move to London.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But you live here! (Ross rolls his eyes.) You know that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What-what-what are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I bet if I talk to Carol and Susan I can convince them to move to London
with Ben.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I'm sure your ex-wife will be more than happy to move to another
country so you can patch things up with your new wife.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It could happen.
[Scene: Unitel Video, Studio 55, Joey's telethon, he is being shown around by the stage
director.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To the pledge volunteers) How ya doin'? Welcome. Good to see ya!

lines.speaker: Stage Director
lines.text: This will be your phone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's great. But uh, I'm not really expecting a lot of calls.

lines.speaker: Stage Director
lines.text: No you answer it and take pledges.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But I'm the host!

lines.speaker: Stage Director
lines.text: No, Gary Collins is the host. You'll be answering the phones.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don't seem to understand. See, I was Dr. Drake Remoray.

lines.speaker: Stage Director
lines.text: Well, here's your phone doctor. (She walks away.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe, Rachel, and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I cannot believe I can't find a selfless good deed! Y'know that old guy
that lives next to me? Well, I snuck over there and-and raked up all the leaves on his
front stoop. But he caught me and force-fed me cider and cookies. Then I felt wonderful.
That old jackass!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Maybe Joey's right. Maybe all good deeds are selfish.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I will find a selfless good deed! 'Cause I just gave birth to three
children and I will not let them be raised in a world where Joey is right!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey, Monica? Can I ask you a cooking question?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If you're cooking on the stove, does that mean that your new secret
boyfriend is better in bed than Richard?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler! (Pause) Is he?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, y'know I-I-I think I'm gonna respect the privacy of my new secret
boyfriend.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?! I mean if this guy was me and it was me who had
learned that it was me who was the best you'd ever had, I'd be going like this. (He
jumps up onto the table and starts doing his happy dance.)

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, he's on the phone with Emily.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right Emily, as much as I love you, I'm sorry, I can't move to London
without Ben.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I understand that would be difficult.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, would you please consider moving here? I mean you were gonna
move here anyway, why can't you just do that?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I don't know, it's just…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh-okay, but-but I know, that even though I've been a-a complete
idiot up 'til now, I mean, I mean you-you-you have to come here. You have to come here so
we can work this out.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, did you just say all right?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I did. Now I'm the idiot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, Emily that is, that is so great. It's gonna be so great! We're gonna
be like-like-like two idiots in love!
(She laughs.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ross, there's one thing that really scares me still.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, tell me.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Well, you have to understand how humiliating it was for me up on that
altar in front of my entire family, all my friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know. I am, I am so sorry.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: And then after decided to forgive you, seeing you at the airport catching
our plane with her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Again, very sorry.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I mean, I can't-I can't be in the same room as her! It drives me mad just
thinking of you being in the same room as her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emily, there is nothing between Rachel and me. Okay? I love you.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: All right. I'll come to New York and we'll try and make this work.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh that is so great! That's…

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (interrupting him) As long as you don't see Rachel anymore.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is telling Phoebe, Monica, and Chandler about Emily's
ultimatum.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So I asked Emily if she would come to New York, and she said yes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh-ohh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no-no! Only if I promise never to see Rachel again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! You can't—what did you tell her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I told her I'd have to think about it. I mean, how the hell am I supposed
to make this kind of a decision? (They're all quiet.) I'm actually asking you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you can't just not see Rachel anymore, she's one of your best
friends.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! But, he can't not exactly see Emily, I mean that's his wife.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's true!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but you've known Rachel since High School and you cannot just cut
her out of your life.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's true!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, you cannot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks for the help, problem solved. (Wipes his hands.)
(The phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (answering it) Hello.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Hey Mon!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh hey Joey! We've been watching all day, when are you gonna be on TV?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See, there was kind of a mix up in my agent's office, but I'm still on TV
and that's good exposure.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Looking at the TV) You're not on TV.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, uh, okay, how, how about now? (He waves his hand in front of the woman
next to him and you can now see his arm on TV.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, there he is! There he is!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello New York! (The woman bats his hand out of the way.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, the chick and the duck are watching Emeril Live, a cooking
show.]

lines.speaker: Emeril
lines.text: (on TV.) Now maybe you just like wanna but the whole duck in there! Who
cares, y'know? Now I got the legs…
(Chandler enters and sees what they're watching, panics, and runs to turn off the TV.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How many times have I told you guys, you never watch the
cooking channel!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hi Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, listen, I need that broiling pan that Joey borrowed the other day.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that was yours? Uh, yeah, we used it when the duck was throwing up
caterpillars.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: William Sonoma, fall catalog, Page 27.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Expect it in 4-6 weeks. (She starts to leave.) Umm, hey, umm, Joey's
gonna be at the telethon for the rest of the day, we have the whole place to ourselves.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, so?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well I just, thought maybe you'd wanna book some time with the best
you'd ever had.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what, champ? I think I'll pass.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why? (She hops into the living room and imitates Chandler's happy
dance.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What's your point?

scenes.location: The Telethon, Joey's phone rings and he answers it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in a bored voice) PBS telethon.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (on phone from Central Perk) Hey Joey, I just wanted to let you know
that I found a selfless good deed. I just went down to the park and I let a bee sting me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! What good is that gonna do anybody?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it helps the bee look tough in front of his bee friends. The bee
is happy and I am definitely not.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now, y'know the bee probably died after he stung ya.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Thinks for a moment.) Aw, dammit! (Slams the phone down.)

lines.speaker: Stage Director
lines.text: Back on in 30 seconds people!
(Joey gets up and moves to the other end of his row to talk to the guy sitting there.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, excuse me, would you mind switching with me?

lines.speaker: PBS Volunteer
lines.text: Hey, no way, I'm in the shot man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on man! You've been here all day!

lines.speaker: PBS Volunteer
lines.text: Yeah, I-I'm taking pledges here, eh?

lines.speaker: Stage Director
lines.text: We're on in 3, 2, (points to Gary Collins.)

lines.speaker: Gary Collins
lines.text: Welcome back to our fall telethon. Now if you've been enjoying the
performance of Cirque Du Soleil, (As he is speaking, Joey and the volunteer
getting into a shoving match.) and you'd like to see more of the same kind of programming,
it's very simple. All you have to do (Joey is knocked down.) is call in your pledge and at
that time tell the operator, one of our volunteers, what kind of programming you'd like
to… (Just as the volunteer sits down, Joey pulls him to the ground.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Phoebe are cooking, Chandler is reading a
magazine.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Okay, that's it. I cannot make this decision! It is too
difficult, so I'm just gonna leave it entirely to the gods of fate. (He holds up and
starts shaking a…)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A Magic Eight ball?! You can't be serious, you can't make this decision
with a toy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, it's not a toy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I don't know what else to do. I mean, I either keep my wife and lose
one of my-my-my best friends or I keep my friend and get divorced the second time before
I'm 30! So-so if anyone has-has a better suggestion, let's hear it! 'Cause I-I got
nothing! All right, don't be shy, any suggestion will do. (There are none.) Okay then.
Here we go. Magic 8 Ball, should I never see Rachel again? (He turns it over and reads the
answer) Ask again later. Later is not good enough. (He shakes it up again and reads the
answer.) Ask again later. What the hell! This is broken! It-it is broken!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, let me see. (She grabs the 8 ball.) Will Chandler have sex
tonight? (Reads the answer.) Don't count on it. Seems like it works to me.

scenes.location: The Telethon, Joey answers his ringing phone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in an unenthusiastic voice) PBS Telethon.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (on phone) Hi Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I would like to make a pledge. I would like to donate $200.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: $200? Are you sure Pheebs? I mean, after what Sesame Street did to
ya?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I'm still mad at them but I also now that they bring happiness to
lots of kids who's moms didn't kill themselves, so by supporting them, I'm doing a good
thing, but I'm not happy about it. So there, a selfless good deed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And you don't a little good about donating the money?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it sucks. I was saving up to buy a hamster.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A hamster? What, those things are like 10 bucks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, not the one I had my eye on.

lines.speaker: Gary Collins
lines.text: (on TV.) It looks like we have surpassed last year's pledge total!
Thank you viewers! The pledge that did it was taken by one of our volunteers…(He
walks over to where Joey is sitting.) Oh boy! And may I say one of our sharpest dressed
volunteers, (Joey stands up.) Mr. Joseph Tribbiani!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, look-look, Joey's on TV! Isn't that great? My pledge got Joey on TV!
Oh that makes me feel—Oh no! (Realizes that her deed made her happy and therefore
it's selfish and covers her mouth in horror.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, later that day. Monica is coming out of the bathroom
carrying her cleaning gear.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Look, maybe I got carried away before. But there's
something you gotta know. If I'm the best, it's only because you've made me the best.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Keep talking.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I mean I was nothing before you. Call the other girls and ask. Which
wouldn't take long. But when I'm with you, and we're together, OH…MY…GOD.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-aw my God! Now, I understand if you never want to sleep with me
again, but that would be wrong. We're too good! We owe it, to sex!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, if we owe it? (She throws down her cleaning stuff and jumps into
his arms.) Oh my… When is Joey gonna be home?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I was kinda hoping we could do this without him. (She starts to
take off her latex gloves.) Oh no-no-no, leave the gloves on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But, I just cleaned the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, why don't we lose the gloves.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. (She takes them off.)
(He carries her over to the door and opens it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, let's show them how it's done.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
(He starts to carry her into the hallway but hits her head on the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know that wasn't part of it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!
(He carries her into the hall.)
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Ross is prying at the Magic 8 Ball with a screwdriver as
there's a knock on his door which he goes to answer.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi! Are you ready? We're gonna be late!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: For what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: For Stella! Remember? She's gettin' her grove back in like 20 minutes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I uh, totally forgot about that. You mind if I take a rain check?
I'm waiting for a call from Emily.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure. I guess. Hey, I hear you don't have to go to London. Yay!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's not that easy, there's still a lot of relationship stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just stuff. Y'know kinda what Emily wants.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, why don't you talk to me about it, maybe I can help.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No. You-you can't help. I mean, I kinda have to do this without your
help.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I-I know you can do that too. I'm just, I'm just saying if you
need somebody to talk to… Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross? Look, whatever this relationship stuff that Emily wants, just give
it to her. Come on, the bottom line here is that you love her. So just fix whatever she
wants fixed. Just do it. (The phone starts ringing.) I mean, you're gonna have to
try. You'll just gonna hate yourself if you don't. (The phone keeps ringing.) Oh come on
answer it! It's driving me crazy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (answering the phone.) Hello. (Listens) Hi sweetie. (Listens.) Good. Look
umm, yes I've been thinking about that thing that you wanted me to do and, I can do it.
(Rachel gives him a thumbs up.) So will you come to New York? (Rachel wants to know what
she said, and he gives her a thumbs up and she goes over and hugs him. All the time not
knowing what's going on.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, ??????? is playing, as Chandler peaks his head out of the storage
closet and sneaks back to his seat and pretends he's reading something. Then a short while
later Monica pokes her head out of the closet and sneaks back to her seat and sits down,
pretending as if nothing has happened.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Never done that before.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nope.

title: The One with the Kips

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, 3:02 A.M., Chandler is up. There's a knock on the door and
Chandler answers it.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (quietly) Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (quietly) Hi! (They both start kissing.)
(Joey enters and Chandler pushes her away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica? What time is it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh, 9. (He pushes the clock into the sink.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But it's dark out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well that's because you always sleep to noon, silly! This is what 9
looks like.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I guess I'll get washed up then. Watch that sunrise. (He goes into the
bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm really getting tired of sneaking around.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, me too. Hey! Y'know what if we went away for a whole weekend?
Y'know we'd have no interruptions and we could be naked the entire time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All weekend? That's a whole lotta naked.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I can say that I have a conference and you can say you have a
chef thing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, I've always wanted to go to this culinary fair that they have in
Jersey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, y'know your not though. Let's go. (He starts for his bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait! What about Joey?
(Chandler opens the bathroom door to reveal Joey passed out on the toilet with a
toothbrush in his mouth.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the next morning, Chandler, Joey, and Phoebe are eating
breakfast.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from her room) Hey, guess what I'm doing this weekend! I'm
going to this culinary fair in New Jersey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh weird, Chandler just told us he's got a conference there!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh now that-that-that's funny, it seems like Chandler's conference
could've been in Connecticut or Vermont.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not in charge of where the conference is held. Do you want people
to think it's a fake conference? It's a real conference.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is Rachel here? I gotta talk to her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, she's out shopping.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damn!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I told Emily to come. And I just need to y'know, talk to Rachel about it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait a minute! So when Emily comes you're just, you're not gonna see
Rachel anymore?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well look, I'm just trying to focus on the "I get to see my
wife," part, all right? And not the part that makes me do this. (He takes a big swig
of Pepto Bismol.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, so you guys are, you're never gonna be in the same room together?
How is that even gonna work?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have no idea. I mean… But-but I assure you I will figure it out.
(They all reflect briefly on what was said.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Doesn’t seem like it's going to work, I mean…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi, guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We're flipping Monica's mattress.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So I'm thinking, basically we pick it up and then we flip it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah that's better than my way.
(They all agree and head to Monica's room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh okay, hey guys, would you flip mine too?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aww, man! (They go into Monica's room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (going through the mail) Oh look! A letter from my mom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, Rach, y'know-y'know how Emily's coming right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! I know.
[Cut to Monica's bedroom, Chandler is trying to listen through the door.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Chandler) Can you hear anything?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes, somebody just said, "Can you hear anything?"
(Joey is bent over at the waist and is looking for something under Monica's bed.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Joey's ass! What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (holding a box) Well, remember when they got in that big fight and broke
up and we were all stuck in her with no food or anything? Well, when Ross said Rachel at
the wedding, I figured it was gonna happen again, so I hid this in here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooh, candy bars, crossword puzzles…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, Madlibs, mine! (Grabs it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Condoms?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don't know how long we're gonna be in here! We may have to
repopulate the Earth.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And condoms are the way to do that?
[Cut to the living room.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway it-it kinda-it all boils down to this, the last time I talked to
Emily…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting) Oh my God! My dog died!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, Le Poo, our dog!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Le Poo's still alive?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, it says he was hit by an ice cream truck and dragged for
nine-(turns over the note)-teen blocks. Oh. (They all come out from Monica's bedroom) Oh
my God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sweetie, we heard you crying. Please don't cry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's Le Poo.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know it's le poo right now, but it'll get better.
[Scene: Atlantic City, New Jersey, Chandler and Monica are about to start their weekend
of sex, sex, nothing but sex.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (jumping on the bed) I can't believe it! We're here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooh, chocolates on the pillows! I love that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, you should live with Joey, Roll-os everywhere.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come here. (He does, and they kiss.) Okay, be right back.
(Goes to the bathroom and Chandler turns on the TV and finds a high-speed police
chase.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes! Monica, get in here! There's a high-speed car chase on!
(Monica returns, carrying a glass.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're switching rooms.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks at what she's holding and shies away) Oh dear God, they gave us
glasses!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, they gave us glasses with lipstick on them! I mean, if they didn't
change the glasses, who knows what else they didn't change. (He glares at her.) Come on
sweetie, I just want this weekend to be perfect, I mean we can change rooms, can't we?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but let's do it now though, because Chopper 5 just lost it's
feed! (He grabs their bags and sprints out.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is trying to tell Rachel about Emily's ultimatum again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, so uh, y'know how there's something I wanted to talk to you about?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! (Turns to face him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, y'know how I'm trying to work things out with Emily. Well, there's
this one thing… Okay, (Rachel has her back turned to the camera, and Ross isn't
looking at her.) here goes. I made a promise that-(they cut to the other camera and Ross
notices something coming out of Rachel's nose)-Oh hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're nose is bleeding!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God. (He hands her some tissues.) No! Oh not again! (Wiping her
nose.) This-this happened when my grandfather died. It's ugh! Sorry. (She puts her head
back.) Oh, okay, so I'm sorry, what-what were you-what did you want to tell me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm… (Rachel blows her nose.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sorry. Sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I uh, I can't see you anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I know. It's ridiculous! I can't see you either.

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's weekend, a hotel clerk is showing them their new room.

lines.speaker: Hotel Clerk
lines.text: I think you'll find this room more to your liking.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, great. (He grabs the remote and turns on the TV to the chase.)

lines.speaker: Hotel Clerk
lines.text: (watching the chase) They say he's only got half a tank left.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Half a tank? We still got a lot of high-speed chasing to do!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're switching rooms again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is a garden view room, and we paid for an ocean view room.

lines.speaker: Hotel Clerk
lines.text: Our last ocean view room was unacceptable to you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Excuse me, umm, can I talk to you over here for just a
second?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-huh. (He doesn't take his eyes off the TV.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (turning to face her) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, these clowns are trying to take us for a ride and I'm not gonna
let 'em! And we're not a couple of suckers!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I hear ya, Mugsy! But look, all these rooms are fine okay? Can you
just pick one so I can watch-(realizes)-have a perfect, magical weekend together with you.
[Time lapse, Monica and Chandler have changed rooms yet again.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, this one I like!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (watching TV, in fact, ER is on.) Nothing! It's over! Dammit! This is
regularly scheduled programming!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can we turn the TV off? Okay? Do we really want to spend the entire
weekend like this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, am I getting in the way of all the room switching fun?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, don't blame me for wigging tonight!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, who should I blame? The nice bell man who had to drag out luggage
to 10 different rooms?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know, how about the idiot who thought he could drive from Albany
to Canada on a half a tank of gas!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do not speak ill of the dead.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're supposed to uh, be spending a romantic weekend together, it-it,
what is the matter with you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I just want to watch a little television. What is the big deal? Geez,
relax mom.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I said, "Geez, relax Monnnnn."
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is reading a magazine and has two tissues stuck up
her nose in an attempt to stop the bleeding and as she hears Ross enter, she quickly hides
her face behind the magazine and removes the tissues.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. Rachel, I-I-I've been wanting to tell you something for a while now
and I really, I just have to get it out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, what's up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, y'know how you told me I should do whatever it takes to fix my
marriage?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I told you to give Emily whatever she wants.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And while that was good advice, you should know that what-what she
wants…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …is for me not to see you anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's crazy! You can't do that! What are you going to tell her? (Pause)
(Realizes) Oh God. Ohh, you already agreed to this, haven't you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's awful I know, I mean, I feel terrible but I have to do this if I want
my marriage to work. And I do, I have to make this marriage work. I have too. But
the good thing is we can still see each other until she gets here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! Lucky me! Oh my God! That is good news, Ross! I think that's
the best news I've heard since Le Poo died!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You have no idea what a nightmare this has been. This is so hard.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, really? Is it Ross? Yeah? Okay, well let me make this a just a
little bit easier for you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Storming out!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel, this is your apartment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, well that's how mad I am!!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is returning from his disastrous weekend. He
throws his bag down and sits down on one of the leather chairs, but he sits on something
and picks it up and throws it away.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Damn Rollos!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you're back!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How was your conference?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It was terrible. I fought with (Pause) my colleagues y'know, the
entire time. Are you kidding with this? (Throws away another Rollo)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, so your weekend was a total bust?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, no, I got to see Donald Trump waiting for an elevator.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you're back too!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. Umm, Chandler can I talk to you outside for a second?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, how was your chef thing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, it was awful. (To Chandler) I guess some people just don't
appreciate really good food.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, maybe it was the kind of food that tasted good at first but then
made everybody vomit and have diarrhea.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! (Motions for him to come outside.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica. (Follows her out.)
[In the hall.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I'd like to know how much the room was because I'd like to pay my
half.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, fine, $300.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: 300 dollars?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, just think of it as $25 per room!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Urghh!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sticking his head out the door) What are you guys woofing about?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler stole a twenty from my purse!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nooooo!!! Y'know what? Now that I think about it, I constantly find myself
without twenties and you always have lots!
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross is drinking some Alka-Seltzer. The rest of the gang,
minus Rachel is there as well.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You should've seen the look on her face. I don't want Rachel to hate me! I
don't know what to do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You want my advice?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! Please!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're not gonna like it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got married to fast.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's not advice!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I told ya.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm going to the bathroom. (Gets up and exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, if anyone asked me to give up any of you, I couldn't do it.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, me either.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe I could do it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi, Rach.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, I know you guys heard about the whole thing with me and Ross but
y'know, I've been obsessing about it all day and I'd just love not to talk about
it. All right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I-I-I don't know if this falls under this category, but uh, Ross is right
back there. (Points over his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's not Ross!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! Not that guy! He does look like him though.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, Ross is in the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, its happening. It's already started. I'm Kip.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you're not Kip!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Joey) Do you even know who Kip is?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who cares? You're Rachel! (To Chandler) Who's Kip?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kip, my old roommate, y'know we all used to hang out together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, that poor bastard.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: See? Yeah, you told me the story. He and Monica dated when they broke up
they couldn't even be in the same room together and you all promised that you would stay
his friend and what happened? He got phased out!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're not gonna be phased out!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, of course I am! It's not gonna happen to Ross! He's your brother.
(To Chandler) He's your old college roommate. Ugh, it was just a matter of time before
someone had to leave the group. I just always assumed Phoebe would be the one to go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ehh!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, come on! You live far away! You're not related. You lift right
out.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is watching TV.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Mr. Bing. That uh, hotel you stayed at called. Said someone left an
eyelash curler in your room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes that was mine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: 'Cause I figured you'd hooked up with some girl and she'd left it there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes that would have made more sense.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'know, I-I don't even feel like I know you anymore man! All right, look,
I'm just gonna ask you this one time. And whatever you say, I'll believe ya. (Pause.) Were
you, or were you not on a gay cruise?!
[Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe is sitting on couch and Rachel is getting some coffee.
Phoebe keeps turning her head from to keep from looking at Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe? (She turns her head further away.) I'm sorry about the whole
lifting out thing. (Moves over next to her.) You gotta come with me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come where?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wherever I go. Come on you and me, we'll-we'll start a new group, we're
the best ones.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, but try and get Joey too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Pheebs, you mind if I speak to Rachel alone for a sec?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, sure! (She gets up to leave.) Bye Ross! (Whispering behind his
back.) Forever.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. What are you doing here? Isn't this against the rules?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I talked to Monica, look, I'm the one who made the choice. I'm the
one who's making things change, so I should be the one to y'know, step back.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Ross…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, it's okay. Really. They're plenty of people who just see their
sisters at Thanksgiving and just see their college roommates at reunions and just see Joey
at Burger King. So is, is that better?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it's not better. I still don't get to see you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, what-what would you do? Rach, if you were me, what-what would you
do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, for starters I would've said the right name at my wedding!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe this is happening.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am so sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know that too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) (He clears his throat to get their attention.) Hey, Rach? Sorry
to interrupt but umm, Phoebe wanted me to talk to you about a trip or something.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is doing a crossword puzzle.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I just came over to drop off…nothing. So that weekend kinda
sucked, huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, it did.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, I guess this is over.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, y'know, you and me, it had to end sometime.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why, exactly?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because of the weekend, we had a fight.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler that's crazy! If you give up every time you'd have a fight with
someone you'd never be with anyone longer than—Ohhh! (They both realize something
there.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, this isn't over?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) You are so cute! No. No, it was a fight. You deal with it and
move on! It's nothing to freak out about.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? Okay. Great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, welcome to an adult relationship! (She goes to kiss him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stops her) We're in a relationship?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm afraid so.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(They kiss.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica, Rachel, Joey, and Chandler are there as Phoebe
enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hey, Monica, I heard you saw Donald Trump at your convention.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I saw him waiting for an elevator.
(Joey thinks that sounds familiar, but dismisses the thought.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Rach, can I borrow your eyelash curler, I think I lost mine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it's in there. (Points to the bathroom.)
(Joey puts two and two together.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shocked) Oh! Ohh! Oh!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey, can I talk to you for a second? (He grabs him and starts to drag
Joey into Monica's room.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oohh!! Ohh! Oh-oh-oh! Oh-oh!!
(Chandler pushes him through the door and Monica closes it behind them.)
[Cut to Monica's room, Chandler tackles Joey onto her bed and tries to cover his
mouth.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohhhhhhhhhhh!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes. Yes. (Lets him up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) You?! (To Monica) And-and you?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, but you cannot tell anyone! No one knows!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How?! When?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It happened in London.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: IN LONDON!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The reason we didn't tell anyone was because we didn't want to make a
big deal out of it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But it is a big deal!! I have to tell someone!
(They both grab him and stop him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no-no! You can't!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please? Please?! We just don't want to deal with telling everyone, okay?
Just promise you won't tell.
(Joey thinks it over.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Man, this is unbelievable! I mean, it's great, but…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, it's great!
(She goes over and kisses Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aww, I don't want to see that!
[Cut to Phoebe and Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We're so stupid! Do you know what's going on in there? They're trying to
take Joey!
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the gang, minus Ross are playing Madlibs. Phoebe is
reading hers.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The most popular Phoebe in tennis is called the overhand Phoebe. And if
you win, you must slap your opponent on the Phoebe and say, "Hi, Phoebe!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that's cute! We really all enjoyed it. But y'know, it doesn't count.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Count for what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Count in our heads as-as good Madlibs.
(They putting their notepads down and get up to leave.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I guess I'm done.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fun's over!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait-wait, guys! If-if we follow the rules, it's still fun and it means
something!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think I'm gonna take-off.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys, rules are good! Rules help control the fun! (They all leave and
close the door on Monica.) Ohhh! (Throws her notepad down in disgust.)

title: The One with the Yeti

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Monica and Chandler are making out on one of the chairs.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Hey! Hey! Hey!! None of that, not while you're living
under my roof!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, just because I know about you two, doesn't mean I like
looking at it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aren't you supposed to be at an audition for another hour?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I'm sorry if I'm not a middle-aged black woman! (Starts for his
room.) And I'm also sorry if sometimes I go to the wrong audition! Okay, look, if I
have to pretend I don't know about you two, then you two are gonna have to pretend there's
nothing to know about.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry.
(They wait for Joey to go into his room and close the door and then start making out
again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (from the bedroom) I can hear that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Rachel's at work.
(They both go to her apartment.)
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can still hear you!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey, Chandler, and Monica are there as Phoebe enters carrying a
large box.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, what's that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, my mom sent me a family heirloom that once belonged to my
grandmother. Can you believe it?! A year ago I didn't even have a family, and now I have
heirlooms for crying out loud.
(She puts her leg up on the chair and removes this huge knife from her boot to open the
box with. The guys are shocked at the knife's existence.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Eeeee-(She opens the box and removes its contents and sees that it's a
fur coat.)-ohh!! God! (She throws it at Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Argh-argh!! (Catches the coat.) Ooh, soft. Is this mink?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Why would my mother send me a fur? Doesn't she know me but
at all! Plus, I have a perfectly fine coat that no innocent animal suffered to make!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, just some 9-year-old Filipino kids who worked their fingers
bloody for 12 cents an hour. (Phoebe stares at him wide-eyed. Chandler sees her reaction.)
That didn't happen, I made that up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Oh, Ross? Ross! You can't put up flyers in here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How come? Everybody else does.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: You can't.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, umm, I'm just getting rid of a couple of things.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking at the flyer) This is all of your things.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, yes it is! No, but it's good it's—Emily thinks we should get all
new stuff. Stuff that's just ours, together. Y'know brand new.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So basically, this is a getting-rid-of-everything-Rachel-ever-used sale.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Touched. Used. Sat on. Sleep on.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I'll take it all.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Ross, you're okay with that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, if I can just do what Emily wants and get her to New York,
I'm sure everything will be fine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but don't you think this is a little extreme?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: After what I did? Can you blame her?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! You got off easy! When my friend Silvie's husband said
someone else's name in bed, she cursed him and turned his thingy green.
(Ross suddenly gets up and heads for the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (after Ross is gone) What is he doing? What, Emily, thinks Ross's
furniture has got Rachel coodies?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now calm down Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! Everything's gettin' all messed up, y'know? Emily won't let Ross see
Rachel, we're not gonna stop seeing Rachel, hence Ross stops seeing us!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I hate this. Everything's changing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah I know, we're losing Ross, Joey said hence…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, I'm not happy about this either, but y'know if-if Ross says he's
happy then we're just gonna have to keep our feelings about Emily to ourselves. Are you
cool with that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! But y'know, I'm an actor, I'll act cool.
[Scene: The Storage Room in the basement of Monica and Rachel's building, Monica and
Rachel are looking for something.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, whoa God! Storage rooms give me the creeps! Monica, come on please
hurry up honey! Please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, if you want the little round waffles, you gotta have to wait
until I find the little waffle iron.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I want the little round waffles.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. (Looking through a box.) Op, here it is! Right underneath the
can of-of bug bomb. I wonder if the best place to put something that cooks food is
underneath the can of poison?
(The single light flickers and goes out. Leaving the room in total darkness.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y'know what? I'll-I'll have toast!
(She starts to run out but is stopped by a figure looming out of the darkness carrying
a pick axe.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Arghhhh!!!!!!
(They both start screaming at the top of their lungs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Fog him! Fog him!
(Rachel grabs the bug bomb, activates it, throws it at the figure, and they both run
out through the fog.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Joey, and Phoebe are there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't know what I'm gonna do about this coat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'll take it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That might work! (She gives him the coat.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh-ooh-ooh, yeah! (He drapes it around his shoulders.) Enh? All right,
what do you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're on in 5 Ms. Minnelli.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on the phone) No-no-no, it's just a bit sudden. (Listens) No, it's great.
Okay? I'm totally on board. I love you too, all righty. Bye. (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's the matter Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing. Oh, actually, great news! I just got off the phone with Emily and
it looks like I'm moving to a new apartment. Woo-hoo!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, her thought is, and I agree, fresh new furniture, why not a fresh
new apartment? Her cousin has this great place to sublet, it's got a view of the river on
one side and Columbia on the other.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's way uptown! That's like three trains away! (Phoebe pinches him.)
Which is great! I love to ride that rail!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you're really okay with this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! Yes! I mean it's-it's kinda far from work, but uh, y'know, I'll get
so much done on the commute. I-I've been given the gift of time!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now that's so funny, because last Christmas I got the gift of space.
We should get them together and make a continuum.
(Ross exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now he's movin'? Man, what is Emily doing to him? (Phoebe pinches him
again.) Ow!! He's not even here!!!
(Monica and Rachel enter breathless.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys! You guys!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We were, we were just in the storage area and we saw this really creepy
man!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It was like this crazy-eyed, hairy beast man! He was like a, like a
bigfoot or a yeti or something!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And he came at us with an axe, so Rachel had to use a bug bomb on him!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (proud of herself) Yeah, I-I-I just pulled the tab and I just fogged his
yeti ass!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, like dark hair, bushy beard?
