lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you fogged Danny.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please! We did not fog Danny! Who's Danny?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dan just moved in downstairs. Yeah, he just got back from like this
four-month trek in the Andes. Nice fella.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh he's nice. He's nice! Y'know, you always stick up for the people we
fog!
[Scene: Their Building, Monica and Rachel are going to apologize to Danny. Rachel
knocks on his door, which he opens and he has this really bushy beard and long hair.
Picture Paul Bunyan.]

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! You might not remember us, but we are the girls that fogged
you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're-we're really sorry we fogged you.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Okay.
(He closes the door. Rachel's not happy with that and knocks again. He opens the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Just so you know, we-we didn't mean to fog you, we thought
you were like a yeti or something.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Okay.
(He closes the door again. Once again, Rachel knocks (harder this time) and he answers
it.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Yesss?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Sorry to bother you, but I don't think we can accept your
acceptance of our apology, it just doesn't really seem like you mean it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: O-kay!
(He closes the door before Rachel can say anything.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! That guy is so rude!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really! What is with that guy? I mean you'd forgive me if I fogged you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well you did a little bit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, honey, I'm so sorry!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I totally forgive you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is making a drink as Phoebe enters with the fur
coat.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So listen, you know my friend Chris who owns the crematorium?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Crematorium Chris? Sure!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He says, that he would cremate my fur coat for free if I umm, y'know,
bring in the next person I know who dies.
(Rachel enters from the bathroom and sees the coat.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God, look at these pelts!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't get too attached, she's having it cremated.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Uhh, Phoebe, honey, honey, I know you're quirky and I get a big
kick out of it, we all do actually, but if you destroy a coat like this that is like a
crime against nature! Not nature, fashion!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is fashion?! (Grabs the coat from Rachel.) Okay, so to you, death
is fashion?! That's really funny. (She puts the coat on and starts to model it.) Here's
Phoebe umm, sporting uh, y'know, cutting edge hairy carcass from y'know, the steal traps
of wintry Russia. I mean, you really thing this looks good? (Sees herself in the
mirror.) 'Cause I do.
[Scene: Ross's Apartment, the gang is helping Ross move out by carrying boxes. Chandler
has picked a particularly large and apparently heavy box, because he takes a running start
at it and still can't budge it.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) I know I miss you too. I can't wait to see you. I love you.
Bye. (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, what is in here? Rocks?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no, this is my collection of fossil samples.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, rocks.
(He picks up a smaller box and carries it to the moving van as Joey returns.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm really gonna miss this apartment. Y'know, Ben-Ben took his first steps
right over there. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh. Hey, remember when I ran into this thing (The shutters that close off
the kitchen.) and it kinda knocked me out a little?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I loved this place! To tell you the truth, I wish I didn't have to move.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, are you saying that you're not entirely happy about this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I mean if uh, if Emily gave me a choice…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You do have a choice!! Ross, why are you listening to her?! Are
you, are you crazy?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's not right what Emily wants you to do! She is totally-(The gang enters
behind Joey and Phoebe pinches him again.)-Owww!! Stop pinching me! Look, now you guys
said I only had to keep my mouth shut as long as Ross was happy, right? Well he just told
me that he's not entirely happy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We all hate Emily!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nooo!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, Ross, we do not hate Emily. We-we just, we just think that you're
having to sacrifice a whole lot to make her happy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, we just think that maybe she's being a little unreasonable.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes! Yes! Unreasonable!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Unreasonable? How about we have this conversation when one of you guys
gets married! You have no idea what it takes to make a marriage work! All right,
it's about compromise! Do you always like it? No! Do you do it? Yes! Because it's not all
laughing, happy, candy in the sky, drinking coffee at Central Perk all the time! It's real
life, okay? It's what grown-ups do! (He storms out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think he's right. You guys hang out at the coffeehouse way too much.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, and Chandler are recovering from Ross's
rebuke.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God, I feel so guilty about Ross.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I kinda feel like it's my fault.
(Monica and Chandler turn and stare at him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kind of? If you just kept this to yourself none of this would've
happened.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I'm keeping so many things to myself these days, something was bound
to slip out! (He glares at Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I think it's very brave what you said.
(Monica pats Joey on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I can't sit here anymore. I have to walk places. (She puts on
her fur coat.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs, what are you doing with the coat? How about the whole animal
rights thing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I've been reading up and for your information, minks are not very
nice. Okay, I admit it! I love this coat! Okay, I—it's the best thing I've ever had
wrapped around me, including Phil Huntley! (She starts to leave but stops and says to
Monica.) Remember Phil Huntley? He was fine!
[Scene: Their building's lobby, Danny is checking his mailbox as Rachel enters carrying
shopping bags and goes to her mailbox. Danny has shaved his beard and cut his hair, Rachel
doesn't recognize him.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: So you like the short hair better.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Yeti—I mean Danny?

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: I had to cut my hair to get rid of the uh, fogger smell.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Listen, I'm so sorry. I would, I would've never fogged you if y'know
if you hadn't looked so…. Y'know.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Absolutely. Some people are just into appearances.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: That's cool. Cool. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Hey! No-no-no! This not cool! You don't even know me!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Come on, you got the shopping bags and the Sack's catalog.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So from that you think you've got me all figured out? Well, you don't!
Y'know I-I could have toys for underprivileged kids in here!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Do you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y'know, if-if kids like to play with Capri pants.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Okay. (Heads for his apartment.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And stop saying that! I hate that!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Okay!
(Rachel decides not to give up that easily and follows him to his apartment and bangs
on the door, which he opens.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine! I judged you. I made a snap judgement. But you did it too! And you
are worse because you are sticking to your stupid snap judgement! You can't even open up
your mind for a second to see if you're wrong! What does that say about you?

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: The pizza-place across the street any good?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: I'm hungry. Wanna get some pizza? You can keep yelling if there's more.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Stop saying that. I hate that.
[Scene: Ross's now empty apartment, he is spackling some holes shut as the gang comes
to apologize.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, Ross?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you still mad at us?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh good! Because we have an "I'm sorry" song.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know what? I'm really not in the mood.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, Ross, I feel really bad. I mean, you're going through all this stuff
and I just acted like a jerk.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we are so sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Chandler) You're kinda stepping on the song. (She gets ready to play
but is stopped by…)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, we were way out of line, we totally support you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whatever you decide, whatever you do.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, now you're just taking lines right out of the song!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, this is hard enough! I really need you guys right now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! Exactly! And that's why…
(She starts to play her song, but is stopped by Monica.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don't you come over tonight? And I'll make you favorite dinner.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Thanks you guys. Pheebs are you wearing fur?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, let's get some perspective people; it's not like I'm wearing a
seeing-eye dog coat!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the gang, minus Rachel, are getting ready for dinner.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, y'know Ross, I think I kinda understand why I kinda lost it today.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You do, huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah you see umm, well, I'm an actor. Right? So I gotta keep my emotions
right at the surface y'know? See what I'm saying? I gotta lot of balls in the air. (Makes
like he's juggling.) Y'know what I mean? It's tough! Guys like me, y'know, you wander
around, you're alone…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinks) I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, look at you! Where have you been?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I went to have pizza. With Danny.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How did that happen?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That yeti is one smooth talker.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I hope you're not full, 'cause dinner's almost ready.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, y'know I-I think I'm just gonna hang out in my room.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: No! Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on you guys! Listen, if Emily knew I was here having dinner you
with you she would flip out and you know it. It's okay, I really… I don't mind.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait! Wait! Wait! Y'know what? Just stay. Please? It uh… It would
really mean a lot to me if you stayed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: RACHEL PLEASE!!! JUST HAVE DINNER WITH US!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Joey, it's okay. Settle down.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I-I'm sorry. I'm sorry. You see Rach I'm an actor…
[Time lapse, dinner is now finished and Ross is looking out the window.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Hey, look! Ugly Naked Guy's back!
(They all run over to the window.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I haven't seen him in so long!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh God, I really missed that fat bastard!
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, this is so weird. I just realized this might be the last time we'll
all be hanging out together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's almost as if he knew.
(The phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll get it. (On phone.) Hello. (Listens.) Hi Emily! (Listens.) Yeah, uh
you-you tracked him down. Hold on one second. (She hands the phone to Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! (Listens.) Yeah-yeah, we're just having dinner. (Listens.) Uh, yeah,
sure uh hold on. (To the gang.) She wants to say hi. (To Emily) Hold on.
(Ross puts her on speakerphone.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi Emily!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Hello everyone. So who am I saying hello too?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well uh, I don't know about who's here, but I can tell you for damn sure
who's not here and that's Rachel!!

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (laughs) Well, I should hope not. Ross knows better than that by now.
(Rachel waves her hands in disgust and starts to head for her room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know what? Uh, Rachel is here! (Rachel stops.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: She's there?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, there-there she is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, she's here.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Ross, take me off speakerphone.
(He does so.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) Hi.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: How can you do this too me?! I thought I'd made my feelings about Rachel
perfectly clear!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (going onto the patio) Look Emily, I'm just having dinner with my friends,
okay?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: You obviously can't keep away from her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emily that's ridiculous. Look, I'm-I'm moving for you, I'm cutting friends
out of my life for you. Please, just get on the plane and come to New York. Okay, you'll
see you're the only person I want to be with.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: I'll feel better when I'm there, and I can know where you are all the
time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you can't know where I am all the time. Look, this marriage is never
gonna work if you don't trust me.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, can you trust me?
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: No.
(Ross lowers his head.)
[Cut to the inside of the apartment.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think it's going okay. Looks like he's smiling.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How can you tell? You can only see the back of his head!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You can totally tell! Here look, watch me. (He stands up and turns his
back to them so that he is facing the window.) Smile! Frown. Smile! Frown. (The camera
cuts to Ross outside hanging up the phone.) Smile! (Ross turns around and sees Joey
alternately smiling and frowning and just stares at him for a second and heads back
inside.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I guess that's it.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Why, what happened?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What happened? What happened?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My marriage is over.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, sweetie. Oh, look at you. You're shivering.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Here. (She wraps her coat around his shoulders.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, honey, is there anything we can do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. You can help me get my furniture back from Gunther.
Ending Credits
[Scene: A curbside newsstand, Phoebe is whistling and walking up to it wearing her fur
coat. She stops and starts to look through a magazine and notices a squirrel on a nearby
tree chirping at her.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to the squirrel) Okay, stop tormenting me! This mink! Okay, they're
mean! And they hate squirrels! And y'know, okay, most of these probably wanted to be
coats! (The squirrel stares at her.) All right, fine, now I get it. (To the clerk.) Here.
(She hands him her coat.) You take it. (To the squirrel.) Are you happy now? I'm cold!

title: The One Where Ross Moves In

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Joey are there. Joey is looking at a National
Geographic and giggling.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you looking at naked tribe's women?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, look. (Shows him the magazine.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's a pig.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, I know, but look at the knobs on her.
(Ross enters and his hair is a mess.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! (Joey quickly hides the magazine under the couch.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emily's cousin kicked me out!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, when you're subletting an apartment from your wife's cousin and then
you get a divorce, sometimes the cousin suddenly wants his apartment back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How can he do that? Didn't you sign a lease?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who needs a lease when it's family!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you can stay with us! We'll take care of ya!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Absolutely! Anything you need man! But you have to promise
me the second you are feeling better so that we can make fun of your hair!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You got it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks you guys, I really appreciate this. All right, I'm gonna get
packing again. Man, I've been moving around so much I'm beginning to feel like a nomad.
(Joey starts giggling.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He thought you said gonad.
(Joey busts out laughing.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica's restaurant, she is getting inspected by the health department, Phoebe
is watching.]

lines.speaker: Health Inspector
lines.text: Wow, Monica, if every restaurant is as clean as yours, I'd have a
tough time making a living.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Larry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, do health inspectors work on commission?

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: No, bribes.
(Phoebe laughs.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's okay to laugh right?

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Yeah, I was just kidding.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (She laughs harder.)

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: I'll check the kitchen floors.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, knock yourself out, Larry.
(He goes into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yum-my!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Larry?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah! I'd let him check out my kitchen floors.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: (entering) A 98. I deducted 2 points because you are not wearing your
chef's hat, and that is a Section 5 violation.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, look, Larry honey, umm, I wrote the book on Section 5 and I know
that you don't have to wear your hat unless you're in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: And where is your hat?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's in the kitchen, I'll go get it.
(She heads for the kitchen door and just after she goes through the door…)

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Ahh that's the 2 points.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, you should really read that book you wrote. (To Larry) Wow! You saw
the hat in the kitchen and knew that she'd have to go in there hatless to get it.
You can have your own health inspector detective show!

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Oh, I don't know about that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but then I can be you sidekick Vunda.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Maybe uh, Vunda could give me her number and I can ask her to dinner
sometime.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, she would love that! Y'know, 'cause you know all the clean places
to eat.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: I-I'll call ya.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
(Larry goes to leave but heads the wrong way and makes a quick sidestep to go out the
right door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He's so funny! (She imitates what he just did.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Gunther is serving Monica and Rachel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (To Monica) Mon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How's Ross doing? Y'know since all the Emily stuff.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He's not great umm, but he's dealing with it. Oh wait a minute, you're
not gonna try…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, honey, please, no, I can't get started with all that Ross stuff
again. I mean, he's gonna screwed up for a looong time. And besides y'know, I don't, I
don't go for guys right after they get divorced.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Right, you only go for them 5 minutes before they get married.
(Danny enters.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: (To Gunther) Two pounds of Moca Java please.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Monica) Danny. Are you guys ever gonna go out again?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know! He hasn't called me since that one time when we went out.
I see him in the hallway, we flirt, I'm all ha-ha-ha-ha, and nothing.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: (To them) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Danny! (Notices his box of liquor he's carrying.) Wow! Thirsty huh?

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Uh, actually, actually, I'm having a party at my place on Saturday, it's
sort of a house warming kind of thing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, fun!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, great!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Okay, see ya. (Heads out.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I guess we won't be warming his house.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Okay. All right, I see what he's doing! He's not asking me out,
because he wants me to ask him out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And you're not gonna do that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's right! 'Cause that would give him the control! So now he's
all ooh, coming up with this whole I've got a party thing y'know, trying to get me to hint
around for an invitation. Blew up in his face, didn't it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So-so there is no party.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, there's a party. There's a party. But the power, that is still up
for grabs. You follow me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think so. Se, he-he's not inviting you to his party because he likes
you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Exactly.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, they're entering to find boxes strewn about the
apartment.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering from the bathroom) Hey roomies!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Love what you've done with the place.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah I know, I know, it's a lot of boxes, but again I really
appreciate you guys letting me stay here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not a problem. And listen, hey! Since you're gonna be here for a while,
why don't—I was thinking we uh, put your name on the answering machine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I uh, hope you don't mind, I kinda uh, jazzed it up a little. Check
this out. (He plays the greeting, and We Will Rock You starts to play and Ross's
voice comes over it.) We will, we will, call you back!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, all right!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pretty cool, huh?
(They both laugh as Ross heads back to the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) You're fake laughing too, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, the tears are real.

scenes.location: A restaurant, Phoebe and Larry are having dinner.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: You look beautiful this evening.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (smiles) Show me the badge again.
(He looks around and flashes her his badge and she laughs.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shiny.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Oh, will you mind if I wash up? Because I came straight from work and who
knows where these babies (Holds up his hands) have been.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (laughing) You are just nonstop!
(He goes to the bathroom and Phoebe puts some pepper and salt on her food. With the
salt she takes a bit and throws it over her left shoulder as she faces us.)

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: (coming back) We're outta here!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Just walking past the kitchen I saw 10 violations! I'm shutting this
place down!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (awed) You have the power to do that?

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: This does. (Shows her his badge.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (excited) Shut it down.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is entering. As he closes the door, Joey pokes
his head up from a box enclosure built using the 2 chairs.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You built a fort didn't ya?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiles) Kinda.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (notices something) Oh my God, the air purifier! Ross's air purifier!
All I heard through 4 years of college was (makes a humming noise.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, you should've gone out once and a while.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I hate this thing!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on, Chandler, Ross is our friend. He needs us right now, so why don't
you be a grown up and come and watch some TV in the fort!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is opening the door.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi Danny.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Hey guys, I just uh, wanted to invite you to the party tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, thanks! We'll try to stop by.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, actually, I think I'm gonna be busy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You are?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Remember I got that uh, gala.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Yeah, what's the gala for?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's a uh, regatta gala.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Really! You-you sail?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no, but I support it.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Okay, (To Monica) hope I see you tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Take care. (Leaves.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Closes the door.) Walked right into that one didn't he?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What one? You wanted him to invite you to the party and he did it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but he waited until the last minute! So if I said yes, he would
know I had nothing better to do than wait around for an invitation to his stupid party. I
said, "No!" Which puts me right back in the driver seat.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great. So the ball is in his court?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ball? There is no ball.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's and Ross's, Ross is working on his computer and Joey is
making a lot of noise.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (glaring at him) Joey, please! (Motions to his computer.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sorry.
(Joey starts playing with a toy alligator and has it attack him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahhhhhhhhhh…
(Notices Ross looking at him and stops. Ross gives him his 'quiet down' maneuver. Okay,
this may take a while to explain, so center this on you screen and place your hands about
a foot apart with your fingers together and pointing straight up. Now take you fingers and
point them at the other hand and making a 90-degree angle with each of your hands and the
first knuckle counting up from the wrist. Now take your right hand, no your other right
(that was for the dyslexics), and lower it a couple of inches, so that the fingers are
pointing at your wrist. Now take your arms and keeping the elbows bent and your hands in
front of you spread out your arms, kinda like making a bird's wing. Now hunch your
shoulders over and move you hands up and down as if you are trying to tell some one to
turn it down. That's Ross 'quiet down' maneuver. Well, there is an accompanying face, but
I don't want to try and describe it as well.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hello children!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Wanna play some foosball? Please?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Starts to head for where the foosball table usually is.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, no! We have to move the table into my room, yeah! 'Cause of all the
boxes. Come on!
(They go into his bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I have one question. What is the deal with this?
(Imitates Ross's 'quiet down' maneuver, but does move his hands up and down he just flaps
his hands as if he's waving good-bye.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye-bye little puppet Joey hand?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, the quiet down thing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean this. (Does the maneuver perfectly.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Um-hmm! Look, I-I-I don't know how much more of this I can take! Did you
know he taped over my Baywatch tape with some show about bugs! My God! What if that
had been porn?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (gasps) All right look, y'know, this maybe tough but come on, this is
Ross! I survived college with him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I guess I can hold out a little longer. Let's have a game.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(They start playing.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: YES!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Uh fellas, (Does the maneuver and gives them a double thumbs
up, which Chandler returns as he closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so he's out of here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Um-hmm.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica, Rachel, and Phoebe are there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You guys got anything to eat? I just went down to Johnos for some chicken
and it was closed!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I took Larry there to eat but it was all violated. So we shut it
down!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs, if this guy keeps closing down all of our favorite places, where
are we gonna eat?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know, clean places?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm, yum!
(There's a knock on the door and Monica answers it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking through the peephole) It's Danny.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don't let him in! I'm supposed to be at a regatta gala.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Danny) We'll be right there! (To Rachel) Can't you just say it
starts later?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What kind of a regatta gala starts at night?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The fake kind!
(She opens the door and Rachel hides behind it.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Hey, hi, I need a ladle. You got a ladle?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We have a ladle. (Gives him one.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Thanks, see you at the party.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, great!
(He leaves and she closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, guys, you know what Larry would say? He would say, "See you
ladle." (Laughs.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler, Joey, and Ross are there. Chandler and Joey are looking
through the paper.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I-I-I'm done with this. You want anything Ross? Sports?
International? Apartment listings?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll take sports.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mine! (He grabs it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. Uhh, international.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh that's mine too! (Grabs it and Ross looks at him.) I'm Italian!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I guess I can check out those apartment listings, even though
there's never anything in here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not even on page 7?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looks) Oh yeah! You're—hey, you're right! Here's an affordable
place, (reading ad) two bedroom, close to work, ooh, it's available in five weeks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What about that circled one?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I-I don't know, it's kind of expensive for a studio.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But it's available now! Isn't it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, it is.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, let's go look at it! (They both jump up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, let's go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There we go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh-ooh, hey guys, I was wondering if you guys would uh, maybe chip in
on some new air filters for the air purifier? I mean after all, we all are using it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let's go quicker.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!
[Scene: The apartment in the listing, the guys are checking it out. There's one problem
though, it's roughly the size of this computer screen. As they enter Joey lets out a
whistle.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! (Looking around, which doesn't take him long.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well look at this kitchen, slash bathroom. Well that's great!
Y'know so you can cook while in the tub.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Somebody was using his head. Hey, let's check out the rest of the place.
(They don't move, just look all around them.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think this is it. I don't know, maybe we should keep looking.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But hey, Ross, this place is available now!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, you don't want to be stuck with us for the next five weeks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
(He looks at them.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Joey) So, you-you think I should go ahead and take this place?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it's perfect!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) How about you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's a kitchen slash bathroom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, I see what you guys are saying. I'll uh, I'll go downstairs and
fill out an application.
(He exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We are bad people.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He knew we were trying to get rid of him. He knew! (Pause.) You think we
could get a bathtub in our kitchen?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is there waiting for Larry.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: (entering) Hey, ready for dinner?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, absolutely!

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Great! How about you wanted to go the Italian place down on Bleaker
Street right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, I love that place! (Thinks about it.) So, no.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: How about Mama Lisettie's?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Enh. Sure!

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: (notices something) I wonder how long that milk (on the counter) has been
setting out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, no-no, this place is totally healthy! That—this milk is mine. I
bought this today, 'cause I was thirsty for milk, y'know. (She takes a swig of it, but has
to turn away from him as she makes a face to show that it has gone bad.) Okay, let's go!
(Just as they're about to leave, Gunther comes out of the back carrying two garbage
bags. Larry sees this and stops him.)

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Hey, buddy! (Flashes his badge.) Are you familiar with Section 11-B of
the Health Code that requires all refuse material out the back exit?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: But then I'd have to go all the way around the dry cleaner place.

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Oh, so you're saying you'd choose convenience over health?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, stop! Larry, okay, can't you just be Larry and not Larry the
health inspector guy? Y'know I mean it was really exciting at first but now it's like,
okay, so where are we gonna eat ever?

lines.speaker: Larry
lines.text: Well, I suppose I could give him a warning.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you. (To Gunther, who's standing there frozen) Okay, go! Go! Go!
(He runs off.) (To Larry) Now, if after dinner you still really need to bust someone, I
know a hot dog vendor who picks his nose.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler and Joey are lamenting about how they kicked Ross
out.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe, maybe we did a good thing, helping Ross get back on his feet!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes that was a nice place!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not a lot of closet space, but he can just hang his stuff out the
window in a bag!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know. Maybe pizza?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: About Ross!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Oh!
(The phone rings and Joey answers it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello! (Listens.) Oh yeah! (To Chandler) It's the apartment manager; Ross
put us down as references. (To the apartment manager.) Ross is the greatest guy you'll
ever meet! Yeah, he's very reliable.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (grabbing the phone) Of course he has this big huge dog! That uh,
barks into the night. (Listens.) Well, who doesn't love dogs? (Thinks.) Ah, he's a tap
dancer! (Listens.) Yes, some would say that is a lost art. (Thinks.) He's a pimp!
(Listens.) There you go! Yes, he's a pimp. He's a big, tap dancing pimp! (Pause.) Hello?
(The apartment manager hung up on him and he hangs up the phone and throws in on the
chair. Joey motions, "What the hell was that?" Chandler makes a face to say,
"Think about it." Joey tries to divide 136 by 13; he's confused. Suddenly, light
dawns on yonder dunder head. He gets it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohhhhh!
(Joey motions, "Now, that's thinking!")
[Scene: Downstairs at Danny's party, Monica and Rachel are coming down the stairs and
Rachel has on a coat to make it look as if she's just getting back. But just as they reach
the landing they see Danny out in the hall talking to a guest, Rachel then quickly pulls
Monica back up the stairs.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shoot, shoot, this is never gonna work! He's right there!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just go over and say hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I have to go downstairs and come back up as if I'm coming home from
the regatta gala. Okay? So just go distract him. But don't be sexy.
(Monica obeys.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Danny!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Hey! What's going on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (turns his back to the stairs) Oh, it's a great party! Great food.
Y'know, most parties it's all chips and salsa, chips and salsa. (As she's saying this
Rachel tries to head downstairs but is blocked by people coming upstairs. She quickly
retreats back up the stairs.) (Sees that she has to keep him distracted longer.) So umm,
what's this? (Points to his plate.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Salad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooooh! (Rachel now succeeds in getting downstairs.) And-and-and
what-what's this? (Points again.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Bread. Aren't you a chef?
(Rachel returns.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (upon seeing Rachel she points) Oh.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Hey! Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Oh right, tonight was your party.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Oh wow, you look great! Glad you could make it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh well, y'know, the gala had to end sometime.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Don't go anywhere, I'll be right back. (He heads off.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, sure. (To Monica) All right, whose court is the ball in now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I thought there wasn't a ball?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on! He's glad that I came, he doesn't want me to go anywhere,
balls flying all over the place!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: (returning, with a friend) Rachel, this is my friend Tom. (To Tom) This
is the girl I told you about.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, go on! You telling people about me?

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: You two could really hit it off! I'm gonna go mingle. (Leaves.)

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: So you work at Bloomingdale's, huh? My mom calls it Bloomies.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Yeah, okay, at ease solider!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I'm sorry?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it's all right, you can just drop the act Tommy. I know what's going
on here. Your Danny's wingman right? You guys are best buds. Frat bros!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I'm gonna go talk to uh, a friend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, you go talk to your friend. You tell him, "Nice
try."
(He walks off.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Man! He just keeps lobbing them up and I just keep knocking them right
out of the park!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think I need a drink.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!
(They go get a drink.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Ross still has boxes all over the place. Joey is wearing a
football helmet, and Chandler is spinning him around in one of the chairs and counting.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (getting up) Dude, I'm telling ya! I'm fine! (He tries to take a step and
falls flat on his face.)
(He tries to get up again and starts falling backwards and Chandler catches him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here we go! Here we go!
(Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. So I uh, I didn't get that apartment. Some problem with my
application.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're kidding!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're kidding, no!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. But, the good news is that Phoebe said that I could stay at her
place for a while. So…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But you can't stay with Phoebe, Ross! We're-we're roomies!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, you guys don't need me here taking up your space.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, we got plenty of space! There-there's still some over there (Points
to where the window is but sees that there isn't any space there and points towards his
door.) by-by that speaker. Please, just stay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you guys sure about this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Definitely!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Ross, you have to stay!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, buddy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So I'm a pimp huh? It's okay! Look, I know that sometimes I can be a pain
in the ass, but you just have to talk to me. Tell me if something is bothering you. Okay?
And for my part I will do everything I can to keep my annoying habits just (Does the
'quiet down' maneuver).
(Chandler and Joey smile, but when Ross turns away look at each other with looks of
horror.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's and Ross's, Chandler is entering and when he closes the
door Joey pops his head out of the fort like before, but this time he's wearing a cowboy
hat.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I see you've had a very productive day. Don't you think the
cowboy hat is a little much?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (popping up behind Joey wearing an Indian headdress) Come on, it's fun!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right! (He joins them in the fort and comes up putting on a
bonnet.) Isn't this a woman's hat?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, stop talking crazy and make us some tea!
(Chandler does so.)

title: The One with All the Thanksgivings

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, everyone has just finished Thanksgiving dinner and are
groaning over their fullness.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Monica that was the best Thanksgiving dinner ever! I think you
killed us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I couldn't possibly eat another bite.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I need something sweet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Does anyone wanna watch TV?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah, sure.
(She starts pushing the power button on the remote, but it's not facing the TV so it
doesn't work.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica your remote doesn't work.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, you have to lift it and point.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Aw, forget it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, you know what we should all do? We should play that game where
everyone says one thing that they're thankful for.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh-ooh, I! I am thankful for this beautiful fall we've been having.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's very nice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's sweet, Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, the other day I was at the bus-stop and this lovely fall breeze came
in out of nowhere and blew this chick's skirt right up. Oh! Which reminds me, I'm also
thankful for thongs. (Note: Actually, I think every guy is thankful for thongs.
That and spandex. J )
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier. Joey is talking about the wonder
that is the thong.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I mean, it's not so much an underpant as it is a feat of engineering. I
mean, it's amazing how much they can do with so little material! And the way they play
with your mind! Is it there? Is it not there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you aware that you're still talking?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is anyone thankful for anything else besides a thong?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh, I don't know what to pick. Am I more thankful for my divorce or my
eviction? Hmm.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! See, and I didn't think you'd be able to come up with anything.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's just that this is the worse Thanksgiving ever.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no! I am the king of bad Thanksgivings. You can't just
swoop in here with your bad marriage and take that away from me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you're not gonna tell the whole story about how your parents got
divorced again are you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh God, no.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, come on! I wanna hear it! It wouldn't be Thanksgiving without Chandler
bumming us out!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's a tradition, like the parade. If the parade decided it was gay,
moved out, and abandoned its entire family.
(And with that, we start a series of flashbacks to Thanksgiving's of years gone by.)
Thanksgiving 1978
[Scene: The Bing household, Mr. and Mrs. Bing and Young Chandler are eating
Thanksgiving dinner as a housekeeper serves them.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Now Chandler dear, just because your father and I are getting a
divorce it doesn't mean we don't love you. It just means he would rather sleep with the
house-boy than me.

lines.speaker: The Housekeeper
lines.text: More turkey Mr. Chandler? (And he makes eyes at him.)
Present Day

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're right. Yours is worse. You are the king of bad Thanksgivings.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't know about that. I've got one that's worse.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? Worse than, "More turkey Mr. Chandler?"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, did the little rich boy have a problem with the butler? Yes, mine's
worse!
Thanksgiving 1862
[Scene: A Union battlefield hospital, Phoebe, in a past life, is tending to a wounded
Union soldier. (By the way, for historical perspective, 1862 was the second year of the
American Civil War.)]

lines.speaker: Past Life Phoebe
lines.text: More bandages! More bandages! Please, can I get some more
bandages in here! This man is dying—(She is cut off by an exploding shell just
outside the tent. When the smoke clears, she's missing an arm and the blood is pumping out
like you'd see in a horror movie. And upon seeing her condition, she says…) Oh no.
Present Day

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: In this life, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, this life! Oh okay no, Chandler's is worse.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, it must be so cool remembering stuff like that! I don't have any past
life memories.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course you don't sweetie. You're brand new.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know Monica's worst Thanksgiving.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, let's not tell this story.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, come on!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, I know! I know! It's the one where Joey got Monica's turkey stuck
on his head!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! Joey got a turkey stuck on his head?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, it's not like it sounds.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's exactly like it sounds.
Thanksgiving 1992

scenes.location: Monica and Phoebe's, Phoebe is entering.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (muffled) Hello?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (surprised) Hello?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey? What's going on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look. (He walks out of the bathroom with his head stuck in a huge turkey.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! It's stuck!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (walks him to the kitchen) Easy. Step. How did it get on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I put it on to scare Chandler!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! Monica's gonna totally freak out!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well then help me get it off! Plus, it smells really bad in here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, of course it smells really bad. You have your head up a dead
animal.
(They hear Monica trying to unlock the door. So Phoebe quickly pushes his head down
onto the table to make it look like the turkey is just sitting on a platter and not stuck
on Joey's head.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, did you get the turkey basted—Oh my God! Oh my God! (She sees
someone is stuck in the turkey.) Who is that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What-what are you doing? Is this supposed to be funny?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it's not supposed to be funny, it's supposed to be scary.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, get it off now!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't! It-it's stuck!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I don't care! That-that turkey has to feed 20 people at my
parent's house and they're not gonna eat it off your head!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, hold on! Okay, let's just all think.
(They all start thinking. Joey starts rubbing his chin, of course his chin is currently
inside the turkey so he ends up rubbing the turkey. And I didn't do that joke one bit of
justice. It's one of those you have to see it to get it jokes.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I got it. Phoebe? All right, you pull. I'm gonna spread the legs
as wide as I can. (Joey starts giggling.) Joey? Now is not the time!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sorry! Sorry.
(They get into position to pull the turkey off.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, count to three. 1. 2. 3!
(They both pull but Joey slips out and starts to fall backwards just as Chandler
enters, scaring him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Arghhhhhh!! (Joey turns around to taunt him, but Chandler is in the
doorway and Joey is facing the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pointing) It worked! I scared ya, I knew it! Ha-ha!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm over here big guy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (turning all the way around, and still not facing Chandler) Yeah, you are!
(Starts dancing.) I scared you!
Present Day

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughing) You did look like an idiot.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I wasn't the only one who looked like an idiot. All right? Remember
when Ross tried to say, "Butternut squash?" And it came out, "Squatternut
buash?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah that's the same.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's it. That's my worse Thanksgiving.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh wait! That can't be the one Rachel's talking about. She didn't even
know that happened. So which one was it?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, I-I really don't want to tell this story.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, come on Monica, reliving past pain and getting depressed is what
Thanksgiving is all about. Y'know, for me anyway. And of course, the Indians.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look umm, of all people, you do not want me to tell this story!
Thanksgiving 1987
[Scene: The Geller household, Mr. and Mrs. Geller are getting ready for Thanksgiving
dinner. The doorbell rings.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Monica! I think Rachel's here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll get it! (She runs in, and she's her old fat self like The One With
The Prom Video. Not only that, she's out of breath after running a short distance. She
goes over and opens the door to reveal Rachel with her old nose.) Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: Not for me. Chip and I broke up!

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Oh, why? Why? What happened?

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: Well, you know that my parents are out of town and Chip was
going to come over…

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, and you were going him y'know, your flower.

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: Okay, Monica, can you just call it sex?! It really
creeps me out when you call it that! Okay, and by the way, while we're at it, a guy's
thing is not called his tenderness. Believe me! (Walks into the living room and greets
Monica's parents.) Hi!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Hi Rachel!

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: You too sweethart!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!
(He brought home Chandler for Thanksgiving. Chandler is sporting the very popular Flock
of Seagulls haircut. Yeah, it's another you have to see it to believe it kinda thing.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Oh my!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, everyone, this is Chandler! My roommate and lead singer of our band!

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Ross! (Wanting to be introduced.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, this is Monica.

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Hi, I'm Ross's little sister.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (seeing her) Okay.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: I'm so glad you could come Chandler, we've got plenty of food so I
hope you're hungry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, mom. Mom. Chandler hates Thanksgiving and doesn't eat any Thanksgiving
food.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh, well, I'm so glad you brought him here then.

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Umm, Chandler, if you want I can make you some macaroni and cheese
for dinner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, as long as the pilgrims didn't eat it, I'm in.
(As she is drinking, Monica laughs and Chandler's joke and Diet Coke comes out
of her nose.)

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: dammit! (Runs off.)
(Ross points out Rachel to Chandler and goes over to talk to her. Rachel is checking
out her nose in her compact mirror.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh, Rach? Does it, does it feel weird around here now? Y'know since
I've been away at college.

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: Oh! No, not really.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, that's cool. So did… (She walks away from him and he shuts up.)
(Rachel wanders into the kitchen where Monica is making Chandler's dinner.)

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: Ugh! I cannot believe Chip dumped me for that slut
Nancy Branson. I am never going out with him again. I don't care how much he begs!

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: I think his begging days are over now that he's going out with Nancy
Branson.

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: Y'know what? I've just had it with high school boys! They are
just silly. (Ross is overhearing this.) Silly, stupid boys! I'm going to start dating men!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, I'm sorry Judy, I couldn't find that bowl that you and Jack were
looking for.

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Call them mom and dad you loser!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in a high pitched voice) Monica!
[Time lapse, dinner has finished and Chandler is sitting on the couch eating some pie.
Monica sits down beside him, and he gets pushed up a little by the wave she makes in the
couch.]

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Hey Chandler! Did you like the macaroni and cheese?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, it was great. You should be a chef.

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Okay!
(He gets up and walks away as Rachel come running over all excited.)

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: Guess what?! All that stuff about Nancy Branson being a slut
was all a rumor so Chip dumped her and he wants to come over to my house tonight!

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Oh that's so great!

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: Oh gosh, listen if you and Chip do it tonight, promise me you'll
tell me everything.

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: Oh totally, totally. Y'know it's not that big of deal, we
already kinda did it once y'know.

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: I know, but y'know, this time you're gonna definitely know
whether or not you did it!

lines.speaker: Big Nosed Rachel
lines.text: I know, I know. And oh, and this time Chip promised
that-that this time it will last at least for an entire song!
[Cut to the kitchen, Ross and Chandler are doing the dishes.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So I’m thinking about asking Rachel out tonight. Y'know maybe play
her that song we wrote last week.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Emotional Knapsack?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right on! Oh! Uh, but, don’t take to long okay? 'Cause uh, we're
gonna test out our fake ID's tonight, right Clifford Alverez.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, Roland Chang, if things go well, I’m gonna be out with her
all night.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dude, don't do that too me!
(Monica enters behind them.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, it's cool you can stay here. My parents won't mind.
(Monica suddenly gets very happy.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it's not that, I just don't want to be stuck here all night with
your fat sister.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!
(Upon hearing this, Monica starts to break down and storms out. Only to be stopped by
her parents.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (holding two pies) Monica, why don't you finish off these pies? I
don't have any more room left in the fridge.

lines.speaker: Fat Monica
lines.text: No. No, thank you!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well Judy, you did it! She's finally full!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, back to the present day.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I called you fat?! I don't even remember that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am so sorry. I really am. I was an idiot back then. I rushed the
stage at a Wham concert for crying out loud!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I can't believe you called her fat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe you let George Michael slap you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am really sorry. That is so terrible. I am so, so sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Actually, y'know that's not the Thanksgiving I was talking about.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, it was!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it wasn't. It was actually the…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting her) Okay, now Thanksgiving's over, let's get ready for
Christmas. Who wants to go get a Christmas tree?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, no, I have the cutest Christmas story!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We wanna hear Monica's Thanksgiving story!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine, all right, mine had a dwarf that got broke in half, but y'know
whatever.
Thanksgiving 1988
[Scene: The Geller household kitchen, Mrs. Geller is cooking and Rachel, post nose job,
is helping her.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: So Rachel, your mom tells me you changed your major again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah, I had too. There was never any parking by the Psychology
building.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (entering) Hi Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh hi!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Wow, love your new nose!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Jack.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: What? Dr. Wilson's an artist! He removed my mole cluster. Wanna see?
(He starts to show her as the doorbell rings.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: I'll get it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, God! Please, let me! (Runs out.)
(She opens the door to reveal Chandler and Ross. Unfortunately, they seem to have their
holidays mixed up. They think it's Halloween and they're going as Crockett and Tubbs from
that legendary TV show of the late 80's, Miami Vice. God, we looked silly back
then!)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. (To his parents) Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (To Chandler) God, your hair sure is different!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we were just talking about that. I can't believe how stupid we
used to look. (They both quickly push their sleeves over their elbows.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh, where's Monica?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: She's upstairs. Monica! Come down! Everyone's here! Ross, Rachel,
and the boy who hates Thanksgiving.
(Monica enters, but she forgot something. Oh, about 150 pounds. In other words, she
lost weight, big time!)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What-what's the matter? Is there, is there something on my dress? (She
turns around making sure he gets a good look.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You just, you look so different! Terrific! That dress! That body!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Yes, yes Monica is thin. It's wonderful. But what we really want to
hear about is Ross's new girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh mom! Okay, umm, her name is Carol. And she's really pretty. And smart.
And uh, she's-she's on the lacrosse team and the golf team. Can you believe it? She plays
for both teams!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So Chandler, I guess I'll see you at dinner.
(She heads for the kitchen and Chandler watches her leave and admires the view.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Dude!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry.
(In the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Oh-ho, my God! That was so awesome! You totally got him back
for calling you fat! He was just drooling all over you. That must've felt so great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well it didn't!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I mean yeah, I look great. Yeah, I feel great and yeah, my heart
is not in trouble anymore! Blah, blah, blah! Y'know I still don't feel like I got him
back, y'know? I just want to humiliate him. I wanna, I want him to be like naked and then
I'm going to point at him and laugh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, that we may be able to do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well guys tend to get naked before they're gonna have sex.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! I mean, I didn't work this hard and-and-and lose all this weight
so that I can give my flower to someone like him!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, first of all, if you keep calling it that, no one's gonna ever
take it. Then, second of all you're not actually gonna have sex with him! You're just
gonna make him think that you are.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And when he's naked I can throw him out in the front yard and lock the
door and all the neighbors will just humiliate him!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Then, you will definitely get him back!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, so how do I make him think I wanna have sex with him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, oh, here's what you do. Just act like everything around you turns
you on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, like anything can be sexy. Like umm, oh-oh, like this dishtowel!
(She grabs it and starts rubbing it on her cheek.) Ooh, ooh, this feels sooo good against
my cheek! And-and if I feel a little hot, I can just dab myself with it. Or I can bring it
down to my side and bring it through my fingers while I talk to him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (excited) I can do that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah? Okay! Good, good, because he's coming. He's coming. (To Chandler)
Hey, what's up? (She leaves and closes the door behind her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica, I was wondering if you can make me some of that righteous mac
and cheese like last year.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, I'd love too! (She goes over and picks up the box and decides to
follow Rachel's advice and holds the box up to her cheek.) Ooh, I love macaroni and
cheese. I love-I love the way this box feels against my cheek.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Boy, I love carrots! Oh! (She picks up a bunch of them and holds them
between her fingers.) Sometimes I like to put them between my fingers like this and-and
hold them down here while I talk to you. (She is rubbing her hip with the carrots.) Umm,
and-and-and y'know if I get really hot umm, I-I like to pick up this knife (She picks up a
knife without putting the box down. She's holding the box between her cheek and shoulder)
and-and umm, I-I put the cold steal against umm, (Pause) my body. (She doesn't have any
exposed skin within reach of the knife, so while holding the carrots in one hand and the
box between her face and shoulder, she rubs the knife on her stomach.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah, of course. I'm fine it's just that—(She drops the box and
in a reflex action tries to catch it with her arm, the knife slips out and slowly flips
through the air and comes point first down into Chandler's shoe.)

scenes.location: The hospital, Chandler has been rushed to the emergency room.

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: What do we got here?

lines.speaker: The Paramedic
lines.text: Twenty year old has got a severed toe on his right foot.
(They go through the doors into the trauma room, opening them by ramming the gurney
through them, only Chandler's foot is hanging off the end and he screams in pain.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can you please not do that feet first? You know where his injury is!
Severed toe, you just said it!

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: It says here that the knife went right through your shoe.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Of course it did. They're made of wicker.

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: Did you bring the toe?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yes! I have it right here, on ice! (She takes a bag of ice out of her
purse and hands it to the doctor.)

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: (opening it) Don't worry son, we'll just attach it and—(Stops
suddenly.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! What is it?

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: You brought a carrot.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: This isn't your toe, this is a small, very cold piece of carrot.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You brought a carrot?!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh my God! There's a toe in my kitchen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God, I'm sorry! I'll go back and get it!

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: It's too late, all we can do now is sow up the wound.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Without my toe?! I need my toe!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, no-no-no, I can go really fast! Dad, give me the keys to your Porsche!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Oh, I'm not falling for that one!
Present Day

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler is reacting to the story.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's why I lost my toe?! Because I called you fat?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I didn't mean to cut it off. It was an accident.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's why for an entire year people called me Sir Limps-A-Lot?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry! It wasn't your whole toe!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, I miss the tip! It's the best part. It has the nail. (He
storms out.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! (Follows him out.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Joey) Sir Limps-A-Lot, I came up with that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're a dork.
[Cut to the hallway, Chandler is standing in front of his door.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, I said I was sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, sorry doesn’t bring back the little piggy that cried
all the way home! I hate this stupid day! And everything about it! I'll see you
later.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh wait, Chandler, come here is there anything I can do? Anything?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, just leave me alone for a while. (He goes into his apartment.)
[Scene: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, Chandler is sitting on one of the chairs and the
duck is running around him and quacking.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-oh, I'm a duck! I go, "Quack, quack!" I’m happy all
the time!
(There's a knock on the door and Chandler gets up to answer it. He opens the door to
reveal Monica with a turkey over her head.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nice try.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait! (She puts a Shriner's hat on the turkey.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, Monica…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look! (She puts a big, yellow pair of sunglasses on the bird.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is not going to work.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I bet this will work! (She starts dancing and Chandler cracks up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You are so great! I love you!
(Monica stops suddenly and turns around slowly.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing! I said, I said "You're so great" and then I just, I
just stopped talking!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You said you loved me! I can't believe this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No I didn't!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, you did!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No I didn't!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You love me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No I don't! Stop it! Stop it! Stop it! Stop it!
(Joey walks in and sees Monica. He freaks out and runs back into the hallway,
screaming.)
Ending Credits
Thanksgiving 1915
[Scene: The Western front during World War I, Phoebe, in yet another past life, is once
again a nurse tending to yet another dying soldier. But this time she's doing it with a
French accent.]

lines.speaker: French Phoebe
lines.text: Gauze! Gauze! I need to get some gauze in here! Can I please
get some gauze in here! (A shell explodes outside next to the tent and when the smoke
clears, Phoebe still has her arm.) Whew! (Her arm falls off and starts pumping out blood.)
This is getting ridiculous uh!

title: The One with Ross's Sandwich

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the entire gang is there, eating breakfast. Phoebe is on
the couch, fidgeting.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What am I sitting on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Top of the world? Dock of the bay? (He tries to think of another but
can't) I'm out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (taking something out of the couch) Ew-eww!! Undies!
(She throws them into the kitchen and Rachel picks them up with the handle of a large
spoon. Chandler and Monica have horrified looks on their faces.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right! Who's are they? Who's are they?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, they're not mine!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, they're Joey's! They gotta be Joey's!
(Rachel turns and stares at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, they're mine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See? They're Joey's! J-J-J-J-J-Joey's!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why are they here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know uhh… (Pause as he thinks about it.) Well, I'm Joey.
Yeah, I'm disgusting, I take my underwear off in other people's homes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, get 'em out of here! What's wrong with you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (waving them in his face) Take 'em! (Joey makes a noise and jumps out of
the way.) Joey, you can touch them! They're your underwear.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (reluctantly taking them) Chandler? A word.
(Follows Joey into their apartment and shrugs on his way out.)
[Cut to the guy's apartment.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's it! I'm tired of covering for you two! This has got to stop!
(Realizes he still has the underwear in his hand.) Ahh! (Throws them towards Chandler's
room.) And tighty-whiteys! What are you, 8?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Thank you Joey, thank you so much!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey, no, you're not welcome. Okay, look, I hate this! You guys keep
embarrassing me! (To Monica) Yesterday, Rachel found your razor in our bathroom and I
didn't know what to say, so I said it was mine and-and that I was playing a woman in a
play. And one thing led to another and (He puts his leg on the chair and pulls up his
pants leg to reveal that he now has shaved legs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (inspecting his leg) Wow! And around the ankles, y'know that is a tough
spot.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it was! All right, listen, I can't…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting him) All this lying has been hard on us too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-oh, yeah-yeah, I bet all the sex makes it easier!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, yeah actually.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We'll try to be more careful okay? It's just that, we don't want
everyone to know because this is going really well, and maybe the reason it's going really
well is because it's a secret.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know it sounds really weird, but we're just so bad at relationships.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We are! Help us!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Help!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! But, (To Monica) you do it with me once.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Didn't think so.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey, Chandler, Monica, and Rachel are there as Phoebe enters
with her nose stuck in a book.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you reading?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, Wethering Heights. I'm taking a literature class at the New
School and I have to finish it for the first session tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn't know you were taking a class. That is so cool.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Well, I really liked that Lamaze class I took! Y'know and this
time I thought I'd go for something, y'know a little more intellectual, with a less
painful final exam.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey that sounds like fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Ooh, you should come with me! Oh yeah, then I'd have someone to
sit with!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
