lines.text: Yeah! Okay—ooh, but are you going to have time to read it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I read that in high school.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is going to be so much fun! Okay-shhh, I have to finish.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering, depressed) Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's wrong buddy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Someone at work ate my sandwich!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, what did the police say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My Thanksgiving leftover sandwich. I can't believe someone ate it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross, it's just a sandwich!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just a sandwich? Look, I am 30 years old, I'm about to be divorced twice
and I just got evicted! That sandwich was the only good thing going on in my life! Someone
ate the only good thing going on in my life!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, look, I-I have enough stuff for one more sandwich, I mean I was
going to eat it myself, but (motions that he can have it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (quietly) That-that would be incredible. Thank you so much. I-I still
can't believe someone ate it!! I mean, look, I left a note and everything.
(Shows the note to Chandler who reads it aloud.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reading) Knock-knock. Who's there? Ross Geller's lunch. Ross Geller's
lunch, who? Ross Geller's lunch, please don't take me. Okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm surprised you didn't go home wearing your lunch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, look you wanna hold onto your food? You gotta scare people off. I
learned that living on the street.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?! So what would you say Pheebs? Stuff like uh, "Keep your
mitts off my grub?"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Say Ross, when you picture Phoebe living on the street, is she
surrounded by the entire cast of Annie?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, this will keep them away from your stuff. (Writes him a note and
the gang reads it.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Whoa! Ohh!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, you are a bad ass!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Someday I'll, tell you about the time I stabbed the cop.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, he stabbed me first!!

scenes.location: Phoebe's class, the class has already started and Rachel walks in late.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Sorry I'm late, but I left late.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So Pheebs, what is the book about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I thought you said you read it in high school.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well yeah, but then I remembered I started it and there was this pep
rally and I was, I was on top of the pyramid but anyway—umm, what is this book about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, umm, it's this tragic love story between Cathy and Heathcliff and
umm, it takes place on like these really creepy mores in England. Which I think
represents the wildness of Heathcliff's character. I totally get symbolism.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: How would you characterize the theme of this book, uh let's see
here (looks at his attendance sheet), Rachel Green?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, well I would have to say that it's a, it's tragic love story.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Well, that's sort of a given, but yes. Anyone else?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-oh-oh, symbolism! And uh, the-the uh, wildness of the mores, which I
think is-is mirrored in the wildness of Heathcliff's character.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Excellent! What Rachel has shrewdly observed here…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) You completely stole my answer!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, honey that was pretty obvious.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well how would you know?! You didn't even read it!

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: What do you think? You in the blue shirt.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think that uh, yours is a question with many answers.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Would ya care to venture one?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Would you care to venture one?

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Are you just repeating what I'm saying?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you just repeating what I'm saying?

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: All right, let's move on.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay then.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica is there as Phoebe and Rachel return from the class.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah but why didn't you just say that you didn't read the book?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Be-because I didn't want him to think I was stupid! I mean, that was
really embarrassing what happened to you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe! You're note, amazing! Not only did no one touch my sandwich, but
people at work are actually afraid of me. Yeah, a guy called me mental! Mental Geller,
yeah, I always wanted a cool nickname like that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, the best you got in high school was Wet Pants Geller.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That was the water fountain! Okay?! Anyway, people are writing reports for
me, uh pushing back deadlines to meet my schedule, I'm telling you, you get tough with
people you can get anything you want. (Joey walks by with a cup of coffee.) Hey Tribbiani,
give me that coffee! Now!
(Joey casually pushes Ross over the back of the couch and sits down proud of himself.)

scenes.location: The hallway, Joey is returning from a date with Cynthia.

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.text: God, this was really fun! I've been wondering if you were going to ask
me out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you uh, still wondering?

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.text: No, we just went out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're smart. I like that.
(He goes to open the door to his apartment, but finds it locked. As he's getting out
his keys, Chandler and Monica quickly jump up from making out in the living room and run
to Chandler's bedroom. The apartment has about 20 candles burning all over the place. Joey
opens the door and ushers Cynthia in.)

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.text: Oh, candles! (Notices something.) What is that? A blanket? A video
camera? Oh my God! (As she storms out, Rachel returns and overhears the conversation.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no, wait-wait-wait!!

lines.speaker: Cynthia
lines.text: I can't believe you thought that you were going to video tape us having
sex on the first date! (She storms away and Rachel enters to confront Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hiya.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, is what she just said umm—Oh my God. (Looks around the room.)
You were actually gonna… (Chandler picks this moment to return to the living room.)
(Rachel stares in shock.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is going on here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And with Chandler in the next room. What are you, what are you sick?
(Chandler silently pleads with Joey to cover for them.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm Joey. I mean, I'm disgusting. I make low-budget adult films. (Points
at Chandler, angrily.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's; continued from earlier. Joey is closing the door
after Rachel leaves and is about to confront Chandler and Monica.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You guys promised you'd be more careful! I mean, come on! The good
Joey name is being dragged through the mud here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're so sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I'm telling everyone about you! That's the only way to explain the
underwear and the video camera that doesn't make me look like a pig!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no, wait! There's got to be a better explanation. You can tell them
you had to make an adult film for your (Thinks) adult film class.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I like that. But no-no, how does that explain why Rachel found my
underwear at your place?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh—I don't know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, get ready to come out of the non-gay closet!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, just wait, please. I promise we'll come up with something. Just
give us a little more time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. Hey, but it better make me look really, really good. (Starts
for his room.) Oh, and another thing, the video camera? Nice!!
[Scene: The Museum of Prehistoric History (Ross's work); Ross is in the break room
eating lunch as his boss, Dr. Leedbetter walks in.]

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: Umm, Ross. May I have a word with you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, of course, Donald.

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: We've been getting reports of some very angry behavior on your
part.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: Threatening letters, refusal to meet deadlines, apparently
people now call you mental.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Proudly) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: We want you to speak to a psychiatrist.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no, you-you don't understand. Ugh, this is so silly. Umm, this is all
because of a sandwich.

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: (laughs) A sandwich?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. You see my-my sister makes these amazing turkey sandwiches. Her
secret is, she puts a, an extra slice of gravy soaked bread in the middle; I call it the
Moist Maker. Anyway, I-I put my sandwich in the fridge over here…

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: (laughs) Oh, you know what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: I-I'm sorry. I, I-I-I believe I ate that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You ate my sandwich?

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: It was a simple mistake. It could happen to anyone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (getting upset) Oh-oh really? Did you confuse it with your own turkey
sandwich with a Moist Maker?

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you perhaps seeing a note on top of it?

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: There may have been a-a joke or a limerick of some kind.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (getting angry) That said it was my sandwich?!

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: Now-now calm down. Come look in my office, some of it my still
be in the trash.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (jumping to his feet in anger) What?

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: Well, it was quite large. I-I-I-I-I had to throw most of it
away.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You-you-you-you (trying to remain in control) threw my sandwich away!
[Cut to an outside shot of the museum.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (losing control, we hear him shout outside) MY SANDWICH?!!!
[Cut to a shot of a park.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: MY SANDWICH!!!!!! (Ross's scream scares a flight of pigeons away.)

scenes.location: Phoebe and Rachel's class; Rachel walks in, on time this time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sitting down) So umm, what's this book about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You didn't read this one either?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I was gonna, but I accidentally read something else.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Vogue! Hey, so tell me about this Jane Eyre woman.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! You should've read it yourself!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on Phoebe! Don’t be such a goodie-goodie!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine! Okay, all right, so Jane Eyre, first of all, you'd think she's a
woman, but she's not. She's a cyborg.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A cyborg?! Isn't that like a robot?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, this book was light years ahead of its time.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: (entering) Sorry I'm late. Let's get started. So, what did
everybody think about Jane Eyre?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, Rachel and I were just discussing it and she had some very
interesting insights.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Well, go ahead Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, thank you Phoebe. Umm, well, what struck me most when reading Jane
Eyre was uh, how the book was so ahead of its time.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: If you're talking about feminism, I think you're right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, well, feminism yes, but also the robots.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler is on the couch as Monica joins him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. Okay, so umm, since that video camera thing didn't work out uh, I
thought that I would give you just a little preview. (Hands him a Polaroid.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (gasps) You're naked in this picture!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.
(Ross walks in, eating cotton candy. Monica nudges Chandler who hides the picture in
his magazine. Ross sits down on the chair, he seems kinda out of it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in a stupor) Hey Chandler. (Sees Monica.) Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm fine! I saw a psychiatrist at work today.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: On account of my rage.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Which I may say, right now, is out of control.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He gave me a pill for it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A pill?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh. Well, when the psychiatrist told me I had to take a leave of
absence because I yelled at my boss I started to get worked up again, so he offered me a
tranquilizer. And I thought was a good idea so, I took it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute, they're making you take time off work?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And you're okay with that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know. It's going to be weird not having a job for a while, but I,
I definitely don't care about my sandwich.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel and Phoebe are returning from class.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, angrily) Ugh, that was so embarrassing! I can't believe you
let me go on and on like that!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (smiling) I'm sorry. It was just so funny when you started comparing Jane
Eyre to Robocop.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That was not funny!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I snapped! Okay? You weren't taking the class seriously.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, come on! What is the big deal? I thought this was going to be
something we could do together! Y'know, I thought it would be fun!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, yeah! Fun is good, but y'know I also wanted to learn. Y'know,
people are always talking about what they learned in high school and I never went to high
school.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh. Oh, so you really wanted to learn. Yeah, y'know, Pheebs I just
wanted to have fun. Ohh, you know who you should go with?

scenes.location: The Class; Monica has taken Rachel's spot.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (yelling and waving her hand in the air) I know! I know! I know!

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Monica, you asked the question.
(She sits back defeated, and Phoebe groans with disgust.)
[Scene: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's; Joey returns carrying a bucket of chicken, and
starts going through the mail. While doing this, Monica's picture falls out. He bends over
to pick it up and gasps. While he's staring at the picture, Rachel decides to come over
and sees him looking at the picture.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sees the picture) Oh my God! That's Monica!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no-no-no! No-no-no-no-no-no-no!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You get away from me!! You sick, sick, sick, sick-o!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering, with the rest of the gang) What's going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey has got a secret peephole!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Sees the picture) Oh no! No! No! No! (Monica gasps as well.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! He has a naked picture of Monica! He takes naked pictures of us!
And then he eats chicken and looks at them!
(Ross stares in shock at him as he angrily puts down the chicken and takes off his
coat.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look! (Shows Ross the picture.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (covering his eyes) Dude! That's my sister! (She shows the rest of the
gang.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (grabbing the picture) Give me that!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, wait! Just wait. Everybody just calm down. Okay? Let's give
our friend Joey a chance to explain why he's such a big pervert!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! I am not a pervert! Okay? It's just… I just…
Kinda…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, look! Look. I think I can explain this.
(He walks over and stands behind Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey's a sex addict.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!! (He turns around and stares at Chandler who's silently pleading
with Joey to go along with it.) No I'm not!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's okay! It's good! It's good. It's a disease!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No! I am not a sex addict!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes you are! That's the only way to explain all this stuff!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No it isn't! No, it's not. Because you can also explain it with the truth!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what is the truth?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, what's going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinking) I slept with Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well let's….let's see what everybody thinks of that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You slept with my sister?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh yes, but it was, we just did it once uh, in London.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is not good for my rage. (Takes another pill.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, is this true?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course it's true! How else would you explain all the weird stuff that's
been going on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes it's true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, but if it only happened that one time, how come we found your
underwear in our apartment the other day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahh—oy! That was the underwear I was wearing that night in London.
Right Monica?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess I wanted to keep it (Pause) as a souvenir.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My God Monica!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you sure Joe? Are you sure you're not just a sex addict?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! If anyone's a sex addict here, it's Monica! Yeah. Yeah. She has been
trying to get me back in the sack ever since London!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So that's why she gave you a naked picture of herself.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That makes sense!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And the video camera?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, Monica?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess I set up the video camera to try and entice Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But sadly I could not be enticed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Unbelievable! I mean you really kept Joey's underwear?! Why? Why would you
do that?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm Monica. I'm disgusting. I stalk guys and keep their underpants.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I think we've all learned something about who's disgusting and who's
not. Eh? All right, now, I'm going to get back to my bucket. I'm only eating the skin, so
the chicken's up for grabs. (Offers it to everyone.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica and Phoebe's class; the class has ended and Phoebe is talking to one of
her classmates.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I really thought you making a good point. I mean y'know, until you got
cut off.

lines.speaker: A Female Student
lines.text: Yeah, what's up with that girl Monica?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't know! I didn't come with her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering, happily) All right everybody! Everybody guess what? I just
convinced Paul to give us a test next week!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: A test?!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on! Tests make us all better learners! Oh yeah! (Running out) We
should have essay questions!!

title: The One with the Inappropriate Sister

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's apartment, Ross is cleaning out the fridge. Joey
walks from his room. He looks like he just woke up.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I...reorganized the fridge. See, bottom shelf: meats and dairy.
(There’s nothing on the shelf.) Middle shelf: fruits and vegetables. (There’s
one lone tomato.) And top shelf: expired products. (The shelf is jammed packed.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because I am bored...Out of my mind. I’ve already been to the
bank, post office, and the dry cleaners.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, you just described seven days worth of stuff. You’ve got to
spread it out a little, you know. Haven’t you ever been unemployed?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I am not unemployed. I’m on sabbatical!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, don’t get religious on me, ok. (Ross looks a little
confused.) A guy in your position needs to be a little better at relaxing. You know. Why
do you think we have the comfortable chairs? Huh...come here…sit down. (Ross sits
down.) Ready? (Joey flips the foot rest up.) Ahh!! (He reclines the chair fully.) Ohh,
yeah!! Huh?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So what, we just sit?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, no, no. We’re not going to just sit. (Joey sits down and
hits the speed dial button on the phone.) Shhh. (It begins to ring.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Answering the phone at work) Hello, Chandler Bing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (In a high pitched female voice) Hello Mr. Bing...I love you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Angrily) Alright, whoever this is, stop calling me! (Ross and
Joey laugh silently.) It’s been six months! It’s not funny!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But, I love you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Leave me alone! For the love of God, leave me alone!!!
(Joey hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And that’s Wednesday. (He reclines in his chair.) Ohh.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler, Ross, Joey, Monica, and Rachel are there. Phoebe walks
in ringing a bell.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey you guys, guess what?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The British are coming?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, you and your ways. (She shakes the bell at him and sits down.)
Since it’s Christmastime. I’m going to be one of those people collection
donations.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Excitedly) Yeah, I already have my bell and later on...I get my
bucket.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I’m going to be out there spreading joy to the
people. I mean, last year, I spread a little joy but not really enough. So this year,
I’m going to do the whole city.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know, I knew a girl in high school who did that. She was very
popular. (Chandler laughs.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So Pheebs, where are you doing all, your bell ringing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, they gave me a great spot. Right by Macys. Yeah, they
hardly ever give such a good spot to a rookie, but I’m the only one who can sing
"Merry Christmas" in 25 languages. (She smirks.) I lied.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my god. Ok you guys, there’s Danny. Watch. Just watch this.
(He walks past the couch to the counter.) See?! Still pretending he’s not interested.
Ohh, he’s coming over. Just pretend like we don’t know him. We’ve forgotten
who he is.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Hey guys.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey Danny.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Danny? You know Rachel? She’s nice. She’s not bad to look
at, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks, Mon.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Well, of course.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you want to go out on a date with her?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica!!!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: (Looking at Monica) Absolutely! Is Friday okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Friday’s perfect...She can’t wait.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: (To Monica) On the date, I will be able to talk to her directly? (To
Rachel) See ya Friday. (He walks out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Somewhat angrily) Okay. What the hell was that? You know what?
Don’t answer me. (Giggling) I have a date with Danny.

scenes.location: Estelle's (Joey's Agent) Office, Joey is there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How could I not get the part? The play was about a 29-year-old Italian
actor from Queens.

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Well, Telia Shire suddenly became available.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She’s a woman!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: What can I say? She nailed it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Very discouraged) Okay, is there anything else?

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Well, you’re just going to say no again but...gay porn.

scenes.location: In front of Macys, Phoebe is collecting donations and ringing her bell.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Happy Holidays. Feliz Navidad. Allo, and Merry Christmas. (A man put
some change in her bucket.) Ohh thank you sir. Here's some joy. (She waves her hand up and
down as if she is spreading joy.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Walking in from off screen.) Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just wanted to see how it's going.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it's going okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Taking out her wallet.) Well good, here let me help you out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, thanks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow!
(Monica puts some change in Phoebe's bucket.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Is that a new Swede jacket? It looks really expensive.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. I guess. (She puts more money in the bucket.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just get your nails done?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes Phoebe, but this is all I have. Okay? (She pours out the rest of her
change purse into the bucket.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! Thanks! Happy Holidays, here's your joy. (She waves her arm and
spreads her joy.)
(A man walks up and puts a dollar bill in.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you! And Happy Holidays.
(The man starts to take some change out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, you can't take the money out.

lines.speaker: The Man
lines.text: I'm making change. I need change for the bus.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But, can't you leave the dollar? This money is for the poor.

lines.speaker: The Man
lines.text: I'm poor! I gotta take the bus!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, Seasons Greetings and everything, but still…

lines.speaker: The Man
lines.text: Bite me, blondie! (The man storms off.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I'm going to give him something else besides joy, just… (She
scowls at him.)

scenes.location: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, Joey is telling Ross how he didn't get the part.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That part was perfect for me! I can't believe I didn't get it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm sorry, man. Hey, y'know what you should do? You should make something
happen for yourself. Y'know, like-like write a play. Write a movie! Huh? I mean, what
about those Good Will Hunting guys?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on Ross be realistic, y'know? If I did write something, what are the
chances I could get those guys to star in it?
(Ross just stares at him until he figures it out.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait a second, I could star in it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Or that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't write! Y'know I mean I-I-I'm an actor, I don't have the discipline
that takes, y'know? I can't do it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll help you. Yeah, I'll make up a schedule and make sure you stick to
it. And plus, it'll give me something to do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? You'd-you'd do that for me?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (grabbing a notepad and sitting down) All right, we'll start off slow. The
only thing you have to do tonight is come up with the name of your main character.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Done!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And it can't be Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's not.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Or Joseph.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (disappointed) Oh.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is returning. Monica enters from her room wearing
nothing but a robe.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, what's up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just saw Danny getting on the subway with a girl and he had his arm
around her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, honey, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you should be, this is all your fault! You meddled in our
relationship!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You had no relationship!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, but I was doing my thing and everything was going according to the
plan!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God, stop with the plan! So what, so what you saw him with a girl?
Who cares?! That doesn't mean anything! Now look, you're going to go out on a date with
Danny and you're going to be so charming he's gonna forget all about that stupid subway
girl.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She was kinda stupid. You're right. All right, I'm just gonna go on the
date. I'm gonna go on the date. That is the new plan.
(Rachel goes into her room and closes the door. Which allows Monica to let Chandler out
of her room.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on, hurry!
(Chandler runs out the door and closes it behind him. After a short pause the door
opens and Chandler comes rushing back through, grabs Monica, kisses her good-bye, and
heads back out.)
[Scene: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, Joey is trying to write his movie, Chandler is
playing a game on the counter by trying to flip a ping pong ball with a spoon into a
nearby bowl.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, how do you spell suspicious?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because I think this character is going to be suspicious about stuff.
(Chandler makes it into the bowl.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Chandler Bing, 7! Chandler Bing, 0.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're driving me crazy with that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I'll stop.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t stop! Move the bowl further away! Ross could make that shot!
(Chandler slides the bowl to the far end of the counter. He tries again, but he hits
the spoon to hard and the ball goes flying away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, you suck! But at least you suck at a man's game now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You wanna play?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, I can't be playing games, Ross is gonna be home soon. And I have
to write five whole pages if I'm gonna stick to his schedule.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, so, play for the next 30 minutes and then write until he gets
home.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (jumping up) All right! But uh, listen, what do you say we crank it up a
notch?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm intrigued.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, all we need is a little lighter fluid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but be careful okay, because I wanna get our security deposit
back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I think we said good-bye to that when we invented hammer darts.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you even remember which part of the wall is not spackle?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh yeah, right here. (He punches his fist through the wall next to the
door.)
[Scene: In front of Macys, Phoebe is still ringing her bell. A guy puts some
change into the bucket.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you, Happy Holidays.
(Another woman walks up and throws something into the bucket.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now, that's trash. Young lady, you can't… (The lady ignores her and
walks off.) Hey! Stop that young lady, she donated trash!
(Another guy walks by and throws his light cigarette butt in the bucket.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!! (The bucket starts smoking.) The charity's on fire! Help! (Yet
another guy walks by carrying a cup, which Phoebe grabs.) Oh good! Thank you, I need that.
(She throws onto the smoldering fire. Suddenly the bucket erupts in flames.) Whoa! What is
that?! (She sniffs the cup.) (To the guy.) It's nine o'clock in the morning!

scenes.location: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, Ross is reading what Joey wrote.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. (Reading.) A room. A man enters, he looks suspicious. (Stops
reading a flips the page to find the next one is blank.) That's it? (Joey shrugs.) Joey,
you're supposed to have five pages done by now! Including an exciting incident!
(Flipping through the rest of the pad.) And what is, and what is all this?! (Reading.) The
official rulebook of Fireball.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, that's the uh, game we were playing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering from his room carrying a fire extinguisher and wearing oven
mitts) Oh yeah, it's great! See you take a tennis ball, a bowl, and some lighter
fluid—Op! Op! (He puts out a small fire which has re-ignited in his room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is helping your career?! Huh? I thought you wanted to be an actor not
the creator of crazy lawsuit game!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're right, you're right, I'll get back to work.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) And shame on you! You should know better, Joey needs to
work. (To Joey) Now come on!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!
(He tries to fire a burnt tennis ball into the bowl Chandler is standing by, but Ross
grabs the ball away from him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Ah-ah-ah-ah-ah! You can have this back when the five pages are done!
(After Joey walks past, Ross throws the ball down in pain.) Ahh! (Chandler shows him the
burn spots on his oven mitts.)

scenes.location: Outside Danny's apartment, Danny and Rachel are returning from their date.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: I had a really nice time tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So did I. I'm really glad Monica asked us out.
(He kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: I'd love to ask you in, but uh, my sister's visiting and I think she's
asleep on the couch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You're sister? You're sister's asleep on the couch? (Danny nods,
"Yes.") Ohhh! I saw her with you on the subway and now she's asleep on
the couch!

lines.speaker: Danny's Sister
lines.text: (opening the door) Oh, I thought I heard you.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Oh hey, great, you're up. Rachel, this is my sister Krista. Krista, this
is Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I wish you'd told me we were having company, I'd fix
myself up!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Like it would help.

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.text: You are so bad! (Hits him softly.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: You are! (Hits her back.)

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.text: You are! (Hits him softly.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: You are! (Hits her back.)

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.text: You are! (Hits him softly.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: You are! (Hits her back.)

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.text: You are! (Hits him harder this time.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: You are so dead! I'm gonna get you.
(He starts chasing her around Rachel a couple of times before she runs into the living
room and he tackles her on the couch where he starts tickling her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (not sure what to do) Uh, it was very nice meeting you. (They continue
to ignore her.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is complaining to Ross and Monica about the
bucket.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nobody! Nobody respects the bucket! You wouldn't believe what people put
in here! Look! (Hands it to Monica.) Okay, does this look like a garbage can to you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Does it look like an ashtray?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Does it look like a urinal?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Eww!! (Throws the bucket down.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So Pheebs, are you gonna go back out there or what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, yeah! But I'm not gonna take anymore crap. Okay? No more Mrs. Nice
Bucket!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, good for you. Y'know you're tough, you lived on the streets.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I'm gonna go back to being Street Phoebe. Yeah! Oh but, y'know
what? I can't go totally back because Street Phoebe really wouldn't be friends with you
guys. Sorry. (Leaves.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her room) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, umm, can I ask you guys something?

lines.speaker: Monica and Ross
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, I don't have any brothers so I don't know, but uh, did you guys
wrestle?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All the time. In fact, I was undefeated.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, you weighted 200 pounds.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Still, I was quick as a cat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I met Danny's sister yesterday, and uh that was actually the girl
on the subway.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you're kidding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, they were very y'know…wrestley. But, I guess that's normal?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughing with Ross) We don't, we don't wrestle now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, not since I got too strong for you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Too strong for me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You wanna go right now? 'Cause I'll take you right now, buddy! You wanna
go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ready? (They grab a hold of each other's necks.) Wrestle! (They start
wrestling.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y'know what uh, actually, that's great. That helps a lot. Thanks.
(She leaves them to wrestle.)
[Scene: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, Ross is cleaning the foosball table, Joey is
working on his script.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering from his bedroom) Guys, come on! Let's go! The puck drops in
20 minutes! Come on, Joe!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey's not going.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) I didn't finish my five pages.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, why can't you do them tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because tomorrow he's redoing yesterday's pages.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yesterday's pages did not reflect my best work.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) Why don't you cut him a little slack? Okay? Maybe if he
relaxes a little bit, he'll get some work done.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think he's been relaxing enough, thanks to you and Fireball.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, if you think Fireball's relaxing, you've obviously have never
played.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The only reason you're doing this to Joey is because you're bored.
Okay, it's not his fault that you're unemployed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am not unemployed. I'm on sabbatical!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on look guys, don't fight.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And the reason I'm doing this is because I am Joey's friend. And if
you were a good friend, you'd be doing the same thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, so being a good friend means acting like a total jerk?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: If it does? Then you're an amazing friend of mine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey guys, hey! How about we settle this over a friendly game of
Fireball? Huh? I'll go unhook the smoke detectors!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How about we settle this right now! (He rips up the tickets.) There! Now,
no one's going to the game. Ha-ha-ha!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I paid for those tickets!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No you didn't. You said you would, but you never did!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah! (Makes an unintelligible taunting sound.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica, Rachel, Joey, and Chandler are listening to a story being
told by Danny and his sister.]

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: …so we finally get to the top of the mountain and airhead here (His
sister) forgets the camera!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, y'know the same thing happened to me one time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When did that happen to you?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don't you remember when we were jogging in the park and we saw that really
pretty bird and wanted to take a picture—I didn't have my camera!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah. First off all, chasing the Churo guy isn't jogging.

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.text: Oh, this is so good (A piece of cake.) you have got to try it. (She
takes some on her finger and feeds it to Danny. Then takes a little more and does it
again. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang stares on in shock. Then they pick up a part of it
and some filling falls into his lap.)

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Oh, damn! I got it on my pants.

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.text: Here, I'll get it. (She grabs a napkin and tries to wipe it up. The
thing that gets the rest of the gang going is that she's whipping awfully close to his
crotch. In fact, she is whipping his crotch. Chandler's about to come out of his chair.)

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.text: We'd better take these pants off upstairs or that stain's gonna set.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Yep. (To Rachel) I'm gonna wear these on our date tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, great!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, bye! (To the gang.) Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was unbelievable!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, see? I told you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, wow, sorry Rach.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't believe they're brother and sister.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They're brother and sister!!!
[Scene: In front of Macys, Phoebe has adorned her bucket with numerous signs.
Like "We are not a urinal!" and "I have no Macys info."
And other stuff like that. She also has a scowl on her face as she is ringing her bell. A
little old lady walks up to make a donation but Phoebe stops her.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh whoa-whoa-whoa! Wait a minute, open up your hand; let me take a look.
(The lady opens up her hand.) Quarter. Dime. Lint? Not interested in that. (She throws the
lint away.) What's this? A Canadian coin? Get outta here! (The lady walks away.)
(Another man walks up with a drink in his hand, Phoebe stops him too.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa! No drinks near the bucket! Set it down over there and
then you can make a contribution! (The guy starts to walk away with a hurt look on his
face.) And you can leave the hurt bunny look over there too! (Her boss and a co-worker
walk up.) Hi Bob! (The same old lady from before walks bye.) (To the old lady.) I thought
I told you to get outta here!

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Uh, Phoebe we've been getting complaints and uh, we're gonna move you to a
less high-profile spot.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Umm, Ginger's gonna take over this corner.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That chick can't handle my corner.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Look, either you leave, or we remove you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine. (She hands her bell to Ginger and starts to take down her signs.)
(The same old lady walks by again.) All right, I'll give you one pointer. Look out for
that bitch. (The old lady.)

scenes.location: Danny's apartment, there's a knock on the door and he answers it.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Oh, hey Rach! I thought we said seven?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah uh, y'know what uh, let's skip it.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: What?! Why?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, you-you and your sister seem to have umm, a very special bond,

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Oh great! That special bond again! Why do women have such a
problem with the fact that I'm close with my sister?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, okay, look. I don't know, listen, I don't know what's going on
here but let's…

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Do-do you, do you have brothers?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I have two sisters. But one of them has a very masculine energy.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Are you close with them?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no, they're not very nice people.

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: Okay, listen, I really like you. Okay? I think this can go somewhere. So
what if I'm close to my family, are you gonna let that stand in the way of us?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, uh, I-I don't know. See when-when you put it that way y'know it
does sort of…

lines.speaker: Krista
lines.text: (calling from the bathroom) Danny! Hurry up! The bath is getting cold!

lines.speaker: Danny
lines.text: (seeing Rachel's shocked look) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, okay, I'll see you later. (Gets up and runs from the apartment.)

scenes.location: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, Ross is there as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh hey! There's some kids playing in the street, you wanna go down
there and give them a project, ruin their day?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, if they have a ball maybe you can stick razor blades in it and teach
them a new game, Gonna Need Stitches Ball.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys! I was at the library all morning and I already
finished my five pages for today!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great! Now, we can go to the Ranger game! (Pause) Last night!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No dude, Ross tore up the tickets!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I guess when you don't have so many distractions, it's easier for you to
focus. Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah or also when you don't have somebody breathing down your neck ALL
THE LIVE LONG DAY!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, well, that's fine, but the important thing is that I finished it.
And uh, I think it's really good, but y'know it'd really help me is if I could hear it. So
would you guys read it for me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right. (Takes a copy.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. (Takes another copy.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (Reading.) "It's a typical New York City apartment. Two guys
are hanging out." Ross (Points to him.)
(Ross and Chandler start to read Joey's script aloud.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: About yesterday, I was really wrong. I am sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it was me. I'm sorry. I over reacted.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe it was both of us, but we had our best friend's interest…
(Pauses and looks at Joey.) But we had our best friend's interest at heart.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Could I be more sorry. (Looks at Joey.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know, I'm one sorry polentologist. (Stops reading.) All right
Joey, we get it. (To Chandler) I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) I'm sorry too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no! No-no, keep reading! The good part's coming up. Keep going.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (reading from the script.) I am sorry, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am sorry, Ross.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A handsome man enters. (Playing the part of the handsome man.) Hey! How's
it going guys? I don't know what you two were talking about, but I'd like to say thanks to
both of you. You, (Ross) you wouldn't let me give up on myself, and you (Chandler) well
you co-created Fireball. The end.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This took you all day?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, this only took five minutes. I spent the rest of the day coming up
with new, Ultimate Fireball. (Takes out a bowling ball and a propane torch.) Ha-ha!
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are about to read another one of Joey's
efforts.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Reading the scene set up.) Okay, it's a typical New York City apartment.
Two girls are just hanging out.
(Monica and Rachel begin to read from the script.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, how are you doing Kelly?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm doing just fine! God, Tiffany, you smell so great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's my new perfume. Why don't you come closer where you can really
appreciate it?
(They both start to read ahead.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, y'know Joey, you are sick!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is disgusting!
(They both throw the scripts in his face.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm not reading this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! Wait-wait-wait! The handsome man was about to enter!!

title: The One with All the Resolutions

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are hosting a New Year's party. So the
place is crowded and in a shameless promotion for NBC they're watching Jay Leno's coverage
of New Year's from Time Square.]

lines.speaker: Jay Leno
lines.text: (On TV to Dick Clark) Is there any entertainment there? What are people
doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Here we go! 1999! The year of Joey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (deadpan, standing next to Monica) We're very happy for you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's the matter?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We wanted to kiss at midnight, but nobody else is going to so
y'know…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I'll take care of it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no, wait! Joey!
(They try to stop him, not sure of what he's planning. He ignores them and goes to talk
to Ross.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross! Ross! Ross, listen! Who are you kissing at midnight, huh? Rachel or
Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well you gotta kiss someone, you can't kiss your sister.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, who's gonna kiss my sister.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Awww, man! Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude-dude, who would you rather have kiss your sister, me or Chandler?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's a good point.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh well, since I have that whole history with Rachel, I guess Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs! Pheebs! Ross wants to kiss you at midnight!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's so obvious, why doesn't he just ask?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach! Rach! Listen, I'm gonna kiss you at midnight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, everyone's gotta kiss someone. You can't kiss Ross you got the
history.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So? Who would you rather have kiss you, me or Chandler?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, good point.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (watching the ball drop) 3! 2! 1! HAPPY NEW YEAR!!
(And with that everyone starts playing tonsil hockey. Chandler with Monica, Ross with
Phoebe, and Joey with Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Happy New Year!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Happy New Year.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Happy New Year, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You too!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Joey) Happy New Year, Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So did that do anything for ya?
(Rachel slowly walks away.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, after the party. Everyone has left, except for the gang.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know what? I'm gonna go out on a limb and say no divorces in '99!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But your divorce isn't even final yet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just the one divorce in '99! Y'know what, I am gonna be happy this year. I
am gonna make myself happy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you want us to leave the room, or?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Everyday I am gonna do one thing that I haven't done before. That
my friends is my New Year's resolution.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! That's a good one! Mine is to pilot a commercial jet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's good one too, Pheebs. Now all you have to do is find a
planeload of people who's resolution is to plummet to their deaths.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe your resolution is to not make fun of your friends, especially the
ones who may soon be flying you to Europe for free on their own plane.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She has a better chance of sprouting wings and flying up your nose than
you do of not making fun of us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: In fact, I'll bet you 50 bucks that you can't go the whole year without
making fun of us. Eh, y'know what, better yet? A week.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'll take that bet my friend. And you know what, paying me the 50
bucks could be the "new thing you do that day!" (Ross looks at him.) And it
starts right now!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, my New Year's resolution is to learn how to play the guitar.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?! How come?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, y'know those special skills I have listed on my resume? I would love
it would be great if one of those was true.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do you want me to teach you? I'm a great teacher.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? Who-who have you taught?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I taught me and I love me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah that'd be great! Thanks Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Op, look! Claire forgot her glasses! And she's gonna be really needing
these to keep an eye on that boyfriend, who, I hear, needs to keep his stapler in his desk
drawer, if you know what I'm talking about.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Rach, maybe your resolution should be to umm, gossip less.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't gossip!
(They all laugh.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, maybe sometimes I find out things or I hear something and I pass
that information on y'know kinda like a public service, it doesn't mean I'm a gossip. I
mean, would you call Ted Kopel a gossip?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well if Ted Kopel talked about his coworkers botched boob jobs, I would.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? They were like this!
(She puts her hands over her breasts and indicates that the coworkers boob job resulted
in one pointing up and one pointing down with her hands by pointing up with one hand and
down with the other.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is talking to a beautiful woman as Chandler and Joey enter.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I'll see you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! (She leaves.) (To Chandler and Joey.) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just asked that girl out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nice!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice!! Yeah! Is that part of your resolution, your new thing for today?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes it is. See. (Shows them the piece of paper she gave him with her name
and phone number on it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reading it) Elizabeth Hornswoggle?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's right, uh, Elizabeth Hornswoggle.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Horn-swoggle.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You all right Chandler? Is there something funny about that name?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. No, I just think that maybe I-I'd heard it somewhere before. (Sits
down rubbing his temple.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh really! Where? Somewhere funny I'd bet! (Chandler is straining to keep
quiet as Phoebe enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh, guess what? I-I have a date with Elizabeth (Talking into Chandler's
ear.) Hornswoggle.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hornswoggle? (To Chandler) Ooh, this must be killing you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, see you later.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See ya! All right Pheebs, I am ready for my first lesson.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Joey tries to take the guitar.) Oh no-no-no, you don't touch the
guitar! First you learn here, (Points to her head.) then you learn here. (Points to the
guitar.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm, okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, lesson one: chords. Now, I don't know the actual names of the
chords but umm, I-I-I made up names for the way my hand looks while I'm doing them. (She
starts to show Joey the chords. Transcribers Note: For this one you'll have to use your
imagination, 'cause it would take me 50 pages to describe each one. So if you want to see
them, you'll have to wait for this episode to come to a TV near you.) (Holding up her hand
and then reconfiguring her hand with each name.) So then, this is Bear Claw. Okay, umm,
Turkey Leg and Old Lady. (Joey tries to imitate them.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What an interesting approach to guitar instruction. Y'know some might
find it amusing, I myself find it regular.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is entering with Rachel.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey everybody, Rachel was so good today. She didn't gossip at all.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I didn’t! Even when I found out…umm, all right, well let's
just say I found something out something about someone and let's just say she's gonna keep
it. (Goes into her room.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs! Check-check this out. (Holds up his hand in one of Phoebe's
chords.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, you nailed the Old Lady! (They both laugh at what she said.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah listen so, I thought I was getting better, so on my way home today I
stopped by this guitar store and…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Did you, did you touch any of the guitars while you were there?
Did you?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Give me your hands. (He does and she smells his left hand.) Strings.
Gimme it! (He gives her his right hand and she smells it as well.) Pick. Do you want to
learn to play guitar?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then don't touch one!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering, with Ben) Hi!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi Ben!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Auntie Monica!! (He runs to hug her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (notices something) Ross is wearing leather pants! Does nobody else
see that Ross is wearing leather pants? (Pause, no one speaks.) Someone comment on the
pants!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think they're very nice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I like 'em.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! (Chandler bangs the table in frustration.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I like them a lot.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's not what I had in mind! See, people like Ross don't generally
wear these types of pants. You see, they're very tight. (Motions to Ross's buttock.) Maybe
there's something in that area.
(They all speak at once in general approval of his pants selection; Joey asks where he
got them. I can't pick out the rest of it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh see, I-I needed a new thing for today and there's this leather store
that always smells so good and I thought to myself, "Wow, (To Chandler) I never
really owned a good smelling pair of pants before."
(No one says anything.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh come on!! (Storms out.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (after he's left) Okay, seriously, what do you think?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You look like a freak.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Awful, absolutely awful. (Plus other negative comments from Phoebe and
Monica.)
(Monica starts taking pictures of Ross and Ben, with the flash.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's my New Year's resolution!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, to blind my child?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! To take more pictures of all of us together. I mean I really think
it's the best resolution because everyone will enjoy the pictures.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, everyone will enjoy my music as well. (Does a chord and Monica
starts taking pictures of him and Phoebe. They both start to strike a pose with the
excessive amount of pictures that Monica takes.)
[Scene: Elizabeth Hornswoggle's apartment; Ross is there on his date with her. They are
sitting on the couch watching a movie. Ross is obviously hot.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (talking to himself) My God! These pants are burning up! (He's still
wearing the leather pants.) (She snuggles closer.) Oh come on, she wants to snuggle now!
What is she trying to kill me? It's like a volcano in here! (Out loud.) Are you hot?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth Hornswoggle
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, it must just be me then.
(He shifts on the couch and a ripping sound emanates from his lower regions, the sound
reminds one of a brief explosion of gas. In other words, it sounds like he farted. She has
a look of horrific wonderment, wondering "Did he just fart?")

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That was just the pants on the couch. Umm, hey, do you, do you mind if I
use your bathroom?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: No, go ahead.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. (Gets up and as he does so, the sound returns. Without another
word he heads into her bathroom.)
[Cut to Elizabeth Hornswoggle's bathroom, Ross frantically pulls his shirt out and
drops his pants. He exhales in sheer ecstasy as the coolness of the bathroom envelops his
legs. He sits on the cast iron bathtub, again gasping in pleasure. He next grabs a
magazine and starts to blow air on his exposed legs, but that doesn't work the way he
wants it to. So he throws the magazine down, looks around for another idea, and finds one.
He jumps up and hops to the sink. He turns on the water and starts to splash some on his
legs, cooling them further.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in ecstasy) Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhh……….

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: (yelling from outside) Hey, my favorite part is coming up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 'Kay!
(He goes to pull up his pants, but can't seem to get them past his knees. He
frantically tries to pull them up to no avail. Panic sets in.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is drilling Joey on the chords as Monica looks on.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Tiger! (Joey moves his hand in an attempt to do the chord, in fact he
does it with each name.) Dragon! Iceberg!! (He fails.) Joseph, did you even study at all
last night?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes! Yes, I did.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then do Iceberg!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinks) (quietly) G-sharp.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: G-sharp? Have you been studying the real names of the chords?
(Joey doesn't answer.) Have you? (He looks away in shame.) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! I didn't touch a guitar!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, but you're questioning my method!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I'm not questioning it, I'm saying it's stupid! (Notices Monica
standing between them and smiling.) What?! (The camera clicks, taking another picture.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you. (Leaves.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know none of my other student thought I was stupid.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Your other student, was you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, well, y'know maybe you just need to try a little harder!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking in the Yellow Pages) Look, maybe I need to try a real teacher!
Right here! Here! Andy Cooper, he teaches guitar and look ooh, there's a nice picture of
him with a little kid and THE KID'S GOT A GUITAR!!!!!! (Storms out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine! You go learn from your qualified instructor! But don't come crying
to me when everyone's sick and tired of hearing you play Bad, Bad Leroy Brown!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, singing) "Baddest man in the whole damn town."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, fine! Take his side! (Storms out.)
(Rachel looks shocked, gets over it, notices she's alone, and picks up the phone. The
last part of which is something she shouldn't have done, because the phone is already in
use. By Monica, and now Rachel can hear every word.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) I can't wait to be with you! I'll sneak over as soon as Ross
picks up Ben. I'll just tell Rachel I'm gonna be doing laundry for a couple of hours.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on phone) Laundry. Huh. Is that my new nickname? (Rachel is
absolutely stunned, she opens her mouth in absolute amazement.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Awww, y'know what your nickname is, Mr. Big…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Arghh!! (She quickly hangs up the phone and starts to pace around
wondering what to do.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, The phone rings and Joey answers it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (answering phone) Hello?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (calling from Elizabeth's bathroom) Joey, it's Ross! I need some help!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, Chandler's not here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you can help me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, I'm in Elizabeth's bathroom…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I-I got really hot in my leather pants so I took them off but they
must have shrunk from the-the sweat or-or-or my legs expanded from the heat. Look, I-I
can't put them back on. I can't!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. That is quite a situation. Uh, do you see any like, powder?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Powder! Yeah! Yeah, I have powder! (Grabs some of her shelf.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good-good, okay, sprinkle some of that on your legs, it'll absorb some of
the moisture and then you can get your pants back up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, okay, hold on! (He puts the phone down and proceeds to spread a
large amount of powder on his legs and makes another attempt at pulling up his pants. It
doesn't work, and without picking up the phone leans down to it.) (Almost in tears.)
They're not coming on man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm, do you see any—oh, Vaseline?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, I-I see lotion, I have lotion! Will that work?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, sure, spread some of that on there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hold on.
(Ross proceeds to apply copious amounts of the lotion on his legs. He literally starts
spraying the back of his legs with the lotion, and as he applies some to his butt he makes
a happy face like he enjoyed that sensation. After using about half the bottle he again
tries to pull up his pants, but at the first sign of resistance, his hand slips off of the
pants and hits him in the forehead.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross? You okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They're still, they're still not coming on man and the lotion and the
powder have made a paste!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?! Uhh, what color is it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What difference does that make?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I'm just—if the paste matches the pants, you can make yourself
a pair of paste pants and she won't know the difference!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Joey, do you have a minute?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude, what am I gonna…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Ross) Uh, Rachel's here, so good luck man, let me know how it works
out. (He hangs up the phone and strands Ross in the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Joey, I have such a problem!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well, you're timing couldn't be better. I am putting out fires all over
the place.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Okay. Joey, I have got to tell you something!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What-what is it, what is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, it's so huge, but you just have to promise me that you cannot
tell anyone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no, no-no-no-no! I don't want to know!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! Yes! Yes, you do want to know! This is unbelievable!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't care, Rach! Look, I am tired of being the guy who knows all the
secrets but can't tell anyone!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What secrets? You know secrets? What are they?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And you're not supposed to be gossiping!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I know! I just can't keep this one in, so I pick up the
phone… (Joey in a childish attempt to not hear what Rachel is about to say, puts his
fingers in his ears and starts to scream loudly. Rachel turns and walks out upon seeing
that Joey's not gonna listen, and as she exits Chandler walks in and sees Joey in his
current state.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm not listening to you!
(Chandler seeing that Joey has his eyes closed sneaks over and picks up the chicken.
The chicken starts flapping it's wings in protest as Chandler holds the chicken inches
from Joey's face. Joey stops yelling and upon opening his eyes sees the chicken, screams,
and falls to the ground in horror.)
[Scene: Elizabeth's apartment; Elizabeth is inquiring as to the delay in Ross's exit
from her bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Ross, umm, you've been in there for a long time. I'm starting to get
kinda freaked out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, I'm coming out. Hey, can you turn the lights off.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: No, let's just leave the lights on.
(Ross opens the door and steps into the living room. He has fully removed his pants and
holds them wrapped into a ball in front of his crotch. His legs are covered in the powder
and lotion paste. He looks terrible.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I had a problem.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is there to apologize to Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I can't talk to you! I don't have a fancy ad in the Yellow Pages!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, Pheebs, I just, I wanna apologize for, for saying that your method
was stupid and-and maybe ask you to be my teacher again. And-and I promise, I won't touch
a guitar until you say I'm ready. (After a short pause she hands him her guitar.) You
really think I'm ready?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! Cool! (He takes the guitar, stands up, and goes to play a note.
However, while strumming it, he knocks it out of his hands and it bounces off the table
and lands on the floor. Phoebe just stares at the guitar.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sitting back down) Was the chord at least right…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is returning from his horrible trek back home without
pants on. The whole gang is there.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We heard about your pants, I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This year was supposed to be great! But, it's only the second day and I'm
a loser with stupid leather pants that don't even fit!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: No. No, you're not a loser.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look at me! (Chandler squeaks in an attempt not to make fun of him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, hey, look. Look Ross, Ben drew a picture of you! (Shows him Ben's
picture.) Huh? You're-you're a cowboy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, be-because of the leather pants.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See? Ben doesn't think you're a loser, he thinks you're a cowboy! Now
that's something.
(All at once.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That really is something; that's really cool.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Howdy partner!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe I should get another pair! Ooh, y'know, they-they had some with
fringe all down the sides. (Chandler starts rubbing his temple again.) I'm gonna go kiss
Ben goodnight. (He starts to head for Monica's bedroom.) I can't believe he thinks I'm a
cowboy. (Pause.) I would make a good cowboy. (He struts into Monica's room.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, now that everything's wrapped up here, I think I'm, I'm gonna go
do my laundry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, me too. Y'know if this shirt is dirty. (Smells it.) Yep.
(They both exit.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I'm gonna go too. I'm gonna go to the airport. I figure if I hang
around there long enough, someone's bound to leave one of those planes unattended.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good luck, honey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bye! (She exits, leaving Rachel and Joey alone.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, uh, Joey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Remember that big thing I was gonna tell you about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, no! (Starts that screaming thing again. Rachel stops him by pulling
his fingers out of his ears.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm not gonna tell you, but if you found out on your own, that would be
okay and then we could talk about it. Right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, then it wouldn't be a secret. So yeah, that would be okay. Yeah.
Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (quietly) Yeah. Well. (Pause.) Hey uh Joe, would mind going over to
Chandler's bedroom and get that book back that he borrowed from me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now? You want me to go over there now?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you know something?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you know something?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I might know something.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I might know something too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's the thing you know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, I can't tell you until you tell me what you know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't tell you what I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well then I can't tell you what I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, fine.
(Silence ensues.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don't know!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, how about I go over there and I will walk into
Chandler's bedroom and I will see that thing that I think that I know is actually
the thing that I think that I know! (Note: Kudos to Ms. Aniston on the delivery of that
line. She said it very quickly and didn't screw up a word. Try it yourself, it ain't that
easy.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (gasps) YOU KNOW!!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: AND YOU KNOW!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I know!!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler and Monica?!! Oh, this is unbelievable!! How long have you
known?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Too long! Oh my God, Rach, I've been dying to talk to someone about this
for so long! Listen, listen, we can't say anything about this to anybody, they're so weird
about that! Listen… (Phoebe returns and interrupts them.)

lines.speaker: Joey and Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! It's raining. I don't want to fly in the rain. So…
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I am going to go for a walk in the rain.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh, yeah, me too.
(They both exit.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's weird. (Pause.) I bet they're doing it.
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe, Ross, and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Oh good, okay, I can't take it anymore. I can't take it
anymore. So you win, okay? Here! (Hands him the 50 bucks he's about to owe him.) Pheebs?
Flying a jet? Better make it a spaceship so that you can get back to your home
planet! And Ross, phone call for you today, Tom Jones, he wants his pants back! And
Hornswoggle? What are you dating a character from Fraggile Rock?! (He sits down and
sighs in relief.)
