title: The One with Chandler's Work Laugh

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is trying to pry more information about Chandler
and Monica from Joey who's sitting on the couch and busy downing a pizza.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on Joey!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach, I told you everything I knew last night! Look, it's not that big of a deal,
so Monica and Chandler are doing it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't believe you would say that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sorry. Monica and Chandler are making love.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! I mean come on! This is a huge deal! (She sits next to him on the
couch.) Fine I want—I need more details, who-who initiated the first kiss?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinks) I don't know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is he romantic with her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are they in love?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinks) I don't know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don't know anything.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, I know one thing!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They did it right there on the couch.
(He points to where she's sitting and she jumps up quickly.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (disinterested) Hey-yeah. (He hurries up to the counter.) Hey Gunther, can I have
a scone please? (To the gang.) Wanna hear some good news? Someone I know is getting
married! Yeah! And weddings are happy occasions! Oh, by-the-by it's my ex-wife Emily!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What? Oh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry man.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Here's your scone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thanks Gunther. (He takes it, hands the plate it's on to Rachel, sets it down
on the table, and proceeds to pound it into oblivion while saying.) STUPID BRITISH SNACK

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did they teach you that in your anger management class?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, you know what might help you deal with it? Think of it this way, you and
Emily are in the past and you can't be mad about the past. So are you still mad about the
Louisiana Purchase?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, I don’t think anyone's mad about that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Exactly! Because it's in the past!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (eyeing the flattened scone) Anybody gonna eat that?

scenes.location: Chandler's office, Monica and him are at a party his office is throwing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look at us all dressed up for the big office party! By the way, what are we
celebrating?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, we had a lot of liquor left over from the Christmas party.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think this is so cool because none of our friends are here and we can be a
real couple. We don't have to hide.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, I can do this. (He takes her hand.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooh, and I can do this. (She kisses him on the cheek.)
(They both stand real close together.)

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: We can't do that. (They separate.)
(Chandler's boss (Doug) walks up.)

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Hey Bing! (Slaps him on his ass.) (Sees Monica) Wo-ho-ho, who's the pretty lady
and what the hell is she doing with you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I asked myself that very question, sir. Uh, (Points to Monica) this is
Monica. (Points to his boss.) This is my boss, Doug. Doug this is Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Hi! And this is my wife Kara.

lines.speaker: Kara
lines.text: Nice to meet you Monica. Bing! (Slaps Chandler on his butt.)

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Say uh, Bing, did you hear about the new law firm we got working for us?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, sir.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Yeah, Dewey, Cheatum, and Howe.
(Chandler does a fake laugh.)

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Come on honey, let's go drink our body weight. (They walk off leaving Chandler
and Monica alone.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That noise you just made?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that was my work laugh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? Your work laugh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, believe me, to survive this party, you're gonna have to come up with one
too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, check me out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(She walks up to where Doug is finishing another joke to another group.)

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: …says $30 Father; same as in town.
(Monica does a fake laugh. For the laughs, you'll have to see the episode. I can't
describe them.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica is buying a muffin as Chandler runs in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Everybody at work loved you last night!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And! They like me more just because I was with ya! I think you
repaired a lot of the damage from when they met Joey. And Doug wants us to play tennis
with them. He's never even talked to me outside of work. Except for that time when
we bumped into each other at that strip club. (She glares at him.) Strip church. Anyway,
I'm gonna go try and find a racquet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, I thought you already had one.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh I used too, but then Joey thought it would be fun to go to Central Park
and hit rocks at…bigger rocks. (He starts to leave and stops an entering Rachel.) Hey
Rach, do you have a tennis racquet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh umm, y'know I lent it to Joey and I never actually got it back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, good luck with that. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Monica) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What's up?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing here? I thought you had to do inventory all day.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well yeah, I do, but I decided to take a long lunch and spend some time with my
friend Monica. Y'know I-I feel that we don't talk anymore. How are you? What is new with
you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uhh, not much. Uh, work's good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh y'know what, we don’t have to talk about work. We can talk about
anything!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Umm…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Y'know what? Let's talk about relationships!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, what's going on with you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing! You go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I-I—there was this guy at the bank that I thought was cute umm, but
I don't anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow that's uh, juicy. Umm, (checks watch) y'know what though Mon, I actually do
have a lot of work to do so if-if—are you sure there's just not anything else?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, I'm sure! Rachel is there something that you want to talk me about?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! (Gets up to leave.) (Under her breath.) If there was I wouldn't tell you.
[Scene: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, Phoebe is settling a dispute between the chick and
the duck.]
(The duck quacks.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, then what happened?
(The duck flaps its wings frantically.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) Ohh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. (The chick clucks.) You'll get your turn!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering from the bathroom) Hey Pheebs, what's going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing! (Picks up and sets the chick down on the floor.) (To the chick.) This
is not over!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was up all night writing this really nasty letter to Emily! It was perfect and
now it's all covered in-in… (The duck quacks.) Actually, thanks!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering from his room) All right! Everybody ready to go to the movies?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh actually, I think I'm gonna skip it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I'm gonna stay and read my book. I just wanna be alone right now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Are you sure you don't want to come? Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, they get mail and
stuff.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's okay, Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, let's go Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (licks the envelope and encounters a foreign substance on the glue.) Oh God!
[Scene: A tennis court somewhere in the city of New York, it's the doubles match-up of
a century Chandler and Monica versus Doug and Kara.]

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Bing!
(Hits the ball towards Chandler who returns it back to him. He then hits the ball at
Monica who slams it and it bounces off Kara's leg.)

lines.speaker: Kara
lines.text: Oww!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Game!

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Well, I gotta tell ya Bing; that partner of yours is a real tiger. (To his wife.)
Are you all right sweethart?

lines.speaker: Kara
lines.text: (out of breath and mouths) I'm not all right.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: We're, we're just gonna get a little sip of water.
(They both walk off the court.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Am I on fire today or what?! Those birds are browned, basted, and ready to be
carved!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, easy Martina. I think we should let them win the next game.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry, I don't understand what you just said.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let them win one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you crazy?! We own those two! I mean look at 'um, he can't breath and she's
popping pills.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're not even giving them a chance!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They have racquets don't they?!

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Uh Bing, I think we're gonna make this the last game.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes, sir! Put me out of my misery. Are you sure you never played pro?
(Does his work laugh.) (To Monica) Please let them win!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll take it down to 95% but that's the best I can do.
(She serves to Doug who returns it to Chandler. As it bounces over his head Chandler
swings and misses.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oopsey, missed it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I got it! (She hits a forehand smash that bounces right in between Doug and
Kara and scores a point.)

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Nice shot.
(Chandler glares at her and she shrugs her shoulders. Monica serves again; and Kara
returns it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I got it!!
(Chandler cuts in front of her and hits the ball high and long.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Long! (Gives Monica the Work Laugh.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Chandler are returning from the game.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe you let them win!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, at least you hid your feelings well about it. (Removes a smashed
racquet from his bag.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was frustrated.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It was my racquet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was frustrated with you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If we hadn't lost the game they never would've invented us to dinner tomorrow
night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what really bothers me? Is—it's how-how different you act around
them! I mean y'know the throwing the tennis games, the fake laugh, the "I'll see you
around, Bing!" "Not if I see you first, Doug!" (Mocks the fake laugh.) I
gotta tell you, I don't like Work Chandler. Okay? The guy's a suck-up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay y'know what, because you said that, I'm not putting out tonight.

scenes.location: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, the next morning the girls are there with Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm telling you, something's wrong! My brother does not stay out all night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe we should check the trash chute.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross couldn't fit down the trash chute.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's right, he almost could. Which is exactly how I got stuck there.
(Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: There he is!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! (She goes to hug him, stops short, and hits him on the shoulder.)
Where the hell have you been?!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just, y'know out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, out, oh God, I don't know why we didn't think to check there!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What were you doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I uh, went to a bar. And then I just uh, just walked around for a while.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You walked around all night in the city by yourself?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (snaps his fingers) He hooked up! He hooked up with someone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I don't have to answer your questions! Okay? I'm a big boy, I can do
whatever I want!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He hooked up!! Tell us about her!
[Suddenly the door opens and Ross's mystery girl enters. I'll give you a hint to who it
is: OH….MY….GAWD!! Uh-huh, it's Janice.]

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (entering) Ross you left you scarf in…(sees everyone.) Hey you guys. (Does
the laugh.)
(They all turn and with shocked looks on their faces stare at Ross. Ross is at a loss
for words at this moment.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Uh-oh-okay. Uh-oh-okay. I know what you all are thinking. But Chandler is in Yemen!
I'm a young woman! I have needs! I can't wait forever!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! No that's what I was thinking.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: So I'm asking you please, take a moment before you judge me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, nobody's judging you. (They all turn and look at Ross.)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh! Okay! (To Ross) You, Mister Right Place at the Right Time, call me! (Does
her famous, or is that infamous, laugh and exits.)
(They all turn and glare at Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, look, I-I know what you guys are going to say…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You two will have very hairy children.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I didn't know you would say that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! Janice?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, hold on! Hold on. Hold on. This is Ross, okay? He's our friend. He
obviously went crazy. He obviously lost his mind.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I didn't lose my mind! Okay, Janice and I have a lot in common!
We've-we've both been divorced. We-we both have kids.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So are you actually gonna see her again?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phoebe! Don't put ideas in his head!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am gonna see her again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damnit Phoebe!!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is going through her purse as Rachel rushes in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Okay, I have to tell you something that I have never admitted during
our entire friendship! But, when we were in high school I made out with James Farrell even
when I knew that you liked him! Wow, that feels so good to get off my chest! Okay, you go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My turn? What-what are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, Monica, I know about you and Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I overheard you guys on the phone the other day, and you said, "I'll just
tell Rachel that I'm doing laundry for a couple of hours." And he said,
"Laundry? Is that my new nickname?" And you said, "No! You know what
your nickname is, Mr. Big."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well. Sounds like you're writing yourself a little play there Rach. Wow! Let me
know how that one turns out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I wouldn't know because I got so freaked out that I hung up the phone.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, if you had kept listening, you-you would have heard me call him Mr.
Big…(Thinks)…ot.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mr. Bigot. He tells the most racist jokes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. So you're telling me that there is nothing going on between you and
Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Me and Chandler?! (Does her fake laugh.)

scenes.location: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, Phoebe and Joey are there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, put your 20 bucks down. First one to find the tasty treat wins. Okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. Let's get the contestants out of their isolation booths. (He removes
the waste bucket that's over the duck and the laundry basket that's over the chicken.) And
they're off! (He puts his foot in front of the chick, stopping it from moving.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Get your foot off my contestant! Judge!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Judge rules, no violation.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohhh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!
(Neither of them turns around from watching the chick and the duck look for the tasty
treat.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know what? It sounds so weird to say this but, I just had a great day with
Janice!
(They both turn around.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you serious?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! I opened up to her about all the terrible stuff that's been happening to
me. I mean I talked for hours. (Joey has lost interest and is watching the race again.) It
is amazing to have someone give you such-such focused attention.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You don't need Janice for that, you've got us. We…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And the duck gets the Nutter-Butter!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (turning from Ross.) No!! Hey-hey that's not a Nutter-Butter, that's just an
old Wonton!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Judge rules, Nutter-Butter.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, tough call.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

scenes.location: Doug's house, Chandler, Monica, and them are just finishing dinner.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: But seriously, I believe that we should all support President Clinton. And her
husband Bill. (Chandler does the laugh.)

lines.speaker: Kara
lines.text: So how do you kids like your coffee?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, none for me. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Just a little bit of sugar.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Well, maybe I'll bring it out and have Monica stick her finger in it. That oughta
sweeten it up, huh? (Once again, with the laugh.)
(Doug and Kara go get the coffee.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) How does that laugh not give you a headache?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, you get used to it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know, I-I-I don't think that I can. So if you don't mind, maybe this will be
it for me on the work things.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So I laugh at my boss's jokes, what's the big deal?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'd rather hang out with a sniveling work weasel guy when I can be hanging out
with my boyfriend who I actually respect.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh. (Does a double take when he realizes what she just said.)

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: (entering) Uh, I gotta apologize for Kara's coffee. Y'know, I feel sorry for it
if it ever got in a fight, it's not strong enough to defend itself. (Chandler does not
laugh.) Did you hear what I said Bing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: The joke Bing. What's the matter with you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I-I just didn't think it was funny sir.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I just…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) Honey, I just don't think that you understood the joke.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! I mean it was really funny, I-I just don't think you got it. You see
Kara's coffee is-is-is weak tasting, okay? But-but what Doug was-was imply that it was
weak physically. You get it now honey?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think I do! (They all laugh.) Thank you, Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I thought you could use the help.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Coffee in a fight! (Does the laugh again.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is going through the mail as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey Rach! Hey, you mind if I read my comic books in here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure! Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well, Chandler and Monica are over there and it's kinda hard to concentrate.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! She just called and said that she was gonna be working late! She keeps
lying to me! That's it! Y'know what? I'm just gonna go over there and confront them right
now!
[Cut to Chandler, Joey, and Ross's apartment, Rachel enters and sneaks up to Chandler's
bedroom where she overhears Chandler and Monica talking.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (from his bedroom) All right, so you're telling me that I have to tell racist
jokes now?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sorry! I'm just—I'm not very good at this! I'm a terrible liar and I hate
having to lie to Rachel!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But we're not ready to tell yet!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! It's just that…ever since high school Rachel was the one person I
told everything too. Y'know? I miss that so much now. She's my best friend.
(Rachel decides not to confront them and starts to walk out, knocking over a lamp in
the process.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Joey?! Oh my God, Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wh-wh-what are you doing here? (She tries to pull her shirt down to cover the
fact that she's wearing men's boxers.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I was actually—I-I came over here to-to borrow this lamp. To umm,
look at my books, y'know, see them a little better.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great! Umm, well what-what I was doing in Chandler's room is that umm, I was
cleaning it! In fact, he pays me to clean it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! What a great way to earn some extra pocket money.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know when I said to you earlier that I was at work umm, I'm at my new work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's good enough. Right? (Pause.) Okay, well umm, I'm gonna go look at my
books!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll get back to my new job.
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: 'Kay. (Pause.) Congratulations on your new job. (She goes and hugs Monica and
is almost in tears.)
(After she exits, Chandler enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Man, she is really gullible.
(Monica motions that it went right over Rachel's head.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross and Janice are sitting on the couch.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Here you go. (Serves them both some coffee.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Actually, I should get going.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you sure? Because I can stay out as late as you want. I told you how I'm on
sabbatical from work, right?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Yes! Yes! You did!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: What is wrong now?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This isn't what I ordered! Man! Can anything go right in my life?! First my
marriage falls apart and then…

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I know! I know! And then you lose your apartment! And then you lose your job!
And then your ex-wife gets married so fast! And now the coffee—ahh!! Ross, we need to
talk.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Sometimes I feel…

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: No-no-no, no. I'm going to talk. I believe that the sun has set on our
day in the sun.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (starting to cry) You're a very sweet person Ross, umm, unfortunately I don't
think I can take another second of you whining!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let-let me make sure I'm hearing this right, you're ending this with me because I'm
too whiney? (Janice makes an agreeing sound.) So you're saying, I've become so whiney that
I annoy you, Janice.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Well yeah!!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Are you gonna be okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am now.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Okay.
(Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm, hi.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh hi! Well, I guess that's two out of three, Joey. (Laughs and exits.)
(Joey looks at Ross with a horrified look on his face.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Chandler, Joey, and Ross's, Chandler is reading a magazine as Ross hands him a
beer.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude, we got to talk.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just wanted to tell you something before you heard it from someone else and I
hope this isn't too weird, but uh, I had uh, a thing with Janice. (He laughs, his real
laugh this time.) What you're-you're not mad?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why would I be mad?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, because y'know there are certain rules about this kind of stuff. You don't
uh, you don't fool around with your uh, friend's ex-girlfriends or possible girlfriends or
girls they're related to.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (realizes what Ross just said and the implications to him) I am mad! But you
know what I'm gonna do? I'm gonna forgive you! Because that's what friends do! They
forgive their friends when they do everything you just said, all on the list there. Well,
but I want you to remember that I forgave you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I also want you to remember that I let you live here rent free!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And, I want you to remember that I gave you twenty (counts his money) seven
dollars. No strings attached. Now, if you can't remember that, I think we should write it
down—let's write it down!

title: The One with Joey's Bag

scenes.location: Chandler's bedroom, he is giving Monica a massage.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe we've never done this before! It's sooo good! So
good for Monica!
(Chandler picks up the timer being used and turns it to zero at which it chimes.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Look at that, time's up! My turn!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was a half an hour?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's your timer.
(They change places.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know, I don't like to brag about it, but I give the best
massages!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, then massage me up right nice!
(She starts the massage, only she is doing extremely hard and Chandler is gasping in
pain.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah! Ahh!! Ahh!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's so good, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's so good I don't know what I've done to deserve it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Say good-bye to sore muscles!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good-bye muscles!!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler and Joey are sitting on the couch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm telling you, she gives the worst massages ever!! Okay, it was like
she was torturing me for information. And I wanted to give it up I just—I didn't know
what it was!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, if it really hurts that bad you should just tell her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, for the first time in my life I'm in a real relationship. Okay,
I'm not gonna screw that up by y'know, telling the truth.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (walking up with Rachel and carrying coffee) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, dude, look out! You almost crushed my hat! (He picks a hat up from
the floor. It's one of those magician stovepipe hats.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (examining the hat) And the bunny got away. (Turns and starts looking
for the bunny as Joey puts the hat on.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (glaring at Joey) This would be the place where you explain the hat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Yeah, look there's this play all right? And I'm up for the part of
this real cool like suave international guy. A real clothes horse. So I figure that
everyone at the audition is gonna be wearing this kinda y'know, ultra-hip, high fashion
stuff.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And you're gonna make them all disappear.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, like you could find something as sophisticated as this.
(Chandler picks up a basket from the table and puts it on his head.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Done.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, if you wanna look good, why don't you just come down to the store?
I'll help you out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! Thanks, Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure! (Pause) God, please take those off!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right.
(Both of them remove their hats as Phoebe enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, how's it going?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Umm, well, only okay because I just got back from, from the
hospital.
(All at once.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, no-no-no. I'm fine. I'm okay, but umm, my Grandma sorta died.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs! Sorry!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's okay, I mean she had a really incredible life. And it's not like
I'm never gonna see her again, y'know she's gonna visit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well maybe, maybe she's with us right now?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, her first day on a new spiritual plane and she's gonna come to the
coffeehouse!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering, in a hurry) Guys! Guys! I just saw two people having sex in a
car right outside.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhh, Pheebs' Grandmother just died.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh my God, I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's okay. Actually y'know what, it's kinda cool. 'Cause it's like
y'know, one life ends and another begins.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the guys) Not the way they're doing it. What, what happened? How did
she die?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well umm, okay we were in the market and she bent down to get some
yogurt and she just never came back up again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs, I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It was really sweet. The last thing she said to me was; "Okay dear,
you go get the eggs and I'm gonna get the yogurt and we'll meet at the checkout
counter." And y'know what? We will meet at the checkout counter.

scenes.location: Bloomingdale's, Rachel is fixing Joey up with some new clothes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay now Joey, y'know that since you're returning all of this stuff
right after the audition you're gonna have to wear underwear?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, then you'd better show me some of that too then.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, it's missing something. Ooh, I know! Umm, okay. (Goes and grabs a
bag, that looks like a purse, and shows it to Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? A purse?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's not a purse! It's a shoulder bag.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It looks like a women's purse.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Joey, look. Trust me, all the men are wearing them in the spring
catalog. Look. (Shows him.) See look, men, carrying the bag.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See look, women, carrying the bag. (He puts it on his shoulder and
looks at himself in the mirror and likes what he sees.) But it is odd how a women's purse
looks good on me, a man.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Exactly! Unisex!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe you need sex. I had sex a couple days ago.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No Joey! U-N-I-sex.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I ain't gonna say no to that.
[Scene: Ursula's apartment, Phoebe is about to break the bad news to her sister. She
knocks on the door.]

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Oh great! (Opens the door.) (Disappointed) Oh, you. Umm, what's up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, well I sorta have some bad news, can I come in?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Umm, yeah—no thanks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, well, umm Grandma died.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Wow! Didn't she die like five years ago?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, she just died today! Okay, umm, we're having a memorial service
tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Okay, I know that I went to that all ready.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No you didn't!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Well, then who's been dead for five years?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, lots of people! Look, are you coming to memorial service or not?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Umm, no. See I already thought she was dead so I kinda made my peace with it.
Plus, I'm going to a concert tomorrow. So… I'd invite you, but umm, I only have two
tickets left.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine. Okay, enjoy your concert. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Thanks! Enjoy your funeral.
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross and Chandler are on the couch as Joey enters with his new
bag.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!
(As he walks past both Chandler and Ross notice the bag and stare at each other in
shock.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! You look just like your son Mrs. Tribbiani!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? Are you referring to my man's bag? At first, I thought it just
looked good, but it's practical too. Check it out! It's got compartments for all your
stuff! Your wallet! Your keys! Your address book!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Your make-up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Joey, what are you doing with the bag? You're audition is not
until tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but sandwich time is right now. (Removes a sandwich and starts
eating.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, y'know you get any mustard on that bag, you can't return it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why would I return it? I love this bag!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, then you owe me $350.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine! Do you take Vasa or Mustercard? (He's holding the fake credit cards
that come with the bag.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (glaring at him) Joey…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right relax, look I'll pay you with the money from the acting job I am
definitely gonna get thanks to you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's the part, Anti-man?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, don't listen to them. I think it's sexy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: U-N-I-sexy? (Smiles provocatively.)

scenes.location: Phoebe's Grandmother's memorial, Phoebe is at the door welcoming people.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well hello, Mrs. Penella! Thank you so much for coming! Well, okay look,
here's your umm, 3-D glasses and Reverend Pong will tell you when to put them on.
(The gang arrives.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi sweetie!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, how are you holding up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (notices his bag.) Hey, y'know what? My Grandma had the exact same bag!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here, I brought you some flowers. (He pulls them out of the bag.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pulling flowers out it makes the bag look a lot more masculine.
(Another man, an older man, enters, looking around and bumps into Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oops, I'm sorry. Excuse me. Is this the umm, the memorial?
(The gang moves off as Phoebe greets the new guest.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, welcome.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hello. Hello.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm here's your 3-D glasses.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Oh, umm, all right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So how did you know Francis?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Well I actually, I-I really, I haven't seen her for years. But umm, well I-I
was pretty tight with-with her and her daughter.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?! What's your name?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Umm, Frank Buffay.
(Needless to say, Phoebe is stunned into silence. And one audience member gasps.)

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: (Seeing the look on her face) Y'know what? Strike that. My name uh,
actually is-is Joe. Uh, Joe umm, Hill.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're Frank Buffay?

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Shh! (Whispers) No! Joe Hill!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You just said…

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Y'know what, I gotta go. And thank you so much for coming.
(Hands back his glasses and hurries out.)
(Phoebe takes one step after him and stops.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! What honey?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That was my dad!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!
(They all look down the hall he left from.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (approaches, wearing his glasses) Hey you guys, check it out. Check it
out. (Moves his hand towards and away from his face.) It's like it's coming right at me.
(Chandler helps out a little bit by pushing on Joey's arm, which causes his hand to slap
him in his face.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: The Funeral Home, continued from earlier. Phoebe is returning after looking for
her father.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, did you catch him?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wh-what did he say?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He said, "Nice to meet you Glenda." (They stare at her,
dumbfounded) Well, obviously I couldn't give him my real name?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why?! Why not?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, you saw the way he ran out of here! What do you think? He's
gonna stick around and talk to the daughter he abandoned!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What did you say to him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I said, I told him y'know, that I was the executor person of
Francis' will and that I needed to talk to him so I'm gonna meet him at the coffee house
later.

lines.speaker: The Pastor
lines.text: Could everyone please take their seats?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, well, I just can't think about that right now. I just wanna
say good-bye to my Grandma.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, let's go say good-bye.
(They put on their glasses and try to find their way to their seats.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, after the funeral, everyone is there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, with bag) Hey! I'm off to my audition. How do I look?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahhh, I think you look great! That bag is gonna get you that
part.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And a date with a man!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'know what? Make fun all you want. This is a great bag! Okay? And
it's as handy as it is becoming. Now, just because you don't understand something, doesn't
make it wrong. All right? So from now on you guys are gonna have to get used to the fact
that Joey, (pats the bag) comes with a bag! (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I'd better go too. I have to go talk to my dad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, Pheebs, what are you gonna say? Are you gonna tell him who you are?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, no, not at first 'cause I-I don't want to freak him out

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, but aren't you pissed at him?! I mean this guy abandoned you!
I gotta tell you if this were me, this guy would be in some serious physical danger!
(Getting worked up) I mean I-I-I'd walk in there and I'd be like, "Yo, dad! You and
me outside right now!" (Calming down.) I kinda scared myself.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, at least you scared someone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know it's funny, you'd think I'd be angry. I mean, you'd think
I'd wanna rip his tiny little head off. Fortunately, I'm past it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, you do seem a little tense. Here, let me help you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right.
(She goes over and tries to give Phoebe a massage. Phoebe yelps in pain and jumps away
from her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Get off!! Ow!! Oh, stop it!! Why?! Why are you doing that to me?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: As a masseuse and a human, I'm begging you, never do that to anyone!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (indignant) I give good massages! (Ross laughs.) I used to give them to
Rachel all the time before she got allergic! And-and-and Chandler loves them! Watch! (She
starts giving Chandler a massage.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (seeing the look on Chandler's face) He-he does not like it! He hates
it! He's in pain!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No he's not!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (wincing) Yes, he is!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry but, ow-owww-owww!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You've been lying to me? I can't believe you'd do that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, maybe he just didn't want to hurt your feelings.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But the minute we start to lie to each other… (Pauses after she
realizes what she's saying.) And by 'we' I mean society.

scenes.location: Joey's audition, he is with bag.

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Any time you're ready, Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (reading from the script) Well, you must be new here. Why don't we get a
table and I'll buy you a drink.

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: (stopping him) I'm sorry. Could you, could you try it
without the purse?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, sure. (He takes it off and starts reading.) Well, you must be new
here. Maybe we should—I'm sorry, can I ask you something? (He stops and asks a
question.)

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Sure. What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, first it's not a purse.

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Okay, anytime.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I mean if-if you're thinking it's a woman's bag, it's not. It's a man's
bag!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Okayyyy! Anddd, go!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right look, let me show you the catalog! (Does so.) See? Huh? It's the
latest thing! Everyone's got one! Men! Women! Children! Everyone's carrying them!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Umm, do you sell these bags?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Noooo. No-no-no, these babies sell themselves.

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Okay! Thank you! That was great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah but I didn’t read anything.

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: I think we've seen enough!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay! All right, I'll see ya. (As he's walking off stage.) (Patting the
bag.) We got it! We got it!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler is poking his head in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, is Rachel here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (coming all the way in) Listen, I just wanted to apologize about this
afternoon and the whole massage thing. Y'know? I-I really like 'em.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, please, stop! Look, we're supposed to be honest with each other. I-I
just wish you could tell me—just say, "I don't like your massages."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (falling into that trap) I don't like your massages.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (starting to cry) See? It's no big deal.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but now see you're crying!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm not crying about that! I'm crying about something that happened at
work.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (bursting into tears) My boyfriend said he didn't like my massages.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's okay, you don't have to be the best at everything.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! You don't know me at all!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, you give the worst massages in the world.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm crying here!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, hear me out. Okay? You give the best bad massages. If
anybody was looking for the best bad massage and they were thinking to themselves,
"Who's the best of that?" They'd have to go to you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Huh. So you're saying like umm, if there was an award for the best bad
massage, well who would get that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it would be you! You! Monica! And you'd get all the votes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So maybe they could umm, call the award the Monica?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Absolutely!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. I suck!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! (They hug.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Frank Sr. is just arriving.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, thank you for meeting with me.

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Thank you. All right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come, sit. (He's hesitant.) Sit. (Still hesitating.) Sit! (He sits on
the arm of the couch.) Umm, all righty, before we get started I just—I need you to
state for the official record that you are in fact Frank Buffay.

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Oh yes. Yes, yes, I am, uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: So, what did Francis leave me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Well, that's why you wanted me to come, right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yes. Yes. Yeah—no. She did. She left you umm, (looking in her
purse) this lipstick.

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Oh. Huh. It's huh, well it's (opens it) oh it's—ew used. Umm,
cool.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. I have just a few questions to ask so I'm going to get out my
official forms. (She picks up a couple of crumpled receipts.) Okay, so, question 1) You
and uh, you were married to Francis' daughter Lilly, is that correct?

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Yes, yes I was.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, umm, question 2) Umm, did that marriage end A. Happily, B. Medium,
or C. In the total abandonment of her and her two children?

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: It really says that?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. See? (Quickly shows him.)

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Well then I guess then I-I would I would have to say C.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm, okay, total abandonment. Okay, reasons for abandonment, A.
Top secret government work, B. Amnesia, or C. Or you're just a selfish, irresponsible bad,
bad man?

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Y'know, I don't think I want the lipstick that much. (Gets up to
leave.) But umm… Oh, would you do me a favor? And umm, would you, would you give
Lilly that, please? (Hands her a note.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Well Lilly, when you see Lilly would you give her that, that note?
Because I wanted to talk to her at the memorial but, well I pictured her getting mad at me
the way you got mad at me and I well, I chickened out. So, uh, I wrote her that note,
would you give it to her please?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But you-you-you came to see Lilly?

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Lilly's dead. (He looks up in shock.)

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: She what?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She's dead.

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if she isn't then cremating her was a big mistake.

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: I can't believe this. I just—I can't believe this.
How-how—Oh my God. How long ago?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: 17 years ago.

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Oh! What about, what about the girls?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, Ursula is a waitress and-and she lives in Soho. And Phoebe,
(pause) is on this couch.
(Silence ensues.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yep, lipstick and a daughter, big day for you!

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.
lines.text: Phoebe, I-I-I-umm, (Sits down next to her and brushes against her
leg.) Oops. (He backs up.) I just, I-I-I-I don’t, I don’t know what to say. I
just can't believe that you're my daughter, you're so pretty.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. Well, that's neither here nor there.

lines.speaker: Frank Sr.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on in.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I was going too. (They go inside and he closes the door.) Umm, I brought
some wine. Would you like some?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure.
(She makes a big show out of pulling out the cork and pours the wine.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, here we are. Nervous?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me? No. You?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I want this to happen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So do I.
(They click their glasses and take a sip. That sip turns into a gulp, which quickly
progresses into their mutual draining of their glasses at once.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm gonna put on some music.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe, maybe I'll dance for you. (She starts doing a rather suggestive
and seductive dance that's silly at the same time.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You look good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks! Y'know, that when you say things like that it makes me wanna rip
that sweater vest right off!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, why don't we move this into the bedroom?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, do you not want to?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. No! It's just y'know first, I wanna take off all my clothes and have
you rub lotion on me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (swallowing hard) Well that would be nice. I'll go get the lotion.
[Cut to the bathroom, Chandler is entering.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen, this is totally getting out of hand! Okay? She wants me to put
lotion on her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's bluffing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, she's not backing down! She went like this! (He does a little
mimic of her dance.)
[Cut to the hallway where Phoebe is conferring with Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He's not backing down. He went to get lotion.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering the hall) Oh man! Aren't you guys done yet?! I wanna sit in my
chair!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey look, just look at it this way, the sooner Phoebe breaks Chandler
the sooner this is all over and out in the open.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I like that! (To Phoebe) Oh, okay! Show him your bra! He's afraid of bras!
Can't work 'em! (He swiftly rips open the front of Phoebe's dress revealing her bra.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey! (Examining the dress.) Wow, you didn’t rip off any buttons.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's not my first time.
[Cut to the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You go back out there and you seduce her till she cracks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, give me a second! (Pause) Did you clean up in here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course.
[Cut back to the living room. Chandler slowly exits the bathroom and gets pushed from
behind by Monica and sees Phoebe closing the apartment door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, you're-you're going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, not without you, lover. (She slowly walks over to him and is
showcasing her bra.) So, this is my bra.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (swallowing hard) It's very, very nice. Well, come here. I'm very were
gonna be having all the sex.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You should be. I'm very bendy. (Pause) I'm gonna kiss you now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not if I kiss you first.
(They move closer to together and Phoebe hesitantly puts her hand on Chandler's hip. He
puts his hand on her left hip but then decides to put his hand on her left hip. Phoebe
then grabs his butt. Chandler goes for her breast, but stops and puts his hand on her
shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I guess there's nothing left for us to do but-but kiss.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Here it comes. Our first kiss.
(They slowly and hesitantly move their lips together and kiss gently. Phoebe has her
eyes wide open in shock and Chandler is squinting. He finally breaks the kiss after only a
short while and pushes Phoebe away.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! Okay! Okay! You win! You win!! I can't have sex with ya!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And why not?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because I'm in love with Monica!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're-you're what?!
(Monica comes out of the bathroom like a bolt, and Rachel and Joey both enter.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Love her! That's right, I…LOVE…HER!!! I love her!! (They
walk together and hug.) I love you, Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you too Chandler. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just—I thought you guys were doing it, I didn't know you were in
love!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And hats off to Phoebe. Quite a competitor. (Pause) And might I say
your breasts are still showing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God! (She turns and buttons up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! So that's it! It's over! Everybody knows!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well actually, Ross doesn't.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, and we'd appreciate it if no one told him yet.
(Joey suddenly gets very angry.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Ross's new apartment, he is showing his boss, Dr. Ledbetter his new place and
new outlook on life.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A new place for a new Ross. I'm gonna have you and all the guys from work
over once it's y'know, furnished.

lines.speaker: Dr. Ledbetter
lines.text: I must say it's nice to see you back on your feet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I am that. And that whole rage thing is definitely behind me.

lines.speaker: Dr. Ledbetter
lines.text: I wonder if its time for you to rejoin our team at the museum?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh Donald that-that would be great. I am totally ready to come back to
work. I—What? (He notices something through the window.) No! Wh… What are you
doing?!! (Dr. Ledbetter is slowly backing away.) GET OFF MY SISTER!!!!!!!!!!!!!

title: The One with the Girl Who Hits Joey

lines.text: [Scene: The hallway, Ross is running up the stairs. Note: This show continues where the
last one left off.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler!!! Chandler!!! (He opens the door to the apartment but is stopped
by the chain; Chandler and Monica quickly stop making out and try to get dressed.)
Chandler, I saw what you were doing through the window! Chandler, I saw what you were
doing to my sister! Now get out here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Wow! Listen, we had a good run. What was it? Four? Five
months? I mean, that's more than most people have in a lifetime! So, good-bye, take care,
bye-bye then! (He kisses her and starts to climb out the balcony window.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I'm going on the lamb.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on Chandler, come on, I can handle Ross. (They go to the door. Ross
is trying to stick his hand through and undo the chain; Monica pushes his hand back.) (To
Ross) Hold on! (She opens the door.) Hey Ross. What's up bro?
(Ross spots Chandler and starts chasing him around the kitchen table. Chandler runs and
hides behind Monica.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What the hell are doing?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (running from the guy's apartment with Joey in tow) Hey, what's-what's
going on?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I think, I think Ross knows about me and Monica.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (panicking) Dude! He's right there!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) I thought you were my best friend, this is my sister! My
best friend and my sister! I-I cannot believe this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, we're not just messing around! I love her. Okay, I'm in love
with her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm so sorry that you had to find out this way. I'm sorry, but it's
true, I love him too.
(There's a brief pause.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (happily) My best friend and my sister! I cannot believe this. (He hugs
them both.) (To Joey and Rachel) You guys probably wanna get some hugs in too, huh? Big
news!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Awww, no, it's okay, we've actually known for a while.
(There's another pause as Ross gets angry again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What? What?! You guys knew? (Joey and Rachel backup against the
door.) You all knew and you didn't tell me?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Ross, we were worried about you. We didn't know how you were going
to react.
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (happily again) You were worried about me? You didn't know how I was going
to react? (He hugs them both.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, all right, whew! What do you say we all clear out of here and let
these two lovebirds get back down to business? (Ross turns and glares at him.)
Hey-hey-hey, I-I-I'm just talking here, he-he's the one doing your sister.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, you know what I just realized? If you guys ever have kids…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting) Whoa-whoa-whoa! We're having kids?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (quickly) I call Godfather!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can't just call Godfather. Don't you think her brother should
be Godfather?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, if you cared enough to call it first.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys, you're a few steps ahead of us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, big zero gravity moon steps.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Oh, I just thought of the greatest wedding gift to get you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, I'll go in on that with you! I couldn't think of anything.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(A girl enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to her) Oh, hey Katie! Everyone, this is Katie.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, are you ready to go?

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Yeah, I just gotta run to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh sure, right back there. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Hey, where are we going to lunch?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was thinking Chinese food.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Ohh, I love Chinese! How did you know I love Chinese?! (She hits
him repeatedly as she says that.)
(She heads to the bathroom and Joey sits back down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She is so cute! You could fit her right in your little pocket!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know. I mean I like her a lot, and she's really nice, but…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shyly) She keeps punching me.
(They all laugh.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: In that cute, little, sweet way she just did?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, it's a lot harder than it looks! Okay? (Quietly) She-she-she's
hurting me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know what you need, you need a bodyguard. Hey Ross, what is Ben doing
after preschool?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey listen, come on, Joey is having a problem! A little girl is
beating him up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aww, Joey, come here. (She takes his hand.) Look honey, I know this must
be really, really difficult for you and I--Oh, I'm sorry. Am I hurting you?
[Scene: Ross's apartment, he's unpacking after moving in. There's a knock on the door
and he answers it.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (opens it to reveal Phoebe) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! I brought you some house warming gifts.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aww.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Salt, so your life always has flavor.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bread, so you never go hungry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And a scented candle for the bathroom, because well, y'know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. Thanks. And thanks again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!
(The door across the hall opens and a guy walks into Ross's apartment.)

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Welcome to the building. I'm uh, Steve Sarah; I'm president of the tenants
committee.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh hi! Ross Geller. And this is my friend Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Oh hi Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mr. President.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: I came to talk to you about Howard.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Howard?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Yeah, he's the handy man. He's gonna be retiring next week and everyone
who lives here is kicking in a 100 bucks as a thank you for all the hard work type of
thing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh that's nice.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Yeah. So, do you want to give a check? Or…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Uhh…

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Oh look, you don't have to give it too me right now! You can slip it
under my door. (Points to his apartment across the hall.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no, it's not that, it's just… I-I just moved in.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Well, the guy's worked here for 25 years.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, but I've lived here for 25 minutes.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Oh, okay, I get it. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No wait, look. Look! I'm sorry, it's just I've never even met
Howard. I-I mean I don't know Howard.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Howard's the handy man!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes but too me he's just, man.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Okay, fine, whatever. Welcome to the building. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Ugh, can you believe that guy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. I really like his glasses.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Ross is lamenting to Chandler and Rachel about his
troubles in his new building.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …so then President Steve told everyone that I was a cheapskate, and
now the whole building hates me! A little kid spit on my knee! Y'know what I'm gonna do?
I'm gonna throw a party. That's right. For everyone in the building, and I'm gonna sit
them down and explain to them, I am not a bad guy. I am not a cheap guy! I'm just a guy
who-who stands up for what he believes in. A man with principles.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Rachel) Sounds like a fun party.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmm. Look, Ross, if you want your neighbors to like you, why don't you
just pay the hundred bucks? The party's gonna cost you way more than that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It doesn't matter! It's my principles! We're talking about my principles!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I thought it was about your neighbors liking you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, they'll like me. Once they come to my awesome PAR-TAY! Okay, I gotta
run. I gotta go get some nametags. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And that crazy party animal will be your brother-in-law.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Very, very funny, but don't say things like that in front of Monica. I
don't want you putting any ideas in her head.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, Chandler, you do realize that those ideas are probably
already in Monica's head.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wh-wh-why?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, because she loves you and because you love her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, so, what's that supposed to mean?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, Chandler, don't freak out! I'm telling you something you already
know! Come on, she broke up with Richard because he didn't want to have babies. And she's
a woman, and she's almost 30, and y'know it's Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't see it that way. Okay? Because, I see two Monicas, the one
that was my friend, who lived across the hall, and wanted to have a lot of babies and then
the new Monica, who I just started to date. Now, who's to say what she wants?!
I’m right. I'm right. Am I right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, you're right, you are absolutely right. I mean that makes, that
makes everything different.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. It's not different at all, is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Not unless different means the same.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is sitting on the couch with Katie.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: You were so funny with that waiter! You're such a nut! (She slaps her
thighs, Joey jerks, and spills some of his coffee.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sets the coffee down) Y'know, breadstick fangs are always funny.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: No, you make them funny. You're the funny one! (She punches him again and
he retreats to the arm of the couch.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, look Katie, uh listen, we-we need to talk. Okay? Umm, look I like
you. I-I really do, I like you a lot. Okay? But sometimes when you, when you playfully
punch me like that it-it feels like someone's hitting me with a very tiny but very real
bat.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Aww, like I could hurt you. Are you making fun of my size? Don't make fun
of me because of my size! (She punches him again and almost knocks him off the arm of the
couch.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler and Monica are curled up on one of the chairs.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Isn't this great?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Couldn't you just stay like this forever? (His eyes snap open.)
Chandler! Couldn't you just stay here forever?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, here, somewhere else, y'know where-where ever. (Gets up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I'm cool. Casual.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What-what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm just hanging out. Y'know, having fun. Y'know with the girl that
I'm seeing casually.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Man, I knew it! I knew you were going to do this!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Get all freaked out because everybody was talking and just joking around
about marriage and stuff.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you do want all that stuff, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh and you know what I want!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! You want babies! You have baby fever!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I do not have baby fever!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh please, you are obsessed with babies and-and marriage and
everything that's related to babies and-and marriage! I've got an idea, why don't we turn
down the heat on this pressure cooker?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have you lost your mind? Chandler, this isn't about me! This is about
you and all your weird relationship commitment crap!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nah-uh! I know you! Okay? I know the thoughts that you have in the
head--in your head!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You don't know everything. Did you know that I'm going out with Rachel
tonight instead of you? Hmm? And did you know that the only baby around here is you?! And
did you know that I can't even look at you right now?! (She storms out.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I did not know that.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler is getting advice from Ross and Joey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's gonna be okay, right? I mean she's not gonna leave me? This is,
this is fixable.

lines.speaker: Ross and Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, yeah, sure. Absolutely.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: By me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, unless you make some kind of big gesture.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, big!
(Monica enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-oh, shht! The Misses.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Gunther, can I get a coffee (Looks at Chandler) to go?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica. (Goes to talk to her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm still not done not wanting to talk to you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Just tell me what I need to do to make things right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, that's what we do. Y'know, I-I mess up and then you tell me how
to fix it and then I do and then y'know you think I'm all cute again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? I'm really tired of being your relationship tutor. You're gonna
have to figure this one for yourself. All right? Y'know what? If you're too afraid to be
in a real relationship, then don't be in one. (She walks out.)
(Chandler turns to watch her go and then sees Ross and Joey both with huge grimaces on
their faces.)
[Scene: Ross's apartment, he's having his party, only he's the only guest. He gets up
and puts on a nametag that says Ross, but doesn't quite like it. So he takes it off and
puts on one that says Dr. Geller and he puts the Ross one underneath the Dr. Geller one.
Then as he turns off the music, we hear the party for Howard raging in the apartment
across the hall.]

lines.speaker: Party Guests
lines.text: (chanting) Howard! Howard! Howard! Howard! (Ross goes to investigate
the noise) Howard! Howard! Howard! (They're holding Howard above their heads.) Howard!
Howard! Howard! Howard! Howard! (He sees Phoebe chanting along with them.) Howard! Howard!
Howard! Howard! Howard! Howard! Howard! Howard! Howard! Yay!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe! (He grabs her arm to get her attention.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hi Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I thought this was your party and it turns out it’s a party for
Howard. He's just the sweetest little man! (A guest walks up to her.)
Guest #1: See ya Phoebe! Oh and hey, thanks for chipping in!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You chipped in?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, uh-huh, a 100 dollars.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe! I can't believe you gave them money! I thought you agreed it was
totally unreasonable that they asked me for that money!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but they didn't ask me! Y'know? This way I'm just y'know, the
exotic, generous stranger. That's always fun to be.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but you're making me look bad!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No I'm not. No! If anything I'm making you look better! They'll see you
talking to me and that's--I'm a hit!

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: (walking up) Oh hey, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Oh hey, Ross. Umm, see, I was thinking maybe you two could switch
apartments because Phoebe's more our kind of people. Something to think about. (Walks
away.)
(Ross turns and glares at Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, okay, my bad.
[Scene: Central Perk, Rachel is getting some coffee as Joey enters. He's looking a
little puffy, but that's probably from the large number of different color sweaters he's
wearing.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Wow! You look, you look…big.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks! I've been working out. Hey listen, is it obvious that I'm wearing
six sweaters?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uhhh, yeah. But it's not obvious why.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well look, I’m breaking up with Katie so I had to put on some extra
padding. Y'know? I mean, if she hits me when she's happy, can you imagine how hard she's
gonna hit me when I tell her I'm taking away the Joey love?

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Hiya!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Hey, cute jacket!

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Oh, thanks! That's so sweet! (She punches Rachel like she punched Joey.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Ow! (Joey motions, "You see what I mean?!")

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Oh, ow! Did Joey tell you to say that? You guys, (Punches Joey) are too
much! (Punches Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa! (Laughs) Y'know what Katie? I gotta tell ya I-I-I-I think you are
the one who is too much. (She punches Katie back.)

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Ohh, Joey has the nicest friends! (She punches Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, and the nicest girlfriend! (She retaliates.)

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: You're so sweet! (Punches Rachel yet again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, you're so sweet! (She kicks Katie in the shin.)

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Oww!!!! Joey, she just kicked me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Well? Aren't you gonna do something?

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: You'd better do something, or I'm gonna walk out that door right now!
Well? Are you gonna?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nah.
(She looks at Rachel and storms out. After she's left Joey hugs Rachel in thanks.)
[Scene: Howard's party, Phoebe is talking Ross up to two more partygoers. Ross isn't
happy about it.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (trying to get her attention) Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (ignoring him and continuing her conversation) That's what I'm saying.
(Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (tapping her on the shoulder) Phoebe? Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh. (Turns to him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, this is a disaster! Can't I please just go?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No! I'm talking you up to people. Just give it a little time, all
right? Relax, get something to eat! Okay?
(They go to the food table.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh, what did you tell them about me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I was telling them about you and Emily. Y'know, try to get some
sympathy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh. (He cuts himself a piece of cake.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But somehow you came off as the bad guy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I think I told it wrong. Y'know, we should talk about that because
I don't totally understand what happened there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (trying a piece of cake) Ohh, this cake is really good!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, see? Things are looking up already!
Guest #2: (sees the cake) Oh my God! Someone cut Howard's cake! (Ross tries
dumping it into a nearby plant.) Who would do a think like that?
(Steve goes over to look at Ross who's trying to look cool, but has some frosting on
his lip.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh yeah, aww!

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Okay, you got your free food! You ruined everyone's fun! Don't you think
it's time you went home?!
Guest #3: Yeah, leave!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah, get out! Now!

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Go back to 3-B, 3-B!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, everyone calm down! Everyone calm down! I have something that
I would like to say! Who here likes Ross? (Ross is the only one who raises his hand and
Phoebe glares at him to put his hand back down.) Of course you don't like him! He-he
didn't give you any money, he raised his own hand when I asked, "Who hear likes
Ross," and he's wearing two nametags! (He takes one off.) I-I'll be honest with you
guys, when I first met Ross I didn't like him at all! But then once I got to know him I
