saw that he's really sweet and caring and very generous. I mean, all I'm saying is
don't judge Ross before you get to know him all right? I mean, I like all you guys now,
but when I first meet you y'know Kurt, I thought, y'know abrasive drunk, umm Lola, mind
numbingly stupid! And okay, you guys (She turns to an elderly gentleman and a 20 something
woman, who're a couple.) (To the girl) Gold-digger, (To the old guy) cradle robbing perv!
So, I think you all know what I mean.

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, Ross and Phoebe have been banished to Ross's place.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Obviously I didn't think they were gonna start throwing things. I just
thought if I kept insulting everyone, you would jump in and defend everyone and then you
could look like the hero.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh wow, yeah! See, I did not get that.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler comes running in. Everyone else is already
there.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where's Monica?! Where is she? I need to talk to her! It's urgent! Is
she here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (raising her hand) I'm Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I need to talk to you, it's urgent!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I've been doing a lot of thinking about us, y'know a lot of uhh,
us thinking. And uh, well I guess there's only one-one way to do this. (He slowly and
awkwardly gets down on one knee.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait what-wh-wh-what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (getting out a ring box) Monica…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no, don't-don't-don't do it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Will you marry me?
(Phoebe hides her eyes in shame. Rachel is starring at them wide-eyed and open-mouthed.
Joey and Ross are stunned to temporary silence.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-no. No. No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What a bad idea!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhhh, I cannot look at it! (She doesn't move.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know. But I know I'm not afraid to do this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm doing this because I'm sorry?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you umm, you really think the best reason to get married is because
you're sorry?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, the best reason to get married is pregnancy. Sorry is pretty much
fourth y'know, behind being ready and actually wanting to get married. (Laughs.)
Will you be my wife?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (kneels with him) Chandler, umm, I want you to take just a minute and I
want you to think about how ridiculous this sounds.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I'm kinda wishing everyone wasn't here right now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey! Do you know that none of that stuff came from me?! I mean I never
said I wanted to have babies and get married right now!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah I know, but I was really confused and then I talked to these
guys. (Turns to look at Ross and Joey.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who? Two divorces and Joey?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She's right y'know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but still, cheap shot!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what? Y'know when I said that I want you to deal with this
relationship stuff all on your own? Well, you're not ready for that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn't think I was!
(They hug.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, what would have done if I said yes?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well I would've been happy because I would've be able to spend the
rest of my life with the woman that I love. Or, you would've seen a Chandler shaped hole
in that door. (Points at the door.)
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Everyone is there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross, will you pass me that knife?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I will not!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it's okay. You don't have to be so mean about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're right, I'm sorry. Will you marry me?
(They all laugh.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Aw, and I was gonna ask you to marry me because I forgot to say hello to
you last week.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no wait Pheebs, I think for something like that you just ask them to
move in with you. But I'm not sure, Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, how long is this going to go on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well I think the length of teasing is directly related to how insane you
were so, a long time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is fun. Hey Rach, remember that whole "We were on a break
thing?" Well, I'm sorry, will you marry me? (Laughs--whines as he sees that no one is
laughing. They're just staring at him in shock.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's not funny.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's not funny at all!
(They all get up and leave.)

title: The One with the Cop

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Monica and Chandler are sitting on one of the chairs doing
a crossword puzzle.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you guys doing up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, we wanted to finish the crossword before we went to bed. Hey, do
you know a six-letter word for red?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinks) Dark red.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I think that's wrong, but there's a Connect the Dots in here for
you later. (To Monica) Hey, how about maroon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (checks to see if it works) Yes, you are so smart! (Kisses him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aww, you guys are so cute!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I'll see you in the morning.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Monica
lines.text: Okay.
[Scene: Joey's bedroom, time lapse. He's asleep and dreaming. In his dream he's doing
the crossword puzzle with…wait for it…Monica!]

lines.speaker: Dream Monica
lines.text: Y'know, I love doing crossword puzzles with you honey!

lines.speaker: Dream Joey
lines.text: Aww, me too. Now let's finish this and go to bed.

lines.speaker: Dream Monica
lines.text: Okay! There's only one left, three letter word, not dog

lines.speaker: Dream Joey
lines.text: Cat.

lines.speaker: Dream Monica
lines.text: Yes! You are so smart! (Kisses him.) I love you.

lines.speaker: Dream Joey
lines.text: I love you too.
(They hug.)
[Cut back to Joey in bed, he's smiling, enjoying the dream as he wakes up. Suddenly, he
realized what he was dreaming about and bolts upright in bed.]
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, everyone is there but Ross and Joey. Gunther hands them the bill,
and Chandler gives some money to pay it.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at the bill) Uhh, we still need a tip.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. Hold on. (She starts digging in the chair.) I got it. Nickel!
(Donates it.) How much more do we need?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A couple of bucks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, dime! (Donates that.) You guys should probably keep talking; this
could take a while. (Finds something else.) Oh no, wait! Look it! Whoa! (Looks at it.) Oh
my God, this is a police badge!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that's so cool! Why would a cop come in here though? They don't
serve donuts. (No one laughs.) Y'know what actually, could you discover the badge again? I
think I can come up with something better than that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, I bet somebody's missing that badge.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I should probably take it back. Ooh, but you know what? While I'm
at the police station, I could check their Ten Most Wanted lists because my friend Fritzy
has been like number 11 forever, so this could be her year! (She crosses her fingers in
hope.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey, you guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Joey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Monica) Hey. That uh, that my sweatshirt?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yes, it is. I'm sorry I borrowed it, I was cold. I hope its okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well uh, it's just that uh, y'know if-if you're gonna be wearing someone's
sweatshirt shouldn't it be your boyfriends--and I’m not him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'll give it back to you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no! No! I mean it's gonna be all smelling like Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you saying I smell bad?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No, you smell like a meadow. (Pause.) I'm sorry. (Runs to the
bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What's with him?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, y'know what? The last time Joey went to a meadow, his mother was
shot by a hunter.
[Scene: A couch store, Ross is trying to decide on a new couch for his place. He has
dragged Rachel along for the trip, and she's not too happy about it. Ross is sitting on it
in different ways to see how it feels. He tries to just sit on it normally, and then he
tries flopping on it. One thing about this couch, it's huge. It's like twice the size of a
normal full size couch. Whoever designed this thing, needs help and fast.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (disgusted at Ross's antics) Ugh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) Yeah, I still don't know. (To the salesman who is hovering
nearby) I'm sorry I just wanna make sure that I bought the right couch. I need a couch
that says, "Kids welcome here." But that also says, (In a sexy voice) "Come
here to me!"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! You say that to kids?!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! No! The "Come here to me" is y'know for the ladies.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, honey, it's a nice couch. It's not a magic couch.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: You picked a great couch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Yeah. Could you just sign right here please? (Hands him a
clipboard.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, sure. Whoa-whoa, what's this? The delivery charge is almost as much as
the couch!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait! No, that's ridiculous. Come on, he lives three blocks away!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, y'know what? I'll take it myself, thank you! (He signs the form and
hands it back to the salesman.) All right Rach, let's go! (He picks up one end of the
couch.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! (She puts on her coat and turns around and sees Ross is expecting
her to help.) (Laughing.) Are you kiddin'?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, come on it's only three blocks! And-and, it's not very heavy, try it!
Come on! Come on!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Disgustedly she goes and tries to pick up the couch. Much to her
amazement, she is successful.) Oh. Oh! I can do it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: You two are really gonna enjoy that couch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, we're uh, yeah we're not together. (He starts backing out of the
store.)

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Ohh, okay. (Laughs.) Something didn't quite add up there. (Ross
stops, walks back to talk to the salesman, and in the process pushes Rachel up against a
wall.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Well you, her, I mean, she's very…y'know. And you're
like…y'know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not that it's any of your business, but we did go out.

lines.speaker: The Salesman
lines.text: Really? You two?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on, I don't really want to be doing this right now. I am carrying a
very heavy couch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then tell him quickly.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Ross) Fine! (To the salesman) We went out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not only did we go out, we did it 298 times!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross!! Oh my--ugh!! You kept count?! You are such a loser!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A loser you did it with (To the salesman) 298 times!
(Rachel pushes on the couch and pushes Ross out the door.)
[Scene: Outside of Central Perk, Phoebe is exiting and sees a woman put out her
cigarette on a tree.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Oh! Ma'am? Excuse me, ma'am?

lines.speaker: The Smoking Woman
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You can't put your cigarette out on a tree!

lines.speaker: The Smoking Woman
lines.text: Yeah I can, it worked real well.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No but you shouldn't! Don't ever do that again.

lines.speaker: The Smoking Woman
lines.text: I won't! (Turns away) Until I have my next cigarette.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hold it! (Grabs the badge) N.Y.P.D! Freeze punk!

lines.speaker: The Smoking Woman
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah that's right you are so busted. (To no one in particular.) Book
'em.

lines.speaker: The Smoking Woman
lines.text: Who are you talking too?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Save it Red! Unless you wanna spend the night in the slammer, you
apologize to the tree.

lines.speaker: The Smoking Woman
lines.text: I am not going to apologize to a tree!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You apologize to the tree right now or I am calling for backup. (The
woman calls her bluff.) (Screaming at no one in particular) Backup! Backup!!

lines.speaker: The Smoking Woman
lines.text: I-I'm sorry! Sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, cancel backup! Cancel backup!
[Scene: Ross's building's lobby, he and Rachel are about to attempt to take the couch
upstairs.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (Throws off the last cushion.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, didn't you say that there was an elevator in here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhh, yes I did but there isn't. Okay, here we go.
(They start the attempt. Ross is going backwards and reaches the first landing. This
staircase has three steps then a landing, makes a 90-degree turn, and has more steps
before another landing and another 90-degree turn.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, go left. Left! Left! (The bottom of the couch is hitting the
railing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y'know what? There is no more left, left!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh okay, lift it straight up over your head! Straight up over your head!
You can do it! You can do it! (She gets it lifted up and they make the first turn.) Okay.
You got it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good-good-good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-oh!
(She can't stay at the end as the couch rounds the turn so she shifts to the back
corner of the couch and is at a 90-degree angle to it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, you got it right? You got it right? You got it?
(She don't got it as the couch slips out of their grips and falls over the bottom
railing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Any chance you think the couch looks good there?
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Phoebe is telling Chandler and Monica how she fought crime
in her own way with the badge she found.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: …so this guy was all (Mumbles.) And I'm all, Buffay, Homicide.
(Flashes the badge.) It was just so cool!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (cooking something) Phoebe, you were supposed to take that back!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know but I'm having so much fun doing good deeds.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but impersonating a police officer is a serious thing. You could
get arrested.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You could get arrested, right now! (Flashes the badge and they glare at
her.) All right, yeah, I gotta take it back. I'm totally drunk with power. (She heads for
the door just as Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Joey) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Hey! (Sees that Monica's there.) Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I didn’t know you guys were going to be here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Joey, sweetie, taste this. (Holds out a spoon for him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (backing away) What?! Why?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is going on with you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, come on! You've been acting strange all day!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! There is something. I kinda had a dream, (pause) but I don't
want to talk about it. (Starts for his room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa-what-what if Martin Luther King had said
that? (Imitating what his famous speech would sound like.) I kinda have a dream! I
don’t want to talk about it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it involved Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You had a dream about a girl that I am seeing?! Oh, that is so cool!
(To Monica) I can't tell you how many times I've dreamt about a girl that he was seeing.
(Seeing Monica's stare.) (To Joey) Anyway we're talking about your dream. (To Monica) I
love you. (To Joey) Your dream? (Leans in to listen closely.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don't worry, there wasn't any sex in it or anything. I haven't dreamt
about her like that since I found out about you two--ish.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What was the dream about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, okay. You were my girlfriend and we were doing the crossword
puzzle. Y'know like you guys were doing last night. So, that's it. I'm in love with Monica
and I'll be moving out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, Joey! Joey! That doesn’t mean that-that you're in love with
me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It-it doesn’t?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it can mean anything. Like uh, all of the sudden you're jealous
because I've become the apartment stud.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That kinda sounds like your dream dude.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Or, it could mean that-that you saw Chandler and me together and we
y'know were being close and stuff and then you just want to have that with someone too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: In the dream I did enjoy the closeness.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey, look, are you attracted to Monica? Right here, right now, are
you attracted to her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looks at her) Not really.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well there you have it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well sure! I'm just wearing sweats! (Looking at Chandler and slowly
realizing what his point is.) But that's good that you're not in love with me, because you
just want a girlfriend!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I don't think it's just about just getting a girlfriend. Y'know? I
mean, yeah, I can get a girlfriend! Yeah, we could sit in the chair and do crosswords, but
y'know are we ever going to have y'know the closeness like-like you guys have?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well y'know, Monica and I were friends before we started
dating. So maybe-maybe that's it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Friends first? That's interesting.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You become friends after?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, never done that either.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey, umm, do you guys have that tape measure?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, it's actually in my bedroom.
(Monica and Chandler both remember a special moment between them.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughing) That's right.
(They realize the implication of their behavior, stop instantly and head for his
bedroom. In the meanwhile, Joey is starring at Rachel in a seductive way.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (noticing him) What's up Joey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in a sexy voice) How you doin'?
(Rachel is stunned.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Outside Central Perk, Phoebe is walking up and notices a car that is parked
half on the curb and right in front of the door, making it difficult for people to enter
Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Excuse me, is this your car?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well I don't think it's very nice of you to park here, y'know you're
blocking the entrance.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Don't worry about it. It's not a problem.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it's a problem for me, which means it's a problem for you 'cause
I'm a cop. (Shows the badge.)

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: (he reaches into the car and slams his siren on the roof.) So am I!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, no. (Pause) Oh okay, so you're a cop which means you can park
anywhere, 'cause I know that 'cause I'm a cop too. So, all right, keep up the good work.
10-4. (Tries to leave.)

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: (stopping her) Hey, wait a second! So wait, what precinct are you with?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I'm with the umm, the 57th.

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: Oh, I know a guy in homicide up there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm in vice. Yeah, in fact I'm undercover right now. I'm a whore.

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: Who-who else is in vice up there?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, do you know, umm Sipowicz?

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: Sipowicz? No, I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, big guy, kinda bald.

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: No, I don't know him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (starts to walk away, but stops) Don’t try to call him or anything,
'cause he's not there, he's out. His umm, his partner just died.

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: Wow umm, tell Sipowicz I'm real sorry for his loss.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I sure will, take care. (Starts walking off.)

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: (following her) Hey by the way, I'm sure Sipowicz is gonna be all right. I
heard that kid from Silver Spoons is really good. (Phoebe's stunned) And where did
you find my badge?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. (She starts laughing. Then she throws the badge at him and runs
away.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Joey is entering. Rachel is there getting some tools to
help Ross out.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Joey, would you mind giving me and Ross a hand moving his couch?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I'd love too, but I got acting class. But y'know what? I guess I can
blow that off, (In a sexy voice) for you.
(He starts staring at her longingly.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, hey, Rach let me ask you something. Uh, I was just over there talking
to Monica and Chandler, boy they are really tight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah that's not such a bad situation they got going over there. I'm
thinking of getting me one of those.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What's up Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, the reason I think Monica and Chandler are so great…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: …is because they were friends first. Y'know? So I asked myself,
"Who are my friends?" You and Phoebe, and I saw you first. So…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughing) What are you saying?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm saying maybe you and I crank it up a notch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know honey, umm, as uh, as flattered as I am that uh, you saw me
first, uhh, I just, I-I don't think we should be cranking anything up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'll treat you real nice. (Pulls out a chair for her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs and pushes the chair back in) Yeah, well, y'know umm… No
honey, listen I think it's a great idea to become friends with someone before you
date them, but I think the way you do it is y'know you meet someone, become their friend,
build a foundation, then you ask them out on a date. Don't hit on your existing friends!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Won't-won't that take longer?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah. Oh, but once you find it, ohh it's so worth the wait.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. I understand. I understand. (Pause) Man, I wish I saw Phoebe
first!
[Scene: The lobby of Ross's building, he's sitting on the couch at the bottom of the
stairs, and he's practicing enticing women to join him on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come here to me. No-no, you come here to me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey Ross! I brought reinforcements.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh great! What, you brought Joey?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I brought the next best thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler?! You brought Chandler?! The next best thing would be Monica!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I would be offended, but Monica is freakishly strong, so…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I-I drew a sketch about how we're gonna do it. (Showing them) Okay
Rach, (points to the sketch) that's you. That's the couch. (Points again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa-oh, what's-what's that? (Points.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, that's me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! You certainly think a lot of yourself.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! That's-that's my arm!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking at the sketch) Oh, I see. I thought you just really, really
liked your new couch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know what? Just-just follow my lead.
(Chandler and Ross head for opposite ends of the couch.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, Chandler.
(They pick up the couch and after throwing off the last pillow; Rachel helps out on
Chandler's end.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. (They start up the stairs. Ross is first.) Okay, here we go!
(Chandler has moved forward and is now underneath the couch as it heads up the first
set of stairs.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, ready?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Turn.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (straining) Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Turn! Turn!
(As they turn the couch, Chandler gets sandwiched between the railing and the couch.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I don't think we can turn anymore!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I don't, I just don't think it's going to fit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah it will! Come on, up! Up-up-up! Up! Yes! Here we go! Pivot! (They
start up the stairs again. Chandler is between the couch and the wall now.) Pivot! Piv-ot!
Piv-et!! Piv-ett!!! Piv-et!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!!
(They set the couch down.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I don't think it's going to pivot anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Rachel
lines.text: You think?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, let's uh, let's bring it back down and-and try again.
(As they start back down the couch drops a little bit and gets jammed. They try to free
it to no avail.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, yeah, I think it's really stuck now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe that didn't work!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, me neither! I mean, you had a sketch!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, y'know, what did you mean when you said pivot?
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is returning and finds Chandler, Monica, and Rachel
are there.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! How's it going? Did you make any new friends?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I met this woman. (Starts for his room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stopping him) Hey, whoa-whoa! What's she like?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, well, she's…really good in bed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, I thought you were gonna try to be friends first!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) Well look, hey, it's all your fault!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! Why?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well because you didn't give me advice! No! You gave me a pickup line! As
soon as I told her I wanted to y'know, build a foundation and be friends first. I
suddenly, through no fault of my own, became irresistible to her! (Pause) And her
roommate!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What about the closeness?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Closeness-shmoshness! There was three of us for crying out loud!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Joey is entering with a pizza and finds everyone but Ross
there.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) All right! Hey, who wants pizza?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, I do! I do! I do!
(They all walk over to get a slice.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (taking a bite) Oh, great! Can you believe I found it on the second floor?
(They all throw their pieces back as there is a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Voice
lines.text: N.Y.P.D!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Joey
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, just a minute officer!!
(He throws his piece back in the box, runs into the living room, looks for a place to
hide the pizza, finds one, slides the box under the couch, sits down on the table, and
tries to quickly chew the food in his mouth.)

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: I'm looking for Phoebe Buffay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, God, it's him! It's that cop! God, I can't believe it! He found me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, Phoebe, are you gonna go to jail?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if I'm going down, I'm taking you (Points at all of them) with me.
(They all look at her.) Harboring a fugitive? That's one to three years minimum. Good luck
Chandler. (She opens the door to the cop from before.) Okay, you can arrest me. Fine. But
you'll never make it stick and you know it!

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: Yeah, but I kinda don't have a choice, it's my job. I mean, you understand
right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yep! As long as you understand that I'm going to call my lawyer and once
he puts you on the stand he'll make you look like a fool. A fool!

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: I don't like looking foolish. Y'know what? Maybe uh, I don't arrest you
today. Maybe I came by and you weren't here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I would love it if I weren't here!

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: Okay, so since umm, you're not going to jail tonight I was wondering if you
would like to go to dinner with me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me?!

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: Yeah. Ever since you flashed my badge at me, I kinda can't stop thinking
about you. You're the prettiest, fake undercover whore I've ever seen.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Joey
lines.text: Nice!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! I didn't see that coming! You're-you're asking me out!

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: Yeah. I mean, I coulda done it better, but these people keep staring at me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, yeah, I'd like to go out with you officer…

lines.speaker: Cop
lines.text: Gary.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Gary.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Okay, so it's a date.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! So--ooh, I gotta ask you though. How did you know where to find
me?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Well you're fingerprints were all over my badge so I just ran it through
the computer and this was listed as your last known address so I just checked it out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, impressive.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Not as impressive as you. I gotta tell you, I looked at your record and
you've done some pretty weird stuff.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, we'll talk at dinner.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Okay. (He starts to leave.) So I'll come by in a couple hours and pick you
up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I can't wait!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Okay. And don't worry, I'm not just gonna take you out for donuts.
(Chandler busts out laughing and everyone just looks at him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Rachel) He has a gun!

title: The One with Rachel's Inadvertent Kiss

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there as Rachel enters, happily.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good, you guys are all here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! What's up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I have a job interview at Ralph Lauren tomorrow!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Congratulations! Ohh, that's great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Boy, that guy's underwear sucks!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh-what?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I got this pair marked excess, I gotta tell ya, there was no room for
excess anything in there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anyway, I'm going to be the coordinator of the woman's collection, I'll
work right under the director, it's the perfect, perfect job for me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! Well, if you nail the interview, you'll get it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You wanna work on your interview skills?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: O-okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! All right, let's start with the handshake. Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.
(They shake hands.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Very good handshake, good wrist action.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let me try. (Gets up to join them.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (They shake hands and she pulls away suddenly) Oh my God! What did
I ever do to you?! (Rubbing her hand.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did I squeeze it too hard?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Let's just say, I'm glad I'm not Chandler.
(Chandler tries to comprehend that remark.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Joey is standing at the window waving at Ross.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's right Ross, I can see you in your new apartment! And you can see
me! Same as yesterday, (To Monica) same as the day before.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is he doing his shark attack bit yet?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope. Op, wait! There he goes.
(We see Ross through the window and he acts like a swimmer that gets attacked by a
shark, picture one of the many, many, many Jaws movies they made and you get the
idea.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (waving) Very funny Ross! Very life-like and funny. Okay. (Notices that a
woman is waving back.) Oh no-no-no, I wasn't waving at you lady. (She just stares at him.)
(Joey sees how beautiful she is.) Whoa, maybe I was! Hey, Monica, this totally hot girl in
Ross's building is flirting with me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Get in there man! Flirt back, mix it up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I-I-I'm down with that. (He turns back to the woman.) Okay, here
goes. (Thinks.) How (Holds up his hand like an Indian) you (Points at her) a-doin'? (Does
a little twisting motion with both hands and ends up pointing at her, he then winks. She
smiles and waves again.) (To Monica) It worked! She's waving me over. (Towards the woman.)
Okay, I-I-I'll be right over. Let's see, she's on the third floor…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (joining him) Wow! She is pretty, huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Tell me about it, huh? (Realizes that she can see Monica.) Oh no-no-no,
I'm not with her, she's just Monica! (He pantomimes that out.) Ewwuck! (He pushes Monica
away and makes a disgusted face.)
[Scene: Ross's Building, Joey is trying to find the hot girl's apartment. So he's
walking up the hallway counting doors. He comes to what he thinks is the right one and
knocks on it. Ross opens the door, it's his apartment.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Joey! Great stuff huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is your place?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course it is. Yeah, come on in. Ooh-ooh, go by the window you can
pretend to be surfing. (He pretends he's surfing by the window.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But I counted, you're not supposed to live here! Oh man! (Runs away.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Joey is entering again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ugh!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I ended up at Ross's place. Oh, I musta missed counted or something.
(Looks out the window.) Damn! She's not there anymore. Oh, l-l-look, Ross is doing his
'Watching TV' bit. (We see Ross sitting on the couch and flipping through the channels on
his remote.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No Joey, I think he's just watchin' TV.
(It's only when the camera cuts to Ross's apartment that we see that the TV is turned
off and Ross is indeed doing a bit. He then tries to hide his smirk.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, later that day, Gary is kissing Phoebe good-bye.

lines.speaker: Gary's Radio
lines.text: We've lost visual contact with the suspect.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Okay, now I've really have to go!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But it's just so unfair that our date has to get cut short just 'cause
some guy shot at a store clerk.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: I know, but it's my job, sweethart!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, then maybe I can come too!

lines.speaker: Gary's Radio
lines.text: Suspect has just emerged naked from the sewer.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, you go. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Bye-bye.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: 'Kay, bye!
(Gary closes the door behind him.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh I just miss him so much!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! For just a week you guys are really close, huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, it's weird. I can't help it though he's so sweet, he's like this
little puppy dog, y'know? But like a really tough one that shots bad guys. Ohh, I just love
beginning parts of relationships, y'know?! You just like can't keep your hands off each
other.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know it is the best.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So-so how long did that last for you and Chandler?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? It's still going on.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, seriously! When did it end?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I-I am serious, I mean, we're, we're all over each other all the time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, you know where you are better than I do. I was just curious.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Start annoying hyper-competitive mode now.) (Jumping up) What don't you
just calm down Phoebe! All right?! Why don’t you just get all your facts before you
run around telling everybody that you're the only hot couple!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Under her breath) God, I woke the beast. Sorry. (To Monica) I was wrong
obviously, I just—I misspoke. It's okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no, it is okay, I mean as long as you know that Chandler and I
are also very hot and fiery, just as hot as you! I mean our flame, whew, is on fire!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey Monica, here's your broom back.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You are so cute. (She goes over and kisses him passionately.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the next day, Chandler and Joey are there as Rachel
returns from her interview.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh hey, how'd the interview go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, horrible! I did the stupidest, most embarrassing thing!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Did you tell the guy you wanted to have sex with his wife and then fall
right out of your chair?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So what happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, it was horrible! And-and the interview part went so well, y'know? I
even made him laugh. He said something about a boat and I was like, "Well, yeah! If
you've got enough life jackets!" (She starts laughing; Chandler and Joey are not
amused.) Trust me, it was actually, it was very funny. Anyway, so we were saying good-bye
and ugh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (We see a flashback as Rachel describes what happened.) All right, we
were shaking hands and he kinda leaned toward me… Y'know maybe he was going to open
the door, but I totally miss read him and I uhhh… (The flashback shows that she
kissed him on the cheek.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You kissed him?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I didn't know what else to do!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well you coulda tried, not kissing him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from the bathroom) Hey Rach, a guy from Ralph Lauren
called, you got a second interview!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't believe it! I got a second interview!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I bet that kiss isn't looking like such a big mistake now, is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What-what, wait a minute, you don't think that's why he wants me back?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! (Chandler makes a noise) No?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A kiss? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I accidentally kissed him in the interview, and now he wants me back
y'know of course, 'cause "Let's bring the girl back who kisses everybody!"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on, Rach.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! What if he thinks I'm the kind of girl that-that would just
sleep with him?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He probably wants you back because you're right for the job.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Maybe. I-I don't know—Oh God, how could I be so stupid?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh Rachel look, don't say that, I think you just need a hug from Joey.
Come on. Come on. (She hugs him and Joey looks out the window.) She's back! Hot girl's
back!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, well I'm not totally back yet, but thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, in Ross's building! (He throws Rachel onto the chair and heads to the
window.) She's back! She's back! (Pantomimes) Okay, wait there, I'll be over in a second.
(He counts where she is again.) Got it! (Runs out and does a little hot over a chair.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I gotta check out this hot girl! (He heads to the window but realizes
something, stops, turns and points at Monica.) There she is! (He dances over to her and
kisses her.)
[Scene: Ross's building, Joey is knocking on a door again. It's again answered by
Ross.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damnit!! Did you move?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. I lived with you guys for a while and then I found this place. (Joey
just stares at him) I'm Ross.
(Joey makes a frustrated face and noise and walks away. He knocks on the next door and
it's answered by an old man.)

lines.speaker: The Old Man
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Looking around) Uhh do you happen to have a hot girl in there?

lines.speaker: The Old Man
lines.text: No. I'm all alone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Sorry about that. (He walks away and knocks on the next door which
is answered by a little girl.) Oh, hey little girl. Uhh, is-is your mommy, or sister, or
babysitter by any chance a hot girl?

lines.speaker: The Little Girl
lines.text: Daddy!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Later! (He runs away down the hall and hides behind a corner to a whole
other corridor.) Oh man! (Walks down the hallway in desperation.) Hot girl! Hot girl!!
[Scene: Rachel's job interview, she is waiting outside Mr. Zelner's (the interviewer)
office banging her pen between her teeth.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Hi Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Come on in.
(They go inside.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: It's really nice to see you again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: (Sees that she has some ink on her lip from her pen.) Oh Rachel,
uhh… (He points to his lip to get her to notice the ink on hers.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Just ah… (He points again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Here let me… (He goes to wipe it off himself.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stopping him) Wh-whoa! All right, okay-okay, I see, I see what's going
on here! Now listen, look-look, I'm sorry if I gave you the wrong impression, but I am not
some hussy who will just sleep around to get ahead! Now even though I (He tries to
interrupt and tell her about the ink), hey-hey-hey, even though I kissed you, that does
not give you the right to demand sex from me. I do not want, this job that
bad. Good day, sir. (She storms out of his office.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is returning from her interview attempt.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Ugh, you will not believe what that sleaze-ball from Ralph
Lauren did too me!
(Joey, Monica, and Ross all point to their lips to get Rachel to once again notice the
ink on her lip.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay-okay that-that's amazing. How did you know that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You got ink on your lip.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. (Realizes.) Ohhhhhhhhh….

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Gary and Chandler and Monica are all there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Gary) So what do you say, maybe sometime I hold your gun?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: I don't know man, we're really not supposed to do that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, what can happen? I mean, would you… (He gestures and spills
some of his coffee.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Yeah, I'm gonna say no.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, do you want to go see a movie after dinner tonight?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh we can't, we already have plans.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, same thing we did all day, hang out at Gary's apartment. He is so
amazing, we never left the bedroom. But have fun at the movie.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (That annoying competitiveness thing kicks in again, what the heck is
that with her and why must the writers show it every flippin' episode?!) Oh, we're not
seeing a movie!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're not? Then why did you ask us if we wanted to go?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh umm, that's because I just wanted to y'know walk in on me and
Chandler while we were, y'know, doing it all night. Will you excuse me for just a second?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (She gets up and walks over to Chandler.) Chandler? Can I see you
for a second?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (They walk away to get some privacy.) We have got to beat
them! {Here we go yet again.}

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: 'Cause, Gary and Phoebe think they're a hotter couple than we are!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh, so?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So! So we've got to go upstairs and have a lot of sex to prove them
wrong!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica, you have got to stop this competitive thing! Okay? It's
crazy. {Finally! The voice of reason.} I mean, just impress Gary and Phoebe we have to go
upstairs and have sex over and over and I'm saying no to this, why? Get your coat.
Commercial Break
[Scene: The lobby in Ross's building, we see a flyer that is on the bulletin board that
reads, "Are you the Hot Girl who waved at me? If so, give me a call!" and it's
signed, Joey 629-9*** (The last couple of numbers have been ripped off). Anyhoo, Ross is
getting his mail.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the woman checking her mail next to him) Hey!
(A man walks up.)

lines.speaker: The Man
lines.text: (To Ross) Excuse me. (He puts up a flyer that has a sketch drawing of
Joey and it reads, "Warning! Intruder! If you see this creep - call the cops!")
You should check this out, tell the other tenants. Apparently he's running around looking
for some kind of a hot girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the woman checking her mail) Who isn't?
(For the first time we see that the woman Ross is talking too is in fact the hot girl
that Joey is looking for. She just kinda stares at him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't, I don't think we've meet. I-I'm Ross.

lines.speaker: The Hot Girl
lines.text: I know. You're the guy who wouldn't chip in for the handyman.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nevermind! (Goes back to his mailbox.)

lines.speaker: The Hot Girl
lines.text: No, I-I actually thought it was unfair the way everyone reacted. I
mean you had just moved in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I had just moved in. Thank you! Listen umm…

lines.speaker: The Hot Girl
lines.text: Jen.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Jen, I know this may sound a little…(makes some kind of crazy noise)
But uh, would you maybe wanna grab a cup of coffee sometime, or…

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: Sure! That would be nice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm?

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: Oh! My number is on there. (Hands him a business card.) Give me a call.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I will give you a call.

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: I'll see you later. (Starts to walk away.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay!
(After she's left, Ross gets really happy and starts kissing the card. Suddenly, she
returns.)

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: I forgot my paper. (Ross quickly hides the card in his mouth.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, a post-coital Monica and Chandler are recovering on the
couch.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was amazing!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe and Gary are so gonna hear about this at dinner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was amazing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We are the hottest! Huh? No one is hotter than we are! You're the
best.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, you're the best.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, you're the best.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, you're the best.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am the best.
(Just as they start to get up, Joey walks in.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys! (Sees their state of undress) What 'cha been doin'?
(Has a silly grin.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking out the window) Hey Joey! Isn't that the girl that waved at you
the other day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know. But I can see through your sheet. (He looks out the window.)
Yeah, yeah, that's her. But y'know what? Doesn't matter, I'm never gonna get to meet her
anyway.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because it's impossible to find her apartment! She lives in some like of
hot girl parallel universe, or something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about? (Pointing out the window.) She obviously
lives on the second floor, seventh apartment from the left!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. No. No. She lives on the third floor, eighth apartment
from the left.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, those first two windows, (Points) that's the lobby. And y'know the
other one over there, that's the stairway. You've been counting wrong.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I did not know that! Thank you Monica. (Starts to leave) I can't
believe I almost lost another girl because of counting.

scenes.location: Jen's apartment, Ross is picking her up for their date.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uhh, you ready?

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: Sure, I'll just get my coat. (There's a knock on the door.) Could you get
that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure. (He opens the door to Joey. Needless to say, Joey's stunned.)
Joey…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dahhhhh!! (Ross has a puzzled look on his face.) No! Noooo!! (Storms off.)
[Scene: Mr. Zelner's office, Rachel has come back again to try and do that second
interview.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, first, I-I would like to say thank you for agreeing to see me again.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: That's quite all right, but I feel obligated to tell you that this
meeting is being videotaped.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looks around for the camera) Okay. Umm, well, first I would like to
start by apologizing for kissing you and uh, for yelling at you.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Fair enough.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now you're probably going to hire one of the people who did not ah, (She
puts her hands on his desk blotter and he moves it. Rachel then doesn't know where to put
her hands.) who did, who did not umm, yell at you and storm out, and I think that's a big
mistake and here's why. I made a huge fool of myself and I came back, that shows courage.
When I thought you wanted sex in exchange for this job, I said no. That shows integrity.
And, I was not afraid to stand up for myself and that shows courage. (Suddenly realizes
that she said courage twice.) Okay umm, now I know I already said courage, but y'know you
gotta have courage. And umm, and finally when I thought you were making sexual advances in
the workplace, I said no and I was not litigious. {By the way, litigious means to want to
litigate and litigate is to make a lawsuit against. So she didn't want to sue him.
Don't worry, I had to look it up too.} So there you go, you got, you got (counts
them off with her fingers) courage, you got integrity, you got (Pause) courage again, and
not litigious. Look Mr…

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Zelner.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Zelner! Right! I knew that! I really, really want this job and I think,
I think I would be really good at it.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Y'know what? I may regret this but uh, I'm going to give you a shot.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Oh! You are?

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? Oh thank you! Oh… Oh, would it be completely inappropriate
to give you a hug?

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well then how about a handshake? (She goes to shake his hand but
misses and touches his groin.) Oh God I'm sorry! Oh God, I'm sorry! I did not mean to
touch that—I mean you there. There. Uhh, okay, so thank-thank you, I'm going
to leave now thank you very much uh-huh, thank you so—Hey! I'll see you Monday!
(Exits.)
[Scene: A restaurant, Chandler, Monica, Phoebe, and Gary are on a double date. Chandler
is yawning.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You tired Chandler?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You better believe he's tired, after the day we had! If you know what I
mean. You know what I mean?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, the tortilla chips know what you mean.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: So uh Chandler, you like that badge I got you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, it's so cool. (He opens his coat and has it pinned to the
lining.) Now I gotta go, Officer Bing has gotta, 10-100. (Pause, softly) That's pee-pee.
(Heads for the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, you have a, a twig in your hair.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, (laughs) umm, we kinda took a little detour on the way over here.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Yeah, we took a little stroll in the park and no one was around, so…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You didn't!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We did! We violated Section 12 Paragraph 7 of the criminal code!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The park huh? A public place.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I hear ya. Excuse me for just a second! (Gets up and heads for the
bathroom as that annoying Gotta-win-at-all-costs-super-competitive thing kicks in again.)
[Cut to the Men's room. Chandler is practicing flashing his badge as Monica enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica! This is the Men's room! (Pause) Isn't it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes it is. You see I've always found the men's bathroom very sexual.
Haven't you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. And if I did, I don't think we'd be going out. Monica, this is
getting ridiculous!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on, we can't let them win!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ugh, we have already proved that we are hot! Okay? So why-why are you
getting so obsessed about this thing?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because Phoebe and Gary are in
that-can't-keep-their-hands-off-each-other-doing-it-in-the-park phase!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (gasps) So?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I feel really sad that we're not…really there anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh wow! Is that what this all have been about?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wasn't it a lot more exciting when we were y'know all over each other
all the time?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah that was great. That was really great! But to tell you the truth,
I'm more excited about where we are right now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! I've never been in a relationship that's lasted this long
before. Y'know to get past the beginning and still be around each other all the time, I
think that's pretty incredible. And the fact that this is happening all with you, yeah I
think that's pretty exciting. (Kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is so sweet. I know that I was acting a little crazy but umm, I
feel the same way.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what I just realized? You just freaked out about our
relationship.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did not.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes you did! Admit it! You freaked out!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I freaked out a little.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Little?! You freaked out big time! Okay? And I fixed it! We have
switched places! I am the relationship and king and you are the crazy, irrational
screw up! (Does a dance of joy.) (Monica glares at him.) And now we're back.
Ending Credits
[Scene: Looking through Ross's window, he's doing more pantomimes. The first one is
he's walking a dog that has stopped, then suddenly tugs him forward.]
[Cut to the inside of Monica and Rachel's apartment, Monica and Rachel are sitting at
the table.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) I cannot believe Ross is buying this!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank God! I can't watch him anymore!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) You guys ready fore the movies?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Oh by the way, thank you for loaning us Pamela and Yasmine.
(We see through the big window from the outside and see that Monica and Rachel have
pictures of their faces pasted onto cardboard cutouts of Pamela Anderson and Yasmine
Bleeth wearing their Baywatch swimsuits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (from his apartment) Man! They cannot get enough! (Makes like he's a robot
and waves at the cutouts.)

title: The One Where Rachel Smokes

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Joey, Chandler, Monica, and Phoebe are there. Joey is holding a
deck of cards out to Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, pick a card.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (He picks the 9 of Spades)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right now, memorize it. (Pause) You got it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (holding up the Queen of Clubs) Is that your card? (He winks and smiles.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pause) Yes.
(Joey laughs then realizes the trick didn't work when Chandler hands him his card
back.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (entering with Ben and Ross) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi there!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Hi!!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Guess what? Ben is going to be in a TV commercial!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you talking about?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sets Ben down) Well, it's not for sure but umm, we met this guy in the
park who thought Ben was really cute--y'know, which he is--so umm anyhoo, he uh, he gave
us his card and told us to bring him down for this commercial he's auditioning.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (reading the card) Whoa! This guy is like the biggest commercial casting
director in town! (Ross gasps) Ben takes one lousy walk in the park and gets an audition!!
(Ross and Carol stare at him, then Joey realizes what he just said.) I mean, way to go
Ben! (Gives Ben the thumbs up, which Ben returns.) Man! I've been in that park a million
times and no one offered me an audition.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, it's crazy! We were just pushing Ben on the swings…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm always on the swings! What am I doing wrong?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is eating breakfast, Ross is heading for the
bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her room) Okay, gotta go! Wish me luck!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Luck!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Rach, now that you're working at Ralph Lauren, can you
bring me back some of those polo shirts?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh well, y'know what? I don't think if I feel comfortable stealing on my
very first day…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Unwilling to steal from work, interesting.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Besides, if anybody's gonna get free stuff, it's gonna be me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay guys, way to wish me luck!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Good luck! Go get 'em! (Rachel exits.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, let's discuss Rachel's birthday. I say we throw a surprise party
this weekend.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa, but her birthday isn't like for another month.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah but if we throw her a party on her birthday, then it's not a
surprise.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think it's a great idea. Yeah, we could have a dinner party and just
invite her close friends.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross!! We're having a surprise party for Rachel!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (from the bathroom) Okay!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Done.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, great so do you want to do it together?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I would love to do it together!
(Joey starts to giggle.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They're gonna do it together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dude! That's my girlfriend!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What, so I gotta shut it down now?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, I gotta take off. I'm picking up Ben then we're off to the big
audition.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's gonna be weird to watch some actor pretending to be Ben's dad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Weirder than watching his two moms make out? (Monica nods in
agreement.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa dad? There's a dad in the commercial?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah the dad and Ben eat soup and pretend to enjoy it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, hey, maybe I'll go down there with ya and see if I can get an
audition to play the dad. I mean who better to play Ben's father than his godfather.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're not his godfather.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! Are you kidding?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Pause) Of course I am! (Joey is relieved) Okay, let's go godfather.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right!
(As they walk out he motions to Chandler that he is still Ben's godfather.)
[Scene: Ben's audition, Carol, Ross, and Ben along with about 10 more families are in a
waiting room as Joey enters happily.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! I'm in, they're gonna let me audition!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? That's great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! I know! It turns out that one of the casting ladies has actually
seen me in a play, so I steered clear of her…

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (noticing a kid who has picked up a copy of Variety to read) Hey,
that kid looks familiar.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, yeah! He's done tons of commercials. I've seen him in like Sugar
Smacks, Playstation, and that one for the phone company. In fact he was so good in
that one, he actually convinced me to switch phone companies. Chandler was mad….

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah well, he's not gonna get this one. Ben is way cuter than that kid. I
mean look at him, look at you, (Starts to whine like a baby and Joey just glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's great. Listen, wouldn't it be great though if I got to play Ben's
dad?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, you look nothing like Ben.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I look more like him than you do! (He winks at Carol.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Y'know, I don't really know you well enough for you to do that.
[Scene: Rachel's new job, she's in her new boss's office (Kim's) and with the other
assistant (Nancy). Together they're deciding what clothes to buy or something, who knows,
let's all watch/read to find out.]

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: So it's down to these two, Nancy I know you like this one and I think I
agree. Rachel, what do you think?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well umm, that one is pretty but uh, I just, I just love this fabric (On
the other one.) Sorry.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh don't be sorry, that's part of your job here to give your opinions and
then I take credit for them--I'm kidding.

lines.speaker: Nancy
lines.text: She is kidding, but don't ever disagree with her again. Okay, now I'm
kidding!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughing nervously) Oh, what a fun office.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I don't know which one, but I do know I need a cigarette. So what do you
say we take a break, we go outside, and we'll figure this out when we come back?
(They all get up to leave.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: (at the door) Rachel? Do you smoke?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, my dad's a doctor and he would always tell me just horror
stories…(stops and tries to change directions)…about ghosts and goblins who
totally supported the princess's right to smoke.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is telling Chandler and Monica about her day.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …and then they came back from smoking and they had made all of the
decisions without me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That doesn't seem fair.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know! It's like I'm being punished for not having this disgusting,
poisoning habit!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, it is the best.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean what if this keeps happening? Y'know, they'll-they'll be outside
smoking, making all the decisions and I'll just be up in my office breathing my stupid
clean air, y'know? And then when the day comes when Kim wants to promote one of us, who do
you think she's gonna pick? Me or Smokey Smokerson?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, you can go down there, you don't have to smoke. Just say you
wanna get some fresh air.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I can do that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, or you can do the easy thing and smoke.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Rach, you wanna get some coffee?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I would love to!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh good!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I wanna go to babe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh good.
(They all start out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh wait, I change my mind! (She slams the door on them.) Okay, let's
talk about the party! I have so many ideas! (Holds up a cocktail napkin.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, me too! (Runs and grabs her 3-ring binder of ideas.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, look at that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, that's a little sketch of the cake, umm some sample menus,
umm y'know what I thought we would start out with Tuscan style finger food, and for music,
here's an alphabetized list of all my CDs! I've highlighted the ones that would go really
good with the food.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What happened to the intimate dinner party?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, we're not doing that. Okay…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So wow, it looks like you took care of everything. Thanks a lot,
co-host.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! I didn't take care of everything, there's-there's plenty of
things for you to do!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Thinks) Cups.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Cups? You're giving me cups?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And ice!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Cups and ice? Ooh, I get to be in charge of cups and ice? (Thinks of
something) All right. Fine, okay, I will be in charge of cups and ice!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute, I can get ice at the restaurant…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I got it! Mine!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering, downtrodden) Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! How'd the audition go?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not so good.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute, are you doing Joey's (sadly) "Audition didn't go so
well. (Happily) Yeah it did?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Pause) Yeah I am! Yeah, Ben got a second audition!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (also downtrodden) Yeah, I had to teach Ross my bit because I actually
didn't get a callback.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You got a callback too didn't you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Happily) Yeah I did!

scenes.location: The smoker's balcony, Rachel is out to join Kim and Nancy.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Hey Rachel, what are you doing out here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh well, it's kinda lonely up there, so I just thought I would come out
here and get some fresh air.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Nancy and I were talking about the fall collection.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh great!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: So anyway we really… (Someone exhales and Rachel turns and coughs.)
Honey, we're just smoking all over you.

lines.speaker: Nancy
lines.text: Oh, sorry!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh that's okay.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: No-no-no, we'll move you just stay right there. (They walk away.)

lines.speaker: Nancy
lines.text: So anyway I sent the designs over to Ralph and he's very excited about
the line.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh that's great! You are the best!
(Rachel gets fed up and heads over to another smoker.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me, can I, can I bum one of those? (He holds up his pack.) Y'know
what, actually… (She takes the one he's smoking and heads over to where Nancy and Kim
are standing and laughing.) Okay, okay, okay, what's so funny over here?

lines.speaker: Nancy
lines.text: I thought you didn't smoke.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I thought you guys meant marijuana cigarettes, y'know? Y'know what I
mean, like dubbies? And I actually, I thought to myself, "Wow, those guys are
crazy!" But no, I actually smoke the regular ones all, all the time.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: We get high.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, me too.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I'm kidding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Laughs) Oh, me too.

scenes.location: Ben and Joey's (Isn't that an ice cream??) callback.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh God, this is so nerve wracking! How-how do you do this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, unfortunately, I don't get many callbacks so…

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Is it a good sign that they asked us to hang around after the audition?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who knows?

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: (entering) Okay uh, we have narrowed it down to Raymond,
Ben, Kyle, and Joey. The rest of you, thank you very much.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes!! I knew it!! (To the people who didn't make it.) Bye-bye! So long!
Later!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh this is great! I might actually get to play Ben's dad!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Actually, that can't happen. Yeah because you all have
such different looks, we're putting you with Raymond and Kyle with Ben. So it'll be either
you two (Points to Joey and Raymond) or you two. (Points to Kyle and Ben.) (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, this is gonna be kinda weird.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it is.

lines.speaker: Kyle
lines.text: Yeah. It's gonna be weird.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, we-we're gonna be like best friends, that's why it's gonna be weird.

lines.speaker: Kyle
lines.text: Oh, oh, I thought we were just talking.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Ross and Chandler are talking.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering, carrying two garbage bags) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross and Chandler
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Is it okay if I leave this stuff here 'til Rachel's birthday party?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah sure. What's in 'em?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, cups.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh good, because uh we got Rachel 800 gallons of water.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Seriously that's a lot of cups.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah well, that's 'cause Monica put me in charge of cups and ice, and
Monica is gonna rue the day that she put me in charge of cups and ice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know I rued the day once…didn't get a whole lot else done.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, time to bring up the rest of the cups. (She goes and opens the
door to Joey.) Oh, hi Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs! (To the guys) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross good, I'm uh glad you're here. I wanna talk to you about something.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I've been thinking about this whole commercial thing, y'know me
going up against Ben, the two of us competing, and that can't lead to anything good. So, I
think I'm just gonna step aside. I'm gonna tell them that I won't audition.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, uh, Joey that's-that's great. Thanks man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's it? You're-you're gonna let me do this?! This-this is my career
we're talking about here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you just…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I just said that so you wouldn't let Ben do it! Look Ross, if anyone
should step aside it should be Ben!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? Chandler! Tell 'em!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (shocked) Well I mean, let me get the door first. (Goes and opens the
door.) Oh, hi! No one. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why should Ben step aside? It was his audition in the first place! You-you
just tagged along! You're like the uh, tag-a-long dad.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: At least I care about his feelings!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you know how hard this is gonna be on him when he doesn’t get it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And why wouldn't he get it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, come on! Have you seen what my kid can do?! Huh?! I mean he
dials phones! He-he-he eats tortilla chips! He-he plays soccer with the cartoon tiger!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you saying your kid eats soup better than my kid?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You just give him a spoon baby!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah? I guess we'll just see!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Because this commercial belongs to me and Mitch!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're kid's name is Raymond!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?! So's yours!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler and Monica are there as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Rachel) How did work go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh it was great! It was great! I went down there just like you said,
y'know? And we talked business. Kim totally took my opinions.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You stink!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I'm-I'm serious!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well-well that's 'cause I went down there and they were all smoking.
This is actually the smell of success.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, there's something different though--Oh my God! You smoked!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did not!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes you did! You look happy and sick; you smoked!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, fine! But I had too! I had to do it for my career!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I wish I had smoked for my career…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's so gross!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No well, no it's not that bad, y'know? I mean yeah, my tongue feels a
little fuzzy and these fingers sort of smell, I actually feel like I can throw up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
