lines.text: Okay, but you gotta push past this because it is about to get so good!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! I have to tell you, you smell so smokey I have to get up. I'm
not kidding. (She's not; she stands and walks away. Chandler moves closer.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think you smell great! (He sniffs her shoulder.)
[Scene: The smoker's balcony, Rachel, Kim, and Nancy are all puffing away on their
cancer sticks.]

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: So, we're decided, no on plaid, yes on pink?

lines.speaker: Nancy
lines.text: Absolutely!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am so on board! (She throws away her recently lit cigarette.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Rachel didn't you just light that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I did, but y'know what? I am really, really trying to cut back,
y'know? (Laughs) Good luck, Rach.

lines.speaker: Nancy
lines.text: I've actually been thinking about quitting lately.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh sure, every Sunday night I'm telling myself I'm quitting but every
Monday morning it's like (Mimics chain smoking.)

lines.speaker: Nancy
lines.text: Tell me about it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well then let's just quit! We'll just quit! Let's all quit!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: It does sound appealing.

lines.speaker: Nancy
lines.text: Oh, I never could do it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh but you could. You can. Absolutely! We can help each other out! We
can get--what are those--those patches! We could be like the Patch Sisters!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh y'know, we really should quit. Okay, let's quit!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! Great! Give me those cigs! Give it! Give it! (She grabs their
cigarettes and lighters and throws them in the trash.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: My late husband gave me that lighter. (Rachel laughs.) I'm not kidding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay then! (She starts rummaging through the trash to find Kim's
lighter.)
[Scene: Joey and Ben's audition, Joey is rehearsing his lines, uh correction, Joey is
rehearsing his line.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hmmm, soup! (Tries again.) Hmm soup! (Tries again, with a little
caveman thrown in.) Hmm, soup!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Joey, Ross is gonna be here any second, would you mind watching Ben for
me while I use the ladies' room?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, no problem.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Thanks. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (goes over to Ben) Hi Ben! So you wanna be an actor huh? I gotta tell ya,
it's no picnic. There's tons of rejection. No stability. One day you're Dr. Drake
Remoray, the next day you're eating ketchup right out of the bottle.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering, angrily) Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (angrily) Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (angrily) Ben! (Pause.) (Happily.) I mean, Ben! Ben!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: (entering) Okay, Raymond, Joey you're up.
(Raymond and Joey go in the office.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Okay, uh well, let's try one. Whenever you guys are ready.
(Some dude puts down a couple bowls of soup in front of them.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well this is noodle soup and uh, I've been working with tomato. But that's
okay, no problem. No problem. Hmm, noodle soup.

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Y'know, that's-that's fine, but the line is, "Hmm,
soup."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, what did I say?

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Hmm, noodle soup.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How's that different? (She looks at him until he gets it.) Oh! Yeah!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: All right, let's try one.
(Raymond and Joey both eat a spoonful and Joey turns to Raymond and says…)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hmm, noodle soup.

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Okay. Let's do it again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.
(They do it again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hmm, soup. (Pause.) I mean, noodle soup. I mean soup!

lines.speaker: Raymond
lines.text: COME ON!!!!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Y'know what? We need to move on.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No! I-I can do it one more time! See? Look! (Eats another spoonful)
Hmm, noodle soup. Damnit! (Storms out.)

scenes.location: The smoker's balcony, Kim and Nancy are cheating and are caught by Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Hey-hey-hey!!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Uh-oh, busted!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on you guys! What are doing?! I thought we were the patch sisters!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Yeah. That didn't work out.

lines.speaker: Nancy
lines.text: Rachel we tried to quit, but it was too hard!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y'know if you, if you started smoking again you could've at least
told me! Come on, give me one of those! What are we talking about?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: No. No! You're doing great! Don’t you give up! That's why we didn't
tell you and we're not gonna drag you down with us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wait, no-no-no! Drag me down. Drag-drag me down.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Forget it Rachel! We're both so proud of how well you're doing. I'm not
gonna let you blow it. In fact, if I catch you with a cigarette, you're fired. So go on,
get out of here! Go on, I don't want you breathing this stuff! Go on!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Starts to walk away.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: (to Nancy) So, okay! So you'll come with me on the Paris trip.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (hearing that) Oh man!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel's surprise party. The apartment is festooned with
cups. There are cups everywhere! Cup centerpiece, cup garland, etc., etc]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Chandler) Check it out! Cup hat! (Points to her hat.) Cup banner!
Cup chandelier! And the thing that started it all, the cup! (Holds up one.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great job with the cups, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (overhearing that) Why don't you just go out with her!
(Chandler starts to follow her into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (following him) And did you notice the ice? (Gestures to 3 huge buckets
of ice on the table.) Look! We have it all! We have crushed! Cubed! And dry! Watch! (Pours
some water onto the dry ice, causing it to evaporate/smoke.) Ahhh! Mystical!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Awesome!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! Everyone--no one's eating my Tuscan finger food 'cause they're
all filling up on Phoebe's snow cones!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There are snow cones! (Monica glares at him.) Snow cones! Yuck!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know…go! Go! Right there! (Points)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you! Thank you! (Runs to the snow cone machine.)
(Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (noticing her) Oh, look! Look! Look!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Surprise!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! What?! My birthday's not for another month!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's the surprise!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! You guys this is so great! I mean it's so unexpected! I mean
Chandler's birthday is even before mine!
(Everyone stops and looks at Chandler, who's nodding.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Surprise!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! This is great! Look at all these cups! This is so weird.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I was in charge of cups.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, okay, not so weird.
[Cut to another part of the room, Ross is going to talk to Joey.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen man, uh, I'm sorry the audition didn't go so well.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah right! (Gets up for a refill to his snow cone.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No really, I-I am! I feel bad!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah? Well look Ross, you don't have to. Okay? It's not your fault I suck.
I mean what kind of an actor can't even say, "Hmm, noodle soup." (Nods his head
in disgust.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah y'know what? Maybe-maybe you didn't mess up your audition because you
suck, maybe you messed up because you care more about uh, your godson.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What you do mean?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think, sub-consciously…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait-whoa-whoa, you lost me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pause) I think on some level, you-you sabotaged your own audition so that
Ben would get the part.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, you're way sounds a lot better than mine. (Thinks about it.) Yeah.
Yeah! It's not that I'm a bad actor…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, it's just ah, I care so damn much about little Ben that uh, it was
more important to see him succeed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There you go. Thank you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you! So, did-did he get it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Eh, what are you gonna do?
Ending Credits
[Scene: The smoker's balcony, Kim and Nancy are out smoking as Chandler sticks his head
out the door.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Kim and Nancy) Oh, hi! Excuse me, is uh Rachel Green here? I was
supposed to meet her for lunch.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh, she doesn't come down here any more. You can find her up on ten.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, great.
(Kim exhales and Chandler stares at it longingly.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: (to Nancy) So we talked about the (Chandler sneaks closer to her cigarette)
whole presentation yesterday at lunch (Closer) and he wondered if one person would be
enough (Closer) to get a take on the trip (Still closer) and I said, "Yeah,
absolutely!" (She's interrupted by Chandler who has reached his goal and takes a drag
from her cancer stick.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'll catch you guys later. (Exits.)

title: The One Where Ross Can't Flirt

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is getting ready for a date with Monica as Ross
enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! You look nice. What's the occasion?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica and I are celebrating our ten-month anniversary, we've got
reservations at Ja George.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! How'd you get in there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Made a few calls, pulled some strings, and they agreed to seat us at
11:30 if we both had the chicken and didn't get desert.
(There's a knock on the door and Chandler answers it. It's the pizza delivery girl.)

lines.speaker: Delivery Girl
lines.text: Hi Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Caitlin! Somebody got a haircut.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Ugh, I hate it! I look like an 8-year-old boy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, if that was true, gym class would've been a lot more
interesting.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: It's uh, 27 dollars even.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, okay. (Hands her the money.) Here you go.
(The duck starts quacking.)

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Hey, where's the chicken?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, he's in the back. The duck pissed him off, said that eggs came
first.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: (laughs) Great. I'll see you later!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, bye!
(He closes the door and turns to see Ross glaring at him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What the hell was that?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The flirting! Aren't you supposed to be going out with, I don't know hmm,
let's say my sister?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was not flirting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was totally flirting. "Somebody got a haircut (Makes some whiney,
nasally noises.)"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay first of all, the impression, uncanny. And second, that was not
flirting, that was just casual conversation between two people. That is all.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You wanna see flirting? I'll show you flirting. (Starts to move
towards Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (backing away) I'm good.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel and Phoebe are in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am so proud of Joey, I can't believe he's going to be on Law &
Order!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. But don't you think that it should be called Order and Law?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No because first they arrest the guy and then they try him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don't get me started on that.
(Ross and Chandler enter with the pizzas.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was not flirting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And on your anniversary, for shame!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler was hitting on the hot delivery girl!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was not and oh God, shh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I'm sorry but you were! Okay? And besides if anyone should be hitting
on her it's the guy who's single, the guy that who-who-who can do something about it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sounds like somebody wants to be Mr. Pizza Delivery Girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is that what this is about? You like Caitlin?
(Ross looks at Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! We broke up two years ago; you've been married since then.
I think it's okay that we see other people.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I-I was watching her the other day at the pizza place.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hm-mmm.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And she's just so sexy and funny and has the cutest little…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y'know what? We don't need her measurements.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looking through the pizzas) Okay pepperoni, pepperoni, pepperoni, okay
Ross, I know she's pretty and you love her, but is she stupid?! She forgot my vegetarian!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is perfect! She'll have to come back here with your pizza, and when
she does, I'll turn on the Charm-O-Ross. Oh I'm so glad you don't eat meat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: See? Vegetarianism benefits everyone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, with his grandmother) Hey everybody, look who's here! You
remember my grandmother!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Big night!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is so cool!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, Joey on Law & Order, you must be very proud!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, she doesn't understand a word of English.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry, I thought you were Joey's other grandmother. (She just
stares at him.) I've done it again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She's my biggest fan. Yeah, she's the only one in the family that's
believed in me.
(They both start speaking Italian to each other, and since I'm not Italian and don't
understand one word, we'll move on to the English portion of the show. Not, that I'm
English. Not that there's anything wrong with that, it's just that I'm not. Y'know I think
I should shut-up now and move on. Anyhoo, she says something about Joey being fat I think
based on this line.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I uh weighted like 27 pounds when I was born so…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from the bathroom) Hey! Happy Anniversary!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Happy Anniversary, 10 months! (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So umm, when I was in the shower I was thinking about our first night in
London…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh, Joey's grandmother is right there. (Points)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is that the one that speaks English or the one that doesn't?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The one that doesn't.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was some hot love you gave me! I'm gonna go get ready.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, why don't you wear those earrings I gave you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's a great idea! I was saving them for something special.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (runs over to Phoebe) You have got to go home!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But I like it here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You gotta go home and get the earrings that you borrowed from me okay?
Chandler wants me to wear them tonight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well I think that they're in my purse. Why don't you go get
dressed and I'll look for them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! (Walks over to Rachel) Rach, hi, I need those earrings you
borrowed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, umm, okay, yeah, I'll be, yeah I'll be right back. (Goes to her
room.)
(Phoebe then gets possessed 'cause she starts speaking in tongues. She speaks Italian
to Joey's grandmother. She is quickly exorcised and returns to speaking in English. Of
course, too most people English is a strange language as well. But none of them are
probably reading this and if they were they wouldn't understand it. So why am I talking
about them? I have absolutely no clue. Moving on…)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow Pheebs, you speak Italian?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I guess so. (See, the brief possession didn't affect her at all, like we
could really tell.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (She enters and hands Phoebe the earring) Here you go. Thank you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, Rach! Where's the other one?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh what, you-you want both of them?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel Karen Green, where's the other earring?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay, look, just don't freak out, but I kinda lost it. I
know it's in the apartment, but I definitely lost it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, what am I going to tell Monica? She wants to wear them tonight!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Tell her to wear her own earrings.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: These are her earrings.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nooo! Nooooo! You lent me Monica's earrings?! I'm not allowed to borrow
her stuff!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because I lose her stuff!
[Time Lapse, the gang is now watching Law & Order. By the way, the entire
rest of the episode takes place in Monica and Rachel's apartment. Why are they called
apartments when they're all stuck together? Something to think about.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, see that blind guy right there? I'm gonna bash his head in later.
(His grandmother asks him something.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh umm, my big scene is coming up. Big scene coming up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If you said, "Big lima bean, bubbling up." Would she
understand the difference?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (noticing Rachel crawling behind the couch) Rach? What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh boy, I just can't watch. It's too scary!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's a diaper commercial.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah well, you know me, babies, responsibilities, ahhh!!!
(There's a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Pizza delivery!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll get it! I will get that! (Runs over and opens the door.)

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: One uh, vegetarian pizza. That's $12.15.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Uh, by the way, if it makes you feel any better. I happen to like
8-year-old boys.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (I can't make it out.) The uh, your hair, before, your hair, you said you
thought your looks like an 8-year-old's, and I'm just saying I like it. The hair.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Oh. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You understand I don't actually like 8-year-old boys.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Y'know, all I'm looking for is the money.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here you go. (Hands her the money.) Now stop bringing us pizzas you.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: I'm gonna try. (Walks away and Ross closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You couldn't let me have her, could ya?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is a girl that I really like and had too swoop in there!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What's goin' on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler was totally flirting with the hot delivery girl!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you for that! (To Monica) I was not flirting.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's okay. I don't care. It's uh, it's fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's no big deal, I do it all the time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (starts to laugh, but then gets serious) So umm, you-you flirt with
guys all the time?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure! It doesn't mean anything! Just like I know it doesn't mean
anything with you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but there is a big difference. You are a lot hotter than
I am.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (walking past) True story! (Goes and sits down.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, this actually bothers you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, it does bother me! And I think it would bother a lot of people.
Rachel, when you were going out with Ross, did it bother you when he flirted with other
women?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uhh, no, no, it bothered me when he slept with other women.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And thank you, for that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But y'know, I never really had anything to worry about. Ross was never
very good at the flirting thing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (Mumbles) What-what, what are talking about? It-it worked with you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Y'know what? You're right! We meet, you flirted and then bamn
nine years later you had me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, all right. You-you-you know what I'm going to do? I am going to
order another pizza and when Caitlin gets here, you-you--I will show how well I flirt.
Yeah! I will, I will get her phone number! (To Chandler) And not the one on the menu!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering from Rachel's bedroom) I found it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! Thank God! Where was it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: On your dresser.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay that is the one we already have!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, here's my big scene. My big scene's here! (They have two of the cops
on the street, then they cut to where they're entering an apartment.) Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling) Okay, everybody just keep smiling. It'll kill my grandmother if
she finds out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiling) Well, what is it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling) Oh, they cut me out of the show.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (smiling) What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (smiling) Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (smiling) Maybe your scene's coming up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling) Not likely. 'Cause you see that body bag right there

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (smiling) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling) I'm in it.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, it's continued from before the commercial break.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (smiling) This is terrible, what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling) I don't know. This little, old lady lives for my career. When
they dumped me off of Days of Our Lives she almost died.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (not smiling) That's not good.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling) No, smile! Not that face, smile! Everybody smile! (They all
smile.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (smiling) Joey, why don't you just tell her what happened? It's not your
fault.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiling) If we keep talking this way, aren't we gonna freak her out
soon?

lines.speaker: Grandma Tribbiani
lines.text: (Something in Italian to Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Soon, soon, I'm gonna be on soon. There I am! (Points to the screen, of
course it isn't him.)

lines.speaker: Grandma Tribbiani
lines.text: (pointing at the screen) No! Sam Waterston!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no, that-that's me, that's me.

lines.speaker: Grandma Tribbiani
lines.text: No, it's Sam Waterston! Crimes and Misdemeanors,
Capricorn One.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Doesn't know, "Hello." But she knows Capricorn One.
(Phoebe gets up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (following her) Phoebe! I have to have those earrings, we're going to
leave as soon as the show is over.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But I already gave them back to you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No you didn't.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I already didn't give them back to you, that's what I said.
(Walks away over to Rachel.) Where is that other earring?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's not here Pheebs, it's not here. Ohh, I went to Joey and Chandler's
last night! Okay! (Goes to the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Make sure you check Chandler's jewelry box.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait a minute. Chandler has a jewelry box?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, we have like ten minutes. Do you want me to get into that now?!
(Rachel heads for Joey and Chandler's and Phoebe heads for the kitchen to find Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Hey Pheebs! How's that uh, vegetarian pizza working out for
ya? You and those vegetables have a real thing going on, huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (she just looks at him) Why are you being weird?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you like it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, that would be, "Why are you being cute?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I'm working on my flirting.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! I did not get that.
[Cut to Chandler and Monica on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So uh Monica, do you, do you like the Law & Order?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, it's good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See, I'm finding out all this stuff about you today, like you like the
Law & Order and that you flirted with every guy in the Tri-State area!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! (Joey and his grandmother shush them and wave them away, which
they do.) Okay, let me get this straight, it's okay for you to flirt, but not for me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I'm so glad we cleared that up. Look, I'm sorry, some things are
different for men and for women.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Go on, teach me something about men and women.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I've already taught you so much already, but whatever. See when
you flirt with a guy you think, "I'm just flirting, no big deal." But the guy is
thinking, "Finally! Somebody who wants to sleep with me!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's true.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well that's pathetic!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Again true.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And this goes for all guys?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All guys that are awake. Then we go to sleep and then all the guys
from the other end of the world wake up and behave the exact same way.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Ross in the kitchen) All right, it's another commercial; I still
haven't told her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey! This is like the last commercial. You've got like (checks his watch)
ten minutes left!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, I know! What am I going to do? (Thinks) Ooh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! You are not gonna run out and leave her here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (dejected) Yeah, all right. (Thinks of something.) Ooh! (He quickly runs
out before anyone can stop him.)

lines.speaker: Grandma Tribbiani
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, Joey is gonna be right back. Right back! (Tries to pantomime it
for her.) Meanwhile, let's-let's-let's talk about you. (Pause.) So, you're old and small.
[Time lapse, Rachel is coming back from Chandler and Joey's.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) (To Phoebe) (whispering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Did you find it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The earring? No. But look, I found my sunglasses under the couch! I've
been looking for these since like last summer. (Puts 'em on.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, those are my sunglasses, you borrowed them from me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, calm down, here they are. (Gives back the sunglasses.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from her room) Phoebe! (Motions for the earrings. Phoebe gives
her the one-minute sign.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) What are we going to do?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know, I don't know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right well, we're just gonna have to tell Monica, that's all.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh gosh, she's going to kill me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I suppose I could tell her it's just all my fault.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh that'd be great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mon, can I talk to you for a sec?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, what is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, I lost one of your earrings. I'm sorry! I am so, so sorry!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shocked) Wow! All right well, I mean, what can you do? If you lost it
you lost it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I will replace it, I promise. I feel so terrible.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, sweetie that's fine. You didn't do it on purpose.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look at you! Come here! (They hug.) Feel better?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! You're the best!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, wait a minute. Wait a minute, I-I-I, I can't do this. Listen
honey, this is, it's not Phoebe's fault. She lent me the earrings, and I lost it.
I'm so sorry. Honey, I feel terrible too. (Holds out her arms for a hug.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (angrily) That is exactly why I do not lend you stuff!! (Rachel
looks over at Phoebe in resignation.) Okay?! I mean, first it's my jewelry! And if it's
not my jewelry, it's-it's my blue sweater! And if it's not my sweater, it's my sunglasses!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Your sunglasses?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, right! (Hands Monica back her sunglasses.)

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: (from outside) Pizza!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (running to the door) Oh, mine! Mine! Mine! (to everyone) Okay, here goes.
Prepare yourselves for some Class A flirting.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, hold on. (Pauses as he readies himself.) Okay. (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, you have nothing to prove. And if you really like this girl, I
don't flirting is the right thing to… (Ross interrupts and shushes her.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You'll see. Okay. (Readies himself.) Oh, what's-what's her name?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Caitlin!

lines.speaker: Grandma Tribbiani
lines.text: Caitlin!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (He opens the door while faking a laugh.) Hey! Oh, we-we can't keep eating
like this. (Monica turns her head in shame.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, (gets the money) so, do you make the pizzas in one of those uh,
wood-burning ovens?

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: No actually umm, I think that they're umm, gas.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Gas? Wow! Intense.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) If this is the way all the Gellers flirt, we don't have a
problem.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Caitlin) Hey uh, y'know that smell gas has?

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: (wanting more than anything to get the money and leave this horrible,
horrible place) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They put that in.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The gas is odorless, but they add the smell so you know when there's a
leak.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: (getting more desperate to leave) Well okay!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A lot of other gas smells…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh the humanity.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Meth-methane smells…

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Y'know what umm, actually I, I really, I should go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh but I-I-I haven't paid you yet!

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Y'know what? That's okay, you guys have ordered so many that this one
is on me! (Runs for her life.)
(Ross closes the door slowly.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To All) Was I talking to her about gas?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: More so than anything else.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I-I found it interesting.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, no-no, hey, hey, don't worry about it! In nine years, she and I will
be right there. (Goes and sits on the couch dejectedly.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well, I'm gonna clear out some of these boxes. (She grabs a couple
of the old pizza boxes and exits.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (walking over to Ross) Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What else do they add smell too?

scenes.location: The street outside the building, Rachel is running to catch up with Caitlin.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Hey! (Stops Caitlin) Hi! Hey-hey-hey, I'm Rachel! From upstairs?
The ones with all the pizza?

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Oh, is there a problem?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. No. Every thing's--they're fine. Great pizza. But it's uh, actually
umm my friend Ross. He uh, just gets really nervous when he's flirting.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Oh my God! That was flirting?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I know, but uh just, I'm telling you, once, once you get past
that part, that where it-it just feels like you wanna die, he's-he's really a good person.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: The guy with the gas?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. I'm-I'm telling you he's really sweet and he's really funny and
he's just ugh, got a good heart. And besides, I y'know, I think he really likes you.

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y'know, we have 7 people and like 10 pizzas, what do you think?

lines.speaker: Caitlin
lines.text: I just, I thought Joey was there.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe, Chandler, and Joey's grandmother are still
watching Law & Order.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey Ross? Umm, I just ran into Caitlin in the hallway and-and
uh, you must be getting better at this flirting stuff than I thought.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I don't get it, but she wanted me to give you her phone number.
(Hands him the slip of paper with the phone number on it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And she just gave you this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, thanks but uh, I don't need you doing me any favors.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I-I-I didn't! I didn't! She thought you were cute.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well that I can believe.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Is the show still on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Almost over man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (says hi to his grandma) Look! Oh! (Pointing out the window.) Is that the
Pope?! (Chandler and his grandma turn to look and Joey slips a tape into the VCR.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why am I looking?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, here I am, here's my big scene!
(Joey has made a little home movie that's his big scene. He braces himself against the
door to his apartment and while holding a plastic gun and wearing the same sweater

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on the tape) All right back off! I gotta gun! I'm not afraid to use it!

lines.speaker: Grandma Tribbiani
lines.text: Oh Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You couldn't have at least changed your shirt.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on the tape) Now, I wanna a suitcase filled with 100,000 dollars. (The
duck quacks, to the duck) Choo! Choo! Choo! (To the imaginary cops) Filled with $100,000
in small bills, and if I don't get it…(the duck quacks louder) Choo!! And if I don't
get it, (pause, picks up the duck) I'm gonna shoot this duck!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on the tape) I'm comin' out! (He opens the door and hops out pointing the
gun in all directions and then runs out of view.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Phoebe) And she's supposed to buy this?!

lines.speaker: Grandma Tribbiani
lines.text: Joey, bravo! (Starts with that Italian stuff again.)
(Suddenly, the tape cuts away from Joey's impromptu scene, to Chandler standing really,
really close to the camera.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (singing) Ground control to Major Tom! Commencing
countdown…engines…on!
(Joey and Chandler both run to shut off the tape.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to his grandmother) That's uh, scenes from next week's show. Next week's!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I am definitely gonna watch that!
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, another time lapse, Monica is seeking advice from Rachel
and Phoebe about possible replacement earrings.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What about these? These look the same?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Definitely!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not as each other!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, then no.
(Goes over to Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You ready?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You look amazing. I'm the luckiest man in the world.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, you're about to get a little luckier.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me see the earrings.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, honey, the earrings…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking at them) They look great! Does your boyfriend have the best
taste or what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My boyfriend really does have good taste!
(He turns to get his coat and Monica gives Rachel and Phoebe two thumbs up as Chandler
walks over to Ross.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) Thanks for picking out the earrings man.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hm-mmm.

title: The One with the Ride Along

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Chandler, Rachel, Joey, and Monica are sitting on the couch as
Ross is up getting some coffee.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, guys, listen, don't forget that tomorrow is the day that Emily
gets married again, so whatever we do, just try to really keep Ross's mind off of it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah, good idea.
(Ross returns.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey man, what's up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sits down at the table) Oh, eh, just thinking about Emily getting married
tomorrow. (Joey panics.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, Ross, look! Look! (Points behind Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (turning and looking) What? Where?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right over there! Right there! Look-look-look!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What am I looking at?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the rest of the gang) Somebody help me out here!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering, with Gary) Hey!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: How are you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica, I'm sorry I didn't come by last night. I was out with Gary; he
let me ride around with him in his cop car. We saw and prevented crimes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got to go on a ride along?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I want to go on a ride along!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, yeah! Me too!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Really?! You?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Well, it's kinda dangerous.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I like danger.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Okay, you guys free tonight?

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: Yeah!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tonight? You-you didn't say it was going to be at nighttime.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is kneeling at the coffee table and has a bunch of
pictures laid out in front of her as Rachel enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Oh, I'm so glad you're home, I thought tonight we could finally
organize these photos!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, thank God! Finally!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I've broken them down into categories. Okay, we have uh, we got
holidays, birthdays, candids, y'know… And then what I've done is I've
cross-referenced them by subject. Right? So if you're looking up, oh let's say birthdays
and dogs, you get Photo 152. See? (Hands her the photo.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, it's me and La Poo! Wow! I miss that dog.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You can also find him under umm, dog and dead.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Great! Thanks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, hand me that other box of photos; that's the very last one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(She picks up the box and the bottom falls out, spilling all of the pictures onto
Monica's neat little piles.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oops. Sorry! Well, good thing you number all of them, huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I hadn't! Photo 152 was a prototype.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhhh. Honey, honey, honey, it's okay, it's okay honey. I'm gonna fix
you a drink, huh? Maybe a margarita?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ross has the blender! Ugh, everything's just falling apart!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No honey, it's okay! Listen, I'll got to Ross's and get the blender, you
get all the margarita stuff ready.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, he's keys are in the drawer. Y'know what? I also need some
cash.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you want me to stop at the ATM?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nah, while you're at Ross's if you see any lying around…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! I-I-I don't, I don't do that!
(Rachel slowly leaves the apartment.)
[Scene: Gary's cop car, Ross is in the front seat with Gary of course. Chandler is in
the back seat.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Gary) That was so cool man, the way you leaned on that guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It is starting to get dark out there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Gary) He told you everything! I mean you totally cracked him!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Yeah well, being that he was the victim, they're usually pretty talkative.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughing) Okay. (Deadpan) But it is officially nighttime.
(Gary reaches up to grab that little light that cops have for unmarked cop cars.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh hey, Gary, want me to grab the berry for ya?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: It's called the cherry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's the—Chandler!!
(Chandler starts laughing at his joke.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (returning from a deli) Okay, I got it! This place makes the best sandwich
in the world!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hey Joe does it have meatballs on it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-ho, yeah!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Does it have melted cheese and marinara sauce?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Yeah, you can't eat that in my car.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (dejected) Yeah okay. (To Chandler) Even though my tax dollars paid for
this car.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Your tax dollars?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, okay.
[Time lapse, they're still on the ride along and Joey is just sniffing his sandwich.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (leans in and takes a sniff of Joey's sandwich) Wow! That sandwich
really does smell good.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Did I say you could smell it?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't smell your sandwich?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Half the taste is in the smell! You-you're sucking up all the tastiness!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I'll give them back. (Exhales strongly through his nose and Joey
just glares at him.) Look! What is so great about that sandwich?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, imagine the best sex you've ever had.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you thinking about Monica?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, what's that like?
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Rachel is just entering. She takes off her coat and heads for
the kitchen. As she does, she knocks something off of a bookcase next to the kitchen door
with her coat and it breaks.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh please don't be from a real dinosaur! Please! Please! Please!
Please! Please! Please! Please! Please! (She picks up the 2 pieces and looks at the
stand.) Made in Mexico! Yes!! Ugh, who would buy this?! (Looks for a place to hide it and
finds a wall sconce and drops the pieces into it and heads into the kitchen as the phone
rings.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on the answering machine) Rach! It's me! Pick up!
(Rachel runs over and answers the phone with the blender in hand.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! What's up?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I need a few more things to make the margaritas. Uhh, I need some salt,
some margarita mix, and tequila.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So all we have is ice?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See if he has ice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(She hangs up the phone and starts to head back to the kitchen and notices some money
lying out, stops, reaches down to pick it up, the phone rings causing her to drop it, she
quickly puts it back, and heads for the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (on answering machine) Hello Ross? It's Emily. (Rachel runs back into the
room with the tequila.) I know this is out of the blue but uh, I'm getting married
tomorrow. Well, maybe I am. I keep thinking about you and I'm wondering if-if we made a
mistake giving up so fast. Are you thinking about me? Of course you're not, but if you
are, call me tonight. Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Oh! (Takes a slug of tequila.)

scenes.location: The ride along.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So where are we going next?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: This witness won't return my calls so we're gonna see if we can surprise
him coming home.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sur-surprise him? We're not, we're not gonna make anybody mad are we?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on man! (To Gary) Listen so uh, are you gonna squeeze the perps shoes
a little bit before he lawyers up?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: It's a witness not a perp. And no one talks like that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, no one talks like that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh what? Like your Mr. Cop!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I'm more cop than you two!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How do you figure that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello! I'm in the front seat, okay? I'm Gary's partner!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, when you say partner it doesn't sound cop. It, it sounds gay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, jealous! (He drops the cherry and it turns on.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hey, do you mind? We're under cover here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, no problem. (Tries to turn it off.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry! Sorry! Oh, (He sticks it under his shirt) there! (It's just there
flashing through his shirt) Hey Gary, who am I? Phone home!
(Gary just glares at him.)
[Time lapse, Ross has been demoted to the back seat with Joey and Chandler. He's not
too happy about it.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look at Officer Ross riding back here with the visitors.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, what's up with that Serpico?

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, Rachel is playing Emily's message to Monica.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: (on answering machine) Are you thinking about me? Of course you're not,
but if you are, call me tonight. Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (does Rachel's) Nooo!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (does Monica's) I know!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well thank God you were here! I mean, we have to erase that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! We can't do that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We have too! I mean what if Ross's hears that and then calls her back
and then they get back together? Is that what you want? Ross back with that controlling,
neurotic, crazy Emily? The Emily that wouldn't let him see you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noo! Oh no! No! God no! He should not get back together with her. I know
that! You know that! Even Ross knows that! But that still doesn’t give us the right
to erase his message!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm his sister, okay? I love him! I don't want to see him get hurt! Come
on! Doesn’t that give me the right to control him—help him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't think he's the one who needs help.
(They both sit down.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, look, she's obviously unstable, okay? I mean she's thinking about
running out on her wedding day. (Rachel slowly turns and glares at her.) (Realizing what
she just said.) Okay, fine! But I mean, look at the position she's putting him in! What's
he gonna do? Ross is gonna run over there on the wedding day and break up the marriage?! I
mean, who would do that?! (Rachel again turns and glares at her in disgust.) Okay, fine,
all right, but that's y'know, it's different! Although it did involve a lot of the same
people.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what, this is obviously some kind of twisted joke she's trying to
play on him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you are crazy! I'm sorry, but she sounded generally upset!
I mean, listen! (She hits a button on the machine.)

lines.speaker: Answering Machine
lines.text: Your messages have been erased.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noooooooo!
[Scene: The ride along, they're all waiting outside of the witness's house and still in
the car in the same places as before.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, y'know, we-we're safe right? I mean nothing bad can go down!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: No. But that reminds me, (handing back a clipboard) sign this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Oh it's nothing, it just says that you can't sue the city if you scrap
your knee or y'know, get your head blown off.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (deadpan) Oh, hurry up. I want to sign that.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Okay, here he comes. What is he doing? What the hell is he doing?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What? What? What is it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Okay, he sees us. Now don't move. Don't look at him.
(They all turn and look away. Suddenly a loud bang sounds out and in slow motion Joey
slowly throws his body over Ross. Gary is shocked at what he sees while Chandler is
obviously hurt.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hey, it's okay. It was just a car backfire. (Joey slowly moves off of
Ross.) Hey, look at that! You tried to save your buddy. You see that? You see what he did?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Ross) You okay man?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh. Thank Joey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, HELLO!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Monica has all the supplies she needs and is getting ready to
leave.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I guess we should go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, wait. Wait.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah right! (She grabs the money and shoves into her pocket.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, Monica! Monica! We have to fix this!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There's nothing we can do. You erased the message!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah well unless we tell him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, if you're gonna be totally rational about this, I can't argue with
you! All right? Fine, if you wanna tell him, tell him. I just don't want to be a part of
it.
(The phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, maybe that's Emily calling back to leave the exact same message.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on the machine) Hey Ross! It's you! I just want you to remember this
feeling. You are lucky to be alive! So live everyday to the fullest. Love yourself, okay?
Okay. Oh, and also get stamps. Bye! (He hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! Play that message for Emily and this whole problem goes away!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right?
[Scene: Central Perk, the guys are returning from the ride along to find Phoebe already
there.]

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hey, anybody want to meet a hero?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (excited) John Glenn is here?!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: No, Joey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, we had the most incredible night! Okay, so, we're in the

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Wait! Hold on! (He goes over to Phoebe and gives her a kiss.) (To Phoebe)
Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (To Ross) Okay, go ahead.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, so we're in the car. Right? And bang! A shot was fired.
And Joey with no regard for his own safety throws himself on me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My God, Joey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pouting) It was a car backfire!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but-but he didn't know that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I didn't know that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And it could've just as easily have been a bullet.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hey Joe, you ever think about joining the force? We could use a guy like
you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who jumps at loud noises!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! I could've died tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! If the car that backfired had run over you! Y'know what, I think
I'll go home before Ross starts rambling about his newfound respect for life. (He gets up
and starts for the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I do have a newfound respect for life.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (returning) Oh my God! (Storms out.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (To Phoebe) So you wanna get some dinner?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Sure! Yep! (Gets up) Oh, y'know what? If I heard a shot right now,
I'd throw my body on you.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Oh yeah? Well maybe you and I should take a walk through a bad
neighborhood.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Ross and Joey
lines.text: Bye!
(They leave as Ross stares in awe at Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Cut it out Ross! I hate to have to save your life and kick your ass in the
same day!

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is pacing as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude! How come you took off?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I just went for a walk, around the living room. Whatever…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. No I'm just tired. Y'know, from-from the walk.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You dove in front of Ross! Ross!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's what this is about! Oh my God, you hate Ross!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I do not hate Ross!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course you do! I saved him! You're mad at me! It all adds up! You want
Ross out of the picture.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What picture?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know, but I don't like what I'm hearing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look I'm very glad that you saved Ross from the car backfire, but
y'know, it could've been a bullet and you y'know, you didn't try to save me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, you're upset because you think I chose Ross over you! No!
I…knew…you could take care of yourself. Y'know, I mean Ross, he need help. He's
not street like us!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When it comes down to it, you would risk your life for Ross before you
would for me. That's the bottom line.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, no, not exactly! All right, look, I, I wasn't trying to save Ross.
Okay? My sandwich was next to Ross. All right? I was, I was trying to save my sandwich.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: From a bullet!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know it doesn't make much sense…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Much sense?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look Chandler, it was instinct! Okay? I just went for it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you risked your life, for a sandwich!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know it sounds crazy, but Chandler this is (Goes and picks up the
sandwich) the greatest sandwich in the world!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you didn't uh, choose Ross before me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! I would never do that! You-you're like my brother!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! In fact, to prove how much you mean to me, (He unwraps the sandwich
and holds it out for Chandler) here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks. (He grabs the sandwich.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, eh, oh-oi, easy, it's not a hot dog!
(Chandler takes a bite.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How good is that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (with his mouthful) Oh-oi-ho, yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hm-hmm. (Goes to take another bite.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-whoa-hey, dude, what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I thought you were showing me how much you mean to me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. With a bite! (Takes back the sandwich.) Gee-e-e-eez!
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Rachel is trying to repair the thing she broke earlier, but
gets interrupted by hearing Ross at the door. She panics and throws the thing into the
kitchen. And runs to the couch as Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, what uh, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Y'know what? You are in our apartment all the time! Okay?
This is, this is just a drop in the bucket mister!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know, it-it doesn't matter. The important thing is that you're here.
You're my friend, and you're here. Oh! (He goes over and hugs her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, just a little scared. What's going on Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The most amazing thing happened tonight. I thought my number was up. I had
an actual near death experience!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! What? What happened?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, we were on the ride along with Gary, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And somebody took a shot at me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Really?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, a car backfired, but (Rachel suddenly calms down) I thought somebody
was taking a shot at me. And Rach, I…I survived! And I was filled with this-this
great respect for life. Y'know? I-I want to experience every moment. I want to seize every
opportunity. I-I am seeing everything so-so clearly now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because a car backfired?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stares at her briefly) Okay, why are you here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I-I-I don't know how this fits into your whole "seizing"
thing but um, Emily called you today.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You talked to her?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, she left a message. (He starts for the machine.) (Stopping him.) But
it-it kinda got erased. There's just (Pause) something wrong with your machine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, okay, what-what did she say?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, uh something about having second thoughts about the wedding and
did you guys make a mistake breaking up and uh, she wants you to call her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now, that-that was a good thing that I told you, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh? Yeah! Yes, of course!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Thank you! Thank you! Because—I'm sorry, all right. Because
y'know what? She didn't want me—not important. The point is, I was right. Your
decision. Okay? I was right. (She starts for the door.) (Stops) Your decision.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right. I guess, I guess I should call Emily.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, no, that's not the right decision. That's not, that's not right,
no Ross-Ross, come on! I mean, that woman made you miserable! Okay, Ross, do you really
want to get back into that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, look, yesterday I would've even considered calling her back, but my
ex-wife calls on the same day I have a near death experience. I mean, that-that has got to
mean something!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, Ross! That was not a near death experience! That was barely
an experience!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You weren't there! Okay, maybe this is something that I-I'm supposed to
seize! Y'know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y'know what? Maybe, this is not about seizing stuff. Maybe this is
about escaping stuff.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean, look-look today you escaped (Pause) (Not believing it) death,
y'know? And maybe this is a chance for you to escape getting back together with
Emily?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That does make sense. Because I do wanna seize some opportunity, but I-I
really don't wanna see or talk to her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, there you go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Maybe today is just, close call day.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughing) Close call day.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, thanks Rach. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, honey no problem. Okay. (Gets up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh wait-wait-wait! The message is blinking. Maybe you didn't erase it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh?
(Ross hits the playback button.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on machine) "Hey Ross, it's you!" (Hits the stop button) Oh
yeah, no that's-that's an old message, nobody needs to hear that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. (She heads for the door again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking at the coffee table where his money was) Hey umm, was-was Monica
here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I want my money back.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (going out the door) Yeah, uh you-you probably need that for stamps,
right?
(Ross is stunned.)
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, has Gary ever been shot at for real?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. Once. Yeah, a little. He kinda did it to himself. It's not really a
good story.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I wonder how I would react under fire, y'know? And not backfire but-but
heavy fire, like I was in a war or something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Man, I would be great in a war! I mean, I really, I think I would make a
fantastic military leader. I mean I know I would make General way before any of you
guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Before or after you were shot by your own troops?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know where Joey would be. He would be down in the foxhole protecting all
of us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, if the foxhole was lined with sandwiches.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, hero sandwiches. (Points at Ross who points back.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well you all know that I'm a pacifist so I'm not interested in war in
any way. (Gets up) But y'know what? When the revolution comes, I will have to destroy you
all. (Starts to leave.) (To Joey) Not you Joey.
(Joey gets all happy with himself, while the rest of the gang is less than enthused.)

title: The One with the Ball

scenes.location: Central Perk, Gary, Phoebe, Monica, and Chandler are there.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Would you like some more coffee, baby-doll?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm fine, thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Yeah, see, I can't pull of baby-doll can I?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. I think we learned that from the sugarlips incident. I'm gonna get
some tea.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(Monica leaves and Chandler moves to talk to Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hiya doin' pumpkin?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nope. (Chandler nods in agreement.)
[Cut to Gary and Monica at the counter.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So it looks like it's going really well for you two, huh?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: I know, really well. In fact, I'm gonna ask Phoebe to move in with me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shocked) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: What do you, what do you think?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think that is so great! When are you gonna ask her?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Tonight, but don't say anything. Okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I swear, I promise. I promise. Oh my God, I'm so excited! {And I just
can't hide it! I'm about to lose control and I think I like it! Sorry, just
couldn't resist it.} All right, listen let me tell you, do not get her flowers.
Okay? Because y'know, she cries when they die, and there's the whole funeral…

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (To Phoebe) I'll see you after work sweetie. (Kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Bye!
(Gary exits and Monica rejoins them.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, what movie should we see?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sitting down) Gary's gonna ask you to move in with him!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He just told me at the counter. He made me promise not to tell, but I
couldn't hold it in any longer!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can't believe this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (terrified) Right, because it's fast. Because, it's so fast. It's
fast!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Relax! It's Phoebe! Not you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Good for you Pheebs, way to go! (Breathes a sigh of relief)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, but it is fast. Isn't it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohhhh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I like him a lot but I don't think I'm ready for this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, what are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't know. I'll just handle it—I'll ask you to talk to him!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me?! Why me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because you are so afraid of commitment! You talk to him, make him
scared like you! Make him a…man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'll try, but I'm not sure what good it would do, y'know? Because I'm
a lot less afraid of commitment than I used to be.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is so sweet! (She kisses him and turns to add some sugar to her
tea.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Phoebe, behind Monica's back) Still terrified, I'll take care of
it. No problem. (When Monica turns back he smiles and kisses her, when she turns away he
nods that he'll do it to Phoebe.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Joey and Ross are playing catch with a little foam globe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross, is uh, is Staten Island really an island?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh, that's why they call it Staten Island.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohhh. I thought it was like Long Island.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he catches the ball and pauses, staring at Joey in disbelief) Also an
island.
(The game resumes.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what time is it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looks at his watch) 2:17.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! You realize that we've been throwing this ball, without dropping it,
for like an hour?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you serious?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. I realized it about a half-hour ago but I didn't want to say
anything 'cause I didn't want to jinx it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! We are pretty good at this! Hey! We totally forgot about lunch!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I-I, I think that's the first time I ever missed a meal! (Checks his
pants.) Yeah, my pants are a little loose!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey, you guys…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is Monica here?

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right listen umm, I just bought something I'm not sure she's gonna
like it, and it's gonna seem a little crazy, but this is something that I wanted since I
was a little girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You bought Shawn Cassidy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noo! I wish! Okay, you ready?

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! (She goes and gets her surprise and when she returns with it, Ross
stares in shock.) Check it out!
(Joey turns and looks at quite possibly one of the ugliest pets that you can possibly
buy on the planet. Rachel has bought herself a hairless cat. Yep, a hairless cat! Joey and
Ross start to get sick.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What-what is it?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What the hell is that?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's a, it's a cat!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That, is not a cat! {I have to agree with Joey on this one.}

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes it is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why is it inside out?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me! But this is a purebred, show-quality Sphinx cat!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How much did you pay for that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it was a little extravagant, but I a pretty good deal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? How much?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A thousand bucks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ON A CAT??!!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's not a cat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right listen ball boys! My grandmother had one of these when I was a
little girl and it was the sweetest thing! I mean it was so cute, it would sit in my lap
and purr all day long, and I would drag a shoestring on the ground and he would chase it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Free cats do that too, y'know. {Which reminds me, if I might get a little
political here, support your local animal shelter. Pet shops are not the place to
buy dogs and cats from, you get a much better deal from the shelter, plus they probably
won't die on you in a week and a half. If you want a leash, go to the pet shop. If you
want the dog for that leash, go to the shelter and save it's life. Now back to regularly
scheduled programming.}

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's not a cat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh! Look you guys, I'm really excited about this! Okay? I don't care
what you think! I'm gonna go set up a little litter box for Mrs. Whiskerson. (They both
glare at her.) Well, what am I gonna call her? Fluffy?!
(Rachel goes into the bathroom as the guys continue throwing the ball.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Joey) Hey, you wanna get something to eat or uh, do you wanna see how
long we can throw this ball back and forth? Huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, the ball thing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross, wouldn't it be great if we could go two straight hours without
dropping it?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhh, yeah it would! Let's do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay!
(They throw the ball back and forth once.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (catches the ball) Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I have to pee. And Rachel's in the bathroom!
[Cut to Chandler and Joey's, Ross is seen throwing the ball into the bathroom,
presumably where Joey is currently using the facilities.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, I didn't think we were gonna make it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know! (Looks at the ball in his hands.) Don't switch hands, okay?
[Scene: the 5th Precinct, Gary's precinct, Chandler has come to talk to him
about commitment. And as he's walking through the door he notices a couple of "Ladies
of the night" sitting there. (If you know what I mean.)]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey ladies! What are you in here for? (Laughs at his joke.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hey Chandler, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Gary, I'm here to report a crime.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It is a crime that you and I don't spend more time together.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (laughs, then suddenly serious) What's up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I heard that you thinking about asking Phoebe to move in with
you and I thought maybe, we should have a talk. Man to uh, me.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Sure. Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, are you crazy? Are you insane? If you live with Phoebe, you two
are gonna be y'know, live-living together!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Yeah, I-I considered that. I just know it would make me happy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean scared.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: No, I mean happy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Scared? Happy?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Chandler, what-what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am trying to open your eyes, my man! Don't you see, if you lived
with Phoebe she's always gonna be there. You're gonna get home, she's there. You go to
bed, she's there. You wake up and oh yes, she's there!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: I know! I can't wait!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Were you're parents happy, or something?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Listen Chandler, the way I see it is that I was lucky enough to find
someone that I really love. I just—I wanna be around her as much as I can.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow, y'know when you say it, it doesn't sound so scary.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: So you know what I'm talking about, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I think I do! Y'know what? You move in with her! You move in
with her right now! Maybe I should in with Monica!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: No, it's too soon for you guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pause) Yeah, you're right about that.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Ross and Joey are still playing catch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …now when they found the remains of the Mesozoic Mastodon they
discovered what appeared to be the remains of a Paleozoic Amphibian in its jaws!
How did it get there?!
{Y'know, sometimes I think the script writers throw in a line like that to try to
trip me up. But it won't work. I'll always have the last laugh! <manical_laugh.wav>
Okay, so maybe I'm a little deluded, it's probably just my spellchecker. But, I must admit
I did get Mesozoic and Paleozoic on the first attempt. Yay me! Anyhoo…}

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe this should be more of a quiet game.
{Oh, all right! Geez, I can't have any fun!}

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, I left my watch on the counter last night. (Goes to the counter)
It was right here, where is it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, come on, I'm-I'm late for work!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How do you know? You don't have a watch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys, could you please just stop throwing the ball for one minute and
just help me find it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I don't know…. Yeah, can't do it.
