(He throws it back to Ross, but it's intercepted by Monica and the guys both scream in
horror.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica, whatever you do, do not drop that ball!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, we haven't dropped it in… (Looks to Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 2 hours, 27 minutes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!
[Time lapse, Monica has joined in and is calling to get out of work.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone, faking she's sick) I-I'm not gonna be able to make it into
work today, I don't feel very good. (Joey makes a high throw and Monica has to catch it
way over her head.) (Not sounding sick) Yes!! (Realizes what she just did.) (Sounding sick
again) Wow! Uh, for a second there I thought I was really better, but I'm not. (Hangs up
and keeps throwing the ball.)
(Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Check it out! Almost 3 hours without droppin' it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, wow! Congratulations, that's quite a waste of time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You have scratches all over you, what happened? (Rachel's arms are
covered with scratches.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it's my cat.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shocked) What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, I got a cat.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't want a cat!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, don't worry, it's not a cat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys this cat is nothing like my grandmother's cat. I mean,
it's not sweet, it's not cute, I even dragged that little string on the ground, and it
just flipped out and scratched the hell out of me. And I swear, I know this sounds crazy,
but every time this cat hisses at me I know it's saying, "Rachel!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Doesn't sound as crazy as paying a thousand dollars for a cat.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Rachel) What?! You paid a thousand dollars for a cat when you owe me

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I was gonna let you play with it.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is drinking coffee as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm, did you talk to Gary about the moving in thing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes I did, and I think you should do it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He's a great guy, y'know? And he loves you a lot, you are a very lucky
lady.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You are useless! Freaking out about commitment is the one thing
you can do! The one thing! And you can't even do that right! God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry. (Pause) If you ask me, I'd move in with him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh!! God! (Gary enters and she sees him) Ooh! (To Chandler) Get out of
here, good for nothing.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hey Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Gar!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Hi sweetie. (Kisses her.) Hi, can I talk to you for a second?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Okay. (They move to the couch.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: You look very pretty today.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks! Okay. (They sit down.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Here's the thing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Y'know I really want to move this relationship forward.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Because if you're not moving forward, y'know you're just moving backwards.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No that's not true. If you're not moving forward, you're just staying
still. And staying still is good. Watch this. (She stays still for a brief second.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: I want you to move in with me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is so sweet. But don't you think it's a little too soon? I mean
there's so much we don't know about each other.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (disappointed) Oh. Oh-oh-okay, I get it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just—I don't want us to jump into something we're not ready for.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (disappointed more) Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I really don't want to mess up what we have. I'm just—I'm worried
it's gonna be a big mistake.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (on the verge of tears) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Which is why my answer is yes!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (suddenly happy) Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh! (They hug.) I'm so…happy. (She's not happy.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey, Ross, and Monica are still playing catch, with
Chandler looking on. Joey throws the ball to Monica who catches it and whips it at Ross.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (catching the ball) Monica! Stop throwing it so hard! We're on the same
team!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Four hours? You guys have been doing this for four hours?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's right baby.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, let me in. (He jumps off of the counter to join in the
game.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (jumping in front of him) No-no! Don't do it! Don't!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He's a dropper!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, that's right!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not a dropper!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's really a uh-uh three person game, y'know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's throwing and catching!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. (He gently tosses the ball to Chandler who catches it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Oh! That's so hard. (Starts to juggle the ball, but loses control
and almost drops it and hands it to Monica.)
(Rachel enters with the "cat" and the chick and the duck start to get riled
up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa you guys, it's not a cat!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my—Oh good God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she's wearing an oven mitt to protect her hand) I give up you guys, I
don't know what I'm going to do with this thing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Baking it didn't help, huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, why don't you just take it back to where you got it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I tried! They won't take her back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe that's because she's a minion of the anti-Christ.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, why won't they take it back?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, they said would but they would only give me store credit. I mean,
what am I going to do, get a thousand regular cats?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, if you want you can keep it at our place until you find out what
to do with it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Mon that's not the point. I'm out a thousand dollars, I'm all
scratched up, and I'm stuck with this stupid cat that looks like a hand! (Storms out.)
(Monica sneezes.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, the cat's made my eyes water! Don't-don't throw it to me! My
vision's been compromised!! (Quickly grabs a tissue to wipe her eyes.) Oh God! Okay. Okay.
It's okay. Man, that was close.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, you almost overreacted to something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Gary
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: We have great news!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We're moving in together! Isn't it great! Yay!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Congratulations! Congrats!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, I'm so excited!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: So am I!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, you're not more excited than I am! No way! I'm the most
excited!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Okay, I'll see you at the station later.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, yeah, I'll see you later! Don't forget about the moving in!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: All right.
(Phoebe closes the door behind him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you're moving in with him. What happened?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I couldn't tell him no. He got so sad. Maybe it'll be all right. I do
really like him a lot and probably do it eventually anyway and plus, think of all the
money I'll save on stamps.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why, do you write him a lot?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I just heard when people live together, they split the cost of
stamps. Don't they?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah! That's right. Yeah-yeah! Yeah!
(Rachel enters with the cat, wearing the oven mitt, and startles Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, the oven mitts really freaked me out.

scenes.location: Gary's precinct, Phoebe is entering.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hey, honey! Okay, so did you find any apartments? Anything in Brooklyn
Heights?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, nothing.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Oh really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Nothing at all?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, as soon as something opens up we'll move right in. Unless it doesn't
have a pool, I need a pool. (Turns away from him.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Phoebe, can I talk to you for a second?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh!
(He takes her into one of those typical interrogation rooms you see on TV and in the
movies. Which is really appropriate here, since this is a TV show. What are the odds of
that?)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Take a seat. You okay? You feeling all right? (Closes the door and takes
off his coat.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sits down) Yeah, I feel great. 'Cause we're moving in together.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: So you uh, you checked the paper for listings in Brooklyn Heights, right?
You-you checked the Post?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, uh-huh, there was nothing. (Pause) Can I get some water?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: In a minute. You-you checked today's Post?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, yeah! Today's.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: 'Cause uh, this is today's Post (produces one from the other chair)
and uh, these are the listings I found. (Points) Brooklyn Heights, two bedroom. (Points)
Brooklyn Heights, one bedroom. (Points) Brooklyn Heights, (points) Brooklyn Heights,
(points) Brooklyn Heights!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looks at the paper) Are these for rent! I thought people were just
bragging!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Let me tell you what I think might be going on. (Phoebe looks down in
shame.) No-no-no, don't look at the table. Look at me. (Points to his eyes and she does
so) Okay, I think somebody asked someone to move in with them. And I think someone said,
"Yes" but now she's having doubts because things are moving to fast for someone.
Does that sound at all possible to you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. Yes! Fine! I am someone! You want me to say it? I have
doubts! (Pause) I'm sorry! (Puts her head down.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Phoebe…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Phoebe, it's okay that you feel this way. I mean it is soon. And
there's a lot of things we don't know about each other, and I just figure that everything
I really like. And the things I don't know, I get to learn about at someplace with both
our names on the mailbox.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's so sweet.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Sweethart, but none of that matters if it's too soon for you. It's fine!
We don't have to move in together. I just—I want you to be happy

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Living with you would make me happy.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Phoebe, you don't have to say that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I really wanna live with you! I wanna move in with you!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. Definitely! Yes! Let's live in an apartment that we both live in!
(Hugs him.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Oh that's great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh wait, one sec. One sec. (Goes to the mirror) Hey you! Behind the
glass! Who are you looking at! I've always wanted to say that when I was in one of these
rooms, (sees the look on his face) which was never!

scenes.location: The street outside Central Perk, Rachel is trying to sell the cat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Show cat! Quality show cat! Show cat! (A woman approaches.)
Woman No. 1: (looks into the box) Oh my God! What's wrong with your baby?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's not a baby! It's a cat!
Woman No. 1: Eew! It's creepy looking!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no! No! It's actually—it's very sweet. It's very sweet. Look!
(Goes to pet it and it hisses at her.) Yeah, do you want it?
Woman No. 1: (laughs) No, I hate cats.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, so then what are you doing to me? Okay? Just get out of here! All
right? Move on!
(Another woman approaches.)
Woman No. 2: Wow! What an unusual cat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! Thank you! Exactly! You want it?
Woman No. 2: Maybe. I was thinking about getting a cat, I was just going to go
to the shelter (Good for her) but… Okay, why not?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, terrific! That'll be $2,000.
Woman No. 2: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, a thousand.
Woman No. 2: I thought you wanted to adopt your cat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I do, but you're just gonna have to actually look at this as more
of an investment than a cat.
Woman No. 2: Okay, yeah, I just wanted a cat. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (makes some unintelligible sound to stop her from leaving) Obviously you
know how to haggle, so I'm not gonna try and take you on. Okay? So $800 and I don't call
the cops because you're robbing me blind! Blind! (Covers her eyes) Just take cat, leave
the money, and run away! Run away! (Uncovers her eyes and sees that the woman has fled)
Damnit! (To the cat) Cat, can't you at least smile or something?! (The cat hisses at her
again, it sounds like Rachel) Okay, did anybody just hear that? Anybody?
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey, Ross, Monica, and now Chandler are still playing
catch. The guys are exhausted and sitting around the room. Monica is still standing all
pumped up and being hyper-competitive yet again. {Okay! We get it! She's competitive!!
Must we see all the time?!}]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm starving!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on guys! Suck it up! We're closing in on ten hours! It's gut-check
time!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know who made you the boss? All right? We (Ross and him) invented
this game!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please! I made this game what it is.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not fun anymore?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm still hungry!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, there's some pizza at my place, we can all eat with one hand
right? Are you with me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right! Let's go! (Runs to the door.) Let's go Team Monica! (The guys
all stop and stare at her) All right, we can work out the name later.
[Cut to her apartment where Rachel is sitting at the table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel! What is your cat doing in one of my bowls!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's not! I'm defrosting a chicken. (Pause) Oh, I uh sold Mrs.
Whiskerson.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thank God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Did you get your money back?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, 15 hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! You made a profit!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (entering with the cat) I just came for the red-velvet pillow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, there you go. (Hands over the pillow.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Thanks Rachel. And-and don't forget you-you can come visit her anytime
you want.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh good, great! I'll-I'll keep that in mind. (Turns and walks away.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (To Ross) Hey! So what is this? Some kind of snake or something?

scenes.location: Gary and Phoebe's apartment, it's morning and they're both waking up in bed.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: I really like waking up with you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I like waking up with you too. (Looks out the window) Oh! It's such a
beautiful morning. (Some birds are singing outside the window) Oh, I can stay here all
day.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: That would be great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We could have breakfast in bed…

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Wait, just a second.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (He grabs his gun and shoots the bird.) Oh! Oh no.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Hyper-competitive Monica, Rachel, Chandler, Joey, and Ross
are still playing catch. Monica is finally tiring while the rest of them are totally
exhausted and virtually asleep.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right! Come on Monica! Look alive! Come on, look alive!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Oh good, you're all up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe! It's 6 o'clock in the morning! Why aren't you at Gary's?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, that's over.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on! Gary's such a great guy! Whatever the problem is, you can
work it out!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He shot a bird!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that is over!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: That's terrible! I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, I'll be alright.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey, here Pheebs. (He throws her the ball.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (catches it) Nah, I don't feel like playing. (She sets the ball down on
the table and everyone gasps.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's okay. It's okay. Just pretend that it didn't happen! Okay? No one
needs to know! I mean, Phoebe's not an official ballplayer! I mean, only official
ballplayers can drop the ball!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: All right. Okay. I'm starving! (They all get up, thus officially ending the
game.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, honey, wanna get some breakfast?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! Okay, let's race! First one there wins! Ha-ha! (Runs out the door
and everyone watches her leave.)
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You guys wanna eat here?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah! As long as we're here!
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man that was great! Huh? Can you believe how long we threw that ball
around?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it is amazing it lasted that long.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know. My arm is killing me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I meant with the dropper over here. (Points at Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, how did I get this reputation as a dropper? Okay? I'm anything
but a dropper. (We see various scenes of him dropping a football, a mug of coffee, the
phone, an apple, a Frisbee, a record, and the final scene has a ball bouncing off of his
chest. I'm not going to describe them, you'll have to see them.)

title: The One with Joey's Big Break

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, everyone but Phoebe are there reading. Rachel is sitting on the
couch flanked by Ross and Monica. She suddenly stops reading and starts blinking her left
eye as if it's bothering her. The problem is that Joey is on her left and thinks she's
winking at him and winks back. Ross is watching this and isn't quite sure of what to make
of it.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, my eye is a little itchy.
(Ross turns to look at Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhhh, mine too! Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Rachel) Wow! It's really red! You should go see my eye doctor.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Richard? I'm not gonna go see your ex-boyfriend!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, Richard. That's all I ever hear, Richard, Richard, Richard!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Since we've been going out, I think I've mentioned his name twice!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so Richard, Richard!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's not Richard! Okay? It's this new guy and he's really good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I'm sorry I'm not going to an eye doctor!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh God, here we go!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anytime anything comes close to touching her eye or anyone else's she like
freaks out. Watch! Watch! (He takes his finger and moves it towards his eye.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (flinches) Ross! Come on! That's all right! Fine--Okay, I have a weird
thing about my eye. Can we not talk about it please?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: All right, fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Rach, remember that great song, Me, Myself, and I? (And on
the "I" part she mimics poking her eye.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (flinches again) Monica! Come on!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, does anybody want to get some lunch? All those in favor say I? (Pokes
his eye)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (freaks) Ross! Stop it! Come on!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How much did I love The King and I? (Oh, you get the
point by now.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too! Me too! Me too! (Yeah, he does the same thing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just stop it! Come on!
(Joey howls in pain and holds his eye.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You okay there man?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I got too excited!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross, Chandler, Monica, and Phoebe are eating breakfast.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, I gotta go. I'm taking Ben to the park.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, give him a kiss for me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, bye!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Later! (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (after he's gone) I am so sorry you got caught in the middle of that. I
didn't mean to be so out there. I am furious with him!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow umm, calm down.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm trying, but man that guy can push my buttons!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why are so mad at him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, I don't wanna talk about it. Okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it just seems that…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You wanna be on my list too? Keep talking! Has anyone seem my list by
the way?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, no Pheebs. What's it look like?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh, it's a piece of paper and it says, "Ross" on it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, depressed) Hey. I just got off the phone with Estelle and guess
what. (Pause, then very excitedly) I GOT THE LEAD IN A MOVIE!!!!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got the lead in a movie? That's amazing! What's the movie about?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's called Shutter Speed, it's really cool! Yeah, umm, I meet this girl
in the subway and we fall in love in like a day, right? And then, she
disappears… But I find out where she lives and when I get there this like old lady
answers the door and I say, "Where's Betsy?" Right? And she says, "Betsy's
been dead for 10 years."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh-oh, chilling!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And the best part is, we're filming in the desert outside Vegas! (To
Chandler) And you know what that means buddy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I know that means buddy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Road trip! Yeah, we can rent a car! I just have to be there by Tuesday!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh wait, my grandmother's dead.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, uh, we can talk about that too Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No, her cab! She probably won't be using it; you can drive it to Las
Vegas.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Thanks Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa, what are we going to do about my job?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh umm, not go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, great, road trip baby! (To Monica) This okay with you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! You don't have to ask for my permission. (Quietly) You can go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Rach, come on! We're gonna be late for the eye doctor appointment!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her bedroom) All right! Let's get this over with! Ugh!
(She walks by the table and notices that no one is looking and accidentally on purpose
knocks over the open cereal box.) Ohhh! No! Look what I did! (She starts walking through
the mess. {Also, notice the continuity error in this scene. Note the position of the box
and dispersal pattern of the cereal before and after the camera cut.}) Oh, I mean, look at
this mess! I mean, we're probably gonna have to clean this up! Y'know? We're gonna have to
reschedule!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. If you thought this mess is going to bother me, you are wrong! All
right, let's go Blinky! (She ushers Rachel out the door, but before the door fully closes
she sticks her head back in.) Chandler!!!! (Chandler agrees to clean up the mess.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is reading a map as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hey Joey! What's up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't decide which route to take to Vegas. Hey, you've traveled a lot
right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I've been around.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, so-so which route should I take the northern route or the southern
route?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, if you take the northern route there's a man in Illinois with a
beard of bees. {Okay, I must protest this, I've lived in Illinois all my life and know of
no man with a beard of bees! Wisconsin, on the other hand, might be a different story.}

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! Problem solved!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But on the southern route there's a chicken that plays tic-tac-toe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, back to square one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I know a way that you can decide! All right, I'm going to ask you a
series of questions and you answer as quickly as you can.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (quickly) Yes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good, but wait. Okay, all right, here we go. Now I want you to relax.
Take a deep breath. Clear your mind. (Quickly) Which do you like better peanut butter or
egg whites?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Peanut butter!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Which would you rather be a fireman or a swimmer?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A swimmer!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who would you rather sleep with Monica or Rachel?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica. Oh… huh, I always thought it would be Rachel.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No thinking! No thinking! Tie or ascot?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ascot!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: North route or south route?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: North route!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bamn! There you go! Huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! That was incredible! Beard of bees, here I come!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, this guy again. (She ignores him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey man, what's up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhh, not much. You guys want to see a movie tonight?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, what do you want to see?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know, umm…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I know how we can decide. Phoebe, show him your game!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, no thank you. (She gets up and moves to the couch. They were at a
table previously.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's with her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know. But hey, I know we can decide. Okay, I'm gonna ask you
questions and you answer real quick. Okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What do you like better action or comedy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Action.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who would you rather sleep with Monica or Rachel?
(Ross pauses and looks at him, Joey motions for him to hurry up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude, you are sick.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I forgot you had that whole Rachel thing.
[Scene: Monica's eye doctor's office, Monica and Rachel are waiting in an exam room and
looking at this big white thing used to check eyes. I have no idea what it is, and if an
ophthalmologist happens to know what that is, let me know.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! What does that thing do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looks at it more closely) Oh that's an eye removal machine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I'm outta here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm kidding! I'm kidding!
(Rachel heads for the door but is intercepted by the doctor.)

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: Hi Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: I'm Dr. Miller. Monica told me you were a little nervous, but don't
worry everything's gonna be just fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So were done then!

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: Almost! But first, we gotta start.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: This is a glaucoma test.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: Sit down.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: But your chin here. (She does so.) Now, you'll feel a small puff of
air in each eye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (jerks back from the tester) What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A small puff of air, now come on!

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: Here we go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: 1…2…3! (Rachel jerks back on 3.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm sorry. All right, I'll just stay in here this time. (Puts her head
back.) Okay.

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: Ready?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: 1…2… (She flinches on 2 this time.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what, I'm gonna hold her head.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: That's okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (Monica backs off.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay!

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: 1…2! (She flinches again.) (Gives up.) Y'know what? You're
young; you probably don't have glaucoma.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (really excited) Great!! It was very, very nice to meet you sir--Ow!
Hey! What are you doing?! Are you crazy! (He took out that thing they use to look at
people's retinas and looked at Rachel's when she was shaking his hand causing her to
flinch and scream at him.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: Okay. You've got a small, minor infection in that left eye. I want
you to take these drops three times a day and you'll be as good as new.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, no, I don't-I don't put things in my eye.

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: Okay then, I guess we'll see you back here in three months.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: And I'll fit you for a glass eye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, just give me the damn drops! (Grabs them and storms out.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Dr. Miller? (She covers her right eye and reads from the chart) P E C F
D.

lines.speaker: Dr. Miller
lines.text: Very good Monica! You know where they are.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I sure do! (She runs over to a drawer, opens it, and grabs a lollipop.)
(To Rachel) And you don't get one!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe, Rachel, Monica, and Joey are there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know, I-I gotta tell ya, those eye drops are a miracle. My eye is a
100% better.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They're still in my coat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Damn!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! You ready to go?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, listen, how cold is it going to be there? Do I need a coat or
will all these sweater vests be enough? (Holds up 3 of them in different colors.)
(Monica stares at him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you.
{There's another continuity error here. Before Monica says I love you, Chandler's
holding the vests so that you couldn't see the collar, you could see all three, and they
were folding nicely. After she says the line and the camera cuts back to Chandler, you can
only see two out of the three, you can see the collar of the top one, and it looks like it
was folded sloppily, unlike before. Hey, you notice things while spending this much time
on this!}

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, I wish Ross was coming with us! Y'know? I'm gonna miss him!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks a lot! I just got that jerk out of my mind!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, so where are we staying? Is the movie putting us up in a big
hotel suite?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh no, not really. It's an independent film y'know? So we don't have a
real big budget. I figured I'd just stay in your room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I see, but once you get your first paycheck you'll be springing a big
hotel suite, right? I mean, lead in a movie, they must be paying you a lot?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah! For every dollar Shutter Speed makes, one penny of it goes right
in Joey's pocket.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you don't get paid unless the movie makes money?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Did you not hear the plot of the movie? "She's been dead for ten
years." I'm gonna be a millionaire!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just wanna say good-bye to you guys and to see if you guys will
place a little bet for me, huh? Twenty bucks on black 15.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right!
(Joey nods to Chandler, no way!)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, bye-bye now!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye you guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bye-bye!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wanna say good-bye at the car!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Anybody want to say good-bye to me at the car?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh honey, I'll say good-bye to you at the car if you don't mind the
puss.
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See ya! (Walks out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, wait a minute! The puss is good! It means it's healing! (Runs
after him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, what 'cha reading? (Phoebe ignores him) Pheebs? (Turns away)
Hello? (He sits down next to her and she moves over a bit.) Phoebe? (He moves closer and
she keeps moving away.) Phoe-Phoebe! (They end up hanging over the arm rest.) Come on! (He
grabs the magazine away from her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't see you there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, are you, are you mad at me, or something? 'Cause if are please,
tell me what it is I did!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if you don't know I can't help you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I don't know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I can't help you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, whatever it is I'm-I'm very, very sorry. Okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Apology accepted.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. So we're, we're good?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. (Gets up.) I'll uh, I'll see you later, okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (quietly) Bye, fat ass.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ALL RIGHT!! Phoebe now come on! Will you please tell me what it is I did
that mad you so mad at me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't know! I don't remember!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well if you can't remember, can't we just forget about this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, I am mad at you. I know that much. But, I am sorry about the fat
ass thing. You actually have a very sweet little hiney.
(Ross isn't sure what to do with that comment.)
[Scene: Phoebe's cab, Joey and Chandler are headed across the George Washington bridge
on their way to Las Vegas. Joey is driving.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, I'm getting pretty tired. You're might have to take over soon.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We've been driving for a half-hour, and you haven't looked at the road
once.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don't worry, it's out there! (Just then a horn honks and Joey quickly
looks at the road.) I think I just need lunch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You wanna eat? (Pulls out the twenty) My treat!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Isn't that Ross's money?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Okay. Ross's treat! Where do you wanna eat?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, hey, I know how we can decide! All right, uh, I'm gonna ask you a
bunch of questions and then you have to answer real fast. Okay? So uh, clear your mind
Clear it right out! Clear it out! Clear!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, uhh, would you rather be too wet or too dry?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Too dry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you believe in ghosts, yes or no?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is this movie gonna be my big break?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shocked) What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude you said, "No!"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I also said, "Yes!"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don't think this is going to be a big break for me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! (Realizes) Ahhh!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't believe this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look Joe, I just, I just don't want to get your hopes up real high.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you talking about?! I'm the lead in a movie!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They're not even paying ya! This doesn't even sound like a real movie!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y'know what? I don't need this! Okay? I don't know why you're dumping all
over my big break.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joe, I don't think this is going to be your big break.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is that why you're on this trip, huh? Make me feel like a loser? 'Cause if
it is, I'll tell ya, I-I-I'd rather be alone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, you don't want me on the trip?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not if you're gonna be like this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, I'll tell ya what, the next time you ask me a question like
that I'll lie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! I don't want you on the trip!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, fine! Fine! Why don't you pull over? I'll get out right
now!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine! (He slams on the brakes, stopping the car on the bridge to the sound
of numerous car horns.) Get out!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're not actually supposed to stop on the bridge.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Get out!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right!! (Gets out and Joey speeds away.) Wait! Wait, there's no
sidewalk! Yeah, I'm gonna die here.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross, Phoebe, Rachel, and Monica are there. Ross is trying to
figure out why Phoebe's mad at him.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, are you mad at me because my hair gel smells?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you angry at me because I said your handwriting is childlike?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No that made me feel precious.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I know! Umm, is it because he's always correcting people's grammar?
Whom! Whom! Sometimes it's who!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Sometimes it's… (Does the fist thing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, did you beat him at a board game? He turns into such a baby when he
starts to lose.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I'm the baby. (Points at his eye.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Eh! Stop it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey kicked me out of the car on the George Washington bridge!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know! He went crazy! Y'know, we were playing that game where
you-you ask a question and you answer it really fast.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That game should not be played without my supervision.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I don't know what mad him so mad, y'know? All I said was that
uh, I didn't think this wasn't gonna be his big break, that this movie wasn't going to do
anything for him, and that uh, y'know it didn't sound like a real movie--Okay, he
should've pushed me off of the bridge.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What's in the bag?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I figured you guys would all be mad at me. So I got you some gifts
that I found on the side of the road. (Looks into the bag.) Who wants the teddy bear with
one leg?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I do!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is trying to apply her eye drops while Monica looks
on.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (She tilts her head back and squeezes the eyedropper. The only
problem is, it's not over her eye.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not even close.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, then y'know what? Help me! I need help! I can't do this!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! All right! Let's do it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sit down. (They sit down on the couch.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Put your head back.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now, open your eyes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, they are. (No they're not.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How many fingers am I holding up? (She's not holding any up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (thinks) Four.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, I was thinking four.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! All right, y'know what? Why don't we start with a practice run?
Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No drops!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: On three, 1…2…3! (Rachel turns her head on three to avoid the
drops.) Now my pillow's all wet! (She was trying to fool Rachel and squeezed the
eyedropper.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, well, you said it was practice!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then why did you move?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because I knew you were lying!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, come here! (She gets up and drags Rachel off of the couch by
her legs.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as she's being dragged) What are you? Monica!! Stop it!! Oh my God!
Stop it! (Monica drags her totally onto the floor and on her back.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am going… I'm going--Turn it over! (Rachel rolled onto her
stomach and Monica rolls her back.) I'm… I am going to get these drops in your eyes.
(She is holding Rachel down with both hands and has the eyedropper in her mouth.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! You really are freakishly strong!
(Monica starts biting on the eyedropper, spraying the fluid all over. But Rachel keeps
turning her head back and forth and Monica keeps missing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica! Stop it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (spitting out the eyedropper) Damn! It's empty!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, y'know if Joey and Chandler walked in right now, we could make a
fortune! (Monica is straddling Rachel and holding her arms down. In a rather risqu� pose,
at least for primetime TV.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, time lapse, Phoebe and Monica are playing cards as the
phone rings.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh that is definitely Chandler, Joey, or Ross. (Thinks) Or-or Rachel!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (answers the phone) Hello? (Listens.) (To Phoebe) It's Joey. (Phoebe's
proud of herself.) (To Joey) I'm so glad you called! Chandler told me what happened.
Y'know he's really upset about it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on a pay phone holding a box) Not as upset as he's gonna be when he finds
out what I did with his sweater vests!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What did you do to his sweater vests?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let's just say there's a well-dressed pack of dogs in Ohio. Hey Monica
listen is-is Phoebe there? I gotta ask her something about the car.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, she's here. Hold on a second. (She hands the phone to Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, dude!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs! Listen, this wooden box keeps sliding out from under the seat.
What-what is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that's my grandma. (Joey holds the box away from him.) And thanks
Joey she's having a really great time. (Joey is happy now.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (who has just entered) Is that Joey? Is that Joey? Let me talk to him!
I wanna talk to him!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay Joey? Chandler's here, he was wondering… (We hear the dial
tone as Joey hangs up.) Okay, I guess he ran out of change.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, he won't even talk to me. How am I going to apologize to him
if he won't even talk to me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, maybe you should send him something. So that when he gets to Las
Vegas he'll know that you're sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's a good idea. I wonder where I could (Pause) get a basket of
porn…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, don't-don't say I'm sorry with porn!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know what you should send him? A cartoon of cigarettes. 'Cause that
why he could trade it for protection. No. That's prison.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Okay Pheebs, I know how we're going to figure this out. Okay,
clear your mind and answer the first thing that comes into your head. Okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do you like better flora or fauna?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fauna.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who would you rather be Simon or Garfunkle?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Garfunkle.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why are you mad at me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You said I was boring--Ohh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: When did I say you were boring?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, I remember now! We were playing chess!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe! You and I have never played chess!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, come on! Yes, remember that time on the frozen lake? We were playing
chess, you said I was boring, and then you took off your energy mask and you were Cameron
Diaz! (Realizes) Okay, there's a chance this may have been a dream.
[Scene: The desert outside of Las Vegas, Joey is arriving and we hear the song, Name.
Y'know, (singing) I've been through the desert on a horse with no name! It felt good to
be out of the rain. In the desert, you can't remember your name, 'cause there ain't no one
for to give you no pain. La…la…la-la-la, la, la, la, la-la-la. You get the
idea. Anyhoo, he pulls up and stops. As he gets out of the car, he spills a huge pill of
fast food containers out of the foot well.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey! Stanley! Hey-hey! You're leading man is here! Let's get to work.

lines.speaker: Stanley
lines.text: Umm, slight change of plans. We've shut down.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wh-what?! Why?!

lines.speaker: Stanley
lines.text: It's a money thing, we don't have any.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) You're kidding right?

lines.speaker: Stanley
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Stanley
lines.text: It-it's probably just temporary. We're hoping to get some more money
soon, so if could just uh, hang out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, hang out?! How long?

lines.speaker: Stanley
lines.text: I don't know. A week? Maybe two? The money will turn up! People will
always wanna invest in movies! Hey, you're not rich are ya?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Stanley
lines.text: Eh, worth a shot. (Gets into his car.) Look Joey, let me know where
you're staying, okay? (The car peels away.)
(I think one of the grips walk up to Joey, mainly because there's a credit for The
Grip. What the heck is a grip anyway?!)

lines.speaker: The Grip
lines.text: Hey pal, are you Joey Tribbiani?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: The Grip
lines.text: These got left for ya. (He hands him a bunch of helium balloons.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks. (The grip walks away.) (Reading the card.) Congratulations on your
big break.
(The rest of the crew start to drive away leaving Joey sad, alone, and holding his
congratulatory balloons as the song comes up again. La-la-la. See, I've been through
the desert on a horse with no name! It felt good to be out of the rain! In the desert you
can't remember your name, 'cause there ain't no one for to give you no pain. La-la-la, la,

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, the phone is ringing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (answering it) Hello?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone from Vegas) Hey Monica, it's Joey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Joey! Aww, you remembered even though you're a big star!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aw, come on! It'll be years before I forget you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, what's it like on a movie set, huh? Do you have a dressing room?
Do you have a chair with your name on it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, well yeah-yeah, I've got all of that going on. Yeah, listen uh, I want
you to make sure you tell Chandler that he couldn't have been more wrong! Uh-oh! I gotta
go Monica, my uh, my sushi's here!
[Cut to Joey hanging up the phone in Vegas. He's wearing a Roman gladiator's uniform
and goes over to join a family to pose for a picture. You see, he's apparently taken a job
at Caesar's Palace.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the family) Sorry about that. Thanks for waitin'.

lines.speaker: The Husband
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Everybody smile! (The picture is taken) Okay, thanks a lot! Enjoy your
stay at Caesar's! We hope it's toga-rrific! (The family leaves.) Kill me. Kill me
now.
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, The gang is surrounding Rachel at key positions.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Rach, can you pass me the TV Guide?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yep!
(As she moves to get it, Monica yells…)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Go!!
(Phoebe jumps to the floor as Ross tackles Rachel off of the couch. Chandler helps push
Rachel onto the floor by jumping over the back of the couch. Phoebe grabs Rachel's head to
hold it still and opens Rachel's eye as Monica jumps onto Chandler's back to administer
the torture--I mean medicine.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!! Stop it! Stop it! Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! Okay! Okay! (She succeeds in getting the eye drops in and everyone
climbs off of Rachel.) We'll see you in about 3 to 4 hours.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! (She's trying to recover while still on the floor.)

title: The One in Vegas

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is sitting in the living room and Phoebe is
standing in the kitchen as the phone rings.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs? Could you get that? Please?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why? Just 'cause you're too lazy to get up off your touchie?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No! It's just that all the people in the entire world that I
want to talk to are right here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (smiles) Okay! (Goes to answer the phone.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (under her breath) Sucker!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (answering the phone) Hello? (Listens) Hey Joey!
[Cut to Las Vegas, Joey is on the phone and wearing his gladiator costume.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs! Listen, uh can you do me a favor? I forgot the pin number to
my ATM card can, can you get it for me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure! Where is it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, I scratched it on the ATM machine down on the corner.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! So you're 5639?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's it! Thanks Pheebs!
[Cut to Monica and Rachel's]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Joey) Ooh, do you want to talk to Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Is that Joey?! (She nods yes) Let me talk to him!
[Cut to Joey]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! (She nods no to Chandler) Because he didn't believe in my movie! Which
is a big mistake because it is real! Real!

lines.speaker: A Casino Boss
lines.text: Hey! Tribbiani! Get back to work! Break time's over!
[Cut to Phoebe]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who was that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, my stunt double. Yeah, and y'know, he's getting a little too familiar
for my tastes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Y'know what? I have been trying to apologize to him all
week! If he's not gonna let me do it on the phone, I'm gonna go down there and do it in
person.
[Cut to Joey]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh Pheebs, I heard that. Can you put him on?
[Cut to Phoebe]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! (She hands the phone to Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Joey) Hey!
[Cut to Joey]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don't come out here!
[Cut to Chandler]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no, I've supported you one hundred percent and I want to
prove that to you in person!
[Cut to Joey]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I got that! I forgive ya! Don't come out here!
[Cut to Chandler]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Forgive me? You haven't been taking my calls in a week!
[Cut to Joey]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I'm totally over it Chandler. Friends forever! Don't come out here!

lines.speaker: A Tourist
lines.text: (To Joey) Would you mind doing a picture with us?
[Cut to Chandler]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, what was that?
[Cut to Joey]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, Entertainment Tonight. [Cut to Chandler] Yeah, okay so, good
talking to ya and don't come out here. All right. (Hangs up the phone and poses for that
picture.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is entering.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica! I'm sorry I'm late! (Starts looking around for her) Monica?
(Goes into Monica's bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Phoebe? (Phoebe comes back into the living room) Oh, Phoebe,
I'm so sorry. Have you been here long?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (saddened) It's okay. What the hell took you so long?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, you can not tell Chandler. Okay? That I ran into Richard.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Which Richard?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The Richard.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Richard Simmons?! Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Noo! My ex-boyfriend Richard! Y'know the tall guy, moustache?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Okay, that actually makes more sense. So how was it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was, it was really nice. We started talking and I-I ended up having
lunch with him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is so weird! I had a dream that you'd have lunch with Richard.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But again, Simmons. Go on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The strange part was, he was really nice, umm and he looks great, but I
didn't feel anything at all!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! So now why can't we tell Chandler?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because it would totally freak him out and tomorrow's our anniversary. I
just don't want anything to spoil that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I can't believe you guys lasted a whole year!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! I owe Rachel 20 bucks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: On a totally different bet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's almost our anniversary!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know. Can you believe it? One year ago today I was just your
annoying friend Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Awww! Now you're just my annoying friend Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I got you a present!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, but it's not 'til tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, but you have to open it today! (Hands it too him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(He starts taking his time opening it. Finally Monica snaps.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (grabbing the gift from him and opening it) Okay! There you go! It's two
tickets to Vegas!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: For this weekend! Oh gosh, it would be perfect, we get to see Joey plus
we get to start our anniversary celebration on the plane. We can call it out
plane-aversary.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do we have to?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay this is great, but Joey said he didn't want any of us out there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, he just doesn't want us to go through any trouble. Think of how
excited he'll be when we go out and surprise him! Plus we get to have our own,
ani-Vegas-ary! A-Nevadaversary!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I think we should see other people.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But we can go, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's a great idea. (They kiss)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I'm gonna go too!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know Pheebs, it's kinda our (His and Monica's) anniversary.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh please, you are not gonna ditch again like you did with London.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ditch you? Phoebe, you were pregnant with the triplets!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh, great story! I'm going!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering with Ross) Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, you guys, listen, this weekend we're all gonna go to Las Vegas to
surprise Joey! Including me!! You wanna go?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I guess I could take a couple days off work.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course you can take a couple days off work because this trip includes
me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, wait a minute, wait, I've got a presentation tomorrow. I can't
miss that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, but I've got tickets to the Van Gogh exhibit! I've been waiting like a
year for this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (coughing) Art lover!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What'd you say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I said art lover.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is that supposed to be an insult?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know, I'm very tired.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So Rach, maybe you and I could fly out together Saturday.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That sounds great.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? All right I'll call the airlines. (Picks up the phone and does so)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Yeah, that would be nice actually, to have the apartment to myself
for a night.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, so you can walk around naked.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! So I can be by myself. Y'know? Have a little alone time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Naked alone time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Phoebe just because I'm alone doesn’t mean I wanna walk around
naked. I mean, you live alone, you don't walk around naked.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh! Why do you think it takes me so long to answer the door?
[Scene: An airplane cabin, Phoebe has the aisle seat, Chandler the window, and Monica's
stuck in that horrible middle seat.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, so far is this trip to Vegas better or worse than the trip to
London?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So it's pretty much the same Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, what about after I give you these candies? (Hands them each one
from her purse.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I guess it's a little better now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah-ha! Okay, (takes out a notepad) Las Vegas 1, London 0! I'll be right
back. (Gets up and heads aft.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Happy plane-aversary.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aww! I love you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can I give you a present now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! (He grabs his carryon and starts rummaging through it.) Oh man!
Don’t tell me I did this!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love the "I forgot the present" fake out!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How do you feel about the, "I really did forgot the present,
please forgive me" not fake out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that's okay. Don’t worry about it, you can give it to me when we
get back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh that's the worse thing that can happen on an anniversary
ever!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sitting down) Oh good! All right, so you decided to tell him about the
Richard thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What-what Richard thing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no. [The patented version.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What Richard thing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Monica under her breath) Simmons! Go with Simmons!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I umm, I ran into Richard yesterday and he asked me if I wanted to
go for a bite and I did. The only reason I didn't tell you is because I knew you'd get mad
and I didn't want to spoil our anniversary.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (talking out of the side of his mouth) I'm not mad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah! Yeah, so you-you bumped into Richard! You grabbed a bite!
It's no big deal. (He still ain't happy.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great!
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, London 1…
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is coming out of the bathroom after a shower
wearing only her bath robe, walks into the kitchen, and opens the fridge. As she bends
over to grab a bottle of wine, her robe falls open (Damn this network primetime
programming, we didn't see anything!) and she quickly closes it again. But then realizes
she didn't have to do that. So she closes the fridge and stands next to the table, thinks
about it for a little while and…]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (takes off her robe) Oh! Look what happened! {Don't get your hopes up
guys, we only get to see her from the back or from the neck up. Its times like these I
wish that the networks would broadcast some nudity other than Denis Franz's butt.} (In her
head.) Huh, check me out! I'm in my kitchen…naked! I'm picking up an orange. (Does
so) I'm naked! (Goes into the living room) Lighting the candles, naked, and
carefully. (She backs anything that might have a point like a candle on her body
away.)
[Cut to Ross's apartment, he's sitting by his window looking at an art book. As he's
turning the page, he glances up and notices something.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in his head) Oh my God! That's Rachel naked! I can't look at that! I
am looking at this. (Looks back at his book.) Okay, vivid colors, expressive brush
strokes—Unless she wants me to be looking at that. She knows I'm home. She
knows I can see her. What kind of game is she playing? I think maybe someone's lonely
tonight. Oh-ho, Dr. Geller! Stop it! You're being silly! Or, am I?
[Cut back to Monica and Rachel's apartment, Rachel is singing along with a song and
dancing while facing the big picture window. Y'know, I think I'd pay real good money to be
on the other side of that window!]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (singing) Love to love ya baby! Ow! Love to love ya baby! Ow!
(There's a knock on the door, she turns off the music, puts on her robe, and goes to
answer the door.) Love to love ya, baby! (There's another knock.) Darnit! (Looks
through the peephole and turns on the lights.) Ugh. (She opens the door to Ross who's
leaning against the door jam.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the scene is continued from where we left off before the
break.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: May I come in?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, yeah, if you want too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you want me too?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, sure?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So do I. (Slowly walks in.) Okay Rach, before anything happens (He takes
off his coat) I just want to lay down a couple of ground rules. (Turns back to face her.)
This is just about tonight. I don't to go through with this if it's going to raise the
question of "Us." (Rachel's confused) Okay? I just want this to be (Kicks off
his left shoe) about what it is! (Kicks off the other one.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And um, what-what is that Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The physical act of love. (Hisses at her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) What?! Are you crazy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh so-so you weren't trying to entice me just now with your-your
nakedness?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Oh God, you saw me?! Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You weren't trying to entice me with your nakedness.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noo!! No! You thought, you actually thought I wanted to have sex with
you?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! (Grabs his coat) No! (Grabs a shoe.) No-no-no-no. (Grabs the other
one and heads for the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh wow! I’m sorry, but Ross you kicked off your shoes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can we, can we just forget this ever happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes of course, absolutely! You're right. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right I guess I'm, gonna go pack. (Starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Oh wait! One more thing umm, do-do we still need to uh settle the
question of "us?"
(Ross storms off embarrassed.)
[Scene: Las Vegas, we have the typical glamour shots of Vegas, the Strip, slot
machines, a couple other gaming tables all set to the tune of you guessed it, Money.
Anyhoo, we finally get through that and watch Chandler, Monica, and Phoebe enter Caesar's
Palace carrying their luggage.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey you guys wait! Guys! (Catches up to them.) This place is so much
better than London! Okay? This lady dressed like Cleopatra gave me a coupon, 99 cent steak
and lobster dinner. Huh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, you don't eat animals.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: For 99 cents, I'd eat you. (Sees the casino) Okay, I can totally settle
down here. It's got everything I could ever want, including Joey! Look! (Points to Joey in
his gladiator suit posing for a picture with two old ladies.) Oh! Look! Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Joey! (They all head over to him, he spots them coming and panics.)
Hey! Hey!! Wow! (She hugs him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Love your condoms my man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What-what are you guys doing here? I thought I told you not to come.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why are you dressed as a gladiator?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, because I'm shooting a scene right now. Yeah, I uh, I play a
gladiator. Uh, y'know what? Hold-hold on a second. (To no one in particular) Can we cut?
Yeah, my-my friends are here, I'm gonna take a little break.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who are you talking too?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They uh director. Uhh, her. (Points to an old woman standing behind him.
Who glares at him and walks off.) All right, all right, it's not a gladiator movie. I work
here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?! What happened?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, the movie got shutdown because they ran out of money, so I'm working
here 'til it starts up again, if it ever does.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I'm sorry I didn't tell ya. (To Chandler) I'm sorry man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no, that's okay, apparently there's a new policy where we don't
have to share everything with everybody.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I knew you were not okay with that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you're a gladiator! Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, what-what's going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica had lunch with Richard.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dawson?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Noo! But that would've been so cool!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! Her boyfriend Richard!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It meant nothing! Okay? After all this time, how can you not
trust me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When you go lunching with hunky moustache men and don't tell me about
it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're right. I'm sorry. I should've told you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aww, there we go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I love Vegas!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I promise you, next time I will absolutely tell you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pushing her away from another hug) Next time?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, so close.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There's not gonna be a next time! You can not ever see him again!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can not see him? I mean, you can't tell me what to do!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's so funny, because I think I just did!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh y'know what? If you're gonna be acting like this all night, I really,
I don't even want to be around you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine with me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine! Happy Anniversary!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa! Whoa! Guys! Please! Come on! Come on! This is obviously just a big
misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No it is not!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you talking…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey don't look at me! I just work here! (Walks away.)

scenes.location: An aircraft cabin, Ross and Rachel are on their way to Vegas.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (taking off her sweater) Okay umm, Ross? I'm-I'm really warm, so I'm
going to be taking off my sweater. Now, I'm just letting you know that this is not
an invitation to the physical act of love.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastic) Yep! That's hilarious!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'm done. I'm done.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y'know, last night was embarrassing for you too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, not really. I mean you've seen me naked hundreds of times.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh. But it was a first for the rest of my building.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. All right, that's true! But y'know I just don't embarrass that
easily.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! You totally get embarrassed!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I don't! Ross, I think I'm just a more secure person than you are.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (loudly so that everyone can hear) Hey lady! I don't care how much you
want it! Okay?! I am not gonna to have sex with you in the bathroom! (Rachel
sinks lower on her chair trying to hide.)
[Scene: Chandler's hotel room, he's sitting there with Joey who's talking about his
helmet and running his hand through that feathery thing at the top.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, y'know in Roman times this was more than just a hat.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, sure! Sure! They would uh, they would scrub the floors with it! They
would use it to get the mud off their shoe. And sometimes underneath the horse would get
dirty so they would stick it right…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting in the nick of time) Joey, I uh! I can't believe
this is how I'm spending my anniversary.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right well, I'll take you someplace nice then. Look! A guy tipped me a
hundred bucks today.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, he was playing blackjack for like an hour and he won $5,000.
Can you believe that? $5,000!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, if I won $5,000 I'd join a gym, y'know build up my upper body
and hit Richard from behind with a stick! (Mimics it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait a minute! Why don't I do what that guy did? I'll take this $100 and
turn it into $5,000! And then I'll turn that into enough money to get my movie
going again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good luck!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler! I don't need luck. I have thought this through!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I see.
(Joey exits as Chandler shakes his head.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: The casino bar, Phoebe and Monica are sitting at the bar, while Wayne Newton's
signature song Danke Schoen is playing in the background.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the bartender) Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe this! This is like the worst night ever!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y'know Monica you had a minor setback in your relationship with
Chandler. Big deal! It's only Chandler. (Monica turns and stares at her.) I am so
sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is crazy! I mean, it's such a stupid argument. I don't even wanna
see Richard again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So go fix it! Go find Chandler! He's probably up in your room! Tell him
that you're sorry and that you love him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y'know what? You're right Phoebe. You're right. Thank you! (Gets up to
find Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure! (When Monica gets close to the door.) (Yelling) Yeah! Las Vegas,
number one!
[Cut to the casino, Monica is walking through it past the craps table when she notices
a chip on the floor. She picks it up and heads to the table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Anybody lose this? (Holds up the chip and the woman next to her shakes
her head no.)

lines.speaker: The Croupier
lines.text: Comin' out. Place your bet. (Monica does so.) Dice are out. (The
woman next to Monica rolls the dice.) Double or nothin'! Pay the front line! (Monica won
and doubled the chip.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hmm.
[Scene: An airplane cabin, Ross and Rachel are both reading as a guy stops by their
row.]

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: (To Rachel) So uh, I'm on my way back to the bathroom. (Ross
giggles.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, all right. All right! Just keep walkin'! All right?
(Ross keeps giggling and Rachel decides upon revenge. She gets up and kisses the rather
large man in the seat in front of Ross on the back of his head. The guy turns around
angrily.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! What are you… I'm sorry sir. I just, I think he just really
likes you.
[Time lapse, Ross is drinking something and decides to get Rachel again.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the guy in the window seat next to him) Hey! Y'know that teacher who
had a baby with her student? (He points at Rachel.)
[Time lapse, Rachel pushes the flight attendant call button, takes Ross's drink, and
