spills it into his lap.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What the? What…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to the flight attendant who appears in record time. It was only seconds
after Rachel pushed the call button was she there. Once again, more proof that TV isn't
real, IRL she would've been waiting for the rest of the flight and by then Ross's pants
would be dry.) Hi!

lines.speaker: The Flight Attendant
lines.text: Miss? May I help you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, I'm sorry. Do you have any extra pants? Umm, my friend seems to
have had a little accident.
[Scene: Caesar's Palace Casino, Joey is approaching one of the blackjack tables
on his quest to make enough money for his movie.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the dealer) Can I change a hundred? (He hands him his chip.)

lines.speaker: Blackjack Dealer
lines.text: Changing one hundred! (Gives him the change.) Good luck sir.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (betting all 100) Let's ride.

lines.speaker: Blackjack Dealer
lines.text: (Deals the cards) 13.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hit me! (He does so.) Ohh man! (Joey busts and loses all the money, but
when the dealer starts to collect the cards Joey notices something.) Wait! (He holds his
hand next to the dealer's hand.)
[Cut to Chandler's room, Joey is relaying to Chandler his amazing discovery.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler! You are not gonna believe this! I have found my identical
hand twin!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (totally confused) What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: My identical hand twin!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What's an identical hand twin?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's it sound like? It's a guy with my identical hands! It was
incredible! Chandler, the dealer's hands were exactly like me! It-it was like looking at
my hands in a mirror!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you sure you weren't (pause) looking at your hands in a mirror?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t you see what this means?! I can forget about that stupid movie.
I'm gonna be a millionaire!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (totally confused) How?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I don't have it all worked out yet, but it's gotta mean big money!
Come on! Identical hands!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Again I must go back to, how?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is Vegas man! People will pay to see freaky stuff! Okay, how much
would you pay to see this hand (Holds up his left hand) twice? Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Pause) Y'know, I-I can't really put a price on that Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, are you unsupporting me again?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No! I support you 100%! I just didn't, I didn't get it right away.
Y'know now I'm caught up! Identical hand twins! It's a million-dollar idea!
(Joey starts to leave to embark on his genius moneymaking scheme, but is freaked out
slightly when as he goes to open the door, there's a mysterious knock. He calms himself
down and opens the door to reveal Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I found my identical hand twin!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, you are so lucky! (To Chandler) Hey! So, where's Monica? Did
you guys make up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But she just came up here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was Joey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I wonder where she is. That is so weird.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, she's probably talking to Richard.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Would you stop that! Do you wanna know the first thing she said when she
came back from her lunch with Richard? She didn't feel anything for him. She loves you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! Now, she feels terrible! She really wants to make up! You gotta
find her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (He gets up and goes to find her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good. (After he leaves, she puts on Joey's gladiator helmet and checks
herself out in the mirror) I should really start wearing hats!
[Scene: Caesar's Palace Casino, Chandler is looking for Monica while Tom Jones's
signature song is playing in the background (Getting the theme yet? Tom Jones, Wayne
Newton, casinos… They're in Vegas people! Catch up!) It's Not Unusual, y'know,
"It's not unusual to be loved by anyone! It's not unusual to have fun with anyone!
But when I see you hanging about with anyone, it's not unusual to see me cry!
I wanna die." Well, while that's playing he spots Monica playing craps and
in victory hug the guy next to her. Chandler turns and walks out.]
[Scene: That same plane cabin, Ross is working on a crossword puzzle and Rachel is
asleep against his shoulder. She shifts a little bit and Ross suddenly gets an idea. An
evil idea when he looks at his pen. Then we have a little time lapse, the plane has landed
and everyone is disembarking. The flight attendant is saying bye-bye to everyone.]

lines.speaker: The Flight Attendant
lines.text: (to another passenger) Welcome to Las
Vegas.
(Rachel approaches and we see the fruits of Ross's evil plan. He has drawn a moustache
and beard on Rachel. The flight attendant just ignores it.)

lines.speaker: The Flight Attendant
lines.text: (To Rachel) Thank you! (Not sure of
herself) Enjoy your flight?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, I did. Thank you very much, it was excellent. (Disembarks)

lines.speaker: The Flight Attendant
lines.text: (To Ross) Hope you had a nice flight.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, it was the best!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The casino, Ross and Rachel are entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think the check in is that way. (Points)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahh.
(A young boy sees Rachel, points, and starts laughing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello! (She makes a face and the kid laughs harder. Finally, his parents
drag him off.) Ohh, kids love me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sees Ross and Rachel) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe! (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys are here! Yay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! (Hugs Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sees Rachel's face) What? Did you go to a costume party? Let me guess
umm Pancho Vila? (Points at Rachel) and you're Bob Saget. (An old lady has sat down at the
slot machine Phoebe was just at.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pancho Vila?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! (Motions to her face, indicating all of Rachel's
"make-up.")

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you talking about Pheebs? (Takes out her compact) I don't…
(She gasps when she looks in the mirror and sees her face.) (To Ross) Oh my God, you drew
on me?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, you wet my pants!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whoa, what kind of party was this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I have been walking around like this since the plane! I
can—you have so crossed a line. (Heads for the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach! Wait! The men's room is that way. (Points in the other direction.
Rachel hits him with her purse and heads for the ladies room.)
(The old lady at Phoebe's machine wins. Phoebe turns around in shock.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's like the third time that lady's won on a machine I was playing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oooohhh, I'll bet she's one of those people.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: M-M-Mole people?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? No-no, a lurker.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. What's a lurker?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay when you're playing a machine and it hasn't paid out, a lurker waits
for you to give up and then…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Kills you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. They swoop in and steal your jackpot.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohhh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How do you know about this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My nana used to do it. That's how she paid for all my dance—karate
lessons.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Dance karate?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, it's a deadly but beautiful sport. (Does a karate chop, then does a
little dance-type sway.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (returning with her purse covering her face) All right, it won't
come off!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It won't come off!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! Rach-Rach, are-are-are you sure?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, actually I took it off then I drew it back on.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey-hey-hey you made it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Hey-hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who's your friend? He's hot! (Ross laughs and Rachel smacks him with her
purse.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Joey) Thanks man.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. (She hugs Joey.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey listen I uh, talked to Chandler, sorry about the movie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, don't be sorry. I don't need it anymore. I found my identical hand
twin!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Your what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: My identical hand twin! The person whose hands are exactly like mine! This
thing is a gold mine!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! That's not gonna make you any money!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Well, if that's how you feel about it, fine! None of you get to live
with me in my great big hand-shaped mansion! Except uh, you Pheebs. You can live in the
thumb.

scenes.location: The craps table, Monica is on a big roll.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right baby, come on! (Rolls the dice) Yes! Yes! I am on fire!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (walking by with his luggage) See you later Mon.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait Chandler, what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What does it look like? I'm going home.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? Wait! Why? (He turns and heads for the door and she chases after
him.) Chandler! Chandler! Wait! I’m sorry, I was just playing for one second! I was
trying to find you to tell you that, look if you don't want me to see Richard again, I
won't! He means nothing to me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on! I was there! (He's propped up with his hand on a statute of a
naked guy. He winces and pulls his hand away.) I know he's the love of your life.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not any more.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really! (They hug and kiss) All right? Let's forget about this going
home stuff and celebrate our anniversary. (She picks up his suitcase.) Okay, this is
empty.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I wanted to make a dramatic scene, but I hate packing.
[Scene: A blackjack table, it's the same one Joey's hand twin was working at, only he's
not there anymore and has been replaced by a beautiful woman.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Uhh, hey. Where's the other guy?

lines.speaker: The Woman Dealer
lines.text: Which guy?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He's kinda tall, dark hair, hand looks exactly like this. (Holds up his
hand.) See?

lines.speaker: The Woman Dealer
lines.text: I don't know about the hands, but the guy that was
here before me just went to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay! (Walks away, then turns back.) How you doin'?

lines.speaker: The Woman Dealer
lines.text: Very busy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right! Okay. (Heads for the bathroom.)
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's hotel room, Rachel is still trying to get the ink off and
Ross is on the phone to the company. Wait a minute, why exactly are they sharing a hotel
room? Didn't they like break-up or something? Did I miss a memo? Or maybe, it's just
foreshadowing things to come. Who knows? Maybe the answer's at the bottom of the page.
Then again, maybe it isn't and it's just one of those things TV writers just don't
explain. Anyhoo…]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on the phone) Yes, hello. I have a question. Umm, I used your pen to draw
on my friend's face. (Listens) A beard and a moustache. (Listens and laughs) Thank you.
(Rachel turns around and glares at him.) No, she didn't think so. (Listens) I know
it's like (turns and sees Rachel staring at him and quickly changes the subject) anyway,
umm well make-up didn't cover it and we've tried everything to get it off and nothing's
worked. What-what do we do? (Listens) Yeah. (Listens) Uh-huh. (Listens) Yeah. (Listens)
Oh! Okay. (Listens) Okay, thank you! (Rachel gets excited at his tone.) (Hangs up the
phone) Yeah, it's not coming off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! What else did he say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, he said he thought I was funny. So…(Rachel stares at him.) Okay,
look-look umm, let's just go downstairs, we'll have some fun, and you will forget all
about it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, no! There is no way I am leaving this room looking like
this!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, come on! Rach, it's-it's not that bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I am a human doodle!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, just because some idiot drew on your face doesn't mean you shouldn't
have any fun! Okay? And besides, hey-hey-hey no one is even gonna look at you.
Okay? This is Vegas! Hello! There are tons of other freaks here! (Rachel turns around and
glares at him.) There are tons…of…freaks here. No other. No. Come on! No one
will notice, I swear!
(They both exit.)
[Time lapse, they're both entering.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, there was some staring and pointing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I need a, I need a drink! (Makes a beeline for the mini-bar.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, hey y'know, they-they really overcharge you for that stuff. (Rachel
glares at him.) But who cares?! Because it's all on me! (Rachel reaches into the fridge
and pulls out two handfuls of those mini booze bottles.) (Watching her.) That is, one big
drink!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she's finished reliving the fridge of its entire alcohol content.)
Macadamia nut?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking at the price list) Umm… Wow! That's-that's some pricey nut!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hm-mmm! (Opens the container)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really like those Macadamia nuts, huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nope! (She puts one in her mouth and spits it out, then does it again in
another direction.)
[Scene: The casino, Phoebe is playing on a slot machine. Suddenly the lurker sticks her
head around the aisle of slot machines.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (seeing her) Get out of here you lurker! (She doesn't move) Go on! Get!
(She throws a quarter at her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (arm-in-arm with Monica) Hey Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! You made up!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I couldn't be mad at him for too long.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, she couldn't live without the Chan Love. (They start kissing.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, get a room.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We have one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. Use it.

scenes.location: The Men's room, Joey is entering and sees his hand twin washing his hands.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-oh-oh, yeah! (He grabs some towels and takes them to him.) That's
right, you take good care of those babies!

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's me, Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: Do I know you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (holds up his hand) Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: Oh-ho, yeah. Yeah, the hand guy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, so what are we going to do about this hand twin thing?!

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: Nothing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, you and I have been given a gift. Okay? We have to do something with
it. Like-like, hand modeling! Huh? Or-or magic! And you know NASA's gonna wanna
talk to us!

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: (tries to leave) I have to get back to…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (stopping him) Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! Whoa-whoa! We could have our own show!
Y'know we could clap our hands together people will love it! Huh? And-and-and I wrote a
song for us! (Singing, to the tune of This Land is Your Land) This hand is your
hand! This hand is my hand! Oh wait, that's your hand! No wait, it's my hand!

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: That's okay. (Walks out.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (following him) But you haven't even heard the chorus!
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's room, Ross is drinking a beer while Rachel is examining
herself in the mirror.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, I'm starting to look like my great aunt, Muriel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (gets up) All right. Y'know what? We don’t have to go downstairs! We
can bring Vegas up to us! (He grabs a deck of cards and pulls up a chair.) All right, come
on, come on, we'll play some blackjack. Here we go. (Deals the cards.) 13.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hit me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (does so) Oohh, 23. (Rachel looks at him.) Which is what we play to at
this casino! You win 10 dollars! (Holds out a ten.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I bet 20.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're right! (Gives her the twenty she won.)
[Scene: The Craps Table, Monica is still on her roll, only this time Chandler's with
her and she has a huge crowd of people around.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shaking the dice) A new pair of shoes for the Chan-Chan man! (Rolls the
dice.) Yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! I've-I've never seen a roll like this in my life!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's right baby! Okay, what do I want now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, ah umm, ah, a 8. Ah, a 6?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pick a number! That is your only job!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If you get this one, we buy everybody here a steak dinner!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yay!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yay!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) We're not really gonna buy these people steak dinners are
we?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Noo!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, good! Okay, what do I want now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahh, ooh, try a hard 8.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Two fours.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (Rolls the dice)

lines.speaker: A Drunken Gambler
lines.text: (To Chandler) Don't you let her go! You're a lucky guy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you, Mister Drunken Gambler! Okay, you get this and uh, we get
the biggest suite in the place! (Everyone cheers) Wait-wait-wait-wait! We (motions
to Monica and him.) get the biggest suite in the place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, biggest suite in the place. Come on! (Rolls the dice.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sees the roll) Yes!! I love you! I can't even remember what we were
fighting about!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, that's because I had lunch with Rich—Me neither! Okay, what do
I want now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Another hard 8.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hard 8?! We should call it easy 8!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, okay, I tell you what. You roll another hard eight; (pause) and
we get married here tonight.

lines.speaker: Drunken Gambler
lines.text: Go! Come on! Roll!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Roll-roll!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Shut up!! It just got interesting!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The Craps table, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You roll another hard eight and we get married here tonight.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you serious?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! I love you! I've never loved anybody as much as I love you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I've never loved anybody as much as I love you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so if an eight comes up, we take it as a sign and we do it!
{Whoa! Where have I heard that before? Matthew Perry talking about signs in Las Vegas. I
guess it must've been some movie I saw.} What do you say?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! Come on! Let's go! All right!
(She rolls the dice, but one bounces out of the table.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (spots one) Okay! That's a four! And where-where's the other one?

lines.speaker: Drunken Gambler
lines.text: It went under the table.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nobody move! (To Chandler) Okay, you look that way; I'll look this way!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right!
(He searches to his right; she searches to her left. They're both on their hands and
knees when they spot the die. It's propped up against the table leg, and it's not lying
flat. Both the four and the five are showing.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here it is! Here it is!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That could be a four or a five. It's your call.
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's a four.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think so too.
(Cue up the music as they move in and kiss. This time I think it's Perry Como, but I'm
not sure. It's Everybody loves somebody, sometime! Everybody falls in love somehow!
Something in your kiss, just told me, my sometime, is now!)
[Scene: The slot machines, Phoebe is still feeding quarters into the one-armed bandit
as the lurker peeks over the top of the machines.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh well, lost again. (She gets up and slowly moves away. The lurker
scurries in and takes her spot, only this time Phoebe set a trap for her and catches her
in the act.) That's it! You and me, outside!

lines.speaker: The Lurker
lines.text: I don't want to see you lose a chunk of that pretty blond
hair!
(They start smacking each other's cups, but Phoebe notices a security guard
approaching.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Be cool! (They both pretend to have a nice conversation as the guard
walks by, but after he leaves they both start fighting again.) Okay lady, your lurking
days are over!

lines.speaker: The Lurker
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, from now on everyone you lurk, I'm gonna lurk first! You move on
to someone else, I'm gonna be one step ahead of you, every single time! And then I'll be
on your ass every hour of every day 'til Monday, because that's when I go home. When do
you leave?

lines.speaker: The Lurker
lines.text: Also Monday.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What time? Maybe we can share a cab!
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's room, they've pretty much consumed the entire mini-bar.
Needless to say, they're feeling no pain and are still playing blackjack.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hit me. (He does so.) Hit me. (He does so.) Hit me. (He does so.) Hit
me. (He does so.) Hit me. (He does so.) Hit me. (He does so.) Hit me. (She slows down with
each one.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (runs out of cards) We need more cards.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and also we need more umm, drinks. Hold on a second. (Gets up but
stumbles a little bit.) Whup, okay. (She makes it to the phone and picks it up, without
dialing.) Hello! Vegas? Yeah, we would like some more alcohol, and y'know what else? We
would like some more beers. Hello? Ohh, I forgot to dial!
(They both start laughing. There's a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That must be our alcohol and beers! (Gets up to answer it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, it's Joey! I love Joey! (Hugs him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, I love Joey! Joey lives with a duck! (Goes and hugs Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look-look-look you guys, I need some help! Okay? Someone is going to have
to convince my hand twin to cooperate!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll do it. Hey, whatever you need me to do, I'm your man. (He starts to
sit down on the bed. There's one problem though, he's about two feet to the left of it.
Needless to say, he misses and falls on his butt.) (Looking up at Joey.) Whoa-oh-whoa! Are
you, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! I'm fine! Thanks! (He starts to leave, but gets an idea and stops.)
Hey Rach, how you doin'?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm doin' good, baby. How you doin'?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, don't let her drink anymore! (Exits)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, here's that Macadamia nut!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he puts it in his mouth) Nope! Something else. (Throws it back under the
bed.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oops! All right, so what do you want to do now?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I wanna get out of the room! Y'know, I…I really miss downstairs.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y'know what? There's only one way I'm leaving this hotel room.
[Cut to the casino, a very drunk and doodled on Rachel is walking arm in arm with an
equally drunk and doodled on Ross are walking through the casino and greeting people on
their way through. Ross has some whiskers and his nose colored in, along with his name on
his forehead.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well hello! I'm Ross!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good luck to ya!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excuse me sir, you've got a little something right here. (He points to the
corner of his mouth and they both laugh.)
(They've made their way to the statue of the naked man that Chandler was leaning
against earlier.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (bowing) Hello!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (bowing) Hello!

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: (bowing) Hello!
(They both continue on and Ross meows like a cat.)
[Scene: The slot machines, we see some guy not having any luck. Both Phoebe and the
Lurker are lurking him and each stick their heads around the corner at different times
This is all set to that Pink Panther song. Finally the guy gives up and walks past
the lurker's position, thus giving her the advantage. She scurries in and quickly drops a
coin in the slot before Phoebe gets there. Phoebe arrives slightly later and pulls the arm
just after the lurker deposits the coin and wins.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I won! I won! I finally won!

lines.speaker: The Lurker
lines.text: I won! That was my quarter!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine! Here! Take a hike toots! (Gives back her quarter.)
(The security guard approaches.)

lines.speaker: The Lurker
lines.text: (to the guard) Excuse me, sir! This lady played my quarter,
this is my money. (Motions to the jackpot.)

lines.speaker: The Security Guard
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Is that true miss?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (quietly) Sells drugs to kids.

lines.speaker: The Security Guard
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She sells drugs to kids. (The guard looks at the lurker.)

lines.speaker: The Lurker
lines.text: It was my quarter!

lines.speaker: The Security Guard
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Was it her quarter?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How about we talk about this over dinner?

lines.speaker: The Security Guard
lines.text: Okay lady, you're out of here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No, you can't arrest me! No!! I won't go back! I won't go back to
that hell hole!!

lines.speaker: The Security Guard
lines.text: I'm just taking you outside!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay. (Walks out.)

scenes.location: The Gift Shop, Monica and Chandler are entering.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, come on, I can't get married until I get something old, something
new, something borrowed, and something blue.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, all right, all right, all right! Okay! (Picks up a blue
sweater.) Okay, here's something, here's something blue and new.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're so efficient. I love you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let's go! (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no-no! We need something old!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh, great, I have condom in my wallet I've had since I was twelve.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That'll work!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, now we just need something borrowed!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks around) Here just…take this. (Hands her the sweater.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's stealing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, we'll-we'll bring it back! Just put it under your dress.
(She does so and it makes her look pregnant.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh. (Rubs her fake stomach.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, one thing at a time. (They run out to get married.)
[Scene: A blackjack table, Joey is moving in to try and get his hand twin (who's
dealing) to join him in his evil plot to rule the world! "Join me, and together we'll
rule the universe as father and son!" (Sorry, I had a little Star Wars creep
in there—Ooh, I have a big spoiler for The Phantom Menace, Yoda lives at the
end! Ha-ha, spoiled it! Now you don't have to see it!)]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sitting down) Ahhh! (Slides his hands across the table.)

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: Are you gonna play?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, I don't really have any money. Not yet, anyway… (Shakes his
hands.)

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: You can't sit here if you're not gonna play.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (throws down a small wad of money, and as his hand twin starts to unfold
it, Joey once again brings attention to their special gift to the world. {Y'know, looking
at it now, they really don't have that similar of hands. Joey's are bigger.}) Ooh-ho-ho!
(The dealer stares at him and he stops.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering and sitting down at the table.) Hello. My name is Regina
Phalange. I'm a businesswoman in town on business. Would you like to see my card? (Looks
down) Ooh, what did I do with my file-a-facts? I must've left it in conference room B.

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: (To Joey) 14.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hit me! (He does so.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! May I just say that you two gentlemen have the exact same
hands! They're identical! Now, I've never seen anything like that in the business world.

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: Stop it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, Ms. Phalange, may I ask you a question as an impartial person at-at
this table?

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: Please stop it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wouldn't you pay good money to see these identical hands showcased in some
type of a uh, entertainment venue?

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: (To Joey) If you leave now, I will chop off my hand and give
it too you!
(The security guard from before approaches and Phoebe tries to turn her back on him.)

lines.speaker: The Security Guard
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Didn't I just throw you out of here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, you threw out Phoebe. I'm Ms. Regina Phalange. Phalange!

lines.speaker: The Security Guard
lines.text: Come on, lady! (Starts to escort her out.)

lines.speaker: Joey's Hand Twin
lines.text: Please, please take him too. (Motions to Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me?! Oh come on, man! You can't do this! Come on! (Being dragged out by
the guard) I'm your hand twin!!

scenes.location: A Little White Chapel, Chandler and Monica are entering.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello! One marriage please!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yep, we wanna get married!

lines.speaker: The Attendant
lines.text: Well, there's a service in progress. Have a seat.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Monica
lines.text: All right.
(They both sit down.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (singing) Dum! Dum-dum-dum! Dum! Dum! Dum! Dum-dum-dum!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that's The Wedding March. Does, does that freak you out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, only because that's the graduation song.
(The real Wedding March begins playing from behind the closed doors of the
chapel.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! (Stands up) This is it! (Claps his hands) We're gonna get
married!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you sure you wanna do this?
(Suddenly the doors burst open, and ROSS AND RACHEL COME OUT ARM-IN-ARM!!!!! And
Rachel's carrying a bouquet!!! THEY GOT MARRIED!!!!)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, hello, Mrs. Ross! (Throws some rice.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, hello, Mr. Rachel! (Throws some more rice.)
(They storm out into the street.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait! (Gets her bearings) Okay!
(She goes one way; he goes the other. The camera pans back to Chandler and Monica, and
needless to say, they're standing there dumbstruck as The King's (Elvis Presley to the
yougin's) Viva, Las Vegas begins to play. Sing along with me now, "Viva!
Las Vegas! Vivaaaaaa! Vivaaaaa! Las Vegassssss!!" Fade to Black.)
Ending Credits
[That's all folks, no teaser; just the big cliffhanger for season 6. Yes, there will be
a season 6, and it'll start again in September. Have a good summer everyone!]

title: The One After Vegas

lines.text: [Scene: The Wedding Chapel, continued from last season. Chandler and Monica are about
to get married.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! (Stands up) This is it! (Claps his hands) We're gonna get
married!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you sure you wanna do this?
(Suddenly the doors burst open, and ROSS AND RACHEL COME OUT ARM-IN-ARM!!!!! And
Rachel's carrying a bouquet!!! THEY GOT MARRIED!!!!)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, hello, Mrs. Ross! (Throws some rice.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, hello, Mr. Rachel! (Throws some more rice.)
(They storm out into the street.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait! (Gets her bearings) Okay!
(She goes one way; he goes the other. The camera pans back to Chandler and Monica, and
needless to say, they're standing there dumbstruck.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering with Phoebe) Come on Pheebs! Hurry! Hurry! Hurry! Hurry!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! Okay! Okay! (They run into the chapel.)
(Chandler and Monica are stunned again.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!! Is everybody getting married?!!
(Phoebe and Joey run back out and head towards the street.)

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.text: (scolding them) N-No running in the chapel!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to her) Hey! Don’t you give me any of your—Hey! (Sees
Chandler and Monica standing there.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you guys doing here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross and Rachel left us a message saying they were getting married!
Isn’t that why you guys are here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Well that-yes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why else would we be here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well! What happened?! Did we miss it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We actually missed it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, maybe you wouldn’t have had you (turns to the attendant) run
in the chapel!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is insane!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s the big deal, y’know? It’s not like it’s a
real marriage.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, if you get married in Vegas, you’re only married in Vegas.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about? If you get married in Vegas you’re
married everywhere.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (shocked) Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!—Eh! Well…
Opening Credits
{Transciber’s note: In case you haven’t heard, Courteney Cox got married to
David Arquette during hiatus and changed her name to Courteney Cox Arquette. But David was
a busy boy during the off season for not only did he marry but everyone else as well. For
they’re all listed as Jennifer Aniston Arquette, Lisa Kudrow Arquette, in an
interesting twist Matt LeBlanc Arquette, Matthew Perry Arquette, David Schwimmer Arquette,
and even the creators of the show are now David Crane Arquette and Marta Kauffman
Arquette. I just wonder what the new sleeping arrangements are…}

scenes.location: Rachel’s hotel room, she’s waking up with a horrendous hangover.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh! (Looks in the mirror and sees that she still has her mustache and
groans.)
(Suddenly, there’s movement beside her, startling her. It’s Ross! He wakes up
and they both start screaming in terror. Then they both grab their heads having aggravated
their hangovers.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why are we in bed together?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know. Do-do you have any clothes on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (checks) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! But we-we didn’t have…sex-uh, did we? I mean, I don’t
remember much about last night, it was such a blur.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! I remember laughing! I laughed a lot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And we didn’t have sex.
(Rachel agrees with him and starts to get out of bed.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, I mean, we were really drunk. I’m just glad we didn’t do
anything stupid.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (getting up) Tell me about it. (He sits up on the edge of the bed and has
"Just Married" written on his back.)

scenes.location: The breakfast buffet, Phoebe is already sitting at the table as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mornin’ Pheebs. (Sits down.) Well, my movie has officially been
canceled.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Joey, I’m so sorry. You want some of my breakfast?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nah, I’m too depressed to eat. I’ll probably eat in like 5
minutes. So I guess I’ll just fly home with you guys, what time’s your flight?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What about my cab?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t need that anymore.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, Joey! You borrowed my cab; you have to drive it back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t want to drive all the way back by myself, I get so lonely.
(Gets an idea.) Oh—ooh! How about you come with me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know, it’s such a long trip.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’ll be great! We-we could talk, and play games! Huh? This could be
our chance to like renew our friendship.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you asking me to have a frenaissance?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. Although I don’t think we need one, I never stopped
loving you.
(Chandler and Monica enter.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, has anyone talked to Dr. and Mrs. Geller yet?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um-hmm, yeah. They left me a message; they should be here any minute.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where is the waitress?! I’m starving!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s a buffet man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, here’s where I win all my money back! (Gets up and heads for the
buffet table with Chandler in tow.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen, I gotta talk to you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure! What’s up? (He grabs a plate and proceeds to load it with a
huge pile of scrambled eggs. Chandler just stares at him and Joey reluctantly gives him a
spoonful.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica and I almost got married last night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God! That’s huge! (Hugs him.) Wait a minute, why come I
wasn’t invited? And who was going to be your best man? Don’t say,
"Ross." Do not say, "Ross."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I just don’t think Monica and I are ready to get married
yet! Y’know? I mean, I love her and everything but seeing Ross and Rachel coming out
of that chapel was like a, like a wake-up call that Monica and I are moving so fast.
Y’know? And, how do I tell her without crushing her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Tell her she’s not marriage material.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Girls say it to me all the time! And believe me, if she’s anything
like me, she’s just gonna be relieved.
[Pan to Monica and Phoebe having the same conversation.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How do I tell Chandler that it’s too soon. It’s gonna break
his heart, he’s not gonna think that I don’t love him anymore.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well you don’t.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes I do!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good! Good! I was just testing you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (returning with Joey) Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh hi! Hi! Y’know, we were just talking about bacon.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, we were talking about tennis. Tennis is more believable.
(Ross and Rachel enter.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: The Girls
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!
(They both sit down and Rachel pours them both some coffee. They’re acting like
nothing’s happened and everyone is just staring at them.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are we gonna talk about what you guys did last night? Or…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Ross) I don’t know. (To the gang.) What do you mean last night?
Nothing, nothing uh, happened last night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh! Ross invited us all to watch.
(Rachel turns to Ross stunned.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach! We weren’t gonna miss our friends getting married!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Who got married?! (Ross is as surprised to hear this as she is.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (not quite sure) You did.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! Hello! We didn’t get married.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, we didn’t get married! That’s ridiculous!
(They turn to look at each other and suddenly remember that they did in fact get
married.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We-we-we—I remember being in a chapel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I—They would not let us get married when we were that drunk!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They let you get married when you’re drunk! Most people who get
married in Vegas are drunk!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hell, I’m drunk right now! (They all turn and look at her.) What? I
can’t have a mimosa with breakfast?! I’m on vacation!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you guys gonna do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I guess we just find a divorce lawyer? (Looks at Ross.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I think, I think, Ross already has one. Now, this one’s
free, right? Because you paid for the first two, so the third one’s free.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Laugh it up, but the joke’s on you. Because we don’t need to get
divorced, okay? We we’re just gonna get an annulment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: An annulment? Ross! I don’t think surgery’s the answer here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh-oh, that’s your thing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re thing. You’re thing. Y’know? You’re the guy
who gets divorced.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no, that’s-that’s not my thing! I do not love getting
divorced!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes you do! This is your third divorce! You love divorce so much
you’re probably gonna marry it! Then it won’t work out and you’re gonna
have to divorce it, divorcing guy. (Pause) I’m so drunk.

scenes.location: The casino floor, Chandler and Monica are walking through it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, what do you think we should do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know. But I-I-I know I love you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know I love you! (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So where are we on the whole going back to the place where they have
all the marriages thing? I love you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s a good question. Look umm, last night we let the dice
decide. Maybe we should leave it up to fate again. I love you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, we don’t get married unless there’s a sign! Okay, so
say uh, say you roll another eight (motions to the craps table) then there’s a definite
sign that we should get married.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, eight we get married, but 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12 we
don’t get married.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sounds great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (They approach the craps table.)

lines.speaker: Croupler
lines.text: Coming in, we got a shooter! Money please.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ready?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ready!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sarcastic) Come on eight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (deadpan) Yes, yes eight.
(Monica rolls the dice.)

lines.speaker: Croupler
lines.text: Eight! Easy eight. (She rolls a 3 and a 5 and they’re stunned.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! I can’t believe I actually rolled an eight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was so unlikely. Well, let’s get married! I guess.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute. That wasn’t a hard eight! Last night I rolled a hard
eight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s right! It was the wrong kind of eight, no wedding! Damnit!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wanted it so bad! (Pause) Wanna go pack?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. (They go pack.) We’re doing the right thing, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, of course we are! (They walk up to the elevators.) We left it up to
fate. (Pushes the elevator button.) If we were supposed to get married there would be a
clear-cut sign. (The elevator door opens to a priest reading from a bible with Chandler
and Monica standing side-by-side holding each other’s hands.)
[Scene: Phoebe’s cab, Phoebe and Joey are driving back. Phoebe is driving while
Joey is sleeping.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, you have 19 questions left. Use them wisely. (Joey groans.) Come
on Joey! You can’t win if you don’t ask any (sees that he’s asleep) QUESTIONS!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (wakes up) What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, you promised me a fun road trip! We’ve been on the road six
hours and you’ve been asleep for five and a half! We are switching at the next rest
stop and you are going to drive all the way back! That will be your punishment, you
greedy sleeper!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. All right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! And until then you are going to sing to me because the
radio’s broken and you are selfish but have a nice voice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? I don’t…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sing!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (starts singing) I wanna rock and roll all night! (Falls asleep.)
[Time lapse, Phoebe is asleep, Joey’s driving and having a hard time staying
awake.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to himself) Man, this is a long drive! Are my eyes open? No! (He opens
his eyes and sees a hitchhiker.)
[Time lapse, Phoebe is still asleep only Joey is now passed out next to her and the
car’s still moving. She wakes up, sees Joey, and screams.]

lines.speaker: Hitchhiker
lines.text: (driving) Morning! (Phoebe screams again.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is on the couch as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, hubby!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, actually um, I wanted to talk to you about that whole
annulment thing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m not going to do that. (Rachel glares at him.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier. Rachel starts laughing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! So, we’ll just stay married.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, exactly!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I will make everyone call me Mrs. Geller!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! This is so amazing. I uh, I really thought I’d have to talk you
into this more.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, see now I’m scared because I don’t actually think
you’re kidding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m-I’m not kidding. Look I-I, I can’t have three
failed marriages. I can’t. Okay? I-I am not gonna be that guy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What-wh-what so we’ll just stay married forever?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, look, how is this gonna affect you? Really? I mean you fill some
form out once and a while and instead of checking the box that says Ms you check the box
that says Mrs.! It’s right next to it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, okay, I’m sorry. You’re right. Y’know what? We
absolutely can stay married, because I was under the impression that the boxes were far away
from each other. All right, look, just please, take a moment here and think about what
you’re asking of me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m asking you to do me a favor.
{Note: Does anyone else want to smack Ross right about now? Raise your hands. Okay, put
them down before you stink out the person next to you.}

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are asking me to be your wife!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And as my wife I think you should grant me this favor.

scenes.location: The hallway, Chandler is helping Monica to the door.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That kid really kicked me hard on the plane.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well you did pull his hair.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He took my snack!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not getting into this again!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! Oh God, y’know what? It’s really bad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I told you not to walk. Here. (Picks her up.) There. Okay.
(He opens the door, carries her across the threshold, stops, backs out, and lets go of
Monica who is only holding on by his neck.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This doesn’t mean anything, does it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
[Scene: Phoebe’s cab, she’s driving, Joey’s in the back seat, and the
hitchhiker is riding up front with Phoebe.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Joey) How could you pick up a hitchhiker?! He could be a
rape—(She holds her hand in front of the hitchhiker’s face), a rapist or a
killer or something!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t you think I asked him that before he got in?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know what? I’m not talking to you! You go back to sleep! (To
the hitchhiker) And you, are you a rapist?!

lines.speaker: Hitchhiker
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do you like car games?

lines.speaker: Hitchhiker
lines.text: Yeah, y’know the license plate game?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I love the license plate game!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, I’ll play! I’ll play!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-No! You need your sleep. Night-night! Shh! (She closes the
partition.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, I know you wanted to talk to me, but I have an idea that may make
you want to stay married. (Rachel shakes her head.) We register, and you get to
keep all the presents!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (thinks about it for a second) No! Ross, come on! No! Listen, look I
thought a lot about how to tell you this and the bottom line, Ross, is we can not stay
married.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know if it’s true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh b-b-but it is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, okay, y’know what this is? This is a difference of
opinion. And when that happens in a marriage...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ross, come on! This is not, this is not a marriage!! This is the
world’s worst hangover! Ross, listen, if you do not get this annulment, I
will!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. All right, I’ll do it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (He goes to leave.) Hey-hey umm, uh, is there, is there any
such thing as an annulment shower?
(Ross turns and leaves.)

scenes.location: Phoebe’s cab, it’s the same arrangement as before.

lines.speaker: Hitchhiker
lines.text: Wait! Wait! There is the train station!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.speaker: Hitchhiker
lines.text: This is where I get off. Well, I have your address and phone number.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And I have your name and the fact that you’re a drifter, so the
ball’s pretty much in your court.

lines.speaker: Hitchhiker
lines.text: All right, see ya Pheebs. (Gets out and Phoebe drives away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on Pheebs! I can’t take this anymore! Let-let me make it up to
you. Huh? (Starts singing.) Ground control to Major Tom. Commencing countdown, engines
on. Take your protein pills and put your helmet on!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Stop it! Stop it no! That’s not fair! Y’know I can’t
resist that beautiful voice!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs, I am so sorry! I know I promised you a fun road trip with your
friend and I didn’t deliver. But-but-but now I know that you think being awake is an
important part of friendship! So, so, so I will strive to-to stay awake for as long as I
know you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You can still sleep at night and stuff.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, thank you. So, can we play 20 Questions now? I’ve got a really
good one! I’ve been thinking about it since Kansas.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Is it a kind of hot sandwich?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Is it a meatball sub?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That is incredible! You are the master!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler and Monica are there and Rachel is arranging a
bouquet of flowers, pricks her finger on a thorn, throws the bouquet over her head, and
those you who are quicker than some already know that Monica is the one who catches it.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh, that’s funny. You look like you’re gonna be the…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, don’t say it! Don’t even think it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. Okay Chandler, enjoy your handful. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, should we just, should we just get married? Y’know? I
mean should we just do it? All the signs are telling us to do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sick of the signs! It’s too fast, I’m happy the way
things are!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t want things to change! Do you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right then, then nothing changes! Everything is great! Everything
stays the same! And you go unpack because it’s been three days and it’s driving
me insane!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Jeez, relax! It’s not like we’re mar-ah-ah!! (Runs out.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, slowly) Y’know I was thinking, what if I uh, unpack
here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then all your stuff would be here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, what if all my stuff was here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then you’d be going back and forth all the time, I mean it
doesn’t make any sense.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. What if we lived together and you understand what I’m
saying?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Live together? There have been no signs for that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me asking is kind of a sign.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!!!!!
(And the crowd goes wild! Well, at least the live studio audience.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! Okay! Okay! Wait-wait-wait!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here’s your key (Gets him one.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here’s your key. All right, you have to christen it! Now, go out
and come back in!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The door hasn’t been locked in five years, but okay! (Runs out.)
Ready?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ready!
(He tries, but something happens.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, a little problem. The key broke in the lock and I can’t get
in!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait! Oh my God! I can’t get out!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is not a sign!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it’s not a sign! It’s a very old key!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s an old key!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God it’s old!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I love you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you hugging the door right now.
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, me neither.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel and Phoebe are on the couch as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, so did everything go all right with the annulment?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah, no problems. It’s all taken care of.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, thank you. Hey, do you guys wanna go see a movie?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, why not?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No thanks, I’ve already seen one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, umm, I’m gonna get my sweater. (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (Sits down next to Phoebe.) You uh, you wanna hear something weird?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Always.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I didn’t get the annulment.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We’re still married! Don’t tell Rachel. See you later. (He gets
up leaving Phoebe in shock.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: The hallway, Joey is coming up the stairs and sees Chandler trying to open the
lock.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The key’s stuck in the lock.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can fix it. Hold on. (He goes and gets a screwdriver from his apartment)
Look out. Look out. (Pries at the door a little bit.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (trying the handle) It still doesn’t work.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m not finished.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh.
(Joey goes back into the apartment, runs back into the hallway, throws his shoulder
against the door, and knocks it down off it’s hinges.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nice job Joe! You’re quite the craftsmen.
(Joey pats him on the stomach and heads to bed.)

title: The One Where Ross Hugs Rachel

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, it’s the same scene from the end of last week’s show.
Phoebe and Rachel are sitting on the couch as Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, so did everything go okay with the annulment?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah, no problems. It’s all taken care of.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, thank you. Hey, do you guys wanna go see a movie?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, why not?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, umm, I’m gonna get my sweater. (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (Sits down next to Phoebe.) You uh, you wanna hear something weird?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Always.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I didn’t get the annulment.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We’re still married! Don’t tell Rachel. See you later. (He gets
up leaving Phoebe in shock.)
[Cut to outside Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) Hey, do you have any gum?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh? Yeah! Sure!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (running out) Wait! Wait! Hi! Listen, Ross can I just talk to you for
just a second?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh but Phoebe, we’re gonna be late for the movie.
(A cab pulls up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, there’s a cab! Taxi!! (The cab stops and she opens the door.)
Good timing, my God, huh? Here you go. (Pushes Rachel in and closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, we’re, we’re actually just gonna walk ‘cause
it’s right up there at the Angelica.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, the Angelica!! Go! Go! (She bangs on the cab’s roof and it
pulls away.) (To Ross) You didn’t get the annulment?!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I tried! But when I got to my lawyer’s office all I could hear
was, "Three divorces. Three divorces!" Look, I just don’t want my tombstone
to read, Ross Gellar, Three Divorces.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t be worried about that! Your tombstone can say whatever you
want it to say! It could say, Ross Geller, Good at Marriage! Y’know? Mine’s
gonna say Phoebe Buffay, Buried Alive.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, all I know is I-I can’t have another failed marriage!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So okay what? You’re gonna be married to a girl who doesn’t
even know about it?!—Op, woman! Sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, okay so, I don’t have it all worked out quite yet. Just
don’t say anything to Rachel, please?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel is one of my closest friends. (Pause) Although, being the only
one who knows anything about this does makes me feel special. Okay!
(Rachel’s cab backs up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to the driver) Okay, stop-stop! Phoebe?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What was that?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sorry, mix up. Hey, how was the movie?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I haven’t seen it yet!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well then you’d better hurry! The Angelica! Go! Go! (Bangs on the
roof again and off they go.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noooooooo!!
Opening Credits
{Transciber’s note: In case you’re wondering, and I know you are. Their names
are all back to normal. Just in a slightly smaller font than usual to allow Courteney Cox
Arquette to fit on one line and not be smaller than the rest of their names. Now, on with
the show…}

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler and Monica are cuddling on the couch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know when we move in together, can I get a gumball machine?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course! Joey wouldn’t let you have one?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. When it comes to sweets, he’s surprisingly strict.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, have you figured out a way to tell him you’re moving out?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, I keep trying, y’know? I can get out, "Joey, I have
too…" but then I lose my nerve and I always finish with, "…go to the
bathroom." He may think I’m sick.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, I really have to tell Rachel, but I… We just have to
get it over with! Y’know, the next time we see them we’re just gonna tell them.
Okay? That’s it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, so that’s this is gonna work now? You’re just gonna
order me around all the time?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pretty much.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) Hey man, you feeling any better? (Chandler answers him
with some guttural sounds that only he can make and that no human can transcribe.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, we have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God! You’re pregnant!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-o-o! (To Monica) No? (She nods no.) No-o-o! Look Joey, here’s
the thing, Monica and I have decided to live together, here. So, I’m gonna be moving
out man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! (Tearing up) Well, uh… Hey! I’m really happy for you guys!
Congratulations! (Kisses Monica on the cheek) See you later. (Starts for the door on the
verge of tears as Monica stops him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait! Joey! Joey! Are you okay?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I gotta go! I got an acting job. (Turns towards the door, pauses,
and turns back.) Like you’d believe that. This sucks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I-I’m just gonna be right across the hall and I promise
you, the minute Monica and I break up I’m moving right back in with you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Monica) Okay! Look-look-look, uh, if you’re gonna be moving in
with him I feel it’s my responsibility to tell you the truth about him! Okay?
He’s a terrible roommate! Terrible! He uh, forgets to umm… Oh-oh he always, he
always umm—Oh, who am I kidding! He’s the best roommate ever! (Hugs Chandler.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is on the couch as Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, have you seen Rachel?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I have some pretty exciting news!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) You’re pregnant!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Chandler and I are moving in together!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! That’s good! Wow! But now if you were pregnant, what would you
name it? Hint: Phoebe.
(Ross returns from getting some coffee.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s up?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well umm, Chandler and I are moving in together.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God. Ohh, my little sister and my best friend…shaking up. Oh,
that’s great. That’s great. (Kisses and hugs her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Guys, I’m happy too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, come here! (Phoebe joins them in the hug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! Big day huh? People moving in, people getting annulled… (Winks
at Ross.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I gotta go find Rachel but umm, if you guys see her could you
please try to give her some really bad news so that mine doesn’t seem so bad?
(Exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm, something bad to tell Rachel… Bad news for Rachel, what could
that be?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Could ya just, could ya just lay off, please? All right? My life is an
embarrassment! I should go live under somebody’s stairs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, it’s not that big a deal! So you’ll been divorced three
times, you’ll still have a life, you’ll go on dates…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupting) No! No, I won’t! I’ll be at the bottom of the
dating barrel now. The only guys below me will be Four Divorce Guy uh, Murderer Guy,
and-and, Geologists.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, you’re being ridiculous! Okay? You are cute and smart and
sweet and that is much more important than three stupid divorces!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah? Have you ever dated anyone who has been divorced three times?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know that’s really fair. Y’know? Most guys who have
been divorced three times are like 60. Ross, nobody cares about this except you! This-this
embarrassment thing is all in your head! Here, I’ll show you! Come here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! Why?
(She grabs his arm and drags him over to a table where three beautiful women are
sitting. Now, I’m going to go out on a limb and say that their names are Stephanie,
Karin, and Meg. Okay, so I looked at the credits. Of course, only Meg is named later on,
so I’ll have to guess who is Stephanie and who is Karin. But, we’ll cross that
bridge when we come to it.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to the girls) Hi! Hi! Listen, my friend Ross is about to be divorced
for the third time, but wouldn’t you date him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And if you wait right here, I’ll go get Ross. (Phoebe grabs his arm
and prevents him from escaping.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is pacing anxiously waiting for Rachel.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ugh, I thought you were Rachel!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking down) What gave me away?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just tell her, I have to get it over with. I told Ross and Phoebe and
she’s the only one left!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so that’s it, everybody knows! It’s official,
we’re moving in together. No turning back. Are ya scared? Are ya?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow that was my scariest voice! You’re very brave.
(They hug as Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, the worse day! Y’know, you think you’re making progress
at work and then your boss calls you Raquel.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey listen, for the first four years of my work everybody called me
Sha-la-lap. (Awkward silence ensues.) Seriously.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I believe you. So, it was right in the middle of a staff meeting so of
course no one else wants to correct her so everyone else is calling me Raquel! By the end
of the day, the mailroom guys were calling me Rocky!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I-I still think you’re very-very nice and very pretty…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) All yours babe. (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have a seat. (They sit at the table.) Okay, listen umm, Chandler and I
are going to live together, here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! That’s so great! I’m so happy for you guys!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And that was so sweet of you to ask! Oh my God, the three of us are
gonna have such a good time living together!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, we are. (Chandler is frantically trying to get Monica to correct
her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And Chandler, you’re gonna have to watch those long showers you
take in the morning because you know Raquel can’t be late.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Rach…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, he’s gonna work on that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! This is so exciting! Oh God… (Gasps and starts to sing)
Come and knock on my door…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (singing) We’ll be waiting for you…
{Transciber’s note: I’ll finish that one for those of you who don’t know
what they’re talking about. Where the towels are Hers and Hers and His,
Three’s Company too! Yeah, that’s the theme song for Three’s Company.}
Commercial Break
[Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe is hosting an impromptu roundtable discussion with
Stephanie, Karin, and Meg about Ross’s three divorces.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …once you know the stories, it’s not that bad. First marriage,
wife’s hidden sexuality, not my fault. Second marriage, said the wrong name at the
altar, a little my fault. Third marriage, well they really shouldn’t allow you to get
married when you’re that drunk and have writing all over your face, Nevada’s
fault.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so what do you think ladies? Who wouldn’t be interested? Who
wouldn’t want to date him?

lines.speaker: Stephanie
lines.text: Well the divorces don’t bother me, I’d date him. But, not
while he’s still married.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, what about you? (Points to Karin) Wouldn’t you want a date?

lines.speaker: Karin
lines.text: Actually, I’m dating at all anymore. See, I figured out that I was
only dating guys that were like y’know bad for me, so until I work that out…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting) Whatever! What about you Meg?

lines.speaker: Meg
lines.text: Well, I don’t care about the divorces either, but I wouldn’t date
him. It’s just that he’s obviously still in love with this Rachel girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (leaning to him) She said, "He’s obviously still in love with
this Rachel girl." (He glares at her.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is crazy! I mean, yes-yes Rachel is my good friend and I-I have loved
her in the past, but now, she is just my wife! Phoebe, will you-will you help me
out here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I thought you loved her when you-when you married her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We were drunk! I would’ve married uh, Joey with that amount of
alcohol!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! You could do a lot worse than Joey Tribbiani!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the panel) Look, I’m sorry, but you guys are wrong. I just
don’t want to be divorced three times.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, and now he’s using this three divorces reason because he wants
to stay married to her because he loves her. I must say, "Well done!" Bravo Meg.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (getting up) Okay! Fine! Fine! If-if this is what you think, forget about
the whole three divorce thing! Okay, I-I’ll go to my lawyer’s office right now
and get this marriage annulled! Okay?! Because she means nothing to me! Noth—(leans
down to Meg’s ear)—Nothing!!

lines.speaker: Meg
lines.text: Okay now I wouldn’t date you because you seem a little creepy.

lines.speaker: Karin
lines.text: I am so attracted to him right now.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler and Monica are still debating about how to tell
Rachel that Chandler’s moving in and she’s moving out.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, when are we gonna tell Rachel what is actually gonna happen?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Soon! I-I just couldn’t before. You saw how upset Joey got! I
couldn’t do that to her, she’s my best friend!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, Joey’s my best friend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m not your best friend?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You just said… Of course you’re my best friend. Would you
please tell Rachel though?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, all right, at least I’m prepared.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (She grabs a tin of freshly baked cookies) Oh yes. (He reaches
for one.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (slapping his hand) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey-hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: These aren’t for you! Are you upset?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am now!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey roomie!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, bye! (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, there’s something uh, important I have to tell you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Are you pregnant?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! But, I’m throwing this shirt away! I think there was a little
misunderstanding before.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, when I said that uh, that Chandler and I wanted to umm, live
together we meant alone together.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Oh my God! Oh, that’s funny, I can’t believe I did
that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no sweetie, no! This is my fault, I wasn’t clear! I’m
really sorry. And listen, you take as much time as you need to move out okay? There’s
absolutely no rush.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Sits back and resumes her reading.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Don’t you want a cookie?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure? (Monica hands her one.) Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe, do you need a tissue?
(Rachel mumbles uh-huh and spits the half-eaten cookie out onto the tissue.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, where did you get these?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I made them!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, good God, they’re so yummy! (She re-ingests the previously
expelled cookie matter from the tissue.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is packing some books and Joey is watching him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: God, it’s gonna so weird like when I come home and you’re not
here. Y’know? No more Joey and Chan’s. No more J and C’s. "You wanna
go over to Joey and Chandler’s?" "Can’t, its not there."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I’m just gonna be across the hall, we can still do all the
same stuff.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah but we won’t be able to like get up in the middle of the night
and have those long talks about our feelings and the future.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not once did we do that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So I, I told Rachel it was just gonna be the two of us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah? Well, how’d she take it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really well. Yeah. Surprisingly well. Yeah, she didn’t cry. She
wasn’t angry or sad. (Sits down, slightly disgusted.)
