lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And you’re upset because you didn’t make your best friend
cry?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean, all I’m asking for is just a little emotion! Is that too
much to ask after six years?! I mean what? Are-are-are Rachel and I not as close as you
guys?! I mean do we not have as much fun?! Don’t I deserve a few tears?!! I mean
we-we told Joey, he cried his eyes out!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! I did not cry my eyes out!! Come on! It’s like the end of an
era! No more J-man and Channie’s!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I gotta ask, who calls us that?!
[Scene: Ross’s lawyer’s office, his name is Russell and has just been told by
Ross about his current situation.]

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: You got married again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: So that’s your second marriage in two years.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, second in two years. Third overall.

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: Ross, I have been a divorce attorney for 23 years and never had I so
much business from one client. Why don’t you tell me what happened.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Basically, Rachel and I were in Vegas and we got drunk…

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: (interrupting) I’m sorry, is this the same Rachel who’s name
you said at the altar in the second marriage?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes-yes-yes! But, I-I do not love her.

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: Oh, that’s better then.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This was just a drunken mistake and I need to get it annulled.

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: I see. Have you considered therapy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think just the annulment for today.

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: There are a couple of forms to fill out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Easy.

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: And we’ll need to have witnesses who can testify that you were not
of uh, sound mind.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: And we’ll need you and Rachel to testify before a judge.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ooh! There’s no way to do this without her? ‘Cause I kinda all
ready told her uh, it was, it was already taken care of.

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: Of course you did. Look Ross, you can’t get an annulment unless
you and Rachel are both there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-ha, what about someone who looks like Rachel? (Russell glares at him.)
I will think about the therapy.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is painting her toe nails as Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. So um, I was thinking that maybe we should start dividing up our
stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, no point in dragging it out. Dragging out the long
process of you moving out and us not living together anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Rach, what about this? (She holds up a chrome 5-point star.) Huh?
Who-who gets this? See, I don’t know if I want it because it might be y’know,
too many memories!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (grabbing the star) What the hell is that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know. (Picks up a big plate from the coffee table.) Hey,
Rachel, you want the big plate? I want you to have the big plate.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Mon, thanks! I love this plate!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Something to remember me by!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mon, honey you’re not dying. I’m just moving out. Y’know,
I mean we’re gonna see each other all the time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But still, it’s a big change. The end of an era, you might say!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you okay? You’re not blinking.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m fine! I just, I’m thinking how much it’s an end of
era.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, all right. But y’know I gotta say, I don’t, I don’t
think six years counts as an era.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: An era is defined as a significant period of time. Now, it was
significant to me, maybe it wasn’t significant to you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is the matter with you?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is the matter with you?!! Why aren’t you more upset?!
Aren’t you gonna be sad that we’re not gonna be living together anymore?! I mean
aren’t you gonna miss me at all?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, fine, but don’t get mad at me. It’s-it’s just
a little hard to believe.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s hard to believe?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y’know, it’s you guys. You-you do this kind of stuff!
Y’know? I mean, you-you were gonna get married in Vegas and then you backed out! I
guess I’m not upset because I don’t see you guys going through with it. I’m
sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, it’s going to happen. Chandler is gonna move in here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no, wait! Just let me finish, okay? This isn’t something that we
just, we just impulsively decided in-in Vegas, this is something we both really want. And
it is going to happen.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It is? Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, sweetie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starting to lose her composure) I mean we’re not, we’re not
gonna live together anymore?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Oh my God! I’m gonna miss you so much! (Starts to cry.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m gonna miss you! (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean it’s the end of an era!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!
[Scene: The hallway, Ross is coming up the stairs as Phoebe leaves Joey and
Chandler’s.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Joey and Chandler) Okay, bye!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So? Did you get the annulment?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I couldn’t.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I knew it! Because you love Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s not that. Okay? Annulments are more complicated than I…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, complicated ‘cause of the love.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I… I do, I do not love Rachel. I’m gonna tell her right now
about the whole thing so we can get this marriage annulled as fast as possible. Okay?
Would I do that if I loved her?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’ve never been more convinced of your love for her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I do not have feelings for Rachel! Okay?! (He goes into her apartment.)
[Cut to Monica and Rachel’s as Ross walks through the door. Rachel is holding the
chrome star and crying.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, what’s wrong?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica and Chandler are really moving in here and I have to move out and
everything is changing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my—Come here! Come here! (He hugs her.) It’s okay.
Everything’s gonna be okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course.
(Ross suddenly realizes something.)
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Phoebe are talking.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, Ross and Rachel got married, Monica and Chandler almost got married,
do you think you and I should hook up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh we do, but not just yet.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?! Well, when?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay umm, well, first Chandler and Monica will get married and be filthy
rich by the way. Yeah. But it won’t work out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. Then, I’m gonna marry Chandler for the money and
you’ll marry Rachel and have the beautiful kids.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But then we ditch those two and that’s when we get married.
We’ll have Chandler’s money and Rachel’s kids and getting custody will be
easy because of Rachel’s drinking problem.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-oh, what about Ross?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t want to go into the whole thing, but umm, we have words and
I kill him.

title: The One with Ross's Denial

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Joey, Monica, and Phoebe are there as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Check it out! This is unbelievable! Joey has been holding his
breath for almost four minutes!
(We see Joey who has puffed up his cheeks and Chandler nonchalantly reaches down and
pinches Joey’s nose shut. In a few seconds, Joey has to move because he’s now
forced to actually hold his breath.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) Dude! What are yo—you trying to kill me?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her room) Pheebs, I wanna ask you something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh, what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well since I’m movin’ out and-and you’re so
beautiful…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …how about I move in with you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, that would be great but then what do we do about Denise?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who’s Denise?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My roommate.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You have a roommate?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, Denise. Denise!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what is with the secrecy Phoebe? Huh? And what about this Denise, is
she cute?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs, I don’t understand. How can you have a roommate that none
of us know anything about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe because you never listen to anything that I say. I talk about her
all the time! DENISE!!!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Rach, listen I was thinkin’ uh, I’m gonna have an extra room
over at my place…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that’s true.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, why don’t you move in with me? It’ll be great! We could
stay up late, watch movies, and you know about Naked Thursday’s right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, yeah I think I’m gonna find my own place.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey-hey! I thought Naked Thursday’s was just our thing man!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross is reading a magazine, eating a cookie, and drinking some
coffee as Phoebe enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, what did Rachel say when you told her you were still married to her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, that. Umm, she took it really well.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You didn’t tell her did you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course not, because you’re in love with her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am not in love with her. She was very upset about having to move out so
I eh, didn’t tell her we were still married because she would only get more upset.
I-I just comforted her, as a friend.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What do you mean, comforted her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s nothing, I just gave her a hug.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah-ha! A classic sign of love, the hug!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s also a sign of friendship.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, not in your case Lovey Loverson. (Tries to take a bite out of
Ross’s cookie.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (grabs back his cookie) It was a hug!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, just tell me this, did you or did you not smell her hair?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: S-s-smell her hair? What if I did?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ninety percent of a women’s pheromones come out the top of her
head! That’s why, that’s why women are shorter. So that men will fall in love
when they hug them! (Ross is staring at her dumbfounded.) Oh come on Ross, you’re a
scientist.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was hugging her as a friend. It’s not my fault her-her hair got in
my face, she’s got a lot of it and it smells all-all uh…coconutty. (Phoebe
raises her eyebrows.) What?! Oh, that doesn’t mean I have feelings for Rachel! Maybe
it means I have feelings for coconuts!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (taking his coffee) Okay, whatever you say. But just be careful, all
right? Rachel’s not in the same place you are.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (grabbing back his coffee) If the place you are referring too is being in
love, then she is in the same place as me because I am not in that place!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I didn’t understand that, but y’know, maybe that’s
‘cause you were speaking the secret language of love!
(She goes for his magazine and he grabs it away before she reaches it. But she was only
using the magazine as a decoy because she grabs his cookie and coffee, takes a bite out of
the cookie and drinks some of the coffee.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler and Monica are there as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! (To Chandler) Dude, some guy just called for you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who was it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know! How about, "Thanks for taking the message."
Jeez! (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay listen, y’know when you move in Rachel’s room is gonna be
empty, you wanna talk about what we want to do with it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I was thinking we should have a beautiful guest room, right? With
a mahogany sleigh bed and bedside tables with flowers on them all the time! And we could
have a roll top desk with comment cards on them so people could say how much they loved
staying here!! Okay, whatever, I really haven’t thought about it that much.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I like that idea. Obviously! I was thinking maybe-maybe-maybe it
could be a game room, y’know? I mean you can buy old arcade games like uh, like Space
Invaders and Asteroids for $200, the real ones! The big-big ones!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay so you mean no as in, "Gee Chandler, what an interesting
idea. Let’s discuss it before we reject it completely."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. Of course I mean that. Interesting idea, umm, talk
about it, but no.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, that’s it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just don’t think arcade games go in the beautiful guest room. The
beautiful guest room is gonna be filled with antiques.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Which is why Asteroids is perfect! It’s the oldest game!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you have against the beautiful guest room?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t have anything against the beautiful guest room,
especially since everybody we know lives about 30 seconds away!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you mocking me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I’m not mocking you, (in a mocking voice) or you beautiful
guest room. (Exits.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler is coming from across the hall.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what’s up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing, Monica and I had a stupid fight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But you’re still moving in together, right? Because my ad came out
today. (Shows him the paper.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reading the ad) "Wanted. Female roommate, non-smoker,
non-ugly." Nice!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah? I just figured y’know, after living with you it’d be an
interesting change of pace to have a female roommate, y’know? Someone I can learn
from, someone-someone who’s different than me. And what’s more different than
me; a guy who’s not 19 than say a girl who is 19? Enh? (Points to his head.)
Not just a hat rack my friend!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is on the couch staring off into space as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, I have to ask you…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shhhhhh! I’m swamped right now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re just staring into space.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, I’m trying to move that pencil. (There’s a pencil lying
on the table.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This one? (Picks it up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It worked!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, this whole apartment thing is just a nightmare! Every place I
can afford comes with a roommate who is a freak. I mean, look at this; (Points to one and
starts to read it.) "Wanted. Female roommate, non-smoker, non-ugly." It’s
just, there is nothing! The city’s full!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, no, look at this! (Points to one.) (Reading) "Two bedroom,
two bath, must be non-smoker, Satan worshipers okay…" Oh, yeah, but it’s on
the ground floor.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, uh, you still looking for a place?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, there’s this guy, Warren, from the museum and he’s going
on a dig for like two years and he’s got this great place he needs to sublet. So uh,
you interested?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That sounds great! I’d love to live at Warren’s!! I love
Warren! Thank you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don’t thank me! If you wanna thank something, thank the volcano that
erupted thousands of years ago, killing but perfectly preserving an entire civilization.
(Rachel just looks at him.) Here’s Warren’s number.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, this is great! I am gonna call him right now! (Jumps up.) Oh, thank
you!
(She hugs him and he starts to hug her back but notices the look Phoebe is giving him
and pushes her away.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, you go grab it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I saw it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know what you’re talking about.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, I’m talking about that which you already know but won’t
admit. You love her again; you re-love her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I do not re-love her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t believe you won’t just admit it! (Pause) Okay, just
promise me that you won’t do anything stupid.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, we’re just friends now! Okay? Why would I do anything stupid?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (returning from calling Warren) Ugh!!! Well, the apartment is already
subletted! I mean, this is just hopeless. I’m never gonna find anything.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can live with me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Are you serious?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh. (Phoebe grunts.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I would love to live with you Ross; that’s-that’s great! Thank
you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’m-I’m just glad I could, y’know, help you out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! I’m-I’m so happy for you guys. (To Ross) This is so-so,
not stupid.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross-Ross, you have no idea what this means to me! I mean, I mean I was
gonna be homeless. You just saved me! You’re my hero!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hero, I uh, I don’t know—well, all right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I have to go tell Monica what a wonderful brother she has! (Kisses
him on the cheek and exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh please! (He sits down.) (To Phoebe) You’re gonna say things now,
aren’t ya?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. No, I won’t. But I should tell you this, this exact same thing
happened to my roommate Denise. She moved in with a guy who was secretly married to her
and he said he didn’t love her, but he really did, and it just blew up! And
that’s how she ended up living with me! (Ross looks at her.) (Pause) Okay,
that’s a lie.

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is in the kitchen as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, listen, I’m sorry about before. I don’t need to have a
game room. I mean when I was a kid I only played those games because I couldn’t get
girls, and now I can ‘em—Now, I have you. (Monica glares at him.) Not-not
that I think that I have you or think of you as property in any sort of way, I see
women…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Stop it Chandler. (Chandler is relieved) I’m sorry too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! Oh yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Listen, we don’t have to make that a guest room, we can think of
something to do with the room together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s a great idea! We can easily think of a way for us
both to enjoy the room.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Totally!
(They start thinking.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We don’t have to come up with this now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, y’know what? Why don’t we think about changes we can
make in the living room?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Changes?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I mean we’re gonna have to move around some furniture to
make room for my chair. (Kisses her and heads into the living room.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re-you’re-you’re gonna bring the Barca Lounger over
here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is that a problem?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it’s a set and they should probably stay together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that’s cool. Then I’ll just bring them both over.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See now-now you’re taking them away from their home.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I get it. So, I get nothing! Nothing here is mine! Everything
here is yours! I’ll get up in the morning put on your clothes, and head off to work!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, y’know what? Yeah, that’s it-that’s it,
everything will be mine! Nothing will be yours! That’s-that’s what I said! Oh
come on, Chandler! I’m talking about the barca lounger! It just, it doesn’t
match! Where is it gonna go?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: In the game room!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look it is not my fault that your chairs are incredibly ugly!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right! That’s fine! That’s fine! I won’t bring over
the chairs! I won’t bring anything over! I wouldn’t want to ruin the ambiance
over here at Grandma’s place!! (Storms out.)
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is interviewing a potential roommate. And yes,
she’s a female, non-smoker and very non-ugly.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (exiting from Chandler’s room with the new roommate) Everything on
your application looks really good—Ohh! Just one last question umm, are you and your
friends gonna be over here all the time like partying and hanging out?

lines.speaker: The Potential Roommate
lines.text: Oh don’t worry, I’m not really a party girl.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa!! Now look, don’t be just blurtin’ stuff out. I want you to
really think about your answers. Okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) You can call off the roommate search! (To the potential
roommate) Hi! I’ll be living here. (Heads for the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh don’t listen to him, he’s just some guy who really wants the
apartment, but I don’t think he’s gonna get it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why did you take the shower curtain down?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That thing was a hazard! (To the potential roommate) I’m very safety
conscious.
[Scene: Ross’s Apartment, Rachel is entering and Ross is making some room on the
shelves for his stuff.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Oh listen, I was just clearing some space for your stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh thanks, but listen, I was just at Monica’s and she and Chandler
had a big fight and they’re not moving in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do you mean, they’re not moving in? They-they’re still
moving in right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no, they just had a big blowout over what to do with my room.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! Over a stupid room!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I feel kinda bad for them, but I’m also really psyched
‘cause I don’t have to move in here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no, yeah no, that part’s great!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Ross is entering, dragging Chandler, to mediate the
argument between Chandler and Monica.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s all this about you guys fighting?! Is this really over a
room?! I mean, that is so silly!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, we can handle this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, apparently not, and I can’t just stand by and watch two people
I care about very much be hurt over something that is so silly. I mean, enough of the
silliness!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, why don’t you tell her to stop being silly! (Monica mocks
him and he joins in.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stopping them) Okay-okay! Two very good points, look I’ve known you
both a long time, and I’ve never seen either of you one/millionth as happy as
you’ve been since you’ve got together. Do you really want to throw that all away
over a room? That is so silly. Now wh-what is more important, love or silliness?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, we are fond of the silliness, but we also have a soft spot for
the love.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Love is the best medicine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s laughter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why do you do it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! All right! Now, Chandler you-you wanna live with Monica, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And Mon, you wanna live with Chandler, don’t ya?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (jumping up) Good! A verbal contract is binding in the state of New York!
(Storms out.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Rachel is sitting at the counter waiting for Gunther, yep
Gunther’s back, to refill her coffee.]

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: So I understand you’re looking for a place.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no, I’m staying put.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Oh, I was going to offer you my apartment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why, where are you going?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re never gonna believe it uh, Monica and Chandler are moving in
again. That’s great news right—I mean for them. Right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah but, on the bright side, we get to be roommates again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Y’know umm, uh, umm, about that, umm, Ross I really
appreciate your offer to let me move in and everything, but don’t you think it’s
gonna be weird?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wh-why?! Why-why-why would it, why would it be weird?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, because of us! Because of our history.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! It would be weird if we were still in that place, I mean are you
still in that place?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Not at all!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good! Me neither! So it’s not a problem. We’re just two friends
who happen to be roommates.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, but Ross, eventually you and I are gonna be dating.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?! We are?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! I’m gonna have a boyfriend, you’re gonna have a
girlfriend…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh! That would be great.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But y’know what, if you think it’s gonna be okay we’ll
just work out a system. Y’know, it’ll be like college, I’ll hang a hanger
on the door and put a sign, "Come back later, I’m gettin’ lucky."
(Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (laughs as well, but for a different reason) Yeah, I didn’t think of
that.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler is once again being dragged in by Ross so he that
he can try to manipulate the situation so that it’s best for Ross, not necessarily
what’s best for Monica and Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So are you sure about this whole moving in thing?! I mean it’s a really
big step! And-and what’s the rush?!
(They both start laughing at him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s very funny!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He’s being silly, because he knows that we enjoy the silliness!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I-I-I’m serious, okay? I mean, think about it. You move in, you
start fighting over stupid game rooms, next thing y’know you break up!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, you were right before, it was just a stupid fight about a room.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, there are no stupid fights!! This isn’t about the room, this is
about what the room…represents! And unfortunately, this room (Points to Rachel’s
room) could destroy you!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I'm not so worried.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, no, me neither.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine! It’s your life! (Starts to storm out mad about his failed
attempt at the manipulation of his best friend and sister, but stops and tries one last
time.) I just don’t want to see you guys break up! Which you will do if you
move in together, (Monica and Chandler just stare at him.) but that’s what you want,
there’s nothing I can do. (Opens the door and tries one more time.) DON’T DO
IT!!!!! (Finally leaves.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You still want to move in together right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross didn’t scare you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Scared me out of ever wanting to live with him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come here, I want to show you something!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!
(They run to the living room where Monica has moved the chair back (Towards the step),
the coffee table forward (Towards the TV), and taped a square outline on the floor.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God! Someone’s killed Square Man!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is where I thought the barca lounger could go! You see you could
see the TV and it’s still walking distance to the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s so sweet! I want to show you something too!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know those big-big uh, road signs that say "Merge?"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know? So I was thinking that we could get one of those signs
and hang it over our bed. Because, that’s you and I together! Merge!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! I love that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, no!!
[Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe is singing a new song. Yep, the first new Phoebe song of
season six, Ross, Joey, and Rachel are also there.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) I found you in my bed!
How’d you whined up there?
You are a mystery!
Little black curly hair!
Little black curly hair!
Little black, little black, little black, little black, little black curly
(Applause.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now if you want to receive e-mails about my upcoming shows, then please
give me money so I can buy a computer.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) So umm, where are the other guys?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, well let’s see Monica and Chandler are occupied.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fighting?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, the other thing. I really think it’s great they work things
out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. There’s no breaking them up, is there?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, can I borrow the key to your house so I can run across the street
and make a copy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure! Here. (Hands her his keys.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (Gets up) Now are you sure? Because once I make a copy,
there’s no turning back.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I’m-I’m sure. (Deadpan) Yeah, get out of here before I
change my mind. (She exits)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm, listen, Ross do you really think this moving in with Rachel is a good
idea?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’ve been back and forth.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah well, maybe you should go back! Okay? Rachel moves in, and before you
know it you’re right where you don’t want to be! Back together!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ehh, I don’t, I don’t think so. She’s already talked about
y’know, dating other guys.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s not gonna work out! Then she’s gonna come home all weepy
and you’ll be tellin’ her, "Oh that’s okay. You’ll find
someone." And then, bamn! She finds you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well, m-maybe you’re right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I am telling you Ross, she is definitely gonna fall in love with you
again! Now, is that what you want?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is that what I want?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (on the microphone, accidentally) Yes.
(Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here she comes. Hold on, I’m gonna make your life much easier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, well the place was closed. I’ll just copy it later.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or not. Uh, Rach, why don’t you just move in with me? (Rachel sighs.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa, Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no-no-no-no-no-no… It’s okay, I mean I—look Rach, I
know I scared you off with that whole Naked Thursday’s thing, but we don’t have
to do that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it would be easier to move just right across the hall. Wait a
minute, unless you’re thinking about Naked Wednesday’s.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thursday’s clearly not good for ya, pick a day!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey has The Potential Roommate back for another
interview.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (opening the door to The Potential Roommate) Hi!

lines.speaker: The Potential Roommate
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come in. Thanks for comin’ back, umm, okay there have been a lot of
people interested in the room, but I have narrowed it down and you are one of the
finalists!

lines.speaker: The Potential Roommate
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay now, before I make my final decision I uh, I just want to make sure
our personalities match. Okay, so I made up a little test. Now, I’m gonna say a word
and then you say the first thing that comes to mind.

lines.speaker: The Potential Roommate
lines.text: I can do that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay! Here we go. Pillow.

lines.speaker: The Potential Roommate
lines.text: Fight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Very good! Okay. G.

lines.speaker: The Potential Roommate
lines.text: String?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Excellent! Okay umm, doggy.

lines.speaker: The Potential Roommate
lines.text: Kitten?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, sorry! No-no-no, so close though, but—bye-bye! (He ushers her
out the door.)

title: The One Where Joey Loses His Insurance

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Rachel is packing her belongings to move to Ross’s.
She’s standing in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, which of this kitchen stuff is mine?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This bottle opener. (She grabs it off of the freezer door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And it’s a magnet!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look at that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How weird is that? Y’know? You’re moving in with me and have the
one thing I don’t have. It’s like uh, in a way you-you complete me
(Phoebe glares at him) kitchen.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in an Australian accent) You complete me kitchen, matey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, I know what you’re thinking.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That she’s gonna move in with you and maybe then she’ll fall
in love with you and then when she finds out you’re already married, she’ll just
be happy. Y’know? You’re just, you’re very sad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh…my…God! I-I see what this is! You are in love with
Rachel!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course! It all adds up! I mean you you’re obsessed with her.
It’s always, "Ross, what are you gonna do about Rachel?" "Ross,
why-why are you moving in with Rachel?" "When are you gonna confess your secret
marriage to Rachel?" You want her!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! (Ross’s phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (answering it) Uh-oh, saved by the bell. (On phone) Hello?
[Cut to the living room where Monica is helping pack a box.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Rach, aren’t these candlesticks (holds up a pair) mine?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no, I bought those.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh! Yeah, I forgot.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. (Rachel walks away.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (under her breath) That you’re a liar. (Hides the candlesticks in a
drawer.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) No-no-no, that’s great! I’ll be there Monday. And
thank you again! (Listens) Okay. (Hangs up) (To All) Umm, that was the head of the
Paleontology department at N uh, Y, uh U!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! Uh what, did he uh, say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well remember that paper I had published last year on sediment flow rate,
huh? They loved it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, who wouldn’t?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know! Anyway, they asked me to be a guest lecturer! I mean it’s
temporary, but uh, if they like me it could lead to a full time job. How great would that
look great on a mailbox, huh? "Professor Geller."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, Professor and Mrs.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And Mrs.?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Yeah, y’know you and Ross are still married.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just kidding!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! Oh God! (Laughs her way into the living room.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Ross) Saved your ass.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey, Monica, Rachel, and Chandler are all there as Phoebe enters
dejectedly.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, what’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, you know that psychic I see?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, she told me that I’m gonna die this week, so I’m kinda
bummed about that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and I know you guys don’t know a lot about psychic readings,
but that one is pretty much the worse one you can get.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe that’s crazy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can’t believe she would say that too you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah honey you don’t believe her do you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t—she said y’know that I’d have triplets! But
she also said one of them would be black.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Just out of curiosity did she tell you how you’re gonna go?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, ‘cause she didn’t tell me I was gonna die until the very
end of the session, and I was not gonna waste a whole another hour there! I mean I’ve
only got a week left, y’know? I’ve really gotta start living now! (So she
picks up the latest copy of Car and Driver (a U.S. auto magazine), leans back, and
starts reading.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey everyone!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey uh, well, today’s my first lecture and I kinda wanted to try it
out on you guys, do you, do you mind?
(They pause to think about it.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh that’d be great. Sure!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he starts reading directly from his cards word for word very quietly)
"There are three primary theories concerning sediment flow rate. Each of these
theories can be further subcategorized into two distinct…"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, this is it. This what’s gonna kill me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (continuing) "…subcategories. The first of these subcategories
is…"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (interrupting him) Uh Ross! Are there uh, are there naked chicks on that
piece of paper?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I’ve just never seen a guy stare so hard at a piece of paper
that didn’t have naked chicks on it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh! Okay! Okay. (Resumes reading word for word from the card) "There
are three (pauses and looks at Joey) primary theories concerning sediment flow rate.
(Pauses and darts his eyes between Chandler and Rachel.) (Rachel starts laughing) Each of
these theories (glances at Phoebe) can be further subcategorized (glances at Chandler)
into…"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why don’t you open with a joke?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Open with a joke? It’s a university, not a comedy club!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait a minute, hold the phone! You’re not talking about
Chuckles University?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (gets up) Okay!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh! We’re kidding! Oh, we’re kidding!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, hey you know what might make it less boring?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Some uh, some visual aides.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-ooh-ooh! Y’know what’s a good visual aide?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please don’t say naked chicks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I-I-I don’t even know why I bother to talk to you guys about it.
Y’know what? I’m just gonna do it on my own with no naked chicks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s the way I did it ‘til I was 19.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is playing that string game with the two hands and
the weird crossing patterns as Chandler enters with the mail.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Any good mail?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, you got something from the Screen Actor’s Guild.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, it’s probably a residual check, hey can you open it for me,

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (opens and reads it) "Benefits lapsed."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hmm that’s weird. I don’t remember being in a move called
benefits lapsed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, it’s not a check. They’re saying your health insurance
expired because, you didn’t work enough last year.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let me see that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (reads it) Oh, I can’t believe this! This sucks! When I had insurance
I could get hit by a bus or catch on fire, y’know? And it wouldn’t matter. Now I
gotta be careful?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry man, there’s never a good time to (pauses) stop
catching on fire.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right well, I guess I gotta go get a job. I’m gonna go see my
agent.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, make sure you look both ways before you cross the street.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (mocks him, in a whiney voice) …look both ways before you cross the
street. (Turns and walks headlong into the closed door.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe enters to find Rachel still packing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, you’re still alive! How are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh, it’s so exhausting waiting for death. Ohh, by the way,
do you think you could—(Groans, hacks, and then freezes with her eyes open and her
tongue hanging out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, what-what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I was preparing you for my—didn’t you think I was dead? Did
that not come off?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, scared the hell out of me. I thought we’d lost you
forever. Pheebs, you lie down?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, thanks. And listen, can you do me a favor? Could you just umm,
wake me up in a couple hours, y’know if you can.
(Phoebe goes and lies down as Rachel opens the drawer Monica hid the candlesticks in
and as Monica walks out of her room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hmm? (Rachel holds up the candlesticks.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did-did you take these back?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no, I-I just, I liked them so much that I went out and bought some
for myself.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, they’re really great! Aren’t they?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I loved them!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. (Monica walks away) Nice try! (Rachel puts them in a box.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hello!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How’d the lecture go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It went great! And I didn’t need any jokes or naked chicks either!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, that’s great Ross, I’m sorry we weren’t more
supportive before.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I knew all I had to do was let the material speak for itself.
Everyone’s all, "Ross you have to be funny and sexy." Well, I proved them
wrong! And now, I’m gonna pass the news onto Joey and Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That you’re not funny or sexy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right!

scenes.location: Estelle Leonard Theatrical Agency, Joey is there to see his agent.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey Estelle, listen…

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Well! Well! Well! Joey Tribbiani! So you came back huh? They think
they can do better but they all come crawling back to Estelle!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you talkin’ about? I never left you! You’ve always been
my agent!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Oh well, no harm, no foul.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Estelle, you gotta get me some work. I-I lost my health insurance.

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: All right, first thing we gotta do, damage control.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Well, I think uhh, someone out there may have been bad mouthing you all
over town.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bastard!
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler enters to find Joey lying in the fetus position
on the floor.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in obvious pain) Hey! So Estelle lined up a bunch of auditions for me
tomorrow and I’ll have my health insurance back in no time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s great, but shouldn’t you be on the toilet right now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s wrong with you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing! Well, I-I got this blinding pain in my stomach when I was lifting
weights before, then I uh passed out and uh, haven’t been able to stand up since. But
um, I don’t think it’s anything serious.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This sounds like a hernia. You have to—you-you go to the doctor!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No way! ‘Kay look, if I have to go to the doctor for anything
it’s gonna be for this thing sticking out of my stomach! (Rolls over and shows
Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s a hernia.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why did I have to start working out again? (Looks at the weights he was
using.) Damn you 15s!
[Scene: a NYU lecture hall, Rachel and Monica are arriving to talk to Ross after the
lecture, but are there early.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, we’re a little early, the lecture doesn’t end for 15
minutes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but y’know we could sneak in and watch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, we could. Oh hey look! There’s some Kappa Kappa Deltas! I was
a Kappa. (to them) Hey sisters! (They ignore her.) (To Monica) Wow, we really are bitches.
(They enter the lecture hall to find Ross speaking in an English accent for some
unknown reason.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the class) Right! So when Rigby got his samples back from the
laboratory he made a startling discovery! What he believed to be igneous, was in fact
sedimentary. Imagine his consternation when—(sees Monica and Rachel.) Oh bloody hell.
Commercial Break
[Scene: a NYU lecture hall, the scene is continued from earlier, only Ross has
dismissed the class and is now talking to Monica and Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What the hell are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I was nervous! You guys had me all worried I was going to be boring!
I got up there and they were all like staring at me. I opened my mouth and this British
accent just came out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and not a very good one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Will you-will you please?
(Another professor walks down from the back of the lecture hall.)

lines.speaker: The Professor
lines.text: Dr. Geller, Kurt Rathman, I’m a professor in the
paleontology department here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: The Professor
lines.text: Do you have a moment to talk about your lecture?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in his British accent) I’m sorry, I’ve got plans with my
sister.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (in an Irish accent) Monica Gellerrr. (She rolls her ‘R’)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in accent) Right, will you excuse us for one moment? (Takes Monica
aside.) (In his normal voice.) What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (normal voice) Oh, you can have an accent and I can’t?! (To an
exiting student in accent.) Top ‘O the morning to ya laddies!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just please stop!
(They turn back to Rachel and Professor Rathman.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (in an Indian accent) Yes, yes, Bombay is bery, bery nice time of year.
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler is reading on the couch while Joey, still suffering from
his hernia, is returning with coffee for them both. After a series of grunts and groans he
manages to painfully walk back from the counter, sit down, and slide Chandler his coffee.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, will you grab me a cruller? (Joey starts to groan and get up.)
Sit down! Will you go to the hospital?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude! Hernia operations cost like, a lot probably. Besides it’s
getting darker and more painful, that means it’s healing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I will loan you the money. Just go to the hospital and let’s just
get that thing…pushed back in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you, but it would take me forever to pay you that money back and I
don’t want that hanging over my head. Okay? Besides, as soon as my insurance kicks in
I can get all the free operations I want! Yeah, I’m thinking I’ll probably start
with that laser eye surgery too.
(Phoebe enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh Joey’s got a really bad hernia, but that’s nothing a
little laser eye surgery won’t fix!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I’m telling you if I put my hand on my stomach right here (He
puts his hand down his pants, like Al Bundy on Married…With Children always
used to do.) it doesn’t hurt that bad.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Maybe you’ll die!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, now I’m scared.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, we can go together! Just don’t wait too long though, okay?
‘Cause I’m outta here sometime before Friday.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but I don’t wanna die!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no, it’ll be fun! We can come back and we can haunt these guys!
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are having a tug-of-war over the
disputed candlesticks.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Gimme ‘em!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! They are mine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You stole them from me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You stole them from me!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Gimme them!
(With one last mighty tug the combatants lose their grip and split, each holding one
candlestick.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You just wanna each take one?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah that seems fair. We never use them.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Look, I really need some help, okay? Why? Why did I have to
speak in a British accent?! What do I do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don’t you phase it out? Yeah, fade the accent out and people
will think you’re, y’know, that you’re adjusting to life in America.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I mean, come on Ross, no one will even notice. I mean they’re
probably not even listening!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They’re not listening too me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Of course they’re listening to you! Everybody listens to you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica you really think I should try this phasing out thing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think you look fine.
[Scene: Casting Director #1’s office, Joey is on his first audition. His partner
is an 8-year-old boy.]
Casting Director #1: Whenever you’re ready.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in a gravely, painful voice) Okay. "Hey, Timmy, I’ve got a
surprise for you."
Casting Director #1: Hold it. I’m sorry, the surprise is a new swing set,
if you could play it a little less…intense?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, sure, no problem, I’ll just—hold on one second. (He
turns around and puts his hand in his pants and groans in relief.) (In a relaxed voice.)
"Hey Timmy, I’ve got a surprise for you!"
Casting Director #1: Oh my God!!
(Joey pulls his hand out and reverts back to intense pain.)
[Scene: Casting Director #2’s office, Joey is on his second audition. This one is
for Purina One Dog Chow, an actual item. Please note the gratuitous product
placement.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So that’s why I feed my dog Purina One! Pick up a bag today!
(He turns, looks at the bag and realizes he won’t be able to pick it up.)
Casting Director #2: That’s where you pick up the bag.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Exactly.
Casting Director #2: No, the line is pick a bag, so you need to pick up the bag.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or, I could just point to it! Huh? Blah, blah, blah, Purina One,
point to a bag today. (She just looks at him.) I didn’t get it, did I?
Casting Director #2: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, okay. (Leaves)

scenes.location: Casting Director #3’s office, Joey is entering.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi. I’m Joey Tribbiani; I’m here to audition for (Groans) man.
Casting Director #3: You mean dying man?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica and Rachel are playing phone pranks on Ross.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, come on, do it one more time!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! (Picks up the phone and starts dialing.) (In an Irish accent)
"Hello Ross, this is Dr. McNeeley from the Fake Accent University, we’d like you
to come on board with us full time! (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Listen to this! My reading was wrong, I’m not going die!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?! How do you know?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because my psychic is dead! She must’ve read the cards wrong!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Eh, better her than me! Hey, let’s bake cookies!
[Scene: Silvercup Studios, Joey has won the part of dying man and is now able to play
the role he was injured for. Chandler is helping to carry him in.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen, I’m really glad you got the part.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (barely audible through the pain) Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But are you sure you can do this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! And hey, thanks for coming with me. And thanks again for helping me
take a shower.
(Chandler steps away quickly.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now, is that never talking about it again?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the director) Hiya!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Hey Joey, we’re ready for ya! (Joey stumbles over) Joey, this
is Alex he’s going to be playing your son.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi Alex! (to the director) And uh, as you can see my hands are not in my
pants. (Holds them both up.)

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Okay. (to Alex) All right uh, Alex now when Joey says his line,
"Take good care of your Momma son," that’s your cue to cry. Got it? (Alex
nods yes.) All right, let’s do this.
(Joey lies down on the gurney.)

lines.speaker: A Crew Member
lines.text: (with that board thingy) Scene 5, take 1.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: And Action!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "Take could care of your Momma son." (Alex just looks at him and
the director motions for him to continue so he tries it again.) "Take could care of
your Momma son." (Alex does nothing.) "Come on son! Your Momma’s good
people!"

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Cut! Alex, remember you’re supposed to cry. Can you cry for
us this time?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: All right, from the top.

lines.speaker: A Crew Member
lines.text: Scene 5, take 2.
[Time lapse.]

lines.speaker: A Crew Member
lines.text: Take 36 is up!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: All right! Let’s try this again! You ready Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, just one thing umm, is it all right with you if I, if I scream right
up until you say action?

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Uh sure.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (Starts screaming.)

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Action!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (he stops screaming at action) "Take good care of your Momma
son." (Again Alex does nothing.)

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Cut!!!!!!!!!! (Joey starts screaming again.)
(Chandler decides to help out.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry! Hey-hey Joe, why don’t you uh, lift up your
shirt? (He does.) Take a look at this kiddo. (Alex finally starts crying.) We
have a crying child! Roll the damn cameras!

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel’s apartment, Rachel is unpacking as the phone rings.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (answering it) Hello?

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: (Ross’s divorce lawyer.) Hello, is Ross there?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh no, he’s not. Can I take a message?

lines.speaker: Russell
lines.text: Yes, this Russell, Ross’s divorce lawyer, just tell him that since
I haven’t heard from him, I assume he’s decided to give the marriage a try.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross got married again—Nooooooo!!!!!!!!!

scenes.location: a NYU lecture hall, Ross is trying to phase out his accent.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in his head) All right, keep going. We are phasing the accent out,
phasing it out. So without out re-testing the results in the laboratory (pronounced
the British way) the team would never have identified (British) the initial errors in
their carbon dating analysis (British). Were there any questions at this point? (One
student raises his hand.) Yes. (Points to him.)

lines.speaker: A Student
lines.text: What’s happening to your accent?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (British) Come again? What’s-what’s this nonsense? (Giggles.)
(American.) All right, I’m-I’m not English. I’m from Long Island. I was
really nervous and the accent just uh, just came out. I’m sorry. So, if we could just
get back to the lecture. Umm, were there any questions? (Everyone raises their hands)
About paleontology. (They all put their hands down.) All right, look I was just trying to
make a good first impression. Obviously, I screwed up. But what you guys think of me is
really important because I’m-I’m hoping to get a permanent job here. So if you
just give me another chance to make a good impression…
(At this moment Rachel bursts through the door. Needless to say, she’s not in the
best of moods having just found out Ross’s dirty little secret.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross!! Are you crazy?! I am still your wife!! What, were you just
never gonna tell me?!! What the hell is wrong with you?!!!! Ugh, I could just kill you!!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in the accent again) Well, hello Rachel!
Ending Credits
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is holding a football helmet; and apparently, in a
rather disgusting scene, Joey wants Phoebe to beat him senseless. (Luckily it isn’t a
long trip.) Because he’s made a miraculous recovery from his hernia and wants to take
advantage of all those free surgeries he can get now since he’s re-established his
health insurance.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Have you really done this before?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! You just take a big, big swing. Now, don’t hold
back. (He dons his protective helmet (Why, I have no clue.) and Phoebe picks up a wooden
baseball bat and starts to swing as Chandler and Monica enter.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We’re just celebrating that Joey got his health insurance back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, all right.
(Decided that they are less than human as well, Chandler picks up a golf club and
Monica a frying pan, to join in on the fun of beating their good friend to within an inch
of his life!)

title: The One with Joey's Porsche

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the gang is there except for Rachel and Ross, who both
come storming in. Rachel is still going off about Ross’s secret marriage.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I cannot believe that you didn’t tell me that we are still
married!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look I was going to tell you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: When?! After the birth of our first secret child?! (To All) Ross
didn’t get the annulment; we are still married.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re kidding!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (overdoing it) Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, maybe it wasn’t my best decision. But I just couldn’t face
another failed marriage.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, let me just jump in and ask, at what point did you think this
was a successful marriage?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, come on, if you think about it, it’s actually kinda funny. (He
laughs, and he laughs alone.) Okay, maybe it’s best not to think about it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, this is inexcusable. I am shocked to my very core!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, I told her you already knew.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Another lie. You have a sickness!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross, just for my own piece of mind, you’re not married to
anymore of us are ya?
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Monica are at the counter getting some more coffee.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Hey, somebody left their keys. (Looks at them) Ooohh, to a Porsche!
{Transcriber’s note: Oh come on! Who would leave the keys to their Porsche behind? If
I had a Porsche, I’d have the keys surgically attached to my hand!} Hey Gunther,
these yours?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Yeah, that’s what I drive. I make four bucks an hour, I saved up
for 350 years!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Na-uh! (To everyone there) Hey did anybody lose their keys?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, why don’t you put them in the lost and found?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There’s a lost and found? (Gunther sets the box up on the table.) My
shoe! (Grabs it out of the box.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You left a shoe here?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I didn’t realize until I got home. I wasn’t gonna walk all
the way back down here with one shoe! Y’know what? I’m gonna go find that
guy’s car and leave a note on the windshield. (Goes to do so.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh good, when he comes back for his keys, I’ll be sure to give
him your shoe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! Thanks. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (coming in from the bathroom) Oh, good, good, you guys are here! Listen,
how would like to spend tomorrow taking care of three incredibly cute little puppies?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, what a fun day! That sounds great!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (not enthused) Yeah, all right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well I’ll bring them by tomorrow morning. Okay, and uh, by
the way, they’re not actually puppies, they’re Frank and Alice’s triplets.
Okay, see ya! (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa! What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (stops) Please! Please! Please! Please! Oh please! Please! Please! Frank
and Alice asked me to baby sit the triplets and I’m nervous ‘cause I’ve
never done that before by myself!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don’t worry about it Phoebe, we’ll absolutely do it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’m gonna pass. ‘Cause I was kinda iffy when it was
puppies.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on Chandler, come on! It’ll give us great practice for
when—(realizes what she’s about to say and changes)—people with babies come
to visit.
[Scene: The street down the block from Central Perk, Joey has found the Porsche and is
writing the note.]
Guy #1: Nice car!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it’s not mine.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (walking up) I love your car.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it’s (looks up and sees the woman) mine.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I bet it’s fast.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too! Yeah. And comfortable. Do uh, do you like leather seats?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (checks in the window to make sure it has them) It’s got ‘em!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe and Rachel are having tea.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, I still have boxes here. I still have boxes at Ross’s, and
I have nowhere to live! Wow. I could so easily freak out right now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What about me? I just found out that Denise is leaving town for a while,
I don’t have a roommate.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, maybe-maybe I could be your roommate Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe you could be my roommate!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well there’s an idea!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That would be great! Wait, how long is Denise gone for?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, she said she’d be back December 26th.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: December 26th, huh maybe she’s Santa Clause.
(Phoebe laughs, then stops to think about it. Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (deadpan) Oh look who it is, my husband. The apple of my eye.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I got us a court date for tomorrow at 2:00 and I picked up all the
forms. I’ll take care of everything.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well sure, if you say you’re gonna take care of everything I have
no reason to doubt you. Give me those forms! (Grabs them from him.) All right, now
I’m gonna do this my way and I don’t want to hear a peep out of you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay Rach, but…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Op! You’re peeping!
(Ross grunts something and hands her the pen he was trying to hand her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! Y’know what, I just got—why? Why did you do this?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look I told you…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t wanna hear "Three failed marriages!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, if you’d had two failed marriages, you’d understand!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know what? Thanks to you I’m half way there! Ugh! Oh!
I am so mad! Ross, I don’t think I have ever been this angry!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What about the time I said we were on a break?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh! (Stares at him.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the next day, Chandler, Monica, and Phoebe are
baby-sitting the triplets. They each have one baby.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Pheebs, how’s it going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (rapidly) I’m doing okay. I think it’s going well. Do you
think they’re having fun? Am I talking to fast?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nope, sound like me. Pheebs, it’s going great. Look at Chandler
with little baby girl Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Little baby girl Chandler, where I have heard that before? Oh right,
Coach Ruben. (Tries to get her to drink a little more from the bottle when he suddenly
smells something. It’s times like these I’m glad Smell-O-Vision hasn’t been
invented.) Do you know what Pheebs? When you’re done over there, we kinda have a
situation over here too. (Phoebe is changing hers.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Na-uh, no, we are all responsible for our own babies.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See that’s where I think that you’re wrong. We’ve been
playing these babies man for man; we should really be playing a zone defense.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I just think that things would go a lot smoother if we each have our
own zone. Phoebe, you can be in charge of wiping. And y’know Mon, you can be in
charge of diapering and I can be in charge of looking how cute they are when they put
their hands around… (He degrades into baby talk, but he means when they grab his
finger.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That sounds really great, but maybe you should be in charge of wiping.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I’m a rookie. I should not be in the end zone.
[Time lapse, they have set up a little assembly line for diaper changes. Phoebe wipes,
Chandler adds the powder, begrudgingly, and Monica puts the diaper on.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is so great! This is exactly how we set the plates at the
restaurant.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah? (Checking the final diaper) Well this is not what I ordered.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey babies! Oh, I’m having the best morning. That uh, that Porsche
I’ve got the keys too, still there!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Shocking! Since you still have the keys.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You should see the treatment I get when I’m with that car! People are
friendly; they-they wanna talk, and not just about the car! One guy gave me advice about
my equity investments.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What equity investments?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The ones that got me the Porsche! Will you keep up! (Chandler wipes his
forehead with a baby wipe, that might have been used. He drops it disgustedly.) But I
figured, if-if people keep seeing me just standing there, they’re gonna start to
think that I don’t own it. So I figured I’ll wash it. Right? Monica, you got a
bucket and some soap I can borrow?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah, I got soap and sponges and rags and Carnuba wax and polishing
compound.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t even have a car!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know. But umm, one time there was this really dirty car in front of
the building, so I washed it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And six others.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There you are.
[Scene: The Porsche, Joey is finishing up washing the car and is talking to a guy about
the car.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, she tops out at 130.
Guy #2: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And that’s just in the city. I get her up to 160 when I take her
upstate.
Guy #2: Really! You got a place upstate?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure!
Guy #2: Well, I’ll see you later.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, take it easy.

lines.speaker: The Porsche Owner
lines.text: Hey! That’s my car.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? Oh uh, oh just give me five more minutes with it.

lines.speaker: The Porsche Owner
lines.text: What-what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh I-I uh, found the keys and now I’m just polishing her up.

lines.speaker: The Porsche Owner
lines.text: But it’s my car!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but it’s my wax.

lines.speaker: The Porsche Owner
lines.text: Listen, I-I-I don’t come to this city much so I
don’t know if you’re crazy or this is some kind of street theater, but could I
have my keys.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure. Here. (He hands them over.) I’ll uh, save your parking spot.

lines.speaker: The Porsche Owner
lines.text: I’m not coming back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: The Porsche Owner
lines.text: I live upstate.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, so did I.
(The guy gets in and drives off.)
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the triplets are all in their crib as Monica and Phoebe
watch them.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know why I was so nervous about this. And I don’t know
why Frank and Alice are always complaining. This is so easy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, two hours, a lifetime that’s the same.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Check it out! Check it out! When the babies wake up, they
can meet Krog! (He holds up this Xena-like warrior action figure.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, what are you doing? That thing can put someone’s eye out!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He can do more than that! He can destroy the universe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No Chandler, they can swallow one of those little parts! And also, look
at his smooth area, that’s just gonna mess them up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They’re not gonna swallow anything, you guys are being way over
protective. When I was a kid, my mom used to just throw me into a pile of broken glass!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Glass, sand, whatever. (Walks out as Monica and Phoebe turn to check
on the babies again.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, look at little Leslie stretching in her sleep.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh it’s so cute. I wonder what age it is when you stop being able
to put both legs over your head.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I can still do that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How are you still single?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) All right. (Clears throat) I thought about it and maybe
you’re right. Maybe Krog is not a safe toy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good. What made you change your mind?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I swallowed the sonic blaster gun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How did that happen?!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I was trying to prove that I was right. Y’know? And it
turns out I was wrong. And now it’s lodged in my throat. (Mimics a cat trying to
cough up a hairball.) (He does it again.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Damnit! Y’know this whole time we were concentrating on watching
the babies and, and no one was watching Chandler! (He does it again.)

scenes.location: A judge’s chambers, Rachel and Ross are filing their annulment papers.

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: Okay you two are asking the court for an annulment?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes your honor, and here are, are forms, all filled out.

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: So based on your petition you are seeking an annulment on the grounds
that Mr. Geller is mentally unstable.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, I’m mentally unstable.

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: And based on the fact that Mr. Geller is intravenous drug user.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh yes, heroin and crack.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Crack isn’t even an intravenous drug!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you would know.

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: Now it also says here that you lied about your sexual preference before
marriage?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, come on!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starts to cry) Ross, please, I found the magazines!

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: And finally that you were unable to consummate the marriage. Well, that
makes sense since you’re gay and addicted to heroin.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I’m sorry, this is insane! I-I-I’m not addicted to heroin,
