I’m not gay, and there is no problem with my ability to consummate anything!
Look, I’ll consummate this marriage right here, right now!

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: That won’t be necessary.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And when we were dating we consummated like bunnies!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: Now if you were two involved in a serious relationship, that really
creates a problem.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! Your honor, rest assured relationship ended like two years ago!
(To the stenographer) And could you strike "Consummated like bunnies" from the
record?

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: Is there, anything in this record that is actually true?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, yes, we got married in Vegas and uh, and the names I think.

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: Well, based on what I heard, you two certainly don’t qualify for an
annulment. If you two don’t want to be together you’ll have to file for divorce.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stands up) That’s great! Are you happy now? Look what you did with
your funny, funny form!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stands up as well) What?! Me?! What about you and your consummated like
bunnies nonsense!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And what—(notices the stenographer is still typing)—What are you
typing that for? Did you hear what she said? We don’t get the annulment. Don’t
type that! What?! Stop typing! (He goes over to where the stenographer is typing and in
the process pushes Rachel out of his way.) Hey! Stop typing! (He’s still typing.)
Stop typing! Stop typing!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to the judge) Okay, do you see, do you see what you’re keeping me
married too?!

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: You need to get out of my chambers.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right look lady here is the deal, I came here for an annulment and I
am not leaving here until I get one!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Judge
lines.text: Would you like to spend the night in jail?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And thank you for your time. (They both beat a hasty retreat.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler is still doing the hairball thing as Monica and
Phoebe are watching the babies. I can’t describe it, you’ll have to see it when
it comes on in your area.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering wearing nothing but Porsche clothes) So the Porsche guy took his
car back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But you found the keys to his clothes?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. No, I just uh, I just loved the way it feels when everybody thinks I
own a Porsche.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And people will think you own a Porsche because you’re wearing the
clothes?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course! Only an idiot would wear this stuff if you didn’t have the
car! Right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is true.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but only a genius would swallow a sonic blaster gun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I’ve been there. Yeah, I am gonna go drive my Porsche. (Starts to
leave.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, you know you don’t actually have one.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! What are you doing?! I’m in character! Would you talk to
her! (Storms out.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahh, I think it just moved. It’s really poking me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, that’s it, we’re going to the emergency room.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! No, you can’t, you can’t leave me here with them!
We’re baby-sitting!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The babies are asleep, I’m sure you’ll be okay on your own for
a while!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But you-you can’t leave me with them! We-we’re a team!
We’re playing a zone! They’re gonna triple team me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He’s got something plastic lodged in his throat, we’ve got to
go to the hospital.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But no, because a doctor won’t be able to help him, it’s just
gonna y’know naturally pass through his system in like seven years.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think that’s gum.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m pretty sure it’s gun.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, listen this really hurts. Let’s go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A real man wouldn’t just run to the hospital! (They don’t
stop.) No! What would, what would Krog do? (They ignore her and Phoebe is left alone.)

scenes.location: The street, Joey is hanging out wearing his Porsche grab.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why isn’t that valet back with my Porsche?

lines.speaker: Passerby
lines.text: Maybe because you’ve got the keys?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to women passing him) Porsche.
(Ross and Rachel approach, they’re still yelling at each other.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This is totally your fault!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My fault?! You threatened the judge!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you ripped the paper out of the court reporter’s machine!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That was the only way I could get him to stop typing!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi! How are the Gellers?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don’t call us that! (Storms away)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The judge wouldn’t let us get an annulment! Now we gotta get a
divorce!! Did a Porsch throw up on you? (Walks on.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! It’s Porsche!! (He’s right y’know.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Phoebe is being triple teamed.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me taking care of you is no problem, huh? You guys feel safe. Right?
Okay, I’m gonna take that spit bubble as, "Yeah, I do!" Okay, after I get
rid of this dirty diaper Leslie, I’ll set you up with a clean one. (She throws it at
the garbage without looking, misses, and knocks over a vase and flowers, which fall to the
floor and break.) Okay, I’m sorry. I didn’t mean to scare you. I just have to
clean that up. Okay? ‘Cause let’s face it, we’re at Monica’s. (She
crawls over, disposes of the diaper, picks up the flowers, and the vase.) I broke it. All
right. Well, that’s just the way that goes. (She throws out both the flowers and the
vase.) Okay, good. (She turns around and only counts two babies.) Why are there only two
of you? Where is Leslie? Well, you can’t answer. (She starts looking for her) Leslie?
Where are you Leslie? Leslie, now would be a good time for your first words! (She
turns around and finds that Leslie has managed to crawl into the bottom drawer of the TV
cabinet.) Well, look at you! Hey! You are a little bit mischievous! My gosh! (She picks
her up and notices a surprise is waiting in the drawer.) Oh, you’re a lot
mischievous! Well, it’ll dry. (Closes the drawer with her foot.) (To Leslie) Okay,
you sit with your brother and sister now—who aren’t there! (They both have
disappeared as well.)
[Time Lapse, the babies are finally asleep. Good for Phoebe! The only problem is,
Monica’s apartment looks like a tornado, a hurricane, a swarm of locusts, fire,
brimstone, hail, and giant man-eating, radioactive ants have torn the place apart.
Needless to say, it’s messy enough to cause Monica to die of shock right away.
Parents with small children know what I’m talking about.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (exhausted) How do you feel?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, let’s just say that Krog will be fully equipped to destroy
the universe again in twelve to fourteen hours.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so I totally took care of the babies all by myself! I fed
‘em, bathed ‘em, and put ‘em to bed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And protected them from a tornado?
(Monica enters and her jaw drops in horror.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, the babies are asleep.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, what, what happened here?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I did it! I took care of the babies all by myself!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But my apartment!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Was the setting of Phoebe’s triumph.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But the mess!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is not as important as the fact that Phoebe took care of the babies
all by herself.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re right, you’re right I shouldn’t freak out.
‘Cause this is what will happen when you and I have babies! When will that be?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pause) Phoebe, would you take a look at this mess!!!!
[Scene: Ross’s apartment, Rachel is packing what she still has over there as Ross
enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (deadpan) Oh honey thank God you’re home, I was getting worried.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I picked up the divorce papers. Uh, I’ve already signed everything
and I put little ‘X’s where you need to sign.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, little ‘X’s! Great! That makes up for everything!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know, I-I—you’ve done a lot of stupid stuff too! Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, name one stupid thing that is as stupid as this one!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, how about you flew to London to stop my wedding! Ah, how about you
told me you loved me after I was already married!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Wait a minute! That was different! I did those things because I was
in love with you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Right!
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re right. That’s very different. So let’s, let’s
just sign the papers. All right? (Sits down and Rachel keeps standing there.) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing. (Sits down.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, can we just sign please?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-hmm. (Just as Rachel finishes signing her name, Ross yanks each page
out of the way.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Congratulations. (Gets up to leave.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Ross, we’re—wait a minute. Umm, I uh, I kinda have a
little confession.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know this whole marriage thing, kinda my idea.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, remember how we were too drunk to remember anything the night we
were married?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And uh, yeah, I didn’t really, I didn’t want to say anything,
but it kinda it just, it kinda kept coming back to me, and umm, remember we were in the
casino and for some reason thought it would be funny to eat a lot of grapes. And uh, and I
thought it would be funnier if we got married. So as a, as a compromise we decided first
to get married, and then (Ross joins in) to eat a lot of grapes. So umm, sorry I got us
into this mess.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So then if-if—I mean if you think about it, this is all (Pause.) your
fault.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, don’t push it though.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’ve got to say; I know I divorce a lot of women, never thought I
would be divorcing you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. I always thought if you and I got married, it would be the one
that stuck. And it wouldn’t be a secret, and we wouldn’t have our wedding dinner
at Pizza Hut. (They both laugh.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did I, did I even treat?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it was on the house, it was, it was a newlywed special.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That may be the most depressing thing I’ve heard in my life. I should
probably get these to my lawyer’s office.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, thanks Ross, for taking care of all of this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Eh, no problem.
(They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m gonna need a copy of those.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Totally. (Exits.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: The street, Joey is messing with a car cover and still wearing the Porsche
stuff. This guy playing street football catches a pass next to the car cover Joey is
fooling around with.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Hey! Be careful around my Porsche!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (the same one from before approaches) Hi Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! How you doin’?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (to her friend) He has the most amazing Porsche under there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’d love to show ya, but I just tucked her in. She’s sleeping.
(The women both laugh) Hey uh, would you two girls like to go for a drink? (Just then the
same guy with the football dives to make a catch, lands on the car cover, and collapses
it. It turns out that Joey set up a bunch of boxes to make it look like a Porsche.)

title: The One on the Last Night

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is balancing a mini hockey stick on his hand as
Chandler enters from his room carrying a bunch of bills.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (watches Joey for a moment) Okay! (Joey quickly moves the hockey stick
so that he’s scratching his back with it.) Listen, I’m gonna be moving out so you
will be in charge of paying the rent.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right! And when is that due?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: First of the month.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And that’s every month?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, just the months you actually want to live here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahhh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, here is the phone bill. (Hands it to Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking at it) Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s our phone number. Now look, I know I kinda sprung this
whole me moving out on thing, so why don’t I just—why don’t I just cover
you for a while?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no! No way! Joey Tribbiani does not take charity…anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s not charity, Joe…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! Forget it! Okay—I mean thanks, but I’m done taking money
from you. All right, I can take of myself. Now, what’s next? Come on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay uh, here’s the electric bill. (Hands it to him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is how much we pay for electric?!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, yeah.
(Joey runs over and shuts off the lights.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, we’ll do the rest of the bills later then?
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, Chandler is talking to Phoebe about trying to give Joey
some money.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So is Joey going to have to give up the apartment?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I hope not! I tried to offer him some money, but he wouldn’t
take it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, how much do you think he needs?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I figure that $1,500 would cover him for a few months, y’know?
But I have to trick him into taking it so I won’t hurt his pride.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why don’t you hire him as an actor? You could have him dress up and
put on little skits. Whatever you want.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well that would help the pride thing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from her room) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Wow! You look great! Wanna move in with me tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (thinks) Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! (They kiss) So, what do you girls have planned for tonight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, instead of being sad that tonight is my last night together with
Rachel we thought we’d go out to dinner and celebrate the fact that Rachel is moving
in with Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And also, my birthday.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s not your birthday.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What a mean thing to say! I would never tell you it’s not
your birthday!
(Joey and Ross enter.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! So you guys have anything planned for the big last night?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, instead of just hanging out, we figure we’d do nothing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa, Knicks season opener tonight. I thought maybe you guys
would come over and watch it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know Ross, not if you’re gonna talk about how you gave
up a career in basketball to become a paleontologist.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I did give up a career in basketball to become a paleontologist!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her room) Pheebs, I was wondering…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re not dressed yet?! We’re supposed to start having fun in
15 minutes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well and clearly not a minute sooner.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, you are packed though right, I mean please tell me that
you’re packed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Of course I packed! Monica relax! I just wanted to ask Phoebe her
opinion on what I should wear tonight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My God, I can’t get a minute of peace around this place.
[Cut to Rachel’s bedroom, Phoebe and her are entering. And it’s obvious that she’s
not packed.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! Monica’s just gonna kill you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, what you’re wearing is fine for that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Rachel, I need to borrow—You’re not packed!!!!
You’re not packed even a little bit!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Surprise!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no don’t get mad because look—this is what happened. So
I-I started packing, then I realized, "What am I doing? I am lousy at packing!"
Right? But you love packing! So, as a gift to you, on our last night, ta-da!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (grabs a bag of those Styrofoam peanuts) I’ll be coordinator! Oh my
God! I’m so sorry, I didn’t get you anything! Okay, look everybody has to help!
Okay? You can help, can’t you Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I have plans.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re plans were with us.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, Chandler can make boxes, Ross can wrap, and Joey can lift
things. Now Phoebe, go tell the guys they have to help out!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! (To Rachel) Oh my God, thank you!!
[Cut to living room, Phoebe enters and closes Rachel’s door behind her.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hurry! Monica’s gonna make you pack! She’s got jobs for
everyone! Now, it’s too late for me, but save your selves! (The guys scramble for the
door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering and interrupting the guy’s escape attempt) Okay! The
movers will be here in 11 hours. Rachel has not packed. Now, everybody has to help!
Chandler, we’re gonna start with…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh nope, I-I have plans with Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I thought you said you were going to do nothing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but for the last time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay fine, now Ross…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, but-but I can’t do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (quietly) I’ve got Ben.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because, because I’ve got Ben.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s almost 8 o’clock, it’s almost past his bedtime.
Where-where is he?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He’s at a dinner party.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is he really coming? Because I can see right into your apartment!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course he is! What, do you think I’d just use my son as-as an
excuse? What kind of father do you think I am?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, sorry. (Goes back to Rachel’s room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the guys) I gotta go make a fake Ben.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is entering carrying two pizzas.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here it is! Our last pizzas together as roommates.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I wish I’d know you were going to do that, I ordered Chinese.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh that’s okay. Hey, actually in a way it’s kinda nice. Me,
bringing the food of my ancestors, you, the food of yours!
(Chandler stares at him, dumbfounded, then finally agrees.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Say, Joe, I had a strange idea of what we could do for our last night.
What do you say we play a little uh, foosball for money?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What, are you crazy? You haven’t beaten me once since my injury
plagued ’97 season. It would be easier if you just give me your money.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes it would. What do you say to $50?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, you’re on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, let’s play! The big game, Italy vs. China, apparently.
(They start playing.)
[Scene: Rachel’s bedroom, she’s in her closet bringing down her pair of
roller blades from a top shelf.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhhhhh, look it’s the roller blades.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (starting to cry) Oh God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You remember when we got these?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I guess you weren’t there. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys, we said we were gonna have fun! Come on, hey, remember the
time… (She starts laughing hysterically.) You don’t remember?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry Pheebs, I guess I’m just really said that I’m
leaving.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m gonna miss you so much.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, this doesn’t have to be so sad though. Y’know? Maybe
instead of just thinking about how much you’re gonna miss each other, you should like
think of the things you’re not gonna miss.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t think there’s anything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, there’s gotta be something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nope, she’s perfect.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I have one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good! Great! You can go first.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh well, I guess I’m not gonna miss the fact that you’re never
allowed to move the phone pen. (Laughs. Monica lags behind the laugh a little bit.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good that’s a good one. Okay, Monica, anything? Y’know? Does
Rachel move the phone pen?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aw, sometimes. Always, actually.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, good. There you go. Doesn’t anyone feel better?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not just the phone pen. I never get my messages.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You get your messages!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, well I don’t think it really counts if you have to read them
off the back of your hand after you fall asleep on the couch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So-so, you missed a message from who? Chandler or your mom? Or Chandler?
Or your mom?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great! It worked! No one’s sad.

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, they are just finishing up another game of foosball.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (scores) Yes! I win again! Ha-ha! That’s like 500 bucks you owe me!
Whoo-ho-hoo! (Goes over to the fridge and starts opening and closing the door rapidly.)
$500 that is a loooot of electricity! (By the way, there’s nothing in the fridge.)
Whoo-ho-ho! (Notices the sparseness of the fridge.) I gotta buy some food.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, give me a chance to win my money back. Okay? Sudden death, one

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You serious?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, get ready to owe me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, here we go. Ready?
[In slow motion, as some haunty demonic music plays in the background, Joey throws the
ball in, Chandler quits playing and goes for his Chinese food. Joey smacks the ball really
hard, shooting it down the table. Chandler slowly takes a bite, the ball bounces off of
the wall, heads back up the table, and scores the goal for Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No! No! No—(Joey looks at him)—one can beat me.
(In frustration, Joey kicks the table, breaking it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See? Now, that’s why only the little fake men are supposed to do
all the kicking.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, the phone rings and Monica answers it as Rachel and Phoebe
move a box into the living room.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello? (Listens) Oh, hi Ross! (To Rachel) See? Other people call me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, your brother. Score!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) What’s up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I’m just over here with Ben. I thought we’d say hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, put him on!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ben, say hi to Aunt Monica. (He holds the phone to the fake Ben he has
created out of a pumpkin.) Oh, I guess he doesn’t feel like talking right now.
He’s smiling though! Okay, talk to you later.
[Scene: Rachel’s bedroom, Rachel is entering carrying two glasses of wine. She
gives one to Phoebe, keeps one, and completely ignores Monica.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I think it was better when you guys were sad. Hey, uh, remember
the roller blades?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what else I’m not gonna miss? "I’m Monica. I
wash the toilet 17 times a day. Even if people are on it!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: "Hi I’m Rachel, is my sweater too tight? No? Oh, I’d
better wash it and shrink it!"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: "I’m Monica, I don’t get phone messages from interesting
people. Ever!"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! I call her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: "Oh my God, I love Ross! I hate Ross! I love Ross! I hate
Ross!"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: "Oh my God, I can’t find a boyfriend! So I guess I’ll
just stumble across the hall and sleep with the first guy I find in there!"
(Monica picks up one of those boxes of hair curling things, dumps it in a box, and
storms out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, we should get a move on if we wanna make those dinner
reservations. (Phoebe dumps a drawer full of makeup into a box.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is examining the broken foosball table as Chandler
enters from his room.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Still broken?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This sucks man! The last night you’re here and I lose the two most
important things in my life, the foosball table and $500.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, there are other ways of winning back your money, how about a
little uh, a little Blackjack? (Holds up a deck of cards.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nah, not my game.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, uh, how about, how about—y’know what? We could play a
new game. A new game, it’s fun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, what’s it called?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Cups.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know how to play Cups.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll teach ya! Come on, come on, it’s really easy and
really, really fun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, here you go. (He deals out two cards each.) I have two queens,
what do you have?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A two and a five.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ho-ho, you win! 50 dollars!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah! Okay, let’s play again. (He deals out two cards each
again.) What do you got?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A four and a nine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re kidding right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well that’s a full cup! (Pays him again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damn! I am good at Cups!

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica is whining to Phoebe about Rachel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m not talking to her!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, one of you has to take the first step! And it should be you,
because she’s the one who’s leaving. It’s harder for her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, maybe you’re right—She made fun of my phone pen!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, I took it hard too.
(Monica goes into Rachel’s room.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Listen Rachel, I feel really bad about—What are you doing? (She
sees that Rachel is unpacking.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m unpacking!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not moving! (She re-hangs a picture, crookedly.) Is that
picture straight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It needs to go about 20 blocks to the left!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, y’know what? You’re the one who wants to make this big
change and move in with Chandler! You should be the one to go! Why should I have to
leave?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because it’s my apartment!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well it’s mine too! What else you got?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How about, you’re moving!! (Grabs a bunch of clothes and throws
them into a box. What follows is a brief sequence of Rachel unpacking and Monica packing
the same stuff over and over again as Rachel chants "No." and Monica chants
"Yes.")

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look! This is ridiculous. We should be packing you!! (She knocks over
Monica, grabs a box, and runs into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, how are you guys doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Great! Monica’s moving!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) I am not!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh really?! Then how come all your stuff is in this box?! (Monica starts
chasing Rachel around the table.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, you guys. You guys I think I know what’s going on here. Okay,
you guys… STOP!! (They stop.) I know that, I know that you’re
acting mad because you think that it’ll make it easier to leave. But deep down
you’re still really sad. Deep-deep down.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No Phoebe I am mad!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, deep-deep-deep down!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I’m just mad!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then keep running. (They resume the chase.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, they’re still playing Cups.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You win.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, what did you have?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It doesn’t matter because nothing beats a three and a six. That
my friend is D-Cup. Okay, now much have you won so far?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, (counts the money) wow, 700.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not 700 exactly?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Double it! (He does.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well you see in Cups, once you get $700, you have to double it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, I didn’t make up the rules. Now, after you receive the
doubling bonus, you get uh, one card. Now that one card could be worth $100 bringing your
total to 1,500. (Joey gets excited.) Don’t get to excited because that’s not
gonna happen unless you get—No way! (He takes the top card, which is the two of
clubs. Of course, any card would’ve won. Chandler pays him.)

scenes.location: Monica and Rachel's, Monica carries a box out of Rachel’s room.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, this is the last box of your clothes. I’m just gonna label
it, "What were you thinking?"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Funny, because I was just gonna go across the hall and write that on
Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey you guys, I don’t mean to make things worse, but umm, I
don’t want to live with Rachel anymore.

lines.speaker: Monica and Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re just so mean to each other! And I don’t want to end up
like that with Rachel. I still like you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Phoebe that’s fine because I’m not moving.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa, Phoebe you gotta take her! Y’know I-I-I said some
really bad stuff about her, but y’know Rachel has some good qualities that
make her a good roommate.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh really? Like what Monica?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know she has 147,000 pairs of boots…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, good start Mon.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She lets you borrow them.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah and you stretch ‘em out with your big old clown feet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you wanna live outside?! Because it’s gettin’ cold! (To
Phoebe) She gets tons of catalogs and umm, she’ll fold down the pages of the things
she thinks that I’d like.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What else?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When I take a shower, she leaves me little notes on the mirror.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I do. I-I do, do that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s nice. I like having things to read in the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When I fall asleep on the couch after reading, she covers me over with a
blanket.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y’know, I don’t want you to be cold.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And when I told her that I was gonna be moving in with Chandler, she was
really supportive. (To Rachel) (Starts to cry) You were so great. You made it so easy. And
now you have to leave. And I have to live with a boy!! (They both break down in tears.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s gonna be fine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay Rachel, I can’t wait to live with you! And you know
what we should do? Bring Monica and then we could all live there together! We’ll have
so much fun!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But honey, I think she’s moving in with Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’s right. You’re still set on that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Kinda. (She hugs Phoebe and looks out the window. She moves closer to it
to get a better look.) Oh my God!
[Cut to Ross’s apartment, he’s watching TV and eating some popcorn as the
phone rings.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (answering the phone) Hello? (Listens) Hey Mon, how’s the packing
going? (Listens) Ben? He’s fine. Yeah, he’s right—Oh my God! (He looks over
at the fake Ben and notices that the head has fallen off.) Get your head of your shirt
there son! (He tries to push the pumpkin through the neck hole.) What? (Listens) Yeah,
it’s a pumpkin. I’ll come pack.
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, (Ohh, that’s the last time I’m ever gonna type
that line. It’s just so sad.) Joey is entering, angrily.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross and I were helping the girls pack, took a little break, I lost $1,500
to him in Cups!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wh-How did you lose at Cups?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The same way you lost. I started out with a King and a Queen, bamn! Ross
gets a 2 and a 3. Then I get a Jack and a King, boom! Ross gets a 4 and a 5! Ross was
getting the Cup card, the D-Cup, the Sittin’ Down Bonus! Meanwhile, I didn’t
even get half a cup! Nothin’!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh man!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And he never played before either! Y’know what I think? I think
beginner’s luck, very important in Cups.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, let’s play one more hand! One more!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no more! I cannot lose another dime! I’m serious this time!
In-in fact, look, there’s a—I wanna give you something. And let me give it too
you know before I pawn it for Cups money. (He rolls the big white dog over) Now, I want
you to have the big white dog as a kinda of a, y’know, thank you for being such a
great roommate.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t take the big white dog! You love it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s him, not it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, but wait—what if I bought it from you, y’know? And your
nice gesture would be giving it to me at a reasonable price, say (Gets choked up) $1,500?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait a second, I see what you’re trying to do here! You-you’re
trying to give me money again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When did I try to give you money?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Over there! (Points to the couch) Before, with the bills! You tried to
give some charity, I said "No," you dropped it. Okay? Then we had a nice last
night together, we had some fun, we gambled, nobody tried to give anybody any money! Now
out of the blue, you start with the charity thing again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m just trying to help you out! Okay? I wanna make sure that
you’re okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I will be okay! Look Chandler, you gotta get it out of your head
that I can’t take care of myself. Okay? Look, I’m not gonna miss you helping me
out with money. The only thing that I’m gonna miss…is you. And now the dog.
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, (And that’s the last time for that line, no more
Chandler and Joey’s or Monica and Rachel’s, ever!) Joey and Ross are carrying
the last table of Rachel’s. Rachel follows slowly, but is stopped by Monica.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. Call me when you get there. Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m really gonna miss you.
(They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! I have your key. Here you go. (Hands it to Monica.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.
(Silence ensues.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God! This is silly, I’m gonna see you in a couple of hours!
(They hug again.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye house!
(They break the embrace.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye Mon.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye.
(Monica closes the door and slowly walks into Rachel’s old and now empty room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She really left.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know. (He kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No problem roomie. (She turns around and hugs him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can I ask you a question?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What the hell is that dog doing here?! (She notices the dog
sitting in the living room.)
(And with that, an era ends as Chandler moves in with Monica as Rachel moves in with
Phoebe. It ‘tis a sad and happy time for Friends.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Ross’s apartment, Chandler is trying to get Joey’s money back from
Ross.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I invented the game of Cups as a way to give Joey money.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And now you want that money back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler, what kind of an idiot do you take me for? (As he picks up the
fake Ben.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s not a real game! I made it up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry you lost your money, but I won it fair and square.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: At a fake game!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now, if you wanna try to make some of it back, I’d be glad to play
you for it. But I should warn you, I am very good at Cups.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! Now I assume the Saucer card came up when you played last.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hmm, let’s see if it comes up this time. (He looks at his cards
and shrugs.)

title: The One Where Phoebe Runs

lines.text: [Scene: Phoebe and Rachel’s new apartment, Rachel and Phoebe are making their
answering machine message.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ready?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: it's...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Rachel...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe’s...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: please...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: leave...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: leave…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, I-I just said "leave."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I know because you have all the good words. What do I get? I get
"it’s," "and" oh I'm sorry, I have "A." Forget it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, come on that's silly.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, so let's switch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I have all of the good words. OK, fine, fine, we can switch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Everybody…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Rachel…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Please...wait, how did you do that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you're no ordinary roommate are you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, come on can we finish this later? Cause I wanna go running
before it gets dark. Oh! Why don't you come with me?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it'll be fun. We'll run in the park. It'll be like our first
y’know roommate bonding thing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, let's go running!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah and there's really cute guys there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Let's run towards them!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, wait just one more second. Hi, it's Phoebe and Rachel's.
Please leave a message, thanks!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now wait a minute. You just took all the words!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh. You've met your match Rachel Green.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s new apartment, Ross and Chandler are there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, I just finished this fascinating book. By the year 2030, there'll be
computers that can carry out the same amount of functions as an actual human brain. So
theoretically you could download your thoughts and memories into this computer and-and-and
live forever as a machine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (not amused) And I just realized I can sleep with my eyes open.
[Monica enters]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross and Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (jumps over a box) Honey, that's a great idea nailing the boxes to the
floor!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn't nail the boxes to the floor.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, So you can move them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, and while I'm doing that, Ross has a great computer story for
you.
[Joey enters with his new roommate who is played by none other than Elle MacPherson.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey everybody! Uh, I'd like you to meet Janine. She's-she's gonna be my
new roommate!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi! (Rushes over to shake her hand instantly.)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Hi

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, she's gonna live with me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's nice to meet you. Janine...?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Lecroix. Janine Lecroix

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I didn't know that! Well, what a pretty last name!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, uh, wh-where ya from?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Australia, I just moved here a couple of weeks ago.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shocked) From the land down under? I didn't know that either!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh, wha-uh, what do you do?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I'm a dancer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're a dancer? She-she's a dancer!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well, I think I'll go and unpack.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey let me. (Opens the door for Janine and after he closes the door
behind her gasps ecstatically.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, did you even interview this woman before you asked her to move in?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course I did.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-huh, what exactly did you ask her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "When can you move in?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you for bringing her into our lives.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Unbelievable

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, so you like her too Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, look at all the boxes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ugh, I cannot wait to ask her out!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute...Joey. Joey you can't ask her out, she's your roommate.
It-it'll be way too complicated.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah man don't do it. I mean if you date her, then-then-then I can't
date her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, think about it. Now remember when you were going out with
that girl Donna and you guys broke up. Remember how horrible it was when you guys bumped
into each other at the supermarket?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh God, yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now imagine you live at the supermarket.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (happily) Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, Oh, you're right! I don't want that. I can't date her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah and you better watch the flirting too, cause you know, in such
close quarters, it could be trouble.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, that's gonna be tough Mon. I mean it's hard for me to be around an
attractive woman and not flirt.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (chuckles) Hmm, well you're around me all the time and you don't flirt.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You a little sad about that sweetheart?
[Scene, The Park: Phoebe and Rachel are getting ready to go running]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I have to tie my shoe, so you go ahead, I'll catch up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Runs off.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Starts running crazily with her arms flapping and her legs far
apart) Come on! That's not running! Let's go! (Rachel pauses, then follows, embarrassed.)
[Scene, Central Perk: Rachel, Ross and Monica are there]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys, I'm telling you, when she runs, she looks like a cross between
Kermit The Frog and The Six Million Dollar Man.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica had such a crush on him. Yeah, she used to kiss his poster every
night before she went to bed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! I used to do that too!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you also have his album, It's Not Easy Being Green?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw, Mon...(Kisses her on the cheek)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, Phoebe runs weird huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, yeah and you know what, I know she's gonna wanna run again, I just
don't know how to get out of it, I mean, I live with her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don't you just be straight with her? Tell her the truth.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You're right, you're right. I should just tell her the truth.
[Phoebe enters]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, Monica tripped me, I don't think I can ever run again, ever!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why? Why would you do that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know. Rachel I'm-I'm sorry that I hurt your ankles.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ankle.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We'll see.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s new apartment, Chandler is putting something away
under the sink.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: OK, I'm officially unpacked. Thanks for helping me man. (Turns around
and sees that Joey isn't there.) Joe? (Hears giggling coming from a box) Well, I guess
Joey went home. Oh and look, there's still one box that I have to unpack. (Hears the
giggling again)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (jumps out of the box) I Gotcha!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pretending) Oh my God! You-almost-gave-me-a-heart-attack.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Boy, it was so hard not to laugh, I tell ya. Hey, hey, the place looks
great!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, not bad right? You know what, Monica’s gonna be working
late, so I'm gonna make this place spotless. You know what else I'm gonna do, know what
else I'm gonna do? I'm gonna go downstairs, I'm gonna get her some flowers. Now who
wouldn't wanna live with me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (raises his hand) I don't! No, I wanna live with the super-hot Australian
dancer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, now how's that going though? Are you okay with the not-flirting
thing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Well, so far yeah. But it's tough you know? I got all this built up
flirting energy and I don't know how to get rid of it. (Gives Chandler the
"Joey-love," look.) How you doin?
[Scene Joey and Janine’s new apartment, Janine is there. Joey walks in to see
Janine bent over, stretching.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (voice cracking) Ohhhh man

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Sorry, there's just more room out here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no-no-no, it's-it's uh, you just uh, uh reminded me that uh, I need
to do my stretches too. (Starts to stretch, groans painfully)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: (touches his waist) Why don't you try to do-

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (jumps up and yells)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-uh nothing. I-I-I-I didn't want you to touch me cause I'm -I'm all
sweaty from the workout. I better hit the shower. (Goes into the bathroom and comes back
out quickly) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Oh, sorry about that stuff hanging in there. It's just my
thongs are too delicate for the dryer.
(Joey laughs nervously and goes to his bedroom.)
[Scene, The Park, Rachel is running and Phoebe is hiding behind a tree.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (jumps in front of Rachel) Hi! Oh yeah, uh-huh, it's me. I saw you grab
your running shoes this morning and sneak out. You lied so you could run by yourself.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no Phoebe no, I was...no. You know what, I was, I was actually just
checking to, see, if I could run. And I can!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Please Rachel, I am not an idiot. (Runs off)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, wait Phoebe.
[Scene, Monica and Chandler’s, Chandler is there. Everything is out of its place
and Chandler's cleaning.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (enters) Wow, couples who live together do start to look alike. So,
Mondler...uh, what uh, what ‘cha doin?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What does it look like I'm doing? I am cleaning!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did you get Monica's authorization to move all of her stuff?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Authorization? I don't need that. I'm gonna put everything back.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Put it back exactly where you found it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes I'm gonna put it back (Mocking Ross) exactly where I found
it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ‘Kay, first of all, this attitude is not helping.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She's not gonna care if I put her stuff back in the same stupid place.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa, hello, did you just meet Monica?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She is gonna recognize that I did a nice thing and-and, appreciate it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm -you know, actually this'll work out well. Cause when you have to move
back in with Joey, Joey's hot new roommate can come and live with me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I see, I see, y-y-you're trying to freak me out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look Chandler, Monica is really weird about this kind stuff all right.
Believe me, I lived with her for 16 years. She is going to freak…out. Oh my God,
she's going to sit on you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, she's not okay? And I'll prove it to you. I'm gonna call her right
now. (Picks up the phone and wipes it off) Phone's done ehh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Mon, how's it going?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Terrible. If-if I want something done right, I have to do it myself.
Other people just wreck stuff. I really think I might kill someone tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh come on, come on, it can't be that bad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's worse. The only thing that's getting me through is knowing that I'm
gonna be seeing you soon. I think I may even try to get out of here early.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No-no-no-no-no-no. It sounds like they really need you down there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, are you just hanging out with Ross?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's, all good! Okay bye-bye Mon! (To Ross) She's-she's gonna kill me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, the phone was facing the other way. (Chandler fixes it and a picture
frame off the table.) And that goes back up there.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We should start with the big stuff. Y’know? That'll be the
easiest. Uh, let's start with the couch. (He picks up one end and Ross doesn't help) I got
it. (He moves it back to where he thinks it goes.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah that-that, doesn't look right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you talking about? The couch is perfectly in line with the
carpet. And then I can just walk over here and casually just put my feet right up on
the...(Tries to rest his feet on the coffee table but they won't reach) OK, OK, here's
what we do, we just uh, move the couch closer to the coffee table.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, but then the back of the couch won't line up with he back of
the carpet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: OK well here, we'll just move the coffee table closer to the couch.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa, Whoa, Whoa, but then the coffee table won't be centered in the
seating area.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but the coffee table doesn't match
the...blahebdmsdlkhdyslkd;btyds...Rooosss!!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Look, what am I gonna do? I'm not flirting but still, I'm
drawing her to me like - like a moth to a flame! (Tries to put his feet on the coffee
table...they won't reach and looks around.) What the hell's going on over here?!?!?
(Points to Chandler) Monica's gonna kill you! Look I need your help, I have to do
something to-to repel this woman! Wait a minute, wait a minute, you guys repel women all
the time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I've been married 3 times
(Chandler gives him a round of mock applause.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no I've seen it happen, you-you get a rapport going with a woman but
somehow you manage to kill it. What's your secret?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, we do not repel women OK? That is completely untrue.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no, yes we do my man. Remember when we were back in college and we
went to that spring dance and you walked right up to that girl you liked and you could not
stop talking about the Irish potato famine?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well what about you? You weren't you know, so hot in college either.
After everything he said, he'd go "ba dum bum chessh"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, Monica doesn't like that either, Maybe I should stop doing that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh y'know what, girls don't like it when I start talking about science.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's not specific to girls.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is great, this is great, what else, what else?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, they don't like it when you correct their grammar.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And they don't like it when you explain why your jokes are funny.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They don't like it when you keep asking them if they like you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Man, I'm so lucky I have Monica.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (nonchalantly) I'm never gonna find love again.

scenes.location: Phoebe and Rachel’s, Rachel is there as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Phoebe, can I talk to you for a second?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, um, I...(Phoebe walks into her room.) All right Phoebe look, I
just wanted to say that I'm sorry. OK? I handled the situation horribly and I should not
have lied to you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, what should you have done?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I-I should've told you the truth.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-Huh, Which is...?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y'know, the reason I didn't wanna go running with you is because
um, well y'know the way that you run is a little...(Starts flapping her arms)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it's embarrassing. People were looking at us like we were crazy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why do you care?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because they're people.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But people that you don't know and will never see again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, but still. They're people…with eyes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I didn't get embarrassed running next to Miss (panting). But no,
okay. No, no, I can see why running with me would be embarrassing to you. Yeah, okay.
You're uptight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I-I am not uptight—Hey-hey-hey-oh-oh! Listen, I am not uptight,
man.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's okay Rachel. I'm not judging you; that's just who you are. Me.
I'm more free y'know? I run like I did when I was a kid, cause that's the only way it's
fun. Y'know, I mean didn’t you ever run so fast you thought your legs were gonna fall
off? Y'know, like when you were like running towards the swings or running away from
Satan? (Rachel looks confused) The neighbor's dog.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s, Chandler has the tape measure out and is busy
lining up the lamp on the kitchen counter, Ross is supervising the whole operation.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, is this lamp in the same place?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who cares? I repel women.
[Monica tries to come in]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (blocks the door) No-no-no-no-no-no-no-no!!! You can't come in here!
R-r-r-r-Ross is naked.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (whispers) What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) I couldn't say that I was naked because she's allowed too
see me naked.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why does anyone have to be naked?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why is Ross naked?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I-I had to show Chandler something?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Naked?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah-yeah I uh, I have a uh, a guy problem.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is it the same thing that Chandler had?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, uh, just come later, we'll get everything squared away and you
can come back later.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, listen, there's still some of Chandler's medicine under the sink
in the bathroom. Bye!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye! Thank God

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude, what'd you have?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, we have no time okay? We must focus. We gotta get everything
back into its original place.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (realizes something) The photo album! There were millions of pictures of
the apartment in the photo album. We just go through it and match everything to the
pictures.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's perfect! That's brilliant! (Starts going through the photo
album)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So really, what'd ya have?

scenes.location: Joey and Janine's, Janine's there. Joey enters

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Hey Joey, I got some beer for you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, don't you mean "for whom?"

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Sure, listen I was gonna order some pizza, you wanna share one?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pizza, heh, its not like I never had that before...ba dum bum cheshhh.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Is there something wrong?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, All right, let's just get this out in the open okay? You're
hot. I'm lovable. Clearly there's a vibe going on between us. But, we're roommates and
it's a huge mistake for us to continue down this road.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Joey...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no, I'm telling ya. Imagine yourself living in a supermarket and
you will understand okay? So the question is, what do we do?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well, I don't think there is anything to do. I mean I think you're
really sweet, but I'm just not interested in you like that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: No! I mean you're a really nice guy and I'm happy to be your roommate
and your friend, I'm just y'know, I just don't feel that way about you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! I see what happened. It's because I was trying to repel you. Right?
Believe me, you'd feel a lot different if I turned it on.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I do. (Gives her the Joey-love look.) How you doin?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I'm OK

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!?!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh dear God!
[Scene: The park, Rachel's running by herself and panting. After a little while she
decides to run like Phoebe.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Runs into Phoebe.) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh honey, I'm so sorry, you were right, this feels great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: See? And you don't care if people are staring, it's just for a second
cause then you're gone!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Gone! I mean its amazing Pheebs. I feel so free and so graceful. (Turns
and bumps into a mounted policeman and falls) Hey! Look out for the horse! Sorry! (Runs
off.)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s, Chandler and Ross are there. Monica enters

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is it okay for me to come in now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-huh

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why is everything different?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye! (Runs out)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I don't see anything different other than the fact that the room
got so much brighter when you came into it. (Forced laughter)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, the end table is wrong, The couch looks bizarre and don't even get
me started on the refrigerator magnets.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay look, don't...don't be mad okay? But after I unpacked the boxes I
wanted to do something nice for you, so, I-I-I cleaned the apartment. So I moved
everything around and then I forgot where it, where it went back and I'm sorry, I'm very
sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's okay. Chandler, are you afraid of me or something?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you want me to be afraid of you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course not. I mean gosh, Chandler what you did, it's, it's a
wonderful thing and I really appreciate it. I know I have this weird thing where I want
everything to be in the perfect place, but I'd never expect you to worry about that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh well you're the best. You come here to me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, hold on okay? First thing's first. (Gets her cleaning gloves
on) Okay, now did Ross sit anywhere while he was naked?

title: The One with Ross's Teeth

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and Janine’s, Chandler knocks on the front door. Joey answers the
door.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, my name’s Chandler. I just moved in next door and I was
wondering if you would be interested in battling me in a post-apoplectic world for control
of the galaxies last remaining energy source?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, neighbor come on in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, is Janine around?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, no, she’s at dance class.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can I check out what she did to my room?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but, hey look, don’t go through her stuff. She gets really
mad.(Chandler gives him a look and walks to the door of his old room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (The room is filled with flowers and a floral print sheet on the bed.) Oh
my God. What is th… it’s like a guy never lived in here. Look, you’ve got
to be careful. This girl thing is dangerous. (Looking around the living room.) It’s
spreading already.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Looking around the room.) It is???

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Picking up a pillow.) Yeah, is this your pretty pink pillow on the
couch?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Pointing to the table and picking up the box.) Is that your tiny little
box, that’s too small to put anything in?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! Ok, this is not good. You are a guy. Ok? This is a guys place. If you
let this go, you’re going to be sitting around with your fingers soaking in stuff.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (With Big Eyes.) All right, you’re right. I’ll talk to her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes talk to her. Be a man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m a man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Defend yourself.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Grunting) Hmm. (Monica opens the front door and comes in.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler come on. We have to hem the new dust ruffle.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Be right there sweetums. (Monica leaves. To Joey.) A totally different
situation.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, The gangs all here. Monica is walking in.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, how was your breakfast with Hillary?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was okay. She’s still kind of depressed because she broke up with
her boyfriend.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, is this Hillary your HOT assistant chef Hillary?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The one that always stares at me when I come in?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, the one who looked at you once because you got in her way.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Still I could tell. She was into me. (Joey rolls his eyes.) Well, why
don’t you set us up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, are you setting Ross up with someone? Does she have a wedding dress?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Walking over and Sitting down.) Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m, uhh, making up flyers trying to get new massage clients. So, can
I come to Bloomingdale’s and use the copy machine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, sure, but they might think it’s kinda weird considering I
don’t work there anymore.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God. What happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I-I, got a job at Ralph Lauren.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well that’s great! Congratulations!! (She hugs Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. (chuckling) A year ago..

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Hugging her again.) You’ve lasted a whole year. Good for you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But, Pheebs, you can still use the copy machine where I actually work. But,
just come by at lunch so my boss doesn’t see you. Cause Kim will just freak out and
she already doesn’t like me very much.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s weird. I don’t think my boss likes me either.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t think mine likes me either.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe it’s a universal thing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or maybe, it’s because you’re hanging around here at 11:30 on a
Wednesday. (Everybody gets up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah let’s head off to work.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We should go.

scenes.location: Rachel’s office, Phoebe hands Rachel a key card.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now you will not believe this. But, I was in the copy room, making copies,
and Ralph Lauren came in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God. Did you talk to him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah a little. He seems really nice. Good kisser.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What!?! You kissed him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Totally.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Gasps) Phoebe are you serious?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. I was just in there. He introduced himself and the next thing I know,
we’re making out. You know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, I mean, you do know he’s married?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What am I supposed to do? Ask every guy I make out with if he’s
married? (Rachel looks at her.) No, yeah, I should.
[Scene: Joey and Janine’s apartment, Joey stares at a picture of a bay on the
wall. Janine comes out of her room.]

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Hey Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey. Uh, can I talk to you for a second? This, uh, kid in this picture. Do
you, uh, know this kid? Is that like a relative or something?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: No, I just thought it was cute.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, that’s what I was afraid of.. Okay, uhh…Look Janine I really
want you to feel at home here, but some of this new stuff. It’s…too girly.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Ohh. Like what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Like this. (pointing to the picture) Pictures of cute babies we don’t
know. We..we can’t have that.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Joey, it’s Anne Geddes. She’s a famous artist.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look I don’t know this baby. I don’t know if she’s a famous
artist or not. You know, and I don’t want to be a jerk but you’re changing too
much around here.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well, I’m sorry. I just thought I’d try to make the place a
little nicer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah but it’s too much stuff. You know like, you got the candles and the
foofy schmoofer thing here and over here you got a picture of a watering can.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well I just thought…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sure it’s a famous watering can, okay. But, come on…and
what is with the really hot stick in the bathroom?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: It’s a curling iron.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, well, that’s ok then. But, okay my towels for instance. I come in
to the bathroom here and my towel is not on the floor where keep it. It’s up here on
some hook..and…smells different.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: It’s clean.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, well, it feels different.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: It’s dry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, I can make my peace with the clean dry towels…Also what is with
these chips you bought?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: No no no no, it’s potpourri. You’re supposed to smell it. (Joey
takes a big whiff of the potpourri.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Voice cracking) Well that’s like summer in a bowl.

scenes.location: Elevator at the Ralph Lauren offices, Rachel gets on her boss Kim is there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Kim, Hi. (Kim doesn’t even look up from her report.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Uhh-huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So you know, I…I handed in that marketing report and I never got to
hear what you thought.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I didn’t read it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahh….So…Wow…The spring line, it’s really going to be
great this year, huh?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So I hear the Ralph Lauren fooled around with someone in the copy room.
(Kim stops the elevator and turns to Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Tell me everything.
[Scene; Central Perk, Monica and Chandler are on the couch. Ross walks in.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s up? (He smiles. His teeth are freakishly white.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know…Oh My God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What happened to your teeth.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I whitened them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Sarcastically) Really.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. What do you think.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I think I shouldn’t look directly at them.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, seriously.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross they’re really, really, really white.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, what was wrong with your old…human teeth.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahh, I-I did leave the gel on a little longer then it said to.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How much longer?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A-A day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross you know that tonight is your date with Hillary?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know. That’s why I did it. (With a big smile) Come on, are they really
that bad?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no no no. You’ll be fine. (turning to Monica) Hillary’s
bind, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She will be after tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. (Rachel walks in.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, hey, hey Rach, do you notice anything..ahh…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Your teeth? Yes, I saw them from outside. (Sitting down on the
couch.) You guys are never going to believe this. But, Phoebe made out with Ralph Lauren.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What???

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah I know. She ran into him at my office and they just…made out. And
the craziest thing is, now my boss likes me because I told her about it and she said it
was the best gossip she’d heard all year.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am proud of all my friends today.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My God, Rachel, I can’t believe Phoebe made out with Ralph Lauren.
Ohh, I’m so jealous. (Chandler looks at her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, I’m Chandler. Your live-in boy

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, please, come on. Look at him. (Pointing to a picture of Ralph on
a magazine,.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I am no women, but that is one tasty dish. (Phoebe walks in.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey. Here. (Hands Chandler a copy of her flyer and sees the picture of
Ralph.) Ohh, who’s the silver fox?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That-that is your make out buddy. Don’t you recognize him? (Holding up
the magazine in front of her face.) Oh wait. Ohh, Phoebe I love you. Kiss me please.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s not Ralph Lauren. Sounds like him though.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, no, Ralph doesn’t look anything like that guy.
He’s-he’s young and he’s got long hair and a beard and a hacky sack.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh My God, Phoebe, that’s not Ralph Lauren. That’s Kenny the copy
guy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh..Go..Oh..and I told my boss that someone made out with Ralph Lauren. If
she finds out that I lied to her, she is going to hate me even more. Phoebe!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why would the copy guy say he was Ralph Lauren?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: To get you to make out with him!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohhh.

scenes.location: Ross’s Apartment, Ross and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Holding a shirt in front of Ross.) Okay, maybe this will make your teeth
look less white. (Ross has a big smile.) Nope. Okay, colors that don’t work are blue,
yellow, green, red, black, white, orange, and purple.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know what I’m going to do. That date starts in like an
hour.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Ross, maybe if your skin was lighter. Your teeth wouldn’t look so
bright.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh great. So all I need to do is get some new skin. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m just saying, if we put just a little bit of makeup on you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa. Whoa. Whoa. We’re not 13 anymore.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross this is the only thing left that has a shot at working.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But, won’t she notice I have makeup on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please. Half the guys out there have makeup on.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What??

lines.speaker: Monica
