lines.text: All right, half the people. I mean, just try it and see.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. I am not putting on makeup. (Knock at the door. Phoebe enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hello. Oh good. Ross could you put up some of these flyers for me? (He
smiles at her.) OH!! Demon!! Demon!!
[Scene: Chandler’s and Monica’s apartment, Chandler and Monica are sitting at
the kitchen table making potpourri sachets.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now are drawers will smell nice and we didn’t waste these pantyhose.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, God forbid we throw out old underwear. You-you know what? I’m
going to go over to Joey’s.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, we’re supposed to organize the wrapping paper drawer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but I feel like I’ve really gotten in touch with my feminine
side enough today. You know. In fact I think we’re two sachets away from becoming a
lesbian couple.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what? This has been kind of a girlie day. You’re right,
I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nah, Nah, it’s okay. I feel like I need to be in guy place. You
know, do kind of like a man thing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. Go over to Joey’s. Go over to Joey’s and drink some beer
and hammer up some drywall.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know when guys hang out they don’t just drink some beer and
hammer up drywall?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When girls hang out, we don’t have pillow fights in our underwear.
(Chandler gets a hurt look on his face.) I’m sorry. We do. We do. I don’t know
why I said that.
[Scene: Joey and Janine’s apartment, Chandler walks in. Joey and Janine are
knitting at the kitchen counter.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Chandler. Come on in. We’re knitting pot holders.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No thanks, Josephine.

scenes.location: Ross’s apartment, Chandler enters. Ross is putting on makeup.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Ross, I was wondering if… Oh my God!! Where are
all the men???
[Scene: Elevator at the Ralph Lauren offices, Kim’s waiting for it. The door opens
and Rachel is inside.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, hi, Kim.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Hi Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, remember that thing I told you that happened yesterday? Well it
didn’t happen.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: You didn’t cancel the fabric order from Taiwan?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, two things didn’t happen. Remember I told you that someone made
out with Ralph Lauren in the copy room? Well, it turns out that’s not true.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That’s not true?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh that’s interesting? Because I checked and only one keycard was used to
access the copy machine yesterday during lunch and that keycard belonged to you, Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, no, no. Oh God, you think I made out with him.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Listen to me. If you think sleeping with Ralph is going to get you my job. You
are sadly mistaken.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I-I don’t want your job. I-I don’t. Ohh this is such a mistake. I
did not make out with him. Nobody made out with him. I did not use my keycard yesterday. I
don’t even know how to use my keycard. (The elevator stops. Ralph steps on.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Hi Ralph.

lines.speaker: Ralph Lauren
lines.text: : Hi Kim. (Dead silence until Ralph gets off the elevator.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Yeah, nothing happen. You could cut the sexual tension in here with a knife.
[Scene: Hillary’s apartmen,. Hillary and Ross are having dinner. He is avoiding
opening his mouth.]

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: And after that, what could I do except become a chef.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mmm-Hmm.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: And someday soon, I hope to open my own restaurant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mmm.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: You know, you’re a really great listener. Most guys I go out with,
they just talk and talk.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mm-Hmm.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: After a while it’s like, shut your mouth, you know?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Chuckling) Hmm-Hmm.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: I’ve probably been talking too much. Why don’t we talk about you
a little bit?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mmm-Unmm.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: Come on. I want to know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm-Hmm-Hmm. (Putting his hand up to block his mouth.) Okay. I, uh, am from
Long Island. I-I came to the city for college. Um, I, um, have a 5 year old son and in my
spare time I like to read spy novels. But, but, let’s talk more about you. Hmm.
[Scene: Joey and Janine’s apartment, Joey and Monica are arranging flowers.
Chandler walks in.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what’s really neat. If you sear the stems of the flowers first in a
frying pan, your arrangement will look fresh much longer.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, Joey, that is such a great tip.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica, could you excuse us for a second? I need to talk to the girl with
the flowers.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Oh but Joey, come over later because I’m going to teach you to
make a bird feeder out of just a pine cone and some peanut butter.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, I love birds. (Monica leaves. Chandler shuts the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is the matter with you ?!?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re arranging flowers! (Pointing to the dish on the table.) You
got dead flowers! You got a picture, a picture, of a baby dressed like flowers! This is
not Joey!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey. Hey look I am still Joey, okay. Flowers they’re just, you know,
they’re nice to look at. And that happens to be a picture by a famous artist. Of a
famous baby.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re turning into a women.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No I’m not. Why would you say that? That’s just mean.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now I’ve upset you? What did I say?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s not what you said. It’s the way you said it….Oh My God,
I’m a women!!!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Rachel are there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now, she thinks that I made out with him and I did it to get her job.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But why didn’t you just tell her the truth.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did but she doesn’t think anyone would be stupid enough to confuse
Kenny the copy guy with Ralph Lauren.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, hey, what if Kenny were the real brains behind the whole company? You
know. What if Kenny hired that Ralph Lauren guy to be the pretty front man? Huh, did she
ever think of that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You were with Kenny today, weren’t you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just for a second.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, Phoebe, what am I going to do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, the only thing you can do. Sleep with Ralph Lauren.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not going to sleep with Ralph Lauren. I mean, I could, but I
wouldn’t.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, sleep with Kenny.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That wouldn’t help me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, yes it would.

scenes.location: Hillary’s apartment, Hillary and Ross are finishing up their date.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: I’ve had a really good time tonight.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mmm.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: You know, I rarely connect with someone this much on the first date.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Giggling) Hmm-Hmm-Hmm. (Picking up a piece of bread and covering his mouth.)
Me, neither. I’ve had a really good time too, you know. (Putting the bread down.)

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: Are you going to eat that bread?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Putting the bread up to his nose.) Ohh, I just like the smell. (Sniffing
it.) Mmmm.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: (Laughing) You make me laugh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm-Hmm.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: Would you like to move over to the couch?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mmm-Hmm. (Picking up their wine glasses.)

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: Maybe I’ll just turn the lights down a little.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Covering his mouth with the glass.) How about all the way.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: Okay. (She goes to turn the lights off and Ross sits on the couch. She has
some black light posters on the wall.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Looking at the posters.) Wow, cool poster. Or should I say groovy poster?
(They sit down on the couch. Ross smiles and the black light fluoresces his teeth.) So,
ahh, where were we?

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: Are those your teeth??

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, you can see them, huh?

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: Yes. They’re insanely white.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I-I, did that for you.

lines.speaker: Hillary
lines.text: What’s a matter with you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s a matter with me? You’ve got a black light. It’s 1999!

scenes.location: Elevator at the Ralph Lauren Offices, Rachel gets in . Kim is there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Kim, hi.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Hi Rachel. Ohh, I’ve been meaning to ask you. Have you seen the new Ralph
Lauren sheets? Ohh, what am I thinking. Of course you have.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay..Okay.. Look. I’m sorry that I lied to you before. You were
right. Ralph and I were an item but were not anymore.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Faking crying.) Yeah, he dumped me. He said, "Rachel, I can’t do
this. Even though you are a very, very, very beautiful women. I can’t do this.
I’m married and I’m sorry." And then I don’t know why but he said,
"and you will never get promoted. Especially not above Kim, who is an integral cog in
the Ralph Lauren machine."

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: You expect me to believe..(Doors open, Ralph steps in.) Hi Ralph.

lines.speaker: Ralph Lauren
lines.text: : Hi Kim. (Dead silence again until he gets off.)

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh my God. He just gave you the coldest look I have ever seen. It’s like
he hates you. Then it is true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Of course it’s true and it hurts so bad.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Ohh honey come here. (Hugging Rachel.) Ohh it will be ok. We’ve all been
there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You and Ralph?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Kenny the copyboy.
Ending Credits
[Scene: Joey and Janine’s apartment, Joey paces the floor waiting for Janine. She
walks in.]

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, uhh, I need to talk to you.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: What’s the matter? Are you upset?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sorry but we’ve got to get rid of all this girlie stuff in
here. I, uh, I got to be a man! Okay. The living room has to remain a guy place, okay?
That’s just the way it has to be.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well, if that’s what you want. I’ll just put it all in my room.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great…Great…and thanks for being so understanding. I mean, I
didn’t want to make a big deal out of this, you know. (She starts to collect all the
girlie stuff up.) You could, uh, put the picture of the famous baby in my room. I mean, if
you want to.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And, uhh, maybe the watering can there.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And a couple of these little tiny boxes.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Joey? Do you want me to put it all in your room?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Smiling) Okay.

title: The One Where Ross Got High

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is mixing some Thanksgiving treat (I’m
assuming mashed potatoes) in a bowl.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Okay, great! Bye. (Hangs up as Chandler enters.) So
guess who’s coming to Thanksgiving dinner?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sydney Portier? Hehheh.
[Chandler throws his coat on the couch]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (not amused by Chandler’s joke) I miss Rachel. (To Chandler) No, my
parents.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! That’s great, they haven’t seen the place since I moved
in!
[Monica goes to fiddle with something on the table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, and y’know, if you could not mention to them that we live
together, that would be great! (Quickly trying to change subjects), I was thinking we
would eat around four.
[Monica goes to the stove.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (shocked at the news) Why can’t I tell them that we live
together?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because they don’t know we’re dating. (Again, trying to
quickly change subjects.) Do you think we should eat in the kitchen? (Goes to the sink and
the stove to cook.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why haven’t you told them?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Um, well, I was going to, I-I-I really was. But um, then somewhere, just
out of nowhere, I didn’t.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why haven’t you told them?! Wouldn’t they be happy?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (trying to change subjects, excitedly) So! Dinner in the kitchen around
four! I’ll see you then. (Pats Chandler on the shoulder and goes into the living
room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why wouldn’t they be happy?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, um, because mainly, um, they don’t like you. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? What? Why?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe because you used to be aloof, or that you’re really
sarcastic, or that, y’know, you joke around all the time. Or that you take off your
clothes and throw them on the couch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is this why they don’t like me or why you don’t like me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, I know that I should’ve told them. I know I shouldn’t
care what they think. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know, it’ll be okay. It’ll be okay. Because when they
come over, I will be all charming, I will make them fall in love with me, and then
we’ll tell ‘em.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You really think that’ll work?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, I can be pretty charming, babe, I won YOU over, didn’t I?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (hugging Chandler) I don’t think you’ll ever get my parents
that drunk!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Joey and Janine’s, Joey and Ross are playing Sony Playstation.
Chandler enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! (Sees Ross is there) Oh, good, Ross! You’re parents like me,
right?
[Chandler goes to stand to the side of the TV.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (only half-paying attention) Yes, of course they like you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well Monica just told me that they don’t.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (not paying attention) Yeah, they don’t like you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (annoyed) Do you know why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I dunno, maybe it’s because you’re really sarcastic. Or maybe
it’s cause you uh-

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (angry) Well if people don’t know they shouldn’t just guess!
[Joey and Ross get annoyed with Chandler's outburst.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is great, another Thanksgiving with nothing to give thanks for.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe I could give thanks for you shuttin’ up, eh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe I could give thanks by taking my Playstation over to my
new apartment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well maybe I love ya’.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: [mocks that last comment].
[Chandler starts to leave as Janine enters]
Janine [to Chandler]: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.
[Chandler exits]

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Hey guys!
[Joey and Ross drop their video game controllers.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (trying to act manly in front of Janine) No I don’t want to
play video games, Joey!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Are you guys going to Chandler’s for Thanksgiving?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah, why? What’s up?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well, me and my dancer friends are thinking of doing Thanksgiving
uptown. I thought you guys might like to come.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: For real?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: No, but you should go to Chandler’s. Because none of us knows how
to cook, we’ll probably just end up drinking all day.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ye-ye, we go to yours!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, see, we-we-we have to stop across the hall, because it’s my
sister. But, uh, uh y’know actually, growing up with a sister was nice because it
really helped me understand women. Yeah, you-you should tell your friends that.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: (not sure of what to make of that) Okay.
[Janine leaves]
[Ross looks at Joey coyly.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How you got three women to marry you, I’ll never know.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s, Phoebe enters with a paper turkey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Hey, Pheebs, check it out. Yeah, for my desert, I have chosen to
make a traditional English truffle!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, that sounds great! And what are you making Monica, in case
Rachel’s dessert is...[about to say “bad”] so good that I eat all of it.
There’s none left for anybody else!
[Monica, Phoebe, and Rachel laugh]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (worried) Nothing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, sweetie, I-I trust you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, if-if I mess this up, there’s nothing else for dessert?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re not gonna mess it up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, Monica, I love that, you really have faith in me. Thank you.
Technical question, how do you know when uh, the butter’s done?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it’s done about two minutes before it looks like that.
[Joey and Ross enter.]

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, ooh the food smells great, Mon!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And the place looks so nice!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, hey hey, Happy Thanksgiving everybody!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: The Girls
lines.text: Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, this has been great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: See ya!
[Joey and Ross go to the door, ready to leave.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whoa whoa whoa! Where’re you goin’?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, oh, we did say we’d stop by this little thing Joey’s
roommate is having.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Janine, the really hot dancer girl?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Some would say she’s attractive, yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And who else is going to be there?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, some of her friends, yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Her dancer friends?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (frustrated) Yes, all right? All of her hot dancer friends are gonna be
there and they’re gonna be, be drinkin’ and dancin, and we really wanna go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) Dude, we were good!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re not gonna go anywhere, you said you were gonna eat here, and
you’re gonna eat here!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and-and leaving us to go see hot dancer girls is not very
Thanksgivingy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, but-but it is, uh, it’s just like the first Thanksgiving, when
the Indians and the Pilgrims uh, sat down to dinner.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, and the Indians taught the Pilgrims what it meant to be hot in
the new world!
[Enter Jack and Judy Geller]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Hello everybody!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi!
[Kisses and hugs are exchanged.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Dad [kisses Jack], Mom [kisses Judy]. Look! Look who it is it’s
Chandler!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (less than pleased) Oh yes of course, hello Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mr. and Mrs. Geller, you look wonderful, it is great to have you hear,
let us take off your coats!
[Chandler goes to take off Jack’s coat. He then notices little white flakes on
Jack’s shoulders. He begins to wipe them off.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa, snowing out there?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (angry) No.
[Time lapse. The gang is sitting down for Thanksgiving dinner. Chandler is at the head
of the table, Mr and Mrs Geller are to his right. Joey and Ross are to his left. Monica is
serving things. Phoebe is in the living room and Rachel is at the sink.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Monica, all this food looks wonderful, you should think about doing
this for a living.
[Chandler, trying to make nice with Jack, laughs at his joke and points at Jack.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Ok, I have dandruff. There’s no need to laugh and point.
[Monica rushes over to Chandler’s side.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Dad, Chandler was just laughing at your joke.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: My joke wasn’t funny.
[Phoebe walks from the living room to the kitchen and talks quietly to Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rach, Rach, I just remembered. I had a dream about Mr. Geller last
night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I dreamt that he saved me from a burning building and he was so
brave and so strong! And it’s making me look at him totally differently. Y’know,
I mean he used to be just, y’know “Jack Geller Monica and Ross’s dad”
and now he’s he’s “Jack Geller, dream hunk."
[We see a shot of Jack stuffing his face with food. Some dream hunk!]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I dunno. Y’know to me he’ll always be “Jack Geller, walks
in while you’re changing.”
[Time lapse. Ross and Joey are cleaning the table while Judy and Phoebe talk by the
window. Jack and Chandler are sitting on the couch while Monica sits on the coffee table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know dad, Chandler is one of Ross’s very best friends!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, Ross sure is a great guy, y’know I’ve always felt that
how a young man turns out is a reflection on his father.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I always thought that too. Tell me, what does your father do?
[Chandler and Monica exchange worried looks.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (worried) He’s the headliner of a gay burlesque show.
[Rachel is in the kitchen fiddling with her English truffle. Joey and Ross, anxious to
leave and go to Janine’s party, are egging her on to hurry up.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach, you’re killin’ us here, will ya serve the dessert already?
Those drunken dancers are waiting!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at her truffle) Look at it, isn’t it beautiful?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, what is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s a truffle. It’s got all of these layers. First
there’s a layer of ladyfingers, then a layer of jam, then custard, which I made from
scratch, [Joey and Ross make impressed faces] then raspberries, more ladyfingers, then
beef sauteed with peas and onions, [Joey and Ross look like something’s wrong.] then
a little more custard, and then bananas, and then I just put some whipped cream on top!
[Joey and Ross make confused faces.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: W-What was the one right before bananas?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The beef? Yeah, that was weird to me, too. But then, y’know, I
thought “well, there’s mincemeat pie,” I mean that’s an English
dessert, these people just put very strange things in their food, y’know. [To Joey]
Oh! by the way, can I borrow some Rum from your place?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y-sure!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (teasingly) And while I’m gone don’t you boys sneak
a taste.

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: (faking dissapointment) Okay.
[Rachel leaves]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Beef in a dessert?! I- no no no, there is no way!
[Ross goes to look in the magazine Rachel got her recipe from.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, and only one layer of jam?! What is up with that?
[Ross looks up as if saying that Joey was weird. He begins flipping through the pages,
only to find that they are sticky. So one page is overlapping another, making two recipes
look like one.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God, the pages are stuck together!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (turning to Chandler in a scolding tone) Chandler!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh My God, she-she made half a English Trifle, and half a...Sheperd’s
Pie!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sad) Oh man! Now she’s gonna start all over! We’re never gonna
get to introduce the hot girls to the new world!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, we will. We just won’t tell her she messed up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just let her serve the beef-custard thing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it’ll be like a funny Thanksgiving story!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shrugging his shoulders to go along with it) Vomiting stories are
funny...
[Rachel enters]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, God, your apartment is like a hundred degrees!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Did-did it make you wanna walk around in your underwear?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (frustrated) Still not hot enough!
[Joey leaves]
[Phoebe walks over to talk to Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, look at him. Look at those strong hands. Oh what I wouldn’t
give to be that can of (looks closer to see what Jack is drinking) condensed milk.
[We see a shot of Jack drinking condensed milk on the couch.]
[Ross and Judy enter the living room. Judy and Ross sit down on the couch beside Jack.
Monica and Chandler are sitting on the coffee table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mom, uh, Chandler was just saying how beautiful your sweater is.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh, thank you Chandler! I just bought it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yes. Well it’s very beautiful. It’s cream-colored and
tight [Realizes what he just said and looks worried. Monica and Ross also looked shocked.
Judy and Jack give Chandler a very dirty look.] I don’t mean tight, I mean it’s
not too tight, not that I was looking at-[giving up all hope, he puts his head into his
hands.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: What’s the matter with him?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (whispers to Jack a little loudly) I think he’s stoned again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (worried) Dude, I need to talk to you a sec.
[Ross and Chandler get up and go into Rachel’s old room.]
[Scene: Rachel’s old room. It’s pretty much empty except for a few boxes
against the walls. Ross and Chandler enter.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I think I might know why my parents don’t like you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You do? Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, remember, we were young. Hey, Spring break, sophomore year, I got
high in my bedroom and my parents walked in and smelled it and so I told them that you had
gotten stoned and jumped out the window.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?! Why did you do that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know, aheh, your’s was the first name that-that popped
into my head, I’m I’m sorry. I-I didn’t think it would matter.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How could it not matter?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How was I supposed to know we’d end up being friends after college,
let alone you-you would be living with my sister?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What about all that “friends forever” stuff?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know, I-I was all high.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Rachel’s Old Bedroom, Continued from earlier. Monica enters the room.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mom and dad just sent me in here to find out if you (points to Chandler)
were trying to get Ross stoned!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Your parents caught Ross smoking pot in college and he blamed it on
me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, I can’t believe you’d do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The reason we haven’t told them we’re together is because
they hate me, okay? So will you fix this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, I’ll tell ‘em it wasn’t Chandler who got high.
Now who should I say it was?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You! It’s not like it’s a big deal! You-you don’t still
do it or anything!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, alright, now-now who should I say tricked me into doing it?
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s, Time lapse. Jack is still on the couch, picking his
teeth with his feet on the table. Phoebe and Judy are sitting on the table looking at him.
Ross and Chandler are sitting by the window talking. Rachel and Joey are in the kitchen
fooling with Rachel’s trifle. Monica walks into the living room from the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Dad, please don’t pick your teeth out here! Alright, and if
you’re gonna put your feet up, why don’t you sit on the-

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica, leave him alone!
[Monica gives Phoebe a surprised expression and goes over to Ross and Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Rachel) Will you hurry up? Did you not hear me before when I told you
that all of Janine’s friends are dancers?! And that they’re going to be drinking
alot!?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastically) No, I did, but tell me again, because it’s so
romantic.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well you’re whippin’ so slow! Can’t you do it any faster?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! Come on! I don’t wanna make any mistakes, alright? This is
the only dessert and if I screw it up everybody's gonna be like “Oh, remember that
Thanksgiving when Rachel screwed up the trifle?”
[Joey gives her an understanding look.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So why don’t you just let me worry about making the trifle and you
just worry about eating it, alright?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh I am!
[Chandler and Monica are by the window pressuring Ross to tell his parents the truth.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, if you don’t tell them, then I will!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, fine!
[Ross gets up to go tell his parents.]
[Joey rushes over.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross! Can I talk to you for a second?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, uh, can it wait a second Joey? I have to tell my parents something. No
it can’t? Okay.
[Monica and Chandler make “What was that?” gestures. Joey and Ross go into
Rachel’s old room.]

scenes.location: Rachel’s old room, Ross and Joey enter.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, look, I think we have to tell Rachel she messed up her dessert.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! What is with everybody? It’s Thanksgiving, not...Truth-Day!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, when everyone eats that...that...Banana-Meat thing, they’re all
gonna’ make fun of her, do you want that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, we’ll just get everyone to act like they like it.
That-that way noone makes fun of her and we still get to go to Sweet Potatoe Pie!
(Referring to the dancers.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (scolding) Dude, they’re not objects.
[Ross makes a sorry face.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just kiddin,’ I’ll talk to them, you distract Rach.
[Joey and Ross go back out into the main area.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Rach, can I talk to you outside for a second?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay...
[The hallway. Rachel and Ross go out and they just stand there for a few seconds.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’s up, Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So um...Thanksgiving. The holiday season is upon us, hm?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And um...You look nice today.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no. No Ross, don’t do this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just- I don’t think us getting back together is a good idea.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked) Eh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I thought this might happen today. Ross, I know the holidays can be
rough. Y’know? And it’s probably really hard for you to be alone right now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (cutting her off) You’re alone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I-I live with Phoebe. I mean you’re [pity-tone] alone,
alone. And I just-it’s just not the time for us. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (just trying to get out of the conversation) Ah well, can’t blame a
guy for trying!
[Inside Monica and Chandler’s. Joey is almost done explaining the situation to
everyone.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh and (Ross begins to open the door and Joey says some gibberish word to
indicate to Ross that he’s not done yet. Ross closes the door again.) Okay, and uh if
anyone needs help pretending to like it, I learned something in acting class, try uh,
rubbing your stomach (Rubs his stomach) or uh, or saying “mmm” and uh, oh oh!
And smiling (Smiles while pretending to stir a bowl), okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’m not gonna pay for those acting classes anymore.
[Ross and Rachel re-enter.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rachel, there you are! Come on, let’s serve that dessert already!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, you’re gonna have to stop rushing me, you know what? You
don’t get any dessert.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (happily) Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I’m just kidding I would never do that to you! Okay, everybody,
it’s trifle time!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, now, Rach, this is a traditional English trifle, isn’t it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It sure is.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow. So then did you make it with beef or Eggplant?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Beef.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t have any. You know I don’t eat meat. (Faking
dissapointment.) Ohhh no.
[Phoebe gets up and goes into Rachel’s old room, a smile on her face.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, Monica, I want you to have the first taste.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?
[Rachel hands Monica a plate. Monica takes a spoonful of the whipped cream portion.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh oh oh, wait! You only got whipped cream in there! Ya gotta take a
bite with all the layers!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
[Monica takes a bigger spoonful and a pea falls off]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Op! Wait, you dropped a pea.
[Monica puts the pea on top of the spoonful and takes a bite.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (faking joy. Rubbing her stomach and smiling at the same time, like Joey
said) Mmmm! It’s good!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? How good?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s so good, that I feel really selfish about being the only one
who’s eating it, that I think we should have everyone taste how good it is.
Especially Ross.
[Ross glares at Monica.]
[Everyone takes a bite of their trifle.]

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (faking enjoyment) Mmm.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (clearly lying and hating the dessert) Yeah, this is so good, that
I’m gonna go enjoy it on the balcony so that I can enjoy the view whilst I enjoy my
dessert.
[Chandler exits to the balcony.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (lying) I’ve gotta call my friend Mary and tell her how good
this is, from Monica’s room.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (also lying) I’ll help you dial.
[Jack and Judy exit to Monica’s room.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (again, lying) I’m gonna go into the bathroom so I can look at it
in the mirror, as I eat it.
[Monica exits to the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, now what was that all about? Is it-does it not taste good? Let me
try it.
[Rachel reaches for Ross’s plate]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha? No no! Ah! (Ross scarfs all of his trifle down in about a second. He
looks like he’s going to throw up.) (Lying) All gone! So good! Maybe Chandler has
some left.
[Rachel leaves to the balcony.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It tastes like feet!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I like it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you kidding?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s not to like? Custard? Good. Jam? Good. Meat? Gooooood.
[Rachel and Chandler re-emerge from the balcony.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...So a bird just grabbed it, and then tried to fly away with it and,
and then just dropped it on the street?
[Chandler makes a fake "I know I couldn’t believe it either" gesture.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (lying) Yes, but if it’s any consolation, before the bird dropped
it, he seemed to enjoy it.
[Phoebe comes back from Rachel’s old room.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel, come here. (Rachel walks over to Phoebe. Chandler sits down on
the lounge-chair.) Okay, I was just starting to take my Thanksgiving nap, and I had
another dream about Jack.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Phoebe, do I wanna hear this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I dunno, let’s see! So, okay, I dreamt that we were gonna get
married, and he left, becuz he had to go fight a fire. And, um, so okay, I went to a night
club, and I saw him making out with a girl.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (humoring Phoebe) Oh my God, he dream-cheated on you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but then Jacques Cousteau came and he kicked his ass for betraying
me! It was soo cool! Then, he took me diving and he introduced me to his pet seahorse,
who, by the way, was totally coming on to me, and please, that is not gonna happen.
[Jack and Judy come out of Monica’s room and sit down on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Boy, I’m glad I wore the big belt today.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Five minutes ago, a line like that would’ve floored me. Now
nothing. Well, not nothing, I am still a woman.
[Rachel and Phoebe walk into the kitchen. Monica comes out of the bathroom and goes
over to Ross.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross? Let’s go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, about telling Mom and Dad, I was thinking about maybe writing a
letter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, you know what? That’s it. You’ve had your chance.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha-what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (out loud, to her parents) Mom! Dad! Ross smoked pot in college!

lines.speaker: Mr. and Mrs. Geller
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in a 5 year old’s tone) (To Monica) You are such a tattletale! Mom,
Dad, you remember that-that time you walked in my room and smelled marijuana?

lines.speaker: Mr. and Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Yes. (They look at Chandler angrily.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I told you it was Chandler who was smoking the pot but it was me.
I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: It was you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And Dad, y’know that mailman that you got fired? He didn’t
steal your Playboys! Ross did!
[The Gellers stare at Ross. Ross looks at his parents with an afraid, shocked look.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well, Hurricane Gloria didn’t break the porch swing, Monica
did!
[The Gellers glare at Monica.]
[Joey, Phoebe, and Rachel are sitting at the table, looking at the Geller siblings like
they’re weirdos.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross hasn’t worked at the museum for a year!
[The Gellers glare at Ross.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica and Chandler are living together!
[The Gellers glare at Monica, shocked]
[Monica and Chandler both are shocked. Ross gives Monica a “take that!”
look.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross married Rachel in Vegas! And got divorced! Again!!!!
[The Gellers glare at Ross.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (joining in) I love Jacques Cousteau!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading the recipe magazine, finally figuring out that...) I
wasn’t supposed to put beef in the trifle!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pounding the table) I wanna gooooooo!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (rubbing her temples) That’s alot of information to get in in
thirty seconds! Alright Joey, if wanna leave, just leave. Rachel, no you weren’t
supposed to put beef in the trifle. It did not taste good. Phoebe, I’m sorry, but I
think Jacques Cousteau is dead. (Phoebe makes a sad face.) Monica, why you felt you had to
hide the fact that you were in an important relationship is beyond me.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: And we kinda figured about the porch swing.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Ross, drugs? Divorced? Again?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: What happened son?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I-I uh, I got tricked into all those things!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Chandler! You’ve been Ross’s best friend all these years,
stuck by him during the drug problems. (Ross gets disgusted.) And now you’ve taken on
Monica as well. Well, I don’t know what to say. You’re a wonderful human being.
[Chandler is mega shocked!]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: No! Thank you! (Hugs Chandler) Monica, and Ross! I don’t know
what I’m gonna do about the two of you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (In a parent-like tone) I’ll talk to them!

title: The One with the Routine

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler’s apartment, everyone except Ross is decorating the
tree.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me ask you, why is everybody using these tiny lights nowadays? I
remember when people used to use big lights.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s a good story, Grandpa.
(Ross enters)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, Monica’s letting other people help decorate her tree! Did
someone get her drunk again or?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Having a perfectly decorated tree is not what Christmas is about.
It’s about being with the people that you love.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is nice and we’re done. TADA!
(Her side of the tree looks a complete mess)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I dunno what it is, it just doesn’t quite feel like Christmas to
me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, here.
(She turns the tree around so that her side, which is perfectly decorated, is showing)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See now it feels like Christmas!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone except Phoebe and Joey are there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: … and that’s the story of the dreidle. Now, some people
trace the Christmas tree back to the Egyptians, who used to bring green palm branches into
their huts on the shortest day of the year, symbolising life’s triumph over death.
And that was like 4000 years ago.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, pretty much around the same time that you started telling this
story.
(Joey enters)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey you guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Joe what’s up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I had to get out of the apartment. Janine is like stretching all over the
place. Y’know, everywhere I look she’s like… (He imitates her stretching)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can see why that’s hard to resist.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I like her so much!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aw, I’m sorry sweetie that she doesn’t feel the same way.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know. And she’s so sweet. I just wanna feed her grapes and brush
her hair.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You are aware that she’s not a monkey, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am so over Janine. I mean, yeah, at first I thought she was hot,
but now she’s like OLD NEWS!
(Janine enters)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi Janine!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I just got a call to be a dancer on a television special for New
Year’s Eve. It’s called some sort of Dick’n Rock’n Dickie Eve.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hold it! Are you talking about Dick Clark’s New Year’s
Rocking Eve?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Yeah, that’s what I said.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! We love that show! I mean Ross and I have been watching it
since I can remember!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, you’re still just a little fat girl inside aren’t you?
(He kisses her on the cheek)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well I’m gonna be on it this year. I’m gonna be one of the
party people.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re gonna be a party person! Those guys rock the most!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well they said I should bring someone. (To Joey) Do you wanna be my
dance partner?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Totally! I would love to spend New Year’s with you.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well actually they’re taping tomorrow. I don’t really
understand why.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, well you see how it works is, the part with Dick Clark in Times
Square is actually live, but they tape some of the party stuff ahead of time. Yeah, not a
lot of people know that.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Yeah well, do you guys wanna come too?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We are there!
(Rachel laughs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What, what are you laughing at?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I used to date him, but you’re still going out with her!
(Gunther brings Janine a coffee)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Thanks. (To Monica and Ross) Great so we can all go together! I gotta
run. Catch you later!
(Janine leaves)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye Janine!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Did she just ask me out on a date?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about? She just invited him to the biggest party of
the millennium!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but she also invited you and Ross. Yeah, honey, I’m sorry,
but I don’t think that was a romantic thing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Maybe. But hey I know how I can find out. We’re going to a New
Year’s Eve party, right? So at midnight, I can kiss her. And if she kisses me back,
great! Y’know? But if she says ‘Dude, what the hell are you doing?’ I can
say ‘It wasn’t me, it was New Years!’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, that’s a lot better than Ross trying to kiss me in High
School, and saying that he did it because he needed chapstick.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was a dry day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We are going to Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rocking Eve!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Rachel) Oh my God!

scenes.location: The Set, Joey, Janine, Ross and Monica are walking in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: OK, listen I’ve been on sets before, so let me give you a little
advice, alright? It’s a show, but we’re just dancing, OK? It’s no big deal.
The important thing to remember – stay cool.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Got it!
(They get to the main stage)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God it’s just like I dreamed it!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: OK, everyone gather up.
(Monica and Ross push to the front)

lines.speaker: Monica and Ross
lines.text: ‘Scuse us

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Here’s what’s gonna happen. The music’s gonna start,
you’re gonna dance, we’re gonna tape, you don’t look at the camera. Any
questions?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I have a question. When is this gonna air?
(He and Monica laugh)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Uh, yeah. Now you guys dance over there, you guys over there, and I
want you two right around here, and everyone else spread out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross! So when is it gonna air?
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s apartment, Chandler is there. Phoebe and Rachel
enter.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you look in the kitchen, I will look in the back closet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can save you time ladies, I’m right here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, Chandler why don’t you take a walk? This doesn’t concern
you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We are looking for our Christmas presents from Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? That’s terrible!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no, we do it every year!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh well, that makes it not terrible.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, yeah, we never find them! She’s always best at us that wily
minx.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don’t worry, we’re just gonna search here for an hour, them
we’re gonna go over to Joey’s and search, OK?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No not okay, you can’t look for Monica’s presents!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But we have to!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, you don’t have to, and you can’t because I live here
too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well then, you should look with us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, aren’t you worried about what to get Monica for
Christmas?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I have a great idea for a present for her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, that’s it? (Mimics Chandler) A great idea!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, that’s not enough. I mean what if she gets you a great
present, two medium presents, and a bunch of little presents? And you’ve just gotten
her one great present? I mean that’s just gonna make her feel bad. Why would you do
that to her Chandler? Why? Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If I help, we can find ‘em faster!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s right!
(Phoebe looks under the couch)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh ooh, we have a live one!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s a Macy’s bag!
(Phoebe tips it upside down, and a shoe falls out)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, who’s it for?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Reading) Dear losers, do you really think I’d hide
presents under the couch? P.S. Chandler, I knew they’d break you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-oh. She may be onto us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We are so gonna find them this year.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know when you guys said you were gonna go across the hall and
look, you don’t, you don’t do that every year do you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t, like go into the back of my closet, and look under my
gym bag or anything?

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: No, we never do that
(They turn away.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because that’s where Joey gave me some stuff to store that
I’ve never seen before in my life! Okay, that did not just happen! (He does a weird
clicky motion with his fingers, that kinda hard to describe.)

scenes.location: The Set, everyone is dancing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, here comes another camera.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right. No biggie. Stay loose.
(As the camera passes by, they start to dance really rigid, but the camera is facing
the other way.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why do they keep doing that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: If we wanna get on camera, I think we have to get up on one of those
platforms. They’ve been taping those people up there all day.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right.
(They move towards a platform, dancing really strangely as they go)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what’d you guys do to get up on there?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: We learned how to dance.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah? Well when you learned how to dance did you forget how to put on
underpants?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!
(Camera pans to Joey and Janine)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Hey! You’re a good dancer!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Yeah, well you’d be better if you just loosened your hips a little.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Like this.
(She pulls Joey towards her and dances really close to him.)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: That’s it, feel the rhythm. That’s better.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: (To Joey) Okay, you’re dancing with that girl over there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no-no-no we came together!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: I don’t see it. (To Janine) You are dancing with the tall guy
over there. Tall guy, raise your hand! (He does. Janine goes over to him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no hey buddy, please let me dance with that girl, I really like her and
I think I have a shot.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Really, y’think so? I don’t..
(He leaves, and this girl grabs Joey and starts dancing really wild.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment, Phoebe and Rachel are there and Chandler
enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I couldn't find anything at Joey--Hey-hey, oh hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, we found them. There were in the guest room closet behind some
coats.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and you have nothing to worry about 'cos they're all crap!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Those are my gifts, I got them for you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohhh. Thanks Chandler they're great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well Chandler, what is this very weird, metal A Z thing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Those are book ends! That's a great gift!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, I'm sorry, thank you for my azzz.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ha!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Make sure you put all that stuff back in the closet, okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, okay, oh, by the way, I just gotta say, I think it's really nice of
you that even after you've moved, you still keep storing that stuff for Joey!
(Chandler does the weird clicky thing again.)

scenes.location: The Set, the girl is still dancing with Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey dancer girl! Can I go to the bathroom? I just.. (The girl starts
dancing really close to him, so he picks her up, twirls her round, and puts her against a
platform) Here we go. (He walks away to find Monica and Ross doing a really out of place
dance) Looking good Gellers!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We know!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, see that snippy guy over there? He’s the one who decides who
gets up on the platform. We should go dance by him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.
(They dance over to him.)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Okay, everybody hold!
(Ross and Monica high-five)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Next on the platforms are… (He points to the right of Ross and
Monica, so they dance over to where he’s pointing to. He points away from them)
…you two! And… (He points the other way, and Ross and Monica follow his arm.
Again he points away.) …You two!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Excuse me, sir, would it help if I weren’t wearing underpants?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica! (Pause) Would it?
(The director shakes his head.)

scenes.location: The Men’s Bathroom, the tall guy is there as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Tall guy! Hey, listen, I wanted to talk to you about that girl that
you’re dancing with.

lines.speaker: Tall Guy
lines.text: She’s nice, huh? To think I almost brought my wife to
this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, okay. Uh, look buddy, I came with that girl, and I had this
plan to kiss her at the new years countdown – I’m trying to win her over, so I
was wondering if..

lines.speaker: Tall Guy
lines.text: No I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh come on man, you can dance with my partner, she’s real, uh,
mellow!

lines.speaker: Tall Guy
lines.text: Look, are you dating this girl you came with?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I was hoping after tonight that maybe I could you know…

lines.speaker: Tall Guy
lines.text: No, no. She’s fair game if you ask me, sorry buddy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, alright, hey y’know fair is fair, (he pretends to wash his
hands) if you’re right, you’re right, what can I say, but hey oh no! (He throws
water on the guy’s pants)

lines.speaker: Tall Guy
lines.text: God! What are you, in second grade?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, now you’re the one who wet his pants. (He throws another handful
on him and runs out)

scenes.location: The Set, Monica and Ross are dancing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Man, this sucks! Y’know if Mom and Dad don’t see us on TV
after we made them so jealous, I mean, who’s gonna be the losers then?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I know what’ll get us up on a platform!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The routine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, we haven’t done the routine since middle school.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, when the snippy guy sees the routine, he’ll wanna build
us our own platform!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Was it really that good?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We got honourable mention in the brother/sister dance category!
Look, it’s almost fake midnight, do we really have any other choice?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, let’s do it. Mom and Dad are gonna be so faced!
(They move into a space, and Ross points to his eyes and then to hers)
(They start the routine. However hard I try, I really cannot describe it. You will have
to watch it. I’m sorry.)
(When they finish, they walk over to the director)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, do we really have to ask who’s going up on the platform
next?

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Oh no! You get up there and do that again exactly like that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! (They run over to a platform)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: (To Cameraman) Make sure you get this, they’re gonna want it for
the bloopers show. (To everyone) Alright cut! Listen up everyone, when we start again
it’s gonna be the countdown to new years, so I wanna see everybody’s excitement.
[Cut to Joey and Janine]

lines.speaker: Tall Guy
lines.text: Hey, pal, you have about three seconds to get away from my
partner.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: What’s going on over here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, take a look at the guy’s pants! I mean, I know you told us to
show excitement, but don’t you think he went a little overboard?

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: What’s the matter with you? Get out of here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, take a hike wetpants!
(The director pushes the Tall Guy away)
[Cut to Ross and Monica, who are finally on a platform!]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can you believe this? We’re gonna be on the platform for the
Millennium moment!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! Hey, you haven’t been practising the routine, have you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, when the music starts up again, I was thinking of maybe goind
into the robot, y’know? (He mimics a robot)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, I think we should stick to the routine, we don’t wanna look
stupid!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Alright we’re back! Ten seconds left here we go! Ten! Nine!
Eight! Seven! (He continues to count as we hear Joey think)
Joey’s Head: Okay, it all comes down to this. Whatever happens,
happens. Destiny.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Three, Two, One!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Cut!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! Year! Happy No Year!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Okay, here’s where we go to the live shot of Times Square, nice
work everyone that’s a wrap!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s apartment, Chandler and Rachel are there, and Phoebe
enters with the Chick and the Duck.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Look who I found!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, hey guys!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know, birds have a very good sense of direction, and I thought
maybe they could help us find where the presents are hidden.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, if the presents are hidden south for the winter.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or we could just follow your clever jokes – any ideas? No!
Didn’t think so! Okay, c’mon guys, show us where the presents are!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, the duck seems to think that Monica got me garbage! Hmm, I wonder
what I could get Monica that’s as good as garbage?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm, how about my azzz?
(Rachel sits on the window seat, and knocks against it)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, this is hollow.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This bench, it’s hollow! I can’t believe I never knew that!
(She pushes all the pillows off it and opens it up) Oh, the presents!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, don’t look directly at them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, no, we could look at them!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, this one’s for me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, this one’s for Chandler. Here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And the big one’s for me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, let’s open them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! Okay! Okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hee hee!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait, we can’t do this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t wanna know what Monica got me. Y’know? I mean, look,
I’m sure she worked really hard at getting you a present, and wanting to surprise me,
and you guys are gonna ruin that, and I, look we have to put these back, this is not what
Christmas is about.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whatever Linus, I’m opening mine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nobody is opening anything ok? Look, I don’t know about you guys,
but I wanna see the look on Monica’s face when I give her my present, and I’m
sure she wants to see the look on my face when I get mine. So please, please, can we just,
can we put them back?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Will you get us better gifts?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine!
(Monica enters, and they throw the gifts behind them.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey guys! You found the presents? Chandler, you let them find the
presents? Great! Do you know how long it took me to find you that water purifier?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s what you got me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yes, I see what you mean. That look is priceless.
(Rachel leans over to look at him.)

scenes.location: Joey and Janine’s apartment, they both enter.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Home sweet home, huh? Nice to, uh, get back to reality. Plus we know how
the New Year’s gonna go off. I guess there’s no reason for all that Y2K panic,
y’know? Anyway, g’night!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: (She takes his hands) 3, 2, 1. (She kisses him) Happy New Year.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yoii. What was that for?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well, I don’t know tonight when they yelled cut and we didn’t
get to kiss, I was really, really, disappointed, and I just, really wanted to kiss you

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? In the moment, I really wanted to kiss you too. In the moment.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: In the moment, yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But only in the moment. So do ya wanna kiss again?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Sure, New Year’s Eve is only two weeks away. Can you wait?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Me neither.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Joey, you don’t have to count down every time we kiss.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, yeah, okay. Except I sorta felt like I needed a couple of seconds to
get ready.
(They kiss to the music of Auld Lang Syne)
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment, everyone except Joey is there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We were on the platform, ready to dance the world into the new
Millennium, and the guy yelled ‘CUT!’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, wait, so you guys are telling me you actually did the routine from
eighth grade?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. But of course we had to update it a little bit. (To Ross) Hey, by
the way, great thinking about catching me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ‘Cos I was gonna say there’s no way you could’ve done the
end the way you guys did it back then!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? We could do it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know, I mean you were a lot bigger, I mean, stronger
back then.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can do it, okay? Come on, let’s go. (She and Ross get up)

lines.speaker: Monica and Ross
lines.text: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 (Ross runs to be caught by
Monica, but she moves out of the way)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t do it! (Ross falls into Monica’s room)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now you do that, you’re on TV.

title: The One with the Apothecary Table

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, everyone is there as Joey enters happily.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, do you guys think I have a chance with Janine?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, we have been through this before!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Don’t do this to yourself.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She’s made it pretty clear, it is not going to happen.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well all right then, I guess I shouldn’t get to excited about the
fact (excitedly) that I just kissed her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You serious?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah well, we’ll see.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You kissed her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh we kissed it up real nice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you kissed her, so what happened after that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I came over here to tell you guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So she’s just waiting over there for ya?
(Joey nods yes, but suddenly realizes what he did and runs out of the apartment and
back to his place.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey and Janine are pretty much making out at one of the tables
as Monica and Rachel look on from the couch.]

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I gotta go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I’m gonna be really late for dance class!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Okay, now I’m really late. (Gets up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, I’m all right, okay, but hey, could you just leave your lips?
(She kisses him on the cheek and starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: (to Monica and Rachel) Bye.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye. (Janine exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Have you kissed her yet? It’s awesome! I could do it forever!
Y’know what? She-she kisses better than my mom cooks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am so glad you said cooks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Oh hey Rachel, sweetheart? You have got to tell the
post office that you have moved. Okay? We are still getting all your bills and stuff.
(Hands her all of her bills and stuff.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-oh, Pottery Barn! (Grabs the aforementioned catalog and holds
the rest back out to Chandler.) You can throw the rest away.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not your garbage man. I’m your mailman.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica look! Look-look-look! Here is that table that I ordered. (Shows
her the picture.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You got it from Pottery Barn?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! It’s an apothecary table. Does anyone even know what an
apothecary is?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A pharmacist. (Rachel mocks him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, Phoebe hates Pottery Barn.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I hate Pottery Barn too. They kicked me out of there just because I
sat on a bed!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You took off your pants and climbed under the sheets!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (indignant) I was tired!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe hates Pottery Barn?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, she hates all mass produced stuff. She thinks her furniture should
have a history, a story behind it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well this has story behind it! I mean they had to ship it all the way
from the White Plains store.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s gotta be one of a kind. Y’know like umm, y’know uh,
what’s that God awful ceramic fruit bowl she has on her counter?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! I made that for her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You made pottery?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! I made it of this fruit bowl I found in the garbage.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m telling—If you put that in her apartment you’ll never
hear the end of it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay fine! I’ll-I’ll just tell her it’s an antique
apothecary table, she doesn’t have to know where it came from. Oh! Look at this
little drawers! Oh look-look it says that it holds 300 CDs.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahh, just like the apothecary tables of yore…
[Scene: The Hallway between the apartments, Joey, Janine, Chandler, and Monica are
returning from a double date. Chandler is telling a joke.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: …so then the farmer says, "That’s not a cow and
you’re not milking it." (Everyone laughs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am so glad you guys got together, Chandler and I are always looking
for a couple to go out with and now we have one!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look at us, we’re a couple of couples!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I had so much fun tonight, and what a great restaurant.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And Chandler I can’t believe I let you pay for this one. (They hug
and he whispers in his ear.) Thanks man.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So do you guys gonna come over tomorrow? I’ll make that pasta thing
I was telling you about.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Oh that would be great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, but hey look, at least let us bring the wine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, you don’t have too!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope-op! I insist! (He hugs Chandler again and whispers to him.) You get
the wine right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah all right. (They part.) Okay, good night guys.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See ya tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Can’t wait! (They each go into their respective apartments.)
[Cut to Joey and Janine’s.]

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: How are we gonna get out of that one?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I can’t handle two nights in a row with them.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What-what’s wrong with Monica and Chandler?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I don’t know, they’re just a little blah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Blah?!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well y’know, he’s blah, she’s just—she’s very
loud for such a small person.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, they’re like my best friends. Are you saying we can’t hang
out with them? ‘Cause that would kinda be a problem.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: No! Of course we can still hang out with them. Just y’know, not two
nights in a row. Okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Thank you. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If you want, I’ll sell my friends and use the money to buy you
presents.
[Scene: Phoebe and Rachel's, Rachel is placing CDs into her antique apothecary table as
Phoebe returns home.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sees the table) Ooh, what a great table! Where-where did you get it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Guess!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, a flea market?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ha! See, I knew, I knew you’d get it on the first guess. Isn’t
it cool! It’s an apothecary table.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! Oh you can just imagine that this is where (She’s opening and
closing the drawers) they kept all the stuff to make their potions.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know? Ooh, you can almost smell the opium.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Almost.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How much was it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It was only 500 bucks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: 500 bucks at a flea market?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, okay see I thought, I thought you meant how much was it when it was
new, y’know like back then.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah no, I mean it was at a flea market, so it was y’know, it was
like a dollar.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A dollar?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And fifty. So it was like one and fifty dollars.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, okay, they gave you the old time pricing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, what period is it from?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, it’s from yore. Like the days of yore. Y’know?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, yes I do. God, oh it’s just perfect! Wow! I bet it has a great
story behind it too. Did they tell you anything? Like y’know where it was from

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! That I know, this is from White Plains.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) White Plains. Oh, it sounds like such a magical place.
[Scene: Ross’s apartment, Rachel is entering as Ross comes out of the kitchen
carrying popcorn.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! We’re here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing his new table) Ohh! Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You like it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s my new apothecary table!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! Phoebe’s gonna be here any second, she cannot see this!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well why not?! She’ll-she’ll love it! It’s the real thing!
I got it at Pottery Barn.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know you did! I bought the same one! And if she sees your table
she’s gonna know that I lied to her. I told her ours was an original.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why did you do that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because she hates Pottery Barn.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She hates Pottery Barn?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know! I know, she says it’s all mass-produced, nothing is
authentic, and everyone winds up having the same stuff. (Ross looks at his table.) So come
on, she’s gonna be here any second! Can we please just cover this up with something?!
Please?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? No! No! I am not gonna hide it from Phoebe—Ooh, although I did
get some great Pottery Barn sheets! (Gets them.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooo! Oh, I forgot they made sheets!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, yeah! I still can’t believe she hates Pottery Barn!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, get over it! It’s not like she hates you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah but Pottery Barn! Y’know what I think? It’s just
she-she’s weird. Y’know it’s because she’s a twin. Twins are weird.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, she’s not weird, she just wants her stuff to be one of a
kind.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh. Y’know what’s not one of a kind? A twin!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, Phoebe’s here! Okay, let’s turn out all the lights and
we’ll just watch the movie!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Hey—Ooh, cool sheets! (Notices the sheet over the table.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you like it? You wanna know where I got it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He got it a flea market!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You bought your sheets at a flea market? Ross come on, you gotta loosen
the purse strings a little.

scenes.location: Joey and Janine’s, Joey is pacing around as Chandler and Monica enter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The dinner will be ready in twenty minutes. This is so exciting.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And here is the bottle of wine for you to bring over tonight. (Hands
it to him.) You were also going to buy Monica flowers but you couldn’t afford it,
because you paid dinner last night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks. Thanks, but uh actually it’s just gonna be me again tonight.

lines.speaker: Monica
