lines.text: What happened to Janine?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, she’s uh-uh really sick.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s too bad.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, she’s been in there all day (Points to her room), uh high
fever, a nose problem… Phlegm! Phlegm! Phlegm-phlegm-phlegm!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: (entering from her room) Monica! Chandler! I’m really-really sorry
about tonight. I don’t know if Joey told you; I just couldn’t get out of going
to this play. I’m sorry. Have a great time.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Bye. (Exits)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s funny, I saw no phlegm.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Joey and Janine’s, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, she really is sick!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then why-why is she going to a play?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, y’know, starve a fever, go to a play for a cold.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey! Why is Janine not coming over for dinner?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well uh, she didn’t want to hang out with you guys two nights in a
row. I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, why does she not want to hang out with us?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because she uh, she-she thinks that you are blah and that you, Monica, are
too loud.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (loudly) What?!! (Quietly) What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So she was just pretending to have a good time last night? She was
lying to our faces?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ugh, I can not believe this! I mean, who is she to judge us? We could
not have been nicer to her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I am not blah, I am a hoot!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! I know! Come on, please-please you guys, don’t-don’t be
mad. I’m sure she just, she just said that stuff because she was nervous and you guys
are like my best friends! Y’know? And it was our first date! Plus, she’s really
sick!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, you sh—No you said you made that up!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, but don’t you think the sick thing is way better than the
play thing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eh, they’re both good. I generally just go with, Monica’s
drunk again. (Monica glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on you guys, come on please-please just give her another chance, huh?
She’ll come around I promise.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course we will, come on we gotta make dinner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(They exit and close the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (from the hallway) I do not like that woman!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shouting) I can hear you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am loud!

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, Ross, Rachel, and Phoebe are watching a movie.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Aww! (They all laugh.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s funny. (Phoebe puts her feet up on Ross’s table.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, could you please not put your feet up on my new…(On
Rachel’s glare)…old sheet?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh sure! (She goes to take her feet off, but drags the sheet with her
which spills the wine.) Noo!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My apothecary table!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noooooo!! (Phoebe lifts up the sheet to discover the exact same
apothecary table they have.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, where did you get this?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I got it at Pottery Barn!! Okay?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, Phoebe, Pottery Barn has ripped off the design of our
antique!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! Oh my God, well if they’ve ripped off our table ours must be
much more than one and fifty dollars!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well this doesn’t even smell like opium.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course not, it smells like wine, which you spilled! And thanks for
wrecking my sheet by the way.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Ross, calm down, I’ll give you the 80 cents. (Ross glares at
Rachel)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Chandler are sitting at the kitchen table.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, one more time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, would you like some more orange juice?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Perfect decibel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (loudly) I know!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So uh, what are you guys doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh nothing, we’re just talking. Y’know, blah-blah-blah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, come on you guys, you said you were gonna try! All right look, I
came over here to invite you guys to a movie with me and Janine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I’d like to but, (extremely quietly) I’m not sure we
have time to go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ha-ha, very funny—Look! I don’t know what to do! I really want
you guys to get along. Just please come to the movie with us. I mean you owe me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We owe you?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right! I helped you guys out a lot in the start of your
relationship. Huh? I helped you guys sneak around for like six months, and I looked like
an idiot! And I was humiliated. And I only made 200 dollars!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We didn’t give you any money! (Chandler is motioning,
"No!")

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don’t think I know that!
[Scene: Phoebe and Rachel's, Rachel is showing Ross around the newly decorated living
room.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …see I can’t decide whether it would go better next to the new
wicker dining chair, the Sahara desk, or the Parker console table.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! I didn’t know that there was a Pottery Barn up here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I know. I went a little crazy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A little? Your place looks like page 72 of the catalogue. Oh look at that!
The ornamental bird cage! Large!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sees Ross) Oh Ross no. Be careful, that is very old! Okay? Early
Colonial bird merchants used to bring their birds to market in that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (glaring at Rachel) Fascinating.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) Another amazing find! Wow! Oh I bet this has a great story too!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh it does, it does! It is a room separating apparatus from Colonial
times.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm, a lot of this stuff is from Colonial times. Hey, what are some other
time periods Rachel? (She glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well there’s yore. And uh, y’know, yesteryear.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah no, I’m telling you Rachel has such a great eye for this
stuff. Ross, y’know if you ever decide you need to redecorate—And I think that
you should. You should, you should ask Rachel to help.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh honey he doesn’t need my help.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, come on! I think he’s ready to get rid of, what did you call
it? The cheap knock-offs and dinosaur junk.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?! (To Rachel) Hey, y’know what? Since you have such a great
sense of what I need, uh ooh, here’s-here’s 60 bucks, why don’t you take
Phoebe down to that Colonial flea market of yours and get me some stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (not sure of what to do) Y’know what? I don’t, I don’t
think Phoebe really wants to come.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! I do want to!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, she does want to.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She does want to.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

scenes.location: The Street, Phoebe and Rachel are heading back from that Colonial flea market.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, I don’t know what to say. I guess the flea market was just
better last time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well at least I got these sheets for Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.
(They walk by a Pottery Barn window display.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uck, look at this! Pottery Barn, yuck!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, y’know what? Don’t look at it. (Realizes the display is
their living room) Seriously, don’t look at it. (Tries to pull Phoebe away.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Look-look! There’s the coffee table they stole from us!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, those bastards! Let’s go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That fan kinda looks like ours. And the birdcage and the…wait a
sec! This is our exact living room!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No! No! No it’s not! No it’s not! Come on! Phoebe, ours is
totally different! I mean we don’t have the… (Looks desperately for something
different.) We don’t have the…that lamp! And-and that screen is y’know, on
the other side.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God. This is where you got all our stuff, Pottery Barn! Oh
my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! Okay-okay look—no I did, I just wanted this stuff and I know
how you feel about Pottery Barn. Just… Come on don’t be mad.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no-no, but I am mad! I am mad! Because this stuff is everything that
is wrong with the world! And it’s all sitting up in my living room and all I can
think about is how I don’t have that lamp!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well then honey, buy the lamp! Hey, we have that 60 bucks from Ross.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t! I can’t! Unless… Well are you saying that-that
you would move out if-if I didn’t buy that lamp?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! No! I’m not gonna move out!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But are you saying that you would move out if I didn’t buy that
lamp?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gets it) Oh. Yes! I would so move out!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay then I don’t have a choice! I have to buy that lamp!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s right!
(They start to go inside.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But at least the apothecary table is real.
[Scene: The hallway, Joey, Janine, Monica, and Chandler are returning from their second
date.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, this-this-this was great. Didn’t everybody have a great time?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Well I did. I really did. And you guys, I’ve got to say, I’m
sorry if I was a little weird after the last time we went out. I guess I was just nervous
or something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s totally understandable.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don’t worry about it.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: So we can go out again?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Absolutely!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Oh good.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well then, good night!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good night! (They go into their respective apartments.)
[Cut to Joey and Janine’s, they’re entering.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See? Eh, wasn’t that fun?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: We have got to move!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (bursting in) I knew it!! Y’know, you’re not so quiet
yourself, missy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I’m blah? Listen, the only thing more boring than watching
modern dance is having to listen to you talk about it, (Imitating her) "Oh Chandler,
I just lost myself in the moment."

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Y’know, I know you’re talking, but all I hear is, "Blah.
Blah. Blah-blah-blah."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (steps up and points at her) All right! You and me! Let’s go! Right
now!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! All right! Enough! Enough! Enough!! Enough! (To Chandler and
Monica) You two go home! I-I-I gotta talk to Janine! (They start to leave.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Y’know I think you can take her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Janine) You’d better hope I don’t see you in the hallway!!
(They exit.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, uh, we’ve got a little bit of a problem here. These people
are my friends; you can’t treat them that way.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: They said stuff to me too, y’know!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! I know! And I’m going to talk to them about it. They mean so
much to me. They… They’re like my family. If you guys are gonna be fighting all
the time, I-I… I don’t think we can be together. It just, it just can’t
work. It can’t. (Starts to break up) I’m very upset.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Would, would it help if I went over and apologized?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah! That would be very helpful! Yeah. (He opens the door for her
and she exits into the hallway.)
[Cut to the hallway, Janine is entering as Monica is taking out the garbage.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What did I tell you about the hall?!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I was just coming over here to apologize for my behavior! I’d
really like it if we could be friends.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I know that would make Joey happy, so, I would like that too.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now come on. (They hug like men.) Well, I’m glad we worked things
out.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I’ll see you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye. (Leaves to resume her garbage removal task.)

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: (muttering to herself) Or I’ll hear you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (hearing that) That’s it big girl! (Hits Janine in the butt with
the garbage bag) Come on!

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: Wait! (Janine pauses, then runs down the stairs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (chasing her) You’d better run!
(Joey and Chandler both come into the hallway.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah uh, what am I gonna do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’m sorry man. (Pause) You wanna go watch?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! (They head downstairs.)
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross, Chandler, and Monica are there as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How ya doin’?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey so, did uh, did she move out?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pretty much, yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I cannot believe you broke up with her just like that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, when it’s not right, you know it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah. I’ll be all right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what would cheer you up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m giving this lecture on erosion theories tomorrow night, I think
you should come.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughing hysterically) You’re right! That did cheer me up!

title: The One with the Joke

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Chandler, Phoebe, Rachel and Monica are there. Ross walks in with
a magazine in his hand.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, you’re not going to believe this. I made up a joke and sent it
in to Playboy. They printed it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I didn’t know Playboy prints jokes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, they print jokes, interviews, hard-hitting journalism. It’s not
just about the pictures.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That didn’t work on mom, it’s not going to work on us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (showing them the page) Here, check it out. It’s the first
one, too.
(They all laugh indifferently, except Chandler, who’s a little angry.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is funny. It was also funny when I made it up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I made that joke up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, oh-oh, no you didn’t. I did.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, I did. I told it to Dan at work, and he said it was the funniest
joke he’d ever heard.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, tell Dan, ‘Thanks.’
(Rachel is looking at the magazine and laughing.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry, I was just reading the joke below it. Man, that one is
funny. (Ross grabs the magazine away from her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica, you remember me telling you that joke, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Seriously?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you tell a lot of jokes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, Chandler, it’s my joke. But, hey, if it makes you feel any
better they don’t print the name, so it doesn’t really matter who gets credit,
right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I guess.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (jumping up from his chair) Hey, Joey, Playboy
printed my joke.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it’s my joke, it’s mine. You can call them, they’ll
tell you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s my joke.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s my joke.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa. Jokes? You guys know they have naked chicks in there,
right?
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Joey’s apartment, Joey is sitting at the counter as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dude, you have got to turn on Behind the Music. The band Heart
is having a really tough time, and I think they may break up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let’s go watch it at your place.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nah, Monica’s watching some cooking show. Come on, I don’t
want to miss when they were skinny.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, Chandler, y’know what we should do? You and I should go out
and get some new sunglasses.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? No, I want to watch this. (He turns on the television and the
screen is completely covered in snow). Did your cable go out?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, that’s VH-1. I gotta tell you, the music these kids listen
to today . . . It’s like a lotta noise to me. I don’t know…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey, why is your cable out?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I uh, oh! Because, uh, I haven’t really paid the bill

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If you need money, will you please-please just let me loan you some
money?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, Chandler. Look, forget about it, okay? Look, I know things have been a
little tight since Janine moved out. Oh, was she hot.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa ho.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! Yeah, but, look I can handle it. All right? Look, I can listen to
the radio, huh? And Ross gave me this great book (holds up the Playboy magazine).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (picks up the phone) All right, you want to see if the joke stealer
will let us watch the show at his place?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (with phone to ear, obviously hearing no dial tone) Paid your phone
bill?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not so much.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Rachel are on the couch looking at the Playboy
magazine. When they hear someone coming, Monica goes to hide it under the sofa cushions.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (relieved) It’s only you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wh-wh-what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We are looking at a Playboy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I want to look too! (She runs over and sits down and checks out a
picture). Yikes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So do you think that these pictures—Are, are they trying to tell a
story?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah, sure. I mean, like in the case of this young woman, she has
lost her clothes, so she rides naked on the horse, she’s crying out, ‘Where are
they, where are they?’

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, she’s not going to find them lying in the grass like that.
(They flip through the pages to another picture.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Aw, remember the days when you used to go out to the barn,
lift up your shirt, and bend over?

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You see, now, I would date this girl. She’s cute, she’s
outdoorsy, you know, and she knows how to build a fire. I mean, that’s got to come in
handy

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I’ve got a question. If you had to pick one of us to date,
who would it be?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (thinks) I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Me neither.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know. (Pause) Me neither.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey, Chandler, and Ross are sitting on the couch.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You forget how many great songs Heart had.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, Barracuda was the first song I learned to play on the keyboard.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, you heard it, you repeated it, so that must mean you wrote it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you guys, with this joke. I gotta say, I know I cracked up, but
I’m not even sure I got it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, you didn’t get it? The doctor is a monkey.
(He and Chandler crack up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And monkeys can’t write out prescriptions.
(He and Ross crack up again. Joey just sits there)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stops laughing, to Ross) You are not allowed to laugh at my joke.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Your joke? Well, I think ‘the Hef’ would disagree, which is why
he sent me a check for one hundred ah-dollars.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, you stole my joke, and you stole my money.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I was going to stick it in the ATM, but now I think I’ll show
the sexy teller that I am a published writer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, she is going to know that you stole the joke.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, what are you going to do, follow me down there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’m not going to go now anyway (he goes to sit down).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay (he goes to sit down).
(Ross leaps out of his chair and runs out the door, with Chandler in hot pursuit.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (handing Joey the bill) Here you go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, Gunther, I can’t pay for this right now because I’m not
working, so I’ve had to cut down on some luxuries like uh, payin’ for stuff.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Well, if you want, you can work here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, I don’t know. Ya see, it’s just, see I was a regular on a
soap opera y’know? And to go from that to this, I just… Plus, I’d have to
wait on all my friends.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Okay, but the money’s good, plus you get to stare at Rachel as
much as you want.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Flexible hours.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe I could be a waiter. Could I use the phone?

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s bedroom, they are in bed together.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (visibly upset) She picked Rachel. I mean, she tried to back out of it,
but it was obvious. She picked Rachel.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (visibly upset) He took my joke, he took it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s wrong. You know what else is wrong? Phoebe picking Rachel.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know who else picked Rachel? Ross, and you know what else Ross
did? He stole my joke. You know what? I’m going to get a joke journal. Y’know?
And document the date and time of every single one of my jokes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s a good idea.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you know what’s a bad idea?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Picking Rachel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right. (A noise comes from the living room.) Did you hear
something?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe it’s the sound of Ross climbing into my brain and stealing
my thoughts.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s coming from the living room.
(They go out to investigate, and find Joey wrapped in a blanket watching their
television.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sheepishly) I finished my book. (Chandler and Monica slowly retreat back
to bed.)
[Scene, Phoebe and Rachel’s, they’re sitting together on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey, you guys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughing) Oh, don’t you guys look cute. You guys make
such a cute couple.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughing harder) Nothing, I’m just trying to recreate
some of the fun that we had at my place the other day. (To Phoebe) Remember, when you
picked Rachel over me? That was funny.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I guess it was kinda funny.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (angrily) It wasn’t funny at all! Why would you do that?
Why didn’t you pick me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine. The reason that I was leaning a little bit more toward Rachel than
you is just that you’re … just … kinda high maintenance—Okay
let’s go to lunch!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is completely untrue. You think I’m high maintenance? Okay,
prove it. I want you to make a list and we’re going to go through it point by point!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, okay, you’re right. You’re easy-going. You’re just
not as easy-going as Rachel. She’s just more flexible and-and mellow. That’s
all.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Monica) Well, people are different.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ya, you know, Rachel … she’ll do whatever you want.
Y’know, you can just walk all over her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Wait a minute. What are you saying, that I’m a pushover?
I’m not a pushover.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay, (laughing) you’re not a pushover.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my … you think I’m a pushover. Well wait, watch this, you
know what? You’re not invited to lunch. What do you think of that? I think
that’s pretty strong, that’s what I think. Come on, Monica, let’s go to
lunch. (She leaves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Phoebe) You start working on that list. (She grabs her
coat and leaves, too.)
[Cut to the hallway.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I cannot believe her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know. Where do you wanna go eat?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, oh, I love that Japanese place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sick of Japanese. We’re not going there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, wherever you wanna go is cool.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right.
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica, Rachel, and Chandler are there as Ross enters and sees
Gunther.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (showing the Playboy magazine to Gunther) Oh, hey, Gunther, check this
out.
(Gunther looks at the joke and laughs.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Yeah, that-that Chandler cracks me up.
(Ross begins to say something, realizes what Gunther just said, turns, and glares at
Chandler. Chandler just shrugs it off.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross, listen, you want anything to drink, ‘cause I’m heading
up there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, yeah, I’ll take a coffee. Thanks, man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure. (To Monica and Rachel) Coffee? ‘Cause I’m going up there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to a table of strangers) You guys need anything, ‘cause I’m
heading up there.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’d love an ice water.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just being friendly. (He gives Monica a ‘what’s wrong with
you?’ look and proceeds to walk behind the counter.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, honey, I don’t think you’re supposed to go back there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nah, it’s okay. Right, Gunther? (Winks at him as if they’re in
on a secret together.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Don’t wink at me. And put on your apron.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, but I don’t see you asking any other paying customers to put on
aprons.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, do you work here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Hey, waiter.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, what’s going on. What didn’t you tell us you work here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s kind of embarrassing, y’know. I mean, I was an actor and
now I’m a waiter. It’s supposed to go in the other direction.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So is your apron. You’re wearing it like a cape.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I mean, the job’s easy and the money’s good, you know? I guess
I’m going to be hanging out here anyway. I might as well get paid for it, right? I
just feel kind of weird serving you guys.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on, Joey, I did it and it was fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, why would it be weird? Hey, Joey, can I get some coffee?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, I guess it doesn’t seem that weird.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Seriously, I-I asked you before and you still haven’t gotten it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See, now it’s weird again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think it’s great that you work here. You’re going to make
a lot of money, and here’s your first tip: Don’t eat yellow snow. (He laughs,
then picks up a pen, glares at Ross, and writes in his journal). Ah ha ha, 2:15,
coffeehouse.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you know what? This is great. Finally, I have someone I can pass
on my wisdom too. Let me tell you about a couple of things I learned while working at the
coffeehouse. First of all, the customer is always right. (Joey nods.) A smile goes a long
way. (Joey smiles) And if anyone is ever rude to you? Sneeze muffin.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks, Rach. Look, you guys are just terrific. Y’know? Now, how
about clearing out of here so I can get some new customers. It’s all about turnover.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, seriously, can I get my coffee?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry, Ross. I’ll get it for you right now. And since I
made you wait, I’ll toss in a free muffin.
(He looks at Rachel and winks, she gives him the thumbs-up sign.)
[Scene: Phoebe and Rachel’s, Phoebe is sitting on the couch as Rachel and Monica
enter.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe. We would like to talk to you for a second.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, maybe I am a little high maintenance. And maybe Rachel is a little
bit of a pushover. But you know what we decided you are?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, we are very sorry to tell you this, but you, Phoebe, are flaky.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That true, I am flaky.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, what, you’re just, you’re just okay with being flaky?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, totally.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, then, I’m okay with being high maintenance.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and I am okay with being a pushover.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s great. Good for you guys.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am not high maintenance!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am not a pushover!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who said you were?

lines.speaker: Monica and Rachel
lines.text: You did!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I’m flaky. I’ll say anything.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is coming back from using the phone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Gunther. Can you uh, can you cover for me? I just got an audition.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: No, I’m leaving to get my hair dyed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?! I like your natural color. Come on man, it’s a great part.
Look, check it out. I’m the lead guy’s best friend and I wait for him in this
bar and save his seat. Listen-listen. ‘I’m sorry, that seat’s saved.’

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: That’s the whole part?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, maybe he’s not his best friend, but …

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Okay, I’ll see you in an hour.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, man, I could totally get that part. ‘I’m sorry, that seat is
taken.’

lines.speaker: Patron
lines.text: Oh, excuse me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, I didn’t mean you. But, you believed me, huh?

lines.speaker: Patron
lines.text: I believed you were saving this seat for someone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, you’d hire me, right?

lines.speaker: Patron
lines.text: For what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Exactly! All right, everybody, listen up. The coffeehouse is going to be
closed for about an hour.

lines.speaker: Customers
lines.text: Huh? What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it’s for the kids. To keep the kids off drugs. It’s a very
important issue in this month’s Playboy. I’m sure you all read about it.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler and Ross are both pouting and sitting on the
couch.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s my joke.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s my joke.

lines.speaker: Ross and Chandler
lines.text: It’s my joke.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know, I don’t think we’re going to settle this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let’s have Monica decide.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Mon.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mon, get out here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica! (She appears, not sure why she was summoned.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, okay. You have to help us decide whose joke this is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why do I have to decide?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because you’re the only one that can be fair.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t be fair. You’re my boyfriend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but I’m your brother. We’re family. That’s the most
important thing in the world.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) Don’t try to sway her. (To Monica) (Softly) I’m
your only chance to have a baby. Okay, let’s go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We’ll each tell you how we came up with the joke and then you decide
which one of us is telling the truth—me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Chandler, you go first.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I thought of the joke two months ago at lunch with Steve.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, wait, is he the guy I met at Christmas?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can I finish my story?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you want me to pick you?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: See, I would never snap at you like that.
(Chandler motions to Monica that he’ll give her two babies.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Continue.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So Steve said he had to go to the doctor. And Steve’s
doctor’s name is Doctor Muppy. So I said, ‘Doctor Monkey?’ And that is how
the whole Doctor Monkey thing came up. (He slams his feet up on the table to emphasize his
point.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you kidding? Okay, look. I-I studied evolution. Remember, evolution?
Monkey into man? Plus, I’m a doctor, and I had a monkey. I’m Doctor Monkey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not arguing with that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I’ve heard enough. I’ve made my decision.
(Both Chandler and Ross are eager to hear her decision.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You are both idiots. The joke is not funny, and it’s offensive to
women, and doctors, and monkeys! You shouldn’t be arguing over who gets credit, you
should be arguing over who gets blamed for inflicting this horrible joke upon the world!
Now let it go! The joke sucks!
(Monica leaves the room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s your joke.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is not.
[Scene: Central Perk, Rachel is sitting at a table and Phoebe is on the couch. Chandler
and Monica can be seen outside, she’s lecturing him, and pushes him inside. He then
nods to Rachel, and is obviously counting off the seconds in his head and then Monica
makes a grand enterance.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, Chandler. There you are.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, oh hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, it’s Phoebe and Rachel. Um, why don’t you tell them what
you were telling me earlier about me not being high maintenance?
(Rachel and Phoebe exchange looks.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (starts to recite a rehearsed speech) Monica is a self-sufficient,
together lady. (Pause.) Being with her has been like being on a vacation. And what may be
perceived as high maintenance is merely attention to detail and—(He falters and
Monica prompts him.)—generosity of spirit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, you know what? That is the best fake speech I think I’ve ever
heard.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? I’ve heard better.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, wait, he came up with that himself. Tell them, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Chandler) I’m out of words. Should I just say the whole thing
again?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, I am not high maintenance. I am not. Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pauses as he struggles with what he has to say) You’re a little
high maintenance.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ahhh! You are on my list.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry. You’re not easy-going, but you’re
passionate, and that’s good. And when you get upset about the little things, I think
that I’m pretty good about making you feel better about that. And that’s good
too. So, they can say that you’re high maintenance, but it’s okay, because I
like … maintaining you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (embarrassed) (To Phoebe and Rachel) I didn’t even tell him to say
that. (They hug). All right you’re off my list.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (happily) I’m off the list. (Sits on the couch.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sits next to him) Phoebe, it’s okay that you don’t want me to
be your girlfriend because I have the best boyfriend.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Monica) Y’know, suddenly I find you very attractive.
(Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, buddy boy, how’d the audition go?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not good, no. I didn’t get the part, and I lost my job here, so

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! That is a bad audition.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How-how did you lose your job here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I had the audition but Gunther said I had to stay here and be in
charge so he could go get his hair dyed. So, I went anyway, and then he fired me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He left work in the middle of the day to do a personal errand and left
you in charge when you’ve been working here two days? That’s not, that’s
not right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, what are ya gonna do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, you can’t let him get away with that. Ya know what, I’m
not going to let him get away with that. I’m going to say something to him—No, I
really shouldn’t say anything—No, I should say something to him. (Goes to the
counter) Gunther, I want you to give Joey his job back. That is really not fair that you
have to fire him…

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: He can have his job back.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s right, he can have his job back. I’m glad we got that
all straightened out. There you go, Joey, you got your job back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s great. Thanks Rach.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, pretty nice, huh? Now who’s a pushover?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (returning from the bathroom) Rach, you’re in my seat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. (Gets up and moves.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica, Phoebe, and Rachel are sitting at the kitchen
table, talking.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, I never got to hear who you guys would pick to be your girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I pick you, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Definitely you, Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, well, I kinda thought.
(Phoebe gets up from the table, and while her back is turned, Rachel and Monica
indicate via sign language that they each would have picked the other.)
(Joey, Chandler and Ross enter.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey. Oh, I have a question. If-if-if one of you had to pick one of the
other two guys to go out with, who would you pick?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No way.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m not answering that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey! (Pause as they all stare at him.) No way. I’m not answering
that.

title: The One with Rachel's Sister

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is giving Rachel, Chandler, Phoebe, and Ross their bills.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay Rach, that muffin and espresso, $4.50. Ross, double latte, $2.75.
Chandler, coffee and a scone, $4.25. And Pheebs, herbal tea, $1.25. So, all together
that’s (pauses to figure the total) $12.75.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This coming from the man who couldn’t split our 80 dollar phone
bill in half.
(A good-looking woman approaches.)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: How much do I owe you for the muffin and the latte?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh that’s on the house courtesy of Joey Tribbiani.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh great! Well, tell him thanks. And since uh, Joey seems like such a
nice guy, maybe we could go on a date sometime?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, he’s not used to women being so forward with him; but uh, I
good check with him—He says it’s okay. (She hands him her card.) Great! Thanks!
Bye-bye!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Joey, how come our stuff isn’t free?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It will be when you look like that in a tight skirt! This is great!
I’m getting more dates than ever!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait a minute, you’re only giving free stuff away to the pretty
girls?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah Joey that is so gross!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How about a scone on the house baby?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (giggles) I’m pretty.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, everyone but Monica is there playing Monopoly.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey does anyone have any gum?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh I do! (She grabs her huge purse and starts rummaging through it and
taking out various items in a futile search for the gum.) Oh, y’know what? No.
(Pause) Wait a second. (She removes a bag filled with water that has a goldfish swimming
in it.) I know it’s in here somewhere.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? I’m good! I’m good!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, what are you doing here? Shouldn’t you be at work?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (congested) Ugh, they sent me home. They said I can’t work if
I’m sick.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m so sorry you’re sick.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m not sick!! I don’t get sick! Getting sick is for weaklings
and for pansies!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, no one thinks you’re a pansy, but we do think you need a
tissue. (She notices something hanging from Monica’s nose, as does Joey.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (wiping her nose) I have not been sick in over three years! (Sneezes.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m gonna grab you some tissue.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t need a tissue! I’m fine-d!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: When you put a ‘D’ at the end of ‘Fine’ you’re
not fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m fine-d. I’m fine-d! Y’know, it’s a really hard
word to say.
(There’s a knock on the door. The gang is stunned and Phoebe counts to make sure
that everyone is there. Out of curiosity Chandler goes and answers the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes?
(A woman enters.)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, is Rachel here? I’m her sister.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, Jill!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Oh my God, Rachel!
(They run and hug each other.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God, introduce us!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This is Chandler. (Points at him.)

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you know Monica and Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi Jill.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And that’s Phoebe (points), and that’s Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, (in the Joey voice) how you doin’?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don’t!! (Joey backs away frightened.) (To Jill) Honey, what are you
doing here?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Ross) Which-which sister is this? Is this the spoiled one or
that’s bitter?

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (To Rachel) Daddy cut me off.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Never mind, I got it.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: And y’know what I said to him? "I’m gonna hire a lawyer and
I’m gonna sue you and take all your money. Then I’m gonna cut you off!"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! What did he say?

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: That he wouldn’t pay for my lawyer! Then he told me to come here and
learn about the value of money from the one daughter he’s actually proud off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Did you hear that?! My dad’s proud of me! My dad’s proud
of me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach? (Points to Jill.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, sorry. Wait honey, so what did you do that made dad cut you
off?

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Okay, I bought a boat.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You bought a boat?

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Yeah but it wasn’t for me, it was for a friend.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Boy did we make friends with the wrong sister! (Rachel glares
at him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Jill, honey, I think this is the best thing that could’ve ever
happened to you. I mean you needed to get out on your own anyway! And you know when I did
it, I-I-I at first I was scared, and look at me now! I’m the only daughter dad is
proud of! Okay, well this is, this is what you’re gonna do. You’re gonna get a
job, you’re gonna get an apartment, and then I’ll help you and you can stay with
us. Right Pheebs, she can stay with us?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course, yeah!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Oh, that’s so great! Okay, I’m really gonna do this! I
don’t know how to thank you guys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, I like cards.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is working as Phoebe and Ross are sitting on the couch.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to a customer) Are you all finished here?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! (Joey takes his cookie and finishes it.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Okay, here are the tips for this morning. Jen gets 50, 50 for me, and
Joey owes eight dollars.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: For all the free food you gave away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well if it’s free food, how come you’re charging me for it?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: We don’t give anything away unless it’s someone’s
birthday.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, what if they came in third in a modeling contest?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to a woman who came in third in a modeling contest) Sorry! (He grabs her
muffin away and returns it to the serving tray.)

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (entering, carrying a bunch of shopping bags) I just had the hardest day.
Those bags are so heavy. (Sets them down.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Jill, how did you pay for all this? I thought your dad took away your
credit card.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Oh please, I memorized those numbers when I was 15. But look at all the
cool make-it-on-my-own stuff I got! (Holds up a red sweater) This is my "Please, hire
me" sweater. (Holds up a pair of black pants) And these are my, "Don’t you
want to rent me this apartment?" pants.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t think charging new clothes too your dad qualifies as making
it on your own.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Oh, Mr. Scientist has to get all technical!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Seriously, I don’t Rachel’s gonna think it’s a good idea.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: So who made her queen of the world?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I would love that job!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey! What’s goin’ on?

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (notices Jill’s bags) Jill! Did you shop?!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: No! They did! (Points to Phoebe and Ross)

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Ross
lines.text: Yeah, we went shopping!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You went shopping?! What, and then you just came in here and paraded it
right under Jill’s nose when you know she’s trying to quit. Wow, you guys are
terrible!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sorry Jill.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry-sorry Jill.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’d you get?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh well, all right, I got (Ross hands her a bag) (To Ross) thank you, I
got uh, this y’know "I want a job sweater." (Holds up the same sweater.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And, and then I got uh, these are apartment pants.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Apartment pants?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you never heard of them?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, of course, of course I’ve heard of them! Ross, what did you
get?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh? Oh, I got this—(Holds up this pink frilly thing)—this!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A pajmena?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Oh, I-I love this babies!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ross, wants a pajmena?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s a rug. (Jill winces.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Jill?

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (covers her eyes and starts crying) I’m sorry Rachel, I’m
sorry…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on! You think that’s gonna work on me?! I invented that!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Right! But, I am sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, it’s okay. One little setback is okay, just don’t
let it happen again, all right? Now since daddy paid for all this stuff, I should
take it all away. But I’m just gonna take the-the pajmena. (Ross hands it to her.)
And the uh, and the uh pants. Y’know what, I’m just gonna take it all away,
‘cause that way you’ll just really learn the lesson. Okay? All righty, I’m
gonna run a couple of errands and I will see you at dinner. (Leaves with all of
Jill’s stuff.)

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: She took all my stuff.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Everything but, the little blue one. (Holds it up for her.)

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (gasps) That’s the best one! Oh my God, (hugs him) thank you so much!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well. Hey…

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Oh my gosh, that was so lame. Like a pajmena could be a rug!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, how about you and the, (mimics her fake cry) "I’m
sorry!"

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (hits him) Shut up! I did not sound like that at all!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What about, what about when I said y’know about the apartment
pants, how dumb was I?
(They both look at her.)

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Were you this cute in high school?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh stop.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: No you stop!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, you stop!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: You stop!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gets up and sits between them) Okay-okay, why don’t I sit here and
you’ll both stop it!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is still very sick and is entering the living

lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: You’ll never believe what just happened, Ross just totally blew me
off and he didn’t even tell me why!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh well. Y’know what honey? The best thing to do to get over a
guy is to start dating someone else. Oh! There is this great guy you will love at work
named Bob! He’s a real up-and-comer in Human Resources.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Y’know, thanks for trying to cheer me up, but I’m not gonna date
some random guy from your work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s not random, it’s Bob.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: It’s probably because not mature enough. Or smart enough. Maybe he
doesn’t like the way I dress—No that can’t be it. It’s really gotta be
the smart thing. Oh I’m so stupid! I’m just like this incredibly pretty
stupid girl!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No honey, okay, okay, you wanna know why Ross canceled the date? Because
I asked him to.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: You asked him too?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hm-mmm.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because you are my sister and Ross and I have this huge history…

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: I don’t understand, do you want to go out with Ross?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: You don’t want him, but you don’t want me to have him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (changing the subject) Y’know Bob in Human Resources…

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Ugh! I cannot believe you did this too me! You had me doubting how smart I
was! (Gasps) You had me doubting my fashion sense!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, this is not that big of a deal! You just don’t date Ross!
There’s a million other guys out there, you just…

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Hey! You have no right to tell me what to do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not telling you what to do! I am telling you what not to
do!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Why are you so jealous of me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Jill this is not about me being jealous of you! This is about you being
a brat! Wanting what you can’t have!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Can’t have?! Excuse me, the only thing I can’t have is dairy!
(Starts to storm out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, all right, well you just blew your chances at dating Bob!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Who?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: In Human Resources!!!!!!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Rachel is ranting about Jill to Chandler and Monica.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …I am jealous of her?! I mean who does she think she is?! Princess
Caroline?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re jealous of Princess Caroline?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do I have my own castle?
(Joey and Ross enter.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Uh, Phoebe’s not here is she?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (noticing the bag Joey’s carrying) Oh great! Did you get a movie?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhhh, yeah. Yeah. But uh, I don’t think it’s the kind
you’re gonna like.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You didn’t get more movies that are gonna have us reaching for
the tissues all night did you?
(Joey and Ross exchange looks.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sort of…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys, what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (holds up the movie) Phoebe’s a porn star!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What?!!
(They all run over to Joey and Ross, Chandler grabs the movie and reads the title.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe Buffay in Buffay: The Vampire Layer.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s Phoebe! Where did you get that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well down at the adult video place down on Bleaker.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And-and I, and I saw that Joey was about to go in, so I ran in ahead of
him to-to surprise him and, and then I pretended I didn’t know he was in there. (They
all kinda look at him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! I mean, I just—I can’t, I can’t believe this.
Y’know, I mean you think you know someone even, even Phoebe who’s always been
somewhat of a question mark.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is so bizarre. I guess it kinda makes sense though, y’know she
had such a terrible childhood.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, I had a terrible childhood and I don’t do porn.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, but you are dead inside.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right well, I’d better take that back.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wh-what, why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We can’t watch that! I mean that’s Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah you’re right, we can’t—we shouldn’t watch this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Absolutely not.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (hands the tape back to Joey, but doesn’t let him grab it)
Y’know maybe a little bit!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Probably just the first half.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! Hey no! This is wrong you guys! Phoebe’s our friend! Well,
I’m not gonna watch it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Good for you Joe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
(Ross stands next to him for a second, then goes and watches the movie.)
(The movie starts, it’s a vampire’s lair and Buffay, The Vampire Layer enters
dressed in leather and carrying a wooden stake. Suddenly, the vampire opens his coffin and
sits up.
Buffay, the Vampire Layer: Ah, I thought I’d find you here, Nasforatool.

lines.speaker: The Vampire
lines.text: Buffay, are you going to plunge your stake into my dark places?
Buffay, the Vampire Layer: Actually, I was kinda hoping it would be the other
way around.
(At this point, Buffay, the Vampire Layer and Nasforatool start to get it on. Of
course, since this is network TV, we can only see the reactions of the gang to the film
playing off screen.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hold on a second! What is that on her ankle?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Her ankle is what you’re watching?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well it’s hard to tell… (Rachel gets up to get a closer look,
only she’s having some trouble.) Oh God, if she would just stop moving.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She’s just doing her job!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sitting at the kitchen table with his back to the TV) You sick bastards!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s a tattoo! That’s weird, Phoebe doesn’t…
Wait that’s Ursula! That’s not Phoebe that is Ursula!
(Upon hearing this, Joey can’t turn his chair around fast enough and knocks it
over.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Re! Re! Then I can watch that! Rewind it! Rewind it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey! What’s up? (Sees the TV) Oh my God! What am I
doing?!!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is reading Chicken Soup for the Soul as
Monica enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey sweetie!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! (He quickly tries to hide the book by throwing it under the
couch, only the couch has no back and it slides into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (picking up the book) Chicken Soup for the Soul?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There’s no back to this couch!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why are you reading this? You hate this kind of stuff.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah I know, but I figured a shot y’know? Maybe one of those
stories would make me cry and then you wouldn’t think I was y’know, all dead
inside.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that’s so sweet! Look Chandler I don’t care if you
can’t cry, I love you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that makes me feel so warm in my hollow tin chest.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Stop it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I mean, come on, seriously think about it, we get married,
we’re up at the altar and I’m like this. (Makes a bored face.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I won’t care, because I know you will be feeling it all in here.
(Points to her heart.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! And if, and if we have a baby one-day, and the doctor hands it to
you in the delivery room and you don’t cry, so what! And-and-and, and if we take him
to college and come home and see his empty room for the first time, and you got nothing,
it won’t matter to me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, well I won’t uh, worry about this anymore then.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And-and-and if I die, from a long illness. And you’re writing out
my eulogy and you open a desk drawer and you find a note from me that says, "I will
always be with you," and you still can’t shed one tiny tear, I know you’ll
be crying a river inside.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aww, I love you so…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is wrong with you?!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! You can’t shed a tear for your dead wife!! Now, I left you a
note from the beyond!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you didn’t mean any of that?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No you robot!!
[Scene: Ross's apartment, his doorbell is ringing and he’s running to answer it
while doing up his pants.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You damn kids! You ring my bell one more time, I swear to… (Opens the
door to find Jill standing there.) Ohh, uh Jill. Umm, that-that’s just a little game
I play with the kids down the hall. Umm, they’ve really taken a liking to me.
(Quickly looks out to see if they’re watching.) Uhh
what’s-what’s-what’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Rachel and I had a really big fight, can I come in? I-I mean I know
we’re not supposed to see each other anymore and I’m okay with that, it’s
just that I don’t know anybody in the city and I really need somebody to talk to
about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course, what happened? (Lets her in.)

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (entering) I don’t want to talk about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, umm…

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: But you know what might really cheer me up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Seeing some more of your super-cool slides.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! Really?!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Totally, I love them! And, maybe you could finish telling me about all the
different kinds of sand.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’d love to! Here, you wait right here and I’ll go get the
projector and my notes!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Oh great! Thanks Ross, you’re such a good friend!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh!
(He goes into another room to get his projector and notes. While he’s gone, Jill
quickly checks her makeup.
[Cut to Monica and Chandler’s, Rachel is entering.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Have you guys seen Jill? I can’t find her anywhere.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I haven’t.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, is Ross home? Maybe I’ll just call him to see if he’s
actually seen her.
(She goes to look out the window at Ross’s apartment and sees Jill staring at her
and closing the drapes with an evil look on her face. Rachel is stunned into silence.)
[Scene: Ursula’s apartment, Phoebe is going to confront her twin about her new
porn career.]

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s Phoebe! Phoebe!
(Ursula opens the door and is all dressed up with big hair and lingerie.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (seeing her dress) Oh God. So-so you’re making porn movies.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: No I’m not.
(Someone calls out from her apartment.)
Man’s Voice: We’re still rolling!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re making one right now!
Another Man’s Voice: Let’s go Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And-and you’re using my name!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah, can I help you with something?
Same Man’s Voice: Phoebe, come on!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, I’m talking right now! You’re—you mean her.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Y’know, twin stuff is always a real big seller.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah, I can talk them into giving you like, 30 dollars.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No!! No way! No! And stop using my name! And shame on you! (Yells into
the apartment) And shame on all of you! You’re disgusting! Especially you (points to
someone) with that! (Storms away.)

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, Ross is setting up for the slide show.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Slides are almost ready.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Yeah. Ooh, I know what this is missing! Alcohol!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh okay, well there’s-there’s wine in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Oh great! (Goes to get it as the phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (answering it) Hello?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) What is my sister doing there?! And why are the
drapes shut?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: O-okay, Rach calm-calm down, okay? She-she’s really upset we’re
just talking.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! I think she is trying to make something happen with you to get
back at me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So that’s the only reason she could be here huh? It couldn’t
have anything to do with the fact that-that maybe I’m a good listener and I uh I put
on a great slide show!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I am telling you that she is using you to get back at me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? I think I can take care of myself, I’ll talk to you
later. Good-bye. (Hangs up the phone and turns to find Jill sitting really close to him.)
Whoa! Uh, that was your sister actually. She-she thinks that you’re just using me.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: So? (Kisses him passionately.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is reading a paper as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, I just came from the company Ursula works for.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no, not you too!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No! I just went to pick up Phoebe Buffay’s checks; there were a
lot of them.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um-mmm, and I won’t have to go there anymore because I gave
them my correct address.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s great, but isn’t it gonna bother that people still think
you’re a porn star?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! No! I know how to handle it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. (She notices some guy putting a coat on his girlfriend is trying
to remember where he’s seen her before.) (To him) You’re trying to figure out
where you know me from? All right, I’ll give you a hint. From porn! Okay? (He tries
to rush his girlfriend out.) Yeah your pervert boyfriend watched me in a porno movie! (To
Joey) See?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, time lapse, Ross is entering. Chandler and Monica are at
the kitchen table. Rachel is on the couch reading.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) You uh, you may have been right about Jill.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! I knew it! What happened?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, she kissed me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! You kissed!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Maybe we should give them some privacy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Shhhh!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I uh, I tried not to kiss her, okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it doesn’t sound like it! I mean, it’s pretty easy not
to kiss someone, you just don’t kiss them! See look at us, right now, not kissing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let me finish, okay? She started kissing me and-and I didn’t stop it.
I guess I-I just wasn’t thinking…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah that’s right you weren’t thinking! Y’know what? Let
me give you something to think about! (She pulls up her sleeves and steps towards him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh wait—hold it! But then I started thinking and I stopped the
kissing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well thank you for taking your tongue out of my sister’s mouth
long enough to tell me that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look I-I realize if anything were to happen with me and Jill then nothing
could ever happen with us!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I mean, look I don’t know if anything is going to happen with us,
again. Ever. But I don’t want to know that it-it never could. So I stopped it and she
got mad and broke my projector.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow. I, I don’t even know what to say. Thank you. (Gently kicks
him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re welcome. (Gently kicks her back.)
(Chandler starts crying.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Are-are you crying?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (crying hysterically) I just don’t see why those two can’t
work things out!
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there as Jill enters.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: All right, I’m leaving! Because I’m not going to spend one more
day with someone whose out to sabotage my every move. That’s you Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I got that.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (To Ross) And you! I throw myself at you and you say no, how gay are you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You take care Jill.

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: (happily) Okay, see ya! (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye-bye-e!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (starts crying) I-I can’t believe Jill’s gone. (They all
look at him.) I can’t help it, I opened a gate.

title: The One That Could Have Been

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, you guys! Guess what? Barry and Mindy are getting a divorce!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Ross) What is the matter with you?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Barry and Mindy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh sorry, I hear divorce I immediately go to Ross. (To Rachel)
Who-who’s Barry and Mindy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Barry was the guy that I was almost married and Mindy was my best
friend.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh-oh, wasn’t he cheating on you with her?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but that just means that he was falling asleep on top of her
instead of me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why did they get divorced?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, apparently she caught him cheating on her with someone else.
Isn’t that sad? (Giggles.) God, could you imagine if I actually married him?! I mean
how different would my life be?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know what you mean, I’ve always wondered how different my life
would be if-if I’d never gotten divorced.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Which time?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The first time! No seriously, imagine if Carol hadn’t realized she
was a lesbian.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (starts to imagine it) I can’t. I keep seeing it the good way.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’d bet I’d still be doing my kara-tay. (That’s karate,
he’s just saying it that way.) Towards the end of our marriage I was doing a lot of
kara-tay as a way of releasing the tension from y’know, not doing anything else
physical.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe the problem was you were pronouncing it kara-tay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And what if I was still fat? (To Chandler) Well, you wouldn’t be
dating me, that’s for sure.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure I would!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (simultaneously) Oh yeah! Come on! Yeah right!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What, you guys really think that I’m that shallow?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I just think Monica was that fat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, imagine if I never got fired off Days Of Our Lives! (Closes
his eyes to do so.) Oh-hey, there’s Carol again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What if I had had the guts to quit my job? I’d probably be
writing for the New Yorker, getting paid to be funny. But my job’s fun too! I
mean tomorrow, I-I don’t have to wear a tie.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What if I had taken that job at Merrill Lynch?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Merrill Lynch?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I had a massage client who worked there and-and he said I had a
knack for stocks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well why didn’t you take the job?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because at that time you see, I thought everything that rhymed was true.
So I thought y’know that if I’d work with stocks, I’d have to live in a
box, and only eat lox, and have a pet fox.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, do you guys think that if all those things happened, we’d still
hang out?
Opening Credits
{Transcriber’s note: This is where the opening credits are, but they’re not
the usual opening credits. Oh no! These credits are based on the world that would
have been created had all of the above actually happened. It starts out with all of them
at the fountain sitting on the couch as Fat Monica runs up and sits on the arm of the
couch, tilting the whole thing towards her. It then goes on to show Rachel’s still a
shop-aholic and with Barry. Fat Monica is sweating while cooking and dancing while eating
a donut. Phoebe as the Wall Street shark smoking while on two cell phones. Then
they’re dancing in the fountain. Joey entering as Dr. Drake Remoray and meeting a
groupie. Chandler trying to write as a bird does its business on his shoulder and falling
asleep while typing. Ross doing some kara-tay and trying to get Carol into bed. And
finally, some more dancing in the fountain, them all flexing, and the turning out the lamp
and shutting off all the lights bit from the first season. Just remember one thing, this
is an alternate universe. Everything from every other episode doesn’t apply, for
instance, Ross and Rachel have no history. And in fact have not seen each other in years
in this world.}

scenes.location: A newsstand, Ross is buying a magazine and gets in line behind a woman.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (recognizing her) Oh my God! Rachel Green?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Rob Tillman!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no. It’s-it’s me, Ross!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. Ross Tillman.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no-no, Ross Geller.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, of course Monica’s brother!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! How are you?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good-good, I’m-I’m married. (Shows her his ring.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! Me too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is-isn’t it the best?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s the best! (They both exhale contemplating the joys of
marriage.) So, umm how’s Monica?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh really, really great! Yeah! A-actually she’s right down the
street, umm, do-do you know what? You should stop bye and say hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, I would love too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Oh-oh, she’d be so excited!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! Okay!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on! (They start to leave.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wait, don’t you have to pay for your, (looks at his magazine)
Busty Ladies?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it’s okay. Some-some kid asked me to pick it up for him, but I

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Oh yeah? Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (putting the magazine back and holding the money for it) Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But! Don’t you have to give him his money back?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh. (Steps to a random kid nearby and hands him his money.) Hey, here
you go buddy. Sorry, no porn for you. (To Rachel) Okay, let’s go see Monica!
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey, Fat Monica, and her boyfriend are sitting on the couch.
Monica’s boyfriend is getting up to get something. For future reference, for the rest
of this episode Monica’s fat, I won’t be calling her Fat Monica throughout.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So Monica, still going out with Dr. Boring huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He’s not boring! He’s just-he’s just low key.
