lines.speaker: Monica's Boyfriend
lines.text: (returning) Here we go, one Hazelnut Latte. (Hands it to
Monica and sits down.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica's Boyfriend
lines.text: Yeah. Y’know, the hazelnut actually not a nut,
it’s a seed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (not impressed) Wow!!

lines.speaker: Monica's Boyfriend
lines.text: Can anyone else name a well known seed that’s been
masquerading as a nut?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh dear God, let me think. (Starts to sarcastically think about it.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, depressed) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no! What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh I just got another rejection letter. They said my writing was
funny, just not "Archie Comic funny."

lines.speaker: Monica's Boyfriend
lines.text: Y’know what honey? I got to get back to the hospital.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica's Boyfriend
lines.text: (kisses her) Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Monica's Boyfriend
lines.text: Bye-bye. (Gets up to leave.) Oh uh, by the way, the answer
is, the Brazil nut. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Was his question what’s more boring than him?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey man, look sorry about that Archie thing. Do uh, do you need me
to give you some money?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, I may have no money, but I still have my pride.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ehh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe Joey doesn’t have to give you the money, TV stars have
assistants right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s an idea! (To Chandler) Hey, if I hired an assistant,
would-would you take money from her?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No Joey! Chandler could be your assistant! See, he could answer all of
your fan mail and stuff!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s great! That would be great! Let’s do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I could use the money; it could give me time to write.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh right great! Welcome aboard!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Now hey, I need to use the bathroom. Since I don’t need
any assistance in there, take a break!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right!
(As Joey goes to the bathroom, Corporate Phoebe enters. She’s wearing a business
suit and carrying a briefcase.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Phoebe! Guess what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey just hired Chandler to be his assistant!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh that’s so sweet! (Her cell phone rings.) Oh! Hang on! (Quickly
grabs a cigarette and starts to light it as her phone rings.) Hang onnnnnn!!! (Gets the
cigarette lighted and answers the phone.) (On phone.) Go!! No! No-no! I said sell when it
hits 50! 5-0, it’s a number! It comes after 4-9!! No, it’s okay. It’s okay,
you’re allowed one mistake. Just kidding, you are of course fired.
(She hangs up as Ross and Rachel enter.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Mon!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mon, look who I ran into! (Gestures towards Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (gets up and gasps) Oh my God! Rachel!! (Rachel is stunned to see that
her long lost friend is still fat.) (Monica goes over and gives Rachel a big bear hug,
which is quite easy for her.) You look terrific!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, so do you! Did you lose weight? (She’s not quite sure of that
one.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You are so sweet to notice! Yes, I lost three and a half pounds!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And, and uh, you-you remember my friend Chandler. (Points to him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And that’s Phoebe over there! (Points to her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, sit down! Sit down! How long as it been since we’ve seen
each other?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (answering it) 1987, the day after Christmas, at Sean McMahon’s
party. I played you one of my songs, y’know Interplanetary Courtship Ritual.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah. Right. So now, are—do you, do you still do music?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sometimes, you should come over (Joey returns from the bathroom) sometime!
I’ll play you one of my other…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting him and seeing Joey) Oh my God! Joey Tribbiani from Days
of Our Lives, just walked in here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, he’s a friend of ours.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stunned) You are friends with Dr. Drake Remoray?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well it’s kinda hard to be friends with Drake because of his busy
schedule and the fact that he’s not real.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) Hey-hey, or I could bring my keyboard over here
sometime!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He’s coming over! He’s coming over!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (getting up) Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (holding a plate of what looks like Rice Crispies Treats) I know,
here-here!! (Hands her the plate.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohhh! (Takes the plate.) No! This is my friend Rachel, we went to High
School together.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (giggles and can’t look at him) Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shaking Rachel’s hand) Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (still not quite able to look at him) Hi! I love you on that show! I
watch you everyday! I mean, when you took out your own kidney to save your ex-wife even
though she tired to kill you…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it’s always nice to meet the fans.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (turning and whispering to Monica) She’s not crazy is she?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) So uh, how you doin’?
[Scene: Monica and Phoebe's, Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe are there. Phoebe’s cell
phone rings and she goes through her little routine of lighting a cigarette before
answering the phone.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hang on! Hang on! Hang on! (Answering the phone.) Go!! Who’s this?
(Listens) Oh okay, you’re gonna like working for me. What’s your name? (Listens)
What kind of name is Brendy? I… Whatever… Stop talking! All right, from now on
your name is Joan. You can pick your own last name.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey there you are!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-oh, it’s my boss!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, here’s a list of things for you to do today. Man, this
going to be so great! Thank you so much! All right, I got to go to work I’m
delivering twins today, but only one of them is mine! (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reading the list) Drop off my dry cleaning. Pick up my vitamins.
Teach me how to spell vitamins. Wear in my new jeans.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) You realize what you are don’t you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re his bitch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (yelling from Monica’s room) No-no!! No!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (panicked) Oh wait! You didn’t just sit on my Kit-Kats did
you?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! There-there was a little, a little diff in the market and I lost 13
million dollars.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But the Kit-Kats are all right?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What am I gonna do?! What am I gonna do?! I can’t call my office
they’ll kill me! I can’t call my clients they’ll kill themselves! Great,
now my chest hearts.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (louder) My chest hurts! Oh, and now I-I can’t breathe.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe, are you having a heart attack?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, if I were, would-would I have shooting pains up and down my left
arm?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then yes that is what I’m having. (Takes another puff of the
cigarette.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!
Commercial Break
[Scene: A hospital, Phoebe is recovering from her heart attack as Ross, Monica, and
Chandler are there to comfort and support her.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on Pheebs, it’s not that bad! Y’know most people would be
excited if they didn’t have to work for a couple of weeks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Most people don’t like their jobs, I love my job! I have not
been working for three hours and I’m already going crazy. I miss Joan.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, having a heart attack is nature’s way of telling you to slow
it down.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I always thought having a heart attack was nature’s way of
telling you to die! (Phoebe glares at him.) But you’re not gonna die. I mean, you are
going to die, but you’re not gonna die today. I wish I was dead.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let’s take a walk. (They start to leave.) Y’know maybe you
should consider writing for Talking Out of Your Ass magazine! (They exit.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Ross) So what’s going on with you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well umm, I’ve been doing a lot more of my kara-tay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Still going through that dry spell with Carol?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How long has it been since you had sex?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, last weekend…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’s not so bad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …will be two months…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …since I stopped trying.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe you need to spice things up a little.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What-what do you mean?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know. You could tie her up, she could tie you up; you could
eat stuff off each other…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know, dirty talk, m�nage � trois, toys…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Roll playing… You could be the warden; she could be the prisoner.
You could be the pirate; she could be the wench!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I think I got it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Or too, you could be two stockbrokers and
you’re-you’re-you’re rolling around naked on the trading floor and
everybody’s watching! (Ross looks at her.) It never happened.
[Scene: A hospital hallway, Chandler is sitting on a gurney with his hands spread out
behind his back. Then Monica comes and plops down on the gurney and one of his hands.
Chandler immediately recoils in extreme pain.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sorry. So how’s it going with Joey?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh just great. He beeps me now with codes. One is, "Bring me
food." Two is, "I’m with a girl, bring us food." Three is,
"I’m lost and I can’t find food."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Is uh, is she gonna be all right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! She’s right in there! (Points to Phoebe’s room.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh great. (Starts to go in.) (To Chandler) Hey! Go take off those pants,
they look ready!

scenes.location: Silvercup Studios, Joey is showing Rachel around the set.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, and over there is Brady’s Pub where I like to unwind after
a long day of surgeoning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! This is so amazing! What else? What else?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, that is a large piece of television equipment. (Points at a
large piece of television equipment as an old man walks by.) And uh that is an old
man! Hey old man!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All righty, what do you say we head back to my place?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Wow! Umm, y’know, I-I would really love to, but I-I
shouldn’t.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why? (In Drake’s voice.) Why can’t the world stop turning, just
for a moment? Just for us?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (awestruck, then not) Isn’t that a line from the show?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, yeah but uh, (In Drake’s voice) I may have said those things
before but, I never truly meant them. Until now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s a line from the show too!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, you watch too much TV.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (approaching) Here you go Joe, here’s the freshly squeezed orange
juice you asked for. (Hands it to him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks! (Looks at it.) Yeah, there’s pulp in that. (Hands it back.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I thought we talked about this. I don’t like pulp. No pulp. Pulp
isn’t juice. All juice, okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry, I guess I just like the pulp.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God, I’m sorry, I’m being so rude. (Turns to Rachel.)
Rachel, would like a soda or something? Because Chandler would run right out and get it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah sure, iced tea would be great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) Iced tea.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, anything for you sir?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) Did I not just tell him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (mouthing it to him) Yes, you did.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) Okay look, Chandler, if this (Motions back and forth
indicating the arrangement.) you have got to listen! (Tugs on his ear.) (Chandler glares
at him.) You’re gonna throw that juice at me, aren’t ya?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s not all juice! (Rachel quickly gets out of the way.)

scenes.location: Ross and Carol's, Ross is trying to talk to Carol about what Phoebe told him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So honey, this morning was fun, huh? Me hopping in on you in the shower
there.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Yeah! And maybe someday we could get a place with two bathrooms.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look Carol umm, I was, I was thinking maybe uh, maybe we can spice things
up a little.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Carol our sex life is—it’s just not working…

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (entering) Dad!! (Runs and hugs him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey there little fella! Hey, uh-hey, why don’t we get some shoes on
ya, huh? Hey, why don’t you show dad how you can put your shoes on, in your room!
Yay!!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Yay! (Runs off.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yay! (To Carol) Seriously, our sex life… I was thinking, maybe I
don’t know, we could try some-some new things. Y’know? For fun?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I don’t know umm, (Pause) what if we were too tie each other up?
(Carol’s shocked and obviously doesn’t like that idea.) Umm, some people eat
stuff off one another. (Carol doesn’t like that idea either.) Nah! Umm, y’know
we-we could try dirty talk? (Carol still says no.) Umm, we could, we could have a
threesome.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (quickly) I love that idea!

scenes.location: Monica and Phoebe's, Monica is eating breakfast as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who sold a story to Archie Comics?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! That’s great! Oh wow! (Hugs him.) You’re a
published writer! I wish I had a present for you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aww.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute! (Quickly checks her pockets and pulls out…) My last Kit-Kat
bar!
(Chandler tries to take it, but Monica won’t let go. He tugs harder, and she still
doesn’t budge.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You wanna share it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Hey Chandler look, I know you’re mad, but I just want
to say I’m sorry. I-I was a total jerk. Completely o-over the line. Uh, I just I hate
pulp! Y’know? I mean, y’know how Monica feels about low fat mayonnaise?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s not mayonnaise!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, o-o-o-o-okay anyway, I just wanted to say I’m sorry. Here.
(Hands him a cup.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fresh squeezed orange juice, with pulp! Just the way you like it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aww, thanks man. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Joey, Chandler sold a story to Archie Comics!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God! That’s great! Congratulations! What’s the story?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh you wouldn’t uh, care. It’s just a stupid comic book
story.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you kidding me?! I love Archie! And the whole gang!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well uh, Archie needs money to fix his jalopy (Joey laughs), uh but he
doesn’t want Reggie to just give him the money. So Reggie hires him as his
assist—as his butler. And then makes him do all these crazy things like bring him
milkshakes that can’t have lumps in them.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait a minute. That sounds a little familiar! Did they already do that
one? ‘Cause I think I read it!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica is there as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Mon, listen I have to ask! Okay, Joey Tribbiani invited me back to
his apartment, now does he do this with a lot of girls?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, a lot. A lot, a lot!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! And I’m one of them!! Wow! Oh, I just cannot believe this! I
mean, Joey Tribbiani!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, y’know it’s none of my business, but aren’t you
married?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Oh I just wish we could not be married for a little bit!
Y’know I just wish we could be like on a break!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you’re not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s so easy for you I mean, you’re not married, you get
to have sex with who ever you want!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah I can! (Laughs) And don’t think I don’t, because I do! I
mean all the time, you betcha! (Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica. You’ve, you’ve done it right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (giggles) Of course I have! What do you think, I’m some 30 year old
virgin?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! You’re a 30 year old virgin!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Say it louder, I don’t think the guy all the way in the back heard
you!

lines.speaker: Guy All the Way in the Back
lines.text: Yeah, I heard it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s not like, I haven’t any opportunities. I mean,
y’know, I’m just waiting for the perfect guy. I’m seeing this guy Roger,
all right? He’s not perfect, but umm, I think maybe I should just get it over with.
Y’know, give him my flower.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!! Do it!! Honey, you’ve waited long enough!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what? You are right?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!! I mean sex does not have to be a big deal! There shouldn’t be
all this rules and restrictions! Y’know, people should be able to sleep with who ever
they want, whenever…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel! I’m never gonna think it’s okay for you to cheat on
your husband!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh what do you know? Virgin!
[Scene: The hospital, Ross and Monica are in Phoebe’s room. Phoebe is in the
bathroom and Monica notices smoke coming out from underneath the door.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, why is smoke coming out of the bathroom?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, the doctor said that could be one of the side effects.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe! Put that cigarette out!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! It’s not a cigarette! The smoke is coming out of me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Put it out!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! Okay! (Puts it out and comes out of the bathroom.) I’m so
glad you’re here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on. (Helps her into bed as her phone rings.) I got it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, give it to me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I got it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Give it!
(He does a kara-tay move to silence her, then answers the phone.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on the phone) Hello? (Listens.) No she can’t come to the phone right
now. (Listens.) Oh, right no problem. Okay, bye-bye. (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Was it my work? Were they mad? Was it Jack? Did he yell?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: J-j-just relax, nobody yelled. Jack just was calling to make sure that you
were getting better.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Monica) Yeah, she’s fired.
[Scene: Rachel and Barry’s bedroom, Rachel is watching Days of Our Lives.
Of course it’s a Dr. Drake Remoray scene. It’s set in a hospital room, and Dr.
Wesley and a nurse are talking about a female patient with a bandage around her head.]

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: You’ve done all you can Dr. Wesley. You have got to let
her go.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wesley
lines.text: Good-bye and God speed, Hope Brady.
(He goes to turn off a machine. Suddenly, Dr. Drake Remoray appears at the door with
two cops!)

lines.speaker: Dr. Drake Remoray
lines.text: Not so fast Wesley! (Rachel does a silent clap.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Wesley
lines.text: (with evil dripping off his tongue) Remoray!

lines.speaker: Dr. Drake Remoray
lines.text: That’s right Wesley! I just stopped by to say that,
you’re not a real doctor! And that woman’s brain, is fine!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (very relived) Oh! Thank God!
[Cut back to the TV, the cops are leading Dr. Wesley out, and as they pass Remoray and
Wesley exchange evil glances.]

lines.speaker: Dr. Drake Remoray
lines.text: Hope! Hope!

lines.speaker: Hope
lines.text: (sleepily) Drake!

lines.speaker: Dr. Drake Remoray
lines.text: You’re not dying Hope, you’re gonna live a long,
healthy life. With me.

lines.speaker: Hope
lines.text: Oh Drake.
[Drake and Hope kiss.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! (She picks up the phone, Joey’s phone number, and starts to
dial.) Here we go! Okay! (On phone.) Hi, Joey! It’s Rachel! Umm, I am free tomorrow
night. Yeah, sure, sure I can bring some sandwiches.
Commercial Break
{Transcriber’s Note: This is where Part II begins, which means this is now episode
[Scene: Ross and Carol's, Carol is working on something at the table and Ross is
reading a newspaper on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So honey this uh, this threesome thing umm, I mean how-how are you gonna
start to find…

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Ooh, actually I’ve been making a list of all the women I know who
might be into doing this!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. (He takes the notepad she was using and looks at it.) Wow! (Flips to
another page.) Huh. (Flips another page.) Boy! (Flips another page.) Well, someone’s
been doing their homework. (Flips two more pages.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Yeah. Ooh, and I know Gail Rosten is in there twice, but she is so…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I know. (Laughs) Y’know, just-just talking about it is getting me
kinda…

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh, me too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Well, I-I think Ben’s asleep.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh umm, y’know I think it would be better if we just save it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Right. Save it. I can do that. (Gets up and does a little kara-tay.)

scenes.location: The hospital, Chandler and Monica are there with Phoebe as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, how’s it going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I’ve got to get out of this bed, I’m going crazy here.
Crazy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (handing her a cup) Here you go sweetie.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What the hell is this, herbal tea? I hate herbal tea!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But, I put some honey in it.
(Phoebe mocks what Monica just said. Ross pulls Chandler aside.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She doesn’t know she was fired yet, does she?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, the doctors say it may kill her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you two girls whispering about over there?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) But I think we should tell her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, maybe this whole heart attack thing is a sign, that-that you
should start think about getting a different job.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, what is this? A stupid contest? Because we got a winner here!
(Points at Ross.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen Phoebe, he’s right. People are not supposed to have heart
attacks at 31.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know! But if I didn’t work there, what else would I do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you used to like playing the guitar.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah that was lucrative! Smart like your brother!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, what about y’know the massage thing? That never gave you a
heart attack.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm, pulling in a salary in the high six figures or rubbing gross naked
people for chump change—ooh, what do I do?! What will I do?!
[Scene: Joey's apartment, (The one he had when he was Dr. Drake Remoray, because he
still is.) Rachel is there and admiring the big ceramic fake dog.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, I mean it’s just so realistic!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know. (Joey is sitting in this tall chair that is made up of balls on
polls. You’ll have to see it to know what I mean.) Yeah, his name is Pat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pat the dog. Oh! Oh! I get it!! (Laughs and finishes her drink.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (climbing down from his chair) Do you uh, do you—ready for a refill?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I probably shouldn’t—so I will! (Joey starts making her
refill and Rachel notices that rain thing Joey has.) Oh! Wow! It’s like it’s
raining!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pretty cool, huh? But if you’re thinking you can put a fish in there
and it wouldn’t get sucked up into the mechanism, well you’d be wrong.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, can I use your bathroom?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s uh, right through there. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Starts to go.) God y’know, if someone told me a week ago
that I would be peeing in Joey Tribbiani’s apartment…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, life’s pretty great isn’t it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it sure is!

scenes.location: Monica and Phoebe's, Monica is pouring wine for her boyfriend, Dr. Roger.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I hope you’re hungry, we’re starting with oysters. And
y’know what they say about oysters, don’t you?

lines.speaker: Dr. Roger
lines.text: They have parasites?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Umm well, some people say that Oysters are an aphrodisiac.

lines.speaker: Dr. Roger
lines.text: What people?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: People! People say it! Come here! (She grabs him and kisses him.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Roger
lines.text: So oysters, huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And then we’re gonna have a little Middle Eastern cous-cous.
Something we can eat, with our hands.

lines.speaker: Dr. Roger
lines.text: Y’know, it’s funny, but when we were studying communicable
diseases…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no-no, no! It’s sensual!

lines.speaker: Dr. Roger
lines.text: Ohh! Didn’t know! Okay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! (They kiss again and his beeper goes off.) Ohhh no!

lines.speaker: Dr. Roger
lines.text: I’m sorry sweetie, it’s the hospital. The food looks great,
maybe save me some?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t promise anything. (She starts to dig in.)
[Scene: Ross and Carol's, Ross and Carol are waiting anxiously for their new partner to
arrive.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We’re really gonna do this, huh?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Looks like it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know, if, if this is too weird for you, we can still back out
at… (A knock on the door interrupts him.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (jumping up to get it) I got it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (opening the door) Susan! Hi! (Who’d you think it was gonna be?)

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Hey! (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Thank you so much for coming.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: Oh, I wouldn’t miss it for the world.
(They start moving towards the bedroom, never taking their eyes off each other. They
move past Ross and stop.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m-I’m Ross by the way.

lines.speaker: Susan
lines.text: (not taking her eyes off Carol) Hello Ross. (Takes off her coat and hands
it to him.) I love what you’ve done with this space.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Thank you so much.
(They disappear into the bedroom leaving Ross standing in the living room holding
Susan’s coat.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How hot is this?!

scenes.location: Monica and Phoebe's, Chandler and Monica are eating Monica’s dinner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry you’re here with me instead of Roger.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, me too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I could make it seem like he’s here. (Imitates him.)
"Here’s some little known facts about cous-cous. They didn’t add the second
cous until 1979." (Mumbles something further.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Stop it!! That’s not funny!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sorry, okay? It just—tonight was supposed to be
y’know, it was supposed to be a big deal.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What was tonight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You don’t want to know what tonight was.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Pause.) What was tonight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, tonight was—was going to be my first time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: With Roger? (Monica shyly looks away.) Not just with Roger?! (Monica
shrugs.) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right relax Mr. I’ve Had Sex Four Times!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Four different women! I’ve had sex way more times!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was just waiting for the perfect guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well good, good for you. You really think that Roger is the perfect
guy?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. He’s not a horrible guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey that’s what I tell girls about me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, I’m gonna die a virgin!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No you are not! You are sweet and wonderful and this is gonna happen
for you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh really? When? Do you wanna do it with me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (They both realize what he just said.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was kidding.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So was I.
[Scene: Joey's apartment, Rachel is now three sheets to the wind and Joey is watching
her.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, you’re such an amazing actor! (He smiles.) How do you know
where Dr. Drake Remoray leaves off and Joey Tribbiani begins?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, with Dr. Drake they always tell me what to say. And with Joey, I
pretty much have to make it up on my own.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Tell me something Joey—(She falls off the couch)—Whoa! I
just fell right off the couch there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah you did.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (She climbs back onto the couch.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here you go. Let me ask you a question.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: When was the last time someone told you just how beautiful you are?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! I can’t, I can’t feel my hands.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come, come here.
(He takes her hands in his and kisses each one, then kisses her on the lips. When the
break the kiss, Rachel starts to get nauseous and throw up. Joey backs away in horror.)
[Scene: Monica and Phoebe's, continued from earlier. Monica and Chandler are still
discussing the previous question.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We can’t do this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! (They both laugh.) Oyster?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! (Takes it.) If-if-if we did do this there would be a lot of
pressure on me, y’know? Because you’ve been waiting a very long time and I
wouldn’t want to disappoint you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah but see I have nothing to compare it too. So even if you’re
horrible, how would I know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I do like that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s harder for me! I have those four other women to compete with!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, if it helps there were only three. So it would just be for
tonight, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Absolutely! It would just be one friend (Points at Chandler) helping out
another friend. (Points at herself.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stop it! We’re doing this! Let’s do it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Noo!! Okay!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! (They both get up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, do you have any uhh, moves?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have some moves.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I have no moves. (He moves in to kiss her and she laughs and backs
away.) Okay, whatcha doin’ there?! (Giggles.) Oh y’know what? I’m sorry,
this is just too weird.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, let’s just forget it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What if I turn out the lights? (Runs to shut them off.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!
(She turns out the lights and in the darkened room Chandler starts to moan.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sexily) Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s the couch.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica’s bedroom, she has just lost her flower to Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! I’ll tell you something, we are gonna do that again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, okay! (He rolls over to do that again.)

scenes.location: Joey's apartment, the next morning, Rachel is passed out on the couch.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Morning!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (wakes up suddenly and realizes where she is) Oh right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (groans) Oh God. Oh I can’t believe Joey Tribbiani heard me throw
up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well he actually saw you a little bit too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noo! Oh God we did—we didn’t, we didn’t uhh…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No! No, not after seeing that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God I’m just a horrible person.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wh-why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because I’m married. That’s right, I am a married woman! And I
came to a TV star’s apartment to have an affair! Uck!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s ridiculous! I’m not a "Star," just a regular
famous actor.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah and I’m a horrible, horrible person.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rachel, would you stop saying that?! Hey-hey look, remember on the show
when-when Caprice was dying and she gave me…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The ring from the cave, yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! Uh okay, well uh… (He gets up, opens a drawer, and pulls out the
ring.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing the ring and gasping) Oh my God, they let you keep that stuff?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure! As long as they don’t find out you can keep whatever you want!
And I want you to have it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No-no-no…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes! Yes!! And every time you look at it, I want you to remember that you
are a good person. Okay, you’ve had the chance to cheat, and with me, but you
didn’t. And that’s what this ring stands for.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I thought that ring stood for Caprice’s undying love for her
brother.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, do you want the ring or not?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!
[Scene: Phoebe’s hospital room, Joey and Ross enter as Phoebe comes out of the
bathroom wearing her robe.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look at you! You’re up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I thought I’d try to take a walk. Would you pour me some water?
I’ll be back soon.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa! You’re not gonna use the pay phone to call work, are
ya?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. I’ve learned my lesson.
(She goes out into the hall and when she’s there and the door is closed; she rips
off her robe to reveal her work clothes.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Let’s go! Come on! Move it! (Grabs her coat.) Come on! (To an old
man who’s holding her shoes and briefcase.) Shoes! Briefcase! (Takes them both.)
Thanks Lou, good luck with the gall bladder. (She leaves.)
[Cut back to her room, Joey and Ross are sitting there waiting for her.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Joe did… Did you ever have a threesome?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (not quite sure of how to answer that) Well uh, look Ross I uh, I think
Carol’s great and I’m sure you’re a very attractive man, but I….

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! The reason I’m asking is that… I sorta had one last night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! So, was it amazing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was, it was okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just okay—Did you do it right?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, it’s just did, did you ever go to a party and think,
"Would really anyone miss me if I weren’t here?"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh. But still Ross, you’re worst day with two women, pretty much
better than any other day! Y’know what I mean?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh, absolutely!
(They both laugh.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s just, my part seemed to be over pretty quickly and then, and
then there was a lot of waiting around.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But you got to be with both of them, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not-not really. Th-th-there was just Carol.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not the other one?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, she kept kicking me away!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you don’t want that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well hey, at least you got to see a lot of stuff, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh I a lot of stuff!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got a little bored?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A little. Yeah. I made a snack.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah? What did ya have?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just a sandwich. Turkey, a little mustard…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sounds good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It really was!

scenes.location: Monica and Phoebe's, Monica is making a sandwich as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me tell you about this chick I scored with last night! Oh no wait
a minute that was you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, check me out, I’m a slut!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you uh, want to do something tonight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh I can’t. Dr. Roger is coming over again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh. Oh right! Right! Because you’re still seeing him and uh,
he’s a good guy. I mean, I remember a time when… (He fakes falling asleep.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! Totally! Totally, and you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great! It’s so amazing! I mean, last time Dr. Roger came over, I
was so nervous, but then after being with you I’m all like, "Can the
doctor see me now?"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I bet he can.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, I don’t have an appointment, but I sure could use a
physical. (He laughs halfheartedly) Are you sure you’re okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah! Yeah! Don’t worry about me, I’ll be fine! (Does a
kara-tay move.)
[Scene: Rachel and Barry’s bedroom, Rachel is returning from her disastrous
attempt at an affair to find that Barry was much, much more successful with his.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! My God! Barry!!

lines.speaker: Barry
lines.text: You-you-you said you were gonna be away all weekend!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh that’s right! I’m sorry! I-I am early! Finish! Please!!
[Scene: Phoebe’s office, she is arriving without the knowledge that she’s
been fired.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Surprise! Look who’s back!

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Hey Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: (To another coworker) Call security. (To Phoebe) Pheebs, didn’t
you get fired?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh, I don’t think so!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Jack!! Hey!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All better! Back to work! Except this clown from research told me I was
fired. He should do his research, huh?

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: Well, you were fired.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nu-uh!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: I told that guy who answered your phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay I didn’t get that message. So this doesn’t
count—Anyway, I’ll be in my office.

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: Uh, Phoebe you-you don’t have an office.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s all right, I’ll work here. This is goo, next to this
plant. (She picks a place in the lobby next to a plant.)

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: (approaches her) Phoebe, listen…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re in my office! Look, I have made a lot of cash for this
company! Okay? I am talking big bucks! Pesos! Yen! Rubles! You make one little
mistake…

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: You lost 13 million dollars.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, so this is all about money! Y’know it’s bad enough
that—Ow! Oh, you have got to be kidding!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m having another heart attack!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m having another heart attack!! Call 9-1-1!!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: Take it easy. (Sits her down.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Arthur, he’s the guy calling 9-1-1) Dumbass!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hey Pheebs! How’s it going?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, they fired me and I’m having heart attack.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Wow! Well, welcome back!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is there as Rachel storms in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is Joey Tribbiani here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, no.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, if you see him, will you please tell him that I’m looking for
him and that this I am not gonna throw up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That-that’s always good news. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Me? I’m great! I’m fine! I’m sooo good!! But, you know
who’s not great?! Men! You’re a man right Ross?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sit down!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (He does so.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let me uh, let me ask you something, do wedding vows mean squat
to you people?! And why is it that the second we tell you we’re going out of
town, bamn there you are in bed with the neighbor’s dog walker?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We’re sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No seriously! Seriously! What has happened to the sanctity of
marriage?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Didn’t you spend last night at Joey’s?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw what are you?! A detective?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look I-I don’t know what’s going on with you and your husband
and what is hopefully an adult dog walker, look can I just say not all men are like that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. (Doesn’t believe it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! There are some men who will do whatever it takes to make their
marriage work! Okay? There are some men who will stand by and-and watch as their wives
engage in-in what only can be described as a twosome with some-some woman she
barely knows from the gym!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who are these men?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Men. I guy I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you might want to tell him it sounds like his wife is (whispers)
gay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She is not… (Realizes) She’s gay. Oh my God. She is so
gay! I can’t believe this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good day for married people huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry your husband cheated on you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry your wife is gay. I guess women aren’t that great
either.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Try telling my wife that.

scenes.location: Monica and Phoebe's, Monica is blowing out a candle as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sticking his head in the door) Okay to come in?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, come on, eat, whatever you want. Dr. Roger got beeped again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah I know, guess who beeped him?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m the ruptured spleen. (Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why would you do that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because you shouldn’t be with him. (Pause.) You should be with
me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! When you were talking about Roger, that was killing me! Look,
things like last night they don’t just happen. Y’know? Or at least not to me. Or
with the other two women, in the morning y’know I was just lying there and I
couldn’t wait to just go hang out with my friends, but with you I always y’know
with a friend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know you probably don’t want to go out with me, y’know
because I make too many jokes and I’ve never been in a serious relationship and I
guess I’m not technically a "doctor…"
(Monica runs over and kisses him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There was just one woman, wasn’t there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, there were two.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Including me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah.
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is singing a new song as the gang looks on.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing)
It only takes two heart attacks to finally make you see…
One of them won’t do it, but the second one will set you free…
Tell all your hate and anger, it’s time to say good-bye…
And that is just what I will do, soon as those bastards I work for die!
La, la-la-la, la-la-la-la, la-la-la, la-la-la……

title: The One with Unagi

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross, Chandler, and Phoebe are there. Joey is working.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, remember when I had a monkey?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, what, what was I thinking?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (he’s just picked up their bill) Hey! So, what’s with the 20
percent tip? Did I do something wrong?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Twenty percent is a pretty generous tip Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what’s more generous than that?! Fifty percent!
Y’know what’s even more generous than that?!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I see where you’re goin’!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s up with the greed Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, look I’m sorry you guys, but it’s just that I gotta
get these new head shots made. And they’re really expensive, y’know? I’m
down to like three! Well, actually two ‘cause one of ‘em I kinda blackened in
some teeth—Why did I do that?! (Hits himself in the head.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well isn’t there something you can do to earn a little extra money? I
mean, can’t-can’t you pick up, I don’t know, an extra shift here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or, y’know, I used to beg for money. Of course it helps if
you’ve got y’know a little of this (she sticks her chest out and shakes it)
goin’ on. Wow! I still have it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, wait! Wait! Don’t you have an audition today? Yeah! Maybe
you’ll get that job!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, ha-ha-ha! Ooh! Wait a minute, I used to get medical experiments down
on me all the time!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reminiscing) Ah, finally an explanation.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no! I used to get paid for all kinds of medical stuff, remember?
Let’s see uh, well I don’t want to donate sperm again. (To Ross) I really prefer
doing that at the home office y’know? (Ross nods his head.) Ooh-ooh, maybe they want
like some of my blood or-or spit or something, huh?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (approaching with a tray with an order on it) Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: What did I tell you about talking to your friends while you’re
working?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh do it?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: That guy (points) has been waiting for his coffee for ten minutes!
He’s complained about you three times! (He hands the coffee cup to Joey, assuming
that Joey will deliver it and walks away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, where was I? (Takes a sip of the coffee.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross is there as Phoebe and Rachel enter wearing workout
clothes.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what have you guys been up to?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! We went to a self-defense class today!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, kicking a guy in the crotch all morning really takes it out of ya!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Takes it out of you? (Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now, we can kick anybody’s ass!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: After one class? I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? You wanna see me self-defend myself?! Go over there (points) and
pretend you’re a sexual predator! Go on! I dare ya!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, of course you can defend yourself from an attack you know is coming,
that’s not enough. Look, I studying kara-tay for a long time, and there’s a
concept you should really be familiar with. It’s what the Japanese call (he holds two
fingers up to his temple, and he does this every time he says this word) unagi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Isn’t that a kind of sushi?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it’s a concept!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah it is! It is! It’s freshwater eel!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, maybe it means that too…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! I would kill for a salmon skin roll right now!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? Fine! Get attacked! I don’t even care!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (deadpan) Come on Ross. We’re sorry. Please tell us what it is.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Unagi is a state of total awareness. Okay? Only by achieving true unagi
can you be prepared for any danger that may befall you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You mean in case someone is trying to steal your bamboo sleeping mat or
your kettle of fish?
(Rachel laughs and Ross mocks her.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (moves closer) All I’m saying is, it’s one thing being prepared
for an attack against like each other; whole another story being prepared for an attack, I
don’t know, like a (turns and puts his face close to Rachel’s and screams) surprise!!
(Rachel calmly wipes the spittle off her face.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, you know that one was coming, but that doesn’t mean you
have unagi. (Does the finger thing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Ooh! Y’know what? If we made reservations, we could
have unagi in about a half-hour.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what… (Moves away as Chandler enters, panicked.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey-hey, is Monica here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, look I need your help, I don’t know what to get her for
Valentine’s Day.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Valentine’s Day was like two weeks ago, so I wouldn’t
get her a calendar!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughs) She was working on Valentine’s Day so we’re
celebrating it tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, hey! Why don’t you book a date for both of you at one of those
romantic spas?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, Joey, that’s actually a really good idea!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And of course, crotchless panties.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well appealing as that does sound to her boyfriend (pause) and her
brother, (the camera pans to Ross flashing Joey a very evil look; Joey gets scared) I
can’t do that we promised we’d make each other gifts this year.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw, I love that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You can’t make crotchless panties? You take, you take a pair of
scissors and you just cut…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting him) Okay-okay-okay! So, making things. That sounds like
so much fun.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I thought so to until I paper mached one of my eyes shut.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I love paper mache! What did you make?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I made a… (Does one of those gibberish words.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So what are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, have you guys made anything that maybe I can take credit for?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! I have! I have! I started making these little sock bunnies! (She
takes out a sock that’s been made into a bunny with eyes, nose, mouth, whiskers, and
two other socks sown onto it for ears.) Oh for crying out loud!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, wait a minute! That is my sock!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now, it’s you little bunny friend. (She sticks it in Rachel’s
face and they both laugh.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is desperately trying to make his
Valentine’s Day gift. He takes a paper cup, turns it upside down, sticks two pencils
into the top, and hangs a coat hanger from the bottom.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (admiring his work) This, this actually is a… (Does the same
gibberish word from before.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Honey, can I ask you a question about the Valentine’s Day
gifts?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do we have to make the entire thing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! Why, did you—you forget to make yours?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Of course, of course not. I just have to uh, go over to the place
where I-I made it and pick-pick it up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (They kiss.) Okay, I can’t wait! This is going to be the best
Valentine’s Day ever! (Chandler giggles and exits.) I can’t believe it! Make the
presents! Make the presents!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sticking his head back in) What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m just so excited to make the presents! (Chandler does another
sarcastic/scared laugh and leaves.) Shoot!
[Scene: A Medical Research Office, Joey is there to sign up for an experiment, any
experiment.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the receptionist) Hi uh, I’m Joey Tribbiani and with all do
respect I’d like to donate some fluids.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: We’re actually at the end of one of our research cycles, so
we’re not looking for applicants right now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh that’s too bad. I’ve kinda been saving up. (She just looks at
him in horror.) Uh, are you sure there’s no studies I can participate in?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Well, here’s a schedule of what’s coming up. (Hands it
to him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks. (Starts to read it.) Well but this one starts now. (Points to
one.)

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Oh that one is available now, but only identical twins are
eligible. It’s a twins study.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well how about this one? Testing the effects of Joey Tribbiani on
attractive nurse receptionists.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: We already got the results back on that on, and they’re not
good. (Joey beats a hasty retreat.)
[Scene: The Hallway between the Apartments, Ross is hiding behind that bump out on
Monica’s side waiting for Phoebe and Rachel. As they come up the stairs, he jumps out
and yells…]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: DANGER!!! DANGER!!!!!
(They both scream and jump away.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What the hell was that?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A lesson in the importance of unagi. (He starts doing the finger thing
every time now.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, you’re a freak!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Perhaps. Now I’m curious, at what point during those girlish screams
would you have begun to kick my ass?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, so we weren’t prepared!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry I had to take such drastic measures to make my point, but
I—look, I just want you guys to be safe. (Monica comes out to throw out the garbage
and Ross screams…) DANGER!!!!! (She completely ignores him and keeps walking.)
Ahhh, huh? Unagi.
[Scene: Cole-Geddes Casting Agency, Joey is there on his audition and thinking about
that 2,000 bucks for the twins study.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in his head) 2,000 bucks is a lot of money. Oh, I wish I had a twin.
Where could I find someone who looks exactly like me? (The camera widens its shot to
reveal a room full of Joey look-a-likes. Joey looks at the guy next to him and then back
at his script.)
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Ross is coming in from doing his laundry. He starts folding
it as Chandler enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (not turning around) Chandler. I sensed it was you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Unagi. I’m always aware.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, are you aware unagi (does the finger thing) is an eel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t figure out what to make Monica.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, why don’t you make her one of your little jokes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m going crazy! Okay? Do you have any thing around here that
looks homemade?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? She’d-she’d love this. (Picks up a model of
the Saturn V rocket, that’s the one that took man to the moon.) Uh, it’s an
exact replica of Apollo 8. I made it in the sixth grade.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I guess I could use that. I could say that your love sends me to
the moon.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, except Apollo 8 didn’t actually land on the moon. But
you-you-you could write that umm, your love lets me orbit the moon twice and return
safely. (Apollo 8 was the first one that orbited the moon and the one that read the
Christmas Story from the orbit of the moon on Christmas Eve, 1968. They also took the
famous Earthrise picture of the Earth rising over the moon.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait a minute, I can’t give this to her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because it says "Captain Ross" on the side and "I hate
Monica" on the bottom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.
(Chandler leaves dejectedly. When the door closes Rachel and Phoebe jump out from
behind the curtains and scream…)

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: DANGER!!!!!
(Ross screams like a little girl.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahhhhh, salmon skin roll. (She does the finger thing.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s bedroom, he’s still trying to figure out what
to make Monica.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Okay. (He goes to the closet, moves the clothes out of the way,
and notices an empty hanger. He takes the empty hanger and bends it all out of shape. Then
he holds it out as if he’s giving it to her.) Yes honey, I made it myself. (He throws
it down and goes to her chest, grabs something, goes to the bed table, and takes out a
pair of scissors. He turns around and holds the scissors to the crotch of the panties he
just removed.) I can’t do it. I can’t do it. (He throws them both down and
continues looking. He opens another closet door and finds a tape.) Oh! Oh! A mixed tape! A
mixed tape!! (He runs out into the living room.)
[Cut to the living room, Chandler is entering as Monica finishes wrapping her present
for him on the kitchen table.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Hi! You uh, ready to exchange gifts?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure! Okay, you go first.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, come here! Come here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! (She takes her present for him and they move over to sit on the
couch.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now, it’s not wrapped because I just, just finished it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But I made you a tape of what I think are all romantic songs.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, what a great gift! Is The Way You Look Tonight on it?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (momentarily terrified) Maybe we’ll have to listen and see!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I love it! Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, you ready to open yours?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
(He opens his present to find Phoebe’s sock bunny from earlier.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s a sock bunny.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, you remember how I call you bunny?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I did one time, and-and I want to start doing it more. See
that’s what this is about.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I see. Y’know umm, Phoebe makes sock bunnies.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No, she doesn’t. Uh Phoebe, what she makes—that’s
uh—they’re sock rabbits. They are completely different—Okay! Okay! Okay! I
didn’t make it! I’m sorry! I totally forgot about tonight and the fact that
we’re supposed to make the presents!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it’s okay. I don’t…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no, it’s not okay! It’s not! I mean you were just…
You’re so incredible! You went through all this time and effort to make this tape for
me! Y’know I’m just gonna—I, I am gonna make this up to you! I will! I-I am
going to cook anything you want in here (points to the kitchen), and I am going to do
anything you want in there! (Points to the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (thinking it over) Well, I did put a lot of thought in the tape. (They
both run into the bedroom.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s bedroom, they are relaxing in sexual bliss.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! (To the sock bunny still on his hand.) You are way to
young to have seen that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oops! (Covers its eyes.) Y’know, your birthday is in a
month-and-a-half, what do you say I forget to get you a present for that too?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You are totally and completely 100% forgiven.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We have got to wash that! (Referring to the sock bunny.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! (Takes it off his hand and throws it behind the night-stand.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you remember that jacket that you love so much, that you thought was
too expensive?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You have done enough!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wanna wake up early and go get it for you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No you don’t—get it in black, not brown.
(The oven dings.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oop, your cake is ready!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oop!
(They both get out of bed and go get some cake.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it’s like that old saying, have some sex, eat some cake.
(As they approach the kitchen, the door opens and in walks in a Joey look-a-like.)
Joey's Look-A-Like: Hey Mon! Hey Chann! (He goes to the fridge) Just
gettin’ a soda! (Does so.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who the hell are you?!
Joey's Look-A-Like: I’m Joey! How are you doin’?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) No! No! No! No! No! How you doin’?! How you
doin’—Damnit Carl! Go wait in the hall! (Goes into the hall.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I got to apologize on the behalf of Carl.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who the hell is Carl?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, did I not mention? Carl is a guy I hired to be my identical twin for a
medical research project.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know sometimes the good ideas are just right in front of you,
aren’t they?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, I know it sounds crazy, but I think it might work. Y’know? The
only problem is, Carl’s acting is… (Does the international hand symbol for
so-so.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The only problem!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, he’s the reason I didn’t get that big Minute Maid
commercial a couple of years ago remember? We were supposed to be brothers, but he messed
it up.

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.text: (sticking his head back in) Hey, uh can I get a little piece of that cake?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Carl) Pizza!! We like Pizza!! Get out!!! (Carl does so.)

scenes.location: Phoebe and Rachel's, Phoebe and Rachel are returning.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Pat Sajak?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alex Trebek?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, of course!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chuck Woolery?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Definitely! Phoebe, you will not find a single game show host,
who’s ass I cannot kick.
(They start to walk into the living room and notice someone’s head sticking up
from behind a chair. The camera cuts to the other side and we see it’s Ross.)
[Time lapse. The girls have Ross pinned face down. Phoebe is sitting on his back and
arms while holding his head down and facing Rachel. Rachel is sitting on his knees and
holding his lower legs vertically, causing Ross pain.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Say it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Say we are unagi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s not something you are! It’s something you have!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Say it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? I can easily get out of this, but there is a chance you
can get very, very hurt!
(Rachel yanks on his legs again and he groans in pain.)
[Scene: The Medical Research office, Joey is there with Carl in the waiting room. Two
identical twins come out and both wave by at the same time.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right Carl, we’re next. Now remember, what is not gonna be?

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.text: Another Minute Maid fiasco.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right! And what are you not gonna do?

lines.speaker: Carl
lines.text: Well, I’m not gonna talk because…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (gets very angry) Damnit Carl! (Carl goes to say something more, and Joey
silences him with a grunt.)

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: (entering) (To the receptionist) Can I have the next one please?
(Takes the form.) Joey and Tony Tribbiani. (Joey and Carl stand up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s us.

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: (seeing they’re not identical) But uh, this is a study for
identical twins.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right, $2,000.

lines.speaker: The Doctor
lines.text: But, you’re not identical twins.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damnit Carl!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is getting ready for Chandler’s arrival. He
enters and finds the place lit with candles and dinner on the table.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my good God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Continuing the countdown of your favorite meals. Tonight, No. 3,
macaroni and cheese with cut up hot dogs.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, you have done enough! Okay? You have to stop this now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I will! But not tonight. For dinner music, I thought we could listen to
that tape you made me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, the mixed tape.
(Monica pushes play and The Way You Look Tonight starts to play.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The Way You Look Tonight is on here! Dance with me?
(He hesitates, then goes over to dance with her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You are just the sweetest. (They kiss.)
(Suddenly, a strange and familiar voice comes out of the tape player. Here’s a
hint, OH…MY…GAWD!! That’s right, it’s Janice!)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I love the way you look every night Chandler! (Monica breaks the
kiss and Chandler freezes in terror.) That’s why I made you this tape! Happy
Birthday! Love Janice!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! You’re the sweetest! (He tries to kiss her but Monica backs
away with a look that could kill on her face.)

scenes.location: A women’s self-defense class, the instructor is just finishing a class.

lines.speaker: The Instructor
lines.text: Okay ladies, that ends today’s class, and let’s
remember, let’s be safe out there.
(The women all clap and start to leave as Ross comes up to the instructor. Apparently
he was hiding in the back.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s a great class.

lines.speaker: The Instructor
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I was watching. (The instructor just nods and walks away.)
Umm, hey, a couple of questions though. Umm, about that-that-that last move where the
woman tripped you and then pinned you to the floor, what-what-what-what would you do next?

lines.speaker: The Instructor
lines.text: Well, she would take her keys and try to jam them…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No-no. No. What would you do next?

lines.speaker: The Instructor
lines.text: Who? Me the attacker?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes that’s right.

lines.speaker: The Instructor
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I tired attacking two women, did not work.

lines.speaker: The Instructor
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I mean it’s okay, I mean, they’re-they’re my friends.
In fact, I-I-I was married to one of them.

lines.speaker: The Instructor
lines.text: Let me get this straight man, you attacked your ex-wife?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no! No-no! No, I tired! But I couldn’t. That’s why I’m
here. Maybe we could attack them together? (He glares at him.) That-that’s a no.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is trying to explain himself to Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am so, so, so, so sorry!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (not buying it) Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I will cook anything you want in here (points to the kitchen), and
do anything in there! (Points to the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pointing to the kitchen) Yeah you will! (Points to the bedroom) And,
are you kiddin’ me?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on Monica, it’s our Valentine’s Day. Please?
Please-please, please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (They hug.)
Janice’s Voice: (singing) My funny valentine, sweet comic valentine! You
make me high over my heart!
(Monica breaks the hug and starts for the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, are we going in there?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I am!! (Enter her room and closes the door behind her.)
Janice’s Voice: (singing) You’re look for laughable…(She does
the now patented Janice laugh.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: The street in front of Central Perk, Ross is walking up and sees two women that
look like Phoebe and Rachel from behind.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah-ha, nowhere to run! (He starts to run towards them.)
[Cut to Central Perk, Phoebe and Rachel are sitting up by the window because two guys
have their couch.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t like sitting up here! I’m just gonna over… (She
starts to get up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (stopping her) No Rachel! They got here first!
(Ross appears at the window behind them crouched behind a garbage can and ready to
spring his attack on who he thinks are Phoebe and Rachel. The camera cuts to the exterior
view and Phoebe and Rachel call the shots from inside.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why is Ross doing that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: DANGER!!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Why is he jumping on those women!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We should help him!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I… Well, I don’t think they need any help.
(Ross starts to scream and run away. He stops in front of the window of Central Perk to
check the pursuit and notices Phoebe and Rachel inside looking at him. He mouths,
"What?" Then realizes that the women he attacked are closing in so he screams
and runs away.)

title: The One Where Ross Dates a Student

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler, Rachel, and Joey are there as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! I just got uh, my teacher evaluations! Check out what this one
student wrote, "I loved Dr. Geller’s class. Mind blowing lectures! Dr. Geller,
you are definitely the hottie of the paleontology department!"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahh, Hotties of the Paleontology Department, there’s a big
selling calendar, eh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who wrote it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I wish I knew, but the evaluations are all anonymous.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey, do you still have their final exams?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, ‘cause you can just match the evaluation to the exam with the
same handwriting and boom, there’s your admirer. (Ross is stunned.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A hot girl’s at stake and all of the sudden he’s Rain Man.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, wait a minute, wait a minute, why are we so sure that this is a
girl?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s a girl! Anyway, it wou—it wouldn’t matter. Okay?
Because I’m a teacher and she’s a student.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, is that against the rules?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, but it is frowned upon.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Besides, there’s a big age difference.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, well think of it like this, when you’re 90…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know when I’m 90 she’ll be like 80 and it won’t seem like
such a big difference.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No that’s not what I was going to say at all. No, what I was going to
say is when you’re 90 you’ll still have the memory of what it was like to be
with a 20-year-old.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Phoebe, Monica, and Chandler are eating breakfast as
Joey enters.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Chandler! Y’know that girl you went to college with who-who
became a movie director?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, Dana Keystone. She was in my Movement class.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s a Movement class?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s Chandler’s way of pretending he didn’t take mime.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well listen, anyway she’s directing the new Al Pacino movie. You
gotta get me an audition!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I don’t know man. I haven’t talked to her in like ten
years.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no, please-please Chandler I-I-I would owe you so much!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You do owe me so much. You owe me three thousand, four
hundred…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey dude, why are you changing the subject? Why? Will you make the
call or what?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh okay, I’ll-I’ll try.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Thanks! You’re the best! Now listen, the last day of
