auditions is Thursday. Okay? So I gotta get in there by Thursday. Okay? Just remember
Thursday. Thursday. Can you remember Thursday?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah so, Tuesday?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (angrily) Thursday! Look if you need help remembering think of like this,
the third day. All right? Monday, one day. Tuesday, two day. Wednesday, when? Huh? What
day? Thursday! The third day! Okay?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastically) Thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from the bathroom) Hey Mon? I’m gonna check my messages.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You just thought of that in there?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah sure, nature called, she wanted to see who else did.
(Rachel dials her number.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? (Shocked that someone answered.) Uh, Rachel. (To the
gang.) Great, someone is in our apartment. Call the cops!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re on the phone!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on phone) Oh my God! Oh my God! Thank you! (Hangs up) That was the fire
department, there was a fire at our place!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! How bad was it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, he didn’t say, but it was a fire. I’m guessing not very
good. Come on, we gotta go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on! (The girls all run out and Joey holds up Chandler by smiling.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you smiling about? What is so funny?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The part I want to audition for is a fireman, this is so meant to be!
[Scene: N.Y.U. Paleontology department, Ross is putting up the grades on the message
board.]

lines.speaker: Burt
lines.text: (another professor) Wow! It looks like you were very generous with your
grades this semester! (Ross frantically starts to change some as a female student,
Elizabeth, approaches.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Professor Geller?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (startled) Yeah?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: I wanted to say how much I enjoyed your class.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh thank you. Thanks very much. (Leans up against the board and on a
thumbtack.) Ow! (He pulls away.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Uh, I’m a little embarrassed about calling you a hottie on my
evaluation…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That was you?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yeah. I felt a little weird about it. You’re a teacher. I’m a
student. But would you maybe want to go out with me sometime?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh I, I don’t-I don’t think that would be the best idea.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh, because I was thinking, the semester’s over; you’re not my
teacher anymore.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What time?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: (checks her grade) Oh, y’know what? Forget it, you already gave me
an A.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Gotcha. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: I’m kidding!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! So-so seriously, what time?
[Scene: Phoebe and Rachel's, everyone minus Ross are arriving to inspect the damage.
The fire department is still there.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Coming through! (Has to dodge a fireman) Oh! Coming through! (Sees a
cute one.) Oh! Hello! Hi! (Smiles then realizes) No! Right! Coming through!
(They start to look around seeing that the living room is undamaged.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh well, it’s not so bad.
Fireman #1: Yeah, most of the damage is pretty mostly contained in the bedrooms.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My God! (They both run into the bedrooms.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the fireman) Hey buddy, do you think I can borrow your uniform this
Thursday?
Fireman #1: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey! He’s working! (To Chandler) You would look good in
that.
(Phoebe and Rachel return)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, how bad is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it’s bad. It’s really bad. The only thing in there that
isn’t burned is an ass. Which I do not remember buying!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How’s your room Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Everything’s ruined. My bed. My clothes. Look at my favorite blue
sweater. (Hold it up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Isn’t that mine?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine! I’m sorry for your loss! (Hands it back to her.)
Fireman #1: So uh, you’re not gonna be able to live here for a while, you
ladies have a place to stay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stands up) Wow! Oh-okay, look pal, I am not in the mood to be
hit on right now! But if you give me your number I will call you some other time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pulling Rachel back down) Yes, they can stay with us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Have you figured out what started the fire Mr. Fireman?
Fireman #1: Well uh, do either of you smoke?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, not usually. But yeah, I could use one right now.
Fireman #1: No-no-no, do you uh light candles? Burn incense?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! I do! All the time! I love them! Oh my God! I did it! It’s me!
It’s me! I burned down the house! I burned down the house!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Phoebe calm down, there’s no need to place blame. Okay? (To
the fireman) I warned her about those candles.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is on the phone as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: God, it’s great to catch up! I can’t believe how long
it’s been!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, is that… (Mimes someone using a movie camera and Chandler
nods yes.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on phone) Oh that’s great! Good for you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey listen… (Chandler waves him away.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! So yeah, maybe we can get together umm… (Joey mimes
throwing something in the air, catching it, rolling it out, putting it in an oven and
cutting it.) Can you hold for one second please? (To Joey) What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: When you’re off the phone, do you wanna get a pizza?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on phone) Hi! I’m back. (Goes to hang up the phone.) Yeah, that
sounds great. (Listens) Okay. Well, we’ll do it then. (Listens) Okay, bye-bye. (He
hangs up the phone and turns around to see Joey standing close to him and screams.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey listen, so when’s-when’s my audition? I mean I know
it’s Thursday, but what time?
(Monica enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Joey) We didn’t get to the audition. I’m gonna take her
to coffee and then we’ll do it then.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah-ha!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! So, now you’re going on a date with this girl?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, it is not a date! I haven’t talked to her in ten years!
You can’t just call up somebody you haven’t talked to in ten years and ask them
for a favor. There are rules, y’know? You gotta, you got to put in some time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re right, I’m sorry. It’s not like you’re
y’know, going out with an ex-girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, we only went out once.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You dated her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not once!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, well why don’t I go out with an ex-boyfriend and do Joey
a favor?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you wanna do Joey a favor, maybe you go out with Joey. (He turns
around to see Chandler glaring at him.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler is having coffee with Dana.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughs) Oh that’s great, my friend Joey’s in the movie
business.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Y’know who I ran into from school? Howie.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (giggles) My friend’s name is Joey.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Apparently Howie’s editing now. Yeah, he-he-he calls me up and asks
me if he can edit my new movie. Can you believe that?! Y’know I-I-I haven’t
spoken to him in like ten years and he asks me for a favor!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’ve always hated that Howie.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: No, no "How you doing?" Man, I mean not even a cup of coffee
first!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The nerve huh?

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Refill?
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is about to debut Hotel Monica (formerly known as
Rachel’s Room) to Phoebe and Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now, this is last minute so I want to apologize for the mess. Okay?
(They walk into a completely redecorated and repainted room. And of course, the room is
immaculate. Only an obsessive-compulsive like Monica could find fault with the room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! It sure didn’t look this way when I lived here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! Now look, there’s only one problem though. There’s
only room for one, so I guess one of you will have to stay at Joey’s.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, since the fire was kinda my fault I guess (To Rachel) you should
get to stay here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Hey-hey, now this was no one’s fault Pheebs. Okay? It was an
accident.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well no, it was my fault so you should get the nice room.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! (She jumps on the bed.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So Rach! You’re the first guest at Hotel Monica! Umm, you’ll
just have to tell me how you like your eggs in the morning. And I thought I would bring
them to you, y’know, in bed. Oh, you have been through so much.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I have.

scenes.location: Joey's apartment, Joey is showing Phoebe around.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This right here is where I keep the pizza. (He points to the chair.) And
uh that’s where the napkin is. (Points to the floor next to the chair.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s that smell?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! (Shrugs his shoulders.)

scenes.location: A street, Ross is walking with Elizabeth on their date.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh please! It was such a big class! You never even noticed me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Of course I did! You uh, you sat next to Sleepy Sleeperson.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh uh, I had trouble remembering everyone’s name, so I-I kinda came
up with nicknames. Like the guy on the other side of you was Smelly von Brownshirt.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh yeah. So umm, did you have a nickname for me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, no. No.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yes you did! What was it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, it’s Cutie McPretty.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Ohh that’s so sweet!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, I gotta tell ya, I-I’m having a great time! Y’know how
before you said it might be weird, the whole student teacher thing, and to be frank I
thought it would be too, but it’s not. I mean it’s not at all.

lines.speaker: Burt
lines.text: (exiting from a restaurant) Dr. Geller!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pushing Elizabeth into a doorway) Burt!

scenes.location: Phoebe and Rachel's, Phoebe and Rachel are cleaning up the mess.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So did you sleep well last night?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did, Monica was so sweet she left a little mint on my pillow.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know what Joey left on my pillow?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Gum!
Fireman #2: Well, we determined the cause of the fire.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah I know, it was my candle. My candle!
Fireman #2: No, there was an appliance left on in the bathroom. It’s looks
like a curling iron.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t use a curling iron.
Fireman #2: Well someone does.
(Phoebe looks at Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, don’t look at me! My hair’s straight! Straight!
Straight! Straight!
Fireman #2: It could’ve been a hair straightener.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

scenes.location: Joey's apartment, Joey is now showing Rachel around.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is where I keep the pizza. (It’s the same location as before.)
And—Hey! Where did the napkin go?! (The napkin is not in it’s spot.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Phoebe is reading and Monica runs over and turns on the
lamp behind Phoebe.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now there you go! I wouldn’t want my best guest to strain her eyes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Does that smell bother you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What the smell from Joey’s? No, I can hardly smell it over here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well you let me know if you can, because y’know I can bake a pie to
cover it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can smell it a little, bake the pie.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
(The phone rings and Monica answers it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello? (Listens) Oh yes, one minute please. (To Phoebe) It’s for
you. It’s the fire inspector.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! (Takes the phone.) Hello? (Listens) Yeah this is Phoebe. (Listens)
Really?!
[Cut to Joey’s, he’s on the phone.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in a funny voice) Yeah, so it turns out that it wasn’t the hair
straightener that started the fire. (Rachel prompts him on what to say next.) No-no, it
was the candles. It’s very not good leaving candles unattended. In fact, one of the
first things they teach you in fire school is… (Phoebe suddenly enters.) Uhh…
Uhh… Okay. Well, I have to go now. (Phoebe leaves.)
[Scene: Joey's apartment, Ross is telling Monica and Joey about his date with
Elizabeth.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We had such a great time! She’s-she’s incredible! I thought
the-the age difference might be a problem, but it wasn’t. It wasn’t at all.
Elizabeth is very mature for her age. (Joey makes the international sign for big boobies.)
(To Monica) A concept lost on some people!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So it’s okay to date a student.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, not really. I mean technically it’s-it’s not against the
rules or anything, but it is frowned upon. Especially by that professor we ran into last
night, Judgey von Holierthanthou.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well Ross, you be careful now. You don’t want to get a reputation
as y’know Professor McNailshisstudents.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. What-what should I do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well Ross, it seems pretty clear. I mean what’s more important? What
people think or how you feel, huh? Ross, you gotta follow your heart.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey that is so sweet.
(He turns his back to Monica and does the international sign for big boobies again.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey! So, how did it go with Dana? Any reason I should leave a
block of time open say Thursday?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I couldn’t do it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You couldn’t do it?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, relax I just need more time. We’re going to dinner tonight.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! You’re going out with her again!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Going out with who?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, Dana Keystone from college.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah! Wasn’t she uh… (Does the international sign for big
boobies.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, that was Dana Caplin.

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: Ohhhh! (They all look up in a moment of reflection.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey! You didn’t even know her!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah whatever!

scenes.location: A Restaurant, Chandler is having dinner with Dana.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great story again! The yarns that you weave! Woo-hoo-hoo!

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Y’know uh, actually I-I-I should get going.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no! Stay! Stay! Because you-you should you-you-you should
stay!

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Wow. Oh, I am really flattered, but I just I don’t feel that way
about you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, that’s not—No-no-no!

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: I’m sorry Chandler, y’know you are such a sweet guy and I, I
don’t want to hurt you. Oh, I wish there was something I can do to make you feel
better.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no—Really?!

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (breaking up) Well, it just hurts so bad. I uh…

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Ohh, I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well maybe there is one thing you can do.

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: What?! Anything! Anything!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I umm, I mean this is just off the top of my head now, umm but I
have this friend. This actor friend and he would kill me if he thought I was doing this
umm, but umm would it be possible for him to get an audition for your movie say on
Thursday?

lines.speaker: Dana
lines.text: Absolutely! But you-you would really feel better about me rejecting you if
your actor friend can audition for my movie?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, the heart wants what it wants. I’ll see you later. (He runs
off and leaves her with the bill, which the waiter promptly delivers.)

scenes.location: Hotel Monica, Phoebe is on the bed playing her guitar as Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! How’s it goin’?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, not much has changed in the last five minutes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes it has! I made cookies!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’s all right. I’m still full from your homemade potato
chips.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But you should eat them now because they’re hot from the oven.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Reaches for one.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pulling the plate back) Oh-ho! But not in here! Can’t eat ‘em
in bed, remember? No crumbies!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gritting her teeth) Okay, I’ll be out in a second.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!
(Monica leaves and Phoebe closes the door behind her and tries to lock it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (opening the door) What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That doesn’t lock does it?
[Scene: Joey's apartment, Joey and Rachel are eating spaghetti in the living room while
watching TV and Rachel drops some on the floor.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Joey! Sorry!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No that’s all right. Don’t worry about it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh but look! That’s gonna leave a stain!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach! Hey! It’s fine! You’re at Joey’s!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Look! (He throws some of his spaghetti on the floor.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ve never lived like this before.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know.
(Rachel throws some of hers down.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, don’t waste it, I mean its still food. (He picks it up and
eats it.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross and Elizabeth are deciding what to do on their second date.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do you want to do now? Huh? You wanna go get a drink?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Uhh, I can’t.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you have some studying to do?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: No, I have some turning 21 to do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know I remember when uh, when I was in college, we used to…
(He sees some of his colleagues enter and puts his head on her lap.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing, I’m-I’m just, I’m so comfortable with you!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Do you not want to be seen with me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? No! Of course, of course I do! Are-are they gone?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Uh no, they’re still here but I think I’m about to leave.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! No! No! Wait! You’re right, this is stupid. Who cares what
people think? I mean, I mean we like each other right? There’s nothing wrong with
that. Come on. (They get up and go over to the table where his colleagues are sitting.)
Burt? Lydia? Mel? This is Elizabeth.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Lydia
lines.text: Aren’t you in my Popular Culture class?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right Lydia, Elizabeth here is a student and uh, we’re
dating. And you may frown upon that, but we’re not gonna hide it anymore.

lines.speaker: Mel
lines.text: You are so fired.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Burt
lines.text: They’re gonna fire you! You can’t date a student! It’s
against the rules.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? Its not just frowned upon?
[Scene: Joey's apartment, Joey and Rachel are throwing huge spitballs at the
entertainment center.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I love it at Joey’s!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, here you go. (Hands her another one.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, sees Rachel’s throw) Ni-hi-ice!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Joey) So, you busy Thursday?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, very funny. I don’t know if you remember, but my audition was
supposed to be Thursday. (Chandler doesn’t say anything until Joey figures it out.)
You got me the audition?! Let’s hug it up! (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Okay. (Joey puts him down.) What are you gonna do to me if you
get the part?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) Listen umm, yeah okay, I need to talk to you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now I know that they said that the umm, the hair straightener started
the fire but I think I’m partly at fault. You see, I didn’t, I didn’t tell
you but umm, but I-I had recently refilled the tissues and so y’know let’s just
face it, that’s just kindling! So I think it’s better that I stay at
Joey’s.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no-no-no. Phoebe, this was my fault and besides y’know what?
I’m fine here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Oh umm, Chandler, Monica is looking for you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah she said something about crumbies.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No! No! I was so careful! (Runs out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) Okay, you have to switch with me! Monica is driving me
crazy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right, all the ladies want to stay at Joey’s.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No! Phoebe, come on! I don’t want to switch! Please come on! I
can throw wet paper towels here!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No but at Monica’s you can eat cookies over the sink!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right fine! This looks like so much fun. (Examining the bowl of wet
paper towels.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God, what a mess. (She grabs the bowl and heads for Monica’s.)

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, Ross is looking at his handbook. Elizabeth is also there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! It actually is in the handbook. I can’t date you or have a hot
plate in my office. I can’t believe we have to stop seeing each other.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: For what it’s worth I did appreciate you standing up for me. It
felt really nice. It kinda made me like you even more.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, I know I really like you too. But we-we can’t date. It’s
against the rules. It’s forbidden.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Just hearing you describe it as forbidden, it’s really hot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I-I-I don’t care how hot it is it’s-it’s uh, it’s
wrong.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Stop it! (She starts to get all worked up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (feeling it too) No! No! It’s wrong! It’s-it’s-it’s
naughty. It’s taboo.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Shut the book!
(They frantically start making out.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let’s also get a hot plate!
(They start making out again.)
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Joey's apartment, Joey is eating pizza as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s Thursday! How was the audition?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wh? Monday, one day. Tuesday, two day. Wednesday, when huh what?
Thurs—(He gasps in horror.) Oh! (Runs out and Chandler just shakes his head. After a
second Joey runs back in to grab a piece of pizza and runs back out.)

title: The One with Joey's Fridge

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and now Rachel's apartment, Joey has the fridge pulled out away from the
wall and is in the process of pulling off the cooling grate behind it.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well that thing is clearing in the way! All right. Ah-ha! (He grabs a
screwdriver and starts to attack the compressor, only he causes a small short circuit and
shocks himself.) Ah-ah!! Damn fridge!
(Rachel enters from her new room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Joey, how ya doin’?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! Roomie!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh, yeah I guess we are roommates now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Well, now that you brought it up, our fridge is broken. We have to
get a new one. Now, I checked around and your half is $400. Thanks a lot.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not paying for half of that! I’m only staying here until
my apartment gets fixed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look Rach, my parents bought this fridge just after I was born, okay? Now,
I have never had a problem with it. Then you show up and it breaks! What does that
tell ya’?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That refrigerators don’t live as long as people.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, now you know that the ATM will only lets you take out 300 at a
time, I’ll take a check for the other hundred.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re jokin’ right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course I’m jokin’! I don’t take checks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank God you’re pretty. (Exits.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey, Chandler, Monica, and Phoebe are there as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi! Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you guys know any cute guys?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, of course I do! My good friend Joey over here. (Pats Joey’s
arm, Joey pats Chandler’s shoulder, and Chandler motions for Joey to say the same
about him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. Thank you Chandler.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anyway, there’s this big charity ball this weekend and Ralph Lauren
bought a table, so I kinda have to go…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s the charity?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, something either trees or disease—Ralph mumbles
a lot.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Does Ralph mumble when you’re not paying attention?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! It’s weird. But the thing is need to find a date.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, what kind of guy are you looking for?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, someone that has his own tux, or has the ability to rent a
tux.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So he has to be a male who has at least $50.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh! So close.
(Ross and Elizabeth enter.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey everybody!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey uh, this is Elizabeth.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh hi!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: I’m the student.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughs) Isn’t she cute? (On Monica’s death stare) No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know, this is probably none of my business, but weren’t you
guys supposed to not be seen in public together?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh, we’re not together.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, we’re just two people who happen to run into each other
here at the coffee house. (He winks at her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, sly.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Well, I really wanted to meet you guys, but I have to run. I’ll
see you later?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Bye Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye.
(They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oops! I did not mean to run into you like that sir.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh that is quite all right ma’am. (Elizabeth exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, why is she leaving? Is it a school night and she has a lot of
homework to do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, her molecular epidemiology paper is due tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, tell her good luck with that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyone else? Huh? Bring ‘em on!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oo! When’s her birthday?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know Rachel, why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know it’s just been so long since I’ve been to Chuckie
Cheese.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I like Elizabeth.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well thanks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. In fact, I like her so much you tell her I want my cookies early
this year! Y’know, a box of Thin Mints and some Tag-a-Longs.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey come on you guys, give him a break. Ross, seriously, how’s it
going with her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, actually it’s been great. She’s 20 so she’s not
looking for anything too serious, which is perfect for me right now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well that is great. And seriously, she seems very nice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. I know you guys like to give me a hard time and all, but it really
means a lot to me that you like her. Just knowing that you guys are…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting) Okay, I got a good one. Okay, umm, what is she? Like 12?
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is sitting at the table and Monica is
doing something in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, do you think we talk about our relationship enough?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Do we have any Fruit Roll-Ups?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I just thought of the perfect guy for Rachel to take to her thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s so funny because we found someone too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’s good, I guess she’ll have a choice between my guy
and your weirdo.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why would our guy be a weirdo?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ‘Cause that’s just your taste.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs sarcastically) Rachel is not going to pick your stupid guy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My guy is a lawyer who has volunteer work. And, he has one of these (She
squeezes the skin on her chin together to form…)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A face ass?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A chin dimple!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, uh y’know, our guy works with Chandler and he’s really
nice and smart and he’s a great dresser!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Have you seen your guy’s body?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, our guy is just a floating head.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well my guy is spectacular. Okay? He’s a massage client and one
time umm, when he was on the table, I looked at it. And I mean all of it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re not supposed to look!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, like there are police for that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (horrified) Wait! You look? You-you massaged me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. (Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right fine, your guy may have a great body, but our guy is really
funny.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Chandler funny?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Our guy’s a great dancer!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My guy is well read.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Our guy has great hair.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My guy has great teeth!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Our guy smells incredible.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Do you want our guy to be your guy?
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Chandler is entering to find Joey bingeing on the
food from the fridge. Joey isn’t doing all that well.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you…don’t look good Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The fridge broke. I have to eat everything. Cold cuts, ice cream,
limes—Hey, what was in that brown jar?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s still in there?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not anymore. So anyway, how do you want to pay me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is this a service you’re providing me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No! No! For my new fridge—our new fridge!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Our new fridge? I don’t live here anymore.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what? Look, suppose we were a divorced couple.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And I got custody of the kid, right? Now suppose the kid dies and-and I
gotta buy a new kid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (not quite sure where Joey’s going and is a little worried)
Okay…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause) Give me $400!

scenes.location: Ross’s office, he’s unlocking his office door as Elizabeth walks up.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Professor Geller?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm? (Turns around and sees that its Elizabeth) Oh, a student I don’t
know.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: I was wondering if I could talk to you for a moment?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, yes of course, what-what would this be regarding?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Making out in your office.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shh! (Laughs then composes himself) Of course, why don’t we go
inside?
(They go inside and Ross closes the door. When he turns around Elizabeth walks up to
him, pushes him back against the door, and starts kissing him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-ooh!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Doorknob! Doorknob!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh! Sorry! Umm, I actually do need to talk to you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, okay. What-what about?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Spring vacation.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Spring vacation.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yeah, we have time off and a lot of people are going on trips…
(Another professor barges in.)

lines.speaker: Professor Feesen
lines.text: Professor Geller!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (quickly jumping away from Elizabeth) Yes, professor
Feesen-sen-stenlger… I’ll be with you in one moment. (To Elizabeth) So, I will
take one box of the Thin Mints. (And he ushers Elizabeth out of the office.)

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Ross, Chandler, and Joey are entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You don’t understand! Elizabeth was about to ask me to go on a trip
with her! Is that taking it slow?! No, I’m not ready for this! Okay? What-what do I
tell her?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Just tell her the truth! Tell her you’re not ready.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can do that. Oh-oh, what if she gets upset?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then you distract her with a Barbie doll.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or! You can just, y’know… (He walks up close to whisper in
Ross’s ear and when he gets there he pushes Ross into the fridge.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What the hell are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? What the hell am I doing? You just broke my fridge!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! What? How do you, how do you even know its broken?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho, you think I don’t know what breaks my fridge? Excuse me!
(He opens the door and feels inside.) Well what do you know! Broken! That’ll be $400!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey, I saw you push him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause) You pushed him!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, I did not break this! Okay? (He opens the freezer and smells inside
and recoils in disgust.) That has been broken for a while.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. Chandler, do you remember how I told you about our fridge?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I still haven’t gotten a check for your half yet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do not give him any money!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m not talking to you! You broke my fridge!

scenes.location: Ross’s office, he’s opening the door to Elizabeth.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: You wanted to see me Professor Geller?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. Yes! Please, come in.
(She does so, he closes the door, and she pushes him against the doorknob again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oo-oo!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Doorknob?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it kinda grows on you. (They both laugh.) Actually, I wanted to
finish talking to you about uh, spring vacation.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I… (He has trouble sitting in his chair.) Look, I’m having
a great time with you and I just don’t want us to move to fast or put to much
pressure on us. So, I’m sorry I just don’t think we should go away together yet.
It’s-it’s too soon.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Ross, I think you misunderstood what I was saying. I just wanted to
tell you that I’m going to Florida for a couple weeks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. I think you misunderstood what I was saying. What I meant

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: You are so adorable.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That! Let’s talk about that.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe are there as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! How did it go with Elizabeth?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh? Oh-oh, it was fine. Uh, it was just a misunderstanding. She
didn’t want me to go with her. She just wanted to let me know that she’s going
to Florida for spring vacation.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait a minute, is she going for spring vacation or is she going for
spring break? (Does a little whooping/party noise.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s-what’s the difference?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, spring vacation is doing nice things with your grandparents.
Spring break you’re doing frat guys.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, y’know what? Not all spring breaks are like that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What did you do on yours?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I went to Egypt with my dad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can see it now, "Look dad, it’s the Sphinx!" (Does
that party noise again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I think Elizabeth is a little more serious than, "Spring
break!" (Imitates the party noise.) All right? I mean she’s taken my class!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And slept with the professor.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m gonna call her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.
(Ross leaves to do so and Rachel enters with a guy.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! You guys umm, I want you to meet Sebastian.

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We just uh, we just met at the newsstand. We both grabbed for the last Field
& Stream. (Chandler’s shocked.) What? I read that.

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.text: Can I get you a cup of coffee?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yes! Thank you! (He does so and Rachel sits down on the couch.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel, what the hell is this?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You ask us to find you a guy and you come traipsing in here with your
own!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You found me a guy?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! We found you a really cute and funny guy from Chandler’s work!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah and I-I found you one too who is not a weirdo.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know what though you guys? I really appreciate that but I
think I’m just gonna take Sebastian to the charity.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you sure?! Because our guy smells incredible!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, would you stop it with that already?!
(Sebastian returns with the coffee.)

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.text: Here you go. (Hands her, her cup.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, thank you.

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, Sebastian, do you do any volunteer work?

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.text: Uh, no not really. Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No reason, it’s just I know a single guy that cares about other
people.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you funny?

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you guys doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you funny? Tell us a joke!

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.text: Look, I just wanted to have coffee with Rachel.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, so do a lot of people.

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.text: Actually, I uh, I gotta get going. (To Rachel) Give me a call
sometime.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, but y’know, no, you didn’t give me your phone number.

lines.speaker: Sebastian
lines.text: Okay! See you later! (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Turns out he is kinda funny.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I cannot believe you guys! He was really nice and he left because of
you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, but Sebastian? What is that? A cat’s name?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, y’know what I noticed Rachel? He scares easy. Is that the
kind of guy you’d like to take to a ball? "Hey Sebastian, would you like to
dance?" (Imitates him.) "Uhh, okay—I gotta go!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right guys stop it. Rachel, we’re very sorry that is a very
insensitive thing for us to do. And y’know what? Let us make it up to you, we have
two really great guys for you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! What have you got to lose? Y’know you might even end up with
someone really special (whispers) if you pick my guy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so you will meet our guys?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, I’ll meet ‘em.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay now it doesn’t matter which one you choose, y’know?
It’s completely up to you. Our guy is perfect, or you can go out with the guy Phoebe
deemed not good enough to go out with herself.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Pheebs! There you are! Okay, you broke my fridge; you owe me
400 bucks!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay sure!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, technically you owe me $600 for sending out happy thoughts on your
last ten auditions.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Call it even?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
(Ross returns.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) Well, there you are! So what did Elizabeth say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, it turns out that she is going to Daytona for spring break woo-hoo.
That means, that means wet T-shirt contests, guys doing shots off of girl’s bodies,
waking up next to people you don’t even know…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, she is going to have a great time! Is she staying at the Hotel
Corona?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know the hotels?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure! I was there! Spring Break ’81! Woo-hoo!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: In 1981 you were 13!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what? I drove down, sold T-shirts, had a blast. And y’know who
knows how to party? Drunk college chicks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, she can’t go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, you can’t tell her not to go. You just started dating.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then what am I supposed to do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing, you just have to be cool with it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, what is she goes down and-and sleeps with a bunch of guys?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, maybe you don’t marry this one.

scenes.location: Elizabeth’s apartment, she is packing for her trip as Ross watches.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m so glad you’re going on this trip!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yeah! I’ve been working so hard this semester. I really need to
go crazy y’know, blow off some steam.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure. Sure. Look I don’t, I don’t know if your plans are
finalized yet, but umm, hey I-I know another great way to blow off steam.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you into crafts at all?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Ross, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, yeah, of-of course I’m okay! What? I’m just being
supportive. Supportive of you and this whole trip, and-and (notices something) what-what
is uh, what’s this? (He holds up a rather skimpy bathing suit.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: It’s a bathing suit?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: To wear in front of people?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Is that supportive?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is this?!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is reading as Monica and Chandler enter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good-good-good-good.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re really glad you decided to meet our guy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re gonna like him so much. So umm, when do you want to meet
him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know. I know I don’t work late tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tomorrow night is good. Tomorrow night is good, but uh, y’know
what? Why put off something till tomorrow that you can do right now? (Laughs) Eldad come
here! (He stands up from the next table.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Eldad, this is Rachel.

lines.speaker: Eldad
lines.text: How are you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well-well a little blind sided but y’know good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eldad, sit down. (To Rachel) Move over! Move over now!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I—Ohh! (Moves over and lets Eldad sit on the couch.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There you go! There you are! (Rachel stares at Monica and Chandler)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! Okay! We can take a hint! (They start to leave but run into Phoebe
with her guy in tow.) (To Phoebe) What are you doing here?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is Patrick. (Points to him.)

lines.speaker: Patrick
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi. (To Phoebe) Okay, you’re too late okay? Because she’s
already with our guy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looks) Oh my God, you’re right! I am too late; they’re
sitting on the couch and talking! (To Patrick) Come on! (They go over to the couch.)
Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is Patrick.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi.

lines.speaker: Patrick
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, this is the guy I was telling you about.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. And believe me, this suit does not do justice to what’s
underneath it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-okay, but Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m just sort of in the middle of something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Okay! Yeah, that’s okay. (To Patrick) Have a seat. (Sits
Patrick down next to Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! You can’t do that!

lines.speaker: Eldad
lines.text: Maybe I should go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (stopping him) Sit down! We’re winning!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y’know what? Maybe I should go!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (Chandler stops her) No-no-no-no! Have a seat! Have a seat!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel! Rachel! You haven’t touched Eldad’s hair!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It is the softest hair! Touch it! (Both he and Monica do so.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I’m good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel? Patrick is really rich. (To Patrick) Give her some money.

lines.speaker: Patrick
lines.text: Y’know what Phoebe? This isn’t really worth the free massage.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right Patrick, bye-bye!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Rachel) Eldad is much more cooperative! And he can dance! (To
Eldad) You dance for Rachel!
(He starts to get up, but Rachel stops him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no! Don’t dance for me! Please? Don’t! (She gets up to yell
at her ‘friends.’) What is the matter with you guys?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, okay, let’s talk it out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I… Am I the only one that this is embarrassing for?

lines.speaker: Eldad
lines.text: I’m a little embarrassed. (Chandler shushes him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ll tell ya who should be embarrassed! It’s you guys! Come
on! This is ridiculous! Thank you very much, but I do not need you to get me a date!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then why did she ask us to…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am still talking!! And then you chase away the one guy that I actually
liked! I mean, no offense to you guys. Really! I mean (To Patrick) congratulations on all
the cash, (He nods) and-and y’know—(Feels Eldad’s hair)—Wow! You do
have very soft hair! But I would much rather go to the ball all by myself than go through
anymore of this! Good-bye! (Grabs her stuff, starts to leave, then turns back suddenly,
and to Eldad) Now do you use some sort of special conditioner on that hair?!

lines.speaker: Eldad
lines.text: Yes, Papaya Extract.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you! (Storms out.)
[Scene: The airport, Elizabeth’s flight is about to leave and Ross is there to
send her off.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh, have a great time down there.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. And did you, did you pack that bathing suit?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was pretty funny when I, when I hid it for a while, huh? Anyway, umm,
I-I am worried about that bathing suit, not because it’s revealing which I’m
fine with, no I’m concerned about your health, sun exposure.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh, don’t worry I have plenty of sun block, it’s SPF-30.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, if what’s in the bottle is actually 30. I mean sometimes you
get 30, sometimes it’s-it’s get 4, and I swear to God more often than not
it’s just milk.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Ross, it’s going to be okay. I’m not going down there to
hook up with a bunch of guys. I really like you. I like how things are going between us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yeah! I’m just going down there to relax and hang out with my
friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Cool.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh hey! Here they are!
(A group of about 10 guys and no women come running around the corner.)

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Elizabeth!
(The guys pick up Elizabeth and carry her onto the plane as she waves bye.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Call me!
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Rachel, Chandler, and Phoebe are there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel, we’re sorry for pushing those guys on you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh that’s all right! Y’know, I ended up having a really good
time. Y’know, the charity was a big success and they raised a lot of money and
awareness.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So what was it for anyway?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I wanna say a disease.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I just got this really weird message from Ross. He said turn on MTV.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh. All right.
(Rachel does so and it’s one of those dance party shows they have during spring
break and we see…)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, look! That’s Elizabeth!
(Suddenly Ross jumps in and starts dancing with her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-oh Professor Geller.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahh, to be 13 again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

title: The One with Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Phoebe is helping Joey rehearse for an audition.
Phoebe is overacting her part.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The reactor’s gonna blow in three seconds, we’re never gonna
make it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’ve got to get out of here! Save yourself!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! I won’t leave you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t worry about me, I’m a robot! I’m just a machine!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No you’re not! Not to me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (she stops reading from the script) Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I am extremely talented!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you’re great! Okay, let’s take it from…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting) No, I mean I was really acting my ass off.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I thought I was pretty good too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, you’re solid. Yeah, you’re just no me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what? I think that’s enough for now. Yeah. I don’t
want to be over rehearsed.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (tremendously overacting) Fine! I’ll do it without you! (Joey gives
her thumbs up) I don’t need you or anybody else! I’m gonna make it on my own!
(Joey closes the door to his bedroom.) You’ll see!! You’ll all see!!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Joey is memorizing his lines. Chandler, Rachel,
and Phoebe are there as well.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Joey) So uh, what’s this thing you’re auditioning for?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it’s a new TV show. Yeah. I’m up for the part of Mac
Macaveli or "Mac." Yeah, I’m a detective and I solve crimes with the help
of my robot partner. He’s a, he’s a Computerized Humanoid Electronically
Enhanced Secret Enforcer or-or "C.H.E.E.S.E."

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s the title! Yeah! Y’know they really lucked out that the
initials spell cheese.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is lucky.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh—Wait so Joey if you get this, you’re gonna be like the
star of your own TV show! I mean you’ll be like the Big Cheese! (To Phoebe) Or the
Big Mac—Hey! You love those!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, don’t get your hopes up, because probably not gonna happen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now-now, why would you say that Joseph?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I mean come on you guys! My own TV show? I just don’t know if
I’m good enough.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, what are you talking about? You’re a terrific actor.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You really think so?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, how can you even ask that question?!
[And with that we go into the save the budget portion of the show, which features
flashbacks from previous episodes. The first set of auditions feature high lights or low
lights of Joey’s acting career. The first flashback is from The One With The Lesbian Wedding.]
[Scene: Monica and Rachel's, everyone is there to watch Joey's first scene as Dr. Drake
Remoray.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa, she's pretty. (Mentioning the girl on TV)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, and oh she's really nice too. She taught me all about how to
work the cameras, and smell-the-fart acting.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm sorry, what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's like, you got so many lines to learn so fast, that sometimes
you need a minute to remember your next one. So while you're thinkin' of it, you take this
big pause where you look all intense, you know, like this. (Does this intense look where
it looks like he's smelling a fart.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, ok.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (there's a gunshot on TV) There's my scene, there's my scene. [Joey on
tv] "Mrs. Wallace, I'm Dr. Drake Ramoray, your sister's neurosurgeon. I'm
afraid the situation is much worse than we expected. Your sister is suffering from
a..." (Does the smell-the-fart look.)
[The next flashback is from The One With The Butt.
The gang is watching Joey in Freud!]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on stage in an Austrian accent) Vell, Eva, ve've done some excellent vork
here, and I vould have to say, your pwoblem is qviiite clear. (He goes into a song and
dance number.)
All you want is a dingle,
What you envy's a schwang,
A thing through which you can tinkle,
Or play with, or simply let hang...
[The next flashback is also from The One With The Butt
and it's also on the soundtrack. He's Joey telling everyone about his big break in
Monica and Rachel's apartment.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I play Al Pacino's butt. All right? He goes into the shower, and
then- I'm his butt.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (trying not to laugh) Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: C'mon, you guys. This is a real movie, and Al Pacino's in it, and
that's big!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no, it's terrific, it's- it's- y'know, you deserve this, after all
your years of struggling, you've finally been able to crack your way into show business.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, okay, fine! Make jokes, I don't care! This is a big break for me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're right, you're right, it is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So you gonna invite us all to the big opening?
[Cut back to Joey about to leave for his audition for Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right well, I’m outta here. Wish me luck.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (overacting with a song this time) (singing) Gooood luck! Gooood
luck! We all wish you good luuuuuuuuck!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, whatever. (Exits.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Ross are playing chess and are both studying the
board intently.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s your turn.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, are we playing this?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, dejectedly) Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! How’d the audition go?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Terrible! I messed up every line! I shouldn’t even be
an actor!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, are you doing that thing where you pretend it didn’t
go well but it really did go well?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, did I fool ya?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Totally!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So it did go well.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it went amazingly well!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, it’s down to me and two other guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And I know both of them, they’re really good. One of them is the guy
from those allergy commercials who’s always getting chased by those big flowers…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I love that guy! (Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-oh, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stops laughing) What am I doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m just so nervous! Y’know? The callback isn’t until
tomorrow at five. I feel like my head is going to explode!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it is overdue.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, don’t worry. Okay? You’re gonna be fine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There’s just so much pressure. I mean no offense, but what you guys
do is very different. I don’t know if you’d understand.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, none of us have to deal with pressure at our jobs.
[Thus starts another series of flashbacks all dealing with the pressure the rest of the
Friends have to deal with in their jobs. The first flashback is from The One With The Stoned Guy.]

scenes.location: Chandler's office. He's on the phone, agitated.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on phone) Yes, Fran. I know what time it is, but I'm looking at the
WENUS and I'm not happy!
[The next flashback is from The One With The Prom Video.
Monica is at a job interview at a new restaurant.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, well I'm tearing the lettuce.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Uh-huh. Is it dirty?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh-oh, no no don't worry, I'm gonna wash it.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Don't, I like it dirty.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's your call.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: So, uh, what are you going to do next?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I thought that I would cut up the tomatos.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Are they, uh, firm?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They'r alright.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: You sure they haven't gone bad? You're sure they're not very,
very bad?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No really, they're OK.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: You gonna slice them up real nice?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Actually, I was gonna do them jullienne.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Aaaahhhhhhh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm outa here. [Monica leaves]
[The next flashback is from The One With Rachel's Crush.]

scenes.location: Bloomingdale’s, Rachel’s new job.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the phone) Monica, I’m quitting! I just helped an 81 year
old woman put on a thong and she didn’t even buy it! (Pause) I’m telling you
I’m quitting! That’s it! I’m talking to my boss right now! (Pause) Yes I
am! (Pause) Yes I am! Yes I am! Yes I am! Yes I am! Yes I am! Okay bye, call me when you
get this message. (Hangs up.)
[The next flashback is from The One With The Dozen Lasagnas, Phoebe is telling everyone
but Rachel about the pass Paulo made on her.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, what happened?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, he came in for a massage and everything was fine until...
(The flashback shows Paulo lying face down on the massage table and slowly moving his
hands up Phoebe's legs and grabbing her butt.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohhhhhh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And all of the sudden his hands weren't the problem anymore. (The
flashback shows Paulo rolling over and showing Phoebe his equipment.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Was it...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Boy Scouts could've camped under it!
[The next flashback is from The One With Ross's Sandwich,
Ross his confronting his boss about him eating Ross's sandwich.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You ate my sandwich?

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: It was a simple mistake. It could happen to anyone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (getting upset) Oh-oh really?

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: Now-now calm down. Come look in my office, some of it my still
be in the trash.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (jumping to his feet in anger) What?

lines.speaker: Dr. Leedbetter
lines.text: Well, it was quite large. I-I-I-I-I had to throw most of it
away.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You-you-you-you (trying to remain in control) threw my sandwich away!
[Cut to an outside shot of the museum.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (losing control, we hear him shout outside) MY SANDWICH?!!!
[Cut to a shot of a park.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: MY SANDWICH!!!!!! (Ross's scream scares a flight of pigeons away.)
[Cut back to Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I want this part so much! Y’know? If I don’t get this part
I’m never gonna eat Macaroni and Cheese again!—No, I didn’t say
that! That’s a lie.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Chandler is there talking to the chick and duck.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh come on guys, it’s not like I moved to Europe! I just moved
across the hall! And we would have you over all the time if it weren’t for
(struggles to get this out) Monica’s allergies. (The duck quacks.) You’re right,
I could never lie to you. She hates you. (The phone rings.) Should I get that? (Laughs,
then answers the phone.) Hello? (Listens) Uh no, Joey’s not here right now. Can I
take a message? (Listens) Yeah, okay so the audition has been moved from 5:00 to 2:30?
(Listens) Okay great. (Listens.) Bye. (Hangs up the phone and goes to write the message on
the Magna-Doodle on the door but Monica walks in and forces him to jump out of the
way.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (startled) Ahh! Aren’t you dressed yet?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks down at his clothes) Am I naked again?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re supposed to meet my parents in 15 minutes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah okay, I was just talking to the guys. Just look at them I mean,
is it okay if they come visit?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wh?! What about my allergies?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh right, your allergies. (Monica leaves and to the chick and duck)
All her, she hates you. (Chandler leaves without finishing the message for Joey.)
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Joey and Chandler are playing foosball and Joey
scores a goal.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes!! Ha-ha!! All right! Hey! How cool would it be if you could watch like
a real life-sized version of this? Huh? I mean how crazy would that be?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: As crazy as soccer?
(The phone rings and Joey answers it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? (Listens) What are you talking about? The
audition’s not ‘til 5:00! (Chandler suddenly remembers and looks at the
unfinished message then tries to sneak over and finish it as Joey listens.) Well, nobody
told me! (Listens) Who’d you talk to? (Listens and turns around to see Chandler
trying to finish the message.) Nevermind! (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean you didn’t get it from this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The allergy guy got the part! Thanks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, maybe we can fix it y’know? Maybe we can send him some-some
big-big flowers and scare him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How could you do this to me Chandler?! This part could’ve turned my
whole career around!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I messed up. Okay? I’m sorry, I really messed up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you don’t even live here anymore! What are you doing answering
my phone? I have my machine!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Which I bought for ya. Taught ya how to use it. You thought it was a
copier. Look, if there was anything I could do, I would do it. Okay? But everybody’s
allowed one mistake, right?
[Joey just laughs as a third set of flashbacks featuring Chandler’s mistakes
starts. The first flashback is from The One With The Prom
Video. It's Chandler telling Phoebe how much he hates the bracelet Joey bought
him. They're both at Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know he coulda gotten me a VCR, he coulda gotten me a set of
golf clubs, but no, he has to get me the woman repeller! The eyesore from the
Liberace house of crap!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's not that bad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah, easy for you to say, you don't have to walk around
sporting some reject from the Mr. T collection. [Joey walks in behind Chandler]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler, Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I pity the fool who puts on my jewelry, I do, I do. I pity the
fool that. . . [turns around and sees Joey] Hi!
[The next flashback is from The One Where Chandler
Crosses The Line. He's telling Joey that he kissed Cathy.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I mean when you were late last night, Kathy and I got to
talking, and one thing to another and…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And what?! Did you sleep with her?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No! No! I just kissed her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!! That’s even worse!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How is that worse?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know! But it’s the same!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re right, I have no excuses! I was totally over the
line.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Over the line?! You-you’re-you’re so far past the line,
that you-you can’t even see the line! The line is a dot to you!
[Cut back to Joey and Rachel’s apartment.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I’m not saying that you should magically forgive me! But
you’re not perfect! You’ve made some errors in judgment too!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Name one!
[Chandler proceeds to point out Joey’s errors in this forth set of flashbacks. The
first flashback is from The One With The Cat.
Chandler has just returned home to see that their apartment has been cleaned out and finds
Joey trapped in the entertainment center.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (lets him out) What happened?!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (getting out) Awww, man! He promised he wouldn’t take the chairs!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What the hell happened?!! How were you locked in?!! And where
the hell is all of our stuff?!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, this guy came by to look at the unit and-and he said he
didn’t think big enough to fit a grown man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So--You got in voluntarily?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was tryin’ to make a sale!! Oh, man, if I ever run into that
guy again, do you know what I’m gonna do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: BEND OVER?!!!
[The next flashback is from The One With The Candy Hearts. Joey and Chandler are
waiting at a restaurant as Lorraine and her friend arrive.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, now, remember, no trading. You get the pretty one, I get the mess.

lines.speaker: Lorraine
lines.text: Hi, Joey. (Sees Chandler.) Well well, look what you brought.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...And what did you bring?

lines.speaker: Lorraine
lines.text: She's checking the coats. Joey, I'm gonna go wash the cab
smell off my hands. Will you get me a white Zinfandel, and a glass of red for Janice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Janice?
(Lorraine leaves. Joey shakes his head as though to say, 'It can't be the same Janice.'
Janice enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Janice?!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh.... my.... God.
[The next flashback is from The One With Ross's New
Girlfriend. Chandler is telling Ross and Joey that Joey's tailor took advantage
of him.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey's tailor...took advantage of me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No way! I've been going to the guy for 12 years.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh come on! He said he was going to do my inseam, and he ran his
hand up my leg, and then, there was definite...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Cupping.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's how they do pants! Ross, will you tell him? Isn't that how
they measure pants?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, yes it is. In prison!
[Cut back to the present.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I said name one!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica and Rachel are consoling Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t believe I did this! What an idiot!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, stop beating yourself up! People make mistakes! These things happen!
There aren’t any message you’ve forgotten to give me are there? (Chandler has a
disgusted look on his face.) Apparently you’re not very good at it! I…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you think he’ll ever forgive me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Of course he will! But Chandler the most important thing is you forgive
yourself!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what? I-I kinda have.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Already? That’s pretty bad what you did.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what? He will forgive you. And I like to bring a pad
with me when I go answer the phone just in case… (Chandler gets that disgusted look
back.) Okay…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You didn’t see how mad he was, y’know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sure he will forgive you. Look, we have all been there!
Y’know, you fight, you make up, it’s just the way it works.
[We then go into another set of flashbacks of famous fights. The first is the second
breakup of Ross and Rachel from The One With The Jellyfish.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It took two people to break up this relationship!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! You and that girl from that copy place, which yesterday you took
full responsibility for!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I didn’t know what I was taking full responsibility for! Okay?! I
didn’t finish the whole letter!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I fell asleep!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (mocking him) You fell asleep?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was 5:30 in the morning, and you had rambled on for 18 pages. Front and
back!! (they go into the living room, trapping Monica, Chandler, and Joey in the kitchen)
(to Rachel) Oh-oh-oh, and by the way, Y-O-U-apostrophe-R-E means ‘you are,’
Y-O-U-R means ‘your!’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y'know I can’t believe I even thought about getting back
together again! We are so over!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (starts to cry) FINE BY ME!! (he opens the door and traps Chandler behind
it)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And hey! Just so you know, it’s not that common! It doesn’t
happen to every guy! And it is a big deal!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (coming out from behind the door) I KNEW IT!!!!
[The next flashback is from The One After The Superbowl,
Part II. Monica and Rachel are fighting over who gets to see Jean-Claude Van
Damme.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You had no right to go out with him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is the most ridiculous...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You sold me out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did not sell you out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes you did. You absolutely sold me...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Would you let me talk. [flicks Monica on the forehead]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you just flick me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OK, well, you wouldn't let me finish and I was jus- [Monica flicks her
back] Ow. That hurt [flicks Monica]
(They keep flicking each other. This turns into slapping each other.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! All right. Now, let's not do this!
(Rachel tackles Monica onto the couch.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Happy thoughts! Happy thoughts!
(They wrestle on the couch for a little while until Monica gets the upper hand and
pulls Rachel off of the couch by her sock. Monica removes Rachel's sock and starts
beating her with it.)This leads to wrestling on the floor. This finally angers Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: OK, now I'm gonna kick some ass.
(Phoebe grabs each of them by an ear.)

lines.speaker: Monica and Rachel
lines.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know! I know! I know!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, now I will let go if you both stop.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There we go.You know what, if we were in prison, you guys would be,
like, my bitches.
[The next flashback is from The One Where No One's Ready.
Joey is retaliating against Chandler hiding his underwear by wearing a whole bunch of
clothes.]

lines.speaker: Joey
