lines.text: Okay, buddy-boy. Here it is. You hide my clothes, I'm wearing everything
you own.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look at me! I'm Chandler! Could I be wearing any more clothes?
Maybe if I wasn't going commando...
(Chandler does this throat sound.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Whew, it's hot with all of this stuff on. I ah, I better not do any,
I don't know, lunges. (starts doing lunges)
[The next flashback is from The One Where Eddie Moves In.
It's the sequence where Joey and Chandler are both saddened that they're not living
together anymore. All By Myself is playing in the background.]
[Joey's place. He goes to say something to Chandler in the other chair but no one's
there. He goes to call Chandler but decides not to and throws the phone back down.]
[Chandler's. He's playing foosball by himself.]
[Joey's. Playing ping pong by himself.]
[Chandler is sitting in front of a window while it's raining outside. We see Joey
through a rainy window. The camera zooms out to show it's just his tabletop water
sculpture.]
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Chandler is entering with a peace offering of a
Joey Special, two pizzas.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey? Got you a Joey Special, two pizzas! Joe? (The phone rings
and he answers it) (On phone) Hello? (Takes the phone away from his mouth when he realizes
what he just did and yells.) Damnit! (Back on phone.) Hello? (Listens.) No, Joey’s
not here right now, but I can take a message I think. (Listens) He’s still got a
chance for the part?! Oh, that’s great news! (Listens) Well no obviously not for the
actor who was mauled by his dog. (Listens) Oh well, that’s great. I will give Joey
the message. Thank you! (Hangs up and goes to write the message on the Magna-Doodle.)
Yes! (Reading what he’s writing) Okay, Mac audition at 2:00. Allergy actor attacked.
(Pause) By dog not flowers.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Joey is entering to find Chandler waiting
patiently for him.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Please tell me you got the message!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What message?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The actor playing Mac couldn’t do it, they needed to see you at 2
o’clock.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! It’s 6 o’clock!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Du-du-I wrote it, I wrote it on the board! I wrote it on the board,
then I went all over New York City looking for ya! I went to Ross’s! I went to the
coffeehouse! I went to any place that they made sandwiches!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can’t believe this Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry! I-I-I don’t know what to say.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well you-you-you-you might say congratulations! I saw the board! I went to
the audition! I got the part!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (angrily) Is that supposed to be funny! I was really worried over
here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, well I’m uh…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know, sometimes that fake out thing is just mean!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh wow! Okay man, I’m sorry. I did not mean to make you feel bad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well that’s good. Because you didn’t! And I’m
incredibly happy for ya!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shocked) That’s mean! You really had me going there!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, we could do this all day.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you’re right. Okay look, listen, let’s talk about what a
huge star I’m gonna be!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You are gonna be a huge star! I’m gonna hug ya!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You hug me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right!
[What follows is the final set of flashbacks that feature a whole lot of lovin’
between Chandler and Joey. There’s no words, just hugs and even the kiss from The One
With The Monkey. All of this is set to the song, You’ve Really Got a Hold on Me!]
[Cut back to the present, they are still in each other’s embrace.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, do we do this too much?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think so. Yeah, get off me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
(They separate.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Joey and Phoebe are reading a scene from Mac and
C.H.E.E.S.E.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on C.H.E.E.S.E., I’m not leaving without you! Try routing your
backup source through your primary CPU.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (overacting badly) I can’t! My circuits are fried! They’re
fried I tell you!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! (Back to reading the scene.) Well then I’ll just have to carry
you.
(Suddenly Ross jumps up from behind the counter armed with a plastic gun. By the way,
he’s overacting too.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’ll be a neat trick, when you’re, (looks at the script) when
you’re dead!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, you don’t have to yell.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There was just an explosion, okay? My hearing would be impaired.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I thought you were excellent! In fact for a minute there I was like,
"Ooh, where’d Ross go?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you! And I have to say that first scene when you meet Mac…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God. I mean…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what? I think that’s enough for today. Thanks for your
help! (He grabs their scripts and heads for his room.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Ross) He’s holding us back.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Totally.

title: The One Where Ross Meets Elizabeth's Dad

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe, Rachel, Chandler, and Monica are there. Rachel is reading
everyone’s horoscope.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And your horoscope says, "On the fifth a special someone is going
to give you a gift."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Oh, well thank you in advance. (Kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Op, but the twelfth brings a lover’s spat.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) You are going to make a joke about my special
present! Why would you do that?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, wait and on the nineteenth a secret crush announces itself.
(Phoebe winks and licks her lips while eyeing Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (ecstatic) Oh my God! It’s Joey Tribbiani of Mac and
(Everyone claps and cheers, Joey mimics looking about with a gun.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s right. It’s your first day! So are you psyched to
fight fake crime with your robot sidekick?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Am I psyched? The lead in my own TV series? I’ve dreamed about this
for years! Why have I not been preparing?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Joey, you’re going to be great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But I got to act with a robot Pheebs, and-and I don’t know anything
about technology! I can’t even use Chandler’s computer except to find porn!
And-and that’s only ‘cause it’s right there when you turn it on!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think our lover’s spat will start a little early this month.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (in a sexy voice to Chandler) I’ll be waiting.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, time lapse. Phoebe is now looking at the covers of two different
books.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you judging them by their covers? Because you’re really not
supposed to do that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I’m just deciding which one to use—I’m gonna start
writing another book!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Be-because the last one was such a big seller?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if you must know I have written 14 books. And as I am the only one
who has read them, I can tell you that they all have been very well received.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you guys doing later?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Rachel and I have appointments to get our hair cut.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe) We do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I want to see what he wants first.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (continuing) I just found out that Elizabeth’s dad wants to meet me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait a minute, hold the phone! You’re not Elizabeth’s dad?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on guys, I-I really want this guy to like me. It-it would really help
me out if you guys were here to make me look good.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Of course we’ll help! Yeah! We’ll be here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We know how tough those parent/teacher conferences can be.
[Scene: Pier 59 Studios, it’s the set of Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E. The producer is
showing Joey around the set.]

lines.speaker: The Producer
lines.text: (walking into Mac’s office) So uh, here’s your office
set!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! Huh? (Picks up the phone) Mac Macaveli, Private Investigator!

lines.speaker: The Producer
lines.text: (checking his watch) Let’s get you into wardrobe for a
fitting.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Hey uh, when do I get to meet the robot?

lines.speaker: The Producer
lines.text: I’m sorry, why don’t we do that right now? He’s
right here. (Points to a guy.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: The Producer
lines.text: Joey Tribbiani, this is…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh wow! He’s so lifelike! (Starts touching the guy’s cheeks)
Unbelievable! (He starts tugging on the guy’s ears.

lines.speaker: The Producer
lines.text: This is Wayne, the man who created and operates C.H.E.E.S.E.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (slaps Wayne on his cheek) How do you do there, Wayne? (Backs away.)

lines.speaker: The Producer
lines.text: I’ll let you two guys get acquainted, huh? (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Sorry about that…(Mimics that cheek thing he just did.) Uh, so
where’s C.H.E.E.S.E.?

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: C.H.E.E.S.E. is right here. (He puts on his headset, picks up the
controller, and wheels C.H.E.E.S.E. in. C.H.E.E.S.E. is just a plain old robot on tracks;
he kinda looks like No. 5 in the movie Short Circuit.)

lines.speaker: C.H.E.E.S.E.
lines.text: (Wayne with a computerized voice) Nice to meet you Mac!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) This is like the temporary robot, right?

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: No. Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I-I just, I just it was going to be like a really cool robot,
y’know? Like the terminator or uh, when I first saw you.

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: I spent two years developing this machine, it’s absolutely state of
the art.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sorry, it just—I don’t know it doesn’t really look
like it can do anything.

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: It can do this. (He moves C.H.E.E.S.E.’s arm close to Joey’s
special area and he jumps back.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross is at the counter drinking coffee as Elizabeth enters with
her dad, Paul. Elizabeth goes to kiss Ross, but he just kisses her on the forehead. By the
way Paul is played by Bruce Willis. Yes, that Bruce Willis from Moonlighting, Die
Hard, and Armageddon.]

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: This is my father, Paul Stevens. Dad, this is Ross Geller.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It-it’s great to meet you Paul.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I usually prefer Elizabeth’s boyfriends to address me as Mr. Stevens.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course, of course, Mr. Stevens.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: So Ross, what your problem?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Eh-wh—Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Why can’t you get a girlfriend your own age?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s funny. Umm…. (Pause, then serious) It’s not funny.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I don’t like you going out with my daughter Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. I can, I can see that. Umm, but I think if you give me umm, one
chance I can, I can change your mind.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Okay. I’ll give you one chance to change my mind. (Ross laughs in
relief) You got one minute. (Ross suddenly gets worried.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Daddy!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Fine! Two minutes. Go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is—you—(Ross starts laughing.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (laughs then checking his watch) 1 minute 50 seconds.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, umm I want you to know that I have never done anything like this
before. I mean, I mean I’ve been in um, relationships in general, uh but I have never
done it with a student—I mean I not—not it! I mean, I mean I
don’t—We haven’t done it. Uh, I mean, I mean,
we’ve-we’ve-we’ve done stuff. (Paul is not amused.) Okay, okay, a joke, a
joke—lighten the mood. Umm, two guys go into a bar. One of them is Irish.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I’m Irish.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And the Irish guy wins the joke!
(Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe enter.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How crazy that we’d run into you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh God, thank you! (Runs and gives all of them a group hug.) Umm, uh, Mr.
Stevens I’d like you to meet my friends uh, this is Phoebe, Monica, and Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re Elizabeth’s father, huh? I can see now where she gets
her rugged handsomeness.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (obviously attracted to him) Is-is-is there a-a Mrs. Stevens?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There’s a Mr. Bing!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: No, unfortunately Lizzie’s mom passed away shortly after she was
born. I raised her by myself.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Monica
lines.text: (sympathetic) Ohh!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I get that a lot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay umm, why don’t we all take a seat, y’know? And uh, and
I’ll get us all some uh some coffees—(He goes to pull out Elizabeth’s
chair, but Paul steps in)—Yeah, why don’t you. (Paul pulls out her chair) Uh and
you guys can talk about whatever, whatever you want. Y’know? Whatever pops into your
head. (He turns his back to Paul and Elizabeth and points to himself for Chandler, Monica,
and Phoebe. Then he goes to order the coffee.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, it is so strange seeing Ross here this time of day,
‘cause usually he’s got the children’s hospital.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Not looking for dates. (Monica turns in horror.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: So uh, Monica is Ross’s sister.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And he’s a great brother!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I had a sister.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: She passed away.

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: (sympathetic) Ohh!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Oh, you don’t have to do that every time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But uh Ross, Ross is a great guy! I was roommates with him in college.
Uh, funny story… (He starts laughing then notices that Paul isn’t happy.)
You’re roommate in college died didn’t he?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: A part of him did yes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (returning with the coffee) Okay here we are Paul, Elizabeth. (He sets
down their cups.) So I hope you guys were finding something to talk about.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, we were just…
(Rachel runs in.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, I’m sorry I’m late but I am ready, ready to talk you up!
When does Liz’s father get here?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I’m already here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Ross is sooo great!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Phoebe is working on her book at the kitchen
table, Monica is on the couch, and Chandler is entering from the bathroom carrying a
package of toilet paper.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey honey, you got the kind with the little girl, you said we were
gonna to get the kind with the baby.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, you said the baby creeps you out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, the little girl creeps me out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You said the baby.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why would the baby creep me out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why would the little girl creep you out?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (writing frantically) You guys, I’m sorry, could you please talk a
little slower?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is going in your book?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, it’s about relationships. Y’know? The traps, the
pitfalls, what not to do, keep going. This stuff is great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! Excuse me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And how none of it matters when the people really love each other.
(Chandler and Monica kiss.) And how people will believe anything you tell them as long as
it’s a compliment.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is there alone as Paul enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing him) Oh hi!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Hi! Hi. (He’s looking around.) I think I left my keys here somewhere.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Well let’s look for them. (Finds some under one of the couch
cushions. It has a pink, fuzzy ball on the key chain.) Oh-oh-hey! Are these them?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right! (Throws them back under the cushion.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Oh, here they are right here. (Picks them up from underneath the corner of
the couch.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh good.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Thanks for your help. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (chasing after him) Oh, wait! Sorry, Mr. Paul? Mr. Paul?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Just call me Paul.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Paul. Umm, I just wanted you to know that Ross really is a great guy.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Well maybe you can date him then that would save me the trouble of killing
him. (Rachel laughs then starts looking at him.) Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You just don’t look old enough to have a twenty-year-old daughter.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Well, we were very young when we had her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. We?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Well yeah, it usually, it takes two people to… (He taps his index
fingers together.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no! Yes! Of course, I know that! I just—I meant y’know are
you still a ‘We’ or are you just ‘You?’

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I’m just me, my wife died shortly after Lizzie was born.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sympathetic) Ohh. So you raised her all on your own?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Yes I did.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh. (She touches his arm for support and likes what she feels) Ooh!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Phoebe is still writing in her book, Chandler
and Monica are in the kitchen as Joey enters.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How was your first day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pretty great! Except I did get a little attitude from the robot.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Damn those robots, they’re supposed to be our faithful
servants!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Anyway, it wasn’t the robot, it was the guy who controls him. Yeah,
he doesn’t like me. He had C.H.E.E.S.E. knock over the sandwich right when I was
reaching for one! Ohh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, why don’t you just get him fired?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I may have to, I hate to do it, but I’m the star! Y’know?
There’s a limit to how many sandwiches I can eat off the floor. (His cell phone
rings) Excuse me. (Answers it, on phone) Joey Tribbiani.

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: (on the other end) Joe! I’m glad I found ya, I got an audition for
ya!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: The thing is it’s kinda on the Q.T. The actor who has the part
doesn’t know he might be fired. It’s the lead in a series, Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m the lead in Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.!!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Uh-oh!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Ross is entering looking for Joey, but instead he finds Paul
and Rachel making out on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey?!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Hi Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I was just getting him to like you.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, scene is continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey?! Joey!! (He runs into his bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, Joey is not here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I’ll just wait for him in here!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, it’s okay. You can come out.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Yeah Ross it’s okay, it’s me, Mr. Stevens.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (coming out of the bedroom) Oh! Oh my God! I didn’t even see you!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Sure you did! You came in, you got all awkward, and you ran into the
bedroom. You were shouting, "Joey! Joey!" Bye Rach. (Kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I’ll call you later. Bye Ross. (Leaves)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What-what-what the—how da-how did-what the-how did-what?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know he lost his keys so he was looking for them…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (incredulous) In your mouth?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Downstairs! And we got to talking y’know, for like two hours,
and I really liked him so I invited him up here for a cup of coffee.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You were at the coffeehouse!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, what’s the big deal? So I kissed the guy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He is my girlfriend’s father, okay? It’s-it’s, it’s
weird!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh—You dated my sister!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That was different!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Why?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is weird for me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross look, look this is good for you. Okay? Let’s face it, so far
the guy’s not lovin’ ya! But I can turn that around! I got the inside track! We
can all go out to dinner, y’know? And I can talk you up! Ross, the guy is a very, very
successful lawyer!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How is that important?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh it’s important!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Joey is telling everyone about his impending
termination at Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Apparently, there’s like a million guys out there that can play Mac,
and there’s only this one robot and this one guy who controls it! I didn’t know
he could get me fired! What am I going to do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well y’know Joey, you’re a pretty charming guy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks, but I kinda have a problem to deal with here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No sweetie, you’ve got to win over the guy that controls
C.H.E.E.S.E.! You’ve got to kiss some serious robot ass!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s not a bad idea. Yeah. Okay, but if I got to turn on the charm
tomorrow I’m not wasting anymore of it over here with you guys. (Starts to leave, but
stops and turns to Phoebe.) Well, actually I got a little bit saved for you Pheebs.
(Exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So do you think uh, Joey’s more charming than me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! That’s why I’m sleeping with him on the side.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, you wish. (Stops to think about it and gets depressed.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (writing in her book) "You wish."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, stop writing about us!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m not writing about you! I’m writing about other people.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Marcia and Chester.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay fine! Fine! Then you know what, I’ll just write about Phyllis!
Hmm!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (writing on a piece of paper) Phyllis is sitting in a chair.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I see what you’re doing!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (still writing) Phyllis sees what I’m doing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-oh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, I have tasted my own medicine and it is bitter!

scenes.location: Pier 59 Studios, Joey is walking up to C.H.E.E.S.E. and Wayne.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Morning! Hey, how’s my favorite genius and my little robot buddy?!
(Pats C.H.E.E.S.E. on the head.)

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: Don’t touch him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay! (He yanks his hand away.) All right. Umm, all right Wayne, level
with me. Okay? I-I keep hearing all these rumors that I might get fired. Okay, they even
have actors coming in to read for my part! Come on man, you-you got to give me a second
chance! I mean, I love-I love this little guy! (He grabs C.H.E.E.S.E.’s arm and pulls
it off at the elbow.) Ah-ah!! (Wayne is shocked.) Okay, that’s why you didn’t
want me to touch him right? Here you go! Okay? (Hands Wayne the arm and he goes to fix it.
Meanwhile Joey starts to berate himself.) Stupid! I can’t believe it! God! (A very
beautiful woman walks by.) (To her) Hey, how you doin’? (He and her go over to talk
and Wayne looks on with envy.)
[Scene: A Restaurant, Ross and Rachel are on their double date. Rachel is busy talking
Ross up.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So it seemed that my prom date had stood me up, so Ross selflessly,
offered to take me.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: What a nice story!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: So Ross was in college and decided to jump at the chance to take a young
girl to her high school prom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! I definitely did not see that one backfiring! I’m gonna
go to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, take your time.
(Rachel heads for the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Paul) Just-just so you know I was a freshman and she was a senior. So
it wasn’t as bad as-as…

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Ross, look, I know I’ve been giving you a lot of jabs and it’s
partly because I’m very protective of Lizzie, and partly because well, they just keep
coming to me. But I have to admit that after all the wonderful things that Lizzie has told
me and the many, many, (pause) many stories that Rachel has told me that, well (pause)
you’re not (pause) all bad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not all bad.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: And anyhow, I’m sorry I was so harsh before, but you have to
understand that I (pause) still look at Lizzie like she’s a twelve-year-old girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. You know what? I know what you mean; I do that too.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I beg your pardon?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! Not—I don’t mean I-I see her as a twelve-year-old girl!
I mean I-I have a son, who’s umm six and I still think of him as a baby.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: You have a son?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well my-my ex-wife and I share custody of Ben and umm, uh, and just
so you know, Carol and I are on excellent terms as I’m sure you are with your
wife! (Realizes) Oh, I’m sorry! (To Elizabeth) It’s unbelievable!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Don’t worry about it, I just didn’t realize you were married.
(Rachel returns and hears that.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh we were, but that was just a (pause as the audience reacts), I mean
that was just a big drunken mistake.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re back.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: You two were married?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Whoops! I’m sorry, you were talking about Emily!
(Ross slams his head down on the table.)
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica and Chandler are entering and
they’re arguing.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, we said we would meet at the coffeehouse at six.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We said seven!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We said six!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The only way that I said six would be if the seven’s, let meet at
seven, not at six.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah and if I had seven, maybe I would’ve said something like this,
"Wow! My boyfriend’s such a wise ass—seven!"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Turning around in the chair) Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my good God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know what time you said.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well actually, I know what time Chester and Marcia said.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What time?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Quite an interesting turn of events, suddenly it’s my book to the
rescue, huh? (Reading her book) Ooh, very interesting. Yeah, well this certainly clears
things up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (disgusted) What does it say?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I will tell you as soon as you thank me for writing my book.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you for writing your book. Its-its uh, great book and you are
the queen of everything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks! So are you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) I told you I should not wear this color. (He’s
wearing a reddish-orange sweater.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading from her book) Mon… (Pause as she restarts) Marcia and
Chester are planning on seeing a movie on Sunday night. Marcia thinks they’re
supposed to meet at six, Chester thinks it’s at seven.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you knew we were gonna miss the movie!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Inside of telling us you decided to write in your stupid book!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (writing in her book) Marcia and Chester are mad at Phyllis.

scenes.location: Joey’s Dressing Room, Joey and Chandler are there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can’t believe I’m going to lose this job!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh I’m so sorry man! Is there anything I can do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Help me get this mini-fridge past the security guard.
(There’s a knock on the door and Joey answers it to Wayne.)

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: Hey Joey, I want to talk to you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah? Well, I don’t want to talk to you Wayne! I hate you! You ruined
my life! Oh, Chandler, Wayne. Wayne, Chandler. (They shake hands.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, how are ya?

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: Joey, Joey, I-I-I’ll g-get you your job back if you help me out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (incredulous) Why should I help you?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (whispering in Joey’s ear) The reason he just said.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (happily) What do you need?

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: I-I-I saw you on stage talking to that beautiful woman, y’know
Sarah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: I wish I could talk to her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you in love with her or something?

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: Yeah. Her. All of them. Anyone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’ve been there my friend.

lines.speaker: Wayne
lines.text: Listen, I-I guarantee you keep your job if you can teach me how to talk
to women like you do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh wow Wayne, it’s not really something you can teach y’know?
It’s pretty much something you’re born with if you—(Off Chandler’s
look)—You-you can teach it! I’ll show you right how to do it.

scenes.location: A Restaurant, Rachel is still trying to talk up Ross, not to much success.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean if you think about it, I mean Ross did learn something from each
marriage.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: How to make the next one even shorter?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now wait a minute that’s not fair. He was married to me a hell of a
lot longer than he was married to Emily, he just didn’t tell me. (Everyone looks at
her, Ross not happily.) Maybe I have to pee again. (Gets up to try to use the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Well, this is fun. So Ross, did you kill any of these wives?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? I-I-I… I-I have had enough of this! Y’know,
I-I-I care a great deal about your daughter and I have treated her with nothing but
respect! So if-if you’ve got a problem with me, frankly…

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Are you yelling at me?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: God no!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Y’know what daddy? If you don’t like Ross, that’s
fine. It doesn’t matter to me, I’m gonna go out with him anyway.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Really?! (She nods in the affirmative.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well if it doesn’t matter to her, it doesn’t matter to me! (to
Paul) Still not yelling!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Wow. What can I say? (Pause, pointing at Ross) This doesn’t make me
like you any better!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s okay, I’m not so crazy about myself right now either.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Then we agree?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh yeah, I guess—Yeah! I guess so.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Neither of us like Ross!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: I like Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohhh! Kids!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (returning) Wait-wait-wait, I just thought of another story about how
nice Ross is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s okay Rach, we’re not liking Ross right now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! I’ve got a lot of those too!
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Mac’s Office, Mac is talking to C.H.E.E.S.E. about their case.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it turns out you were right C.H.E.E.S.E.

lines.speaker: C.H.E.E.S.E.
lines.text: The shipment never made it through Omaha?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got it! And the rabbi’s beard, 100% horsehair. Nice catch
C.H.E.E.S.E.! (Pauses as he waits for C.H.E.E.S.E.’s next line.) It’s your line
C.H.E.E.S.E.! (Suddenly C.H.E.E.S.E. goes crazy and starts flinging it’s arms and
advancing on Joey behind the desk.) Wayne! Wayne!!
(The camera cuts to Wayne who’s busy making out with Sarah and rubbing
C.H.E.E.S.E.’s controller on her back causing C.H.E.E.S.E. to go crazy. Joey starts
throwing books at C.H.E.E.S.E. to get him to stop.)

title: The One Where Paul's the Man

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel, Chandler, Monica, and Joey are there as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (dejected) Hi, you guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well it’s just—it’s one of those situations that I just
hate. Y’know? A massage client gave me three tickets to the Helmet-Pelts exhibit at
the Morgan Chase museum.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (nodding knowingly) Now you’re thinking you gotta sleep with him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No! It’s just that he gave me three tickets and there are six
of us!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll give up my ticket.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay that’s so generous!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I think Ross is generous too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great! Okay then it’s just us girls!

lines.speaker: Monica and Rachel
lines.text: (less than enthused) Great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what-what is the exhibit.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s mostly just photographs of lesbian love scenes interspersed
with video games and free sandwiches.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh man! (Hits Chandler)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross listen Chandler got you out of going to the lesbian sandwich
museum this weekend!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks? But I have plans; Elizabeth and I are going out of town.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that’s great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean think about all the money that you’re gonna make!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why? What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, her father pays you for baby-sitting right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, that’s funny. But maybe it’s time to move on, let it go,
y’know? Stop it! Besides, Rachel is going out with Elizabeth’s father, so ah,
he’s much older than she is. Looks like I’m not the only one interested in
fossils, huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean Ross all that does is remind us that you are interested in
fossils.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay. Uh, well uh, Rachel is going to need to yell sweet nothings
(Paul enters) in his ear.
(And walks up right behind Ross, and standard sitcom joke 2B follows with the person
being insulted standing right behind the person doing the insulting while the rest of the
people become frightened and try to warn the insulter about the insultee’s presence.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, come on you guys; that’s funny! Y’know? Because he’s
need—he’s got like a hearing aide y’know, ‘cause-‘cause
y’know, ‘cause he’s all old, and…
(Paul reveals his presence by laughing, thus concluding standard sitcom joke 2B. Paul
then pulls Ross aside to have a little chat with him and tells the rest of the group that
he’ll just be one second.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Okay look, Ross, just so you know that since Lizzie likes you so much,
I’ve decided to accept the fact that you’re going out with her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? That okay, that’s great.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Yeah. But then I changed my mind. I’m funny like that. So I told
Lizzie, now I’m telling you, I don’t want you seeing my daughter anymore.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right look, I-I realize it upsets you.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Yes it does.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But, Elizabeth and I are-are both adults and so I don’t think
there’s really anything you can do about it.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I’ll call the university and tell them about your relationship and
have you fired.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh! A man with a plan!
Opening Credits
[Scene: A Dry Cleaners, Joey is there with Phoebe and is trying to get his picture put
back amongst the other celebrities hanging on the walls.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, this is so exciting! You get your picture back up on the wall of
fame! Eek!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know. It was so cool when I was up there before. Me and Jim Belushi
would just be crackin’ up about something… Then I get fired off of Days Of
Our Lives and he takes me down. Now he’s just laughing at me. Look at him, that
smug Belushi bastard, I’ll…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) Ohh, okay maybe they put your picture back up they can put you
next to Matt Lauer. Look at him, smiling at me. (Giggles) Yeah I know; we’d be great
together!
(The dry cleaner finishes with the customer in front of Joey and they approach the
counter.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! So I’m back.

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Joey Tribbiani! From the wall! (The dry cleaner doesn’t remember)
Okay, maybe this will jog your memory, huh? (Holds his picture up in front of his face.)
Huh? Okay eh-ah-anyway, I’m ready to go back up on the wall I’m the star of a
new TV show.

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: (picking up a TV Guide) Show me in the table.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well, it’s not on TV yet.

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: Well, then it’s not on the wall yet.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, fine, I will bring you a tape, huh? (Walks away)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So umm, now do you have any of Matt Lauer’s clothes here? Maybe?
Just ones that haven’t been cleaned yet?
(The dry cleaner just stares at her and she retreats.)

scenes.location: The Morgan Chase Museum, the girls are entering.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I love museums!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Soakin’ up all the culture.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Where do you want to start?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, the gift shop!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, and then lunch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, wait yes, but I can’t eat too much. Paul is taking me out to
dinner tonight, he said he has a big surprise planned.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh wow. What, do you think maybe he’s gonna tell you that he’s
gay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! No! Why?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No reason! That would just be a really big surprise, right?
(A museum official enters with another man and woman.)

lines.speaker: The Museum Official
lines.text: (to the couple) You can put the aisle over here (points),
and put the wedding ceremony right over here. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I didn’t know you could get married here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This would be a beautiful place to get married, yeah, but I
wouldn’t put the aisle there and I would never have the ceremony there!
(Points to both places.) I mean you’d have the ceremony under this big beautiful
arch. (The arch at the entrance to the room.)

lines.speaker: The Museum Official
lines.text: (To Monica) May I help you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh sorry didn’t mean to interrupt. It’s just such a beautiful
space; do you do a lot of weddings here?

lines.speaker: The Museum Official
lines.text: Yes. We’re very popular. There’s a two-year
waiting list. Sorry! (She kinda storms out with the couple.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, you should totally put your name down on the list

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! Are you crazy?! I’m not getting married! I’m not even
engaged.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but there’s a two-year wait. And then what if you get engaged
in two years and then you got to wait another two years for this place. That’s
four years. Chandler’s not gonna wait that long. He’s gonna find somebody else,
y’know? Someone, someone who did put their name on the list. (Rachel agrees.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah hon, it can’t hurt to put your name down! I mean in if two
years if you’re not engaged you just don’t use it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I mean I guess there is no harm in putting my name down.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m gonna do it too!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? Who would, who would you marry?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know, I don’t have anyone right now. Y’know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t feel too sorry for me. At least my boyfriend isn’t gay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, that stuff is…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t even get me started on yours!

scenes.location: The Dry Cleaners, Joey is trying to get his picture up again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey! So, did you watch the tape of my show?

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, let’s get me back up there! (Holds out his picture.)

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: No! It don’t go up on the wall!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What—But you saw the show!

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: Yes, it was very offensive to my people!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dry cleaners?

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: Russians! It showed them as terrorists and villains!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay! Okay, look! You-you-you got Harrison Ford up there!

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: That’s right. Mr. Ford is a very good customer, he brings
us a lot of clothes; you bring us nothing!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay well that may be true. But, in-in okay, Air Force One the
Russians were terrorists! And evil! And plus he kills a bunch of them!
That-that-that’s offensive to Russians.

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: I’ve never seen it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh you should, it’s great.
(The Dry Cleaner stares at him and Joey retreats.)

scenes.location: A Cabin in the Woods, Elizabeth is giving Ross a tour.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This place is really beautiful!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yeah, I’ve been coming here since I was a kid. This used to be
my Grandma’s.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! The only thing I got from my Grandmother was her eyes. I mean not-not
her actual eyeballs, but, but people say that my eyes—Do-do you want to make out?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Sure!
(They fall to the couch and start to make out, but Ross stops suddenly.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Are you okay? What’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ehh, I was just, I was just thinking about your father.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Well, whatever works for ya…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No-no uh, he just, he just really freaked me out before.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh. Well, so we have to hide our relationship from one more person.
Big deal. Besides, it’s kinda fun hiding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.
(They start making out again.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: (quietly) Hey umm, you brought protection right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (loudly) Why?! Are there like bears or something?! (Looks around and then
sees that Elizabeth is shaking her head no and realizes what Elizabeth meant.) Ohh. Oh,
protection. Yeah-no, yeah-no, that-that-that I forgot.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: I’ll just run to the store and get some.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no! Hey-hey, I’m the guy! I’ll get it.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Do you know where the store is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Do you want to ride around town on my little pink bicycle?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A little bit.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: (laughs) I’ll be back in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Why don’t you get in the hot tub and I’ll meet you there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, okay.
(Elizabeth leaves and Ross starts to remove his clothing right there in the middle of
the living room where someone can see him. Of course, someone almost does, but he hears a
door opening and…)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (from another room) Oh my God, what a great surprise! This is such a
beautiful house.
(Ross with his pants around his ankles tries to run, but Dr. Geller forgets that he has
his pants around his ankles and falls down trying to flee.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (To Rachel) Thank you, it’s my mom’s. So this is the kitchen.
(Dr. Geller, the man with the Ph.D. in Paleontology, is trying to find a place to hide,
but this supposedly intelligent man in the hands of clich�d scriptwriters runs around
with his pants down around his ankles like one of the Three Stooges.)
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is reading the newspaper as the phone
rings. He let’s the machine answer it.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on machine) You’ve reached Monica and Chandler’s, if
you’re listening to this message, we’re probably screening. (to himself) Yeah we
are.

lines.speaker: The Museum Official
lines.text: (on phone) Hi, this is Heldi from the Morgan Chase museum.
I’m calling for Monica Geller. I want to let her know that there was a cancellation
and if she’s still interested in having the Bing-Geller wedding at our facility, it
is available… (Chandler runs to answer the phone.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on phone) This is Chandler Bing! This is Chandler Bing! (Listens)
Yes, the groom—No! Not the groom!!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Paul’s Cabin, Paul and Rachel are sitting on the couch drinking wine and
talking.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s so secluded up here.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I know. I like it up here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I feel like we’re the only two people in the world. (She sets down
her wine class, picks up a walnut, and knocks another one on the floor.) Oops. Sorry. (She
reaches down to pick it up and Ross hands it to her. Ross is hiding under the couch and
causes Rachel to scream.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: What’s the matter honey? Did you see a little mouse?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no! Big bear! Big bear outside! I think I-I—would
you—actually, would you go check on that?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Honey, we don’t have any bears here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, okay. Would-would you get me a Diet Coke?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Okay. I’ll be right back. (Gets up and heads for the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (After Paul leaves Rachel drops to the floor to confront Ross.)
What?! What are you doing here?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you doing here?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I came with Paul!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I recognize the ankles!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Get up!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (entering) Here you go honey! (Rachel kicks Ross back under the couch.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahh. Thank you!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Diet Coke. (Hands her the glass.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Op, ice. I need ice.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I’ll be right back. (He goes to get the ice.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (under the couch) You and your ice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh! Get out! Get out! Go! Come on! (Ross gets up and heads for the
kitchen.) No! Not in there! He’s in there! (She points Ross to the door next to the
kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (before entering) Did you really hear a bear?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Go-go!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (entering) Here you go honey. One Diet Coke with ice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, thank you.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I’m so happy that you’re here.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: (entering) Here I am!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (jumping up) Elizabeth! Oh look, Elizabeth’s here! Who are you
talking to?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Uh, you guys?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: How did you know we were here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, she-she ob-obviously saw the tire tracks that were leading up to
the closed garage.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Obviously.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Elizabeth, what are you doing here?! (Motions that he brought Rachel here
to be alone with her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did-did you come up here to work on that term paper or something?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yeah! Yep.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, why do y’know go in that room (points to the room Ross is in)
and do your homework?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Ohh, I wouldn’t do it in there. That’s my dad’s
bedroom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s your, that’s your dad’s bedroom. (Yelling)
That’s your dad’s bedroom!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Why are you yelling?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa, that Diet Coke just went straight to my head! Woo!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is sitting at the kitchen table
staring at the phone as Monica enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, honey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (gets up) See you later. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? I-I bought groceries, I was gonna make you dinner!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (angrily) Well next time ask! Or at least wait for me to ask! (He
storms out.)
(Monica puts the groceries down and goes to check the answering machine and hears.)

lines.speaker: The Museum Official
lines.text: (on machine) Hi, this is Heldi from the Morgan Chase
museum. I’m calling for Monica Geller.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no!

lines.speaker: The Museum Official
lines.text: (on machine) I want to let her know that there was a
cancellation and if she’s still interested in having the Bing-Geller wedding at our
facility, it is available…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh please, he didn’t hear it! He didn’t hear it!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on machine) This is Chandler Bing! This is Chandler Bing! (The
machine beeps off.)
[Scene: The Dry Cleaner’s, Joey has brought in a bunch of laundry in another
attempt to get his picture on the wall, but the dry cleaner isn’t working right now.
Instead, a beautiful woman is working.]

lines.speaker: Female Clerk
lines.text: Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh yeah, where-where’s the guy who decides who’s pictures go up
on the wall?

lines.speaker: Female Clerk
lines.text: He’s not here right now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you’re kidding me! All-all right, well make sure you tell him
that Joey Tribbiani stopped by to drop off all of these clothes. Okay? I’m an actor;
I’m kinda getting my picture up there on the wall.

lines.speaker: Female Clerk
lines.text: Y’know, there are two people who could put your picture up
there. (She makes eyes at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh really? Well, maybe you and I go out for drinks? (Pause) You’re
the other one right? (She thinks about it for a second and nods yes.)

scenes.location: Paul’s Cabin, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: So Lizzie, are-are-are you planning on staying the night?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Oh no-no believe me, I’m leaving as soon as possible!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Good. Good. Not that we don’t want you to stay, obviously you’re
welcome—How much more homework do you have?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Ahh, I just have one problem left that I do not know how to
solve. Uhh, Rachel maybe you want to come upstairs and help me figure it out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? Okay. Okay, I-I’ll go upstairs. (to Paul) If-if you get me
something from the car.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: What do you need from the car?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Surprise me.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (whispering) Okay. (Starts for the car.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (yelling) So you’re gonna be in the car, I will be upstairs, and
that’s where everybody’s gonna be!
(Rachel and Elizabeth go upstairs. Paul starts for the car, but notices his luggage is
still out and decides to take in into the bedroom.)
[Cut to his bedroom, Ross is listening at the door as Paul opens the door, trapping
Ross behind it. With Paul’s back turned Ross coils up like a snake and slitters
underneath the bed.]

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (standing in front of a mirror and to himself) Just relax. Just relax
Paul, you’re doing great. (Ross moves a piece of luggage over so he can watch Paul.)
She likes you. She… Maybe, she likes you. She likes you. Y’know why? Because
you’re a (pause) neat guy. (Ross can’t believe what he’s hearing.) You are
the man. You are (pause) the man! (He opens his shirt and looks at his chest.) I still got
it. Nice and sexy. You’re just a love machine. (Starts singing) I’m just a
love machine and I won’t work for nobody but you! Hey bab-y! (Flexes and grunts
loudly.) Showtime. (Starts to leave and starts singing.) I’m just a love machine,
yeah ba-by! (Grunts again and Ross is stunned.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is there as Monica rushes in.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have you seen Chandler?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The woman from the museum called and said that there was a cancellation
and that we could move up our wedding and Chandler heard! (Phoebe gasps.) I know! How bad
is this?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well for the regular guy, it’s bad, but Chandler, Oh dear God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! I know! And he totally freaked out and I can’t find him
anywhere!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I’m never gonna listen to you again, that’s for sure!
(Mimicking her.) "Y’know, harm can it do if you go and put your name down?"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel said that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well Rachel’s not here! (Runs out.)
[Scene: The Dry Cleaner’s, Joey and Phoebe are entering to see if his picture is
on the wall.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Here it is! (Noticing it next to the door.) Ooh, Joey! Why did you
sign it, "Son of a bitch?" (Son of a bitch is written across the entire
picture.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I didn’t do that! Who would’ve done that?!

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: (entering) Son of a bitch!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, maybe ask this guy.

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: You, get out of my shop!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, what did he do?

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: He went out with my wife!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa, I-I—Hey! I did not go out with your wife!
(The same woman from before enters.) Okay? I went out with her! (Points at her.)

lines.speaker: The Dry Cleaner
lines.text: That’s my wife!!! Get out! (Starts yelling at him in
Russian, and I’m betting he’s not saying pleasant things about him.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, we should go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

scenes.location: Paul’s Bedroom, Elizabeth is entering.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Ross? Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Elizabeth! (He opens one of the bed stands that he has curled himself up
into.) Okay. Okay. (She helps him out.) I’m gonna go out this window. (Points to the
window next to him.) I’ll meet you at the front door. Just tell them you’re
going home, okay?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (yelling from the living room) Oh wait-wait-wait!! No! Don’t go in
there! Don’t go in there! I need another soda!
(Ross frantically starts to open the window as Paul enters and traps him halfway out
the window.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God Ross! What in heaven’s name are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Elizabeth) And that is why we cannot see each other anymore.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Ross. You and I are going to have to have a little talk.

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Daddy!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: You’re next!!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Okay. I didn’t know he was here. (Runs over to Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Let me just see if I got this straight. I tell you to stay away from my
daughter or I’ll have you fired. What you heard was, "Take my daughter, come up
to my country house, and ruin my weekend with Rachel!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, please-please Paul, just let me explain…

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: No, let me explain! Fired!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, fine! Fine! Have me fired! But uh, I want you to know that you
and I are not all that different. I mean, I too am a neat guy. (Paul just looks at him.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (panicked) What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And I too am just a love machine. (Hums a little bit and mimics
Paul’s flexing.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Ross, let me show you where the guest room is.
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is pacing, waiting for Chandler to
return. Chandler enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (going over to him) I’m so sorry. Please, stop freaking out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not freaking out. Why would I be freaking out? A woman named
Heldi called and said we were getting married, but that happens everyday. (Does one of
those Chandler noises.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, we were at this beautiful place, and I-I-I just put our names
down for fun! I mean, what’s the harm in that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right here! (Clucks like a chicken for some reason.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, please don’t think I was trying to pressure you. Phoebe
and Rachel…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe and Rachel! So the people that knew about our wedding before me
were you, Phoebe and Rachel, Heldi, and apparently some band called Starlight Magic 7 who
are available by the way!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was a mistake. Please don’t take this to mean anything, because
it doesn’t.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, if it really doesn’t mean anything, because you know that
I’m just not ready…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! I know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m gonna go tell Joey that (laughs) that you’re back. I was
really worried about you. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering from her room) Hey, did she buy it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Totally.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So did Heldi show you the place?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, it’s beautiful.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t believe you’re gonna ask Monica to marry you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know.
(They hug.)
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is going up to the counter.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Gunther.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Hey! Take these cappuccinos to table 11 and that guy over there
(points) wants the biscotti.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh uh, well I just came in for a cup of coffee to go.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Do you still work here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No, I quit a long time ago. (Pause) Did I forget to you that one?
I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Oh that’s cool, I was gonna fire you anyway.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! (Takes his coffee and leaves.)

title: The One with the Ring

lines.text: [Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Phoebe is at the sink and Chandler is looking
at a ring brochure.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs, can you help me pick out an engagement ring for Monica? I
can’t figure this out! It’s so hard! Should I get her a (turning to each page)
Tiffany cut or a Princess cut or a—ah-ah! Paper cut!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now, have you told anyone else?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I don’t want to tell anybody else because I don’t want
Monica to find out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You told me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it’s because I trust you, you’re one of my best
friends, and you walked in on me when I was looking at ring brochures.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah well, once again not knocking pays off. I only wish you hadn’t
been on the toilet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me too.
(Joey and Ross enter causing Chandler to quickly hide the brochure behind his back.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey. (Heads straight for the fridge.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! So Chandler, wanna go to the coffeehouse?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh all right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, coffeehouse.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh perfect, we were just gonna see if you wanted to go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh well, we don’t because we got…the…other pl-place.
(Joey returns with a piece of pizza as Chandler and Phoebe exit.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How rude.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. You wanna bite? (Holds his piece out for him.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Rachel are sitting on the couch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So how are things going with Paul?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good. Although y’know, he-he’s a private guy. Y’know, I
wish I could get him to open up a little bit, share some feelings.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s easy! You just have to think of him as a-as a jar of pickles
that won’t open.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what are you saying; I should run him under hot water and bang his
head against a table?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No that’s what you do when you want to get the truth out of
someone.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (entering) Hi honey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) Watch this.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (To Rachel) How are you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi Paul!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Hi Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So how are things going with you?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Can’t complain.
(Phoebe turns to Rachel and mimes remove a lid of a jar. Ross enters and Paul motions
for Rachel to leave with him now.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (whispering) Come on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Gets up and starts to leave with Paul.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (To Ross) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!
(They shake hands and their lines overlap.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great to see you!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Good to see you too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How you doing?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Good. Bye! (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! You take care!
(Ross turns his back on Paul and makes a ‘I hate that guy’ face. Paul does
the same thing.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, what-what was the deal with you and Chandler blowing us off
before?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! That was so weird, huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, why’d you do it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I didn’t do it! It was Chandler! He’s… He’s mad at
you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! Why?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Please, I think you know why.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t think of anything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on Ross, you’re a paleontologist, dig a little deeper.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, is it because Joey and I didn’t invite him to that
Knicks game a couple of weeks ago?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do you think that’s something that he’d be mad at you for?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I guess it could.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well then I think that’s it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, if he’s angry, he really shouldn’t just cover it up. I-I
wish he would just tell me the truth.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, if that’s what you want you then you really should run his head
under hot water and bang his head against a table.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Paul and Rachel are getting ready to go out. Paul is
entering from the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Honey I made a reservation at China Garden, is that okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah that’s great. But first, wait, talk to me, talk to me. Tell me
about your day.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: It was fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Hey, what are you thinking? What are you thinking right now?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I’m thinking that you are looking really fine it that dress.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah that’s great Paul, but y’know I wanna know
what—(Puts her hands on his shoulders)—Wow, those are really great! I just wanna
know what, what is behind this-this strong, silent exterior. Y’know they say that
still waters run deep and I wanna swim in yours.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Are you talking about having sex?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Paul, I don’t know anything about you! Y’know, like-like
your childhood! Tell me about your childhood!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Normal.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well then how about puberty! Come on, that’s always a painful
time! Y’know your friends invite you to a slumber party and then they stick your hand
in warm water while you’re sleeping so that you pee in your sleeping bag.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Nope! That never happened to me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you’re lucky you never met that bitch Sharon Majesky. Anyway,
umm… The rest of you life, y’know? Any regrets?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right Paul, I’m not asking for a lot here. Okay? Just give me
something. Anything!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: When I was six years old.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hm-mmm.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I wanted a big wheel. And instead my parents got me this little plastic
chicken that you hop around on. It was embarrassing; kids made fun of me. That was a
pretty tough year.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s-that’s great! See? I already feel like I know you a
little better! Thank you. Okay, come on. Now we can go eat. Let’s go. (Gets up to
leave, but Paul doesn’t move.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: It was horrible. They called me chicken boy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!
[Time Lapse, Paul is now weeping uncontrollably in Rachel’s arms.]

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: And in fifth grade I got into a fight. Well, it wasn’t really a
fight. Richard Darinvel bit me on the nose and, and I feel down. I still have a little
scare right here (points to it) you can see it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, I-I-I see the scare. Listen, Paul, I think this is really
great that-that y’know, you shared your feelings. It’s really, it’s
beautiful, but umm, what do you say we go share some food?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Oh, I couldn’t eat now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! Wait! What are you talking about?! You love their Kung Pao
Chicken!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Chicken? (Pointing to himself.) Chicken boy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My God, I’m sorry! I’m sorry! I didn’t mean to do that! I
wouldn’t do that!
(Paul screams like a chicken and breaks down into tears again.)

scenes.location: A Jewelry Shop, Chandler and Phoebe are looking at engagement rings.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothin! This is the nine millionth ring store we’ve been too and
I can’t find the perfect ring! (Goes over to another display counter and starts
pointing at rings.) Ugly ring! Ugly ring! Ugly ring! (Notices that one of the jewelers is
watching him.) It’s a beautiful selection. (The jeweler walks away slowly.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so maybe you don’t get her a ring. Maybe you-maybe you do
something different. Y’know? Maybe you get her an engagement bracelet, y’know?
Or an engagement tiara? Or—ooh! An engagement Revolutionary War musket! (Picks one up
from the display in the corner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know, I’m so glad I picked you to help me with this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh? Can you just imagine getting down on one knee and handing her this
gorgeous piece of weaponry?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’m gonna stick with the ring. (Goes to another display
counter.) Oh, this one’s nice! (Pointing to another ring.) I like this one! Sir? Uh,
kind sir? Can I see this one?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (coming over after returning the musket) Wait a minute, no, this is,
this is the reason you brought me. Okay? I know how to haggle. So let me handle this from
here on out.

lines.speaker: Male Jeweler
lines.text: Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-uh, yes. I would like to see that ring please.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or not, whatever.

lines.speaker: Male Jeweler
lines.text: This ring is from the 1920s, it’s a one and a half carat
diamond with sapphires on either side.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sir, can I ask you to umm, could you…hold out that ring and ask
me to marry you?

lines.speaker: Male Jeweler
lines.text: Okay. (Holds out the ring, deadpan.) Will you marry me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (choking up) Oh my God that’s it, that’s the ring! How much
is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler, I-I will handle this! (To the jeweler) How much is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We will give you $10.

lines.speaker: Male Jeweler
lines.text: (angrily) Are you interested in this ring?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Yes, but I can only pay $8,000.

lines.speaker: Male Jeweler
lines.text: Okay, I can let it go at eight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We stand firm at $10.

lines.speaker: Male Jeweler
lines.text: (ignoring her) How would you like to pay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, credit card. (Reaches for it then realizes) Oh no! No-no, but I
left my credit card with Joey. (To Phoebe) Okay, I’ll go get it. You guard the ring.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (To the jeweler) Listen, I’m sorry about before. Do you have
anything her for $10.

lines.speaker: Male Jeweler
lines.text: Uh yes, I have these two rather beautiful $5 bills. (Holds them up
from his pocket.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’ll give you $1 for them.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross and Joey are there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, remember how Chandler and Phoebe blew us off yesterday?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Remember? You-you were eating pizza.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Well, apparently Chandler’s angry at us for not getting him a
ticket to that Knicks game a couple of weeks ago.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, we’re supposed to just get him a ticket?! That guy is always
mooching off of us!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Anyway, I-I still think we should try to patch things up,
y’know? Like uh, maybe we could get him to get tickets to another Knicks game and
invite him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh wow that’s a great idea! And I still have his credit card.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (handing them the bill) Here you go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. (Starts to get his money)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey-ho-ho, I got this one. Here you go. (Hands Gunther
Chandler’s card.) Y’know I gotta tell ya, sometimes I just—I don’t get
Chandler. Y’know, me and him do stuff all the time without you and you don’t get
all upset.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All the time?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All the time!

scenes.location: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is there as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Still crying?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Like a little girl. I know. I know. I know. This is all my fault;
I wanted him to open up. But God, I didn’t know that I was gonna unleash this-this
weepy, clingy, moist monster!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, I only know of two surefire ways to shut a man up. And one
of them is sex.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’s the other one?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know, I’ve never had to use the other one. I’m
just saying y’know, if we’re having sex, he’s not gonna be talking.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh that’s right. You’re the talker. (They both reflect on that
briefly) Anyway uh, great idea! Umm, I gotta go to the store; I told him that I would buy
him some more tissues.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, we have some…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No you don’t!
[Scene: The Jewelry Store, Phoebe is busy trying on virtually everything in the store.
She’s got earrings, rings, bracelets, and enough necklaces to put Mr. T to shame on.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay umm, I’d also like to try on the tiara. (The male jeweler
hands it to her.) Oh yeah. Okay. (Puts it on.) (To the jeweler) What do you think, too
much?

lines.speaker: Male Jeweler
lines.text: A tad.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Then, take the tiara back and let me hold the musket again. (He
hands it to her and Phoebe poses in front of one of those small mirrors.) Something’s
missing. It’s not… Okay oh, let me see the ring my friend picked out.

lines.speaker: Male Jeweler
lines.text: (to the female jeweler) Where’s the 1920s princess cut ring.

lines.speaker: Female Jeweler
lines.text: I just sold it to that gentleman. (Points to the one walking out
the store.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!! (She runs after him, but sets of the security system, which
locks the store’s door and brings down a set of bars behind her, caging her in.) No!
What?! Help me! Let me out! Now! (Points the musket at them.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Paul is still crying as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. How are ya Paul? (Starts to look for his credit card.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (acting manly to try and cover up his crying) Okay. Chandler, did your dad
ever hug you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, did he hug you?!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: No! No! It’s just that, my dad never did. I miss my dad.
