lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you can see my dad in Vegas kissing other dads.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Hey Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Would you…….Would you hug me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m a little busy here Paul.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: That’s exactly what my dad used to say! (Starts to breakdown again.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, a quick one. Come on hug it out. (Paul rushes over and hugs
Chandler tightly.) Oh hey! There you go. (The hug continues.) Okay. (The hug continues.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Five more seconds.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! (Pushes him away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Joey! (Goes over and hugs Joey and picks him off of his feet.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-hey-hey! (Motions to Chandler, "What’s going
on?") Hi, Paul is it? (Paul nods yes and still hugging Joey.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you have my credit card?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes, it’s in my… In…in my pocket. (Paul hasn’t dropped
him yet.) (Chandler starts to reach for his front pocket.) My back pocket! My back pocket!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank God! (Grabs his card.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey listen I got us tickets to a Knicks game tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I can’t go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! It’ll be fun! Me, you, and Ross, and… Paul
probably…
[Scene: The Jewelry Store, Chandler is entering with his credit card and Phoebe is
holding out another ring for him.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler, I found the perfect ring. (Holding it out for her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that’s uh, that’s pretty nice but I’m gonna go with
the one I picked first.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God Chandler, the one you picked is gone. It’s over!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Some guy bought it. I’m sorry. I tired to stop it but they (points
to the jeweler) put me in jail!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They put you in jail?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The little jail between the doors!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe, I asked you to guard the ring!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, I’m sorry! But y’know, this ring is better! Monica
never even saw the other ring.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah but when he proposed to me with the ring I got goose bumps.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe it was the guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It was the ring!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is on the couch and Joey is entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! So uh, was he excited about the tickets?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! He blew us off!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t believe it. (Pause) Can I tell you something? I’m a
little mad at him now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Can I tell you something? Me too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? He didn’t want to talk to us about being angry,
well maybe we don’t talk to him at all!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooooh! Freeze him out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I like it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Eh? We’ll show him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: From now on, it’s gonna be Joey and Ross, best friends. (They shake
hands.) Okay! We’re gonna be the new Joey and Chandler.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Paul is writing something as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. I’m back.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Hey! I have so much more to tell ya, I’ve written it all down!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah that’s great. No actually that’s… (In a sexy voice)
That’s great! That’s really great! Y’know, I gotta tell ya writing, I mean
writing, gets me uh, gets me kinda hot.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Wait! Wait! Listen! Listen to this! (Flips a couple pages and points to
something.) Y’know what I wanted to be when I was that age?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A lover?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: A surfer.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah surfer?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I wanted to be one with the waves, y’know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, hold on real quick, hold on a second let me just uh, (sits on the
counter and buttons her sweater to show some cleavage) get a little more comfortable here.
Wait, now wait a second, this isn’t too revealing is it?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: (barely glancing at her) No. What ever happened to that little dude.
(Pause) So full of dreams…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t care about the little dude! I can’t! I cannot listen
to anymore of this! Y’know, the only person who would want to listen to this is a
mental health professional! And then it’s only because they get paid $100 an hour! Do
you know how much money I could’ve made listening to you? $2,000! And do you know
when I figured that out? While you were talking!

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: What?! I can’t believe you’re trying to stifle me! When just 14
hours ago we figured out that that is exactly what my mother was trying to do to me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh… I’m sorry. I… I-I don’t mean—I didn’t
mean to stifle you. I… This is all just a little overwhelming.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Oh Rachel, I’m so sorry. I didn’t mean to overwhelm you.
It’s just that, when those gates open, you… (Starts to breakdown.) Hard to close
‘em. But they are closed now. Believe me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m so glad, I’m so glad you shared. (Feeling his shoulder.)
And I’m glad that you’re done. What do you say we umm… (Nods in the
direction of the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I would really like that. (They kiss.)

scenes.location: Rachel’s Bedroom, Paul and Rachel are recovering.

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: That was…so good. (Starts crying again.)
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is looking at the ring he bought and
not liking it.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering from her room) Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t believe I let you talk me into buying this stupid gumball
machine looking ring!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s not a stupid gumball machine looking ring! It’s a
beautiful ring!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it’s not! When I looked at the other ring I could see
Monica’s face when I gave it to her, y’know? And I could see her saying yes.
When I look at this ring, all I see is a ring! Unless I look at it really closely and then
I can see my own eye. (Does so and laughs.) Look, this is the most important thing
I’m gonna do in my life. I wanna make sure it’s perfect.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. There may be a way that we can get the other ring back.
‘Cause I heard the guy tell the jeweler where he was going to propose. So maybe we
can get him to trade rings or something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t do that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well you certainly can’t give her that stupid gumball ring.
[Scene: A Restaurant, Chandler and Phoebe are entering. This is the place where the guy
who bought Chandler’s ring is going to propose.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There he is! (Points.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay and he hasn’t proposed yet because she has no ring on her
finger.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! You’re good! After this, we should solve crimes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! Okay, go, go, go get him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay. (Walks over to him.) Excuse me sir? Could you come with me
please? You have a phone call.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It is your office.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Do you know who at my office?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: John?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Oh John! Great!
(She brings him over to Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Chandler) Here he is.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to him) Hi! Hi. Okay, there was a slight mix-up at the jewelry store,
the ring you’re about to propose with was supposed to be held for me. So, I’m
gonna need to have that back. (The guy isn’t sure.) But, in exchange I’m willing
to trade you this beautiful, more expensive ring. (Looking at the ring.) Ew.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! I would trade.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: It is beautiful, but I’m gonna use this one. Now, if you’ll
excuse me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no! This is my fiancee (Phoebe) and her heart was set on that ring.
You don’t want to break her heart now do you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, do you want to break a dying woman’s heart?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: You’re dying?!
(Phoebe coughs.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, she’s dying… Of a cough apparently.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, and it is my dying wish to have that ring. See, if I’m not
buried with that ring then my spirit is going to wander the nether world for all
eternity…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting her) Okay, that’s enough honey!

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: I don’t know. (Pause) Let me see the ring.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great! Okay, here. (Holds the ring up for him.)

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: (looks at it) All right. (Exchanges rings.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you. Thank you! (To his girlfriend) And you
are about to marry a wonderful man! (She stunned and he’s horrified.) Hey! I’m
marrying a dead woman!

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Joey and Ross are watching TV as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Guys? (They ignore him.) I’ve got something important to tell ya.
(Still nothing so he walks over and stands in front of the TV.) Guys? (They lean over to
try and watch the TV, Chandler mimics them.) Guys?! (Pause) I’m gonna ask Monica to
marry me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Ross) I think we gotta end the freeze out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, is this, is this for real?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, check out the ring. (Shows it to them.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So you two are really serious?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yep, pretty much.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You-you’re gonna get married?! I mean… We’re gonna be
brothers-in-law! (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And-and-and-and-and-and, and we’re gonna be friends again!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (goes to hug him and stops short) Heyyyy—What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh it’s water under the bridge, forget it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! (They hug.) I was gonna wait ‘til uh, it was official
y’know? But I got so excited I just had to tell you guys because you’re my best
friends.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think I’m gonna cry!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (who has just entered) Ugh! No more crying! Please! I just dumped one
cry baby, I’ll dump you too!
(Ross and Joey urge Chandler to tell Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m gonna ask Monica to marry me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God! Oh Chandler!! (Hugs him.) You guys are gonna be so
happy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (holding an empty tissue box) Where’s all the tissues?! (Throws the
box down in disgust.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, continued from earlier. Chandler is showing Rachel the
ring.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Check out the ring.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Nice! One and a half carat easy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey-hey Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler’s gonna ask Monica to marry him!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh I know, I helped pick out the ring.
(Chandler laughs, turns, and sees that Ross and Joey aren’t happy.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You told her before you told us?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, she walked in when I was looking at the ring brochures. You can
understand that, right? (Ross and Joey look at each other and go back to watching the game
on TV.) Guys? Guys? (Walks in front of them again.)

title: The One with the Proposal

lines.text: [Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is showing Ross, Rachel, Joey, and
Phoebe his engagement ring again.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: God that is the most beautiful engagement ring ever!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah? Well, you should know. You’ve bought like a billion of

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, you didn’t get one.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, well tonight’s the big night.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay listen, how are you gonna ask her?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It is going to be perfect. I am taking her to her favorite restaurant.
I’m going to get her a bottle of the champagne that she really loves; therefore knows
how expensive it is. Then when the glasses are full, instead of proposing a toast I’m
just gonna propose.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That sounds perfect!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re gonna mess it up let me do it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not gonna mess it up.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If she says no, can I have the ring?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She’s not gonna say no.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!
(Monica’s entrance makes Phoebe try to hide the ring by putting it in her mouth.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (with her mouthful) Hi Monica.
(Monica goes into her room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Give me it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s gone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe!
(She takes it out of her mouth and hands it to him as Monica returns from her room and
this time forcing Chandler to put the ring in his mouth.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (with his mouthful) Hi Monica.
(She goes into the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Chandler) We’re practically kissing. (Makes a kissy face and
winks at him.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica, Chandler, Phoebe, and Joey are there as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are any of you guys free tonight? My boss is hosting this charity event
for underprivileged kids and the more people I bring, the better I look. So, Monica?
Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (glaring at her) Well, Monica and Chandler can’t go. We’re
going to dinner remember?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s the big deal?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I just get mad when Rachel doesn’t remember where we’re
going.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where are you going?
(Chandler stares at him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How about you guys? (Points to Phoebe and Joey.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Open bar?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can do that for the kids.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, y’know what? I’ll come too. I’m making money now;
it’s about time I give something back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you could also give back the money you owe me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Have a benefit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Ross, listen can you come to a charity event tonight?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no, I have plans with Elizabeth.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, so you’re already doing your part for the kids.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry, it’s just one of my last nights together before she
leaves for camp—to be a counselor!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross let me ask you a question. All jokes aside, where is this
relationship going?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait a minute, all jokes aside? I didn’t agree to that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you really see this as a long-term thing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know, you are 12 years older than her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, does-does everyone feel this way?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah, sort of. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-uh—Wow! Uh, I thought you guys were just like making jokes, I had
no idea. What you know what? You guys are wrong. Uh yes, there is a chronological age
difference but I never notice it. You know why? Because she is very mature. Besides, it
doesn’t really matter to me what you guys think. I mean, I’m the one dating
Elizabeth, not you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s not what she said last night. (Ross glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: See? Now, he could date her.

scenes.location: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is practicing proposing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Will you marry me? Will you marry me? (Makes like a gun with
his fingers.) Hey, you marry me! (He gives up as Joey, Rachel, Phoebe, and Ross slink in
all excited.) What’s going on little elves?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s the big night! We wanted to wish you good luck!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah you have the ring?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, right here in my pocket. (Pats his pocket. Phoebe smiles, goes
over to hug him, and removes the ring from his pocket.) Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Oop! (Hands him back the ring.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, now will you guys get out of here? I want this is to be a
surprise and she’s gonna know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the rest of them) Yeah-yeah you guys. Get out of here!
(Monica enters from the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) You are beautiful.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, thank you! (The gang exhibits signs of quiet apprehension and wears
knowing glances.) (Monica giggles.) What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (breaking up) We’re just really…very excited about this
charity event that we have to go to.
[Scene: The Charity Event, they’re holding a silent auction, Rachel is looking at
one of the items and Phoebe walks up and hands her a glass of wine.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Thank you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So now what’s going on here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh well, uh this is a silent auction. They lay out all the stuff here
and then you write down your offer and then the highest bid gets it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I know what a silent is I meant, what’s going on with your
hair?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (suddenly worried) Uh, wh-why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! It’s nice!
(Rachel’s boss, Mr. Thompson walks up.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Nice to see you Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi!

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: So glad you brought someone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Someone? I brought people. Mr. Thompson, this is Phoebe. Phoebe, this is
Mr. Thompson. (She introduces them.) He’s the head of my department.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hi. (They shake hands.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I also brought my friend Joey…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (behind them) Oh!! Shrimp toast! (Walks right past the little group on his
way for the shrimp toast.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know I-I don’t know where he is.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Well, I hope you’re gonna bid on some things Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know what? Actually, I was about to bid on this lovely trip
to Paris.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Ohh, nice choice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (Mr. Thompson walks away and after he’s left.) Okay,
(writing her bid down) twenty dollars.
[Scene: Elizabeth’s Dorm Room, Ross is walking up to her door and knocks on it.
Suddenly the door opens and Elizabeth drags him into the room.]
{Transcriber’s Note: Elizabeth has two friends in the room with her who are named
in the credits, but not in this scene. So I’m just gonna guess since it doesn’t
matter one way or the other. (The last part is to discourage e-mails, who cares if I got
it right or not?)}

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Shut the door! Shut the door!! (Runs over and closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s-what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: The guys across the hall are throwing water balloons at us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you have to call the police! That’s what I did to the kids in my
building!

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: No, it’s a water balloon fight! We started it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! (Does a laugh/groan.) Listen umm, I, I just stopped by to see if you
wanted to see this play tonight. Umm, it’s supposed to be excellent. The director is
the same…

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: (ignoring him and picking up a pitcher) Who drank all the Kamikazes?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: (approaching with two filled balloons in her hands) Nobody! We put them
in here! (Indicates the aforementioned balloons causing both of them to scream in delight
and start drinking from the balloons.)

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: (To Ross) You want some?! (Starts to squirt the Kamikaze at him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Okay! Okay! (Stops her.) Okay, look, can I, can I just-just talk to
you for a second?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: Yeah, sure.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, so this play umm, what do you think? It’s-it’s gotten great
reviews! Y’know the uh…
(Suddenly the door opens and two guys come rushing in wielding water balloons.)

lines.speaker: First Dorm Guy
lines.text: Attack!
(They start lobbing the balloons in. Ross desperately tries to get out of the line of
fire but is struck in the back. The girls all retreat to relative safety behind the
couch.)

lines.speaker: Second Dorm Guy
lines.text: Put your balloons down!

lines.speaker: The Girls
lines.text: You put your balloons down!!

lines.speaker: First Dorm Guy
lines.text: You put your balloons down!!
(Both opposing camps start screaming at each other to drop their weapons and surrender.
Finally, Ross steps in as a mediator.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (screaming) Everybody put their balloons down!!! (There is a
temporary cease fire.) Now this is a nice suit!! (Shows everyone where he was hit.)
[Scene: The Charity Event, Mr. Thompson is announcing the winners of the silent
auction.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Our next item is the romantic trip to Paris. (Pause.) It goes to
Emil Alexander high a high bid of 2,300.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh! So close!
(Phoebe returns a with a tray full of different kinds of drinks.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey you guys! Look!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I got me some drinks!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Open bar!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well now it’s an empty bar.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You just can’t stand anyone else enjoying themselves can’t
you?

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: And finally, our biggest item of the night, the 22-foot
gentleman’s day sailer sailboat. The winning bid was a whooping $20,000! (Joey
suddenly gets excited.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I won! That was my guess!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! What?! What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I guessed 20,000!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! It is an auction! You don’t guess, you buy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! I don’t have 20,000!

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Congratulations on your new boat, Joey Tribbiani!!
(Everyone applauds and he stands up slowly.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! Sit down! (Pulls him down.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Forget her! You enjoy this!! (Pulls him back up and starts applauding
again. Joey waves and does a salute.]
[Scene: A Restaurant, Monica and Chandler are sitting at a table. Monica is checking
her makeup as Chandler suddenly has a horrifying thought and starts patting down his
pockets until he finds what he’s looking for and sighs in relief.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (trying to cover up why his hand is over his heart) One nation, under
God. Indivisible with liberty and justice for all. (Laughs.) I remembered it. (It’s a
butchered version of the Pledge of Allegiance of the United States for our foreign
friends.) The champagne is here. (The waiter is delivering it and pouring two glasses.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Yes! I’m good! Are you good? Are you good? Is
everything—are you—are you perrr-perfect?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. I’m okay. I’m actually—I’m a little cold, can
I have your jacket?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah. (Starts to take it off and then realizes) Uh, no you
can’t have my jacket! Because then I would be cold! If you thought that you were
going to be cold, you should’ve brought your own jacket. But uh, other than that, are
you okay? Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) Are you sure you’re okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! I’m fine. In fact I’ve been fine for a long time now
and I think, the reason is you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh that’s sweet!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay umm, before I meant you I had really little life and I
couldn’t imagine growing old with…
(As he’s talking Monica notices someone familiar has just entered the restaurant.
Let’s see; I seem to remember him driving a Ferrari in Hawaii solving crimes
as a private investigator and as a certain eye doctor in more recent times.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting him) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (not knowing the true meaning of her exclamation) I know, but just let
me say it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, Richard. (Yep, Richard’s back.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?! I’m Chandler! (She nods towards the doorway, Chandler
turns and looks) Oh, that’s Richard!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God, maybe he won’t see us. Richard!
(Monica smiles then acts shocked. Chandler can’t believe she just did that.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: (approaching them with a woman in tow) Monica! Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey-hey, hey! (Gets up and hugs him.) I don’t know why I did
that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, it’s good to see you!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: You too, you let uh, your hair grow long.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah—Oh that’s right. You, you always wanted me too. Hey, I
see you got your mustache back.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well, my nose got lonely.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Richard’s date) And uh, you don’t have a mustache which
is good. (She just smiles.) I’m Chandler; I make jokes when I’m uncomfortable.
Richard’s Date: Hi, I’m Lisa.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. (Introduces them.) Lisa, (nodding at each) Monica,
Chandler. We used to date.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Richard! No one supposed to know about us! (Richard just smiles at
him.) See I, did it again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, wh-why don’t we sit down?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’ll sit down. (He slides back into his chair.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Richard) It’s good to see you

lines.speaker: Matire'd
lines.text: (to Richard) You’re table’s ready sir.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh. Good to see you guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes. (Thinking he’s gone.)

lines.speaker: Matire'd
lines.text: (motioning to the empty table next to Monica and Chandler’s) Or
if you prefer, this table is available.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: That might be fun. (Richard and Lisa sit down.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The Charity Event, Rachel, Phoebe, and Joey are sitting at their table.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What were you thinking?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I didn’t know it was an auction!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I figured, take a guess, help a charity, free boat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why would a charity give away a free boat?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know! Charity?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, just buy the damn boat! (She’s still working her way through
her tray of booze.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, don’t you think you’ve had enough to drink?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m just helping the kids!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How is you drinking helping the kids?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because the more I drink, the less there is for the kids to drink.

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: (approaching) Mr. Tribbiani.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hi!

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: Your generous contribution brings us a big step closer to building
the youth center.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just out of curiosity, how-how much is that boat worth?

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: I think it was valued at 19,000

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) Hey, I was pretty close. (She just glares at him.) Uhh, so bad
news. Umm, I can’t buy the boat, I don’t have any money.
(Mr. Thompson looks shocked and at Rachel, she suddenly starts laughing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! Joey, good one! (Mr. Thompson starts to laugh.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Thompson
lines.text: That’s good. Very good! (Walks away.)
(After he’s left, Rachel stops laughing and glares at Joey again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So uh listen, I think I’m gonna take off now. (Starts to get up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stopping him) Hey! You…can’t…leave Joey! You agreed to
buy that boat, all right?! That is a contract! And plus if you leave, my boss is gonna
kill me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, what am I gonna do Rach?! I don’t have that kind of money!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. Okay. (Whispering and thinking.) Okay. Okay. All right. All
right, this is what we’re gonna do, we are gonna go to the next highest bidder, and
we are just gonna let them buy it, and then you’re just gonna pay the difference.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I don’t know why the kids need a youth center anyway!
Y’know? They should just watch TV after school like I did and I turned out fine!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Not great.
[Scene: The Restaurant, Monica and Chandler’s and Richard and Lisa’s tables
have been pushed together and they’re all eating and talking.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And so, we’re hiding in the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: And-and then I sneak out and before Monica can her parents come in.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So I hide in the shower and the next thing you know they’re going
at it right on the bathroom floor.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: (laughing) Oh my God!
{Transcriber’s Note: For further reading on the above story, please check out The One Where Joey Moves Out.}

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I got a good one, I got a good one! I once walked in on both my
parents making love to the same guy.
(An awkward silence ensues.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: It’s so great seeing you guys again. I’d like to make a
toast. (Everyone raises their glasses) Uh, as a poet once said, "In the sweetness of
friendship, let there be laughter and sharing of pleasures for in the due of little things
the heart finds it’s morning and is refreshed."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!
(They all drink.)
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica and Chandler are returning to find Ross
is there waiting for them.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God, you guys!! (He’s excited about what he thought happened.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stopping him from going any further) Before you say anything, have we
got a story for you! Guess who we bumped into at dinner!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Richard!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (Excited) A-ohh! (Realizes) Ohh. Oh that’s right that’s
right. That’s Richard’s favorite place too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh you knew that. Good!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I thought you were going out with Elizabeth.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I was but uh, she was a little busy with a water balloon fight.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh Ross, sometimes grown-ups have commitments they just can’t get
out of!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know, maybe she is too young for me. Y’know, when I was over
there and she was running around with her friends, I felt like I was a baby-sitter. I
finally started to see what you guys were talking about. I don’t know what to do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don’t you just weigh out the good stuff about the relationship
against the bad stuff. I mean that’s what I did when I first (looks at Chandler and
pauses) weighing stuff.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay umm, bad stuff. Well, I’m-I’m 12 years older than she is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: If the school finds out you’re fired.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s leaving for three months.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: For camp!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, good stuff. Umm, well she’s-she’s sweet and pretty

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look Ross, the only question you need to ask is, "Do you see a
future?" I mean like do you see yourself marrying her? (Ross pauses in
consideration.) Oh my God! You did it already! You married her, didn’t you?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! I…didn’t do that. It’s just… Okay, honestly
no. I don’t, I don’t see a big future with her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay well I think…that’s your answer.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’ve got to talk to her. Ugh, I hate this part.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you have to forget about Elizabeth. I mean if you’re not
careful you may not get married at all this year!
[Scene: The Charity Event, Rachel and Phoebe are sitting at the table as Joey
approaches.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach! Rachel! Okay, the next highest bidder is at table one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Oh and uh the guy who got the Paris trip is at table four.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Why do you care about the guy who won the Paris trip?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s a trip for two! (She gets up and takes off her blouse-type
thingy she’s wearing over her dress.) Excuse me. (She walks over to table four.)
Excuse me, is the person who won the Paris trip at this table?

lines.speaker: Emil Alexander
lines.text: That was me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, en chante. (She holds out her hand for him to kiss it, but he only
shakes it.)
{Transcriber’s Note: Please correct my French here.}
[Cut to Joey and Rachel approaching table one.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, excuse me is there a Mr. Bowmont at this table?

lines.speaker: Mr. Bowmont
lines.text: That’s me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahh, yes. (Pushes Rachel in front of himself so that she could do the
talking.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh well, hello. This is your lucky day Mr. Bowmont, the uh gentleman day
sailer as just become available again and I believe that you made a bid of $18,000.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You-you have to pay that! It’s not just a guess.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Joey) Okay. Okay. (Shushes him.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Bowmont
lines.text: I was actually relieved uh I didn’t win the boat. My wife
would’ve killed me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you kidding me?! She’s gonna this boat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y-Yeah! What-what is your wife’s name?

lines.speaker: Mr. Bowmont
lines.text: It’s Pam.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pam! Oh God okay, just imagine this, "The Pam."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aw-awww!

lines.speaker: Mr. Bowmont
lines.text: I don’t think she’d like that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, uh-uh imagine this, "The Mr. Bowmont."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oooooh…

lines.speaker: Mr. Bowmont
lines.text: I don’t think so dear.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay look, let me paint you a little picture. (She sits down next to
him.) All right, you are settin’ sail up the Hudson! You’ve got the wind in your
h—(sees that he’s bald)—arms! You-you get all that peace and quiet that
you’ve always wanted! You get back to nature! You can go fishin’! You
can—ooh, you can get one of those little hats and have people call you captain, and
then when you’re old, Cappy.

lines.speaker: Mr. Bowmont
lines.text: What the hell, it’s for a good cause! All right!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No way! It’s mine!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Joey) What?! What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All that stuff you just said? I want that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But Joey you don’t have $20,000!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who cares?! I-I’ll make payments, whatever it takes, I want the Mr.
Bowmont!!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is taking out the garbage as Phoebe and
Joey enter. Phoebe gasps.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God, you’re back!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, let me see it! Let me see your hand! (Chandler is frantically
trying to wave them off.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why do you want to see my hand?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I wanna see what’s in your hand. I wanna see the trash.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
(Chandler puts his face in his hands as Joey and Phoebe start to examine the trash.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Eww! Oh, it’s all dirty. You should throw this out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (suspiciously) Okay. (Exits to carry out Phoebe’s wishes.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (after the door closes) What did you guys just do?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Richard was there so I couldn’t do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! Noooo… (Phoebe gasps.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m gonna do it tomorrow y’know, and-and surprise her, but
now you’ve ruined it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We didn’t ruin it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who walks into a room and asks to see a person’s hands?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, a palm reader, a manicurist, a hand doctor…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Glove salesman!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good one! Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is terrible. What am I going to do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, she only suspects something okay? She doesn’t know for sure,
so just throw her off the track.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s right, I can throw her off. I can make her think marriage
is the last thing on my mind.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah! Convince her that-that you’re scared of commitment!
Convince her that you’re a little coward!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can do that, I’ve had 30 years of practice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, being you is finally gonna pay off! (They give each other fives.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) I had to go all the way to the basement because some idiot
keeps stuffing the trash chute with pizza boxes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That guy’s still doing that?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey! (Sees Monica, gasps, and runs over to her.) Oh my God
you’re here, let me see your hand!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, you’re too late!!! She already took out the trash!!!
[Scene: Outside of Elizabeth’s dormitory, Ross is exiting after breaking up with
her and we can hear his thoughts.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in his head) Wow! I have never had such a healthy break-up! She was
such a grown-up about it! She didn’t seem too immature for me! Did I just make a huge
mistake?

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: (sticking her head out her window) Ross! Wait!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Elizabeth, thank God! I was just thinking about…

lines.speaker: Elizabeth
lines.text: You suck!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!
(She throws a water balloon at him and hits him on the head and hits him again at the
waist with another one.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, break-up’s still on!
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler is looking out the window and Joey is sitting on the
couch.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, okay, here she comes! (Sits on the couch next to him.) How do I
look? Do I look like a guy who doesn’t want to get married?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! And also, a little like a French guy. (They both squint at each
other.) I never noticed that before.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hi guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you up too?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, just hanging out, talkin’ about uh, websites. (Joey laughs.)
Yeah, we saw this really interesting website about marriage and how totally unnecessary it
is and how its just a way for the government to keep tabs on you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) Yeah, Big Brother.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well that’s a little crazy. Although I am y’know glad to hear
that you’re branching out on what you look at on the Internet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well… Y’know, it just got me thinking though, why
would anybody ever want to get married huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?! To celebrate your relationship! To solidify your commitment! To
declare your love for one another to the world!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay well that’s good to know.
(We hear the backup horn of a truck and see through the window that the Mr. Bowmont has
arrived.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (all excited) The Mr. Bowmont’s here!!! (Jumps over the back off the
couch and runs out into the street.)
[Scene: Monica’s Restaurant’s kitchen, she’s cooking as a waitress
sticks her head in.]

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.text: Hey Monica, there’s a customer who wants to complement the chef,
should I let him in?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure, I love this part! (Starts to look busy.)

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.text: (to the customer) Come on in.
(The customer turns out to be…)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Richard!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Actually, I’m not here to complement the chef.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh… Oh, that’s okay I hate when people come back to
complement the chef. Like I have nothing better to do! So what’s up?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well, it was great seeing you the other night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, good to see you too. Did you come down here to tell me that?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: No! I came here to tell you something else. (Pause) I came here (Pause)
to tell you I still love you.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica’s Restaurant, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What uh—What did you—What?!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I still love you. And I know I probably shouldn’t even be here
telling you this, I mean you’re with Chandler a guy I really like, and if you say
he’s straight I’ll believe you! After seeing ya the other night I knew if I
didn’t tell ya I’d regret it for the rest of my life. Letting you go was the
stupidest thing I ever did.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know you’re really not supposed to be back here!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well yeah, I’m sorry. I know this is the wrong time and the wrong
place but I had to tell ya! I wanna spend my life with you. I wanna marry you. I wanna
have kids with you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God… (Starts looking around.) Why don’t they put chairs
back here?!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I know this is crazy but am I too late?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What the… Yes you’re too late! Where was all this three years
ago?!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well I know I was an idiot! And I tried to forget you, I really did!
Y’know after we had lunch last year I spent six months in Africa trying to get
you out of my head!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What were you doing in Africa?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Working with blind kids.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohhh! What are you doing to me?! Oh look, I-I… I’m sorry but
umm, this-this-this-this is not going to happen.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Okay that’s fine, I’ll walk away. And I’ll never bother
you again, but only if you tell me Chandler’s willing to give you everything I
am.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well he is! Yeah, I mean marriage is all he talks about! My goodness, in
fact, I’m the one that’s making him wait!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: You are?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why? Because of the government.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is bringing Phoebe some coffee.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Isn’t it incredible?! Monica and Chandler, gettin’ married.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, they’re gonna be so happy together.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh… I mean two best friends falling in love, how often does that
happen?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not that often!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! I’m so happy for them!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too! So happy for them!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m so happy and not at all jealous.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! No God, definitely not jealous!
(They both take a drink of coffee.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean I’m probably 98% happy, maybe 2% jealous. And I mean
what’s 2%? That’s nothing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Totally. I’m like 90/10.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah me too.
(Joey enters looking like Captain Stubing from the Love Boat.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey uh, have you guys scene Chandler?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (staring at him) Wh—no, but y’know who did stop in here
looking for ya, Tennille.

scenes.location: A Pizza Joint, Chandler and Monica are eating lunch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So that marriage stuff that you were saying yesterday, you don’t
really believe that do you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure I do. In fact, I think the whole concept of marriage is
unnatural. I mean look at pigs. Let’s take a second here and look at pigs. Okay pigs
don’t mate for life. I mean a pig can have like a hundred sexual partners in a
lifetime, and that’s just an ordinary pig not even a pig that’s good at sports!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but that’s pigs not people!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If marriage worked, I’d be all for it. But do you know what the
divorce rate in this country is? 97%.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute. Are you honestly telling me that-that you may never
want to get married?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, never say never but y’know probably uh yeah, never.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Then-then-then what are we even doing?! What is this?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! What is all this pressure?! Is this some new kind of
strategy? Why don’t you put down your copy of ‘The Rules’ huh mantrap?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what?! I gotta go! Ugh!
(She gets up and storms out. The people at the other tables are staring at Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to them) It’s okay, I got a plan.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Rachel are still talking.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’re gonna find love!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Definitely!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I’m pretty confident about that. That’s what makes it so
easy for me to be 80% happy for Monica and Chandler! It would be nice to have a little
guarantee though.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y’know, some people make deals with a friend, like if neither
of them are married by the time they’re 40, they marry each other.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You mean a backup?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Exactly!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, yeah I got that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hm-mmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you serious?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I locked him years ago!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh… So… If neither of you are married by the time you’re
40, you’re gonna marry Joey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yep, we shook on it. Yeah but believe me that is not how he wanted to
seal the deal.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, seriously?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, yeah. I think his exact words were… (She makes two clicking
sounds with her tongue and purrs.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Charming.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well hey, it’s just a backup.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey, still looking like Captain Stubing, is practicing his
slipknots as Monica enters.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have you seen Rachel? Or a mirror?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is for my boat, pretty cool huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, it’s great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa, what’s the matter?! Talk to the captain!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m just having one of those days where you realize you’re in
a dead-end relationship!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler giving you a hard time huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s not like I want to get married tomorrow! It’s just that
I-I’d like to believe that I’m in a relationship that’s actually going
somewhere, that I’m not just wasting my time!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, you know Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No I don’t know Chandler! Not anymore! It’s like it’s
like something’s changed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe you changed?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I didn’t change!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe that’s the problem.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler is a complex fellow, one who is unlikely to take a wife.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is that some kind of boat talk?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know! (All excited) I haven’t totally decided how to
talk on my boat yet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What does he think? Does he think I’m just gonna wait around for
nothing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica face it, Chandler is against marriage. And-and always will be!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (starts for the door) Well there’s some people who do want to marry
me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There are?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! Richard!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: R-R-Richard said he wants to marry you?! (Monica nods yes.) And-and
Chandler’s tellin’ ya how much he hates marriage?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler loves marriage!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You just told me that he hates marriage! That-that he’s a-a complex
fellow who’s unlikely to take a wife! That-that he’s against marriage and always
will be!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got that from what I said?!
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Ross is watching a show about the extinction of the
dinosaurs.]

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: When the Cretaceous period ended, the dinosaurs were gone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What happened you guys?
(There’s a knock on the door, he shuts the TV off, and answers it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, come on in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh thank you. Hey y’know, I’m so sorry to hear about you and
Elizabeth.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thanks. Yeah, I really thought we’d be able to make it work, but
uh, I guess it just wasn’t meant to be.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, love. It’s a tricky business isn’t it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I guess so.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what do you say we make a pact? If you and I are both single by the
time we’re 40, we get married. I mean, we know each other, we like each other, and
we’ve-we’ve already slept together so y’know there’ll be no surprises
there! You know what I mean? No like, "What’s that?!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right. Ohh! You-you want me to be your backup.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, yeah I already have one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Who?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe?! Wait a—but-but she just, she said that Joey was her
backup.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! I just had a conversation with her, and she said that she and Joey
made a deal!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s impossible! I mean we have had a deal for years!
We-we-we shook on it, although believe me she wanted to do a lot more than that.
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is entering to find Joey, still
looking like Captain Stubing, on the phone.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where the hell have you been?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was making a coconut phone with the professor.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Richard told Monica he wants to marry her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah, I’ve been trying to find ya to tell to stop messing with
her and maybe I would have if these (lifts a leg) damn boat shoes wouldn’t keep
flying off!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: My—Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! They suck!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He’s not supposed to ask my girlfriend to marry him! I’m
supposed to do that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well what… Y’know what I’m gonna do? I’m gonna go
over there; I’m gonna kick his ass! (Pause) Will you help me?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, Chandler I don’t think us getting our asses kicked is a
solution. Okay? Just go and find Monica!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Starts running for the bedroom) I’m gonna get the ring!
I’m gonna get the ring! (Does so) I’m gonna go find her and (starts running for
the door) I’m just going to propose!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude-dude-dude!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let me know about that coconut phone, it might great for the boat.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Richard’s Apartment, he’s smoking a cigar and reading a book as there
is a knock on the door. He gets up and opens the door to reveal…]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know why I’m here.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I didn’t ask. You wanna come in?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh, okay. Well, I’ll just leave the door open and go sit on the
couch. (Does so.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Chandler is such an idiot!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: (standing up quickly) Drink?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I’ll have a scotch…

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: …on the rocks with a twist? I remember. (Goes to make her drink.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (moving over to the couch) Still smoking cigars?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Uh, no! No! That’s…art! If it bothers you I can put my art
out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No that’s, that’s okay.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: So Monica let me ask you a question. Y’know, since we broke up do
you ever, think about me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh yeah, I-I actually I thought about you a couple months ago.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah but it was because I-I had an eye exam and I don’t like my new
eye doctor.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Edward Nevski?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Yeah he’s no good. Do you ever (pause) think about me in a (pause)
non-eye doctor way?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Ahh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But getting over was the hardest thing that I’ve ever had to do.
And I never let myself think about you.
(Richard mouths, "Wow!")

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is reading as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe! You picked Joey and Ross?! You can not have two backups!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course I can! It’s just good sense to backup your backup! Look,
I’ve already lost Chandler!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phoebe! We’re both (points at Ross and himself) your backup?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, how could you do this to me?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t—Look I don’t know what you’re complaining
about now? You were both aware of the situation!
(At the same time.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No we weren’t!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was not!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, this kind of back talk is not gonna fly when we’re married!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe you can’t have both of them! You have to pick one!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pick me!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Pick me! I don’t want to end up an old maid!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right well let’s see, Ross is a good father, but Joey has a
boat—This is hard!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is crazy! Hey look, I wanna switch to Rachel!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ooh, I wanna switch to Rachel too!
(Rachel gets all happy.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No wait! Just—Okay—Just wait! You guys! Wait you guys!
Don’t make any rash decisions, okay? Just remember my promise, when we get married,
three times a week.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God, Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) I’m talking about massages.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.
(She turns her head away and when she’s not looking, Phoebe shakes her head and
mouths, "No, I’m not." Both Joey and Ross smile, look at each other, and
then stop smiling.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y’know what?! I know-I know how to settle this! All right
here, this is what we’re gonna do! I’m gonna write Joey on one napkin (does so)
and I’m gonna right Ross on the other napkin (does so) and we are going to pick one!
And that person is going to be our backup! Okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay that’s fair.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good!
(Rachel mixes them up in her hands, moves them all around, and puts her hands behind
her back.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pick one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Left! (Rachel hands her the napkin in her left hand and they both unfold
and read them.) Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re welcome.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading) Ross!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading) Joey! (Pause) We should just switch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah absolutely! (They both switch.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
[Scene: Richard’s Apartment, Monica is looking around and notices an African mask
hanging on the wall.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the mask) I missed you-you ugly, flat faced old freak!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! (Laughs and points at the mask.) Him.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh. (Laughs.) Whew!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I missed this apartment! Now, this is a grown-up’s apartment!
Y’know, I-I should be with a grown-up, do you know what I mean?!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Yeah! You’re saying, you need to be with someone more mature.
Maybe someone with, a license to practice medicine. Or a mustache.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, let’s face it, I’m not a kid anymore! I-I need to
be with someone who-who wants the same things that I do! I mean coming to my place of work
and telling me that you love me, I want that! Talking about pig sex over lunch, I don’t
want that!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I think that’s fair.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fair? Please don’t even talk to me about fair! Fair would’ve
been you wanting to marry me back then! Or fair would’ve been Chandler wanting to
marry me now! Believe me, nothing about this is fair! Nothing! Nothing! Nothing!
Nothing! Nothing! Nothing! Nothing! Nothing! Nothing! Nothing!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: It’s okay! Shh! Hey. Hey. (Hugs her) Shhhh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing. (She backs away a little bit but is still in his arms and looks
up at his eyes.) I don’t kn—Umm. I don’t know. Umm…

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I know. (Backs away.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, I-I… I have to figure…some st—Y’know,
some stuff before I can…

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Yeah, I understand. Take as much time as you want. (Pause) Ten, even
twenty minutes if you need it. I’ll be here. Not smoking. (Monica leaves.)
[Scene: Richard’s Apartment, time lapse. Richard is smoking as he hears a knock on
the door. He quickly puts out his cigar and opens the door.]

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where is she? I’m not scared of you! (Averts his eyes and walks
in.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: She’s not here and please come in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (examining the coffee table) Scotch on the rocks, with a twist, on a
coaster? Ha-ha, Monica! Monica!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Okay, she was here, but she left.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well where did she go?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well she said she had to think things over.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God, I can’t believe this! Y’know, I thought…I
thought you were a good guy.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh, hey look nothing happened.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing happened? Nothing? So you didn’t tell my girlfriend that
you love her?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well all right, one thing happened?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what? I can’t believe this! Do you know what you did?
My girlfriend is out there thinking things over! You made my girlfriend think!!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And what does she have to think about? I love her!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well, apparently I’m willing to offer her things that you are not.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But I am willing to offer her all those things. This was just a
plan, y’know? A way to throw her off course so that when I offered her all these
things, she’d be surprised!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well if it helps, it worked very well.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It was working until you showed up, you big tree! I mean, this
isn’t fair. You had your chance with her! You had your chance and you blew it! And
this is my chance and I am not going to blow it because we are meant for each
other! And this is all just been one stupid mistake! (Sits down heavily.) I was gonna
propose tonight.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: You were gonna propose? (Sits on the arm of the couch.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah I even (pause) got a ring. (Puts in on the center cushion.) Did
you get a ring?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: No I don’t have a ring! (Pause) You go get her Chandler. (Pause)
And can I give you a piece of advice? If you do get her, don’t let her go. Trust me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know Richard…you are a good guy.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I know. (Pause) I hate that!
(Chandler gets up and runs out, but as soon as the door closes behind him he opens it,
runs back in, picks up his ring Richard is holding up for him, and runs back out.)
[Scene: The Hallway, Chandler is running up the stairs and towards his apartment, but
Joey is taking out the garbage at the same time and stops him in the hall.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t talk to you now, I gotta find Monica!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She’s gone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She’s gone. She had a bag and she left.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She was all crying. She-she said you guys want different things, and that
and that she needed time to think.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well why didn’t you stop her?! Why didn’t you just tell her
it was a plan?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I-I did! I told her everything, Chandler! But she wouldn’t believe
me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well where… Where did she go?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: To her parent’s I think and she said you shouldn’t call her. But
if I were you I would.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t believe I ruined this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I am so sorry man.
(He walks dejectedly into his apartment to find it lit with about a thousand candles
and Monica standing in the living room.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You wanted it to be a surprise.
(He turns to look at Joey who smiles slyly and closes the door leaving them alone.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God.
(Monica gets down on one knee.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler… In all my life… I never thought I would be so lucky.
(Starting to cry.) As to…fall in love with my best…my best… There’s a
reason why girls don’t do this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! (He joins her on one knee) Okay! Okay! Oh God, I thought…
(Starting to cry, pauses) Wait a minute, I-I can do this. (Pause) I thought that it
mattered what I said or where I said it. Then I realized the only thing that matters is
that you, (Pause) you make me happier than I ever thought I could be. (Starting to cry
again.) And if you’ll let me, I will spend the rest of my life trying to make you
feel the same way. (Pause as he gets out the ring.) Monica, will you marry me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes.
(The crowd goes wild as he puts the ring on her finger. They hug and kiss this time as
an engaged couple.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I knew you were likely to take a wife!
(They hug again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (yelling through the door) Can we come it yet?! We’re dying out here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come in! Come in! (Joey, Rachel, and Phoebe burst through the door.)
We’re engaged!!!
(Everyone screams and has a group hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh, this is the least jealous I’ve ever been!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no wait no, this is wrong! Ross isn’t here!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh hell, he’s done this three times! He knows what its about!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!
(They all hug again.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, it’s just Monica and Chandler dancing to Wonderful
Tonight on the Slowhand album by Eric Clapton. And you can buy that album from
the CFSI, just click on the CDNow link.]

title: The One with Monica's Thunder

lines.text: [Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler, Joey, Rachel, and Phoebe are standing
around the table drinking champagne as Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I found a note on my door, "Come to Monica’s quick, bring
champagne and a Three Musketeers bar."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (grabbing the candy bar) Yeah I’ll take that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica and I are engaged.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God. (Hugs Chandler.) Congratulations.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Where is she?
[Cut to Monica out on the balcony.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (yelling at the top of her lungs) I’m engaged!!!!!! I’m
engaged!!!!
[Cut back inside.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, she’s been out there for twenty minutes, I’m surprised you
didn’t hear her on the way over.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I thought it was just a kid yelling, "I’m gay! I’m
gay!" Can I bring her in?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, let her stay out there. It’s sweet.
[Cut to Monica.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m getting married!!!! I’m gonna be a bride!!!! (Someone else
yells at her.) No, I will not shut up because I’m engaged! (He yells again.) Ohh, big
talk! Huh, why don’t you come over here and say that to me?! Huh, buddy?! Yeah, my
fiancee will kick your ass! (Chandler starts to look worried.) Come on, apartment 20!
Apartment 20!
[Cut back inside.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) Okay, you get her in here. (To Joey) You bolt the door.
I’ll be in the closet.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, continued from earlier, everyone is now in the
living room drinking champagne.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! Wait-wait-wait! Shhh! (Bangs on her class with a spoon to make a
toast.) Okay, umm, I just wanna say that…I love you guys so-so much and-and thank you
for being here on my special night. (Chandler clears his throat.) Our special night. I
mean it just wouldn’t be my—our-our night, if you all weren’t here to
celebrate with me—us—Damnit!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s okay, I want this to be your night too. (Raises his class.)
To Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Awww, come on—wait—stop it. Okay, to Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: To Monica!
(They all say to Monica, clink their glasses, and drink.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So have you decided on a band for the wedding? Because, y’know,
I’m kinda musical.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah Pheebs, honey, she just got engaged a couple of hours ago. I doubt
she’s even had time to…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well speaking of chiming in, remember the time you burned down my
apartment?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Monica) Yeah, you’re on your own.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what we should do? We should all get dressed up and go to
have champagne at The Plaza.
(They all agree and start to go and get ready.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But I-I-I can’t stay too long, I gotta get up early for a commercial
audition tomorrow and I gotta look good. I’m supposed to be playing a 19-year-old.
(Everyone stops in their tracks upon hearing this.) What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So when you said, "Get up early," did you mean 1986?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You guys don’t think I look 19?
(A brief silence ensues.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, 19! We thought you said 90!
(They all politely laugh and stop just as quickly.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay everybody, let’s go! Let’s go!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(They all leave and Joey comes back in quickly.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Hey, is uh the rest of my candy bar around here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh honey no, you ate it all.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was afraid of that.
(Walks out and after he closes the door Phoebe turns around and takes a bite out of
what is left of his candy bar.)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s bedroom, they’re getting ready.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking at her hand) Y’know what shoes would look great with this
ring? Diamond shoes! (Sees Chandler sitting on the bed.) You’re not getting dressed.
(Chandler quietly folds over the comforter on the bed making a spot for her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Know what I mean?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but I don’t think we have time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There’s gonna be a wedding. You’re gonna be the bride. Two
hundred people are going to be looking at you in a clean white dress.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (lustily) Let’s do it! (She kisses him and they fall back onto the
bed.)
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, time lapse, Chandler is fully dressed and
slowly walking out of the bedroom with a distressed look on his face.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (chasing after him) Chandler! It happens to lots of guys! You-you-you
were probably tired, you had a lot of champagne, don’t worry about it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (motioning with his hands) I’m not worried, I’m uh, I’m
fascinated. Y’know it’s like uh, Biology! Which is funny because in high school
I uh, I-I failed Biology and tonight Biology failed me. (Exits as Phoebe enters from her
room with her guitar.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Check it out. Okay, I can play this when the guests are coming in. Okay.
(Singing)
"First time I met Chandler, I thought he was gay.
But here I am singing on his wedding day!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If you would’ve let me finish, it goes on to say that he’s
probably not gay.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Chandler is looking at the foosball table.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure, you guys don’t have this problem, you’re made of wood.
(Rachel comes out of the bathroom) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You look great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (quietly) Oh, thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You okay over there?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, y’know? I feel a little umm… No,
y’know what? Nevermind, I’m gonna be fine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, don’t worry about it I mean you probably were tired, you had
a lot of champagne, it happens to everybody.
[Rachel exits into the hallway just as Ross is coming up the stairs.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! Happy Monica’s night!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well thank you, you too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, do you believe this? Do you believe they are actually getting
married?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well sure. But I get married all the time so…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I guess. I-I… I mean, do-do you think we’re ever gonna
have that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You mean, we—you and me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no-no, no, no! We, you with someone and me with someone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh good, you scared me for a minute.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shake it off.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I mean—no, it’s just ‘cause, it’s just ’cause you
and I were like a nightmare. (Screams.) No, but there was some good times.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, absolutely. Y’know like it was umm…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Surely you can think of something good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, just give me a minute! (Thinking) Oh well, yes, I can think of one
good thing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well you uh, you were always really good at the uh, at the uh the stuff.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? I was good at the stuff huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-hmm, uh-hmm, yeah, yeah, I really liked your hands.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My hands?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to his hands) Way to go guys. Y’know, you-you were really good at
the stuff too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I know. Hey, y’know what we never did? (Ross looks at her.) Oh
no, not that. (Ross nods okay.) We uh, we never had bonus night!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know, bonus night. Y’know, when two people break up but they
get back together for just one night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: One night, just-just sex. No strings attached?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, we never had that,

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.
[Silence.]

lines.speaker: Ross
