lines.text: Okay, this is getting a little crazy. I mean, I’m-I’m sure it
would be amazing but I…gotta say I really-really don’t think it would be a good
idea. Y’know? I really, really…don’t.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Chandler is playing Playstation, Crash Team Racing
to be exact (he’s in last on Hot Air Skyway to be more exact) as Joey enters from his
room desperately trying to look like a 19-year-old. He’s got the wool cap, he’s
got the cut-off Knicks jersey over the faded T-shirt, and he’s got the whole
pants-around-the-knees-showing-off-the-boxers thing that rich, white, suburban kids have
adopted in a desperate and extremely futile attempt to try to look like they’re from
the inner-city.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ‘Sup? ‘Sup dude?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (putting his hands up) Take whatever you want, just please don’t
hurt me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you’re playing a little Playstation, huh? That’s
whack! Playstation is whack! ‘Sup with the whack Playstation,
‘sup?! Huh? Come on, am I 19 or what?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, on a scale from 1 to 10, 10 being the dumbest a person can look,
you are definitely 19.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on man, really how old?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Young! You’re a man-child okay?! Now go get changed because
everybody’s ready and please, oh please, keep my underwear!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow thanks! (He goes into his bedroom and closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh, you’ve had a lot of sex right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: When? Today? Some, not a lot.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it’s just the reason that I’m asking is because I kind
of eh, uh, I was unable to—I mean I really wanted too, but I couldn’t….
There huh—hmm, there-there was an incident.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t worry about that man, that happens.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s happened to you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Once.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, what’d you do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I did it anyway.
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is in the living room and Phoebe is in
her room.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe! Come on! Let’s go! (Knocks on her door.) Come on! (Phoebe
enters with guitar and not ready to go.) Why aren’t you dressed yet?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry, but I just wrote the best dance song for your wedding.
Check this out. (Gets ready to play.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (grabs the guitar away from her) No, Phoebe, I’ll tell you what, if
you get ready now I’ll let you play it at the wedding.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?! Oh that’s so exciting! Thank you! Thanks Mon! Oh but Mon,
if you touch my guitar again I’ll have to pound on you for a little bit.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fair enough, now go get ready!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (She goes to get ready.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’ll get everybody else (Does so), finally we can start celebrating
my—(She gasps and is stopped by the sight of Ross and Rachel making out in the hall.)
I’m sorry, uh apparently I’ve opened the door to the past.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, continued from before the commercial break.
Monica is walking into the apartment followed by Ross and Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, Monica. Mon, uh what-what you just saw…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) Can I ask you just a little question, huh? Why tonight?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See, I’ve been waiting my whole life to be engaged, and unlike some
people I’m only planning on doing this once. So, uh y’know, maybe this is
selfish and I’m sorry about it, but I was kinda hoping tonight could just be about
that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh honey, but it is just about…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It is! It is!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No it’s not! No! No! Now it’s about you and Ross getting back
together!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See yeah umm, you kinda stole my thunder!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! Ho-ho! We did not steal your thunder because we are not
getting back together!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. No. And you know what? Nobody even saw!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey I swear it we just kissed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was just a kiss. (Phoebe enters and overhears this.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys kissed!!!!! What does this mean?!! Are you, are you getting
back together?! Can I sing at your wedding?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thunder being stolen!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay come on Phoebe, it’s nothing! Monica, come on!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look let’s not make a big deal out of this! It was a one time
thing. It doesn’t even matter!
(Chandler and Joey enter and overhear that.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God! I cannot believe you guys are talking about this! The problems
in the bedroom are between the man and the woman!!! All right?!! Now Chandler is doing the
best he can!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (angrily) I don’t think that’s what they were talking about
Joe!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What a great night, Chandler can’t do it, these guys kissed…
(Points to Ross and Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You guys kissed! Oh my—this is huge!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no, it’s really not huge.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And; people thinking it’s huge has led Monica to believe that we
are stealing her thunder. (To Monica) Which we are not!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, we’re still talking about it, aren’t we?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well yeah, that and Chandler’s problem.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica-Monica-Monica-Monica, listen-listen, listen, listen, would-would it
make you feel better if we all stop talking about Ross and Rachel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes that would be lovely.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got it. Okay. Now, I can pass for 19 right?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, you can pass for 19.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Seriously?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Seriously? Seriously, no! You can play your own age which is 31!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, you are not! You’re 31.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (realizes) Aww crap!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so The Plaza! Okay, we’ll get us some Mai Thai’s,
(To Chandler) maybe no more for you though.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what? I-I think that umm, I don’t feel like going to The
Plaza.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, Monica, this is ridiculous! Look…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no, I-I really don’t want to talk about it! I don’t! (To
Rachel) Especially with you. (Goes into her room.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Psss, that is whack!
[Time lapse, Phoebe is playing the guitar for Joey.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (she’s strumming something) Yeah? (Joey nods yes.) Okay, I think
I’ll play it at the wedding.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Well, I think we’ll see if they actually let you play. Huh? I
mean they tell you anything you want to hear like-like, "You look 19," and then
they just take it away like-like, "No you don’t."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I don’t think Monica is gonna take this away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wouldn’t she?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Would she?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Would she? (He smells something and gasps as he realizes what it is.) You
ate my candy bar!
[Scene: Rachel’s bedroom, she’s pacing as Ross knocks on her door and opens
it a little to stick his hands in.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Guess who? (Enters fully.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I just realized we kinda let some stuff up in the air…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What do you think Monica mean when she said she didn’t want to
talk, especially with me? I mean, why not especially you and me? We were both out there
kissing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Still thinking about it huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on! Serious-ser-ser-seriously, what did she mean by that?
(Mimicking Monica.) Especially you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (loosening his tie) Oh, who cares?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I care!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (tightening his tie) And so do I.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know what, I-I have to go talk to her, would you let me just get
changed?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Sure. (Sits down on her bed.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Am I going to let you watch me undress?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sitting up) No! (Exits.)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s bedroom, they are both getting undressed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t believe her, y’know it’s just—it’s so
typical.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now Monica, I know you’re upset, but don’t forget. There is
going to be a wedding, you are going to throw the bouquet, and then there’s
going to be a honeymoon, maybe in Paris.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Paris?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We will take a moonlit walk on the Rue de la (mumbles something).

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Keep talking.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then we will sprinkle rose pedals on the bed and make love. Not just
because it’s romantic, but because I can!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you!
(They start making out and both start to feel something growing below the belt line.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (in a French accent) Bonjour, monsieur.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, don’t say anything, you might scare it away.
(There is a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s Paris, who knows we’re here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (opening the door) Hi Pheebs, what’s up? (She enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, you said I could sing at your wedding so, I’m just gonna need
a small deposit.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know, just some good faith money to hold the date.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs, we’re not giving you a deposit for our wedding!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I see. (Exits angrily.)
[Cut to the living room, Joey is eating a sandwich.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They break your heart, don’t they?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know, I don’t really their permission.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! If you wanna sing at their wedding, well you sing at their wedding!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! And if you wanna look 19, then you… You gotta do something
about your eyes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! What’s wrong with my eyes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They give you away! There’s just-there’s just too much wisdom
in there. (Joey nods in agreement.) Just put some tea bags on there for like 15 minutes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And that’ll get rid of my wisdom?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe just 10 minutes for you.
[Cut back to Monica and Chandler’s room, they are making out again as there’s
another knock on the door.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, give her the deposit! Give her the ring! I don’t care!
(Monica opens the door to Ross and Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, what did you mean before when you said you didn’t want to
talk to anyone, especially me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What a great apology! (To Monica) And you accept! Okay, bye-bye!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no, seriously-seriously, what was the especially me part about?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, let’s just say it’s not the first time you’ve
stolen my thunder.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) Hey, here’s a thought.
(Rachel ignores him and follows Monica into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, what are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My Sweet Sixteen! Remember, you went to third base with my cousin
Charlie.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Ahh, third base.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s all everybody at the party could talk about!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, y’know what? The only reason I did that was because your
party was so boring!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (gasps) We had a characturist!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing, angrily)
"Whenever I get married, guess who won’t get to sing?
Somebody named Geller! And somebody else named Bing!"
(Exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, your Sweet Sixteen was like a million years ago.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And yet, here we are doing it again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, Monica I don’t want to steal your stupid thunder!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh please! Why else would you have made out with Ross?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Got me. (He shows of his hands.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, easy mimey, the moment has passed, it ain’t gonna
happen!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just thought it would be nice if I could have just this one night!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I swear, I never wanted any part of your night!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, is that why you did it the secret hallway where nobody ever goes?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, Rachel, I’ve been thinking. I don’t think us getting
together tonight is such a good idea. I’m calling it off.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) Why to save your dignity my man.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (ignoring them) Monica, why? Why would I ever want to take away from
your night?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know! I don’t—maybe you’re feeling a little
resentful. Maybe ah, maybe you thought you’d get married first! Maybe you can’t
stand the fact that your formally fat friend is getting married before you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow. That—y’know what? That is so unfair. Y’know what?
Now I want to steal your thunder! Come on Ross, let’s go have sex!
(Ross tries to dismiss it by making that sound, but decides to go for it and follows
Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (yelling after them) I can’t believe you’re gonna have sex on
my engagement night!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, somebody should. (Monica glares at him.)
[Cut to Rachel’s bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look uh, if we’re gonna do this…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’re not gonna do this, all right? She’s just gonna think
that we’re doin’ it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I see, so everybody wins.
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (outside the door) It’s Monica, open up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay well Ross! Stop it please! Wait a minute! (Motions for him to
follow her lead, but he angrily shakes his head no. So she pokes him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oww!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, you like that baby? (Monica bursts in followed by Chandler.) May
we help you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just wanted to say that I hope you do have sex tonight and I hope that
you guys get back together, but I must warn you, the night that you announce your
engagement I’m going to announce that I’m pregnant!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How is that ever going to happen?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right Monica, do you want to know why I was with Ross tonight?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know why!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No you don’t know why!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! Why?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because! Because I was sad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, I am so…so happy for you guys, but you getting married just
reminds me of the fact that I’m not. I’m not even close. And I don’t know,
maybe I just wanted to make myself feel better. And I know that that’s dumb, but oh
my God you were so depressed when Ross got married that you slept with Chandler!
(Ross looks at Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) I don’t care, she slept with me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anyway sweetie, I am, I’m so sorry I ruined your night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (starting to cry) I’m sorry I almost made you sleep with Ross.
(They hug.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (deadpan) Well, I’m going to take off. (To Chandler) Congratulations
man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (at the door) And uh, Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What can I say, you missed your chance. From now on the only person
who’s going to enjoy these bad boys (holds up his hands) is me. (Quickly realizes
what he said and exits disgustedly.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Phoebe is singing outside Monica and
Chandler’s door.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing)
"We thought Phoebe would leave, but she just stayed and stayed.
That’s right, I’m here all night, and Chandler will never get l…"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting her just in time) Hey! Here’s a dollar, consider it
a deposit. Please sing at our wedding.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Goes back to bed.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now… (Starts singing again) "Who will perform the ceremony!
Who will perform the cer—(Chandler enters and grabs her guitar and closes the
door behind him)—Oh—oh! All right, I’ll pound on him in the morning.

title: The One with Rachel's Book

lines.text: [Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, everyone is there having breakfast and Joey
enters carrying a loaf of bread.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who wants French toast?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I’ll have some!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good, me too. (Tosses him the loaf.) Eggs and milk are in the fridge.
Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from her room) Oww!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s the matter honey?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know, my hand feels weird. I guess it’s because,
I’m engaged! (Shows off the ring.) How long before it starts getting annoying?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It starts?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, so let’s get started on the wedding plans!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! (Runs off.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (incredulous) Already?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, we got a lot to do! We gotta think about the flowers, the
caterers, the music…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I got some thoughts on that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wait Chandler, too many cooks…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Take from me, as the groom all you have to do is show up and try to say
the right name.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (returning) Okay! (Sets down a huge 3" 3-ring binder on the table.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What in God’s name is that?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God, the wedding book?! I haven’t seen that since the forth
grade!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This baby has got everything. Take y’know, locations for instance.
(She opens up the binder to the locations chapter.) First, organized alphabetically, then
geographically, then by square footage.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is so smart! (To Chandler, under her breath) Break it off. Break it
off now.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: A Classroom, Ross is giving a lecture.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And that should conclusively prove that I had the idea for Jurassic
Park first! Now let’s take a look at… (Phoebe rushes in.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, oh my God! Wh-wh-what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I need to talk to you, it’s pretty urgent. It’s about Monica
and Chandler.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! Of course, of course. (To the class.) Umm, would you please
excuse me for a moment? Umm, do you know each other’s hometowns? Why don’t
you… (Motions that they should learn everyone’s hometown.) (To Phoebe)
Wh-what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, umm, not much. But, I was just thinking that since those guys just
got engaged that maybe it would be nice if they had some privacy, y’know? So, could I
just move in with you for a couple days?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, okay, yeah, sure. But wh-what’s wrong with Monica and Chandler?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing—Why?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, you said it was urgent!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah it is! I’m going to the movies and it starts in like five
minutes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you realize I have a classroom full of students?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to the students) Oh, I’m sorry. I’m so rude. Does anyone want
to come to the movies?
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Rachel and Monica are pretty much telling
Chandler what the wedding plans are.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, so I haven’t cleared the budget with my parents yet, but
tell me how this is for music.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right umm, a string quartet for the procession.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A jazz trio for cocktails. The Bay City Rollers for dancing.
Wait, that was from my sixth grade wedding.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you couldn’t get them anyway. Ian doesn’t plan anymore
and Derrick… (Off of Rachel and Monica’s looks) And Derrick is a name I
shouldn’t know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sitting up from the couch) Hey Mon, do you have another pillow? (Holds up
one.) Y’know, something a little snugglyer?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why are you napping over here instead of over at your place?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, the duck…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! The duck?! What the hell did the damn duck do now?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, well he did not get sick somewhere in there and it was
immediately found and properly cleaned up!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now, do I get to look at this book or is it just for people who are
actually involved in the wedding?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course you can look at it! Yeah, I want your opinion too!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here you go! What do you think about centerpieces?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Centerpieces!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! Roses or Lilies? (Holds up a picture of each.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Definitely roses. (Monica and Rachel exchange a look.) Well, I just
think they’re a little more weddingy. (Monica holds the Lily picture closer to him.)
But Lilies are the clear choice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! It’s like one mind.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sitting up again) Guys! Guys!! You gotta let me nap! Ugh, I’m
gonna get cranky!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, there is a perfectly good couch across the hall!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes it is perfectly good, and it is not one of the places the duck
got sick!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I’m gonna go! (Gets up and heads for the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now Joey, what did the duck do?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know! But he did not eat your face cream!
[Cut to Joey and Rachel’s, Joey enters and heads for his bedroom. He pushes open
the door to find the duck.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey little buddy, how are you feeling? (The duck does not get sick
and Joey recoils in horror and heads for the couch.) What the hell is in that face cream?
(He’s about to try out the couch but notices the bed in Rachel’s room. He walks
into her room and feels the bed.) That’s so soft. (He pulls back the comforter.)
Pillowcases! (He climbs in and groans in delight. Suddenly, he feels something under him
and pulls out a little beat up paperback book. He opens it and starts to read from it.)
(In his head.) Zelda looked at the chimney sweep. Her father, the vicar…(Stops
reading and thinks.) The vicar? (Continues reading) …wouldn’t be home
for hours. Her loins were burning. She threw caution to the wind and reached out and
grabbed his…(Out loud.) Whoa! (Reads on in silence.) Whoa-ho-ho-ho! This is a
dirty book! (Continues to read.)
[Scene: Ross’s apartment, Phoebe has moved in and has a massage client on her
table she’s set up in the living room. Ross enters and is shocked to see a naked man
lying on the table.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, Phoebe…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Ross, hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry, I’m with a client right now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, let’s talk outside.
(They go into the hall.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, you can’t massage people in my apartment!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s the big deal? I did it at Monica and Chandler’s!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And they knew about it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (pause as she considers it) Okay, well Ross, what is this really about?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, this is my home and I want to be able to come and go whenever I
want!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I will find someplace else to do the rest of my appointments. I
just don’t know what the big deal is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The big deal is I don’t want naked, greasy strangers in my apartment
when I want to kick back with a puzzle—beer! Cold beer.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is sweeping up as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Joey, what ‘cha doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sweepin’. Why? Turn you on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh. What if I was sweeping a chimney?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, did you my face cream?
(She walks into her bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where are you going? The vicar won’t be home for hours.
(She comes back out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, (nervously) where did you learn that word?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where do you think, (pause) Zelda?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) You found my book?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah I did!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, what-what are you doing going into my bedroom?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, look I’m sorry, I went in there to take a nap and I know I
shouldn’t have, but you got porn!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey-hey, y’know what? I don’t care! I’m not ashamed of my
book. There’s nothing with a woman enjoying a little…erotica. It’s just a
healthy expression of female sexuality, which by the way, you will never understand. (She
goes into her room.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got porn!
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Ross is coming out of the living room carrying his salad and
a puzzle—beer! Cold beer. And he decides to fold up Phoebe’s massage table, but
being Ross has trouble with it as there is a knock on the door. He sets the table back up
and opens the door to reveal a beautiful woman.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, is uh Phoebe here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh no-no, she-she’s out for the night.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Ohh great.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can I, can I help you with something?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well, I don’t know. Are you a masseur?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (deadpan) Yes I am.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great! (Calls down the hall) Dad! (Her old father walks in.) Thank you so
much, I’ll be back to pick him up in an hour. (She walks away.)
(Ross isn’t happy and closes the door slowly.)

scenes.location: A Restaurant, Monica and Chandler are having dinner with her parents.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: So Chandler, you’re parents must’ve been thrilled when
you told them you were engaged.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, I should probably call them.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I remember when we first got engaged.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I don’t think I ever heard that story.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh dad, really you don’t need to…

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (ignoring her) Well, I’d gotten Judy pregnant. I still
don’t know that happened.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (incredulous) You don’t know how that happened?! Your dog
thought my diaphragm was a chew toy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What a sweet story.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, at least you’re not hearing it for the first time at your
fifth grade Halloween party.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: What?! They wanted a scary story!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Anyway, we’re really excited about our wedding plans, and well I
guess pretty soon we’ll be making a big withdrawal from the Monica wedding fund.
(Chandler and her laugh, but her parents don’t.) What?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: You tell her Jack, I can’t do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What happened? You still have the Monica wedding fund don’t you?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: We have it. Only now, we call it the beach house.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: A Restaurant, scene continued from before the break.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t believe you spent my wedding fund on the beach house!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: We’re sorry honey, but we just assumed if you got married
after you turned 30 you’d pay for it yourself.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You bought the beach house when I was 23!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Which means you had seven years of beach fun and you can’t put
a price on that sweetie.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: We really do feel bad about this though.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: We started saving again when you were dating Richard and then that
went to hell, so we redid the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What about when I started dating Chandler?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Well it was Chandler! We didn’t think he’d ever
propose!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Clearly I did not start drinking enough at the start of the meal.
(Starts to make up for lost time and takes a big swig of his drink.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t believe it! That there is no money for my wedding?!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: We might still have some money, if your father didn’t
think it was a good idea to sell ice over the Internet.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: It seemed like such a simple idea.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Stupid Jack, the word is stupid.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: All right, enough! I don’t want to hear about it anymore!
(Under his breath) Good luck, Chandler. (Chandler takes another drink.)
[Scene: Ross's apartment, his massage client is on the table and Ross is reluctantly
starting his massage. He spreads some lotion in his hands, and doesn’t like it.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! Now, I’m going to touch you. (He does so, very gingerly.) Ohh,
that’s soft. (He starts poking him and notices his salad spoons and starts to massage
him with those.)
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica and Chandler are returning from dinner,
Rachel is already there.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t believe this. Do you think that your parents could help pay
for it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know, my mother spent most of her money on her fourth
wedding. She’s saving the rest for her divorce. And any extra cash my father has he
saves for his yearly trips to (Pause) Dollywood.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well what happened at dinner?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My parents spent the money for our wedding!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) My God! What did you order?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, but there’s no money! Well this is terrible! You guys are
gonna have to get married in like a, rec. center!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, it’s gonna be okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No it’s not! It’s not gonna be okay! It sucks! No swing
band! No lilies!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, y’know what? It’s gonna be okay. I mean you don’t
have to have this rustic Italian feast. Y’know? And-and you don’t need, you
don’t need this custom-made, empire waisted, duchess, satin gown; you can wear off
the rack. (She starts to cry, as does Monica.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, it really is gonna be okay. The important thing is that we love
each other and that we’re gonna get married.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you even understand what off the rack means?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, why don’t you just pay for it yourself?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How? I don’t have any money.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I have some.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How much?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, close to… (Notices Rachel leaning in to hear and decides to
write it on a piece of paper and hand it to Monica as Phoebe averts her eyes.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whoa!!! Are you kidding me?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well what?! How-how much is it?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s enough for wedding scenario eight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! (Whispers.) Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) How great are you, you little saver?! I mean, the-the
amount you have is exactly the budget of my dream wedding!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starting to cry) Ohh, you guys are so made for each other.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you’re not suggesting that we spend all of the money on the
wedding?

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: Ah, yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, come on, I’ve been saving this money for six years and I
kinda had some of it earmarked for the future, not just for a party.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading the slip of paper) Wow! (In a sultry voice) Hello, Mr.
Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is the most special day of our lives.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I realize that honey, but I’m not gonna spend all of the
money on one party.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, umm I-I love you, (laughs) but umm, if you call our wedding a
party one more time, you may not get invited. Okay? (Laughs) Listen, we could always
earn more money, okay? But uh, we’re only gonna get married once.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I understand, but I have to put my foot down. Okay? The answer
is no.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You-you’re gonna have to put your foot down?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, I am!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, money and a firm hand. Finally a Chandler I can get on board with.
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey and Ross are there as Rachel enters and sees Joey sitting
there.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Rach.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (quietly) Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Rach, do you smell smoke?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh, I get it, smoke, chimney, chimney sweep, very funny, ha-ha.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no, I’m serious. You don’t smell it? Something’s on
fire.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well no, I don’t smell anything.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, y’know what? It’s probably just your burnin’ loins.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sitting down) Hey, what are you guys, what are you guys talking about?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (takes a drink) Damn, this coffee’s cold! Hey Rach, do you mind if I
heat this up on your loins? (Joey and he both laugh.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know, I can not believe you told him, Joey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So I guess you bought that book after we broke up huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh, yeah I did, because I wore out my first copy when I was with
you. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (chases her) Oh yeah, yeah? Well uh, when we were going out, I read tons
of porno magazines! (Realizes a table of women overheard him.) (To that table.) ‘Sup?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Ross! How could you do that to an old man?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking at the table) Excuse me ladies. (To Phoebe) I’m sorry?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My massage client, Arthur? His daughter called and said that some guy
that worked for me gave him a really weird massage this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (incredulous) I gave him an extremely professional massage!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He said you poked at him with wooden spoons.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, so it wasn’t uh, a traditional massage. But I did give him
accu-pressure with a pair of chopsticks. And, and I gently exfoliated him with, with a
mop.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, he’s never coming back! Okay? You just cost me eight dollars
a week!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, y’know what? This is your fault! You’re the one that
didn’t move his-his appointment.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it’s my fault?! You didn’t have to massage him! You
could’ve sent him away! You could’ve not rolled Tonka trucks up and down
his back!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He said he liked that!! Oh you’re right, you’re right. I’m
sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, what are you massaging an old man for?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: His daughter was hot.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Gotcha.
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is looking at the wedding book as
Monica enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Listen umm, I’ve been thinking, it’s not fair for me to ask
you to spend all of your money on our wedding. I mean, you work, you work really hard for
that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ehh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Eh, you work for that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I thought about it too, and I’m sorry. I think we should
spend all of the money on the wedding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You do?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’m putting my foot down. Yeah look, when I proposed I told
you that I would do anything to make you happy, and if having the perfect wedding makes
you happy then, then that’s what we’re gonna do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you’re so sweet. (They hug and kiss.) Oh, but wait, what about
our, what about the future and stuff?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eh, forget about the future and stuff! So we only have two kids,
y’know? We’ll pick our favorite and that one will get to go to college.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You thought about that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How many kids were we gonna have?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, four, a boy, twin girls and another boy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What else did you think about?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, stuff like where’d we live, y’know? Like a small place
outside the city, where our kids could learn to ride their bikes and stuff. Y’know,
we could have a cat that had a bell on it’s collar and we could hear it every time it
ran through the little kitty door. Of course, we’d have an apartment over the garage
where Joey could grow old.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) Y’know what? I-I don’t want a big, fancy wedding.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure you do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I want everything you just said. I want a marriage.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You sure?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I love you so much.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you. (They kiss.) Hey listen umm, when, when you were
talkin’ about our future you said cat, but you meant dog right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, totally!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh good.
Ending Credits
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is balancing her checkbook as Joey enters from his
room wearing a hockey helmet, gloves, and shin guards.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello, Zelda.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who are you supposed to be?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The vicar!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you even know what a vicar is?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Like a goalie, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastically) Yeah. Look Joey, it’s enough all right?! You keep
making these stupid jokes and this sleazy innuendoes and it’s—I’m
not—it’s just not funny anymore!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I’m sorry. Rach I—Rach I’m sorry. Okay? I’m
sorry! Maybe I can make up for it by, taking you roughly in the barn. (Giggles.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right! Y’know what? That’s it! You wanna do it?!
Let’s do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starting to move closer to him) That’s right, I wanna do it with
you! I’ve been trying to fight it, but you just said all the right things.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (nervously backing away) I-I-I-I did? (He puts a stool in front of her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (moves the stool out of the way) Yeah! Ohh, I’ve been waitin’
so long to get on that body!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This body? (He backs into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah that’s right! Come on Joey; sex me up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey, you’re startin’ to sound like the butcher’s wife
there in-in chapter seven.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on now, don’t keep me waiting. Get those clothes off! But,
I would keep that helmet on because you’re in for a rough ride! (He backs into
the door.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t want to, I’m scared.
(Rachel walks away, pleased with her self.)

title: The One with Phoebe's Cookies

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Rachel, Phoebe, Joey, Ross, and Monica are all there as Chandler
enters wearing glasses.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you guys!

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, what do you think?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you kidding? Okay, I’ll give you a hint; I’ll give you a
hint. (Points to his glasses.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Eyes! No, no. Your eyes! No. Chandler’s eyes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I got glasses!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you-you’ve always had glasses.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No I didn’t!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, did-didn’t you use to have a pair? They were really
round, burgundy, and they made you look kind of umm…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Feminine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sweetie, I think the glasses look great. They make you look really sexy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sitting down on the arm of her chair) You didn’t think I used to
wear glasses, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course! (She mouths, "I have no idea," to the rest of the
gang.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Rachel, Phoebe, Chandler, and Monica are making
some sandwiches.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So what do you guys want for an engagement present?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s okay Pheebs, we’re not having a party or anything, so
you don’t have to get us…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupts him) If someone wants to give us a present, we don’t
want to deprive them of that joy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, y’know what you should get ‘em? One of those little uh,
portable CD players.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I already have one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not unless someone borrowed it and left it at the gynecologist.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and-and-and by someone, she means Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, I know I what I want!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What we want honey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, you don’t want this. I want to have your grandmother’s
cookie recipe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You mean the chocolate chip cookie recipe?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-huh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You mean the one that my grandmother made me swear on her deathbed that
I would never let out of our family?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dying people say the craziest things.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wanted it for years! I was gonna make cookies for my children.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Break my heart—Oh, all right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. I’m gonna be the mom that makes the world’s best
chocolate chip cookies.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Our kids are gonna be fat aren’t they.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Ahoy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! How’s the boat?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! I’m finally getting into this sailing stuff.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, so you finally took it out of the marina huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why would I do that? It took three guys to get the thing in there!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If you don’t sail your boat, what do you do on it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it’s great! It’s a great place to just kinda, sit, hang
around, drink a few beers, eat some chips. (He says that as he sits, hangs around, drinks
a beer, and eats a chip.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it’s good that you finally have a place to do that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know Joey, I could teach you to sail if you want.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You could?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! I’ve been sailing my whole life. When I was fifteen my dad
bought me my own boat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Your own boat?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! What?! He was trying to cheer me up! My pony was sick.
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Monica are there. He takes off his glasses and
starts chewing on the ear piece.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you know what I was thinkin’?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nothing, I just like to go like this. (Does it again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering from the bathrooms) Hey Chandler, what are you doing tonight?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh why, do you have a lecture?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then free as a bird. What’s up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My dad wanted to know if you wanted to play racquetball with us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! That’s great! Dad must really like you, he doesn’t ask
just anyone to play.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah and he didn’t really ask for you, he asked for Chancy, I assumed
he meant you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, did-did you correct him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I-I thought it would be more fun this way.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is so cool, maybe this is something you can do every week.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Or you can sit with him on the front porch and make sure no one steals the
trash cans. He does that every week too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, just so you know, you-you have to let him win.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He hates to lose.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no problem, maybe I’ll play with my left hand.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re not a lefty?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Does anybody know me?!
(Phoebe enters, walks up to Monica, and exhales exasperatedly.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s wrong Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just went to my old apartment to get you the-the cookie recipe and the
stupid fire burned it up!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!! Why didn’t you make a copy and-and keep it in a fireproof box
and keep it at least a hundred yards from the original?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (pauses as he figures out how to answer that) Because I’m normal!
That was the one legacy my grandmother left me, and I know you wanted it as an
engagement present.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, we have to get you an engagement present?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don’t worry about it Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No one got me an engagement present.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, here I wish you health and happiness. (She hands Monica a cookie
in a plastic baggie.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: An old cookie?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) This is what happens when you don’t register for
gifts!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: See no-no, I made a batch and I froze it, and this is the only one left.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We can’t accept this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ‘Cause it’s gross.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Wait! I think I can figure out the recipe from this cookie! I do
stuff like this at work all the time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! I bet I can do it.
(Chandler looks over and sees Ross glaring at them.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, we owe you a present.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Two! I’ve been engaged twice!
[Scene: The Mr. Bowmont (Joey’s boat), she’s shown to be in one of the
waterways around New York, but in reality she’s in a sound stage on the Warner Bros.
lot and we see New York from the water in some rather poor green screen shots. Rachel and
Joey are on board.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (drinking a beer) Look at this clown! Just because he’s got a bigger
boat he thinks he can take up the whole river. (Yelling) Get out of the way jackass! (To
Rachel) Who names his boat Coast Guard anyway?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is the Coast Guard.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are they doing out here? The coast’s all the way over there.
(Points to the coast, meanwhile there is coast behind him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, just ignore the boats all right? We’re not finished with the
lesson yet.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I’m just gonna go over the basic points just one more time,
are you ready?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on Rach, not again. I got it! Okay? Let’s start sailing, and I
want to go over there (Points) where that boatload of girls is! (Yelling to them)
Yo-ho-ho!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, okay. Is that what you want to do? You wanna go over and give a
little shout out to the old, hot chickas? Okay, let’s do that Sailor Joe. Quick
question though, (grabs some of the rigging) what’s this called?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, boat rope.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wrong! How do you get the mainsail up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, rub it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. What do you do if I say we are coming about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’d say, come again. No-no, wait I-I-I know this one, I know this
one, uh…
(Rachel blasts an air horn in his ear.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Time’s up, now your dead.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And deaf!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you just go on and make your little jokey-jokes, but if you do not
know what you are doing out at sea you will die at sea. Am I getting through to you
sailor?! (She punctuates each word by slapping him on the forehead.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don’t just say yes! This isn’t a game, Joey you can really get
hurt out here. Okay, so do you want to pay attention or do you want to die?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I want to make a ship to shore call to Chandler.
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica and Phoebe are trying to determine the
cookie recipe by eating small pieces.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I definitely taste nutmeg.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You don’t? (Laughs) Well, that’s the difference between a
professional and a layman.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That and arrogance.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! How was sailing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t want to talk about it. Y’know, you could’ve at
least saved me a whole cookie. (He grabs what’s left of the cookie and pops in his
mouth.)

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: No-wait-no-no!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (recoils in horror) Women are mean!!! (Storms out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t believe that! Now the only thing left of my
grandmother’s legacy is this crumb. (She picks it up with her finger and holds it out
to Monica.) I wish you a long and happy marriage.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering with Chandler) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! How was it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I had a great time! Umm, Chancy on the other hand…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I will tell the story! It was going great. I let him win. We
were bonding. He even said I could call him dad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And what did he ask you not to call him?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Daddy. All right look, here’s the story. (Flashback to Chandler
about to enter the steam room as he does the voice-over.) Well, we had just finished
playing racquetball and we were gonna take a steam. I walk into the steam room and it was
really steamy. (The flashback shows his glasses fog up and him trying to find his way
around the steam filled room. He takes off his glasses.) So I take off my glasses and
that’s when in happened.
[Cut to the flashback, Chandler’s no longer doing the voice-over.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Guys?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Over here. (You can see Ross sitting at the far wall.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Have a seat son. (You can see Mr. Geller sitting closer to the door
as Chandler walks over and sits in his lap.) Hey!! (Chandler quickly jumps off and sits
next to him with a shocked expression on his face.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is finished telling everyone what
happened.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God Chandler! I can’t believe it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You gave my father a lap dance!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why do they put so much steam in there?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ‘Cause otherwise they’d have to call it the room room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why? Okay? Why? Wh-wh-why did that have to happen?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, it’s not that big a deal!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not that big a deal? There…there was touching of things.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now, I know you wanted to bond with my dad, but did you really have to
bond to that part?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Listen, I’m sure that dad doesn’t care. He probably thought
this was funny; he’ll be telling this story for years!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t want him to tell this story for years.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, but he will. He still tells the story how Monica tried to escape from
fat camp.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wasn’t escaping.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then how did you get caught in the barbed wire?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was trying to help out a squirrel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You were trying to eat it!
(The phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If that is your father calling to tell this story then the
marriage is off!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (takes the phone from Ross) Come on. (Answering phone) Hello? (Listens)
I’m sorry you have the wrong number. (Listens) (Whispering) Okay, I’ll call you
later dad. I love you. (Hangs up.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Ross, and Rachel are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (getting up) All right, I’m off to see your dad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa-whoa, aren’t you a little over dressed?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughing) Yeah, and-and you better make sure he tips you this time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I figured I would try to convince him not to tell the story
anymore, and I figure the best way to do that is face to face—And by face I
don’t mean his lap. And by face, I don’t mean my ass. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) Hey are you getting Monica and Chandler an engagement present?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know. Y’know, they didn’t get us anything.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well hello! So, when are we gettin’ back out on the water matey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh uh, I don’t know the boat way to say this, but uh never!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because! You’re mean on the boat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? I was just trying to teach you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, lesson learned! Rachel is mean!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeeeeeep… Yep-yep-yep-yep-yep. I remember when she took out on her
dad’s boat she wouldn’t let me help at all.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me, I wanted you to help, but you couldn’t move your arms
because you were wearing three life jackets.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You have to respect the sea! (Storms off.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look Joey, I’m sorry if-if you thought that was mean, but I gotta
tell ya something. That was not mean. Okay, my father is mean. He used to yell at me all
the time on the boat, I mean it was horrible. I was just being a good teacher.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Does a good teacher say, "Put down the beer pinhead!?"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, does a good student drink seven beers during his first lesson?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Six and a half! You knocked that last one out of my hand! Remember?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I didn’t want you to get hit by the boom!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well it hit me anyway! And it would’ve hurt a lot less if I had
finished that last beer.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, y’know what? I-I’m sorry. I will try to tone it
down and uh stop yelling.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You won’t boss me around anymore?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I won’t boss you around.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And you’ll be nice?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And, I’ll be nice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And you’ll be topless?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And—Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you want me to learn?!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is trying out different cookie recipes.
Ross and Phoebe are the tasting group.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, here’s batch 22. Ohh, maybe these’ll taste a little like
your grandmother’s. This has a little bit of orange peel, but no nutmeg.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let’s give it a shot.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Man, I have not made this many cookies since I was in the
ninth grade.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, what was that for? Like a bake sale?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, just a Friday night.
(They all take a bite.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh, these are pretty good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but not as good as batch 17.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Which one was that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The ones we had right after you almost threw up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah! Batch 17 was good. I did not like batch 16. (Burps a
little bit.) I’m okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are there anymore from the good batch? ‘Cause we could just work
off of those.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, ooh yeah, I think there is one from batch 17 left, uh… (Grabs a
cookie and takes a big bite out of it and doesn’t like it.) It’s batch 16! 16
people! Get out of the way! (Gets up and runs for the bathroom.)
[Scene: The Mr. Bowmont, its Joey’s second lesson with Rachel as the resident
sailing expert.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Joey honey, you’re doing really good! All right, now I’m
just gonna need you to step to the port side. (Joey pauses as he tries to remember which
side is the port side.) Remember? Remember how we talked about the port side?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s left sweetie, but that’s okay sweetie, that’s a
tough one.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know why you just don’t say left.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, go to the left. (Joey goes starboard or sits on the right side of
the boat.) The left!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (yelling) Just sit over there!! (Points to the port side.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (hurrying over) Okay! Okay, you’re yelling again! See that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No-no, no-no-no, very quiet, said with love, no yelling.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, y’know what? Since I’m here, I think I’m gonna have me
a little beer on the port side. (Grabs and opens one.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Joey, we’re luffing a little bit, so could you tighten up the
cunningham? (The mainsail has started to flap in the wind and has stopped working
efficiently; she wants him to tighten it so that it starts working again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, wow, you just said a bunch of stuff I didn’t know there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, come on! We just went over this! (She does it instead.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, y’know, when we did that was when that bird was flying overhead
with the fish in his mouth. Did you see it? It was gross!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (angrily) No! All right?! I did not see the bird! I did not
see the fish! I did not see the piece of Styrofoam that was shaped like Mike Tyson!
I did not, because I was trying to teach you how to sail a boat! Which
obviously is an impossible thing to do!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right that’s it! You’re yelling and I don’t see you
taking your top off! I quit!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What do you mean you quit?! You can’t quit!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because you’re not finished yet and I won’t have it! Greens do
not quit!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Greens? I’m a Tribbiani! And Tribbianis quit!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, wait did I—I just said Greens don’t quit
didn’t I? (Pause) (Angrily) Did I just say Greens don’t quit?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes! Yes! You did and you’re still yelling at me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No! No! I’m not yelling at you, I’m just yelling near you.
Oh God Joey, ohh I’m my father. Oh my God, this is horrible! I’ve been trying so
hard not to be my mother I did not see this comin’. Oh, Joey, I’m sorry.
I’m so sorry. I just wanted you to learn.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, hey I did learn.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Come on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Awww…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it’s okay. I know what a mainsail is. (Points to it. It’s
the larger sail.) I know, I know to duck when the boom comes across. I-I know port is
right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Left.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damnit!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, the cookie trying period has pasted. Monica,
Phoebe, and Ross are reflecting on the day’s events.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know, I bet it would actually make my grandmother very happy to
know that we’re trying to figure out her recipe. I bet she’s l-l-lookin’ up
at us and smiling right now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Looking up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah—No, she was really nice to me, but she’s in hell for
sure.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I’ve tried everything. I give up. I guess I’m not gonna
be the mom who makes the world’s best chocolate cookies. I do make the best duck
confit with broccoli rabe. Kids love that right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aww, Pheeb, come on isn’t there any relative that would have the
recipe? What about, what about your sister?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no-no, no, I made a promise to myself that the next time I would talk
to Ursula would be over my dead body. And that’s not happening ‘til October 15th,

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s the day you’re gonna die? See—darnit, I’ve got
shuffleboard that day.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s what you think.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I mean what about friends of your grandmother’s?
Wouldn’t they have the recipe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, y’know I may have relatives in France who would know. My
grandmother said she got the recipe from her grandmother, Nesele Tolouse.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What was her name?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nesele Toulouse.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nestle Tollhouse?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you Americans always butcher the French language.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (grabbing a bag of Nestle Tollhouse chocolate chips) Phoebe, is this
the recipe? (Tosses her the bag.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading the recipe on the back of the bag) Yes!! (Realizes.) Ohh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I cannot believe that I just spent the last two days trying to figure
out the recipe and it was in my cupboard the whole time!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know! You see it is stuff like this which is why (Looking down)
you’re burning in hell!!

scenes.location: The Gym, Chandler and Mr. Geller are heading for the whirlpool room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you understand, I’d feel a lot more comfortable if you
didn’t tell people what happened. Y’know, I’m a little…I’m a
little embarrassed about it.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I understand completely, there’s nothing more horrifying than
embarrassing yourself in front of your in-laws. As a matter of fact, when I started dating
Judy I was unemployed, and her father asked me what I did for a living and I told him I
was a lawyer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What did you do when they found out?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: They never did, so if ever see me giving them legal advice just nod
along. Shall we?
(Chandler nods along and they enter the whirlpool room and remove their robes. Only
Chandler is lacking a certain item of clothing. You see this is a coed whirlpool, which
means swimsuits, and in fact there are two women already there and Chandler didn’t
seem to wear his. Needless to say, everyone is shocked, including Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So I guess we wear swimsuits in here!
Ending Credits

scenes.location: The Mr. Bowmont, is tied up alongside the pier; Joey and Rachel are relaxing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well Joey, I hate to admit it, your way of sailing is a lot more fun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Hey, why don’t you give a pull on that rope? (Points.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh we’re not sailing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just pull on it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. (She does so and it brings the cooler closer together.)
Hey-hey-hey!! (Sees what’s in the cooler.) Sandwiches!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What else?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (hands him one) Here you go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow! (She takes a bite, but holds the sandwich vertically so that the
stuff falls out.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What you—don’t hold it like that! You’re lettin’ all
the good stuff fall out.
(More falls out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh whoops.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Careful! You’re wasting good pastrami! (Gasps.) Oh my God! I’m my
dad!

title: The One with Rachel's Assistant

lines.text: [Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, everyone is there and they are finishing
watching the first episode of Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E. Joey is of course Mac.]

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.text: (on TV) Well, if we learned one thing today C.H.E.E.S.E. is that
cheerleaders and high explosives don’t mix. (Cut to Joey laughing while Rachel,
Chandler, and Monica aren’t amused.)

lines.speaker: C.H.E.E.S.E
lines.text: You can say that again Mac.

lines.speaker: Mac
lines.text: Well, I couldn’t have done it without you buddy. You’re a genius.

lines.speaker: C.H.E.E.S.E
lines.text: Oh yeah? Well then how come I can’t get my VCR to stop
blinking 12:00?
(They both break into a huge laugh and do that stop motion thing they had at the end of
ChiPs.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughing and turning off the TV) So, what did you guys think?
(They all make happy faces as they are unable to express their feelings verbally.
Finally, the phone rings and the race to answer it is won by Monica.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? (Listens) Hold on please. Joey, it’s your mom.
(Hands him the phone.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s your mommy. It’s your mommy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohhhh…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s nice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Mom, so what did you think? (He walks away allowing the gang a
chance to figure out what they’re gonna say.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well that was umm…Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It wasn’t the best.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was one of the worse things ever. And not just on TV.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wh-what are we gonna tell him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, the lighting was okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh no you don’t! You got lighting last time, lighting is mine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And I have costumes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh great! That means I’m stuck with, "So, we were watching you
in there (Points to the TV) and you were sittin’ right here! Whoa!"
(Phoebe gets up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you gonna do Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know. I don’t know. I can’t lie to him again. Oh
no I—no! I’m just gonna press my breasts up against him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And say nothing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh, yeah that’s right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (hangs up the phone) Wow! Well, my folks really liked it! So what-what did
you guys think? (Phoebe smiles, walks up to him, and presses her breasts against him.) It
wasn’t that good.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Monica are reading on the couch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, do you think that your favorite animal says much about you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? You mean behind my back?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, excitedly) Oh! Hi you guys, oh my God! You’ll never
gonna believe happened to me today! I am sitting in my office and…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering from bathrooms excitedly) You guys! You guys! You’re not
gonna believe what my agent just told me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! Kinda in the middle of a story here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, sorry. Sorry. You finish, go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, so anyway I’m sittin’ in my office and guess who walks
in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m gonna be on two TV shows!

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, that’s great!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you weren’t finished?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Guess who walks into my office is the end of my story. (To Monica
and Phoebe) It was Ralph Lauren! (Monica and Phoebe gasp) Ralph Lauren walked into my
office!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh Rach, if you’re gonna start another story, at least let me finish
mine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s the same story.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (groans in disgust) Wow, it’s really long.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (ignoring him) Anyway, Ralph just came in to tell me that he’s so
happy with my work that he wants me to be the new merchandising manager for polo retail.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Still get a discount on wedding dresses?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m so happy for you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, these really are the days of our lives.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, since you ask. They want me back on Days of Our Lives!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) Oh God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I got—I get a big pay raise!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’ll be playing Drake Remoray’s twin brother, Stryker!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oooh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I get to hire my own assistant!

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Ahhh!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (jumps up) Well—I got a head rush from standing up to fast right
there.
[Scene: Rachel’s New Office, she’s interviewing a potential new assistant,
Hilda.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading the resume) And you were at this job for four years?

lines.speaker: Hilda
lines.text: That’s right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well this is all very impressive Hilda, um I just have one last
question for you. Uh, how did I do? Was this okay?

lines.speaker: Hilda
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ve never interviewed anyone before. I’ve actually never had
anyone work for me before. Although when I was a kid, we did have a maid, but this
is-this isn’t the same thing.

lines.speaker: Hilda
lines.text: No dear. It’s not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. Yeah, and I know that. All right, well thank you so much for coming
in it was nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Hilda
lines.text: Thank you! Good meeting you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. (Hilda exits) I’m a total pro!
(There’s a knock on the door and a handsome man enters.)

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing him) Wow! H-umm! Hi! Yes, uh I’m sorry the models are
actually down the hall.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Actually, I’m here about the assistant job.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?! (Taking his resume) Okay well then, all right, well just have a
seat there. Umm, so what’s—what is—what’s your name?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Tag Jones.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh, go on.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: That’s it. That’s my whole name.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s your whole name, okay of course it is! Okay, well
let’s-let’s just have a look-see here. (Looking at his resume)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I know I haven’t worked in an office before, and I really don’t
have a lot of experience, but uh…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh come on, what are you talking about? You’ve got three years
painting houses. Two whole summers at T.G.I. Friday’s, come on!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: It’s lame, I know. But I’m a goal-oriented person, very eager to
learn…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, hold on just a second. (She grabs a camera out of the desk and
takes his picture.) I’m sorry, it’s for human resources, everybody has to do it.
Could you just stand up please?
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler is sitting on the couch when some unknown guy comes in
and sits in their easy chair.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no. (Waves him away as Monica and Phoebe enter whispering to
each other.) Hey! (Monica shushes him.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Monica) Anyway, I should go. Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Hey sweetie.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi sweetie. So, what was with all the whispering?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t tell you. It’s a secret.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Secret? Married people aren’t supposed to have secrets between
one another. We have too much love and respect for one another.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Awww. (Kisses him.) But still no.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No I’m serious, we should tell each other everything. I do
not have any secrets from you.

lines.speaker: Monica
