lines.text: Really? Okay, so why don’t you tell me what happened to Ross Junior
year at Disneyland?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no, I can’t do that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: If you tell me, I’ll tell you what Phoebe said.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, Ross and I are going to Disneyland and we stop at this
restaurant for tacos. And when I say restaurant, I mean a guy, a hibachi, and the trunk of
his car. So Ross has about 10 tacos. And anyway, we’re on Space Mountain and
Ross starts to feel a little iffy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God. He threw up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, he visited a little town south of throw up. (Monica laughs
hysterically.) So what was Phoebe’s secret?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Nancy Thompson from Phoebe’s old massage place is getting
fired.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s it?! I gave up my Disneyland story for that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right! You lose sucker!! (Pause) Please still marry me.

scenes.location: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler, Rachel, and Phoebe are there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, you have an assistant right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (angrily) Did she call? You-you told her I was sick right? Always tell
her I am sick!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I-I just don’t know how you decide who to hire. I mean
I’ve got it narrowed down to two people. One of them has great references and a lot
of experience and then there’s this guy…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What about him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I love him. He’s so pretty I wanna cry! I don’t know what to
do. Tell me what to do.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on you know what to do! You hire the first one! You don’t hire
an assistant because they’re cute, you hire them because they’re qualified.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh. No, I hear what you’re saying and-and-and that makes a lot
of sense but can I just say one more thing? (Takes out his picture.) Look how pretty!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Let’s see. (Looking at the picture) Oh my God! Oh… But no! No!
You can’t-you can’t hire him, because that—it’s not professional. Umm,
this is for me (The picture) yes? Thanks. (Puts it in her pocket.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay you’re right. I’ll hire Hilda tomorrow. Dumb old perfect
for the job Hilda!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me see this guy. (Phoebe hands him the picture.) W-H-Wow!
Don’t show this to Monica! And don’t tell her about the W-H-Wow!
[Scene: The Days of Our Lives producer’s office, Joey is entering to find
Terry there.]

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Terry!

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Good to see you again!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s been a while, huh? Wow, it’s funny these halls look smaller
then they used to.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: It’s a different building.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So! Stryker Remoray huh? When do you want me to start?

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Why don’t we start right now!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Here are the audition scenes. (Holds out the script.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking between the pages and him) Audition? I thought you were gonna
offer me the part.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Why would you think that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I was Dr. Drake Remoray, Stryker’s twin brother. I mean, who
looks more me than me right?

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Everybody has to audition.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know Terry, I-I don’t really need to do this. I got my
own cable TV series, (Pause) with a robot.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: I’m sorry Joey that’s…that’s the way it is.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well. I guess you think you’re pretty special huh? Sittin’ up
here in your fancy small hall building. Makin’ stars jump through hoops for ya, huh?
Well y’know what? (Throws the script away) This is one star who’s hoop…
This is a star that the hoop—this hoop—I was Dr. Drake Remoray!
[Scene: Rachel’s office, she’s there as Tag knocks on the door and enters
carrying a plant.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Tag. What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I just wanted to come by and thank you for not laughing in my face
yesterday. And I noticed there aren’t any plants in your office so I wanted to bring
you your first… (Notices her plant) There is a plant in your office.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Kinda.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Right. So I guess I shouldn’t put good at noticing stuff on my resume.
(Sets the plant down on her desk.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-ohh, thank you.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Anyway, I’m guessing you hired somebody.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well…

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Gotcha. Thanks again for meeting with me. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I hired you!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! You-you got the job! You’re my new assistant!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I am?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I can’t believe it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Me either. Umm, all right, first thing I need you to do is go downstairs
and find a women named Hilda and tell her to go home.
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is setting the table for dinner as
Chandler enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Good, you’re home!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh it’s always nicer to here than, "Aw crap! You
again!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey baby. (Kisses him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I made you a surprise.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, tacos! Ever since you told me that story I’ve had such a
craving for them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did you not understand the story?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! What’s up?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, nothin’ much. Just trying to figure out what I’m gonna do
for dinner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (notices the table) Hey—Ooh! What’s-what’s that, dinner
stuff? You making dinner?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! (The oven dings.) Shhh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What you got over there? Tacos?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No. They’re umm… They’re just uh…ground beef
smileys. (Holding up one of the shells.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhh, those are tacos.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Excuse me Mr. Mexico.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Eh, either way I’ll pass. (Quietly to Chandler) I still can’t
eat those. (Monica is getting something out of the fridge and starts laughing.)
What’s so funny?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (trying not to laugh) I’m not laughing.
(Ross and Chandler move closer to her and she starts laughing again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) You told her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nancy Thompson’s getting fired! (Monica slaps him on the
shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Monica) Look, okay-okay I had food poisoning! It’s not like I
choose to do it! It’s not like—It’s not like I said, "Umm, what would
make this ride more fun?!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re right. I mean I’m sorry. Yeah, I shouldn’t be
laughing. I should be laying down papers for you! (Runs off laughing which gets Chandler
laughing.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) How could you tell her?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I had too okay?! We’re getting married! Married couples
can’t keep secrets from one another!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh really? Well I-I guess Monica should know about Atlantic City.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Du-ude!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (running up to Ross) What happened in Atlantic City?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, Chandler and I are in a bar…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did you not hear me say, "Du-ude?!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And this girl is making eyes at Chandler, okay? So after awhile he-he goes
over to her and uh, after a minute or two, I see them kissing. Now, I know what
you’re thinking, Chandler’s not the type of guy who just goes to bars and makes
out with girls, and you’re right, Chandler’s not the type of guy who just goes
to bars and makes out with…girls.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) You kissed a guy?!! Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: In my defense, it was dark and he was a very pretty guy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh Mon, I laughed so hard…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ho-ho, so hard we had to throw out your underwear again?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whatever dude, you kissed a guy.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Phoebe is giving Joey a massage as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey—Ooh, how’s Hilda? Is she working out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, my new assistant is working out, yes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Was she happy you gave her the job?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, my-my new assistant has very happy that I hired my new assistant.
(The phone rings and Joey answers it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? (Listens) Oh hey! Can you, can you hang on a second? (To
Phoebe and Rachel) It’s the producers over at Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E. can you excuse me
for a minute? (On phone) Hey, funny you should call. I was just looking over next
week’s script. (Listens) Canceled?! (Listens) Like they’re taking it off the
air? (Listens) Ohh. (Listens) All right, see you Monday. (Listens) We’re not even
shootin’ them anymore?!! (Listens) All right, bye! (Hangs up) They canceled Mac and
C.H.E.E.S.E!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why would they do that?! It was a good show right?!
(Phoebe and Rachel both pause, look at each other, and go press their breasts against
him. Which Joey doesn’t mind, of course.)
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler, Monica, and Ross are still giving
away all of their secrets.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You wanna tell secrets?! Okay! Okay! In college, Ross used to wear leg
warmers!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right! All right! Chandler entered a Vanilla Ice look-a-like contest
and won!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross came in forth and cried!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! (Laughing)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, is that funny?! Oh, you-you find that funny?! Well maybe Chandler
should know some of your secrets too!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I-I already told him everything! (Threateningly) You shush!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Once Monica was sent to her room without dinner, so she ate the macaroni
off a jewelry box she’d made.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross used to stay up every Saturday night to watch Golden
Girls!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica couldn’t tell time ‘til she was 13!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s hard for some people!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Of course it is. (Mouths to Ross) Wow—whoa!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler one time wore my underwear to work!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, I’m sorry I couldn’t think of anymore for Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh! Ohh! In college, Chandler got drunk and slept with the lady who
cleaned our dorm!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whatever dude, you kissed a guy.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is still bumming about cancellation of Mac and
C.H.E.E.S.E.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How could this happen to me?! Yesterday I had two TV shows! Today,
I got nothin’!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well wait a minute, what happened to Days of Our Lives?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, well they might be a little mad at me over there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well maybe I got a little upset and maybe I told them where they could go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, why would you do that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because they wanted me to audition!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You! An actor?! That’s madness!
[Scene: Rachel’s Outer Office, Tag is sitting at his desk as Rachel walks up. She
stops and watches him pick up the phone.]

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Rachel Green’s office. (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Tag? (He turns and looks at her.) Hi, who was that?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (shyly) Nobody. I was just practicing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? (Giggles.)
(Phoebe rounds the corner.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Hi! Rachel Green’s office.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You must be Hilda.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, this is Tag. Tag, this is Phoebe. Phoebe, can I see you for a
second? (Goes into office.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Phoebe! That’s a great name.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you like that? You should hear my phone number.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (grabbing Phoebe) Okay. We’ll be right back. (They go into her
office and she closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you hired yourself a little treat did ya?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right I know, I know how it looks Pheebs, but I’m telling

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But-but you know you cannot get involved with your assistant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, I know that. I know that. And I know that hiring him was probably
not the smartest thing that I’ve ever done. But I’m telling you, from this
moment on I swear this is strictly professional. (There’s a knock on the door.) Yes?
(Kathy enters (Because she’s listed in the credits).)

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Hey Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Kathy
lines.text: Cute assistant! What’s his story? Is he…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Gay? Yeah. (Kathy leaves dejectedly.)

scenes.location: Terry’s office, Joey has come to beg for a second chance.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Terry.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: Joey Tribbiani! I’m surprised your big head could fit through our
small halls! (Gets up) I gotta go Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait! Terry! Wait—Look—Wait I-I… Look, I’m really
sorry about before. I was an idiot thinking I’m too big to audition for you. You
gotta give me another chance.

lines.speaker: Terry
lines.text: I can’t help you Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait! Terry! Please! Look, I just lost my other job. Okay? You have no
idea how much I need this. Please, help me out, for old times sake.
[Cut to a hospital room set on the Days of Our Lives stage. Two nurses are
standing next to a bed with a man whose face is completely covered in bandages and reading
his chart.]
Nurse #1: This poor guy’s been in a coma for five years. It’s
hopeless.
Nurse #2: It’s not hopeless! Dr. Stryker Remoray’s a miracle worker.
Look, here he comes.
(Stryker enters, only it’s not Joey playing him.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Stryker Remoray
lines.text: Good morning. (He walks over to the bed, leans down, and
whispers to him.) Drake, it’s your brother Stryker. Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: And cut!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (jumping up and removing the bandages) I’m back baby! Ha-ha-ha!
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler, Monica, and Ross are sitting there and not talking to
each other.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, in my defense, umm there was no glitter on the macaroni and
very little glue.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And in my defense, the cleaning lady came on to me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) You have no trouble telling time now right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Quick! What time is it?! (Holds his watch in front of her face.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t know! Time to kiss a guy maybe?! (Ross laughs.) What are
you laughing at Pampers? (He stops laughing and glares at her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know when I said that because we’re getting married that
we should share everything and not have any secrets?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah that was stupid. Let’s not do that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, absolutely.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And! We should keep all the stuff uh, we told each other secret from
everybody else.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, definitely!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, (gets up) if you’ll excuse me, I-I’m gonna go hang out
with some people who don’t know the Space Mountain story.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Then, I’d steer clear of Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Man! (Monica mouths, "I’m sorry.")

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, and not that you would, but I wouldn’t hang out
with…all the guys in my office.
(Ross storms out.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Rachel’s office, she’s looking at a picture of Tag when he knocks and
enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (noticing him) Hi! (Puts the pictures away.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Do you have a minute?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well yeah, sure, what’s up?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I got asked out twice today when I was at lunch…by guys.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh really?!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Yeah. Did you tell someone that I was gay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, did you not want people to know that?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: But I’m not gay. And I especially wouldn’t want you to think I
was gay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why’s that?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I don’t think I should say.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, you can say. Come on, I don’t want you to feel like you
can’t tell me things. (Motions for him to sit down.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Well…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I’d love to ask out your friend Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Pause) Yeah, she’s gay.

title: The One with the Engagement Picture

lines.text: [Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica and Phoebe are going through a bunch of
pictures as Chandler enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Someone on the subway licked my neck! Licked my neck!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Willie’s still alive!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you guys doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, my mom called, they’re gonna run our engagement announcement in
the local paper, so we’re looking for a good picture of us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oooh, I’m afraid that does not exist.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s not true, there are great pictures of us!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, there are great pictures of you standing next to a guy who’s
going like this… (Makes what can only be described as a toothy frown. Henceforth,
this shall be known as The Face.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! That’s the creep that you’re with at the Statue
of Liberty.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know what it is, I just can’t take a good picture.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking at one) Oh, here’s a great one.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’m not in that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, but look at me all tan.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, why don’t you guys go, get portraits done by a professional
photographer.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s a good idea! I bet they have one of those wind machines!
Y’know… (Does the whole hair blowing in the wind model type poses.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah that’s great! Next to that, Chandler won’t look so
stupid.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler what do you say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, but I should warn you, I’m not going. I’m going.
(Does The Face while saying that last part.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Rachel is siting on the couch as Ross and Chandler enter after
playing basketball.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) Dude, that reverse lay-up! Oh…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How about those three pointers?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Amazing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And those guys were this (Doing the standard "This
Close" gesture) close to lettin’ us play this time too.
(They both get dejected and go sit down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey look-look, Phoebe’s talking to uh, Cute Coffeehouse Guy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you guys call him Cute Coffeehouse Guy, we call him Hums While He
Pees.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, and we call Ross Lingers In The Bathroom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (returning) Hey you guys, Hums While He Pees just asked me out!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, I thought that guy was married.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He is! But he’s getting divorced—Ross! Maybe you know him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s not a club.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, if this guy’s going through a divorce, is it such a good
idea to start going out with him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, divorced men are not bad men!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They have that on the napkins at the club.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I gotta get back to work.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You don’t have to be back for a half-hour!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah but, my assistant Tag does sit-ups in the office during lunch. Ohh!
I could just spread him on a cracker.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Rach, if you have a crush on this guy, why would you hire him? I mean
y’know you can’t date him right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, I know that. I know that. Although, we made a joke that we spend
so much time together he should call me his work wife.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Soon he’ll be able to call you, that lady he knew who got fired.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am not gonna get fired, because I’m not gonna act on it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you wouldn’t mind if he was dating someone else?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why? Is he? He is! Isn’t he? He’s dating that slut in
marketing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe I should open a divorced men’s club.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dude that is so sad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I could put uh-uh a basketball court in the back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Could I play?
[Scene: Rachel’s Outer Office, she’s returning from lunch to see Tag not
doing his sit-ups.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no sit-ups today Tag?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I just did them.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well drop and give me ten more!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, I-I had a drink with lunch. Did those cost reports come in?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Yeah, I filled them out last night?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, great could you make me four copies of those?
(He gets up to make the copies leaving Rachel alone with his stuff. She notices his
sweater in his backpack and holds it up to her nose as Melissa, a coworker, walks up.)

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Hey Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (startled) Ahh, hi! Hi! Melissa, what’s up? I’m just uh, about
to umm, go out to the store to get some stuff to put in my backpack. Y’know, like
dried fruit and granola and stuff. What’s up? (She has put on the backpack.)

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Umm, is Tag here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. Why?

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Oh, I was gonna talk to him about doing something tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?! Got a little crush on Tag there do ya?

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Well, we’ve been flirting back and forth, but I was hoping that
tonight it would turn into something a little more than that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, whoa-whoa easy there Melissa! This ain’t a locker room, okay?
But, y’know I remember him saying that-that he had plans tonight.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Oh no!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah. All right, back to work.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Hey! Isn’t that Tag’s backpack.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah Melissa, I don’t want to be known as the uh, office bitch, but
I will call your supervisor.
(Melissa beats a hasty retreat.)
[Scene: A Portrait Studio, Chandler and Monica are trying to take their engagement
picture. Monica has a beautiful smile, while Chandler isn’t.]

lines.speaker: The Photographer
lines.text: (taking pictures) Great! That’s great Monica! Great! Now,
Chandler, you want to give us a smile?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Does The Face.)

lines.speaker: The Photographer
lines.text: I’m sorry, is the seat uncomfortable?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I am.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, listen to me sweetie, I know you can do this. Okay? You have a
beautiful smile.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I do? (He smiles, beautifully.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! (They turn to the camera, and Chandler does The Face again.) All
right, maybe you don’t have to smile. Let’s try something else. Let’s try
umm, try looking sexy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (You’ll have to see it, I can’t describe the face he
makes, but it isn’t good.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Or not.
[Scene: Rachel’s Office, Joey is knocking on the door holding a hand over a spot
on his shirt.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Joey! What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, well I’ve got an audition down the street and I spilled sauce
all over the front of my shirt. (Removes his hand to reveal a huge sauce stain.) You got
an extra one?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, sure. Umm…here. (Hands him one.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great. (He doesn’t like it.) You got anything that’s not Ralph
Lauren?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I don’t think so Joe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I guess this will be fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, listen umm, what-what are you doing tonight?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing, why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How would you feel about taking out my assistant Tag? I’ll pay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh, Rach I got to say it’s gonna take a lot of money for me to go
out on a date with a dude.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not asking you to go on a date with him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? ‘Cause I could kinda use the money.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, just-just he-he’s new in town and I know he doesn’t have
any guy friends. Just take him to like a ball game or something. I’ll really
appreciate it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, no problem. (Sees something.) Ooh—Hey, donuts!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (He grabs a jelly donut, takes a bite, and guess what he spills all
over himself. He tries to clean it up and smears it all over the shirt.)
[Scene: A Portrait Studio, Chandler and Monica are still trying to get the picture
taken.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know. Let’s try a look…of far off…wonderment. Okay,
we’ll-we’ll gaze into our future and we’ll think about our marriage and the
days to come. (Chandler is still not getting it.) Chandler! What is the matter with your
face?! I mean this picture is supposed to say "Geller and Bing to be married,"
not "Local woman saves drowning moron!" (The photographer laughs.) Hey!
Don’t laugh at him! He’s my drowning moron!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aww! (Smiles.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s it! Take it! Take it! Take it!
(Chandler turns to the camera and does The Face.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler, Monica, and Ross are going over the picture proofs.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I like this one. (Points to it.) It seems to say, "I love you and
that’s why I have to kill you."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They can’t all be bad. (To Chandler) Find the one where you make
your bedroom eyes. Ohh, there it is.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God! Those are my bedroom eyes?! Why did you ever sleep with me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you really want to pull at that thread?
(Phoebe enters with Hums While He Pees also known as Kyle.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m having a really good time!

lines.speaker: Hums While He Pees
lines.text: Me too! I’m sorry that guy in the subway licked your
neck.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh. No that’s okay, he’s a friend.

lines.speaker: Hums While He Pees
lines.text: Hey uh, I don’t mean to be presumptuous but I have
these two tickets to the ballroom dancing finals tomorrow night if you want to go?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I… Well y’know I-I mean I missed the-the semi-finals, so
I’d just be lost.

lines.speaker: Hums While He Pees
lines.text: I know it’s really lame, but I got these tickets from
my boss and—Oh no! No! No! My God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, don’t freak out. I’ll go.

lines.speaker: Hums While He Pees
lines.text: No it’s… Uh, my ex-wife Whitney is out there. I
cannot deal with her right now. That woman is crazy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I know. Hold on. (She walks over to the couch.) Hey Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, umm that’s Whitney (Points), Kyle’s ex-wife out there,
now do you think that you can y’know divert her so that we can slip out?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well okay but I have two tickets to the ballroom dance finals. (She
holds up the tickets that Kyle gave her.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I don’t think so Pheebs. (Pause) All right, I’ll do it.
But just because you’re a friend. (Grabs the tickets and heads to divert Whitney.)
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Ross is dancing around his living room as Phoebe enters,
catching and startling him.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi Ginger.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right! I want my key back!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t have it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s right there! (Points to her hand.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh, okay Sherlock! (Hands over the key.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I’m sorry but you-you-you better go Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, well I just wanted to say thank you though for diverting
Kyle’s ex.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah—No—You’re welcome. We’ll talk about it later.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
(Ross opens the door to reveal Whitney standing there.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi Whitney.

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.text: Hi Ross! You ready for breakfast?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yep. (Phoebe slams the door shut.) Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Ross) Kyle’s ex-wife? You were supposed to divert her not date
her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (opens the door and to Whitney) Hi! I’m sorry, but can you give me a
second while I talk to this woman, who by the way did not spend the night.

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (Closes the door.) (To Phoebe) I did divert her and we ended
up having a great time! Okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Watching ballroom dancing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! That’s where we realized we were both super cool people!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well look-look, okay Ross, Kyle just told me some really bad
stuff about her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Like she’s really mean, and she’s over critical,
and-and—No! She will paint a room a really bright color without even checking
with you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And! She uses sex as a weapon!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine! Thank you for warning me. At breakfast I’ll be on full alert
for room painting and sex weapons.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re still gonna go out with her?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, didn’t you just hear what I said?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs come on! I mean, consider the source! Of course her
ex-husband’s gonna say that stuff. Now, if you’ll excuse me…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting him) No listen to me! She is crazy!

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.text: (outside the door) Uh, your door isn’t sound proof.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You see? Nothing is good enough for her!

scenes.location: Rachel’s Office, Tag is arriving as Rachel is standing there.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Good morning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Tag! Hey, so did you have fun with uh, with Joey last night?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Oh yeah! We went to the Knicks game.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh that’s nice.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Then we went to this bar and he hooked us up with all these women!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wo-women? You mean like old women?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Well kinda old, like 30.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Pause) Oh.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: And I never used to be able to just talk to girls in bars, but I got like
20 phone numbers last night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s great! Wow man, so Joey must’ve really taught you some
stuff huh?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: A little.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?
(A beautiful women walks up.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (To her, in the Joey voice) How you doin’?
Commercial Break
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is teaching Chandler how to smile. Chandler is
smiling.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See? That’s a great smile! Easy. Natural. Now, pretend I have a
camera. (Chandler immediately does The Face.) You’re changing it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t help it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, all right, all right, all right, you wanna know what I do when
I take resume shots?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Borrow money from me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, first—first of all, you want to make it look spontaneous. I
look down (Looks down), look down, keep looking down; then I look up. (Looks up and
smiles.) See? All right, now you try. Look down (Chandler looks down), you’re looking
down, keep looking down…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why is there jelly on your shoe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I had a donut. (Chandler nods.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So uh, heard you had some fun with Tag last night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! That guy’s all right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah and you had fun teaching him how to be all Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know, all the women.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey well, you can’t teach someone to be good with women. Y’know,
that’s why I never had any luck with Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Pause) I’m right here!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, would-would you mind just not going out with him again? Okay,
just the idea of you and he and all these women, it’s just—And I know he’s
my assistant and I can’t date him—but it just bothers me, all right?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! No-no-no-no, you can’t take him away from me! I got a great
partner to pick up girls with! Finally!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m still right here!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, will you, will you at least tell him how hollow and
unsatisfying this, dating tons of women thing is!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shocked) What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just don’t want him to meet anybody until I am over my
crush—And I will get over it. It’s-it’s not like I love him, it’s just
physical! But—I mean I get crushes like this all the time! I mean hell, I had a crush
on you when I first met ya!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, Monica told me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did you have a crush on me, when you first met me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Sure. (Joey nods his head questioningly and Rachel nods no.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can you people not see me?! (He waves his arms around to get their
attention.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Joey) So, will you talk to him?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know Rach.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on! I’ll give you ten free Ralph Lauren shirts.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: One! (Pause.) No ten! You said ten! You can’t take that back!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is there as Tag enters carrying a bag.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Hey Joey, you wanted to talk to me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know. You uh, you got something for me?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Oh, yeah, this is from Rachel.
(He hands Joey the bag and he quickly counts its contents.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ten. Okay. Now Tag there’s such a thing as to many women.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, for you!
[Scene: The Portrait Studio, Monica is waiting for Chandler to make another attempt at
taking a good picture.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (seeing him approach) Hey! There you are!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There I am!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, Joey said I uh, I needed to relax so he gave me an
antihistamine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, and then I fell asleep on the subway and went all the way to
Brooklyn. Brooklyn is f-far!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, what were you thinking?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know, but don’t worry, don’t worry, because I
know how to take a picture now. (They get ready) Okay, see? Look down (Looks down), look
down, look down… (He falls asleep.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (awakens) Yeah! (Looks up and does The Face.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross and Phoebe are there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, how are things going with crazy? Has she cooked your rabbit yet?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, you are hearing one side of the story, okay—and F.Y.I
she must’ve shown Kyle over 30 paint samples before she painted that room! And his
response to each one was, "I don’t give a tiny rat’s ass."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah well, maybe she should’ve spent a little less time decorating
and a little more time in the bedroom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I don’t think we are gonna have that problem, but maybe
that’s just because I am not emotionally unavailable!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You think he’s emotionally unavailable?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think he can be.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, maybe he wouldn’t be she didn’t bring the office home
every night!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, excuse her for knowing what she wants to do with her life!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah well, she certainly knew what she was doing New Year’s Eve

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (angrily) I knew you were gonna throw that in my face!! That
was three years ago! She apologized and she apologized! What more do you want?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gets up and starts to leave) We want the last six years back!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So do we!! So do we!! (Ross notices a couple has been staring at them.)
I’m sorry you had to see that.

scenes.location: Rachel’s Office, Tag is entering.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Good morning Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! (He hands her, her mail) Thanks, hey so uh what’d you do last
night?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Went out with Joey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah? Another night of birdogging the chickas?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: No. We had a really good talk. I don’t think I’m gonna do that
bar scene anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! I did not see that coming.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: It’s just not really who I am. Y'know, I’ve always been happier
when…Why am I telling you this? You don’t care about this stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, yes I do! I do! I mean, come on go on, you were, you were saying
I am happier when uh, y’know?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: When I’m in a relationship, I love having a girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Someone I can spoil, y’know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sp-spoil?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Uh-huh! Let me ask you something?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Do you believe that there is one perfect person for everyone?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I-I’m startin’ too.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: And if that person is already in your life, you should do something about
it right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! Hell yes!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: All right then, it’s settled.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I’m gettin’ back together with my ex-girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’d love to!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (panics, turns around, picks up the phone, and pretend to talk on it)
Hello?! (Listens) Oh, yeah! (To Tag) This is gonna be a while. Excuse me. (Tag leaves and
she closes the door behind him, disgustedly.) Yeah!
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross and Phoebe are there again, only now they’re not
talking to each other. Phoebe is loudly stirring her coffee.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. Is that annoying? And speaking about being selfish
in bed, how’s Whitney?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well maybe she wouldn’t have to be selfish in bed if someone else
knew where everything was!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh he knows! (Quietly) For the most part.
(Kyle and Whitney enter.)

lines.speaker: Kyle
lines.text: Oh hey! Good, you’re both here.

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.text: We kinda need to talk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Both of you together?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wh-what’s up?

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.text: Well, I went over to Kyle’s last night to pick up a few things and
we got to reminiscing…

lines.speaker: Kyle
lines.text: …we talked through most of the night and we realized that the reason
we were so angry at each other was because there are still feelings there. So…
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh just say it Kyle!

lines.speaker: Kyle
lines.text: We’re gonna give it another try.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What about her whining and her constant need for attention?!

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.text: I’m gonna work on that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh right, because you’re so capable of change.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Whitney) Y’know, he hums when he pees!

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.text: I do know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It makes him miss the bowl, but whatever.

lines.speaker: Whitney
lines.text: We’re so sorry. (They get up to leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s all right, we-we don’t need you. In fact, hey I’m
over it already.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and y’know what? I don’t give a tiny rat’s ass.

lines.speaker: Kyle
lines.text: Yeah, we’re gonna go. (They leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Phoebe) I’m sorry. Ugh, Pheebs, you were, you were right about
her. Y’know, she did try to use sex as a weapon! Yeah, I hurt my back a
little.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Y’know, he hums while he does other stuff to.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, were better off without them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And y’know, even if they break up again, you’d better not let
him in your sad men’s club!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Divorced men’s club.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Potato, Potaato. (She’s pronounces potato with the both the short
and long As.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe, Chandler, and Joey are there as Monica enters with the
local paper that has the engagement picture in it.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey guys check it out! My mom sent me the paper!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, let’s see it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahhh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (She opens it up and shows it to them.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, that looks good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys make a very attractive couple. (The camera cuts to a
shot of the picture and we see that Monica is posing with Joey instead of Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, we look great together.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, we really do!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! Imagine what our kids would look like!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know, we don’t have to imagine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m marrying her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We’ll just see.

title: The One with the Nap Partners

scenes.location: A Restaurant, Phoebe, Rachel, and Monica are having brunch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, the reason why I asked you guys out to brunch today is because I
have been doing some thinking about who should be my maid of honor.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! This is it! (She and Phoebe hold hands.) (To Phoebe) I really
hope it’s you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I hope it’s you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: First of all um, I love you both so much and you’re both so
important to me…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, bla-bla-bla-bla!! Who is it?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well umm, I was thinking that maybe we could come up with a system where
we trade of being maid of honor for each other. Like hypothetically, if Phoebe were
mine…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes!!! Oh!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hypothetically!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Still.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: If Phoebe were my maid of honor…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel would be Phoebe’s, I would be Rachel’s, that way we all
get to do it once and no one would get upset.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah that’s actually a pretty good idea.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I’ll do that. So who gets to be yours?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) Well that’s the best part. Umm, you guys get to
decide!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wh-why is that the best part?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because then I don’t have to!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well of course we will help you decide! We will do anything we
can to help you! Now, I would like to make a toast, to the future Mrs. Chandler Bing (A
woman at the table behind them overhears Chandler’s name and starts listening
closer), my best friend, and truly one of the nicest people that…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m really not deciding!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine!
(The woman gets up and walks over to their table.)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Excuse me, I-I couldn’t help overhearing, you’re marrying Chandler
Bing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah that’s right.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (sarcastically) Huh, good luck!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Aww, and good luck to you too! (To Monica and Rachel) What a nice lady!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Chandler, Joey, and Ross are finishing watching Die Hard
on video.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Die Hard still great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yep. Hey, what do you say we make it a double feature?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’d you rent?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Die Hard 2.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking at the tape) Joey, this is Die Hard 1 again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, well we watch it a second time and its Die Hard 2!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, we just saw it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And it’ll be cool to see it again! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: Die Hard!!!!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude, you didn’t say Die Hard. Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I just got uh, got plans.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, John McLane had plans!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, see the thing is I want to get out of here before Joey gets all
worked up and starts calling everybody bitch.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you talking about? Bitch.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is bringing Rachel some coffee.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, when I get married will you be my maid of honor?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God Phoebe! I mean I’m just—Wait a minute. If I’m
your maid of honor that means you are Monica’s.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Well, if that’s what you want…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! No way Phoebe! I want to be Monica’s!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But why does it even matter?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why does it matter so much to you?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because this one is now! And-and it’s two of our best
friends! Who knows what you’re gonna marry!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What-what if I marry Ross—Or Joey?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) You wouldn’t! Okay look, Rachel I know you really want to
do this, but I-I’ve never been maid of honor to anyone before! And I know you’ve
done it at least twice!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah but Phoebe…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And no, oh please, oh please let me finish. (Rachel stops talking.) Oh I
guess that was it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay. It’s—since you’ve never done it before you
can be Monica’s made of honor.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, thank you so much! (They hug.) Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m gonna marry someone good y’know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Better than Chandler. (Phoebe exhales as if to say, "Like what
isn’t?")
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Die Hard has ended, only I don’t think Joey and
Ross know that yet. As you see, they are both asleep. And they’re on the same couch.
Which means they’re sleeping together. Not like Joey is at one end and Ross is on the
other, they both happen to be lying down and sleeping together. Well, there hasn’t
been any clothes removed so not that kind of sleeping together. Not that
there’s anything wrong with that. That is unless you’re a Republican in which
that kind of thing will bring about the downfall of Western society, especially if they
should happen to want to get married. Anyway, let me recap. No, there is too much, let me
sum up. Ross and Joey are taking a nap together on top of each other and both wake-up at
the same time, realize what they just did, scream, and jump up.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What happened?!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I don’t know!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We fell asleep! That is all.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Yep. Yeah. All right, well uh, I’d better go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think that would be best.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. All right, I’ll talk to you later.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. But not about this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! Never! Never! (Pause, then Joey wants to shake Ross’s hand.) Bye.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No touch! No touch!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica has just gotten back from brunch and is
telling Chandler about it.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah hey, a weird thing happened today whey I was at brunch. This woman
overheard that I was marrying you and-and then she…she wished me good luck.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s sweet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it’s more like a (sarcastically) good luck.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So uh, what did this woman look like?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She was like 30, dark hair, attractive.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, is there any chance you were looking into a bright, shiny thing
called a mirror?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on, was it somebody maybe you dated in college?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no I only dated two girls in college, both blonde, both not
attractive… (Thinks a little while.) Hold on one second; let me check this out. (He
gets up and grabs a photo album.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, let’s see… (Finding the picture he wants.) Okay uh, is
that her? (Pointing to the picture.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God yes! Who is she?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Julie Grath, my camp girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you break up with her?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pause) No, we’re still together. Yeah we went out for two
summers, and then I broke up with her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, ‘cause she came back the third summer and she’d gotten
really fa-aa-aw-ow…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fat?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I did not say fat! I said, "Fa-aa-aw-ow…"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You broke up with a girl because she was fat?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, but it was a really, really long time ago! Does she still
feel bad?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, apparently she does.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you know what they say, elephants never forget. (Monica is not
amused by that statement.) Seriously, good luck marrying me.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is entering, Rachel and Phoebe are already there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe is gonna be Monica’s maid of honor!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Well I hope it goes better than the last time you did it for that
girl downstairs, remember? (Phoebe glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) You have been maid of honor before?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: See? This is exactly why you shouldn’t lie!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right that’s it! I am maid of honor!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Na-uh, I am!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How come you are?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because I cared enough to lie!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey-hey, I can help you decide who should do it! Yeah, we could
have like uh, like an audition and see how you’d handle maid of honor type
situations.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Like when I want a job, I go to an audition and if I’m the best of
the people they see, they give me the part.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so after this audition, who decides who gets it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh uh, me and Ross can be the judges.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) Well, it’s better than us deciding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on! This is crazy! Can’t we just flip a coin?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Coins hate me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay fine, y’know what? We will let Ross and Joey decide.
(Ross enters.) (In a sexy voice.) Hiiiii, Ross! Sweetie.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey there, you handsome thing. (Rachel and Phoebe exit.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, this cologne really is every bit as good as Georgio.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just uh, brought back your videos.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh hey look uh Ross, look I think we need to talk about before.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No we don’t!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes we do! Now look, that was the best nap I ever had!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I… I don’t know what you are talking about.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! Admit it! That was the best nap you ever had!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’ve had better.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay! When?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right! All right! It was the best nap ever!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’ve said it! Okay?! But it’s over Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I want to do it again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We can’t do it again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because it’s weird!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine! Do you want something to drink?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, what do you got?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Warm milk and Excedrin P.M. (Ross just leaves.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is approaching the bathroom door behind
which Chandler is using the facility.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! (Knocks on the door.) Chandler! I just figured out who you
are!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can you figure out what I’m doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re Lewis Posin.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Lewis Posin! He was my best friend in fifth grade, and-and then one day
I asked him to be my boyfriend and he said no. Do you know why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because you kept talking to him while he was trying to go to the
bathroom?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! But because he thought I was to faaaaa…. (Chandler emerges,
without flushing by the way.) And every time I think about it, it makes me feel as bad as
I did in fifth grade! Y’know, I-I really think that you should apologize to Julie.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? Are you kidding? That was like 16 years ago.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I know. But y’know what? It would make me feel better if Lewis
apologized to me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I will do it. But I have to warn you; this may make me a better
person and that is not the man you feel in love with!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey and Ross are laying out the ground rules for the maid
of honor auditions to Rachel and Phoebe.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, all right, this is how it’s going to work. We’re gonna
give you hypothetical maid of honor situations and you will be scored on a scale of 1 to
10, 1 being the highest.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, 10 is the highest.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why is 10 the highest?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because it’s the highest. (Joey shrugs his shoulders) Okay, Rachel
you’re up first. (Rachel stands up and gets ready.) Situation No. 1: You’re with
Monica, the wedding is about to start when Monica gets cold feet. Go! (Joey is playing the
part of Monica.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (crying) I don’t want to marry Chandler!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, uh…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’ve got cold feet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …it’s gonna be okay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, one man for the rest of my life? I don’t know if I can do it!
This means I’ll never get to sleep with Joey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look Monica, getting cold feet is very common. Y’know,
it’s-it’s just because of all the anticipation and you just have to remember
that you love Chandler. And also, I ran out on a wedding. You don’t get to keep the
gifts.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (out of his Monica character) Very good! Drawing on your own experience, I
like that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, very nice Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you judges.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh, what a kiss ass.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, Phoebe…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! Your honor?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We’re now in the ceremony, Monica is about to say, "I do"
when her drunk uncle starts yelling. What do you do? Go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (playing the drunk uncle) When Monica was a little girl, I remember
that—(Phoebe screams and tackles him)—Ooh!! Ow! Very good!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes! Excellent! Perfect score!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait a minute! She just made a scene in the middle of the ceremony!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Do you want do you want a little taste of Pheebs?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It is time for you to give your maid of honor speech.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, wait a minute, we haven’t pre…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Go!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! Okay! Umm, Webster’s Dictionary defines marriage
as… (Ross and Joey start writing.) Okay!! Forget that! That sucks!! Okay, never mind!
Forget it! Umm, umm, okay, uh… I met, I-I met, I met Monica when we were just a
couple of six year olds and I became friends with Chandler when he was 25, although he
seemed like a six year old.

lines.speaker: Ross and Joey
lines.text: Oh! That’s nice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you very much. Umm, I’ve known them separately and
I’ve known them together and-and to know them as a couple is to know that you are
truly in the presence of love. So I would like to raise my glass (Grabs a glass and holds
it up) to Monica and Chandler and the beautiful adventure they are about to embark upon
together. I can think of no two people better prepared for the journey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow. (To Ross) Good speech.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it really was!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw, thanks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay Phoebe, I guess you’re next (To Joey) although I really
don’t see the point.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I can’t believe that Monica and Chandler are getting married.
I remember talking about this day with Rachel while we were showering together, naked.
(Raises her glass and drinks.)
(Joey and Ross pause while they picture the event.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And she’s back in the game.
[Scene: A random apartment building, Chandler and Monica are knocking on the door of
the woman from the beginning.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (she opens the door) Julie hi! Chandler Bing, I, I guess you remember
me.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: Hello Skidmark.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) It’s a nickname, I’ll explain later.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s pretty clear.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, uh, I owe you a long overdue apology. I never should have broken
up with you because you were overweight.

lines.speaker: Julie
lines.text: That’s why you broke up with me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You-you-you didn’t know that. (Pause as she nods no.) Well, I
guess my work here is done!
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey and Ross are giving Phoebe and Rachel the results of their
election. Somewhat faster than Florida I might add.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, well first of all I would like to say that you both performed
very well. Okay? You should be proud of yourselves. And-and I would also like to say that
in this competition there are no losers. Well, except for Rachel—Damnit!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?! I won!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry Rach, it was, it was really close.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well then I demand a recount! (Hmm, I wonder where I’ve heard that
before.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually, it wasn’t that close.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Y’know what? No! No! You thing was so stupid anyway, this was
ridiculous—We’re gonna flip a coin! (Phoebe gasps.) All right?! (She flips the
coin.) Heads! (Looks at the coin and grunts in disgust.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The coins have finally forgiven me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y’know what? I hope Monica forgives you after you throw her,
her vegetarian, voodoo, goddess circley shower! (Runs out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (running after her) Rach, it’s gonna be okay! (To Ross and Joey)
You guys are the best!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Boy I tell ya, that judging stuff took a lot out of me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! I was thinking about maybe going upstairs and taking a little nap on
my couch. (Raises his eyebrows, questioning Ross to see if he wants to join him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why-why would I care about that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No reason, I’m just saying that uh… That’s where I’ll
be.
(Joey gets up and heads for the door. After a pause Ross decides to join him.)
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler and Monica have returned from
Julie’s.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: As bad as that went I actually enjoyed myself. I think that I’m
going to apologize for all of the stupid things I do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don’t you just stop doing stupid things? Then you wouldn’t
have to apologize.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I would really love it if could do both.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I…I have to ask.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you gonna break up with me if I get fat again?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you broke up with Julie Grath! How much weight could she have
gained?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A hundred and forty-five pounds.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: In one year?! My God what did she eat? Her-her family! That’s not
the point.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look I know it was a stupid reason to break up with somebody, but I
was 15!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well… That’s not the only time this was an issue. You remember
when umm, you spent Thanksgiving with us? You called me fat.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Okay, now wait a minute that was totally different.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You were not supposed to hear that! I said that behind you back!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What if I have babies, okay? I mean I’m gonna look different.
I’m okay with that, but I’m not sure that you are!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look you have to realize I don’t think of you as a thin,
beautiful woman. (Monica glares at him.) See this is one of things that I can apologize
for later! Look, what I mean is you’re Monica! Okay? And I am in love with Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Keep going.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you can balloon up or you can shrink down and I will still love
you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Even if I shrink down to two inches tall?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’d carry you around in my pocket.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you. (They hug and kiss.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Skidmark’s still got a way with the ladies.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is there as Rachel enters carrying a shopping bag.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! I just want to apologize. I’m really sorry I was a baby.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s ridiculous Rachel, we were all babies once. (Rachel looks at
her.) Oh, you mean today.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, and y’know you-you deserve to win. And-and y’know
I was thinking about it, if-if you’re Monica’s maid of honor that means I get to
be yours.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Oh, umm when-when Monica and Chandler got engaged I started
putting some stuff together, y’know just in case…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’s so sweet thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Here is a book of poetry that I know Monica loves. And-and ohh God this
is funny, look, this is a picture of one Halloween where she dressed up as a bride. (Shows
Phoebe the picture.) And look, she made me carry her train, which was weird because I was Wonder
Woman. Oh and here’s a little purse that I found. (Hands her the purse)
Y’know I just thought that maybe they could hold the rings in there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And umm, vintage handkerchiefs y’know ‘cause, people cry at
weddings. (Starting to cry.) I’m just gonna grab a couple of these.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This stuff is great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I forgot this was in here. Umm, this was the uh garter that I was
saving for my wedding and I wanted it to be Monica’s something borrowed and it’s
blue. (Starts to cry again.) Yeah…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know Rach, I think that, I think you should be Monica’s made
of honor.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You do? Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because I think it means more to you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But Pheebs, y’know you earned it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Its fine. I mean, this is something that you’ve been thinking about
since you were what, 14? (She’s referring to the Halloween picture.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I was ten. I just developed early.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looking at the picture again) Man alive!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey, what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, we just decided that Rachel is gonna be your maid of honor.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (gasps) Ohh, wow! That’s great! (Rachel and Monica hug.) Oh wow! We
really have to start planning! I have, I have a lot of really specific ideas! We should
probably get together like four times per week. You can come over to my place; we’ll
get together before work! What do you say, 6:30, my place? I’m so excited! (Runs out
leaving Rachel completely stunned and Phoebe laughing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah okay, you laugh now, but she’s gonna be yours. (Phoebe gets
suddenly scared.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey and Ross are napping together again and both wake up at
the same time.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great nap.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It really was.
(Suddenly Rachel clears her throat and the camera cuts to the rest of the gang staring
at them. Needless to say Joey and Ross are shocked and slowly turn their heads to see the
gang.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (reacting first by jumping up) Dude! What the hell are you doing?! God!
(Heads for his room leaving Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (slowly stands up and says quietly) Excuse me. (Exits.)

title: The One with Ross's Library Book

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is eating breakfast as Rachel enters having just woken
up.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Morning!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Oh, how was your date last night?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pretty good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh good. (She walks to the closed bathroom door, opens it, and finds a
naked woman wrapped in a towel.) Ahhh! My God, sorry! (She closes the door and confronts
Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, really good. Anyway I gotta go; I’m late for work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What-what?! You’re gonna leave this person with me?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah—Hey, don’t worry, she’s a terrific girl. And hey
listen, could you do me a favor? When she comes out could you just mention that I’m
not looking for a serious relationship; that’d be great.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why?! What?! Are you kidding?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just casually slip it in, y’know lay the groundwork. Tell her uh,
I’m a loner—No! An outlaw! Tell her she doesn’t want to get mixed up with
the likes of me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know what? That’s a lot to remember, can’t I just tell
her you’re a pig?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I’m gonna call her later! Honest! Oh come on, Chandler used to
do it! He’d even make the girl pancakes! Plus, he’d make extras and leave
‘em for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well forget it, I’m not telling that girl anything. That is not my
responsibility.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine! (Pause) Now, where’d we land on those pancakes? (She chases him
out the door as his date emerges from the bathroom.)
Joey’s Date: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.
Joey’s Date: Sorry about that, but I couldn’t get that lock to work on
the door.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, Joey kinda disabled it when I moved in.
Joey’s Date: You must be Rachel, I’m Erin.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Hi. I don’t mean this to sound like high school, but did he say
anything about me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause) Would you like some pancakes?
Opening Credits

scenes.location: N.Y.U’s University Library, Ross is entering with Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: …Come on! Why are we here?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay take a guess.
(An old woman pushes a cart full of books past.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The hot chicks?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, I was typing names into the library computer earlier,
y’know-y’know for fun, and I typed mine in and guess what came up? My doctoral
dissertation! It’s here! Yeah, it’s right-it’s right down here! In the
biggest library in the university! (They start heading that way, towards a secluded
section behind the racks.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow that’s actually pretty cool.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stopping quickly) Oh umm, there’s also a book here by a woman named
Wendy Bagina. (They both laugh, but stop when the hear moaning coming from the next
aisle.) What is that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sounds like two people are really enjoying the Dewey decimal system.
(They go around the last row of bookshelves and find a couple doing what college coeds
do in secluded corners of university libraries. For those of you who don’t know what
I’m talking about, let’s just say that clothing is undone. Ross gasps and the
couple gets up and runs away.)

lines.speaker: Female Student
lines.text: (as they are moving past Ross) I’m so sorry!

lines.speaker: Male Student
lines.text: Sorry!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You didn’t bring me here to do that, did you?
[Scene: Monica’s Restaurant Kitchen, Monica is cooking as a waitress enters
carrying a plate of food that has been sent back.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She sent the chicken back again?!

lines.speaker: The Waitress
lines.text: She says it’s to dry now and she wants to come back here and
explain to you exactly how she wants it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well fine! I want to meet this chicken expert! Send the Colonel in!
(The waitress lets her in as Monica is about to throw a lobster into a pot of boiling
water (Although, she hasn’t taken off the rubber bands that hold the claws, so she
can’t be that good of a chef). Anyway, guess who the Colonel is by the
following phrase.)

lines.speaker: The Colonel
lines.text: OH…MY…GAWD!!!! (Yep, it’s Janice.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the lobster) Lucky bastard! (Throws the lobster in and turns around
to face the planet’s most annoying woman, next to Dr. Laura and Kathy Lee Gifford of
course. She’s the most annoying female TV character however.) Janice.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: How are you Ms. Hot Shot chef with the big fancy restaurant with the
best chicken ever! (Does the laugh.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m fine.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (notices Monica’s engagement ring) Ohh! What is that on your
finger?! I’m blind!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: So, who’s the lucky guy?
[Cut to Monica and Chandler’s just after Monica has finished telling Chandler what
happened.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: OH…MY…GAWD! I am so sorry sweetie, are you okay? You
didn’t tell her we were getting married, did you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, she saw the ring.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did she freak out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, she was shocked when I told her, but then again so were most
people.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, she actually has a boyfriend y’know herself, named Clark. Uh,
she also kinda invited herself to our wedding. Clark too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughs) You said no right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You said no right?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, she corned me! She asked if the wedding was in town! I mean, what
was I supposed to do?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Lie!!! How hard is that?! The check’s in the mail! Oh your baby
