is so cute! I can’t wait to read your book Ross!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on! So she comes to the wedding! I mean it won’t be so bad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What do you think she’s just gonna sit there quietly? You
don’t think she’s gonna want to make a toast? You don’t think she’s
gonna want to grab the microphone and sing Part-time Lover?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, she’s not gonna like the chicken that night either is
she?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what? It’s gonna be okay. Y’know what?
She’s probably not gonna even want to come.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! That was a lie! See how easy that was?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So-so you would’ve just lied?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Would it really have been that easy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good, so do it Saturday night because we’re going to dinner with
her and Clark.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is coming back from work to find Phoebe, Rachel, and
someone else with her back turned is there.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! What’s up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey, who’s your friend? (Erin turns around to face Joey,
startling him) Hey!!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Hey Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Erin! Still here!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, we ended up spending the day together and had such a great time!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why wouldn’t ya? Erin is great! Then-then there’s you guys.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Ohh, listen. I’ve got to get going. Today was great, thanks!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Bye Joey. (Kisses him.) Last night was fun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. I’ll uh, I’ll call ya.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh and I’ll call ya too!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Or I’ll call you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And call me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Erin) Okay, good to see you again.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bye-bye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye!
(Joey closes the door behind her.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, system kinda broke down huh?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Joey, I’m sorry I just couldn’t tell her all those things
you wanted me to tell her. And y’know we got to talking and I…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We want you to marry her!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She is so amazing! You have no idea.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No idea? Who do you think brought her here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Cupid.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, she’s so cool. She speaks four languages.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, do you know what guys want!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look Joey, come on she’s so perfect for you! I mean she’s
sweet, she-she likes baseball, and she-she had two beers at lunch.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: My beers?! Look you guys, she’s a very nice girl. Okay? We had a good
time, but I just—I don’t see it going anywhere.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but you always say that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, maybe if you gave this girl a chance it would go somewhere.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look I’m sorry you guys, I-I just don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whatever.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine. (They start to walk away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, don’t start judging me! (To Rachel) Huh? You’re the one
who’s in love with her assistant! (To Phoebe) Huh? And you, you’re the one
having the affair with the guy who keeps the pigeons on the roof!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Secret affair!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel and Joey are there as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: People are doing it in front of my book!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My doctoral dissertation is in the library at school, I went to see it,
and there were students makin’ babies right in the middle of the Paleontology
section!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Did you get to see anything good?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let me ask you something, at your school was there a like uh a place on
campus where students went to uh, fool around.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, there was. It was—there the corner of the library where-where
all these dusty books that nobody ever read—Yes, there was.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great! Because people kept showing up, I think it’s like uh-a thing!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now hold on a second, fifth floor against that back wall?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh for cryin’ out loud! (He storms out.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, so we should go catch our movie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well now what’s the rush?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I like to see the previews. (Rachel looks at him.) The candy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering with Erin) Oh. Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well look who’s here!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Erin.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Hey Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Well, we were just about to take off and see a movie. Oh no!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: What’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Phoebe, we forgot that party we have to go to.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (skeptical) What party?

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: A birthday party.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who’s birthday party?

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Allison’s birthday party.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (still skeptical) Oh, and how is Allison?

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: 32. (Joey’s not buying it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (does a retching sound) Wait a minute! Why don’t you guys do
something?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (still skeptical) Yeah, look how that worked out.
Commercial Break
[Scene: The Library, Ross enters and heads to the desk to talk to the male librarian on
duty.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excuse me. Hi, I’m a professor here. Do you know the Paleontology
section, fifth floor, stack 437?

lines.speaker: The Librarian
lines.text: Well, yes! Just give me five minutes, I just have to find someone
to cover my shift.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No!! No! Can I speak to someone in charge please?! (The librarian
brings his boss over.)

lines.speaker: The Head Librarian
lines.text: How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi, I was wondering if it is possible to increase security in the
Paleontology section? See I-I wrote a book up there and instead of reading it people
are-are-are well, rolling around in front of it.

lines.speaker: The Head Librarian
lines.text: We are aware of the problem you are referring too. (He turns
to look at the previous librarian.) But as far as increasing security, I’m afraid the
library is very understaffed. I, I can’t help you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, fine. Fine! If-if I’m the only person with any appreciation of
the sanctity of the written word, I’ll go up there and defend it myself! (Starts to
do so, but stops and to the previous librarian) And don’t you follow me!

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel and Phoebe are doing dishes as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How did it go with Erin?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, unbelievable! We had the best time!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yay!! Oh so, you’re not, you’re not mad at us anymore?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No! No! You guys were totally right! This is so much better than the
first time we went out. Y’know? That was so awkward, we were really nervous.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Didn’t you sleep together?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah that really calms me down. And! We have so much in common! She loves
sandwiches, sports, although she is a Met fan, not much of an issue now but if were ever
to have kids, well that’s a…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Oh my God! Listen to you talkin’ about having kids. Oh my
Joey. (She goes over and hugs him.) Oh, please don’t get married before I do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.
[Scene: A Restaurant, Monica and Chandler are on their date with Janice and Clark,
however Clark is a no show and Janice is crying the Mississippi River about it.]

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh. Oh I just cannot believe Clark stood me up!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He might still show up.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, what are you, stupid? It’s been three hours.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is that all?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I should just go on to happier things, okay? Umm, why don’t you
tell about your lovely wedding?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well actually uh, there was something we wanted to tell you about the
wedding. Um, it’s going to be a small ceremony. Uh, tiny! We’re not even sure
why we’re having it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s actually going to be just family.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh…wait…you two think of me as family?! Oh, I have to ask you
something now and be honest; do you want me to sing Careless Whisper or Lady In
Red?
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey is entering and arguing baseball with Erin. Phoebe and
Rachel are already there.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How can you say that?! The Mets have no closer!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: What about Benitez?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What about Game 1 of the Series?

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: What about shut up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You shut up! (To Phoebe and Rachel) I love arguing with her. (To Erin)
I’ll be right back.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Okay. (Joey goes to get some coffee and Erin sits down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So how’s it goin’ with Joey?

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Uh, okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay? Wait okay, tell-tell me that you like him, please? I mean tell me
that you like him.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Look, he’s a really great guy and I know that you really want
this to work out, but I just don’t see this having a future.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But you said that you liked him! I mean what happened?! Did ya just
change your mind?!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Kinda.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then change it back!

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: I’m sorry I… It’s just there’s no real spark.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No spark? Didn’t you sleep together?

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, tramp!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Does Joey have any idea?

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: I really don’t think he does. And y’know what? Maybe you guys
could help clue him in. Y’know, tell him I’m-I’m not interested in a
serious relationship or something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you mean like that you’re kind of a loner.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Yeah! That would be great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and maybe that you’re a real (She says something in Italian,
and it doesn’t matter what she said. It’s not important so I don’t need
everyone who speaks Italian telling me what she said.)

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: I’m sorry?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh well, I guess Italian isn’t one of the four languages you speak.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (returning) Hey! You wanna go?

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Yeah, let’s go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. See you guys later.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Bye guys.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, see ya.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (whispers to Phoebe and Rachel) Hey, thank you so much. (They both exit.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow. Well, I guess it was Cupid who brought her here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, just a regular old flying dwarf.
[Scene: The library’s Paleontology section, Ross is patrolling as a couple walks
up.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes? Yes?! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Yeah, we were…we were just looking around.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh, you’re-you’re fellow scholars. What exactly were you
looking for, hmm? Perhaps, (Grabs a book from the shelf behind him) perhaps Dr. Chester
Stock’s musings on the Smiledon Californicus?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah… Ah…Get out of here! (The couple retreats. Ross starts
looking through the previously mentioned book as a beautiful woman walks into the
section.) Uh, meeting someone? Or-or are you just here to brush up on Marion’s views
on evolution?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Uh, actually I find Marion’s views far to progressionist.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I find Marion’s views far to progressionist.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m sorry, who are you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m a professor here uh, Ross…Geller.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Ross Geller, why do I know that name? It’s uh—Wait! (Grabs his
book off of the shelf.) Did you write this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! You’re the person who checked out my book?!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Y’know, you look nothing like I would’ve thought.
You’re…you’re so young.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I uh, I skipped forth grade.
[Time Lapse, Ross and the woman are now in a state of partial undress and are standing
in front of the head librarian with two security guards watching them.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am very…very sorry.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Phoebe and Rachel are watching TV as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So how was, how was your date?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it was great! I mean we walked all around the village. We went to this
ice cream place, split a milkshake, 70/30 but still… And guess what, I’m
thinking about taking her upstate to one of those bed and breakfasts.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh really? She said she wants to go away with you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no-no-no! It’s a surprise, but it’s gonna be tricky
thought because she said she was gonna be pretty busy at work for a while.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Jo-Joey, look honey we-we need to talk okay? Umm, I kinda got the
feeling from her today that uh, she’s not lookin’ for a serious relationship.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where are you gettin’ this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, she told me. She said she’s kinda a loner.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No hey Rach, it’s cool okay? Y’know I’m a loner too! (Heads
for his room.) Right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Joey, y’know what? You are way to good for her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah and honey I promise next time that I will just say good-bye and
tell ‘em you’re not looking for a relationship.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No. Don’t do that, just next time make sure she really likes me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well that too. (Joey goes into his room.) Joey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you want some pancakes?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (coming back out) Finally!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler and Monica are sitting at the kitchen
table and are still trying to decide what to do about Janice.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I say we go with Careless Whisper.
(There’s a knock on the door and Janice enters.)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Did she see us yet? Did she see us?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Janice, what umm, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Well umm, I thought I was going to go back to my apartment but then I
just felt I couldn’t really be alone tonight. (Joey walks into view of the open door
behind Janice, sees her, gets a terrified look on his face, and flees in horror.) I was
wondering if I could maybe stay here with you, just I really feel that I need to be with
family.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Our kids are gonna call her Aunt Janice aren’t they?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Please, it’s because otherwise I really don’t know what I
might do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aren’t you just a tinsy bit curious?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: (starting to cry) Do you have any tissues?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, in-in-in the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Okay! (She runs for the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’ll just…we’ll just let her stay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no, if we let her stay, she will stay forever!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Kinda like your Barca lounger.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is that what you’re thinking about right now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I never stop thinking about it.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Hey you guys, umm do either one of you want to get in there before I
take my bath.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Janice, I’m sorry but umm, you can’t stay here tonight.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honestly? Our apartment is a hotbed for electromagnetic activity. Now
Monica and I have been immunized, but sadly you have not.
(And she does the laugh.)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Okay, I’m going to need a comforter, but did you have a
hypoallergenic one because otherwise I get very nasal. (Makes some weird sound) Do you
have a cat? ‘Cause it’s already happening. (Makes a nasal sound) Do you hear
that? (She keeps making the nasal sound.)
(Chandler does the same nasal sound to Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God! You have to go!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because Chandler still has feelings for you!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: He does?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Say again?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right. That’s right. And that is why you can’t
stay here tonight. And probably why you shouldn’t come to the wedding.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Feelings, such strong feelings.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean, I realize that his feelings may never completely go away, but you
can.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh…my Gawd, I-I understand. I-I am so sorry, I’ll go. (Starts
for the door.) Good-bye Monica (hugs her), I wish you a lifetime of happiness with him.
Chandler, (hugs him) you call me when this goes in the pooper. (Hurries out.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: The library’s Paleontology section, Ross is on patrol and stops a security
guard through the stack of books.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the guard) Don’t sweat it, I’ve got this section covered.
Yeah, in fact I’ve got this little baby (Turns on a mini-flashlight) to shine in
people’s eye—(The guard walks away)—Okay, see you later.
(Ross resumes his patrol when his best friend and sister walk up and start to take off
their coats, but they stop when they see him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I just wanted to show Monica your book. (Ross just glares at him.)

title: The One Where Chandler Doesn't Like Dogs

lines.text: [Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is in the kitchen, Joey, Rachel, and
Phoebe are sitting around the table writing one notepads while Chandler is looking over
their shoulders.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey everybody! Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no. No-no-no.
Joey, Rachel, and Phoebe: Shhhh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, are we keeping Thanksgiving a secret this year?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, we're playing this game I learned at work. You have to name all
the states in six minutes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? That's like insanely easy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now, that's a lot harder than it sounds. You always forget at least
one, or in some cases... fourteen (looks over to Monica).

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's a stupid game and I wasn't playing against other people, so
technically I didn't lose.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? You forgot fourteen states?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nobody cares about the Dakotas. (That’s true in so many ways, trust
me, I’ve lived in one and been to the other.)
[Chandler's watch beeps]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, okay, time's up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I got 48.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that's not bad, Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I got tired of naming states. So I decided to list the types of
celery, and I have one: regular celery.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so Rachel's got 48 and Phoebe has the lead in…vegetables,
Joey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Say hello to the new champ of Chandler's dumb states game.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, how many have you got?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fifty-six!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's. Ross is sitting in the couch doing Chandler's
game. Chandler is sitting in his barca-lounger. The girls are in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! How is New England not a state? Huh? They have a sports-team!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Does South Oregon have a sports-team? (Joey strikes one from his list)
There you go.
[Cut to the girls in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (counting the place settings) How come we have one extra place setting?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: 'Cause you invited your assistant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, right. Sorry. But Tag's not coming; his girlfriend came into town,
so he's spending Thanksgiving with her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! Why didn't you tell me? I made him his own individual sweet potato
stuffed pumpkin.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I was going to, but then I figured, you know... you're food is so
delicious and perfect, you can never have too many of those pumpkin things.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now you think I wouldn't enjoy that, because it is so fake, (Laughs) but
I still do.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Regular Celery! (Starts to write that on her list) Oh, I already have
that. (She gets up and heads for her room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Done! With time a-to-spare.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oooh that may be a New World's record (Looks at his watch and picks up
Ross' pad)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, I hate to lecture you guys, but it's kinda disgraceful, that a
group of well-educated adults and Joey can't name all the states. Did you ever see a map,
or one of those round, colorful things called "a globe?" Hmm?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, Magellan? You got 46 states. (Smiles and hands Ross back his pad)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? That's impossible.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: 46. Wow! Who's well educated now, Mr. I-forgot-ten-states?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I'm out of oven space. I'm gonna turn on Joey's. Please,
watch him! Do not let Joey eat any of the food!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am only one man! (Monica heads out) Okay Ross, time is up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, just give me another minute.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look Ross, if you don't know them by now, you will never know them,
okay? That is the beauty of this game. It makes you want to kill yourself.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This-this is crazy! I can do this! All right, uhh, I bet I can get all 50
before dinner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, but if you can't…no dinner!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're on!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (gets up) All right. Don't look at my list, Ross, 'cause there's a lot on
there that you don't have.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering, to Joey and Rachel) Hey, did you guys know, that your oven
doesn't work?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But the drawer full of take-out menus is okay, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, I'm gonna use yours, okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pshhshhh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler? Can you give me a hand? (Grabs her jacket)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure, and Joey; do not let Ross look at any of the maps or the globe
in your apartment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don't worry, Chandler, it's not a globe of the United States.
[Chandler and Monica head out with some stuff. Phoebe comes out of her room with a
bag.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey you guys I'm gonna go out and take a walk.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, why is your bag moving?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it's not!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Seriously, it's moving!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What the hell is in there?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's just my knitting that's all! (A dog sticks its head out of Phoebe's
bag. Everyone looks puzzled.) Yes! I knit this. I'm very good.

scenes.location: Ross' apartment, Monica and Chandler enter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross’s apartment is nice! How come we don't hang out here more
often?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know. Maybe it's because it smells a little weird. It's like
old pumpkins or something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's my pie!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Which smells delicious!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-oh! Uh-oh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We left Joey alone with the food! (Walks towards the window and looks
out) Yep! Yep, I knew it! There he is... feeding stuffing to a dog!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Ross is still doing his list. Rachel and Joey
are feeding the dog as the phone rings.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (answering the phone) Hi Geller-Bing residence. How can I help?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, why is there a dog in our apartment?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry, who's this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, there's a dog sitting on my couch!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tell her, I'm allergic, and I will sue!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, there's no dog here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes there is! He's black and white and shaggy and [Cut to Monica’s
apartment] he's sitting next to Rachel and licking Rachel's hand.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my god! Where are you? (Looks around.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll be right there!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Phoebe hangs up and someone knocks on the door. She gasps.) They're
here already? How are they doing this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gets up and opens the door) Hi Tag! What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I, uh, wanted to see if your offer to spend Thanksgiving with you is still
good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, sure! Come in! (He enters) Well, what-what happened to your
girlfriend?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: We kinda broke up this morning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Yeah, so she went back to Ohio.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohio!! Thank you!
[Time lapse, Chandler and Monica enter.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Huh! Where is the dog?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What dog? There-there's no dog here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah that dog left!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (walks to Phoebe's door) Phoebe! Phoebe, open up!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There's no dog in here.
[The dog barks.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe, we can hear the dog barking!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No that's just me coughing! (Doing some weird coughing noises and the
dog barks again. Phoebe comes out of the room.) Oh, good, there you are! Listen, um, I
have a dog in my room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is it doing here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I'm watching it for some friends who went out of town. Wait. (She
bends down, picks up the dog, and waves with one of its paws) Hello, my name is Clunkers.
May I please stay with you nice people?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oooh, I wish she could stay here, but Chandler is allergic!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Extremely allergic, okay? If I'm anywhere near a dog for more than 5
minutes, my throat will just close up!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's odd, 'cause this dog's been living here for the past 3 days

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (gasping) Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, if that dog's been here that long, and you haven't had a
reaction, maybe you're not allergic to this dog?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it still has to go, right?

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, it's um…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (interrupting him) Don't do it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't do what?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) I have to! Okay? It's time! (Joey shrugs as if to say,
"Do what you have to do") Okay, I hate dogs.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you crazy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you out of your mind?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Told ya. (Waves bye-bye.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They are needy, they are jumpy, and you can't tell what they are
thinking, and that scares me a little bit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right, they are scary. (He jumps up, screaming) Ahh, she just ate a treat
out of my hand!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait a minute. Do you not like all dogs? I mean, not even puppies?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (scared) Is there a puppy here?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: You don't like puppies?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Tag) Okay, you are new!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, Chandler, I told you, never tell anyone about this dog thing. It's
like Ross not likin’ ice cream.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You don't like ice cream?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's too cold.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, it's just that dogs make me a little uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Phoebe) It hurts my teeth.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I don't wanna say this, I don't you guys to hate me, but uh, I
don't think, I can be around that dog anymore. Okay, so either the dog goes, or I go. (An
awkward silence ensues.) Oh my god!!
[Time lapse, Ross is still doing Chandler's game. Tag is heading for the balcony.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How can I not get this? I'm a college professor; I got 1450 on my S.A.T.s.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damn, I forgot you were here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. We're gonna take Clunkers to Ross’s. We'll be back in a
minute. (Gets up with Monica to do so.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, wait before you guys go, can I just ask you a question?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: When a guy breaks up with his girlfriend, what is an appropriate amount
of time to wait before you make a move?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I'd say about a month.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? I'd say 3 to 4.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Half hour. (Rachel turns to look at him and he nods yes.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Interesting.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When it's your assistant, I would say never.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, Rach, the big question is, does he like you? All right? Because
if he doesn't like you, this is all a moo-point.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh. A moo-point?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it's like a cow's opinion. It just doesn't matter. It's moo.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica and Phoebe) Have I been living with him for too long, or did
that all just make sense?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please, don't listen to Joey, okay. Would you look at him? He-he’s
obviously depressed. He's away from his family; he's spending Thanksgiving with strangers.
What he needs right now is for you to be his friend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You're right, I'm sorry. Thank you. Okay, that's what I'm gonna do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine! Take their advice. No one ever listens to me. When the package is
this pretty, no one cares what's inside.
[Cut to the balcony, Tag is looking down while Rachel enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How are you holding up?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Not bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah? I'm sorry about your girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So were you guys together a long time?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: A year. On and off. I kinda thought we'd end up together. I don't anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now that she broke up with you?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Hmmmm.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: It's weird. I always used to assume, that I would meet someone and fall in
love and be happy and all that was just a given. But lately it's like what if it's not. Do
you ever have that feeling?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No…Yeah, all the time, constantly. It's terrifying. But you know
that I figure it…it has to work out.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because, uh—it has to.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: You have all the answers, don't you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I know, I do. I really do.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Hey, thanks for talking to me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what is a boss for? Hug it out! (They hug)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (through the window) All right, he likes you back! Huh? Told ya, you
should go for it!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (realizes what he said) Street noise drowned any of that out? (Rachel
moves madly towards him) No, all right, I see you later, okay... (Turns away embarrassed)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The Balcony, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What did Joey say? I like you back?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, yeah, well, see, he… Joey knows, that I'm-I'm very insecure
about my back and, and…you're hugging me, so obviously you are not repulsed by it,
yeah!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Wait-wait a minute; that doesn't make any sense.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No? (He shakes his head) All right, here's the truth um, Joey said what
he said, because um, I'm attracted to you.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Wow. (He starts to walk towards the railing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I admit it. I have a crush on you, and uh, and, and I know that's
crazy because we work together, and-and nothing could ever happen, and the last thing I
want to do is-is to freak you out or make you feel uncomfortable. Which is why it would be
really great if you said something right about now.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (looking at the street) Oh my god! Those guys are stealing my car! (He
points down to the street)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Right there! That's my car! (Sound of a breaking car-window) Hey!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, that's gonna take them a minute. Do you have anything else you
wanna get off your chest?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I can't believe this! (He walks back in again)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she hurries after him) Wait, we still have time to talk and
they’re-they're not even in the car yet! (She takes a quick look down the street.) Oh
look, there they go, okay. (She hurries in, too)
[Scene: Ross' apartment, Monica and Phoebe sitting on the floor next to Clunkers
basket.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay Phoebe, we should probably go back now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (doing Clunkers) Please don't leave me, I'll be lonely.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Stop it. Stop! Okay let's go. We can be strong.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, okay.
[They both get up and head for the door. Clunkers whines a little]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god! Did you hear that? She said Monica! (She goes back to
Clunkers again) Oooh, I can't leave her!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know if you want, we can sneak the dog back in and Chandler wouldn't
even know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's not gonna work.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I've had that dog there for three days and Chandler had no idea. He's
not so smart.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! I didn't know either.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but you kinda knew that something was going on, didn't you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I knew.
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's. Ross lays a lot off small papers, shaped like
the U.S. states onto the floor making a map with the states. Phoebe enters]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where's Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (comes out of the bathroom) Here I am.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wash your hands!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How did you…know? (Heads back into the bathroom)
[Phoebe waves Monica in. Monica sneaks in with the bag with Clunkers in it and heads
for Phoebe's room.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! What's she doing back here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Relax, Ross. She's not made of ice cream!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey look, Phoebe. I, uh, I laid out the states geographically...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupts him) No, no, we don't really have time for this right now.
Okay, we have to keep Chandler away from my bedroom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but, but look what I'm...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: See, this is exactly what we do not have time for. (She rushes into her
room)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (comes out of the bathroom) Where's Monica?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Um, in Phoebe's room. You can't go in there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?
(We can hear the dog whining at a high pitch.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica's crying. She's very upset about this whole Clunkers thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I, I should go in there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No, no. She doesn't want to see you right now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because you sent away the dog!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is ridiculous. (He heads for Phoebe's bedroom)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, is it? Is it? Look, when Monica and I were kids, we had a dog
named Rover. And, uh, one day, my dad decides, he doesn't like dogs. So Monica and her
friend…Phyllis…take away the dog. And that was the last time we ever saw him.
Don't you see? This is just like that. Only with a few details changed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Okay, I'm in my sweat pants. Bring on the food! (Sees that
Chandler has a worried look on his face) What's the matter?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica's all upset, because I sent Clunkers away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So? Bring the dog back, you're a hero.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I can be a hero, I could do that. I could, I could do... I,
w-w-what if, what if it attacks me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, it's like a big gerbil.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And that doesn't scare you? (He walks out)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, you need some help?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: From you? (He does a weird desperate laughter, like he's almost crying)
Yes, please!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sits down next to Ross) First of all, Utah? Dude, you can't just make
stuff up!
[Time lapse, Ross still laying a lot out the states.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I hate America! When I finish this game, I swear I am moving.
[Joey stands up again. Rachel enters the door]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Tag's still talking to the police.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, ohh! Why, damnit, why did I open my mouth? (In a girlish voice) I
have a crush on you; I am attracted to you. (Back to normal again) Gee, I-I know that I
freaked him out

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If you said it like that, you probably did, yeah.
[Rachel walks past Joey towards the couch]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (opens her bedroom door and peeks out) Hey, is Chandler here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no he went for a walk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, but you cannot tell him... but look whose back!
[The dog barks, runs out of Phoebe's room and jumps onto the couch]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh No-no-no-no-no-no-no! He went over to Ross' to bring the dog back here!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, the dog's not going to be there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You think?
[The door opens and Chandler comes in. Rachel covers the door with a blanket]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, honey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Please, please, please, don't be mad at me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? Why, why would...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupts her, to Monica) Shh, wait and see. Maybe we will, maybe we
won't.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I went over to Ross' apartment to bring back Clunkers.
Y’know, for you, and…(Clears his throat) I left the door open and she must have
gotten out and I looked everywhere, all over the apartment, including the roof,
which FYI Ross, one of your neighbors, growing weed. I couldn't find him, and I am so, so,
so, sorry. But I do know where we could all go ease the pain. (Points up and then
over to the street)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We have good news, look whose back!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (uncovers the dog) Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Clunkers?! Oh my god!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's right, she came back all by herself.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's a Thanksgiving miracle!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Clunkers) It is so good to see you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, she came all the way back from Ross' building. Oh, the things she
must have seen! And then she climbed up the fire escape and she tapped on the window with
her teeny little paw and then we ran to let her in…(Realizes, that Chandler starts to
not believing her) I went to far, didn't I? When should I have stopped?
[Time lapse, after dinner. Ross stands up from his self-made map.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, maybe this is so hard, because there aren't 50 states. Let me tell
you something, I have 49 states, and there are no more! I-I think, I should be able
to eat something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's up to you.
[Ross whines and starts working again. The door opens and Tag enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi! How are you doing?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I'm okay. I gotta go down to the police station and look at mug shots.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Thanks for having me over, you guys.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Tag? Y-You're going? (Comes over to Tag) Uh we didn't, uh we didn't get
the chance to talk. Uh, so, where did you say you're from again?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Colorado.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, what good are you. (Walks back to his map dejectedly.)
[Rachel and Tag go into the hall.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, um, I think we should talk about what happened on the terrace.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, I-I never should have said what I said. It—y’know what? It
just doesn't matter how I feel. I mean we work together, so nothing could really ever
happen between us, and what I would love is just to go to work on Monday, and-and never
talk about this again, okay? Big day Monday lots to do. So, we're okay?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Um, I'm not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, god, I know it, that I freaked you out.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: No, you didn't. The only thing that freaked me out was you saying that
nothing could ever happen between us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Yeah, so, please don't fire me for doing this. (He kisses her)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well, that's one less thing we have to do on Monday.
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, later that night, there is someone knocking on
the door and Chandler stumbles out into the living room, turns on the light, looks through
the peephole, and opens the door.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Delaware! (Starting to cry.) Delaware!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (hands Chandler his pad and walks in) I want my turkey now!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got it. (Starts looking at the pad, while Ross got the turkey out
of the fridge and starts to unwrap and it) You got Nevada twice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pauses) I know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. (Throws the pad on the table and heads for the bedroom)

title: The One with All the Candy

lines.text: [Scene: Central Park, Ross is teaching Ben how to ride a bike. Chandler, Monica, and
Phoebe are they also.]

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (on the bike) I’m ready!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You sure?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, let me just straighten out your helmet there. (Does so.)

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (To Chandler) Thanks daddy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no, one daddy, two mommies. All right, it’s all yours.
(Ross pushes him off.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! Yes! Yes!! (Everyone stands and claps.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: His first big kid’s bike, this is so exciting!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah, I remember mine! Ohh, it was my sixth birthday, my dad took me
to the park, I got it, and…it bent.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I never had a bike of my own.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked) What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, we didn’t have a lot of money. But the girl across the street
had the best bike! It was pink and it had rainbow colored tassels hanging off the
handle grips, and-and-and a bell and this big, white wicker basket with those
plastic daisies stuck on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That sounds like my first bike. (They all turn and look at him.) My
dad gave me his old one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ohh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did the girl ever let you ride it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! But she gave me the box that it came in. It had a picture of the
bike on the front. (They’re all speechless) So I would sit on it and my step-dad
would drag me around the backyard.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That is so unfair!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not really, I got to drag him around too! (They all nod,
"Oh.")
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is cooking, Joey is eating, and Chandler
is entering from the bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! What are you guys doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Making holiday candy for the neighbors.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry, who?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m gonna hang this basket (Points to the one sitting on the table)
on the door and when the neighbors walk by they can all take a piece.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But we don’t know the neighbors.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I do. There’s uh, let’s see, Guy With a Mustache, Smokes-A-Lot
Lady, Some Kids I’ve Seen, and A Red-haired Guy Who Does Not Like To Be Called Rusty.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See? This is exactly why I’m making this candy. We can learn
their names and get to know our neighbors.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wouldn’t it be easier if we just moved?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, happily) Gooood morning!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eh, somebody’s in a good mood!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, why shouldn’t I be? I have great friends! I have a wonderful
job!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Where you can make out with your assistant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on, it’s not a big deal! We stayed up all night coming up with
a plan so that us dating will not be a problem.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah, what’s the plan?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pauses as she thinks and exhales loudly) We… We are not…
…going to let it… be a problem.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! It took you all night to come up with that plan?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y’know, we did other stuff too. (Joey and Chandler start to
giggle.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you two…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Monica come on, y’know I don’t sleep with guys on the first
date!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Matt Guire, Mark Lynn, Ben Wire…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anymore!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
[Scene: Rachel’s Office, she’s at her desk while the mailman delivers her
mail and calls Tag in.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. Tag, I have a conference call today is that correct?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Yes, at 4:00.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, thank you. That’ll be all. (The mail guy leaves and Tag
starts to follow, but Rachel stops him.) (Excitedly) Wait! Wait! (Rushes over and closes
the office-door.) Did you see that? That mail guy had no idea there was something going on
between us. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I’d better get back to my desk.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you hard worker! I’ll remember to put that in your
evaluation.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: My what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you’ve been here for two months now and your boss is required
to hand in a performance evaluation. But y’know, there is one thing that I have yet
to evaluate. (She turns around and sweeps the stuff off of her desk and hops up onto it.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I’ve just always wanted to do that. Can you help me clean this
up?
[Scene: The Hallway, Monica and Chandler are returning and Monica finds her basket is
empty.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The basket is totally empty! My God, the neighbors ate all the candy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, either that or uh…(Motions towards Joey’s door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey!!
(She storms into his apartment to find him with a towel around his shoulders, a bowl on
his head, and Phoebe with scissors in her hand.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you eat all the neighbor candy?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh well yeah, that was the plan, but by the time I got to it there was
only a couple of pieces left!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and they’ve been coming by all day. They love it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They love my candy? Oh man!!! I’ve gotta go make more!! (Starts to
do so.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Mon, you might wanna make some more lasagna too, because something
might’ve happened to a huge chunk of it.
(Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross! The neighbors ate all my candy!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mine stole my newspaper! It’s like a crime wave!! (Monica runs
to make more candy.) Pheebs, you uh, you got a second.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, ever since you uh, told me that story about that bike I-I
couldn’t stop thinking about it. I mean, everyone should have a-a first bike,
(He goes out into the hall and re-enters with a bike exactly like the one Phoebe
described earlier.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) Oh my God Ross!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You like it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I love it!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh!! Ohh!! And I love you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ahh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not that way! But the bike brought you a lot closer!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah! (She hugs him.) Well uh-uh, t-take it downstairs, y’know give it
a test ride.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! Oh my God! My first bike! Thank you for the best present I’ve
ever gotten.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stunned at the complement) You’re welcome.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (starts to leave, but stops) Oh and Chandler’s about to cry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (about to cry) Am not!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, the middle of the night, there is someone
knocking on the door and Monica and Chandler get up to answer it.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (turning a light on) Who is that?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don’t worry, I’m brave! I am brave! I…I am brave! (They
get to the door and Monica goes to open it.) No-no-no-no!! (He stops her.) (Through the
door.) Can you tell me who is there please?

lines.speaker: The Knocker
lines.text: My name is Gary, I live upstairs.
(Monica opens the door.)

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi. Do you know what time it is?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: It’s candy time! My roommate says that they taste like little drops
of heaven.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh please! (To Chandler) Did you hear that? Little drops of heaven.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughs) 4:00 A.M.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: So, can I get some candy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am sorry, but some of us have to get up early and go to work!
(Monica looks at him) (To Monica) He does not know that I am not some of us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, listen I am sorry, but I’ll put some out first thing in the
morning.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Well okay, I’ll swing by later. Do you live in this building?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Um-hmm.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: (looking at Monica.) Mm! Seems like I would’ve remembered you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mm! Night Gar’! (Monica closes the door.)
[Scene: Rachel’s Office, she’s slinking out to where Tag works and checks to
make sure no one is coming.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (hugging him) So did you read your evaluation yet?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: No! It was marked confidential I just sent it down to Human Resources.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (worried) Okay please, you’re kidding right?! I wrote that one as a
joke for you!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: A joke they would appreciate?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m thinkin’ no.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What did you say?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, I said I thought you were a good kisser, and uh, and that I like
your tiney-tiny touchie.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: No, not my touchie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it gets worse. When asked if you take initiative I wrote,
"Yes, he was able to unhook my bra with minimal supervision," and under Problems
with Performance I wrote, "Dear God, I hope not," and then uh, then I drew a
little smiley face, and then a small pornographic sketch.
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey, Monica, Ross, and Chandler are watching Phoebe polish the
daisies on her bike outside.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross! That is so sweet of you to get Phoebe that bike! When I heard the
story, I almost cried.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Almost cried huh? Hear that Chandler? Almost cried!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you cry every time somebody talks about Titanic!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (about to cry) Those two only had each other!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe really likes the bike huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah! I saw her walkin’ it down the street the other day. She
had uh, these flowers in the basket. It was so cute.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I saw her this morning walkin’ it by the park.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, she was walking the bike? Both times?
[Cut to outside, they’re going to talk to Phoebe about walking the bike.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! So are you enjoying the bike?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, uh-huh so much!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs you uh…you do know how to ride a bike don’t you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, can we see you ride it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (The gang is giggles then Phoebe gets the bike out of the rack,
gets on, pushes off, rolls a few feet, and falls over.) See?
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is making candy while Chandler and
Rachel are taste testing and Joey is on the couch doodling.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See, this is why I told you never get involved with your assistant! And
here is no such thing as keeping secrets when it comes to affairs. (To Chandler) Did you
hear that Chandler? No such thing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (with his mouth full) What happened? I’m just eating candy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Maybe it’s not as bad as I think. Y’know, maybe they
didn’t take it the way I meant it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Absolutely! Y’know, because touchie can mean both ass and good
worker.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh, I just gotta get the thing back!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That sketch you mentioned? Might it have looked a little something like
this? (He shows her what he’s been drawing.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Joey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is the matter with you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Boy I tell ya, this little talent came in handy before I could afford
porn.
(There is a knock on the door and Monica answers it. There is a woman standing there.)

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: Hi! I’m sorry, I know it’s after hours but I really need
candy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sorry, I can’t help you. See? (Points to her new sign.)
Rules are rules.

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: Please! I have people coming from out of town today! And, I told them
all about your candy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No kidding, out of towners huh? What did you tell ‘em?

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: I told ‘em your candy is absolutely indescribable!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Some people have been saying its y’know little drops of heaven, but
whatever.

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: Please, can’t you help me out?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (watching the discussion) Hey Chandler, do we know that lady?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe, isn’t she the woman who lives below you and has sex really
loud?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (still talking to the woman) All right, I’ll do it just this once!
But you can’t tell anybody!

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: (exasperatedly) Yes! Yes! Please, just give it to me!

lines.speaker: Joey and Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, that’s her.

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: (after Monica gives her the candy) Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (closing the door) It’s unbelievable! I-I can’t believe that
sign didn’t work!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what would work?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stop making candy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But they like it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean they like you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is that why you became a chef? So that people would like you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you really want to talk about getting people to like you huh, funny
man? (Joey laughs but stops when Chandler turns to glare at him.)

scenes.location: Central Park, Ross is teaching Phoebe how to ride her bike.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, now just remember everything I taught you and you’ll be fine.
Okay? Here we go. Ready…Set…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (hopping off the bike) Wait! This seat is really uncomfortable! Yeah,
maybe before we start we should just get another one. Perhaps, like an airplane
seat—or a beanbag chair!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, you can’t get out of this! Okay? You have to learn how
to ride a bike!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why? Why do I have to learn?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well…In-in case of emergency.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What kind of an emergency?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well let there—what if a man comes along and puts a gun to your head
and says, "You ride this bike or I’ll sh…I’ll shoot you."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I would ring the bell to distract him and then I would knock the
gun out of his hand with a Chinese throwing star.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, Phoebe just-just get-get on the bike and—Hey! I’ll hold
you up and-and push you. Okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You won’t let go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Swear?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I swear!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (thinks it over) Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on. (She gets on the bike.) All right, here we go. All right? (They
start.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. Feel good?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, try pedaling.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Does so.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s it, your doing great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Doing great! Yes-yes-yes! Take control! Yes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Weee!!! (Ross pushes her and lets go.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes!! Yes!!! (He starts clapping and Phoebe turns around to look at him
and falls off the bike.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Oh! Oh no!! You swore!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I-I just thought you were doing so well. I…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I am shocked! Shocked!! (She storms off leaving Ross to defend himself
from the angry looks from onlookers.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s a legitimate learning technique. (Looking around and seeing the
woman behind him glaring at him.) Wow!
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica is making candy like mad as Ross
enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, there’s uh, some people outside, askin’ about candy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, they’re just gonna have to wait aren’t they? I’ve
only got two hands!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Need some help?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! You don’t know the system! There’ll be nobody messing with
the system!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: By the way, the week before your wedding you may not see a lot of me. (She
glares at him and he quickly makes his way to Phoebe’s room.)
[Cut to Phoebe’s room, Phoebe has put her helmet on one of her teddy bears and is
playing around with it. Ross knocks and pokes his head in the door.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (seeing him) Oh, hello liar.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Look, I-I’m really sorry I let go of the bike.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I could’ve been killed I hope you know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know. I know. But, can we please try it again? Huh? I mean, you were so
close Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I would love to but…the bike got stolen and the police have
no suspects. (Ross just happens to have his hand on a sheet that is covering something
that suspiciously looks like a bike.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! (Ross rings the bell.) What the hell?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, y’know what? If you are not going to learn how to ride
this bike then I’m sorry, I’m just gonna have to take it back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! Why?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because! Because, it-it-it’s… It’d be like you having this
guitar (Points to hers) and-and never playing it. Okay, this guitar wants to be
played! And-and this bike wants to be ridden and-and if you don’t ride it
you-you’re-you’re killing its spirit! (Pause) The bike is dying.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. If you care enough to make up that load of crap, okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great! Great! (He runs to the door.) You’re making the bike very
happy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sarcastically) Okay Ross! (Ross exits and she says quietly to the bike)
Please don’t die!

scenes.location: Rachel’s office, Tag and her are planning how to get the review back.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I think we can get the evaluation back before they see it, but
we’re gonna have to get into Mr. Zelner’s office. Now, he doesn’t get in
until 10, so he’s no problem, but his assistant, Betty, she comes in early to eat her
breakfast at her desk.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: That’s kinda sad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, well Betty’s kinda sad. Which is why I believe I can lure her
away with these chocolates. (Holding up the box of chocolates.) Now, while I distract her,
you get in the office.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let’s roll!
(They start towards the door but are stopped when Mr. Zelner enters.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Hello Rachel, you uh, got a minute?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (worried and shocked) Yeah, sure Mr. Zelner, for you
anything—minute. Okay. Fine. (To Tag) Abort the plan, abort the plan. (She start to
usher Tag out.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Uh actually, I’d like to speak with both of you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Uh, well can we, can we get you anything Mr. Zelner? Maybe some
chocolates? (Holds up the box.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Umm, no. Thanks, but I’ll give these to Betty. (Rachel glances
at Tag to say, "See?") So I read your evaluation of Tag, or to use his full
name, Tag Sweetcheeks Jones. Is something going on with you two?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Oh my God. Can you imagine if there was?! I mean, (getting
serious) what would happen exactly.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Well, I’d be forced to file a report. I’d have to consult
with the legal department, and your future at the company would be in jeopardy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well…

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (interrupting) Uh Mr. Zelner, I’m the one who filled in that
evaluation.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no-no-no…

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (interrupting again) Yeah-yeah-yeah-yeah-yeah, I thought it would be funny.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: You wrote that you have a cute touchie?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (pause) Yes. I have a weird sense of humor, and I’m kinda
strangely proud of my butt.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: It’s kind of a risky joke Tag, and what is-what is this drawing
I can’t figure out what this is?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re lookin’ at it upside down—y’know what? (Grabs
the evaluation and throws it out.) It doesn’t matter.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Yeah, it’s not like I don’t have a sense of humor, huh?
Hell, I even enjoy a naughty limerick now and then. But there’s a time and a place,
huh?! Unless you uh, have a limerick right now? (They both nod no.) No? Okay, well uh,
you’ve (Grabs the chocolates.) got my fax number. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa! I can’t believe you did that. That was really sweet.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: No, don’t worry about it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, you could’ve lost your job.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Are you kidding me?! With a cute butt like this, I’d find work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you! You’re great! (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Y’know what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I feel great. (Rachel laughs) In fact! (Walks over to her desk, sweeps its
contents onto the floor and Rachel just glares at him.) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I… It just—it took me so long to get that desk organized.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. (He bends over to pick the stuff up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at his butt) There it is. (They hug.)
[Scene: The Hallway, Chandler is returning from work to see the hallway jammed full of
people waiting outside their door.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (asking a man leaning against the wall) What is going on?

lines.speaker: The Man
lines.text: We’re waiting for the candy. (Yelling at the door.) Bring out the
candy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah lady! Give us candy!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s up buddy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Waiting for candy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Get in here! (They head for the door and Chandler sees Smokes-A-Lot
Lady standing next to the door and smoking, to her) Hey, and you can not smoke in here!
(Takes the cigarette and takes a drag for himself.) (Exhaling in ecstasy) Merry Christmas.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (opening the door and frantically) Okay, guys! The candy is coming; I
just need another 15 minutes for the chocolate to cool!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: We want candy! We want candy now! (And other general commotion
sounds.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right everybody! Just be quiet! Be quiet! Be quiet!!
Pipe-pipe-pipe down! (They settle down) What is the matter with you people?! This woman
was trying to do a nice thing for you. She was making candy so she could try to get to
know all of you, and I’ll bet that not one of you can tell me her name! Am I right?

lines.speaker: The Man
lines.text: (from earlier) Candy Lady?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No not (imitating) Candy Lady.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (stepping in and knocking the man over) Hey, if we know it can we have
candy?!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, y’know what? Forget it, all of you forget it!
You’ve ruined it! Go home! You’ve ruined it! You’ve ruined it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right, it’s all ruined! You guys ruined everything! You
ruined it! (Steps into the apartment and Chandler closes the door.) (Joey struts over to
the candy and starts eating it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re welcome. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you smoke?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! Smokes-A-Lot Lady blew smoke directly into my mouth.
Eh-uh—are you okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m fine now, but it was really scary there for a while. I mean,
someone slipped a-a threatening note under the door.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (with his mouth full) Oh yeah, sorry about that. Mob mentality or
whatever, I don’t know… (Grabs the note.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Central Park, Phoebe is now riding her bike with ease and stops in front of
Ross. They both giggle.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t believe it! I did it! I rode a bike! I never thought
I’d be able to do that! Thank you Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh hey, don’t thank me, thank yourself. You’re the one who faced
her fears and ultimately overcame them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t be so corny Ross, it’s not an after-school special. (She
rides off and the camera pans down to reveal two shiny, silver training wheels firmly
attached.)

title: The One with the Holiday Armadillo

lines.text: [Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is on the phone, Rachel and Monica are
sitting in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Buh-bye. (Hangs up the phone) I just got us reservations at
Michelle’s and tickets to the Musicman to celebrate our first holiday season
as a betroughed couple.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Betrothed… (Corrects him)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: …betrothed couple.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering carrying a skull) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Haaaa... (Puts the skull on the table) ... ahhhh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Skull?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, it's my mom's.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (freaking out) Oh my god!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, no. It's not! It's not my mom. It belonged to mom. Yeah, no, she
used to put it out every Christmas to remind us, that even though it's Christmas, people
still die. And, you can put candy in it. (She grabs the skull, pulls out a stick of
licorice, and takes a bite.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Offering Ross the skull) Licorice?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Thinking it over) Sure! (Takes one) Hey, I just found out, I get Ben for
the holidays this year.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Ohh! That's great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you gonna dress up as Santa?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nope. I mean, I know Susan does every year, but I think I wanna take this
year to teach him all about Hanukkah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And maybe I could teach Ben about the Christmas skull and how people
die.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You may need to use this year to teach Ben about Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm.
(Joey comes out of the bathroom reading a newspaper)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey. (He exits)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica) Did you know he was in there?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How long have we been home?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: About a half an hour.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Lovely!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler is getting a cup of coffee and sits down next to
Monica.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you know what I was thinking? When we get married, are you gonna
change your last name to Bing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bing's weird.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Oh, hey, you guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey. Guess what! My landlord just called and my apartment is gonna get
ready soon, so I guess I'll be moving out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ahh, Phoebe, I'm gonna miss you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, you will be very sad. All right, well I gotta go tell Rachel the
good news.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh! You guys gonna be living together again?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, she's just so much fun with Joey, I just assumed, she'd still be
living with him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why do you think, she's having so much fun living with Joey?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No reason, except…she…told…me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? So she said, she didn’t wanna live with me anymore?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No, she didn't say that. I-I-I think you should talk to Monica
now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, don't worry about it. I'm sure she wants to live with you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're sure? You're absolutely sure?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, no. But, um, I bet she probably does.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Probably? Yeah, I don't like that word. (Chandler and Monica look
surprised) Kind of what ‘probably’ really means. Yeah, uh-huh. Yeah, oh,
"Your mom probably won't kill herself," y’know? I'm sorry, but I'm not
hanging all my hopes of Rachel and I living together on-on "Probably!"
Y’know? You gotta take care of yourselves! (She starts to walk out) In this
world history teaches us nothing! (Exits)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bing doesn't seem so weird now, does it?

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel’s, Joey is sitting behind a red drum set.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Great, you’re home! Guess what Phoebe got me for Christmas!
(Starts drumming.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Drums?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (yelling) No! Drums!

scenes.location: Michelle's, Chandler and Monica enter.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to the Maitre d') Hi, could we get two burritos to go, please?
(Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry. But not that sorry, 'cause you don't have to live with it.
Um, we have a reservation under the name Chandler Bing.

lines.speaker: Maitre d'
lines.text: Oh-kay, we'll have a table for you in about 45 minutes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
