lines.text: Forty-five minutes? We have tickets to the Musicman at 8:00.

lines.speaker: Maitre d'
lines.text: I'm sorry. Christmas is a very busy time, sir.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is this because of the burrito thing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pulling Chandler away from the Maitre d') You need to give him money.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Give him money? It was a joke!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, to get a table! Places like are always shakin’ you down.
Everybody wants to be paid off.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right, calm down, O'Mally. I'll slip him some money.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You've got to be smooth about it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, I can be smooth. (Walks back to the Maitre d', very smoothly)
Listen, we're a little bit in a hurry, so, if you can get us a table a little quicker, I'd
appreciate it. (Shakes his hand)

lines.speaker: Maitre d'
lines.text: Of course, sir.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Walks back to Monica)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How did it go?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Had the money in the wrong hand. (Shows her his left hand with the
money in it)

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, Ross is whirling Ben around.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wooooooo, hehehe. Hey, ahh, you don't feel like you're gonna throw up, do
ya?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I do, so let's... (Ben and Ross sit down on the couch) So, Ben, you
uh, you know what holiday is coming up, don't ya?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Christmas.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yep, and you know what other holiday is coming up?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Christmas eve.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, but also (Pauses to let Ben answer, but he doesn’t.) Hanukkah!
See, you're part Jewish, and-and Hanukkah is a Jewish holiday.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Santa has reindeers that can fly!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right, um, but, on Hanukkah, Hanukkah is a celebration of a miracle. See,
years and years ago there were these people called the Maccabees.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (singing) Jingle bells, jingle bells...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupts him) Okay, that's right, yes, but on Hanukkah, uh, we sing, uh
(Sings) Dreidel, dreidel, dreidel, I made you out of clay.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (singing) Rudolph, the red-nosed reindeer...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupts him again) Okay, it's not a contest.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: When is Santa coming?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, how about this year, instead of Santa, we have fun celebrating
Hanukkah?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No Santa? Was I bad?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Oh, no-no-no. Hey, you weren't bad, you've been very good, Ben.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Santa's mad at me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, hey-hey, come on, (He grabs Ben and sits him on his lap) Ben, Santa is
not mad at you, okay? Hey, you're-you're his favorite little guy!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: So Santa's coming?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (disappointed) Yes! Santa's coming!
[Scene: Michelle's, Chandler and Monica are discussing how to bribe the Maitre

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's easy! Just keep it casual! Give him a kind word, shake his hand and
give him the money!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How do you know so much about this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Richard used to do it, didn't he?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We'd be eating our soup right now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mustached bastard…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sees two people exit) Okay, those people just left, come on! Quick!
Give him the money and get their table!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (walks up to the Maitre d') Excuse me...
[Chandler can't find his money in the pocket. In the meantime, another couple shows up,
and Chandler turns away to look for his money]

lines.speaker: Male Guest
lines.text: (to the Maitre d') Good evening. (Shakes his hand)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (finds his money) Ahh-hahaha! (Turns around to give the Maitre d' his
money, but he isn't there anymore)
[Scene: The Hallway, Phoebe comes up the stairs and hears drumming coming from Joey and
Rachel's, so she enters smiling and then sees that Rachel, not Joey, is the one playing.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stopping at Phoebe’s entrance) Ha!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you like the drums! That's, that's great! Y’know, I was worried,
that, you know, they would maybe an unbearable living situation. All right, okay, well,
apparently not! So, yay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey, Pheebs, check it out, we already learned a song. (To Rachel)
Ready? One, two, three, four...
[Rachel hits some tom-toms and ends up on the 'crash'-cymbal, which is in fact a
ride-cymbal, but whatever...]

lines.speaker: Rachel and Joey
lines.text: Tequila!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's fun. (She exits disappointedly.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, Gunther is serving Chandler and Monica coffee.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Here you go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you Gunther, put it there. (He gets up, and shakes Gunther's
hand. A bunch of coins fall out his hand. He sits down next to Monica.) Definitely not
easier with coins. (Joey gets up and picks up the coins. Chandler thinks, Joey is just
helping him to pick them up.) Thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you. (He gets up and puts on his jacket.) (Phoebe enters) Hey
Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here. (Gives her the coins) Now I only owe you $49.50.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! (she sits down next to him)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If you wanna give Joey a Christmas present that disrupts the entire
building, why not get him something a little bit more subtle, like a wrecking ball, or a
vile of small pox to release in the hallway?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's not just the drum noise. Every five minutes, Joey throws his sticks
in the air, and I have to hear, "Oh my eye! Oh god, my eye!" I mean, it is so
annoying.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, thank you. You see, this is how normal people are supposed to react
to drums.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, you got Joey drums to annoy Rachel, so she wouldn't wanna live
there anymore?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe on some level.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is sitting behind the drums wearing safety goggles,
hitting them with his sticks as Rachel watches.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, y’know that you could just not throw the sticks up in the
air.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What is Rock 'n' Roll about that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering with an aquarium covered by a towel) Hey, Joey, I got you
another present. (She puts it on the counter)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh wait, before you tell me what it is! (He plays a drum-roll) Okay, what
is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's a…tarantula! (Joey almost falls down from his drum-stool
jumping up) Oh! God! Rachel, look, I'm sorry. What was I thinking giving Joey this big,
gross, scary spider in such a poorly constructed cage?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you talking about? I love them! (Looks into the cage) Yeah, I
had a tarantula when I was a kid. But it-it died, because my cat ate it. And then, then my
cat died. But Joey, isn't this cool?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is it on me? I feel, I feel like it's on me! I got, hey! (He storms into
his room)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, isn't that adorable? Joey is afraid of the tarantula.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sarcastic) Ah, yeah, he's so adorable, God, he's just so much fun, Joey
is the best, I'm glad you're having so much fun here. (She turns around, about to leave)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Wait-wait a minute, what? Phoebe, what's the matter?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Our apartment is ready.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And that makes you angry because…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because you would rather live here with Joey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Where did you get that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica and Chandler said that you were having so much fun here. And
apparently no amount of drums or tarantulas is gonna change that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did you get all this stuff for Joey to try and drive me out of the
apartment? Honey, if you wanted to do that, you might as well just gotten him a fish, you
know how fish freaked me out!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (nods along) Fish!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It wouldn't have mattered anyway, Phoebe, you and I are, are gonna live
together, we're roommates; that's the deal.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, but I wanted you to want to live with me, but okay, if you're
having so much fun over here…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it's so much more fun with you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We did have fun, didn't we?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We did!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, anyway, they say, if we want, we can see it tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I would love to!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yay, okay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good, good, good, good, good. (She runs to the drums and gets the
sticks)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great, all right, okay, and Monica ask me to make the drumming stop.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (with the sticks in her hands) Um... (She goes to the tarantula-cage and
puts the sticks into it) Done!
[Scene: Halloween Adventure, a costume shop, there is a salesman behind the
counter, Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Salesman
lines.text: Hello, Sir. You're here to return those pants?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, these are my pants.

lines.speaker: Salesman
lines.text: Oh. Okay! How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, uh, do you have a Santa-outfit left?

lines.speaker: Salesman
lines.text: Two days before Christmas? Sorry, man.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay look, do-do, you have anything Christmassy? I promised my son, and I
really don't want to disappoint him, um, come on, I…uh, you gotta have something.
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Monica has just opened the door for Ross who is
costumed as an Armadillo. Ben is standing next to her.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm the holiday armadillo! I'm a friend of Santa's and he sent me here to
wish you (Points to Ben) a Merry Christmas!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What happened to Santa, Holiday Armadillo?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Monica) Santa was unavailable so close to Christmas.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, come in, have a seat. You must be exhausted coming all the way
from…Texas.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Texas?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's right, Ben. I'm Santa's representative for all the southern states.
And Mexico! But, Santa sent me here to give you these presents, Ben. (He tries to bend
down to pick up the bag with the presents, but can't because of the costume) Maybe the
Lady will help me with these presents.
[Monica picks up the bag, while Ross closes the door and hits Monica with his tail.
They walk into the living room, and Monica empties the bag.]

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Wow! Thanks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're welcome, Ben. Merry Christmas, ooh, and Happy Hanukkah!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Are you for Hanukkah, too? Because I'm part-Jewish.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (gasps) You are? Me, too!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because Armadillos also wandered in the desert?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Monica) You wanna wander in the hall? (to Ben) Ooh, hey Ben, what if
the Holiday Armadillo told you all about the festival of lights?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Cool!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on Ben.
[Monica and Ben sit down on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Years and years ago there were these people called the Maccabees...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering in a Santa costume) Ho, ho, ho! Merry Christmas!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Santa! (Runs to Chandler and hugs him)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! (Grunts as Ben hits him at full speed.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you doing here, Santa?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I'm here to see my old buddy Ben. What are you doing here,
weird…turtle-man?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm the Holiday Armadillo, your part-Jewish friend. You sent me here to
give Ben some presents. Remember?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Did you bring me any presents, Santa?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You bet I did, Ben, put it there! (He shakes Ben's hand, but the money
falls out of his hands) (to Monica) Well, it would have worked this time, if his hands
weren't so damn small! (Realizes, that Ben is standing right there) Ho, ho, ho!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay Ben, why don't you come open some more presents, and Santa, the
Armadillo, and I have a little talk in the kitchen? There's a sentence, I never thought
I'd say.
[They walk to the kitchen; everyone is lowering their voices]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Chandler) What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You called everyone and said you were having trouble finding a Santa
costume, so I borrowed one from a guy at work!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you, but, but you gotta leave.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because, I'm finally getting him excited about Hanukkah, and, and
you're-you’re wrecking it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But I didn't get to shape my belly like a bowl full of jelly.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm sorry, Chandler but this, this is really important to me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine, I'll give the suit back.
[Ross turns around and walks back to Ben.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Chandler) Hey, you think, you can keep it another night? (She has a
really teasing look on her face and keeps twirling Chandler's beard.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Santa? Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, is that okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did your Dad ever dress up like Santa?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then it's okay! (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay Ben, Santa has to go. Say good-bye!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No! Why does he have to go?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because, if Santa and the Holiday…Armadillo? (Ross nods) ...are
ever in the same room for too long the universe will implode. Merry Christmas!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No! Why can't the Armadillo leave? I want Santa!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, I-I give up. Santa, Santa can stay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I'll stay, but only because I wanna hear about Hanukkah. Ben,
will you sit here with Santa and learn about Hanukkah?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Okay, Santa!
(Ross mouths to Chandler, "Thank you," and he mouths, "You’re
welcome," back.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, it's time for the story of Hanukkah. Years and years ago, there
were these people called the Maccabees.
[Joey enters in a Superman-costume]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering wearing a Superman costume) Merry Christmas!
[Scene: Phoebe and Rachel's, they are entering to check out the newly refurbished
apartment.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow! Look at this place!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, this is terrible. Oh, they’ve made so many changes I can’t
even feel my grandmother’s presence anymore—Ooh! New sconces!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (yelling from another room) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (returning) Okay, remember uh, remember how you told me that your
grandmother put up that wall to make that into two bedrooms?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And remember how you always said you were afraid the landlord would find
out and then tear it down?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you really not know where I’m going with this? (Phoebe nods,
"No.") It left! It’s one huge room!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! (She runs to see.) (Running back, excitedly) Oh! Wow!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I guess we’ll just have to put the wall back up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You can’t, because of the new skylight!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There’s a skylight?! (Runs to see and yells from the bedroom.)
Wow!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what should we do? Should we start looking for a new place?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (returning slowly) Y’know I’m-I’m sensing that um, my
grandmother would not be comfortable with that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah? Startin’ to feel her again there are we?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A little bit, yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs is your grandmother maybe saying that you should live here alone?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You heard her too?! You have the gift!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, it’s okay. I like living with Joey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh please, I hate packing, it’s closer to work, and we do have fun.
Although, I’m really gonna miss living with you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh me too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. (They hug.) Oh-oh, wait did you hear that-hear that? Listen,
I’m gettin’ something from your grandmother, she said that since you get to keep
the one bedroom apartment you should give Rachel the purple chair?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I do not hear that.
[Scene: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Santa (Chandler), Superman (Joey), Ben,
and Monica are listening to the Holiday Armadillo (Ross) finish telling the story of
Hanukkah.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …and the miracle was that that little bit of oil that should’ve
just lasted just one day, burned for…

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (answering him) Eight whole days.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right, and that’s why we celebrate Hanukkah today. The
end.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Awesome!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: My favorite part was when Superman flew all the Jews out of
Egypt. (Glaring at Joey who’s nodding.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The Armadillo was actually not so thrilled about that part! Okay
Ben, it’s time to light the Hanukkah candles! (Santa, Superman, Monica, Ben,
and the Holiday Armadillo go over to the menorah to light the candles.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering with Phoebe) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing the collection of characters.) Wow! It looks like the Easter
Bunny’s funeral in here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, come on, we’re-we’re-we’re lighting the candles!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.
(They both go over to light the candles.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I understand why Superman is here, but why is there a
porcupine at the Easter Bunny’s funeral?
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is closing the door on the tarantula cage.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I got it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (yelling from the bedroom) Is it back in the cage?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Its back in cage!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Cage closed?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, would you just come out here and stop being such a baby!
(Joey throws open his door and stands there still in the Superman costume then
slowly makes his way to the bathroom while keeping both eyes on the cage.)

title: The One with All the Cheesecakes

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Monica’s, Chandler is sitting at the kitchen table eating
cheesecake. The box it came in is also on the table.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh. Mmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Comes in the front door and walks towards the kitchen.) Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you have got to try this cheesecake.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, y’know I'm not that much of a sweet tooth. I—(Chandler
puts a forkful of the cheesecake in her mouth.)—Wow. My God, so creamy. Oh my God,
this is the best cheesecake I have ever had. Where did you get this? (She reaches over to
look at the label on the box.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (nervously) It was at the front door. When I got home. Somebody sent
it to us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, this is not addressed to you. This is addressed to Mrs.
Braverman downstairs. (Gasping) Thief.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I—no! I didn't read the box before I opened it. And you can't
return a box after you've opened the box.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why, why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because it's too delicious.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, you stole this cheesecake. That is wrong.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no! It is going to be okay, because Mrs. Braverman is gonna send
away for a free one and that way we all win! The only losers are the big cheesecake
conglomerate, (Reading the label) Momma’s Little Bakery. (Pause) I feel terrible,
I’m a horrible, horrible, horrible person.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (taking a bite) Oh, I’m sorry what?
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, everyone except Rachel is there as Joey gets up and starts
putting on his coat.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I should get going, big day a work. Y’know I’m in a
coma? Today, they do this test on me and it turns out I’m not brain dead.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah-ah-ah Mr. Smartie Pants, it’s just not my character that’s
not brain dead. Hey, so Pheebs, we still on for tonight?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Absolutely!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’ll see you at 8:00.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Joey exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, what’s at 8:00?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I have dinner plans with Joey. We get together about once a month to
discuss the rest of you guys.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, did not know that! May I say how lovely you look today?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Duly noted.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. (Phoebe gets up to get a refill.) (To Monica) Oh! So for tomorrow,
do you want to rent a car and drive down together or what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Cousin Frannie’s wedding, its tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You were invited?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My God, I can’t believe this! I mean I knew that mom and dad were
invited, but I thought that was it! I mean from the ages 7 to 9 Frannie and I were
inseparable!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, maybe since the age of 9, Frannie’s made some new friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well l-look okay, it’s probably just a mistake. Let me call Aunt
Sheryl okay? Maybe you are invited and the invitation just got lost in the mail.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, well you call her and tell her that y’know when we were kids
her precious little Frannie tried to undress me several times, okay? And if I hadn’t
have stopped her, there probably wouldn’t even be a wedding to go too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know, she tried to undress me too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I used to undress my cousin Glenn. (Monica looks at him then sushes
him.)
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Monica, Chandler, Rachel, and Ross are playing Monopoly
as Phoebe enters angrily.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joseph Francis Tribbiani are you home yet?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, I think he’s still out. What’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I’ll tell you Rachel Karen Green, I had plans with Joey
tonight and he left me this note. (Hands it to Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading the note) "Pheebs, can’t make it, got a date. Talk to
you later. Big Daddy." (Laughs) Big Daddy?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’s a nickname we were trying out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, y’know what nickname never caught on? The Ross-A-Tron! (Monica
shakes her head in disgust.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Here’s Joseph Francis!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-Wha-Ho! What are you middle naming me for?! I left you a note!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So what?! That doesn’t give you the right to ditch me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you can cancel plans with friends if there is the possibility for
sex!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe he’s right, that is the rule.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t accept this rule. When me make plans, I expect you to show
up. Okay, I can’t just be a way to kill time ‘til you meet someone better!
Y’know boyfriends and girlfriends come and go, but this (Motions that their
friendship) is for life!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! I’m so sorry; I had no idea it would bother you this much.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it does.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, can I-can I make it up to you? Huh? I’m sorry. (They hug.) How
about uh, dinner tomorrow night?! I’ll pay for myself!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, you wore me down.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Joe, while you’re over there how about another beer for the
Ross-A-Tron?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The Ross—Is that back?!! (Chandler motions no.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Rachel enters to find Chandler staring at another
cheesecake box.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Another cheesecake came! They delivered it to the wrong address again!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So just bring it back downstairs, what’s the problem?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t seem to say goodbye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you serious?! Chandler, we ate an entire cheesecake two days ago and
you want more?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well I’ve forgotten what it tastes like okay?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It was cheesecake. It was fine. It had a buttery, crumbly, graham
cracker crust, with a very rich yet light, cream cheese filling… (Pause) Wow! My
whole mouth just filled with saliva!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (closing the box) Y’know what? Forget it! We are just
hungry! We have not had lunch! We are just light-headed! So let us go out and have lunch
and forget about the cheesecake.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah and we’ll drop it off downstairs so that we’re not
tempted.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good idea. Where do you want to go to lunch?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Momma’s Little Bakery, Chicago, Illinois. (They exit with the
cheesecake.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica and Joey are there. Joey is reading a newspaper.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Awww! Mel Torme died.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, that paper’s like a year old!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aw! Does that mean the Sam Goody’s sale is over?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So I finally heard back from Aunt Sheryl and apparently it wasn’t
a mistake. Ahh, there’s-there’s limited seating in the hall.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Limited seating?! (Screechingly) I am just one tiny person!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well yeah, but she doesn’t know that. I mean, the last time she saw
you-you would’ve turned one of those little wedding chairs into kindling.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (disgusted) Limited seating! Oh, that is such a lame excuse! That’s
not the reason she’s not inviting me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh what’s the big deal?! I wasn’t even invited to the ceremony,
just the reception. And-and y’know what? If it makes you feel any better, Joan and I
will just make an appearance and then, and then we’ll-we’ll leave early as a
sign of protest.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joan?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, Joan Tedeski my date. She’s an assistant professor in the
Linguistics department. Tall, very beautiful, and despite what some people say, not
broad backed!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute, you got Ross Gellar and guest?! I wasn’t invited and
you got "and guest?!"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-uh, excuse me, I do have to interrupt on Ross’s behalf. I-I think
the rule applies here y’know, since she has a chance to get on broad back…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupting) Not broad backed!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute, y’know, you’re bringing me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? I can’t cancel on Joan!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bec—Did you not hear me?! She’s an assistant professor in the
Linguistics department, okay? They’re wild! Why do you want to come anyway?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because! She’s my cousin. I mean, we grew up together! We’re
family y’know? Well that’s important to me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, all right, I’ll take you. I’ll go call Joan. (Does so.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aww that’s nice. Family should be there, huh? This is her wedding,
happiest day of her life.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) We’ll see.
[Scene: The Lobby of Chandler and Rachel’s building, Chandler and Rachel are
returning from lunch.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, thank you for lunch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Wait a minute, I didn’t pay, I thought you paid!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So apparently we just don’t pay for food anymore. (Rachel laughs
then Chandler notices something.) Do you see what I see?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Its still there! (The cheesecake they returned to Mrs. Braverman
is still lying in front of her door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mrs. Braverman must be out. (They move closer to it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She could be out of town. Maybe she’ll be gone for months.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: By then, the cheesecake may have gone bad. We don’t want her to
come back to bad cheesecake.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No that could kill her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, we don’t want that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No so we’re protecting her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But we should take it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But we should move quick.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because I think I just heard her moving around in there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Go! Go! Go! Go! Go! Go! Go! Go! Go! Go! (Rachel grabs the cheesecake
and they take off upstairs.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica and Phoebe are entering. As Phoebe is sitting down, she
recognizes someone sitting at the counter.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) (whispering) Oh my God! That’s David!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: David who?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: David the scientist guy, David that I was in love with, David who went
to Russia and broke my heart David!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: (noticing Phoebe) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you say someone’s name enough, they turn around.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: David! (He kisses her cheek) What-what are you doing here? Aren’t
you supposed to be in Russia?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Yeah, I’m just, I’m just in town for a conference. Umm, God
you look phenomenal!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well… Yeah. You look great too. Did you get a haircut?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Yeah. Well I-I got like thirty of them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Umm, look I-I-I got a confession to make…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Uh, I-I-I was hoping to run into you here. I didn’t know whether I
should call or not, y’know I-I was only in town for a few days. And y’know, I
didn’t want to intrude on your life or-or anything like that, but I-I really wanted
to see you and—but I didn’t know if you wanted to see me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, of course I would want to see you. I…I think about you all
the time.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Really? Because I think about you all the time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I mean, there’s a statue in Minsk…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That reminds me of you so much, I mean umm, it-it’s actually
of Lenin. But, y’know at certain angles…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Umm, anyway…Do you want to have dinner tonight?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (excited) Yes! Oh no!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: (disappointed) Oh. Uh, what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t. I can’t believe I have plans, I can’t. Can you
do it tomorrow night though?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Uh no, I have to go in a few hours. I have to be on the red-eye. Well
listen, y’know, next time you’re in Minsk umm…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, can I talk to you for a second?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh. (They go over and talk.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I have plans with Joey tonight.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So! He’ll understand!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No he won’t. And that’s not even the point! Monica, I made a
whole speech about you do not cancel plans with friends! And now y’know what? Just
because, potentially, the love of my life comes back from Russia just for one night, I-I
should change my beliefs?! I should change beliefs! No! No! No, if I don’t have my
principles, I don’t have anything!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God, you are so strong.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or! I should rush through dinner with Joey and I can meet David at 9:00!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel and Chandler are eating the cheesecake right out of
the box.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (taking a bite) Oh my God! That is so good!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m full, and yet I know if I stop eating this, I’ll regret
it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (seeing what they’re doing) What do you got there?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh it’s umm, it’s tofu cake. Do you want some? (He makes a
disgusted noise and heads for his room, Chandler follows him in.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you doing tonight?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh? Uh… (He starts taking off his pants.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dude! Dude! (Motions that Joey should pull up his pants.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! (Pulls up his pants.) Sorry. Uh, I’ve got those plans with
Phoebe, why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh really? Uh, Monica said she had a date at 9:00.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! Tonight?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s what Monica said.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: After she gave me that big speech?! She goes and makes a date with a guy
on the same night she has plans with me? I think she’s trying to pull a fast one on
Big Daddy!
[Scene: Cousin Frannie’s Wedding Reception, Monica and Ross are entering and
finding their table.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh here, I think this is us. (Reading the name cards.) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Limited seating my ass. Let’s see who made the cut. (To the couple
sitting to her right.) Hi!

lines.speaker: The Wedding Guest
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m Monica Gellar. Who do you know the bride and groom?

lines.speaker: The Wedding Guest
lines.text: Oh, I used to work with Frannie.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Used to work with her. Used to! I’m a relative and I didn’t
get invited! A blood relative! Blood!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Monica) Stop saying, "Blood" to strangers.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the couple on her left) So, how about you huh? How do you know the
happy couple?

lines.speaker: The Second Guest
lines.text: We went to college with both of them and now we live
next door.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, you’re fine.
[Scene: Iridium Restaurant, Phoebe and Joey are looking at the menus as the
waiter comes to take their order.]

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Are you guys ready?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! I will have the green salad, umm the house salad, and water’s
fine.

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: (To Joey) And for you sir?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, this slow roasted salmon, just how slow are we talkin’ here?

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: It’s uh, it’s already been roasted.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh, then no. Maybe I should hear those specials again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Joey, we’ve heard the specials three times! Okay? There’s
prime rib, mahi mahi, and a very special lobster ravioli. (She grabs his menu and hands it
to the waiter.)

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: Actually we’re out of the lobster ravioli. (Putting Joey’s
menu under his arm.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well, that changes everything! (Grabs his menu and starts looking at it
again. The waiter leaves.) Y’know what Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You were right before. I mean, friends are so important.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (checking her watch) Yeah, I’m very wise. I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know-y’know what I really want?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is to have a long, long talk. Y’know? Get Joey out on the open road
and really open him up.

lines.speaker: The Waiter
lines.text: (returning) Any progress?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes! I will have the lobster ravioli.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God Joey, this is taking forever!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s the rush? What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: W-w—I just—it’s that—I have—y’know I
have-I have an appointment. And it’s very important.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa, what is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well… It’s a date.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A date?! No, no Pheebs you-you must be mistaken, because I know you
wouldn’t schedule a date on the same night you have plans with a friend!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on Joey, don’t make me feel badly about this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I’m gonna!! That’s right! Yeah, you made me feel really
guilty about goin’ out with that girl! Like-like-like I did something terrible to
you! And now Pheebs, you’re doing the same thing!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That—It’s not the same thing! This is totally
different! This is with David! Remember David, the scientist guy? Okay, he’s very
special to me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, well my girl from the other night was special. She was a scientist
too!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She was?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, she graduated from high school!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, whatever. Y’know what? I don’t have time have time to
convince you because he’s only here for four hours, and I’m gonna go see him!
(Gets up and leaves.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! (She exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the waiter) What are you still doin’ here?! I told you, lobster
ravioli!

scenes.location: Outside Central Perk, Phoebe is running up to meet David.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Hey! Oh, I was just about to leave. I-I-I-I didn’t think you were
coming.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I wouldn’t miss this.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Well, I’m very glad you’re here. (Kisses her hand.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you’re such a gentleman. (Grabs his arm.) Come on! We’re
going to my place! (Drags him off to her place.)
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is eating the cheesecake and Chandler enters and
catches her in the act.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you eating the cheesecake without me?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (with a mouthful) Mm-mmm. (Nods no.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I will give you a hundred dollars to whistle right now. (She tries to
whistle and blows little chunks of cheesecake out of her mouth.) How can you eat the
cheesecake without me?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, what are you going to do?! Are you gonna go run tell Monica?! Are
you gonna tell Joey?! No! Because then you will have to tell them what we did! We are
desert stealers! We are living outside the law!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what? I don’t trust you with this cake anymore! And I
got it first, and I’m takin’ it back! (Grabs the cheesecake and heads for his
apartment.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait a minute!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no-no, no you don’t!
[Cut to Chandler and Monica’s as they enter.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes! Oh yes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You think I trust you with it?! No! We’re gonna split it! You take
half and I take half!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well that’s not fair, you’ve already had some!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Oh, well then y’know what? I think Monica would be very
interested to know that you called her cheesecake dry and mealy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What do we use to split it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! (Grabs a knife and cuts it in half.) All right, pick a half.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (examining the cake) Okay well, this side looks bigger. Uh…
There’s more crust on this side. Y’know? So, maybe if I measured…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh for God sake just pick a piece!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, I’ll pick that one. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s also the smaller piece. (Puts the piece onto a plate.) Okay,
there you go. Enjoy your half my friend, but that is it. No sharing. No switching, and
don’t come crying to me if you eat your piece to fast. (As she’s saying
that she is backing out the door, when she finishes she turns around to return to her
place, stumbles and drops the cheesecake on the floor.) Oh!!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (gloatingly and holding his piece) Ohhh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you gotta give me some of your piece.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho-ho-no! No! No switching! No sharing, and don’t come
crying to me! Ha-ha-ha! I may just sit here and have my cake all day! Just sit here in the
hallway and eat my… (Rachel knocks the plate from his hand and it falls on the floor.
That process leaves just the forkful Chandler has, Rachel starts to go after that little
bit and Chandler retreats into his apartment.)
[Scene: Cousin Frannie’s Wedding Reception, Monica and Ross are sitting at the
table, alone as a woman approaches.]

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: Ross, sweetheart!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, hey Aunt Millie.

lines.speaker: Aunt Millie
lines.text: Isn’t it a beautiful wedding?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, yes it is. It’s uh… (Aunt Millie uses this opportunity to
grab Ross and kiss him on the lips. After she leaves Ross quickly wipes his mouth with a
napkin.) Every time on the lips! Why?! Why on lips?!
(Cousin Frannie and her husband enter.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here’s Frannie. Hmm, won’t she be happy to see me? (Starts to
get up and great Frannie.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now wait a minute, you be nice! All right? I didn’t bring you here so
you can ambush her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Frannie was the one who found your Playboys and showed them to
mom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That bitch! (He gets up and they go over to ambush Frannie. Monica taps on
Frannie’s shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: (turning around) Monica! What…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Am I doing here? Why? Surprised to see me? Ross brought me. How do you
like that?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Frannie) Hi Frannie, congratulations.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You invite my brother, you invite my whole family, and not me?! Why?!
What—Why wouldn’t you want me at your wedding? What could I have possibly done?!
(Frannie’s husband walks up.) Stuart!

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: I believe you know my husband.
(Monica is shocked into silence.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So it’s really a question of who could you have possibly done.
[Scene: Outside Central Perk, David has a cab waiting to take him to the airport and
he’s saying goodbye to Phoebe.]

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Oh, I hate this but I-I-I have to go. I-I can’t miss my
flight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you sure? I’ll bet there’s another flight to Minsk in
like…

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: July. Umm, (He speaks Russian.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s really beautiful. What does it mean?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Please, clean my beakers. I don’t get out of the lab much.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s good. I got to admit, I thought it was something else.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Yeah, I… Well I really actually wanted to say umm, that, but um, I
figured I probably shouldn’t because y’know, I…have to leave.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re right! You’re right. Don’t say it.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I-I do though.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I do too. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Bye Phoebe. (He gets in and the cab drives off. Joey walks up and
witnesses that event.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (seeing him) Okay, now’s not the time Joey. All right? You can yell
at me tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No! No Pheebs, I’m not gonna yell at you. I just y’know,
started thinking about you and David and I…remember how bummed you were the first
time he left. And I just… Oh Pheebs, come here. (He hugs her.) Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No I’m not okay. The only guy I’ve ever been crazy about has
gone to Minsk and I may never…I may never see him again. (Crying.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, y’know you could always visit him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh right, like they’re gonna let me have a passport.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Anything I can do? Whatever you need.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well—But—Now, if-if you can achieve positronic distillation of
sub-atomic particles y’know before he does, then he can come back. (They hug again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can give it a shot.
[Scene: The Hallway, Chandler and Rachel are on their knees with forks trying to
salvage what they can of the cheesecake off of the floor.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Yay! Look! There’s a piece that doesn’t have floor on it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stick to your side!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, come on now!
(Joey finishes climbing the stairs and sees them. Chandler and Rachel both stop and
look up at him. Joey sits down on the step.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pulls out a fork) All right, what are we havin’? (Starts digging
in.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Cousin Frannie’s Wedding Reception, Ross and Monica are at the door and
about to leave.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh wait I forgot my wrap.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Oh, okay. Wait here. (Goes to get it, but before he gets there Aunt
Millie sits down on it forcing him to pull it out from behind her which gets her
attention.)

lines.speaker: Aunt Millie
lines.text: Hi sweetie! Are you leaving?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well…

lines.speaker: Aunt Millie
lines.text: Give us a kiss. Come on! Come on!
(Ross hesitates then leans down trying to get her to kiss his cheek, but she moves his
head around and kisses him on the lips again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why?! Why on the lips?! (He wipes his mouth on Monica’s wrap and
walks off, leaving Aunt Millie stunned.)

title: The One Where They're Up All Night

lines.text: [Scene: The Building’s Roof, the entire gang plus Tag are there to look for a
comet. They’re looking for a comet on a roof of a New York apartment building. Yeah,
that’s realistic. You might as well look for the moon on a bright sunny day.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking up) Ross, when’s this comet thing start?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, technically it seven billion years ago… (Well,
technically you’d be able to see it for days, well nights; that is if you could see
it with all of the bright lights of New York.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (groaning) Oh no! Oh no! (They all start to get up a leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! Okay! Fine, I’ll stop! No teaching, okay? We’ll just watch
the pretty light streaking across the sky. (Comets don’t streak across the sky,
meteors do.) Okay? Who’s official name is Bapstein-King.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Okay! Okay! (They start to leave again.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looking up) There it is! Oh, look at that! Isn’t Mother Nature
amazing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking up with her) That’s a plane!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, all right. 1700 bags of peanuts flying that high, that’s
pretty amazing too.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Hey, I wonder if you can see my apartment from up here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. No, you can’t.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh I don’t-I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Man, look at all those stars! (Yeah, you can see what? Five of them from
the city?) Infinite space. It really, really makes you wonder, doesn’t it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking through his binoculars at a nearby building) Y’know what
else makes you wonder?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Check out the rack on this chick! (Turns around to point it out to Ross
and finds that Ross is glaring at him. So he quickly puts his binoculars to his eyes and
starts looking for the comet.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: The Roof, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, we’ve been out here for two hours and we haven’t seen
any stupid comets. Can we go now? I mean, Chandler’s getting chilly. (She walks over
to where Chandler is bundled up in a big coat and shivering.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (with a quivering voice) No, I’m not!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then why are you wearing Monica’s jacket?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because it’s flattering! (Shivers harder) Come on Monica! Come on
Monica! (He goes inside.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah actually, I think we’re gonna take off too. We rented a movie.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! I won’t say, ‘no’ to a movie!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh Pheebs, we just actually kinda wanted to be alone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shh! Get me out of here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. (They leave, leaving just Joey and Ross.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (whispering) Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come here, check this out!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Is it the comet? (Runs over to where Joey’s standing.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No-no. Look, there’s a bug stuck in tar right here. (Bends down
to get a closer look.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey come—I can’t believe—I bring you here to see the
Bapstein-King comet, one of nature’s most spectacular phenomenon, and all you care
about are bugs stuck in tar and-and some woman!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (standing up) Y’know, there’s two women dude.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Show me where?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right-right up here. (Starts looking at them through a piece of pipe.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (noticing the pipe and looking at the door) Joey where’s the pipe
that was holding the door open?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (annoyed) I don’t know! (Goes back to looking through the pipe.)
(Pause) Yeah, I do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! All right—Hey! Don’t look at me! You’re the one who
wanted to come up and look for some stupid Burger King comet!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s called the Bapstein-King comet, okay? (Joey starts to groan.)
Hey! Hey! Bapstein was a very well respected astronomer!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (covering his ears and yelling) Oh no! No! No! (He starts banging on the
door.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s bedroom, Monica is sleeping and Chandler’s
sitting in bed, wide awake.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (whispering) Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s sleeping.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, just quick-quick question, quick question. Which one was Deep
Impact and which one was Armageddon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Deep Impact was the one with Robert Duval, Armageddon is
what’s going to happen to you if you wake me up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry, I just…can’t sleep. Ooh! (Turns on the light and
Monica groans.) Where is that book that you are reading with the two women who were
ice-skating and wearing, wearing those hats with the flowers on it? Because every time I
look at that cover I’m like…(Fake snores.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It is in the living room where there is also a light! And no one will
kick you in the shin.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?! (Monica kicks him in the shin.) Ow! (He gets out of bed and
heads into the living room.)
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment, there is a beeping noise coming from the living room and
Phoebe sleepily goes to investigate.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (crossing her fingers and closing her eyes) Please don’t be a space
ship. Please don’t be a space ship. (She turns on the light and looks around and
finds that it’s the smoke detector that’s beeping.) Oh thank God! (She moves a
chair over and starts to investigate how to make the beeping turn off, in frustration she
yanks the thing off of the wall. She sets it down and heads for bed, just as she gets
there it beeps again. She opens the cover and removes the battery, but it still beeps.)
How could you be beeping?! I just disconnected you! I took out your battery! How can…

lines.speaker: Smoke Detector
lines.text: Beep!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t interrupt me!!

scenes.location: The Roof, Ross and Joey are banging on the door.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel!! Monica!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on!
(Ross gets fed up with Joey’s banging and stops him by pulling him away from the
door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t believe this!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right well, y’know…I guess we know what we have to do to get
down.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (standing at the edge of the roof) Yeah, I guess we don’t have a
choice. (Screaming to the street) Help us! Please help us! We’re stuck up on the roof
and we can’t get down!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross. I was thinking we could just go down the fire escape. (Points it
out.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Joey) I know, I wasn’t finished. (Joey motions him to finish.)
(Yelling at the street) But don’t worry! We’re gonna go down the fire escape!!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's kitchen, Chandler has a jug of milk in his hands and
decides to make some warm milk. He opens up the cabinet to get a pot and manages to knock
several other pots onto the floor making a lot of noise.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Shhhhhhhhh!!! (Monica enters) I’m sorry, I thought maybe I’d
make some warm milk and it would help me sleep.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: With a wok? (Chandler’s holding a wok.) I thought you were going to
read my boring book to put you asleep.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It got interesting! Damn you Oprah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here, let me make the milk, I’m up anyway.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, y’know what we can do? Y’know, now that we are up? We
can just like talk to each other all night long, y’know like we did when we were
first going out. It’d be fun!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay that does sound like fun.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so how bummed were you when the second sister died huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The second sister dies?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Pause) No. No, I-I was, I was talking about the book I was reading.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The second sister dies in Archie and Jughead Double Digest?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s correct.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel and Tag are making out on the couch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You wanna go in the bedroom? It’s a little more comfortable.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (They start to head for the bedroom) Oh wait! Umm, did you send
those contracts to Milan?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: If this is your idea of sexy talk? (Shakes his head that it’s not
working.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No seriously, y’know the contracts I gave you, did you overnight
them?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What contracts?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay please tell me that this is just one of your jokes that you do that
I don’t get.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know, like the thing when you put the phone in your pants? (He
starts laughing.) Tag! I’m serious! This isn’t funny! Those contracts absolutely
had to go out today!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Rach, I’m sorry, but you didn’t give me any contracts!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes I did! And I put a little Post-It on it that said, "Must
go out today," and underlined today three times and, and then I put a little heart in
the corner because I didn’t want to seem to bossy.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I’m telling you, you never gave them to me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know what Tag, if we went down to the office you would see those
contracts sitting on your desk.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: No, I would see you looking embarrassed because they are not on my
desk!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Or maybe you would see me looking embarrassed because you are talking on
the phone with your crotch!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: You wanna go down to the office right now?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Come on its late, we’re not gonna go down to the office.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Okay I understand. (Sits down.) I wouldn’t want to be proved wrong
either.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay get your coat! (They get their coats and start to leave. Rachel
suddenly stops and sticks the hand up the back of her shirt.) Oh! When did you unhook
this? (Her bra.) Nice work!
[Scene: The Fire Escape, Joey and Ross have reached the last landing. Joey is tugging
on the ladder that extends to the ground, but it won’t budge.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, it won’t go down any further. It’s stuck.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ugh. Well, we’re just gonna have to jump. (Joey looks at him.) Yeah.
Now, we’re gonna have to make sure to land to the right of that patch of ice, okay?
Not hit the dumpster on the other side and uh, and try to avoid that-that weird brownish
red stuff in the middle. So, when you get down there…you go up to the
roof and you let me in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh whoa-whoa wait a minute! I have to do it?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Oh yeah, you’ll be fine! It-it’ll be uh, just like bungy
jumping. Y’know? But instead of bouncing back up you-you won’t.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What if I smack my head on the concrete?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’m gonna lie to you Joey, it’s a possibility.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looks at the ground and at Ross) I don’t know Ross! I-I tell you
what, let’s flip to see who does it, okay? You-you call it in the air, all right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, all right. (Joey flips the coin.) Tails! (The coin bounces off of the
landing above them and falls to the ground.) Can you-can you see what it is?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Well, you be careful.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? No! No Ross! No-no! Stop! I’m not jumping! Okay, look I have an
audition tomorrow and I can’t go if I break my leg.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I’m jumping! I have a son! Okay? He won’t have a father
if-if I die!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well all right so, it looks like we’re even!
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment, Phoebe is still investigating the smoke detector trying to
figure out how to stop the beeping.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. So, this wire is connected to this wire which plugs into here.
(She points at each as she says it.) Okay so, to get the beeping to stop all I have to
do… (She picks up a shoe and proceeds to pummel the smoke detector. She then gets up
and heads to bed, stops, quickly turns around, and is satisfied that the beeping has
stopped.) Well done, Pheebs. (She resumes her trek to bed, but is stopped at the entrance
to the hallway by the now steady and extremely loud tone emanating from the smoke
detector.) (Yelling.) What do you want from me?!!!!!!!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's bedroom, Monica is entering with a mug.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, here’s your milk. What do you want to talk about? (She sees
that Chandler has fallen asleep and slams the door loudly to wake him up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (startled) What? What? What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh! Ohhhh! Were you sleeping sweetie? I’m sorry. Here. (Hands the
mug of milk to him.)

scenes.location: Rachel’s Outer Office, Tag and her are arriving.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Okay! Feel free to look, but I’m telling you those contracts are not
on this desk.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh how can you possibly know? Look at this mess, Tag! I mean,
this is what I’m talking about! You have to be organized! You’ve got newspapers!
You’ve got magazines! You got—Ohh! (Finds a picture.) And who is this chippy? A
little young for you Tag, but whatever.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: It’s my sister.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, very cute braces. Anyway y’know what, the point is
Tag, start looking because you are going to find those contracts on your desk. (She goes
into her office.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: So when do you imagine you gave them to me? In the morning or in the
afternoon?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: In the afternoon. Mr. Zelner came into my office after lunch. He put
them on my desk, and then I put a Post-It on it (Looks down onto her desk and finds
the folder with the Post-It on it that contains the contracts she imagined she gave
Tag) that said, "Must go out today." So you just keep looking in there! All
right?
Commercial Break
[Scene: Rachel’s outer office, Tag has finished searching his desk and Rachel
comes out to try to plant the folder on the desk.]

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: It’s not here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Puzzler. A bit of a puzzle. Why don’t you um, check the copy room,
maybe you left the contracts in there?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: How could I have left them in the copy room?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know Tag! How can your genitals make phone calls? Okay?
It’s not a perfect world! Just go please.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (He leaves and she proceeds to plant the folder in his bottom
drawer. She then picks up the phone and holds it to her breasts.) Hello? (Hangs up the
phone.) I still don’t get it.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's bedroom, Chandler has his eyes closed, while Monica is
fully awake.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you still awake?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! You?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You do know that was me who just said that right? (He doesn’t
respond and she turns on the light, waking him.) Hey. As long as we’re both up…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (intrigued) Yeah? (Monica nods yes.) I hope you’re not thinking
about cleaning the living room.

scenes.location: The fire escape, Joey and Ross are still trying to figure out how to get down.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, I’m starving! What the hell was I thinking at dinner?! "Do
you want soup or salad?" Both! Always order both!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking in the window behind them) Y’know, y’know I’m
lookin’ and I don’t think anyone’s home here. I say we just break the
window, crawl through, and-and y’know explain later.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah? Really? No one’s home?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t think so. Hello? (Knocks on the glass, which angers the big,
large, angry dog behind the glass and causes them to jump to the other side of the
landing.) When you get in there… (Joey nods his disapproval.)
[Scene: Phoebe’s apartment building, in desperation she has wrapped up the smoke
detector in a blanket and is going to throw it into the trash chute.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, this is where you and I part ways. (She drops the blanket into the
chute.) Noisy bitch!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's bedroom, Chandler is turning on the light to awaken a now
sleeping Monica.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! What are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you know what just happened?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. We-we had sex and then we fell asleep.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. We were in the middle of sex…and you fell asleep.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nooo! No, that’s not true. No, best time ever! Yeah, you rocked me
world! (She turns out the light to go back to sleep.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (turning the light back on) Monica?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was giving you some of my best moves, and you missed it. So please
wake up so we can do it right!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Okay, I’m ready. Come on big fella!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Give me the good stuff.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! (Monica falls asleep) No! No! No! Don’t fall asleep! Okay,
I am going to make you some coffee. (Monica doesn’t move as he gets out of bed and as
he’s heading for the door.) And I probably won’t spill coffee grounds all over
the kitchen floor.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I’m up! I’m up!
[Scene: Rachel’s outer office, she’s returning with two coffee cups in hand
to find Tag sitting there.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! I got you some coffee. To, uh… (She looks for a place to set it
on his messy desk and he clears a spot for her to set it down.) …fair enough. So! Do
you got anything for me?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Still no luck.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Did you check your entire desk! Did you check all the
drawers!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Do you want me to check again?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well yeah, I wish that you would. (He opens the top drawer.) Well, no
it’s not in there! (Closes it.) How about that drawer? (She points to the bottom one
and he opens it. She doesn’t see the folder she planted and bends over to check.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Well, it’s not out here. Is there any chance it could be in your
office?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (thinks) Y’know, I don’t-I don’t know. Let me, let me
check. (As she heads for her office, she stops glances over her should at Tag, looks into
her office, and finds the folder on her desk.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (smirking) Any luck?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can I see you in my office for a minute?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (entering) Yeah? (She holds up the folder) You found them!! (Rachel is not
amused, because she’s still going to try to blame him for her mistake like every
‘good’ boss.) Y’know what? I’m not even going to gloat. I’m just
really relived this whole thing is over.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You put these on my desk!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I did not!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh really? So you’re saying they just slid out of your
bottom drawer, crawled across the floor, then jumped on to my desk?! (I think Dogbert
should have a line here.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: How did you know they were in my bottom drawer?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause as she realizes her lame attempt to shift the blame has failed) I
am so hot for you right now.
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment, there is someone pounding on the door and Phoebe sleepily
walks over and answers it. As she nears the door, the pounding stops and she can hear the
smoke detector’s wail.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! How did you get back here?!

lines.speaker: A Disembodied Voice
lines.text: (yelling through the door) Phoebe Buffay?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (scared) Fire alarm? (She opens the door to reveal a fireman holding the
blanket with the smoke detector.) Oh! Hi, officer—fireman, can-can I help you?

lines.speaker: The Fireman
lines.text: We found your fire alarm in the trash chute.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s not mine.

lines.speaker: The Fireman
lines.text: Yes it is.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How do you know?

lines.speaker: The Fireman
lines.text: The next time you want to dump a fire alarm in a trash chute,
don’t wrap it in a blanket that says, "Property of Phoebe Buffay not
Monica."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay do you—Okay, do you have a search warrant? Because the last
time I checked this was still America!

lines.speaker: The Fireman
lines.text: Please reattach this, it’s against the law to disconnect them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine! (She takes the blanket.) But please God; tell me how to stop them
from going off!

lines.speaker: The Fireman
lines.text: There’s a reset button under the plastic cover.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There’s a reset button?! Ugh, thank you! Thank you! (He exits and
she goes to shut it off.) There’s a reset button! My God! Why didn’t I see that!
(She takes off the plastic cover and looks for the button.) Reset button, reset button,
where is there a reset button? (Finds it.) Oh here it is! (Picks it up off of the floor.)
Oh! (She presses it hard, but of course it would help if the button was still attached to
the detector. In frustration she presses it so hard it causes pain in her thumb.) Ohh,
God!
[Scene: The fire escape, Joey is now hanging off of the bottom rung of the ladder that
won’t move and Ross is watching from above.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, do-do you have a good grip?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I’m going to start climb down you now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Just hurry up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Now-now-now should I climb down your front so we’re face to
face or-or should I climb down your back so we’re-we’re butt to face.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think face to face.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I would say that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Face to face, yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, here I go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right.
(Ross steps onto the bottom rung of the ladder and then steps on Joey’s chest.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (grunting) Oh my… How much do you weigh Ross?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I prefer not to answer that right now, I’m still carrying a little
holiday weight.
(Ross continues to climb down. He puts his other foot further down on Joey’s
torso, but that doesn’t work very well and he’s forced to wrap his legs around
Joey. Which then forces Joey to get a nice and close view of Ross’s crotch.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know, when we talked about face to face, I don’t think we
thought it all the way through.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So what do you want me to do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, just shimmy down me and drop!
(Ross continues his trek south, and when they get face to face.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking down) M-maybe I should hang and you can climb down me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (angrily) Yeah? Maybe we should talk about that for a little while!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s still looks pretty far!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s not that far! Just drop!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do not rush me!!
(Ross continues south and his now wrapped around Joey’s legs.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, you should know that my pants are startin’ to come down and
I’m not wearing any underwear!
(Ross panics and falls off, dropping to the ground with a huge crash.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oww!! My ankle! I really hurt my ankle! I think I twisted it when
I—Ooh, a quarter!
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's bedroom, they’re cuddling.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That really was some of your best work.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hm-hmm, I told you! (Looks at the clock) I can’t believe that
I’ve only got two hours before I call in sick for work.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I have to be up in seven minutes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you’re not gonna believe this, but if you have seven
minutes…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you wanna?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! You get the vacuum cleaner and I’ll get the furniture polish!
(She runs off leaving a stunned Chandler behind.)

title: The One Where Rosita Dies

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is trying to move Joey’s chair and not having
much luck at it as Joey enters.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know I was thinking of moving the couch over here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) Why would you want to do that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So that there will be a decent place for me to sit.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach, there is a decent place to…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And your lap does not count! Okay? Come on help me move this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. No. No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. Rosita does not move.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry, Rosita? As in…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: As in Rosita does not move.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, it’s just a chair! What’s the big deal?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The big deal is that it is the exact equal distance from the bathroom to
the kitchen and it’s at the perfect angle so you don’t get any glare coming of
off Stevie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Stevie the TV?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (glaring at her) Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! (Joey sets his beer and bag of chips down and heads into his room.)
Oh what does he know! Come on Rosita, us chichas got to stick together! (She tries pulling
on the back of the chair, until the hinge breaks and the back falls off.) You bitch!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Ross are on the couch talking. Phoebe is getting
coffee.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, y’know what’s weird? After you guys get married, when you
introduce me to people you’re gonna have to say, "This is my brother-in-law
Ross." Not, "My friend Ross," "brother-in-law Ross." That’s
weird isn’t it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Couldn’t I just say, "This is Ross?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (disappointed) Sure, do whatever you want.
(Phoebe sits down between Chandler and Ross.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering, carrying a newspaper) Hey Ross! So, I was checking out the
uh, real estate section…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look at this. (Hands him the newspaper.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, it looks like mom and dad’s house. Oh, it even has a tree with a
broken limb out front and the uh, the window in the attic is…Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? What happened to the window in the attic?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t believe mom and dad are selling the house!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t believe they-they didn’t even tell us!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t believe I still don’t know what happened to the window
in the attic!
(Ross calls his parents on his cell phone.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) Uh, hello dad! Monica and I just saw the house in the paper!
(Listens) Yes we’re surprised! (Listens) Who did you leave a message with?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (knocking on the window while outside) Sorry! (Runs off.)
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is examining the injury to Rosita while Rachel is
apologizing to him.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
