lines.text: Joey, Joey I am so sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I told you not to move it! Rach, how would you feel if say, I wanted to
move you mom, and you said don’t, and I did it anyway and her head fell off?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, come on—Joey, I’ll buy you a new one! All right?
We’ll go down to the store right now and we’ll-we’ll get you a new chair.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (slowly turning and glaring at her) She’s not even cold yet!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But don’t you think Rosita would’ve wanted you to move on? I
mean y’know, she did always put…your comfort first.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s true.
(Rachel turns for the door and makes the "Wow!" face.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (grabbing her coat) Okay? You ready?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I… (Shuts off the TV.) I don’t want Stevie to see her like
this.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Ross and Monica are still going on about the house.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t believe we have to say goodbye to the house we grew up in.
Man, some-some stranger’s gonna be living in my room.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, after 15 years of mom and dad keeping it as a shrine to you,
it’s time the velvet ropes came down.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They kept your room for a while.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh please! Dad turned my room into a gym 20 minutes after I moved out! I
gotta say, a tanning bed and a stack of Victoria’s Secret catalogues, not a
gym!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, you know they love you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: As much as they love you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was their first born! They thought she was barren! It’s not my
fault.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh, I hate this year!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s wrong with this year?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well okay, it’s already February and I’ve only given two
massages and they were both the worst tippers in the world!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was me and Ross.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’s right!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, y’know if you want to pick up some extra cash? Some friends of
mine made good money doing telemarketing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that’s a great idea. You’re really good on the phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah and yeah, and it would probably be better than the last telephone
job I had. Y’know, I probably wouldn’t have to say spank as much. (Monica and
Ross are shocked.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, like you never called!
[Scene: The telemarketing office, Phoebe is getting shown to her desk by the
supervisor.]

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.text: So basically this is very easy. You read from the script and try to
sell as much toner as you possibly can.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I can do that! Oh, by the way, I love my office.

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.text: (laughs) Why don’t we do a trial run.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh okay. Umm, all right. (Picks up the phone and starts reading from the
script.) Hi, this is Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies, can I speak to your supply
manager please?

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.text: I’m the supply manager.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, okay I would like to talk to you about your toner needs.

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.text: We don’t need any toner.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh okay, well I’m sorry to bother you. Bye-bye. (Hangs up the
phone.) Yeah you’re right, this is easy.

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.text: Okay, what was wrong with that call?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh well, all right…um, no offense, but you were kind of rude.

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.text: They’re always going to tell you they don’t need toner,
but that’s okay because whatever they say, you can find the answer to it here in this
script.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.text: So, I think you’re ready to sell toner, do you have any last
questions?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. (Pause) Oh wait yes! I do, I do have one question. What is toner?

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Chandler is entering.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey! Joe! (Sees that he’s not here and starts investigating. He
picks up the bag of chips.) Full bag. (He picks up the beer.) Beer’s still cold.
Something terrible must’ve happened here! (He decides it’s not that
important; sits down on Rosita, and the back falls off causing him to flip over.) Oh
no-no-no-no-no-no! (Runs over to Stevie.) Stevie, I was never here! (Runs out.)
[Scene: Ross and Monica’s parent’s garage, Ross and Monica are arriving to go
through their things. Mr. Geller is in the garage.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I’m here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering with Monica) Hey!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Hi. God, it seems like just yesterday you guys used to come out to
watch me work.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad, we-we can’t believe you’re selling the house.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well, it’s time for a new family to start their memories here
and hopefully their check will clear before they find the crack in the foundation and the
asbestos in the ceiling.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Monica) Let’s grab our stuff and get the hell out of here.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I’m sorry we can’t store your childhood things anymore.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, that’s okay, I can’t wait to see everything again! All of
the memories…

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well, I don’t know what’s in the boxes down here, but I do
know there are six or seven Easy Bake Ovens in the attic.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I used to love to play restaurant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, not as much as you used to love to play uncooked batter eater.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, it is unreasonable to expect a child to wait for a light
bulb to cook brownies! (She goes to the attic.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: So, I think you’re boxes are over here. (They walk over to
them.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! Great! (Finds a pack of cigarettes.) Wait, dad who-who’s
cigarettes are these?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I don’t know. They-they must be your mother’s, but please,
please don’t ask her. I’ll throw these away. (He puts them in his pocket as Ross
finds something of interest in one of his boxes.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Cool! Dad! My report cards! Hey, check this out dad, (reading his grades)
Math, A. Science, A. History, A. Gym…(He puts it away and finds something else.)
Oooh, my rock polisher!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Oh look, look there’s your old makeup kit!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s a clown kit! Clown kit!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well, the white seems to be untouched. (He throws it back into the
box as Mr. Geller moves a tarp and makes a discovery.) Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Y’know how the garage floods every Spring?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How are you ever going to sell this place?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I think I accidentally used Monica’s boxes to keep the water
away from the Porsche.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no. Dad! Dad! What…(He goes to open one of her boxes and it rips
apart.) Oh God…everything’s ruined! Dad, she’s gonna be crushed!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: You don’t secretly smoke do you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: So it’s just your mother then.

scenes.location: The telemarketing office, Phoebe is hard at work.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (on phone) Hi, this Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies, can I speak to
your supply manager please? (Listens) Earl, thanks. (Listens) Hi Earl, this is Phoebe from
Empire Office Supplies I’d like to talk to you about your toner needs. (She’s
reading from the script.)
[Cut to Earl’s office, who is played by Jason Alexander, George from Seinfeld.
They cut back and forth between Phoebe’s and Earl’s offices with each of their
lines.]

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: I don’t need any toner.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m hearing what you’re saying, but at our prices everyone
needs toner.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Not me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: May I ask why?

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: You wanna know why. You wanna know why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I surely do!

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Okay, I don’t need any toner because I’m going to kill myself.
(Phoebe desperately tries to find the scripted response to that line.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (doesn’t have any luck) Umm, is-is that because you’re out of
toner?
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The telemarketing office, Phoebe is still talking to Earl.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Okay, so…no toner today. Thanks anyway, bye-bye.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no wait-wait! I can’t just let you hang up! Just please talk to
me.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Well…I only have one thing to do today. (He looks at his board in his
office that reads, "Today’s Tasks: KILL SELF.") I guess I could push it
back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Now, why do you want to kill yourself?

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: It’s just that I uh, have been working for ten years now at this
meaningless, dead-end job and nobody here even knows I exist!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: I-I’m sorry?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No look, I-I’m sure that people know you exist!

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Oh yeah? I work in a cubicle surrounded by people. I’ve been talking
to you for five minutes now about killing myself and no one’s even looked up from
their desk. Hang-hang on. (To the people standing around his cubicle.) Hey everybody! Uh,
I’m gonna kill myself! (There’s no response; no one even looks up.) I’ll
get back to ya. (To Phoebe) I got nothing. Wait. (He sets the phone down.) Uh, hey Marge!
(Mimes putting a gun to his head, pulling the trigger, and splattering his brain on the
wall behind him. Then points to himself. Marge watches this, then goes back to work.) (To
Phoebe) Ehh, nothing. Nothing.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Chandler has replaced Rosita with his chair.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: My chair. Now, if anybody asks, your name is Rosita! (He runs out the
door, grabs the back of Rosita, and we can hear Joey and Rachel talking as they are coming
up the stairs. Neither of them have reached the landing yet.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You will like it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No I won’t.
(Chandler runs to check on them coming up the stairs.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don’t even know!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because, I know what I like and what I don’t like! It’s not the
same thing!
(Chandler throws the back of Rosita into his apartment and quickly starts pushing the
base into his apartment.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well look, if you don’t like this…(The audience’s
laughter at Chandler’s progress cuts out the rest of Rachel’s line.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know why you say that so soon.
(Joey and Rachel reach the landing just as Chandler closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on Joey, I just bought you a new chair! The most expensive one in
the store! Hey, y’know what I was thinking? We could name her Francette.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Francette? What is she? A couch?
(They enter their apartment.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Poor thing. Cut down in her prime.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, the new chair will be here in an hour. Maybe we should actually
move Rosita out of here. Y’know, start the heeling process?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I guess you’re right. Maybe, maybe I’ll take her down to
the incinerator. It’s gonna be so said, and kinda cool. (He goes to remove the back,
but it doesn’t come off. So he sits down in it, puts his feet up, stands up, and
looks back at it.) She’s heeled!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s weird.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No it’s not weird, it’s a miracle!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s not a miracle Joey! I’m sure there’s some
explanation.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh there is! If you want something enough and your heart is pure, wondrous
things can happen!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, I really don’t…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (interrupting her) Can you tell me how this happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well no.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Miracle!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, y’know what? Maybe somebody came in here and fixed it! Or
something!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Someone like an…angel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s right Joey, the chair angel came in and heeled your chair.
(She sits down in the chair.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (angrily) Get your non-believer ass outta my chair! (She gets up and heads
for her room.)
[Scene: The Geller’s Garage, continued from earlier. Ross and Mr. Geller are still
deciding what to do.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well, she’ll understand right? It’s not like I did it on
purpose.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad that won’t matter to her. Look, all my stuff is safe and dry and
all her is-is, is growing new stuff! See, this is exactly the kind of thing that makes her
think you guys love me more than you love her.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Oh my God, does she really thinks that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, can you blame her?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well I don’t know, I-I suppose we may have favored you
unconsciously, you were a medical marvel! The doctor said your mother could…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad, dad I don’t want to hear about it.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, not right now. Okay look, Monica came here for some memories and
damnit, we’re gonna give her some! Okay, grab…grab some empty boxes. Okay?
We’ll-we’ll take stuff from mine and whatever we can pass off as hers
we’ll-we’ll put ‘em in their.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Like uh y’know like this! This! (He picks up one of those art
projects that kids make in kindergarten and first grade.) She-she could’ve made this!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right? And this! (He picks up a trophy) She-she could’ve won this!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (grabbing a glove) This could’ve been hers!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure! Ooh-ooh, what about this?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Your make-up kit? I’d feel better.
(Ross angrily throws the kit into one of Monica’s new boxes.)
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is sitting the now heeled Rosita as Rachel is sitting
in the newly arrived Francette. Francette is one of those new chairs from La-Z-Boy
that has and does everything except cook and go to the bathroom for you. It’s got a
small refrigerator under one armrest it has phone jacks for the Internet and regular
phone, and so much more.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (grabbing a beer out of the chair’s fridge) I am so psyched I kept
this chair for myself!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, me too. (He flips up his armrest in disgust.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, how’s…how’s the uh, miracle chair?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah? Wow! Y’know, that this thing has speakers in the headrest!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! You can hook it up to your TV and you get radio!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (quietly) My chair heels itself.

scenes.location: The telemarketing office, Phoebe is still trying to talk Earl out of suicide.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Earl, you’re not hearing me! All I’m saying is that
you’re not alone all right? Everybody hates the people they work with! (One of her
coworkers overhears that, and she mimes that she didn’t mean him.)

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: (walking past Earl’s desk) Hey guy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, what was that? That sounded like someone being nice to you.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: No! That’s just the "Hey Guy" guy. He says that to
everybody! He’s the worst! I’d like to take him with me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right so Earl, let’s just forget about the people at the
office, okay? There-there’s gotta be someone else in your life worth sticking around
for! What about-what about your family, your friends, or maybe your girlfriend?

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: (laughs) Yeah! Right!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh sorry, boyfriend!

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, whatever! Anything!
The "Hey Guy" Guy: Hey guy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, he’s gotta go.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Okay, I should, I should probably be getting back to my thing now. See ya.
(Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! I’m not finished yet! Don’t! Don’t you dare hang up
on me!!!

lines.speaker: Supervisor
lines.text: (walking by and overhearing that) (to the rest of the staff) The new
girl’s good.
[Scene: The Geller’s Garage, Mr. Geller and Ross are finishing up recreating
Monica’s memories as Monica enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey guys! Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, I just whipped us up some Easy Bake treats, they should be
ready in about three days.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (overacting) That’s a good one! Do you hear that Ross? Three
days!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (overacting as well) Yeah! Yeah! (Laughs.) Oh, this will make a great
memory.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (wary) Okay. So, which boxes are mine?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, these. These are yours right here. (Pointing to the boxes they just
created for her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (Starting to go through them) Oh! A coloring book! (Holding it
up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, oh you loved that thing. You always had it with you. You never
went anywhere without-without that coloring book.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking through it) Really? Wow! It looks like I had some trouble
staying inside the lines.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nu-uh! (Grabs it and examines it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (holding up a glove) Oh, an old glove?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Oh, yeah you loved that glove! You took it every place you went. You
never went any place without that glove.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! Look at this! (Picking up a shirt.) I can’t believe I even fit
into this shirt! (She holds it up and it reads: Tyrannosaurus Ross.) (She turns it around
and looks at it.) Oh, this is yours. (Hands it to Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I don’t know how that got in there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (holding up a small cowboy hat) This isn’t mine. (Sets it down and
looks at the rest of the boxes.) Hey, this isn’t, this isn’t my stuff! Ugh,
Ross! (Grabs and holds up a doll.) These are your boxes! Where are my boxes?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, your boxes are umm…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well, the garage flooded sweetie and it ruined everything in your
boxes. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just mine?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I’m afraid so.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So why-why wasn’t Ross’s stuff ruined? (Pause) And if you say
the words medical marvel I’m going to Easy Bake your head!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well, I used your boxes to divert water away from the Porsche.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So wait, Ross’s stuff is fine, but I have no memories because you
wanted to keep the bottom two inches of your car away from water!!!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: There was also leaves and guk and stuff.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t believe this! (Storms out.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (To Ross) Screw it! I’m having one. (Takes out and lights a
cigarette.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is writing a letter by the bay window as Rachel
enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How would you like to sit in a chair that fully reclines, has a rolling
massage, and speakers in the head rest?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’d love to but I’ve tried that so many times they
won’t even let me in the store anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well what if I told you, you can do it in my apartment?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (excitedly) Are you telling me that you bought the chair that is
making all other lounge systems obsolete? The chair that Sit magazine called the Chair of
the Year?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just purchased the La-Z-Boy E-cliner 3000. (Which is an actual
product by the way, I’m not sure about the 3000 part.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s awesome! That’s great! What made you do it?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it’s a long story, but umm I broke Joey’s chair…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa! You broke Joey’s chair?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I thought I broke Joey’s chair! That’s why I replaced
it with mine!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhhhh. That’s how it got fixed!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, what did you think, that-that elves came in and fixed it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Noo! (Laughs) Angels.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m gettin’ my chair back! (Heads for Joey and
Rachel’s.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Wh-hey!
(They enter Joey and Rachel’s to find that Joey has broken Chandler’s chair.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it looks like it wasn’t heeled after all! Yeah! So, I guess
this chair is mine now! (Sits down in it and groans.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey you broke my chair!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Your chair?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, he thought he broke your chair so he switched the chairs!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, there was no miracle?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Joe, no miracle.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh no this is devastating! My faith is shaken. I’m so
glad I have the new chair to get my through this difficult time in my life.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh! Nice try, but you don’t get that chair anymore! All right?
That is my chair now! You can sit on my lap! (Joey starts to get up.) No I take that back!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think I should get the chair!
(Rachel and Joey both laugh at that suggestion.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How do you figure?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because you (Points to Joey) broke a chair and you (Points to
Rachel) broke a chair! The only one around here that hasn’t broke a chair, is me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no-no! This chair’s not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, where’s the logic in that?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The logic is, that there are two of us and we are both strong enough to
break a chair in half!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So Joey breaks my chair and I get nothing!
(Joey whispers in Rachel’s ear to confirm his response.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you guys? Like a gang or something?!
(They confer again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! We are!
(Rachel whispers in Joey’s ear.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’re the Cobras!

scenes.location: Earl’s Office, Earl has his head in his hands as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Marge) Excuse me! Can you tell me where I can find Earl? He’s
the supply manager around here.

lines.speaker: Marge
lines.text: Sorry, I don’t know any Earl.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: (screaming) I’m right here!!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (goes over to his desk) Earl! I’m Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Phoebe? The lady who sells toner?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, look it, you-you can’t kill yourself.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: (exhales) Look, um I really appreciate your coming down…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no I can’t! I can’t let you do it!

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because it was fate that made me call you today!

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: I thought it was toner.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Think about it okay? This isn’t even my regular job!
Okay? And my first day on the job, you’re my first call! And-and somebody else
might’ve hung up on you, but I wouldn’t do that because I know about this stuff.
My mom killed herself.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m not gonna give you tips! Look don’t you see that
this-this…this all came together so that I could stop you from doing this.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Couldn’t it just be a coincidence?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it’s fate!

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: It doesn’t really seem like enough to be fate.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Well umm, okay here’s a weird thing. My mother was also a
supply manager.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: I’m actually the office manager.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! So was she! And! Get this, okay? Your-your name is Earl,
right? Her name was Pearl, P-Earl.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Well, was there anything else?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure! (Thinks.) Umm, where are you from?

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Philadelphia.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! So was she! Oh, I’ve got-I’ve got goose bumps. (She
holds out her arm.)

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: (inspecting it) Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, y’know I’m wearing layers and it’s warm.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Yeah-yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But if—no look, okay. These jerks might not care about you, but the
universe does! And that says a lot!

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: (To All) Did you hear that?! I don’t need you guys to care about me!
Because the universe cares! The whole universe! (Laughs as everyone ignores him.) (To
Phoebe) I really wished they’d care just a little bit though.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know, I don’t-I don’t think it’s you. This is a
freaky place. (To All) Hey! Guys! (Everyone looks up.) (To Earl) Oh no, it’s you.

lines.speaker: Earl
lines.text: Yeah.
[Scene: The Geller’s Garage, Monica is picking through her ruined childhood
heirlooms with Ross.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, this terrible! Everything is destroyed! Look at this. (She
picks up some kind of furry thing.) It obviously meant enough for me to save it, and I
don’t even know what it is! Ohh, it’s still soft. (She rubs it against her
cheek.) What do you think this is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. I think it was a mouse.
(Monica screams, throws the mouse down, and rubs her hands on Ross’s sweater to
clean them.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (entering) How are you honey?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How do you think I am?! You’ve wrecked all my childhood memories.
You love Ross more than me. And I just rubbed a dead mouse on my face!
(Ross gets up to let his dad sit next to Monica.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Sweetheart, we love you just as much as Ross! Now, I’m sorry
about everything that happened and I’d probably never be able to make it up to you,
but here’s a start. (He hands her a small box.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (opening it) What’s this?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: It’s the key to my Porsche. Well, the key to your Porsche.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shocked) What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (even more shocked) What?!!!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I’ve been thinking about getting rid of it. I was driving it
the other day and saw my reflection in a store window. Your mother’s right, I do
look like an ass.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, you’re giving me your Porsche, you’re kidding me
right?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well w-w-w-w-wait, w-wait, wait, wait a minute! I mean a couple of stupid
boxes get wet and she gets a Porsche?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (To Monica) Why don’t we take it for a spin?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, what about me?! I’m a medical marvel!!
Ending Credits
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is sitting in Joey’s lap on Francette, and
they’re both groaning.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahhhh….

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahhh…… (To Rachel) Eh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you guys know what happened to Chandler’s barca lounger?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, Joey broke it. Had to get rid of it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you kidding?! I get a Porsche and the barca lounger’s
gone?! This is the best day ever! (Runs out.)

title: The One Where They All Turn Thirty

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is knocking on Rachel’s door, whose door frame is
decorated with balloons. The rest of the gang is there as well. Rachel opens the door and
the gang blow on noisemakers.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Happy birthday!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Happy birthday!!!
(Rachel glares at them and goes back into her room, closing her door.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Rach! Come on! Rach!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s your birthday!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (entering from her room) Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) She’s not as pretty as she was when she was 29.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Ms. Green would like to establish some ground rules before she comes out.
She would appreciate it if you don’t use the words old or downhill or (To Joey) they
still look pretty damn good. (Joey smiles and everyone glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They do!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel! Come on out! Monica made breakfast!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chocolate-chip pancakes!
(There is no response from Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We’ve got presents!
(She opens the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good ones?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They all came from the list you handed out to us two weeks ago.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, can I keep the presents and still be 29?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on Rach! Look, turning thirty is not that big a deal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh really. Is that how you felt when you turned thirty?
[Flashback to Joey’s thirtieth birthday party. It is being held in Monica and
Chandler’s apartment.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (screaming) Why God?!! Why?!! We had a deal!! Let the others grow old! Not
me!! (He buries his head in Phoebe’s lap for comfort.)
[Cut back to Rachel’s party, everyone is now eating breakfast, except Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know, I’m still 29 in Guam.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, 30 is not that old! Do you know how old the Earth is?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Late thirties? Oh come on you guys! Is it just me? Am I overreacting to
this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No Rach, it’s not just you. My thirtieth birthday certainly
wasn’t that much fun.
[Flashback to Chandler’s thirtieth birthday party. It is also being held in Monica
and his apartment. He is about to blow out the candles on his birthday cake.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (screaming) And now Chandler! We’re all gettin’ so old! (Looking
up) Why are you doing this to us?! (Turns away crying.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, breakfast is finished but Rachel’s still down.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, you’re in a great place in your life. Come on, you’ve
got a great job! Good friends…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you’re roommate is a soap opera star.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, y’know I know my life’s going pretty well, but I look
around and I just see so many people who’ve accomplished so many other goals by the
time they’re thirty.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but you shouldn’t compare yourself to me.
[Flashback to: The Street in front of Central Perk, Ross and Joey are holding a yellow
tape across the road and everyone is cheering Phoebe as she bounces around the corner on a
hippity-hop.]

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Come on Phoebe! You can do it Phoebe! Come on!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: There you go!
(She crosses the line and they all cheer again.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I did it! One mile on a hippity-hop! That’s it!! That’s
everything I wanted to do before I was thirty. Oh, except I wanted to patch things up with
my sister. But oh well. Yay!! (They all cheer again.) And-and girls this thing is a
Godsend if you know what I mean. (Rachel and Monica look intrigued and as they all head
into Central Perk, Rachel picks up the hippity-hop that Phoebe left behind.)

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thirty. Ugh, I mean thirty! Monica, do you remember mean, old Mrs.
Kreeger in the fifth grade? She was thirty!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Come on, let’s have some fun. Huh? (To Rachel) What do you want to do
today?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing. I don’t want to do anything.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, doing nothing on your thirtieth is better than doing something
stupid, like Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! That was a practical purchase! I needed that car for transportation!
Okay? I-I have a child!
[Flashback to: A street, Ross is sitting in his newly purchased MGB. Which is
one of the better British sports cars ever made. Of course, ‘better’ is a
relative term. Which reminds me of a joke. Why don’t the British make computers?
Because they couldn’t figure out how to make them leak oil. Anyway, the gang is all
staring at his new purchase.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How hot do I look in this, huh?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross, a sports car? Wouldn’t it have been cheaper to just stuff a
sock down there?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s not what this is about okay? I-I am a sports car enthusiast. I
have always been into cars.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what’s the horsepower on this thing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (giddy) I don’t know, but-but look how shiny!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t believe you bought this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really! God Ross, what were you thinking? (To Phoebe, quietly) I know
it’s really shallow, but a part of me wants him again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, well get in line missy. (To Ross) So, can I have a ride stud?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hop in. (Phoebe hops in.) Get ready for the smoothest ride of your life.
(He starts the car and surprisingly in fires right up and comes to a nice idle. (Both
can be rarities with British sports cars with their lovely Lucas ignition systems,
which tend not to work especially in the rain.) Anyway, this being New York he is parallel
parked on a street with the car in front of him only inches ahead of his bumper, likewise
with the car behind him. He’s completely boxed in and can’t move more than two
inches. He tries to get out several times by bumping the bumpers of both cars to no
avail.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damnit! (Shuts the car off.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (getting out) Okay, who’s next?

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Phoebe is pouring Rachel some coffee.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know what? I am going to do something today. I’m not just
gonna sit around like some old lady. I’m gonna get something pierced. Like my uh,
like my nose or my tongue or something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?! ‘Cause y’know that hurts.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what?! Y’know what? The way I see it—(Phoebe pulls out a
hair from the back of her head)—Ow! Son of a bitch!!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Look Rachel, I know what you’re going through. I’m totally
freaked about turning 25.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (glares at him) Get out, get out of my apartment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right Rach, for what it’s worth, I think that you’re doing
great. I mean y’know let’s face it, no one handles this well.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Least of all you.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Why? What you’d do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Weren’t you asked to leave sonny?
[Flashback to Monica and Chandler’s apartment. Chandler has a bunch of people over
in formal wear to give Monica a surprise birthday party. Joey is coming out of the
bathroom and removing his tie.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Joey) Would you put that back on?! Monica’s gonna be here any
minute!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But it hurt’s my Joey’s Apple.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (frustrated) Okay, for the last time. It’s not named for each
individual man.
(Joey walks away and Mr. and Mrs. Geller walk up. Mr. Geller is wearing this ancient
velvet tuxedo.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (To Chandler) You’ve done a wonderful job with this party
Chandler. Everything looks so lovely.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh well, not as lovely as you. I mean, I can’t believe that you
would have a thirty-year-old daughter! (To Mr. Geller) And you! I can’t believe that
you would have a tux that’s thirty years old! (Puts his hand on Mr. Geller’s
shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: It’s older than that. Ross was actually conceived right near
this tuxedo.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ohh! (He quickly removes his hand and looks at it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Everybody hide! Hide! I saw her! She’s coming!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay! Okay! Everybody down! Everybody down! (Rachel turns off the
lights and everyone crouches. As everyone crouches, a ripping noise erupts from the
assemblage.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Crap.
(We hear some fumbling at the door, then silence.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (getting up to investigate) Okay, everybody stay here. I will find out
what’s going on.
(He goes out into the hall and finds a very drunk Monica lying up against Joey and
Rachel’s door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Heyyy!! You got the door open!! (Giggles.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey-hey are you drunk?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nooo! (Giggles) Okay. (She tries to pull herself up by Rachel and
Joey’s doorknob, but the door opens and she almost falls into the their apartment.
She manages to catch herself.) Whoa! (Stands up, unsteadily) Okay. See I was, I was a
little nervous about turning (whispering) thirty. (Giggles.) So the bus boys took me out
for some drinks. (Pause) I wanna puke on you later!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, here is the thing. We have thrown a very formal surprise
party for you in there! All of your friends are in there and your parents!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Noo!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Noo!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no! My parents have never seen me drunk! (Pause) That they know of.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, here’s the thing. We’re gonna get you some coffee and
they will never know that you’re drunk.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?! You promise?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’ll take care of it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. I love you so much. (Kisses him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughing) Okay we have to do something about your breath.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What about your breath?! (Breathes on him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s still yours. Okay, now remember it’s a surprise
party. So, when you go in, act surprised.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. I can do that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(Chandler opens the door and Monica sneaks up on it. They go inside.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Surprise!!!
(Monica screams and they all stare at her.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Ross’s birthday, Joey is now trying to get his car out while Ross is
directing him.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, forward. Forward—Stop! (The car moves an inch and Ross runs to
the back of the car.) Okay, back—Stop! (The car barely moves and Ross runs back to
the front.) Okay, forward—Stop! Stop! Stop!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, just forget about it. This guy’s got you totally wedged in.
(A beautiful woman approaches.)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (To Joey) Is this yours?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well actually…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no-no! It’s mine! It’s-it’s mine. (The woman walks
away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, you soooo need this car.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (running up) Okay. Okay, here’s what we’re gonna do. Okay,
I’m gonna break into this mini-van and put it in neutral. You guys push it forward so
Ross can drive out of his spot. Okay? All right, here we go. (She opens her coat and
reveals that thing car thieves use to break into cars as Ross jumps in behind the wheel.
She inserts the device, unlocks the door, opens it, and the alarm goes off.) Haul ass!!!!
(Runs off.)
(The rest of the gang runs away, except for Ross who’s tramped inside his car. To
hide he puts the top up as Monica, Rachel, and Joey come running past.)
[Scene: Phoebe’s birthday, she’s taking the hippity-hop to Ursula’s
apartment as a gift. She knocks on the door and Ursula answers it.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Happy thirtieth birthday! Here! (Hands her the hippity-hop.) It’s
for the child in you, and the woman. Happy thirtieth!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Right, why do you keep saying that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because it’s our thirtieth birthday.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah, no we’re not thirty. We’re 31. Okay. (She closes the
door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait! (Knocks on the door and Ursula opens it.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Oh, it’s you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. What?!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah, we’re not thirty, we’re 31.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nu-uh!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yea-huh! That’s what is says on my birth certificate.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You have your birth certificate?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah, I got a big box of family stuff when my mom died.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Our mom.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: (sarcastic) Right! Okay. (Hands Phoebe her births certificate.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do you have my birth certificate?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: No, I sold it to a Swedish runaway.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (reading the certificate) Oh my God! Oh my God, we are 31.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just lost a whole year of my life.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: (sarcastic) Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Your middle name is Pamela?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I never knew mine. Do you remember what it is?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yes! Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s my first name.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Right, okay, then no.

scenes.location: Monica’s birthday, it’s just after the surprise.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay before we start the celebration, Monica has to go put on her
party dress.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See? (Does his laugh.) Here we go. (Starts walking her to their room,
and has to pass in front of Mr. Geller who’s sitting at the table and Mrs. Geller
who’s standing next to him.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Happy birthday, sweetie! Give us a hug! (Starts to get up.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (stopping him) Don’t get up Jack! The safety pins are about to
blow.
(They continue their trek.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sees someone) Paul!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (correcting her) Phil.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phil!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now, there is a dress laid out on your bed. (Monica stumbles on the
steps.) Okay, (catches her) you’re doing great. You’re doing great. You’re
doing fine.
(Phoebe approaches as they almost get to their room.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica’s a little drunk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yay! I love drunk Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Awwwww… (Giggles.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Go change! (To Phoebe) She doesn’t want her parents
to know she’s drunk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! All right! All right. Here’s what we’ll do, I’ll get
twice as drunk as Monica and then no one’s will even notice her.
(Chandler walks over to where the rest of the gang is.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’s-what’s going on? Phil’s really pissed!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica’s wasted.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe that will liven up this party.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Rachel) Okay, will you just go help her change please!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, but taking care of a drunk, naked woman seems like a job for Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yep. (Starts for Monica’s room, but Chandler stops him.)

scenes.location: Rachel’s birthday, everyone is presenting their presents to Rachel.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: (handing his to her) This one’s from me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahh!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: It wasn’t on your list, but hopefully you’ll think it’s
really fun.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (opening it) A scooter! (She’s not happy.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Tag) Stick to the list. Always stick to the list.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No-no, I love it. Thank you. (Kisses him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, open ours next. Open ours next!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now that you’re a couple, we don’t get two presents from you
guys?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: For my last birthday you gave me a hug! (To Rachel) Okay, read
the card! Read the card!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Opens the card and reads it.) Happy birthday Grandma! It’s
better to be over the hill (starting to cry) then buried under it. (Breaks down as
everyone glares at them.) All our love Monica and Chandler. (Crying) That’s funny,
yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no-no! That was the joke!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (crying) No, I know! I get it! It’s funny!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, because you’re not a grandmother!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No I know, because to be a grandmother you have to be married and have
children and I don’t have any of those things. That’s why it’s so funny.
(Runs into her room crying.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All you had to do was buy the card!
[Scene: Rachel’s birthday, a time lapse has occurred. Rachel is coming back into
the living room carrying a notepad.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Look who’s back! It’s the birthday girl! How’s the
birthday girl feeling?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I feel fine, but I think you’re bumming out the rest of the
kids.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (Glances over and sees the faces of the rest of the group, then goes
and sits down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! Y’know what? I realized it was stupid to get upset about not
having a husband and kids. All I really needed was a plan. See I wanna have three
kids…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh let me guess, and you wanna have them all at the same time and you
wanna have them for your brother.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: As I was saying… I should probably have the first of the three kids
by the time I’m 35 which gives me five years. I love this plan! I wanna marry this
plan!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If you could do that, I’d marry the hippity-hop.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, if I wanna have my kid when I’m 35, I don’t have to get
pregnant until I’m 34. Which gives Prada four years to start making maternity
clothes! Oh wait, but I do want to be married for a year before I get pregnant…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really! That long?! (Chandler slowly turns and looks at her.) (To
Chandler) Look all you want, it’s happening!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, so I don’t have to get married until I’m 33! That’s
three years, that’s three whole years—Oh, wait a minute though. I’ll need a
year and a half to plan the wedding, and I’d like to know the guy for a year, year
and a half before we get engaged… Which means I need to meet the guy by the time
I’m thirty.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Which is fine! Because you just turned—(Removes two candles
from the cake)—twenty-eight!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Ross, no! It is not fine! Eh-eh-according to my plan I should
already be with the guy I wanna marry!
(We hear Tag scream out in the hallway and jump into view of the open door on the
scooter. He gives a hearty thumbs up to the group and rides off, with Joey following
breathlessly behind.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Will you quit hoggin’ it!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica’s birthday, Monica is now dressed and is being helped out by
Chandler and Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Chandler) I’m telling you it’s like watching Bambi learn
how to walk.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Monica) You’re drunk! Mom and dad are gonna be maaaaadd! Maybe
I’m a little drunk.
(Monica sits down on the barca lounger.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to a waiter) Oh that’s great! Right there! Can we get some of
that over here please? (The waiter comes over) There we go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the waiter) Hey! Are those crab cakes? (The waiter nods) Did I not
tell ya to come straight to me when more crab cakes were ready?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You are so handsome! I wanna make love to you right here, right
now! (Growls and pulls him into a kiss.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I really wish that you wouldn’t.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Now all you have to do is just get through a little bit
more, okay? Then we can put you in bed, okay? Just smile and don’t talk to anyone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (clinking two glasses together) Speech! Speech! Let’s hear from the
birthday girl! Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t you see? Everyone’s looking at me! The plan’s
working! I didn’t even have to take off my top yet!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Speech! Come on Monica!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Come on! Speech!
(Monica stands up and wobbles slightly and Chandler runs over to catch her.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (filming this) Hey Chandler, you can’t keep your hands off her
for one second!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh-ho, I think it’s nice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think it’s necessary. (Backs away anyhow.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I-I-I wanna thank you all for coming. My family and my friends…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (screaming) Wooo!! Hoo!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I really like to say that I’m-um… (Pause) Y’know what
I’d really like to say? I’m drunk!! (Mrs. Geller pulls the camera down.)
That’s right mom and dad your little Harmonica is hammered!! (Ross grabs the camera
out of his dad’s hands.) And guess what! I’ve been drunk before! And I’ve
smoked a cigarette! And I got a box of Ding-Dongs hidden in my underwear drawer!
It’s all okay. It’s okay because I turned thirty today. And, and I can do
anything I want! Because I am a grown up. (Falls over sideways with Ross filming
the fall.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Joey) Okay quick, help me get this off! (Motions to her top.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!!
(Ross pans the camera over to Phoebe.)
[Scene: Phoebe’s birthday, she’s telling everyone what she found out at
Ursula’s while sitting in Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I lost a whole year! I can’t believe it! This is so unfair!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I don’t know Pheebs. It’ll be okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Will it? Will it?! I mean, how would you feel if you found out you were

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s not gonna happen. No. (Looks up) Because we have a new deal!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Plus, it totally ruined my schedule! I…I haven’t done any of
the things I wanted to do by the time I was 31!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Like okay I-I-I, I haven’t met any Portuguese people! I, I
haven’t had the perfect kiss! And I haven’t been to sniper’s school!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, y’know why don’t we just go upstairs and have some
birthday cake?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I just feel like being by myself for a while. All right? I’ll
see you guys later. Thanks. (Gets up and exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey. (After she leaves.) Oh, poor Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, y’know what you guys? I think I’m gonna go walk her home.
(Gets up and runs out.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He’s gonna eat the cake!
[Cut outside, Joey is catching up with Phoebe.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs! Wait up! (She stops.) Listen uh, close your eyes. (She does so and
Joey passionately kisses her.) Maybe that’s one thing you can cross off your list.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah.
(Joey starts to walk away, but stops.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, and plus I’m 1/16th Portuguese.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! (Phoebe walks away smiling.)
[Scene: Ross’s birthday, his car is still trapped in it’s spot. Now Joey,
Phoebe, and Ross are at the front of the car with Monica, Rachel, and Chandler at the rear
of the car.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, is everybody clear? We’re gonna pick it up…and move it.
Now all we need is teamwork, okay? We’re gonna lift the car…and slide it
out. Lift and slide!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I really don’t think…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupting her) Lift!! And slide!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, here we go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right everyone, lift! (They and try to lift the car, of course it
doesn’t raise up) And slide!! (Everyone leans over, but the car still does not move.)
[Scene: Rachel’s birthday, she is coming into the hallway where Joey and Tag are
playing with the scooter.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Joey, can I…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, come on Rach! My turn just started!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Actually, I just wanna talk to Tag.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Okay. Hey, can I ride this outside?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whatever! Okay, I’m not your mother.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay! (Runs off downstairs.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Not in the street!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Tag) Hi.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: How are you doing? Are you feeling any better?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I’m doing okay. I’m um…let’s talk.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Okay. (They sit on the step.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What’s up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh Tag, umm…you’re such a great guy and we have sooo much fun
together but I don’t-I don’t…

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Wait! I think I see where you’re going, but before you say anything
else, can I just say one more thing? (Kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well said. And a uh good example of the fun I was referring to uhh, but
I just think I’m past the point where I think I can y’know, just have fun.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Rachel, don’t do this. This is just because you’re turning
thirty.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it is! But you’re just a kid! I mean you’re 25!

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Twenty-four actually.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God! Y’know what I wish? I wish you were six years older. Well
actually, if I’m wishin’ for stuff, I actually wish I was six years younger.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I’m sorry. (They hug.)
[Time lapse, Rachel is entering her apartment after breaking up with Tag.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! How’d it go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, if I only want two kids, can I keep him for another year?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You did the right thing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, limping, and holding his arm) I don’t like this anymore.
(He sits down with them in pain.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, here we are, just a bunch of thirty year olds.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: God, do you realize in ten years we’re gonna be 40?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (crying) Why God?! Why are you doing this to us?! (He buries his head in
Ross’s shoulder.)
[Scene: Ross’s birthday, night has fallen and Joey and Ross are walking by where
his car is parked to find that both cars blocking him in have left.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! My baby’s finally free!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All-all right! (They run and jump in the car.) Start it up! Let’s go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (starting it) Woohoo!
(Just as they are about to pull away, a big, fat, bald guy pulls up in the exact same
car as Ross and stops next to him.)

lines.speaker: The Man In The Sportscar
lines.text: How hot are we? (He drives off.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You wanna buy a car?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.
(Ross shuts it off and they get out.)
Ending Credits
{Transcriber’s Note: There was no credits scene with this episode.}

title: The One with Joey's New Brain

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica, Chandler, Ross, and Rachel are sitting around
the table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m glad you’re here, we have a couple of things to ask you
about the wedding ceremony.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starting to cry) Ohh…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s the matter? You okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it’s just y’know…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) Monica said wedding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, so anyway, we thought one of you could read something during the
ceremony.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! I would love to read a poem.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you think you could get through a poem?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (crying) It’ll be a short one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, so Ross will be doing the reading.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Yeah, I guess, I guess I could do that too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Too?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I kind of uh, have something else planned for you guys.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you mind telling us what it is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry, I’m kinda keeping this one on the Q.T.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, whatever it is, I hope it involves winking. (Winks in a spy-type
manner.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, excited) Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So I just talked to one of the DOOL writers today, and…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is DOOL?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Days Of Our Lives. Anyway, you’re not gonna believe it! My
character is coming out of his coma!!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And-and-and not only that, I’m gettin’ a new brain!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So great things are happening at work and in your personal
life!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, what do you mean you’re getting a new brain?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well, they’re killing off one of the characters on the show, and
when she dies her brain is being transplanted into my body.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? A brain transplant?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (seriously) Yes, it’s a highly controversial procedure.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s ridiculous!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I think it’s ridiculous that you haven’t had sex in three
and a half months.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Monica and Rachel) It’s winter, they are fewer people on the
street. (Rachel and Monica smile and nod, knowingly.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who are they killing off?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh Cecilia Monroe, she plays Jessica Lockhart.

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: Noo!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s my favorite character on DOOL.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She is so good at throwing drinks in people’s faces, I mean I
don’t think I’ve ever seen her finish a beverage.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And the way she slaps all the time!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wouldn’t you love to do it just once?! (Raises her hand towards
Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don’t do it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Cecilia Monroe man, what a great actress.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, tell me about it. And she’s been on the show forever, it’s
gonna be really hard to fill her shoes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, help me out here, when you come out of the "brain
transplant," you are going to be her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes, but in Drake Remoray’s body. (Ross laughs unbelievably.) Why is
this so hard for you to get? I thought you were a scientist!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Phoebe and Rachel sitting on the couch in Central Perk

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Clears Throat) Rach, so, that guy there. Straight or gay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (They both look behind them.) Well, I'd have to say gay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah? Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well mainly because he's kissing that other guy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no not that guy there. That guy right there. (Pointing to an
attractive man sitting at a table behind them.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah he's too cute to be straight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (A woman with large breasts walks in the door) Ohh knockers will help us
figure it out. (She walks by and he checks her out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, straight, and not subtle. (The man gets up and leaves.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, he left his cell phone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well, we can hand it to Gunther and he'll put it in lost and found.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or we could use it to call China. See how those guys are doing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What if, um, if he calls his own cell phone to find out who found it and
I answer and we start talking and we fell in love. I mean wouldn't that be a great story?
Kind of like a fairy tale for the digital age.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah… That does sound great. I'm going to get the phone. (They both
get up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Wait! Why…why do you get the story?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't know. I haven't been out on a date in so long.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, you had a date three days ago.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That wasn’t a date! That was, that was just friends getting
together…(quietly) having sex.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay, see? I get the phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No way! No way! You just broke with Tag a week ago.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! (Breaking up) And until now, I didn’t think I’d love
again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nice try.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh hey-hey wait! How do we fairly decide who gets the phone?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know.
(They edge closer to the phone on the table.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well umm, maybe we could uhh… (Grabs the phone) Ah-ha! Too slow!!
(She holds the phone out and starts taunting Phoebe. Phoebe calming knocks the phone
out of Rachel’s hand and catches it.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah-ha! Too cocky!

scenes.location: Silvercup Studios, Joey is watching Jessica Lockhart perform a scene.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: I’m going to keep dating him Mother, and there’s nothing you can
do about it!

lines.speaker: Jessica Lockhart
lines.text: Oh yes there is!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: What are you going to do? Kill him? Like you did with Charles?!

lines.speaker: Jessica Lockhart
lines.text: (gasps) That was an accident! And so were you.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Well, at least I’m not a murderer! (Jessica slaps her.)

lines.speaker: Jessica Lockhart
lines.text: (crying) Oh, my baby! (Hugs Dina, but moves Dina’s head
to her other shoulder so that she’s the only one in the picture.)

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Cut!
(Joey walks up to Cecilia Monroe who plays Jessica.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That was a great scene! And-and-and that slap looks so real! How do you do
that?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Oh, just years of experience.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: (crying) Can I get some ice here?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh anyway, I just wanted to say how wonderful I think you are.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: You’re not the fan who’s dying are you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Say what?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: I’m supposed to meet and hug a fan whose dying, but that’s
not supposed to be until (to no one in particular) later!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. No, I’m Joey Tribbiani; we did a scene together yesterday.
I-I’m the guy in the coma!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Oh that was a real person?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: An-an-anyway I-I just wanted to say that since I’m getting your brain
when you leave the show, I was wondering if there was any tips you can give me…

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: I-I-I’m leaving the show?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (quickly) I don’t know. Why? Did you hear something?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Who told you that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh uh, one of the writers.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Which one? Was it bald or was it tall?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Y’know what? It doesn’t matter! Because it is not true!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: And if it were true, how dare you come to me ask me for tips
about a character that I’ve been playing for 20 years—I’ll give you a tip!
(She throws her drink in his face.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ms. Monroe… (She slaps him) Oh there you go. (She storms off, leaving
Joey standing next to Dina. They share a nod at the ferocity of the slap they just
received.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Rachel are still arguing over the phone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Phoebe! You cannot get the phone that way; that’s not fair! Okay
look, I have an idea. Why don’t we, why don’t we see what kind of number he has
on his speed dial, and then from that we can tell who has more in common with him. And
then whoever does gets the phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or, we can decide by whose ever name is closer to the word phone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (handing Rachel the phone) Fine all right, but I’d bet you’d
be singing another tune if we were fighting over a ratchet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (checking the speed dial) All right, first name on the speed dial is
mom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh, I lost my mom to suicide.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay no way, you cannot use that to get the cute guy and the last
blueberry muffin.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Did I use that already today? I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes okay. (Checking the speed dial again.) Well now see this isn’t
telling us anything. (Reading the speed dial) Joe. Carlos. Peter. Ooh! Peter Luger! T
hat’s a steak house!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, a meat eater. Fine, that’s one for you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at the speed dial) Oh, I win! He’s got Barney’s
on his speed dial.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you don’t know that’s Barney’s the store! That
can be y’know his friend’s house, or a bar. Who has Barney’s the
store on their speed dial?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (showing Phoebe her phone) His new girlfriend!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Chandler are eating lunch, when they start to
hear a horrible screeching noise. It sounds like someone is skinning a cat.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think it’s the dying cat parade.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It sounds like it’s coming from across the street.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (turning around and looking) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know that thing that Ross was gonna do at our wedding?! He was
hanging out with me yesterday and he turned to me and said, "You’re half
Scottish right?"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nooo!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes!!
[Cut to Ross’s apartment, he his playing the Bagpipes, badly. He’s worse than
that whole keyboard thing a few years ago.]
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, scene continued from earlier. They both get up and move
to the window.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, there is no way! It can not be Ross! (She looks through the
window and sees Ross practicing and fumbling around with the pipes.) Unbelievable! Why
is your family Scottish?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why is your family Ross?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He cannot play at our wedding! I mean everyone will leave! I mean come
on, that is just noise! It’s not even a song!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If you listen very carefully, I think its Celebration by Cool
and the Gang.
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment, Phoebe is putting out some Sunflower seeds as Rachel
enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How are ya?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm Pheebs, remember when we were in the coffee house we decided that I
was going to keep the uh, the cute guy’s cell phone?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And remember how I said I was going to keep it in my purse so that if it
rang I could just pick it up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And do you remember going into my purse and stealing the phone?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, now you lost me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You stole the phone!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No I didn’t!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No? So you’re saying that if I called it, it wouldn’t ring?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, okay. But while you dial, let me show you the features of my new
ringing handbag. (Rachel dials her phone and Phoebe’s bag starts to ring.) Oh, it
does work! (Rachel grabs the phone and takes it out of Phoebe’s handbag.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is a different phone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh is it?! (She answers the cute guy’s phone.) Uhh, hello? (On her
phone) Yes hi, is Rachel there? (On the other phone) Yes she is, just one moment please.
(To Phoebe, holding out both phones.) It’s for me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is damning evidence.
(The cute guy’s phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! I bet that’s him. My digital fairy tale is about to
begin. I wonder how I should be? Should I be uh (In a sexy voice) Hello? Or should I be
(Happily) Hi! It’s Rach… (Phoebe knocks the phone out of Rachel’s hand,
catches it, and answers it.) Would you stop doing that?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? (Listens) Yes, I’m the one who found your phone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe! You can’t do th…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) Shhh! I’m on a call! (On phone) Umm well yeah, you can
pick it up tonight, say 8:30? At-at my apartment. It’s umm, it’s umm 5 Morton
Street, Apartment 14, umm and then maybe y’know after we can grab a bite to eat or
whatever. (Listens) Okay, well okay I’ll see you then. (Listens) Bye. (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You do know that I will be here when he comes over.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh? And how will you know what time to come over?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You just said it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Okay, well I-I was kinda hoping that I would just…be alone
y’know to think about my mom and her suicide.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! That’s the first time today!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! (Exits.)
[Scene: Silvercup Studios, Dina is at the craft services table getting some food as
Joey walks up.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you like the nachos uh? Myself I’m partial to…

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: (interrupting) I’m 16.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See you in 2003. (She walks away.)

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: (walking up) You’re absolutely right they are writing me out of
the show. They don’t know exactly when it’s going to happen, but apparently
going to be very soon and that’s it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m so sorry. Look, if it was up to me you would never leave the
show.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Yeah, thanks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No I mean it! I can’t believe they would do this to you! And to your
fans! I mean they are going to be devastated! Heart broken! They love you so much!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Oh you’re right. Thank you! What’s your name again?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Joey.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Joey, well thank you. That is so sweet. Oh, excuse me. (She throws her
drink on a passing writer.)

lines.speaker: The Writer
lines.text: It wasn’t my decision!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: (to him) I’m having a conversation here! (To Joey) You were
saying?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh yeah-ye-ye-ye-ye-ye—l-l-l-l-l-look the-the-the only reason that I,
that I came up to you before was because well, I’m really nervous about-about being
you. Y’know if you can help me capture the essence of the character. Y’know?
Help me keep Jessica alive. Please?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: All right Joey, I will help you. Not because I-I owe it to this stupid
show, but because I owe it to Jessica.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh that’s great! Oh thank you so much!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: You’re so welcome.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Now, I’ve been watching some tapes, how’s this? (In a
British accent.) "Jessica Lockhart will never step foot in this place again!
Ever!!"

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Is that supposed to be me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Yeah but Jessica doesn’t have an English accent.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shocked) I can do an English accent?! That baby’s going on my
resume!
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica and Chandler are sitting on the couch. Ross is sitting on
the armchair.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I feel like a snack!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you want some shortbread? Eh that’s Scottish like you are.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no thanks. I don’t like any thing from my Scottish
heritage.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well it’s just my entire family was run out of Scotland
by…Vikings. Anyway, lots of bad memories. (Makes a few unintelligible noises.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh well, it sounds to me like your family is ready to uh, rediscover its
Scottish roots.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No-no they’re not. They’re still very angry! But
y’know Chandler is also half-Swedish. You know what the Swedish people are famous
for? Sitting down and being quiet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well yeah-yeah the Scottish history is so much more…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) You can not play bagpipes at the wedding!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How did you know about that?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We heard you play all the way from your apartment!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Were you the ones called the cops?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s not really important right now. What is important is;
while we appreciate the gesture, we just don’t feel bagpipes are appropriate for our
wedding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because we hate them.

lines.speaker: Ross
