lines.text: Come on that’s not fair! I mean you haven’t even heard me play!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We have heard you play.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, you’ve heard my practice. Okay? Just-just give me a chance to
perform for you and then decide whatever you want. And I’m not going to tell you what
song I’m gonna play either. But uh, let’s just say when it’s over I’ll
bet there will be a we bit o’ celebration.

scenes.location: Silvercup Studios, Joey is getting pointers on how to play Jessica Lockhart.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: So, the essence of the character is rooted in her confidence. So, when
Jessica enters a room for instance, she owns everything and every person in that room.
(Joey is nodding.) You try.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay! (He scurries out the set door and re-enters, extremely impressed)
All right!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: No, he already knows that he owns everything in the room! He’s not
finding it out for the first time! So, try it again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Okay. (He goes out and comes back in, glaring at everything.)

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Right. He’s not angry at the room either. Try it again, he owns
it! He owns the room. It is his. He owns, owns, owns, owns the room! He owns it!!
(Joey gets a snooty look on his face.) All right, it’s a little weird, but it’s
getting better. (Joey is pleased.) Oh well, I’m gonna miss this woman so much. I
don’t know what I’m going to do! I mean, it’s been 20 years of my life.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well—Hey-hey! Maybe, maybe uh, maybe this is a good thing.
Y’know? It’ll-it’ll give you a chance to shake things up, play different
characters. You’re so talented.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: I am. I am, but I don’t know you know. An actor of a certain age
is not that easy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey that’s not true! Look at uh, look at Angela Lansb—Angelina
Jolie!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: I probably should’ve just left years ago when the offers were
pouring in, but y’know I just got so comfy here! And… Ohh, I turned down some
amazing work!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Like-like what?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Well, let’s just say if I left 15 years ago, the landscape of
Mexican cinema would be very different today!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (impressed) Wow!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: But… Well now, now’s a different time for me. (Starts to
cry.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey come on, don’t-don’t-don’t do this! Umm, look
let-let me tell you something, okay? Now when I watch you do a scene, I’m thinking,
"Boy, she-she is a great actress!" (She’s not buying it.) Uh but-but, I am
also thinking, "She is hot!"

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: (intrigued) You think I’m hot?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You own the room. (She smiles and stares longingly into his eyes.) We
should probably get-get uh…

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Oh yeah-yeah, we should get the… (Pause) So when Jessica kisses a
man, she usually puts umm, both her hands on the man’s face. (She does so.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, I noticed that! Is that ‘cause she’s so passionate?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: No! It’s because that way the camera only sees her! (She takes her
hands off his face.) Do you wanna try it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Okay. (He puts his hands on her face and they kiss.)

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: That was good, that was really good. But I-I think your hands maybe a
little off, they should be maybe right like… (She grabs the back of his neck and
kisses him passionately causing them to fall onto the couch.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment, Phoebe and Rachel are waiting for the cute guy to show up
for his cell phone. Rachel is putting on perfume by spraying it ahead of her face, and
moving into it. Phoebe tries to steal some.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Hey!
(There is a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: (simultaneously) Who is it?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Hi! It’s Tom, I’m here to pick up the phone.
(Rachel excitedly jumps up and heads for the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Whoa! Why do you get to answer the door?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well why shouldn’t I?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because it’s my apartment!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, then I get to give him the cell phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. All right. (Hands her the phone.) Good luck explaining all the
calls to China.
(Phoebe opens the door and Tom, an older gentleman with white hair, enters.)

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) Wow! How long were we arguing for?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) You’re not the man who left the cell phone.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: No that’s my assistant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is-is he coming? (Looks hopefully out the door.)

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Umm, no.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Could you-could you umm, give us one second?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’ll be right back sir.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Sure.
(They walk into the living room.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wh-what do we do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Can you believe this? (Rachel exhales in amazement.) We were waiting for
a hot guy and then an even hotter one shows up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know! (Realizes what Phoebe said.) What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm, they just don’t make ‘em like that anymore!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (turning and looking at Tom again) No-no they do but, you just have to
wait.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel, listen—I mean, if you let me have him then I will really
owe you one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (fake disappointment) All right. All right Phoebe I will let you have
him, but you owe me; you owe me big!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! You’re such a great friend!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: So, which one of you lovely ladies am I going to take to dinner huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’d be me. Sir. (Hands him the cell phone.) After you.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Okay. Okay. (Exits and Phoebe checks him out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (whispering) Nice!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Cecilia is entering the living room from Joey’s room
followed by Joey.]

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Well, you certainly own that room.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Actually I rent the whole place and, I just got what you meant. Thank you.
(She laughs as Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!
(Rachel stops dead in her tracks when she sees whom Joey is with.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God!! Ohh, Jessica Lockhart!! In my apartment!! I am
such a huge fan! I am such a huge fan!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Well, it’s nice to know that you…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (screaming) MONICA!!!! MONICA!!!! (Runs to Monica’s.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That uh, that is my roommate Rachel.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Oh that explains all the women’s underwear.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shrugs) Sure. Yep.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering with Rachel) Oh my God! It’s true!! Oh my God you are so
amazing! Oh my God, can I just ask you to do me oh, just one favor?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Certainly.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Would you slap me? Would you slap me right here in the face?! (Points to
her cheek.)

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: I’d love to, but my lawyer said I can’t do that anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God. You seem really, really nice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, bye-bye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean n-not-not fake at all like most famous people.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, here we go. (He grabs them and starts to pull them out of the
apartment.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (breaks away) Oh wait, just one more thing! One more minute! (To
Cecilia) Umm, you’re a stupid bitch.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: I really can’t slap you. (Monica walks away angrily)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are so beautiful.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nice to meet you! My God you’re great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks for stopping by. See ya! (Throws them out and closes the door.) (To
Cecilia) I-I am so sorry. I…

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no, being adored. I’m used to it, don’t worry
about it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (notices something in the mail that Rachel brought in) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They sent me today’s script! They never send the script!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: They don’t?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well no, I’m just in a coma. This must mean I have lines! (Realizes
what that means.) Oh…

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: How does it happen?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (flipping to the last page) Ew, you get thrown from a horse into an
electric fence.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Ah what?! Jessica hates horses!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah well, I’m guessing after this she’s not going to be crazy
about electricity either.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Rachel, Phoebe, Chandler, and Monica have gathered to
hear Ross perform his interpretation of Celebration by Cool and the Gang on
the bag pipe.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …now remember you have to imagine me in a kilt.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (giggles) (To Ross) I can imagine you in a short plaid skirt and knee
socks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) Do you wanna start telling secrets?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stands up) Now umm, remember I’m still learning.
(As he prepares to start, he makes several horrible noises that scares Rachel into
retreat.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: One, two, three, four!
(He starts. And well, Celebration was never meant to be played on the bagpipe,
so even the best bag pipe players in the world would have trouble with that particular
song. So of course, for a beginner like Ross, it sounds absolutely dreadful. The assembled
audience minus Phoebe, are horrified. Phoebe, immune to bad music, seems to enjoy it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know the song! Sing along!
(Ross resumes playing, this time accompanied by Phoebe screeching out E’s in tune
with Ross. While Phoebe is singing along, Rachel is having a very difficult time keeping a
straight face. Thankfully, Ross gives up after a little while.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Monica and Chandler
lines.text: No!
(Ross throws the bagpipes down in disgust.)
[Scene: Silvercup Studios, a scene is being shot where Dina and Fredrick are
celebrating Jessica’s horrible accident by drinking champagne.]

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Loosening the saddle on mother’s horse was brilliant Fredrick. And
the electric fence, inspired.

lines.speaker: Fredrick
lines.text: Thank you sweetheart. (They clink glasses.)

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: I can’t believe she’s really gone. Look around you, all of this
is ours. (They move into kiss but; they’re stopped by Joey entering with a huge
bandage wrapped around his head.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (as Jessica) I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Who are you?!

lines.speaker: Jessica Lockhart
lines.text: What’s the matter Dina? Don’t you recognize your own
(Does a hair flip) mother?!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Cut! That was great everybody! Thank you!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: (running out to Joey) That was so wonderful! (Hugs him) Ohh, I think
that you’re a better Jessica than I ever was!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh noo…

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Well of course not, but you were very good.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: And guess what? Good news! I got another job!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! Hey! All right! Well-well what is it?!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: A film in Guadalajara!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The airport?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: No that’s La Guardia. (Joey nods in recognition.) This is Mexico.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh. Wow! Well how-how, how will you be gone?

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Eight months.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s a really long time.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: Yeah, but you can come and visit me. I bet that you could uh, own a few
places down there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well I tell ya, I should probably buy a place in the city first.
(Realizes.) And I just got what you meant again—That is—I tell ya, that is a
tricky one!

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: That is a tricky one. Well, Joey I really wanna thank you. You’ve,
well you made a very difficult time for me a little less painful.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: Cecilia
lines.text: You too.
(They kiss and both put their hands on the other’s face like Jessica would do.)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Rachel, Phoebe, Chandler, and Monica have gathered to
hear Ross perform his interpretation of Celebration by Cool and the Gang on
the bag pipe. Yes, I typed that earlier. We’re seeing this again, only this time Ross
as already started playing.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know the song! Sing along!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Eeee!!! Eee!! Eee!!
(Monica (Courtney Cox) and Chandler (Matthew Perry) are laughing. That then causes Lisa
and Jennifer come out of character and start laughing hysterically. And that
finally causes David Schwimmer to come out of character and start laughing as well.
Matthew decides to sing along now as well.)

lines.speaker: Matthew Perry
lines.text: Eee!! (This causes more laughter.)

lines.speaker: Lisa Kudrow
lines.text: Do it again!
(Matthew mimics the sound again.)

title: The One with the Truth About London

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is filing her nails as Ross and Ben enter.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Hi Ben!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi, we have a little bathroom emergency.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah go ahead.
(Ben starts to go, but Ross stops him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, before we do uh, are any of Joey’s special romance magazines in
there?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Ben) Okay! All clear!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (running to the bathroom) Thanks Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ben, its Rachel! (He closes the door.) But whatever.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Ben) Everything okay in there?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Don’t talk to me now!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Awww, just like his daddy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey listen can you do me a big favor? The dean’s office just called
and said there was an urgent meeting. Can you watch Ben for like an hour?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What-what about Monica?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, she isn’t home.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (nervous) So it would just be, me alone?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, Ben would be there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh umm…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well that—y’know it’s just uh, I’ve never done that
before. Me and him alone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, he’s not an ex-con.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Okay. Uh, what do I, what do I do with him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know! Just-just talk to him-entertain him and keep him alive.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (Ben enters) Ben? Come here. All right, I’m gonna leave you
here with Aunt Rachel for about an hour. Okay? Are you gonna be okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah I think so.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel) I wasn’t talking to you.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I’ll be okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I’ll see you soon buddy. (He hugs and kisses him.) Be back in
an hour.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Bye dad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye. (Ross exits.) Ahhh… (Silence) So this is fun, huh?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Uh, want something-want something to drink?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh great! How do you feel about Diet Coke?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I’m not allowed to have soda.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Well that’s pretty much all that we have—Oh! Oh! Have
you ever had a virgin margarita? (Holds up a bottle of margarita mix.)

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: What’s a virgin?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Water it is.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica and Chandler are talking. Joey and Phoebe are getting
coffee.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What about the second minister we meet with? I kinda liked him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean the spitter?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on! It wasn’t that bad!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Easy for you to say; you’ll be wearing a veil.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, what about the third guy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean the guy who kept staring at your chest?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can you blame him?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry, I just don’t like the idea of when I say, "I
do," he’s thinking, "Yeah, I’d do her too!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well then we still have a problem.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (returning with Joey) With what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, we’re trying to find someone to perform our wedding and
they’re all either boring or annoying or y’know, can’t stop staring at the
ladies. (Points to her chest.)
(Joey nods his approval.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oo! You should have one of us do it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, we’re getting married, married; not sixth grade
married.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! No! It’s-it’s uh a real thing! Anyone can get ordained on
the Internet and perform like weddings and stuff!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! A friend of mine did it and it’s totally legal!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I call it!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! No! It was my idea!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Guys thank you very much but neither of you is marrying us.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Does calling it not mean anything anymore?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We are going to have a legitimate member of the clergy! And when I say
legitimate I mean, gay and in control of his saliva!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel and Ben are sitting on the couch bored out of their
minds.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ben y’know when uh, when you were a baby, you and I used to hang
out all the time. ‘Cause I was, I was your daddy’s girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: But you’re not anymore!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I’m not.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: ‘Cause you guys were on a break.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! We were not on a—Okay. That’s fine! Fine.
Y’know what Ben? One day when you are a lot older I am going to tell you that entire
story over a pitcher of real margaritas, okay?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: When’s my daddy coming back?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (checks her watch) Fifty-two minutes. (Pause) So no-no brothers and
sisters, huh? That must be nice. You don’t have to share stuff.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Sharing is good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you’re one of those. But y’know what? I have two
sisters of my own and we just-just tortured each other.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Really? Like how?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y’know, we would umm, repeat everything the other said, or uh,
we’d jump out of closets to scare each other, or switch the sugar for the salt so
they’d put salt on their cereal.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (laughs) That’s a good one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah? You like that one?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Yeah, you’re funny.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m funny? Oh thank God! Well hey, I’ve got a ton of these!
Umm, oh hear—Do you want a good one? Here’s a good one. Umm, you uh, you take a
quarter, take a quarter and, and you blacken the edge. Right? (Does so.) And then you say
to person, I bet you can’t roll this quarter from your forehead to your chin without
it leaving your face. And then when they do it, they’re left with a big black pencil
line right down the center of their face.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Can I do it to you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I-I-I-I’m funny Ben, but I’m not stupid. Okay?

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Chandler are eating lunch as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, did you uh, find anyone to marry you guys yet?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, but Horny for Monica Minister called, wanting to know if we were
still together.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re never gonna find anybody.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well then let me do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no! Look, I’ve been thinking about it. I’m an actor right?
So I won’t get nervous talking in front of people.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey look it’s really sweet…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no-no look no! I won’t spit, and I won’t stare at
Monica’s breasts! Y’know? Everyone knows I’m an ass man!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is true.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah and the most important thing is that it won’t be some like,
stranger up there who barely knows you. It’ll be me! And I swear I’ll do a
really good job. Plus, y’know I love you guys and-and it would really mean a lot to
me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Y’know, we haven’t found anybody else.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It might be kinda cool.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So I can do it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah you can do it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right!!! Okay!! All right! Okay-okay, I gotta get started on my
speech! Oh, wait a minute, Internet ministers can still have sex right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.
(Phoebe enters slowly.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, how’s it going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I have a headache. A horrible headache!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. Can I get you something?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, you’ve got to stop chattering!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here, take a couple of these. (She gets up to grab a couple of pills.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s Hexadrin.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, I don’t believe in Western medicine. No, if you just apply
pressure to these points right here. (She’s pinching the bit of skin between her
right thumb and forefinger with her left hand.) Then your hand starts to hurt and you
still have a headache, so thanks. (Takes the pills.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, while we’re waiting for these pills to kick in, I’m
gonna sit you down on the couch. Come on. (Phoebe gets up and goes with her.) Get some
nice soft pillows under your head, I’m gonna turn the TV on and you can watch
whatever you want. And I’m—Sit down—(She sits down on the couch)—gonna
make you some tea. And then, I’m gonna rub your feet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! My head! Oh! (He’s sitting on the chair, lies back, and puts his
feet up for Monica to rub.) Oh!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is reading and there is knock on the door which she
answers.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Coming.
(She opens the door to reveal Ross with a pencil mark from his forehead to his chin.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have a bone to pick with you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! Ben learned a little trick.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah? Did he pull the old… (She is waving her hand up and down
her face. She’s thinking about the pencil mark.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right! That’s right! Saran Wrap on the toilet seat
so the pee goes everywhere!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah that! You know I hate practical jokes! They’re mean and
they’re stupid and-and I don’t want my son learning them!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on! Saran Wrap on the toilet seat, you don’t think
that’s just a little funny?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was barefoot. Now tell me, the toilet thing is the only thing you taught
him right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at his mark) Yes.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe, Chandler, and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s amazing! My headache is completely gone! What are those pills
called?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hexadrin. (She gets the box out of her purse.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I love you Hexadrin! (She kisses the box.) Oh look! It comes with a
story! (She pulls out the instructions and side affects paper.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No Phoebe, those are like the side affects and stuff.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Say what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, the possible side affects.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! (Starts reading them.) Dizziness, nervousness, drowsiness,
facial swelling, nausea, headache—Headache. Vomiting, stomach bleeding, liver damage!
Now okay, I don’t recall any of this coming up when you gave me these little death
capsules! Oh I’m sorry, extra strength death capsules!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, relax none of that stuff ever happens! They just put it on there
for legal reasons!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: In case it happens.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Say hello to Reverend Joey Tribbiani! (Holds up the piece of paper bearing
the proof of his ordination.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You did it! You got ordained?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I just got off the Internet! Man, there is a lot of porn out there!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Our minister…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I have liver damage. Ow! Oh! (She grabs the left side of her torso.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, your liver is right here. (She points to the right side of her
torso.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, then I must be disoriented.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Anyway, I started working on what I’m going to say for the ceremony,
do you wanna hear it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now-now, listen this is just a first draft so… (Starts to read the
piece of paper he brought.) "We are gathered here today on this joyous occasion to
celebrate the special love that Monica and Chandler share." (Monica and Chandler like
it so far.) Eh? (He continues reading.) "It is a love based on giving and receiving.
As well as having and sharing. And the love that they give and have is shared and
received. And through this having and giving and sharing and receiving." (Phoebe nods
her approval.) "We too can share and love and have and receive."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Should we call the spitter?
Commercial Break
[Scene: Carol and Susan’s, there is a knock on the door and Carol opens it to
reveal Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Hey Rachel! (The camera cuts to her face and we see that Ben pulled the
quarter trick with her as well.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: What a nice surprise! What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y’know I was just in the neighborhood and I passed by your
building and I thought to myself, "What’s up with Carol and sweet, little
Ben?"

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Can I ask what—Come on in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Umm uh, I’ll make some coffee and we can uh, chat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’d love that. I would loooove… (Carol goes to make the coffee
and she sits down.) So uh, so where is sweet little Ben? I would love to have a little...

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (jumping up from behind her chair) Gotcha!! (Rachel jumps up startled.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I found him! (To Ben) Very funny, come here! (She sits down on the
coffee table and Ben walks up.) That is exactly why I’ve come here to talk to you
okay?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (from the kitchen) Rach, do you want some sugar in your coffee?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes oh—(To Ben)—Do I want sugar in my coffee? (Ben nods no.)
No, just some milk would be good Carol. Thanks. (To Ben) Okay, do you remember all that
stuff I taught you yesterday?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (mimicking her) Remember all that stuff I taught you yesterday?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don’t do that.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Don’t do that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Seriously, your dad doesn’t like pranks.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Seriously, your dad doesn’t like pranks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh damnit!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Oh damnit!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Don’t say that! Don’t say that!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Damnit!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No don’t! Go back to repeating!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Damnit!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh crap!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Oh crap!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler, and Monica are returning from
Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I feel like my face is swelling. (To Monica) Is my face swelling?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, your face is fine! Come on, none of this stuff is going to
happen to you! Stop being such a baby!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, interesting you should call me that! Now that I may never have one!
(Holds up the warning label.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay you guys, I got a little more written. Are you ready?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. O-okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (reading) "When I think of the love that these two givers and
receivers share, I can not help but envy the lifetime ahead of having and loving and
giving and…" And then I can’t think of a good word for right here. (He
points to the stop on the paper where he left off.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How about receiving?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See Joe, not that that’s not grrreat! But, one of the cool things
about having somebody we know perform the ceremony is that it can be about us!
Y’know, it can be more personal. You can tell stories about us!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, like the time you and I went to Atlantic City and I made you laugh so
hard you threw up your whole steak?! Remember?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, not us… (Motions Joey and him.) Us! (Motions Monica and him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I gotcha. Sorry. (To Monica) So, did you ever make him throw up a whole
anything?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Did you ever feed him a poison capsule that made him bleed from the
eyes?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It doesn’t say that!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Suddenly somebody knows all about the side affects!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See Joe, we want you to tell stories but y’know, romantic
stories. Nice stories.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Okay. Ooh! Ooh! Okay, maybe I’ll talk about London! Y’know
when you two hooked up! Only, only I won’t say hooked up. I’ll say, "Began
their beautiful journey…"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There you go!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "…by doin’ it."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. All right. Umm, so uh, so how did it happen? Did your eyes meet
across the room? And then the next thing y’know you’re in the bathtub together
and she’s feeding you strawberries?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Isn’t that what happened with you and the bride’s maid?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!! I call that London style.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No that is not what happened with us. Well, I was umm, I was really sad
that night because this guy that I was Ross’s mom.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And then Chandler was, was really sweet and he consoled me. And well we
drank too much…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah baby!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I was a perfect gentleman and I walked her to her hotel room and
said goodnight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But then later that night…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah baby!
[Cut to London, Chandler’s hotel room. He is getting ready for bed by doing
push-ups. One push-up. Just as he gets under the covers, there’s a knock on the
door.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (answering the door) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (standing outside) Cute PJ’s! You’re really livin’ it up
here in London huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well I was… I was exactly expecting company after…(He looks
at his watch.) 9:15.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Is Joey here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, last time I saw him he was heading out the door with the
bride’s maid and a bucket of strawberries. So uh, you’re not still upset about
what that guy told ya are ya?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wouldn’t you be?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, look it’s been a really emotional time y’know, and
you’ve had a lot to drink. And you’ve just got to let that go okay? I
mean you were the most beautiful in the room tonight!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You kidding? You’re the most beautiful woman in most rooms…
(She jumps up and kisses him.) (Breaking the kiss.) Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! What’s going
on? You and I just made out! You and I are making out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, not anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But we don’t do that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, I just thought it would be fun.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How drunk are you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Drunk enough to know that I want to do this. Not so drunk that you
should feel guilty about taking advantage.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (thinks) That’s the perfect amount!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!
(They run to the bed, sit down, and start making out again.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (breaking the kiss) Y’know what’s weird?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This doesn’t feel weird!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re a really good kisser.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I have kissed over four women. (They kiss again.) Do you wanna
get under the covers?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hm-hmm!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!
(They do so and they take off their clothes.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! You are really fast!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It bodes well for me that speed impresses you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re gonna see each other naked.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you wanna do it at the same time?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Count of three?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: One!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Two!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Two!

lines.speaker: Monica and Chandler
lines.text: Three! (They lift up the covers and check each other
out, then come back up with silly grins on their faces.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well I think it’s safe to say that our friendship is effectively
ruined.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Eh, we weren’t that close anyway!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eh!
(They start making out again, and it takes Joey trying to enter to stop them.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey! Joey! Joey! J-J-Joey-Joey-J-Joey! (Monica hides under the covers
as Joey enters. Remember?)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Joe! I was just watching a movie-e-e… (Notices that the TV is
turned off.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, dude I’m so sorry!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No! No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey no-no-no-no! It’s cool! It’s cool! I-I’ll only be a
second, I’m still with my bride’s maid, I just—Where are those condoms you
brought?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They’re in my bag over there. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah. (Joey walks to Chandler’s bag by getting as far away from
Chandler’s bed as possible.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, could you leave me one?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause) For just you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey listen, why don’t you come downstairs with me? There’s some
really nice girls down there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No I-I-I’m fine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, here you go buddy. (He tosses him one.) Go nuts. (Exits.)
[Cut back to Monica and Chandler telling Phoebe and Joey the story.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s what that was?! ‘Cause that other thing? I thought you
were on to something, but it did nothing for me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, can we change the topic? Because it’s really doing
nothing for me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh… (To Chandler) Can you imagine if I hadn’t left you that last
one? You two might’ve never gotten together. Ooh-ooh! Could you imagine if I sent
that hooker up to the room like I was gonna?! It’s like it was in the stars!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, it’s totally meant to be. (To Monica) Tell him who you
originally wanted to hook up with that night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Joey) What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who did you originally want to hook up with?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, fine but please don’t be upset! Okay? I was really
depressed okay? And really drunk! I just wanted something stupid and meaningless. I just
wanted…just sex. So, when I…went to your room that night…I was actually
looking…for Joey. (Joey smiles.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah baby! (Chandler glares at him.) No baby!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, scene continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) So you came to the room looking for Joey? Did you ever
in-intend on telling me about this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No because it-it didn’t seem important.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it’s not important? It’s not important?! If it
wasn’t for a bride’s maid you’d be marrying him (Points to Joey) not me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Noo!! The point is that is was you that was there that night! It
is you that I am marrying! It is you that I feel in love with!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And it is a love that is based on having and giving and receiv—(Shuts
up on Monica’s glare.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t believe it. The most romantic night of my life and
I’m runner up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, please! Do you know how unbelievably glad I am that Joey was
not there that night?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! (Monica turns and looks at him) Now I’m a man of the cloth, but
I still have feelings!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Joey) Look there is no way you’re doing this wedding now.
Okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! That’s not fair! It’s not my fault! I was off with my
bride’s maid! And who’s to say I would’ve even said yes?! (To Monica) I
mean I would’ve said yes. Chandler look y-y-you are making way to big a deal out of
this, all right? Look, everything worked out okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, it’s just weird! Okay? I don’t want to be standing
their saying my vows and then having the mental image of you and Monica! I-I-I need…I
don’t know what I need. I need a walk.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait Chandler come on, let’s—it’s not a big deal!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It is to me. You wanted to sleep with Batman, and instead you
had to settle for Robin. (Walks out and slams the door.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is crazy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know! Robin is so gay!

scenes.location: Carol and Susan’s, Rachel is talking with Ben.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So now what have we agreed?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: No more pranks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And-and what else?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: That you and daddy were not on a break.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Very good.
(There’s a knock on the door and Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel! What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m just visiting my good friend Carol.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Your good friend?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s her last name?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Carol…Lesbian?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nice. And by the way that uh, that line down my face?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What line?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wh-wh-what line? The line that prompted a student in my last class
of the day to say uh, (In a college frat boy voice) "Dude, don’t you ever was
your face?"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I’m sorry. I’m sorry I didn’t tell you but you
were so mad already!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course I was mad! I told you I-I hate this stuff! Okay? It-it’s
not funny!

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (entering from the kitchen) Hey Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: What’s not funny?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Practical jokes.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Oh I…I think they’re funny.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You have a line down your face.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: What? (Goes and checks.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, maybe they are not funny to you…

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: (yelling from the bathroom) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Or Carol! But they’re funny to kids and who is it hurting?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, y’know what? I’ll tell you who it hurts! It hurts the kid
who has all his clothes stolen in gym class so he has to go to the principal’s office
wearing nothing but a catcher’s mitt!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That was you?! We heard about you in Junior High! Did you really
just shake your fist in the air and shout, "I will be revenged?!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I will be! Listen, I don’t want you teaching my son that stuff
anymore. Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine. Fine, but I’ll have you know that once I taught him that
stuff he called me Fun Aunt Rachel. And I loved being Fun Aunt Rachel but I’ll go
back to being Boring and Uncomfortable Aunt Rachel if that’s what you want!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No that’s not what I want. Uh, I’m glad you guys were bonding
but I…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look he doesn’t have any brothers or sisters, somebody’s gonna
have to teach him this stuff! And I haven’t taught him anything that a normal
6-year-old doesn’t know anyway!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: (yelling from off camera) Crap!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I gotta go! (Runs out.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler is sulking on the couch as Joey enters to talk with
him.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey. Do you want this scone? (Holds up his plate) It came for me but
it would probably rather sleep with you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, come on nothing even happened!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look Joe, I know you wanted to do the wedding…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-hey-no! If you don’t want me to do it, I except that. I don’t
care about that. I just…I don’t want you to be upset.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How can I not be upset? Okay? I finally fall in love with this
fantastic woman and it turns out that she wanted you first!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah for like a half an hour one night! Chandler, she wants you for the
rest of her life! You’re so lucky! Look what I missed out on by not being there!
Although you know what? It could never have worked like you guys did, ‘cause you guys
are perfect for each other. Y’know, we look at you and-and we see you together and it
just…it-it fits. Y’know? And you just know it’s gonna last forever.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s what you should say.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When you’re marrying us; that’s what you should say.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? I can do it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’d love it if you would do it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But those are the words! Those exact words!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well I don’t know remember exactly but, it’s-it’s pretty
much about having and giving and sharing and receiving.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is in the kitchen as Ross and Ben are entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey I’m sorry to do this to you again but uh, is there any way you
can look after Ben for a little bit? I-I’ve got this meeting at school. And-and he-he
asked for his uh, ‘Fun Aunt’ Rachel, so…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhh! Well of course I will watch him! We have fun, don’t we Ben?
(He nods yes.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I’ll see you later pal.
(Ross turns to leave.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, okay. (Ross has a sign on his back that reads ‘Poop.’)
Wh—Ah-ha! (Ross stops and turns.) Wait a minute. Uh Ben, I can’t do it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can’t let him go out that way, he’s got a meeting. (To Ross)
You’ve got something here on your back.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (She takes the sign off and hands it to him.) That’s great.
That is great. (Crumples up the paper and throws it down in anger.) What did we just
finish talking about Ben?!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: What did we just finish talking about Ben?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, that’s it! (He runs over to Ben, but he runs past him and
out the door.) Come—you—no! You are in big trouble young man!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Wait! Come on!
[Cut to the hallway, Ben runs upstairs with Ross in pursuit.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait! No! Ben, come here! I am not kidding!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No you guys… (She walks out into the hallway.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I-I-am—(Suddenly Ross starts screaming and comes falling down the
stairs landing just in front of Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: EHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!! My God!!!!!!!!!!! Oh my God!!!!!!! (She runs over to
him and finds that it was a dummy and that she had been had.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Monica are entering. Phoebe and Joey are sitting on
the couch.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey-hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So are guys doing okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we talked and Monica made me see that I over reacted a little
bit and some things in life are more important.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah baby! (Phoebe and Joey nod.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m really glad you guys are okay but, I just keep thinking what
would happen if-if you two (Points to Monica and Joey) actually had hooked up.

scenes.location: Monica and Joey’s, Monica is cooking.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey! Dinner’s ready!
(Joey, whose new diet is working out great, he looks like he only weighs 375 down from
420 enters from the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Fat Joey
lines.text: What’s my little chef got for me tonight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Your favorite!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ho-ho-ho, (pausing for a rest next to the fridge) fried stuff with cheese!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yep! And lot’s of it!

lines.speaker: Fat Joey
lines.text: Thanks sweetheart. Give me a little sugar here. (They
kiss.) Okay.
(Joey sits down.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, in we go.
(Monica gets behind him and in combination with his sliding the chair forward and her
pushing with her leg manages to get up to the table.)

lines.speaker: Fat Joey
lines.text: Here we go! Here we go! Here we go! (Groans and picks
up a piece of food.) How you doin’?
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is getting Phoebe some coffee.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here you go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (still reading the label) Oh my God! This is a six-hour pill! (Checks
her watch) That’s it! I’m out of the woods! Ohh! What a relief!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good for you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it’s like huge weight has been lifted! ‘Cause look, (reads
the side affects) no hair loss, not a rash, no hives, I’m just so happy! Because no
shortness of breath, no temporary euphoria—Oh.

title: The One with the Cheap Wedding Dress

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Monica, Chandler, Phoebe, and Joey are there. Monica is holding a
piece of paper.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So the wedding caterer sent me this list of twelve appetizers and I have
to narrow it down to six.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Food? Uh-huh gimme! (She hands him the paper.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So did Monica tell you about this great band called the Swing Kings
that we’re trying to get to play at the wedding?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Since when are you into swing music?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh since forever! I used to go all over town listening to bands!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Gap commercial. (To Monica) So did you book them? Did you call?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you want me to call?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I’ll do it. You just stick to your job.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What is your job?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Staying out of the way.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is impossible Monica, why don’t you just pick all 15? (Hands
back the paper.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There were only twelve.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, I added three.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are peanut butter fingers?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah… (He mimes sticking his fingers into a jar of peanut butter,
scooping some out, and eating it off his fingers.)
Opening Credits

scenes.location: A Street, Chandler and Ross are at a newsstand.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (noticing a beautiful woman moving in down the street) Well hello!
She’s cute! Should we uh, go try to talk to her?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure! That’s one of the great things about being engaged.
I’m not nervous talking to pretty girls anymore.

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: Could you guys help me? (Chandler shyly exhales and looks away.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh yeah! Let me, let me get that for you.

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: It-it’s really heavy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (exhales) I got it. (He lifts the box and grunts under the strain.)
(Calmly) So hi, I’m uh, I’m Ross and this is my friend Chandler. (He shyly
waves.)

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: I-I am Kristen.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Kristen, hi. Are you uh, new to the area, ‘cause if you
are…I’d love to show you around sometime.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: I…I uh, actually just moved from four blocks over.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: But-but this block is like a whole other world.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know actually it does have a very interesting history. Uh, this
street is the first street in the city to have an underground sewer system. (Kristen
crinkles her nose at that.) Before that sewage and waste would just flow right down the
street. Yeah, sometimes ankle deep! (He stops when he realizes what he’s talking
about.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) Smooth.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: (To Chandler) Excuse me? (Chandler does the shy thing again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, say you’re gonna be starving after all this moving. What do you
say I take you to dinner tonight?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Oh I’d like that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great! Uh, let me take this up for you. (The box he’s holding.)

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: After you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no-no, after you. (She grabs a chair and heads upstairs.) (When
she’s gone.) Oh my God! (He drops the box and Chandler can’t pick it up.)
[Scene: A Bridal Shop, Phoebe and Rachel are waiting for Monica who is trying on her
wedding dress.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (wearing a veil) Am I crazy or does this totally go?!
(Monica enters from the dressing room wearing her gown.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! You look so beautiful!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) Thank you Rachel but, look at Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is it. Yeah, this is the one. I can’t believe I found it!
(Another woman walks up.)

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: Wow you look so beautiful! If I knew you, I’d cry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well I’m Monica Geller, ball like a baby.

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: I’m Megan Bailey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have you found your dress yet?

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Oh no, these dresses are all so amazing but there is no way I could
afford one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I can’t afford this either. No. I-I-I’m, I’m just to
figure out which one I want then I’m gonna get it at Kleinman’s, this discount
place in Brooklyn, day after tomorrow they are having a huge sale.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Oh, thanks for the tip.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! So-so when are you getting married?

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Oh I’m not, I just like to try these on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I do the same thing.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: I’m just kidding. I’m getting married July 25th.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m just kidding too. (Laughs) I’m getting married in
December. (Turns away not happy with herself.)

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: (To Monica) So when are you getting married?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh May 15th.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Oooh it’s getting close!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: So uh, who’s your photographer?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Jeffery.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: We met with him. Did he show you the photos of the nude wedding he did?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The best man? Wow!

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: I know! I almost called off my wedding. Oh, who’s your band?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, my fiancee wants the Swing Kings.

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Oh, you’re so lucky. My fiancee wants the heavy metal band Carcass.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, is that spelled with a ‘C’ or a ‘K’? Oh my God!
It doesn’t matter; they’re both great!
(Another woman walks past Rachel carrying a wedding dress.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh y’know what? Y’know what? Now that you know what you want
you should go to Kleinman’s and get it half off. This place is so overpriced.

lines.speaker: The Woman
lines.text: I own this store.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, does this (The dress) come in another color or… (The store
owner walks away.)

scenes.location: A Street, Joey is walking by Kristen who is still moving in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (checking her out) Hi! You uh, movin’ in or movin’ out?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: I’m moving in.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh uh, can I give you a hand?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Oh okay. But y’know what? Be careful. Because a guy was helping me
before had to leave because he hurt his back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Boyfriend?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m Joey. (They shake hands.)

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Kristen.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh wow, what a beautiful name! (Pause) What is it again?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Kristen.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Got it! (He picks up a lamp.) So…

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: So uh, do you live around here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah! Right down there. (Points.) Hey listen; let me give you a
little tip. Do not take a nap on this stoop (Points to hers) or you can wake up with your
shoes gone.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: I’ll remember that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Yeah. Listen would you uh, would you like to have dinner with me
tonight?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Oh I, I have plans tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: But how about tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sounds great! Okay all right, well where does this go? (The lamp he’s
holding.)

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: You look strong, why don’t I take that and you grab one of the
boxes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Yeah. (She leaves and he goes to pick up a box marked books, but
decides to take the box marked pillows instead.) Yeah, I’ll grab this one. (He
follows her upstairs.)
[Scene: Kleinman’s, a horde of women including Rachel, Phoebe, and Monica are
waiting for the store to open.]

lines.speaker: A Woman
lines.text: What is taking so long?! I mean whatever!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe) So this is Brooklyn.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, listen up. There is usually only one dress in each size so
when they open those doors, fan out. Now, this is what you’re looking for! (Holds up
a picture of it.) Memorize it! When you locate the dress, blow on these. All right? (She
passes out whistles to them.) Three short blasts, when you hear it. Come running.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right.
(A worker comes to open the door and the horde starts to press forward.)

lines.speaker: A Woman
lines.text: Here he comes! Hurry!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh they’re pushing! They’re pushing!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Rachel) Hey! Don’t be a baby!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well I…
(The door opens allowing the horde to charge in, knocking Rachel out of the way and to
the ground.)

lines.speaker: A Woman
lines.text: Let’s go!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (coming back out) Hey! Rachel! Come on!!!!
[Time lapse, inside the store, Monica is frantically looking for her dress.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. No. Not it. Not it. Not it. (Checks another rack and another woman
tries to reach around her.) (To the woman) Don’t crowd me! (Finds it) This is it!
This is the dress! Oh my God, it’s perfect! (She takes it off of the rack and someone
has a hold of it on the other side of the rack and tugs on it.) I’m sorry, this
one’s taken! (The other woman tugs harder pulling Monica through the rack.) Whoa!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Megan!

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You came?!

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is my dress!

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes it is! You saw me wearing it!

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: And now you’ll see me buying it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? You freak! You wouldn’t even have known about this place if
it wasn’t for me!

lines.speaker: Megan
lines.text: Look, you don’t want to fight me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe I do! I’m pretty feisty! (She blows the signal.)
[Cut to Phoebe in another part of the store.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (hearing the signal) I’m coming! I’m coming! (She takes off
towards the signal and almost knocks another woman over.)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hey!
(She hears another signal in another direction.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! (Runs that way and hears another whistle blast.) Hey! (Heads the
other way and hears another blast.) What do I do?!! (She runs in the second direction and
finds that the whistling is coming from inside a rack. She moves the dresses out of the
way to find Rachel curled up in a fetal position frantically blowing on the whistle.) What
are you doing? (Rachel doesn’t stop.) Did you find the dress? (Rachel won’t stop
so Phoebe pinches her nose shut which causes her to spit the whistle out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Did you find the dress?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! You gotta get me out of here Phoebe! These bargain shoppers are
crazy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I—We gotta get Monica. (She starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! You gotta hold my hand!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!! (She grabs Rachel’s hand and drags her towards Monica.)
Excuse me! Excuse me! (She’s knocking women and veils out of the way as she moves.)
(She gets to Monica who has the dress balled up in one hand and is sitting on Megan who
is sprawled out on the floor.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (handing Phoebe the dress) Go! Go! Go!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing who’s trapped) Hey…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: NOW!!!!!!!! (Rachel runs off and Monica gets up to follow her.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Chandler and Ross are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So Ross, how was your date the other night? Did you tell her about the
magical ride that starts with the flush of every toilet?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Laugh all you want but uh, she actually left me a message saying
she’d like to go out again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah in fact, I’m gonna go call her right now. And I’ll make
sure to tell her my friend Chandler says… (He mimics the shy reaction Chandler did.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, sorry I didn’t stop by last night but I had a date.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh Joe, when it’s one o’clock in the morning and you
don’t come by? That’s okay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well check it out, I was with this really hot girl who just moved in right
across the street!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? Right across the street?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When’d you meet her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Two days ago.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Excellent! Y’know Ross met somebody too!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (returning) Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi! How’d it go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh great! We’re going out again Saturday. But I just found she’s
also seeing some other guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastically shocked) Really?! Joe? What would you do if you were in
Ross’s situation?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I sorta am. I mean yeah, I’m dating this girl who’s also
seeing another guy. But, I don’t know, I’m not to worried about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well you shouldn’t be. Believe me I wouldn’t want to be the guy
who’s up against you. (Chandler laughs.) I mean that doofus is going to lose!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So this is nice! I wish I didn’t have to go, believe me! But
unfortunately I have to. (He gets up and Joey moves over next to Ross.) Oh uh, by the way,
what’s the name the girl you’re dating?

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: Kristen Lang.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye! (Exits.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, time lapse from the earlier scene.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well obviously only one of us can keep dating her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Obviously! So, how do we decide?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well now let’s-let’s look at this objectively, I think I should
date her…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (not buying it) Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Or, or I’m the one who dates
her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s interesting, but check this out. I date her…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah I like that but just to go in another direction…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay. This can go on for a while.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah well we should order some food then.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No Joey! Look why don’t, why don’t we just let her decide? Okay?
Hey-hey, we’ll each go out with her one more time. And-and we’ll see who
she likes best.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling) That sounds fair.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe I’ll take her to that new French restaurant down the
street…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah yeah—wait a second now! Look we’re gonna have to set a
spending limit on the date. I don’t have the money to take her to a fancy place like
that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well sorry, that’s what I do on dates.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, well I guess I’ll just have to do what I do on dates.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So let’s decide on the spending limit…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Uh, (thinks)…a slice…(Thinks)…six dollars?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was thinking more like a hundred.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Can I borrow 94 dollars?
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica, Phoebe, and Rachel are admiring Monica’s
wedding dress.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. Hand me a tissue. (Monica hands her one.)
(Rachel goes to the fridge, opens it, and blows on the whistle Monica gave her at the
store, which causes Phoebe and Monica to turn around and look at her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re out of Diet Coke.
(The phone rings and Monica answers it as Rachel goes into the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello? (Listens) What?! (Listens) You what?! (Listens) Hey you listen
here missy! (Listens) Wh—(She is hung up on.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was that girl Megan! She booked the Swing Kings on the day of our
wedding and said that I couldn’t have them back unless I gave her the dress!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) Does that mean Carcass is available?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What am I gonna do?! That is the dress! That is the dress!
Wh…Chandler wants the band. What do I do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well just figure out a way to talk him out of it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How?
(There are three short whistle blasts from the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re out of toilet paper!

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, Ross is getting ready for his date with Kristen.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! What’s up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I just wanted to come by and y’know, wish you good luck on your date.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh thanks!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. What time are you meeting her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We have 8:00 reservations at Grammercy Bistero.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow, that’s in like 20 minutes. You’d better get dressed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am dressed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Well good! (To himself) For me. (He picks up a jar of lotion.) What is
this? Did you give yourself a facial?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have an oily T-zone!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay dude! (Finds a receit.) Hey you uh, you sent Kristen flowers.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You spent a hundred dollars. That’s the limit. You’re screwed!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh actually, I sent the flowers before the actual date. So techincally, technically
I didn’t break any rules. Thanks for stopping by though.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-oh! So that’s the way it’s gonna be huh? Yeah I can break the
rules too y’know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah? What are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why am I not surprised?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what Ross? I’m not gonna let you get away with this!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t think you have much choice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well we’ll see!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye-bye!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah bye-bye! (Exits and comes back in still holding the lotion.) Hey! So
just a light layer?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. Yes. Just here (Runs his fingers down the bridge of his nose) and
there (Runs his fingers across his forehead).
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is entering without touching anything with his
hands. Phoebe, Monica, and Rachel are there.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey got meat sauce on the banister again! (He goes into the bathroom
to wash his hands.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, swing music is so out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, he’s gotta be in the room for that to work.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (returning) What are you guys talking about?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well umm, we were just talking about the y’know, the Swing Kings
and just wondering whether y’know, they were the right way to go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I went to a wedding once where they had swing music and uh, two
months later the couple got divorced. And now I’m not saying that there’s any
connection here y’know, but they did tell me that’s why they got divorced.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But I love swing music!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah but the Swing Kings? Y’know they suck so much that people
actually die at their concerts—They just stop living.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look all I know is when Monica and I went to see them, we had fun! And
there’s another reason too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what is the other reason?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t want to say.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well you have to because maybe it’s stupid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well it’s just while Monica and I were dancing to them it
was…the first time I knew that…you were the woman I wanted to dance all my
dances with.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh crap!
[Scene: Grammercy Bistero, Ross and Kristen are waiting for their table to be ready.
Ross is returning from talking to the matire’d.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So they said our table will be ready in just a few minutes.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Oh great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Is your back feeling better?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah it’s fine. I guess the more muscles you have the more they
can spasim out of control.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Kristen?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Hi! What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh I like this place. And technically, technically I’m not breaking
any rules so I…

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Well uh, Ross? This is Joey. Joey? Ross.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi. (They shake hands.) It’s nice to meet you. I used to have a
friend named Joey. I don’t anymore.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Our table will be ready in a couple minutes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. So…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure! I would love to wait with you guys! Thanks! (Sits down.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So Joey umm, you look familiar. Are uh, are you on TV or something?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Well Joey doesn’t like to talk about it but, he’s one of the
stars of Days Of Our Lives.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right! That’s right, don’t you play a woman?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A woman in a man’s body.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Much better.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So y’know Ross it’s funny ‘cause, you look familiar to me
too. Have you ever been married?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well yes, yes I have. In fact umm, just the other day Kristen and I were
talking about how I’ve been married and how I have a son.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Yeah, little Eric.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right! Wait no, Ben.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you’ve just married the one time then?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well umm…

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: You’ve been married twice?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. And another time after that. Boy I’m getting hungry! Hey Joey,
have you ever been so hungry on a date that when a girl goes to the bathroom you eat some
of her food?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: You said the waiter ate my crab cake.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs that one off) Yeah. So uh Ross, well now—why did that first
marriage breakup? Was it because the woman was straight or she was a lesbian?

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Do you two know each other?

lines.speaker: Joey and Ross
lines.text: No. No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. It just seems like Ross is the kind of a guy that would marry a woman
on the verge of being a lesbian and then push her over the edge.
(Kristen is not enjoying this.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute! Were you on a poster for gonorrhea?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Have you ever slept in the same bed as a monkey?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey you leave Marcel out of this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine! Have you ever got stuck in a pair of your own leather pants?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey-hey have you ever locked yourself in a TV cabinet VD boy?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monkey lover!
(They both notice that Kristen has left.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: When do you think we lost her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Probably around gonorrhea.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is entering.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, honey! I’m home!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (from the bedroom) Don’t come in here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why? Do you another boyfriend in there or something?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! We only mess around at his place!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know it’s funny I started it but, now it’s scary me.
So could you come out here please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I’m wearing a wedding dress.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh you got a wedding dress? That’s great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah but I’m not keeping it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well then why can’t I see it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. I guess you can. Okay but; I-I have to return it, so you can’t
like it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay I promise. I’ll-I’ll hate it. (She enters.) Wow!
You-you look…hideous.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, that’s like the most ugliest dress I’ve ever seen.
Wh-why do you to return it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh because it doesn’t…really fit. Oh by the way, I-I booked
the Swing Kings.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s great! Great! Thanks! But that dress I mean it’s
like yuck! It’s terrible! It makes me wanna just rip it right off of you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! But you can’t rip it. Well, maybe a little.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!
Ending Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler, Joey, and Ross are watching a basketball game
on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys! Do you wanna look at the song list for the wedding?
(They ignore her.) Guys?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (without turning around) I thought you were gonna be gone all day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right? What’s going on?
(They all slowly turn around to reveal that they are giving themselves a facial.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sorry. I’m sorry. I-I should probably leave you girls
alone. (She heads for the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, laugh all you want but in ten minutes we’re gonna have younger
looking skin!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! (Monica goes in the bedroom.) Y’know, she could use a
little…(Whistles that she needs to do what they’re doing.) (Something happens on
the game.) Oh nice shot!!! (They all cheer.)

title: The One with Joey's Award

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Monica are there as Joey is entering excitedly.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! You guys! You’re not gonna believe this! I just got off the
phone with my agent…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! (Joey looks at her.) I’m sorry, too soon. You go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. I got nominated for my part on Days of Our Lives!

lines.speaker: Monica
