lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good for you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Congratulations! Wow! I can’t believe you’re nominated for an Emmy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh Soap Opera Digest award!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! I’m up for a Soapie!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey? Is that something you’re making up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no! It’s real! And it has been since 1998. (Rachel returns
from the bathroom.) Hey Rach! Rach! I’m up for a Soapie!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Oh my God! Oh my God!! That is like the third most prestigious
soap opera award there is!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you! Well, I guess now I know who I’m taking to the awards.
(Points to Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, stop that! Don’t kid about that! (Gasps) Will all the stars be
there?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Many are scheduled to appear.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God! I can’t go! I’m gonna be too nervous!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Joey) Okay, I’ll go!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!! You are getting married! This is all I have.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: N.Y.U, Ross is giving a lecture.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …and it was Ernst Muhlbrat who first hypothesized that the
Velociraptor would expand it’s collar and emit a high pitched noise to frighten
it’s predator. (A student raises his hand.) Yes Mr. Lewis?

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: What kinda noise?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just a high pitched intimidating noise.

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: But like how?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well we-we don’t know for sure. But in my head it-it sounded
something like this. (He makes a high pitched noise and Alan doesn’t know what to
make of it.) Of course, this is just conjecture. Okay, that’s uh, that’s all for
today. (Everyone starts to get up.) Uh Mr. Morse, can I see you for a moment?

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: Yes sir.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mr. Morse I need to talk to you about your mid-term exam, I’m afraid
I-I had to fail you.

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: (shocked) Why?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well you need 60% to pass…

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: What’d I get?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Seven.

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: That’s not so good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no it’s not. What-what happened there Ned?

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: Well maybe you can cut me some slack. I’m sort of in love.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I’m sorry but, that-that’s really not my problem.

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: I’m in love with you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well that brings me in the loop a little.

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: You see, that’s why I did so bad on this test. I’m having a
hard time concentrating. When you’re up there (Points to the podium) and you’re
teaching and your face gets all serious…you look so good. (In a sexy voice) You wear
that tight little turtleneck sweater…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! (Walks away from him.) Umm, I uh, I’m your teacher. I’m
sorry, you’re-you’re a student and I-and I like women. In spite of what may be
written on the backs of some of these chairs.
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica and Phoebe are drinking coffee and Phoebe notices a cute
guy checking them out.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! That guy at the counter is totally checking you out!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? (Looks.) My God, he’s really cute.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Go for it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, I’m engaged!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m just saying, get his number just in case. But no Chandler is in
an accident and can’t perform sexually and he would want you to take a lover to
satisfy the needs that he can no longer fulfill.

lines.speaker: The Cute Guy
lines.text: (To Monica) Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Op, can I just tell you something? Very flattered but umm, I’m
engaged. (Points to her ring.)

lines.speaker: The Cute Guy
lines.text: Wow! Uh, this is kind of embarrassing. I was actually coming over to
talk to your friend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well you should be embarrassed. (Leaves.)

lines.speaker: The Cute Guy
lines.text: (To Phoebe) I thought you knew I was looking at you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I did, but that was really fun.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is sitting in the chair.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pretending to be an announcer) And the winner is…Joey Tribbiani! (He
then gets excited and goes over to the counter to practice his acceptance speech using a
bottle of maple syrup as the award.) Oh… Wow! I honestly never expected this. I uh, I
didn’t prepare a speech. But umm, I’d like to thank (Rachel enters quietly) my
parents, who’ve always been there for me. I’d also like to thank my friends,
Chandler, Monica, Phoebe, Rachel…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m fourth! (Joey is startled.) Look at you with your little maple
syrup award!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah may-maybe you don’t tell anyone about this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? No! It’s not a big deal! I do that too, with my shampoo
bottle.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What award are you practicing for?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Grammy, Best New Artist.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey listen! The Soapie’s called today and I also get to present
an award.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh that’s great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So you’ll definitely get onstage, even if you don’t win.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (confused) What you-you don’t think I’m gonna win?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well of course I do! But y’know, favorite returning character is a
tough category Joey. I mean you’re up against the guy who survived his own cremation.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. No-no I-I know I might not win, but it’s just…I’ve
never even been nominated before! I want it so much.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well Joey, you’ll probably get it. But you should probably
your-your gracious loser face. Y’know when like the cameras are on you and you wanna
look disappointed but also that your colleague deserved to win. Y’know? So it’s
sorta like… (Does it, you’ll have to see it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! (Likes it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You practice losing the Grammies too?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, at the Grammies I always win.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah.

scenes.location: Monica’s Restaurant Kitchen, she’s cooking as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! How’d your date go with Jake?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, great! We couldn’t keep our eyes off each other all night and
then every once and a while y’know, he’d kinda lean over and stroke my hair and
touch my neck. (Does that to Monica.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, stop it Phoebe, you’re getting me all tingly.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (laughs) All I could think of was y’know, "Is he gonna kiss
me? Is he gonna kiss me?"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And did he?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m a lady Monica, I don’t kiss and tell. But this hickey
speaks for itself. (She starts to open up her blouse.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay-okay, I got it. I got it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just like him so much that I just feel like I’ve had 10 drinks
today and I’ve only had six.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I haven’t had that feeling since I first started going out with
Chandler. Wow, I’m never gonna have that feeling again am I?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You sound like a guy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, a guy would be saying, "I’m never gonna get to sleep with
anyone else." Oh my God! I’m never gonna get to sleep with anyone else!
I’ve been so busy planning the wedding that I forgot about all the things that
I’d be giving up! I mean, I…I’m never gonna have a first kiss again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’ll have a last kiss.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Ross is helping Joey with his tie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can I ask you something? Have you ever had a guy have a crush on you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is that why you wanted to tie my tie?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There’s this kid in my class who said he’s in love with me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her room) Whoa what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross has a boyfriend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I do-I do not have a boyfriend. There’s a guy in one of my
classes who-who has a crush on me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! I don’t know. I mean, last year Elizabeth now-now this kid.
What-what-what-what is it?! Am I giving out some kind of…sexy professor vibe? (Rachel
and Joey both look at him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Not right now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It-it—The point is my natural charisma has made him fail his midterm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, see now I feel bad for the kid! I had a crush on a teacher once and
it was so hard! Y’know you—I couldn’t concentrate and I blushed every time
he looked at me. I mean come on, you remember what’s it’s like to be 19 and in
love.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. I guess I can cut him some slack.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How’d you get over that teacher?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I didn’t. I got under him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Ross) Problem solved.
[Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe is saying good-bye to her boyfriend Jake at the door to
Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Jake
lines.text: Bye Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay bye. (They kiss.)

lines.speaker: Jake
lines.text: All right. Bye. (Backs out the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bye! (Phoebe goes over and joins Monica on the couch.) We said good-bye
at the door so as not to flaunt our new love.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, it’s okay. You don’t have to tip toe around me.
I-I’ve been thinking about it and umm, y’know what? I’m okay about not
having that new relationship feeling…

lines.speaker: Jake
lines.text: (yelling through the window to Phoebe) I miss you already!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (yelling back) I miss you too!!!! (He walks away.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See? That’s what I mean. I mean that, that’s great! But
I wouldn’t trade in what I have for that. I mean I’m gonna be with Chandler for
the rest of my life, and that’s what makes me happy. (Chandler approaches.) Hey
sweetie, come here! Come sit down. Hey Phoebe and I were just talking about how our
relationship is deep and meaningful. It really is don’t you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh totally! (Holds up his finger.) Pull my finger.
[Scene: The 2001 Soapie Awards, Joey’s category is up next and the presenter walks
to the podium.]

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Presenting the award for Favorite Returning Male Character is
McKensize…
[Cut to Joey and Rachel’s table.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) This is it! This is my category.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know! My God! Do you have your speech?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I got my speech!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you got your gracious loser face?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. (Does it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now Joey remember, if you win you have to hug me! You hug me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Can I squeeze your ass?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: On TV?! Yeah!
[Cut to the presenter.]

lines.speaker: The Presenter
lines.text: …in the category of Favorite Returning Male Character the
nominees are: John Wheeler from General Hospital (Applause), Gavin Grant from The
Young and the Restless (Applause), Dunkin Harrington from Passions (Applause),
and Joey Tribbiani from Days of Our Lives (Applause). And the Soapie goes
to…(She opens the envelope)…Gavin Grant from The Young and the Restless!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What the?! (Joey pounds the table and starts yelling at Rachel, and which
is drowned out by applause. Rachel is desperately trying to tell Joey that he’s on TV
right now. He finally notices and he does his gracious loser face.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The 2001 Soapie Awards, the announcer is introducing the next presenter.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Presenting the award for Favorite Supporting Actress is Joey Tribbiani
from Days of Our Lives. (Applause as Joey angrily walks to the podium and eyes the
trophy.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (angrily and monotone) Any one of the brilliant actresses nominated for
this award tonight deserves to take it home. Unfortunately only one can. (Shakes his head
in disgust.) The nominees for Best Supporting Actress are from Passions Erin Goff.
(There is applause, which Joey disgustedly waits to dye out.) From One Life to Live
Mary Loren Bishop (They start to applaud again, but Joey interrupts in with the rest of
the nominees), from All My Children Sarah Mchann, and from Days of Our Lives
Jessica Ashley. And the winner is…(Opens the envelope)…Jessica Ashley from Days
of Our Lives. (Applause) Uh, unfortunately Jessica couldn’t be with us tonight so
I’ll be accepting this award on her behalf. (Realizes something) And I’m sure
that Jessica would like to thank my parents who always believed in me. She’d also
like to thank my friends, Chandler, Monica, Ross, Phoebe, and Rachel who’s
sittin’ right there! (Points at Rachel.) (The music starts and his microphone is
turned off, this angers Joey again and he disgustedly exits.)

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Joey and Rachel are entering.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! Why did we have to rush out of there so fast?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach we had to get out of there because, look what I won! (He whips out
the award for Best Supporting Actress that he accepted for Jessica.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God you stole her award!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no! No, I’m accepting it on her behalf. (He puts it up above the
TV to display it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey I don’t think you know what behalf means.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure I do! It’s a verb! As in, "I behalfin’ it!"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, you have got to take this back!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But why?! I should’ve won one and I really want it and she
didn’t even care enough to come to the thing! It could also be a Grammy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at the award) No! Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on Rach! No one saw me take it! There was a whole table full of

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you really want an award you didn’t win?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! I want an award I did win! But nobody’s giving me any of those!
Plus—Hey Rach, if-if I put it up there (Points to the TV) right? When people come
over they’ll see it and they’ll think I won it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey is says Best Supporting Actress!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can scratch that right off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey no, this is wrong! You have to take it back, okay? You don’t
want to win an award this way. You’re very talented. And someday you’re gonna
win one of these for real and that one is gonna mean something.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right? (He sets the award down.) Thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’ll take it back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.
(He goes into his room and closes the door. Rachel goes to pick it up and…)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (opening his door) If I can’t have it you can’t have it! (Rachel
walks away angrily.)
[Scene: Ross’s Classroom, he is writing on the board and Alan is coming in to see
him.]

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: Professor Geller?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (turning towards him) Yes Mr. Lewis, how can I help you?

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: I know I didn’t do well on my midterms and stuff but, I was kinda
hoping you could change my grade.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And why exactly would I do that? (Goes back to writing on the board.)

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: Because I’m in love with you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (turning around and dragging the chalk down the board) What?!

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: Yeah, I’m all…in love with you and stuff. So could you change
my grade?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: Well why not you changed Ned’s grade!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well that’s different! Okay? Because he, he was actually in love with
me!

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: No he’s not! He’s totally yanking your chain! He’s done
this with three other teachers!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: He’s got a girlfriend!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t believe someone would do that for a grade.

lines.speaker: Lewis
lines.text: I know! It’s awful. I love you.
(Ross glares at him.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is sitting on the couch as Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have you seen Chandler?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ‘Cause I just keeping thinking about all these things that I’m
not gonna have and it’s freaking me out. I don’t know what to do about it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, don’t sweat it. (Looking around her.) Chandler is nowhere
around so go ahead get it out of your system. That guy’s cute. (Points to a guy
sitting behind Monica.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe! Come on I’m serious! I just got to talk to him about all
this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No that is the last thing you want to do!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because you’re marrying him!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You gotta help me out here Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I’ve never been engaged and I’ve never really been
married, but I can only tell you what my mother told me. Whenever you have doubts or fears
or anxieties about a relationship, do not communicate them to your husband.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So I’m not supposed to share my doubts and fears with the guy
I’m gonna spend the rest of my life with?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is correct! Yes, you’re supposed to take all of that stuff and
put it in a little box in your mind and then lock it up tight.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Your mother told you this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The woman that got married a bunch of times and killed herself when you
were 13?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! You’re right! Go! (Monica starts to leave.) Go tell
Chandler! Hurry before it’s too late! Wait no! (Monica stops.) Does this also mean
putting out doesn’t get you love? (Monica is shocked.)

scenes.location: Silvercup Studios, Joey and Rachel are there to give Jessica her award.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I cannot believe I’m gonna meet Jessica Ashley!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay wait-wait p-please be cool! Okay? I work with this woman.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I’m totally cool! (She coolly knocks on the door)

lines.speaker: Jessica Ashley
lines.text: Come in.
(The enter.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Jessica.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (coolly) Hey Jess.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, this is my friend Rachel.

lines.speaker: Jessica Ashley
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ‘Sup? (Joey glares at her.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh listen, here’s your Soapie. I accepted it for ya. (Hands it to
her.)

lines.speaker: Jessica Ashley
lines.text: (shocked) Oh my God! I won! Do you have any idea what this
means?! (She rolls her eyes and throws it onto the couch.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, that-that-that’s it? You’re gonna, you’re gonna put
it on your self or anything?

lines.speaker: Jessica Ashley
lines.text: No, I try to save that for real awards. Now, if you’ll
excuse me. (She exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) Take it back?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Absolutely.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y-y-yeah! (As they start to leave, Rachel pauses and steals a vase with
flowers in it.) Yeah you do. (They exit.)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is talking to Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, as we get closer to the wedding, is there anything that you would
like to talk about or share?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Well, I think the centerpieces are too big

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re wrong! The centerpieces are fine! Do you ever get scared at
all?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kinda. They’re really big.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Doesn’t it ever just freak you out that-that you’re never
gonna be with anybody new again?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just, I love you so much. Just…It’s just sometimes it bothers
me that I’m never gonna have that feeling. Y’know when you meet someone for the
first time and it’s new and exciting? Y’know that rush?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. No, see when I first meet somebody it’s uh it’s mostly
panic, anxiety, and a great deal of sweating.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, but all right you’re a guy, does it not freak you that
you’re never gonna sleep with anybody else?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sleeping with somebody new, anxiety, panic, and I’m afraid even
more sweating.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Even with me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was dangerously dehydrated during the first six months of our
relationship. (Monica laughs.) Look, for me the rush is knowing that we are gonna be
together for the rest of our lives.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well yeah! But now that I know that you’re having these thoughts,
I’m back to panic, anxiety, and uh I’m definitely gonna need some kind of sports
drink.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come here! Come here! (They hug.) Sweetie you don’t have to worry.
No, besides y’know what? I’m gonna have a lot of new things with you. The first
time we buy a house. Our first kid. Our first grandkid…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (hoarsely) Water! Water! Water!
[Scene: Ross’s classroom, he has just finished his lecture and the students are
filing out.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh Mr. Morse, can I speak to you for a moment?

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: (walking up) That was a great lecture today. Did you get a little hair
cut?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-hmm, yeah-yeah do you like it? Do-do you looove it? I just want you to
know that I’m changing your grade back.

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: What?! Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ‘Cause I know what you’re trying to pull here. Okay? It’s
not gonna work.

lines.speaker: Morse
lines.text: I’m not trying to pull anything. Look I love you dude.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? I-I’m not even gonna talk about this. Okay? This
little thing is over. I know you have a girlfriend! Okay—(Ned looks
shocked)—Yeah! And I know about the other professors! How do you think that makes me
feel Ned?! You used me! You don’t love me and you never did! (Ross turns around to
make a grand exit but runs into two colleagues.) Ah Professor Winston, Professor
Fredrickson, I’ll be right with you. (To Ned) Don’t make this worse and
I’ll give you a C. (To the professors) Shall we? (They leave.)
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Phoebe is entering.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ll be out in a second.
(Phoebe notices the Soapie on the counter.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. (Picks it up.) It’s just so unexpected! I…I uh…Boy
I’ll tell you it’s just such an honor to be nominated for a Nobel Prize
and y’know to win one for a massage. Especially after having just won a Tony
award for best actress in…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her room) Honey, we have to go. Our reservations are at

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: …in Reservations at 8:00 by Neil Simon. (To an imaginary Neil
Simon) Thank-thank you Neil. Thank you for the words. (Blows him a kiss.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay honey, you can finish this later we’re gonna be late. We gotta
go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Please, don’t play the music. Just uh one more. LIVE FROM NEW
YORK! IT’S SATURDAY NIGHT!!

title: The One with Ross and Monica's Cousin

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica and Phoebe are on the couch as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Joey) Oh hey! How was your audition?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sorry, do I know you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing, I’m just practicing blowing you off because I’m gonna
be a big movie star!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! You got it?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, no not yet. But the audition went really good.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What was it for?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it’s this big budget period movie about these three Italian
brothers who come to America around the turn of the century. It’s really classy! Oh,
and the director is supposed to be the next, next Martin Scorcese.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The next, next?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, there’s this guy from Chicago who’s supposed to be the
next Martin Scorcese, all right? But then this guy’s right after him. (Joey’s
cell phone rings and he answers it.) Hello!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Joey! It’s Estelle! I just talked to the casting people;
they loved you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Monica and Phoebe) They loved me!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Yeah, they wanna see you again tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: There’s just one thing. Do you have a problem with full
frontal nudity?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you kidding me? I never rent a movie without it! (Listens) Oh.
(Listens) Uh, okay uh let me call you back. (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They want me to be totally naked in the movie!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! My grandmother’s gonna see this!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Grandma’s gonna have to get in line.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, (although its really just Monica’s now with Matthew
Perry in rehab) Monica is folding her laundry with Ross reading the paper and Phoebe
standing in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey the wedding is so close! Are you getting nervous?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. But a part of me also can’t wait ‘til it’s over.
Chandler and I have this pact not to have sex again until the wedding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A no sex pact huh? I actually have one of those going on with every woman
in America.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Phoebe, will you give me a hand?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I gotta make up the guest bedroom. (To Ross) Hey, Cousin Cassie is
coming to stay with us a few days.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Cassie?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, I haven’t seen her for like forever. I wonder if she still
carries that Barbie everywhere she goes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, she’s 25 years old.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So what! I still have—No you’re probably right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, can I talk to you over here for a second?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Subtle guys!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know you’re planning my surprise bridal shower.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Well okay—Well don’t ruin it! Just play along at
least!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Sorry. (She goes into the guest bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Oh my God! We have to throw her a shower?!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Joey is entering.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! What did you decide to do about the movie?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know! It’s not like it’s porn! This is a serious,
legitimate movie. Y’know? And the nudity is really important to the story.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s what you say about porn.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re right. Maybe I shouldn’t even go on the call back.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No you should! A lot of major actors do nude scenes! I mean the
chance to star in a movie? Come on!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well that’s true. And I am only naked in one scene. Plus it sounds
really great. My character’s catholic and he falls in love with this Jewish girl. Who
run away together and they get caught in this big rainstorm. So we go into this barn and
undress each other and hold each other. It’s really sweet and-and tender.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Plus, everyone’s gonna see your thing. (Giggles.)

scenes.location: Phoebe's apartment, Phoebe and Rachel are trying to plan Monica’s shower.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well when can we have this shower?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She has got so much going on we-we have only two options. We have
Friday…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well that’s only two days away. What is the other option?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yesterday!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well if we make it yesterday, woo-hoo! We’re done!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God Phoebe, this is impossible! We can’t do this by Friday!
We have to find a place. We have to invite people! We have to get food! There’s just
too much to do! It’s impossible! We can’t do it! We cannot do it! We cannot do
it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel, calm down!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (calmly) Okay. I’m sorry. You’re right, you’re right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (grabs and shakes Rachel) Just calm down woman!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, I already, I already did.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh okay. All right, then I need to calm down a little.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay. (They sit down.) I think we can do this if we just get
organized. All right? We have two days to plan this party. We just need to make fast
decisions! Okay? All right, where are we gonna have it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh, here. What time?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: 4 o’clock. Food?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Finger sandwiches and tea.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh great! Very Monica.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And chili!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah you went one too far. Uh, flowers or balloons?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Both!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’re paying for this y’know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Neither.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Umm, what should we do for the theme?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Lusts of the flesh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause) What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know. (Timidly) A cowboy theme?
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is on the couch writing when Chandler enters to
make his brief cameo.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know I’m-I’m really glad we decided not to sleep
together before the wedding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh boy me too!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know I was thinking if we had a…a big fight and uh we
broke up for a few hours…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Technically we could have sex again. What do you think, bossy and
domineering?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The wedding is off, sloppy and immature!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s me! Come on!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (They both jump up to head for there room, but Monica stops.) But
wait, we can’t. My Cousin Cassie is in the guest room, we’re supposed to have
lunch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well get rid of her, obsessive and shrill.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Shrill?! The wedding is back on!
(Cassie enters from the guest room, with her hair up. The extremely beautiful and sexy
Denise Richards is playing Cassie. Woo hoo! For those of you who don’t know who she
is, rent Wild Things and she was also the last Bond girl in The World Is
Not Enough.)

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: I thought I heard voices. You must be Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (transfixed) Hi! Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: Nice to meet you too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, are you ready to go?

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: Yeah.
(She lets her hair down and whips her hair around in Baywatch-esque slow motion
with a Barry White song in the background. Chandler needless to say can’t help but
stare along with the rest of the male and lesbian population of North America.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (catching him) Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll be right with you.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is there as Chandler and Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Ross) Cassie needs to stay at your place.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What—why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because Purvry Perverson over here can’t stop staring at her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! Chandler she’s our cousin!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was not staring at her. Okay? I was just listening intently.
It’s called being a good conversationalist. Watch. (Stares at Monica’s eyes.)
Say something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You were staring about eight inches south of there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, she can stay at my place. By the way, what-what does Cassie even
look like now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She looks exactly like Aunt Marilyn.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Umm, so this Aunt Marilyn is-is-is-is she coming to the wedding?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wafer thin ice!

scenes.location: A Casting Director’s Office, Joey is entering for his callback.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I’m back!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Hi-hi Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh so, will-will I be reading the same scene again?

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Actually, I tried to call to you. You didn’t need to
come down here today.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh great! Y’know I would’ve been perfect for this part, but
whatever! Y’know, thanks for making a bad decision and ruining your movie! Good day!
(Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Wait Joey! You didn’t need to come down because the
director saw your tape from yesterday and loved it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And scene! Huh? Wasn’t that fun? We did a little improv there. Yeah!
Okay! So you-you-you-you were saying?

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Well, the director thinks you’re really right for the
part and wants to meet you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! Sure! That’s great!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Oh and your agent said you were okay with the nudity.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah sure, just long as it’s handled tastefully and that barn
is not too cold.

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Terrific! Well uh, there’s one more thing. Uhh, uh
it’s really important to the director that everything in this movie is authentic.
Yeah and so in your love scene with Sarah she talks about how she’s never seen a
naked man who wasn’t Jewish. So… (Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So…What?

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: So uh well the director is insisting that whoever play
that part be authentically, anatomically not Jewish. Do you know what I’m saying?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. What?

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: An Italian Catholic immigrant at this time would not

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Barmifsaed?
(The casting director shakes her head.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Joey is telling Monica what the casting director was
trying to get too.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So to get this part you can’t be?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But you are?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But you told them you weren’t?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! Wow! And it’s definitely all gone? There’s nothing there
to work with? (Joey glares at her.) What were you thinking?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know! I really want this part! And they tell you no matter
what you get asked at an audition you say yes. Like if-if they want you to ride a horse,
you tell ‘em you can! And just figure out how to do it later.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey! This is not like learning to ride a horse! This is like learning
to…grow a turtleneck!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I kn-I know! I know! Okay? And apparently tomorrow when I go in to meet
the director I have to take off my clothes so that they can see what my body looks like.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, what are you gonna do?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I just have to call my agent and tell her I can’t do the part. (Gets
up for the phone.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Unless!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Unless what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, this may sound crazy, but there maybe something we could fashion.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well I’m not sure yet, but umm of the top of my head I’m
thinking double sided tape and some sort of luncheon meat.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Phoebe is entering and Rachel is still planning.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! I’ve got a great idea for party favors for the shower. Okay,
we get some uh mahogany boxes and carve everyone’s names in them and inside is
everyone’s individual birth stone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Okay. All right, you take care of that. And meanwhile, the party
is tomorrow and we still don’t have a guest list.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Okay! Well okay, who do we know that’s coming? Me. Are you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! What’s up Mon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well uh, I’m trying to make something for Joey. Do you mind if I
raid your fridge?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Have at it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (Opens the fridge.) All right, turkey. Eh, that won’t work.
Cheese? (Picks it up) That won’t work. Olive loaf? (Picks it up) I hope that
won’t work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you makin’ him a sandwich?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No it’s umm, more like a wrap. Okay so uh, I’m gonna go guys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess you can get back to deciding on what to get me for a present!
(Runs out.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe, after Monica’s gone) We have to get her a present?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay but look! Look at what I got! It’s her address book! (Holds it
up.) We have a guest list!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God you’re amazing! Did you just pull that out of her purse?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh, and a little seed money for the party. (Holds up $40.)

scenes.location: Ross's apartment, there is a knock on the door and Ross opens it to Cassie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked at her beauty) Cassie?!

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: Hey Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: (hugs him) It’s been so long! Last time I saw you, you were setting
up your tent in line to see Return of the Jedi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Oh, that’s right. So-so you did see me that day because it seemed
like you didn’t.

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: Ah yeah, sorry about that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s okay. Come, come on in.

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: Thanks for letting me stay here! I mean Monica’s place was nice,
but her fiancee sure stares a lot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.
(She sets down her bag and we travel back to slow motion world. She once again whips
her hair around in slow motion with the love doctor Barry White singing in the background.
And I’d also like to take this opportunity to mention that she can also be seen in Starship
Troopers and that she was born in Downers Grove, Illinois which just happens to be a
few miles from where I live. Anyway Cousin Ross is now staring.)

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: Oh my God! You do a great Chandler!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh. Yeah I-I have a knack for impressions.

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: Well, maybe after we get reacquainted uh, you can do me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah—No!!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Cassie is eating dinner and Ross is pacing behind her because
of what she’s eating.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Cassie, how you-how you doin’ on that…hot dog.

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: I’m all done.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (quietly) Thank God.

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: I guess the last time we really hung out was when our parents rented
that beach house together.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh right. Right. Ooh, remember the time I uh, I pinned you down and
tickled you ‘til you cried? (She laughs) We’re probably too old to do that now.

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: I’ll always remember that summer, because it’s when I got all
of these freckles. (She pulls her blouse open to show him her shoulder and bra strap.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking then moving away quickly) Uh-huh! Uh-huh! And-and-and I’ll
always remember that summer because that’s when I realized that we are related.

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: It took you that long to figure it out, huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I’m, I’m a little slow. (To himself) Just as our children
would be.
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment, it’s Monica’s bridal shower and Phoebe is passing
out some finger food.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How are you? (The woman nods) Good. (She goes over to another couple of
women.) Hi, thanks for coming.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh thank you.
(The other woman declines.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you. (To the other woman) No? (She nods.) All right. (She goes to
another pairing.) Oh, it’s so nice to see you.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: The Other Woman
lines.text: No thanks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Goes over to Rachel.) Hey Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who the hell are all these people?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I don’t know. I called all the people in Monica’s phone
book and these are the only ones who could show up on 24 hours notice.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm, y’know there’s another word for people like that. Losers!
(A woman approaches.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to her) Hi! I’m Rachel. This is Phoebe. I’m the maid of
honor. How do you know Monica?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I was her accountant four years ago.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohhhh!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m very interested to find out who’s been doing her taxes
these last four years.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s great!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: So, what time is Monica supposed to get here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: (to each other) I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to the woman) Excuse us for a minute. (They go into the kitchen.) You
didn’t tell her to come?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You were supposed to tell her!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No I wasn’t! You were supposed to tell her to come and I was
supposed to bring the cake!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine, I’ll go call her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! And please tell her to bring a cake!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is standing at the counter as Monica enters carrying a
tray.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, we have a lot of options here, a number of prototypes for you to
try on.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! This looks great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! Okay, this one is a mushroom cap. (Points to it.) Umm, this one is
made of bologna. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And-and-and-and-and the toothpicks?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, just until the glue dries.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to a whole group) Now, these are-are more realistic, but perishable.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay? (To a different group) Over here we have pink suede, which is
nice. But umm, if it gets wet then you know it’s gonna shrink.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well maybe we just take that one away. (Picks it up and throws it away.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I also, did a little something in fur. But umm, that’s really just
for me. (Rubs it against her cheek.) Okay. So, why don’t you go into your room and
try these on and we’ll see—get a better idea of what’s gonna work.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks, you are such a good friend. And this is so weird.
(He goes into his room to try them on and closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Toothpick?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you trying on now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The fruit roll up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Delicious.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait a minute! Wait a minute! We have a winner!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! Which one?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The Silly Putty! It’s not so silly anymore!
(They hug.)
[Scene: Ross's apartment, Cassie and Ross are watching a movie and Cassie is pouring
Ross some more wine as Ross has his hands full with the glass and holding the bowl of
popcorn in his lap.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in his head) She’s your cousin. She’s your cousin! If
she knew what was going on in your head she’d think you were sick! (She grabs
some popcorn.) Or would she? Let’s back up a second. She was the one who
suggested opening a bottle of wine. She was the one who turned down the lights. She
was the one that wanted to rent Logan’s Run, the sexiest movie ever. (She
grabs the blanket from behind him and looks at him.) Oh, I know that look. Forget it. I
want it. She wants it. I’m going in.
(They exchange looks, smile, and shrug their shoulders before Ross suddenly lunges
forward in an attempt to kiss her, but she expertly backs away.)

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: Hey! What the hell are you doing?! (They sit back up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in his head) Say something clever! (Pause.) Okay, doesn’t
have to be clever, it just has to be words. Say some words. (Pause) Any words will
do. (Pause) Oh my God! This is the longest that anyone has not talked ever! (Pause)
There is nothing you can say to make this worse!! So just say something!! (Pause.) (To
her) I-I, I uh haven’t had sex in a very long time. (She leaves.) (In his
head) Yeah, you really shouldn’t have said anything.

scenes.location: outside Phoebe's apartment, Monica is knocking on the door.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe! Rachel! It’s Monica! I wonder what you could possibly need
me for on such short notice! (She bursts into the apartment to find only Phoebe and Rachel
sitting on the couch.) Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Monica, we are so sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: For what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well first, for forgetting to throw you a bridal shower.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And then for forgetting to invite you to it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You al-you already had it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Well, we called everyone in your phone book and bunch of people
came, but it took us so long to get you here that they-they had to leave.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, we wanted to throw you a big surprise and a great shower, and now
you don’t have either.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We ruined everything.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well no wait a minute that’s not true! No, what did, that was
really sweet. And it kinda works out for the best.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What do you, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well now, I get to spend my shower with the only people I really love! I
mean, I get all those presents (Motions to the pile in the corner) without having to talk
to people I don’t even like!
(Suddenly, everyone stands up and comes out of hiding. All of them are glaring at
Monica.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Surprise…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sur-surprise.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …Monica.
[Scene: The casting director’s office, Joey is there to show off to the director,
so to speak.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And what’s cool is, the character is from Naples, right?

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: My whole family’s from Naples!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Oh that’s great! Okay, well I’ve heard everything I need
to hear. I just need to uh, Leslie…

lines.speaker: The Casting Director
lines.text: Joey, this is awkward part.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Hey right! Not a problem. (He starts taking off his clothes.) I
totally understand. You need to y’know make sure I don’t have any horrible scars
or tattoos. Don’t you worry; I have nothing to hide. (He drops his pants and stands
back up and looks down.) So there you go, that’s me. (We cut to a camera angle
looking at the casting director and movie director through Joey’s legs.) One hundred
percent natural! (Suddenly, there’s a thud as something falls off.) (Everyone is
shocked.) I tell ya, that has never happened before.
Ending Credits
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment, Phoebe is getting out linens for Cassie who is in the
bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Cassie, are you finding everything okay in there?

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: Yeah! Thank you so much for letting me stay here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! No problem! I… (Cassie emerges from the bathroom and we once
again visit slow motion Barry White background music land with the sexy hair-flipping
thing going on, only this time Phoebe is entranced. For more information on Denise
Richards you can visit your local library or look her up on the Internet at her official
website at www.deniserichards.com.)

lines.speaker: Cassie
lines.text: (noticing her) What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (in her head) Say something! Say anything! Ask her out! She’s
not your cousin!

title: The One with Rachel's Big Kiss

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Joey, Monica, and Rachel are sitting on the couch and Ross is
sitting on the chair, and they’re all talking.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Out of all of us, who do you think is gonna get married next?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Probably Monica and Chandler.
(A woman walks up to Gunther in the background.)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (to Gunther) Hi. Could I have a pack of Newport Lights,
please?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Oh umm, uh we don’t sell cigarettes, but they have them at the
newsstand across the street. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That’d be great, thanks. (Gunther goes and gets them.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to the gang) Oh my God, Melissa Warburton. I don’t think I have
the energy for this.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: (Gasps when she notices Rachel) Oh my God! Ray-ray Green?! (Screams)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (screaming) Melissa!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: You have been M.I.A for the past seven sorority newsletters,
what’s up with you?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh—(Turns and looks at the gang who’s staring)—Why
don’t I tell you over here? (She walks Melissa away from the gang.)

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: So last I heard you were gonna get married. (Grabs Rachel’s hand
and notices that she doesn’t have a ring on it.) (Sadly) Oh poor Ray-ray.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no-no, no! It’s good! It’s all good! I-I actually work at Ralph
Lauren!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Shut up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I will not! I’m the divisional head of men’s sportswear!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Oh shut up more! Now, are you friends with Ralph?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh please…

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: (excitedly) Are you?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Listen, we-we have to have dinner. What-what are you doing tomorrow
night?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh tomorrow, oh I don’t know. Um…

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: You do now. You’re having dinner with me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shut up.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: I-I’ve got to go. This has been so great Ray-ray! (Gunther returns
with her cigarettes.) Oh, there you are. (Takes them from Gunther.) (To Rachel) Umm, so
listen, just call me. Here’s my card. (Hands the card over.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, wow thanks! (Reading the card) Oh you’re in real estate!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Oh no, that’s-that’s an old card. Umm, I wanted to get out of
that and-and do something where I can really help people and-and make a difference.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! What do you do now?

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: (quietly) I’m a party planner. I’ll see you tomorrow.
(Exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! (Joins the rest of the gang.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey guys! Look who’s back! It’s Ray-ray!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shut up that was my friend Melissa from college.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She seems really, really fun!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She’s actually very sweet and we used to be very close.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute, she isn’t… She’s not the one who you…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (excitedly) Who you what? Who you what?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Monica) Yes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (excitedly) Wow? Wow what?! Wow what?! Who you—what?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s not a big deal!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Joey) They were lovers.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No we weren’t! It was nothing! It was one night, senior year we
went to a party, had a lot of sangria and y’know, ended up…kissing for a
bit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So that’s two of my wives.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is working on the seating chart while Chandler
looks on and Rachel reads.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (telling Chandler the seating arrangement) Okay so this is where the
band is. (Points.) And this is where the bar is. (Points) And all these pins have
people’s names on them. (She has pins to show the seating at each of the tables.) And
Rach, here you are. (Points to Rachel’s place.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow. Why don’t we just take me (Grabs her pin) and put me with a
Manhattan in my hand, talking to the cute bartender. (Puts her pin at the bar and laughs.
Monica just glares at her.) These pins aren’t for playing are they?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Okay, the red ones are my guests and the blue ones are
yours.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is so sad. I mean, I only have like ten pins.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, relax it’s not a contest. (To Rachel) Certainly not a
close one.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hello!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Rach. (Stares at her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Stop picturing it!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I think that’s it. The seating chart is done. This is our
wedding. They all look like they’re having fun don’t they?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, so where are my parents gonna be?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! (Gets up) Let’s see, well…if this is the wedding hall then
umm (Walks away) you’re parents will be at home in Queens.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What they’re not invited?! Oh no, that’s terrible! They’re
gonna be crushed!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why would they think they’re invited?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking around) You got me. I don’t…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I’m sorry. I thought parents were coming! Y’know? Your
parents are comin’! Chandler’s parents are comin’! Ross’s parents are
comin’!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross’s parents are my parents!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well-well—see? Parents are comin’!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know I think we should invite them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh please, you just want more blue pins.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well this is just sad!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, all right. Maybe I can fit them in if I just do some
rearranging. But uh, Rachel may actually have to sit at the bar!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is not a problem.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (leaning down to her) Maybe you’ll order a little sangria?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, get out of here! (Jumps back and walks away.)

scenes.location: Ralph Lauren, Rachel is showing Chandler the selection of tuxedos.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (motioning to a rack) So now, these are all the tuxedos that we make and
if there’s anything that you like, we can make you a deal. Anything at all. (Grabs a
few) But these are the three that Monica pre-approved.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, thanks a lot for hookin’ me up Rach. I want you to know
that I want you to attend our wedding as my guest.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m Monica’s maid of honor. Okay? Don’t try to blue pin
me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sees another rack) Well, what’s the deal with these? These-these
look nice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh they are nice. We-we custom-make tuxedos for celebrities and then
when they’re done with them they just send ‘em back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean like for award shows?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Some of them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean these tuxes have been down the red carpet with people
yelling, "You are you wearing?! You look fabulous!"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, might I suggest watching a little more ESPN and a little
less E!?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, who wore those? (Points to the tuxedos.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, well let’s see uh, this one is Tom Brokaw.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading a tag) This one is uh Paul O’Neil.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who’s that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He plays for the Yankees. Seriously, ESPN! Just once and a while,
have it on in the background. (Chandler nods and Rachel grabs another tux) Ooh, this one
was Pierce Brosnan!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pierce Brosnan?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: 007?! This is James Bond’s tux?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I have to get married in James Bond’s tux!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s a pretty cool tux.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it’s not just that, I would be England’s most powerful
weapon. Jet setting heartbreaker on her majesty’s secret service. A man who fears no
one; with a license to kill. (Worried.) Would Monica let me wear this?
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey and Phoebe are moving chess pieces around on the board
and hitting the timer at random.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We should really learn how to play the real way. (Moves another piece.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I like our way. Oh! (Grabs a piece and jumps a bunch of Joey’s like
in Checkers.) Chess!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice move.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So Joey I just hooked Ross and Chandler up with some tuxedos for the
wedding, do you need one?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I’m performing the ceremony. I’m not wearing a tux.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what are you going to wear?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Multi-colored robes! Ooh, and maybe a hat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh. Does Monica know about this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can I please be there when you tell her? (Joey nods yes.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey oh, Rach wait! Do you want to go to a movie tonight?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, y’know what? I can’t. I have to have dinner with that
Melissa girl.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (excitedly) Can I come?! I won’t even talk! You’ll just hear the
noise from my video camera.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What is this? What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh good! Can I tell her?! Can I tell her?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, do you want to hear what actually happened or Joey’s lewd
version?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey’s!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, come on! I had this friend from college and I made the stupid
mistake of telling Joey that one time…she and I y’know…kissed a little bit.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (laughs) Yeah, I’m sure that happened.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It-it did!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey. (Laughs then seriously) It happened!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it was senior year in college. It was after the Sigma Chi luau and
Melissa and I got very drunk! And we ended up kissing! For several minutes!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Joey) Which means she had a couple spritzers and a quick peck on the
cheek.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why are you taking this away from me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, why is it so hard for you to believe?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! I just—I didn’t know that you are a lesbian. (Joey
smiles and nods lewdly.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not saying that I’m a lesbian! I’m just saying that
this happened!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, it just seems pretty wild and you’re so—y’know
so…vanilla.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) Vanilla?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not vanilla! I’ve done lots of crazy things! I mean I
got-I got drunk and married in Vegas!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: To Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, y’know what? If you don’t want to believe me about
this, why don’t you just come with me to dinner tonight and she will tell you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay! All right! Yeah! ‘Cause I just can’t picture it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-ho, you should get inside my head.
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler is on the couch reading as Ross enters carrying a
garment bag.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Guess what I got for your wedding! (Holding up his garment bag.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A freakish thin date with a hanger for her head?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. Rachel hooked me up with a tux! But not just any tux, Batman’s
tux!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right! Made expressly for Val Kilmer and worn by him in the
hit film…that Batman film he was in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can’t wear that! I’m wearing the famous tux! James
Bond’s tux!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So—If you wear that you’ll make mine less special.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you need something to make this day special? Hello! You-you-you have
the most special thing of all! You are marrying the woman you love.
(Chandler mimics him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Please, don’t take away my cool thing. Please?! Pretty please?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pretty please? Not very uh, 007.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, it’s my wedding day okay? If you were getting married I
would never do anything to upset you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: When I got married you slept with my sister.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was pretty 007.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is still working on the seating chart as Joey
enters.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. Oh good-good you’re here! All right, I figured it out.
I’m gonna take two tables of eight, I’m gonna add your parents, and I’m
gonna turn them into three tables of six. Okay? And I called the caterer; I added two
extra meals, we are good to go!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, they’re not coming.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking at him) What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Somehow they got the idea that you only invited them because of me.
They…feel a little unwanted.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that’s too bad. It’s true, but too bad.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look Mon, if you could just call my mom…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! Look just-just tell—let her know that you really want them
to be there. Let’s not forget, this is a woman that has sent you many lasagnas over
the years.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No she hasn’t.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is it her fault that some of them didn’t make it to you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, what am I going to say?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know. Just uh, just tell ‘em it was a mix-up with the
invitations, or—No-no-no! Blame it on the post office. They hate the post
office. And the Irish! But I don’t think you can blame it on them so… (He dials
the phone and hands it to Monica.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? (Listens) Yeah, hi! Mrs. Tribbiani? (Listens) Hi, this
is Monica Geller. (Listens) Yeah I’m just calling to say that Chandler and I uh,
really hope you can make it to the wedding. Yeah, apparently a bunch of invitations that
we sent weren’t delivered. Umm, I guess there was some screw up at the damn post
office! (Joey nods his approval.) (Listens) T-Tell me about it! (Listens) Yeah, yeah, the
US Post Office? No, more like US lost office! (Listens) What are they Irish?! (Joey gives
her a thumbs up.)

scenes.location: A restaurant, Melissa, Rachel, and Phoebe are talking.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: …anyway, his name is Allan and we’ve been going out for three
years. He was my first client when I became a party planner. He was planning a party for
his girlfriend at the time. Oh well. (Rachel and Phoebe politely laugh) And he was Theta
Beta Pi at Syracuse.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Oh, that’s great!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Hmm Phoebe, were you ever in a sorority?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course! Yeah, I was uh, umm Thigh Mega Tampon.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: What one?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Y’know, we were really huge too, but then they had to shut us
down when Regina Philange died of alcohol poisoning.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Oh, isn’t a shame when one girl ruins it for the whole bunch?
(Phoebe agrees by grunting.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (changing the subject) Anyway, speaking of drinking too much. I was uh,
tellin’ Phoebe about that one crazy night after the Sigma Chi luau where you and I
uh, we made out.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: (shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Remember?! We—come on both had the sarongs on, and we had the-the
coconut bikini tops…

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …we went back the house and we got really silly and we…we made
out.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Oh wow, Ray-ray I have no idea what you’re talking about.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is on the couch as Chandler disgustedly enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross is Batman!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, he did manage to keep his identity secret for a long time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Rachel got Ross the tuxedo that Val Kilmer wore in Batman. Okay Batman
is so much cooler than James Bond!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about?! 007 has all those gadgets!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Batman has a utility belt!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: 007 has a fancy car!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Batman has the Batmobile!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: 007 gets all the ladies.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Batman has Robin! (Pause) We get ESPN right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How about you go put on your 007 tuxedo and I’ll make you a nice
martini.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually, I don’t like martinis.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How about a Youhoo with a funny straw?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, yum! (Runs into the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, I know the invitation says 6:00, but does that mean that you want
people to get there at six, or the show is gonna start right at six?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The show?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right. Right. The wedding, gotcha. But I mean, it’s gonna start a
little late right? I mean, weddings start late. Right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Have you ever been to one of my weddings?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah. Yeah. Well look, the thing is it’s the same day as my
niece’s christening and I really want my parents to be there in time to see me.
‘Cause my part’s just in the beginning I’m not even in the rest of the
show—Wedding!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The wedding starts at six.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Okay, I totally hear ya. Oo how about this? I vamp a little
‘til they get there?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’ll vamp?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah y’know, like warm up the crowd. Ask ‘em where
they’re from. ‘Cause in Joey Tribbiani you get a minister and you get an
entertainer. I’m a minis-tainer! (Rapping) There is no one better! There is no one
greater!

scenes.location: The restaurant, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How can you not remember us kissing?!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: I don’t know. I don’t remember a lot of things that never
happened.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh… Come on! Remember? We were on the sleeping porch! We
couldn’t stop giggling? And our coconuts kept knockin’ together?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, somewhere Joey’s head is exploding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah—but come on—Listen, I’m sorry I don’t want to
make you uncomfortable, but I told Phoebe that it happened and she doesn’t believe
me.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: I’m sorry Ray-ray. I mean if I thought it happened I would say it.
Maybe I passed out and you did stuff to me while I was sleeping.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel, it’s okay. You don’t have to do this. I believe you.
All right? Okay, if-if you say that you kissed Melissa, then you kissed Melissa.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: She didn’t.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Chandler are working on the seating chart as
Ross enters carrying his tux around.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You just carry that around?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. I find it to be something of a conversation piece.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Between you and…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Gunther. (To Chandler) Hey-hey! Why don’t we put them on? Y’know
get a picture of Batman and James Bond together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I would but mine doesn’t fit. The pants are a little tight.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A little tight? I could see double-oh and seven in those pants.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well that stinks. I was looking forward to us wearing our celebrity tuxes
together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, does that mean that you’re not going to wearing yours?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you kidding? It’s Batman’s tux!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (standing up) Let me try it on!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, but just the jacket. Double-oh and seven are not gettin’ in
there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (trying on the jacket) Okay. Holy double-vented comfort Batman! (Finds
something in the pocket) What’s this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: An invitation for the At First Sight premiere? Oh my God! Val
Kilmer didn’t wear this in Batman! He wore it to the premiere of some tooty-fruity
love story where he played a blind guy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let me see that! (Grabs the invitation and reads it.) Oh man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The only superpower you have is a slightly heightened sense of smell.
(Hands him the jacket and walks away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Uh, Monica? Chandler? Can I talk to you guys for a second?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right that’s it, I give up! Whatever you want you can have it!
You wanna sing a song? You wanna do a dance? You want your mom stand at the Alter and
scream racial slurs? I don’t care!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No, I-I just wanna thank you guys for what you did for my parents,
that was really sweet. They’re so happy they get to be a part of your special day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (defeated) Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you’re welcome. And tell them we’re really glad
they’re coming.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. I will. Ohh! Check out what they got me to wear for the ceremony!
(Runs to his apartment and returns wearing a rather silly hat.) Huh? I wear it like this
when I marry you guys, and then this (He tilts it to the side of his head) is for party
time.

scenes.location: Outside the restaurant, Melissa, Phoebe, and Rachel are emerging.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It happened! I am telling you it happened!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Okay. (To Phoebe) Well, it was great meeting you. And uh Rachel, I-I
don’t think I’ll be calling you (hails a cab) because umm, y’know
you’ve gotten weird. (The cab pulls up.) Take care you guys.
(She’s about to get in when…)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! Wait a minute! No wait a minute! (She does so.) Okay? Look, that
night was the one wild thing I have ever done in my entire life, and I’m not
gonna let you take that away from me! Okay, so if you don’t remember that, maybe
you will remember this! (She grabs Melissa and kisses her on the lips.)

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: My God! You love me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Of course I remember our kiss. I think about it all the time. I can
still hear the coconuts knockin’ together I… (Phoebe is shocked.) I just
didn’t want to tell you ‘cause I didn’t think that you’d return my
love, and now that you have… (Leans in to kiss Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (moving away) Whoa! Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa! Whoa! Whoa!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: Aww, look who’s being suddenly shy. You can’t tell me you
don’t feel what I feel. Nobody can kiss that good and not mean it. (Goes in again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (moves away again) I-I-I-I’m just…I’m just a good kisser!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: (suddenly frightened) Shut up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry!

lines.speaker: Melissa
lines.text: (laughs) Oh you don’t have to be (Laughs again) sorry.
I’m…I’m obviously kidding. I’m not in love with you. (To Phoebe)
I’m not in love with her. I don’t hear coconuts banging together. Yeah, I
don’t…picture your face when I make love to my boyfriend. Anyway, I gotta go.
Eh…kiss good-bye? (Rachel stares at her stunned.) No? Okay. (Hurries into the cab and
drives off.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! I mean I had no idea that that was gonna…
(Suddenly, Phoebe leans in and kisses her on the lips!)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What the hell was that?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just wanted to see what all the fuss was about.

lines.speaker: Rachel
