lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’ve had better.
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Ralph Lauren, Rachel is hooking Chandler up with another tuxedo.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (yelling from the changing room) All right! I found one that fits!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y’know what they say, the 23rd time’s the
charm. (Chandler enters.) Aww, look at you all handsome!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whose is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh does it matter?! All that matters is that you look so handsome.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whose is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t want to say.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, come on! I don’t care! Come on! Whose is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Diane Keeton.

title: The One with the Vows

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is at the kitchen table and Chandler is in the
living room.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you realize that four weeks from today we’re getting married?
Four weeks baby!! Four weeks!!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you realize you get louder each week?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There’s still so much to do. Have you written your vows yet?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I figured I’d buy those. Pat, I’d like to buy a vow.
(Laughs)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sweetie, you know I have no sense of humor when it comes to the wedding.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right. So uh, have you written yours yet?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! But I know exactly what I’m going to say.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you happen to know what I’m going to say?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (handing him a pad of paper and a pen) Let’s just do it right now.
Okay? It won’t be hard. Just say what’s in your heart. (She goes back, sits
down, and starts feverishly writing.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (watching in her) (in his head) Look at her go! She must love me
more than I love her! What’s wrong with me? Ooh, don’t open that door.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Chandler is getting help writing his vows from Joey and
Ross.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (writing) Monica, there are no words… (To Joey and Ross) There
are no words! This should not be this hard!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, uh… (To Ross) Oh hey, you’ve done this before Ross,
well what did you say when you made up your vows?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well with Carol, I promised never to love another woman until the day I
die. She made no such promise.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m so pathetic! Monica knows what she wants to say! You
should’ve seen her. Writing, writing, writing!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica has hit a writer’s block as Rachel and
Phoebe enter.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is the emergency?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You have to help me! I’m supposed to be writing my vows and all I
have is this! (Shows them what she’s been working on.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I like the pretty little drawing of you in the wedding dress.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, except your breasts look kinda small. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Those are my eyes! Those are my breasts. (Points.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Yeah! (Monica glares at her.)
[Cut to the guys.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, why don’t you just start with something simple. Like umm,
Monica from the moment I met you, I knew I loved you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I’m not sure I can do that.
[Flashback to when Chandler was introduced to Monica in The One With The Thanksgiving
Flashbacks.]

lines.speaker: Ross

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can’t do that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If he goes first he can!

title: The One with Chandler's Dad

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Phoebe, Monica, and Rachel are sitting around the
kitchen table as Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey uh Mon, I saw the Porsche parked out front, can I get the keys?
Thought I’d take that bad boy out for a little spin.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait a minute! (To Monica) You let Ross drive the Porsche and
when I ask you, you say you’re the only one who’s allowed to drive it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, well he’s my brother! And plus he drives so slow he could
never hurt it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s a car Monica! Not a rocket ship!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whatever Ross! Just replace the bulbs in the brake lights after
you’re done.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Saw the Porsche out there Mon, lookin’ good. When do I get to take
that baby out again?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) You let Joey drive it?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’ve never driven it! Okay? Not once! Okay once. Okay, I drive it
all the time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nice work everybody! So much for the y’know, "You can drive
it, but don’t tell Rachel" plan!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! I can’t believe you lied to me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I can fix this! Okay Monica, Rachel thinks all you can talk about
is the wedding. (Rachel glares at her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great! Well Rachel, the reason why I won’t let you drive the
Porsche is because you’re a terrible driver. There! That wasn’t about the
wedding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look Rach if-if you want to go for a ride in the Porsche I’ll be glad
to take you for a quick spin around the block.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you got a couple hours?
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Rachel is there as Ross enters with his all his hair sticking
straight up.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whew! That was a brisk ride!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Take the top down did ya?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Only way to fly.
(Rachel laughs.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on Ross give me the keys! Monica does not know what
she’s talking about! I am an excellent driver!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re fast and irresponsible. That adds up to a bad driver.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well in High School, that added up to head cheerleader.
(A woman walks by and smiles at Ross’s hair.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did you see the look that girl just gave me? Huh? She must’ve seen me
cruising in the bad boy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think she’s checking out your beehive Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! (Checks his hair.) Give-give me a brush.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Gimme the keys!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well no brush!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine! Y’know what? It doesn’t matter, because, if I remember
correctly, there is a comb on the floor of the bathroom.
(He goes to the bathroom and after he leaves Rachel goes through his coat and grabs the
keys along with a $20 bill. The woman from before watches her do this.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to the woman) Alimony. (Runs outside.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Phoebe are counting the invitations as
Chandler exits from the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, we still haven’t gotten an RSVP from your dad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Right. Umm, maybe that’s because I didn’t send him an
invitation.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! He’s your father; he should be at the wedding.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t even know the man. Okay? We’re not the close. I
haven’t seen him in years.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well what are you gonna do when he finds out he wasn’t even asked?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well he doesn’t have to know! It’s not like we run in the
same circles. I hang out with you guys, and he stars in a drag show in Vegas.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, I think I wanna trade circles.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Trust me, you don’t want him there either. Okay? Nobody is gonna
be staring at the bride when the father of the groom is wearing a back-less dress.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So what! As long as he’s not wearing a white dress and a veil I
don’t care.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I think I need to do some shopping. (Gets up and leaves.)

scenes.location: A Street, Rachel is throwing her coat into the Porsche and getting in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahhh! (Gets in.) Ooh, nice!
(Suddenly from out of nowhere Ross dives onto the hood.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do you think you’re doing?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just washing the windshield. (She turns on the wipers forcing Ross off
of the hood.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There is no way I am letting you drive this car! So why don’t
you just hand over the keys?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.
{Transcriber’s Note: She puts the key into the ignition, which is on the left side
of the steering wheel. Does anyone know why that is? It’s a tradition left over from
Porsche’s racing history. The world’s greatest endurance race is the 24 Hours of
LeMans. Which is in France and runs for 24 hours straight from noon on Saturday through
the dark of night and finishes at noon on Sunday. In the 60s LeMans had a unique
start where the drivers would actually start the race outside of the car and across the
track. At the start of the race, the drivers would run across the track, get in the car,
buckle up, start the car, and drive off. Porsche wanted to reduce the amount of time that
took. Since all cars to that point had the ignition switches on the right side of the
steering wheel, that required the drivers to use their right hand to grab the seat-belts,
put the car in gear and start it. The driver’s left hand did nothing. Porsche in
order to save a few seconds in a 24-hour race; moved the ignition switches to the left
side of the steering wheel so that the driver could start the car with his left hand while
grabbing the seat-belts with his right hand. That’s why every Porsche car built since
then has the ignition on the left side of the steering wheel.}

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No ah-ah-ah! Do not start this car! (She starts the car.) Okay!
Okay! I will give you twenty bucks if you get out of this car right now! (He looks for the
twenty Rachel stole and doesn’t find it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look Ross, if you’re so freaked out, just get in the car!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: With you?! Yeah right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. (She starts off.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (grabbing the car) Okay! Okay! Okay! (He gets in, but into the back seat.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you doing?! Get in the front!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: In the death seat?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my…
(They drive off.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Phoebe are on the couch as a man enters.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey sweetie!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Ready to go?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Sure! Ooh, I left my purse up at Monica’s. I’ll be right
back. (She goes to get it.)

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: (stopping her) Wait a minute!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? (He leans in to kiss her.) Oh. (They kiss and Phoebe pauses.) Ooh.
(Pause) Whoa! That one kept going. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So! You and Phoebe huh? How long have you been going out?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Over a month.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! Maybe uh, maybe you and I ought to get to know each other a little
better.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sure, I’d like that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So uh, what’s your name?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: (laughs) Its Jake.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Joey. (They shake hands.) Hey Jake, do you like the Knicks?

lines.speaker: Jake
lines.text: Yeah, big fan.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too! There’s a game on Tuesday do you wanna go?

lines.speaker: Jake
lines.text: Yeah that would be great! Let me make sure I’m not doing anything
Tuesday. (He bends over to open his bag, when he does so his pants slide down his butt
revealing a pink lace secret.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is entering from the bedroom carrying two bags of
luggage.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here! (She sets a bag down in front of him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s your suitcase. We’re going to Las Vegas.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you serious?! I mean like eloping?! No more stupid wedding stuff?!
No more these flowers or these flowers or these flowers—Think of the money we’ll
save!! (Monica just looks at him.) We’re not eloping. I love the flowers. Can our
wedding be bigger please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re going to Las Vegas to see your dad. It’s time you two
talked, and I want to get to know my father-in-law.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know we already went over this and I won!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No you didn’t. Oh and honey just so you know, now that you’re
marrying me, you don’t get to win anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look forget it okay? I don’t want to go. I don’t want to see
him. I don’t wanna.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, look I-I know that your dad embarrassed you. I know…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no all kids are embarrassed by their parents, you’d
have to come up with a whole new word for what I went through. When I was in High School,
he used to come to all of my swim meets dressed as a different Hollywood starlet.
Y’know it’s hard enough to be fourteen. You’re skinny. You’re wearing
speedoes—That your mom promised that you would grow into! And you look up into the
stands and there’s your dad cheering you on dressed as Carmen Miranda. We was wearing
a headdress with real fruit that he will later hand out to your friends as a
healthy snack!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, the point is that he was at everyone of your swim meets and he was
there cheering you on! Okay? That’s a, that’s a pretty great dad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He had sex with Mr. Girabaldi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who’s Mr. Girabaldi?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Does it matter?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, you’re not fourteen anymore. Okay? Maybe it’s time
that you let that stuff go. If your father’s not at your wedding…you’re
gonna regret it for the rest of your life.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah o-okay, but I’m just doing this for you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So I really never get to win anymore?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How much did ever really win before?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is there as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, you know how uh, when you’re wearing pants and you lean
forward I check out your underwear?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, when Jake did it I saw that…he was wearing women’s
underwear!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. They were mine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. (Laughs.) No! No wait, that’s weird!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it’s not! We were just goofing around and I dared him to try
them on.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s weird!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m wearing his briefs right now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s…kinda hot.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think so too. And that little flap? Great for holding my lipstick.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I wouldn’t know about that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And! Y’know what Jake says? That women’s underwear is actually
more comfortable. And he loves the way the silk feels against his skin.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah well next thing you know, he’ll be telling you that your high
heels are good for his posture!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There is nothing wrong with Jake! Okay? He is all man! I’m thinking
even more than you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, he looked like a real lumberjack in those pink laceys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m just saying that only a man completely secure with his
masculinity could walk around in women’s underwear! I don’t think you could ever
do that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! I am secure with my masculinity.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay whatever.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’ve seen my huge stack of porn right? (Phoebe nods.)
[Scene: The Porsche, Rachel is driving along a highway and Ross has finally moved to
the death seat and is terrified.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God. I forgot how much I love driving. I have got to get my
license renewed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked) You don’t have a valid driver’s
license—Okay that is it! Pull over right now!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ross you’re so tense! You just gotta relax okay? Just need to
relax all right? Just need to relax… (She takes her hands off of the wheel.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (grabbing the wheel) What-what are you doing?! Are you—Okay
that’s not funny! Just stop horsing around!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am not horsing around okay? I am Porsching around.
(Suddenly a siren goes off behind them.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-oh. (She starts to pull over.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, stay calm. Nothing is going to happen to you, you are not in that
much trouble.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? You think so?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was talking to myself! You’re going down!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is walking from the bathroom to his bedroom and walks
past a pile of Rachel’s laundry, which just happens to include a selection of
panties. He stops, goes back to the basket, looks for Rachel, picks up a lavender thong,
and heads for his bedroom. However, he decides he doesn’t like his selection and goes
back this time picking up a red low-cut silk brief and heads for his room, flexing along
the way to prove his masculinity.]
[Scene: Las Vegas, we have the typical glamour shots of Vegas and the strip before we
arrive at 4 Queens bar, where Chandler and Monica are sitting at a table waiting for the
show to start.

lines.speaker: A Waiter in Drag
lines.text: (to Chandler and Monica) Has someone taken your order yet?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh oh yeah, she did. Uh, he did. (To Chandler) She? (To the waiter)

lines.speaker: Waiter in Drag
lines.text: (To Chandler) Hm-mmm?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I just ordered a beer! (Pounds the table.)

lines.speaker: Waiter in Drag
lines.text: You’re straight. I get it. (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I still say that if we had called your dad we coulda gotten better
seats.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No! I don’t want him to know we’re yet! I’m not
sure I’m ready for that. And besides he’s not gonna be too happy to see me
either.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know if I’ve told you this, but he’s kinda
tried to get in contact with me a lot over the last few years

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, he’s made phone calls, written letters, he even came to New
York, but I always said I was too busy to see him. Y’know it’s all very Cats
in the Cradle—I don’t want to get into it. (The show starts.) Here we go.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen please welcome the incomparable Helena Handbasket!
(There’s applause as Helena turns around and it’s Kathleen Turner.)

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: Hello darlings.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And there’s daddy!
Commercial Break
[Scene: The Porsche, they have pulled over and are awaiting the cop to come talk to
them.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Switch places with me! Switch places with me! Come on! I’ll
go under, you go over!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I’ll get right on that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh come on Ross!! (She tries to switch places with him and goes under
his leg.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No Rach! Come on! No-no! Yeah, I’m sure we won’t get arrested
for this.
(She sits back up as the policeman approaches. She undoes her top button.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sexily) Hi officer, was I going a little too fast?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Can I see your license please?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yes, absolutely! Y’know, it’s weird uh, but I had a dream
last night where I was stopped by a policeman. And then he uh…well I probably
shouldn’t tell you the rest.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Your license?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (handing it to him) Yes. Here you go Officer uh, Handsome.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: That’s Hanson.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oops sorry, my mistake.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dear Lord!!

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here it comes.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: This is a great picture.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?! You think so? Y’know, I had just rolled out of bed.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Yeah? Well you look phenomenal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well she should, it was taken ten years ago!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know you’re-you’re probably wondering about the old
date on there.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Yes I am.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: You’re an Aquarius, huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I bet you’re a Gemini.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Taurus?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Virgo?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sagittarius?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I knew it! I knew it, ahh….

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Well I tell you what…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: You’re not gonna speed anymore right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I won’t speed.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: And you promise you’ll get this taken care of right away?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: And in the meantime you better let him drive. Does he have a license?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Can he handle the stick?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh well…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can handle the stick!!

scenes.location: 4 Queens Club, Helena Handbasket is singing.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: I feel pretty. Oh so pretty. I feel pretty and witty and…(She
holds the mike out to the audience.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Gay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That can’t be your father.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Believe me, I’ve been saying that for years. Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s Mr. Girabaldi playing the piano.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: (singing) For I’m loved by a pretty wonderful boy!
(Applause.) Hello! And welcome to the show. I see some of our regulars in the audience.
And a couple of irregulars. (He starts going into the audience.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He’s coming into the audience. He’s coming into the
audience.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Relax! You’ll be fine. (Chandler exhales and turns off the table
light.) Oh much better. You’re invisible now.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: (standing at a table and asking the guy sitting there) Where are you
from?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Bakersfield.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: I’m sorry? (Holds out the mike.)

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Bakersfield!

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: No-no I heard! I’m just sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It can’t happen like this. Okay? I’ll meet you back at the
hotel.
(He gets up to walk out, but Helena spots and stops him.)

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: (to Chandler’s back) Oh look, a standing ovation already! So early
in the show. Oh turn around honey; let me see your pretty face. (He slowly turns around.
Helena recognizes him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can we have our drinks please?! Waiter—Uh, tress!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is sitting on the couch as Joey enters strutting.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs! (He sits down next to her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Check it out. (He turns around, pulls down his pants, and shows Phoebe
that he’s got panties on.) How much of a man am I?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! Nice! Manly and also kind of a slut.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know, I’m beginning to see what Jake was talking about.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The silk? Feels really good!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! And-and things aren’t as…smashed down as I thought they
were gonna be.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s great Joe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! And you have so many more choices than you do with
men’s underwear!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bikini, French cut, thong! And-and the fabrics! You’ve got cotton,
silk, lace! And y’know what I’ve always wondered about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pantyhose! Y’know? They way they start at your toe and go all the way
up to here… (He mimed that and stops when he realized he went to far.) I should go
take these off shouldn’t I?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think it’s important that you do.
(Joey agrees and heads to take them off.)

scenes.location: 4 Queens Club, scene continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: So what’s your name?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (resigning himself to his fate) Chandler. (He quickly sits down.)

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: Chandler? What an unusual name! You must’ve had terribly fascinating
parents.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, they’re a hoot.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: (To Monica) And who is your friend?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m-I’m Monica.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: Monica! Where are you from?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: New York.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: I’m not very fond of New York. Queens I like. (Noticing
Monica’s ring.) Ooh, what is this sparkle something! (Shows the audience who
woos.) Honey! Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually Monica and I are engaged.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: Really?! Congratulations. When’s the big day?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looks at Chandler) In…in two weeks.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: (disappointed) I see. Well, I wish you both a lifetime of
happiness. (To a bald guy.) So you’re bald?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait! Wait! We’d really love it if you could be there.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: We? (Looks at Monica who nods.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know it would make me happy, ma’am.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: Well I wouldn’t miss it for the world. Oh! I’m getting all
misty here! You’d think I was having my legs waxed or something. (Goes back on
stage.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) You okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Thanks for making me do this.

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: Before we go on with the show, I just want to say to the bride and groom
how lucky they are to have found each other. In every life, a little rain must fall.
Fortunately, in my life… (Four guys wearing rubber boots, shorts, hats, and nothing
else carrying umbrellas run onto the stage.) (Singing) It’s raining men!

lines.speaker: The Chorus Line
lines.text: Hallelujah!

lines.speaker: Helena
lines.text: It’s raining men!

lines.speaker: The Chorus Line
lines.text: Amen!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) When I was growing up I…played the one on the far
left.
[Scene: The Porsche, cars are whizzing by and honking their horns on both sides very
quickly as Ross creeps along.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Remind me to introduce you to someone!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fourth gear!!
(Suddenly a siren goes off.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! What does he want?! I wasn’t doing anything!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well maybe he saw your hand slip briefly from the ten and two
o’clock position.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe it’s uh Sergeant Sagittarius coming back to flirt some more!
(They pull over.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s a different guy!
(The policeman walks up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good evening officer.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Do you know how fast you were traveling back there?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah no. I don’t, but it could not have been more than sixty.

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: You’re right. It was 37. (Rachel laughs.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I mean you’re not gonna give me a-a ticket for driving too slow are
ya?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: That’s right.
(There’s a pause as Ross gets suddenly flirtatious.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know of-officer I uh…I had the weirdest dream last night…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Your license please.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (laughs) You don’t-you don’t want to hear about my dream
Officer…Pretty?

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: It’s Petty. (He grabs Ross’s license.) I’ll be right
back with your ticket. (Walks back to his car.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause) You have a son!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know. I know.
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is returning from having removed Rachel’s panties.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Feel better?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Much! Listen uh, not that I’m y’know insecure about my
manhood or anything y’know, but I think I need to hook up with a woman like right
now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I understand.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Okay! (He notices a beautiful woman sitting behind the couch and
goes to talk to her.) Hey! Hi!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know, you look familiar. Do I know you from somewhere?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Maybe it’s because I’m on television. I’m an actor on Days
of Our Lives.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hm-mmm.

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.text: (to the woman) $4.50 please.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, let me get this. (He takes out his wallet, but the panties come with
it. The woman and waitress are shocked.) (Realizing) (To the woman) These are for you.

title: The One with Chandler and Monica's Wedding

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you realize this is probably the last time we’ll all be here in
the coffee house as six single people?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?! What’s happening to the coffee house?! (Monica looks at her.)
Oh! (Realizes.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yep! From now on its gonna be the four of you guys and me and the
misses. The little woman. The wife. The old ball and chain.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Old?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The young hot ball and chain.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s much better.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (checking her watch) Op! We gotta go! (The girls stand up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, where are you guys going?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re gonna pick up the wedding dress then we’re gonna have
lunch with mom. (Joey stands up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah. Joey you’re-you’re having lunch with my mom?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I-I just heard lunch. But yeah, I can go. Sure! (They all exit.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) Y’know what? Actually I’m kinda glad they’re
leaving ‘cause uh, I need to talk to you about something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well this uh, this may be a little awkward.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen, if you want to borrow money, its kind of a bad time. I’m
buying dinner for 128 people tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, its…Its not that. Umm, now what I’m going to say to you,
I’m not saying as your friend. Okay? I’m-I’m saying as it as
Monica’s older brother.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But you’re still my friend?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not for the next few minutes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: During this time…are you, are you still my best man?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do I still call you Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! You guys are getting married tomorrow and-and I couldn’t be
more thrilled for both of you, but as Monica’s older brother I-I have to tell you
this. If you ever hurt my little sister, if you ever cause her any unhappiness of any
kind, I will hunt you down, and kick your ass! (Chandler laughs.) What?
I’m-I’m-I’m serious! (Chandler laughs harder.) Come—Hey! Dude! Stop
it! Okay? I’m-I’m not kidding here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiling) Hey, I hear what your saying, okay? And, thanks for the
warning.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So are we…friends again?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Pause) You won’t believe what Monica’s older
brother just said to me!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, the girls are having breakfast.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What ‘cha doing Mon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m making a list of all the things that are most likely to go
wrong at the wedding. Now, that way I can be prepared.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are they?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, so far I have uh, my bride’s maids dresses won’t get
picked up, my veil gets lost, or I don’t have my something blue.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Those are all the things I’m responsible for!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I had to go with the odds Rach.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey! You guys! Remember that audition I had a while ago and
didn’t get the part?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The commercial?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That play?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That other play?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nooo!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The movie?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes that’s the one about the soldiers who fight in World War I!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Back then y’know, we called the Great War. It really was!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well anyway, the guy they wanted backed out and now they want me! I start
shooting today!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh that’s great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait! Wait! Wait! You can’t start today! Today’s the rehearsal
dinner!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no, I’ll be done by then.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. Well then way to go you big movie star!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! All right, I’ll see you guys over there! I’m off to
fight the Nazis.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, wait Joey! We fought the Nazis in World War II, not World War I.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa! Okay. Yeah well, who-who was in World War I? (Rachel pauses as she
thinks.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re gonna be late! Go! Go! (He runs out.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who did we fight in World War I?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mexico?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! Very good.
[Scene: Pier 59 Studios, Joey is in costume and standing at the craft services table.
He checks his pockets and finds some prop coins in a pouch, which he replaces with some
cookies.]

lines.speaker: The Assistant Director
lines.text: (approaching) Hey Joey! We’re ready.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Me too. (He pats his pocket.)

lines.speaker: The Assistant Director
lines.text: (to another actor) Richard? We’re ready for you.
(Richard approaches.) Joey Tribbiani? This is Richard Crosby he’s playing Vincent.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m doing my scenes with you?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Nice to meet you Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! I can’t believe this! This is incredible. I mean you just won an
Oscar!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: No I didn’t.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think you did.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I think I lost. Three times.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh…Cookie?

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: (approaching) Okay! We’re about an hour away from getting the
scene lit. So uh, if you guys don’t mind, can we run it a couple of times?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Yeah, sure.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Okay, all right. Let’s do it. (He walks off.)
And…Action!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We have to find the rest of the platoon!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Forget the platoon! The platoon is gone! (He is spitting on the hard Ps
and Ts.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (wiping his face) What?!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: (still spitting) The platoon is dead! Face facts Tony!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (wipes face) So what are we gonna do?! We have no reinforcements! No-no
food!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: No, we still have food in the basement! I saw potatoes and some dry
pasta!
(Joey wipes his eye.)

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Hang on a minute! Joey, you keep touching your face. Is something
wrong?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (glances at Richard) No. Nope, I uh…I th—I thought it might be
kind of a cool character thing. Y’know? He’s uh, he’s a face toucher.
(Behind his back, Richard is nodding no.)

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: I don’t think so. Let’s take it back to Richard’s
last line. (Walks off.) Action!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: We may not have any weapons, but we still have food. In the basement I
saw potatoes and some dry pasta, and a few tins of tuna! (Joey backs away and wipes his
face again.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is standing in the kitchen ready to leave for the
rehearsal dinner.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, we gotta go!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering from the bedroom) Okay. Here’s a question you never
have to ask. My dad just called and wanted to know if he could borrow one of your pearl
necklaces.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) I don’t have anything like that, but let me go see if
Rachel does.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, include more people in this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, do you realize that at this time tomorrow we’ll be getting
married?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait a minute! I have a date tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just, I can’t believe that we made it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well you don’t have to sound so surprised.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sorry but…nothing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well…honestly ever since we got engaged I have been waiting for
something to, to flip you out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honestly? Me too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Y’know I keep thinking that something stupid is gonna come
up and I’ll go all…Chandler. But nothing has.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, I’m so glad. Thank you so much for staying so calm during
this. I mean it’s really, it’s made me stay calm. (Chandler just looks at her.)
I coulda been worse!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. I’ll be right there.
(She exits and as Chandler picks up his coat, the phone rings and the answering machine
gets it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (voice on answering machine) Hi! If you’re calling before Saturday,
you’ve reached Monica and Chandler. But if you’re calling after Saturday,
you’ve reached Mr. and Mrs. Bing! Please leave a message for the Bings!
(Chandler freaks out and loosens his tie.)
[Scene: The Rehearsal Dinner, Chandler and Monica are greeting guests as they arrive. A
woman enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Maureen! (They hug.) Gosh! Hey uh, Chandler? This is my cousin
Maureen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’re the Bings.
(Phoebe and Rachel walk up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Oh you guys look so beautiful!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mr. and Mrs. Bing! (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (walks up) Wow Monica! Hey, just so you know I had my uh, older brother
chat with Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I…I told him that if he ever hurt you I would hunt him down and
kick his ass! (The girls all laugh.) What?! What?! What is the matter with everybody?! I
am serious! I would kick his ass! (The laugh harder.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, please! My make-up! (He walks away angrily.)
(Chandler’s Mom enters and Chandler meets her by the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mom. Thanks for wearing something. (They hug.) (She’s wearing a
tight dress with a lot of cleavage showing.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Oh honey! This is so exciting! I thought we screwed you up so bad
this day would never come. Oh and just think. Soon there’ll be lots of little Bings.
(He freaks out and loosens the tie again.)
(Monica and her parents walk up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mrs. Bing? Here, these are my parents umm, Judy and Jack Geller.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (shaking her hand) It’s lovely to meet you.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (shaking her hand) So are you his mother or his father?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Jack!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: What?! I’ve never seen one before!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Dad! There’s Ross (points), why don’t you go talk to him?
(Mr. and Mrs. Geller start to walk away.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I didn’t even have a chance to act as though I’m okay with
it!

lines.speaker: Mr. Bing
lines.text: (entering) Hello all!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi…dad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi Mr.…Bing.

lines.speaker: Mr. Bing
lines.text: Nora!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Charles.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It-it’s so great to see you both here.

lines.speaker: Mr. Bing
lines.text: Yes! Although, I think we may be seeing a little too much of some
people. Aren’t you a little old to be wearing a dress like that?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Don’t you have a little too much penis to be wearing a dress
like that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God! (He and Monica walk away.)
[Cut to Mr. and Mrs. Geller talking to Ross.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: …of course you can kick his ass son.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: You could kick anyone’s ass you want too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks you guys. (Walks away happily and his parents smile.)
[Cut to Monica.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Rach! Rach! Umm hey, could you do me a favor and would talk to
Chandler’s dad and try to keep him away from Chandler’s mom?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! But I don’t know what he looks like!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He is the man in the black dress.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Man in the black dress… (Monica walks away and Rachel looks around
to find a woman in a black dress.) (To her) Hi! I’m Rachel! I’m a friend of
Monica and Chandler’s!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I’m Amanda.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh I get it! A…man…duh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (clinking a wine glass) Can I have everyone’s attention please?
I’m uh; I’m Ross Geller.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Doctor Ross Geller.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad…dad, please! As I was saying umm, I’m Dr. Ross Geller. Uhh,
and I’m the best man. And uh, this marriage is doubly special for me umm, because not
only is the groom my best friend but uh, the bride is my little sister. And, she’s
the greatest sister a guy could ask for. So if you’d all please join me in raising a
glass to the, the couple we’re here to celebrate. (Everyone does so.) To the Bings.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: To the Bings!
(Everyone clinks glasses and Chandler freaks out again.)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica, Phoebe, and Rachel are in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I’m gonna go steam my wedding dress okay? Who wants the
responsibility of making sure nothing happens to it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ll do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who wants it? Anybody?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I said I’ll do it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nobody wants to do it? All right, I’ll do it myself.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica! I’m not gonna screw it up!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what? You’re right, I’m sorry. Actually you were a
big help tonight. Yeah, and thanks for putting my grandmother in the cab and making sure
she got to the hotel safely.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well of course that is what I’m here for!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Sorry. (Monica goes into the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh! (To Phoebe) What grandmother?
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is wearing sunglasses and as he exits his bedroom, Ross
enters the apartment.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Where have you been?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, taking my parents back to the hotel.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Are you going back to work?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nice shades.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks. Yeah, I figure if I wear these in my scenes at least I won’t
get spit in the eyes, y’know?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And if I remember correctly, Ray Ban was the official sponsor of
World War I!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! All right. I’ll see you later. (He starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, where’s Chandler?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, I think he’s in Rachel’s room. See ya. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (going up to Rachel’s closed door) Chandler? (He opens the door and
looks inside and doesn’t see him.) Chandler? (He checks the bathroom and still
doesn’t find him. He then finds a note on the counter. He picks it up and reads it.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Phoebe and Rachel are in the kitchen as there is a knock
on the door. Rachel answers it.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is uh, is Monica here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She’s steaming her dress, why? What’s up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think Chandler’s gone. (He hands her the note.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He left that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading the note) Tell Monica I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (walking up) What’s up? (Rachel hands her the note and she reads
it.) Tell Monica I’m sorry. (Pause) Tell her yourself!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: The Hallway, Ross, Phoebe, and Rachel are discussing the note.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! Chandler just left though!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah but, maybe it’s not what we think. Maybe it’s tell Monica
I’m sorry I…drank the last of the milk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or maybe he-he was writing to tell her that-that he’s changed his
name, y’know? Tell Monica I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think it means he freaked out and left!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t be so negative! Good God! Isn’t it possible that Sorry
is sitting in there (Joey and Rachel’s apartment) right now?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Phoebe, I-I think Ross is right. What are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look—Okay, I’m just gonna—I’m gonna have to go find
him and bring him back! Okay? You-you make sure Monica does not find out, okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (pointing at Ross) Okay but if you don’t find him and bring
him back, I am gonna hunt you down and kick your ass!
(Ross laughs and Phoebe points harder.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (scared) I will, I will find him.

scenes.location: The Movie Set, Joey is getting his make-up touched up as Richard approaches.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Hey Joey, could you uh, go through these lines with me? (He’s
holding a script.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh man! They-they just redid my make-up!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Just the last two pages.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right.
(They go onto the set.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I found the picture!
(He’s still spitting and Joey holds his script in front of his face.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Picture? What picture?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Could you uh, could you lower your script? I need to see your face so I
can uh, play off your reaction.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay uh, look I know you’re a great actor, okay? And you play all
those Shakespeare guys and stuff…

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh, thanks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But you’re spittin’ all over me man!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well of course I am!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know you’ve been spitting on me?!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: That’s what real actors do! Annunciation is the mark of a good
actor! And when you enunciate, you spit! (Spits on the t)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (wiping face) Wow! Didn’t know that.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks! Okay-okay check it out! (Reading from the script) Picture? What
picture? (He pauses then spits) Eh?
[Scene: Central Perk, Gunther is behind the counter as Ross enters looking for
Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Gunther have you uh, have you seen Chandler?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: No. No, I haven’t seen him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh damn!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: He’s getting married tomorrow right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. Yes. Don’t worry. Everything’s fine. We’ll uh,
we’ll see you tomorrow at the wedding.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I wasn’t invited.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well then we’ll-we’ll see you the day after tomorrow. (Walks
away slowly, but notices something.) Mom?! Dad?! (They’re sitting by the window.)
What-what…what you guys doing here?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Well you kids talk about this place so much, we thought we’d
see what all the fuss is about.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: I certainly see what the girls like coming here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: The sexy blonde behind the counter. (She waves at Gunther who waves
back.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked) Gunther?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Your mother just added him to her list.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Your-your list?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Yeah, the list that—of people we’re allowed to
sleep…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! No-no! I know, I know what the list is! Mom! Look if you see
Chandler, could you just let him know I’m looking for him?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: And if you see Rita Moreno, let her know I’m looking for her.
(Ross points at him and exits.)

scenes.location: The Movie Set, Richard and Joey are doing a scene.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Action!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I found the picture!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What picture?!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: The picture of my wife! In your pack!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You went through my personal property?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Why do have a picture of Paulette in your pack?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pause) Because Vincent, we were lovers. (Pause) For two years!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Cut! Wonderful!
(Joey and Richard both wipe their faces and are given towels.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great scene yeah?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh you’re awesome! And, in that last speech? You soaked me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks a lot.

lines.speaker: The Assistant Director
lines.text: (To Joey) Here’s your call sheet for tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I’m-I’m not working tomorrow.

lines.speaker: The Assistant Director
lines.text: You are now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No! I can’t! You gotta get me out of it! I’ve got plans!
(Spits.) Important plans! (Spits on the Ps.)
(The AD walks away wiping his face.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, the next morning, Rachel and Phoebe are eating
breakfast.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (closing the door) Ross said there’s still no word from Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh man.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh but he did say that they found the grandmother wandering down fifth
avenue.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Well there’s one down.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from her room, excitedly) I’m getting married today!!!
(She trips and falls.) (Getting up) I think I just cracked a rib. But I don’t care
because today’s my wedding day! My day is finally here!! (Runs back into her room.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know she might not even notice he’s gone.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (re-entering) I’m gonna start getting ready! (Goes back into her
room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God! Don’t—We can’t let her start getting ready! This is
too awful! Oh God, but wait she’ll be in the gown and then he won’t show up and
then she’s gonna have to take off the gown…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shhh! Stop it! Stop it Rachel! You can’t do this here! (She drags
her into the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry. I’m sorry. It’s just…It’s just so
sad!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but you’ve got to pull yourself together! Monica can’t
see you like this! Then she’ll know something’s wrong!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. I know. Oh God. (Looking around) There’s no tissue! Can you
grab me some toilet paper?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. (Looks.) Oh, that’s gone too. This is Monica’s
bathroom right?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no! I-I…I found one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(Phoebe reaches into the trash can, pulls one out, and hands it to Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh thank you! (Wiping her nose.) Oh God! (She throws it out.) Can I have
another one?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looking into the trash can) Sure. (Reaching into the trash can.) Do you
need some floss? (Grabs a piece of it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God I just can not imagine what is gonna happen if Chandler
doesn’t show up!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh here’s a whole bunch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I mean she’s gonna be at the wedding waiting for him and people
will be whispering, "Oh that poor girl." Y’know? Then she’ll have to
come back here and live all alone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (finding something interesting in the trash can) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There was a pregnancy test in the garbage, and it’s positive.
Monica’s pregnant. (Rachel covers her mouth.) So I guess she won’t be totally
alone.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s bathroom, the scene is continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know! Monica’s gonna have a baby! Hey, can this count as her
something new?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, do you think this is why Chandler took off?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, she had to have just taken that test because I took out the trash
last night.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh God, this is turning into the worst wedding day ever! The bride is
pregnant. The groom is missing. And I’m still holding this. (She throws the test back
into the trash.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Phoebe, we can not tell anyone about this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, okay. Hey, wait. Do you know what kind of birth control she was
using?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just for the future, this is hardly a commercial for it.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Ross is just hanging up the phone as Rachel and Phoebe
enter.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anything?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! I talked to Joey on the set, he hasn’t heard from him. I-I-I
talked to Chandler’s parents again!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You told them he was missing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! I made it seem like I was just calling to chat. Pretty sure, they both
think I’m interested in them.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, we’ve got to tell her he’s gone. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Hey! Hey! We can’t!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, she’s gonna start getting ready soon!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, can’t you at least stall her a little? I’ll-I’ll go
back to some of the places I went last night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, well how much time do you need?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well how much time before she absolutely has to start getting ready?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: One hour.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Give me two.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Then why do you ask?!
(They all go into the hallway.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, wish me luck.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. I’m going with you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, you’re tired. You’ve been looking all night. And clearly
you suck at this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I’ll see you guys later.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Wait, do you know how you’re going to stall her?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ll figure something out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. Good luck.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks.
(Phoebe and Ross go to look for Chandler and Rachel enters Monica and Chandler’s.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Okay, so I thought we’d start with my make up and then do my
hair.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay uh, but before you do that. I-I, I need you to talk to me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm… I’m never gonna getting married!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah you will! The right guy is just around the corner! Okay, are we
done with that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Monica! I’m serious! Oh, maybe I should just forget about it.
Become a lesbian or something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Any woman would be lucky to have ya.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well maybe it would make me feel better if I slept with Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (jumping up) Rachel! You okay?

scenes.location: The Movie Set, Joey is reporting for work.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Excuse me, Aaron? (The director turns around.) Hi! Umm, I have a little
problem with the schedules. Originally, I wasn’t supposed to work today, and I have
this wedding that I really have to be at. It’s my best friend’s, and I’m
officiating so I really can’t work past four.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Joey, you gotta stay until the end. We can’t stop filming
just for you. It’s not like it’s your wedding. (Starts to walk away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m having surgery!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I-I just made up the stuff about the wedding because I didn’t
want you to worry about me. But, I’m having surgery today.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: What kind of surgery?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Transplant.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: But you’re supposed to work on Monday.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hair transplant.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: But you’re not bald.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s not on my head.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Look Joey, there’s nothing I can do. Besides, you’re
probably gonna be out by four anyway. We’ve just got one short scene. It’s just
you and Richard, and God knows he’s a pro. You’ll be fine. (Walks away and sees
Richard entering.) Morning Richard.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! You’re here! Great! Great! Great! Let’s get going buddy,
we’ve got a scene to shoot!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I’m wearing two belts.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you drunk?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes you are!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: All right.

scenes.location: A Street, Phoebe and Ross are exiting a pizza place.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We are never gonna find him! He’s one guy in a huge city!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! Is that him? (She points at someone.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That is an old, Chinese woman!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He could be in disguise, y’know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aw, y’know…Y’know, maybe we’re-we’re just
approaching this all wrong. If you’re Chandler and-and you wanna hide, where is the
last place on Earth people would think you’d go?
[Cut to an office building.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So this is your office?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How did you guys find me? I knew I should’ve hid at the gym!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What the hell are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Panicking! And using the Internet to try to prove that I’m
related to Monica. How is she?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She’s fine. She doesn’t know you’re gone. And she
doesn’t have to know, okay? Now come on, we’re going home.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! No! No! I can’t do that!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because if I go home, we’re gonna become the Bings! I can’t
be the Bings!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s wrong with being the Bings?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The Bings have horrible marriages! They yell. They fight. And they use
the pool boy as a pawn in their sexual games!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler, have you ever put on a black cocktail dress and asked me up to
your hotel room?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then you are neither of your parents!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s not just their marriage! I mean, look at yours. Look at
everybody’s! The only person that can make marriage work is Paul Newman! And
I’ve met me; I am not Paul Newman. I don’t race cars! I don’t make popcorn!
None of my proceeds go to charity.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But look Chandler, right now, no one has a lower opinion of you than I
do. But I totally believe you can do this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I want to. I love her so much, but I’m afr…It’s too
huge.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know, okay. You’re right. It is huge. So why don’t we
take it just a little bit at a time? Okay? Umm, forget getting married for a sec; just
forget about it. Can you just come home and take a shower?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well yeah, but then…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupting him) Yeah—No-but-but-but-but! We’re just gonna go
home and take a shower. Now, that’s not scary right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Depends on what you mean by we.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Rachel is still trying to stall Monica.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The nights are the hardest. (Checks her watch.) But then the day comes!
And that’s every bit as hard as the night. And then the night comes again…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) The days and nights are hard! I get it! Okay? Look umm,
Rachel I’m sorry! I have to start getting ready! I’m getting married today!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. At dusk. That’s such a hard time for me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (getting up) I’m gonna go put my make up on, we have to be at the
hotel in an hour! (Starts for the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. But wait!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let’s go to lunch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t go to lunch!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right.
(Monica goes into the bathroom and Rachel thinks quickly.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh good God! I’ve fallen down! (She trips and falls.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. All right. (Gets up.) Honey listen. When I tell you what I’m
about to tell you, I need you to remember that we are all here for you and that we love
you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, you’re-you’re really freaking me out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We can’t find Chandler…(Phoebe sticks her head and motions
that they found Chandler)—‘s vest. We can’t find Chandler’s vest.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How can that be?! Oh wait! Wait! Are you, are you serious?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Found the vest! I mean we’re gonna have to keep an eye
on it, y’know make sure we don’t lose it again…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh wow! Okay. Don’t scare me like that okay? I mean for a minute
there I was like, "Oh my God! The worst has happened!"
(Monica goes into the bathroom and Phoebe and Rachel breathe a sigh of relief.)
[Scene: The Movie Set, Joey and Richard are in the middle of a scene. They are both
holding swords.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I would sooner die in this hellhole then see her back with you!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: That can be arranged.
(Richard thrusts, misses Joey by several feet and Joey screams in pain and drops to his
knees.)

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Let’s reset.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! He got me! Owwwwww!!!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Let’s take it from there.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: (To Joey) Are you a little off today? It’s going terribly slowly.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, my best friends are getting married in like an hour. Okay? And
I’m the minister. Please! Please! Can you pull it together?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Of course! I’m-I’m sorry. I-I’d hate you to miss
anything like that on account of me. I can do this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you.

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: Still rolling, annnnd action!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I would sooner die in this hellhole then see her back with you!

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Now, that can be arranged! (He brings his sword back and drops it,
causing it to fly over the wall.) Slippery little bugger!
[Scene: The Hotel, Monica’s room, Mr. and Mrs. Bing are staring at each other
while Phoebe looks on.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So-so you two were married huh? What happened? You just drift apart?
(Rachel and Mrs. Geller enter.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Here comes the bride.
(Monica enters wearing her wedding dress.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wanna wear this everyday.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You look so beautiful.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (starting to cry) I’m so happy for me.
(The phone rings and Rachel answers it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on phone) Hey! Did Chandler show up yet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, we got him back. Everything’s fine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damnit!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Why? Where are you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m still on the set!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! The wedding is in less than an hour!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! I’m sorry! The guy’s drunk, they won’t let me go
until we get this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! I’m gonna have to find another minister.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No, I’m the minister! All right, look-look, put ‘em both on
the phone, I’ll marry them right now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh! Joey, I have to go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Don’t you hang up on me! I’ll marry you and me right now! I
have the power!
(She hangs up anyway.)

scenes.location: Chandler’s Hotel Room, Ross is getting Chandler ready.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There you go. You put on a tuxedo! Now that wasn’t so scary, was it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m telling you, just a little bit at a time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah okay. Well, what’s the next little bit?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Getting married. (Chandler panics.) Okay. Okay. You can, you can do that
too! Just like you’ve done everything else!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. You’re right. Hey I-I can do that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, excuse me for a minute. (Starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wh—Hey—Whoa-whoa, where, where you going?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross, I am not gonna run away again! I just want to get a little fresh
air.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(Chandler goes out into the hall and lights up a cigarette.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh fresh air!
(He hears Phoebe and Rachel coming and hides in the ice machine room.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel) Wait! Maybe, maybe you’re overreacting! You do that
y’know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well Phoebe, we gotta do something! (They turn the corner.) Well,
y’know. I mean there’s no way Joey’s gonna make it in time. So I’m
gonna through the hotel and see if there’s any other weddings going on.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Oh but don’t tell them Monica’s pregnant because, they
frown on that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
(They head in separate directions and Chandler emerges and he’s so shocked that
his cigarette is hanging from his lip.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: The Hotel, Rachel is walking through the ballroom area and comes upon the sign
for the Anastassakis/Papasifakis wedding.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anastassakis/Papasifakis wedding, excellent! {It’s a good thing
Jennifer Aniston is Greek, because she had to pronounce those names. Luckily for me, they
were written on a sign.}(The happy couple emerges.) Congratulations. (To the best man and
maid of honor) Mazel Tov! (The rabbi emerges.) Hi! Oh, great hat. (He’s wearing an
interesting hat and she takes him over to talk.) Listen umm, I need you to perform another
wedding. Can you do that?

lines.speaker: The Rabbi
lines.text: I don’t know. Are they Greek Orthodox?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah. They’re…they’re-they’re my friends, uh,
Monica Stephanopolus and uh, and Chandler Acidofolus.
[Scene: Monica’s Hotel Room, Chandler and Monica’s parents and Phoebe are
there as Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi! (To Mrs. Bing) Hi! (Mr. Bing starts rubbing his arm.) Hi. Has umm,
anyone seen Chandler?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I thought he was with you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He-he was with me umm, we’re playing a little game, y’know? Hide
and seek.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: You can’t ask us son, that’s cheating.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pause) You’re right, thanks for keeping me honest dad.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Well, he better not come by here. He can’t see the bride in
the wedding dress.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: As I recall when we got married, I saw the groom in the wedding
dress.

lines.speaker: Mr. Bing
lines.text: But that was after the wedding, it’s not bad luck then.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Honey, it isn’t good luck.
(Monica enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! Hey, how’s Chandler doin’?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great. He’s doing great. Don’t you worry about Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you’re-you’re sweating.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: These-these are beads of joy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that’s sweet. Don’t touch me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh Phoebe, can I see you for a second?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!
(They both go out into the hall.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler’s gone again!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! Why would you play hide and seek with someone you know is a
flight risk?!
(Ross just glares at her.)
[Scene: The Movie Set, Joey is walking up to the director, pleading with him to let him
go.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aaron! You gotta let me go. The guy’s hammered!

lines.speaker: The Director
lines.text: I’m sorry Joey, as long as he’s here and he’s
conscious we’re still shooting.
(He walks away and Joey does Ross’s fist thing. He then enters Richard’s
dressing room, to find Richard cutting his steak with his sword.)

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: You wouldn’t happen to have a very big fork?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So I uh, I just talked to the director. That’s it, we’re done
for the day.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Well have we finished the scene?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! You…you were wonderful.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: As were you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So I got your car, it’s right outside.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Why? Are we done for the day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s what you told me.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Oh, thank you. You’re welcome. (He stands up, staggers to the
couch, and starts to lie down.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no! We gotta go! Come on! (Joey picks him up in a fireman’s
carry and carries him out.) Here we go.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: Is that my ass? (He’s looking at Joey’s.)
(And as Joey walks out the door, Richard grabs a bottle of Scotch, just as the door
closes and carries it with him.)

scenes.location: The Hotel, Phoebe and Ross are looking for Chandler.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (turning a corner) There he is!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?
(Ross runs over and tackles him.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re not getting away this time mister! Unless you want that ass
kicking we talked about!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross! (He starts to get up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hiiii-Ya!! (Chandler lies back down.) I’m serious! You’re not
walking out on my sister!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (standing up) That’s right! I’m not!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then where the hell have you been?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know about Monica.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I heard you and Rachel talking.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! What?! Talking about what?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t know?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Know what—If somebody doesn’t tell me what’s going on right

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? You’ll hi-ya?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica’s pregnant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God. Oh my God! And you’re-you’re…you’re not
freaking out?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well I was! Then I went down to the gift shop because I was out of
cigarettes…

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Ross
lines.text: Cigarettes?!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Big picture please! So I was in the gift shop, and that’s when I
uh, saw this. (He holds up a little, tiny baby jumper that reads I (heart) New York.)
Yeah, y’know what? I thought anything that can fit into this, can’t be scary.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well you obviously didn’t see Chucky 3.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But come on, look at how cute and small this is! So I got it to give
Monica so she’d know I was okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude. (Hugs him.)
(Mr. Geller turns the corner.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Way to go son! I knew you’d find him!
[Scene: The moment we waited for has finally arrived. It’s time for Monica and
