Chandler’s wedding. We’ve got violins playing Every Breath You Take,
we’ve got guests seated, and Chandler starts walking down the aisle with his parents
on either arm.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Bing
lines.text: Our little boy is getting married.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Oh look at you! So handsome!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You look beautiful mom. (His dad clears his throat.) You look
beautiful too dad. I love you both. (He kisses his dad on the cheek) I’m so glad you
here. (He kisses his mom.)
(He walks up onto the altar and notices the rabbi.)

lines.speaker: The Rabbi
lines.text: Are you Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you Joey?
(Ross walks down the aisle with Phoebe and Rachel on his arms.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh. This is nice.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’ve never walked down the aisle knowing it can’t end in
divorce.
(Finally, Monica with her parents on her arms start down the aisle.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Oh I wish you’re grandmother had lived to see this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s right there.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Not that old crow, my mother. (They stop and she kisses Monica on
the cheek.) Congratulations darling.

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I love you sweetheart. (He kisses her and they sit down.)
(Chandler steps off the altar to greet his bride-to-be.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You look beautiful. Is this new? (Her dress.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(They both step up onto the altar and she notices the rabbi.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Who is this?

lines.speaker: The Rabbi
lines.text: I am Father Kalebasous.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (in Monica’s ear) He’s Greek Orthodox.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (leaning in) As are you…

lines.speaker: The Rabbi
lines.text: Let us begin. Dearly beloved…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) That’s my line! (He walks up the aisle and to the rabbi) I
can take it from here, thanks. (To all) Dearly beloved, I’m sorry I’m a little
late. You may be confused by this now, (He’s still in costume) but you won’t be
Memorial Day weekend 2002. Well, let’s get started before the groom takes off again.
Huh? (Monica is shocked and looks around.) We are gathered here today, to join this man
and this woman in the bonds of holy matrimony. I’ve known Monica and Chandler for a
long time, and I can not imagine two people more perfect for each other. And now,
as I’ve left my notes in my dressing room. We shall proceed to the vows. Monica?
(She turns to get her vows from Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Rachel) He took off?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Go on! Go on. (She turns back to Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, for so long I…I wondered if I would ever find my prince,
my soul mate. Then three years ago, at another wedding I turned to a friend for comfort.
And in stead, I found everything that I’d ever been looking for my whole life. And
now…here we are…with our future before us…and I only want to spend it with
you, my prince, my soul mate, my friend. Unless you don’t want to. You go!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler?
(Ross leans in to give Chandler his vows.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) No, that’s okay. (Ross nods and retreats.) Monica I
thought this was going to be the most difficult thing I ever gonna had to do. But when I
saw you walking down that aisle I realized how simple it was. I love you. Any surprises
that come our way it’s okay, because I will always love you. You are the person I was
meant to spend the rest of my life with. You wanna know if I’m sure? (He leans in and
kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You may not kiss the bride. So, I guess by the powers vested in my by the
state of New York and the Internet guys, I now pronounce you husband and wife. Oh wait! Do
you take each other?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah you do!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rings?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aw crap! Okay—uh…uh let’s-let’s do the rings.
(Chandler and Monica both turn, take the rings from Ross and Rachel respectively, and
place them on each other’s fingers.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We good? Yeah? Good? Once again, I pronounce you husband and wife. (To
Chandler) Now kiss her again.
(They kiss and everyone applauds.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) I love you. And I know about the baby.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What baby?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Our baby.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We have a baby?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe found your pregnancy test in the trash.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I didn’t take a pregnancy test.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then…who did?
[Cut to Phoebe and Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh and they’re gonna have a baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.
(The camera zooms in on Rachel who has a very worried and frightened look on her face
and she slowly takes a deep breath.)
[Fade to black.]
Ending Credits
{Transcriber’s Note: There was no trailer for this episode. See you in season 8;
which will start this fall.}

title: The One After 'I Do'

lines.text: [Scene: The Wedding Hall, Monica and Chandler have just said "I do," and the
photographer is taking the required pictures. First of Monica, Chandler, Ross and Joey.]

lines.speaker: Photographer
lines.text: Great. (Takes a picture.) Great! Just give me a sec to change
film.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Monica) Okay, I know I’m not supposed to know, but I do. And
I’m so excited for you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica’s pregnant!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God! Is that why you guys had to get married?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys! I’m not pregnant.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah. (To Chandler) Slow swimmers? (Chandler looks at him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! What do you mean? You-you-you’re not pregnant?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You didn’t tell anybody I was did you?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! (Pause) I’ll be right back. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Photographer
lines.text: Now why don’t we get a shot of just Monica and the bloody
soldier.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Joey) Oh, about that. Joey, you have to change before the party.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can’t! I-I don’t have any other clothes here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Find some! Please! Anything that doesn’t say I-I died tragically in
France. (Joey leaves to find clothes.)

lines.speaker: Photographer
lines.text: Well then why don’t we see the bride and the groom and the
bridemaids.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Phoebe and Rachel join Monica and Chandler on the altar.) Hey
Mon, why did you tell the guys you weren’t pregnant?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because I’m not.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We found your test in the trash, if you’re not pregnant—(She
sees Rachel shaking her head)—It’s because I am.
(Flash, the photographer takes a picture of Monica and Chandler’s stunned faces.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?! What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, I…I am with child. (Flash) And I didn’t want to say
anything because it’s your day; I didn’t want to steal your thunder.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute! So you told people I was pregnant?! (Flash) Does this
look like a conversation that I want to remember?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who’s the father?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t say.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t say because he’s famous.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, who is it?! (Phoebe rolls her eyes.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, come on, you have to tell us.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, okay. It’s James Brolin. James Brolin is the father of my
baby.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: As in Barbara Streisand’s husband James Brolin?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! Well he never said that to me!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: The Wedding Hall, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Photographer
lines.text: Why don’t we have Monica step away and we’ll get
Chandler and the bridemaids.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How about just the bridemaids?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know I am the groom right? I was told it was kinda big deal.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It is.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: For you. (Chandler leaves.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, thank you for doing that. I just can’t deal with this just
quite yet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So instead you told me Monica was pregnant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You said that she was, I just didn’t disagree with you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sneaky.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: Photographer
lines.text: Smile ladies.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! (They smile and the picture is taken.) Oh by the way?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: James Brolin?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I know. I could only think of two names, him and Ed Begley Jr. and
then I remembered he’s gay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ed Begley Jr. is not gay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (intrigued) Really?!

scenes.location: The Reception Hall, the party is in full swing.

lines.speaker: Bandleader
lines.text: Thank you very much! Ladies and gentlemen, it gives me great
pleasure to introduce to you for the very first time, Mr. and Mrs. Chandler Bing!
(They enter.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Before we go out there I’ve got a present for ya.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, I’m going to put my hand in your pocket!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ve been taking dancing lessons.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, the last six weeks. I wanted this to be a moment you will never
forget.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh that is so sweet!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So? Would you care to join me in our first dance as husband and wife?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes.
(They walk onto the dance floor and Chandler slips and almost falls.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know, it’s these new shoes, they’re all
slippery.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, are you going to be able to do this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not well.
(They start dancing and Chandler starts slipping around.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, the good news is, I don’t think anyone’s looking at us.
[Cut to Phoebe and Rachel at their table.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, are you ready to talk about it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, we’ll talk about something else then.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who’s the father?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh! Look honey y’know what? I haven’t told him yet, so until
I do I don’t think I should tell anybody else.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. That’s fine. That’s fair. Is it Tag?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I’m sorry. I’ll stop.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Is it Ross? It’s Ross isn’t it—Oh my God, it’s Joey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, stop it! I am not going to tell you until I tell him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah-hah! At least we know it’s a him.
[Cut to Joey entering wearing a preppy tennis outfit.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (seeing him) Oh sweet Lord.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sorry! Okay? I went down to the gift shop and it’s either
this or a bathrobe! Look, what’s more important, the way I’m dressed or me being
with you on your special day?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, I’m not even going to pretend I was listening. (Sees someone
else.) Hey! Hey! (Goes over to that person.)
[Cut to the hallway outside the room, Ross is going to see which table he’s at and
sees a beautiful woman doing the same thing.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi. I’m uh, I’m Ross. I don’t, I don’t believe
we’ve met. I’m Monica’s older brother.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh hi, I’m, I’m Mona from her restaurant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! Hello uh, Mona from her restaurant. (He uses his card to mouth those
words.) (Pause) Mona, wow what a, what a beautiful name.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: You think so? I’ve always kinda hated it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aw come on, Mona Lisa?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mona umm…Clickclocken. The famous botanist? Huh? Oh no she’s
uh—well she’s dead now. No, supposedly she was once quite the hottie of the
plant world.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Really?! Well see? I never knew about her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Linda Clickclocken. (Pause) So what uh, what-what table are you at? (She
shows him.) Oh, uh me too.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh good. Now there’ll be someone there who likes my name.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sexily) Yes there will. (Mona leaves and Ross tries to find the same
table.) Oh guess what, Molly Gilbert you’ve just been bumped up to table one. And if
it’s all right with you I’m gonna take your place at table six—Martin
Clickclocken.
[Cut back inside to Joey giving a beautiful woman a tennis lesson by standing behind
her.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s better, now just bend your arms a little more. There you go.
Okay, look straight ahead. Now this time I want you to really put your ass into it. (They
do a practice swing and she really puts her ass into it.)
[Cut to Chandler sitting down near Joey as his mom walks over. His birth mother, not
the mother who recently visited one of those clinics in Sweden.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Chandler darling! Look, my date has finally arrived. I’d like
you to meet Dennis Phillips.

lines.speaker: Dennis Phillips
lines.text: Congratulations.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Dennis is a dear old friend and a fantastic lover.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bravo Dennis thanks for pleasing my mother so.

lines.speaker: Dennis Phillips
lines.text: Oh, I’m so sorry I missed the ceremony, I was stuck at
auditions.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Oh yes, Dennis is directing a new Broadway show.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t believe we’ve met, Joey Tribbiani.

lines.speaker: Dennis Phillips
lines.text: Dennis Phillips

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow, I’ve admired your work for years. You-you’ve done some
really amazing stuff.

lines.speaker: Dennis Phillips
lines.text: Oh, thank you. Well if you’ll excuse me, I’m gonna go
get myself a drink. Be back in a moment. (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow Dennis Phillips! That’s great! How did you guys meet?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Bing
lines.text: Well, it’s a funny story.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Funny: ha-ha or funny: (Mimes blowing his brain out.)
[Time lapse. The band is finishing another song.]

lines.speaker: Bandleader
lines.text: Thank you, thank you very much. If everyone will please take your
seats, dinner will be served.
(Ross starts looking for table six and finds out that it’s the kid’s table.
He sees Mona sitting at another table.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Uh, I thought, I thought you were at table six.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: No, nine. (Shows him the card again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh see, before you uh, when you showed it to me you-you held it that way
(he turns her hand upside down) which uh, which was misleading. Well I’m… (He
goes at sits down at his new table and the kids stare at him.) Hello.
[Cut to the hallway, Chandler is putting tape on the bottom of his shoes.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler. Will you see if your mom can give my resume to Dennis Phillips?
‘Cause if I can get in a Broadway show then I would’ve done it all, film,
television, and theater. The only think left would be radio, and that’s just for ugly
people.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What size shoes do you wear?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, eleven, eleven and a half.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great, because my shoes are giving me a little problem on the dance
floor, can I borrow the boots from your costume?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, I don’t even really know where I left those. Sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking at Joey’s feet) Those aren’t eleven and a half.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay fine! I’m a seven! All right, I have surprisingly small feet.
But the rest of me is good, I’ll show ya!
[Cut to Monica and Rachel at their table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can you believe Phoebe got pregnant?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh y’know what honey? Let’s not talk about that right now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is so huge.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure, but come on, as big as your wedding?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course not nothing is. Between me and you…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: …in this day and age how dumb do you have to be to get pregnant?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Y’know, sometimes you can do everything right, everyone can
wear everything they’re supposed to wear, and one of those little guys just gets
through!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know! Maybe they have tools.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well I-I talked to and uh, she’s definitely going to have this
baby. Y’know, she said she was gonna raise it on her own.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, maybe that’s, maybe that’s really brave.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe. I just hope she realizes how hard it’s gonna be.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Maybe she hasn’t really thought it through that well.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, there’s a lot to think about. I mean, how is she, how is she
going to handle this financially? How is she going to juggle work? Does she realize
she’s not going to have a date again for the next eighteen years?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starting to cry) I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-hmm. I’m just thinking about Phoebe; poor knocked up Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Champagne?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yes! Thank you very much! (She grabs a glass, takes a sip, and
realizes what she just did. She then tries to spit the champagne back into the glass
without Monica noticing. It doesn’t work.) Oh that’s-that’s actually how
the French drink it.
(Monica gasps.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: continued from earlier, only now Phoebe joins them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I just got off the phone with my lover, James Brolin…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, and apparently he is married to some singer, but he said he would
leave her for me. And I said, "James, James Brolin, are you sure?" James Brolin
said…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) Rachel’s really the one who’s pregnant.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (shocked) What?! (deadpan) Why bother?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How do you feel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know. I don’t know how I feel. This is all happening
so fast. I have to make all these decisions that I don’t want to make. (Takes another
sip of champagne and spits it back out) Somebody just take this away from me!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Calm down. Maybe you’re not pregnant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: When I got pregnant with the triplets, I took that test like three times
just to make sure.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! Maybe it’s a false positive. Are you sure you peed on the
stick right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How many ways are there to do that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m-I’m just saying, don’t freak out until you’re a
hundred percent sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I’ll-I’ll take it again when I get home.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You-you gotta take it now. Come on, do it as a present to me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’ll run out and get you one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you guys are so great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, wait a minute! Who’s is the father?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, she won’t tell us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, come on it’s my wedding! That can be my present.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh—Hey, I just gave you peeing on a stick.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: See? This is why you register.
[Cut to Ross at the kiddie table. He reaches for something and a fart noise emanates
which causes the kids to laugh.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was the chair again! Okay? I’m not doing it! It what—look, I
don’t—y’know what—eh-eh… (He walks away and goes over to Mona.)
Hi.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, would you like to dance?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh great! (They get up to dance and Ross is interrupted by a little girl.)

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.text: Dr. Geller?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I wasn’t farting! (To Mona) Uh, a little game from our table. (To the
little girl) Yes?

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.text: Dr. Geller, will you dance with me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh umm, well uh, maybe-maybe later. Right now, I’m about to dance
with this lady.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.text: Okay. (She drops her head in disappointment and walks away.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Ohhhh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, unless! Unless, uh this lady wouldn’t mind letting you go first.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I’d be happy to. (To Ross) You are very sweet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes I-I am. In fact umm hey, why don’t we try it my special way? You
can dance on my feet.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Hop on. (They start dancing and Mona sits down.) Is the pretty lady
looking?

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Keep dancing.
[Cut to Chandler in the hallway practicing dancing and is doing it very well.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And the world will never know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Did you talk to Dennis about me yet?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, I told him how talented you were. I told him all about Days Of
Our Lives.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no! No! No! You don’t tell a Broadway guy that! Now he just thinks
I’m a soap actor.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But you’re not just a soap actor. You are a soap actor
with freakishly tiny feet.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!
[Joey walks back inside just as Ross’s dance is finishing.]

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no, thank you Miranda.

lines.speaker: Little Girl
lines.text: Melinda!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. (Walks over to Mona.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: How cute was that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh, were you, were you watching?
(Another little girl walks over to him.)

lines.speaker: Second Girl
lines.text: Can I go next?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Of course you can! Hop on!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Okay, but I get to hop on after her. (Ross bites the air in response.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am so gonna score.

lines.speaker: Second Girl
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I like your bow.
[Behind them, Joey goes up to the bandleader and interrupts the song.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (clinks his glass) I’d like to propose a toast. To Monica and
Chandler, the greatest couple in the world. And my best friends. Now, my when I first
found out they were getting married I was, I was a little angry. I was like, (overly
angry) "Why God? Why? How can you take them away from me?!" But then I thought
back over all our memories together, some happy memories. (Does a fake laugh.) And-and
there was some sad memories. (Starts to break down and cry.) I’m sorry. And-and some
scared memories—Whoa! (He jumps back, startled.) Eh? And then, and then I realized
I’ll always be their friend, their friend who can speak in many dialects and has
training in stage combat and is willing to do partial nudity. (Starts to walk away, but
realizes something.) Oh! To the happy couple!
[Time Lapse, the interrupted song is finishing.]

lines.speaker: Bandleader
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the second girl) That was very nice Ashley.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: Can we do it again?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no. (Walks over to Mona again.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: So, is it my turn now?
(A large little fat girl walks over.)

lines.speaker: Fat Girl
lines.text: I’m next!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! (Recoils in horror.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Uh, that’s okay. You can dance with her first.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you-you sure? (She nods yes.) Okay. (To the girl) Okay. So what’s
uh, what’s your name.

lines.speaker: Fat Girl
lines.text: Gert!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s, that’s pretty. (They start to dance and Gert tries to
step on Ross’s feet, but he pulls them out of harm’s way.) Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!
What are you doing there Gert?

lines.speaker: Gert
lines.text: Dancing on your feet! Like the other girls did it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (Swallows hard.) Hop on Gert. (She does and Ross winces in pain.)

lines.speaker: Gert
lines.text: Why aren’t you moving your feet?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m trying. (He strains to move his feet.)

lines.speaker: Gert
lines.text: Faster! You’re not going fast enough!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe I should stand on your feet! (Gert’s shocked and Ross realizes
what he said and tries to brush it off.)
[Cut to Joey going over to talk to Dennis Phillips.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So did you uh, happen to catch my toast up there?

lines.speaker: Dennis Phillips
lines.text: Oh my God, that was for my benefit?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I’d like to think there was something for everyone. Look, I
know you’re casting for this new show…

lines.speaker: Dennis Phillips
lines.text: Look umm Joey, I-I don’t think you’re quite right for
this project.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, see that’s where you’re wrong. Whatever it is I can do it.
And if didn’t see it up there, just-just try me.

lines.speaker: Dennis Phillips
lines.text: It’s an all Chinese cast. Can you be Chinese?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well I’m not proud of this, but… (He turns around and starts to
mess with his eyelids.)

lines.speaker: Dennis Phillips
lines.text: Oh my God! No-no-no! Please! Please!
[Cut to Monica walking up to Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, are you ready to get back on the dance floor?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did it turn into sand?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh come on, I love this song! Come on, you’ll be fine. (She starts
to walk towards the floor.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sliding up behind her) No. No, I won’t. Do you know why I took
all those lessons? See, for the first time I didn’t want you to be embarrassed to be
seen on the dance floor with some clumsy idiot.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh sweetie, you can never embarrass me. (Chandler grunts.) Okay, you can
easily embarrass me. But come on, it doesn’t matter. All right? I married you! So I
want to dance on my wedding night with my husband. Come on. (They go onto the floor.) Just
try not to move your feet at all. (Chandler starts to get into the groove and bust a
move.) There you go.
(Mr. Geller dances over.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Chandler, I’m gonna have you arrested.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: You stole my moves. (He starts to dance like Chandler was and
Chandler stops.)
[Scene: The Women’s Restroom, Rachel and Phoebe are waiting for the outcome of
Rachel’s second test.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How much longer?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: 30 seconds.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: 30 seconds, okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Did I miss it? (Phoebe nods no.) Rachel, I-I want you to know
that, if it’s positive, we’re gonna…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh I know. I know. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s time.
(Another woman starts to enter.)

lines.speaker: The Girls
lines.text: No!! (The woman backs out.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Go ahead Rach.
(She goes over to look.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wait! Y’know what? I can’t, I can’t look at it. I
can’t. Somebody else tell me, somebody tell me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, it’s negative.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s negative.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Oh. Well there you go. Whew! (Pause) That is—that’s
great—that is really great-great news. (Pause) Y’know ‘cause the whole not
being ready and kinda the financial aspects, all that. Whew. Wow, this is so just the way
it was supposed to be. (Starts to cry.) God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well… Well, great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Here. (Gives Rachel a tissue.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks. (Crying) God this is so stupid! (Pause) How could I be upset
over something I never had? It’s negative?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it’s positive.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s-it’s not negative, it’s positive.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well yeah, I lied before.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now you know how you really feel about it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-oh, that’s a risky little game!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you really gonna do this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. I’m gonna have a baby. I’m gonna have a baby. I’m
gonna have a baby! (They all hug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: With who?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, it’s still not the time.
Dedicated to the People of New York City

title: The One with the Red Sweater

scenes.location: The Hotel Lobby, Rachel and Phoebe are at the front desk checking out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Listen y’know what sir? For the last time, I don’t care what
the computer says, we did not take a bag of Mashuga nuts from the mini-bar and we did not
watch Dr. Do-Me-A-Little!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Joey uh, were you in our room last night?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. (Phoebe grabs the receipt and shows it to Joey who gets mad.) I was
told the name of the movie would not appear on the bill!
(Chandler and Monica enter.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to the front desk clerk) Hi! We’re checking out of the bridal
suite.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (depressed) That’s right. I’m no longer a bride. I’ll
never be a bride again. Now, I’m just someone’s wife!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I’m the happiest guy in the world! (Monica goes and sits down
in a huff.) Oh honey, come on don’t be upset. We still have so much to look forward
to!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah, right. (Rolls her eyes.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We got the honeymoon.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s not ‘til Thursday.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The wedding pictures?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They won’t be ready for weeks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not the disposable cameras from the tables.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s true! (Happily) I knew I married you for a reason!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll tell you what, I will go get them developed and you can go
home.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
(Joey giggles.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? What did you take a picture of?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing! It was something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay Ross has the cameras, has he checked out yet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you joking? Check out is not ‘til noon and he has a good
(checks her watch) eleven minutes left.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross has never checked out of a room a minute before he had to.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, one time, when we were dating, uh we got a late checkout, he got
so excited it was the best sex we ever had. Until y’know, he screamed out Radisson
at the end.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, well I’m gonna get Ross, get the cameras, and get them
developed. (Joey laughs again.) 32 Joe. You’re 32! (Exits)

lines.speaker: Front Desk Clerk
lines.text: (To Monica) Here’s a copy of your bill.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh thanks. (Reading the bill) Champagne, strawberries…Oh my God! I
can’t believe Chandler ordered porn on our wedding night!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, that’s sad. Mashuga nut?
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Ross’s Hotel Room, he is letting Chandler in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey. (He sees that Ross is packing all of the hotel toiletries) Soaps?
Shampoos? Are you really taking all this stuff?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why not? It’s built into the price of the room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah but you don’t need—(Picks up something)—What is
this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thread!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Score! Where are the disposable cameras?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What disposable cameras?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The cameras? Remember last night I told you to take them?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No you didn’t.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Remember? Right before we cut the cake, I went up to you and I
said…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh yeah, you-you came up to me and asked if I could do you a favor, and
my Uncle Murray came up to you and handed you a check. And then you said, "Why do
they call it a check? Why not a Yugoslavian?" (Chandler laughs.) Yeah, then you did
that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you don’t have the cameras?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. Sorry man.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So? What? What? They’re gone! Monica’s gonna freak!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’m sure they’re still somewhere here in the hotel.
I’ll-I’ll help you look for them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: In-in three minutes.
(Chandler goes into the bathroom, closes the door, and then opens it again right away.
Ross looks up and hands him the toilet paper Ross already packed.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Phoebe is entering to see Monica sitting in front of a
mound of wedding gifts.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you gonna open the presents without Chandler?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! (Pause) But, they’re callin’ out to me! I mean this little
guy (Holds up a small one) even crawled up into my lap. Oh come on, Chandler wouldn’t
mind if I opened just one present! What do you think it is?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A little mirror that when you look into it you see yourself as an old
woman.
(Monica opens it anyways.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A tiny salt shaker!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohhh! My God! For tiny salt!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh wow! Okay. Well that was fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good. Okay, I’m just gonna wait for Chandler to open the rest of
them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whew. Although y’know, this is part of a salt and pepper set. I
mean… I guess y’know it may just count as a half a present. What do you think?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well I guess it’s okay to open one more if it’s part of a set.
Y’know, it’s probably this one. (Grabs another small one.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Or this one! (She grabs and starts to open the biggest present.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, how are you feelin’? Any morning sickness?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shh-shh-shh! The guys don’t know yet do they?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Joey and Ross don’t know anything and Chandler still thinks
that Phoebe’s pregnant.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah that’s right Chandler does still think I’m pregnant. He
hasn’t asked me how I’m feeling or offered to carry my bags. Boy, I feel bad for
the woman who ends up with him. (Monica looks at her.) After you of course.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don’t worry I promise that you will only have to be pregnant for a
few more hours, ‘cause I’m going to tell the father today.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, is it someone in this building? Is it that tall guy from the first
floor?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ew! No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! I think he’s cute.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well then you have his baby.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Believe me I’m trying.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow. Y’know it is so weird. I mean, you’re gonna tell this guy
today and he has no idea what’s gonna happen.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. You’re just gonna knock on his door and change his life
forever. You’re like Ed McMahon except without the big check, or the raw sexual
magnetism.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Uh-huh, I guess it is pretty big news.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Pretty big? It’s huge! God, this guy doesn’t have a clue!
He’s just walking down the street thinking, ‘I had sex with Rachel Green. I
rock!’ then bam! He’s a father and everything’s different.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well it’s only different if he wants it to be. I mean, I’m not
gonna ask him for anything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Then he still has this huge decision to make. Now he’s
walking around thinking, ‘Do I want to be a dad?’ and then bam!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What was that bam?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t. He got…he-he-he-he’s hit by a bus.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Joey, what would you do if someone that you slept with told you that
she was pregnant?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (warily) Who called here? Did she sound blond? Huh? Did-did-did she have
an accent? I gotta make a call! (Starts to leave) I shoulda never walked into that
Sunglass Hut!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Joey! Joey! No, it’s not you! You didn’t get anybody
pregnant!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Why would you scare me like that? What the hell is going on? (Pause.)
Is somebody pregnant?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah. That’s me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God Pheebs! You’re gonna have a baby?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. Yes I am. Oh my God, I’m gonna have a baby! (Joey and Phoebe
hug.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, wait a minute. Who’s the father?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You don’t know him. It’s not important. He wants nothing to do
with me or the baby. (She sits down like she’s pregnant.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well who is this guy?! Huh? Who is he? ‘Cause I will track him down
and kick his ass!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: David Lynn.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: David Lynn! David Lynn! David Lynn!! (Exits)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who’s David Lynn?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh some guy from my gym. A little annoying.

scenes.location: The Banquet Room, Chandler is under one of the tables as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Did you find the cameras?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. Did you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! And that’s why I’m under the table. Celebrating.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I checked in the uh, lost and found, I talked to the manager,
no-one’s turned them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well this is great. Y’know, those cameras were the only thing
that was gonna cheer Monica up today, she’s really depressed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now you guys just got married, why is she so depressed?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All my energy is going into not asking that question. I can’t
believe I screwed this up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry man. (Formally dressed people start to enter.) Here’s
a thought. This is the same ballroom. There’s a band. There’s gonna be plenty of
dressed up people.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you suggesting we dance our troubles away?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no-no, I’m saying we-we buy more of this (disposable cameras) at
the gift shop, throw our tuxes back on, and take a few pictures. All we have to do is make
sure not to get anybody else’s faces.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m just thinking about your new bride at home. Okay? Do-do you
really want to start your life together by letting her down?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Marriage advice? Really?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m telling you, this looks exactly like your wedding! Aren’t
these the same flowers?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know, Monica picked out the flowers.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What about the chairs?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She picked those out too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How about the place settings?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What did you do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was in charge of the cameras! Gift shop?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmm. (They head off to the gift shop.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is sitting on the couch as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Ooh, did you do it yet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, well what are you doing here? Are you about to do it? (Gasps) Is it
Gunther?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Phoebe, it’s not Gunther.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank God, ‘cause that hair on a baby…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe the father is not here okay? I haven’t told him yet and I
don’t think I can tell him at all now!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, let me think. I was walking down the street thinking,
‘I’m gonna tell the father today’ and then bam!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bus?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, you! Phoebe you freaked me out. You kept saying how huge this all
is!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well-well but it is huge.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, but I was just thinking about how huge this is for me. I
didn’t even go to how huge this was going to be for the father.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re thinking about this way too much. Just tell him and get it
over with. It’s like, it’s like ripping off this Band-Aid. (On her arm) Quick
and painless, watch. (Rips it off.) Oh mother of…See?
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Obsessive Monica has now opened more of the wedding
gifts.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Ooh-ooh-ooh! Are we opening presents?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No! I shouldn’t have even opened these! I mean I—Joey I am
out of control!! Joey, you have to do me a favor. No matter what I say, no matter what I
do, please do not let me open another present! Okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Give me one more.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (Hands her one.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh good, uh you’re here. Uh Pheebs? Listen uh sit down. I-I got
something I want to say.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. (She sits down like she’s pregnant again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm, now uh… It’s a scary world out there, especially for a
single mom. Y’know, now I always thought you and I had a special bond so… (He
goes to one knee and pulls out a ring.) Phoebe Buffay, will you marry me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Joey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hell yeah! I’ll marry you! (She grabs the ring and puts it on.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You can’t marry him!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey lady, your day’s over! It’s my turn!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?! Why can’t she marry me?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can and I will! (Kisses him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s not pregnant. It’s Rachel. Rachel’s the one
who’s pregnant.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe I think he would notice if you didn’t have a baby in nine
months!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s Joey! (Joey turns and looks at her and she mouths ‘I love
you’ to him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiles then stops) Now I can’t believe it! What? Rachel’s
pregnant? (The girls nod yes.) Who’s the father?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We don’t know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh… I wonder if that dude.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There’s a dude?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who? Who is it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: About a month ago this guy spent the night with Rachel, I didn’t see
who it was but… (He walks out and closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Was that story over?
(They follow him and meet him in the hall coming out of his apartment carrying a
sweater.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The guy left this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (gasps) Oh my God! I know who the father is… (She walks into Monica
and Chandler’s.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: People have got to finish their stories!
Commercial Break
[Scene: The Banquet Room, Ross and Chandler are in their tuxes and have started to fake
the pictures.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to another couple) Uh, excuse me? Could you take a picture of us?

lines.speaker: Woman At The Wedding
lines.text: Oh! Of course. (Ross and Chandler pose and she takes the
picture.)

lines.speaker: Man At The Wedding
lines.text: Uh, would you take one of us?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh… Yeah sure. (Holds the camera up to his face.) Click!

lines.speaker: Woman At The Wedding
lines.text: It didn’t click.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I heard it. I heard it.

lines.speaker: Man At The Wedding
lines.text: But there was no flash.

lines.speaker: Woman At The Wedding
lines.text: Why won’t you take our picture?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah. I’ll take, I’ll take your picture. (He takes the
picture with his finger over the lens.)

lines.speaker: Man At The Wedding
lines.text: Uh, your finger was covering the lens.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who are you? Ansel Adams?! Get outta here!

scenes.location: Outside Central Perk, Rachel and Phoebe are about to go inside.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, I feel really bad about how I freaked you out before, so I called
the father and asked him to meet you here so you can tell him. Go!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Hey wait a minute! Phoebe, how do you even know who the father is?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I may play the fool at times, but I’m a little more than a pretty
blond girl with an ass that won’t quit. (She takes the sweater out of her purse.) I
believe this belongs to the father of your baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God… Oh, he’s in there right now?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh. Now you can turn around or you can go in there and rip the
Band-Aid off. What to you want to do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, let’s rip!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, sorry. Yeah. (They go inside to confront the father.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Hey Rach.
[Scene: The Banquet Room, Ross is taking a picture of a plant, Chandler a fork. The
band stops.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why don’t you go up on stage. I’ll get a picture of you
doing the speech.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Okay!
(He goes up on stage, mimes like he's giving the speech, and Chandler takes his
picture. However, before he gets down everyone starts clinking their glasses for a real
speech.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Will the owner of a 1995 Buick LeSabre please see the front desk? Your car
is about to be towed.

lines.speaker: Anxious Wedding Guest
lines.text: (rushing up) That’s my car!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A ’95 LeSabre?!

lines.speaker: Anxious Wedding Guest
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A green LeSabre?

lines.speaker: Anxious Wedding Guest
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry, I meant a blue LeSabre.

lines.speaker: Anxious Wedding Guest
lines.text: Yes! Green-blue!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well go! Go move it! (He runs off.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, you ready for the last picture?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Get ready to run. (Chandler walks over to the new bride.)
Congratulations on your wedding. (He grabs her, kisses her, Ross takes the picture, and
they both run out.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: So, what’s this about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel has something that she wants to tell you and umm, I believe that
this is your red sweater.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: No. (Unzips his coat.) This is my red sweater.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no. Could I get anyone a coffee or…poison? No? Just for me?
Okay. (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: What’s going on Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing! Phoebe kinda made a mistake. But y’know you do wear that
sweater a lot, are you involved in some kind of dare?

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Y’know, I’m actually glad Phoebe called. (He pulls out a stool
and Rachel sits down.) I know we broke up because you thought I wasn’t mature enough,
but I’ve really grown up and think we should get back together.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s just not the right time.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: It is the right time. (Takes her hand.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: I’m ready for more.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Come on Rach, let’s give it another try.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m having a baby.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Oh. (He drops her hand.)
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You can go.

lines.speaker: Tag
lines.text: Thank you. (Gets up and hurries out.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Obsessive Monica has finished opening all the presents.
She’s ashamed of this, at least, because as someone enters…]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (throwing up the last present) I don’t know how any of these got
opened?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) You opened them all?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! I know! I am a terrible person! I mean, Chandler is never going
to trust me with anything ever again!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey! You got my parent’s gift! (Holds it up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. What is that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I don’t know. I think it does something to salami.
(Phoebe and Rachel enter.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! How’d it go?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. What-what did Tag say?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Tag is not the father! And Joey knows now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I do Rach. I do, and I so happy for you. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow, you didn’t even try to unhook my bra!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So are you ever gonna tell whoever it is?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I will. I’m just not up for it tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Rach listen, no matter what this guy says I want you to know
you’re not gonna be alone in this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen I uh… (He takes her hand.) It’s a scary world out there
especially if you’re a single mom. Y’know, I always felt like you and I have
this-this special bond. Y’know? So, (gets down on one knee again) Rachel Green will
you marry me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs, give me the ring back!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Joey, oh you’re so sweet. You’re so-so sweet, honey. But
I’m not, I’m not looking for a husband.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (heartbroken) I understand.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now, if you will excuse me I am going to go and lie down. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t say that didn’t hurt. But I’ll take you back Joey
Tribbiani.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh yeah. Pheebs, listen about that. I only offered…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! A Salami Buddy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There you go!
(Chandler and Ross enter with the new pictures.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’re back!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great! We’re hangin’ in the kitchen! (She drags him into the
kitchen and turns his back to the living room) Let’s stay in the kitchen!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s picture time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now you are going to love these.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (showing her the pictures) Here’s a picture of Ross. (Shows
another one.) And that’s me. (Another one.) And that’s me and Ross.
(Another one.) Oh-ho, that is a picture of our first kiss as a married couple.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! That is a great picture!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! Oh and interesting because I found the cameras in one of our bags!
(Throws them into his chest.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh, didn’t see that coming.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so this isn’t a picture of our first, but it is a picture
of my first kiss with…with this lady. Which by the look on your face I’m sure
you’ll remember. So we don’t need—(Rips the picture)—There’s no
need to have this picture. How about I take the real pictures and get them developed right
now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That would be a good idea.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Sees the living room.) You opened all the presents without me?!
I thought we were supposed to do that together!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You kissed another woman!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Call it even?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! (They high-five and he walks out.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’m gonna go get these (the floral bouquet he walked in with)
in some water.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait you stole those from these people’s wedding?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no, I took them from the hotel lobby. Yeah, they think they can charge
me for some dirty movie and a bag of Mashuga nuts, they got another think coming. (Starts
to leave.) Hey! My sweater! I’ve been looking for this for like a month!
(He exits leaving a stunned Phoebe and Monica.)

lines.speaker: Monica and Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (slow on the uptake) Oh my God!

title: The One Where Rachel Tells...

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Chandler are getting ready to go on their
honeymoon. Monica is entering from the bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Babe! Aren’t you excited we’re going on our honeymoon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah I am!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (singing) Bermuda, Bahama, come on pretty mama…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right. Get it out of your system while we’re alone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering with Phoebe) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Have a great honeymoon!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’d better go pack.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no, I already packed. The only thing I couldn’t find though was
your Speedo.
(Joey looks at him, Phoebe tries not to smile, and Chandler is shocked.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A Speedo? Uh, I don’t have a Speedo. I’m gonna go pack my
regular long bathing suit. (Goes into the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Oh good you’re still here!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I want to tell you to have a good honeymoon! (Hugs Monica.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I also wanted you guys to know that I am telling the father today.
(They all look at her expectantly) What? What? What?
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We know its Ross!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How?! How do you know?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It was his sweater, but—Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I so wanted Ross to know first, but I’m so relieved you guys
know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is so great! And I’m gonna be your baby’s aunt!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know! (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too! (Joins the hug.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m gonna be an uncle! Come here! (He joins the hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (breaking the hug) You’re all gonna be aunts and uncles.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but I’m the only one related by blood.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Great! So now that you guys all know you can help me. Give me some
advice on how I’m gonna tell Ross!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, what were you gonna say?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well I was gonna tell him that I’m-I’m gonna have the baby and
he can be as involved as he wants.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well that, that sounds good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah but how do I start? I mean, what’s-what’s the first thing
that I say? (They all pause to think.) Okay great! Thanks. (She starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Good luck!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, bye.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bye.
(Rachel exits.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey, what was that all about?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well I guess there is no harm in telling you now, Rachel and Ross are
gonna have a baby.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (in a high pitched voice) What?! I didn’t even know that—Why
didn’t you tell me?! (Pause) Why am I talking like this?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I didn’t think you could keep it a secret.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (in the high pitched voice) What?! (Normal voice) I am an excellent
secret keeper. I have kept all of our secrets.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What secrets?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no Joey, I am not going to tell you because I am an excellent
secret keeper.
(The girls walk away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (whispering to Chandler) You’ll tell me later?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You already know.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Joey and Phoebe are entering.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it's so romantic to send people off on their honeymoon.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know, Monica and Chandler are married. Ross and Rachel are having a
baby. Maybe you and I should do something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All in good time my love. All in good time. Oh shoot! I left my guitar
in their apartment. Well you can let me in later.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t have a key, they took mine to give to you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! They took mine to give to you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why would they take away our keys?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe they don’t trust us.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No that’s not it. They let me keep my key the last time they were out
of town.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You mean the time you broke the ketchup bottle and cleaned it up with
Monica’s guest towels?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I washed those!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No you didn’t.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah that didn’t sound like me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, what am I gonna do? I really need my guitar!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I have stuff in there too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What stuff?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica’s chicken parm! I’ll take care of it. (He picks up the
phone) Hey Mr. Treeger, it’s Joey Tribbiani. Listen, I need to get into Monica and
Chandler’s apartment. It’s an emergency. (Listens) Uhh, gas leak! Yeah oh, and
bring garlic bread. (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Did Rachel find you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh she was looking for you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh well, I guess I’ll catch up with her later.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, she really wanted to talk to you now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it seemed pretty important.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think I might know what this is about.
(Phoebe and Joey trade looks)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Uh, uh we promised we weren’t gonna tell anybody this but uh,
about a month ago Rachel and I slept together.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (deadpan) And?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! I thought you would be a little more shocked.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh sorry. (Shocked) And?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, we-we said we’d just do it that one time but, but now I think
she may wanna start things up again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I don’t think that’s what it is.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why? What-what else could it be?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh wow, I don’t feel well.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m telling you. I’m telling you. That’s what it is. No
wonder she was looking at me all funny during the wedding. She didn’t say anything to
you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Joey) Maybe it’s something you ate?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Please, just-just, just go and talk to Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I guess I should. (Starts to leave.) Man, y’know what I have to
realize? Maybe I’m just not the type of guy women can have just one night with.
Y’know, they-they always seem to want a little bit more. I should remember that. (He
pauses and then exits.)
[Scene: The Airport Ticket Counter, Monica and Chandler are standing in line behind
another couple kissing who are next in line to be served.]

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: Next?
(The kissing couple doesn’t move.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They’re kissing let’s just go around them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh honey, leave them alone, they’re in love.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m in love too! But in an orderly fashion.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: Next?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the couple) Hi! Can you do that and walk? ‘Cause she
said, "Next."
(The couple moves up to the counter.)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Sorry. We didn’t hear you; we’re on our honeymoon.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: Oh, let me see what I can do. (Checks the computer) There are some
first class seats available.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Did you hear that?! They bumped them up to first class
because they are on their honeymoon! Come on! Let’s act like we’re on our
honeymoon.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We are on our honeymoon.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Grab my ass!

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: Next?
(They go up to the counter.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, sorry. I almost didn’t hear you, because y’know I’m
just so in love with my new husband. We’re on our honeymoon.

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: Congratulations. Okay, Mr. Bing you’ll be in 25J and Mrs.
Bing you’ll be in 25K.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no, you see we’re on our honeymoon. So umm, can you do your
little thing and bump us up to first class?

lines.speaker: Ticket Agent
lines.text: I’m sorry, all our first class seats are taken. That couple
got the last two.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You see, if we’d gone around them like I said, we—She
would’ve given us those tickets. Damnit!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: 25J and K, any chance those aren’t together?
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Phoebe and Joey are playing Rock ‘em, Sock ‘em
Robots.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I still can’t believe they took away my key. You trust me with yours.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course I do! And I’m gonna give it back to you as soon as
they’re done with it at the key shining place.
(They hear a knocking sound coming from the hallway and go to investigate.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What the hell is that?
(They go into the hallway and see Mr. Treeger watching one of New York’s bravest
breakdown Monica and Chandler’s door with an ax.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! Treeger, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: You said there was a gas leak in here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well why don’t you use your key?

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: Because by the time I find it on this thing (Holds up a huge key
ring with a thousand keys on it), the whole place might have exploded. If that happens at
another building that I manage, people are gonna start asking questions. (To the fireman)
Come on! Hurry up.
(With a final swing the door gives way.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! We could have done that.
[Scene: The Airport, Chandler and Monica are following the previous couple through a
tiny hallway that proves this is a set on a sound stage and not an actual airport, and see
them enter the first class lounge.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look at that! Look at that! They’re going into the first class
lounge! Do you know what they have in there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Me neither! We have to get in! (She runs through the door with Chandler
in tow.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Just act like you belong.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Oranges!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Shh! (To the guy behind the counter) Nice to see you again. (They
tries to walk past him.)

lines.speaker: Airline Employee
lines.text: Uh sir, may I see your tickets please?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, of course. (Shows him the tickets.)

lines.speaker: Airline Employee
lines.text: I’m sorry, would you move your thumb? I can’t see
the seat number.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s all right, I have it memorized. It’s 1A.

lines.speaker: Airline Employee
lines.text: (grabbing the ticket from him) Sir, this is not a first class
ticket. I’m sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Apology accepted. Excuse us. (They try to enter again.)

lines.speaker: Airline Employee
lines.text: Sir! I’m afraid I’m gonna have to ask you to leave.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine. (Starts to walk away then she runs over and grabs an orange before
she exits.) Go! Go! Go!
[Scene: The Hallway Outside Ross’s Apartment, Ross is walking towards his
apartment and sees Rachel sitting in front of the door.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (seeing him) Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. (He helps her up.) Umm, I think there’s something that we
really need to talk about.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (quietly confident) I think we do. Why don’t we go inside? (They go
inside.) Look uh, I know why you’re here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, and to save you from any embarrassment umm, I think maybe I should
talk first.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (warily) Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (He sits her down in a chair.) Uh, Ross and Rachel. Rachel and Ross.
That’s been one heck of a see-saw hasn’t it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (confused) What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I mean look, that-that one night we had was fun and…and certainly
passionate, but don’t you think it’s better if we just stayed friends?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Seriously. What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Y’know what? If you want to, we can do it one more time.
I mean I’d-I’d be okay with that. In fact, I have some time right now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y’know what? Can I, can I talk now?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh sure. (He sits on the apothecary table and touches her hand.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (touches his knee) I’m pregnant. (Ross stops.) Ross? (Ross is
staring off into space.) Ross? (Ross is still frozen) Okay, whenever you’re ready.
(Sits back and opens her magazine.) And you’re the father by the way—but you got
that…
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Ross's Apartment, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (closes her magazine) Can I get you some water?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m good. I’m good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, there is no pressure on you. Okay? I mean you can as involved as
you want. (Ross nods.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I need uh… I’m just—I don’t know—I
don’t understand, umm, how this happened? We-we used a condom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. I know, but y’know condoms only work like 97% of the time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What? What?!! Well they should put that on the box!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They do!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No they don’t!!! (He runs to the bedroom to check and returns with
his box of condoms.) Well they should put it in huge black letters!!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Ross come on let’s just forget about the condoms.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh well I may as well have!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Listen, y’know what? I was really freaked out too when I found

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Freaked out? Hey no, I’m not freaked out! I’m indignant!
As a consumer!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know what? Let’s, let’s talk later.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! I want to talk now! Okay? I—In fact, (picks up the phone) I
am going to talk to the president of the condom company!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, y’know maybe I should come back… (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (grabs her) Shh! Shh! Shh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stops) Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on phone) Yeah I’ll press 1! (Presses one which allows Rachel to
escape.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Mr. Treeger has finished inspecting Monica and
Chandler’s apartment.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: I’ve looked everywhere. There’s no gas leak.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (eating) Huh. So then I can heat this up? (Goes and does so.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: Anyway uh, I’ll get moving on that new door.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh great! And listen, could you do us a favor and not tell Chandler and
Monica about this? ‘Cause y’know umm, they don’t-they don’t have any
kids of their own and-and this door was like a child to them.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: Well I’m gonna have to put on a new lock, they’ll find
out anyway.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: (measures the top of the doorframe) Whoa! This looks like an all
day job, I’ll have to cancel my yoga class. (Ross walks up.) Hey Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: Could you tell Jasmine that I won't make it to yoga class today?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Mr. Treeger
lines.text: Namaste. (Bows.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Namaste. (Bows.)
(Treeger leaves and Ross notices the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! What happened to the door?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So it’s noticeable huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, is Rachel here? I really need to talk to her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Didn’t you two already talk?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah but uh… Okay, okay look you guys know that Rachel and I slept
together, but there’s something else. (Pause) Rachel’s pregnant.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (simultaneously) Oh my God!!! I can’t believe that!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (simultaneously) Holy mother of God!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: With my child.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is brand new information!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You already know don’t you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A little bit.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How are you doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Okay. I mean I’ll be okay. It’s just I don’t think I
handled it very well.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, what did you say to her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing. But the complaint department at the condom company got an earful.
And then when I turned around she was gone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But hey, in my defense I-I just found out condoms are like only 97%
effective.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I gotta go find her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa! Hey! Whoa!! Hold up! Are you serious?! So like 3% of the time they
don’t even work?! Huh? They should put that on the box!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Evidently they do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! (Grabs his condoms from his pocket and looks.)
[Scene: The Atlantis Resort, Chandler and Monica are arriving to check in, but are
behind the couple from before again.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t believe we’re here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh you’ve got to be kidding me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? (Monica sees the first couple and gasps.)

lines.speaker: Front Desk Clerk
lines.text: As a wedding gift to you, the hotel would like to give you the
honeymoon suite.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!! You have been screwing us all day!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’re you just ten seconds later!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! You already got the first class tickets; you got the lounge! I
mean we should get free stuff too! I mean you’re not the only ones on your honeymoon!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Well you can have the suite if you want. We don’t care about where
we stay. We’re here to celebrate our love together. We don’t have to get free
stuff. We just want to be together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks at Monica then at them) We need the stuff.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Joey is on the phone and Phoebe is watching him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Monica it’s Joey. Listen uh, Phoebe and I smell gas comin’
from your apartment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? Are you serious?! (To Chandler) Joey smells gas!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What else is new?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah and we’d go check it out, but you took away our keys.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well do something! Get in there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How? I guess I could break down your door.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! Do that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And-and you won’t blame us for any damage? (Gives Phoebe a thumbs
up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! (Pause) Are you doing it?! I don’t hear anything! Come on!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, okay I’ll-I’ll-I’ll break it down. (He hands the phone
to Phoebe, gets up, picks up a chair, and starts banging it on the floor.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hey hi, he’s doing it. He’s breaking down the door. (The
chair breaks in half.) Okay, we’re in. (She hangs up the phone.)
[Scene: A doctor’s office, Rachel is on an examining table with her legs in the
stirrups.]

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Okay Rachel, are you comfortable?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sighs) If I said I was, would you judge me?

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: The doctor will be here in a minute to do your sonogram.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (The nurse exits.) Oh man, I swear if they sold these at Pottery
Barn…
(There’s a knock on the door and Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
