lines.text: Uh we-we need to talk.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-uh-uh, right now? Because I’ve kinda got an el fresco situation
going on over here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please, please I want to apologize for the way I acted earlier today.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Ross that’s fine, but can you please stand near my head?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Oh yeah. (He moves next to her head.) I’m sorry. I mean I-I
think I went a little crazy. I mean I was thinking about myself when I (Wanders towards
Rachel’s feet) really—I should have been thinking about you Rach…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Head Ross! Head Ross! Head Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right! Right! I just—I want you to know that I’m going to be
there through this whole thing, okay? Okay? The doctor’s appointments, the uh, the
Lamaze classes, uh baby-proofing the apartment—Although we could probably worry about
that ‘til after we get married.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What married?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well yeah, I think we should get married.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What, because that’s your answer to everything?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, because that’s the right thing to do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, maybe if you’re in love. But Ross, we are not in love, are
we?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No but…but still you can’t possibly do this alone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on Rach, you can’t even eat alone in a restaurant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m just saying if you can’t eat by yourself, how do you expect
to have a baby by yourself?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can too eat by myself!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: When have you ever?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: When certain people leave the table and I am not finished!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well certain other people take two hours to eat a bowl of soup!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh please, you inhale your food!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I grew up with Monica! If you didn’t eat fast you didn’t eat!!

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: (entering) Am I interrupting?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no Dr. Long, please come in. This is Ross, he is the father.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But not the husband, because evidently she can do this alone.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: Huh. Nice to meet you. I’ll get started on this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Rachel, standing by her feet) I don’t know why you can’t
admit that you need me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I do need you! I need you to stand near my head!

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: Okay, everything looks good. Here it is on the screen. (We see Ross
and Rachel looking at the screen.) Here is your uterus. And right here is your baby.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow. There it is, I see it.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: Congratulations. I’ll give you two a minute.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you.
(Dr. Long exits and Rachel starts to cry.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pretty amazing huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t see it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can’t see it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You-you just said that you did!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I lied! I didn’t want her to think I was a terrible mother!
I can’t even see my own baby!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh sure, come here! (Sits her up) Sure you can! Uh, look come here look,
(rolls the machine closer) it’s-it’s-it’s, it’s right there (Points).

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Oh, it’s beautiful. I see it now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I don’t see it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on! Come on! Here, okay-okay, you see this? (Points) This tiny thing
that looks like a peanut?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sweetie that’s it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s it? Well I saw that! Ohh-ohh-oh, thank you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re welcome.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! I can’t believe that’s our baby.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, that’s our baby.

title: The One with the Videotape

scenes.location: The Hallway, Chandler and Monica are returning from their honeymoon.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait. Before we go in, I just want you to know I love you. I had a
great time on our honeymoon, and I can’t wait to go in there and spend the rest of
our life together.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re really sticking with the shell necklace huh? (Points to
necklace of shells he’s wearing.)
(Joey and Phoebe burst forth from his apartment.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! You’re back! (Hugs and kisses all around.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi sweetie!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on in!
(They grab the luggage and drag it into Joey and Rachel’s forcing Monica and
Chandler to follow.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So how was the honeymoon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, so much fun. But the best part is, we met this incredible couple on
the way back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That was the best part? (To Chandler) Good honeymooning tiger.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, they were really cool. They were on their honeymoon too!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They’re terrific, and they live right here in the city.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, can we go call them? Is it too soon to call? I wanna call.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry, we’re just kinda excited because we finally have
a couple to hang out with.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A couple? Like two people? Like (points to himself) one (points to
Phoebe), two people?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is different! Greg and Jenny are in a relationship.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Greg and Jenny yuck! (Angrily) Hi Greg, I’m Chandler this is
Monica. Hi Monica, this is Jenny. Hi Jenny. Hi Greg.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen, they are really great. If you just got a chance…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what? Why don’t you just give us our souvenirs and get
the hell out of here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We really…didn’t get a chance to…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You have got to be kidding me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We didn’t get anything for anyone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hm-mm! Yeah nice necklace!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That you can have.
Opening Credits
{Transcriber’s Note: Tradition was broken here as there were no commercials
immediately after the opening credits, just more show.}
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Ross and Rachel are entering with the rest of the gang
already inside.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Welcome home.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, how was the honeymoon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was great! It was great! How about you?! I mean you’re having a
baby!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Look! I have a sonogram picture!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh great! (Shows them the picture.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross! It’s got your wavy black lines!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, so now that Ross knows can you tell us y’know how it
happened? I mean, when did it happen? How many times did it happen?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica! That’s not right! Start with where.
(Rachel looks at Ross and gets his approval.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well it happened about six weeks ago, and uh I had just got home from
work and Ross was already there ‘cause I guess he had been hanging out with Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re welcome buddy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (glaring at him) Yeah, thanks. (Joey nods no problem.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And so I had a lot of work to do so Ross, nice guy that he is, offered
to help me out. And then we had a little wine, we got to talking, and the next thing you
know out of nowhere Ross comes on to me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (laughs) Umm that’s…that’s a little misleading.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The lie you just told.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That-that you came on to me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There’s the one!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But you did! I mean, let’s be honest.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes let’s. Y’know what? Uh, it’s-it’s not important.
What is important is that, is that we’re having a baby. And it’s
not—Doesn’t matter who came on to who.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whom. (Everyone looks at him shocked.) That’s right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know you kissed me first.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What?! You were begging me to kiss you! You-you-you were sending me
signals all over the place!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I was sending you signals?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh please. Okay, anyone in this room think that I would send Ross
begging symbols, please show of hands. (Ross raises his hand and no one else.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what?! It doesn’t matter! It doesn’t matter what you
believe! What matters is what happened!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. So these signals Ross, explain this to me, ‘cause maybe I
need to be more careful. I mean, am I sending you these signals right now?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? Y’know what? Rachel, just-just drop it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No please, show me how I begged you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can show you, I have it on videotape! (Stunned silence) It’s an
expression.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, time has lapsed, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler, and Monica are
sitting at the kitchen table.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t believe he taped the two of them having sex!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! You gotta tell a girl before you tape her. Such a rookie mistake.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know who has a great video camera?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (nasally) Greg and Jenny?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you still wanna call ‘em? I wanna call ‘em.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let’s call ‘em.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Ask them if they brought their friends any souvenirs!
(Monica goes over and dials their number.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? (Listens) Eighth street deli?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, hang up! You get food poisoning just talkin’ to that place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Uh sorry, wrong number. (Hangs up)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here you go. (Shows her the number again.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Hello? (Listens) (To All) It’s the deli again!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! I’ll have a sandwich!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (hangs up) I don’t think this number’s right!
(Joey and Phoebe laugh.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You got fake numbered.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! People don’t do that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh I think we do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They gave us a fake number? Why? Why would they do that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know! You were a delight to talk to. You asked all those
insightful, great questions.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And you’ve never been funnier. Joke, joke, joke, you were a hoot!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what? Don’t worry about it, you still got me and Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Excuse me, I don’t want Greg and Jenny’s rejects.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Rachel won’t talk to me! She won’t even open the
door!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm, I wonder why. Pervert!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, listen I am not a pervert!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s like the pervert motto! Yeah! Yeah! They have you raise your
right hand, put your left hand down your pants, and repeat that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Filming Rachel is not something I planned. Okay look, here’s what
happened, and Joey you-you can back me up on this. All right, about-about a month and a
half ago I came to you with a problem? Umm, a personal thing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Personal thing? What personal thing? I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: About…about sex? (Joey looks at him confused) That I hadn’t had
sex in months?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) Yeah I knew what you were talkin’ about.
Six Weeks Earlier
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is reading a cereal box as Ross enters wearing the red
sweater.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you have a minute? I’d like to talk to you about something
I’m, I’m really uncomfortable talking about.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure. What? About uh, you showering with your mom?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I actually had a topic in mind! I’m, I’m kinda going through a
dry spell, sex wise.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, for like months?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Five to be lying, six.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Six months? Whoa that’s rough.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I mean it’s not all bad. I’m learning to appreciate the
uh, smaller things in life. Like the sound of a bird and the color of the sky.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The sky’s blue Ross and I had sex yesterday!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please, help me! I have a date tonight. It has to go well
okay—I’m scared for my health!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Umm…Ooh! Oh-oh, I got something. It’s this story I
came up with, very romantic. I swear any woman that hears it; they’re like putty.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? Well then tell it to me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Now you’re gonna want to have sex with me when you hear it, but
you have to remember it is just the story.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastic) I’ll try to control myself.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. (Clears throat) Years ago, when I was backpacking across Western
Europe…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (laughs) You were backpacking across Western Europe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Have a nice six more months Ross! (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stopping him) Okay! Okay! Okay. I’m sorry. Please, please, you were
in Western Europe and?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was just outside Barcelona hiking in the foothills of Mount Tibidabo. I
was at the end of this path and I came to a clearing and there was a lake, very secluded.
And there were tall trees all around. (Whispering) It was dead silent. Gorgeous. (Softly)
And across the lake I saw…a beautiful woman…bathing herself…but she was
crying…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (intently listening) Why?
[Scene: Ross's Apartment, Ross is on his date with Kristen and they’re drinking
wine.]

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Umm, this is great wine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s from France…In Europe…Western Europe. Y’know umm,
a few years ago I actually was backpacking across Western Europe.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-hmm—Wait! It gets better. Um, yeah I was in Barcelona.

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: I studied for a year in Barcelona. (Ross is stunned and worried.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway, umm so I was um, I was hiking…

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: I love hiking!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (whines) Oh that’s great! I was hiking along the foothills of Mount
Tibidaybo…

lines.speaker: Kristen
lines.text: I think its Tibidabo.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay! Do you wanna tell the story?!

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is standing at the counter as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa! What are you doing here? How did your date go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great! I’m across the street having sex with her right now. Your
story sucks!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Look, if it didn’t work it’s because you didn’t tell
it right! Show me how you did it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No, I don’t…don’t want to.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How long since you’ve seen a girl naked?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was backpacking across Western Europe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m not feeling it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was just outside Barcelona, hiking…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No! No Ross! I’m not hot! Are you hot?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s been six months! I’m always hot!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well you’re not selling the story! It’s like; it’s like you
don’t believe it! Look, I gotta go. I got a date, but try this. Do what I do when
I’m preparing for an audition. Okay? I’ll set you up with my video camera and
you can record yourself and-and see what you’re doing wrong.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’ll try that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right now… All right, you’re all set up. You’re good to
go. Just hit record. All right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. And-and hey Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, if you ever have any problem with the ladies you know I’ll
help you out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (trying not to laugh) That means a lot to me man. (Exits.)
(Ross pours himself a glass of wine, hits record, and sits down in front of the
camera.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello! Can I get you anything? Huh? Lens cleaner? Your battery okay?
(Rachel bursts in carrying two boxes and Ross jumps up.) Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank God you’re here! You have to help me! Were you just talking
to yourself?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s less embarrassing, yes. Yes I was.
(They sit down on the couch, which is in front of the still recording camera.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (voiceover) So when she came in, I got distracted and totally forgot about
the camera. [Cut back to the present day.] It kept rolling and recorded everything.
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we’re gonna need to see that tape. (They rest of them
agree.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, definitely.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What a great idea! That will get Rachel to forgive me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what? This is not fair to her. Let’s just forget the
tape!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you. (Joey mouths to Ross, "You’ll show me right?")
No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re right. (Mouths, "I know you’ll show me, right?)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey! No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Loud and clear! (Mouths, "You’ll show me," and nods.)
(Ross storms out.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica, Chandler, Joey, and Phoebe are now sitting in
the living room.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I still don't get why Greg and Jenny would give us a fake number.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know, if they knew what they were doing they probably didn’t
give you real names either.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, maybe people give out fake numbers, but they don’t give out
fake names.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah? (To Phoebe) Hi, Ken Adams, nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Regina Philange. (Ken and Regina shake hands.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I still don’t get it, we didn’t do anything wrong.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! Although, you did tell an awful lot of jokes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I thought you said those jokes were funny. Joke! Joke! Joke!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (rolling her head from side to side) Joke. Joke. Blah! Blah! (Joey and
Phoebe laugh.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well maybe it was all of your questions.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What about my questions?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The sheer volume, it was like flying with the Riddler!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. Was that another joke?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (angrily) Was that another question?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Is Ross still here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh no Rach, he’s gone. But listen, he told us what happened and it
does, it sounds like an honest mistake.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh really? Well how would you like it if I had sex with you and I taped
it? (Joey smiles luridly) Oh forget it! (Ross enters.) Oh there he is now, the father of
my child, the porn king of the west village.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, it was accident! Okay? I-I feel bad that it happened, but I swear, I
didn’t even watch it! Anyway, here. (He takes the tape out of his coat pocket.) I
thought you might be more comfortable destroying it yourself. (Tosses her the tape.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (She sets it on the floor and is about to stomp on it with
her shoe when the rest of the gang jumps up and yells simultaneously.) What? (They all
yell again.) You don’t want to see this do you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hell yeah!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am not gonna show you this!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Not the sex part, just the stuff leading up to it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Forget it, she’s destroying it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay fine! Fine! We’ll just have to think of some other way to put
the whole ‘Who came onto who,’ thing to rest! Come on now, think!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, forget it Phoebe. Okay? It’s Rachel’s tape and she can do
whatever she wants with it. And she wants to destroy it. So, end of story.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I wanna see it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Clearly you don’t want people to see this tape. Now I don’t
want people to see this tape either, but you so badly don’t people to see it makes me
want to see it. You see?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (confused) Are we watchin’ the tape or not?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t want people to see it for your sake.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahh, I don’t believe you. I think you don’t want them to see
you begging me. (Goes to put the tape in the VCR)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel, please…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, a little preview!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine. Fine, but I want the record to show that I tried to take the high
road, because in about five minutes I’m gonna be saying…(He laughs and points at
Rachel sarcastically.)
(They both sit down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, here we go. (Pushes play.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on tape) Hello! Can I get you anything?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Phoebe) I’m so happy!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, the scene is continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) Oh, thank God you’re here! You have to help me! Were you
just talking to yourself?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: There I am.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re gonna get pregnant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) I screwed up so bad, I told Monica that I would stuff and send
all these wedding invitations like weeks ago and I-I…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on tape) You didn’t do it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) I-I know—I had put them in…in-in my desk at work and
I completely forgot about them until today.
(Chandler is shocked and Rachel gets scared of Monica very quickly.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (taking Rachel’s hand) Sweetie okay. It’s okay. Everybody made
it to the wedding. I’m fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Kinda hurtin’ my hand though.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) (Ross hands her a glass of wine) I cannot believe that I did
this. Especially after Monica just went on and on and on about it! (Mimicking Monica)
"Okay Rachel! Here are the invitations Rachel! Now be very careful Rachel! Please,
drinking no liquids around the invitations Rachel!" (She tilts her wine glass above
and moves it back and forth across the invitations) Whoa oh! Oh-oh-oh!
(Rachel hits fast forward. Monica is completely shocked.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did you do it on our invitations?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pause) Not on the ones we sent out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, just the ones gave back to us and we had framed! (Slams the framed
invitation down onto the table.)
(Rachel stops fast forwarding.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) Can you believe this is already happening? I mean it seems
like yesterday they just got engaged.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on tape) I know. Hey remember…remember the night they got engaged?
How uh, you and I almost…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) Oh, I remember how we almost. Do you think we would’ve
gone through with it? Y’know, if we hadn’t gotten caught. Do you think we
would’ve done it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on tape) I mean I…I know I wanted to. I just, I just wasn’t
sure if you wanted to.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) Oh I wanted to.
(Ross and Rachel trade looks while watching the tape.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on tape) So we…we both wanted to.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) Interesting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on tape) Yeah. (Pause) Anyway umm, it probably worked out for the best.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) Oh yeah, sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, in about ten seconds you’re gonna see him kiss me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And in about five seconds you’re gonna see why.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on tape) Ross did I ever tell you about the time that I went
backpacking through Western Europe?
(Joey’s shocked and everyone else looks at Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, get ready to see some beggin’!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you came on to Ross!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now I’m so happy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you talking about?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You used the Europe story!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s the magic story you use when you wanna have sex!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How do you know about that story?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How do you know about that story?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I heard it from my friend Irene who heard it from some guy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (raises his hand) Some guy!! (Points to himself.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. No, she told me his name was Ken Adams.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (raises his hand and points to himself again) Ken Adams!!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is looking at the tape sitting on the counter as Ross
enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So uh, apparently people are familiar with the Europe story?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Listen about that, the whole uh, who came on to who thing really
doesn’t matter. I mean, I think it would’ve happened either way. I mean if you
hadn’t initiated it I-I-I know I would’ve.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It was an amazing night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was. It was an amazing night.
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You think it looked amazing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I uh… I don’t know. I mean I…I honestly didn’t watch
it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, me neither. Yet…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhhhhhh…that-that may be weird.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it would be really weird.
(Ross grabs the tape and heads for the VCR as Rachel goes over and puts the chain on
the door and locks it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good luck to you.
(Ross pushes play.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mind if I mute?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh please. (He does so.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, oh there go the clothes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are undressing very quickly.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Six months Rachel, six months.

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Ah. (Pause) Oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. We-we look…we look pretty good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s what I was gonna say.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh nice tan!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you! I had just gone to the beach that weekend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Have you been working out?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have been working out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? Wow, this is so much better than I…

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! Ew!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh that’s not pretty.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, make it stop!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Make it stop!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Have to make it stop!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!!!
(They both get out of the chair and run for the VCR.)

title: The One with Rachel's Date

lines.text: [Scene: Monica’s Restaurant Kitchen, she is frantically working and is handing two
finished dishes to a waitress.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, now this one is rare, this one is medium well! Now go-go-go!
(Phoebe enters) Hey Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey how was dinner?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Dinner was good!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m just saying hi! Now I’m gonna go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!
(Phoebe turns to leave but notices an attractive man.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To him) Oh, well hello there.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Monica) I didn’t see this on the menu.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh Tim? This is Phoebe. Phoebe this is Tim, my new sous chef.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, so you're Monica’s boss?

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Actually she’s my-my boss. Sous is French for under.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! I sous stand.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Tim? I need a calamari and a Caesar salad. And umm, could you get me
the pesto?

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh you…you made pesto?

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Yes I did.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Would you say your pesto is the best-o?

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: I…I-I don’t know, but I would say it’s pretty good-o.
(Phoebe laughs too hard.)
(Monica goes over and grabs the pesto.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I still need a calamari and a Caesar salad.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: I like your necklace.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I made it myself.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: You are so talented.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it’s no pesto.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, all right! Let’s just cut to the chase, okay? (To
Phoebe) You’re single. (To Tim) You’re single. (To Phoebe) He gets off work at
eleven. (To Tim) She’ll be waiting for your call. (To Phoebe) I’ll give him your
number if I can get one calamari and one Caesar salad!! (Everyone in the kitchen stops.) I
did not yell. I am not putting a dollar in the jar.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Chandler’s Office, he’s working at his computer as his boss, Mr.
Franklin, sticks his head in.]

lines.speaker: Mr. Franklin
lines.text: Wow Bing! Burning the midnight oil.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know me sir. Oh ah, I do have a question for ya. Do you know how I
get around the office computer network so I can access the really good Internet porn?

lines.speaker: Mr. Franklin
lines.text: You’re a joker Bing. (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s funny about that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (running up) Hey! Sorry I kept you waiting so long.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey that’s okay. So, where do you want to go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh ah, I think you know where I want to go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The Hard Rock Caf�?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Again?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!!
(They go out to the elevators.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m telling you, I like the food!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You like the Purple Rain display! (A guy walks up.) Hey Bob.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Hey Toby! Have a good night. (Walks by.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did that guy just call you Toby?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, he thinks that’s my name.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, why don’t you correct him?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh it’s been going on way to long now. Y’know, I mean the
first time he said it we were just passing each other in the hallway, so I didn’t say
anything. And then the next time he said, "Hey Toby, do you want a donut?" And
I-I wanted a donut. And now it’s five years later, the donut’s gone and I’m
still Toby.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Five years?! Chandler you have to tell him!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! That would be so awkward! Look—Besides, we work in different
departments. He’s on the sixth floor y’know? So he calls me Toby once in a
while. What’s the big deal? It could be worse, it’s not like he’s calling
me Muriel. (Chandler suddenly freezes into place.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (laughs) Muriel. Wh-why would he call you Muriel? (Ross realizes
something.) Oh my God! Chandler M Bing? It’s not just an M, your middle name
is Muriel!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Shh! It is a family name!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler Muriel Bing. Boy, your parents never gave you a chance did they?
[Scene: Days Of Our Lives set, Joey is doing a scene with a co-star as Rachel
watches on a monitor.]
Joey's Co-Star: Drake, I’ve discovered the reason for all your headaches
and memory loss.

lines.speaker: Dr. Drake Ramoray
lines.text: What is it?
Joey's Co-Star: Apparently your brain transplant was not entirely successful. It
seems your body is rejecting Jessica’s brain.

lines.speaker: Dr. Drake Ramoray
lines.text: Is it serious?
Joey's Co-Star: Not if we extract tissue from the original host body, synthesize
antibodies, and introduce them into your system, which could stop it from rejecting the
brain.

lines.speaker: Dr. Drake Ramoray
lines.text: Well that sounds simple enough, let’s just do that.
Joey's Co-Star: We would, but when we went to exhume Jessica’s body, it was
gone.
(Dramatic music plays and Joey does a little ‘Smell-the-fart’ acting.)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Cut! Very nice people!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) Okay, let me just get changed and we can go to dinner.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well don’t—What happened to Jessica’s body?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m not telling, you’ll have to see it on TV!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don’t know do you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, couldn’t care less.
Joey's Co-Star: Hey good scene man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey you too!
Joey's Co-Star: Alright.
(Rachel clears her throat.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? You weren’t in it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! (Motions to Joey’s co-star.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh sorry. Uh-uh, Kash?

lines.speaker: Kash
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is my friend Rachel. Rachel, Kash, Kash, Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Kash
lines.text: Hey! How come I haven’t seen you here before?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Joey probably thinks I’ll just embarrass him. Y’know, he
thinks I’m some kind of a soap opera nut—Which I’m not! I’m not.
Although I do know that your uh, your favorite ice cream flavor is butter pecan. (Starts
stroking his arm) And uh, and that your-your dog’s name is Wally. Well look at that,
I’m just stroking your arm.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (grabbing her) Here we go! Here we go! (Starts to pull her away from
Kash.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, we’re leaving. Bye Kash.

lines.speaker: Kash
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Say hi to Wally.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica is getting coffee as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! I had the best time with Tim last night. He is so
sweet! Oh, I can’t wait to get sous-neath him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I…I have to fire him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But why?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because he’s terrible! Okay, he’s slow, he burns things, last
night he lit my pastry chef on fire!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well maybe he was just nervous, y’know you can be very
intimidating. And besides I’ve met your pastry chef and she can stand to be taken
down a peg or two.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, now she has no eyebrows, mission accomplished.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But Monica, he loves his job so much! Can you just give him another
chance? Please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (thinks about it) All right, but if-if he lights someone else on fire he
is out of there!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s fair! Thank you so much. Thanks. Oops, it looks like when he
got the pastry chef he got you a little bit too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I paid to have this done.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Love it!

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is eating at the counter as Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh you know uh Kash, really liked you the other day. He said he thought
you were charming.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I thought I was a complete idiot.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I’m with you. He even asked me if I thought you’d go out
with him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Oh, I think I’m gonna throw up a little bit. What did you say?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I said no.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? I…I just figured since you’re pregnant you’re not
gonna be seeing people.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Joey, first of all Kash Ford is not people. Second of all, what did
he say when you told him I was pregnant?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I didn’t tell him. I didn’t know if you were telling people.
This is back when I thought Kash was still people.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good-good, don’t tell him. Don’t tell him. Just have him call
me okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach look, I really don’t think that’s such a great…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, you go do it! I’ll come back to that set! I’ll meet more
actors! I’ll meet ‘em all!
[Scene: Chandler’s Office Building, Chandler is walking by the elevators and sees
Bob standing there.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Bob.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Hey! How’s my pal Toby doing today?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If I see him, I’ll ask.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: (laughs) Toby!
(The elevator doors opens, Bob boards the elevator, Chandler walks away, and Mr.
Franklin steps out of the elevator.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Franklin
lines.text: Hey-hey! Bing? Was that Bob from six you were just talking too?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Mr. Franklin
lines.text: Oh then you know each other.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’re on a semi-first name basis.

lines.speaker: Mr. Franklin
lines.text: What do you think of adding him to our team?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bob? Ooh, working here with us? Everyday? Yeah, I don’t know if
he has what it takes.

lines.speaker: Mr. Franklin
lines.text: Really? They love him down on six.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But this is eleven. It’s almost twice as hard up here.

lines.speaker: Mr. Franklin
lines.text: Okay, I hear you loud and clear. Bob will stay put.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think it’s best sir.

lines.speaker: Mr. Franklin
lines.text: But we really do need to find someone up here. The work is
starting to pile up. I’ve got a stack of documents on my desk this high. (Holds his
hand at shoulder level.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what you should do, just toss ‘em in the shedder and
claim you never got ‘em.

lines.speaker: Mr. Franklin
lines.text: (laughs) That’s a good one. (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What does a guy have to do to be taken seriously around
here?!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is in the kitchen as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. Okay, I gave him another chance, but Tim has got to go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No-no! He is totally incompetent. I called the chef who recommended
him to me. He said, "Ha-ha! Gotcha!"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Okay, but you can’t fire him today.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because I’m dumping him today.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! You said he was sweet!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He is sweet. He’s too sweet. He calls me all the time.
(Mimicking him) "So did-did you get home from work okay?" "Did-did you get
out of the shower okay?"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just don’t pick up your phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then he comes over! (Mimicking him) "I’m so worried about
you." Uck! Be a man!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? So now I’m not allowed to fire him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You can’t fire him and dump him the same day, he’ll kill
himself.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay well then, I’ll fire him today and you go out with him for
another week.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you kidding?! Another week with that sip, I’ll kill myself!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay well, then we’ll both do it today and he’ll just have to
deal with it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. But the question is who’s gonna go first. ‘Cause whoever
goes second is the bitch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on! The boss that fires a guy that’s just been dumped, bitch!
And the woman who dumps a guy that’s just been fired, blond bitch!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wanted to do this days ago so I think I should go first.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, that makes sense. (Starts towards the door.) Ugh.
But—Screw you I’m going first! (She grabs her purse and runs out.)
[Scene: Chandler’s Office Building, Bob is standing at the elevators and sees
Chandler walk up.]

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Hey Toby, you got a sec?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure, what’s up?

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: I just had a meeting, I was actually hoping to get transferred up here, but
I just found out its not gonna happen. Apparently somebody thinks I’m not eleventh
floor material. Say uh, who the hell is this Chandler?
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is getting ready for her date and Joey is reading a
magazine.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, what do you think is a better excuse for why I’m not drinking
on this date tonight. "Umm, I’m a recovering alcoholic. I’m a Mormon,"
or "I got so hammered last night I’m still a little drunk?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering with a pizza and beer) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, what do you want to do tonight? There’s a Ukrainian film at the
Angelica that’s supposed to be very powerful. Interested?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. No. But I’ll go see a normal person movie with ya.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach? You wanna come?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, I can’t. I got a date.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A date?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Why? Is that weird for you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why no, it’s the opposite of weird. It’s-it’s uh, regular.
It’s-it’s uh, it’s mundane. It’s actually uh, a little dull.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s no Ukrainian film.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah—Ooh! Earrings! (Goes into her room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A date?! She’s-she’s got a date?! With who?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I set her up with this actor on my show.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You set her up?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey what-what were you thinking?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I was thinking that it’d probably be okay because Ross
hasn’t gone out with Rachel in five years!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, I’m not worried about her! I’m worried about my baby!
Whoever she dates my baby dates! Now-now where is this (makes the quote-marks sign) actor
taking them?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! I’m an (does the quote-marks thing as well) actor too! I’m
not sure. I think they’re taking the ferry out to some Italian place on Staten
Island.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A ferry? My baby is going on a ferry? Do you have any idea how dangerous
those are?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are we talking about one of those big boats that carry cars that go like
five miles an hour?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why don’t they just jump out of an airplane?! Huh?! That-that’s
a fun date! Or burn each other with matches?! That’s fun too! Whew!!
(There’s a knock on the door and Joey answers it.)

lines.speaker: Kash
lines.text: Hey Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Kash. Uh hey-hey this is Ross. Ross, this is Kash.

lines.speaker: Kash
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi. I-I hear you’re going on a ferry tonight.

lines.speaker: Kash
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A bit of a daredevil are we?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering from her room) Hey guys do you think this is too
slutty—Hi Kash!

lines.speaker: Kash
lines.text: Hey Rachel! You ready to go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! All right, I’ll see you guys later.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Have a great time you guys.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Kash
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes it is too slutty! (Joey slams the door before Rachel could hear the
entire sentence.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is reading a magazine as Tim enters.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: (walks behind Phoebe) Hi! (And startles her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Oh, I’m so glad you called. I feel like it’s always me calling
you. So, what’s up? Is everything okay with Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It will be…in a minute. Listen, Tim you’re a really great guy.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: It’s because I’m with you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Aw. (Phoebe gets a bad taste in her mouth when he looks away) I’m
just—I’m in a place in my life right now where I…I…
(Tim’s beeper goes off and he answers it.)

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Whoops. Sorry. (Looking at it, like a newscaster) This just in. (Phoebe
fake laughs.) Oh, it’s 9-1-1 from the restaurant, that means Monica needs me right
away. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh-oh no she doesn’t! I know what that is. You can stay.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Awww, I’ll miss you too Pheebs. (Starts to leave) And I will be
holding you, right here. (Holds his hands over his heart, blows a kiss to Phoebe who
catches it, and then leaves and Phoebe throws the kiss back.)

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Joey and Ross are having dinner.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what movie do you want to see—And not another one I have to read.
Okay? I get enough of that from books.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Books?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, car magazines, cereal boxes, but it’s like enough!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I tell you what. Why don’t we uh, why don’t we just stay
here? Let’s not see a movie, we’ll just hang.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And just wait for Rachel to come back from her date?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, if that’s what you want to do I’m not gonna say no.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude! What is going on?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just…I have to find out how it went.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This guy could be my baby’s stepfather!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They go on one date and you’re worried about them getting married?!
He’s not you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just—I-I can’t believe she’s-she’s dating?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well Ross, what did you think she was gonna do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know! I guess I just can’t believe any of this is
happening.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s just I always thought when I had another kid it would be
different. Now I-I love Ben, but every time I have to drop him off at Carol and
Susan’s, it’s like—It breaks my heart a little. I mean I’ve always had
this picture of me and my next wife in bed on Sunday and, my kid comes running in and
leaps up onto the bed. And we all read the paper together. Y’know? Maybe fight over
the science section.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s a nice picture. Maybe you can still have that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No I can’t. I mean Rachel’s out with some guy. My baby went
with her. If anything that picture keeps moving further away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, can I ask you something? In this, in this picture of you and your
wife, is your wife Rachel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It used to be. Now she doesn’t really have a face. Smokin’ body
though.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good call. Yeah. But, the face Ross, the face isn’t Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No but ahh! How much easier would it be if it were?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, but I don’t think that’s what she wants.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it’s not what I want either. I mean I-I can’t force myself
to fall in love with her again now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s okay Ross maybe you need a new picture. Okay? It’s not
gonna be what you thought, but no matter what there’s gonna be a brand new little
baby, your baby. Who cares what the picture looks like?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I tell you what. Let’s you and me go out and have some fun. Huh?
Whatever you want. Come on!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (checks his watch) We can still catch that Ukrainian film.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I said fun!
[Scene: Outside Chandler’s Office, Chandler is just about to go into his office
when Bob calls for him from behind.]

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Hey Toby!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Bobby.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: It’s Bob actually. Hey, you work up here, can you tell me where this
Chandler Bing’s office is?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh yeah. Yeah, it’s (Points down the hall) right, right down
there. (When he has Bob looking down the hall, he turns around and knocks his nameplate
off of his door.) Right there, yeah. Can I ask you why?

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: I want to talk to that bastard, see what his problem is.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay Bob listen uhh, I’m the reason you didn’t get the job
up here.

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Toby don’t.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bob!

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Toby! I’m not gonna let you cover for him. Anything you say right now
will just get me more upset with Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well that puts me in a difficult position.

scenes.location: Monica’s Restaurant Kitchen, Monica is waiting for Tim who enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: I got your page, is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh well that depends, how are things with Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Oh it’s great! It’s great! Thank you so much for introducing us!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my pleasure. Okay, I’m afraid I’ve got some bad news.
(Phoebe enters.) Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (simultaneously) You’re fired!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (simultaneously) I’m breaking up with you!

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m, I’m breaking up with you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re fired.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry, I’m just—I’m…I’m just not ready
for a relationship right now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah and-and I’m sorry too. But, well I just—I like things
done a certain way and the chemistry’s just not right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh that’s good, the chemistry thing for us too.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Wow! Umm, okay. Umm… (To Phoebe) I-I-I realize I came on a little
strong but, it’s only because I think you’re so amazing. (To Monica) And uh, I-I
just wanna, I just wanna tell you how much I appreciate you giving me an opportunity here
because I—you’re the most talented chef I’ve ever worked for. Anyway…
(Starts to leave and Phoebe and Monica trade looks.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Tim wait!

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, I think I spoke too quickly. There-there’s a learning curve
with this job and maybe we can try it again.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Tim
lines.text: Thank you so much! ‘Cause I-I know I can do better!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
(They both look at Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And Tim I just wanna say, good luck here. (Shakes his hand and leaves,
which disgusts Monica.)

scenes.location: A Street, Ross is walking past a newsstand and sees Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, how was the date?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well I’m alone and I just bought fifteen dollars worth of candy
bars, what do you think?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh. What happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I made the mistake of telling him that I was pregnant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, he didn’t uh, take it so well?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well better than you, but y’know still not what you want.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He got all weird and sputtery and then he said uh, "Yeah, I hear
those hemorrhoids are a bitch."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He sounds swell.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Doesn’t he?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, wanna…wanna a little cheering up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sit down.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(They sit on some front steps.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Guess whose middle name is Muriel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (thinks then gasps) Chandler M. Bing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah-ha!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God. (Laughs)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry about your date.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh it’s all right. I’m guess I’m just done with the whole
dating thing. It’s one more thing in my life that’s suddenly completely
different. This is hard.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah I know. (Pause) On the other hand in um, in about seven months
you’re gonna have something that you’re gonna love more than any guy you’ve
ever gone out with. Just wait. Wait until uh, wait until the first time your baby grabs
your finger. You have no idea.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks sweetie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You wanna, you wanna grab some coffee?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, I think I’m gonna go home and eat ten candy bars.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I thought I cheered you up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh you did, there are twenty in here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right. Good night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good night.
(He kisses her on the cheek and heads to Central Perk.)

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is entering and Mona from the wedding recognizes him.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hey it’s Mona! From the wedding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh hi!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! Uh…how are you?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I’m good except umm, you still owe me a dance.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh that’s right. Well uh, would you be interested in seeing a
Ukrainian film?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: (laughs then stops) Oh you’re serious. Sure!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great! Well umm…
(Ross continues to talk to her as the camera pans to show Rachel standing in the
doorway.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I think I might need one more cup of coffee.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure! Uh, let me get it for ya.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Okay.
(Rachel watches that and slowly backs out to head for home.)
Dedicated to the Memory of Richard L. Cox, Sr.

title: The One with the Halloween Party

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, everyone is there as Chandler and Monica enter. Oh, and Joey is
wearing a FDNY T-shirt to make this the first nod to the tragedy that Friends have made.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey you guys?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know it’s last minute, but we decided to have a Halloween party.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh good! (And there’s general excitement.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And everybody has to wear costumes. (And there’s general
disconcertment.) Come on! It’ll be fun!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’ll-I’ll be there. I mean I have to wear a costume to all
my classes that day anyway so…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please tell me you’re not gonna dress up like a dinosaur.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (exhales sarcastically) Not two years in a row.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I’ll come to the party but I’m not dressing up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You have to!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No way! Look, Halloween is so stupid! Dressing up, pretending to be
someone you’re not…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re an actor!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So Ross, are you gonna bring Mona?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, I think I will.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That hot girl from their wedding?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well hey-hey if she needs any idea for costumes, she could be a bikini
model, or a slutty nurse, or a sexy cheerleader huh—Ooh-ooh, Leatherface from The
Texas Chainsaw Massacre—No-no-no! Slutty Leatherface.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now wasn’t Joey hitting on her at the wedding too?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right! He was hitting on her, and I got her. I guess
the better man won. (To Joey) Please don’t take her from me.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: A Street, Phoebe is walking down it and passes Ursula.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ursula! (Ursula turns, smiles, and continues walking.) Wait! Err-err,
it’s me! Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Oh, I thought there was a mirror there. Okay, bye-bye. (Starts to walk
again.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait a second! So, what’s new with you?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Umm, nothing. I mean, I’m getting married next week.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah, it’s gonna be a small ceremony. Just family. (Phoebe
looks at her.) His.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh. Okay. Well, I’m really happy for you. (Starts to walk away.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Wait! If umm, if you want to come, I guess that’d be okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Sure! Why not? You could be my sister for the day.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Okay. Umm, y’know, my friends are having a Halloween party
tonight at my old apartment so, you could come. Maybe I could meet the guy you’re
marrying.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Huh. Well, I’m supposed to be working at the restaurant tonight.
I’m supposed to be working right now, so who cares.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: By the way, it’s a costume party.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Oh! Okay, so that’s why you’re… (Motions to what
she’s wearing.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looks down) No. But thanks. (Walks away.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, The Halloween party has started. Monica is setting out
some food as Rachel enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait! You’re supposed to wear a costume!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am! I am a woman who spent a lot of money on a dress and she wants to
wear it, because soon she won’t be able to fit into it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m Catwoman, who wants to borrow the dress when you’re too
big for it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Kids
lines.text: Trick or treat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Oh! Can I give out the candy? I really want to be with the kids
right now. Y’know, ever since I got pregnant I-I have the strongest maternal
instincts.

lines.speaker: Kids
lines.text: Trick or treat!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to them) Just a minute!!! (She takes the candy and opens the door to
two parents, a witch, a clown, and a cowgirl.) Look at you guys! Wow! You are a very scary
witch. (Gives her candy.)

lines.speaker: Witch
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you are a very funny clown. (Gives him candy.)

lines.speaker: Clown
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to the cowgirl) And you are so in style right now. Y’know, I work
at Ralph Lauren and the whole fall line has got this like equestrian theme going
on. I don’t suppose you saw the cover of British Vogue, but…

lines.speaker: Cowgirl
lines.text: (interrupting) Can I just have the candy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Sure. (Throws some in her bag and she walks away as Phoebe,
dressed as Supergirl walks up and eyes Monica who eyes her back.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah, Catwoman. So we meet again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So we do Supergirl.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it’s me. Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering from the bedroom wearing a big, pink bunny costume) Monica!
Can I talk to you for a second? Listen, I appreciate you getting me the costume…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Monica) Oh, you did this to him?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! I thought he’d love it! His favorite kid's book was the Velveteen
Rabbit!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The Velveteen Rabbit was brown and white!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it was either a pink bunny or no bunny at all.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No bunny at all!! Always no bunny at all!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You didn’t dress up either?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes I did! I’m Chandler. (Looks at Chandler) Dude, what happened?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How is that me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. I’m Chandler (makes a growling/gurgling sound at the end and
the girls laugh.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Chandler) That is so you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When have I ever done that?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: When have I ever done that?! (And does the sound again.)
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Trick or treat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! (Opens the door to reveal a ballerina) Well you’re just the
prettiest ballerina I’ve ever seen.

lines.speaker: Ballerina
lines.text: Thank you. (Pirouettes.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow! That deserves another piece of candy.

lines.speaker: Ballerina
lines.text: Thank you. (Does another ballerina move.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I have to say that earns tutu pieces of candy.

lines.speaker: Ballerina
lines.text: I love you! (Hugs Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh… Oh, honey here. Take it all. (Pours the entire large bowl into
her bag and closes the door.) Monica! We need more candy?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! There’s only been like four kids.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah I know, but one of them just said that she loved me so I just gave
her everything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No wonder your pregnant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey! (He’s wearing a costume as well.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you supposed to be?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Remember the Russian satellite, Sputnik? (They all look at him.) Well,
I’m a potato or a…spud. And these are my antennae. (Points to the colander with
an old TV antenna glued on top that he’s wearing.) So Sputnik, becomes…
(They’re still confused) Spud-nik. Spudnik!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! I don’t have the worst costume anymore!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sees Ross) Hey all right, Ross came as doody.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I-I’m not doody.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, space doody!
(Joey gives him the okay symbol, and Ross rushes towards him to be stopped by Chandler.
Meanwhile, Phoebe goes over to the snack table as some guy, which turns out to be Ursula's
fianc�e Eric, walks in and smacks her butt.)

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Aren’t you gonna give me a kiss?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I will. But right after you tell me who the hell you are.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Ursula?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ursula’s fianc�e?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Oh my God, you’re the sister!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Okay, I just slapped my future sister-in-law’s ass.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: I’m an idiot. Uh, is your mother here? Maybe I can give her a little
slap on the butt.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My mother killed herself.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: She, now I knew that and…now I’m sweating. Look at me, I’m
really sweating—Now I’m saying, "Look at me," I’m getting even
sweatier. I think I probably should go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no! That’s okay, we’ll just start over. Okay? Hi! I’m
Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Eric. (They shake hands and he’s squinting. And, no, it’s not
me.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: ‘Cause the sweat’s getting in my eyes and its burning.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Hands him a napkin.) So, what are you?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: I don’t think they have a name for it. It’s just I get nervous;
I start sweating like crazy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (laughs) No I-I meant your costume.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Oh umm, I’m the solar system. (He’s wearing a black sweater with
the planets glued on around the sun.) Yeah, my students helped me make it—I teach the
second grade.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I love the second grade!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! It’s so much better than first grade when you don’t know
what’s going on and definitely better than third grade. Y’know with all
the politics and mind games.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: So what do you do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, I’m a masseuse…by day. (Stands with her hands on her hips
like a Supergirl pose.)

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Y’know you don’t have to stand here with me, believe me…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No I’m having fun. I’m really—And I’m really-really
excited for you and Ursula.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Oh I feel very lucky, she’s great. I think she’s the most
beautiful woman I’ve ever seen.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you.
[Time lapse, Monica is going over to talk to Joey.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Joey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You read comic books right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Exclusively.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who do you think would win in a fight, Catwoman or Supergirl?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Catwoman, hands down.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But between you and Phoebe, I’d have to give the edge to Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! Really?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you kiddin’? Phoebe lived on the street. Okay? Plus, she’s
got this crazy temper. She—She’s not standing right behind me is she?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No you’re fine. (Joey checks anyway.) All right well, do you think
I could take Rachel?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m not sure.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! Come on I am tough! Punch me right here! (Her stomach) As hard as
you can!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Will you relax?! What are you taking this so seriously for? It
doesn’t matter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh really? Okay? Well what would you say if I told you that,
y’know, Ross or Chandler could beat you up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I would say, "Woman, please!"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (walking over) Hey. Ursula’s fianc�e is really sweet!
He’s a teacher, he does all this volunteer work. Y’know normally y’know, I
don’t like really sweaty guys. But this one? I could just mop him up!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re getting a crush on your sister’s fianc�e.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No I’m not! You are!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Monica) Here comes the temper.
(There’s a knock on the door and Rachel opens it to a little girl.)

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Trick or treat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Y’know what honey, we’re actually out of candy right now.
But someone just went out to get some and I have been giving out money but I’m
out of that too. Hey, can I write you a check?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, what’s your name?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Lelani Mayolanofavich.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I’m just gonna write this out to cash.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Mona!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Hi!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey’s gonna be thrilled! He was hoping you’d come by as a
slutty nurse.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Umm, actually I’m just a nurse.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’d think that would embarrass me, but you see I’m maxed
out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You made it!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Wait-wait! You’re umm, you’re a potato…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’m a spud…

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: And the antennae…Oh my God you’re Spudnik!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) Marry her.
[Cut to Joey and Monica.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, here’s a good one for ya. Who do think would win in a fight
between Ross and Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t answer that! Chandler’s my husband.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So Ross?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.
[Cut to Phoebe and Eric.]

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Hey beautiful.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hello handsome. (Sees Ursula over her shoulder) Oh God. (Walks away in
shame as they kiss.) Oh look at you two. So when did you guys meet?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Two weeks ago.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Two weeks? That’s it?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Yeah, I know it sounds crazy, and it’s not like me to do something so
impulsive, but she’s just so perfect, and we have so much in common.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh really?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: We’re both teachers.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh? (Ursula motions for Phoebe to keep quiet.)

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: And we were both in the Peace Corps.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Peace Corps, really? (Ursula motions, "I don’t know.")

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: In fact when we were building houses in Uruguay, we were, we were just two
towns apart and we never met.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah. It wasn’t a town when I got there, but it was a town when I
left. (To Eric) Shall we get me really drunk?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Sure.
(They walk away.)
[Cut to Mona and Ross walking past Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Howdy doody.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s funny. Yeah. Y’know you’re the funniest man here in
a pink bunny costume his wife made him wear.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh relax man, relax. You’re looking a little flushed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Monica) Hey-hey-hey, I think we might find out the answer to our
question.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What question?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica and I were talking about who could kick whose ass in a fight, you
or Ross?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There’s no question.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you think Ross too?
(Monica turns around slowly.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) You picked Ross?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross is really strong! Okay, he’s the strongest out of all three of
you! (Joey looks at her.) Except for Joey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I cannot believe you didn’t pick me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, in her defense, she’s right. I am stronger. I would destroy you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh really?! You think you’re stronger? Why don’t you prove
it? (He pushes Ross who starts to fall backwards until Mona catches him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh I’ll prove it! I’ll prove it like a theorem!!
(They start to fight with Ross pulling on Chandler’s ears and Chandler hitting
Ross over the head with his carrot.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait-wait!! Okay, stop it! Stop it! Stop! (Breaks it up.) Now listen, no
one’s gonna fight in this apartment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Monica! (Grabs her and pulls her into the living room.) People came to
see a fight, let’s give ‘em what they came for!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hey, you guys could arm wrestle.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Listen to the slutty nurse.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) You’re going down.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah? You’re going further down! Downtown!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Seriously guys, the trash talk is embarrassing.
Commercial Break
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, the party continues with Rachel leaning on the counter
as Gunther walks in carrying candy.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Gunther! You brought candy! Thank you so much for picking this up!
You are so sweet.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, someday you are gonna make some man the luckiest guy in the
world.
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Kid
lines.text: Trick or treat!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Gotta go! (Opens the door to a boy in a cape.) Hi! Wow! There you go!
(Hands him some candy.)

lines.speaker: Boy in the Cape
lines.text: My friend Lewis told me you were giving out money.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, we were but umm, now we’ve got candy.

lines.speaker: Boy in the Cape
lines.text: I’d rather have the money.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, that-that’s not your choice. Happy Halloween!

lines.speaker: Boy in the Cape
lines.text: This isn’t fair.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well is it fair that all you did was put on a cape and I gotta give you
free stuff?

lines.speaker: Boy in the Cape
lines.text: Shut up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You shut up!
(The gang gets interested now.)

lines.speaker: Boy in the Cape
lines.text: You can’t tell me to shut up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, I think I just did. And uh-oh, here it comes again. Shut up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Joey) Yeah I know—I’m good—I got it! (Joey slowly
backs away.) (To the boy) Now wait a minute, I’ve got one more thing I have to say to
you…oh right! Shut up!

lines.speaker: Boy in the Cape
lines.text: You’re a mean old woman. (Runs away.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Wait no! Shut up—I mean don’t cry! Let me get my
checkbook! (Grabs her checkbook and runs after him.)
[Cut to Mona and Joey clearing the dining room table for the grudge match between
Chandler and Ross.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) Look honey, you don’t have to do this, okay?
