It’s the strength you have inside that means the most to me. You’re loyal,
you’re honest, and you have integrity! That’s the kind of strength that I want
in the man that I love!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That means nothing to me. (To Ross) Come on!
[Scene: The Hallway, Phoebe is exiting Monica and Chandler’s, and finds Ursula
standing in the hallway smoking.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi liar!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know the only reason he’s marrying you is because he thinks
all the things you were saying about yourself were true.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Well they could be true.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But they’re not!

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Yeah, it’s a fine line huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why are you lying to him?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: I don’t know. He said he did all this stuff and then I said I did
it too and he got so excited, it was really fun.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: (entering) Honey?

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: (waving the cigarette in Phoebe’s face) It’s a filthy,
disgusting habit and I want you to quit now!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: She’s helped so many people to quit smoking.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Y’know, we’d really better get going.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Oh right, you’ve got a church group meeting tonight.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Right. (Walks down the stairs.)

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Well, it was nice meeting you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You too. And Ursula?! It was really nice meeting you tonight!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Pheebs come on! Bunny vs. Doody! We’re waiting! (They go
inside.) (To Chandler and Ross.) Okay. Okay guys, one match, winner take all. (They grasp
each other’s hand in preparation for battle.) Oh wait-wait! What does the winner get?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pride.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And dignity.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughing) Okay, if you say so. All right, ready? Set! Go!
(They start wrestling, only they are unable to move either one’s arm despite a
huge strain on their faces and a cheering crowd.)
[Time Lapse: the crowd has left and only Mona, Monica, Joey, and Phoebe are still
watching to see who will be able to move the other’s arm first. An event that has yet
to happen.]

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: (To Joey) Wow! They’re both really strong.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or equally weak.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Oh God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler’s making his sex face.
(Basically Chandler’s face looks like he’s not all there and is staring off
into the distance…)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) So, you gettin’ tired?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nope! I can do this all day.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Me too. (Pause) Gettin’ a little tired though.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: God, I’m exhausted.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look this is starting to look really bad for me. Okay? Mona, Mona’s
standing right over there. (Looks behind him.) Oh God, she’s talking to Joey! You
gotta let me win!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No way! If anything you’ve gotta let me win! My wife thinks
I’m a wimp!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, at least you have a wife! I-I keep getting divorces and knockin’
people up! And I’m dressed as doody.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re Spudnik.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, who are we kidding? I’m doody. Please? She’s
watchin’.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine. (He lets Ross win.) Oh no!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (celebrating) Oh yeah!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: (clapping) Yay! My hero!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to her) You’re a weird lady.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: (entering) Hey. Ursula said she left her purse.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: (finds it) What a relief. It has all the numbers of the people in her
prayer chain.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure it does. Yeah, yeah.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Well, I guess I’ll see you at the wedding. (Exits and Phoebe follows
him into the hall.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm listen, I don’t think…I don’t think I’m gonna
make it to the wedding. So I just want to wish you all the luck in the world.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: I think we’ll be okay. Besides it’s so perfect and (whispering)
she’s been saving herself for me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay I can’t let you do this! She’s lying to you.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She is lying! And I bet I can prove it. Excuse me. (She grabs
Ursula’s purse and starts going through it and finds some papers.) Okay. Okay.
Yeah—Not a prayer chain, but what looks like a detailed drawing of a bank floor plan.
(Holds up her nametag.) Okay, here’s the nametag from the restaurant where she works
as a waitress! Not a teacher, a waitress. All right, here’s her driver license, this
oughta be good, she always lies about this. How old did she say she was?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: She told me she was 25.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I almost don’t want to show this. (Hands it to him.) Just
remember I’m a minute younger.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: I am so stupid. Of course she was lying! She’s not a teacher.
There’s not such a thing as the top secret elementary school for the children of
spies.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. You’re not, you’re not stupid.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: I’m not smart. (Phoebe has no comeback.) I just wanted so much
to…be impulsive once. To be romantic.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s good, you should be impulsive and you should be romantic.
Just…you did it with the wrong person. (He looks at her.) What?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: It’s just so weird, two people look so much alike, and so different.

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: (yelling from downstairs) Eric!! Let’s go!!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: I’d better go, deal…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you should. (They shake hands.)

lines.speaker: Ursula
lines.text: Hurry up I gotta pray!!
(Phoebe hands Eric Ursula’s purse and he walks away.)
[Time Lapse: Rachel is returning from chasing down the boy in the cape.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Well, I had to give the kid fifty bucks to stop crying.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s not so bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I also had to go to a couple houses with him as his girlfriend. Oh,
I am just awful with children!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! You’re good with kids. They’re just crazy on Halloween.
Y’know, they’re all greedy and hopped up on sugar!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? You think that’s all it is?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Absolutely! Halloween is the worst. Except for Christmas…and their
birthdays. Kinda get a little crazy during the summer too. And anytime they’re hungry
or sleepy. Y’know, kids are tough. Good luck with that. (Walks away.)

title: The One with the Stain

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is sitting in the living room as Monica
enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.
(Monica notices something.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! You cleaned! (Gasps) Look at these floors! You did the
windows! Oh, I have been begging you for months and you did! You cleaned! And nagging
works!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know uh, I didn’t actually do this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no, was I cleaning in my sleep again?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, it wasn’t you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well then who?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I got a maid. Yay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shocked) I hope by maid you mean mistress, because if some other woman
was here cleaning then…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh honey, I know you don’t like to relinquish control…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, relinquish is just a fancy word for lose!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, she’s really nice. Okay? And she mentioned that she adored
the way that you arranged the sponges.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did she really say that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, I distinctly remember ‘cause I thought it was a joke. Now
just give her a chance, okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine, I can do it. (Gets anxious.) Whew.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, usually when I’m this anxious, I clean!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross, Rachel, and Phoebe are there as someone’s cell phone
starts to ring with one of those fancy ring tones.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looking around) Who’s cell phone is that? It’s just so
annoying; everywhere you go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think it’s coming from your bag.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (checks) I never get calls!! (Answers the phone) Hello?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Hi, it’s Eric. From the Halloween party, Ursula’s fianc�e.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God Eric hi! Wait, how’d you get this number?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Oh, I have a friend who’s a cop and he got it for me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! What an incredible violation—and wonderful surprise.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Uh listen, I just—I thought you should know I broke up with Ursula.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh you did? (To Rachel) He did it! He did it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! What did he do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shhh! I’m talking.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Anyway, I was wondering if, you were the sort of person who…eats
lunch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you asking me out? ‘Cause it would be kinda weird since you
just broke up with my sister.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Yeah uh…okay. I’m-I’m sorry. Bye.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Wait! I was just saying that so you’d think I was a good
person. Fight for me.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Uhh, I won’t take no for an answer.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not great, but we can work on it at lunch. Okay, I can be at your
apartment in two hours.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Great! But wh-wh—How do you know where I live?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’ve got friends too. Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Bye.
(She hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! I’m going out with Eric! Ooh, this day is really gonna
be so much better than I thought it was gonna be. Oh Ross, I can’t make lunch.
(Exits.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So apparently I’m available for lunch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can’t. I’m busy. I’m apartment hunting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re moving?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I can’t live with Joey once the baby comes. I don’t want
my child’s first words to be, (in a baby’s voice) "How you
doin’?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So does-does Joey know you’re moving?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I haven’t discussed it with him yet, but I know he’s
gonna be relieved. Last week, he brought this girl over and I started talking to her about
morning sickness and then I showed her pictures from my pregnancy book.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s not really porn.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Not so much.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, y’know what and if you’re looking for a place? I just heard
in the elevator this morning that a woman in my building died.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Was she old? Does she have a view?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I don’t know, but how-how great would that be huh? You living in
my building. I could help take care of the baby. I can come over whenever I want. (Rachel
looks at him.) With your permission.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah that would really be great.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well can we see it?! Oh maybe we shouldn’t. I mean if she just died
this morning out of respect.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. No. No you’re right.
(Pause as they both take another sip of coffee.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shall we?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.
(They both exit.)
[Scene: Ross’s Building, they are approaching the apartment of the woman who died.
Ross knocks on the door and a woman answers it.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi. I’m Ross Geller. I live in the building.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I’m Rachel, an admirer of the building.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I-I heard about Mrs. Verhoeven passing away and I’m so sorry for your
loss.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: She didn’t pass.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: My mother’s still alive.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, thank God!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: It looked like we were gonna lose her this morning,
but she’s a tough old bird.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ahh.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: Are you close with her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course! Uh yeah, she and I would talk all the time in-in (Rachel pokes
her head in and starts to look around) the laundry room. (Pushes Rachel out of the way.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: You speak Dutch? (In Dutch) Zeer vereerd een vriend
van mijn moeder te ontmoeten. (Translation: I’m very honored to meet a friend of my
mother.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know I would it’s just painful.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So she’s really not dead.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: No, she’s hanging in there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmm. Do you think—Could you tell me if she’s hanging in, in a
one bedroom or a two?

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is observing the new maid, Brenda, clean.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: Mrs. Bing, this tile cleaner is incredible! Where’d you get it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh well umm, I make it myself! It’s two parts ammonia and one part
lemon juice. And now the secret ingredient is…y’know what? We just met.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: Okay. Uhh, I’m gonna go get the clothes from the laundry room now.
And, when I come back I’ll clean behind the refrigerator.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) I love her.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: I’ll be back in a minute.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (As Brenda exits Monica notices something.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See? I told you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She stole my jeans!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pause) What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I have been looking for them all week and she is wearing them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So she stole your pants and then she came back and wore them in front
of you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don’t you see? It’s the perfect crime!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She must’ve been planning this for years!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I will prove it to you! Okay? About a week ago I was wearing those jeans
and I dropped a pen in my lap and it left an ink stain on the crotch. Now when she comes
back I will find it and show you that stain!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, isn’t it possible that the company that sold the jeans
made more than just the one pair?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, shouldn’t we go give her the benefit of the doubt before we
go…snooping around her crotch?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine. I’m just glad I didn’t give her my secret ingredient.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Out of curiosity, what is your secret ingredient?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! (Laughs.)

scenes.location: Eric’s Apartment, he’s opening the door to reveal Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Come in, I’m so glad you’re here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, me too. Not in the shaky angry way you are though.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Sorry, I just saw Ursula. I had to give the engagement ring back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Just seeing her brought it all back. All the lies, the way she used me. I
just…I got so angry just looking at her…(Looks at Phoebe)…face.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. (Covers her face with her hand.) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: I’m sorry. I just…when I look at you I see her. When I see her I
get a little bit angry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe this is too weird.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: No wait! There’s only a problem when I look at you. (Sits down on the
couch.) Oh I got it! I got it. (Puts his hands to his eyes.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No don’t tear out your eyes!!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: I was just, I was just gonna take out my lenses.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah try that. (He finishes and looks at her.) So, is that better?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Not really. You…you’re blurry, but you still look like Ursula.
You’re Blursula. Okay wait. Maybe…If I-if I just don’t look at you for a
while. (Stands up and turns his back to her.) See? It…it works. I’m not,
I’m not angry at all anymore! This is a great date!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look Eric, turn around. (He does so.) Look, I like you, but it
shouldn’t be this hard. Y’know? This is our first date y’know? First
dates are supposed to be about excitement and electricity and ‘Ooh, he just touched
my hand, did he mean to touch my hand?’ and y’know first kisses and…(He
kisses her)…second kisses. (Motions for him to kiss her again which he does and they
start to make out.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Ross is reading some book and Gunther serves him a cup of
coffee.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks for the coffee, or bedankt voor de koffie, Gunter. (He translates
that phrase into Dutch.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Jij spreekt Nederlands? Dat is te gek. Heb je familie daar?
(Translation: You speak Dutch That's cool. Do you have relatives there?)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, we’re done.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Ezel. (Translation: Donkey)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ezel? Ezel? Ezel? (Looks it up in his book.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey Ross! Listen, do you want to go see that new Imax movie on
tide pools?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) No. But I got Knicks tickets for you, me, and Chandler.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sweet!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, well finish your coffee; let’s go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay I-I just have to stop by my place first.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: To tape the game? You do this every time Ross, you’re not
gonna be on TV!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no, I-I have to see if this apartment became available.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you’re switching apartments?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s not for me, it’s for Rachel.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But Rachel has an apartment.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, but when the baby comes she’s gonna want to move.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, you didn’t expect her to live there with a baby did you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I guess I didn’t really think about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (finds the word in the book) Ezel! (Reads the translation.) Hey Gunther!
You’re an ezel!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Jij hebt seks met ezels. (Translation: You have sex
with donkeys.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damnit!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Brenda is sweeping and Monica is sitting at the kitchen
table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nice jeans!

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: Oh thanks! I like your top.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. (Holds on to it.) (To herself) You’re not gettin’ it.
(Brenda bends down to use the dustpan and Monica leans over to look for the stain, but
leans so far over she falls out of the chair.)

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: What happened?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I fell asleep.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: I was thinking about taking my lunch break.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, will you do the top of the cabinets? That’ll really work up
your appetite for lunch.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: All right.
(Brenda pulls a chair to the counter and uses it to get up on the counter in order to
clean the top of the cabinets. Monica sneaks over, bends over, and tries to see the stain.
That doesn’t work so she sticks her head between Brenda’s legs. Suddenly Brenda
changes her stance and traps Monica’s head between her legs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: What’s going on?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sorry. I’ve never had a maid before, is this not okay?
Commercial Break
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is eating pizza as Joey returns from the Knicks
game.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How was the game?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, okay. I…I ate way too much.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh. (Notices the pizza, grabs a slice, and takes a bite.) So umm, I was
talkin’ to Ross and he said you were looking for a new place.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! Hopefully across the street if certain Dutch people would just
let go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was kinda hoping you’d stay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh but Joey, I have to go. There’s no room for a baby here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No room? It’s a baby. It’s like this big. (Holds his hands about
a foot apart.) Y’know, I mean you-you could you could put it over here. (A desk.)
Or-or-or we could put it right here. (The chair.) Aw, it’s cute, right? Or-or we
could put it over here. (By the bathroom door.) You wouldn’t even notice it.
Where’s the baby? (Mumbles that it’s over in the corner.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, it’s not just a matter of where you put it. I mean a baby
changes everything. They cry all the time. I mean imagine bringing home some girl and
trying to score when there’s a screaming baby around.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I could use a challenge! It’s getting pretty easy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, it’s so sweet that you want me to stay, but I-I can’t
do that to you. I mean it would disrupt your entire life.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I love living with you so much. I just wish things didn’t have to
change.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know I blame Ross for this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I do too a little bit.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m gonna miss you, you’re the hottest roommate I ever had.

scenes.location: Eric’s Apartment, he and Phoebe are still making out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, oh no! I have to go! I have a massage appointment.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Oh no, stay here we’ll keep doing this. I’ll pay you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I got in trouble for that before. I’ll see you later.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Absolutely. (They kiss and Phoebe heads for the door.) I love the way you
kiss.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? That’s the thing I’m worse at! You’ll see.
(Exits.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Brenda is shaking out the rugs on the balcony as Monica
pouts in the living room.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Umm, I think Brenda needs a raise.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How come?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because I put my head between her legs.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: To see her pants?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They’re my pants!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you sure? Did you see the stain?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! I was just getting into position and then everything went dark.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: God! She is not stealing from us! Okay, will you let this go?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine. (Brenda comes in to use the bathroom and adjusts her pink bra
strap on the way.) She’s wearing my bra!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh dear God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My pink flowered bra! I recognize the strap!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And yet you don’t recognize that you’re crazy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here’s the plan! Okay? I’m going to leave you get a look at
Brenda’s bra!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here’s another plan…No!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I would do it but she thinks I’m attracted to her!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you not hear where my head was? Come on! Come on we’re a
team! We’re in this together!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I fear a jury will see it the same way!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do this for me! Come on, I catch you looking at woman’s breasts all
the time!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You see that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you see this? (Mimics him drooling over a woman’s breasts.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right. Yes. Okay. I get your point. But if it’s not your bra
will you just let the woman clean the apartment?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! Absolutely. Okay? Look, you’ll know it’s mine because on
the right cup, the lacey part, there’s a very noticeable rip.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You need new clothes.
[Scene: Mrs. Verhoeven’s Apartment, Ross is back to inquire about the elder
Verhoeven’s health or lack there of.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi. How is she?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: It’s not looking good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (happily) Oh. (Realizes then sadly) Oh. Well I uh, I brought her some
bloemen. (Flowers in Dutch.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: That’s so sweet. (Takes the flowers.) Would you
like to come in and say good-bye? I’m sure it would mean a lot to her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh I don’t know that it would.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Verhoeven's Daughter
lines.text: Well, her memory is pretty much gone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right then. (Follows her in and checks the place out.)

scenes.location: Eric’s Apartment, he’s resting on the bed as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Welcome back!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! (Jumps on the bed with him.) Can we pick up where we left off?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: I don’t know, I’m still pretty tired out from this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Uh, the sex.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What sex?

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Our sex.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We didn’t have sex.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Well if I didn’t have sex with you, I had sex with someone that
looked an awful lot like…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (simultaneously as Eric) Ew! Ew! Ew! Ew! Ew! Ew!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: (simultaneously as Phoebe) Oh no! Oh no! Oh no! Oh no! No! No! No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You-you…you had sex with Ursula?!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Uh, a little bit. She-she-she walked in and I thought she was you and I
kissed her and…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You didn’t notice she was wearing different clothes?!

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Well I was just so excited to see you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Ew! Ew! Ew! Ugh! Y’know what? This is too weird.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: No-no it’s not! I don’t want to lose you! It’s-it’s
like I was saying to Ursula when I was making love to her and I thought she was
you—Yeah it is too weird.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So I guess this is it.

lines.speaker: Eric
lines.text: Yeah. (They hug.) Maybe it’s for the best. You smell just like her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, so do you.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Brenda is wiping the coffee table and Chandler is trying
to look at her bra and leans over on the coffee table to get a good look.]

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: (noticing him) What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m leaning. This is where I lean.

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: Okay. (Goes over and fluffs up the pillows on the couch.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Brenda a bee!

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! It’s flown into your blouse and you’d better undo your
buttons lest it sting you!

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: I think I know what’s going on here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: Look, I know it must be hard that your wife is a lesbian, but it’s
wrong. You’re married.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I totally understand. (They both laugh.) Can I just see your
bra?

scenes.location: The Hallway, Monica is sitting on the step as Rachel returns.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking at Rachel’s jeans) Where did you get those jeans?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You gave them to me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No I didn’t!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I took them. But I figured it would be okay because you got a
big ink stain on the crotch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no! Did you take my bra too?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What bra?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The pink one with the flowers?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You mean the one that you’re wearing? (Adjusts Monica’s pink
bra strap as Monica looks down her shirt.)

lines.speaker: Brenda
lines.text: (entering) I quit! (Storms off.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sounds about right.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel enters and notices that Joey has set up a space for
the baby where the couch was, complete with a crib.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Uh, this is just to give you an idea. Okay well, we can put screens
here, (In front of the crib.) so that the baby has privacy, and-and-and maybe a mobile
over the crib. And uh—Oh look! Here’s a baby monitor (Holds it up), which until
the baby comes we can use as walkie-talkies. Huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re so sweet. (Notices something in the crib.) Oh my God! And
you gave the baby Hugsy! (A stuffed penguin wearing a ski jacket, goggles, and hat.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh…. That-that-that’s really just to show where the
baby would go. Y’know why don’t I hold on to him so that there’s no
confusion? (Takes him back, sets him on the chair, and apologizes to him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But Joey the baby is going to be crying, it’s going to be loud.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m loud!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s gonna be up all night!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m up all night!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s gonna poop!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What about all the women you want to bring home?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, if I’m bringing home a woman who can’t stand being around
a baby, then maybe I don’t want to be with that woman! Or maybe we’ll just do it
in the bathroom of the club!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, are you sure?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! All right—Look, I know sometimes it’ll be hard, okay? But,
it’ll also be really…really great. Please Rachel! I-I-I really want you to stay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I want me to stay too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (They hug.) Oh Joey and look at this crib! It’s so cute!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know! I found it on the street.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you serious—Really?! It’s in such good condition.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Whoa-whoa what’s under the covers?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s moving.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ew.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s still—(Screams)—It’s got a tail! Get it out of
here! Get it out of here!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh! Ah! Okay! (Quickly drags the crib outside.)
Dedicated to the Memory of Pearl Harmon

title: The One with the Stripper

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Joey, Monica, and Chandler are sitting on the couch and chair as
Phoebe is getting coffee.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (coming from the bathroom) Hey Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m having dinner with my dad tomorrow night, do you wanna come?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure. Yeah, he’s kinda sexy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, no, I’ll be there too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay so, we’ll just come up with some kind of signal if it’s
going well you can take off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Phoebe! I just need you there for support. I haven’t told him
I’m pregnant yet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Why not?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ‘Cause I know he’s gonna flip out and I hate it when he’s
angry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Rachel, this is all so ‘Papa don’t preach.’

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What Phoebe? Wait! One time he caught me smoking he said if he ever saw
me doing that again he’d make me eat the entire pack.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! Oh well, I will be there!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Gosh. I’m not gonna let that man make you eat your baby. (They both
sit down by the rest of the gang and Phoebe recognizes a man by the window.) Oh. Hey! Who
is that guy? I think I know him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (recognizing him and panicking) No you don’t!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (panicking) No you don’t.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!!! Monica!! He’s the stripper from your bachelorette
party!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Her what?!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Your secret bachelorette party…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You had a bachelorette party?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She untied his G-string with her teeth. (Pause) Somebody stop me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I thought we weren’t gonna have bachelor/bachelorette parties!
Y’know, we agreed that it was a silly tradition.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s a grand tradition!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sorry, they surprised me. There was nothing I could do!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well you could’ve untied it with your hands.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is so unfair! The one thing I wanted to do was throw my best friend a
bachelor party, but no, I wasn’t allowed to. All I got was a stupid steak dinner!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You went home with the waitress.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, that was a pretty good night.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t believe you didn’t tell me! You know that the
two pillars of marriage are openness and honesty!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ugh, I knew giving you that book was gonna come back and bite me
in the ass!
Opening Credits
[Scene: A Restaurant, Rachel and Phoebe are having dinner with Dr. Green, and everyone
is looking at the menu.]

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: How about I order everyone the Moroccan chicken?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I-I don’t eat meat.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: It’s chicken.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I don’t eat that either.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: I’ll never understand you lesbians. (To Rachel) So baby, tell
me…what is new with you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well actually umm…

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: (interrupting) Your ’74 Lafite sir.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: ’74?! I ordered the ’75! That’s a magnificent wine!
The ’74 is sewage! Why would you bring me sewage?! (The waiter’s dumbfounded) Is
that a hard question? Are you an idiot? Is that why you’re a waiter?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: This is why I told the manager I wouldn’t wait on you tonight!
(Runs off.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Oh come on! Don’t be such a baby! (Goes after him)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe) In case you didn’t notice, that is a scary man.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He’s right though, the ’74 is absolute piss.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This was such a huge mistake. I can’t tell him Phoebe. I

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No it’s okay, this is what’s gonna happen. I’m gonna wait
a couple years and then the baby will tell him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why, so he can get mad at the baby?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, that is the…baby’s problem. (Dr. Green returns.) Oh,
everything okay with the waiter?

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: I have no idea, I went to the bathroom. So sweetie, you were starting
to tell me what is uh, what is new with you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well… Umm, I got TiVo.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: What’s TiVo?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s slang for pregnant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Are you really pregnant?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well uh, yes and no. Except not no. So to sum it up, yeah.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Who is the father? Oh no! Please don’t tell me it’s her!
(Points at Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it’s Ross. It’s Ross. You like Ross. (He just shakes his
head.) Oh daddy, I hope you’re okay with all of this. I mean think about it, this is
a good thing. You’re gonna—This is your first grandchild! You’re gonna be a
poppy!

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: That’s true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: (laughs) Poppy. (To Phoebe) Oh, I’m gonna be a poppy. (Stops
laughing) So when is the wedding?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: The wedding! There’s going to be a wedding. Young lady,
don’t you sit there and tell me my first grandchild is going to be a bastard! (Rachel
pauses) Rachel Karen Green, tell me there is gonna be a wedding!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: February 2nd!
(Dr. Green exhales in relief.)
[Scene: Central Perk, Chandler and Joey are reading a magazine and Ross is chatting
with Mona.]

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: So it was really cool seeing you lecture today.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh thanks. Although it kinda seemed like you were falling asleep there a
little.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh no-no, I-I had my eyes closed so I could concentrate and y’know
take it all in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, a lot of my students do that.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: So, I gotta get going.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I-I’ll see you tonight.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, bye.
(They kiss and she starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh hey, thanks again for showing me your semi-precious stone collection.
It was amazing! (She leaves.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: My God! You must be good in bed!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So uh, you and Mona, been a while now. How’s it going?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, it’s good. It’s going good. I mean, we get along great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hot?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I was gonna say sweet, but yeah-huh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She’s okay with Rachel and the baby?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I…I haven’t actually told her yet. I don’t want to
scare her off, y’know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you have to honest with her! Otherwise you may think that
you’re going down the same path, but you’re really going down different ones.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m gonna take that book and beat you to death with it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Oh my God! You are gonna love me so much! I felt really bad
about the whole bachelorette party thing, so tonight you’re gonna have a bachelor
party.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I got this number from this guy at work and I hired a stripper to
come dance for you. Am I going in the wife hall of fame or what?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey! That’s crazy! I don’t want you to get me a
stripper…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Will you let the lady talk?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on! Come on, it’ll be fun! It’ll make me feel so much
better.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I appreciate it, but uh, it’s a little creepy. Y’know?
I’m not a bachelor anymore.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So don’t think of it as a bachelor party, think of it as a…a
two month anniversary present.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, one year is paper, but two months is lapdance! (Joey nods his
agreement.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please! I feel so bad! Just watch the hot woman get naked!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right fine! But I’m only doing this for you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you. All right, now who else do you want to invite?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, no-no-no just Ross. Ross and Joey is embarrassing enough.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh actually, sorry I can’t even make it. I’m seeing Mona again
tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I understand: who would cancel an actual date to go to a fake bachelor
party?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on cell phone) I’m sorry I gotta cancel tonight baby…
[Scene: The Restaurant, dinner has ended and Phoebe and Rachel are talking. Dr. Green
is not at the table.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry I won’t be able to make it to your imaginary
wedding, but I’m really busy that day. Yeah, I already have a unicorn baptism
and a leprechaun bar mitzvah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. I know. I panicked, I panicked. I didn’t want him to start
yelling at me like I was some ’74 Latour.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s Lafite. The ’74 Latour is actually drinking quite nicely.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right here he comes. I’m gonna do this, I’m gonna tell
him, I’m gonna be strong.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: I just called a friend of mine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: I think I may be able to book The Plaza on short notice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?! The Plaza?!! Oh daddy!! (Hugs him and Phoebe glares at
her.) Right. Daddy, I need to talk to you. Please, sit down.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: What is it sweetie?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: There’s not gonna be a wedding. Ross and I are not getting married.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry daddy.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: I don’t believe this!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh now daddy, stay calm. Please.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Stay calm?!! How do you expect me to stay calm?! This is unacceptable
Rachel! And I wanna know why?!! Is it because that punk Ross won’t marry you?!
That’s it! Is that it?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes. Yes, he says I’m damaged goods.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler’s bachelor party has begun, what there is
of it, with only Joey (wearing a gold paper top hat) and Chandler (wearing what appears to
be a Burger King paper crown) enjoying a nice product placement of Budweisers
on ice.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you uh, nervous about getting married?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, look let’s pretend it’s a real bachelor party. Okay?
Y’know? Before your wedding. Come on, it’ll be fun.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. I can’t believe tomorrow’s the big day.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How does it feel knowing you’re never gonna be with another woman
again huh? Knowing you’re gonna have to wake up to the same face everyday until you
finally have the sweet release of death.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’re right, this is more fun.
(There’s a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s her! Okay, come on! (They go over and open the door.)

lines.speaker: Stripper
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi. (Joey blows on a noisemaker.)

lines.speaker: Stripper
lines.text: So which one of you lucky boys is Chandler?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, that-that’s-that’s me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Joey Tribbiani, a big fan.

lines.speaker: Stripper
lines.text: So is that a bedroom? (Points to the guestroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, yeah right over there.

lines.speaker: Stripper
lines.text: All right, whenever you’re ready. (She goes into the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was weird.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why-why would she go in the bedroom?

lines.speaker: Stripper
lines.text: I’m waiting.
(They both slowly enter the bedroom and quickly walk back out.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, that’s one naked hooker!

scenes.location: Ross's Apartment, Ross and Mona are sitting on the couch.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I love your place! Where is this guy from? (A statue from the top of his
apothecary table.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh that’s an eighteenth century Indian artifact from Calcutta.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh wow! So, you’re more than just dinosaurs.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So much more.
(They start making out and she kicks the eighteenth century Indian artifact from
Calcutta off of his apothecary table from the days of yore and the magical city of White
Plains.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God! I’m so sorry!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aw forget it, it’s from Pier One. (There’s an angry knock
on the door.) Sorry. (Goes and opens the door to an irate Dr. Green.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: You think you can knock up my daughter and then not marry her?!
I’m gonna kill you!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know this is actually not a great time for me.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Ross's Apartment, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: So? Come on! Explain yourself Geller! First you get my Rachel
pregnant!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: You got Rachel pregnant?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who did?!

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: You did!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. Yes, yes I did. (To Mona) But-but it was, it was just a one night
thing. It meant nothing.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Oh? Really? That’s what my daughter means to you? Nothing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No sir umm, she means a lot to me. I mean, I care—I-I love
Rachel.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Mona) Oh but not that way. I mean…I mean I’m not in love
with her. I love her like a, like a friend.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Oh really? That’s how treat a friend? You get her in trouble and
then refuse to marry her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Dr. Green) Hey! I offered to marry her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Mona) But I didn’t want to.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Well why not? So you can spend your time with this tramp?!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Tramp?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry. Dr. Green, Mona. Mona, Dr. Green.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler and Joey are discussing what to do about the
now naked hooker in the guestroom.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t believe there is a naked hooker in there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait! Wait! Maybe she’s a hooker and a stripper, but she got
confused about what she’s supposed to do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Could be. I mean technically she did strip, we just, we just missed
it. (Walks towards the bedroom.) Ma’am, are you also a stripper?

lines.speaker: Hooker
lines.text: Uh, no. But I could pretend to strip, but that’s gonna cost extra.
Okay, here’s the extras, handcuffs, spanking… (Chandler grunts for her not to
continue and Joey pulls him back into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe Monica’s playing a joke on ya. Y’know? Getting her own
husband a hooker, that’s pretty funny.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is funny, maybe for my birthday she’ll murder someone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I bet Ross was in on it too. I mean he was conveniently busy.

lines.speaker: Hooker
lines.text: Do you mind if I smoke in here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh actually, I’d rather you…Yeah, go ahead. We’re gonna
have to burn that room down anyway.

scenes.location: Ross's Apartment, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: How could you have kept all of this from me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was going to tell you, but…

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: But what?! You figured you’d get what you wanted and then dump
her like you dumped Rachel!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! I did not dump Rachel! (To Mona) Nor are we still together. (The
phone rings and Ross goes to answer it, only he’s trapped behind the apothecary table
by Dr. Green.) Can I just… (Dr. Green glares at him.) Why don’t we just let the
machine get that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (on machine) Hey Ross. It’s Joey. There’s a hooker over here and
we thought maybe you’d know something about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! No! No! No! I-I-I-I—I need to, I need to lie down.
[Scene: Monica’s Restaurant’s Kitchen, she’s cooking as one of her
waiters, Stu, comes over to talk to her.]

lines.speaker: Stu
lines.text: So, tonight’s the night of the big bachelor party?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! Hey! Thanks for getting me that girl’s number.

lines.speaker: Stu
lines.text: No problem. So who’s the party for?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My husband.

lines.speaker: Stu
lines.text: You hired your husband a hooker?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s a stripper.

lines.speaker: Stu
lines.text: No, she’s a hooker.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is that, is that what they call strippers sometimes?

lines.speaker: Stu
lines.text: When they’re hookers.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God Stu! I-I can’t believe you did this! Now are you
absolutely sure she’s a hooker?

lines.speaker: Stu
lines.text: Either that or she’s just the best, most expensive date I ever had.
(Monica runs out.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Joey and Chandler are still deciding what to do about
the hooker.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe she meant to get you a hooker.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why would she do that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe she wants you to learn something. Huh? Now is there anything
you’re really bad at y’know, sexually?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is the worst bachelor party ever!

lines.speaker: Hooker
lines.text: What’s taking you boys so long?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: In a minute!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Joey) In a minute? What’s gonna happen in a minute?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, all right maybe-maybe you should just ask her to leave.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why me?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! It’s your bachelor party.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Which is why you should do it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t want to. You do it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You do it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right Rock, Paper, Scissors who has to tell the whore to leave!
(Joey smirks.) What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I miss this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t think we’ve actually done this before!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I-I miss hanging out with you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well we…we still hang out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not like we used to. Remember? You and me used to be inseparable.
Y’know now it’s like…things are different.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well y’know, things are different. I’m…I’m married
now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh sure—And hey, don’t get me wrong, I am so happy for you guys.
I just…I miss…hanging out…just-just us, y’know?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I miss that too. I tell you what; from now on we’ll make
time to hang out with each other.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got it. Come here. (They hug and are observed by the hooker.)

lines.speaker: Hooker
lines.text: Oh God! Listen, I am this close to robbing you guys. (Does the close
sign.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering quickly) She’s a hooker! She’s a hooker! She’s
a… (Stops as she sees her.) Hi! Uh, we spoke on the phone. (Goes and shakes the
hooker’s hand.)

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel and Phoebe are at the counter as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So your dad dropped by. He’s a pleasant man!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (quietly) Oh no…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’d better go. (She goes and sits down in the La-Z-Boy E-cliner
3000, the chair that Sit magazine called chair of the year, and they both look at
her.) Just over here: I don’t want to miss the fight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross I’m so sorry. Okay. I-I will promise I will straighten this
out with him tomorrow in person, or via e-mail.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t care about your dad! I care about Mona! She was there and now
she’s totally freaked out!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh okay, I’ll fix that to. What’s her e-mail address?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I promise. I’ll fix this. I swear.
I’ll-I’ll-I’ll-I’ll talk to her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s it?! You call that a fight? Come on! "We were on a
break!" "No we weren’t!" What happened to you two?!

scenes.location: Ross's Apartment, Ross is opening the door to Mona. Rachel is there as well.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you so much for coming back over.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh good, you’re here. Yeah, and I was worried that it was going to be
uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know Mona, just hear me out. First of all, I’m so sorry about my
father yelling at you, but I heard you totally held your own. You’re gonna have to
tell me how you did that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Focus.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Um…But—Okay, yes Ross and I used to date. And yes we are
gonna have a baby. But we are definitely not getting back together.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: How can I be sure on that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh we just—we drove each other crazy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean he was possessive, he was jealous, he could never just let the
little things go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Trying to date this woman.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right! But, none of that compared to how kind and-and how gentle and
thoughtful he is. (Rubbing his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Probably shouldn’t touch me.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Y’know, I-I-I just…I don’t want to get in the middle of
something so complicated.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I get it, but Mona, what relationship is not complicated? I mean
we all have our baggage! You must too! Why else would you still be single? (Mona looks at
her.) I am so gonna leave right now. (Ross opens the door for her and she leaves.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Should I leave this open for you too?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I’m not sure yet. Why didn’t you just tell me about all this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because what’s going on with Rachel has nothing to do with how I feel
about you.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Yeah? Well you still shoulda told me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know and I was going to, but I thought it was better that you heard it
from Rachel’s father. Look I…I made a mistake, but it’s only because I
really, really like you. Really!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Okay, I guess you can…close the door now. (He does so and they kiss.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Forgot my purse! (Sees them kissing.) Oh, you guys made up.
(To Mona) He’s a good kisser isn’t he? (Ross goes to close the door on her.)
I’m going! (Quickly leaves and Ross locks the door.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, the bachelor party has ended and Monica is trying to
explain herself to Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I swear I didn’t know she was a hooker! I mean wh—Did you let
her smoke in here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Her ass print is still on your grandmother’s quilt, do you really
want to talk about smoking?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what? I’m gonna make this up to you. I promised you a
stripper (turns on the radio), and you’re gonna get a stripper. (She starts to
strip.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica! Wait!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (puts on his crown) Carry on.
(She does so by taking off her jacket seductively, only she has trouble getting one
hand out and slams the jacket on the chair angrily to remove it.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooh, these tennis shoes are so tight. I think I’ll take them off.
(Goes to do so.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Could you not narrate?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Gotcha sailor. (Kicks one of her shoes off and it lands in the kitchen
knocking something down, but she continues to strip.)

title: The One with the Rumor

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is reading What to Expect When You’re Expecting
as Rachel enters from her bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Rach listen, did you know that during pregnancy your fingers swell up
to twice their size and never go back.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at her fingers) Oh my…God! Let me see that! (Grabs the
book from him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughing) You fall for it every time!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I brought you my old maternity clothes! (Sets a bag on the counter.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Pheebs that’s so sweet—(Grabs a pair of pants)—Ooh,
those are so cute!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! And look, (Grabs the pants) see how they expand as the baby grows?
(There’s a stretchy part in front.) And then after the baby’s born, they’re
great for shoplifting melons.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Oh good you’re all here. Thanksgiving tomorrow, four
o’clock. (To Rachel) Oh, guess who I invited. Remember that guy Will Colbert from
high school?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He was in Ross’s class…marching band…kinda overweight?
Well, really overweight. I mean I was his thin friend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! I don’t remember him. Honey, are you sure you’re not
talking about your imaginary boyfriend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No that was Jarred! Wow! I haven’t thought about him in a long
time… (Stares off into the distance lost in thought.) (Pause) Anyway, umm
Will’s, Will’s here on business and he didn’t have a place to go so I
invited him here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh that’s nice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, and by the way, he’s lost a bunch of weight. I mean he looks
goo-ood! Okay, I mean really, really gorgeous! (Joey clears his throat.) I still
love Chandler.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I just want you to say it once in a while.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right okay, just so you know, I’m not gonna make a turkey this
year.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well Phoebe doesn’t eat turkey…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Turkey’s are beautiful, intelligent animals!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No they’re not! They’re ugly and stupid and delicious!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right! Okay, it’s just Phoebe. Will’s still on a diet,
Chandler doesn’t eat Thanksgiving food, and Rachel’s having her aversion to
poultry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She is?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Remember I had to leave the room the other day when you had that roast
chicken?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. But I thought that was because I put the whole thing on my hand and
made it walk across the table.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Anyway, it just doesn’t seem worth it to make a whole turkey for
just three people. Okay? It’s a lot of work.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But you gotta have turkey on Thanksgiving! I mean, Thanksgiving with no
turkey is like-like Fourth of July with no apple pie! Or Friday with no two pizzas!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right fine! If it means that much to you! But just—there’s
gonna be a ton left over.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No there won’t! I promise I will finish that turkey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, you’re telling me you can eat an entire turkey in just
one sitting?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right! ‘Cause I’m a Tribbiani! (To Rachel) And this
is what we do! I mean we may not be great thinkers or world leaders, we don’t read a
lot or run very fast, but damnit! We can eat!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is watching football, and it’s actually
the right game Green Bay at Detroit (although not this year’s), as Monica is getting
everything ready.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, isn’t weird to think about how next year at this time
they’ll be a little baby at the table? (Chandler turns around in horror.) (Seeing
him) Rachel’s! But good to know where you’re at!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You too!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Anything I can do to help?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Actually there is. Chandler usually helps me with this, but he’s
really into the game so I don’t want to bother him. Could you help me fold these
napkins? (Hands her a stack of them.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m gonna go across the hall to check on the yams.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (She starts folding the napkins in half.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No! No! No sweetie! No! Not like that! We’re not at a barn
dance. You’ve gotta—you wanna fold them like swans. Like I showed you at
Christmas time, remember?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, it all just came screaming back to me. (Monica exits.) (To
Chandler) So how’s the game?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have no idea.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! I’m just pretending to watch the game so I don’t have
to help out with stuff.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t believe you! That is…brilliant! And Monica has no
idea?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nope! Every once and a while I just scream stuff at the TV.
(Monica enters and Chandler screams stuff at the TV.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is your team winning hon?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! Anderson just scored again! (To Phoebe) There’s no
Anderson.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well I want to get in on this. Hey Mon? I don’t think I can help
you after all, I didn’t realize this game was on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I didn’t know you liked football.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well normally I don’t, but y’know…(looks at the
TV)…Green Bay is playing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You like Green Bay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well it’s only like my favorite bay! {Actually, it’s not bad.
It just gets a little cold in winter, but in Wisconsin winter only lasts from August to
June. J }
(Phoebe joins Chandler on the couch as there is a knock on the door which Monica
answers.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Hey!
(Oh, I should point out that the live studio audience at this point goes absolutely
wild. And I had absolutely no idea that this Will character was that popular! Maybe they
should make him the seventh friend. Which would work out just fine since he’s already
married to one of them. Will is played by some guy named Brad Pitt, I guess he’s some
sort of actor.)

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Aww thanks! God Will I’m so glad that you came! You look great! You
must’ve lost like…

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: 150 pounds. Yeah, I’m gonna be in one of those Subway sandwich
commercials.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A pie! (Will brought a pie.)

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Oh right. All right, it’s no fat, it’s no sugar, it’s no
dairy…it’s no good. Throw it out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You wanna meet some people? This is uh; this is my husband Chandler.
Chandler, this is Will.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh hey. I’d shake your hand but uh; I’m really into the
game. Plus, I think it’d be better for my ego if we didn’t stand right next to
each other.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (nonchalantly glancing) Hey. (Turns back around.) Wow! (Looks up.) Well
done.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Will) Wanna give me a hand?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Sure! Monica, I can’t get over how great you look! You look stunning!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well you look incredible too! You’re just—you’re so fit!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m watching the game, but I’m not deaf!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh umm, I meant to tell you, Ross is coming.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Ross is coming. Great! I love Ross!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good. And Rachel Green too. (Will stops suddenly.)

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Nope. Uh, it’s okay. It’s just uh, God I hated her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Yeah, I hated her. She was horrible to me in high school. But hey, it was
a long time ago, I’m in a good place, it might be actually fun to see her again. You
got any cakes or cookies or something? (Starts looking.) No Will no!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Y’know, it’s been a while since we’ve
screamed something. Maybe we should.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh come on!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Noooo!! Damn you ref! You burn in hell!!!
(Joey enters eating potato chips.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, what are you doing? You gotta save room, you’ve got almost an
entire turkey to eat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let me explain to you how the human body works. I have to warm my stomach
first. Eatin’ chips is like stretching.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t worry, Tribbianis never get full.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: I actually know what you’re talking about. I’m here to tell you
something my friend, you can eat and eat and eat but nothing will ever fill that void.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Monica) Who the hell is this guy?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Will! From high school.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Will) Joey.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Will!

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey-hey you came! Man you look incredible! Hot stuff! (They hug and Ross
realizes what he said.) Hot stuff?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: It’s good to see you man.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, you too. Man, so-so what are you up to?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: I’m a commodities broker.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? Yeah that-that sounds interesting.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Yeah, it’s not. But I’m rich and thin.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! Man I don’t think I’ve seen you since uh, Lance Davis’
graduation party.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: That was such a fun night!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. It would’ve been good if we had gotten in, but still real fun.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: God we were lame back then. Do you remember how into dinosaurs we were?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (laughs) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: So what do you, what do you do now?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So how long are you in town?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering, carrying a baking dish) Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey sweetie. Oh good. (Takes the baking dish from her.)

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: (glaring at Rachel) Rachel Green.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aw—oh, that’s right. Are-are you gonna be okay?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Oh, I’ll-I’ll be fine. Just God I hate her Ross! I hate her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Will, high school was-was a long time ago.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Look at her standing there with those yams! My two greatest enemies Ross:
Rachel Green and complex carbohydrates.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sees Will) Oh my God Monica, who is that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s Will from high school!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! I do not remember him! Wow! He's really got that sexy, smoldering
thing going on. (We see Will angrily staring at Rachel.) Oh my God, he’s… Look
at the way he’s just staring at me. I think he’s trying to mouth something to
me, but I can’t make it out. (Will mouths, "I hate you.")

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, dinner’s ready!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good game!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Solid effort. Solid effort.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, so who won?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (simultaneously) Green Bay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (simultaneously) Detroit.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well the Lions technically won, but it was a moral victory for the Green
Bay…Mermen.
(They sit down at the table and Will goes to talk to Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Will, right?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! I’m Rachel Green.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Oh I-I remember you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?! Aren’t you sweet! I gotta tell you though, I am, I am
having the hardest time placing you. Oh-oh hang on! Did we umm, did we fool around at
Lance Davis’ graduation party?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: You are unbelievable.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (breaking it up) Uh Rachel? Rachel, why don’t you sit here? (Next
to Joey) And Will you sit way over there. (The other side of the table.)
(Monica sets something on the table and removes the cover. It kinda looks like turkey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s it?! Even if nobody helps me I can eat that no problem. At
least give me a challenge!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) This is Chandler’s chicken. This is the turkey. (Sets down
a huge turkey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (quietly) Oh. How-how big is that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: About nineteen pounds.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) It’s like me when I was born.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, who would uh, like some yams? Will?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Oh, you’d like that wouldn’t ya?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? (Joey starts offering Ross some turkey.) Oh y’know what? Can
we please keep the chicken and the turkey and everything on the other side of the table?
The smell is just yuck!

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: (sneeze talks) Typical.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry. What?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: I said it was typical. Typical of you, Rachel Green, Queen Rachel does
whatever she wants in little Rachel land. (Does a fake hair flip.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Monica) Seriously, who is this guy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, I’m sorry. Do you-do you have a problem with me?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: I don’t know? Do I? Do I?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think you do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Rachel) Apparently you were umm, a little mean to him in high
school.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: A little mean? You made my life miserable!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m-I’m—I had no idea. I’m sorry. I…

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Well you should be. Screw it! Bring on the yams!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh Will. But you-you’ve worked so hard…

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Yams!!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (Chandler grabs the dish from Monica and hands it to Will who
starts dishing out a large helping.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh Will umm, I just want to say that I’m real sorry for whatever
I-I did to you in high school…

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Oh, it wasn’t just me. We had a club!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You had a club?!

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: That’s right, The I Hate Rachel Green Club!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa! My God! So what, you all just joined together to hate me?! Who
else was in this club?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Me and Ross. (Points at Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No need to point, she knows who Ross is.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, scene continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Ross) So you were in an I Hate Rachel club?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Yes he was. (Holds up his hand for a high-five.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So who else was in this club?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh actually, there-there was also that exchange student from Thailand but
I-I don’t think he-he knew what it was.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So Ross, we went out for two years, and you never told me you were in an
I Hate Rachel club.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: You went out with her?! We had a pact!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That was in high school! It’s not like it was binding forever.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Then why did it have the word eternity in it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Monica, did you know about this?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I swear I didn’t. (To Ross and Will) Hey! Is that why you guys used
to go up to your bedroom and lock the door?

lines.speaker: Ross and Will
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hmm, a little relieved, I gotta say.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look Rach I-I’m sorry, okay? I…I was a stupid kid, okay? The
only reason I joined…

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Co-founded!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …co-founded. Co-founded the club was because I was insanely in love
with you. Obviously I didn’t handle it very well. But if you think about it the I
Hate Rachel Club was really the I Love Rachel Club.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Uh, except that it was really the I Hate Rachel Club.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. So what? You guys would just like get together and like just say
mean things about me?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Well, we did a little more than that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no! No-no. No-no.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! What else did you do?

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: We started a rumor.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What rumor?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, come on Will! Just take off your shirt and tell us!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was no big deal. We-we…said that the rumor was…that
umm…you had both…male and female reproductive parts.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: That’s right! We said your parents flipped a coin, decided to raise
you as a girl, but you still had a hint of a penis.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shocked) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You started that?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! You heard that?! (Goes and stands behind Joey.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Everyone at our school heard it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Everybody at my school heard it! You were the hermaphrodite
cheerleader from Long Island?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no!!!! Oh my God!! This is all making so much sense to me now! This
is why Adam Carter wouldn’t go out with me! This is why Billy Tratt would just stay
in this region! (Motions to her breasts.) (Joey has turned around.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually, Billy Tratt is gay now. So-so that one’s not really our
fault.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica, how come you never told me this?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I thought it might be true. And I was afraid that you were gonna cry and
then show it to me.
(Joey is now looking at Rachel, and since Rachel’s standing and he’s sitting
down and he’s not looking at her face… You get the picture.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey stop staring! There’s nothing there! It’s not true!
