lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m afraid I’m gonna need proof.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! (Hits him and storms out.)
[Time Lapse, dinner has ended for everyone except Joey who looks like to have finished
the turkey, until he turns the plate around and reveals he only ate one side.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You are my Everest.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, you don’t have to finish that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yes I do. Otherwise what’s next? Today I’m just a guy who
can’t finish a turkey, but tomorrow I’m the guy who eats half a Powerbar,
wraps up the rest, and puts in the fridge? No! No, I just…I just—I gotta change
my pants. (Gets up and heads for the door.) Jeans have no give. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering carrying a book) Okay! Okay! Listen to what Sean McMahon wrote
in my yearbook senior year, "Dear Rach, you’re such a good person." Not
girl! Person!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, I think you’re reading a little too much into it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reading what he wrote again) "Dear Rach, you’re a great
person. Sorry about your tiney-wienie." (Will laughs.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, what do you want me to do? Do you want me to call everyone in the
entire school and tell them it wasn’t true?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Could you also tell them I’m skinny now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! Me too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well look-look I’m not calling anybody! Okay? It was like a million
years ago!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t care how long ago it was! You told people that I was half
and half! Y’know what? I just want to point out I never did anything to hurt you in
high school.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s not totally true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well you-you did start that rumor about Ross making out with Mrs.
Altman, our 50-year-old librarian.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked) (To Rachel) How did you know that?!!!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s true?!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes it is! I saw you guys going at it behind the card catalog!
(Ross is at a loss for words.)

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Mrs. Altman? She also made out with Takaka Ci-Kek the night before he went
back to Thailand.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry. When you were in high school you made out with a
50-year-old woman?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! She didn’t look 50!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did she look 16?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, there’s a picture of her in the yearbook actually.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! (They all look.) Wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She didn’t photograph well!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, she probably wasn’t familiar with the process having spent
most of her life sitting for oil paintings!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So how did this happen? Did she, did she lure you to an early bird
dinner?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was working late in the library one afternoon. It was just the two of
us. She needed some help with her word jumble. And one thing led to another. If you must
know, Anita was very gentle and tender. May she rest in peace…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Didn’t she walk with a cane?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Only when it was damp!! (To Rachel) I can’t believe you-you told
people about this?! Everybody knew?! Y’know what? (To Will) I’m back in the
club!

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Yeah! (They high-five.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I wanna join!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh—Phoebe!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry. I’m sorry. I never got to be in a club. I-I
didn’t go to high school, but three of us would meet behind a dumpster to learn
French. Bonjour.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, y’know—Fine! You guys have your stupid little club,
but I would just like to say is what you did to me is way worse than what I did to you!
You gave me a tiney-wienie! (Will laughs.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, listen you’re just being silly. Rachel, even with that
rumor you were one of the most popular girls in school and everyone wanted to be like you.
One girl wanted to be like you so much she stuffed her pants with a Tootsie Roll!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And Ross, if it weren’t for Rachel’s rumor I mean no one in
high school would even know who you were. She put you on the map!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: As a romancer of the elderly.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Mrs. Altman was the kind of woman you could tell she used to be
pretty.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The eyes…did still sparkle.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey guys this stuff is just so way in the past. You-you’ve been
through so much since then. And right now you’ve got so much more important stuff
going on in your life. Can’t you just let this go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She’s right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. I mean we are having a baby together.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Hold on! You got her pregnant?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: Are ya getting married?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Will
lines.text: So you knocked her up but you’re not gonna marry her. Dude! (Wants
another high-five and Ross ignores him.) Anybody?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Goes over and hugs him.) It’s exactly how I’d imagined
it would be.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, wearing the maternity pants from earlier) All right
where’s that turkey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey! Those are my maternity pants!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not now! These are my Thanksgiving pants!

title: The One with Monica's Boots

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is trying on a pair of new boots as Chandler
enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! So what do you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: New haircut? (Monica nods ‘No.’) Necklace? (No) Dress? (No)
Boots? (Monica nods ‘Yes.’) Boots!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! Now, they’re a little more than I normally spend on
boots…or rent (Shows him the receipt.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m gonna miss being able to afford food.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m sorry, they just, they just look so good! And the saleswoman
was looking at me like, "Oh, these are way too expensive for you."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She had a point. (Shows her the receipt.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! (Notices the boots) Oh Monica! Those boots are amazing!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They’re mine!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah well, too bad we’re gonna have to return them.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Return them?! Shh! They’re gonna hear you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, I’m not returning them. Okay? I mean I-I know they cost a
lot, but I’m going to wear them all the time. You’ll see. Besides, I love the
compliments. I mean, have you ever had something so beautiful everyone wanted it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nice try; I’m keeping the boots.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe, Ross, and Rachel are sitting on the couch and Ross is
talking to Rachel’s, who is now showing, stomach.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right, I love you! And-and I’m gonna play with you all
the time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How can you let him talk to your crotch like that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause) He’s talking to the baby.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ohh! Okay! Okay, cause when-when he said, "I can’t wait to
hear your first words," I thought, "There’s a trick."

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Well, I gotta go you guys. I’ll see you later.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye. (She gets up to leave but is stopped by Joey)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey Rach, listen—Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Umm, can you do me a favor? I was talkin’ to my sister and she knows
you work at Ralph Lauren…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, forget it! No way! I am not sending anymore Ralph Lauren
clothes to prison. It is a waste.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no-no-no-no, not her, not her. My youngest sister, Dina, she’s
really interested in fashion, and she wants to talk to someone successful, y’know, to
give her some advice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I guess I can talk to one of my supervisors…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no, she wants to talk to you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?! Oh my God! I’m successful!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, so will you meet with her?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! I’d love to! Have her come by the office.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great! Thanks! You’re gonna love her so much. And—Oh, she’s
the smartest of all the Tribbiani children. Hey, y’know the S.A.T’s?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She took ‘em!
(Joey goes to get coffee and Rachel exits as the camera pans to Phoebe and Ross on the
couch.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Ross! Doesn’t Ben go to the Smithfield Day School?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sting has a son that goes there too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah I know; he’s in Ben’s class.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You knew this and you never said anything?! With all the stupid dinosaur
stuff you tell us?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine! No more dinosaur stuff! Can I talk about fossils? (Joey is about to
sit down and hears this so instead he groans and exits.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sting’s son, seven years old and there’s a picture.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you reading? The Kidnappers Guide to Manhattan Private Schools?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it’s New York magazine. It’s an article about the
best schools in the city. So how well do you know Sting?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, I actually haven’t even met him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh, yeah that’s too bad. I really want to go to his concert
Friday night, but it’s totally sold out. I know! Why don’t you meet him and get
tickets?! If you get two I’ll take you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well actually, I’m picking Ben up tomorrow, maybe he’ll be
there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There you go! Oh, you are so lucky! You might actually get to meet Sting
tomorrow! That’s why you have kids!
[Scene: Central Perk, the next day Rachel, Phoebe, and Chandler are there as Monica
enters.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey-hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. (Sits down on the arm of the couch.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi boots.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See Chandler? I’m getting a lot of use out of them already!
They’re very practical. See, you can wear them with dresses, with skirts, with
pants…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can wear them with shorts on a street corner and earn the money to
pay for them. (Goes and gets some coffee at the counter.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! They’re beautiful!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (almost crying) They hurt so much!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The guy who made these hates feet and wants to see them die!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well-well you can give them to me! I haven’t felt my feet in years!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t! I spent so much money on them and I told Chandler that
I’d wear them all the time, I just can’t give them away!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well then get your money back and return them!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t do that either! The soles’ are already a little
scuffed up and the insides are filled with my blood.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (returning to his seat) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey I uh just picked up Ben from school…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (spinning around looking for him) I don’t think you did a very
thorough job!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I dropped him off at Carol’s. (To Phoebe) Anyway, it turns out that
I’m not going to be able to get those tickets though.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! Why not?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well it turns out that Ben and Sting’s son do not get along.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How come?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Apparently, Sting’s son made fun of the fact that Ben’s moms are
lesbinims.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait! But Ross if they don’t get along then you should
smooth things over. Make them be friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, you can’t force kids to be friends.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure you can! Give them some blocks, put them in a playpen!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Playpen?! Ben’s seven!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Your kid is seven?! (Ross nods, "Yes.") (To the rest)
He’s really small. (To Ross) Please! Please get the tickets!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look I’m sorry Pheebs, I can’t do it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes you can! Sting says so himself!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Rosssss can!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look Phoebe, I’m sorry it’s just…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Rossss can!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, I…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Rosss can! Give me the tickets! Ross can give me the
tickets!!
(Ross runs out to get the tickets.)

scenes.location: Rachel’s Office, Joey has brought Dina to meet with Rachel.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering, with Dina) Here she is! Future fashion superstar!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Joey, I’m hardly a…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: My little sister Dina!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right! Hi Dina!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nice to meet you. (They shake hands.)

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Thanks so much for meetin’ with me. Joey’s told me so much about
you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is so exciting for her. Well, I’ll let you two fash…ists
get down to business. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. All right Dina, well let’s talk about the different areas of
fashion that you could get involved in. Let’s see, there’s design, but you may
need a whole other degree for that. Uh, there’s-there’s sales, which is great
because you get to travel…

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: I…I don’t care about fashion! I’m pregnant! And I know you
are too, so you gotta help me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stunned) And there’s marketing…
[Scene: The Hallway, Monica is returning, but before she enters the apartment she stops
on the step and changes from wearing tennis shoes to the boots and she moans in pain as
she puts each boot on.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (standing up) Ahhhhhhhh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (opening the door) What’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh nothing I’m just—just was yawning. (Mimics the groan from
before and stretches.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh don’t forget, my office holiday party is tonight. (They go
into the apartment.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, we don’t really have to go to this thing tonight do we?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now sweetie, I know you don’t like my office parties, but you can
wear your new boots. See? Every cloud has a…supple leather lining.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I-I don’t-I don’t think that I’m gonna wear the boots
tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well y’know, I’m just-I’m just worried that bosses will
see them and think they pay you too much money. Or! Or your assistant will see them
and-and want a raise!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you think I work at some kind of boot pricing company?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Anyway, I picked up this outfit that I want to wear and the, and the
boots don’t really go with it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You said that you paid all that money because those boots go with
skirts, dresses, and pants!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine! If you want me to wear the boots, I’ll wear the boots. In
fact, I’ll go into my room right now and y’know try the outfit on.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay? (She starts to walk which causes her to start crying) Ooo wee!
Christmas party in my boots! (Runs into the bedroom and mixes saying ‘ow’ with
laughing.)
[Scene: The Hallway, Rachel is about to enter her apartment with Dina to tell Joey the
news.]

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: I-I can’t go in there. I can’t tell him!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, it’s going to be okay. He’s been incredibly supportive
of me, and if he gets a little upset; that’s what the meatball sub is for. (She gives
Dina a sandwich wrapped in aluminum foil.)

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(They enter.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! It’s my fashion girls! (They don’t react.) What’s
wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, why don’t you sit down? Dina has something that she wants to
tell you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (concerned) Oh. What’s, what’s going on? Is it mom? Is she sick?
Is it dad’s heart? Is that a sandwich?

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Joe, mom and dad are fine…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is that a sandwich?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey…there’s something that you…should know. Dina?

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: I’m pregnant.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (angrily) What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Dina) Now! Give him the sandwich! Give him the sandwich! (She
quickly sets the sandwich in front of him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well obviously this is a mistake! You can’t be pregnant! Because you
have to have sex to get pregnant!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Joe, I tried to wait until I was 25 like you did!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! Dina…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Rachel) Bub!!! (Points at her and quiets Rachel.) (To Dina) I
can’t believe this! You’re the good one! You went to college! Both years! Who
did this to you?!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Bobby Corso, but he’s a real nice guy. I like him a lot. He’s
real funny.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got pregnant for funny?! Dina…if he’s funny…laugh!
All right, I’ll be back in a little while! You stay here!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Why? Where are you going?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can’t look at you right now! (Exits and slams the door behind him.)

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.
(Joey storms back in and covering his face so he doesn’t see Dina grabs the
sandwich and heads back out.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: The Midfield Day School, it’s after school and Ben is taking a drink of
water as Phoebe enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, there you are Ben!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Aunt Phoebe, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I heard you’re having a problem with one of the boys in your
class. And so I thought I would just come down here and sit you both down, have a little
talk and make it all okay. Now umm, the boy’s name is Sting’s son.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Jack? I hate him! He’s a jerk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now Ben, sometimes people may seem like jerks on the outside, but they
have famous fathers.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: I have to go. My friend Doug is waiting for me over there. (Goes over to
Doug.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Him you’re friends with. (Starts looking at the children trying to
find Jack and a teacher notices her.)

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Excuse me. Can, can I help you with something?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! Yes you can, I’m looking for Jack’s parents.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Are you with one of the students?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh, I’m with Ben.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Are you one of Ben’s mothers?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I am one of Ben’s mothers. I’m a lesbian. It was, it was
difficult coming out to my parents.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Well hi, I’m Jenny Boone. I’m the new teacher here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: I’ve only met your partner Carol.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah! Okay so that would make me Susan.

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Right. Are you looking for Jack’s parents to discuss the
problems he’s having with Ben? (Phoebe nods ‘Yes.’) Yeah. Because I really
do think the parents should sit down and have a conversation.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Let’s do that!! That-that sounds good. We should sit down and
talk, just me, my lover Carol, and the Stings. Umm, how-how will I get in touch with them?

lines.speaker: The Teacher
lines.text: Oh, their number is on the contact sheet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Umm, could-could I get a copy of that? ‘Cause Carol
threw it out, she lost ours. She’s such a scatterbrain, but man what a hot piece of
ass.
[Scene: A Street, Chandler and Monica are walking down the sidewalk after his office
holiday party.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know, that party wasn’t bad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! I didn’t know there would be dancing. That was a fun
surprise!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t see any uh, cabs. Maybe we should just walk?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no, we can’t walk!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What honey, it’s like fifteen blocks to the subway. Let’s
go.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Do you think that we can get to the subway right there if we climb
down through the manhole cover?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t walk. Okay? Okay? These boots were a huge mistake!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay you were right! All right, I never should have bought them!
They’re killing me! One toe at a time!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So I was right. This is what it feels like to be right. (Pause)
It’s oddly unsettling.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How are we gonna get home? Maybe a piggy-back ride?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hop on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Wait, just give me a second, I need to just get my boots off
first. (She starts taking them off.) Ah…Ooh…Oohh…Ohh…Oh

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, I know you’re in pain right now, but I’m a little
turned on.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Dina and Rachel are reading pregnancy books, Dina Pregnancy
for Dummies and Rachel something else.]

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Do you ever worry that you’ll be walking and your baby will just like
slip out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What college was that Dina?
(Joey enters dragging a guy.)

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Oh my God! Bobby!

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.text: Hi Dina. Good to see you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just what needs to be done! Dearly beloved, we are gathered here to join
this man and this woman…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Joey this is crazy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t interrupt me when I’m talkin’ to God! Now where were
we? Oh right, okay. Do you Dina, take this man…

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh you’ll take ‘em!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: No I won’t!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! You don’t get a say in this!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Yes I do!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahhh! I heard "I do", we’re halfway there! Okay! (To Bobby)
You!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right Joey! That is enough! (Grabs him and pulls him away from Bobby
and Dina) Listen, as beautiful and moving as this ceremony is, it’s not legal. Okay?
They-they don’t have a marriage license, they don’t have any witnesses, and the
groom only has on one shoe!

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.text: Yeah, he took the other one off and hit me with it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well what am I supposed to do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re supposed to realize that they are adults! And that they can
make their own decisions.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No they can’t! They were stupid enough to get knocked up!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Heyyyyy! Contraceptives are not always effective! (To Bobby and Dina)
Right?

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.text: Yeah…we kinda didn’t use any…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on kids! A little help here!
[Scene: Sting’s Apartment, Phoebe has come to talk about Jack and is waiting for
Sting’s wife, Trudie Styler, to enter.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! This place is incredible! (Gasps) Sting’s pen…that he
gave to Phoebe. (Puts the pen in her purse and goes over to a floor-to-ceiling bookcase)
Come on! Secret passageway! (Starts pulling books at random as Trudie enters.)

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: Hi! (By the way, it’s actually her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: I’m Trudie.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: You must be Ben’s mum.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why else would I be here?

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: Do sit down.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh. (They go and sit down.)

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: I gather Jack and Ben haven’t been getting along lately.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: I’m told there are two sides to this story, but all
I’ve heard is that Ben’s a bit of a poo-poo head.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, I’m sorry. Won’t-won’t Jack’s father be joining
us?

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: Oh I’m sorry, Jack’s father is not available.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-hmm. Okay. Well then, could we reschedule? For say, Friday night
perhaps at 8 o’clock?

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: Oh no, I know that wouldn’t work. My husband’s in
concert.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Concert. Yeah. That does put us in…quite a pickle. Because you see
I’m very busy before and after the concert, and he’s obviously busy during.

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: So, I guess you and I should talk about Jack and Ben right now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Unless! Unless umm, okay I-I would be willing to go to the concert, umm,
all the while thinking about the children of course.

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: Are you here for tickets?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, thank you. Four would be great.

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: I’m not giving concert tickets to someone who’d use
their son like this!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh good! Then you’re in luck! Ben’s not my son!

lines.speaker: Trudie Styler
lines.text: (stands up) Look, I’ve just pressed a button, triggering a
silent alarm. Any minute now, the police will be here!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The Police? Here? A reunion?! (She gets out her camera.)

scenes.location: The Street, Chandler is carrying Monica past a store window.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, ten blocks down. Five to go.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (notices something in the window) Oh wait! Stop! Stop! Stop!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh I’m sorry! Do you need a break?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My boots in tan! Hey! Can you get a little closer so I can see the
price?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can see it from right here. It’ll cost you one husband.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I’m sorry. I think I can walk the rest of the way now.
Just-just give me my boots.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pause) I don’t have your boots.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well I don’t have them either. Where are they?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, why don’t you check in one of my saddlebags while I chew on
a bale of hay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (She gets off him.) God well, we gotta go back and get them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, are you seriously ever gonna wear the boots again?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I’m never gonna wear them again. I just didn’t get a
chance to say goodbye.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what? You can say goodbye to the tan ones.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (Climbs back on his back.) All right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Moves closer to the window.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the boots) Bye boots—Wait! Half off?! (Chandler runs off.)
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey and Rachel are still discussing Bobby and Dina’s
situation.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, just because they’re not getting married doesn’t mean
this is going to be a disaster. Maybe they have a plan!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh? Oh! Okay! Okay! Let’s hear their plan! Now, what’s the
future look like for Dina and Bobby?

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.text: Well…I really have high hopes for my band.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Dina) You were right. He is funny.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, now wait a minute! I get when you told people at first that you
wanted to be an actor they laughed at you! Now come on Bobby, why don’t you tell us a
little bit about your band?

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.text: Well it’s just me and my pal Rooster, the band’s name is Numb
Nuts.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Dina) Really? (Nods her head at Bobby.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dina, if you’re having a baby you should be married! Even if it is to
Bobby! (Bobby gets happy.) Dude, that’s not a compliment!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: No Joey! I knew you wouldn’t be supportive!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa! What are you gonna do? You’re gonna have the
baby and-and raise it by yourself…without a husband?! You can’t be a single
mother alone! You’re gonna ruin your life!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh excuse me! Am I ruining my life?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No! No! It’s different for you. You’re so strong and
together. You’re not some dumb kid who doesn’t know what she’s doing.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: One pregnant woman at a time, please! I just want you to be okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So forcing her to marry Bobby is gonna make that happen?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe! (To Bobby) Well! Well…so-so uh, what kind of music does Numb
Nuts—Oh forget it! I can’t!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Joey, I am scared to death about this. But I really think I can do it,
I’m just gonna need some help. And Bobby’s gonna be here the whole time.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.text: You bet I am! (To Joey) And to answer your earlier question, we’re
straight-up gangster rap. (Joey shakes his head as if he’s about to lose it.)

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Look, Rachel’s told me how much easier you’ve made all this on
her. Why can’t you do that for me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because! ‘Cause… ‘Cause you’re my baby sister!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: And you’re my big brother! I mean, you’re my favorite guy in the
whole world. I’m not even scared to tell mom and dad. I was scared of telling you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well I’d be scared of them, but all right.

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: Joey, I can’t stand the thought of having this baby with you mad at
me. I want him to have his uncle. Is my baby gonna have his Uncle Joey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course he’s gonna have his Uncle Joey!

lines.speaker: Dina
lines.text: We’re gonna be all right. I mean, even if we’re not married this
baby is gonna be so loved. Not just by us.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s right! By his uncle too!

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.text: And by you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Bobby, why don’t we just come over here and let them have a
little moment. (Drags Bobby away from Joey and Dina.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come here! (Hugs Dina and Bobby looks to hug Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Seriously! What’s wrong with you?!

title: The One with Ross's Step Forward

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, Rachel is looking around the shop as Phoebe returns from getting
some more coffee.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look at that guy by the window, wow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He’s awfully short and I think he’s talking to himself. And to
be completely honest, he’s not that good in bed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, what is wrong with me lately? I mean it’s like every guy I
see—I mean look here. (Points behind them) Look at that guy for example, I mean
normally that’s not someone I would-would be attracted to, but right now, with the
way I’m feeling, all I want to do is rip off his sweatpants and fanny pack.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait a second! This is about the fourth month of your pregnancy, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is completely normal, around the fourth month your hormones start
going crazy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?! So this has happened to you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh absolutely yeah! Oh and keep in mind, now, I was carrying triplets so
in, y’know, medical terms I was-I was thrice as randy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! This explains so much! Last weekend, I went from store to store
sitting on Santa’s lap.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, I remember trying to steal a cardboard cutout of Evander
Holyfield from a Foot Locker.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, y’know what? I go see my doctor tomorrow, I’ll ask her
about this. Maybe she can give me a pill or something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, that’s what you need a good…pill.
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Ross are there as Mona enters.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hey! (To Joey) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hi! Look! I got our pictures developed from Rockefeller Center.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh great! Hey-hey Joey, do you want to check out pictures of me and Mona
ice skating?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh uh, ordinarily I would love too, but I am just swamped right now.
(Brushes something off of his shirt and looks around, but doesn’t move from his
chair.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey where-where are the pictures that creepy pretzel vendor took of us
together?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh yeah, probably at the end. (Flips to the end.) Oh my God! He only took
pictures of my breasts!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m missin’ picture time?! (Jumps over to look, Ross glares at
him and he retreats.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sitting down next to Ross) Y’know she has a face Ross!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Okay. Okay, here’s a good one of us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! That is a good one! Wow, it looks like a, like a holiday card
y’know, with the tree in the middle and the skaters and the snow.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Y’know, every year I say I’m gonna send out holiday cards and I
never do it. Do you wanna, do you wanna send this one out together?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pause) Together? Like-like to people?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Yeah, y’know. Happy holidays from Mona and Ross. It’ll be cute,
okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. (Not happy about it.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh, I gotta get to work. So call me later?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh sure, sure.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Bye guys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bye.
(Mona exits.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Ross) Congratulations! You just got married!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know. Can you believe that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, I’m-I’m sorry. What’s the big deal about a holiday
card?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Married couples send out cards, families send out cards, people who have
been dating for a couple of months do not send out cards! What-what is she crazy?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey, hey that’s your wife you’re talking about!

scenes.location: Chandler’s Office, his boss Doug is entering, Monica is there as well.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Bing! Ho! And the Bing-ette!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, you remember my boss Doug right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, hi.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Hi. So good news, the divorce is final. I signed the papers this A.M.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn’t know you and Carol were getting divorced, I’m
sorry.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Sorry? Finally chewed my leg out of that bear trap. Hey, congratulations
to you guys though!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No leg-chewing for us sir.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Oh well, give it time. So the divorce, the marriage, we’ve got a lot
to celebrate. How about we all go out to dinner tomorrow night?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t think of anything we’re doing. (Quietly) Why
can’t I think of anything we’re doing?

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Tomorrow night it is then, I should be out of court by six. They keep
throwing these sexual harassment cases at me and I keep knocking them out of the park!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I’ll see you tomorrow! (Doug exits.) Just so you know,
we’re not seeing him tomorrow. (Chandler wonders why.) I-I cannot spend another
evening with that man. Do you remember how he behaved at our wedding?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s because he wasn’t invited because of the way he behaved
at our engagement party.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah. Boy, urine cuts right through an ice sculpture
doesn’t it?

scenes.location: Ross's Apartment, there’s a knock on the door and he opens it to Mona.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hey, I went by the photo shop, take a look, here is a mockup of our card.
What do you think?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh. Wow, this is great.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Now, do you think it should say, "Love Ross and Mona?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, we-we haven’t said that to each other yet, but I guess its okay
to say it to other people.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: How many did you want? I’m getting a hundred.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A hundred?! Well, I-I guess I’ll take a—Mona, uh…I-I’m
not sure about the whole uh, card thing.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Really? Why not?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sending out a holiday card, together, I mean I just don’t know if
we’re really quite there yet.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh y’know, I didn’t think of it that way. You’re right.
You’re right. So, can I ask you a question?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Where are we?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Y’know, like where are we? Where is this relationship going?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I mean I love spending time with you, y’know I just—I hope
we’re moving forward. I mean, we should probably talk about that. Don’t you
think?
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let’s do the card!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The card! I think we’re there!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Okay. I—But I think we should still have this conversation.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?! I mean, even with the card?
[Scene: Rachel’s Doctor’s Office, she is waiting for her doctor as a nurse
enters.]

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Just so you know, Dr. Long can’t be here today, she was called to
the hospital, so Dr. Schiff will be seeing you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, okay. Hey, can I ask you a question? Was it me, or-or was the guy
who took my blood sample really cute? Y’know who I’m talking about, bald
haircut, hairy fingers… (Stops when she realizes it was her.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Schiff
lines.text: (entering) Hi Rachel? I’m Dr. Schiff. (By the way, he’s an
attractive man.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, you are.

lines.speaker: Dr. Schiff
lines.text: So, how’s it going?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, really, really good. But enough about me, come on! Where-where are
you from? What do you do?

lines.speaker: Dr. Schiff
lines.text: I’m a doctor.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right! Right! I-I actually meant in your spare time, do you cook? Do you
ski? Or do you just hang out with your wife or girlfriend?

lines.speaker: Dr. Schiff
lines.text: Uh, I don’t have a wife or girlfriend, but I do like to ski.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I love to ski! How amazing is this?!

lines.speaker: Dr. Schiff
lines.text: So, are you experiencing any discomfort?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. I’m very comfortable.

lines.speaker: Dr. Schiff
lines.text: Any painful gas?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Shoot, Dr. Schiff what kind of question is that?!

lines.speaker: Dr. Schiff
lines.text: Okay then, would you like to lie down on the table?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well would you like me to lie down on the table?

lines.speaker: Dr. Schiff
lines.text: I’m sorry, is there something going on here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you feel it too?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica and Phoebe are there as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hey! So, how did your doctor’s appointment go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, let’s see. Uh, they gave me cute doctor today and in the
middle of the exam I put my pinky in his chin dimple.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why did you do that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, remember that little problem I was having during my
fourth month of
pregnancy?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah, the Evander Holyfield phase. Oh man you were so hard up you
practically came on to me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You wish.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, I could’ve had you if I wanted you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah? Come and get it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, even this is turning me on!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh hey! Hey Ross! Hey how’s it, how’s it going with you and
Mona? Are you guys still together?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, yeah we’re moving forward. You’ll be getting our card!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You and Mona are doing a holiday card together?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, we’re not just doing a card! Y’know, she-she also wants to
have the conversation about where the relationship is going.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh! Women!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know! I know! Why do you guys need to have this conversation?! Huh? I
mean no self-respecting man would ask a woman, "So, where is this going?"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh Ross? You asked me that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! You were a closed book! Okay? I’m not a mind reader! Besides, I
hate those conversations. I’m horrible at them. Really! Maybe-maybe I need kind of a
gesture. Y’know, something that says we’re moving forward without having to talk
about it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Like asking her to move in with you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Smaller than that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Making her a mixed tape?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, bigger than that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Give her a key to your apartment.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa-hello! We were closer with the mixed tape.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. Have you said, "I love you?" You could say, I love
you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah I-I don’t-I don’t think I’m quite there yet, but I
could say I looove spending time with you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, we hate that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is a slap in the face.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Forget it. I-I—Y’know what? I’ll just have the
conversation. I’ll just say I like things the way they are, and hope for the best.
What do you think Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think, if it was a little colder in here I could see your nipples
through that sweater.

scenes.location: Chandler’s Office, Doug is entering.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Bing! We’re all set for tonight, 8 o’clock.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh uh, as it turns out, we can’t do it. Monica has to work.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Oh, my ex-wife didn’t work, unless you call turning into her mother
work. Fine. Tomorrow night then.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh uh well tomorrow’s no good for her either.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Oh? Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s the semi-finals…of her…botchy ball tournament.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: What’s going on Bing? Does uh, your wife have a problem with me or
something?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well now-now you’re just talking crazy.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: So why can’t the three of us go out together?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because uh…we-we…we split up. Monica and I split up. Hold
me.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Good God Bing I…well I can’t say I’m altogether surprised,
I saw the way she looked at you, and there was no love there. And the way she looked at
me, pure lust.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what would really help me through this tough time is
choking something. Can I choke ya?

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Bing my boy, we’re gonna get you over this. Now here’s the plan,
grab your coat, we’re going to a strip club.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, Monica would freak. (Doug looks at him.) But to hell with
that bitch.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is getting Mona some coffee.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here we go. Mona umm, I think it’s time we-we had a conversation
about-about where things are with us.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Yeah, I-I think I suggested that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aw, we-we are so…(Motions that they’re connected.) So umm, well
I-I-I like you and I-I love umm, y’know hanging out with you. And I mean-I’m
having a lot of fun. (He pauses and thinks there might be more, but decides there

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I mean, there’s no point in spending time with someone if-if
it’s just fun. It’s gotta be, it’s gotta be going somewhere right? So
where-where is it going? (Pause) Ah! That’s-that’s the real question. And-and
the answer is…is it’s going somewhere…fun. Now I-I know what you’re
thinking, fun was fine for you like ten years ago y’know, but you’re-you’re
not getting any younger. No I mean—No not you, not you, you—you are
getting younger. I mean—you-you look like you’re getting younger by the
second—What’s your secret?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I’m sorry, so umm, so where are we?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, well to sum up, we’re having fun, you look young.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Okay…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But that’s not enough. So… So…here’s a key to my
apartment. (Hands her his key.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: You don’t think this is too fast.
(Ross groans no.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Ross is telling Rachel and Monica about yet another mistake
he’s made with a woman.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You gave her a key to your apartment?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not just a key, I gave her the only key! I am now a homeless person in a
very serious relationship.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering with some guy) Hey. Ooh Ross! How’d the conversation go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh great, I live on the street.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where?! (Ross exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi! Okay, Monica, Rachel, this is my friend Roger.

lines.speaker: Roger
lines.text: Hey everybody.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi Roger.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So umm, I’m gonna get us some drinks. (To Rachel) Would you help me
out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. (They go into the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, he’s here to have sex with you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re welcome.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe no!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s okay, he’s a virgin.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel umm, I was just talking to this guy and I think he’ll have
sex with you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, okay let’s leave these two alone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! I do not care what my hormones are doing, I am not going to just do
it with some random guy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine! Then you tell Roger because he was really looking forward to this!
(Phoebe exits.)

scenes.location: A Strip Club, Doug and Chandler are there.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Oh Bing, look at those twin sisters dancing together. Let me buy you a lap
dance with those girls. Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh that’s all right sir, and that’s just one girl.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Bing—What’s this?! (Grabs his hand.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s a hand. It’s a thing you use as a Jack and Coke
holder.

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: No, it’s a wedding ring. You gotta get rid of it. We’re gonna go
to the East River right now and throw it in there!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no!

lines.speaker: Doug
lines.text: Oh yeah-yeah-yeah, y’know I did it and I felt a hell of a lot better
and if you whip it just right you might hit a seagull in the head.
[Scene: Ross's Apartment, a locksmith has finished changing the locks on Ross’s
door.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, and oh I’m gonna need a bunch of extra keys. Apparently I give
them away for no reason at all.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: (entering) Hey Ross, what’s going on? You changing the lock?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. That guy is.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I don’t understand. You-you give me a key to your apartment and then
you change the lock.

lines.speaker: Locksmith
lines.text: Good luck buddy. (Exits.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Umm, I-I thought we were moving forward and now you’re-you’re
sending me all these mixed signals. What are you trying to tell me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m trying to tell you I made you a mix tape.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I love you!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Ohh! (Hugs him.) And I love spending time with you. (Ross isn’t
happy.)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is eating dinner as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi honey I’m home.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: From the tequila factory?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It was awful. To get out of going to dinner with Doug I told him that
you and I split up. So then he took me to all these strip clubs and sleazy bars, and then
when I wouldn’t give him my wedding ring, he threw a soda can at a bird!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come here. I can breath through my mouth.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what the worse part was? I got to see what my life would
be like without you. It was like It’s a Wonderful Life with lap dances. Please
promise that you will never leave me, that we will grow old together, and be with each
other for the rest of our lives.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I promise. Hey, speaking of together, how about we send out a holiday
card this year?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, I don’t know if we’re there yet.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is on the phone.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes. Hi, I’d like to order a pizza. Okay, can I ask you a question?
Is-is the cute blond guy delivering tonight? Very Ambercrombie & Fitch. (Joey
enters.) I’ll call you back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who was that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s just the pizza place.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You hung up on the pizza place? I don’t hang up on your friends.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry honey, I’m just having a, having a rough day.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, what’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh you really, you really just don’t want to hear about it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then why did I ask?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, it’s just—and this is really embarrassing—but
lately with this whole pregnancy thing I’m just finding myself…how do I put this
umm, erotically charged.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is that college talk for horny?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. So y’know, I have all of these feelings and I don’t know
what to do about them, because I can’t date like a normal person, which is fine
because I don’t need a relationship, I mean all I really want is one great night.
Just sex, y’know? No strings attached, no relationship, just with someone that I feel
comfortable with and who knows what he’s doing. For just one great night, I mean is
that really so…hard…to find. (Looks at Joey.) So how was your day?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good, I uh, I saw a pretty big pigeon.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I gotta get up early and it’s almost seven o’clock.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I gotta, I gotta go to my room too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, good night!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good night. (They both enter their rooms.)
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) I can’t do it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) I didn’t ask you to do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You’re my friend!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right back at ya!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But plus, it would be wrong and weird and-and-and bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And so bad. I don’t even know what you’re talking about
because I didn’t ask you to do anything!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know!
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you wanna do it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, me neither! I was just testing you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s the end of this conversation!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This conversation never happened!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Never happened! Good night!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good night!
(They both go into their rooms and after a little while Rachel pokes her head into the
living room.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Get back in there! (Rachel re-enters her room and closes the door.)

title: The One Where Joey Dates Rachel

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Chandler are entering carrying groceries and
find Phoebe already there standing in front of a huge object that has been gift wrapped.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! I got you a present!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my goodness! Where did you hide it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I got it for your wedding and I ordered it weeks ago, and it finally got
here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs you didn’t have to get us anything for our wedding you
already sang…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) I love it! It’s huge!! Let’s open it! Open it!!
(Monica rips open the paper.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s a Ms. Pac-Man machine!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I didn’t know where to put it so I just left it here for now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh well, maybe we can put it in the guest bedroom.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. (He goes to push it and it doesn’t move.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I kinda like it here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do you really like it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you kidding?! I practically spent my entire childhood at the arcade!
This is like—Oh my, this is like my second favorite game!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh really? What was your first?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well I-I really don’t remember the name of it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well what did it do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you just—you put a quarter in and y’know pull-pull some
handles and win like a candy bar or something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A vending machine?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don’t feel bad for me! I won like every time!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Rachel are there as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Oh, I’m so glad you guys are here. I’ve been dying to tell
someone what happened in the Paleontology department today.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) Do you think he saw us or can we still sneak out?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Professor Neuman, the head of the department, so….

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They made you head of the department!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I get to teach one of his advanced classes! (Pause) Why didn’t I
get head of the department? (Goes and gets some coffee.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Hey Rach, listen umm…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I got a big date coming up, do you know a good restaurant?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, Paul’s Caf�. They got great food and it’s really
romantic.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, great! Thanks!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! Oh, and then afterwards you can take her to the Four Seasons
for drinks. Or you go downtown and listen to some jazz. Or dancing—Oh! Take her
dancing!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You sure are naming a lot of ways to postpone sex, I’ll tell ya…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I miss dating. Gettin’ all dressed up and going to a fancy
restaurant. I’m not gonna be able to do that for so long, and it’s so much fun!
I mean not that sitting at home worrying about giving birth to a sixteen pound baby is not
fun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, y’know what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why don’t I take you out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! Joey, you don’t want to go on a date with a pregnant lady.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes I do! And we’re gonna go out, we’re gonna have a good time,
and take your mind off of childbirth and c-sections and-and giant baby heads stretching

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting) Okay! I’ll go with ya! I’ll go! I’ll go
with ya.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’ll be fun.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right?

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is watching Phoebe play Ms. Pac-Man.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. No! Yes! Ahh. Oh, would you look at that Monica? I just knocked off
all of your top scores, how sad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I’m next. (Phoebe starts another game.) Don’t!
Don’t start another game! I said I’m next! Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry. I didn’t hear you over all the winning.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! Phoebe’s hogging the game!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who cares? It’s a stupid game.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You only think it’s stupid because you suck at it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t suck. It’s sucks. You suck.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait okay, if this game is gonna cause problems between the two of you,
then maybe I should just keep it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No-no! I love it! It is a great present! In fact, why don’t you
go home and wait for the thank you card?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why do you want to play this game so bad?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! It’s not like it spits out a Clark bar after every
game.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Phoebe that’s it. Come on, get out—out of the chair. Get
out! (She goes to move Phoebe, but Phoebe goes limp and Monica can’t move her.) Oh
come…Phoebe!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is getting ready for her date with Joey as there is a
knock on the door.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey? Could you get that? (There is no answer and she goes and opens the
door to Joey.) What are you doing here? I thought you were in your room?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I’m picking you up for our date. These are for you. (Hands her
some flowers.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh, Lilies. Joey, they’re my favorite. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And, a brownie! (Hands her a bag with the brownie in it.) Well, half a
brownie. Actually, it’s just bag. It’s been a long walk from the flower shop and
I was startin’ to feel faint so…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh man! This is so great! I actually feel like I’m going on a real
date! Although, I have a hint of morning sickness, and I’m wearing underwear that
goes up to about…(She snaps the waistband on her underwear that is just slightly
below her breasts)…there.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey come on now, this is a real date. Uh, so…nice place you got here.
Foosball, huh? Pizza box. Oh, a subscription to Playboy, my kind of woman.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, actually that’s my roommate’s.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I would like to meet him. He sounds like a stand up guy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah yes, but he’s very protective of me so you’d better watch
yourself.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah… Hey, so this roommate of yours…is he good looking?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hm-mmm.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, it must be tough to keep your hands of him, huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Yeah, but I’m pretty sure he’s gay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no-no-no, he’s not! No! Why are you trying to ruin the game? Come
on!

scenes.location: N.Y.U, Ross is teaching a class.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …which brings us back, of course, to Greely’s theory of dominance.
(The bell rings.) Okay, that-that’s all for today. Oh, uh does anyone know where the
Freeman building is?

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Yeah, it’s the new building on Avenue A.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! That-that’s all the way cross town, I’m supposed to teach
a graduate seminar there in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Student
lines.text: Ooh, dude. That’s not gonna happen.
(Ross grabs his things and runs to the door only to be blocked by his exiting
students.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Move it! Move it! Move it!! Hey!!! I’m the teacher!!

scenes.location: The Freeman Building, Ross is entering his new class completely out of breath.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello. (He throws his jacket towards the coat rack and misses.) I’m
sorry I’m a little late. Ah—(Checks his watch)—Whoa! A lot late. Let me
start by uh, by introducing myself, I am Professor Geller. (The bell rings.) So to sum up,
I’m Professor Geller. Good job today.

scenes.location: A Restaurant, a waitress is taking Joey and Rachel’s dinner order.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Now the filet mignon, what comes with that?

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.text: There’s a side of steamed vegetables.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Emmm. Now, instead of the vegetables, is there anyway I can substitute
the three-pound lobster?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what? Bring her both, and I’ll have the same. (The
waitress leaves.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! This is shaping up to be a pretty good date—Oh, I almost
forgot. I didn’t pay you the rent check.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh whoa-whoa-whoa, no roommate stuff. Okay? We’re on a date.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Wow! So I get to see what Joey Tribbiani is like on a date. So do
you have any moves?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No. Umm, just myself and if they don’t like me for—(Laughs.)
I’m sorry I couldn’t even get through that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I knew it! I knew it. Come on tell me your moves.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh alright. Umm, well, okay, I usually start by having a bottle of wine
sent to my table from a fan.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God. And that works?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well it does when you combine it with, "This is so embarrassing, I
just want to have a normal life!"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you poor little famous man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh okay, how about this one. I was gonna wait until the end of the night
to kiss you, but you’re so beautiful…I don’t think I can.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looks interested) Oh my God! Wow! That was fantastic, I almost leaned
in. I really almost did!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, so…so tell me one of your moves.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright. So where’d you grow up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s your move? Boy Rach, you’re lucky you’re hot.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on, just answer the question!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (exasperated) Queens.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And so were-were you close to your parents?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, with my mom. Yeah, not so much with my dad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know. I guess there’s just always been this distance
y’know—I mean we both try to pretend it’s not there, but it is.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sympathetic) Oh. (Starts rubbing his wrist with her fingers.) It’s
gotta be rough.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, it is. It’s really tough. Y’know sometimes I
think—Wow!! Nice move!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "Where’d you grow up," it’s so simple!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you! And now if you’ll excuse me, I have to go to the rest
room.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
(Rachel gets up and heads for the rest room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And now you’re watching me walk away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes I am! Again so simple!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is entering to find Chandler playing Ms.
Pac-Man.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You are not going to believe what I did today!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well it clearly wasn’t showering or shaving.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I got good. I played this game all day and now I rule at it! They
should change the name of it to Ms. Chandler. (Pause) Although I-I hope they don’t.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute, you stayed home all day and played Ms. Pac-Man
while I went off to work like some kind of chump?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-huh, and I got all the top ten scores, I erased Phoebe off the
board! High five! (Holds up his hand to give Monica a high five, only he can’t
straighten his fingers.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is the matter with your hand?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well I’ve been playing it for like eight hours, it’ll loosen
up. Come on, check out the scores. Oh, and also look at the initials, they’re dirty
words.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, why would you do that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because it’s awesome.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You think this is clever?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well y’know, they only give you three letters, so after A-S-S it
is a bit of a challenge.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey wait a minute, this one isn’t dirty.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It is when you put it together with that one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ah, well if you don’t clear this off, you won’t be getting one
of those from me. But Ben’s coming over here tomorrow to play this game, this
can’t be there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on, he won’t even know what they mean.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler! He’s seven; he’s not stupid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Have you talked to him lately?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, look I’m just gonna unplug it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-no-no, if you unplug it, I’ll have nothing to show for my day!
It would be like I was at work. (She unplugs it.) No! (And plugs it back in.) Hey look at
that! Look at that, it’s still there! This thing must have some kind of primitive ROM
(Read Only Memory, it’s a memory chip.) Chip in it or something!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey you-you got to beat your scores!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: With the claw?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right fine. Fine, I’ll do it. I’ve just got to get this
off the screen. Carol and Susan are still upset that you taught him pull my finger.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiles) Pull my finger—(Looks at his hand)—My hand is
messed up.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's, Joey and Rachel are returning from their date.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am not gonna answer that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh come on! Just pick one! Between Monica, Phoebe, Chandler, and Ross if
you had to, if you had to, who would you punch?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No one! They are my friends, I wouldn’t punch any of them.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but I don’t know why. Look at me, I’m having such a
wonderful time!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too! Hey Rach, can I just say I think this is the best date I ever had!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I never laughed so hard—Did you see the wine come out of my nose?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, I think everyone saw the wine come out of your nose.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I gotta say, I never knew I could enjoy the non-sex part of the date so
much.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well that is because you have never been on a date with me before.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh. Huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, now don’t judge me. I normally wait until my date
leaves, but you live here. I’m ripping into this swan.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah! Okay, well then you don’t judge me. I’m gonna suck on the
cellophane from the brownie I had before. (They both do as they planned.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So tell me, what are Joey Tribbiani’s end of the night moves?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, well, if I want the girl to kiss me, first thing I do is make my lips
look irresistible.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How do you do that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now you can’t tell anyone, but uh…I put on shiny lip balm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, like a moth to a flame, I’m telling ya. Okay all right, so now
you go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I don’t want to tell you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because it’s embarrassing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: More embarrassing than shiny raspberry lip balm?! (Rachel just looks at
him.) I didn’t say raspberry before did I? All right just-just tell me Rach, just
tell me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Okay. All right, stand up. (They do so.) Well, when we’re
at the door, I lightly press my lips against his, and then move into his body just for a
second, and then I make this sound, "Hmmm." Okay, I know it doesn’t sound
like anything, but I swear it works.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (stunned and turned on) Yeah. Why—Yeah, that would work for ya…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I gotta go to bed. Honey, I had such a wonderful time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. (She kisses him.) Yeah. (She goes into her room.) Me to. (He then
starts to freak out.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is telling Rachel about his class location predicament.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …you were 50 minutes late to the class, what did you crawl there?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I ran. It was really far, and when did people stop understanding the
phrase, "Get the hell out of my way!"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, why didn’t you just take a cab?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ugh, between the traffic that time of day and all the one-way streets
it’ll take me twice as long. Besides, I teach the class three times a week, who am I?
Rockefeller?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well you’re not gonna be able to keep doing this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well I have to. Okay? If I don’t, they’ll take the class away
from me. And…I already put it in my family newsletter.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’ve seen it, the Geller Yeller.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right. Wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Besides, I-I think I figured out a much faster route, I’m sure I can
make it this time. I just…I just can’t be afraid to get a little bit…hit by
cars. (He goes to the bathroom as Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Hey, remember how last night we were talking about that movie Cujo?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, I still can’t believe you haven’t seen Cujo.
What is wrong with you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Relax! It’s not like it’s Citizen Kane!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Have you ever tried to sit through Citizen Kane?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah I know it’s really boring, but it’s like a big deal.
Anyway, I was thinking about renting Cujo sometime.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah? All right, let’s do it tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well don’t you have that big date tonight?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Joey, can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: After our date last night, did you feel a little weird?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God! You did too? It totally freaked me out, what was that?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know! (Pause) I’m-I’m kinda thinking it-it was
the lobster…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah-yeah, the lobster.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I mean I was up sick all night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah me too, all night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?! How come we didn’t cross paths?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah well that’s because uh…I stayed in my room. Yeah, you
don’t want to look in my hamper.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is trying to erase Chandler’s dirty words
while he looks on.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I got that. I’ll escape over there. I’ll come back over
here. All right, come on Ms. Pac-Man. It’s got—Right—(She dies.)
Well, you’re just a little bitch, aren’t you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey, you guys. Listen, I’m sorry that I was hogging the
game before—(Sees the top ten list)—Oh my God! Your friends have some
unfortunate initials!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They’re all Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler sucks! He couldn’t have gotten this good!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I did. (Looks at his still deformed hand) But it came at a price.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But Ben is coming over tonight and he can’t see this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh come on, by age seven kids have already seen orgies. (They both
look at him.) Was it just me?!

scenes.location: N.Y.U, Ross’s new class, he is entering out of breath.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!!!! Yes, I made it! I’m on time! (Grabs a bottle of water from a
student, takes a drink, and splashes some on his face like the marathon runners do.) Okay,
why don’t we all uh, (Exhales loudly) open our books to page 23. Where… (Exhales
again) Where you will see…a uh…a bunch of uh…red spots. Okay, (Closes his
book.) umm, why don’t, why don’t you all start to read, while I—(Passes out
and collapses.)

scenes.location: A Restaurant, Joey is on his hot date and they’re not speaking right now.

lines.speaker: Joey's Date
lines.text: Hey. Are you all right? You seem a little distracted.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no! I’m fine. It’s just… Hey, can I ask you something?
Have you ever looked at someone that you’ve known for a while and then
suddenly…suddenly see them a different way?

lines.speaker: Joey's Date
lines.text: You mean like from behind?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, that…that’s exactly it. You’re right. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey's Date
lines.text: Ew, y’know what? One time I saw this guy from behind and he
seemed like a totally normal guy and then he turned around and it was Stephan Baldwin!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (deadpan) Ooh! Yeah. So yeah, so you know exactly what I’m talking
about.

lines.speaker: Joey's Date
lines.text: Totally! Wow! (Pause) Would you excuse me for a sec?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, sure. (She gets up, walks towards the bathroom, and Joey watches
