her go.) Ehhh.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, now it’s Phoebe’s turn to erase Chandler from
the board.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God Phoebe, you’re on fire!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: One more score to go! You can do it! (Touches her shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t touch me!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don’t touch her!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right! Go left! Go left! Go right!! Go right!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t!! I can’t!! (She dies.) Noooooooo!!!!!!! You son of a
bitch!!!!!
(At this point a stream of obscenities burst forth from Phoebe’s mouth just in
time for Ben and Ross to enter and hear most of it, and in slow motion Ross tries to
shield his innocent son from Phoebe’s vulgarity.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hi Ben—No!! Don’t look at the machine! (Covers the screen.)
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is watching Cujo while Joey returns from his
date scaring Rachel.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God! Thank God you’re home! I’m watching Cujo.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (incredulous) Alone?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! But what is wrong with this dog?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, did you get to the part where they’re trapped in the car and
Cujo’s throwin’ himself at the windshield?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No! Seriously, what’s wrong with the dog?! Wait a minute, what
are you doing home so early? What happened to your date?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh uh, it didn’t work out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Do you want to watch the rest of the movie with me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh uh, okay. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know, I never thought I’d say this about a movie, but I
really hope this dog dies. (Joey brings over a stool at sits on it next to Rachel
who’s in the big chair.) What are you doing over there? Come sit here, you protect
me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh sure, yeah, why not? (Sits on the arm of the chair.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Pushes play.) Okay, that’s him! That’s him! That’s
Cujo! That’s Cujo!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, I know! I know. Yeah, it’ll be okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God….What’s he gonna do now? I can’t watch! (Drags
Joey closer to her and cowers into his chest.) Oh. Seriously, how can you watch this?
Aren’t you scared?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Terrified. (But for a totally different reason.)

title: The One Where Chandler Takes a Bath

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and Rachel’s, Joey is at the counter eating a bowl of Frosted
Flakes.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinking) All right. It’s a new day. All that stuff about
Rachel, you don’t feel that now. It was crazy! You’re fine.
You’re better than fine! You are, as your friend Tony would say, Grrrreat!
Everything’s normal! She’s just your friend Rachel! Your friend
Rachel. Your friend! Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (coming from her room) Hi, sweetie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinking) Hey, it’s your girlfriend, Rachel!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s, Chandler is sitting on the couch watching TV as
Monica comes out of the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (airily) Hi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you, are you high?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just had the most amazing bath.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? I don’t like baths.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait, you like them with me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, it’s not the bath I enjoy, it’s the wet, naked lady.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, baths are so relaxing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? What do you do? You just sit in there stewing in your own filth.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How dirty do you think I am? I’m telling you, if you had some candles
and some bubbles and some music, you would love it! It would take all of your stress away.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, it’s 2:00 on a Wednesday and I’m watching Road Rules,
how stressed do you think I am?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey, Chandler, you got a minute? I-I really need to talk to you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Uh, yeah! Is this a cold pizza talk or a leftover meatloaf talk?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, neither.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God, what’s up?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know. It’s-it’s just…lately, I’ve been
feeling… Okay, here’s what it is… (Pause) You know what? I feel a lot
better, thanks! (Starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no, no you don’t, just come back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. Okay. You and Monica, friends for a long time, and sure there are
rules, but then you went to London. Oh, no, but that’s different. I mean, there are
rules there, too! You know what I mean?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It was different for you guys! I mean, I mean, you were both in the same
place, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: In London?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes. When Monica and I were in London, we were both in London.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know what? This is a bad idea. Forget it. Forget it, and listen, do me a
favor, this conversation was between you and me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If that.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Rachel are sitting on the couch. Ross sits down.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Oh, Ross, don’t forget, we have that doctor’s appointment
tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, are you going to find out the sex of the baby?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No-no, we talked about it. We don’t want to know. All we care about is
that it’s happy and healthy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yep! Happy and healthy! And cute!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And smart!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Popular.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: With an aptitude for science.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you two talking about the same baby? Hey! Have you started off thinking
of names yet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! I’ve come up with a bunch of ideas!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? Me too!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh huh! If it’s a girl, Phoebe, and if it’s a boy, Phoebo!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Maybe. But it wouldn’t hurt to have a backup, you know? Uh, Rach-Rach,
what were you thinking? (Gives her a look)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay! I was thinking if it’s a girl, how about Sandrine? It’s
French.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh. That’s a really pretty name for-for an industrial solvent.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay fine, what do you have?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, OK, it’s for a boy. Well, I know it’s a little out there,
but…Darwin.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, oh my God, our child will be beaten to death in the schoolyard.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, by Sandrine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re just saying that 'cause I said no to your name!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m really, really not.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How-how about you each get five vetoes?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That sounds fair.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! I don’t think you’re going to need it though. Okay, check
this out. If it’s a girl, Rain.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Veto.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rain? Hi. Hi, my name is Rain. I have my own kiln, and my dress is made out
of wheat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know her! I bought homemade soap from her at a Dead show!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, how about, for a guy, Thatcher?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, why do you hate our child?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, you go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, James.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But only if it’s a girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, veto. How about—Ooh, I like Ruth! What about Ruth?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! I’m sorry! Are we having an 89-year-old? How about Dayton?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Veto. Stewart?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Veto. Sawyer?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Veto. Helen?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Veto.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Is it me, or is veto starting to sound really good?

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s, Monica comes from the bathroom as Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Boy, do I have a surprise for you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sex on the balcony?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, but someone’s really not going to get over that idea, are they?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I drew you a bath!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, I don’t like baths! Could you draw me a picture of us having
sex on the balcony?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please, could you just try it for me? Come on, I used all my best stuff!
I-I-I lit some candles. I put on some music. I used bath salts, plus bubble bath! And got
you this little plastic Navy ship. So it’s a boy bath!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, this does butch it up a bit.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I swear, if you try it, you will love it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, if I do this, can we at least discuss sex on the balcony?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Absolutely.
(Chandler runs into the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bet I know how that discussion’s going to go.
[Cut to Chandler laying in the bathtub. "Only Time," is playing in the
background.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (thinking) All right, this isn’t so bad. I like the flower
smell! Which is okay, because I’ve got my boat.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) So?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I told you you were a bath person! Hey, when you get out, maybe I can give you
a facial!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m going to need a bigger boat.
[Scene: The Doctor’s Office, the doctor is writing something as Rachel is on the
table, and Ross is standing.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t think you had an open mind about the name Ruth. I mean, come on,
little Ruthie Geller, how-how cute is that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, oh my God! I can practically hear the mahjong tiles!

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: Okay! All your tests look fine. Now, are you two interested in knowing
the sex of the baby?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, no. No, we’re not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But you have it right there in that file? You could tell us whether
it’s a boy or a girl? Dayton or Sandrine? Phoebe or Phoebo?

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: That’s right. But if you don’t want to know…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, we want to wait, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right. Right.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: (looks at her beeping pager) Oh, I’ll be right back. And, uh, I know
it’s really not my place, but please don’t name your child Phoebo.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at the bulletin board with baby pictures) So, which of these
babies do you think is the ugliest?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Rach! Come on, that’s terrible!
They’re…uh…they’re babies. They’re-they’re all beautiful.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Third one from the left?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, why is it staring at me? I think it knows I’m talking about it.
(Rachel starts to peek at the file) Don’t-don’t you—Wh—Wha—Hey!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’re looking!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I didn’t!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I saw you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay fine, I did. But I didn’t see anything, I swear.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shame on you! Ugly baby judges you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, but Ross just listen to me…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no, no! Don’t tell me! I don’t want to know!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I couldn’t even if I wanted to, because I don’t know! I
swear; I didn’t see anything, and I don’t want to know! It was just a momentary
lapse.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Momentary lapse. Don’t-don’t you have any self-control?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (holding stomach) Okay, a couple months late on the lecture, Ross.

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica’s, Monica is entering.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m in the bathroom, can you come in here? I think there’s
something wrong.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what? I-I think I’ll wait out here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m in the bathtub.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. (She goes into the bathroom.) What’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I drew my own bath, but I did it wrong! The water’s tepid. The salt
didn’t dissolve and is now… lodged places. And the scents I used don’t
compliment each other. Eucalyptus and chamomile—Oh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The bath salts! They’re starting to effervesce! It’s different.
(Pause) It’s interesting.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, let’s talk about something else.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! Sure, sure. So, what was going on with you today? Oh-oh-oh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I actually had the weirdest conversation with Joey. He was talking
about rules and right and wrong and…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I had the exact same conversation.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You did? What was he talking about?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know! Joey hasn’t had this much trouble getting out
words since we saw him in Macbeth!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (groans) That was a long night.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, let’s break this down. What exactly did he say to you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, he was talking about rules.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, and looking at people differently.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He didn’t say anything about that to me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What did he tell you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He was asking all these questions about you, me, and London. And, of
course the glue that holds this all together, the rules.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. So you, me and London. Looking at people differently. Maybe he wants
to do what you and I did in London with someone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But what did he mean by rules?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute! He stopped talking the minute Phoebe came in!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because he was looking at her differently.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And Phoebe is his friend, so he thinks that would be breaking the rules!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: My God! He wants to do it with Phoebe in London!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (from outside the bathroom) You guys?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just a minute! (To Chandler) That’s Mrs. Tribbiani!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t say anything.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why would I say anything? That two of our best friends could start the
greatest love affair of their lives! And they would have me to thank, and we could all
start having babies?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not going to let you say anything.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You just stay here! (Dumps a jar of bath salts in the bathtub)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, God!
(Monica runs out to Phoebe, who is in the kitchen)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hey, Monica, I brought back your iron.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you had that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I thought I lost it. I got a new one, like, a month ago.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, just as well, I broke this one.
(Monica starts smiling)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean, I-I, I really shouldn’t say. I mean, I’m really not
supposed to.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s a humdinger!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then it’s really too bad that you can’t tell me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Somebody likes you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Groans) Is it Chandler?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, then tell him to stop staring!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s Joey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really?! Joey?! You don’t say.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is it something you’d be interested in?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know, I don’t know, I don’t know. You know, I mean,
on the one hand, Mother may I? But y’know on the other hand… No. No, I
can’t. We’re friends. No, oh, no. I don’t want to risk what we have.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess that makes sense. So, you think you’re going to talk to him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure, yeah. I mean, it’s Joey. I don’t want him to get hurt.
Well, I must say, I am on fire! First Chandler, now Joey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not Chandler, just Joey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure.
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central perk, Ross is sitting on the chair as Rachel walks in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what? I’ve been thinking about it. I’m really coming
around on the name Ruth. I think I would actually consider naming our child that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, I-I can’t tell you how-how much that means to me! Ohh… Wait a
minute. Wait a minute. You-you hated the name Ruth! Why-why would you change your mind?
Unless, you know we’re never going to have to use it. You did see the folder. You
know it’s a boy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I didn’t see anything! I actually changed my mind about the name.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t think so! You’re just giving me Ruth so you’ll get to
name it when it’s a boy, and that’s when you’ll swoop in and name him Heath
or Blaine or Sequoia.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I would—Sequoia?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Veto.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Unless… (Rachel groans.) You anticipated that I would figure all
this out and you know that it actually is a girl, and you really do want her to be named
Ruth! Well, I’m not falling for that! Okay? Ruth is off the table!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But Ross, you want the name Ruth!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not like this!

scenes.location: Rachel and Joey’s, Joey is sitting on his recliner as Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey. Well, what’s up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, Joey, I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I knooow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whaaat?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know about your feelings.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God. You do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, and I’m sorry. I-I know things worked out for Chandler and
Monica, but that’s very rare.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know. I know. And this is so much more complicated than it was for those
guys. I mean, it’s Rachel for God sakes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: For God sakes, it’s Rachel!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know. I know. And she’s not only my friend; she’s my pregnant
friend! She’s my pregnant friend who’s Ross’ ex!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah that’s Rachel. (To herself) Beat me over the head with it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What am I going to do? You know, and I keep, I keep trying to get rid of
these feelings, y’know? I stayed up all last night and made a list of everything I
don’t like about her. You want to hear it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She made me switch to light Mayo. That’s it! That’s all I got! And,
you know what? It tastes the same and my pants fit better!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, I just think you’re getting worked up over nothing. This is
probably just a crush.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You think?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Absolutely! Y’know, you get this rush of feelings, but then it goes
away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, just a crush! That’s all this is! It’s a crush! I’m
Joey; I don’t get deep feelings.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s right, there you go! Crushes happen all the time! I know
I’ve had them for all you guys. Well, except for Ross and Chandler. And I’m sure
you’ve had them for us.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mm-hmm. (To herself) Throw me a bone here.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel is on the couch as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, I uh… I called the doctor and now we both know the sex of the baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s right. The student has become the master.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I swear, I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, come on, you know it’s a girl!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A what?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You really didn’t know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’re having a girl?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s what you just said!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You said girl!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. I’m… I’m sorry. I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not! We’re having a girl! Sometimes I can’t believe
it’s with you—But still! We’re having a girl!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know! I know. You know what? I’m putting Ruth back on the table!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yes! We’ll have ourselves a little baby Ruth…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Permission to veto.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, please.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s, Chandler enters as Monica comes from the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do I smell essential oils?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I’m going to take a bath. I’m just going to get a magazine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(As soon as Monica leaves the room, Chandler takes off his jacket and runs to the
bathroom. Monica enters the bathroom to find Chandler in the bathtub.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you think you’re doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: L-leaving my troubles behind?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know that you’re new at this, but this is completely unacceptable
bath decorum.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it’s so hard to care when you’re this relaxed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine, you can have the bath, but I am taking your boat. Now you’re
just a girl in a tub!
(Phoebe enters the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (upset) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi, Bubbles. Manly. Well, I just thought I would drop by and let you know
how it went with Joey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) You told her?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She pulled it out of me! She’s like a conversational wizard!
How’d it go?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, you were wrong, he doesn’t like me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! How would you like it if I sent you to Lee Majors’ house and
told you that he liked you, and you went down there and you found out that he didn’t
like you? How would you feel?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Pause) I don’t think I’d care.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? Lee Majors is hot!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (from outside the bathroom) Hello?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We’re in the bathroom!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastically) Because it’s a relaxing and enjoyable time!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering the bathroom) What are you guys doing in here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! A friend he’s looking at differently, but it’s wrong.
It’s Rachel!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You like Rachel?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s no big deal, okay? Phoebe and I talked about it. It’s just a
crush! It’s going to go away! (Looks down) Dude, you gotta rearrange your bubbles!
Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (checking for herself) (To Monica) Mazel tov.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Ross and I were looking for you! What are we all doing in
here? (Looks at Chandler) Oh, my! (Covers the spot where Joey wants bubbles to be
replaced.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, cover it up with the boat!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (from outside the bathroom) Hello?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastically) Yes we’re all in here and we would love for you to
join us!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Well hey! What’s going on? Ooh, cool boat—(Sees why the
boat’s there)—Oh, no. (Averts his eyes by looking around the room) (To Rachel)
Hey, did you, did you tell them?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I was waiting for you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Tell us what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We’re having a girl.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, wow! Yay! Wow! Hooray! Oh, man!
(They all hug and then turn and look at Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll…I’ll get you later!

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel’s, Joey is sitting at the counter eating Cocoa Puffs.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinking) All right. It’s a new day, and it’s just a
crush, that’s all! Just a little crush! All that worrying I was doing,
that was crazy. Crazy! Like my friend here the bird would say, "it
was cuckoo!" Everything’s going to be fine. It’s just a crush.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi, sweetie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinking) I love you.

title: The One with the Secret Closet

scenes.location: The Hallway, Phoebe walks up to and knocks on Chandler and Monica’s door.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (opens the door wearing a robe, but leaves the chain on) Hey,
what’s up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I left my guitar here again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, okay. No problem.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Monica closes the door, gets the guitar, and then hands it out.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here you go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great! Umm…(Monica closes the door again and Phoebe knocks again.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So do you want to hang out or something?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe! You kinda caught me at a bad time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh are you and Chandler…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! Exactly.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Do you guys want me to play for you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) No. (Closes the door as Chandler walks up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, what’s up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You ask an intriguing question Chandler Bing.
(Chandler lets her into the apartment and reveals that Monica is getting a massage from
another woman.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! You’re getting a massage! You never let me massage you!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, I can explain!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You told me you hate massages!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Buy stamps, pick up dry cleaning…Don’t let Phoebe in.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t believe this! How long as this been going on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well umm, Alexandra has been…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it has a name?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, don’t get upset!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay—Oop! Too late! I’m leaving! Come on Chandler let’s
go! (She storms out.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, Phoebe I thought I’d—(Off Phoebe’s
look)—Yeah, what the hell. (Exits with Phoebe.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Joey’s Bedroom, Joey is having a dream about Rachel giving birth with him
as the father.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh okay, okay! One more push! One more push! Come on honey, we’re
almost there! We’re almost there!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Joey, I’m so happy things worked out for us that we’re
having this baby together. I love you so much.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I love you too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I hope it’s not an inappropriate time to say this but,
you’re the best sex I ever had.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s always appropriate! (Back to the matter at hand) Oh, okay. One
more push! One more push!
(Finally, the baby is delivered and starts crying.)

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Oh, here is your beautiful baby. Congratulations!
(She hands the baby to Joey who pulls down the blanket to reveal Ross’s face where
the baby’s should be.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (crying) I hope you’re a better father than you’re a friend!!
(Cries again and Joey wakes up in horror.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (bursts into the room) Joey! Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come feel this! Come feel my belly!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aaaah…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! The baby is kicking for the first time! Will you please come feel
this?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes!
(Joey starts to get up but stops.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, y’know what? Maybe uh, you…you should come to me. I’m a
not, I’m not wearing any bottoms.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, okay! (She goes over to him and he feels her belly.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my, oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw, it’s unbelievable! Wow! She is kicking so much! Oh, she’s
like umm…oh…who’s that kind of annoying girl soccer player?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mia Hamm?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mia Hamm!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh that’s amazing. (Drops the sheet.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking down) Oh-oh!! One hand on the sheet Joe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-hey-oh! Sorry!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica has opened another wedding present as Chandler
enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey babe.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi honey. We just got a wedding gift from Bob and Faye Bing; they
don’t like us do they? (They gave them a pok-a-dotted punch bowl.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who says you can’t get a nice punch bowl for under six bucks?
Maybe we can take it back?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it doesn’t say where it came from. Where would we return it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How about to the street say from the balcony?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don’t we just find a place for it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. How about in that cabinet?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! That’s where we keep the canned goods! Have you completely
forgotten everything you learned at orientation?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How about the closet by the bathroom? (The secret green door by the
bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, okay. Here, why don’t you let me do it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, I will do it. Honey, you have to learn to sit down and
relax and let your husband take care of things once and awhile. (Tries the door.)
It’s locked, you have to help me. Why is it locked?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No reason. I-I keep private things in there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh y’know, I’ve been living here a while and I’ve never
seen what’s inside that closet. What is, what is in there?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Feminine stuff.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don’t try to make me uncomfortable with feminine stuff!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, there is nothing in there that concerns you! If you love me
you-you’ll let it go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you! (He tries the door again and Monica glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (walking casually away) Love you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hello Chandler, lovely day huh? (To Monica) You!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe if it helps Alexandra has only been massaging Monica for like
three years. (Phoebe rolls her eyes and walks away and Monica glares at him.) If! I said,
"If it helps!" (Goes to the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why won’t you let me massage you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well it’s…I mean I’d just—I’d be
self-conscious. You’re my friend; I’d be naked.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica! We lived together for years! I’ve seen you naked!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s different, we were roommates! And when?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m curious about the human body.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, come on Phoebe, you can understand why this would be weird for me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But I’m a professional! And I’m really good! Look, if
you’re uncomfortable we can stop. Just give me a chance, okay. Please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, if it means that much to you…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It does! How would you feel if you couldn’t share your cooking?
Or-or imagine how Ross would feel if he couldn’t teach us about dragons.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Dinosaurs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Potato, potaato.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey and Rachel are there as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross! The baby’s kicking!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! It is?! (He tries to quickly remove his gloves, but runs into
trouble and finally throws them off of his hands like a hockey player in a fight and grabs
Rachel’s belly.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s not kicking right now. Although we would love to see you do
(Mimics him) that again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, when-when was it kicking? What happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Last night! I just felt it and I went into Joey’s room and he was
sleeping…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A dreamless sleep.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My God, the baby’s kicking. That’s great. Although I…kinda
wish I-I would’ve been there to feel the kicking for the first time y’know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well I got stuff going on in here (Rubbing his belly) if you wanna feel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I-I don’t want to miss anymore baby stuff. So…Here.
Here’s my new pager number, okay? Anytime anything pregnancy related happens use it!
I’ll be there! Okay? I don’t care if it’s three in the morning and all you
want is ice cream.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! Can I get a copy of that?

scenes.location: Phoebe's Apartment, Monica is lying on the massage table waiting for Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (calling from her room) Are you under the sheet?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes.
(Phoebe turns on some music and grabs some oil.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (in a soothing voice) Great, let’s begin. (She starts the massage.)
How’s the pressure?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nice! Wow Phoebe you are good!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Stating the obvious, but thank you. And it’s not weird is it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. Ooohh…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s right, you just enjoy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (in a sexy voice) Oh. Oh yeah! Ohhhhh! Ohh! Oh yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (getting uncomfortable) Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God Phoebe!! (Phoebe covers one ear.) Oh that’s it! That’s
it! Right there! Oh! (Tries to cover the other ear.) Ooooh-oooh-ooooh… (Covers both
ears and continues the massage with her elbows.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler has a box of keys and is trying them on the
secret closet when someone enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I wasn’t trying to open your closet! I wasn’t trying to open
your closet! I swear! (Running into the kitchen and sees its Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, Monica runs a pretty tight ship over here. What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica has a secret closet and she won’t let me see what’s
in it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know! What could she possibly be hiding in here that I
can’t see?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know. Ooh, I bet it’s Richard.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why would Monica be keeping Richard in here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well off the top of my head uhh, maybe she’s having her cake and
eating it too. You being the cake and Richard being the too. Or!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And here we go…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I saw this movie once where there was a door and no one knew what was
behind it, and when they finally got it open millions and millions and millions of bugs
came pouring out and they feasted on human flesh. Y’know it wouldn’t kill ya to
respect your wife’s privacy! (He walks away and into his apartment and looks the
door.) Stupid closet full of bugs!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey. Joey, something feels weird and not good weird. I
don’t—Whoa!! (Winces in pain.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey whoa-whoa, don’t worry. Okay. When my sisters were pregnant
they got every weird feeling in the book, it was always nothing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Absolutely. But, we’re gonna stop by the hospital just to be
sure, okay? I’ll page Ross on the way. Come on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Oh God—Ow!—Oo!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay Rach-Rach-Rach look at me, look at me, everything’s gonna be
fine, trust me. Okay. Take my hand. Here we go. (Rachel grabs his hand.) Oww crushing
bones!
[Scene: The Hospital, Joey is in the waiting room as Rachel comes back out with the
doctor.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! So?

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: She’s fine. She’s experiencing Braxton-Hicks contractions,
mild discomfort caused by contractions in the uterine wall.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmm, mild discomfort. So I take it you’ve had one of these Braxton
thingies?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So but everything is normal.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: Absolutely.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And-and there’s no danger to her and the baby?

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: No-no. Contractions can be unnerving if you don’t know what they
are, but she’s fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you doctor. (Dr. Long exits.) (To Joey) Oh thank you for being so
nice and calm.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Calm?! I wasn’t calm! I’ve never been more scared in all my
life!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But wait you said everything was gonna be okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well what do I know?! I’m not a doctor!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I—But everything is okay. I’m fine!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You sure?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! Yes! I got half a mind to contract that doctor’s uterus
though. Mild discomfort, what’s he talking about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (seeing Ross) Oh hey-hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (rushes in) Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, everything’s fine!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Your page said come to the hospital, what? What was it? What happened?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Something called Braxton-Hicks contractions.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Oh. Thank God, most women don’t even feel them.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, no uterus, no opinion.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey uh, what’s with the candy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh when you beeped me I was on line at the concession stand at the movie
theater.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh you went to the movies by yourself?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No I—Mona!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I gotta go back in there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Why? What’s wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, everything’s fine. I just gotta go back…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No really, you tell me what’s up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I-I forgot my underwear. (Ross lets her go.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Joey) So, thanks so much for bringing her to the hospital.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey, don’t worry about it man. Don’t worry about it, no big
deal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah but still, I mean it should’ve been me. I’m the dad.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: (To Joey) Uh, if you have any questions, here’s some information
on Braxton-Hicks. (Hands Joey a pamphlet.) Oh and by the way, you did the right thing by
bringing her in. You’re gonna make a wonderful father.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh uh, hey. Not as good as this guy! (Grabs Ross around the shoulders.) He
brought Twizlers!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Joey and Chandler are still working on the door.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There has got to be a way!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Easy there Captain Kirk. Oh, do you have a bobby pin?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. (Checks his hair.) Oh no wait, I’m not an nine-year-old
girl.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Then why do you throw like one?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe Monica has a bobby pin.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure. "Monica."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, how’s the hideously inappropriate crush on Rachel coming?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, really good. Really good. Yeah, I should be ready to kill myself any
day now. (Chandler returns with a bobby pin and hands it to Joey.) Wow, you sure found
that quick. (He tries the pin in the lock.) I just—I wish I didn’t feel this way
about Rachel anymore, y’know? I wish things could go back to normal. I mean, I love
living with her and God, helping out with the baby is just amazing, but now I think…I
think Ross feels left out. Y’know? When I had to take Rachel to the hospital, the
doctor thought I was the father. God… You should’ve seen the look on Ross’s
face. (Pause) By the way, I have no idea what I’m doing here. For all I know I’m
just locking it more. Oh hey, did you try opening it with a credit card?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s a good idea.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (They switch places and Chandler gets out a credit card.) So uh,
Ross is kinda bummed huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I just…I feel terrible.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it’s not your fault. What are you gonna do? Not take her to
the hospital? Y’know? You’re doing nothing wrong. (Pause) Except for harboring
an all consuming love for the woman whose carrying his baby. (He loses his card behind the
door.) Richard? If-if you’re in there, could you pass me my credit card?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is on the couch as Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I gotta tell you, yesterday was amazing. That massage felt so good!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No-no, I got that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So umm, what do you say we make it a weekly appointment?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Okay but you should know though, I’ve raised my rates to $200
an hour.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I mean $500.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you make sex noises when you get massaged!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? (Laughs.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and it really freaked me out! And after a while I even tried to
hurt you and it just spurred you on.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?! You’re crazy! There’s nothing sexual about the noises I
make!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? There’s nothing sexual about this? (Sexily) Oooh. Oo God!
Ohh. Ohhhh. Ohh. (Some cute guy is watching closely.) (To him) What are you looking at?!
(Pause) I mean hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my—This is so embarrassing. Oh my God, I’m never gonna get
massaged again!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, you can’t let this stop you from getting massages! No look, I
have, I have lots of clients that make the same noises you do!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well not clients, lovers. But let’s just y’know, try it again.
Come back and-and we’ll work through it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great! Okay, if you’ll just excuse me. (To the guy) So, did you
hear something you liked?
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Rachel is balancing an aluminum can on her stomach as Ross
enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Ross! Check it out! I learned a new trick!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey uh, I brought you some lunch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! That’s so sweet of you! Oh yum! (Takes a bite out of the
sandwich and starts to get sick.) Did you put pickles on this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ross!! (Runs to the bathroom and closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! What?! Rach what?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I made her favorite, tuna salad with pickles.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pickle? Pickles make her sick. Giving her pickles is like giving me salad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) I-I’m sorry Rach, I didn’t know. Are you gonna be
okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I’ll be fine. But could someone please make sure that
sandwich is gone when I get out there?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m on it! (Takes a bite out of the sandwich.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can’t believe this! I shouldn’t be the one making her throw
up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude relax! It could happen to anyone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Not to you, because you know this stuff. I don’t know any of it
and I’m the father. I wish I’d be more involved y’know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Well, if anyone is keeping score, I no longer eat tuna.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey uh, can I, can I talk to you guys for a second?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What’s up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, sit down. I wanna talk about our situation.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Gasps) Are you breaking up with us?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The thing is…’cause I live with Rachel I’m here for a lot
of the stuff, okay? (To Rachel) And Ross…Ross is missing everything. So…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe you two should live together.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you asking me to move out? Do you not want me here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no-no, no-no I love living with you. It just seems that…if
you’re gonna have a roommate, y’know it might as well be the father.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But Joey, I don’t think Ross wants me to move into his apartment
and disrupt his life like that. I mean—(Ross turns to her with wishful eyes.)—Or
he does.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No I-I-I would love to be around for you and the baby. And we-we can just
try it like on a temporary basis.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But Ross, its you and me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So? Sure! But it-it wouldn’t be anything romantic. And
I’m-I’m dating Mona—Damnit Mona! I was supposed to meet her like an hour
ago! What is wrong with me?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right now, so? What do you think?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know. Is it crazy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No it’s not. Joey, this is a smart idea.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I was due.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, let’s do it. I’ll move in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh Rach that’s great. That’s great. (They hug and Joey breathes
a sigh of relief.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is pounding out the hinge pins on the closet
door to get it open.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not to shabby, I got this all off myself…using my wife’s
tools. (He takes the door off the frame and we finally get to see what’s behind the
green door! It is stacked, floor to ceiling, with junk.) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) (Gasps) How did you get in there?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (laughs) You’re messy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no! You weren’t supposed to see this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I married Fred Sanford!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No Chandler, you don’t understand! (Chandler starts singing the
theme for Sanford and Son, an old TV show starring Redd Fox.) Okay! Okay! Okay!
Fine! Now you know. Okay? I’m y’know…I’m sick.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, honey you’re not sick! Look, I don’t love you because
you’re organized, I love you in spite of that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? You promise you won’t tell anyone?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! And look, now that I know if I got some extra stuff lying around
can we, can we share the closet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well…it’s just umm…I’m afraid you might mess it up.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's, Joey is drinking a gallon of orange juice as Chandler
enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So Rachel’s all moved out huh? How are you taking it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well uh, I wanted to have a few beers, but uh, I got rid of those because
Rachel couldn’t stand the smell of them. But I have thrown back a lot of orange juice
with calcium though. And uh, it’s a couple weeks past it’s expiration date, so
it’s got a bit of a kick.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you kidding me? I’m great! Yeah, I’m uh; I’m better
than great. I am good. And now that she’s gone, I can uh, I can do all this stuff
around here that I couldn’t do before. Y’know? Like umm, I can walk around naked
again. Y’know? I can uh, I can watch porn in the living room. Right? This is uh, this
is good for me. Y’know? I like being on my own, I’m uh, better off this way.
I’m uh, a lone wolf. Y’know? A loner. Alone. All alone. Forever. What’s a
wolf got to do to get a huh around here?! (Chandler rushes over and hugs him.)

title: The One with the Birthing Video

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk. Rachel is getting a cup of coffee as Joey and Phoebe enter and
sit down.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Hey, Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Hey, Happy Valentine’s Day!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you, too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, so, uh, how’s it going living over at Ross’?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s good. Except he makes us watch the Discovery Channel all
day long. Did you know that something really boring happened to someone really ugly in the
Middle Ages? (to the waitress handing her a cup of coffee) Oh, thank you. I’ll see
you guys later.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bye.
(Rachel exits with coffee)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There’s one lucky to-go cup of coffee.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sighs) Honey, I wish you would get over her. I hate seeing you like this.
Is there anything I can do for you? Do you want to look down my top?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks. But maybe later.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Gunther, can I get a scone?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (to Joey) You want anything?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know what I want? I want a lot of things! I want to be with the woman I
love on Valentine’s Day! And I want her to love me back! And I want just one moment
of relief from the gut-wrenching pain of knowing that that’s never going to happen!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: We have red bagels.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, okay.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s. Phoebe and Ross are sitting in the living room
talking.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, how does Mona feel about you and Rachel living together?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I’m actually on my way to tell her right now. Yeah, she’s been
away all week visiting her parents, but she’ll be cool. I mean, she’s been so
supportive. She-she even got the baby a tiny T-shirt that says, ‘Fossils are my
friends.’

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ugh. Come on, Mona, don’t kiss ass.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, I’m going to take off.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. Oh! Shoot! Oh shoot! Uh, Rachel wanted to see this tape!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s a video of my friend giving birth. Could you just bring it back
to your apartment?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right. (reading the label) ‘Candy and Cookie?’

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Candy’s the mother, Cookie’s the daughter. The
father’s also Cookie. Why am I friends with these people?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering with something behind her back) Phoebe, c’mere. I want to
show you something in the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Monica, grow up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what’s behind your back?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing. Just something I want to get Phoebe’s opinion on for
Valentine’s Day.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You don’t want my opinion?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, I’m your older brother, ask me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, big brother. (holds up two erm…revealing articles of
clothing) Which of these do you think would make your little sister look hotter, so your
best friend would want to do her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (quietly) The red one.
[Scene: Joey and…wait…just Joey’s. Joey is sitting at the counter eating
a pizza.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (knocking and entering) Hey. Look, I know you’ve been really depressed
lately, so I brought someone over to cheer you up. Right outside this door is a real,
live, furry playmate.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I’m not sleeping with your friend Jane again.
(Phoebe goes into the hall and brings a dog inside!)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He-hee!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! A dog! Hi! Who, you got to admit, looks a lot like Jane.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: This is the happiest dog in the world. I borrowed him from my friend Wendy.
Now, you can only keep him until he cheers you up. And he will cheer you up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks so much, Pheebs! (to the dog) We are going to have so much fun, yes we
are! (the dog sticks his head between Joey’s legs) Oh! Not that kind of fun.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler’s. Chandler enters with a bouquet of roses.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Happy Valentine’s!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (from her bedroom) Okay! I’ll be right out. I’m slipping into
something a little less comfortable, and a little more slutty.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (picking up a video from the table) ‘Candy and Cookie’.
‘Candy and Cookie?’ Monica got me porn?! Girl-on-girl porn?! She really must
love me!! (Chandler runs over to the TV, puts the tape in, and sits down to enjoy some
"porn")
(A woman on TV breaths hard)

lines.speaker: Man on TV
lines.text: Yeah, just relax.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I love you, St. Valentine.
(The woman groans, moans, grunts, and screams. Chandler’s eyes get huge!)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Woah, woah, that’s not pretty!

lines.speaker: Man on TV
lines.text: Now, push!

lines.speaker: Woman on TV
lines.text: Ow! Ow! Ooh! That hurts!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Worst porn ever! Worst porn ever! (Chandler starts to press buttons on
the remote control, frantically.)

lines.speaker: Woman on TV
lines.text: Ohhh! Make it stop!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am trying!

scenes.location: Joey’s. Joey is playing fetch with the dog.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Get the ball, ready? Get the ball, get the ball! (Joey pretends to throw it,
but really doesn’t, and the dog goes running off.) Well, you’re cute, but
you’re not too smart!
(The dog returns with a ball that looks exactly like the same one Joey has.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking at the ball the dog brought back) Did I just throw this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I accidentally packed these with my stuff. (looks at the dog and gasps) Who
is this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, that’s, uh, that’s Phoebe’s friend’s dog. I
don’t know what his real name is, but I call him Mozzarella.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (talking with a higher voice, and puckered lips…kind of like you do to
a baby or...well…a puppy…it’s hard to explain. Just use your imagination!)
Oh, well, you are so cute! I wish I could play with you more, but I’ve got to go to
work! I hope I stop talking like this before my marketing meeting, yes I do. Yes I do.
(still talking like that) Bye-bye, Joey. Oh, I seriously can’t stop it. (exits)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the dog) C’mere. Hey. C’mere. That’s Rachel. She’s
the one who used to live here. Might as well be honest with you—we love her. But we
can’t have her. I really miss her. Well, hey, you understand, right? You’re a
guy. (thinks about it and picks up the dog and looks) Well, you used to be.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s. Chandler is sitting on the couch staring at the
tape on the coffee table with his eyes huge and his mouth wide open.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering from her bedroom) So what do you think? (referring to her outfit)
(Chandler glances up at Monica with his mouth still wide open and his eyes still huge)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to herself) I’ve still got it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pointing at the video) Why did you get me this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s yelling…bleeding…dilating. Oh, the dilating…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is this the video of the baby being born? Sweetie, this is Phoebe’s.
Why were you even watching it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I thought…maybe…you got me porn for Valentine’s Day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, if you thought I was going to get you porn for Valentine’s
Day… (pulls a video out of a basket) you were right! Apparently, it’s about a
young girl who moves to the big city, you know, in search of stardom, but ends up having
sex with a lot of guys! Yeah, it got four starts! (looks closer) Oh, wait a minute. Those
aren’t stars. Anyway, you want to take a look?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I’m not really in a sexy mood right now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, remember the first time we saw Jaws?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How long it took to go back in the water?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, we can’t let this tape wreck Valentine’s Day!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t know. You didn’t see it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Child-birth, it’s a natural thing! It’s beautiful.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, beautiful? Really? Beautiful? You think this is beautiful? (picks up
the remote and presses a button, and he immediately makes a face that just looks like
he’s going to throw up!)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! Oh, my God! No wonder my mother hates me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See, honey, there’s—(puts his hand on her leg)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don’t touch me!

scenes.location: Central Perk. Ross is sitting on the couch reading a magazine as Mona enters.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! (they hug) So, how was Atlantic City?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I brought you back a present.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha—? Oh, come on. You didn’t have to—saltwater taffy?! (Mona
laughs) Thanks! This is interesting. You know, most people think this is made with sea
water, but it’s actually made with, uh, salted fresh water. That’s not
interesting.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I think it’s interesting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I do too! I missed you!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: I missed you, too! So, how was your week?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, it was good! It was good. Actually, the baby started kicking!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: How exciting!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! I know! It was. Oh… the only sad thing is I wasn’t around
when it happened for the first time.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh no.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I’m missing out on all this other stuff, too. So, Joey suggested
Rachel move in with me.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: (laughing) Yeah right!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Joey cracks me up! It’s like, ‘Yeah, why don’t you have your
ex-wife move in with you? That wouldn’t be awkward at all!’ (she laughs again)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (not amused) Huh…uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Huh, could you imagine. I go away for a few days, and come back, and my
boyfriend is living with some woman he got pregnant! (Mona laughs…yes…again!)
(Ross fake laughs, obviously not finding this funny, and he’s starting to panic,
so he shoves the whole saltwater taffy he’s eating in his mouth)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: So, what’d you tell him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (with his mouth full) Just a second! (he fake laughs, but turns his head and
starts to break down)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk. Ross and Phoebe are sitting on the couch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How could you not tell Mona that Rachel is living with you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know, she seemed to think it was such a crazy idea! Um, plus,
she, uh, she got me taffy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Taffy, really? I’ve never had any.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ever?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I think my mother was too busy planning her suicide to provide
saltwater treats. (Ross hands her one) Thank you! So what, you’re just never going to
tell her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no, I will! I just want to butter her up, first! You know,
I’m going to take her to an amazing Valentine’s dinner. Do all this romantic
stuff, and then, just when she thinks I’m the best boyfriend in the world, then
I’m going to tell her that my pregnant ex-girlfriend is living with me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If I haven’t said it before: she’s a lucky, lucky lady! So, where
are you going to—what the mother of crap is up with this stuff? (Referring to the
taffy, which she’s been chewing this whole time.) Oh, God. Is it gum, is it food?
What’s the deal? (she swallows it, finally) Oh, it’s nice! May I try a pink one?
[Scene: Joey’s. Joey is laying on his recliner, depressed, and the dog is laying
on the footrest.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, between her and me being friends, and her history with Ross, it just
isn’t going to happen. It would be like you falling in love with a cat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, buddy. How’s my favorite dog, huh? How’s my favorite dog?
(the dog doesn’t move) You’re subdued. (to Joey) Did you give him a beer?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Will you excuse us, we need to talk for a moment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, sure. Go ahead. (pause) Oh, me, right!
(Joey follows Phoebe into the kitchen)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He’s miserable! What happened to him?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing. We just talked about stuff.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What stuff?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rachel stuff.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh…Joey, you bummed him out! This was the happiest dog in the world,
and he spends half a day with you, and look at him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He’s breathing!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I’m going to take him back to Wendy’s.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no, no! He’s fine! Look, look, look! (picks up the ball)
Here’s your ball! Get your ball! Get your ball! (he throws the ball and it bounces
right next to the dog) Get your ball! My God, what have I done to you, huh? I broke the
dog! Pheebs, I broke the dog!
[Scene: Ross and…Rachel’s…I guess I have to call it that now. Rachel is
reading on the couch as Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I’m, uh, going to pick up Mona. What have you got going tonight?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I’ve got big Valentine’s plans! I’ve got my Chinese food
on the way, and the rest of your saltwater taffy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know, it’s interesting! Most people think that’s made with
seawater, when in fact—

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, we actually watched the documentary together.
(There is a knock on the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh! My Chinese food! Let me get my cash! (runs to her room to get her
money)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (opening the door to see Mona standing there) Mona? What are—hi! What
are you doing here? I’m, um, supposed to pick you up!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Change of plans, I made you a special Valentine’s dinner! Surprise!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he makes some really weird noise hear that sounds kind of
like…)Ayyyayyyy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Oh, hey, Mona!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Hi! Hi. Hi, Rachel! (to Ross) What’s she doing here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have no idea!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’ll be watching TV if anybody needs me. (exits to her room)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Seriously, what is she doing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh…lately, she just likes hanging out here.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think she’s lonely.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Okay, but it’s Valentine’s Day!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Can’t we just ask her to go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no. She’s way to emotional. And by emotional I mean crazy.
(Doorbell rings)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m not here! That’s just my Chinese food!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh, my God! She has food delivered here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mm-hmm. She’s—she’s emotional, but, but ballsy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what I’m going to do? I’m going to get in my sweats, and
eat this in bed! (exits)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And you thought she was going to be in our way! So, why don’t you, uh,
open the champagne, and I’ll be right back. I’ve got a surprise for you.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: You got another ex-wife back there?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (fakes a laugh) Please start drinking! (exits)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) I’m just going to grab the phone.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Oh, Rachel! Wait! Hey, I hope you don’t take this the wrong way, but,
but, um… what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I’m sorry! Do you need the phone?

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: No, no. Listen, Ross is too nice to say anything, but this is his apartment,
and, and, we gotta have some boundaries, so why don’t you go back to your place and
give us some privacy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (as Ross enters with a present) But, but, Mona, I live here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (handing Mona the present) Happy Valentine’s Day! …Or something to
remember me by.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler’s. Monica and Chandler are sitting on the couch still
staring at the screen.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How long has it been this time?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: 90 seconds.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s better. 90 seconds is a long time not to think about
it…except all I did was think about it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, it haunts me? Up ‘til now, the worst thing I ever saw, was
my father doing tequila shots off the naked houseboy. After this, I would gladly make that
my screensaver!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, well, we have to get past this! Why don’t we get rid of the tape
and pretend it never existed?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can do that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
(Chandler takes the tape and sticks it under the chair cushion)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. Now all we’ve got to do is get rid of this chair.
(Chandler crawls over to Monica and they move in to kiss, but they can’t do it and
back up. They move in to kiss again, and kiss very awkwardly for a second, until someone
knocks on the door.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, thank God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I know!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come in!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi! I’m so sorry to barge in on your Valentine’s, but
I had to get away from all the yelling. Mona is dumping Ross.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, my God.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Poor Ross.
(Monica and Chandler both look at each other and run over to the window to watch the
action in Ross’ apartment)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, great. We have to watch him do yoga in his underwear, but for this he
closes the drapes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, you know that birthing tape you wanted to see? It’s here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, and we should warn you, before you watch it: don’t watch it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why? You saw it? Is it scary?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, let’s just say it’s ironic how footage of someone being
born can make you want to kill yourself.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, now, wait. Now I’m all freaked out. Come on, you guys will watch
it with me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, but I will leave a sweater that smells like me right next to you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: C’mon, seriously, you guys, you’re not going to make me watch
this alone!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s right…of course not. Honey, get the tape.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (with his arm all the way under the cushion, moving it around) This
reminds me of a very specific part of the tape. (Chandler puts the tape in, and they all
sit down) Okay, here we go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (watching the tape) Ooh, my! (Rachel jumps when the woman starts
screaming) Woah! Why is that baby torturing that woman?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why have I seen this thing three times?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s…still beautiful.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh! It’s horrible!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! I know, I’m so sorry for you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, my God!
(Monica and Rachel both cover their eyes)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait, you guys, look!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Did her ass explode?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, the baby’s out! Look, look!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, look at those little fingers and toes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And look how happy the mom is now!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh…Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, screw you guys, you don’t have to do it!
[Scene: Central Perk. Ross is getting coffee as Joey comes from…God knows where!
Some back area of Central Perk around the corner that we’ve never seen!
Weeeiiirrrddd….]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, hey, man!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what’s up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh…Mona just dumped me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, man, I’m sorry. Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, with everything that’s been going on lately, I haven’t
exactly been the perfect boyfriend. You know, I, uh, I didn’t tell her I got Rachel
pregnant. I gave her a key to my apartment, and then had the locks changed! And then I
lied to her about Rachel moving in with me. In a way, I actually judge her for not
breaking up with me sooner, you know?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Still, that really sucks, man. Especially on Valentine’s Day.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Wait a minute. What are you doing here? Joey Tribbiani without a date
on Valentine’s Day? What’s going on, huh? Girl trouble?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sort of.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don’t have to seem so happy about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, sorry. Well, look, maybe I can help you with it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, whatever it is, I am sure it has happened to me. Y’know, actually
once—once I got dumped during sex.
(Two girls sitting at a table next to them look up in disgust, and Ross and Joey move
away)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway, so, uh, so what is it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Forget about it. It’s no big deal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C’mon! Joey! What is it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s nothing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, hey, it’s me. Why can’t you tell me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, uh…sit down. (they do) Um… there’s this woman that I
like. A lot. But, uh…it can’t happen.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She’s not a Tribbiani?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I knew it. So, is she someone from work?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, uh, does she like you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sometimes I think maybe she could. But it doesn’t matter, because I
can’t do anything about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it’s complicated. She’s with this other guy. For a long time.
Someone from work, too. And I could never do that to the guy, because we’re really
good friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, uh, this guy, she used to go out with, is, uh… is he still in love
with her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. I don’t think so.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Um… is he a good guy?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, he’s the best.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then talk to him! He might be fine with it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, it’s worth finding out. I mean, if you really like her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I do! So much! I can’t stop thinking about her! I can’t sleep,

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, Joey, you know what? You have to go for it. How often does this happen
to you, huh? You owe it to yourself.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: (placing a cup in front of Ross) Here’s your warm milk.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m going to…uh…I’m going to, um, put the bourbon in it
at home.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway… seriously, uh…just…just talk to the guy, okay? And
tell me how it goes. (walks towards the door until…)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s Rachel.
(Ross just stands in the doorway, for like a minute…Ahh! What’s going to
happen next??!!! I can’t make it all the way through the Olympics!!!)

title: The One Where Joey Tells Rachel

lines.speaker: Lisa Kudrow
lines.text: (voiceover) Previously on Friends

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is talking to Ross

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There’s this woman, that I like. A lot. Well, it’s
complicated. She’s with this other guy. For a long time. And I
could never do that to the guy, y’know? ’Ccause we’re really good
friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, uh, this guy, she used to go out with, is, uh… is he a good guy?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, he’s the best.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then talk to him! He might be fine with it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, it’s worth finding out. I mean, if you really like her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I do! So much! I can’t stop thinking about her! I can’t sleep,

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, Joey, you know what? You have to go for it. How often does this happen
to you, huh? You owe it to yourself. (Walks towards the door until…)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s Rachel.
[Fade to Black, then fade in again with Ross stopped at the doorway.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (closes the door) Did you um—I’m sorry, did you just say
