it’s Rachel?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Um, you…you like Rachel?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes. I like Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (startled) Yeah, okay but look, buy uh—Hey-hey, y’know,
y’know who else I like? You! And it-it doesn’t get said enough. I like you Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But R-R-Rachel-Rachel?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but it’s not a big deal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s not a big deal? Oh, I’m sorry I just…um, I…what
about all the stuff you-you just said? I mean how about, I like—you-you can’t
stop thinking about her. Like how you can’t sleep?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m an actor, y’know? As-as a group, we tend to be over
dramatic.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel who’s carrying my baby? Rachel?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look no, I-I know it’s bad, and I know it’s wrong. Okay? But-but
it’s not like anything’s ever gonna happen. Y’know? These-these are just
feelings, they’re gonna go away.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? I-I gotta go. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh come on Ross! Hey Ross-Ross don’t…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stops) I just—y’know—I-I just have one—Rachel?!
(He exits and starts to walk away, passes a window, stops, and says
"Rachel?!" again. Joey sighs and turns around to face Gunther.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Rachel?!!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Rachel and Chandler are on the couch.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-oh! Okay, she’s kicking!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! (Puts his hand on her belly.) She’s growing inside you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! (Pulls his hand away.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow that was a big one.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think that’s the youngest girl ever to reject me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Oh hey you guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey listen let me ask you, do you believe in soul mates?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yes I do. I do. I believe that there is one perfect person out there
for everyone. And do you know how you find him? You stop looking for him. That’s why
I stopped looking for Russell Crowe. He’ll find me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh, (To Chandler) and you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. I mean I believe that uh, certain people are more suited for each
other and I believe in falling in love, but soul mates, I don’t think they exist.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well last night, I met Monica’s.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I had a date with this guy, and I swear to God, he is her other
half.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on, don’t be crazy. (To Rachel) You don’t think
there’s someone out there better suited for Monica than me, do ya? (Rachel looks at
him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Well, what’s he like?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well he’s tall.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He has brown hair.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Of course, of course.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A tall guy with hair similar to mine, oh unknowable universe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He works with food!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh sure. Older?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Obviously, and he’s British.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I was just gonna ask!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah? And, he’s-he’s so centered and mature and confident.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it’s so sad they never had a chance to meet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Luckily, the guy she settled for can’t hear what you’re
talking about.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I’m so sorry. Um, and maybe I’m wrong! I
but—y’know I’m gonna go out with him again, I’ll find out more.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You believe that this guy is destined for someone else and you’re
still gonna date him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, he may not be my soul mate, but a girl’s gotta eat.

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel's, Ross is opening the door to Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just talked to Joey, I just—I want to see how you were.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh y’know, I still—I can’t believe it. Joey and Rachel I
mean it’s… It’s like you and me going out, only weirder!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, I know you’re hurting, and-and I want to be supportive,
but don’t say that again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! What if, what if they get married? Then he’d be the
stepfather of my child.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, I don’t think that’s something we need to worry about!
First of all he’s-he’s never gonna tell her how he feels about her. And even if
he did you have no idea how she’d react.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, because women never like Joey. Y’know, I think he’s a
virgin.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey…he’s not even thinking about going after Rachel!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He’s not?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! All he’s thinking about is how you’re taking this! I mean,
listen it’s totally freaking him out. He’s talking about moving to Vermont.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He says he wants to leave the country. (Pause) He thinks you hate him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hate him? I… No, I don’t hate him. (Pause) It’s just
it’s Rachel, y’know?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey I can’t even imagine how hard this must be for you. But, I
don’t want you to lose Joey over it. And right now he just needs to know that
you’re still his friend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. Okay, I’ll talk to him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. Now do it soon, he just asked me how to convert his dollars
into Vermont money.
[Scene: Central Perk, Monica and Chandler are on the couch as Phoebe enters with
Monica’s soul mate.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, Chandler, Monica, this is Don.

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: Oh, hello. (Shakes Chandler’s hand.) Hello. (Shakes Monica’s
hand.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (mouths to Chandler) Soul mate.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (mouths to Phoebe) What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (cough talks) Soul mate.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, what have you guys been doing?

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: Well, we just had a terrible lunch today at Reattica. What is with all the
sun-dried tomatoes at that place?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! What is this, 1985?!

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: That’s exactly what I said. Phoebe, isn’t that strange.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What’s wrong with sun-dried tomatoes? (Everyone stares at him.)
On a barbecue chicken pizza? (Still there’s staring.) No?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So Don, what-what other restaurants do you like?

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: Well, Octavio, 27&7—Oh! And there’s this great little place,
Alessandro’s.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! That’s my restaurant, I’m the chef there.

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: You’re kidding me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: Your food is fantastic! Wow, I really want to talk to you about your menu,
once I get some coffees first. Um, anyone want any?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I’d like a latte. Oh y’know what? If you’re gonna
talk about me, I’m gonna go with you.
(They go over to the counter and Chandler moves closer to Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing! I swear to God I didn’t know you guys would be here! And
the good news is you didn’t believe in soul mates. So…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I believe in tall, handsome strangers who hit on my wife!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They’re just talking, and y’know what? Just because I think
they’re soul mates doesn’t mean anything’s gonna happen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (returning) Phoebe, good work.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! Oh he’s great, I love him. (Walks away and Chandler glares at
Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don’t worry, we’ll find you someone else.
[Scene: Joey’s Apartment, there’s a knock on the door and Joey answers it to
Ross.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, I understand if you came by to hit me, I deserve it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I don’t want to hit you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh what then? Kick me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (getting worried) Bite me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no I don’t want to do anything to you. All right? I just want to
tell you that I’m not mad at you and…and that I certainly do not hate you. I
just, I just came here to say that. (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh now—Hey Ross-Ross! Do you wanna-wanna come in for a beer or
something?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh…yeah sure. (Enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do uh, do you got any beer? All-all I got is this melon stuff that Rachel
left. I don’t…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pouring two glasses) Hey look Ross, you need to understand something
okay? I uh…I am never gonna act on this Rachel thing, okay? I-I would never do
anything to jeopardize my friendship with you. (He hands Ross a glass.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you.
(They clink glasses and take a drink. Ross likes it, Joey hates it. Then Ross sees Joey
hating it, mimics he hates it as well.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Anyway, it uh…look it’ll just…take me a while to get over
her, that’s all. I’m not even sure how to do that, I mean I’ve never been
in love before so…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?! You’re in love with her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I thought you knew that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Umm, no.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow. Hey look, if it helps, I don’t want to feel this way. Honest. I
just keep thinking, "Ah, I’ll get over this." Y’know? I just—It
just keeps gettin’ harder. I don’t, I don’t know what to do. Y’know?
What do I do?
(Pause)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think you need to tell her how you feel.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay that’s the green stuff talkin’.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I’m serious. You-you need to find out where she is, because if
she’s not where you are, then you can start to move past this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But what if uh—and I’m not saying she will be—But…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: If she is where you are then uh…then my feeling weird about it
shouldn’t stand in the way.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Look if-if she’s gonna end up with somebody else, the truth is
she couldn’t find a better guy. So…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So when do you think you’re gonna talk to her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God I have to tell her! I haven’t even thought about what I
will say. What should I say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m understanding, but let’s not get carried away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sorry, you’re right. What am I gonna say? (He takes another
sip of the green stuff and recoils at the taste.) Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, tell me about it. (He stands up, turns his back to Joey, and enjoys
another sip.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe and Chandler are watching Monica and Don talk.

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: …so I’ve been slowly phasing out the wine importing and focusing
more on the cheese side of things.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Cheese you say? That’s some pretty smelly work, huh Don?

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Cheese, it’s smelly. You must smell a lot of the time too.

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: Uh, not really. But when it comes to cheese, I’m one of the people who
thinks the smellier the better.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Me too! Yeah, Chandler can’t stand it. He won’t even allow me
to have blue cheese in the house.

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: And you’re still married to him? (They both laugh, and Chandler tries
to but fails.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what I’d love to do? I would like to go to France and eat
nothing but bread and cheese—Not even bread, just cheese. No, I want the bread. Yeah.
Ah, and pastries… (Breathlessly) And pate. Oh, I’m really not high, it’s
just I used to be fat.

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: Well if you where ever enter the Loire valley let me know, I’ve got a
great little villa you can stay at.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is it made of cheese?

lines.speaker: Don
lines.text: No. But God, a house made of cheese, wouldn’t that be incredible?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’d move in tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (disgusted) Oh come on! (To Phoebe) Are you listening to this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What do we do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know, they both want to live in a house of cheese! I
don’t know how you fight that.

scenes.location: Outside Ross and Rachel's, Joey walks up to knock on the door, but stops.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Okay, I can do this. I can tell her how I feel. Just uh, just stand
up straight. (Does so.) Take a couple deep breaths. (Does so.) Look confident. (Does so as
Rachel opens the door and startles him.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey? What’s up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I uh, I just came by because I-I want to talk to you about something.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay what’s up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here? In the hall? What are we animals?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well honey, I’m late for a meeting. So can you just make it quick?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay umm, I just came by to tell you that I…want to have dinner with
you tonight. That’s all.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure! That sounds great! Just leave me a message and tell me where to
meet you. Okay? (Walks away.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. That’s good. Okay, that give you a couple hours to prepare what
you’re gonna say. Good. Yeah. (Someone comes out of his apartment and it startles
Joey again.) Don’t you people ever knock?!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Chandler are entering.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’d like to have Don and Phoebe over. Wouldn’t that be nice?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure, why don’t you set it up. I’ll just be over here,
browsing through the personals.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you okay? You’ve been acting weird all afternoon.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, fine. Fine. Not perfect!! But good enough.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Jeez! What is with you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m sorry, did you say cheese?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, what’s going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe thinks you and Don are soul mates, and I don’t believe in
that kind of stuff. But then you two totally get along. So look, I won’t stand in
your way if you want to run off with Don and live in a house of cheese.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, you don’t believe in soul mates?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No. But I’m sure (mimics Don) ‘tomatoes’ does.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t believe in soul mates either.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don’t?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. I don’t think that you and I were destined to end up together.
I think that we fell in love and work hard at our relationship. Some days we work really
hard.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you…you don’t want to live with Don in a cheese house?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I’ve had second thoughts about that. Do you realize how hard
that would be to clean?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what? I am going to take you out to dinner tonight. I
found this place that makes the greatest mozzarella sticks and jalepino poppers . (Monica
doesn’t look impressed.) No? Really? They taste so good.

scenes.location: A restaurant, Joey and Rachel are having dinner.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …and I know Chandler is kidding but it happens every time he
touches my stomach. I mean I’m really worried the baby’s not going to like him.
(Joey is staring at the table.) Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? Yeah! Sure! Uh, look at the uh, the reason…(Exhales
slowly)—Is it hot in here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. Not-not for me, but why don’t you take off your sweater?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I would, but this is a nice place and my T-shirt has a picture of Calvin
doing Hobbs.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! Really?! Can I see it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Sure. (They both half stand up, Joey pulls the neck of his sweater
out, and Rachel looks down it to see his T-shirt.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh. Wow, I wouldn’t think Hobbs would like that so much.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh… How long have we known each other?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um, seven…e-e-eight, eight years. Wow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-huh, long time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But over the past few weeks…
(A waiter runs over interrupting Joey.)

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Hah, sorry about the wait, but it is mega-jammed in here! We have a
couple specials tonight…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Actually uh, could you give us a second?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Sure. Sure. (Turns away, then turns back) Second’s up! (Joey glares
at him.) Not…that kind of table. (He walks away.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So you were saying?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m not quite sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well you had asked me how long we had known each other, and I
said, "Eight years." And the um, waiter came over and cut his tip in half, and
umm…now here we are.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, here we are. Uhh… I… I think I’m…falling in love
with you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stunned) What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m falling in love with you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking around) Who are you talking too? Oh, you’re kidding! Oh,
it’s a joke! (Laughs.) It’s funny. It’s funny. I don’t get it. (Joey
doesn’t say any thing and Rachel realizes it’s not a joke.) Oh. (Pause) Okay.
Umm… I-I…uh, wow. Are you uh… How did umm… When?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Does it really matter?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Wow. Wow. Wow, it is hot in here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay look Rach, I know this is a lot. You don’t have to say anything.
You-you uh, you take as much time as you need. (Long pause as Rachel says nothing.) Okay,
you gotta say something!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, Joey I love you so much, but I…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But. (Hangs his head down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah right. That’s okay. That’s fine. That’s uh,
pretty much what I was expecting. So uh, it’s no big deal. All right? I think
I’m gonna go. (Stands up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Joey please! Please don’t! Please don’t leave like this!
Now come on, you cannot do this to a pregnant woman! (Starts to cry.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t start doing that. You can’t do that Rach, ‘cause then
you’re gonna make me do that. (Starts to cry.) Oh, here we go! (Sits down next to
her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can I? (Hug him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure!
(They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Joey honey I don’t…I don’t want to lose…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey, hey! You can’t. Okay? Ever!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no-no Rach, please, don’t be sorry. Okay? Don’t be sorry.
(They hug again.) Y’know I was only kidding you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, that was a real good one.

title: The One with the Tea Leaves

scenes.location: The Hallway, Rachel walks up the stairs and knocks on Joey’s door.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey? Are you in there?
[Cut to inside Monica and Chandler’s, Monica, Chandler and Joey are eating
breakfast.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (hearing Rachel and jumping up with his plate) Oh God! That’s Rachel!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, you have to talk to her!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No-no, I can’t! I can’t! Not after the other night, it’s
just it’s…too weird, okay? Don’t tell her I’m here! (Turns to run to
the bathroom and his bagel falls off the plate onto the floor.) Don’t eat that! (Runs
to the bathroom as Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is Joey here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t see him. (To Monica) Do you see him?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don’t see him. Hey! Maybe he’s in the sugar bowl! (Opens the
sugar bowl) Joey? Nope! (Closes the sugar bowl and they both laugh.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, at least you make each other laugh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I haven’t seen him since that night that he told me how he
y’know… I don’t know, I think he’s avoiding me. Why is that bagel on
the floor?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We were playing a game.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ew, was Chandler naked? Sort of like a, like a ring toss kind of
situation?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?! No! No!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. Well listen, if you see Joey will you just tell him
uh…tell him I miss him. (Exits and Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Joey) Okay, did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, a naked bagel game? (Picks up his dropped bagel.) (To Chandler)
Dude, I don’t know. That’s a pretty small hole.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, you gotta talk to her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can’t! Y’know? You guys don’t know what it’s like to
put yourself out there like that and just get shot down.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (incredulous) I don’t know what that’s like?! Up until I was
25 I thought the only response to, "I love you," was, "Oh crap!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello? No rejection? I got shot down at fat camp! Boy, kids are mean
when they’re hungry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right so, so what do I do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is Rachel. I mean, what are you gonna do, never going to talk to
her again? I mean I know it’s weird, it’s awkward, but you gotta at least try.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Okay. (Goes to take a bite out of the previously mentioned bagel.)
Whoa! (Stops.) I almost forgot this was on your…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (interrupting him) We didn’t play it!!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Phoebe is holding a book as she, Rachel, and Monica drink some
tea as Chandler looks on.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so when you’re done with your tea I’ll look at your
leaves and tell you your fortune.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn’t know you read tea leaves.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, I’ve done it for years. I actually stopped because I was
so accurate. Y’know, and-and y’know, one of the great joys of life is
it’s-it’s wondrous unpredictability. Y’know? And also tea tends to give me
the trots.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I’m done. Read mine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Looks at the leaves.) Ooh, I see a ladder. (Checks the book)
Which can mean either a promotion or a violent death.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (stunned) I-I’m the head chef. I-I can’t get promoted.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-hmm. Uh-hmm, who’s next?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, I’m done. Do mine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (Reads the leaves) Umm, oh! Okay, I see a circle.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! (Checking the book) Which can either mean you’re having a baby
or you’re gonna make a scientific discovery!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I have been spending a lot of time in the lab.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What does yours say Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm… Wow, all right. (Checks the book.) Wow! Yay! Ooh, I’m
gonna meet a guy! And really soon! And he’s gonna be the man of my dreams. Probably
not the guy I had a dream about last night. (Points at Chandler.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Has anyone seen my shirt? It’s a button down, like a,
like a faded salmon?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You mean your pink shirt?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Faded salmon color.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I-I haven’t seen your pink shirt.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great! Great. Then I must’ve left it at Mona’s. I knew it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I’m sure you get another one at Ann Taylor’s.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s my favorite shirt! Okay? I love that shirt!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well just ask Mona to give it back!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know. I mean I-I guess I could. It’s just that we
didn’t really end things such good terms. And if I go over there I’d be ignoring
the one thing she asked me to do when we broke up, jump up my own ass and die. (Walks
away.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (noticing a guy sitting by the green post looking at her) Oh wait a
second you guys…for the last couple weeks I’ve been that guy everywhere I go. We
take the same bus. We go to the same bookstore, the same dry cleaners; maybe he’s the
tea guy. (He gets up to leave, and smiles at Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe, did you see that?! He totally checked you out! He is so cute!
(Looking at his tea.) Mine has a picture of The Village People, what does that
mean?
(Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.
(He slowly walks to the other side of the couch and sits down at the table, an awkward
silence follows.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi.
(More awkward silence.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Tea gives Phoebe the trots.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is cooking as Rachel paces nervously.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So I thought Joey and I would be okay once we hung out, but it’s
not even like we know how to be with each other anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know it’s tough now, but things will get better.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How do you know that? What if it just gets worse and worse and worse, to
the point where we can’t even be in the same room with each other?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m not great at the advice, can I interest you in a sarcastic
comment? Some cheese?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, what is the Bruce Springsteen CD in the Kat Stevens case?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let’s just say if I can’t find the right CD case I just put
it in the nearest one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, where is the Kat Stevens CD?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: In the James Taylor case.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Where is the James Taylor CD?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, I’m gonna save you some time, 200 CDs, not one of them in
the right case.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. No need to panic. Deep breathes everyone. Okay umm uh, we’re
just gonna have to spend some time and put the CDs in the right cases.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, if we’re gonna do that we should come up with some kind of
order. Y’know alphabetically or by genre?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hmm, I don’t know. We really have to talk this through.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!! You guys have such problems!! I feel so terrible for you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I-I’m sorry. You and Joey, your both focusing on this
uncomfortable thing, what you need to do is to change the subject. Next time you see him
try to get him talking about something else.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah. That makes sense.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, like I don’t know, maybe you have a work problem that you
need his advice on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I can do that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good. (To Chandler) Uh honey, the Miami Vice soundtrack? Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They were just giving those away at the store (off Monica’s look)
in exchange for money.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh I really don’t know what to tell you Rach, I really don’t.
I mean, maybe Joey can help you out with your, with your big work problem.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah Joey she’s…Rachel’s got this really big work
problem, and it is a head scratcher. Wow! (To Chandler) Y’know what, if we’re
gonna make dinner we’re gonna have to leave. Yeah. (She and Chandler exit.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you uh, have a…big work problem?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah it’s umm… Yeah it’s uh… It-it’s
y’know—It’s nothing.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh. Okay. (Awkward silence.) So uh, I think I’m gonna take off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah—No wait! Joey no wait it is. It’s something.
It’s-it’s umm…it’s my boss.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and umm my baby.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My boss wants to buy my baby!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! Oh my-oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know I told you, it’s a really big problem.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What he wants to buy your baby?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can you believe that?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s crazy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s what I told him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, how did this even happen?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well I’ll tell ya! (Pause) See uh my-my boss and his
wife—They-they can’t have children. So umm, and that—we were at the
Christmas party, and he got drunk, and he said to me, "Rachel, I want to buy your
baby."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man! When you said it was a problem about your boss and the baby I figured
it was something about maternity leave.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh! Yeah! (Pause) Yeah that-that would’ve been a much simpler
problem.
[Scene: A newsstand, Phoebe is looking at a magazine as the guy from before walks by
and picks up a newspaper.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hello.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Oh, it’s you. I see you everywhere. I’m Jim, Jim Nelson.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Jim, Jim Nelson I’m Phoebe, Phoebe Buffay. We certainly have
been seeing a lot of each other lately.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: We have. Maybe we’ll be seeing each other at dinner tomorrow night,
say around 8 o’clock?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, maybe we will. (Starts to walk away.) Oh! (She turns around and
the exchange information.)

scenes.location: Outside Mona’s Apartment, Ross is knocking on the door.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mona? (There’s no answer, so he starts to leave but remembers where
her extra key is. He reaches atop a hall light just outside her door and grabs the key. He
looks at in triumph as the pain from it being hot moves along his nervous system to his
brain, and when it arrives his brain orders his hand to drop the hot key and his mouth to
squeal in pain. After dropping the key he pulls his shirtsleeve over his hand and uses the
key to open the door and enter Mona’s apartment.) Okay, if I were a salmon shirt,
where would I be? (He hears a key in the door and as it opens he dives behind the couch.)

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: (entering, with her date) I am so sorry I spilled wine all over your
shirt.

lines.speaker: Mona's Date
lines.text: Oh, it’s okay.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: No, it’s still wet. Y’know what? Let me get it out before it
sets. Ooh, I have something you can wear. Here. (Hands him Ross’s shirt.)

lines.speaker: Mona's Date
lines.text: Oh umm, I-I don’t know if I want to wear a woman’s shirt.

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: No-no that’s a man’s shirt.

lines.speaker: Mona's Date
lines.text: It’s awfully pink. (Ross mouths, "It’s
salmon!")

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Chandler are sorting their CDs.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God, honey we are so meant to be together. We both have copies
of the Annie soundtrack.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, both yours.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hey! Great advice on that Joey thing!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah? The work problem?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh it was perfect! I mean it really felt like he was my friend again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What problem did you tell him you had?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh that’s not important. The point is, I really—I think
everything’s gonna be okay.

scenes.location: Mr. Zelner’s Office, he’s in a meeting as Joey bursts in.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: May I help you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you think you can just buy my friends baby?!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: A restaurant, Phoebe and Jim are on their date.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Isn’t it funny how we kept running into each other? It’s as if
someone really wants us to be together.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Someone does. Me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, witty banter. Well done.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: So, tell me a little bit about yourself.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh okay, well I’m a masseuse, and I used to work at this
place…

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Do you like to party?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I-I like, I like parties.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: You’re wild, aren’t ya?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah I guess, a little.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: It ain’t no thing, I’m wild too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (a little freaked out) So! Umm, anyway I-I lived in New York, someone
wildly I guess, for umm—Well since I was fourteen.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: I’m sorry. I’m staring. It’s just that you have the most
beautiful eyes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh stop it.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: And your breasts! Hmm!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Umm look, you’re coming on a little strong. But I’m
going to give you the benefit of the doubt, because it seems the universe really wants to
be together. So, why don’t we just start over okay? And you can just tell me about
yourself.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: I write erotic novels, for children.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: They’re wildly unpopular.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Oh also, you might be interested to know that I have a Ph.D.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! You do?

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Yeah, (looks at his crotch) a Pretty Huge…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. (Gets up and walks out.)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Monica, Chandler, and now Rachel are organizing CDs.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (singing) The sun’ll come out…tomorrow! Bet…your
bottom dollar that tomorrow… (The girls start laughing, and in a deep voice) …there’ll
be sun.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Oh Joey, honey listen, thank you for talking to my yesterday about
that thing with my boss. That really meant a lot.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not a problem. Oh, and just so you know, that guy’s not going to be
bothering you about that baby thing anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (worried) What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let’s just say I took care of it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa, let’s say more!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don’t worry! Don’t worry. I just told him, very nicely,
"You don’t go buying people’s babies, so back off!!"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler and Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No, no-no-no Joey he doesn’t want to buy my baby! I made that
up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?! Why?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So that we would have something to talk about! So it wouldn’t be
awkward!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And you couldn’t think of anything else?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You said your boss wants to buy your baby?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Joey) I can’t believe that you yelled at my boss!
I’m-I’m gonna lose my job! What am I going to do?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can always sell your baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Joey, I can’t believe you brought my boss into this! I’m
gonna get fired!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You lied to me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, she told me too! (Points to Monica and Joey glares at her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler has two copies of Annie!
[Scene: Mona’s Apartment, she and her date are making out as Ross flips through a
magazine while lying behind the couch and sees something that he likes. Meanwhile,
Mona’s date takes off Ross’s shirt and Mona throws it on the floor. While they
start making out again, Ross tries to pull the rug the shirt is on over to him, but while
he does that he moves the coffee table and it bumps into the couch.]

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: (seeing Ross) Oh my God! Ross!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hello!!

lines.speaker: Mona
lines.text: Ross, what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not touching myself if that makes anyone less uncomfortable.

scenes.location: Mr. Zelner’s Office, Rachel is knocking on the door.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Morning. You wanted to see me?

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Please, come in. Have a seat. (She does so.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay look Mr. Zelner…

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Oh I think it’s best that I speak first.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. (Motions for him to continue.)

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: I’ve asked Lee from human resources to be here as a witness to
our conversation.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: If I in any way implied that I wanted to buy your baby…I am
sorry. Okay? Last week when I asked you when your due date was uh, I certainly did not
mean that I felt that I was due your baby. Yeah, I want to be very clear that I
understand that its your baby, and it is not mine to purchase.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, as long as we are clear about that. (Exits smugly.)

scenes.location: A Street, Phoebe and Monica are walking down it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh there it is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s not your regular dry cleaners.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, but that creep that I went on that date with goes to there so I
have to find a new one. I also have to find a new video store, a new bank, a new adult
bookstore, a new grocery store…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A new grocery store. The universe said I was going to meet a nice guy
and that’s what they gave me? (Looks up) When I get up there I’m going to kick
some ass.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don’t worry Phoebe, you’re gonna meet someone. If I can meet a
great guy, so can you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, we both can. And we both will.
(They enter the dry cleaners.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you didn’t have to come in with me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you kidding? This is where they get out stains! Okay? This is like Disneyland
for me. I’m-I’m gonna be over here watching the dance of the clean shirts. (She
points to and walks over to the electric clothes rack they have.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
(A guy enters that looks suspiciously like Alec Baldwin from The Hunt for Red
October, Pearl Harbor, and Beetlejuice.)

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Oh, excuse me! I think you dropped s…(looks at Phoebe.)
Wow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: I’m sorry, it’s just that you’re so incredibly beautiful.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah well, I’m sorry about that too, but what are you going to
do?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: I hope you don’t think I’m crazy but I feel like I was meant to
pick this up, do you believe in that kind of thing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A little. (She turns around and looks up.) (To the universe) Now
you’re talking.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Would you like to go out and have a cup of coffee?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I-I-I’d love to. Let me just tell my friend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the clerk) Ooh, an ink stain! Hey, can I watch how you get this out?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looking around) She must’ve left.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler is watching Joey pace nervously as Rachel
enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So? What-what-what happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s all gonna be okay. They’re just so happy that I’m
not suing them that they gave me one extra month paid maternity leave. So long as I
understand that the money should not construed as a down payment on this or any other
child I should bear.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow, Ralph Lauren is really going out of there way to show
they’re not in the baby buying business.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, can you give us a minute?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh I’m sorry, you’re kicking me out of my own living room?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll be in there. (Goes into the bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, I’m really sorry that I lied to you. I was just trying to
make things…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know. I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It kinda worked. I mean y’know, I don’t know about you buy I
haven’t thought about our thing since all this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey you’re right. Yeah, it’s kinda been like us again a little
bit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah I know! I miss that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too. I mean I…haven’t thought at all about how I put myself
out there and said all that stuff and how you didn’t feel the same way about me
and-and how it was really awkward.
(Awkward silence.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My gynecologist tried to kill me.

title: The One in Massapequa

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone is there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Ross, Mon, is it okay if I bring someone to your parent’s
anniversary party?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure. Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, who’s the guy?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, his name is Parker and I met him at the drycleaners.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oooh, did he put a little starch in your bloomers? (Sits up) Who said
that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, he’s really great though. He has this incredible zest for
life, and he treats me like a queen, except at night when he treats me like the naughty
girl I am.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Ross) Oh, by the way. Would it be okay if I gave the toast to mom
and dad this year?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, yeah, you sure you want to after what happened at their 20th?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I’d really like to.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, hopefully this time mom won’t boo you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! Every year Ross makes the toast, and it’s always really
moving, and always makes them cry. Well this year I’m going to make them cry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And you wonder why Ross is their favorite?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Really! Any time Ross makes a toast everyone cries, and hugs him,
and pats him on the back and they all come up to me and say, "God, your
brother." Know what they’ll say this year? "God, you"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well I can promise you, at least one person will be crying. (Points to
himself) I’m an actor, and any actor worth himself can cry on cue. (snaps fingers)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really you can do that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you kidding me? Watch! (Makes funny faces trying to cry) Well I
can’t do it with you guys watching me!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica’s, they’re getting ready to leave for the party.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh I’m working on my toast for the party, or as I like to call it.
Sob fest 2002. Hey check this out. (Hands him a picture.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s a dog.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s a dead dog. That’s Chi-Chi; she died when I was in high
school.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s your parents’ anniversary and you’re going to talk
about their dead pet?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The good stuff, huh?
(Ross, Joey, and Rachel enter)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You got a present for my parents. That’s so sweet.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, in honor of their 35th wedding anniversary, I had a
star named after them.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aww that is so cool.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And I got them a book on Karma Sutra for the elderly.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, do you guys have any extra ribbon?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, sure. What do you need? We got lace, satin, sateen, raffia,
gingham, felt, (Pause) and I think my testacles may be in here too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (picking up Chi-Chi’s picture) Aww! Chi-Chi! Oh, I loved this dog!
Y’know Monica couldn’t get braces because Chi-Chi needed knee surgery.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You were the 200-pound 11-year-old who rode her!
(Phoebe and Parker enter)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Everybody, this is Parker, Parker this is…

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: No, no, no wait! Don’t tell me. Let me guess. (Points as he says
their names) Joey, Monica, Ross, Rachel and, I’m sorry Phoebe didn’t mention
you. (Chandler makes a face) Chandler, I’m kidding all ready you’re my favorite!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ha!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Why don’t all of you tell me a little about your self?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, actually, I’m sorry we-we probably should get going.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: (laughs) Classic Ross. Rachel, Rachel, oh how you glow. May I? (Puts
hand on her stomach)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I, uh, think you already are.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Rachel, you have life growing inside you. Is there anything in this
world more miraculous than—Oh a picture of a dog! Whose is this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s my old dog. He passed away years ago.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Oh well, at least you were lucky to have him. Bow-wow old friend,
bow-wow. So where’s the party?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s out on the island. It’s in Massapequa.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Maaaassapequa, sounds like a magical place. Tell me about Massapequa, is
it steep in Native American history? {Transcriber’s Note: Interestingly Alec Baldwin
was born in Massapequa.}

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, there is an Arby’s in the shape of a tee-pee.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I got my note cards. (To Chandler) Do you got the presents?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And I’ve got the car keys.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: We’re driving!?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Aces!
(Everyone except Ross and Rachel leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh, he seems like a nice guy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, yeah I like him a lot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ya wanna hang back and take our own cab?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, otherwise I’m not going.

scenes.location: The Anniversary Party, Ross and Rachel are arriving and see his parents.

lines.speaker: Mr. and Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Hi

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi! (Kisses his mom.) Hey mom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This is such a great party! 35 years. Very impressive, do you guys have
any pearls of wisdom?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Jack?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Why would you serve food on such a sharp stick? (Looking a
toothpick)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s a good question, dad. That’s a good question…

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (To Ross and Rachel) Congratulations you two!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you…we’re so excited

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: And also, congratulations on your wedding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha—What?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Can we talk to you for just a y’know… It’s just a
little thing. Well we think it’s absolutely marvelous that you’re having this
baby out of wedlock, some of our friends are less open-minded. Which is why we’ve
told them all that you’re married.

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Thanks for going along with this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dad so what we have to pretend that we’re married?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: Son, I had to shave my ears for tonight. You can do this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can you believe that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, if you’re going to do the ears, you might as well take a pass
at the nosal area.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, us having to lie about being married.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I know I don’t either, but ya know what, it’s their party,
and it’s just one night. And we don’t even have to lie; we just won’t say
anything. If it comes up again, we’ll just…smile. We’ll nod along.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Rachel!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi Aunt Lisa, Uncle Dan

lines.speaker: Aunt Lisa
lines.text: Congratulations on the baby, and on the wedding

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Hmmmm….

lines.speaker: Uncle Dan
lines.text: Here’s a little something to get you started. (Hands them a
check)

lines.speaker: Aunt Lisa
lines.text: So, how’s married life treating you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking at the check) Unbelievable!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We love marriage!

lines.speaker: Aunt Lisa
lines.text: Great!
(The rest of the gang arrives including Parker.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: What a beautiful place. What a great night! I have to tell you, being
here with all of you in Event Room C…I feel so lucky. I think of all the good times
that have happened here. The birthdays, the proms, the mitzvahs both bar and bat, but none
of them will compare with tonight! My God, I don’t want to forget this moment!
It’s like I want to take a mental picture of you all! Click! (He takes a mental
picture of them all.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t think the flash went off.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Dahaaa! (Punches Chandler in the arm and he makes a face of pain.)
I’m going to find the men’s room, be right back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’ll go with you

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Somewhere there is someone with a tranquilizer gun and a huge
butterfly net looking for that man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I have to go to the bathroom too, but I don’t want him complimenting
my thing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m so we weren’t in the car! Did he ever let up?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He called the Long Island Expressway a concrete miracle.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (imitating Parker) This room! This night! That waiter! His shoes! I must
take a mental picture! (He backs into someone.) Ooh sorry…(He looks behind him then
notices its Phoebe then stops his impression.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Were you guys making fun of Parker?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That depends, how much did you hear?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, he a little enthusiastic, what’s wrong with that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s just that, it’s so much.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, so what I like him! Do I make fun of the people you’ve dated?
Tag, Janice, Mona? No, because friends don’t do that. But, do you want my opinion? Do
you want it? ‘Cause in my opinion, your collective dating record reads like the
who’s who of human crap. (Walks off)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I feel terrible.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What was wrong with Mona?
Commercial Break
[Scene: The Anniversary Party, Ross and Rachel have just gotten another wedding
present.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Open it! Open it! Open it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah baby!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: So we never got to hear about your wedding!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: We were surprise that we weren’t invited.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, it was just our parents and 1 or 2 friends. It was a small
wedding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But it was beautiful. I mean it was small, but kind of spectacular.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Where did you have it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: On a cliff, in Barbados, at sunset, and Stevie Wonder sang Isn’t
She Lovely as I walked down the aisle.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, Stevie’s an old family friend. (Hits Ross’s chest)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh my God. That sounds amazing. I would love to see pictures.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So would I. You wouldn’t think that Annie Liebawitz would forget to
put film in the camera.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Would you excuse us for a second? (Pulls Rachel off to the side)
Umm…. what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? I’m not you. This may be the only wedding I ever have. I want
it to be amazing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay. Ooooh, ooh maybe I rode in on a Harley.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, Ross, it has to be realistic.
(Cut to Phoebe and Parker)

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Are you okay? You seem kind of quiet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I’m fine. I’m great. I’m with you.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: And I’m with you! What a great time to be alive! Look at this
plate-bouncy thing. (Bounces the plates) What an inspired solution to man’s plate
dispensing problems.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hm huh, yeah.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Ah! Oysters! Let me feed you one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, that’s not necessary.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, actually I don’t eat…

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: I won’t quit until you try.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, fine! Fine! (Takes the oyster and pretends to eat it while
dropping it on the floor) Mmm…hmmmmm….

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: What are they like? I’ve never had one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why don’t you just try one?

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: No, they look too weird.
(Cut to Monica and Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you doin’?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just going over my toast. Those two will never know what hit ‘em. I
can’t wait. They’re going to be crying so hard. They’re going to be
fighting for breath.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ya know if you want to, I can just hold them down and you could
(Punches the air).
(Cut to Rachel and Ross)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And my veil was lace, made by blind, Belgium nuns.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Blind?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, not at first, but it was very intricate work and they said even
though they lost their sight, it was all worth it.

lines.speaker: Aunt Lisa
lines.text: I’ll bet you looked beautiful…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I don’t know about that, but some said that I looked like a
floating angel.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (To Ross) So, how did you propose?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah. That’s a great story.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, um, actually, I-I took her to the planetarium.
That’s-that’s where we had our first date. Um, she walked in and I had the room
filled with lilies, her favorite flower…

lines.speaker: Aunt Lisa
lines.text: Oh that is so sweet!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shhh! I want to hear the rest!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then, Fred Astaire singing The Way You Look Tonight came on the
sound system, and the lights came down. And I got down on one knee and written across the
dome in the stars were the words "Will you marry me?"
(Various oohs and ahhs)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And the ring, was the size of my fist (makes a fist)!
(Cut to Phoebe and Joey)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah uh, Phoebe! Look umm, I want to apologize about before, okay? We were
being jerks. Parker’s a nice guy and I’d like to get to know him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then you better do it now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because I’m going to kill him

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What-what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys were right. He’s just too excited about…everything. I
mean I’m all for living life, but this is the Geller’s 35th
anniversary. Okay? Let’s call a spade a spade this party stinks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know I’m having the worst time. There was a 15-minute line for the
buffet, and when I finally got up to the plates, I slipped on a giant booger!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you sure it wasn’t an oyster?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I guess it could’ve been, I didn’t really look at it.
Y’know, I just wiped it on Chandler’s coat and got the hell out of there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He’s just such a great guy I’m so excited about him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey, you should be excited about him. There’s nothing wrong with
him he’s a good guy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You think?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Ya know what I think; I think we were all just being too negative.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re right. You’re right, he’s just embracing life. We
could all stand to be a little more like Parker. You know what? I am like him! I’m a
sunny, positive person.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Actually, you have a little bit of an edge.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What’s that now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh look it’s Parker!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Look! It’s the bunny hop!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oooh I love it!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: You do?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you kidding? People acting like animals to music. Come on!
(Cut to Monica, at the microphone)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay it’s time for the toast! Umm now-now, I know that Ross usually
gives the toast, but this year I’m going to do it.
(Everyone sighs)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, no it’s going to be great. Really! Mom, Dad, when I got
married, one of the things that made me sure I could do it was the amazing example the two
of you set for me. For that and so many other things I want to say thank you. I know I
probably don’t say it enough, but I love you. (Pretends to cry hoping her parents
will join her.) When I look around this room, I’m-I’m saddened by the thought of
those who could not be here with us. Nana, my beloved grandmother who would so want to be
here, but she can’t because she’s dead. As is our dog Chi-Chi. I mean look how
cute she is. (Holds up the picture and pretends to cry again). Was. (To an old man by the
stage.) Do me a favor and pass this to my parents. Remember she’s dead. Okay, her and
Nana, gone. Wow! Hey does anybody remember when Debra Winger had to say goodbye to her
children in Terms of Endearment? (Chandler covers his ears) Didn’t see that?
No movie fans?! You want to hear something sad? The other day I was watching 60 Minutes
these orphans in Romania, who have been so neglected, they were incapable of love. (Waits
for people to cry, but doesn’t get any tears.) You people are made of stone!
Here’s to mom and dad! Whatever!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Thank you Monica that was uh, interesting. Wasn’t it
interesting, Jack?

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: (looking at the picture) Why don’t I remember this dog?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: Ross, why don’t you give us your toast now?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no, Mom, it’s just Monica this year.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: You’re not going to say anything? On our 35th
wedding anniversary

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, of course, Um… Um, everybody? Um, I-I just wanted to say…on
behalf of my new bride, Rachel (She turns around and smiles), and myself. Umm, that
if…if in 35 years, we’re half as happy as you guys are, we’ll count
ourselves the luckiest people in the world.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Geller
lines.text: (crying) Oh Ross…

lines.speaker: Mr. Geller
lines.text: I just wish Nana were alive to hear Ross’s toast.

scenes.location: Phoebe’s apartment, Parker and her are entering.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: My God what a fantastically well lit hallway!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Can I get you something to drink? Like a water and Valium?

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: I must say this apartment, its, its, There are no words…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh thank God.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: It’s a haven. A third-floor paradise. A modern-day Eden in the
midst…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah? I know! I know! Uh huh? Listen why don’t we just um, sit and
relax? You know just be with each other. Quietly!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: That sounds great. (Sits down) My God this is the most comfortable couch
I’ve ever sat on in my entire life. (Bounces on couch)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Let’s try something else, let’s play a game.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: I love games!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shocking! Let’s play the game of who can stay quiet the longest.
(Giggles)

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Or…Jenga.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But, let’s play this one first. And remember whoever talks first
loses!
(They sit back)

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: I lose, now Jenga.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wrong? Really? You know the word wrong. Everything isn’t perfect?
Everything isn’t magical? Everything isn’t a glow with the light of a million
fairies? They were just brake lights, Parker!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Well, excuse me for putting a good spin on a traffic jam!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You don’t have to put a good spin on everything.

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: I’m sorry that’s who I am. I’m a positive person.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! I am a positive person. You are like Santa Clause on Prozac, at Disneyland,
getting laid!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: So what do you want me to do, you want me to be more negative, less
happy?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Much less happy!

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Fine! Well then to quote Ross, "I’d better be going."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So long! Don’t let the best door in the world hit you in the ass on
your way out! (He exits and she slams the door behind him.)
(There’s a knock on door, and Phoebe opens it.)

lines.speaker: Parker
lines.text: Isn’t this the most incredible fight you’ve ever had in your
entire life?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh huh. (Closes door)

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel’s, they’re returning from the party.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …and then, we could’ve gone from the ceremony to the reception
with you in the sidecar!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, it just wouldn’t have been feasible.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But having a dove place the ring on your finger would’ve been no
problem?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It was really fun being married to you tonight.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! And! And, it was the easiest 400 bucks I’ve ever made.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay Ross, can I uh, can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That proposal, at the planetarium…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, I know it was stupid.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you kidding?! With the, with the lilies, and-and the song, and the
stars! It was…really wonderful! Did you just make that up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, actually I thought about it when, when we were going out. It’s
how I imagined I uh, I would ask you to marry me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, that would’ve been very hard to say no too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s a good thing I didn’t do it, because it sounds like it
would’ve been a very expensive wedding. (Rachel laughs) Okay, good night

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Goodnight
(They go off to their bedrooms)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Even if the sidecar had a windscreen so your hair wouldn’t get messed
up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I will think about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s all I’m askin’
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross and Monica are there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay that’s it. I give up. At mom and dad’s 40th
anniversary, you’re the one giving the speech.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know I don’t understand why they didn’t cry. It was a
beautiful speech.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, come on.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! All that stuff you said about true love, you were right, I mean, we
did learn a lot from Mom and Dad! And that picture of Chi-Chi with her mischievous grin.
And what you said about Nana. Ohh, yeah she really would’ve wanted to be there. And
you know what? I think she was.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (starts to cry) Oh good God, Ross! How the hell do you do it?

title: The One with Joey's Interview

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, everyone except Phoebe is there as Rachel enters
carrying a magazine.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, I’m in my apartment doing the Soap Opera Digest
crossword puzzle, and guess who the clue is for three down. (She hands the magazine to
Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (reading) Three down, Days Of Our Lives star blank Tribbiani.
That’s me!! I’m blank!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How cool is this?! We know three down! I’m touching three down!
(She has her hand on his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah you are baby.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Three down knows I’m married, what’s three down doin’?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So did they call you to tell you your name’s gonna be in this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. They really like me over there. They want to do a big profile on me,
but I said no.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why’d you say no?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Remember what happened the last time I did an interview for them? I said I
write a lot of my own lines, and then the writers got mad and made my character fall down
the elevator shaft. So who knows what I might say this time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If only there was something in your head to control the things
you say. (Joey nods his agreement.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on Joey! You will totally keep it in check this time, and plus
y’know the publicity would be really good for your career! And you deserve that! And
if you do the interview you can mention, oh I don’t know, gal pal Rachel Green?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is that gal pal spelled L-O-S-E-R?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, don’t listen to him. Please?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine! All right, I’ll do it. But hey! You guys have to be at the next
table so you can stop me if I y’know, start to say something stupid.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just then or-or all the time, ‘cause we-we have jobs y’know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on! We will be there for you the whole time! Just remember gal pal
Rachel Green. (Excited) Ha-ha! I’m gonna be in Soap Opera Digest! And not just
in the dumb crossword puzzle. (Looks at Joey.) Seriously, proud of you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Central Perk, Joey is there for his interview and everyone but Phoebe are
hiding on the couch.]

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: I really appreciate you taking the time to do this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, not at all. Happy to do it.
[Cut to the rest of the gang sitting low on the couch and craning their necks to watch
the interview.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) You think we’re being obvious?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, we’re just four people with neck problems. You talk like
this. (Out of the sides of their mouths.)
[Cut to the interview.]

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: (To Joey) Y’know I think its great you wanted to meet
here. Y’know when most people hear the magazine is paying for it they want to go to a
big fancy restaurant.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) Actually, I didn’t know the magazine was paying for it.
Wouldn’t have mattered, I’m doing this for the fans, not for the free food.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Can I get you anything?

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Umm, I’ll have a cup of coffee.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And I’ll have all the muffins.
[Cut to the gang.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shhh! We’re not talking.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Finally! Oh. (Sits back in relief.)
[Cut to the interview.]

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: So, according to your bio, you’ve done quite a bit of work
before Days of Our Lives. Anything you’re particularly proud of?
[This starts a series of flashbacks; the first one is from Episode 106: The One With
The Butt, Joey is in a play called Freud!.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (He goes into a song and dance number)
All you want is a dingle,
What you envy's a schwang,
A thing through which you can tinkle,
Or play with, or simply let hang...
[The next one is from Episode 304: The One With The Metaphorical Tunnel, Joey is on
Amazing Discoveries.]

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: Folks, has this ever happened to you. You go to the refrigerator to get a
nice glass of milk, (Joey is in the background struggling to open a cartoon of milk) and
these darn cartons are so flingin'-flangin' hard to open.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you said it Mike. (Rips open the carton and spills milk on the
counter) Aw! There's got to be a better way!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: And there is Kevin.
[Cut forward.]

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: This is the first time he’s ever used this product, he's never used this
product before, you're gonna see how easy this is to do. (To Kevin) Go ahead. ('Kevin'
starts using the product, it is a spout that you jab into a paper milk carton so that you
don't have to rip it open.) This works with any milk carton.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (finishing installing the Milk Master 2000) Wow, it is easy. (Starts
to poor the milk) Now, I can have milk everyday.
(The crowd ahhs.)
[The next one is from Episode 322: The One With The Screamer, it’s the end of
Joey’s play.]

lines.speaker: Lauren
lines.text: So this is it? Victor?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I guess it is. And so… I’m gonna get on this
spaceship, (Smoke starts pouring in from the ceiling, and a ladder comes down, with
flashing, colored lights on the side of it) and I’m gonna go to Blargon 7 in search
of alternative fuels. But when I return, 200 years from now, you’ll be long gone. But
I won’t have aged at all. (Gets on the ladder) So you tell your
great-great-granddaughter to look me up, because Adrienne… baby…I’m gonna
want to meet her.
(The ladder retracts, taking Joey up into the spaceship for his voyage to Blargon 7.)
[The next one is from Episode 204: The One With Phoebe’s Husband, when everyone
including Julie is watching Joey in his porno.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shh, OK, here I come, here I come. See I'm comin' to fix the copier, I
can't get to the copier, I'm thinkin' what do I do, what do I do…so I just watch 'em
have sex. And then I say, wait, here's my line, (Joey from TV) you know that's bad for
the paper tray.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nice work my friend.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you. Wait-wait-wait-wait, you see me again. Hang on, the guy's
butt's blockin' me. There I am, there I am, there I am, there I am, there I am…
[Cut to the interview.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, there are so many things, it’s hard to pick just one.
[Cut to the gang.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m gonna get some coffee, anyone want anything?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, I’d actually love a blueberry muffin and a chamomile tea.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, double latte, extra foam.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And a bagel with only…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting him) I was just being polite!
[Cut to the interview.]

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Okay, how about when you’re not working. What do you do in
your spare time?
[This starts another series of flashbacks about Joey’s hobbies. The first one is
from Episode 703: The One With Phoebe’s Cookies, Rachel is teaching Joey how to sail
his boat, the Mr. Bowmont.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (drinking a beer) Look at this clown! Just because he’s got a
bigger boat he thinks he can take up the whole river. (Yelling) Get out of the way
jackass! (To Rachel) Who names their boat Coast Guard anyway?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is the Coast Guard.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are they doing out here? The coast’s all the way over there.
(Points to the coast.)
[The next one is from Episode 603: The One With Ross’s Denial, Joey is amazing
Phoebe and Monica by holding his breath.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Check it out! This is unbelievable! Joey has been holding his
breath for almost four minutes!
(We see Joey who has puffed up his cheeks and Chandler nonchalantly reaches down and
pinches Joey’s nose shut. In a few seconds, Joey has to move because he’s now
forced to actually hold his breath.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) Dude! What are yo—you trying to kill me?!
[The next one is from Episode 507: The One Where Ross Moves In.]
[Scene: Chandler and Joey's and Ross's, Chandler is entering and when he closes the
door Joey pops his head out of the fort like before, but this time he's wearing a cowboy
hat.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I see you've had a very productive day. Don't you think the
cowboy hat is a little much?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (popping up behind Joey wearing an Indian headdress) Come on, it's
fun!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right! (He joins them in the fort and comes up putting on a
bonnet.) Isn't this a woman's hat?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, stop talking crazy and make us some tea!
(Chandler does so.)
[The next one is from Episode 417: The One With The Free Porn, Chandler and Joey are
lamenting the fact that every beautiful woman they see doesn’t want to have sex right
then and there like in porn.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y’know what, we have to turn off the porn.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think you’re right.
(Goes over and picks up the remote.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, ready?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: One.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Two.

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: Three.
(Chandler turns off the porn and sets the remote down.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s kinda nice.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, that’s kinda a relief.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You wanna see if we still have it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
(Chandler turns on the TV and…)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: FREE PORN!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We have free porn here!!!
