[Cut to the interview.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: In my spare time I uh, read to the blind. And I’m also a mento for

lines.text: A mento…

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Like the candy?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Matter of fact, I do.
(Chandler tries to jump over the couch but everyone stops him.)

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Well umm, another thing our readers always want to know is how
our soap stars stay in such great shape. Do you have some kind of fitness regime?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, we stars just try to eat right and get lots of exercise.
[Another set of flashbacks begin with Episode 521: The One With The Ball, Joey and Ross

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! We are pretty good at this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! We totally forgot about lunch!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I-I, I think that's the first time I ever missed a meal! (Checks

[Scene: Chandler and Joey's, Chandler enters to find Joey lying in the fetus position

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This sounds like a hernia. You have to—you-you—Go to the

lines.speaker: Joey

Damn you 15s!
[The next one is from Episode 609: The One Where Ross Got High, Rachel is describing

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It’s a trifle. It’s got all of these layers. First
there’s a layer of ladyfingers, then a layer of jam, then custard, which I made from

[Time lapse, Ross and Joey are eating Rachel’s disaster.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It tastes like feet!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I like it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you kidding?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What’s not to like? Custard? Good. Jam? Good. Meat? Goooooood.
[The next one is from Episode 619: The One With Joey’s Fridge.]
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Chandler is entering to find Joey bingeing on the

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The fridge broke. I have to eat everything. Cold cuts, ice cream,

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s still in there?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not anymore.
[The next one is from Episode 711: The One With All the Cheesecakes.]
[Scene: The Hallway, Chandler and Rachel are on their knees with forks trying to
salvage what they can of the cheesecake off of the floor.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Yay! Look! There’s a piece that doesn’t have floor on
it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stick to your side!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, come on now!
(Joey finishes climbing the stairs and sees them. Chandler and Rachel both stop and

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pulls out a fork) All right, what are we havin’? (Starts digging

[Cut to the interview.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, I don’t believe in these crazy diets y’know, just
everything in moderation.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Your muffins. (Sets down a huge plate of muffins in front of

lines.speaker: Joey

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Oh, I know what I wanted to ask you. You were on the show years

lines.text: It was so stupid, I said some stuff in an interview that I shouldn’t

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Understood. So, what’d you say back then?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I said that I… (The gang jumps up and interrupts him.)
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Central Perk, continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You guys, this is Shelley, she’s interviewing me for Soap Opera
Digest, and Shelley, this are my friends…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting him) Hi! I’m gal pal Rachel Green, and if you want

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Umm, I’m gonna just go get this warmed up. (She takes her

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey! You’re doing great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, so far nothing stupid.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mento?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No thanks.

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: (returning) So, as Joey’s friends, is there anything that
you guys think our readers ought to know?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh no, no just-just that he is a great guy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (scoffs at him) Yeah, that’s gonna get you into Soap Opera
Digest. Well I…(leans into the microphone again)…I would just like to say

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, I…I just think you don’t expect someone so hot to be so

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Oh! I like that. What’s your name?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Umm, Phoebe Buffay.

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: How do you spell that? So we can get it right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh okay, it’s P as in Phoebe, H as in hoebe, O as in oebe, E as in
ebe, B as in bee-bee and E as in (In an Australian accent) ‘Ello there mate!

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Great! Well, it was nice meeting all of you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, you too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You too!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye. (They resume their previous positions.)

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: So it seems like you have a lot of friends, who would you say

[They gang all lean back to listen better, and this starts another series of

lines.text: Get out.

lines.speaker: Joey

[The next one is from Episode 618: The One Where Ross Dates A Student.]

lines.text: Oh, Joey! Sorry!

lines.speaker: Rachel

lines.text: I’ve never lived like this before.

(Rachel throws some of hers down.)

scenes.location: Chandler and Joey's, Joey is reading a script as Ross enters

lines.text: All right I've been feeling incredibly guilty about this, because I wanna

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’d seen this thing on The Discovery Channel...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Your make-up!

(Ross continues to climb down. He puts his other foot further down on Joey’s

lines.text: Y’know, when we talked about face to face, I don’t think we

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh me? Gay? No! No. No, but I have a number of close friends who are.

lines.text: So, let’s talk about women. I’m sure our female

[Another series of flashbacks begins with Episode 413: The One With Rachel’s

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-oh-oh-oh, how I do it is, I look a woman up and down and say,

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, please!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Hey, how you doin’?

[The next one is from Episode 605: The One With Joey's Porsche.]
[Scene: The street, Joey is messing with a car cover and still wearing the Porsche
stuff. This guy playing street football catches a pass next to the car cover Joey is

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! How you doin’?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: (to her friend) He has the most amazing Porsche under there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’d love to show ya, but I just tucked her in. She’s sleeping.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, is Rachel here? I’m her sister.

lines.speaker: Rachel

lines.text: Oh my God, Rachel!

lines.speaker: Jill
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you know Monica and Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And that’s Phoebe (points), and that’s Joey.

lines.text: Hey, (in the Joey voice) how you doin’?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: No! I mean you're a really nice guy and I'm happy to be your roommate

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! I see what happened. It's because I was trying to repel you. Right?
Believe me, you'd feel a lot different if I turned it on.

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I do. (Gives her the Joey-love look.) How you doin?

lines.speaker: Janine
lines.text: I'm okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!?! Oh dear God!
[Cut to the interview.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not much to tell there I’m really shy.
(The gang is confused.)

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: So, that’s it. I guess that’s all I need. Thank you
so much. I think they will be running this in the beginning of next month.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh great! Great! Thank you. (They shake hands.)

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bye-bye. (The interviewer leaves and he sits down with the rest of the
gang.) I did it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Amazing! Amazing!

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: (returning) Oh wait! I almost forgot. We have to ask everybody
this. Other than Days of Our Lives, what’s your favorite soap opera?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I don’t watch soap operas. Excuse me, I have a life, y’know?
(The gang is disappointed.)

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Thank you. The readers at Soap Opera Digest will be
happy to hear that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, good to know. (The interviewer leaves.) So close!

title: The One with the Baby Shower

lines.text: [Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica and Phoebe are preparing for Rachel’s baby
shower.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So what’s the final head count on my baby shower?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: About twenty, a couple people from work who had something else to do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Also both of your sisters called and neither can make it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! You mean they’re not coming to a social event where
there’s no men and there’s no booze?! That’s shocking! I don’t care,
as long as my mom’s here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, your mother!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! My mom’s not gonna be here?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, given that we forgot to invite her it would be an awfully big
coincidence if she was.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My God!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well it wasn’t my fault, Phoebe was in charge of the invitations!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well I don’t, I don’t have a mother so often I forget that
other people…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting her) Oh give it a rest!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So my mother is not coming to my baby shower?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No. (Pause) Neither is mine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, y’know what? Don’t worry, okay? We’ll take care of
it. We’ll call her. Just go home and get ready.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please, make sure she comes. It’s really important to me, I mean
it’s my mom!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. I know, what’s her number?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Go! I have it in my book. Go! (Rachel leaves and Monica calls Mrs.
Green.) (To Phoebe) Wait a minute! If you’re in charge of the invitations why am I
the one who has to call her—Hello Mrs. Green! Hi, it’s Monica Geller.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Oh, hello Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (on phone) Hi, umm I know this is last minute, but we’ve decided to
throw an impromptu baby shower for Rachel today.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: I know, my daughter’s told me about it when they received their
impromptu invitations a month ago.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I’m sorry. I’m-I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: For what dear? For not inviting me or lying about it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Phoebe) Oh my God, my ass is sweating! (on phone) Please! Please!
Can you come? It’s today at four.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Well all right. I’ll see you at four.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you. (Hangs up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Isn’t it at three?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Son of a bitch! (Calls Mrs. Green again.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Joey's Apartment, Joey is reading a script as Ross and Chandler enter carrying
a basketball.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Joe! You wanna shoot some hoops?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no, I can’t go. I’m practicing; I got an audition to be the
host of a new game show.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh cool!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-yeah, and if I get it by day I’ll (In a sexy voice) Dr. Drake
Remoray, but by night I’ll be (In an announcer’s voice) Joey Trrrribbiani!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You’ll be perfect for this! That’s already your name!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But the audition’s in a couple hours and I don’t even understand
the game.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well do you want some help?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh really? That’d be great! You guys can be the contestants!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Awesome!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I guess we can lose to junior high girls some other time.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (announcer voice) All right! Let’s play Bamboozled!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bamboozled?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, isn’t that a cool name?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (simultaneously with Chandler) Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (simultaneously with Ross) No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. Uhh, okay. Our first contestant is Ross Geller. Why don’t
you tell us a little something about you Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well uh, I-I’m a paleontologist. Umm, I-I live in New York. I have a
son Ben. Uh, hi Ben! (Waves.) And uh…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I said a little bit Ross. Now, how about you Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well Joey, I’m a headhunter. I hook up out of work Soviet
scientists with rogue third-world nations. Hi Rasputin! (Waves.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Excellent! Let’s play Bamboozled! Chandler, you’ll go first.
What is the capital of Columbia?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bogota.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s Ba-go-ta, but close enough. Now, you can either pass your turn
to Ross or pick a Wicked Wango card.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What does a Wicked Wango card do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I should know that. Let’s see, just one moment please. Umm, here we
are, a Wicked Wango card determines whether you go higher or lower.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Higher or lower than what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is embarrassing. (Looks it up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Ross) Can you believe how lame this is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m sorry, I don’t believe contestants are allowed to talk to
each other.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Rachel’s baby shower is underway. Monica and Phoebe
are working in the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I told the stripper to be here at five. That’s good right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You ordered a stripper for the shower?! That is totally inappropriate!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? He’s gonna be dressed as a baby! (Mrs. Green enters.) Oh hi
Mrs. Green!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m so glad you could make it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, thank you so much. And again, we’re so sorry. We could not
feel worse about it.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Try. There’s my little girl. (Goes over to Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s still mad.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah I know. Isn’t it great? One less person we have to make small
talk with.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, Sandra’s mad at you too. It-it doesn’t bother you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No look, we’ve apologized twice! I can’t do anymore than that.
I know you hate it when people are mad at you but you just have to be okay with it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. I can do that. (Pause) I gotta go powder my ass.
[Cut to Rachel and Mrs. Green.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Look at that face! Just like when you were in high school! If I
didn’t know better I’d say you were a cheerleader in trouble. Come on,
let’s get some tea.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Mrs. Green helps her up and they walk over and get some tea.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Oh my look at that. Only three weeks to go, now have you picked your
nanny yet? Now I don’t want you to use your housekeeper ‘cause it would just
split her focus.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh well actually gonna use a nanny and uh, I don’t even have a
housekeeper.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: It’s like you’re a cave person. Rachel, you must get a
nanny. You don’t know how overwhelming this is going to be. I mean when you were a
baby I had full time help, I had Mrs. Kay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mrs. Kay! Oh yeah, she was sweet. She taught me Spanish. I actually
think I remember some of it, tu madre es loca. (I think that’s your mother’s
crazy.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Such a sweet woman.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, however great she was I just can’t afford that.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Oh Rachel!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: I just had the greatest idea! I’m gonna come live with you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh-wh-what? What?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Oh, I’m so happy I’m gonna do this for my little girl. Aw,
look at you. You have tears in your eyes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes. Yes I do.

scenes.location: Joey's Apartment, the guys are still playing Bamboozled.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right Ross you’re in the lead, would you like to take another
question or spin the Wheel of Mayhem?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The wheel has not been my friend tonight Joey. Uh, I’ll take another
question.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, this is gonna be tough. Hold your breath.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s okay, I’m ready.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No dude, you gotta hold your breath until you’re ready to answer the
question.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is ridiculous, he’s not gonna hold his breath… (Ross
cuts him off by taking a deep breath and holding it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, what do you have a fear of if you suffer from this phobia,
Tris…Holy cow, that’s a big word. Trisc… Seriously look at this thing.
Chandler, how do you say that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me see that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This one right here. (Ross whines.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Triscadecaphobia.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (exhaling) The fear of Triscuts!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No, fear of the number 13.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fear of Triscuts?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s possible, they have really sharp edges.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right Chandler, you’re up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, I-I believe I’m entitled to use my Angel Pass for a
free turn?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This game makes no sense!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? You’re just upset because you’re losing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh come on Ross, I think we’re all losers here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. Chandler, you can either spin the wheel or pick a Google card.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me think. Let me think—Oh! I don’t care.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You-you must choose Mr. Bing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Either, it makes no difference.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Choose, you jackass!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll take a card.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, you picked the Gimmie card! You get all of Ross’s points!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This game is kinda fun.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) You don’t think it’s a little crazy that you get
all my points just ‘cause you…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t think the contestants are supposed to speak to each
other.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, the baby shower is continuing as Rachel walks over to
Monica and Phoebe.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why did you invite my mother?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She wants to move in with me and Ross to help take care of the baby.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: For how long?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Eight weeks. I mean I love my mother, but my God, a long lunch with her
is taxing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I personally would be honored if she wanted to live with me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She can’t hear you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? You guys, come on! What am I going to do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if you don’t want your mother to move in with you, just tell
her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re right. You’re right. I mean I’m about to have a
baby, I can tell my mother that I don’t want her to just be sleeping on my couch! Oh
my God! She’s gonna want to sleep in my bed with me. This cannot happen!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right. That is right, you go over there and tell her you
don’t want her to live with you. Do not take no for an answer!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (She goes over to tell her mother.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Phoebe) This is great! Now she’s gonna be mad at Rachel!
Y’know what? And I’m just gonna swoop in there and be like the daughter she
never had.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I have new respect for Chandler. All right everybody! It’s time to
open the presents!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes! Yes! And I think that the first gift that Rachel opens
should be from the grandmother of the baby, because you’re the most important person
in this room. And in the world!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Well uh, I don’t have a gift because I wasn’t invited
until the last minute, but thank you so much for bringing that to everyone’s
attention.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How about you less important people, let’s open your presents!
(Mrs. Green goes into the kitchen and Rachel follows her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mom that’s okay that you didn’t get you a gift!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Well, I kinda did. Me. Eight weeks of me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah. Okay, see mom, the truth is I can do this on my own.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Sweetheart I know you’re gonna be terrific mom, I just think
you need a little help, especially at the beginning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But mom, I really know what I’m doing. I can handle this.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Really? Remember Twinkles?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He was a hamster! I am not going to vacuum up my baby!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, come on Rach it’s present time! Y’know you’re the
glue that’s holding this whole party together. It’s kinda falling apart here.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Oh look.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, this is from your friend at work.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my gosh! Oh wow! Oh, I know what this is! (She’s holding an item
with a large suction cup connected to a yellow plastic box, with a long narrow tube and
bottle connected the yellow part.) Wait a minute. That can’t be right. Is that a beer
bong for a baby?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Darling, that’s a breast pump!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did I say I was done guessing? Okay, thank you for that. Oh wow!
What’s this?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s a diaper genie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it dispenses clean diapers!

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No! It’s where you put the dirty ones!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well that’s gross, why don’t you just take it outside and
throw it in a dumpster?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Oh you’re gonna do that ten times a day?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?! It goes ten times a day! What are we feeding this baby?! Indian
food?!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: No dear, that’s what babies do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, listen to your mother. She is very smart.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Plus, what are you planning on doing with the baby while you’re
trotting out to the garbage ten times a day?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t know, I’d leave it on the changing table? (Everyone
gasps.) What?! What’d I do? What’d I do?!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: You can’t leave a baby alone!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh come—(Stutters)—Of course I know that. I mean of course you
never leave a baby alone! I mean who would—she wouldn’t be safe as she would be
with me, the baby dummy. Oh God, okay. Y’know what? I think opening the presents
right now is a little overwhelming right now. So I think umm, I’m just gonna maybe
open them a little bit later, but thank you all for coming. And for these beautiful gifts,
and this basket is beautiful.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It’s actually a bassinet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay mommy, don’t ever leave me. (Hugs her.)
Commercial Break
[Scene: Joey's Apartment, the guys are still playing the game only everyone is really
into it.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) In what John Houston film would you hear this line,
"Badges? We don’t need no stinkin’ badges!"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Treasure of the Sierra Madre!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Correct! There’s a possible backwards bonus!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Madre Sierra the of Treasure!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’d like to go up the ladder of chance to the golden mud hut
please.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wise choice, how many rungs?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Six!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (makes a sound like a monkey) That noise can only me one thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (disappointed and simultaneously as Ross) Hungry monkey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (excited and simultaneously as Chandler) Hungry monkey! (To Chandler)
Haaa! (To Joey) I’d like a Wicked Wango card!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, it’s an audio question, name this television theme song.
(Starts humming the theme to I Dream of Genie.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (thinking) Oh. (Pause) Oh! Oh my God! Okay, I know this, give me-give me a
second!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tell it to the Time Turtle!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shut up! I Dream of Genie!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes! Yes, you’re back in the lead!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’d like to spin the wheel!
(Joey makes a sound like a game show wheel spinning with the pointer bouncing off of
the bars on the wheel as it slows and comes to a stop.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (annoyed) Oh come on!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! All right! Uh, umm, Super-Speedy Speed round!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is there a hopping bonus?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course!
(Ross gets up and starts to hop on one leg.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who invented bifocals?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ben Franklin.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Correct! Which monarch has ruled Great Britain the longest?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Queen Victoria.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Correct again! But, you forgot to switch legs between questions, so no
hopping bonus!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Noooo!!! Every time!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now, over to Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’d like a Google Card.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! (Pause) No! (Pause) Google!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God! Congratulations Ross, because Chandler, you’ve been
Bamboozled!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Nooo!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is the best game ever!!!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, the baby shower has ended and everyone except for Mrs.
Green have left who is talking to Rachel while Monica and Phoebe are cleaning up.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So umm, you’re gonna stay with me as long as I need you?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Of course I am!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh mom, I swear I’m not an idiot. I’ve read all kinds of books
on pregnancy and giving birth, but I-I just didn’t think to read the part about what
to do when the baby comes. And-and then guess what? The baby’s coming and I
don’t know what to do. Oh, can I throw up in my diaper genie?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: No. Sweetie, you’re gonna be fine. (Starts to get up.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait-wait where are you going? Where are you going?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: I’m going to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Now don’t worry! Everything’s gonna be okay. (Hugs Rachel
while she is standing and Rachel is sitting, seeing this Monica decides to join in on the
hugging by hugging Mrs. Green from behind her back.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It is going to be okay! (Mrs. Green glances over her shoulder and
glares at Monica while she heads for the bathroom.) It was worth a shot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering, out of breath) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Why are you all red and sweaty?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just Bamboozled Chandler! (Flexes in victory while everyone stares at
him.) Which is not uh sexual thing. That was a quick shower.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not if you were here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow! It looks like we got a lot of good stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh we did, but my mom got us the greatest gift of all.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (excited) A Play-Dough Barber Shop?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. She’s going to live with us for eight weeks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! She’s gonna help us take care of the baby! Woo-hoo. (Sees that
Ross isn’t happy.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What—You’re not serious. I mean she’s a very nice woman,
but there is no way we can take eight weeks of her. She’ll drive us totally crazy.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: (entering from bathroom) Hi Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi roomie! (Hugs her and looks at Rachel.)

scenes.location: Joey’s Audition, Joey is being shown in.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hey Joey, hi! I’m Ray; I’m the producer of the show.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (announcer voice) It’s a pleasure to meet you Ray.

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.text: And this is Duncan (points to the cameraman) and Erin, they’re gonna
help us out with the audition. So uh, let’s get the camera rolling.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (announcer voice) Rightie-O Ray!

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.text: Whenever you’re ready.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the camera) Hello, I’m Joey Tribbiani! Let’s play
Bamboozled! Erin, you get the first question! In hockey, who is known as The Great One?

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Wayne Gretzky.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Correct! Now, would you like to pick a Wicked Wango card or spin the Wheel
of Mayhem?

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.text: Uh Joey, didn’t your agents give you the revised rules? We’ve
eliminated all of that. No wheel, no cards.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What—Why?!

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.text: Uh well, the game was too complicated and research showed people
didn’t follow it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well what’s complicated? You spin the Wheel of Mayhem to go up the
Ladder of Chance. You go past the Mud Hut through the Rainbow Ring to get to the Golden
Monkey; you yank his tail and boom! You’re in Paradise Pond!

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.text: Yeah all that’s gone. It’s basically just a simple question and
answer game now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well what’s fun about that? You expect me to be the host of a boring
game that’s just people standing around answering questions?

lines.speaker: Ray
lines.text: Well, there’ll be women in bikinis holding up the scores.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (announcer voice to the camera) Let’s play Bamboozled!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Mrs. Green is telling Ross what needs to be done to baby
proof his apartment.]

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: …and all those dinosaur nick-knacks you have Ross, I thought
they might be more at home in the garage.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well we…we don’t have a garage.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Did I say garage? I meant garbage.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? Maybe, Mrs. Green, it’s not absolutely vital that
you live with us.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Well Rachel needs help with the baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I do. I really do. I don’t know anything.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m-I’m sure that’s not true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no? Pheebs? Monica? Do I know anything about babies?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, not a thing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s frightening.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well uh, y’know what? Even if she doesn’t know anything, I do! I
have a son. And his mother and I didn’t live together, and whenever he was with me I
took care of him all the time, by myself.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: That’s true. You do have another child.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: With another woman. Have you no control Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s a different issue. Uh, the point is, when the baby comes I
will be there to…to feed her and bathe her and change her. And more than that I want
to do all those things.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Well then you really don’t need me to live with you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! Yes, you’re gonna be so missed.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: You’re gonna be a great father.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well you’re gonna be a wonderful grandma. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello?! I still don’t know what the hell I’m doing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, come on, every first time mother feels that way.
You’ll—you’re gonna pick it up. (Rachel doesn’t believe that.) Hey!
You will! Uh look, y’know when you first came to the city? You were this spoiled
helpless little girl who-who still used daddy’s credit card. Do you remember?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I hope you’re going somewhere with this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look at you! What—You’re-you’re this big executive! You are
much more capable than you give yourself credit for. I-I have no doubt you’re gonna
be an incredible mother.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m telling you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you. (Hugs him.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: All right you two, I’m gonna get going.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. (Rachel and he start to stand up.)

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no sweetheart, you stay put. I’ll let myself out.
It’s like I’m not here, which I almost wasn’t.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) You’re still so funny. You’re so funny. (To Phoebe)
What do I do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing! You have apologized to her like a million times and she’s
been nothing but terrible to you. And don’t forget you just threw her daughter
a lovely, albeit slightly boring, shower, and she hasn’t even thanked you for
it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know what? You’re-you’re right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah I mean if you want to say anything to her, I’d tell her off.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! I will! Mrs. Green? Mrs. Green! (She ignores Monica and Monica
follows her out into the hall with Phoebe in tow.) It is rude to leave a party without
saying good-bye to the host! Yeah, and-and also when someone apologizes to you the decent
thing to do is to accept it! Now what I did to you, it wasn’t on purpose! But what
you’re during to me now is just plain spiteful!

lines.speaker: Mrs. Green
lines.text: Spiteful?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right! Maybe it’s time you took a good hard look at a
mirror young lady…old lady…lady!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Monica) Wrap it up, wrap it up, wrap it up…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So whenever you’re ready to apologize to me, I will forgive you.
Good day! (Monica and Phoebe reenter the apartment and Monica closes the door on a stunned
Mrs. Green.) I can’t feel my legs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You were fantastic! I’m so proud of you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah? I’m proud of me too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You should be!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah could-could-could you get me something to drink?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You got it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (When Phoebe turns around Monica runs out into the hall after Mrs.
Green.) Mrs. Green! Okay I’m really sorry!! I’m apologizing for the—(She
trips and falls down the stairs.) (Pause) Okay, I bit my tongue, but I’m still
really sorry!

title: The One with the Cooking Class

lines.text: [Scene: Central Perk, everyone is there except Monica as Ross enters carrying a huge
stack of newspapers.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey you guys I got some bad news. (He sets the stack of papers down on the
table.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well that’s no way to sell newspapers. Why don’t you try,
"Extra! Extra! Read all about it!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, Monica’s restaurant got a horrible review in the Post. (They all
gasp.) I didn’t want her to see it, so I ran around the neighborhood and bought all
the copies I could find. (He hands the paper to Phoebe and they all read it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Man, this is bad! And I’ve had my share of bad reviews. I still
remember my first good one though. (Quoting) "Everything else in this production of Our
Town was simply terrible. Joey Tribbiani was abysmal."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (seeing the stack of newspapers) Oh my God! Look at all the newspapers!
It must be a good review! Is it great?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (reading) Oh dear God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But the good news is, no one in a two-block radius will ever know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What about the rest of Manhattan?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, they all know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, this is horrible!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’m so sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m so humiliated!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah but y’know what they say Mon, "There’s no such thing
as bad press."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You don’t think that umm, (reading) "The chef’s Mahi Mahi
was awful awful," is bad press?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I didn’t write it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is he right? Am I really—Am I awful?

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah Monica! You listen to me, okay? And I’m not just saying
this because I’m your friend, I’m sayin’ it ‘cause it’s the
truth. You’re food is abysmal!
Opening Credits
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's, it’s late at night, Rachel is sitting on the couch in
the dark wide-awake as Ross walks to the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (startling him) What?! What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am freaking out!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are ya?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My due date is in one week!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you doing up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is seven days!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay look, I had a lot of water before I went to bed. Can we do this
after…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting him) No-no-no-no-no Ross! Please, come on we do not have
any of the big stuff we need! We do not a changing table! We do not have a crib! We do not
have a diaper service!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It’s funny you should mention diapers.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m serious.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay look, there’s nothing to worry about. We have plenty of time.
There’s a great baby furniture store on west 10th. Tomorrow, we will go
there and we will get you everything that you need. Okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Thank you. That’s great. Thank you. Wait-wait! Where on west
10th? Because there’s this really cute shoe store that has like this
little…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupting her) Okay. Okay. If uh, if you’re gonna do this, then
I’m gonna do that. (Points to the bathroom.) So… (Starts for the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stopping him) Oh, wait Ross! I’m sorry, one more thing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (annoyed) Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm, our situation. Y’know umm, what we mean to each other. And I
mean we-we’re having this baby together, and we live together. Isn’t that,
isn’t that weird?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stunned) (thinks) Well uh…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m just kidding! You can go pee! (He does so in a hurry.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Monica is cooking as Chandler looks on.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey uh Monica, I can’t remember. Did we say we were gonna
meet here or at the movies?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We said at the movies, but…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, I’ll see you there. (Starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey! (He returns) Now that you’re here…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, I can hang out ‘til I have to meet ya. (To Chandler) What
uh—How come you’re not going?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have a job interview I have to get ready for.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I thought you already have a job.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And people say you don’t pay attention. No, this is a much better
job. It’s vice-president of a company that does data reconfiguration and statistical
factoring for other companies.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! How do you know how to do that?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s what I do now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Joey, come taste this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Remember that guy that gave me a bad review? Well… (Feeds him a
spoonful of what she’s cooking.) I’m getting my revenge!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You cooked him?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. He teaches a course on food criticism at the New School, so before
we go to the movies I wanna go by there and make him try my bouillabaisse again. Oh, I
cannot wait to read the front page of the Post tomorrow! "Restaurant reviewer admits:
I was wrong about Monica."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The front page? You really do live in your own little world,
don’t ya?

scenes.location: The Baby Furniture Store, Ross and Rachel are checking out.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: Do you uh, want these things delivered Mr. and Mrs. Geller?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No-no-no! No, no, no, we’re not married.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We are having a baby together, but we’re not involved. (The cashier,
a very beautiful woman, looks confused) I mean, uh we-we were seeing each other a while
ago, but then we were just friends. And then there was one drunken night. (Rachel looks at
him angrily) Or, yes stranger, we’d like this delivered please.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: Why don’t you fill out this address card. (Hands him one.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: I notice you picked out a lot of our dinosaur items.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! Actually, that’s one of the reasons why we’re not a
couple.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I chose those, I’m a paleontologist.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: Really?! That is so cool!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Oh yeah, don’t get to worked up over it. I mean it-it sounds
like he’s a doctor, but he’s not.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: Oh no-no, I’m fascinated by paleontology. Have you read the new
Walter Alvarez book?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! I-I teach it in my class.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! I’m standing at a cash register, holding a credit card,
and I’m bored.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: (looking at the completed address card) Oh, I love your neighborhood.
There’s a great gym right around the corner from your building.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That’s my gym.

lines.speaker: Cashier
lines.text: I can tell you work out. (Ross is please and Rachel looks at him
confused.) A paleontologist who works out, you’re like Indiana Jones. (Rachel has a
disbelieving look on her face.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am like Indiana Jones.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is there as Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! Oh, how did baby shopping go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it was great! We got everything that we needed! Oh and Ross, almost
got something that wasn’t on the list. A whore.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, we were paying for our stuff and this saleswoman just started
flirting with him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well did she know you two weren’t married?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! Well the idea of a woman flirting with a-with a single man,
we-we must alert the church elders!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You don’t understand! You didn’t see how brazen she was.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sounds like you’re a little jealous.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! I’m not! I-I-I just think it’s wrong! It’s-it’s
that I’m—Here I am about to pop and he’s out picking up some shop girl at

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Is that a real place? (Rachel’s stunned) Are they hiring?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey Phoebe! (To Rachel) Fatty!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Chandler, why so fancy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I got a job interview. It’s kinda a big deal too. Its a lot
more money and I’d be doing data reconfiguration and statistical factoring.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, I think I know someone who does that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me! I do that. So… Seriously, do I look okay? I’m little
nervous.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! You really—You look great.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, just don’t get your hopes up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, the interview…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What about it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Y’know! You don’t make a very good first impression.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (shocked) What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh you don’t know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you serious?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, when I first met you, you were like, "Blah, blah, blah."
I was like, shhh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is it that I do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well it’s just like you’re trying too hard. Always making
jokes, y’know, you just—You come off a little needy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Rachel) Did you like me when we first met?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, I’m not gonna lie to ya, but I am gonna run away from
you. (Gets up and hurries out.)
[Scene: The New School, Monica, carrying her dish, and Joey are confronting the food
critic.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi! Umm, I’m Monica Geller, I’m the chef at Alessandro’s.

lines.speaker: The Food Critic
lines.text: Still?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think the things that you said about me are really unfair, and I would
like for you to give my bouillabaisse another chance.

lines.speaker: The Food Critic
lines.text: I don’t see any reason why I would do that to myself
again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Either eat it, or be in it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Spoon? (Hands him one and he tastes it.) So, what do you think?

lines.speaker: The Food Critic
lines.text: I’m torn, between my integrity and my desire to avoid a
beating. But I must be honest, your soap is abysmal. (Throws down the spoon and walks
out.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thata girl! Huh? We should get out of here; there’s a new class
comin’ in.
(They start to leave.)

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Welcome to introduction to cooking. Now, before we start,
can anyone tell me the difference between a hollandaise sauce and a bearnaise sauce? (No
one can.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can.

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Okay, go ahead.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well umm, they both have a egg yolk and butter base, but a bearnaise has
shallots, shirvel, and most importantly tarragon.

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: That’s very good, what’s your name?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Monica.

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Monica, you go to the head of the class.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (Does so.)
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's, Ross and Rachel are unpacking and setting up their new
purchases.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All this stuff takes up a lot of room. Hey how uh, how serious are you
about keeping Ben in your life?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My son? Pretty serious. (There’s a knock on the door and Ross answers
it.) Oh hey Katie! (The cashier from before) What uh, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Well, the delivery went out to you and I realized they forgot this. (A
blanket.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, must’ve been fairly obvious since it was the only thing left in
your store.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Listen, to be honest, home deliveries are really a part of my job
description.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. (Reaches into his pocket for some money as Rachel enters the living
room and watches holding two stuffed dinosaurs.)

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Oh uh…I actually came here to ask you out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! Wow! Uh, yeah! That sounds great. I’m just gonna put this (The
money) back in my pocket, pretend that didn’t happen. Uh yeah, actually
I’m free now. Do you wanna grab some coffee or…

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Horny bitch. (They both look at her, pretending that the dinosaurs
she’s holding are arguing.) No! You’re a horny bitch! Noooo! You’re the
horny bitch! No! You’re a horny bitch!
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel's, continued from before.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So you guys go, have a really good time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Katie) Yeah, I’m just gonna grab my coat. And uh, and my whip.
(Katie looks worried.) Y’know because of the Indiana Jones? (Katie laughs) Not-not
because I’m-I’m into S&M. (Katie’s worried again.) I’m
not-I’m not into anything weird. Y’know? Just-just normal sex. (Katie is
uncomfortable.) So, I’m gonna grab my coat. (Does so, leaving Katie and Rachel
alone.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, you had a good day huh? Big commission; picked up a daddy.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Are you okay with this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! Yeah please, you guys have fun.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Okay. It was nice to see you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh and it was great to see you too. And you look fantastic, although you
missed a button.

lines.speaker: Katie
lines.text: Oh umm, actually I umm…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh okay, I see what you’re doing there.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler and Phoebe are entering.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can’t even believe this! I really come off that badly?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! It’s okay, you calm down after a while and then people can see
how really sweet and wonderful you really are.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh good. Good, because I’m sure this interview is gonna last a
couple of weeks.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, don’t freak out! Okay? I-I will help you. How
long before you have to leave?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: An hour.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can’t help you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, all right, we’ll just do our best. Okay? So let’s
say I’m the interviewer and I’m meeting you for the first time. Okay. "Hi!
Come on in, I’m uh, Regina Philange."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Chandler Bing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Bing, what an unusual name.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well you should meet my uncle, Bada. (Pause) I’ll let myself out.

scenes.location: The Cooking Class, Joey is trying to cook as the teacher walks over to him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Your Fettuccini Alfredo looks a little dry, did you use all
your cheese?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: When you say used, do you mean eat as a pre-cooking snack?

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: And the cream?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Cheese makes me thirsty.

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Okay. Let’s move on.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: (To Monica) Oh! Something smells good over at Monica’s
station! (She tries Monica’s fettuccini.) Oh my God! This is absolutely amazing!
You’ve never made this before?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no! I don’t know anything about cooking. I had to ask someone
what it’s called when the, when the water makes those little bubbles.

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Well, hats off to the chef.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I-I-I’m sorry, your-your mouth was full, I didn’t hear what
you said. Umm, hats off to who now?

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: The chef!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Chandler and Phoebe are still working on his
interviewing techniques.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: …I think you’ll find if I come to work here, I don’t
micro-manage. I don’t shy away from delegating.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Um-hmm, that’s good to know. But let’s stop focusing on what
you don’t do, and start focusing on what you do do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (suppressing a smile) What I do do…is manage to uh, create an
atmosphere of support for the people working with me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I see. Nice sidestep on the do do thing by the way.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hardest thing I’ve ever done in my life.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You gotta go!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! (Stands up.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, don’t worry. You’re ready.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Absolutely! Just fight all your natural instincts and you’ll be
great.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
[Scene: The Cooking Class, everyone has finished baking a batch of cookies and the
teacher is going around tasting them.]

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Ah Monica, my star student.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Y’know, you called me that before so I-I took the liberty of
fashioning a star out of aluminum foil. Now, no pressure, you like my cookies, you give me
the star. (Hands it to her.)

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: (tasting the cookie and with her mouthful) Oh, yum-yum-yum.
(Hands the star back.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! A star! (The class glares at her.) I know you all hate me and-and
I’m sorry, but I don’t care.
(The teacher goes to Joey’s station.)

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Okay Joey, you’re up next. (Tries one of his cookies.)
This are good! This is amazing! You get an A!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can an A? In-in school? (To Joey) Hey, I’m a dork.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey! I’m so proud of you!

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: I think you should give him your star.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Excuse me? He doesn’t even know what he’s doing!

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: We’re all beginners here. Nobody knows what
they’re doing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I do! I’m a professional chef! (The class gasps.) Oh relax!
It’s not a courtroom drama!

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: If you’re a professional chef, what are you doing
taking Introduction to Cooking?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m-I’m sorry, it’s just that umm… Well I-I cook at
this restaurant, Alessandro’s, and umm I just got a really bad review…

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Oh Alessandro’s! I love that place!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Oh yes! You’re an excellent chef! As a person
you’re a little…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I’m totally crazy, but you-you like the food?

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Very much.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay then, I don’t stink. I’m a good chef. Okay. (Starts to
leave.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa! I don’t want to go. I’m having fun.

lines.speaker: The Cooking Teacher
lines.text: Well actually, did either of you pay for this class?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey, if my friend says it’s time to go, it’s time to go.
(Starts to leave, but comes back for his cookies.)

scenes.location: An Office Building, Chandler is on his interview.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: …also I was the point person on my company’s transition from
the KL-5 to GR-6 system.

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: You must’ve had your hands full.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That I did. That I did.

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: So let’s talk a little bit about your duties.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (nervous) My duties? (Trying not to crack a joke) All right.

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Now you’ll be heading a whole division, so you’ll
have a lot of duties.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (trying not to laugh) I see.

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: But there’ll be perhaps 30 people under you so you can
dump a certain amount on them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (really try not to laugh) Good to know.

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: We can go into detail…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No don’t I beg of you!

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: All right then, we’ll have a definite answer for you on
Monday, but I think I can say with some confidence, you’ll fit in well here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (relieved) Really?!

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Absolutely. (They walk to the door.) You can relax; you did
great.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah I gotta say thank you, I was really nervous. Y’know
I’ve been told I come on to strong, make to many jokes, and then it was really hard
to sidestep that duty thing. (The interviewer doesn’t understand) Duties. (Still
doesn’t.) Duties! (Still doesn’t.) Poo. (Still doesn’t.)

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Poo?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God this doesn’t count! Okay? The interview was over, that
was the real Chandler Bing in there, this is just some crazy guy out in the hall! Call
security! There’s a crazy guy out in the hall!

lines.speaker: The Interviewer
lines.text: Poo?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I’ll look forward to your call. (Walks away.)

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel's, Ross is returning from his date.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! You’re back from your date!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How are you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m fine, but that’s not important. What’s important is
how was she?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhh, it was fun. We, we just had coffee.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh uh-huh, uh-huh, coffee, a little rub-rub-rub under the table.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What’s uh, what’s going on? Do you not, do you not like Katie?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! No, she’s—She was nice. I mean, she’s a little
slutty, but who isn’t?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I liked her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Of course you did Ross, you would date a gorilla if it called you
Indiana Jones!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did you get like a fresh batch of pregnancy hormones today?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! It’s just that, Kate bothered me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why? What was wrong with her?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: There was nothing wrong with her! All right? She was perfectly lovely!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, so what’s the matter?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t want you to date her!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (laughs) Why? What, what are you jealous?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! And not because I want you to go out with me, but because I
don’t want you to go out with anybody! Okay? I know it’s a terrible thing to
even think this, and it’s completely inappropriate, but I want you to be at my
constant beck and call 24 hours a day! I’m very sorry, but that is just the way that
I feel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I won’t date. I’ll uh, I’ll be here, with you, all the
time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? But I’m being so unreasonable.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: True, but you’re allowed to be unreasonable. You’re having our
baby.
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starting to cry) Oh Ross, thank you. Thank you. (They hug.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you feel better?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, not really. You’re pressing the baby into my bladder and now I
have to pee. Sorry. (She gets up and starts for the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. (Stops and starts doing the I-have-to-go-to-the-bathroom dance.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just one thing umm…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We live together. You’re having our baby. I’m not gonna see
anybody else. Are you-are you sure you don’t want something more?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause) Wow! I don’t know, maybe. I’m…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh-oh, Rach! I was just messin’ around! (She’s stunned) Like you
did last night when I had to pee?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) I knew that! I knew that! I was just messin’ with you too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pause) Okay. Okay. Because for a minute you said you…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no-no-no-no, no!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: …that you actually…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No that’s just—(Laughs)—That’s just ‘cause
I’m such a good messer!
(They both laugh. Ross sits down, but Rachel doesn’t move and is lost in thought.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The bathroom?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right! (Heads for the bathroom.)

title: The One Where Rachel Is Late

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey is showing everyone a poster as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! What are you guys looking at?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it’s a poster for that World War I movie that I’m in, check
it out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Wow! It looks really violent!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-huh! I know. I’m coming soon to a theater near you! I’m in
THX! I’m unsuitable for children!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now I cannot wait to see this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, it’s already generating Oscar buzz.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I started that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I thought I did! Oh hey guess what? The premiere is next week and
you’re all invited! (They all gasp.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are we gonna take a limo?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure! Why not?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh I love taking limos when nobody died!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well obviously I won’t be able to come, for those of you who
haven’t checked their calendars today is my due date. Well y’know, I just want
to take a moment and thank you guys for how great you’ve been during this time. I
really couldn’t have done it without you. And I have loved these last nine
months! And even though I am so looking forward to the next part, I am really gonna miss
being pregnant.

scenes.location: Central Perk, time lapse, and Rachel is entering still pregnant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s right, still no baby! (To Monica, Joey, and Chandler on the
couch) Come on people! Please make some room!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh sweetie, maybe you’d be more comfortable here? (Gets up from the
green armchair.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You. Like you haven’t done enough.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I-I know how miserable you are, I wish there was something I can do.
I mean I wish I were a seahorse. (She glares at him) Because with seahorses it’s the
male, they carry the babies. And then also umm, I’d be far away in the sea. (He sits
back down.)
(Rachel turns and looks at the group on the couch and they move over. Chandler measures
the room they’ve made with his arm and decides it’s not enough and they all move
over again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God. (Sits down.) I have never been so uncomfortable in my entire life!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh I know, I’ve been there. I remember toward the end…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting her) Oh Phoebe, that’s a great story. Can you tell it
to me when you’re getting me some iced tea? (Phoebe gets up and Rachel groans.) (To
the baby) Oh God, get out! Get out!! Get out!! Get out!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let’s. (Everyone gets up and leaves Rachel.)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's, Phoebe, Chandler, Joey, and Monica are there as Rachel
enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Did you have the baby yet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you want me to come over there and sit on you? ‘Cause I’ll
do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing here so early?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They sent me home from work. They were like, "Start your maternity
leave now! Just rest, get ready for the baby." Well y’know what? Screw ‘em!
If they don’t want me there, I’ll just hang out with you guys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or you can do volunteer work.
(Joey’s cell phone rings and he answers it.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Joey! It’s Estelle! Great news, I was able to get you and one
guest tickets to your premiere.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: One guest? You told me I can have six tickets!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Well, I sold four of them on Ebay. You’ll be sitting next
to HotGuy372.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God. So that’s it?! I only get to bring one guest?

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: Yeah, what time do you wanna pick me up? (Joey hangs up on her.) Hello?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe) Did you hear that? I only get one extra
ticket to my premiere. So some how I have to pick between you three and Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (overhearing that) What-what about me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You said you didn’t want to go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don’t. But I would still like to be acknowledged. What? Just
because I’m pregnant you think I’m invisible.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Definitely not invisible.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, well Ross didn’t care enough to be here, so I think he’s
out. You snooze you lose.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He’s not snoozing, he’s teaching a class.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well then somebody’s snoozing. Joey, not that this uh should affect
you at all, but if you were to pick me, I was planning on wearing a sequined dress, cut
down to here. (Points to her stomach just above her belly button.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I haven’t seen this dress.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Star in a movie.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, you pick who ever you want. Okay? You just listen to your heart.
What does it tell you? (Mimicking a heartbeat and tapping her chest.) Phoebe, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well uh…I think I want to take Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (still mimicking a heartbeat, only faster)
Phoebe-Phoebe-Phoebe-Phoebe—Burrrrr! (Mimics the sound of a cardiac monitor going
off.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You really want to take me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Yeah! I mean I’m sorry, I wish I can take everybody, but
y’know Chandler always supported my career. He’s paid for acting classes and
head shots and stuff and well this will be my way of paying you back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you’re never actually going to pay me back?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute, just because he paid for your head shots you’re
gonna take him? Joey, I don’t think you’re comprehending just how slutty this
dress is!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s not just the stuff he paid for, I mean it’s-it’s
everything. Y’know? He read lines with me. He-he went with me on auditions when I was
really nervous, and then he consoled me after I didn’t get parts that I really
wanted. You always believed in me man. Even, even when I didn’t believe in myself.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I always knew you were gonna make it. I’m so proud of you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks. That means a lot to me.
(They look at each other and smile for a while.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mon, maybe one of these guys wants to wear your dress.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in a manly voice) I’m gonna go shave. (Gets up.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (in a manly voice) Yeah well, I’m gonna go spit. (He goes into
the bedroom. On his way out, Joey gives Rachel a wide berth.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I have to pee. If I don’t come out in five minutes it’s
because I’ve choked to death on the potpourri stink. (Goes into the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: When she comes out, you hold her nose, I’ll blow in her mouth, and
the kid will just (makes a popping sound) right out of her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s over a week late! She gotta have it today, right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don’t know. I-I think it’s still gonna be a while.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hmm, care to make it interesting? I’ll bet you that she’ll
have it by this time tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re on!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, how much?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: One hundred thousand dollars!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How about fifty bucks?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine! I’ll call Zurich and move some money around.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (calling from the bathroom) All right, who’s turn is it to help me
get up!
(They both look at each other, then Phoebe gets an idea.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No one’s here! (Monica looks at her.) Oh damnit!
[Scene: The World Premiere of Over There, Joey and Chandler are arriving in a limo and
are about to walk down the red carpet.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is so exciting! It’s so glamorous! People taking our
picture. How do I look?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A little tall.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Do you mind crouching down a little bit, so that I look taller? (Chandler
does so) There you go. (And they walk down the red carpet.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s just so glamorous.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's, Rachel is entering, still pregnant.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hey Mon? Rach is here! Ohh, you’re still pregnant. Oh, I’m
sorry. I know how uncomfortable you are. Y’know what? You look great. Yeah, like
fifty bucks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I have to go pee. Apparently this baby thinks that my bladder is a
squeeze toy. (Goes to the bathroom.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Damnit! Damnit!! Here’s your fifty bucks! (Pays Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s interesting that you lost. Now, I forget, do you like to lose?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now stop it! Double or nothing that she has it by tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine! You’re on!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Until then, General Grant, why don’t you set up camp (She puts the
bill in her bra) right there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey is Rachel here? We have a doctor’s appointment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She’s in the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, we gotta go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: In a minute!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: People ask me why we’re not together, I just don’t know what to
tell them.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) All right, all right. Let’s go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, do you wanna go change first? The doctor’s keeping the office
open late for us, but if you hurry…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I’m fine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? You don’t think that’s a little inappropriate.
(She’s wearing a tank top and has her belly sticking out.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good God man don’t anger it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, it is 100 degrees outside. For the first time in weeks, I am
somewhat comfortable.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine! Fine! Y’know what? Whatever you want. Okay? You’re the
mommy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh uh-uh pal! Don’t call me mommy! It’s bad enough you call
your own mother that. (He looks at Monica.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I’m actually with her on this one.

scenes.location: Inside Joey’s Premiere, he is intently watching the movie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (onscreen) "I thought I knew who the enemy was, but it was you all
along."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Chandler) Okay, this is it. It’s my big fight scene coming up.
(He looks over and Chandler and notices that he’s asleep.)
[Scene: Dr. Long’s Office, Ross and Rachel are waiting for the doctor. Ross is
drumming his fingers on the bed.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: When Carol was pregnant with Ben…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mmm?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: …were you this irritating?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh nothing. Nothing! Just uh, you’ve been a little short with me
lately. I’m not trying to irritate you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well then you just must have a natural talent for it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know what? The doctor will be in soon, why don’t we not speak
until then.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (silently) Okay. (Pause) Seriously, breathe louder Ross! That’s
great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Y’know we should probably ask the doctor if she even knows how to
deliver a baby that’s half human and half pure evil!
(Dr. Long enters.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi Dr. Long, how are you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) Oh, you’re nice to her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She has the drugs!

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: We’ll do a quick check.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (Rachel lies back.)

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: So, eight days late huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: You must be a little uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Eh, just a tad.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: You’re about 80 percent effaced, so you’re on your way. It
still could last a little while longer. If you’re anxious there are a few ways to
help things along.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do them!!

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: Actually, they’re things you can do. Just some home remedies, but
in my experience I’ve found that some of them are quite effective.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, we are ready to try anything.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: Okay, there’s an herbal tea you can drink.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: You can take some caster oil, there’s eating spicy foods…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Great! We will do all of those.

lines.speaker: Dr. Long
lines.text: …taking a long walk, and then there’s the one that’s
proved most effective: sex.
(Rachel turns and looks at Ross.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You’ve got to be kidding me!
Commercial Break
[Scene: Joey’s Premiere, the movie is ending and it takes the applause to wake up
Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good job Joe! Well done! Top notch!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You liked it? You really liked it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho, yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Which part exactly?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The whole thing! Can we go?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no-no-no, give me some specifics.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I love the specifics, the specifics were the best part!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what about the scene with the kangaroo? Did-did you like that part?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was surprised to see a kangaroo in a World War I epic.

lines.speaker: Joey
