scenes.location: Rachel’s Room, Ross is entering.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, I um… I heard about the engagement.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Surprised?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And confused. Rach, sweetie, I-I um…I didn’t propose to you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t think you do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You didn’t propose to me. Joey did.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Poor baby, you’re so tired. Rach, I didn’t propose to you, Joey
didn’t propose to you, and Chandler didn’t propose to you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh… You didn’t propose to me, Chandler didn’t propose to
me, but Joey did.
(Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey proposed to you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can come back.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, wait! Wait-wait-wait! Joey, did you propose to her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes you did!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Actually, technically, I didn’t.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well then why did you give me a ring?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait! Whoa-whoa, you…you gave her the ring?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No, and I did not ask her to marry me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, you did!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I didn’t!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, you did!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I didn’t!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, you did! And don’t you say, "No, I didn’t!"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahhh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He was right there. He got down on one knee and proposed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa! You were down on one knee?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, that looks bad. But I didn’t…I didn’t propose!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then what did happen?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, what did happen?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, the ring fell on the floor and I went down to pick it up and you
thought I was proposing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, but you said, "Will you marry me?"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I didn’t!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, you did!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I didn’t!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, you did—Oh my God you didn’t! (Screams) Well then why
didn’t you tell me that before?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well I tried, but people kept coming in and then you took your breast out!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Whoa! Hey! Whoa-whoa-whoa, you saw her breast?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Ross) I’ll tell you about it later. Be cool.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well then Joey, what the hell were you doing with an engagement ring?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It wasn’t my ring! It’s Ross’s ring! That’s why I felt
so bad Rach, because he was going to propose.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You were gonna propose to me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhh… No.
(An awkward silence follows.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, this is awkward. {See? I told you so.}

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But I-I was going to see if y’know, maybe you uh, start dating again
but that—I mean that-that was all, Rach.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, step up! I proposed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, you didn’t!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh that’s right. There’s a lot going on here and I think I ate
some bad fruit earlier.
(There’s a knock on the door and the Nurse enters carrying Emma.)

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Hey, she just woke up! She’s hungry. Why don’t we give this
another try?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Joey) I can’t believe you told her I was going to propose!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can’t believe you’re not going to propose!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I’m not going to rush into anything!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, dude, I totally understand. Usually after I have a baby with a
woman I like to slow things down!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She’s doing it Look, she’s breast-feeding look!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking at the ceiling) Ah, it’s beautiful.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: I’ll come back for her later.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you. (The nurse exits.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow, this feels weird.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good weird?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wonderful weird.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Y’know what you guys? I’m uh, I’m gonna go too. And uh,
I’m sorry about everything.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey don’t worry, it was my mistake.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, Rach, I should’ve told you sooner. It’s just that…Man!
That kid is going to town! (Joey makes his awkward exit.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She’s perfect.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We’re so lucky.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We really are.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I-I know it’s not a proposal and I don’t know where you
are, but with everything that’s been going on and with Emma and…I’ve been
feeling…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. I know. I’ve feeling…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. (Laughs nervously)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, well, that… Wow, okay, well, umm…then maybe, at least we
can, we can talk about us again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, maybe.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well good, okay. I-I, kind of think y’know if we…if…
You’re wearing the ring.
(Pause.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wh-what’s that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And you told Phoebe you were engaged.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m sorry, what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: When you thought Joey proposed did…did you say yes?

title: The One Where Emma Cries

scenes.location: Rachel’s Hospital Room, Ross is sitting next to Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You said you’d marry Joey?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay you have to realize, I was exhausted, I was emotional, I would have
said yes to anybody. Like that time you and I got married! (Pause) I’m not helping.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So you said yes to him, and you just had our baby?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is right and traditionally the daddy is supposed to give the mummy
a present but I am prepared to let that go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So when I came in here to see if you wanted to maybe start things up
again, you were engaged to my best friend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well—Really? I thought Chandler was your best friend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, Chandler’s my oldest friend, but Joey’s my—No! Ah!
(points at Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooooo!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Enters) Hey you guys I’m gonna take off. I just wanted to let you
guys know, say goodbye.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel said she’d marry you?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (He looks around the room) This isn’t the right room, sorry folks.
(leaves)
Opening Credits
[Scene: Ross and Rachel’s, Monica, Phoebe, Joey and Chandler are waiting for Ross
and Rachel to come home and Monica is looking at the sign Phoebe bought that says,
"It’s a Boy!"]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, I don’t wanna be negative so I’ll say that most of the
signs you bought are good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No they ran out of "It’s a girl" but I can fix this one,
(She writes "not" in between it’s and a) See?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking at Chandler sleeping with a balloon in his mouth) So sexy.
(Waking him up.) Honey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yea yea. (Pulls the balloon out of his mouth)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey why don’t you go lie down.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, Ross and Rachel will be back soon and then I gotta go to the
office (Pulls another balloon out of his mouth) Am I producing them?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why’re you so tired?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Couldn’t sleep last night you know, then I started worrying about
this big divisional meeting that I have later today, the more I worried about it the more
I couldn’t sleep. Y’know? I was like, if I fall asleep now I’ll get
six hours sleep, but if I fall asleep now I’ll get five hours sleep. Not matter what
I did I couldn’t fall asleep.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know what you should’ve done, you should have told yourself that
little story.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (enters with Emma) Hi!

lines.speaker: Everyone
lines.text: Hi, welcome home!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe did the signs!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh you guys thanks for doing this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look at all the stuff people sent!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ah! (Sees a big stuffed gorilla) Oh my gosh there’s something
every mother needs, a giant stuffed gorilla that takes up the entire apartment! What are
people think… (Reads the card) Oh you guys I love it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey so where’s Ross?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He’s downstairs getting the rest of the stuff out of the cab.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is he still mad at us?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you more then me, but he can’t stay to mad at me. I mean, I
just had his baby.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s not fair! I can’t do that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I’m not so sure you should be here when he comes up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: See this is what I was afraid of, I didn’t think I should be here
either but somebody (Looks at Chandler) said he’d be over it by now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, what do I know? I wanted to get a bigger gorilla.

scenes.location: A Boardroom, Chandler keeps drifting off to sleep at his meeting.

lines.speaker: Ms. McKenna
lines.text: The numbers we are seeing New York, Chicago, and London are
consistently solid, but many of our officers have reported disappointing fields.
(Chandler drifts off and his arm slips off the table and he wakes back up.)

lines.speaker: Ms. McKenna
lines.text: Boston is down, Atlanta is down, Houston is down, I could go on and
on but instead of boring you I’ll go straight to my forty two point plan.
(Chandler leans over to fall asleep on the man’s shoulder next to him, only the
man catches his attempt.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Walter (nods).
[Scene: Ross and Rachel’s, Phoebe, Monica, Ross, and Rachel are watching Emma
sleep.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She’s just so cute! I just wanna bite her ear off and use it and a
sucking candy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe! But I could take one of those little feet and put it in a pita
pocket.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (enters from the bed room) Okay I put most of the stuff away.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh great, the pacifiers?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: In the closet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The burping clogs?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Linen closet.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The diapers?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: In the hospital.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow you guys got a hospital? Fancy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No I left the diapers at the hospital! There’s some in the bag but
I’ll run out and get some more.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright thanks, oh Ross could you stop by the coffee house and get me a
muffin?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure what kind?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Umm let me think...What do I want, what d-o I w-a-n-t...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please take your time, it’s an important decision. Not like, say, I
know! deciding to marry someone, this is about a muffin.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Blueberry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Blueberry it is.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, he’s really not letting this go, is he?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God how long do you think that’s gonna last?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I dunno, well he got over the "We were on a break" thing
really quickly.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know I can’t even worry about that right now, cause I got
the cutie little baby, oh I can’t believe how much I love her, I can’t get
enough of her, like right now I miss her. I actually miss her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know that’s… that’s her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh god look at her sleeping. Oh, I love her so much! Oh, I
think I’m gonna wake her up.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, Rach, no no, you know you’re never supposed
to wake a sleeping baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well I can do whatever I want! I made her! (Waking Emma up.) Come
on little girl, hi!
(Emma starts crying)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can say I told you so but she’s kinda doing that for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh I’m sorry mummy’s so sorry go back to sleep go back to
sleep. Shh. Shhh! Go back to sleep
(Emma continues crying in the background)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Breaks your heart doesn’t it

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It really does… how long do you think we have to stay?

scenes.location: A Boardroom, Chandler’s meeting continues.

lines.speaker: Ms. McKenna
lines.text: Ok if everyone’s on board, it’s settled, Chandler,
(Walter puts his hand on Chandlers hand, Chandler sleeping puts his hand on top of his, he
then wakes up and pulls his hand away) Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: Ms. McKenna
lines.text: Are you on board?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (not knowing what he’s saying yes to) Yes.

lines.speaker: Ms. McKenna
lines.text: Then, problem solved. Chandler will be running our office in Tulsa.
You’re gonna love Oklahoma.
(Chandler smiles and nods then realizes what he’s agreed to.)
[Scene: Ross and Rachel’s, Emma continues crying while Rachel, Monica and Phoebe
try different methods to stop her crying.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, alright, we already tried feeding her, changing her, burping her,
oh try this one! Go back in time and listen to Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright here’s something, it says to try holding the baby close to
your body and then swing her rapidly from side to side.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok. (Starts swinging Emma rapidly and she stops crying)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It worked!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh (happy) oh no just stopped to throw up a little bit. (Emma starts
crying again.) Oh come on, what am I gonna do, its been hours and it won’t stop
crying.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umm, she Rach, not it, she.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I’m not so sure.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god, I am losing my mind.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, no kidding, this just proves no good can come from having sex with
Ross!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross is getting Rachel’s muffin.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Gunther, can I get a couple of blueberry muffins to go? (He puts a bag
with diapers in it on the counter.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Diapers huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: So I guess Rachel had you baby?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yep, can you believe it?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Nope! I still can’t believe she slept with you in the first
place.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh? Ooh (laughs) you mean like a… Huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey. (Ross turns to see who it is, and seeing it’s Joey he
just ignores him and turns back around.) Ross, I know you’re pissed at me, but we
have to talk about this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah actually we don’t. (Ross walks off)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine, fine okay. But I gotta say technically, I
didn’t even do anything wrong.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (turns back) What! (Angrily) You didn’t do anything wrong?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I said I didn’t technically.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay let’s put aside that you (Makes quote marks with his fingers.)
"accidentally" picked up my grandmothers ring and you (Does it again)
"accidentally" proposed to Rachel.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, can I just stop you right there for a second? When people do this
(Makes quote marks with his fingers.) I don’t really know what that means. (Ross just
looks at him) You were saying?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And I can even understand that you couldn’t tell Rachel, but why
couldn’t you tell me, huh? You had all day to and you didn’t.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know I should’ve. (Makes quote marks again.) "I’m
sorry."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not using it right, Joe.
(He brings his hands in closer to his face then does it again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m gonna go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, come on Ross! (He grabs his bag so he can’t leave) Look, Ross, we
have to get past this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Give me the bag.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, look, I don’t know what else to do. I said I’m sorry!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You should scream at me, or-or-or curse me, or hit me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I’m not gonna hit you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not? You’ll feel better! I’ll feel better, and
you know you want to. I can see it in your eyes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No I don’t.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A little bit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Little bit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (excited) A little bit more.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Give me the bag.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, hit me

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Give me the bag.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hit me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, give me the bag.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hit me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joe I’m not kidding…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (interrupting) Hit me, hit me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shouts) Hit me! Hit me!
(Ross throws a punch, but Joey ducks and Ross punches the pole. Ross then screams from
the pain and turns to Gunther, and Gunther has a huge smile on his face.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You ducked!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m sorry! It was a reflex!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my god, this really hurts!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I couldn’t help it! When a fist comes at your face, you duck! Look!
(He goes to punch Ross, expecting him to duck, but he doesn’t and Joey punches Ross.
Gunther is amused.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What is the matter with you?!?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You were supposed to duck!!! Why didn’t you duck?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why don’t we talk about this on the way to the hospital?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good, good yeah, (Grabs the bags) maybe while we’re there, they can
check your reflexes. (Joey opens the door and it hits Ross in the face with it.) (Makes
quote marks.) "Oops."
Commercial Break

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel’s, Emma is still crying.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Try feeding her again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I already fed her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, that’s why I said again!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright you guys, we can’t turn on each other, Okay?
That’s just what she wants.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (enters) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica can I talk to you outside for a minute?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, you guys, just stay here, I’m gonna go check her diaper,
Pheebs you wanna come?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh I’m kinda part of this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually Pheebs its more of a husband and wife kinda thing

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I knew I should have married Chandler.
(Phoebe and Rachel go to the back room and Emma continues to cry in the background
while Chandler and Monica talk.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay what’s up

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Umm, you know how we always said that it would be fun to move to Paris
for a year? You know, you could study French cooking and I could write and we could take a
picnic along the Seine and go wine tasting in Bordeaux?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah (smiles).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, you know how that people say that Tulsa is the Paris of
Oklahoma?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? Who says that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: People who’ve never ever been to Paris.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What’s going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’re moving to Tulsa! (Makes a excited expression on his face)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, Ms. McKenna, she kind of works above my boss, she asked me to
move to Tulsa and be the president of our office there, and I was sleeping and apparently,
said yes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (stands up angry) Tulsa, Oklahoma!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The Sooner State, whatever that is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, I don’t even wanna see the musical Oklahoma!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? Oh What A Beautiful Morning! Surrey With A
Fringe On Top.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you trying to tell me that we’re moving to Oklahoma, or that
you’re gay? All right, not that this matters, but did they at least offer you a huge
raise?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, but they are going to lease us a Ford Focus. (Monica’s
not impressed.) I’ll get out of it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (hears Emma crying) What is wrong with Emma?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh she misunderstood, she thought she was moving to Tulsa.

scenes.location: Ms. McKenna’s Office, Chandler enters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Umm ma’am, do you have a minute? (She points for him to come in)
I kind of have some bad news. I don’t think I can move to Tulsa.

lines.speaker: Ms. McKenna
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s a funny story, actually. (coughs) I kind of fell asleep in
the meeting this morning so when I said I’d move to Tulsa, I didn’t really know
what I was saying.

lines.speaker: Ms. McKenna
lines.text: You fell asleep?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But only because I was up all night worried about this meeting,
ain’t that funny? Irony? Not a fan, alright (he sits down). See, here’s the
thing. I went home and told my wife about Tulsa and she won’t go. See, me, I love
Tulsa! Tulsa is heaven! Tulsa is Italy—Please don’t make me go
there!

lines.speaker: Ms. McKenna
lines.text: Chandler, I…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No no no! Look, Carol, can I call you Carol? (Pause) Wh-why would I
when your name is Elaine? Oh what a great picture of your son, strapping! (She glares at
him.) That’s a picture of your daughter, isn’t it, well she’s lovely. I
like a girl with a strong jaw. I’ll call you from Tulsa. (Exits.)

scenes.location: The Hospital, Joey is sitting in the lobby as Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, so how is it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I broke my thumb.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Your thumb? That’s weird. (Makes a fist.) You sure you’re
punching right? Make a fist. (Ross just looks at him with his thumb in a cast.) Maybe
later. Ross I feel terrible.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what, you can go, I just have to fill out some forms. (Tries to
hold the pen but can’t)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You, you want me to help you with that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why, does it look like I’m having trouble with my misshapen claw? (He
hands Joey the form)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Name? (Ross looks at him.) I know Ross but what’s it short for? You
know like, like Rossel or Rosstepher.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just Ross!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It’s pretty, Okay date of birth?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know my birthday.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, May...tember.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: October 18th.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Occupation? Dinosaurs.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually I’m a palian… Dinosaurs is fine… the drawing is
not.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, who do you want as your emergency contact?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, Rachel I guess.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, relationship, boy this could take a while.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just ah… just put roommate.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on, you guys are more then that! I mean, you’re gonna get
together right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t think that we are.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But you two were supposed to be together.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I thought so too, but then she said she’d marry you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on, Ross, that didn’t mean anything! She just had the baby, she
was all freaked out about doing it alone, she would have said yes to anybody.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah that’s what she said.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So I don’t wanna be just anybody.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what, it’s, it’s better this way anyway. I mean I
don’t know what I was thinking, going down that road again with us. It’s just
much easier if we’re just friends who have a kid.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And you’re Okay with that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes. I mean, it’s what we always planned. And if you have a
plan, you should stick to it. That’s why they call them plans. Hello?
(Pause) I’m fine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, for what it’s worth, with Rachel I don’t think you’ll
ever be just (Makes quote marks.) "anybody."

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey there you go! (Smiles because Joey used it correctly)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (makes quote marks) "Thanks."
(Ross looks away, not bothering)

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel’s, Emma continues to cry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! How long has she been crying?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: About a week and a half.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well alright, looks like you guys have got it under control so I’m
just gonna go. (She gets up and Rachel looks at her, upset, and Monica just stares.) No!
Really? Misery really does love company. All right! (She sits back down.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, try holding her a different way.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys, I’m doing the best I can, anyone else is welcome to try.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, I’ll try, fine! Yes, Okay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Here you go. (Hands Emma to Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shh! Nothing works with this child! (Hands her back.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh god what am I gonna do you guys, I can’t even comfort my own
baby! I’m the worst mother ever!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You’re just new at this, it’ll get better, think about your
first day at work. I mean, that couldn’t have been easy but you figured that out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah I don’t think dressing provocatively is going to help me here!
Oh my god just please take her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay I’ll take her, here. (Takes Emma)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I have to go to the bathroom. (Goes to the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I have to go scream into a pillow. (Goes to scream into a pillow)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Emma) Bouncy baby, Bouncy baby, Ooh baby baby, Ooh baby baby, Ooh
baby baby. (Emma stops crying and falls asleep)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Have I gone deaf?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It worked! Ooh baby baby baby, ooh baby baby baby!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You must be a fireball in bed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can’t believe it! She’s asleep! I got her to go
to sleep! I have actual magical powers!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can hear traffic and birds! I can hear the voices in my head
again! (Monica looks at her strangely) I’m kidding. (She smiles wickedly.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! You got her to stop crying!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes I did, I’m Monica, Super Aunt

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are the official baby crier stopper!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes I am!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You’re never leaving the apartment!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Say what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That’s your new job, day and night, she starts crying I need you
here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (stands up to hand Emma back) Oh no no no no!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thankfully you don’t need me at all (gets up and to leave) so Okay
Super aunt see you later! Rachel let’s give it six to eight months (she leaves).

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay so listen I’m gonna go lay down.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know the book says that whenever she’s sleeping I should be
sleeping so… (She gives Monica thumbs and goes to lay down)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, loudly) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Shhh! We just got her to go to sleep

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh so there can’t be any yelling.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We’re moving to Tulsa

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (loudly) What!?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Shhhh! Shhhhh! Shhhhh! Shhhhh! (Walks backwards towards the door) I
can’t, I can’t hear you. (He runs out)

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel’s, Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Heeeeey, where have you been? (He shows her his thumb) What happened to
you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah I had a little thing with Joey, if you think this is bad you should see
him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no Ross! This is not good, we have to talk about this Joey thing.
Please sit. (He sits) You have got to get over this Joey thing, okay? I never really
wanted to marry Joey, okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what I really really want?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I wanna sleep, I wanna eat, I wanna take a shower, I mean before she
wakes up and we gotta do this all over again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (smiles) Right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean I got news for you mister, Emma? Not easy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, that’s what I’m here for. (Emma starts crying again) Want
me to get that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No its really okay… Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (comes running out the kitchen to the bedroom) Got it! Got it! Got it!
Got it! Got it! Got it!

title: The One with the Pediatrician

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartment

lines.text: (Ross and Rachel enter)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! So what's the big news you had us rush all the
way over here for?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, our news. My company has asked me to head
up our office in Tulsa , so as of Monday I'm being officially relocated.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monday?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How long do you have to go for?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They said it could be up to a year.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A year?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Monica) Do you have to go?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I kind of have to don't I? Because of this stupid
thing (Points to her wedding ring.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There is nothing like the support of your loving
wife, huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait a minute, you can't go to Tulsa. Maybe you forgot,
but we've got tickets to the Jets game next week.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry buddy, but I don't think I'm gonna be
able to make it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We were gonna go see the Jets!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can't go, I mean you're the glue that holds this
group together!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't believe you guys are moving.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I call their apartment!!!

lines.speaker: Everyone
lines.text: No!!! Ah!! Ahh!!!
[INTRO]

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here you are (Hands Rachel a cup of coffee)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you Joey. You know what? I'm not even sure
I can have caffeine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I went thru this with Ben and Carol. One cup of coffee
won't affect your milk.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. Just to be sure I'm gonna call Dr. Wiener.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Laughs)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Every time? (She takes up her cell phone and starts
dialing.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhuh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, you don't have to call whenever you have a little
question, okay? Trust me, I know this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, I trust you. (Continues to dial)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel, I can see you dialing! I don't understand why...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm on the phone! (On the phone) Dr. Wiener? (Ross
and Rachel walk away)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Laughs)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's so weird seeing Ross and Rachel with a baby.
It's just so grown up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, yeah. I feel like we're all growing up. Person
named Wiener, God that kills me. (Laughs)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look at you all grown up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Actually, you know what? I am. That whole thing with
Rachel made me realize that maybe I'm ready for a more serious relationship.
You know? Like I'd like to meet a nice mature commitment-minded lady. And looks
aren't as important as...Nah, she's gotta be hot.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, I might know somebody. Hey, how about you
set me up with someone, and we double date!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can do that, yeah. How is Friday?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Done. Oh good, really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Let's see! (Opens her address book.) Oh, you know
who's great? Sandy Poophack.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Laughs) Poophack... (Laughs)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah... All right, well that rules out Lana Titweiller

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Laughs)
[SCENE: Chandler and Monica's apartment]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Enters) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I've got good news!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You got out of the whole Tulsa thing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, I have news. You don't have to move to Tulsa.
You can stay here and keep your job.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's great! How?
Chandler. Well my boss and I worked out a deal where I only
have to be in Tulsa four days a week, so the other three I can be here with
you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you're gonna be gone four days a week? (Thinks
about it.) No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry, are you just used to saying that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No. I can't be away from you for that long.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, you're my husband. I'm not gonna live in a
different state than you for 208 days out of the year.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's fast math! We could use you in Tulsa.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, thanks for trying to figure out a way, but
if you're going to Tulsa, I wanna go with you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you said that without gagging!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know! (They high-five.)

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel's apartment

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (On the phone) Excuse me? Oh yeah? Well, up yours
too! (Hangs up)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Enters from his bedroom)Who the hell was that?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Dr. Wiener.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, you can't call people at three in the morning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh you know what, you sound just like his wife!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Was there anything you did wrong with Emma?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, of course there is! Okay? I'm not insane!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, what was it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hiccups.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, I told you, you can't call him every time any
little thing comes up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah well, not anymore I can't. He fired us! What
are we gonna do? We have to find a pediatrician. Wait wait, Monica said that
when you guys were growing up, you really liked your doctor. What was his name?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dr. Gettleman? Yeah I know, I don't think that's a
good idea. In fact, I think he's dead.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Argh! Why does everything happen to me?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, I promise first thing tomorrow we'll find another
doctor, but I gotta get up early and I'm not feeling all that well.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What, do you mean you're not feeling well?
What do you have? Is it Rubella? Because don't go near Emma, she has not had
that shot.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know? Come to think of it, it does feel Rubella-like!
(Walks back into his room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Grabs the phone and stars dialing) (On phone) (In
a high pitch voice) Wiener, Wiener (In a low pitch voice) Wiener, Wiener!!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Comes back into the living room) Rachel!!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Great! Now he's gonna know it was me!

scenes.location: Joey's apartment

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Enters) Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So how is this for our big double date tonight? (She
is all dressed up)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Realizes that he has forgotten all about the double
date) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, great! Just the reaction I was hoping for.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, so you found someone for me. You didn't forget?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course not! And you're gonna love Mary Ellen.
She's really smart and cute and funny, and I can't tell you how I know this,
but she' not opposed to threesomes. So tell me some about my guy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on, give me something. What's his name?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mike.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mike? Okay! What's his last name?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damnit! Is there no mystery left in romance anymore!?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, we'll se you and Mike at the restaurant
in a couple hours.

lines.speaker: Joey and Phoebe
lines.text: (Ad-lib good-byes) (Phoebe leaves)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why did I have to say Mike? I don't know a Mike! Why
couldn't I have said... (Looks through his address book) There's no guy in
there!

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartment

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's impossible to find a good doctor. I mean, how
do you know the good ones from the ones who are gonna push their penis against
your knee?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know what she's talking about.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We've got to find a new pediatrician. Ross was getting
sick last night, and I think Emma may have caught it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don't you go see Dr. Gettleman?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross said he died.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He didn't die. I saw his daughter last week. Said
he was fine. Her on the other hand, botched Botox.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, great! Well, then I'm gonna take Emma to see
him. I wonder why Ross said that he died.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, maybe he was getting him confused with his childhood
therapist.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He saw a therapist?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, he used to have this recurring nightmare, just
really freaked him out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why? What was it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That I was going to eat him.

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.text: (Joey walks in and looks around. He's trying to find a Mike for Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: MIKE!!!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Checks him out) Okay! (Walks over to his table and
sits down with him)

scenes.location: Restaurant

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I gotta tell you, I can't believe I'm doing this with
you. Although I did just get out of a nine-year relationship, so I guess I
should be open and taking some risks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Everything is gonna be fine. Just follow my lead, okay?
All you have to do is pretend to be Mike.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I am Mike.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Atta boy!
(Phoebe and Mary Ellen enter.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, look...

lines.speaker: Everyone
lines.text: (Ad-lib hellos)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, this is Mary Ellen Jenkins. So, Mike, how do
you and Joey know each other anyway?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: How do I and Joey know each other? Wow, if I had a
nickel for every time somebody has asked me that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Laughs) From school.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah, we met in college. (Off Joey's look) I mean,
high school.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, you guys go way back then. So what are you up
to these days?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Well, I'm a lawyer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mike, 'attorney at law'!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Actually, I just gave up my practice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? That's the kinda thing you usually run by me.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I always wanted to play piano professionally, and I
figured if I don't do this now, I never will.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, that's great! I liked that better than the law
thing, so...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Which is why I waited until now to introduce you to
Mike.

lines.speaker: Mary Ellen
lines.text: I thought you thought he was still a lawyer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, that's not what I meant. Let's get you a cocktail.

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartment

lines.text: (Monica Enters. Chandler is in the kitchen with his laptop)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Looking for restaurant jobs for you in Tulsa.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's so sweet. Find anything?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Slim Pickings.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nothing, huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, 'Slim Pickings', it's a barbecue restaurant.
They're looking for a cook. Actually 'cook' may be a bit of a stretch. They're
looking for someone to shovel mesquite.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: 'Slim Pickings'...That is so cheesy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: 'So Cheesy' also has an opening.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, that's okay. I actually know this woman, Nancy,
who's a restaurant biz head-hunter. Maybe she'll know of something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can I just say how much I appreciate you coming
with me. When we get to Tulsa I'm taking you for a great dinner at 'Slim Pickings'.
'So Cheesy'? 'Whole Hog'? It's going to be tough to keep Kosher in Tulsa.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (On phone) Hi, Nancy. Hi, it's Monica Geller. I'm
good. Listen, I'm looking for a job in Tulsa. Well yeah, my husband has been
relocated...Because I love him! No, I don't want a job in New York. Javo (sp?)
is looking? Oh my God! He asked for me personally? Oh my God! Oh, wow, this
is really flattering, but I'm moving to Tulsa. Yeah, so if you would tell Javo
(sp?) 'I'll take it!'

scenes.location: Pediatrician's office

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, my name is Rachel Green, I have an appointment
for Emma.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Dr. Gettleman is finishing up with a patient,
he should be out shortly.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gettleman
lines.text: (To a patient) I think you just have a cold,
it's definitely not Strep.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks doctor.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gettleman
lines.text: Would you like a lollypop?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You even have to ask?! (He grabs a lollypop out of
a jar) (Sees Rachel) (To Rachel) He is alive!

scenes.location: Restaurant

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, it's so surprising that you and Joey have
known each other for so long and I've never heard about you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, that's because we had a bit of a falling out.
Mike hit my mom with a car.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No, I didn't.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's okay Mike, I have forgiven you. And now we're
friends again everything's great!
Mary Ellen Wait, is your mom okay?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Please, we're trying to have a conversation. (Pushes
the wine glass closer to Mary Ellen.)

lines.speaker: Mary Ellen
lines.text: Wow, you're a lot nicer on 'Days of Our Lives'.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: 'Days of Our Lives'! That's why you look so familiar!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do you not know each other?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Laughs) Of course we do! Mike is playing a game that
we used to play in high school. Yeah, where we pretend we don't know each other.
We played all kinds of games. (To Mike) Hey, remember the one where I punch
you in the face for not being cool?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mike, let me ask you something. How many sisters
does Joey have?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (Joey holds up six fingers) Six!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you doing? I said seven! (Holds up six fingers.)
(Realizes his mistake) Argh!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, why did you set me up with a stranger?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because I forgot about our date, I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I'm sorry too. And just to be clear, I didn't hit his
mother with a car.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Joey) You are unbelievable! I spent so much time
