lines.text: What kind of job is that for a man? A nanny? I-It's
like if a woman wanted to be...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she's got that "yeah, try to say it" look
on her face) Yes?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: King?

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: I er... I hope you don't mind. I used some of my home-made
lotion on Emma. It's a mixture of calendula and honey cream. It'll dry that
rash right up. Plus... It keeps the hands young... (it makes Rachel smile)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (whispering and begging) Please? (Ross makes a "whatever"
gesture) YES! Sandy you're hired.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: That's great! (He gets emotional again and waves his
hand in front of his face in a feminine way, like trying to dry his tears) I'm
sorry. It's just... such an emotional thing when you're welcomed into a new
family...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oooh... ***I really can't hear what she says*** come here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You gotta be at least bi...
COMMERCIAL BREAK
[Scene: Joey's apartment. Joey is reading a 'Busty Ladies' magazine when Chandler
enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! (Joey doesn't look up, but gestures 'wait a
minute' with his finger while he finishes reading the article. Chandler waits
for Joey to finish.) I need you to set me up for a joke. Later, when Monica
is around, I need you to ask me about fire trucks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh. I-I don't know Chan. I'm not so good with remembering
lines.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Can't believe what he hears) Well, thank God your
livelihood doesn't depend on it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, right? (Chandler has really big eyes, and nods)
Wh... Wh... Why are we doing this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica says that her Maitre D. is the funniest guy
she's ever met.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Seriously? She actually said that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Am I crazy to be this upset?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nooooo! Being funny is your thing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Without that, you just got "lame with women".

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ye.... (stops because he realises what Joey just
said, and stares at him. At this moment Monica enters)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi! There you are.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sees Monica) Fire trucks! (Chandlers eyes double in
size and he turns to Monica who doesn't understand what's happening. Then he
turns back to Joey, who says "you're welcome" without a sound)
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment. Phoebe just let David in who brought a bottle of
wine.]

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Wow, you look even... more beautiful than you did yesterday.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oof...

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: In fact, ehm... I going to kiss you now. (David holds
Phoebe and wants to kiss her.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, wait, wait!

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Yeah, I-I don't, I can't get away with stuff like that.
I-I-It sounded sexy in my head, so I...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, it's not that. (they go sit on the couch)
Uhm... Remember when you asked me if I was seeing someone and I said no? Well,
uhm... I am. His ... his name is Mike.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Oh... oh...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I should have told you.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: No... well, yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Well, i-it's okay. I-I-I understand... Well, s... well,
are you happy with this guy?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I am happy.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Damn it! I-I'm sorry. I-I don't mean that. I-I want
you to be happy... But only with me. No, uhm... that's not fair. Uh, who cares,
leave him!. Oh, I don't mean that. Yes I do... I'm sorry Uhm, I... I think I
should probably uhm... go...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well... but David, just... I just want you to know
that... that... you know... telling you this... is one of the hardest things
I've ever had to do.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Well... just so you know... hearing it wasn't exactly
a Vladnik carnival either... Can we at least hug goodbye?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course, yeah.(they hug and Phoebe sighs... a little
after that also David sighs and makes his way to the door) You know, a kiss
on the cheek wouldn't be totally inappropriate...

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: No... no...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I mean... (David kisses Phoebe on the cheek, makes
his way to the door and turns around again)

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: In Minsk...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: ...it's uhm... i-it's two on each cheek and uhm...
and one on the lips.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if that's what they do in Minsk... (They kiss
2 on each cheek... and then they pause... David turns to the door) In New York...
it's... (and then David grabs her by her neck and kisses her full on the lips...
They kiss passionately and cannot seem to stop.)
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's apartment. Rachel and Sandy sit on the couch. Sandy
holds Emma. Ross enters the apartment. Sandy and Rachel wipe their tears away
with handkerchiefs]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (in a tearful voice) Oh... Oh boy... (she turns around
and sees Ross) Hi...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (very worried) Is everything allright?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, it's fine, it's fine. Sandy was just... was
just telling me about how he proposed to his fiancée and it was just
sooo beautiful.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Well, her favourite flower is the camellia. From the
poem...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't... I can't hear it again.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: You know, I can't tell it again... (wipes his tears
again)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And I'm fine never having heard it... (Rachel looks
at Ross in a "why do you say that" manner) Rach, can I... can I see
you for a sec?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! (to Sandy) Excuse me... (She walks to the kitchen
with Ross and sighs)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you realise that man has cried in our apartment three
times...? Huh? I haven't cried that many times since I moved in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, Ross, he's just... Sandy is just sensitive,
that's all.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (picks up a cookie) Okay, okay, see... that... that
is the problem. He is too sensitive. (takes a bite from the cookie)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What...? Too sensitive to take care of our baby?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (speaking with his mouth full) Yeah, I mean, all things
that guy... (looks at the cookie) These are amazing!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sandy made Madeleines.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This... this is exactly what I'm talking about. What
kind of a guy makes... makes... delicate French cookies, huh? They're not even...
butch, manly cookies with... with... you know with... with chunks. (takes a
careful bite from the cookie)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I... you know, I-I-I don't know what to say...
I mean, I never thought of you as a guy who needed his men to be men.
You know, 'cause I gotta tell you Ross, it not like you just came in
from branding cattle.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey... there's sensitive... and there is too sensitive.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, what? What is too sensitive? (There's
music coming from the living room. Ross opens the door to the living room and
he and Rachel see Sandy play a song for Emma on his recorder. Rachel is moved
by this, but Ross only sees his point proven again, and walks back into the
kitchen, angrily. The door he was holding, swings back and hits Rachel.)
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment. She and David are still kissing each other in the
living room.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hmmm... No, no... No, I can't do this. It's bad.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: But... I-I-It's nice... A-a-and... nice is good. A-a-and
good is not bad, ergo, w-w-we should keep kissing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no. No.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: But... ergo...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look David, if... if you had never left, then... yeah,
we'd probably still be together right now, but... you did leave, and I-I'm with
Mike and I really care about him...

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Uhm... uhm... Goodbye... Uh... Schto ya ztez vigul...
ui... (David holds his hands gently on the back of Phoebe's neck. There's
a sound of a a bunch of keys rattling, and the door opens... It's Mike)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Well... hey, the key works...! (he looks as if he doesn't
want to believe what's happening)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (points to David) And you thanks for the
face massage. Thank you.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Monica is in the kitchen and Ross
enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did Rachel tell you we hired a male nanny?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah! I think that's great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh really? Did she tell you he plays the recorder, recites
poetry and bakes Madeleines?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh... How are they?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looks like in heaven) Lighter than air... (changes
back to serious) But that's not the point. (Joey now also enters)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey...! Rachel and I hired a male nanny.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looks surprised) Really...? Guys do that...? That's...
weird...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's like a woman wanting to be a...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...a what? A what? What's the end of that sentence?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes... What is the end of that sentence?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhm... A penis model. (Monica can't believe what's she's
hearing and Ross pats Joey on the back.) Anyway, hey... Did you tell Chandler
that some guy from work is the funniest guy you've ever met?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, so?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? Do you not know Chandler?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is that why he's acting so weird...? He's jealous...?
Oh my God, that is crazy. It's not like I'm attracted to Geoffrey...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what? Being funny is Chandler's thing...
You know, like Ross's thing is... (he can't come up with anything)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Science...? Academia...? Being a good father...?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ...No... (he just can't seem to grasp it)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe he's that upset about this...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica, you have to do some damage control here, okay.
'Cause he's feeling like... (the door opens and Chandler walks in with a pizza)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Heeeyy! Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you guys talking about?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhm... Rachel and I hired a male nanny. (Joey makes
a gesture and sound like "Can you believe that?")

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got a man who's a nanny...? You got a manny...?
(Monica starts laughing, but very exaggerated. Joey realises they also should
laugh and punches Ross. Now all three of them laugh, but very fake. Chandler
seems happy again.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, I don't mind a... male nanny, but I do
draw the line at a male wetnurse. (again they laugh, even more fake than before)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohhh, ooohhh... you are on a roll, mister!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If I'd known you guys were coming over, I would
have brought more pizza. (they all burst out in a thundering laugh)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, okay... Chandler you... you stop it! (Monica
wipes away tears)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is so funny about that? (they realise
it wasn't a joke)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I don't know... I-It's... just the way you say
it... I mean, you're funny... You have that funny thing. You're a funny guy!
(Chandler turns to Joey)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did you tell her what we talked about? (Joey starts
laughing hysterically, but then gets serious again...)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah....

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So those were pity laughs? PITY LAUGHS? (Joey and
Ross walk away from the kitchen)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, listen... You have nothing to worry about with
Geoffrey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah? Is he funnier than me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you're... you're different funny... I mean,
you're... you're more sarcastic a-a-and... well, he does... bits... and impressions...
and... and limericks...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I do limericks... uhm... There once was a man named
Chandler, whose wife made him die inside.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, you know I think you're hilarious! Come on,
you know that joke you told me last week? The one about Jerry Lewis and the
girl with the lazy eye...? (he laughs) That slayed me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey... I made up that joke and told it to you! (He points
at Chandler. Joey gestures to Ross "What are you doing?)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Not knowing when to shut up...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yep! That's my thing...
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Phoebe's apartment. David is still there. Mike closes the door.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: So... how many guys have your key?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no... It's not... it's not... i'ts
not as bad as it looks... really. I was just saying goodbye to an old friend.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Your lipstick's on his mouth.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Oh, uh... we just uh... happen to wear the same shade.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, uhm... David and I did use to go out... but years
ago, and he lives in Minsk. He's only... he's only in town for a couple of days.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Did you uhm...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: ...kiss him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, well, yeah...

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Yes, but uhm... You should know... she really likes
you. I-In fact I-I-I don't think you realise j-just how lucky you are fella.
(he points at Mike)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Don't point your finger at me.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Why? Wh-What are you going to do about it?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Well... I'll... just show you what I'm gonna do about
it... (he hits David's finger with his finger and they start to finger-fight
using their fingers as swords saying all kinds of macho crap)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Stop it! Stop it, before someone gets really hurt!
(they stop and Phoebe gets David's jacket and gives it to him) Here David, you
should just go.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Allright... But... if I ever do come back
from Minsk... (points at Mike) well, you just better watch out.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Well, if I ever goto Minsk, you'd
better watch out.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Oh, you're going to Minsk?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Well, I might.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Really? Well, if you do, come in the spring. It's just
lovely there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well... guys?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Right... Goodbye Phoebe. (Makes a move to kiss her.)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey, what are you kidding me?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Right-o, right-o... (to Mike) Take good care of her.
(and he leaves)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry. If you... If you want your
key back, I totally understand.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: It's never gonna happen again right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Right! Never! Never! I swear! (They kiss... The door
opens and David comes in again.)

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I-I... Oh I...I just wanna say uhm... if you do ever
come to Minsk, that's my number (gives Mike a business card) We'll uhm... we'll
party up Vladnik style. (He leaves again)
[Scene: Ross walks in the hallway to his apartment and stops in front of his
own door. Now he hears two recorders playing a song. When he enters, Sandy and
Joey are playing the recorder and Rachel listens.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Allright! Hey, hey Ross. Check it out! Sandy taught
me Hot-cross Buns.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? Sounded like Three Blind Mice.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Noooo... Three Blind Mice goes like this... (he puts
his fingers in position on the recorder)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looks angrily at Joey and points at him) I swear to
God...! (Joey is in shock)

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Who's up for puppets?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me! I'm up for puppets!

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Well, please welcome... The Snufflebumps... Who wants
to be mr. Wigglemunch and who's gonna be the Grumpus?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay... How exactly is a two month old supposed
to appreciate puppets?

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Actually studies have shown that the movement and colours
help their cerebral development... The whimsical characters are just for us.
(He winks to Joey and Rachel. Ross's face says he disapproves. Joey sees that
and kind of angrily says...)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I wanna be mr. Wigglemunch. (and makes a "there"
nod to Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shakes his head) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Well, I guess we know who's gonna be the Grumpus...
(Ross goes to the kitchen)
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's kitchen. Ross got a beer from the refrigerator and
opens the bottle. Rachel now also enters the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That was kind of rude!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Please apologise to Sandy and the Snufflebumps
for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know, he was just doing his job...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you know what... I-I'm sorry I'm the only one
who isn't in love with Gary Poppins out there... But I just... I can't... I
can't go through with this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, come on Ross...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Hey, you know what? I'm sorry. I would never force
you... to hire someone you were this uncomfortable with...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sighs) Oh... That's true.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, you're the one who wants to fire him, so you're
gonna have to do it. (Ross walks to the living room determined to fire Sandy)

scenes.location: Living room. Joey and Sandy are talking with the Snufflebumps.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: (In a puppet voice) So you see Wigglemunch, that's
why it's important to shaaaaaaare...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (kind of emotional) I am learning so much from you.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Monica and Joey are sitting at the
dinner table. Chandler comes from the bedroom with his suitcase.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I'm off to Tulsa, so if your Maitre D. friend
has any funny Oklahoma jokes, tell him to e-mail me at www.hahanotsomuch.com.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, you can relax. Last night at work, Geoffrey
told this really sexist joke. After that, not so funny anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really...? See... that's the thing: you gotta keep
it smart, people!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, don't miss that flight. You know I love you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I love you too. (Monica and Chandler kiss. He turns
to Joey.) And... I like you as a friend. (They hug and pat each other on the
back.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Allright. See you later!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See ya! (he leaves the apartment)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Monica) Did that guy really make that joke?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Naaaa... He still kills me. Last night he had me laughing
so hard, I swear... a little pee came out.
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's apartment. Sandy is knitting baby clothes. Ross and
Rachel walk into the living room.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here goes...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't watch. It's like firing Elmo. (Ross walks
to the couch where Sandy sits)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sandy... Hi, we uhm... we kinda need to talk. I'm afraid
it's not working out.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: (surprised) Oh...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, uhm... I mean, Rachel and I, think you are great...
with Emma... uhm... We just feel...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (from behind the bedroom door) YOU! You feel!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I... just feel that the... the chemistry isn't right.
I'm sorry. We're... we're more than happy to give you good recommendation...

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no... That's okay. I got a lot of offers
from other families. I just picked you guys because... I liked you the best.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (from bedroom) Oh, damn you Geller!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway, uhm...Well, I'm glad there's no hard feelings.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: No, none at all. You need to be happy with whoever
is in your home... Although if you don't mind telling me, what was your problem?
Maybe it's something I can work on in the future.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, you know, it's uhm... nothing you did, it's... it's
uhm... my issue.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: What is it...? (Ross hesitates) Please...? (he tilts
his head)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, I'm just not uhm... that comfortable with
a guy who's as sensitive as you.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: That's fair... Although, can I ask... why do you think
that is?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why... I... I don't know. (Sandy tilts his head again)
Uhm... errrr... maybe... maybe because of my father?

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: hmmm... (and shakes his head)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I mean, uhm... you know when I was growing up he was
kind of a tough guy... You know a-a-and as a kid I wasn't the athlete I am now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (from the bedroom) Huh ha ha!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I play squash...! Anyway, uhm... I uhm... I always get
the feeling he thought I was too sensitive.

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: That must have been hard.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It was hard... I remember... I was in my bedroom...
playing with my dinosaurs... playing and learning... and my father
walks in and says... he says... "What are you doing with those things?
What's wrong with you, why aren't you... why aren't you outside playing like
a... like a real boy?

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: But you are a real boy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know I am! (Ross now starts to cry) ...And when it's
summer, and it's hot, why can't you wear a tank top?

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: It's allright! Crying is good. It lets the boo-hoos
out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here come some more...
COMMERCIAL BREAK
[Scene: Joey's apartment. Joey and Sandy are sitting at the kitchen counter.
Joey is holding mr. Wigglemunch, and Sandy holds the Grumpus.]
Sandy/Grumpus: And what's the one kind of boat that can never,
ever sink?
Joey/Wigglemunch: What kind?
Sandy/Grumpus: A friend-ship...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! You blow my mind...

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Oh, I gotta go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aaahh... How much do I owe you?

lines.speaker: Sandy
lines.text: Twenty bucks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's like the cheapest college ever.
END

title: The One with Ross's Inappropriate Song

lines.text: [Scene: Ross and Rachel's apartment. Ross is playing with Emma on the couch
after just changing her diaper.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And that's why, no matter what mommy says, we really
were on a break. (baby talk) Yes we were! Yes we were! (picks Emma up) Come
here gorgeous. (puts her on his knees and talks to her) Oh! Look at you! You
are the cutest little baby ever! You're just a... a little bitty baby, you know
that? But you've got... (in a softer voice) You've got big beautiful eyes...
Yes you do... and a... and a big round belly. (emphasises the B's) Big baby
butt! I like big butts. (raps) I like big butts and I cannot lie / you other
brothers can't deny / when a girl walks in with an itty, bitty, waist / and
a round thing in your face you get...(Emma laughs) Oh my God, Emma... you're
laughing! Oh my God, you've never done that before, have you? You never done
that before... Daddy made you laugh, huh? Well, daddy and Sir Mix Alot... What?
What? You... you wanna hear some more? Uhm...(raps) My anaconda don't want
none / unless you got buns hon... (Emma laughs again and Ross looks worried)
I'm a terrible father!
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Central Perk. Joey sits at a table and Chandler and Monica enter.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey... hey listen... What do you guys know about investments?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How come?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I'm starting to make good money on the show and
I'm thinking... I should probably do something with it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you do with your money now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I just tape it to the back of my toilet tank.
(realises that anyone could have overheard that) I didn't say that! It's in
a bank guarded by robots!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Do you have any ideas?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, yeah... This guy at work got me excited about going
in on an emu farm. That'd be kinda cool huh? Pitchin' in on the weekends, helping
to plant the emus...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joe... Emus are birds. You raise them for meat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) Yeah! Right! (points at Monica) People eat
birds... Bird meat... Now do they just fly into your mouth or you go to... you
go to a restaurant and you say: "Excuse me, I'll have a bucket of fried
bird." (laughs again) Or... or maybe just a wing or... (realises...)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, I think you should consider something a little
less risky. I mean, I think in this market, real estate is your best investment.The
Fed. just lowered the rates and the interest on your mortgage is totally deductible.
(looks at Chandler) That's right, I know some stuff!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Real estate, huh? Hmmm...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (very excited) Oh, and you know who's selling a great
apartment? Richard!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (imitating Monica) Oh, and you know whose knowledge
of her ex-boyfriend is shocking? Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My dad told me. They play golf together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, well... Maybe I'll join them some time. I just
hope the club doesn't slip out of my hand and beat the moustache off his face.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Rachel and Monica are sitting at the
dinner table and Phoebe enters, knocking on the door.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Listen! You have to help me pick a dress 'cause I'm
meeting Mike's parents tonight! (Rachel gasps)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, the boyfriend's parents! That's a big step.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sarcastically) Really? That hadn't occurred to me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They just gonna love you, just be yourself.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They live on the upper east side on Park Avenue!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, she can't be herself.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, so... allright... Which dress? (she holds up
two 'Phoebe' dresses, Rachel and Monica look at them... taking their time, don't
wanting to hurt Phoebe) You can say "neither".

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: Oh God, neither!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry honey, but we're gonna take you shopping.
It's gonna be fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, totally! You are in such good hands. And I'm
so good with meeting parents. With the father, you know, you want to flirt a
little bit, but not in a gross way. Just kind of like: "Oh mr. Pincer,
I can see where Wallis gets his good looks..."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You went out with Wallis Pincer?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, he took the SAT's for me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I knew you didn't get a 1400!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ssshyeah, well, duh! I mean...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So... now... What about with Mike's mom?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, with the mother, just... just constantly tell
her how amazing her son is. Take it from me, moms love me. Ross's mom one time
actually said I'm like the daughter that she never had.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Monica looks at Rachel in disbelief) She said WHAT?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (speaking louder and articulating) That's she's like
the daughter she never had. (Phoebe points at her ears) Listen! (Monica looks
at Phoebe in a duh! way)

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel's apartment. Rachel enters the apartment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just finished getting Phoebe all dressed to meet
Mike's parents. She's so nervous, it's so sweet!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Guess what? I made Emma laugh today.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (in disbelief) You WHAT? And I missed it? Because
I was giving a makeover to that stupid hippie?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, and it was uhm... it was like a real little person
laugh too. It was... it was like uhm... (Ross tries to impersonate Emma's laugh,
but it comes out very squeaky, very high pitched. He laughs about himself but
then looks at Rachel, realises that it sounded weird and straightens his face.)
Only... only not creepy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well... well, what did you do to make her laugh? (excited)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I uhm... Well, I sang... (Rachel gasps) well actually
I rapped... Baby Got Back... (Rachel's face changes from excited to angry)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You WHAT? You sang... to our baby daughter... a song
about a guy who likes to have sex with women with giant asses?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But you know what, if you think about it, it actually
promotes a healthy uhm... body image... because... even big butts or uhm...
juicy doubles.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (disgusted) owwwww...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please don't take her away from me!
[Scene: Richard's apartment. There's a knock on the door.The listing agent
opens the door for Chandler and Joey.]

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.text: Oh hi, come on in. I'm Catherine, the listing agent.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi I'm Joey. This is Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So how come Richard's selling the place? Went bankrupt?
Medical malpractice? Choked on his own moustache?

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.text: Actually, he is buying a much bigger place. It's
got a great view of Central Pa.....

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: mmm That's enough about you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is there anything we should know about the apartment?

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.text: All the appliances are included. There is a lot
of light, a new kitchen... I think you guys would be very happy here... (Joey
and Chandler both realise what she's assuming and start laughing.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no, NO! No, no... we're not together.
We're not a couple. We're definately not a couple.

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.text: Oh... Okay, sorry!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, you seem pretty insulted by that. What? I'm not
good enough for you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We're not gonna have this conversation again...
Look at this place. Why am I so intimidated by this guy? Pretentious art, this
huge macho couch. When we know all he does is sit around all day crying about
losing Monica to a real man! (laughs) You don't think he's here, do you? (Joey
looks around)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know what it is? It's a nice place but I gotta see
I don't know if I see myself living here. Oh, oh, oh, let me see... (Joey sits
down on the couch, mimes opening a can and puts his hand down his pants) Yeah,
I could see it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Chandler looks around the place and his eye gets
caught by Richard's video collection) Look at these videos. You know, I mean,
who does he think he is? Magnum Force, Dirty Harry, Cool Hand Luke... Oh my
God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There's a tape here with Monica's name on it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh! A tape with a girls name on it. It's probably a
sex tape... (realises) Wait a minute... This says Monica... (looks around) And
this is Richard's apartment... (realises some more)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Get there faster! (Joey gasps and finally understands...)
[Scene: Mike's parents building. Phoebe gets out of the classy elevator, looking
all dressed up like an older woman, and very un-Phoebe. She walks to the door
and rings the doorbell.]

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Wow! You look like... like my mom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm wearing pantyhose!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Great! Come on in! (Mike kisses her on the cheek. A
butler walks in and takes Phoebe's coat.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, thank you! Oh... Oh my God, you're RICH!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No, my parents are rich.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, so... They gotta die someday. (Mike's parents
walk in) HELLO!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Mom, dad, this is Phoebe. Phoebe, these are my parents:
Theodore and Bitsy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (in a very posh accent) Theodore... Bitsy... What
a delight!

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: It's so nice to finally meet you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And you... Your home is lovely.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: Well thank you, I'll give you a tour later. It's actually
three floors.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Holy crap!

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: Phoebe, why don't you come in the living room and meet
our friends?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, try and stop me!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey... Wh... What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (no accent) I'm trying to get your parents to like
me.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah, I'm sure they will, but you don't have to do this...
I'm wanting them to get to know Phoebe, not (accent) Phoebe...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (accent) Got it! It... It's hard to stop...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Well, come on...

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.text: Phoebe, these are our friends, Tom and Sue Angle.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: Phoebe, come sit. Tell us a little bit about yourself...
So where are you from?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (no accent) Uhm... Okay, well, allright, uhm... Originally
I'm from upstate, but uhm... then my mom killed herself and my stepdad went
to prison, so... I just moved to the city where uhm... I actually lived in a
burned out Buick LeSabre for a while... (frowns are received) which was okay,
that was okay, until uhm... I got hepatitis, you know, 'cause this pimp spit
in my mouth and... but I... I got over it and uhm... anyway, now I'm uhm...
a freelance massage therapist, uhm... which, you know, isn't always steady money
but at least I don't pay taxes, huh... (everyone in the room finds it a bit
surreal, which Phoebe realises and starts to talk in the accent again) So...
where does everyone summer?
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Mike's parents house again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God! God! This is not going well.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No, no, no, you're doing fine, really... Why don't you
go talk to my dad?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay, okay... Still sure about me being
myself?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Absolutely! Or maybe just a little less pimp spit.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So Theodore... I uhm... I can see where Mike gets
his good looks from...

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.text: Oh... Well...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah... And that physique! You must work out all the
time...

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.text: Oh no, not all the time... I do the best I can...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah I bet! Look out! (Phoebe punches Theodore right
in the stomach)

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.text: OH! OWWWWW! (Theodore grabs his stomach in agony)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.text: I recently had surgery.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm so sorry!

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.text: No, I'll be fine... I just should check the stitches...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I really, really am sorry.

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.text: How could you know. Why wouldn't you punch me in
the stomach? (Theodore walks out... Mike walks towards Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Uhm... Did you just hit my dad?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes... I'm sorry, I've never met a boyfriends parents
before...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: But, I mean, you have met... humans before, right? Look,
why don't you go talk to my mom?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah okay... yeah, your mom... okay... She looks nice,
I can talk to her.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah, you do that, and I go check my dad for signs of
internal bleeding. (Mike walks away and Bitsy walks in the same direction.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah... Oh Bitsy, hi. Uhm... listen I just wanted
to thank you again for having me here tonight.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: Well, not at all...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Also uhm... I just want you to know what a wonderful
man your son is.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: Thank you, I think so too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, and you know, it really is a testament to how
he was raised. Especially to you. Because he's very respectful of women.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: Is he really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you kidding. He is so considerate of my feelings
and... you know I think... you'd also like to know that he is a very gentle
lover.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: E-e-excuse me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Mike now enters and stands behind Phoebe) Oh no,
no, no, no, no, no. Don't get me wrong. No, he's not in like a sissy way. No,
no, no... when he gets going, he can rattle a headboard like a sailor on leave...

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: That's... my boy. (Bitsy walks away)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Awesome!
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Only Chandler is there with the videotape
in his hands, standing in front of the TV set.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not gonna watch it... I don't NEED to watch
it... I mean, what good could possibly come from watching? (sighs) Well, we
know I'm gonna watch it. (Chandler moves to put the tape in the VCR and Joey
enters the apartment)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey dude, what's up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don't judge me, I'm only human!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Did you take that tape?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I had to! Okay, imagine you were married... and
you found a tape of your wife in another guys' apartment... Wouldn't you need
to know what was on it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know. Who'm I'm married to?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Some girl...!?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She hot?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah...!?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How did she get me to settle down?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Allright, I'm gonna watch it... I mean look, it's
probably not even what I think it is... And even if it is... It can't possibly
be as bad as what I'm picturing in my head... (laughs nervously) Can it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Guess I don't know. My experience: if a girl says yes
to being taped... She doesn't say no to much else, I tell ya...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then you're gonna have to watch it for me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (backs off) What? Whoo... What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Just for a few seconds, so I can know what it is...
Please?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, fine... But if I enjoy this, you have only
yourself to blame... (Chandler turns his back to the TV. Joey puts the tape
in the VCR, switches it on and watches what's on the tape... It's clearly a
american football match, with the referee's whistle blowing, the crowds cheering...)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why am I hearing cheering?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well it's okay, its like... its just a football game.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Football? Just football?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, see... you were all worried for nothing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's football... It's just football... This is great!
This is the first time I've ever enjoyed football... It may be customary to
get a beer... (Chandler walks to the fridge, his back turned to the TV and a
moaning sound replaces the cheering of the crowd... Joey's eyes double in size...)
What the... (Chandler turns around, but Joey already took a sprint for Chandler,
jumps, and floors Chandler in the open space in front of the apartment door...)
What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You don't wanna see what I just saw! (at this moment
Monica comes home, and sees Chandler flat on his back on the floor and Joey
pinning him down)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you guys doing? (Monica hears the moaning
coming from the TV and looks at it) Oh my God, is that Richard? (It only takes
a split second for Joey to realise, he pulls Monica down by her jacket, and
she falls, face down next to Chandler. Chandler gets up a bit, and Joey quickly
covers Chandler's eyes with his hand.)
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's apartment. Emma is sitting in her chair on the apothecary
table and Rachel is trying to make her laugh.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay... aahhh... Please laugh for mommy... Please?
Please laugh for mommy... (Rachel makes a funny face, sticking her tongue out,
making a farting noise and using her hands as antlers, wiggling her fingers...
No response from Emma...) Not funny huh? Oh so, is it... only offensive novelty
rap? Or maybe just, you know, rap in general? 'Cause mommy can rap... (Rachel
tries to rap and makes weird movements with her arms in the process.) My
name is mommy and I'm here to say / that all the babies are... Oh, I can't
rap... Allright sweetheart... This is only because I love you so much, and I
know that you're not gonna tell anybody... (Rachel's face is telling "Oh
what am I doing? The things I have to go through... and she starts to rap) I
like... big butts and I cannot lie... / You other brothers can't deny... / when
a girl walks in with an itty bitty waist and a round thing in your face... (Emma
starts to laugh) Yes! Yes! Yes! YES! Oohhhhh! Oh! (Rachel now really gets into
it, and her insecure movements start getting better) I like big butts and
I cannot lie... / You other brothers can't deny... Oh Emma you're laughing!
Oh you are, you really do like big butts, don't you. Oh you beautiful little
weirdo... (Rachel picks up Emma and Ross now enters)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh you missed it. She was laughing. Oh it was amazing.
It was amazing. It was the most beautiful, beautiful sound that...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh I know, isn't it? Ooh... what'd you do to get her
to laugh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! You know, I just... couple of things I tried ...
I just sang a little doo... Itsy Bitsy Spider...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You sang Baby Got Back didn't you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing else worked. That girl is all about the ass...
[Scene: Mike's parents house, the dining room. Mike, Phoebe, Mike's parents
and the Angles are there.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ...and then it goes back to the chorus... Smelly
cat, Sme-lly ca-t / I-t's not your fau-lt. And that's the end of the song...
I realise that you didn't ask to hear it, but uhm... no-one had spoken in seventeen
minutes.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Phoebe writes lots of great songs. Wha... What was that
one you sang the other night that everybody just loved?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Pervert Parade?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (sighs) No...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Ode To A Pubic Hair?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Stop! (The butler serves dinner)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh God! Is that veal?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Mom, I thought I told you... Phoebe's a vegetarian.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, no, no, no... That's okay, that's okay... I
mean, I'm... I am a vegetarian... except for veal... Yeah no, veal I love...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Phoebe you don't have to eat...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, no, I actually it's any baby animals: kittens,
fish babies... You know... especially veal... and this, this nice vein of fat
running through it... (she cuts the meat, picks it up with her fork and holds
it in front of her mouth, which she keeps closed, trying to overcome her vegetarian
thoughts... and... puts it in her mouth... Clearly not enjoying the meat...)
Hmmm... yummy (everybody seems okay with it, except Mike. He's making a hmmmm....
face... Then Phoebe swallows it) Hmmm... (at first she likes it, but then, in
an instant puts her hand in front of her mouth and runs from the table. You
hear a door slamming.)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: So...? What do you think? (looks at his parents, which
look in disgust)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's. Monica switches off the VCR. Joey and Chandler
are behind the couch.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you stole that tape from Richard's apartment?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoho ho... Listen to the judgement from the porn
star!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That tape was never meant to be seen by... (pauses)
Joey I would feel more comfortable if I was having this conversation in private.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughs) Monica, look... I don't think you and I have
any secrets anymore... (Monica keeps looking at Joey) Not ready to joke about
it yet, okay, I see you later. (Joey walks out)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why in the world would you take this tape and and
why would you watch it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because that's who I am, okay? I'm sure a mature
man like Richard could see a tape like that and it wouldn't bother him. Just'd
be another saucy anecdote for him to share at his men's club over brandy and
moustaches.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is all this about you not being able to grow a moustache?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is about you and Richard. He's clearly not
over you. He keeps a tape so he can... look at it whenever he wants.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Isn't that sad? I mean, can you see how pathetic that
is? You shouldn't be jealous. You should feel bad for him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah, well, poor Richard. Y'... I can grow a
moustache!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, this is not our problem. We've got each
other. That's all that matters.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, oh, but I just keep picturing you rolling
around with him with your cowboy boots in the air...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Cowboy boots? I've never worn cowboy boots in my whole
life! (she turns on the video again)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, good, good. Play more, 'cause I wanna see how
it ends.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: THAT'S NOT ME!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What...? That's not you! Life is good again! Ride
'em cowgirl!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That bastard taped over me! (Chandler's expression
changes)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is that a problem?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I-It's just so insulting! Big spring for a new blank
tape, Doctor!
[Scene: Mike's parents house. Dining room again. Both Mike and Phoebe are not
at the table, but the others still are.]

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.text: I can't imagine what he sees in her.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: She actually makes me miss that pill-popping ex-wife
of his. (Mike walks in) Oh, hello dear...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey, what's going on?

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: We were just chit-chatting. How's your friend?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: A little better.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: By the way, do you know who's moving back into town?
Tom and Sue's daughter Jen.

lines.speaker: Theodore
lines.text: You remember her Michael, she's lovely and... well
behaved and... single.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I'm not interested.

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: Oh, please darling, let's be honest. You can have all
the... sailor fun you want with that one, but... let's be real...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: All right, stop! You know, all Phoebe has done tonight
is trying to get you to like her. And maybe that hasn't been clear all the time,
but she did her best. And yeah... She's a little different than you are...

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: Michael, a pimp spit in her mouth! (Phoebe almost enters
the room, but she hears the discussion and waits and evesdrops next to the door-opening.)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: So what? I mean if even I can get past that, it shouldn't
bother you. And you don't have to like her. You just have to accept
the fact that I do. I mean, if you even can't be civil to the woman I love...

lines.speaker: Bitsy
lines.text: The woman you what? (Phoebe overheard what Michael
said and now enters the room)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah... The woman you what?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: The woman I love... (he walks to Phoebe) I love you...
Which is probably something I shouldn't say for the first time in front of my
parents... and Tom and Sue...Who are by the way the most sinfully boring I've
ever met in my life...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I love you too...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: YEAH...! How great is this...? (they kiss)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Wanna get out of here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Mom, dad, thanks for dinner.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I had a great time. (accent) It was really top drawer.

lines.speaker: And here's something rich
lines.text: thirteen bathrooms in this place... I threw up in
the coat closet... Ta taaa...
COMMERCIAL BREAK
[Scene: Ross and Rachel's. Emma is in her bed and Ross and Rachel are rapping
and dancing for her.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She sweat, wet. got it going like a turbo 'vette.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So fellas

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: fellas

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: has your girlfriend got the butt?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hell yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So shake it! (Rachel slaps Ross's butt on
the beat)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shake it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shake it! (Phoebe, Mike, Chandler, Monica
and Joey step in)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shake it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shake that nasty butt...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Baby got back (Then Ross turns around and sees
their friends standing in the doorway)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: One more time from the top... I like big butts
and I cannot lie, you other br... (She also turns and sees the gang)

END

title: The One with Rachel's Other Sister

lines.text: 908 - The One With Rachel's Other Sister
908 - The One With Rachel's Other Sister

scenes.location: Monica and Chandlers apartment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Hon, could you help me get the plates down?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Hey, here's an idea, why don't we use our
wedding china today?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I think we should save our china for something
really special. Like if the Queen of England comes over.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, she keeps canceling on us, take the hint.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What if something gets broken, they're so expensive.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What is the point of having them if we never use
them?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, but if something gets broken, and then the Queen
comes over..

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I will explain it to her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: <laughs> Oh yeah, like I'm going to let you
talk to the queen.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: wow, the parade is really good this year. Man those
horses can crap.

lines.speaker: TV announcer
lines.text: Next up is a marching band from Muskogee, OK.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Muskogee! That's like four hours from Tulsa. Woo
hoo!

lines.speaker: TV announcer
lines.text: And heres the float with the stars of the popular daytime soap
Days of Our Lives .
<Joey's eyes become large and he stands up>

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aren't you one of the stars of the popular daytime
soap Days of Our Lives?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! I totally forgot I'm supposed to be there. I
can't believe I forgot. I usually write stuff like this on my arm.
<Chandler grabs Joey's left arm and pushes the sleeve up>
<Joey looks>
Oh! Stupid long sleeves.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you going to do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I guess I'm going to have to come up with a really
good reason why I wasn't there. The producers are going to be so mad at me.
They sat us all down yesterday and said "Everyone has to be there at 6:00
AM sharp, that means you Tribbiani." Like.. like I was some kind of idiot.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well you proved them wrong.

lines.speaker: Joey nods
lines.text: Yeah.
<Chandler nods and his eyes get big like he's saying 'what the hell'>
Opening Credits
Ross and Rachels Apartment
<Ross and Rachel are putting baby stuff together like they're going to
be going somewhere.>

lines.speaker: Rachel to Emma
lines.text: Oh Emma. This is going to be your first Thanksgiving. What
are you thankful for? Mommy's bobbies.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A lot of people are thankful for those.
< knock on door>

lines.speaker: Woman at door
lines.text: Hello? Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Woman at door
lines.text: It's your favorite sister.

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel while looking at each other surprised and shocked
lines.text: Jill?

lines.speaker: Woman at door in a sing song voice
lines.text: Amy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hide my rings.
<Ross goes into Rachel's room>

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. <opens door preparing herself and then happily
says>
Amy! Happy Thanksgiving.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Do you have a hair straightener?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um... hi.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: oh... hi.. <goes to Rachel with open arms>

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw.
<Amy grabs her arms>

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hair Straightener?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I haven't seen you in like.. a year.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh, I know, I know. I've just been crazed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh well yeah me too. Um.. I had a baby.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I decorated Dad's office.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.. yeah? Well unless you pushed a desk out of your
vagina, <shakes head no> not the same thing.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Listen, um about the hair straightener, honey.. I really
need one. I'm going to have dinner at my boyfriend's house.
<Amy bending over fiddling with her purse when Emma cries and she hears
Emma>

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: mh hmm..

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Is this Emmett? <pointing to EMMA>

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh.... its Emma.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Its a girl?
<Ross comes out of the bedrooms>

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Amy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Amy, you remember Ross.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Not really. But you are much cuter then that geeky guy
she used to date.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That was me.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: No, he was this creepy guy from high school who had
this huge crush on her since like the ninth grade.

lines.speaker: Ross with a look of wondering how long this is going to go on on his face

lines.text: Still me.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: No, I'm not talking about you. <to Rachel> It
was your fat
friends brother with that bad afro, do you remember?

lines.speaker: Ross starts talking over her 'do you remember' line
lines.text: Amy. I'm going to save
you some time, ok. <spins finger around in circle> All me.
Monica and Chandler's Apartment.
<Joey is walking around looking worried. >

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Careful. <hands Chandler a china plate> Careful.
CAREFUL!
<Chandler is startled and nearly drops the plates.> Sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'll tell you what, for the rest of our lives,
I'll be careful until told otherwise. <looks at china> hey wait a minute
this isn't the china we picked out..

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, after you left the store, I chose different
ones.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: well no offense honey, but your taste is a little
feminine for me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh suddenly, flowers are feminine?
< Phoebe comes in>

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, everybody. Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey happy Thanksgiving.. Pheebs! <motions her to
come over>

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, what's going on Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I.. I.. I need a good lie.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh okay. How about the whole "man walking on
the moon" thing. You know? You. you could. You could see the strings people!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no I need a good lie to explain why I wasn't
at a work thing today.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, honey. You stink at lying.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I do not.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh really. Okay. let me ask you something. Yesterday
at the coffee house, I went to the bathroom and when I came back, my muffin
was gone-who took it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Somebody opened the door to the coffee house and a
raccoon came running in, went straight for your muffin and I said "Hey
don't eat that-that's Phoebe's" and he said.. <pause> He said.. "Joey
you stink at lying." What am I going to do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don't worry, don't worry. We'll come up with a good
lie. I'll help you practice it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh great, that'd be great. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure, what.. what was the work thing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh.. <forgetting what the work thing was, rolls
up his sleeve on his right arm and shows Phoebe, she looks>

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: "Pick up grandma at the airport"?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh.. man..
Ross and Rachel's Apartment.

lines.speaker: Amy with straight hair
lines.text: Oh she's precious. Do you ever worry she's going to
get your real nose?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Amy! <pause> Yes I do.. I really do. <grabs
Ross' hand for support>
<Amy's cell phone rings>

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hello? Yeah, um. Hang on one sec. <to Ross and Rachel> Can
I take this upstairs?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, we don't live there but...

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Seriously? Its.. its just these rooms? <moves hands
around motioning 'just these rooms'> <To Ross> I thought you were
a doctor.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, no. Ross has a PhD.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Ew. <walks into Rachel's room, I'm guessing>

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God she is unbelievable.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, I mean a PhD is just as good as an MD.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh sure Ross, yeah. If I have a heart attack in a
restaurant, I want you there with your fossil brush.

lines.speaker: Amy storms out
lines.text: Stupid Thanksgiving.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What happened?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: My boyfriend canceled on me. I mean.. I I finally find
a real relationship. I mean, someone that I can spend this day with and then
his wife comes back into town. I swear, its almost not worth dating married
guys.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don't say that.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh. I was so looking forward to this. It was going to
be such a beautiful Thanksgiving. We were going to have sushi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Amy, don't cry Amy. Um.. Ross, could I talk
to you in private?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, you want to go upstairs?
<Ross and Rachel go in the kitchen>

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um look I was thinking.. If its ok with Monica I
would like to invite Amy to Thanksgiving.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, I think thats a great idea. It'll be like
the pilgrims bringing the Indians syphilis.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look I know she's a little tough to take. She has
no where else to go, and she's my sister. Alright, she's Emma's aunt. And I
would like them to bond.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, fine, but I don't want them bonding to much. I
don't want her telling Emma she needs a nose job.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, you know what? She may need one..We're just
going to have to make our peace with that!
<Rachel grabs Ross' hand for support and starts to cry a little>
Monica and Chandler's apartment

lines.speaker: Rachel opens their door
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Everyone there says
lines.text: Hi, hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey you guys, this is my sister Amy. This is
Chandler, Joey, Phoebe and you know Mon.

lines.speaker: Everyone
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh my god. You're on Days of Our Lives.

lines.speaker: Joey laughs
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: wow. They must put a lot of makeup on you.

lines.speaker: Joey looks rejected
lines.text: Hap.. Hap.. Happy Thanksgiving.
<Joey turns away and Chandler reassuringly pats him on the back>

lines.speaker: Ross to Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica to Ross
lines.text: Hi.
<they hug and kiss on check>

lines.speaker: Monica to Emma
lines.text: Hey you.

lines.speaker: Monica to Amy
lines.text: So. Welcome. Is this your first time you're
seeing Emma?

lines.speaker: Amy with confused look on face
lines.text: Yeah I.. I think so. <sticks her hand out
to shake hands with Phoebe and says to her> It's nice to meet you Emma.

lines.speaker: Phoebe shakes her hand and says
lines.text: Phoe-Be.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh. That's a funny noise.
<Monica and Amy turn away and walk into the living room towards the secret
closet>

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pheebs, I still need some help here

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh right, ok um. Ok so its not just the lie you tell.
but its the way you tell it. . For example if you look down at the ground when
you're talking, people know you're lying.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh.. I don't know why this is so hard for me. you know..
I mean lying is basically just acting and I am a terrfic actor.

lines.speaker: Phoebe looks down
lines.text: You are a terrific actor.
<Joey realizes what she's doing>

lines.speaker: Amy coming out of the bathroom
lines.text: Hey. Hey where's the baby?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh we just put her down for a nap.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh I was just thinking. You know what would be incredible?
If you guys died.

lines.speaker: Ross first has a look of 'huh' then changes it to sarcastic happy
lines.text: Thank you
Amy.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: no, no, then I would get the baby. I mean you know it
would be just like a movie. Like at first I wouldn't know what to do with her,
then I would rise to the occasion and and then I would get a makeover and then
I'd get married.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thats a great movie. <she claps>
<Joey nods in agreement>

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Now listen, not that you guys could stop me or anything
cause you know you'd be dead. I was thinking about changing her name. I'm just
not really a big fan of Emily. [Transcriber note: I'm surprised that Rachel
and Ross didn't say they weren't either here]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emma.

lines.speaker: Amy turns around to Phoebe
lines.text: Emma, Ross wants you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: PHOE-BE.

lines.speaker: Amy turns to Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Why does she keep making that
noise?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, I don't know how to tell you this, but um,
if something were to happen to Ross or to myself <Ross and Rachel knock
on wood> um you wouldn't get the baby.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Well who would?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well we haven't offically asked them yet, but we would
want Monica and Chandler.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe you'd want us to raise Emma.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: yeah oh my god, I'm so moved.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I don't believe this, hold on a second. You guys die
and I don't get your baby?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: See look Amy, we're a lot closer to Monica and Chandler.
We see them every day. And truthfully honey, you don't seem very connected
to the baby.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Connected? I mean.. to what? She's.. she's a lump.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, guys I got to say. This means so much
to me. That you would trust me with your child. I mean, we all know that Monica
and I have been trying to have a baby of our own. You know I've had my doubts
about my skills as a father, but that you two.. that you two.... <starts
to cry>

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: <points to Chandler> This guy? Seriously?
Later in the day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay! It's time for dinner. Everyone we're using
our fancy china.. um and its very expensive so please be careful.

lines.speaker: Ross starts playing with a plate
lines.text: Woah. Woah... <nearly really drops the
plate and more seriously> Woah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, just to be clear comedy with the plates will
not be well recieved. <pinches Ross' arm>
Ross makes some sort of sound to let us know it hurt.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! How come my plate's less fancy then everyone else's?
Do you not trust me with a fancy plate?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, honey, its. thats a special plate. See
its a game, whoever gets that plate wins.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't believe I won.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Its such a slap in the face. I'm your sister and you
would give your baby to these strangers over me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica is Ross' sister.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: No, Ross' sister was really fat.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was me.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: No, she was this really dorky girl in high school that
used to follow Rachel around like a puppy dog.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey. Amy. You've got to stop doing that.
<Amy gets pissed and starts cutting food on the fancy plate very harshly,
you can hear the silveware scraping the fancy plate>

lines.speaker: Monica about to have a heart attack
lines.text: Okay, listen I know you're having a little
bit of a family crisis, but you don't have to take it out on the plates. I
mean, I mean in fact I think that everyone should cut their food like this.
<Monica holds a turkey leg up in the air over the plate trying to cut meat
off with a knife>

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now see, this way you protect the plate.. and lets
face it you have fun.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Okay, how about this, you guys die and the crazy plate
lady dies, then do I get the baby?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, if crazy plate lad.. <sees Monica frustrated
at this comment> If Monica dies then I would get Emma, Right?
<Ross and Rachel pause and ponder this>

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well actually...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: well.. its just. its just in that case, then um. Emma
would go to my parents.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hurts, doesn't it?
<Chandler gives a look that says "Yeah!">

lines.speaker: Joey raises his hand
lines.text: Uh.. who has to die for me to get her?
<Everyone is looking around and at Joey with looks of 'what?' on their
faces>
Commercial Break.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So if Monica's not around, then I'm not good enough
to raise Emma?

lines.speaker: Ross looks down
lines.text: No, that that is not what we're saying.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah he's lying. He looked down.
<Joey looks to Phoebe and she nods in agreement>

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well what is wrong with me? Am I .. am I incomptent?
Because I managed to survive whatever it is that killed the three of you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Honey, you're taking this the wrong way. We think
you're going to be a wonderful parent. It's just.. you're more the fun parent.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah and we'd want to make sure Emma has someone like
Monica who is more uh. uh discliplinarin.. someone who can be firm and strict.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thats not how you see me, is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe while cutting a sweet potatoe in the air
lines.text: No you're all about the fun.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I may not know a lot about babies, but do
you really think I'm not capable?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, you both are equally capable. Its just.. you're
strongest when.. when you're together.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok. So if we both had Emma and I die <knocks
on table> she'd have to give her up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, Monica would have to give her up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I lie better then that, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So.. let me get this straight. So my two friends
die, I get Emma. Then my wife dies, then Emma the one tiny ray of hope left
in my life gets taken away from me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There's your movie! <claps>
Later on.
Monica opens her front door. Chandler is sitting in the hallway.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey. There you are. You disappeared after dinner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh? Did somebody miss me? Is there a child to raise
poorly?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross and Rachel don't know what they're talking about.
I mean its not like their so responsible. Emma is a product of a bottle of
Merlot and a five year old condom.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah but they're right. I mean, I'm not a strong
father figure and I never will be.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No you learn these things. You grow into it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, but its not who I am. Everything they said
was exaclty why I was worried about having a kid. And its true. And look everybody
knows it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know it! I want to have a kid with you because
I think you're going to be an amazing dad... at the fun parts and the hard
parts.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, well can you picture me saying "Go
to your room! You're grounded"?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can you hear me say "You're grounded"?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You said that to me last week.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How hard is it? No shoes on the furniture.
Back to Monica and Chandler's apartment.
Amy is sitting on a chair by the bay window looking mad.

lines.speaker: Joey groans and gets off the phone
lines.text: The producer from Days left a message
on my machine asking why I wasn't at the parade. They said everybody's pissed
off at me.. <whiny voice> And they all got to meet Santa!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's ok. I thought of the perfect lie for you. It's
easy to remember and doesn't invite a lot of questions. You weren't at the
parade because you had a family emergency.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I like that, yeah. Wasn't at the parade because
I had a family emergency.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, what happened?

lines.speaker: Joey all nervous and looking down and fiddling with his ear
lines.text: Oh.. My sister's
raccoon.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! Nothing with a raccoon.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Arg... Alright, I'll take care of it. <throws hands
out in the air>
Monica and Chandler come through the front door.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh wait.. What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Setting the table.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah we thought it would be nice to use the fancy
china for dessert too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh how nice. Maybe later we can all go blow our noses
on my wedding dress.
Ross comes out of the guest bedroom with the diaper bag and the car seat carrying
thingy.. yeah.. thats the techinal term.. He goes to Chandler.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey dude, you okay? Sorry about before.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no thats okay, you're totally right. I don't
know anything about disciplining a child. But it did hurt my feelings and I
want you to know that when I die, you don't get Joey.
Ross walks away with a face of yeah ok.

lines.speaker: Amy walks over to the couch and sits down next to Rachel
lines.text: Ucch. <pauses> Uchh <louder
this time> In case you hadn't noticed, I'm not talking to you.

lines.speaker: Rachel

lines.text: ooh oooh..

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh my God.� I can't believe you live in that building.� My grandmother

lines.text: So, we're on our way to a couple of parties.� Um. . . maybe we can get

lines.text: Yeah. . . I'm sorry.� We weren't really looking for anything to happen

lines.text: (pause) I'm sorry, no.

lines.speaker: BILL
lines.text: Okay. (They start to walk away.)

lines.text: Oh sure.� (She pulls a business card from her purse and writes on it.)

lines.text: (Reading the card.) Oh my God, you're giving your real number.

lines.speaker: BILL

lines.text: No.� No, because I know exactly how the conversation's gonna go.� "Hey

lines.text: (as Ross) "Yeah."� (Clears throat twice.) "Me neither." (Clears throat

lines.text: Yeah, I see what you mean.� By the way, nice Ross imitation.

lines.text: Oh, thanks.

lines.text: But, your Rachel wasn't whiny enough.

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: (whining) Wha. . . hey!

lines.text: (pointing) Better!

lines.text: Well, the point is, maybe I should just stop waiting around for moments

lines.text: Really?� You're moving on from Ross?

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: I don't know.� Do I have to decide right now?

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: Well, you kind of just did.� That guy is going to call you tonight.�

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh God, Ross.� Ross is going to pick up the phone.� Oh, I have to get

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: (imitating Rachel) "Oh, I have to get my number back.� Oh my God.�

lines.speaker: RACHEL
lines.text: Oh give me , , ,� (Phoebe gives Rachel the phone.)� Hi, Mike?� Hi.�

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: All right. (She takes the phone from Rachel.)� Hello?� Hi.� I'm sorry

lines.text: All right.� I'll do it.� (Phoebe gives the thumbs-up sign to Rachel.)�

lines.speaker: PHOEBE
lines.text: (knowingly chuckles) Oh, Mike.� Bye.

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: Hey buddy.

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: Uh, hi.

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: Um, can I come back in?

lines.text: (putting his arm up with his hand on the door frame.)� Why?� (He starts

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: (Entering the apartment) I, I was just thinking about how much more we

lines.speaker: ROSS
lines.text: (whining) But you left.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Wow!� That didn't take long.� I thought you said Tulsa was, like a three

lines.speaker: CHANDLER

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: (gasp) Chandler!� You're home!

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: That's right.� You're husband's home.� So, now the sex can stop.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: (sniffing the air and then Monica.)� Why do I smell men's cologne?

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: (sniffing Joey) I think that's you.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: (sniffs his shirt.)� Oh yeah.� I rubbed a magazine on myself earlier.

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: There's nobody here Joe.

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: I guess not.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: I can't believe you thought I was cheating.� (pointing at Joey) You

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Yeah, right Monica.� I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: (suddenly starts issuing him out) Ah, it's an honest mistake.� It could

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: (spots the suitcase just inside the door where Chandler left it) Whoa,

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: (thinks, then turns to Monica) I climb down the fire escape and you

scenes.location: Ross and Rachel's apartment.� Mike is reading from a book.

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: So, except for the fermentation process, beer and ale are basically the

lines.text: Maybe you should look up "fascinating."
(Phone rings.)

lines.text: I'll get it.� (He lunges across Ross's lap on the sofa to reach the phone.�

lines.text: (takes the phone, but speaks to Mike) I don't understand what just happened

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment " continuing action.

lines.text: Joey?

lines.text: (pause) Yeah, you could go to the game with me, ah, even though I know

lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: MONICA

lines.text: Yeah, I'll be fine.� You know, maybe I'll stay here and practice the

lines.speaker: MONICA
lines.text: It's gonna be so hot!� (She kisses him.)
