lines.speaker: JOEY
lines.text: Thanks.� (Joey and Chandler exit to the hall.� Joey pulls out the tickets

lines.speaker: CHANDLER
lines.text: Hey, listen.� I'm never going to lie to you again, okay?� And I want

title: The One with Christmas in Tulsa

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's Apartment, everyone's there; Phoebe recites the last verse of a poem to Joey. This poem is known as "The Night Before Christmas" by Clement Clarke Moore, but it seems that it's rather "Account of a visit from St. Nicholas" by Henry Livingston.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ...sprang to his sleigh, to his team gave a whistle;
and away they all flew like the down of a thistle;
but I heard him exclaim, ere he drove out of sight,
"Merry Christmas to all, and to all a goodnight!"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (impressed) Wow, that was great! You really wrote that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (smiling) Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (coming from the bedroom) Say goodbye elves, I'm off to Tulsa.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe you're not gonna be here for Christmas.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're really not coming back?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, we have all this paperwork that needs to be filed by the end of the year. If I don't get it done, I'll be fired.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's so unfair, you don't even like your job!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, who does?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I like my job.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I *love* my job.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I can't *wait* to go back to work.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't get *enough* dinosaurs!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry, I won't be here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's just... It's hard enough not seeing you during the week, but for Christmas... alright, if this is what you have to do, I understand.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks. (they kiss) I'll see you New Year's Day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shocked) You're not gonna be here New Year's Eve??

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did I not mention that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (thinks for a second, then waves his arms, exclaiming:) AND TO ALL A GOOD NIGHT! (and runs out of the apartment)
*Opening Credits*

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right everybody, I know that it's Christmas Eve and you'd rather be with your families, but there's *no* call (he takes it off) for writing "Screw you, Mr. Bing!" on the back of my chair! (he looks at it) -- By the way, you can all call me Chandler.

lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: Hey.

lines.text: Hey. Where've you been?

lines.text: I was, uh, checking out that insurance company's Christmas party on three, oh, it was really beautiful, they have all these decorations and this huge tree and I just, uh... to hell with them, we have to work. -- So I stole ther ham. lines.speaker: Claudia
lines.text: My kid's in a play right now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know what, I know what will cheer you guys up! (he starts spreading envelopes among them) I had a little talk with the boys in New York, told 'em about all the hard work you've been doing and that a little Christmas bonus may be in order.

lines.text: Well, that's like money in your pocket! - Alright look, you want me to say it? This sucks. Being here sucks! This work sucks!

lines.text: Wiper blades. I don't even have a car.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: OK, Pheebs, your turn.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ahh, toilet seat covers! Is that what you were doing while I was getting gas?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guuuyys.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And for Ross, Mr. Sweet-tooth.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You got me a cola drink?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And, a lemon lime.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well this, this is too much, I feel like I should get you another sweater.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And last but not least.
(Chandler and Joey give Monica a pack of condoms.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: They're ribbed for *your* pleasure.
[Flashback to 710 - TOW The Holiday Armadillo]

scenes.location: Monica, Chandler and Phoebe's, Ross is costumed as an Armadillo.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ooh, hey Ben, what if the Holiday Armadillo told you all about the Festival of Lights?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Cool!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on Ben.
(Monica and Ben sit down on the couch.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Years and years ago there were these people called the Maccabees...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering in a Santa costume) Ho, ho, ho! Merry Christmas!

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Santa! (Runs to Chandler and hugs him)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! (Grunts as Ben hits him at full speed.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you doing here, Santa?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I'm here to see my old buddy Ben. What are you doing here, weird...turtle-man?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm the Holiday Armadillo, your part-Jewish friend. You sent me here to give Ben some presents. Remember?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay Ben, why don't you come open some more presents, and Santa, the Armadillo and I have a little talk in the kitchen? There's a sentence I'd never thought I'd say.
(They walk to the kitchen; everyone is lowering their voices)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Chandler) What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You called everyone and said you were having trouble finding a Santa costume, so I borrowed one from a guy at work!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you, but, but you, you gotta leave.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because, I'm finally getting him excited about Hanukkah, and, and you're-you're wrecking it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But I didn't get to shake my belly like a bowl full of jelly.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm sorry Chandler, but this, this is really important to me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine, I'll give the suit back.
(Ross turns around and walks back to Ben.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Chandler) Hey, you think, you can keep it another night? (She has a really teasing look on her face and keeps twirling Chandler's beard.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Santa? Really?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, is that okay?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did your Dad ever dress up like Santa?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then it's okaaay! (They kiss.)

scenes.location: Back in the conference room in Tulsa.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know what, everybody? Go home. You should be with your families. It's bad enough that we're working New Year's Eve.
(All others are looking up, surprised)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did I not tell *anyone* about New Year's Eve? -- Alright, look, go! Go home, okay? Merry Christmas! Go.
(All are leaving, wishing each other a Merry Christmas, peace on earth, etc. Only Wendy stays.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Good, God's speed, good people! (he starts to close the door, turns around and sees Wendy) You're not gonna go?

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: Naah... I couldn't leave you alone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: Besides, I can't leave until their Christmas party downstairs clears out; there are some *pissed off* insurance people looking for that ham.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah. (The phone rings; he answers it) Chandler Bing.

[Scene change back an forth: Monica and Chandler's Apartment, Monica's on the other end of the line. The phone's speaker is turned on, so the rest of the gang, sitting around the phone, can hear Chandler.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi Honey! We're all here; we just want to wish you a Merry Christmas.

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: (simultaneously) Merry Christmas! (except for Phoebe...)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (simultaneous to the others) Ble-blah-blar Blargh!
(All the others look at her, stunned/incredulous)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ahh, Merry Christmas; I miss you guys!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So is it horrible? Is everybody working really hard?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, well no, it's just uh, me and Wendy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wendy? -- That sounds like a girl's name.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It is. Did I... not tell you about her?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Umhmm, umhmm, about the time you told me about New Year's Eve. Where is everybody else?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I sent them home.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh, you are such a good boss! Is she pretty?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhh, uh...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in a low voice) Answer faster, answer faster!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in the same low voice) Answer better, answer better!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't think of her that way, you know, she's a, she's a colleague.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What does she do there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, she's regional Vice President; She's... just below me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She did WHAT?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: BE-LOW me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ahh, wait, is Wendy the runner-up Miss Oklahoma?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: *What*??

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, she... she didn't win...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, well, maybe I should let you and the second prettiest girl in Oklahoma get back to work.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, second prettiest that year; I mean, of *all* the girls in Oklahoma, she's probably...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (interrupting him) Oh Chandler, stop talking!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, there's really nothing to worry about.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm serious!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Merry Christmas.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Merry Christmas.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Merry Christmas, you guys!

lines.speaker: Others
lines.text: (simultaneously) Yeah, Merry... Christmas. (again, Phoebe...)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (simultaneous to the others) Blah blargah, blar-blab.
(Again the others just look at her, silent, puzzled.)

scenes.location: back in the conference room in Tulsa

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (hanging up the phone) The wife says "Hi!".

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: Ah. Fun conversation?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah well, she's got this weird idea, that, uh, y'know, just because you and I are alone, that something is gonna happen.

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: Huh? Really? -- Hm, that'd be so terrible? (She gets hold of Chandler's tie, slowly moving her hands upwards on the tie, getting closer and closer to him, seductive.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is probably the wrong thing to be worrying about, but... you're getting ham on my only tie.
(She's getting closer to him, the scene fades to black.)

scenes.location: The conference room in Tulsa again, Chandler is trying to evade Wendy

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whoa-ho, back off, Missy! (He takes a step back, but she still keeps her grip on his tie.)

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: (laughs) ...Missy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know; I'm not used to girls making passes at me! ... (She lets go of his tie) Wait a minute... am I sexy in Oklahoma?

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: You are to me... (She gets closer again, putting her arms around his torso.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (flattered) No,... no... (realizing) NO! (He quickly gets several steps away from her.) Look, I'm, I'm married!

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: So? I'm married. (Showing him the ring on her finger.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm *happily* married.

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: Oh. - What's *that* like?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right. So, I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: Seriously? Happily married. So that phone call before, that was ... happy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well look, it's not easy to spend this much time apart, you know. She's entitled to be a little paranoid... or, in this case: right on money! ... You know, she's amazing, and beautiful, and smart, and if she were here right now, ...she'd kick your ass. Look, you're a really nice person... ham stealing and adultery aside. But, what I have with my wife is pretty great, so nothing is ever gonna happen between us.

lines.speaker: Wendy
lines.text: Okay, let me ask you something: if what you and your wife have is so great, then why are you spending Christmas with me?
(Chandler starts to think about it...)
[Flashback to 716 - TOW The Truth About London]

scenes.location: London, Chandler's hotel room. He was getting ready for bed when Monica pays him a visit and they started talking

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I mean, you were the most beautiful woman in the room tonight!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You kidding? You're the most beautiful woman in most rooms... (She jumps up and kisses him.) (Breaking the kiss.) Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! What's going on? You and I just made out! You and I are making out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, not anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But we don't do that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, I just thought it would be fun.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How drunk are you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Drunk enough that I know I wanna do this. Not so drunk that you should feel guilty about taking advantage.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (thinks) That's the perfect amount!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!
(They run to the bed, sit down, and start making out again.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (breaking the kiss) Y'know what's weird?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This doesn't feel weird!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're a really good kisser.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I have kissed over four women. (They kiss again.) Do you wanna get under the covers?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hm-hmm!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!
(They do so and they take off their clothes.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! You are really fast!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It bodes well for me that speed impresses you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're gonna see each other naked.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you wanna do it at the same time?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Count of three?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: One!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Two!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Two!

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: Three! (They lift up the covers and check each other out, then come back up with silly grins on their faces.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well I think it's safe to say that our friendship is effectively ruined.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Eh, we weren't that close anyway!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eh! (They start making out again)
[Flashback to 503 - TOW The Triplets]

scenes.location: A hallway in the hospital, Monica and Chandler are talking.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, are you really gonna go out with that nurse man?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well uh, you and I are just goofing around, I thought, why not just goof around with him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I don't know if you've ever looked up the term goofing around in the dictionary... Well, I have, and the technical definition is, two friends who care a lot about each other and have amazing sex and just wanna spend more time together. But if you have this new fangled dictionary that gets you made at me, then we have to, y'know, get you my original dictionary. I am *so* bad at this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think you're better than you think you are.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? Okay, so...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (interrupting) Know when to stop.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Y'know, I sensed that I should stop. So we're okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. (They kiss and as she starts to leave, Chandler starts to dance. Without turning around:) Don't do the dance.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right!
[Flashback to 524 - TOI Vegas, Part II]

scenes.location: The Gift Shop, Monica and Chandler are entering.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't get married until I get something old, something new, something borrowed, and something blue.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, all right, all right, all right! Okay! (Picks up a blue sweater.) Okay, here's something, here's something blue and new.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're so efficient. I love you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let's go! (Starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No-no-no, wait! We need something old!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, okay, I have condom in my wallet that I've had since I was twelve.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That'll work!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, now we just need something borrowed!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks around) Here just...take this. (Hands her the sweater.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's stealing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, we'll-we'll bring it back! Just put it under your dress.
(She does so and it makes her look pregnant.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh. (Rubs her fake stomach.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, one thing at a time. (They run out to get married.)
[Flashback to 702 - TOW Rachel's Book]

scenes.location: Monica, Chandler, and Phoebe's, Chandler is looking at the wedding book as Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Listen umm, I've been thinking, it's not fair for me to ask you to spend all of your money on our wedding. I mean, you work, you work really hard for that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ehh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Eh, you work for that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I thought about it too, and I'm sorry. I think we should spend all of the money on the wedding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You do?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I'm putting my foot down. Yeah look, when I proposed I told you that I would do anything to make you happy, and if having the perfect wedding makes you happy, then, then that's what we're gonna do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you're so sweet. (They hug and kiss.) Oh, but wait, what about our, what about the future and stuff?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Eh, forget about the future and stuff! So we only have two kids, y'know? We'll pick our favorite and that one will get to go to college.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You thought about that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How many kids were we gonna have?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, four, a boy, twin girls and another boy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What else did you think about?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, stuff like where we'd live, y'know? Like a small place outside the city, where our kids could learn to ride their bikes and stuff. Y'know, we could have a cat that had a bell on its collar and we could hear it every time it ran through the little kitty door. Of course, we'd have an apartment over the garage where Joey could grow old.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs) Y'know what? I-I don't want a big, fancy wedding.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure you do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I want everything that you just said. I want a marriage.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You sure?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I love you so much.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you. (They kiss.)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's Apartment, everyone except Chandler is there; they're opening their presents

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (opens her present from Ross; it's a dark-red scarf) Oohh, I love it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? You're not gonna return it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, not this second!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (at the window) Hey look, you guys, it's snowing!
(The others all get up and go to the window.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh wow, it's so beautiful...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, it really is!
(They all stand a moment in silence, staring out of the window.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: "Wendy" is a fat girl name.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Aren't we done with that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, fine. Let's talk about snow. -- Do you think it's snowing in Tulsa, where my husband is having sex on a copying machine?
(Shortly after that, Chandler enters.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!
(Surprised, uttering Ahhs and Ohhs, the others are coming over to him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my god...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-heeyyy - Look at that, it's a Christmas miracle!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I wanted to be with you. I missed you so much.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, hey, uh, who did you miss the most?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Got ya. (blinks an eye)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I never want to leave you again!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But I thought if you left, you get fired.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Turns out they can't fire me. Because I quit.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, you, you really quit your job?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! It's a stupid job, and I could not stand leaving you. And why should I be the only one who doesn't get to do what he *really* wants to do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What do you really want to do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (realizing) I have *not* thought this through!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, I, I should have talked to you first about it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I think that this is what you wanna do, I think it's great!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Chandler, your being here is the best Christmas present I could have ever imagined.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (flattered) Ahh...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now give me my real gift.
(Chandler hands Phoebe an envelope, and some more to Monica)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Chandler) Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Monica) Here, pass these, will ya.. (points to the others)
(Monica passes the Envelopes on to Ross, Joey and Rachel.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, hey...
(They all open their envelopes.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (reading off his card) "A donation has been made in your name to the New York City Ballet." -- How did you know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wha... are you kidding? I can't return this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I... thought it was a timely start to thinking about other people. Besides, this gift still says I love you guys.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mine's is to Lilian Myers.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't have a *job*!
*Closing Credits*

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's Apartment, Monica is cleaning up, Chandler is sitting on the couch, checking the Job offers in a Newspaper.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actuary... no. Book-keeper... no. Topless dancer... (he looks down on himself, checking, then nods satisfied and marks the offer with a pen) (to Monica:) Hey, d'you know what I just realized? You are the sole wage earner. *You* are the head of the household. I don't do anything - I'm a kept man!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You are! (she picks up a bill from the table, handing it to Chandler) Hey, here's twenty bucks. -- Why don't you go buy yourself something pretty while I'm at work tomorrow?
(Chandler looks at the bill, thinking... then looks at the offer in the Newspaper and makes some dancing moves to see if he's up for the job...)

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good morning, Tiger! I'm making you a nice big breakfast so you can keep up your strength for tonight.
You're gonna get me good and pregnant.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I've got nowhere to go this morning. I'm unemployed! I don't know what I'm gonna do with my life.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I just lost my erection.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I mean, what am I supposed to do with myself?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're supposed to find your passion in life. You can be whatever you wanna be now. It's exciting.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But it's all so overwhelming. I don't know where to start.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, wait a second. I can help you with this. You just need to be organized. We can make a list of your qualifications,
and categorize jobs by industry. There could be folders and files!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! This is where your hyper-organized-pain-in-the-ass stuff pays off!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know!!! My erection is back!
[Opening credits]

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Gunther who comes over with coffee and a muffin) Thank you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, can I have a sip of your coffee and a bite of your muffin?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.
Phoebe Thank you. (Pours his coffee in a thermos and puts his muffin in her purse.) Thank you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: : Pheebs, have you ever been bitten by a hungry Italian?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry, it's just, I'm a little short on cash.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If you want I could loan you some money?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, no, no. I learned never to borrow money from friends. No, that's why Richard Dreyfuss and I don't speak anymore.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey, how about this? Wanna be an extra on my show?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You could do that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. The pay is pretty good and you could do it for as long as you need.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my god, I'm gonna be on TV!

lines.speaker: Joey

lines.speaker: Phoebe

lines.speaker: Joey

(Rachel and Ross enter with Emma)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi guys.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: (Adlib hellos)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow! Hey, why are you all dressed up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel and I are bringing Emma to Ralph Lauren today to introduce her to everyone. Doesn't she look cute?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She sure does. Why does she have a pink bow taped to her head?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, because if one more person says "what a cute little boy" I'm gonna whip them with a car antenna!

lines.speaker: Ross

Can I get a blue bow?

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Flipping through bunch of folders as Chandler enters from bathroom) Okay, I have looked through a bunch of career guides,
photocopied and highlighted key passages and put them into alphabetical folders so you can make an informed decision.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How long was I in there?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Let us start with the A's. Advertising.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait. Advertising! That's a great idea!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't you want to look through the rest?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't think I have to hear the rest. Advertising makes perfect sense. Sorry you had to waste all this time, though.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You call eight hours alone with my label maker wasted time? Ooh, now I get to use my shredder!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I mean, I can write slogans. I mean, how hard can it be, right? "Cheese. It's milk that you chew." "Crackers. Because your
cheese needs a buddy." "A grape. Because who can get a water melon in your mouth?"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I got one. "Socks. Because your family's feet deserve the best."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey? Leave it to the pros.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I actually know someone in advertising. I grew up with this guy who is a vice president at a big agency.
Maybe I can get him to meet you? Give me the phone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: "The phone. Bringing you closer to people...who have phones."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: "Marriage. It's not for everybody."

scenes.location: Ralph Lauren

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That went well. Almost everybody knew that she was a girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, after you punched that one guy who got it wrong, word spread.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm just gonna go in my office and pick up some stuff . (To the guy behind her desk) Who the hell are you!?

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: Who the hell are you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm the hell person whose office this is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good one, Rach.

lines.speaker: Guy
lines.text: I'm Gavin Mitchell, the person who's taken over your job.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me?

scenes.location: DOOL set

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, look at me! I'm a nurse!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes you are. I think it may be time for my sponge bath. Sorry, I'm just so used to hitting on the extras.
So, are you excited about your scene?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! But I'm a little shaky and nervous.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, relax. Don't be. You'll be fine, you'll be fine. They'll probably just make you stand in the back.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay! (To Phoebe) You. Here, come here, here. You're gonna take this tray, you're gonna stay on this yellow mark.
You're gonna move on "action!" You're gonna walk over to the operating table. You're gonna stop on that blue mark, you're gonna put
the tray down. Don't walk too fast! But don't doddle.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, now. What?

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: And...Action!!
(Phoebe starts walking toward the operating table. Her hands are shaking like crazy, causing the tray to rattle.)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Cut! Cut!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I'm just a little nervous.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Well, don't be.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, that helps.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: And...Action!
(Phoebe starts walking towards the table again. She's even more shaky than before and almost drops the tray.)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Cut!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you know what? Don't worry, Pheebs! It usually takes me three takes too! (Off the director's look) Alright, eight.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: And...Action!

(Ok, here we go again. Phoebe starts walking toward the operating table, but stops every time the tray starts to rattle. She eventually drops it on the floor, but finishes the scene anyway by putting the now non-existent tray on the table.)

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: So, do you have any other question about advertising?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no. But let me show you what I can do. "Bagels and donuts. Round food for every mood."

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Monica warned me you might do that. I actually think we might have something for you at the agency.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? That's great!

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: It's an unpaid internship.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's funny. When you said "unpaid" it sounded like you said "unpaid."

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Come on now. Monica has a good job. And it's not like you have a family to support.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually, we're trying, and I don't think Monica's gonna wanna postpone it. We're supposed to have sex tonight.
Actually, she's probably at home naked right now. I tend to keep talking until somebody stops me. I can just picture her on the bed right now.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Stop!

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Okay.

scenes.location: Ralph Lauren

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait a minute! What do you mean, you're taking over my job?

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Well, while you were on your baby vacation I was doing your job.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A vacation? My idea of a vacation does not involve something sucking on my nipples until they are raw.

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Clearly you've never been to Sandles Paradise Island.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright! Don't get too comfortable there, because I'm back in two weeks! And I want everything back to the way it was.
I can't say that I care too much for the way you've rearranged my office.

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: I can't say I care too much for that smell you've brought in with you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach we have a code brown situation.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can you please, please take care of it for me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, but you have to do one sometime.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Let me just get this straight! So I go have a baby and they send some guy in to do my job?

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Well, there was talk of shutting down Ralph Lauren all together.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's right. You're very cheeky for a temp.

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: I'm not a temp. I was transferred here from another department.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, what department was that? The Jerk department?

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Oh, they didn't tell me about your quick wit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did they mention that I'm rubber and you're glue?

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: (Enters) Gavin, Ralph loved your ideas.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi Mr. Zelner.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Rachel, I see you've met Gavin. I must say, when you left us we weren't sure what we were gonna do. But then,
Gavin to the rescue. Super Gavin!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's great. So now, Super Gavin, when I come back where are you planning on flying off to?

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Well, that's up to Mr. Zelner. I'm sure he will make the right decision.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To herself) Oh, wow. Super ass-kissing power.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Incidentally, when are you coming back?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Today.

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: You said two weeks.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I said today! See, for a superhero, not so much with the listening.

scenes.location: DOOL set

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey. So, what did he say?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, he can be a little rough around the edges, so I'm gonna replace a word he used a lot, with the word "puppy."
Okay, so he said: "If your puppy friend doesn't get her puppy act together, I'm gonna fire her mother-puppy ass."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry, I can't do this. I'm not an actor.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's right, you're not. You're a nurse. You're Nurse With Tray.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no. Nurse With Tray doesn't know Joey, she doesn't have time for friends. She gets in that operating room and she
carries that tray to the doctor, because if she doesn't, people die!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who dies?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Points to man on operating table) Man With Eye Patch! You get in there and you do your job.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, doctor.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Okay, let's try this one more time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hang in there, Man With Eye Patch, your tray is coming!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: And...Action!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Does the scene) Yes, I did it!!! I nailed it!!! Yay! What's next?

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: The rest of the scene.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, from the top, people!

scenes.location: Ralph Lauren

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Listen. Sudden change of plans. My maternity leave just ended. They told me that if I didn't come back today,
they were gonna fire me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? No, that's illegal. I'm gonna have the labor department down her so fast they won't even...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, alright. Calm down Norma Rae. They didn't actually say that. I'm just afraid if I don't come back right now
this guy's gonna try to squeeze me out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What about Emma? We don't have a nanny.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. You know, we're just gonna have to figure out a plan tonight. Can you please just take care of her for today?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Absolutely. Just give me your breast and we'll be on our way.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on, I don't know what else to do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, fine. (To Emma) We'll have fun, won't we? Yes, we will, yes we will. (Gives her a kiss, and the pink bow tapes itself to his head.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You're pretty.

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Whatever I decide to do, I'm gonna be starting a career from scratch. It's gonna be a while before I make a living at it.
Maybe now is not the right time to be starting a family.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So you have to tell Monica you don't want to have a baby right now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Hugs Chandler) Good-bye.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Enters) Okay, it's baby time. Pants off Bing. (Sees Ross) Didn't see you there Geller.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, Ross is here so...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, and I was really hoping that I could hang out. What do you feel like doing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're gonna have sex.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't feel like having sex. Maybe we can watch a movie or something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let me put it this way. We're having sex whether you're here or not.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pants off Bing!

scenes.location: Ralph Lauren

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright. Now that I'm back, why don't you just fill me in on what you've been up to?

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Well, I've changed your screensaver from that picture of *Nsync.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, they were popular when I left!

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Also, I've just been working on this big presentation for tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I should be involved in that, so why don't you get me up to speed?

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: That's gonna take weeks. Why don't just let me take care of the presentation?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no no no no. I see what you're doing here, alright, listen, this is my job buddy. Okay, I've had it for five years,
and I know how it works, so why don't you just catch me up!

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Sits down in her chair) Oh god. You've totally messed with the back support of my chair. How do you fix this?

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Hey, you've been here five years, you figure it out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Fine, I will. (Pushes that button thing on the chair that makes it "collapse") Alright, fill me in!

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You have a blue tie that would go with this? Emma spit up on mine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah. But you have to give it back if I get a job. Of course, by that time in the future ties will be obsolete
and we'll all be wearing silver jump suits.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Enters from the bedroom) Hi, good morning lover. I gotta say after last night, I'm a little weak in the knees.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here's an idea. You walk into a room...take a quick scan!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Ross) Sorry. (To Chandler) But I kind of have this feeling that we may have made a baby last night.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh god, I have to tell you something. You're not pregnant.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That thing that I have to do to make a baby. I faked it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What!? You faked it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what? I don't need a tie. I mean, it's better, open collar. You know, it's more casual (He leaves.)

scenes.location: DOOL set

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, listen. I can't do this, it doesn't make any sense. Yesterday I was a nurse, and today I'm a waitress at a cafe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, sometimes we use the same extras for different parts. It's okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it's not okay, because I gave a very memorable performance as the nurse. And now suddenly I'm the waitress?
That's gonna confuse my fans.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe you are a nurse, but you moonlight as a waitress.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uhuh. Because I'm a single mother, supporting my two children.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait a minute. Dr. Drake Ramoray and I work at the same hospital. Wouldn't I come over to say hi to him?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no. See, you and Drake are having a fight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He slept with you and then never called you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And I just wanted a new daddy for Davy and Becky.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Okay, okay, from the top. And...Action!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: So, I'm surprised you agreed to have lunch with me.
Joey/Drake: I'm surprised to, but yet here I am.
(Phoebe walks by and slaps him.)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Cut, cut! What are you doing!?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, well, I'm very angry at him, because he slept with me and never called me back.

lines.speaker: Extra
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: Another extra
lines.text: Me too!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, calm down! She means on the show! We need some new extras around here!

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: (Enters) Wow, you're here already.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes. Emma and I came in a little early to do research on the presentation. I actually made a few changes, but
I think I'm caught up on everything. So ask me anything!

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: How do you fix the chair?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Except that! (Mr. Zelner enters) Oh, hello, Mr. Zelner. We're all ready for our presentation this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Good, because it's in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? I can't do that! I have the baby, and Ross is not gonna pick her up for another hour.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zelner
lines.text: Well, then Gavin can give the presentation, okay, we have to do it now. Ralph needs to leave early today. He's going
helicopter shopping.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, there you go. You win, you win. You get to do the presentation, you'll knock 'em dead,
no one will ever remember that I worked here, and then Ralph will buy his helicopter, and Super Gavin will just fly right along side of him!

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: You can do the presentation.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I can't, I have a baby.

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: I'll watch her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why would you do that?

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: Because you've worked really hard, and it's your job, and you're a little crazy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's really nice.

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: I should tell you that crying women make me very uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Then you're not gonna like what's coming. (Starts crying) I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry. Thank you, thank you.

lines.speaker: Gavin
lines.text: I'm really fine, don't worry, I'm great with children. (To Emma) Gavin Mitchell. Pleased to meet you.

scenes.location: DOOL set

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Please don't fire my friend. Just let me talk to her.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Okay, okay. But this is her last chance.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you, thank you. How about I do something for you? Tomorrow, I'll bring you a hat, cover up the bald?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, listen Pheebs. I was just talking to the director, and he was thinking, maybe this time you don't hit Drake,
you just wait on the tables?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can't do that. I'm an actor. I have a process.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're a masseuse. You have a table with a hole in it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait a minute, I see what's happening here. You're threatened.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I'm so good in this scene that I'm stealing focus
from you. Well, rise to the challenge Tribianni 'cause I just raised the bar. Come join me up here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To the director) Yeah, you can fire her, but I would call security, she won't go easy.

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You faked it? You couldn't have faked it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes you can. You just make the faces and the noises.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Guys can fake it? Unbelievable. The one thing that's ours! Besides, why would you fake it when we're trying to have a baby?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's actually why. Look, I'm starting a whole new career now, and I'm not saying that I don't want to have a baby,
I'm just saying maybe we could wait a little while.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Like a month?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Or a year?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really, you want to wait a year?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It could be less than a year. I mean, you've heard my stuff. "Pants. Like shorts, but longer." (Pause)
It'll probably be more than a year.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I really wanna have a baby.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, me too. Look, I'll just get my old job back.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I want you to have a job that you love. Not statistical analysis and data reconfiguration.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I quit and you learn what I do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's just, I think, there's never gonna be a right time to have a baby.
I mean, now you're unemployed and in a little while you'll find a new job that'll keep you really busy.
There's always gonna be a reason not to do this, but I think once the baby comes, forget about all those reasons.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I guess. It's always gonna be scary when we have a baby.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's gonna be really scary. I mean, god. When we have a baby, there's gonna be so much that we're not able to control.
I mean, the apartment's gonna be a mess, I won't have time to clean it. What if the baby gets into the ribbon drawer?
Messes up all the ribbons?! What if there's no room for a ribbon drawer, because the baby's stuff takes up all the space!?
Where will all the ribbons go!?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Should we go make a baby right now before you change your mind?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, please!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, and I promise, I will not fake it this time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wish I could say the same. I'm a little shook up!
[Closing credits]

lines.text: Oh my God, I cannot believe this. You know I actually came in
here hoping to have a mature conversation with you
About us! But I can�t do
that with someone who hides my messages and brings crazy women back to my
apartment!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: None of the sane ones wanted to come back with me! That�s not the
point. Ok? The point is you...you are the one
Who moved on and didn�t tell
anyone!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Ross, this is just so messed up! What�s wrong with us? You
know when people hear about our situation they
Always ask, �what, you live
together but you�re not a couple? And you have a baby, isn�t that weird?� And I
say �No.
You know what, it�s not, because it works for us!� But you know this
doesn�t work. In fact this is the opposite of working!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, clearly.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you know, we said that we would, we would live together as
long as this makes sense. An maybe this, you know,
Just doesn�t make sense
anymore.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, maybe not. So what you wanna do?

scenes.location: Joey's

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi. Can Emma and I live here for a while?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ha, oh, of course.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Your eyebrows look weird.
[Ending Credits]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: �Jeremiah was a bullfrog. Was a good friend of mine, never
understood a single word he said, but I helped him
drink his wine.� So you
just touch yourself for anything?
END

title: The One with the Blind Dates

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment. Rachel is in the kitchen
as Joey enters from his bedroom.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Morning, roomie!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! You remembered to put clothes on this morning.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fifth day's a charm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Joey, it's so great to be back here. I gotta tell you, you're
making it so easy on me and Emma.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, it's great having you back. You know, stay as long as you want,
and when does she stop crying all night?
(Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, you're not naked! So hey, Rach, when will we expect to see you
tonight?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I'll probably be back to pick her up around six, but she's
in the bedroom all ready to go. But she did actually fall back to sleep,
so...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She's probably exhausted from all that adorable screaming she did
last night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye!
(She leaves.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bye! Hey, I hope Emma isn't making it too hard on you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, hey, it's been great.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. And look, I just want you to know that with Rachel staying
here and everything, all my feelings from before are totally over, okay?
And even if they weren't, when you accidentally walk in on a woman using
a breast pump...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, that'll do it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow! So, how are you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm, I'm okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, I mean, do I wish me and Rachel living together would have
worked out? Of course. You know, I'm disappointed, but it's not like it's
a divorce.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, actually it...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it's not a divorce, it is not a divorce! Anyway, I think Rachel
and I need to, you know, get on with our lives, maybe, maybe start seeing
other people.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow, really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, sure, why not? In fact, if you know anyone that would be good
for me...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, I know lots of girls.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Any names come to mind?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, names?
Opening credits.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment. Joey is there as Phoebe
enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey. I was just gonna get something to eat. You want something?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What you got?
Joey (checks the refrigerator): Okay, let's see, we got strained peas,
strained carrots... Ooh! Strained plums. We haven't tried that yet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Goodie! Thanks. So, how is it living with Rachel again? I mean, apart
from the great food.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm fine, I'm fine, it's just, it's just weird what's happening with
her and Ross. You know, yesterday he asked me to fix him up with somebody.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my god, Rachel asked me if I knew anyone for her too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why are they doing this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't know. They're so perfect for each other; it's crazy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know what's crazy? These jars. What is it, like two bites in
here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just wish they'd realise they should be together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, I know. And when they moved back in together, I figured y'know,
that's where things were headed.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. They should be a family. They should get married and have
more children.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes, and they should name one of their kids Joey. I may not have
kids; someone's gotta carry on the family name.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know what? Maybe once they start dating, and they see what's
out there, they'll realise how good they are for each other.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, because it is slim pickings. I had this date last night: Yuck!
But we should probably keep it down; she's still in the bedroom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, what are we gonna do? Are we just gonna go ahead and set them
up with people?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know; that just pushes them further and further apart.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. (BEAT) Oh, I know what we can do. We could set Ross and Rachel
up on horrible dates, so that they'll realise how good they are together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, that's a great plan!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you know what the best part of it is? I get to do my "plan-laugh." (A
maniacal laugh follows.)
(They both start laughing really loudly.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shhh! Not so loud, we don't wanna wake up, uh...
(He looks at his bedroom door, but he can't remember the
name of the girl.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. They're in the
kitchen as Rachel enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys aren't doing anything tonight, are you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See, now, why would you assume that? Just because we're married?
I will have you know that we are very hip, happening people. Now, if you'll
excuse me, I have to get back to reading the obituaries.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I was just asking 'cause I need someone to watch Emma tonight.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure, we'll do that. What are you up to?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Phoebe set me up on a date.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why? What's the big deal?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just figured, 'cause you and Ross are...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What, slept together a year and a half ago? Yeah, I'm all set.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I think it's great that you're going on a date, you know? I
mean, it sounds healthy. I mean, you have needs. Embrace your womanhood!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You want a job? Turn off "Oprah," and send out a resume!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So I'll bring her by around seven? Is that okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, it's perfect.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you guys are gonna have so much fun! She's at such a cute age.
Oh, a couple things. Now that she's eating solid food, she poops around
the clock. And watch out for your hair, 'cause she likes to grab it. And
oh, she's also in this phase where if you leave the room, she screams bloody
murder, but ah... Thanks, you guys. Have fun!
Chandler (reading the newspaper): Suddenly I wish I was reading my own name.
[Scene: Central Perk. Joey is drinking coffee by the counter
as Phoebe enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey. I'm so excited; I just set up Rachel with the worst guy tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right! Who is he?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it's this guy I used to massage. And by massage, I mean hold
down so he wouldn't turn over and flash me.
Joey (gives a thumbs up sign): Okay, okay. Wait till you hear who I got
for Ross.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah.
(They sit down on the couch.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She's this really boring woman. She's a teacher!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A teacher?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, she's really into history and foreign movies... And oh,
oh, she loves puzzles. Huh? Come on, who loves puzzles?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, Ross does. What... You're - you're ruining the plan! Joey,
you've - you've fixed him up with his perfect woman!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my god, you're right!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: She even reads for pleasure!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How do you even know a woman like that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? I'm not allowed to know smart women?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I met her at the library. I went in to pee.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So now what do we do?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, okay, I'll - I'll just call her and tell her the date's cancelled,
and find him somebody else.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What if we don't find him somebody else? We'll just tell her the
date's off, but we don't tell Ross, and he goes to the restaurant and gets
stood up!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh...I hear that's bad.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, so this is great! Rachel's gonna have a terrible date, Ross
gets stood up, and then they'll realise how good they have it together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, yes, The Plan! (Laughs loudly again, but he sounds more like
Santa Claus.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's not Santa's plan. No, it's... (Laughs the real "plan-laugh.")
(They both start laughing again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you know, it's not that fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I think we killed it.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Emma is there
in her playpen, while Chandler is behind the couch.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Emma? Emma? Look at me! Well, I think I'll go downstairs for a while.
(He does the ancient trick of going downstairs while behind
the couch. As soon as he's out of sight, Emma starts crying.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no, no! No, no, no, no! It's okay, it's okay. I didn't go.
Don't cry, it's just a bit! I'm your uncle Chandler; funny is all I have!
(Monica enters from their bedroom with a calendar.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, just so you know, I'm gonna be ovulating from tomorrow until
the sixth, so don't touch yourself in the next 48 hours.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't do that.
(Monica looks at him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'll try to stop. Wait, did you say until the sixth?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Today is the sixth.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it's not.
(Points at the calendar.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, it's also 2003.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god. Today's the sixth?! I may be done ovulating! I may have
also served some very questionable meat at the restaurant.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's okay. Go take the test and see if we're okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.
(She runs to the bathroom, while Chandler starts acting
like a chicken in front of Emma. Emma is silent, however.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tough crib.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, where are all my ovulation-sticks? There's only one here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I might have checked to see if I was ovulating a couple times.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am not working. There's not much to do around here!
[Scene: Delmonico's restaurant. Ross is waiting for his
blind date to show up. A waiter walks past him.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Excuse me, is there a woman waiting at the bar? Someone average height,
dark hair, perhaps doing a puzzle?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Uh, there's a drunk Chinese guy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, if I'm still here in an hour, buy him a drink on me.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Can I get you another glass of wine?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nah, I don't know if I should. I don't wanna be drunk when I go home
alone.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Got stood up, huh?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it's no big deal. It's just a blind date.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Are you worried your date came, saw you, and left?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!
(The waiter leaves.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Monica emerges
from the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're okay. I'm still ovulating.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, good, because as of four o'clock this afternoon, I am not.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, let's do this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I - I don't think I can.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on. I know you're not eighteen anymore, but give it a minute.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because of Emma.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god, Emma. Oh, sweetie, I forgot you were here. Oh, you're
right, we can't do this. We can't leave her alone.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Unless... Maybe we do it here. I mean, how much can she even be aware
of at this age?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, she's aware when we leave the room. She may notice if we start...
canoodling in it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Canoodling?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I can't say "hump" or "screw" in front
of the B-A-B-Y.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know. I mean, I guess having sex in front of a baby isn't
so...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Horrifying? Scarring? Something people go to jail for?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess you're right.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You guess I'm right? When we stayed at that bed and breakfast, you
wouldn't have sex with me because you thought a deer was staring through
the window.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But what kind of a sick bastard wants to do it in front of a deer?
[Scene: Another restaurant. Rachel is studying the menu
together with her date, Steve. Steve is the stoned restaurateur from 115
TOW the Stoned Guy.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, everything looks so good! I think I'm gonna have the chicken.
Steve (staring at Rachel): I - I just have to say this; you're really beautiful.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well, that's - that's very sweet. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: I'm kind of funny looking.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Oh, come on, you're way out of my league. Everybody in here knows
it. Bet that guy over there's probably saying, "ooh, why she out with
him? He must be rich!" Well, I'm not!
Rachel (feeling awkward): So, what do think you wanna order? I'm really
excited about that chicken.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: I'm not funny either. So, if you were thinking, "well, he's
not that good-looking, but maybe we'll have some laughs"... That ain't
gonna happen.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, come on, Steve; let's not rule out nervous laughter. Hey, now
wait a minute. Phoebe told me that - that you owned your own restaurant.
That's impressive.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: I lost it. To drugs.
(Steve makes a face as if his mouth is too dry.)

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: I silk-screen t-shirts now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? What's that like?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: It's really fulfilling doing something you hate for no money. That's
right. I have no money, I'm not funny, I live in a studio apartment with
two other guys, and I'm pretty sure I'm infertile.
Rachel (awkward chuckle): Now, come on, come on, Steve. There must be something
that you like about yourself.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: I do like my hair.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?
[Scene: Central Perk. Phoebe and Joey are there. Phoebe's
cell phone rings.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hello?
(Rachel is still at the restaurant, but Steve is gone.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, it's me. I'm going to hunt you down and kill you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This is the worst date ever. How could you set me up with this creep?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, you are talking about one of my dear, dear friends.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't care! This guy is a nightmare!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, right, so he gets a little crazy when he's stoned.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He's not stoned.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Did he go out for a cigarette?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, four times.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My dear, sweet Rach.
(Rachel hangs up in disgust.)
Phoebe (to Joey): Well, our plan is working. Rachel is having a miserable
time, and Ross is just stood up somewhere at a restaurant all alone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, great, pretty soon they'll be back together.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: By the time anyone's figured out what we've done, we'll be in sunny
Mexico. (BEAT) Oh, wait, that's the end of a different plan.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Emma has fallen
asleep in her playpen, and Chandler has fallen asleep right next to her
on the floor. He's even sucking on a pacifier.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's asleep. Chandler?
(Chandler wakes up and looks a bit confused when he finds
that he has a pacifier in his mouth.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Emma was doing it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's asleep.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, she's asleep, that means we can...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, but we have to be fast.
Chandler (laughs): Okay, I'll try. And you can't make any noise.
Monica (laughs): Okay, I'll try.
(They run to the bedroom and close the door carefully just
as Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello?
(Emma starts making noises, and Joey walks over to her
playpen.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Emma? Hey! Hi!
(He picks her up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How are ya? How are ya? Where are your babysitters, huh? Why's the
bedroom door closed?
(He walks over, but just before he knocks on the door,
he hears some moans and looks shocked.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You can't have S-E-X, when you're taking care of the B-A-B-I-E!
(He walks out quickly with Emma in his arms.)
[Scene: Delmonico's. Ross is still waiting for his date
and drinking wine. The waiter comes up to him again.]

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: I've got bad news. The Chinese guy left.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Eh, if it was meant to be, it's meant to be.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Look; you got stood up, who cares? We're gonna show you a good time.
Just sit and relax. In fact, let me bring you a crab cake appetizer on
the house.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, free crab cakes. Well, that's nice. Although I was hoping to
have sex tonight.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Ooh...
(Ross sees the waiter looking at him.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just the crab cakes.
(Meanwhile, another waiter has come up to the first waiter.)
Waiter #2: What are you
doing? Are you trying to get him to stay? Because you can't do that.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Just get out of here, okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's - what's going on?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Eh, okay, the waiters have a little pool going. We have a bet on
how long it'll take before you give up and go home.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? You - you're making money off my misery?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Well, if you stay till 9:20, I am.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is unbelievable. I - I have never been so insulted in my life.
Now, if you'll wrap up my free crab cakes, I'll be on my way.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. They're done and
come out of their bedroom. Emma is still gone.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, that was weird. You were loud, and I was fast.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think we may have really done it this time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I wish I didn't have to wait to take a pregnancy test.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You may wanna get some more of those too.
(They walk over to the playpen.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where's Emma?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god, where's Emma? Where's Emma?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don't ask me, I was in there canoodling you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, okay, I'm sure that Rachel came home early and picked up Emma.
You go look across the hall, and I'll call her cell.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (Runs out.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, you better hope that we're pregnant, because one way or another,
we're giving a baby back to Rachel.
[Scene: The street in front of Central Perk. Rachel and
Steve are walking home from their date. Steve is sobbing.]
Steve (sobbing): I - I can't believe I�m crying in front of you. You must
think I'm so pathetic.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, no, I admire a man who can cry.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Really?
(He puts his hand on her shoulder.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don't touch my coat!
(Her cell phone rings.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, sorry, it's my phone. Hello?
Monica (on phone): Hey, Rach, how's it going?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my god, this is the worst date ever!
(Steve starts crying loudly.)
Rachel (to Steve): Look, you know what, I'm sorry, but did you really think
that this was going well? (To Monica.) What's up?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, did you stop by here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god, then...
(Joey and Chandler enter with Emma.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, thank god! Emma, there you are!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What do you mean, "there you are"? Where was she?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, we were playing "peek-a-boo." She just � she loves
it when I'm dramatic.
(Monica hangs up, and Rachel looks at her phone.)
Monica (to Joey): Why the hell did you take her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because you two were having sex!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, we weren't!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don't you lie to me! I could tell by Chandler's hair. (To Chandler.)
You are so lazy. Can't you get on top for once?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, all right, we were. We were trying to make a baby. Monica's
ovulating.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! It is unacceptable that you two would have sex with Emma in
the next room. I'm gonna have to tell Rachel about this.
(Joey starts to leave.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, please don't. Please, Joey. She will kill us!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I gotta! Unless...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Unless what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Unless you name your firstborn child Joey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I may never have kids, and somebody's gotta carry on my family
name.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Your family name is Tribbiani.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (BEAT) (Laughs.) You almost had me.
(He leaves.)
[Scene: The street in front of Central Perk. Steve and
Rachel are still there.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, uh...

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Look, I think I know the answer to this question, but... Would you
like to make love to me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really, really not.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Eh, it's just as well. Doesn't work anyway.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, well that's good to know. Good night, Steve.
(She walks over to Central Perk and enters to find Ross
sitting on the couch, eating crab cakes. She takes off her coat while groaning
and shuddering.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just had a rough night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Crab cake?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Eww!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, what happened?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well, I...It's kind of weird talking to you about this, but...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica told me you had a blind date.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I did, too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But is it technically a date if the other person doesn't show up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, oh no. Do you think she walked in, saw you and left?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why does everyone keep saying that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, if it makes you feel any better, I wish my date hadn't shown
up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That bad?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, he makes t-shirts for a living, and he thought it would be
appropriate to give me this.
(She holds up a black t-shirt with "FBI - Female Body
Inspector" on the front.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Female body inspector? What size is that?
[Cut to outside. Phoebe and Joey are walking down the street
to Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. So, they're gonna name their first child Joey?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How - how do I get them to name the next one after me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's easy, you just walk in on them having sex.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, so they owe me like, three Phoebes.
(Phoebe sees Rachel and Ross through the window.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my god! Look, it's Ross and Rachel. Oh, the plan is working.
(Joey does the "plan-laugh.")

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don't, don't do the plan-laugh.
[Cut to inside Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The first date we've had in months, and they were both such disasters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Huh. You know, it is weird that Phoebe would
set me up on a date that was awful on the same night that Joey set you
up on a date that didn't even show.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute; you don't think it was intentional? I mean, that's
just stupid.
[Cut to outside Central Perk.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We're geniuses! Yeah, look at them, look at them, they're really
bonding.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, they're falling in love all over again.
(Rachel and Ross turn around and look at Phoebe and Joey
with puzzled expressions on their faces.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, they see us! Oh, they, they look mad. Oh, they figured it out.
They're coming this way. Run!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mexico!
(They run down the street with Ross and Rachel following
right behind them.)
End credits.
[Scene: Delmonico's restaurant. Ross and Joey are sitting
at a table for four. The waiter is pouring water in their glasses.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Can you believe they're still not here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know. A double blind date, and we both get stood up. What are the
chances?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, I'm so bummed. Can we have our free crab cakes now?

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We've been stood up. (sniffles) And we want our free crab cakes.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Guys, give it a rest. Nobody's betting on you tonight. Although we
do have a pool going to see how long it takes that guy to cry.
(He points at Steve who's sitting at another table. He's
staring at his hands.)

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: I have such fat hands!
(He starts crying.)

title: The One with the Mugging

scenes.location: Central Perk, Joey, Ross, Monica and Phoebe are there as Chandler enters

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (excited) Guys, guys, I've got great news! Guess what…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, ah, Monica's pregnant?!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shocked) Really? (She looks around, suddenly embarrassed) Let's get past the moment.
