lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What's your news?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you. I got a job in advertising. (Everybody cheers)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (hugging Chandler) Oh, honey, that's incredible!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (inquisitive) Gosh, what's the pay like? (Everybody stares at her indignantly) Oh, come on people… (defending) come on, now, if I don't know who makes the most, how do I know who I like the most! (She looks at Joey) Hey Joey! (Joey winks at her)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually, it pays nothing. It's an internship.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, that's cool. We have interns at 'Days Of Our Lives'.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right. So, it'll be the same except… less sex with you. (Joey nods)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, uh, what kinda stuff do you think they'll have you do there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it's a training program, but at the end, they hire the people they like.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (enthusiastic) That's great.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I mean, there's probably gonna be some ground work which will probably stink, you know, grown man getting people coffee is a little humiliating
(At the same time, Gunther puts down a cup of coffee in front of Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (grinning awkwardly) Humiliating and noble!
(Gunther shoots a nasty look at him while leaving)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, if I didn't already have a job, I think, I would have been really good in advertising.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, you did not come up with "got milk?"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, I did, I did! (He turns to Joey, disappointed) I should have written it down!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's Aparment, Monica sits at the table

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where's Chandler? I wanna wish him good luck on his first day. (Monica smiles) ... and I smelled bacon. (taking some)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: He just left.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (puzzled) Who did? (Monica looks bewildered)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Joey! You never gonna believe it: she called.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (standing up, surprised) She did?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (enthusiastic) You got it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (still surprised) I did?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is she talking about?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know, but it sounds great.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Your agent called. You got that audition.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: With Lennart Haze?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my god, that is great! That is *** for a play on broadway… and in a real theatre, not that little one underneath the dally like last time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is it a good play?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it must be, because I read and I didn't understand a singe word.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and Lennart Haze is starring in it…

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, and directing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sighs) He was so good in that movie of MacBeth.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (disbelieving) You saw that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, but… I saw the previews. They played it right before Jackass.

lines.speaker: Rachel and Joey
lines.text: (pointing at Monica, a look of recognition in their faces) Ah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, he's done some amazing works.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Oh, I loved him in those cell phone commercials.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (almost laughing) I know. When the monkey hits him in the face with that giant rubber phone. (They all laugh)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Maybe the monkey will be at the audition!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sitting down) Don't make me more nervous than I already am!

scenes.location: Chandler's new workplace, his fellow interns are already seated around a table

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Good morning, everybody.

lines.speaker: Intern
lines.text: Can I get you a cup of coffee, Sir?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, no, no, I'm an intern, just like you guys… except for the tie, the briefcase… and the fact that I can rent a car.

lines.speaker: Intern
lines.text: Seriously, you're an intern?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, well, I'm kinda heading into a new career direction and, you know, you gotta start at the bottom.

lines.speaker: Intern
lines.text: (shaking his head disbelievingly) Dude!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right. Look, I know I'm a little bit older than you guys, but it's not like I'm Bob Hope (he sits down)
(Everybody gives him an inquiring look)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The comedian? USO?!

lines.speaker: Intern
lines.text: (correcting him) Uhm, it's USA, sir.
(Chandler desperately covers his head in his hands)

scenes.location: Audition room, Joey is lead into the room by a receptionist in a fancy dress

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: This is Joey Tribbiani. Joey, these are the producers and, as you probably already know, this is Lennart Haze.
(Lennart Haze turns around in his chair to face Joey)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It is so amazing to meet you. (They are shaking hands) I'm such a big fan of your work.

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Well, I've… I've been blessed with a… a lot of great roles.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Tell me about it! "Unlimited nights and weekends!"

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: You making fun of me? Because I am not a sell-out. (He stands up and walks menacingly towards Joey) I didn't do that for the money, I believe in those phones. I almost lost a cousin because of bad wireless service.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I-I-I wasn't making fun of you, honestly, I-I think you were great in those commercials.

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Well, I do bring a certain credibility to the role.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (regaining confidence) Are you kiddin'? When they shoot you out of that cannon…

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Peeeeeooooooooch (He mimes flying out of the cannon) "Hang up that phone!" One take!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: So, shall we read?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yah, sure.

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Top of act two. This is my entrance. You got it?
(Joey nods whereupon Lennart acts as if he is entering a room)

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "What the hell are you still doing here"?
(Joey stares at him, fascinated by his performance)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Err, "I think you know".

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "Bastard"!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "I am what you made me. You know what? I could go right now."

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "Go, go!"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "I can't. Oh, I want to, long pause, but I can't."

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: I'm sorry, sorry. You're not supposed to say "long pause"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (understandingly) Oh, oh, I thought that was your character's name, you know, I thought you were like an Indian or something, you know with a… (He mimes wearing a feather on his head)

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: No. Thank you so much for coming in. We appreciate it, thank you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, y-y-you're sure you don't want me to do it again? I could do it with an accent, you know, Southern (He speaks in what he believes is a Southern accent) "I could go right now, maaan!"

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: (stunned, muttering) My god in heaven.
(The producers stand up)
Producer #1: Joey, hang on for a second. Lennart, can we talk to you for a moment?
(They stand aside, talking)

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: You, you gotta be kidding. See, h-he, he can't act. (Joey hears that and his disappointment is reflected in his facial expression).
(Producer #1 whispers something)

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Hey! I-I-I don't care if he's hot, you know. If you want to sleep with him, do it on your own time. (Joey smiles smugly at this) This is a play. No, listen: if you insist on this, I will call my agent so fast on a cell phone that has a connection that is so clear he's gonna think I'm next door.
(Joey approaches them)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (interrupting their conversation) Ah, hi, ah. Thank you so much for whispering for my benefit, but, ah, look, if you just tell me what I did wrong, I'd just love to work on it and come back and try it again for you. And, and also: (to Producer #1) 'How you doing?' (to Lennart again) You should, please, just gimme another chance. I really wanna get better, please.

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Well, if you wanna come back at the end of the day today, here are my notes. Ready?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Uhm, you're in your head. You-you're thinking way too much.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I really doubt that.

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: (explaining to Joey, who nods fervently) No, no, no. It's that you're not connected with anything in your body. There's no urgency. The scene is a struggle, uhm, it's a race. Also, what you did was horizontal. Don't be afraid to explore the vertical. And don't learn the words. Let the words learn you.
(Joey ponders on this for a while)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (suggesting) Couldn't I just sleep with the producer?

scenes.location: Backstreet, Ross and Phoebe walking

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, do you wanna go to dinner tonight?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I can't. I've got a date with that waitress, Katy, yeah, I know we've been only going out like twice, but I have a really good feeling about her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I hear divorce bells.
(A mugger, his face hidden by a cap, approaches them from behind)

lines.speaker: Mugger
lines.text: Alright. Just give me your wallets and there won't be a problem.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (taken aback) What?

lines.speaker: Mugger
lines.text: I have a gun (It looks like he has a gun under his coat)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: O-ok. Just relax, Phoene, just stay calm. (He searches his coat and freaks out). Oh my god, I can't find my wallet.
(He finally finds the wallet and hands it to the mugger)

lines.speaker: Mugger
lines.text: Alright, lady, now give me your purse!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (still in a high-pitched voice) What do you mean "no"? I knew you'd be my death, Phoebe Buffay.
(A sign of recognition runs across Phoebe's face)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Lowell, is that you?

lines.speaker: Lowell
lines.text: Phoebe? (He lifts his cap) Oh my god!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (simultaneously) Oh my god!
(They hug and scream)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (excited) I'm sorry, Ross, this is my old friend Lowell from the streets. Lowell, Ross.

lines.speaker: Lowell
lines.text: Ross, nice to meet you. (He stretches his hand out to him)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, a real pleasure.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah, it's been so long, so long. (They hug again) I can't believe you're still doing this!

lines.speaker: Lowell
lines.text: Ough, I know, but I quit smoking!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good for you!

lines.speaker: Lowell
lines.text: So you look like you're doing really well! I guess you're mugging days are behind you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ouh… (she nods)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked) Oh my god. Phoebe, you used to mug people?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Excuse me, Ross, old friends catching up…

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's Apartment, Monica sits on the couch as Joey enters

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, how did the audition go?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, they wanna see me again this afternoon, but, err, well, Lennart Haze did not like me. (He sits down)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, he said I wasn't urgent enough, you know, and that everything I did was horizontal and I should be more vertical. Oh, and he said that I should think less.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So far so good! (Joey nods)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, carrying a large box) Honey, I'm old!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (standing up, walking towards him) What's wrong?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I am so much older than these other interns. I can't compete with them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you're a little older. Try to look at the positive: You have all this life experience.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but I don't think life experience with these. (He opens the box and takes an inline skate-like sneaker out)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wooooooooow (He takes the sneaker) It's like they're on fire!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are they? (They sit down again)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They're these prototype sneakers and come up with ideas on how to sell them which I can't do because no self-respecting adult would ever where these.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (determined) I give you $ 500 for them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What am I supposed to do with these?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ah, come on, sneakers are easy. You wear sneakers all the time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, first of all, they're not called "sneakers" anymore. Apparently, they're called "kicks" or "skids" and I think I heard somebody say "slorps". (He takes a sneaker) And here, look: they've got these wheels to pop out from the bottom so you can roll around 'cause, apparently, walking is too much exercise. Kids, kids, roll your way to childhood obesity! (to Monica) Would you help me try to sell these?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, have you considered using a girl with huge knockers?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I don't think that's the kinda thing they're looking for.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, that'd work on me! Why did I get to buy Mrs. Butterwords?

scenes.location: Central Perk, Monica sits on the couch as Phoebe and Ross enter

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey, hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, you'll never guess what just happened… Phoebe and I got mugged!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You okay?!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sitting down) Yah, because Phoebe knew the mugger!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (bewildered) How do you know a mugger?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry I have friends outside the six of us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You wanna know how she knew him? (He points at Phoebe) Because Phoebe used to mug people.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (shocked) Seriously?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I'm not proud of it, but, you know… sometimes when I was living on the street and I needed money for food and stuff I…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (disapproving) Phoebe, that is awful!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, ok, I wasn't rich like you guys, ok, I didn't eat gold and have a flying pony… I had a hard life, my mother was killed by a drug dealer…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're mother killed herself!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She was a drug dealer!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, anyway, it was a good thing Phoebe knew the knew him, because (menacingly) I was about to do some serious damage!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (laughing) Okay…

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, this must've brought back some really bad memories for you, Ross.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, Ross was mugged as a kid.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (worried) You were?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it was pretty traumatic. I was outside St. Marc's Comics… you know, I-I-I was just there minding my own business, you know, seeing what kinda trouble spiderman got into that week-

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (coughing) Wonderwoman!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway, I was heading towards this bakery, you know, to pick up a couple of dozen Linzer torts for someone… (He looks at Monica) … when outta nowhere this thug with a pipe jumps out and says: "Gimme your money, punk!"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (shocked) Oh my god…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know! And-and the worst part was they took my backpack which had all the original artwork I had done for my own comic book: "Science Boy"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah! What was his superpower again?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A superhuman thirst for knowledge.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I-I better get to class (He stands up) Are there any more of your friends I should look out for on my way, Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No… actually, you might wanna stay away from Jane street… that's where stabby Joe works.
(Ross leaves Central Perk)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, I think we have a problem here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, uhm, back in my mugging days, you know, I, uhm, I worked St. Marc's Comics.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, a pipe was my weapon of choice and, uhm, pre-teen comic book nerds were my meat.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, there was this one kid who had a sticker on his backpack that said-

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Monica
lines.text: "Geology rocks!"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know… I mugged Ross!

scenes.location: Audition room, the producers and Lennart are waiting for Joey

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: You're late!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) I know, I'm sorry, but can I just have a quick second to run to the bathroom?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: No, Lennart doesn't wait!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But I'm bursting with u-hu!

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: (spotting Joey) Joey! Here we go. Let's go very quickly!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Actually, I really need…

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: (interrupting) We must go now, quickly, please.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes… ahahaaa (He seems to be in pain)

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Ready? "What the hell are you still doing here?"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (walking on the spot) "I think you know!"

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "Oh, you sick bastard!"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "I am what you made me! You know what?"

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "What?"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "I could go right now."

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "Then go, go!"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (urgent) "I, oh, I can't. I want to, but I can't!"

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Cut! That was good. (He turns to the producers) That was very good. You did everything I asked for.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (disbelieving) I did?

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Yes. Plus… what you've got that… I don't know what you've got going… this squirmy quality that you bring into the character that I couldn't've even imagined. Wow, hey, here's what we gonna do: come back tomorrow for the final callbacks with the ***, do all of this what you've got going now, but – you know what? – more, more. Can you do that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, yeah. I don't have time to say thank you because I really gotta go. (He grabs his jacket and limps out of the room)

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: (watching Joey leave) Look at that: still in character, I like it… I plant seeds I can't explain.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's Apartment, Chander sits on the couch as Monica and Rachel enter

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Putting on the sneakers… thought I'd get into a younger mindset, you know, to see if it sparked anything…

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, anything yet?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, how's this: They're so uncomfortable it's like getting kicked in the nuts for your feet!
(At that moment, Joey opens the door)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!
(Joey heads straight for the fridge, takes all the beverage cans and is about to leave the apartment)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Probably wanna know what I'm doing…?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, that seems about right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yesterday at my audition, I really had to pee, and apparently, having to pee makes me a really good actor. I got a call-back, so I'm drinking everything. Oh, by the way, that egg nog in our fridge was great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, that was formula.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We gotta get more of that. (He leaves the apartment)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sitting on the couch) You know what… these aren't half-bad! (to Rachel) You should suggest something like these to Ralph Lauren.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, first of all, that's stupid and second of all, I'm not allowed to talk to Ralph.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright (He stands wearing the sneakers on) I feel youger already!
(He trips and falls hard on his back)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on the floor) Yah, I think I broke my hip.

scenes.location: Central Perk, Phoebe is there drinking coffee and Ross is about to enter

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (spotting Ross) Hey, you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, how was class?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No one ever asked me that, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing, I really wanna know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh… (He looks positively surprised) Well, uhm, there was actually a rather lively discussion about the Pleistocene…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting) Alright, nothing is worth this. Uhm, I have a confession to make… uhm, okay, you know, that girl that mugged you when you were a kid…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (disbelieving) Wh-What are you talking about? It wasn't a girl. It was this huge dude.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You don't have to lie anymore, Ross, I know that it was a fourteen year-old girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it wasn't.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, it was.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, it wasn't. You don't think I would've defended myself against a fourteen year-old…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting, pinching his year) "Gimme your money, punk!"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked) Oh my god, it was you! I can't believe it, you… you mugged me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (apologetic) Yeah, and I'm so, so sorry, Ross, I'm sorry, but, you know, if you think about it, it's kinda neat. (She smiles at him, but he doesn't understand) I mean, well, it's just that I I've always felt kinda like an outsider, you know, the rest of you have these connections that go way back and, you know, now, you and I have… have a great one!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's not the best!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, I'm sorry, please forgive me. I don't know what to say…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (indignant) There's nothing you can say. That was the most humiliating thing that ever happened to me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? Even more humiliating than…

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (interrupting) Hey, let's not do this!
(He picks up his briefcase and walks out of the door, leaving Phoebe behind)

scenes.location: Chandler's new workplace, we are witnessing a presentation of a fellow intern

lines.speaker: Intern
lines.text: … and then, at the end of the commercial, the girls get out of the hut tub and start making out with each other!

lines.speaker: Boss
lines.text: (ironic) That's interesting! Just one thought: You didn't mention the shoes. Who's next? (Chandler raises his hand) Chander…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay… (He stands up) You start on the image of a guy putting on the shoes. He's about my age…

lines.speaker: Intern
lines.text: (snorting) Your age?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A-huh. So he's rolling down the street and he starts to lose control, you know… maybe he falls… maybe hurts himself. Just then, a kid comes flying by wearing the shoes. He jumps over the old guy and laughs, and the line reads: "Not suitable for adults!"

lines.speaker: Boss
lines.text: Chandler, that's great!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, thank you, sir… or man-who's-two-years-younger-than-me (He sits down again)

lines.speaker: Boss
lines.text: You see? That has a clear selling point. It appeals to our key demographic, it's…. (enthusiastic) You did you come up with that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (over-enthusiastic) I don't know, I don' I don' know! I was just trying to get into a young mindset, you know, and it just started to flow.

lines.speaker: Boss
lines.text: That is great. Good work!
Chandler. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Boss
lines.text: See all of you tomorrow. (He leaves)
(Chandler stands up and walks out the room with a cane)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The cold weather hurts my hip!

scenes.location: Central Perk, Ross sits in a chair as Phoebe enters

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, Ross! (He lowers his newspaper and scowls at her) I know you're still mad at me, but can I just talk to you for a second?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure, go ahead. Whoops, sorry, sure, go ahead. (He raises his hands as if being mugged)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just really wanted to apologize again and… and also show you something I think you'll find very exciting.
(She puts a box on her lap, labelled "crap from the street")

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (faking enthusiasm) Oh my god, crap from the street? (She smiles excitedly, but Ross just turns back to his newspaper)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, Ross, in this box are all the things I got from mugging that I thought were too special to sell… or smoke. (Ross looks at her in astonishment) Anyway, I was looking through it and I found "Science Boy" (She holds up some sheets of paper and hands them to Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my god. (He sighs) I never thought I'd see this again. (He browses trough the pages) It's all here. What made you save it all these years?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can't say, I just thought it was really good… and… maybe would be worth something some day.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You really thought "Science Boy" was worth saving!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah… but you should know, I also have a jar of vaseline and a cat skull in here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Still… this is amazing… Oh my god, thank you, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're welcome. And thank you for "Science Boy". I learned a lot from him

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're welcome.

scenes.location: Audition room, Joey and Lennart are rehearsing

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (hoping frantically on the spot, screaming) "I need an answer!"

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "I-I-I can't tell you somethin' I don't know."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "You know!"

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "I don't know!"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "I need an answer now!"

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "Alright, here, you want an answer… the answer… is…"
(He pauses while Joey struggles to avoid wetting his pants)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (screaming) Oh!

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: "She never loved me, she only loved you."

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: "You knew this all along and you never told me? You never told me? I can never forgive you, I can never forgive myself, I have nothing to live for – Bang – End Scene!"

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Absolutely amazing! (The producers applaud Joey) The part is yours.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in pain) Oh thanks, thanks! Now, I really have to get…

lines.speaker: Lennart
lines.text: Wa-wa-wa-wait! Congratulations! You did it! You did it! (He hugs Joey) You can relax now. Yeah.
(Joey relaxes and wets his pants while hugging Lennart)

title: The One with the Boob Job

lines.text: [Scene: Chandler and Monica's apartment. Chandler and Monica are looking through
some papers.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did you see our bank statement? Can this be right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know...God. I haven't seen my savings take a hit like this since
I was a kid and they came up with double-stuffed Oreos. What happened to all
our money?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not sure what they did, but I'm inclined to blame Enron.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess with you doing the internship, we're just spending more than
we're bringing in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe I should quit and get a job that pays.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, But you're finally doing something that you love! I can't ask
you to give that up. Though it'd be nice if the thing that you love was y'know...
finding gold.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know what? You know what? I think we're making too big a deal
out of this. ok? So we pay our bills a little late this month and maybe next
month we cut back on a few things. And maybe we start eating out of Joey's
refrigerator for a change. You're chef... what can you make out of backing
soda and beer?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok worse case scenario is...we borrow some money from my parents.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No! We're not borrowing money.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because we don't do that. We are Bings! And if there's one thing
my father taught me was... well to always knock before going into the pool
house... but the other thing was never borrow money.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! I Had no idea you had this much pride.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's right! I do! And I'm your man. And I'm going to get us through
this situation even if it means you working twice as hard.
Opening Credits
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment. Mike and Phoebe seem to have finished watching
a movie on television.]

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I'm gonna go. (He kisses Phoebe on the cheek)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why??

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I haven't been home in a couple of days and I need to get some more
clothes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh...you don't have to go, I have something that will fit you.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I put that tube top on as a joke.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I want you to stay.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I want to stay too but I've gone as bad as much use out of these boxers
as I can..

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why don't you turn them inside ou...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Done it. (Phoebe becomes a little more subdued) I'll be back in a couple
of hours.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'll miss you.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Me too. (He leaves. A few moments later, he enters again.) You know
what? I just realised something. I don't wanna go home.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great! Ok...I'll go get the tube top.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No, no! What I mean is, I hate going back to my apartment now... and
partly because I live above a known crack den but... mostly because when I'm
there, It's just, I really miss you. So.. do you want to move in together?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, Mike Hannigan...You sure know how to make a girl say "Hell
yeah!"

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: So we're doing it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Let's do it! Let's live together! (They embrace and Mike kisses
Phoebe) Oh god, we're really going to move in together!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I've always wanted to live with a guy. "Pick up your socks!" "Put
down the toilet seat!" "No! We're not having sex anymore!" It's
gonna be fun!

scenes.location: Joey's apartment. Monica enters.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Listen...I need to know that what I'm about to ask you, will never
get back to Chandler.
(Joey frowns...then looks as if he understands)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'd be lying if I said I haven't thought about it myself. Chandler is
my best friend, it would be wrong. Good...(He winks)...But wrong.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Looks exasperated) Ok first of all...It would be great. But that's
not what I'm here to talk to you about. I need to borrow some money.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Aww, I don't know Monica y'know... erm... lending friends money is always
a mistake.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But Chandler lent you money!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And I think he would tell you it was a mistake.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on...I just need it for some rent and..and some other bills.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh...how much?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Two thousand dollars?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Two thousand dollars!? What do you think I am? I soap opera star!?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's right I am! (Opens drawer and rummages through it. Rachel enters)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi you guys!

lines.speaker: Joey & Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oo...what's in the bag?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh er... well you know Emma started crawling? I realised that this
place, is very unsafe for a baby. So I went to the store and got some stuff
to baby-proof the apartment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh...baby-proofing... Why is this such a big deal now? Y'know, when
I was a kid it was like.. "Whoops! Joey fell down the stairs!" or
er.. "Whoops! Joey electrocuted himself again!" Huh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Anyway erm, are you going to get a handyman to install this stuff?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. I was just going to do this myself. (Joey makes a sarcastic laugh.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're gonna do it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, Why? You don't think a woman can do this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, women can. You can't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Monica...would you please tell Joey that he is a pig?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're a pig. And you can't do this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wha!? What!? Come on! I found the hardware store all by myself!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The hardware store is right down the street.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: There is a hardware store right down the street?
[Scene: Central Perk. Ross, Chandler and Monica are sitting on the couch.
Phoebe and Mike enters.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey you guys! Ok, we've got great news.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Phoebe and I are moving in together.
Monica, Chandler, Ross: Congratulations!/Good for you!/Great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know it's so exciting! You know I've never lived with a guy before.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well you know it's just like living with a girl. Only they don't steal
your makeup. Unless they're playing "This is what my sister would look
like" (Looks at Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.... she's not so cute.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I'm gonna go to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well you put down the toilet seat.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yes dear.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is that a bit you guys do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh huh...we're playing you two.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We don't do that! Tell her we don't do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes dear.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe you guys are moving in together. That's, that's great!
I mean...I'm happy for you guys..

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I hear wedding bells.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica slow down! Ok? I'm just excited to be living with him. You
know I mean, I don't know, Can I see someday being married to Mike? Sure! Yeah.
Y'know..I can picture myself walking down the aisle in a wedding dress that
highlights my breasts in an obvious yet classy way. But do I want that house
in Connecticut...you know..near the good schools where Mike and I can send
Sophie and Mike Junior.. Oh my god I do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, I had no idea you were so conventional.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know! I guess I am! Oh my god! Load up the Volvo I want to be a
soccer mom!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You ready to go?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! You bet roomy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't you mean..groomy?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh please, these guys, we haven't even moved in yet and they have
us picking out china patterns. (Mike seems to gag a little...and laughs nervously.
They begin to leave. Phoebe bolts back)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: China patterns!!!!!

scenes.location: Joey's apartment. Rachel is fiddling with the drawer.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This is easy...Can't do this! (Moves away...and finds her sweater
sleeve stuck to the drawer) Oh! Wow! Seriously I can't do this. (Fiddles more)

scenes.location: Central Perk. Chandler sits on the couch. Joey sits at the round table

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Joe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Listen er..I need to ask you a favor but you can't tell Monica anything
about it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I thought you didn't have secrets from Monica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And that would have made the official party line. (Joey nods) Monica
and I are having a little financial trouble.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? What do you mean you know?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Err... I just figured it out! You know, I mean you're not working and
the economy is bad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Right.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to himself) That's the fastest I have ever thought!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Anyway, err... I need to borrow some money.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Sure! How much? Two thousand dollars?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes! Two thousand dollars exactly! How do you know that! (Joey begins
writing a cheque)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Err...Well I...Know how much you used to make and I know how much your
rent is. (shrugs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh ok.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To himself) I am on fire!
Chandler (Stands up and walks to Joey): Listen...this is really nice. Do you...
(sees his chequebook) Did you write a cheque to Monica for two thousand dollars?
Did Monica borrow money from you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Err... Kind of.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe her! Did she tell you we were having money problems?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no no no no no... It wasn't... It wasn't because of your money problems,
it was for something for her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Something personal.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What would she get for herself for two thousand dollars that she
wouldn't tell me about?
(Woman with huge breasts cuts across them. Takes Joey's coffee)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Excuse me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Boob job.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't want her to get a boob job! That's crazy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well it's...It's not that crazy okay? Making them smaller, that would
be crazy.

scenes.location: Phoebe's apartment. Phoebe and Mike are packing stuff.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Well hey, I wanna ask you about Monica's little "groomy" joke.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Alright. Well I think the reason people laugh is becuase it's
a play on the word roomy.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I get the joke. Sophisticated as it was. Now the thing I wanna say is...
maybe we should have talked about this before. Us living together, you're not
expecting a proposal, right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! No no! Not at all. We're just moving in right now. See where
it goes.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah well, that's the thing. For me it's as far as it can ever go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Look. Phoebe, I-I love you. Very much. But I never want to get married
again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh. Wow.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: It's just my first marriage was, you know such a disaster. I kind of
lost faith in the whole idea.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Was it really that bad?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: At one point near the end she deliberately defecated.....

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, well that's bad. But don't you think it might be different with
someone else? Perhaps a blonde who always uses a toilet. Except for once in
the ocean.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Look it's not about who I would marry. And I was certain the first time
I got married it would last forever. And I was totally wrong!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But it's just...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Look Phoebe, It's not about you. I just never wanna get married again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I'm sorry. Are you ok with that? Cause if not...maybe us moving in together
isn't the best idea.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! I definitely don't wanna get married. No I just wanted to make
sure you didn't want to too. Whew! Coz you know when we move in and you start
changing your mind there's gonna be hell to pay mister!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Trust me, I will never...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah I get that.
[Scene: Joey's apartment. Rachel is flipping through magazines. Handyman is
installing things. Monica enters.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you gave in and decided to call someone?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I don't know who I was kidding. I can barely use chopsticks.

lines.speaker: Handyman
lines.text: You're all set. (picks up his bag and starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh thank you so much. (Picks up the guy's spirit level) Oh oh wait!
You forgot your erm...Your game. (hands it to him)

lines.speaker: Handyman
lines.text: Thanks.....
(Chandler enters)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Rach! There she is...My perfectly proportioned wife.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Don't look at me I never get his jokes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no..don't thank me. Thank you. You know there's not one thing
I would change about you? Not one single thing! And definitely not... two...
single things.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, you're being wierd. Do you want sex or did you do something bad?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No no! I just love the way you look, I am warm, for your form.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok..You know the old classics you know,You look nice? They're still
ok.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well yes yes... You look nice can mean that your face looks nice.
I want to compliment your body. I mean..I wouldn't change it. At all. And more
specifically, I wouldn't want anything to get any bigger.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I mean, You wouldn't want any part of me to get any bigger would
you? Don't answer that.
(He leaves)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just when you thought that dude couldn't get any wierder.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know why do you think he was so worried about me getting bigger?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know! I mean, what brought that on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god. We're trying to get pregnant so he's probably starting
to freak out about the fact that my body is going to change.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No you really think that's what it is?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You heard him! "No bigger!" "You're perfect!" "Just
don't get any bigger!" Oh my god he sounded just like my high school wrestling
coach. You know what? I'm going to have to talk to Chandler.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! If you don't I will! Of course your body's gonna change. Your
breasts are gonna get bigger, your ass is gonna get bigger, you're gonna lose
bladder control. (she starts sobbing) God! It's just such a magical time!

scenes.location: Ross's apartment. Phoebe is at the door.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Listen, I wanted to ask you something about marriage.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh great now you're seeking me out to make jokes? I mean I can see for
all hanging out but to come to my home!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No...I really wanted to know how you feel about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mike doesn't ever wanna get married.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Never?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Never.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: wow, are you still going to move in with him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I want to, but I just want you to tell me that marriage isn't really
that big a deal. You know that I won't, I won't be missing out on anything.
That marriage stinks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, marriage... stinks! I mean if you wanna see a man gain weight
and a woman stop shaving? Get them married.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's not how you really feel is it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I'm sorry. Look I don't think that's what you wanna hear right now
but I can't help it. I love marriage.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Seriously? You divorce-o?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: If you have to call me name, I prefer "Ross the Divorcer".
It's just cooler. Look, I know my marriage isn't exactly work out. But I love
to be that committed to another person. And Carol had some good times before
she became a lesbian... and once afterward. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's ok that's how you feel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But come on! I mean living together will be great! I mean you guys have
so much fun and you love Mike.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I do love Mike.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah see? And you are so excited about moving in together before, and
you know what? You should be. It's a big deal!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah I guess you're right. Yeah thanks. This helped. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The Divorcer, to the rescue!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's not cooler.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah I just hurt it.
[Scene: Joey's apartment. Joey enters carrying a tub of ice cream. He sets
it on the table, takes off his jacket and struggles with the drawer. It cannot
be opened.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach?! (He walks over to the fridge to put it in, but it cannot be opened
either) Rachel!!!!? (He walks to the bathroom and tries to lift the toilet
seat cover. It won't come up.) So I can't do anything I like????
[Scene: Chandler and Monica's apartment. Chandler enters. Rachel and monica
are seated at the table.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Rach! Ah........ Perfection. (kisses monica) Wouldn't change
a thing. Not a thing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: About that? Erm...I'm going to change.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But honey you don't have to.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm going to get bigger!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey I... I love your breasts the way they are!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Argh. fascist

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, my breasts are going to get bigger weather you like it or not!
And you know what? It's not just my breasts. My ass is going to get bigger
too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: your ass?!?!?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Man, don't be surprised if her hands and her feet get bigger too!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They...do that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's kind of a package deal!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: God why why would you want to do that to yourself!?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I thought I was something that we both wanted!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright look, if it means that much to you, a may be able to get
on more with the big boobs. But the giant ass and the big clown feet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my god Chandler! If you can't handle this, what are you going to
be like in the hospital? With the blood and the screaming and the little present
that's shooting out of her!?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sedated) What?
[Scene: Joey's apartment. He's prying open the drawer with a crowbar to no
avail. Monica, Rachel and Chandler enter.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey! Why did you tell Chandler that Monica was getting a boob job?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Because she is!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, Chandler knows I borrowed the money.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mmmm hmm! For your boob job!
Monica, Rachel, Chandler: It's over/Joe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: OK so I'm out four thousand dollars and nobody's boobs are getting any
bigger?
[Scene: Phoebe's apartment. Ross is helping with the packing, Phoebe and Mike
are also there.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! What do you guys think about this. "Ross: The Divorce-Force".

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Better.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Very cool.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, you know I'm i'm really glad you came to talk to me the
other day and I hope I was a little helpful.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah you were helpful! Yeah, no, thanks you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good, good. Yeah coz the more I thought about it, the more I realised
I don't think marriage is neccessarily the right path for you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I know the other day in the coffeehouse you were caught up in
the whole soccer mom thing? but is that really you? I mean can you honestly
picture yourself in a Volvo?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They are awfully boxy...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know you'd be so bored with marriage. I mean it's so... normal.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh huh.
(Chandler, Monica, Joey and Rachel are carrying a couch through the door)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey hey, can I help?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well! We er..climbed up four flights of stairs, manueveored a narrow
hallway, dodged a rabid pitbul... but these last three feet are where it gets
really tricky.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know sometimes your words... they hurt.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey uh, where do you guys want this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, seriously coz this is really heavy. (She suddenly lets go) I
mean not for me because i'm only pretending to hold this, but for these guys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just one last time erm... the marriage thing... there's no wiggle
room? None at all?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No but... You don't want to get married either right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Right. Except that I do want to get married.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (voice strained) Couldn't have this conversation down at the truck huh?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You wanna get married?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Someday.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aaaaand....... hernia.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I haven't exactly had a normal life and I never really felt I was
missing out on anything but it just feels that now it's my turn some of the
regular stuff.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: But if you wanna get married why didn't you say something before?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because I just didn't know how much I wanted it. And I love you, and
I wanted to live with you.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I want to live with you too! Let's do that!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But I don't think I can! it was ok to move in when I didn't know what
was gonna happen, but I can't move in knowing that nothing is ever gonna happen.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Can we at least try living together? I mean you might change your mind
about marriage.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you gonna change yours?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me neither. I think I need to be with someone who wants what I want.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: But I don't want this to end.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't want it to end either.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I can't believe this is gonna end. I guess I'll have my stuff packed
up.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Ok... so...(They hug) Goodbye.
Chandler/Joey/Rachel/Monica: Bye bye Mike!/Cya mike!/Bye mike!/Bye bye now!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm so sorry Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're all sorry... (They have a group hug)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, look on the bright side, I mean you won't have to live with
this ugly chair! That was here already huh? I love you. (they hug again)
Ending Credits
[Scene: Joey's apartment. Joey is struggling with the fridge. He finally gets
it open and falls on the floor]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: AH HAH! I DID IT! HA HA! Alright... (He takes a box out, about to close
fridge, then thinks.) Better take all I can carry. Who knows when i'll be able
to get in here again!

title: The One with the Memorial Service

scenes.location: Ross' apartment , Chandler and Joey enter

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Ready to go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, let me just finish this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross, check this out! (he tries to spin a basketball on his fingertip but he throws it against a table) yeah, I can't do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you doin'?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Have you seen this? It's a new alumni website for college! It's cool! You can post messages for people, let everyone know what you're up to.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great, a faster way to tell people that I'm unemployed and childless .

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's actually kinda interesting to find out what people are doing... remember Andrea Rich?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The tall girl who wouldn't sleep with you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh uh... well, her Internet Company went under and she lost an ear in a boating accident...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bet she'd sleep with you now...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No... I already e-mailed her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me see what you wrote about yourself: "Doctor Paleontology, two kids... " (pause) You split with Carol because you have different interests?... I think you split with Carol because you've one very similar interest!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what? I'm gonna finish this later, ok? Let me just grab my coat.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! (he throws the basketball against a table again)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he picks up the ball) What do you think you learnt how to do in the last two minutes?? (he enters another room)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe we finish this for him! (he sits down on the sofa and he start typing on Ross' computer) "Also I cloned a dinosaur in my lab. She's now my girlfriend. I don't care what society says. It's the best sex I've ever had"... aaand SEND!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (he stops Chandler from posting the message) No, no, no... what do... you can't do that to him!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he comes back) Alright, let's go!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude! (he opens his arms to receive the ball from Ross' hands)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think you made it clear you cannot be trusted with the ball inside the house!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (after Ross leaves the room) aaand SEND! (he hits the send button)
Opening credits

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! How was basketball?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, it was a lot of fun right up until Chandler got a finger in the eye!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no! Who did that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler... hey... (he goes towards his room but he stops near Emma's cot) Rach... what's Hugsy doin' in the crib with Emma? (he looks puzzled)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She was just crawling around and she found him, so I just let her sleep with him. That's all right? Isn't it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (still very puzzled) Oh, yeah... of course... yeah... it's a stuffed animal... you know... it's for kids... not for adults... I know that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey... are you sure? I mean, I know how much you love him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rachel... let's be clear on this, ok? I do not love Hugsy. I like him a normal amount...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right... Oh, Emma loves him!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why wouldn't she? He's a wonderful person!

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Phoebe... how you doin'? You feelin' better?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Breaking up sucks! Oh, I really miss Mike!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I'm so sorry!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh God, I tried everything to make myself feel better. I even tried writing a song about it... but... I can't think of anything that rhymes with AARRGGHH!! (pause) Hey Monica, I really need your help getting through this...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're not gonna need my help?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well no, when I get to the point where... you know... I'm ready to hear cruel mocking jokes about Mike... I'm gonna come to you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh good, 'cause I've already thought of 3... 4! I've just thought of a fourth (he goes towards the counter)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok. I mean I know I did the right thing. You know, Mike never wants to get married and I shouldn't be in a relationship that has no future... but... pretty soon I'm gonna miss him so much. I'm gonna wanna see him again and you have to stop me from doing that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, you got it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (after a pause) Unless... Maybe it's too crazy about this... Alright so... you know, there is no future... but that doesn't mean we still can't have fun. You know what? Forget what I said.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? If that's what you want...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That was a test and you just failed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Damn it! Rookie mistake!
(Ross enters and he's really angry. He goes towards Chandler who's sitting at the counter)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (yelling at Chandler) I have sex with dinosaurs??

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I believe I read that somewhere!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That only is not funny, it's physically impossible! Ok? Depending on the species I'd have to have a six foot long... (pause) It's not funny!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I respectfully disagree.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe you put that on my alumni page!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Who cares? Nobody reads those things

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You'd better hope not because I just read what you put on your page today.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't have a page.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh oh oh! I RESPECTFULLY DISAGREE!!

scenes.location: Rachel's room. Rachel and Emma are sleeping; Joey sneaks in and approaches the crib

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look at you, all sweet and innocent, sleeping like an angel... with Emma's chubby little hands wrapped around ya. (he picks up Hugsy) It's okay, Emma, you stay asleep. (Emma cries)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (threatening Joey with a scrunchy): Step away from the crib, I have a weapon!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's okay, it's okay Rach, it's me. Put down the scrunchy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I heard Emma stirring, so I came to make sure she could reach Hugsy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, oh thanks. Alright well, now that I'm up I'm going to go to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (placing Hugsy back in the crib) There you go sweetie... (to Emma) This isn't over.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's. Chandler is looking at the screen of his laptop, shaking his head.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, wait a second, why would Ross tell everyone in your class that you are as... (reads from the screen) "gay as the day is long"?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because I told everyone he slept with dinosaurs.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But that's clearly a joke. This could easily be true. (Phone rings)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Would you get that please? People have been calling to congratulate me all day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (On the phone) Hello? No, he's not here. Yeah, this is his wife. Yeah, well, it came as quite a shock to me too. I guess I should have known. Yeah, I mean, he just kept making me watch Moulin Rouge.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hang up, hang up. And that was a great movie! (Monica hangs up) I'm so gonna get back at Ross... oh yeah, this will show him, here we go (starts typing something).

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, you'll see my friend.
[Time lapse, still Chandler and Monica's, but only Chandler is there. Enter Ross]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (visibly upset) I'm dead?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (faking sympathy) And so young.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Posting that I died? That really isn't funny.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, how you died was funny.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh please, hit by a blimp?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It kills over one americans every year.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Unbelievable, my classmates are gonna think I'm dead, my professors, my... my parents are gonna get phone calls. You're messing with people's feelings here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You wanna talk about people's feelings? You should have heard how hurt professor Stern was yesterday when I told him I wouldn't be able to go with him to Key West!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You've really crossed the line here, but that's okay, it's ok 'cause I'm on my way to buy some Photoshop software and a stack of gay porn. That's right! Your coming out is about to get real graphic.

scenes.location: Phoebe's apartment

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: God, I wish Mike were here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay if Mike were here what would the two of you be doing?
(Phoebe gives her a meaningful look)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you, animals? It's 4 o'clock in the afternoon!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I gotta call him. Just to talk to him, there's no harm in that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, that's how it starts. I don't need to eat the cake, I'll just smell the icing... why don't I just eat a little sliver, or, okay, just a slice or two. And next thing you know, you're 210 pounds and you get wedged in going down the tunnel slide. Phoebe, honey, I know this is hard. Look, if you talk to him, you're going to wanna see him. And if you see him, you're going to want to get back together with him. I know that's not what you want. (pause) Give me your phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And now your cell.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay (she takes a huge, clearly obsolete cellphone she keeps in a closet and gives it to Monica)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is your cellphone?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is your current cellphone?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, it reminds me of a simpler time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, where's your purse?
(They run for Phoebe's purse, Phoebe gets there first and takes the cell. Monica tries to take it away from her)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, no! Give it to me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You can't have it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Give it to me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No (tucks it in her pants)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'll go in there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (disbelievingly) Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe come here
(they fight a little, the phone falls and Monica picks it up)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Damn you Monica Geller hyphen Bing!

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's. Enter Joey

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, look who's here! It's Joey, and he brought home a friend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, Emma's right here! You promised not to bring girls home in the middle of the day anymore.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, it's not a girl, it's... a brand new Hugsy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh that's so great, now Emma has two Hugsy's.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, Emma has one Hugsy, the new Hugsy, huh? The other Hugsy, I don't know, I guess I'll just take it back.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh you know what? When I was a little girl I had a little pink pony named Cotton. Oh I loved her so much, I took her everywhere, I would braid her tail...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Make the transfer! (She does so)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Should I be concerned that a button fell off the old Hugsy and I can't find it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, no don't worry about that, I swallowed that years ago.
(Emma cries)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I don't think she likes the new Hugsy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But he's the same.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I think she wants the old one back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But he's the same.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, come on!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: He's the same!
(they exchange Hugsy's).

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the new Hugsy) You're not the same!

scenes.location: Phoebe's apartment. Enter Monica

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, it's a lot less surprising to do that after I've buzzed you into the building.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So Phoebe, why are there men's shoes by the door.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Those are my shoes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, when you get over this breakup we need to go shopping.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica, I really appreciate you checking in on me, but I'm actually feeling a lot better. Yeah, I just kinda want to be alone right now.
(Someone knocks on the door)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who's that? (goes to open door)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I ordered Chinese food.
(Monica opens the door and Mike is standing at the doorway)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are the chances? 1 billion Chinese people and they send Mike!?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Mike) What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Phoebe called me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry, I broke down... I wanted to see him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Damnit Phoebe! How did you even call him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There is a speakerphone on the base unit...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Base Unit! Think Monica! Think!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Look, if I wanna see Phoebe and she wants to see...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Mike) This doesn't concern you!!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh! Sorry, I guess I was thrown off by the mention of my name!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, guys, you can't do this, it's just going to make getting over each other, that much harder.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not if nothing happens. Why can't... why can't we just hang out as friends?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure! If you're just gonna hang out as friends, then maybe I'll join ya. You know, I'm your friend (to Phoebe) and Mike's friend (Mike is sceptical).

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sit down.
(Phoebe and Mike sit next to each other)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh wow wow wow!! Make room for your friend! (sits herself down between them)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (to Phoebe) So how've you been?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I've been pretty good!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (to Phoebe) You look really beautiful.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks, you look good too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no no no no... this is dangerous territory. Keep it clean!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So how's the piano playing going?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Actually I've been playing a lot of love songs lately. I've missed you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I've missed you too.
(Silence)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know, on the way over here, I saw this drunk guy throw up. And then a pigeon ate it!

scenes.location: Ross's Apartment: Ross is doing something on his laptop when Chandler walks in

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, Ross, I just wanted to apologize... (­looks at laptop screen)..don't tell me you actually made those gay pictures of me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: uhu uhu, check this out. (Chandler sits down and looks at laptop screen)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Huh! So that's what I would look like if I worked out... and was being serviced by a policeman. You're not actually going to send these out are ya?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Eh..actually no, I don't need to because your little "Ross is dead" joke didn't work, ok, there were no responses. Nobody posted anything on the website, nobody called my parents, so the joke my friend is on you. Nobody called, nobody wrote anything, nobody cares that I'm dead. (silence) Oh my God! Nobody cares that I'm dead!?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, come on, you know that's not true.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you talking about? You get sixty responses just for coming out of the closet! I didn't get one response! And I'm dead!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, the gay community is a lot more vocal than the dead community.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe this. Not even my geology lab partner? And I carried that guy! (gets up from his sofa)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright look, let's think about this, ok, do you really think that people are gonna stir up your family at this tragic time? That people are gonna post condolences on a website? This is not about people not caring that you're dead .This is about people not having a decent outlet for their grief.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're right. There isn't a decent outlet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Right, I mean, come on, I'm sure that if you had a funeral or a memorial service, tons of people would come.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Exactly!! (sits back down at his laptop and starts typing)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross, what're you... what're you... what are you doing? (looks at laptop screen)You're having a memorial service for yourself!?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! That would be stupid! You're having it for me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross, don't press send, don't press se... !

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: oh, too late, too late! It's sent... oops sorry and so is the picture of you and the police man...

scenes.location: Joey's room: Joey is sitting on his bed reading DooL transcript when Rachel walks in

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm trying to put Emma down for a nap, have you seen Hugsy?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Original or crappy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Original.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, sorry haven't seen him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Then what's that big lump under your covers?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's Monica, ok?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's not Monica!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright!! Fine! It's original Hugsy! No, now I know that Emma wants him but he's mine and I need him..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to herself) Oh God.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ... she's being unreasonable!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (yelling) Joey, there is a reason that Emma loves that stupid penguin so much (Joey covers Hugsy's ears) Oh don't cover its ears! (stops yelling) It's because it reminds her of her uncle Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It does?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! And she's comforted by him because she loves her uncle Joey so much.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? She... she loves me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! But you know what? If you need Hugsy, don't worry. Emma will totally understand. I won't... but whatever (She leaves the room).

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, wait wait wait wait a minute wait a minute, I mean Rach, I mean if if... . If Hugsy means that much to Emma then... well she can have him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oooh... you're sweet, I knew uncle Joey would step up. (Turns to face Emma in the the playpen) Look Emma, look who's baaack!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look forget it forget it... I can't do it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you gonna... you're going to take Hugsy away from a little child?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How do you think I got him in the first place?

scenes.location: Phoebe's apartment: Phoebe, Monica and Mike sitting on the couch

lines.text: (Monica is getting up from the couch)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright you two, I'm gonna go to the bathroom. Now I don't want anything going on while I'm gone. Here's a few things you can discuss: mucus, fungus and the idea of me and Ross doing it.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I've missed you so much! No, I'm not gonna ask you to get back together because I know we want different things, but just to be with you one more night.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, I want that too, but IS that going to make it too hard?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: It can't be any harder than this... I mean, If I had known the last time I saw you would be the last time, I... I would have stopped to memorize your face, the way you move, everything about you. If I had known the last time I kissed you would have been the last time... I never would have stopped.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (running back into the room) Kiss him, you fool!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Didn't you hear that speech? If you don't kiss him then I will!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I missed you so much! (she kisses Mike)

lines.speaker: Strange man
lines.text: (he bounds into the house) I knew you'd be here!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh, crap!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who is this?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: My friend Manny. I asked him to keep me away from you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, that's what I'm doing for Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Manny
lines.text: Well, you are not doing a very good job!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Manny
lines.text: What's with the kissing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, at least I knew where my guy was.

lines.speaker: Manny
lines.text: Oh yeah yeah, thank God you were here to oversee all the kissing!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You didn't hear the speech!

lines.speaker: Manny
lines.text: I've heard the speech: (in a mocking voice) "if he knew it was gonna be the last time he saw her... "

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, it was very moving! You're just heartless!

lines.speaker: Manny
lines.text: You're weak!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're... weird!

lines.speaker: Manny
lines.text: Your pants are undone!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh (realizes her pants are undone and zips them up)!

lines.speaker: Manny
lines.text: (looking at the sofa) Where did they go?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Damn it!

lines.speaker: Manny
lines.text: Oh we blew it. I blame myself.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And I blame you too.

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's been an hour and not one of my classmates has shown up! I tell you, when I actually die some people are gonna get seriously haunted!
(someone knocks on the door)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There you go! Someone came!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, ok! I'm gonna go hide! Oh, this is so exciting, my first mourner! (he hides in the bedroom and closes the door)
(Chandler and Monica go open the door)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, glad you could come.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (in a mournful voice) Please, come in.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Hi, you're Chandler Bing, right? I'm Tom Gordon, I was in your class.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yes, yes... let me... take your coat.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Thanks... uh... I'm so sorry about Ross, it's...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: At least he died doing what he loved... watching blimps (he goes in the bedroom)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who is he?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Some guy, Tom Gordon.

lines.speaker: Ross
