lines.text: I don't remember him, but then again I touched so many lives. (they press their ears against the door)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, did you know Ross well?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Oh, actually I barely knew him. Yeah, I came because I heard Chandler's news. D'you know if he's seeing anyone?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (a bit surprised) Yes, he is. Me.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: What? You... You... Oh! Can I ask you a personal question? Ho-how do you shave your beard so close?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering, very upset) Ok Tommy, that's enough mourning for you! Here we go, bye bye!! (he shoves him out the door)

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: (before leaving) Hey, listen. Call me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok! (shuts the door behind Tom)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (coming in) I'm dead and no one cares?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I look like a man??

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Please, one ridiculous problem at a time!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It isn't ridiculous, look around! No one's here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You gave them one day's notice, not everyone in our class checks the web site everyday and Monica... it's probably the way you stand!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, you're right. Still somebody must have seen it... I mean, I went to that school for 4 years, I didn't have an impact on anyone?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that's not true. You had an impact on me, I mean, it's 15 years later and we're still best friends. Doesn't that count for something?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sceptical) Yeah...
(someone knocks on the door) Oh, great. More party boys for Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sure it's somebody for you. Now, go hide. (Ross hides in the bedroom again)
(Chandlers opens the door. A beautiful woman stands at the doorway.)

lines.speaker: Kori
lines.text: Hi. I'm here for Ross Geller's memorial service.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kori? Kori Weston?

lines.speaker: Kori
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! You look amazing!

lines.speaker: Kori
lines.text: And you are...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Chandler, Chandler Bing. I'm not gay, I'm not gay at all.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You are married though.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don't listen to him, he's in a really bad mood! (lets her in)

lines.speaker: Kori
lines.text: I can't believe that Ross is gone. It is just so sad.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn't know Ross and you were so close.

lines.speaker: Kori
lines.text: We weren't but we had one class together. He was such a great guy and he talked so passionately about science. I always remembered him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sure that would mean a lot to him. And if heaven has a door, I'm sure he's pressing his ear up against it and listening intently.

lines.speaker: Kori
lines.text: I thought so many times about calling him and asking him out. I guess I really missed my chance.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he bounds into the lounge room) But you didn't! I'm still alive!! Kori, I know this is a big surprise for you. It's a long story but the things you just said really made my day! I mean, the fact that you are here means more to me than if this room were filled with people!

lines.speaker: Kori
lines.text: You sick freak, who does that? I can't believe I had a crush on you! (she leaves and slams the door behind her)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did you hear that? Kori Weston had a crush on me!!
Ending Credits

scenes.location: Ross' apartment

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on the phone) No Mum, I'm not dead. I know it's not something to kid about. It was just a practical joke between Chandler and me, but it's over, ok? (pause) Actually no, even if I had died, you would not be left childless. (pause) Monica?

title: The One with the Lottery

lines.text: Friends - 918 - The one with the lottery
Friends
918 - The one with the lottery

lines.speaker: Teleplay
lines.text: Sherry Bilsing - Graham & Ellen Plummer

lines.speaker: Story
lines.text: Brian Buckner & Sebastian Jones

lines.speaker: Directed by
lines.text: Gary Halvorson

lines.speaker: Transcribed by
lines.text: Eleonora, Pheeboh, Roni & Vanessa
[Scene: Central Perk - Chandler, Monica, Phoebe, Ross
and Rachel are sitting on the sofas. Joey enters]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica, hey, can I borrow the Porsche?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But ehm...what is it not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (abashed) A place to entertain my lady friends.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And what else is it not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (even more abashed) A place to eat spaghetti.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Very good! (Gives him the keys) What do you need it
for anyway?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well, the powerball lottery is upto 300 million and
they don't sell tickets here in New York, so...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! So you're driving up to Connecticut?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (hesitates for a moment)Yeah Connecticut...Not West
Virginia.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, maybe I'll drive you up there! I'd like to buy
some tickets myself!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah with Chandler not getting paid, we could really
use 300 million dollars.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, because if I was at my old job we'd say 300
million? No thank you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey will you get me tickets too?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah me too. oh! I have an idea. Why don't we all
pitch in 50 bucks, we'll pool our money together and then if we win,
we'll split it!

lines.speaker: Everyone almost simultaneously except Ross
lines.text: yeah thats a great
idea!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No thanks!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You don't wanna win the lottery?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in a mocking voice)Uh...sure I do, and I also wanna
be King of my own country and find out what happened to Amelia Earhart.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Still on Amelia Earhart?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The woman just vanished!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Seriously, Ross, you don't want in on this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! Do you know what your odds are of winning the
lottery? I...I mean you have a better chance of being struck by
lightning 42 times.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes but there's six of us so we'd only have to get
struck by lightning 7 times.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I like those odds!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Seriously you guys, I can't believe you're going to
spend 250 dollars on the lottery, I mean that's such a bunch of boohaki.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking around at the others)I'll ask. (To Ross)
Boohaki?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh oh, we think Emma is about to start talking so we're
trying to be careful about what words we use in front of her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah so get ready to hear alot of ehm...boohaki,
goshdarnit and brotherpucker.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How do you know she's gonna start talking?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well when I talk to her I almost feel like she
understands what I'm saying.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kinda like Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (who wasn't paying attention)What's that now?
Opening credits
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Monica,
Chandler, Rachel and Joey are in the kitchen]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God! Look at all these tickets! It's so exciting! You
know I haven't won anything since the sixth grade.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pie eating contest?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! You assume because I was heavy that's the only way
I could win something?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I saw a picture of you covered in blueberries.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (smiling)That was a good day!
(Suddenly Ross comes running into the apartment)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (yelling to Monica)They're towing your car, they're
towing your car!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm parked in a garage on Morton!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (panting)They're towing a car. And I am seeing...spots.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sounding panicky)Oh my god Ross! You don't have Emma!
And Rachel you don't have Emma! (Starts yelling) Where's Emma? Who has
Emma!?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey relax! My mother picked her up two hours ago. You
were there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (not yelling anymore)I was?

lines.speaker: Racel
lines.text: Yes and you talked to her...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I did?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She dropped off a casserole?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah! The casserole lady.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Ross)So, did you come by to watch us win the big
bucks?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, uh... and then I figured after you win, we could
all go out to the balcony and see a night rainbow with gremlins dancing
on top of it!
(phone starts ringing and Chandler comes running out of the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (hysterical)Don't touch the phone! I'll get it, I'll
get it, I'll get it!! (picks up the phone)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Monica)Think he washed his hands?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (into receiver)Hello? Hey Charlie, what do you know?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Monica)What's going on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler is supposed to find out if he's getting an
assistent job at his ad agency. But out of the 15 interns, they are
only hiring three.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh! Tough odds!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (mockingly)Yeah if only it were a sure thing like your
24 state lottery!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling)Look who's coming around!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (still on the phone)Damnit. Alright call me when
you know more.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (excited)Did you get it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: One of the slots got filled.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Still excited)By you!?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sense the tone! No that kid Nate got it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! I hate that guy! I mean come on kid! Pull up your
pants!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, there's two spots left right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah...I mean I want this so much! I mean, I wanna
get one, I want my friend Charlie to get one...Except I don't care
about Charlie.
(Phoebe enters)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (excited)Hey you guys! Ok, you're not going to
believe this! I just saw my psychic and she said I was definitely gonna
win the lottery tonight!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey that reminds me, I thought we could use some extra
luck so I brought a wishbone home from work.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (mockingly)A psychic AND a wishbone? Guys! Give someone
else a chance!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, who wants to do it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh can I? Vegetarians never get to do the wishbone.
It's really not fair either! You know, just because we don't eat the
meat doesn't mean we don't like to play with the carcasses!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, hey Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, I'm good, I don't wanna get that turkey smell
all over my hands.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'll do it!! It'll get the casserole stink off of mine.
(Phoebe and Joey both grab one side of the wishbone)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I hope I win!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it doesn't really matter ... you're both wishing
for the same thing, right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't tell you what I'm wishing for! Else...you
know...won't come true!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Right! .. but we "know" what you're wishing for!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Can't really say!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I understand, but you're wishing for what we think
you're wishing for, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (slightly irritated)I'm not really comfortable with
these questions!
Rachel, Chandler and Monica: Please, just do it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: One, two, three!
(they break the wishbone)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I won, hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what, I'm sure your wish is gonna come true,
but, you guys - just in case, maybe a genie will come out if we rub
this lamp! (rubs lamp, stops because it's very hot) Ah!! That thing
gets hot!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know, Ross, just keep making your jokes. How are
you gonna feel if we actually do win?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, you're not gonna win.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I know, I know, the odds are against us, but
somebody has to win, and it could be us! And then how you gonna feel?
You know, we're gonna be all like "oh everybody, let's take our
helicopters up to the cape" and you're gonna be all like "oh, I can't
guys, I'll meet you guys up there, I gotta gas up the Hyundai"

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, I've heard myself on tape and I sound nothing like
that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can see the headline now: "Lottery winners' friend
filled with regret eats own arm".

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why would I eat my own arm?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well you wouldn't, but we own the paper, we can
print whatever we want.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what, Ross? I'm gonna throw in 50 bucks for
you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because I know that you think the lottery is "boohaki"
but we're all here and gonna watch the numbers and have fun. And you're
my brother, and I want you to be a part of this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You don't have to do that, I'll pay for myself. But just
the fact that you want me to have fun with you guys - that's so sweet!
Come here (they kiss and hug)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Get a room!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, so now that you're in, what are you gonna do if
we win?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know, probably just invest it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh! Calm down ...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Seriously, that's your fantasy? To invest it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, did I say "invest it"? I meant "be cool
and piss it all away" (Joey and Chandler pleased)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, ooh, I know! We should pool all own money and buy
the Knicks!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't really care about the Knicks.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you will when I pick you as starting forward.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (touched) You would do that? I never get picked!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, I'm not sure a sports team is the way to
go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're not gonna let me buy the Knicks?? I can't believe
you're taking this away from me!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're right, it has been you dream for over 15
seconds.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) Uh, how long until they announce the
numbers, Mommy?
(pause)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks around) I'll take this one too (to Ross) Uh
... Mommy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I've gotten into the habit of calling Rachel "Mommy"
when we're around Emma. Which I now realize we are not ...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm hoping that if she hears it enough it will be her
first word.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Although if we're gonna do that, we should probably call
me "Daddy" too.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oooh, I like that, "daddy" (in a sexy tone)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I ... I was just talking about Rachel.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (still in sexy tone) Oooh, is daddy getting angry? Is
daddy gonna spank me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (tries to be sexy too) Well that depends ... have you
been a baaad gi .. (stops) no I can't.
(Phone rings, Chandler picks up)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello? Hello? Oh, hey Charlie. Did anybody else
hear? ... What? Susan got it?? How? Oh man, I would have slept with
him!! .. Alright, bye. (hangs up)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, I'm sorry. But hey, there's one spot left, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well no, Charlie's gonna get that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, don't say that! You got just as good a chance as
anybody else of getting that job!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He's the boss's son.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come on, lottery!! (everybody cheers)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, you guys, it starts in like 20 minutes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, here we go. We need to sort out the tickets as
quickly as possible to see if we've won. So does anybody have any ideas
how to organize this? (doesn't let them answer) Ok, how about this: we
divide them into 6 groups of 40, and the remaining 10 can be read by
whoever finishes their pile first.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I have another idea!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry, idea time is over.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, well, are all the tickets in the bowl?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What about the ones you have on the nightstand?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There are no tickets on the nightstand!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes there are, I just saw them a few minutes ago.
(Rachel get suspicious)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Un, no you didn't! You must be mistaken!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, there are like 20 tickets on the nightstand!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, sense the tone!!
(Rachel comes out of their bedroom waving tickets)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, well, well, look what mommy found!!
(everyone's shocked)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, fine!! I bought 20 extra tickets for me and
Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh! The psychic also said that I would be betrayed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe this, I thought we were all in this
together!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, you just got in 5 minutes ago!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 3 minutes ago!!! I don't know why that's important ...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was with you the whole time we were in Connecticut,
when did you even get those?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When you were reading the dirty magazines without
taking off the plastic!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross) I'll show you how.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, well Monica, suppose one of your "special" tickets
win? How are you gonna feel when you win the lottery and you lose all
your friends?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please ... if I win the lottery, you guys are not
gonna leave me. Someone gave me a basket of mini-muffins last week and
I couldn't get rid of you for 3 days!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chandler, would you just tell her what she did was
wrong?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Mon) She's right, you shouldn't have bought
tickets just for us ...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ahhh! (shocked)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me finish ... (to everyone else) however, it
doesn't look like I'm gonna get this job so I can't afford to have
principles, so screw you, the tickets are ours!! (takes tickets from
Rachel)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There's the man I married!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, believe me.If you win the lottery, it's
the last you're gonna hear from us!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine! Don't be my friends! I'll buy new friends!
Yeah, and then I'll pay for their plastic surgery so they'd look just
like you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (surprised) OH! Alright, you know what? That's it! I
want my share of the tickets (picks up the bowl)!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I want my tickets too (takes the bowl from
Rachel)! And I'm buying the Knicks! And Steffi Graff, ah ah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Than I want mine, too (takes the bowl from Joey)! And
if I win I'm gonna put it all into a very low-yield bond.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you guys! We've got to keep all the tickets
together (takes the bowl from Ross and puts it on the table)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, no! We should divide them up (picks up the bowl)
and I should get extra because we used my card to buy them!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, if anybody gets extra tickets, it should be me!
This all thing was my idea! (takes the bowl from Monica)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Thanks for inventing the lottery!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, that's it! Just give'em to me! I'll split them
up! (she tries to snatch the bowl from Joey's hands but she can't, so
she pinches his nipple and she manages to take it)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in pain) Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (she takes the bowl from Rachel's hands and she
starts running around the room and yelling) OOOOOHHHHH!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (trying to stop her) Hey, hey!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (keeping on running and yelling) OOOOOHHHHH! (she
stops) Fine, I can't take it anymore! I'm putting an end to this! (she
goes out to the balcony)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, if she jumps, I get her tickets.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no! (they all go towards the balcony but they get
jammed in the window)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If we are not doing it together, we're not doing it
at all! So, say goodbye to your tickets! (She holds out the bowl, and
makes as to drop the tickets on the street).

lines.speaker: Everyone
lines.text: NO!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don't come any closer!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can I come a little bit closer, valuable things are
getting squished...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, what's more important, your friends or money?

lines.speaker: Everyone but Monica
lines.text: Friends!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Money! (they all look at her) Friends...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Monica, what about your extra tickets?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They're all in there! Even these five that I hid in
my bra (takes some tickets out of her bra and gives them to Phoebe)...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, good! (pause) You guys were so scared! There was
no way I was gonna dump this...(a pigeon swoops down, scaring Phoebe
who drops the bowl on the street) Oh God, no! (pause) I think I broke
your bowl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Go, go, go!!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment.

lines.text: (All are returning from the street after picking up dropped lottery
tickets)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What a beautiful night to be running around the
street, looking for tickets. And the wind sure made it fun.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, we lost half of them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, what? Monica, we have the winning ticket! My
psychic said I was gonna win, remember?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Weird.. your psychic didn't mention anything about the
scary pigeon...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: As a matter of fact she said that's how I am going to
die. (pause ) So, excuse me for being a little skittish.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking at the answering machine) Hey, there's two
messages. These could be from work!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, play them!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, here we go! (he pushes the play button)

lines.speaker: Message
lines.text: (Phoebe's voice) "Hello. Th-this is the pigeon from
the balcony calling to apologise" (they all turns to look at Phoebe) "I
sh.. I shouldn't have knocked the tickets out of the pretty lady's
hand. It-it was all my fault. Not hers. Bye. Coo."
(they all keep staring at Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I bet that was very hard for him to do.

lines.speaker: Second message
lines.text: "Hey Chandler, it's Charlie"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is..shhh!

lines.speaker: Second Message
lines.text: "Listen, oh... it turns I got the last spot.
I'm really sorry man, it was a lot of fun working with you. Give me a
call if you want."

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God, I am so sorry honey...

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, so sorry man! Sorry!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it is so unfair. It's like that time they
promoted Sandra over me at work.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, is she related to Ralph Lauren?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, she was just much better at job than me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Guys, the drawing is about to start!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Ross) You know what? We should call my mum's
house and say goodnight to Emma before she goes down.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, it's a good idea!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (she hugs Chandler) Honey, you've been really strong
about this, I know how badly you wanted that job.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, you know, I really thought I deserved it.
(pause) But... let's go win the lottery... I mean, we still have 130
chances to win, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (she draws out a ticket from a pocket of her pants)
131! (they kiss)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on the phone) Goodnight sweetheart! I love you. And
remember, you're daddy's little girl... (covering the phone, to Rachel)
Phoebe's totally ruined that for me... (he passes the receiver to
Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi mum, put her back on!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sitting on the sofa in front of the tv) Rach, come on!
They are announcing the numbers! My God, I can already feel myself
changing.

lines.speaker: TV
lines.text: "Here we are, the official Powerball numbers! We have 53"

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I got that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, we have one too!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We are on a roll, people!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (calling Rachel) Come on!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the phone) Mum, please!I know you love your new
lips, but I can barely understand you! Would you, please, just let me
say goodnight to my daughter?

lines.speaker: TV
lines.text: "And number 29! Here we go! The Powerball is 7"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Check your numbers! Make me rich!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she goes towards the others and she's very excited)
Guys, you're not gonna believe this! I was just saying goodnight to
Emma and she said her first words!!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And what did she say?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She said "gleba"!! (she celebrates)
(they just look at her for a moment; then they go back to checking
the tickets)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Make me rich!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Ross) Isn't that amazing?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, no no no...that's great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why-why aren't you more excited?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, Rach...oh..."gleba" is not a word.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, but of course it is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, what does it mean?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know all the words.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm just, I'm just glad I didn't miss my daughter's
first words (goes back to checking the tickets).

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes you did, gleba is a word!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, use it in a sentence.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok... "Emma just said gleba"!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's not a word!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, okay, okay, fine, I'm gonna look it up (she goes
and picks up the dictionary).

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, oh, ok, great. You know what, while you're at it she
said another word the other day, why don't you, why don't you look up:
pbbqqt....
(Rachel glares at him)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (searching the dictionary) Alright, okay, okay, gleba,
gleba... (excited) Gleba! Ha! Here it is: the fleshy, spore-bearing
inner mass of a certain fungi.
(Rachel shows Ross the definition on the dictionary, giving him a
smug look; then she squints at the dictionary, as though unsure what to
make out of it)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She's gonna be a scientist! (kisses Rachel on the head,
very moved)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (checking the last ticket) Damnit! anybody got anything?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm still looking through mine...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just double checking (does so)...no, no, no...(takes off a shoe and takes a ticket out of it) No!
(phone rings)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (answering phone) Hello? Hold on. It's your boss.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ah, the "I'm sorry I rejected you" phone call. I'm
not used to getting it from guys. (on the phone, getting up from the
sofa) Hey, Steve.

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Chandler, hi! I'm sure you've heard we filled the three
positions. We just felt that with your maturity and experience, you
wouldn't be happy being someone's assistant.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh no no no no, I'd love to be somebody's assistant!
Answering phones, getting coffee, I live for that stuff! And I'm not
too mature... farts, boobies, butt cracks!

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Chandler, you were the strongest person in the program.
We're offering you the position of junior copywriter.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me, that guy who just said butt cracks?

lines.speaker: Steve
lines.text: Yes, that's right. We're excited about the level of
sophistication you'll be bringing to the job.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok well, thanks, you won't regret it. I'll see you
tomorrow (hangs up).
(he idly goes to the sofa, starts browsing a magazine. Everybody
stares at him)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? (pause) Oh, yeah, I'm gonna be a junior
copywriter.

lines.speaker: Everybody
lines.text: (excited) Oh my God, congratulations!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh sweetie, I'm so proud of you!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Does that mean I get the good loving tonight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You bet! No TV or anything! (she gets up from the sofa
and goes to the kitchen area)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Chandler) Hey, that is so great about the job.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks, man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And I like to think I had a little something to do with
it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, before, with the wishbone... I didn't wish we
would win the lottery, I wished you'd get the job.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiling, surprised) Oh yeah? (looks towards the
kitchen, worried) Listen, don't tell Monica, she'll rip your heart
right out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what? There is a little part of me that
really thought we were gonna win.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Me too. So much for my dinosaur/Amelia Earhart theme
park.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys, what was the Powerball number again?

lines.speaker: Monica and Ross
lines.text: Seven.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We won.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We won!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let me see!
(they all jump up excitedly and try to see the ticket)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don't tear it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, you don't have any of the first five numbers.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know that, but look, we've got the Powerball number,
we've won 3 dollars!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow, you'd think we should get that over 20 years or
go for the big payout.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (still very excited) I don't care, I've never won
anything before, I can't believe this!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So Pheebs, what are you going to do with your $3?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's not all mine. We all get 50 cents.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what? You can have mine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Me too.
(they all look at Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I guess if everybody else is...

title: The One with Rachel's Dream

lines.text: Friends 919 - The one with Rachel's dream

919 - The one with Rachel's dream

scenes.location: Rachel and Joey's apartment

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (talking to a pineapple in his hand) God, you're beautiful...why are we fighting this?You know you want it to happen as much as I do.
(Rachel comes out of her room and starts staring at him unseen)Joey: I want you.I need you.Let me make love to you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't wanna stand in the way of true love or anything, but I think a
cantaloupe might hurt less.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, ehm...I'm...I'm rehearsing my lines.They gave me a big romantic story on Days Of Our Lives. It's the first time my character's got one. I'm so nervous, you know, I really want it to be good!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Woow!I haven't seen you this worked up since you did that dog food commercial and you thought you were gonna be with a real talking dog!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, that was a disappointment...(pause) Oh, hey!D'you want to come down to the set and tell me if I'm doing ok?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (excited) Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!Hey, you just have to promise not to get yourself thrown out again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey, that was an honest mistake!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right!(he starts to ape her)"Oh my God, is this the men's room? Oh, I feel so foolish, have you always known you wanted to be an actor?" (he inclines his head as if to look at a man's private parts)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, that was an awesome day!
Opening credits

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, do you guys wanna come and eat dinner at the restaurant sometime in the next few weeks?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'd love to!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well you can't! We're booked solid for the next month!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I can't give you a massage, because my licence has been revoked again!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, what happened?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it was an accident...You know, it's a lot of oil and sometimes the hand just slips!
(Chandler enters)Chandler: (To Monica) Have I got a surprise for you? Pack your bags!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no!You guys aren't supposed to get divorced for 7 years!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What? No, I'm taking Monica to a romantic inn in Vermont (shows them a brochure)!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, good!Ok, good for you!Try to recapture the magic!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, what do you say? Can you get out of work?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, honey!I can't. I was just telling these guys that things are crazy at the restaurant!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you really that busy?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I'm sorry. I really am.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that's ok.I'll just try and reschedule. (on the phone) "Hi, this is Chandler Bing. I made a reservation there and I need to change it (pause) Oh, what do you mean it's not refundable? Can I just come some other time? (pause) Oh, can't you make an exception?"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Tell them I'm a chef in a big New York restaurant!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And tell them that in 2 weeks I will once again be a masseuse in good standing!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on the phone) "Look, this is ridiculous! I'm not paying for that room! Ok?" (pause) "Oh, thank you very much!" (hangs up) Yeah, I'm going to Vermont...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, don't worry about it! Just use your travel insurance.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't have travel insurance.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, this is what happens when people live on the edge!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why don't you take Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, don't you think that would be a little weird? I mean, two guys in a romantic inn...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, not if their room has two beds!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (browsing the brochure) I guess...It still seems a little...(enthusiastically) moonlight boat ride!!

scenes.location: Days of Our Lives' Studios

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Joey, is this the bed where Olivia lost her virginity?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know, but one of the extras sure did! (pause) Hey, listen Rach. Thanks again for coming down to watch my scenes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, please!Honey, just the fact that you want me here to support you, I'm...OH MY GOD!Is that Christian Sanders?He's so gorgeous!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Also so gay!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, in my head he's done some pretty "not-gay-stuff"!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, at the Christmas party him and Santa did some definitely gay stuff!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Joey, Joey! We're ready for you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, wish me luck!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, not that you need it but good...GOD!Is that Chase Lassiter?He's straight, right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach, I gotta say...if you weren't here wondering if these guys were gay I don't know if I could do this!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, you're right.I'm sorry, good luck! (they hug)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: On a bell please! Quietly.. and ACTION!
(the scene starts.Joey enters and there's a girl wearing a wedding dress near a bed)Actress/Olivia: Drake! What are you doing in here?
Joey/Drake: Stopping you from marrying the wrong man and making the biggest mistake of your life.
Actress/Olivia: Get out!
Joey/Drake: You don't love him!
Actress/Olivia: What do you know about love?
Joey/Drake: I know what I felt that night when we kissed under the bridge.
Actress/Olivia: That kiss never happened.
Joey/Drake: Oh, what about this one.
(the actress slaps him)Rachel: (watching a television where the scene is shown, startled) OH!
Actress/Olivia: No, I told you...get out!
Joey/Drake: Fine. I'll go. But let me ask you one question...

lines.speaker: Chase Lassiter
lines.text: (talking to Rachel) You look familiar, have we...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: SSSHHHHTTT!!He's asking her a question!!
Joey/Drake: Can you really live the rest of your life never knowing what we could have been?
Actress/Olivia: I don't have a choice...
Joey/Drake: Yes, you do.Yes...you do. I'm the one who doesn't have a choice because I...because I can't stop loving you.
Actress/Olivia: Don't say that...
Joey/Drake: Tell me to stop, just...tell me to stop. (he's about to kiss her)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: CUT!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: NO! (pause) Or, cut!You know, that's your call!

scenes.location: Monica's restaurant

lines.text: 1st Customer: Everything was delicious!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you!
2nd Customer: It was. The duck in particular was superb.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you!(she looks at the 3rd customer waiting for a compliment) You haven't said anything...
3rd Customer: Actually I do have one small complaint.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh..please!I-I welcome criticism.
3rd Customer: The musician right outside the restaurant...it's kind of a mood-killer!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What musician?

scenes.location: Outside the restaurant

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (playing guitar and singing) And there's a country called Argentinaaaa, it's a place I've never seeeeen. But I'm told for fifty pesos you can buy a human spleen. Humaaan spleeeeen. Olè!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you doing here!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, you said that you had customers lined up in the street, so I am here to entertain!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! It really has been great too, you know, some of this people must have seen me play before because they were requesting a bunch of my songs! Yeah, "You suck" and "shut up and go home".

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Listen Phoebe...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know how much I love listening to your music, you know, but...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But what?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is kind of a classy place.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (pause) Ok, say no more.
[Time lapse: Phoebe in front of restaurant again]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (with a fancy dress, still playing and singing): It wasn't just that she was fat, the woman smelled like garbage! Everyone! It wasn't just that she was fat the woman smelled like garbaaaaaage! (to Monica, showing her dress) Classy, uh?
(Monica covers her face with her hands)[Scene: hall of the romantic inn in Vermont]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, Chandler Bing, I have a reservation.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Welcome to the Chestnut Inn Mr. Bing, so where are you joining from?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: New York.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (in a strange voice and eating candies) The big apple!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry, he's a little bit wound up, we had to stop at every maple candy stand on the way here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I ate all my gifts for everybody.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: I am sorry Mr. Bing, there's no record of your reservation in the computer.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, that's impossible, can you check again, please?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (high pitched voice) Check again please!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: I'm sorry, it's not here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me get this straight. I called yesterday trying to cancel my reservation and I was told it was not refundable, then we drove six hours all the way up here and now you tell me that we don't have a reservation?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: I don't know what to say.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (mumbling) She doesn't know what to say!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Just give us the cheapest room you have.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Unfortunatly the only thing we have available is our deluxe suite, the rate is six hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's insane!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Totally insane. Dude, let's drive home, we'll hit all the maple candy stores on the way back and if...if they're closed maybe we'll tap a tree and make some ourselves.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Does that room have a closet I can lock him in? (pause) We'll take it.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (aside, to Ross) What!? They are totally ripping us off!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude, don't worry 'bout it! I know how we can make your money back! This is a nice hotel, you know, plenty of amenities, we just load up on those! Like those apples. Instead of taking one, I'm... I take six!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great, at a hundred dollars an apple, we're there!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mon, you get the idea, ow-ow-ow we'll make our money back in no time!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dude, you're shaking!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I think it's the sugar, could you hold the apple?

scenes.location: Joey's apartment

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, I gotta tell ya, I've been thinking all day about that scene you did, I mean, you were amazing!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you know, the writing was good, and the director is good, and... and my co-star's good but they're not as good as me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God, you have to tell me what happens tomorrow!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ow, I'm just going over the script now! You wanna read lines with me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Me? Oh, no, I am not an actress.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, all right, I can ask Monica.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh screw her, that part is mine!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right... (pause) ok, so just from the top of the page, right here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (pause).(acting) Hello Drake, I'm surprised to see you here.
Joey/Drake: I can't believe you married him.
Rachel/actress: But what choice did I have. He was keeping my sister in a dungeon!
Joey/Drake: So what about us? Everything we feel for each other.
Rachel/actress: It's over! You have to accept that.

Joey/Drake: How can I? Knowing I'll never hold you in my arms again, or touch your skin, or feel your lips, knowing I'll never make love to you? How can I accept that... I can never kiss you again when it's all I can do not to kiss you right now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause) Kiss me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Kiss me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, Rach, it doesn't say that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I'm saying...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: but, but..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: just... don't talk... (she kisses him)

scenes.location: Rachel's bedroom

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (waking up) Ehhh, aw! (pause). Well, that's new!

scenes.location: Hotel's room

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (on the phone) Hi, this is Ross Geller in suite 206. It seems you forgot a couple of things. Could you have some complimentary toiletries sent up to my room? (pause) Thank you! Ok. Toothbrush, toothpaste, razor, mouthwash, deodorant, dental floss, band aids, shaving cream, after shave... and I feel like I am forgetting something... Is there anything else you have that I haven't asked for already? (pause) Yeah, go ahead, send up some tampons.
(Chandler enters the room)Ross: What did you get?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: USA Today

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nice, put it with the others.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I also got... two more apples.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We are four short of a bush-o (pause). God I feel so alive, I love being in the country!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I also got this great salt and pepper shaker from the restaurant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, that's not cool.

lines.speaker: Chandlers
lines.text: Dude, none of this is cool.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, Chandler, you have to find the line between stealing and taking what the hotel owes you. For example: hair drier, no, no, no, but shampoo and conditioners, yes, yes, yes. (pause) Now, the salt shaker is off-limits, but the salt (he opens the salt shaker and pours the salt into his hand) I wish I'd thought this through.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think I know what you mean though...the lamp is the hotel's, but the bulbs (goes to take the bulb)...oh, you already got that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not my first time in a hotel, my friend.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, how about this (picks up the remote control)?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no, you can't take the remote control!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but the batteries...
(Ross claps his hands)Chandler: Thank you, thank you very much!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let's celebrate with some maple candy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: At least tell me where you hid it.

scenes.location: Central Perk. Monica and Rachel are sitting on the sofa

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can I ask you a question?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Have you ever had any weird romantic dreams?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let me think. Oh, when I was younger I used to dream that I got married to Mayor McCheese, and on our wedding night I ate his head.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, well this is like that...in no way. I had a...I had a dream last night that I wanted to kiss Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, do you mean like kiss him-kiss him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah! I mean, that was pretty intense.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you think brought than on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know! I mean, maybe that's something to do with the fact that I saw him do a love scene yesterday.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: A love scene? With who?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Olivia.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Olivia? I thought she was marrying Connor! (pause) Oh right, real life more important.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So do you think that my dream means anything?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know. I mean, you saw him do a love scene, so maybe you don't have a thing for Joey, maybe you have a thing for Drake.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah! Well it was Joey reading Drake's lines in the dream...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Of course it was! Trust me, when it comes to psychology I know what I'm talking about. I took two psych classes in college.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You took the same class twice.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was hard!
(Phoebe comes in)Phoebe: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Here, Monica, look what I got to wear when I play at the restaurant (she dons a top hat) uh, huh wait! (she raises a pair of spectacles to her eyes) Right? I mean, this might even class up the ballad of the uncircumcised man.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh...Phoebe? Maybe I wasn't clear before. I really love listening to your music here, but my restaurant is sort of an upscale place.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Right, yeah, ok, I'll ask the butler to fetch my diamonds out of the vault.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, it's not what you wear. It's sort of your songs... I just don't think you should play at the restaurant anymore.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, ok. Fine, I'll just, I'll take the hat back (she puts the hat in a bag and she crushes it angrily on the floor with her foot).
(silence)Rachel: Hey, so you guys, the funniest thing happened, at work...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My songs aren't good enough for your restaurant?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, we're still on that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I didn't say your songs were not good enough.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Then what's wrong with them? Would they not go with your tiny portions of pretentious food?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Tiny portions?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah well, "excuse me, I ordered the smoked salmon appetizer, but (peering through her spectacles) I can't see it, I can't see it"!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, it's not about quantity.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well...it's not about quality.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh really, you want to talk about quality? Have you heard of a key? It's what some people sing in.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well at least all my songs don't taste like garlic. Yeah, there are other ingredients Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, so that's what we're doing. You know, when I'm in the coffee house bopping along to one of your songs, I'm wearing ear plugs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ear plugs, or cloves of garlic?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what? I take back what I said before. You keep playing at the restaurant, because with your music driving people inside, my bar sales are going up like crazy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are people having, the garlic Martini?

scenes.location: Hotel's reception

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Here's your copy of the bill, we hope you enjoyed your stay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh we did, and you still have all your lamps.
(the receptions is puzzled. She goes in the back.)Chandler: Oh, I didn't factor in the room tax.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh dude, don't worry about it, I found an unattended maid's car. We're way ahead of the game.
(they make as if to go, but Ross notices something)Ross: Oh my god.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There's something new in the bowl.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, we have enough, just walk away.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, but I want...I want the pinecones!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There's a forest right outside.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's not the same.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, go quick!
(Ross starts stuffing pinecones in the suitcase. As the receptionist walks in, Chandler makes a bird's verse and Ross stops)Ross: (to the receptionist) Thank you for a delightful stay.
(he picks up the suitcase, which falls open, revealing all the stuff they have taken from the hotel. The receptionist just looks at them.)Ross: Oh, my maple candy!

scenes.location: In front of Monica's restaurant. Phoebe is playing

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (singing) Food here at 'Javu'..will kill you..the food here at 'Javu' ...will kill you..
(Monica comes out)Monica: Thank god, it's just you! I thought someone was swinging a bag of cats against the wall.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You'd better get back in that kitchen Monica, the garlic is not gonna overuse itself.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, you have to stop playing now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why? The only person my playing is bothering is you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah? Ok, let's settle this, come on!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (while Monica drags her in the restaurant) Get your garlic-peelers off me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the restuarant customers) Excuse me, excuse me, hi, I'm Monica Geller..I'm the head chef here.. (pauses as if waiting for something).. Ok, I was actually expecting a little applause there, but whatever! Ok, quick question: by a show of hands, how many of you were bothered by this woman's singing outside? (a few people raise their hands)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, ok, how many of you enjoyed the music outside? (a few people raise their hands) Ha!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, let me ask you this question: How many of you thought the music was fine, but not in keeping with the tone of the restaurant? (a few raise their hands again).

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, well, who identified the tone of this restaurant as pretentious comma garlicky?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok who thinks the food is delicious and a little pretention never hurt anyone? (a few raise their hands)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, well, alright, who thinks the food is fine, the music was fine, but your evening was ruined by this incessant poll taking? (all raise their hands).

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Excuse us! (then to Phoebe) Alright here's a question: Who was so worried about her restaurant being fancy that she made a big deal about her friend playing her music and feels really bad about it now? (raises her hand)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh...Who was so stupid and stubborn that she lashed out against her friend's cooking which she actually thinks is pretty great! (raises her hand)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry too... (they hug)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ooohh... hey! Wanna stick around and I'll whip you up some dinner?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! As long as it's free! Food here is ridiculously over-p...
(Monica seems to take it amiss)Phoebe: (smiling, raising her hand) Who's hoping the hand raising thing is still cute enough that you won't hate me?

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Rachel walks in

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, do you have peanut butter on the back of your head?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Touches the back of his head and licks his fingers) Oh man! I thought I got it all!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looks puzzled) How...how...?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was making a peanut butter smoothy, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: uh-huh

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And I couldn't find this little plastic thing (holds up plastic thing) that goes on top of the blender...and I thought...well... how important can that be, right...? Turns out very!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to herself) Wow...definitely just Drake...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What...how is it going with Drake?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh...I don't think it's going very well...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What...that scene I saw was so good!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I'm feeling really insecure about the one we are shooting tomorrow...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, is this that thing that you do when you say you're bad so I'll give you a compliment?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A little. Yeah no, I really am worried, you know, I mean I have to make it convincing that I'm in love with Olivia.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So...I've never played that!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh! Honey, it can't be that hard, I mean, you've been in love before?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh...well...just once...with you...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok...this could be a little awkward...I'm just going to blow past it... well can't you just use that method actor thing where you use your real life memories to help you in your performance?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looks at her for a moment) What the hell are you talking about??

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shakes her head) Alright, alright look, just uh... just try to remember how you felt when you were in love, and think about that when you're playing the scene.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (approvingly) Oh! ok, yeah, I think I can do that. Yeah ok, there's this party scene coming up.. and Olivia and her husband are there and all Drake wants to do is grab her and kiss her, but he can't... And that makes me think about all those times when I wanted to grab you and kiss you, but you didn't know so I would just pretend everything was cool, but really, it was killing me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looks touched) Joey, you never..you never talked about that before...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well.. hey, you know what else I could use? There's a scene where Drake sneaks into Olivia's bedroom, and she doesn't know he's there - which never happened with us! And he knows he shouldn't be there, but he just wants to look at her... you know? (In a romantic voice) And I remember all those mornings before you even put on your make-up, when I would think to myself, my God, she...is... beautiful... (Rachel looks very moved) and it hurts so much, cuz I knew I could never tell you (pauses, while looking at her with sentiment) but it was worth it just to be there looking at you.
(Joey and Rachel continue to look at each other in silence for a while)Joey: (excited) Thanks dude!!!This is GREAT!! (leaves Rachel very touched on the couch and goes into his room)

title: The One with the Soap Opera Party

lines.text: Friends - 920 - The one with the soap opera party
Friends
920 - The One With The Soap Opera Party

lines.speaker: Teleplay
lines.text: Andrew Reich & Ted Cohen

lines.speaker: Story

lines.text: Sheldon Epps
