scenes.location: Monica's apartment

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (enters the room) Hey, you guys, what are you doing tomorrow night?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (browsing through a diary) Well, let me see... I-I believe I'm... yes, falling asleep in front of the TV.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, my agent hooked me up with six tickets to a great play.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I could fall asleep at a play.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's a one-woman play called "Why don't you like me: a bitter woman's journey through life".

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It sounds interesting!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it does sound interesting, I mean, to listen to a woman complain for two hours, I don't think it gets bett... (Ross starts snoring, faking to fall asleep)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know, I know, we can drive, we can vote, we can work, what more do these broads want?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You guys are gonna have a great time, I promise!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? How come that you don't have to go!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I wish I could but I just found out that I have to be at work really early the next day, so I can't go, but, you know, take the extra ticket and invite whoever you want.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (browsing through a diary) Uh, let's see, who do I hate?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gets up from the sofa and moves to the kitchen but Joey blocks her way) Oh, sorry... Oops, sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (lifts Rachel up and moves her behind him so she can walk on) Hey, here you go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh... oooh... (pause) (Rachel is all bah-jiggity about Joey) oh, ah... (pause) (to Monica) Can I ask you a question?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you think it's possible for two friends to fool around and... and not have it be a big deal?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, I don't think it ever works. Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No reason.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, no, Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who do you wanna fool around with?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (with high pitched voice) Nobody, forget it!
(Monica points at Joey, Rachel turns and sees him)Rachel: (giggling and whispering) Maybe.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (whispering) You can't!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (whispering) Why? (Monica gesticulates mumbling something that starts with "because") Seriously I did not understand a word that you said.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: In the hall.

scenes.location: In the hall

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You wanna fool around with Joey?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! You know, ever since I had that dream about him, and can't get it out of my head! And what's the big deal, people do it all the time!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who? Who do you know that are friends that just fool around?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, off the top of my head... Don and Janet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who, who are they?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know them from work.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Both of them?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, one of them...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know, what were the names I just said?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, things can get incredibly complicated.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, all right, you're right, I won't do anything with Joey, I just thought that we (Joey enters the hall) Ok so that would be two cups of tarragon, one pound of baking soda and one red onion? (Joey enters his apartment)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What the hell are you cooking!
Opening credits[Scene: Central Perk, Ross enters]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, you guys won't believe what I have to do for work today.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but, Ross you chose a career of talking about dinosaurs.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (covering with his hand Chandler's face, like pretending he's not there) (to Monica) There're these two professors who are joining my department and I have to meet them here and show them around campus.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What's so bad about that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's I just know they're gonna be a couple of windbags wearing tweed jackets with suede elbow patches.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (fingering her elbow): Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking his elbow, where there's a patch) These aren't suede.
(a woman walks in)Charlie: (to Gunther) Excuse me, I'm looking for someone. You don't, by any chance, know a Ross Geller?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi, hi, I'm Ross Geller.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, hi. I'm professor Wealer.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, oh, that's, that's, that's nice.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: It's a... It's good to meet you! Thank you so much for taking the time out to show me around.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no, it's no big deal, I mean, if I weren't doing this I'd just, you know, be at the gym working out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Chandler) Is he gonna introduce us?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Monica) No, I think we're just blurry shapes to him now.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: And, by the way, I really enjoyed your paper on the connection between geographic isolation and rapid mutagenesis.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, ha, I wrote that in one minute.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to chandler) Twenty bucks says they're married within the month.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (hitting Monica with his suitcase) (to Charlie) We should probably get going, you know, we got a lot of ground to cover.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, ah, isn't there another professor that is supposed to come with us?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I'm pretty sure, professor Spafford from Cornell?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, well he's obviously late and the rule in my class is "if you can't come on time, then don't come at all". (pause) An option that many of my students use. (pause) Shall we?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: You don't think we should wait for him?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what, he's a big boy, I'm sure he'll find us, ok?

lines.speaker: Professor Spafford
lines.text: Professor Geller?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, damn it!

scenes.location: Joey's apartment

lines.text: (Rachel enters the room and checks the answering machine)Jane: (from the answering machine) Hi Joey it's Jane Rogers, can't wait for your party tonight. Listen, I forgot your address, can you give me a call? Thanks, bye.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering the room) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's happenin'?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it's a real shame you can't make it to that one-woman show tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I'd love to, but I gotta get up so early the next day and so, you know me, work comes first

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah... (she plays the answering machine)

lines.speaker: Message
lines.text: "Hi Joey, it's Jane Rogers can't wait for your party tonight" (Joey's upset and stops it)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (yelling) Stupid Jane Rogers!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (angry) You are having a party tonight??

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Kinda have a... a thing for the Days Of Our Life's people.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you weren't going to tell us? How did you think you were gonna get away with that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I do it every year.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You do that every year??

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I didn't have to tell you that!! I'm stupider than Jane Rogers!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that's why you got these tickets to that play, to get rid of us??

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And last year is that why you sent us to that medieval times restaurant?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OH! And the year before that, when you set up that nighttime tour of that button factory?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Smiling) I can't believe you guys went for that one!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, why wouldn't you invite us to your parties?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're fine, ok? But everyone else acts like an idiot around famous people!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, then so you just invite me...!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (speaking aloud) Please, I was trying to be nice, you're the worst one!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Joey, come on! Please, please! Let me come, I will behave, I promise! I will behave! Please, please, please...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, ok! Fine! You can come, but don't tell anybody else. It's up on the roof at 8.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (yelling and jumping like a child) OH, a soap opera roof party!! I'm going to a soap opera roof party!! Oh my God, oh my God!! (realizing how she's behaving) And it's out of my system!

scenes.location: Ross, Charlie and Professor Spafford are sitting at the table in a restaurant

lines.speaker: Professor Spafford
lines.text: (speaking very slowly) And then my wife and I went on a cruise to the Galapagos. There was a sea food buffet you wouldn't believe. There were clams, and mussels, and oysters, and cracked crab, and snow crab, and king crab. It's a pity I'm allergic to shellfish.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (very bored, he tries to avoid the conversation speaking to Charlie) So, where did you get your undergraduate degree?

lines.speaker: Professor Spafford
lines.text: And that's not all I'm allergic to.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Charlie) Oh, it's not over!

lines.speaker: Professor Spafford
lines.text: I'm also allergic to peanuts, and cashews, and almonds, and filberts...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So basically all nuts?

lines.speaker: Professor Spafford
lines.text: Interestingly... no.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Kinda playing fast and loose with the word "interesting".

lines.speaker: Professor Spafford
lines.text: If you'll excuse me I'm going to use the restroom. (he goes away)

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh my God!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I've lost the will to live.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Let's ditch him!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Come on, he's still in the bathroom! I'm begging you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh... ok, fine. But... ehm... I just have one question for you, ehm... (aping Professor Spafford) When we exit should we walk, or run, or prance, or stroll...

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Stop it, stop it! He talks slow but he might pee fast! Ok, let's go!! (they run outside)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering with Charlie) Oh, hey you guys! This is Charlie! Charlie, this is Phoebe and my sister, Monica.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, Charlie is gonna be joining my department.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you're a paleonthologist, too! (pause) Oh, ok, now, what do you think of Ranion's new theory of species' variegation in segmented arthopods?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Well, I think he's a little out there, but he does have some interesting ideas...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah, ah.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: (her mobile phone rings) Oh, I'm sorry. I'll take this. Excuse me. (she cuts herself off for a moment)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Ranion's theory of species variegation?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I saw the article on your coffee table and I memorized the title to freak you out!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Ross) So, did you two have fun?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God, she's great! I mean, we-we have so much in common and she's just cool, and funny...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And I don't know if you've noticed but she's a (aloud) HOTTY!! (Charlie looks at her) HI!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she enters wearing a bath-robe) Hey... Hi you guys! Listen, you know what? I'm not feeling really well. I think I can't get out for the play.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? Wh-what's wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know! I think it's kind of serious! Oh, you know... I was watching this thing on TV this morning about... Newcastle disease... and I think I might have it!!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, Newcastle disease is a secretion borne virus that only affects chickens and... other poultry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ... Ok, who is this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm sorry, Rachel, this is Charlie Wealer, she's a collegue.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi! I would check your hand but... I'm sure you don't want to get my chicken disease!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Rachel, Can-can I see you for a sec?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure! (Monica takes her apart) Oh...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You're not sick!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Yes, I am!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, then, why are you... (she opens her robe revealing a nice black dress) all dressed up??

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: When you're sick, you do whatever you can to make yourself feel better! (she closes her robe)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You just wanna stay home so you can make a move on Joey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no, no! I heard you before, that is so not what this is!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, what is this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok! (whispering) Joey is having a secret Days Of Our Lives party up on the roof and he sent you guys to the play to get rid of you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (aloud) WHAT?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking at them) Wh-what's going on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey is having a secret Days Of Our Lives party up on the roof!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And he didn't want you guys to know about it but I came over here to tell you!!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I thought you came to say you were sick.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok professor or detective?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey's having a party and he wasn't gonna invite us?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and he does it every year! That's why he's sending you to that play! That's why he sent us to that medieval restaurant and to that button factory!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And that horrible museum tour!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I arranged that...
(Joey enters, wearing a bathrobe)Joey: (sounds tired) Hey you guys, I'm turning in. Have fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We know about your party Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What party?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The game's over! Take off your robe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looks perplexed and opens up his robe) Ok... I mean...

lines.speaker: Everyone
lines.text: No!! Cover it up!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Charlie after covering himself up again) Nice to meet ya! (Charlie waves hesitantly and Joey leaves)

scenes.location: The Roof

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To some people) Hey! Hey alright! Hey, glad you could make it (Shakes a man's hand) Thanks for coming.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Kyle Lowder!

lines.speaker: Kyle Lowder
lines.text: (to Monica) Hi. (walks on)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Yells after him) I love you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, that's why I didn't invite you. you have to calm down, alright... go, go get yourself a drink or something...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh yeah that's what you want - my inhibitions lowered.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Excited) Oh my God, can you believe we are surrounded by all this? I can barely control myself.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Monica, you might want to remember that you are married. Where is Chandler anyway? (Looks around)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Shocked) Oh my God! Chandler!

scenes.location: The theater. Chandler is sitting in the otherwise empty front row, looking around nervously

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where the hell is everybody?

(The lights dim and Chandler tries to get away but as the bitter lady comes on stage and starts yelling he promptly changes his mind and sits down)Bitter lady: (yelling) Why don't you like me?! Chapter One: My first period.

scenes.location: The Roof, Rachel is talking to a guy who hands her a tissue with something written on it

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Rachel) Hey! Joey said no autographs! But if she's gettting one, then I want one too: To Monica. And none of this "best wishes" crap. I want "love".

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok actually Mon, Matthew was just giving me his phone number.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh man! If I had known I was coming to this party I never would have gotten married!

lines.speaker: Matthew Ashford
lines.text: It was nice to meet you Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Matthew Ashford
lines.text: Call me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok
(Matthew leaves)Monica: (yelling after him) We will!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Rachel) Look at you with all the guys!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess you have forgotten all about Joey?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, well, I guess I have forgotten about Joey and clearly you've forgotten about Chandler!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please... Chandler is the love of my life... (At which point a man in leather pants walks by)... oooh leather pants! Have Mercy! (Follows the man in the leather)
(cut to Ross and Charlie)Ross: (to Charlie) So, eh... it's probably gonna be hard for you to leave Boston, huh?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Actually, I'm kinda happy to be leaving... I just broke up with someeone.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ooh... so sad... Still, it can't be easy for you to leave Harvard? Especially after working alongside a Nobel Prize winner like Albert Wintermeyer?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Actually, Alby is the guy I broke up with.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You... you dated Albert Wintermeyer?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ... And you called him Alby!? (laughs) I mean that's like... like calling Albert Einstein... er... Alby...

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yeah, well, he is a brilliant man.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Eh, you think? I mean, you went out with a guy who improved the accuracy of radiocarbon dating by a factor of 10!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yes! And while that is everything one looks for in a boyfriend, he had a lot of issues...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (very interested) Oh! like what?! (Charlie looks at him confused, but smiling) Oh I'm sorry, I don't mean to pry... it's just that this must be what regular people experience when they watch "Access Hollywood".

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Ok, you want the dirt? Alby was seriously insecure. I mean, he was really intimidated by the guy I dated before him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who is intimidating to a guy who won the Nobel Prize?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: A guy who won two.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (a little suprised) Two? Wha...? Don't tell me you dated Benjamin Hobart

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yeah... for three years.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! Have you ever been in a relationship with someone who hasn't won the Nobel Prize?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: (smiling and thinks for a moment)... no... bu but there was my first boyfriend Billy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah? no, no Nobel Prizes for him?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: No, but he did just win the McArthur genius grant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh... huh... what a loser! Some more wine? (takes the half-full glasses and goes to the counter)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Ross!

lines.speaker: Rache
lines.text: How is it going with Charlie?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastically) Oh Great! After I finish my wine I'm going to blow my... eh. average-sized brains out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, What's the matter?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She... she only dates geniuses and Nobel Prize winners. Oh my God, at the chinese restaurant earlier today, I put chopsticks in my mouth and pretented to be a woolly mammoth.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I always loved that!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Of course you would, your brains are smaller than mine!! (Rachel nods) Man, I can't compete with the guys she goes out with, they are so out of my league! oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Worse?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh much, much worse. I did my impression of Joan Rivers as one of the earliest amphibians... (gestures with his hands and says in an impression voice?) "Can we walk"? (Phoebe starts laughing) Oh, you... you like that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (still laughing) No. (points to Rachel who stuck two straws in her mouth to look like a mammoth's tusks)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (turns around to look at Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Come on! I think this is funny! (Ross leaves)

scenes.location: Chandler in the theater

lines.speaker: Bitter lady
lines.text: Well, I bet you are all thinkin' "Now would be a really great time for an intermission", huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To himself) oh yes, God yes!!

lines.speaker: Bitter lady
lines.text: (now yelling) Well, you're not gonna get one! Because in life there are no intermissions, people. Chapter 7: Divorce is a 4 letter word. (Now standing right in front of Chandler and bending down almost to his level as if speaking to him, yelling even louder) How could he leave me?!?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I... I don't know... you seem lovely.

scenes.location: The roof, Joey is walking towards Ross with a guy

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Ross, this is one of my co-stars, Dirk. (To Dirk) Dirk, this is my good friend Ross. (Ross and Dirk shake hands)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Dirk
lines.text: Hey! So what show are you on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I'm no actor, I'm a professor of palaeontology.
(Dirk is confused)Joey: It's a science.

lines.speaker: Dirk
lines.text: Oh! Hey well listen, I play a scientist on "Days". And my character has just won the Nobel prize.
(Ross looks annoyed hearing that even Dirk's character won a Nobel prize)Joey: Hey Ross, listen, Dirk was wondering about the woman that you brought and if you guys were together, or...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, well no, but I mean, she only goes out with really, really smart guys.

lines.speaker: Dirk
lines.text: Hey, I got a 690 on my SATs.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'd lead with that.
(Cut to Monica holding up her shirt, revealing her bra. An actor stands beside her, holding a pen in his hand.)Monica: That's it, just sign right on the bra (the actor does so).

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't worry Joe, I won't come next year!
(Joey, resigned, walks to Rachel's table)Joey: (To Rachel) What have you got there?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just some boys gave me their phone numbers.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, let me see! (she hands him a pile of tissues) Damn, that's a lot of guys! Are you a little slutty?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (drunken voice) I think I am.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (browsing the tissues) Let me see if I approve any of these clowns. This guy wears a rug (discards one). This guy's Canadian (discards another). And this guy is in a cult, ok, and it costs you 5,000$ to get to level three and I don't feel any different.
(Rachel is puzzled)Joey: (discarding all the remaining tissues one by one) Pass, pass, oh, pass, double-pass, pass...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (picking up the tissues) Why, why, what's wrong with these guys?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nothing major, it's just that, you know, they're not really good enough for you, and you deserve the best.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, you're so sweet.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's true. But you know what, it doesn't matter because I already know who you're gonna go home with tonight.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who (looks around)?
(Joey motions for Rachel to lean in. She does so.)Joey: Me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (surprised) What? (with a nervous smile) Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes, 'cause we live together, that's a joke!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Screw it, I didn't get it! (they high-five)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Gotcha.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Very funny... Joey.
(Joey leaves. Rachel gulps down what's left of her drink and grimaces.)(Chandler walks in)Chandler: (to Monica) So, how did you enjoy the play?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god, honey, I'm so so so so so sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well you should be. You missed the most powerful three hours in the history of the theater.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You really liked it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah! I mean at first I hated it, but why wouldn't I, because as a man I've been trained (bitter woman's tone) not to listen! (pause) But after chapter 16: "fat, single and ready to mingle", I was uplifted.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh really!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, I had no idea the amazing journey you go through as a woman! Tell me, tell me about your first period!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did somebody sign your bra?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So I got it when I was 13...

scenes.location: At the counter. Ross is sitting there, drinking. Phoebe approaches him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Ross! So listen, about you and the dinosaur girl, are you really just gonna let a couple of Nobel prizes scare you off? What is that, come on, a piece of paper?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's actually a 1,000,000$ prize.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Go Charlie! But my point is, ok so she dated them but she also broke up with them. Maybe she's looking to, you know,
slum it with some average Joe Phd.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, maybe. I do have my whole career in front of me. I mean, I can still win a Nobel prize. Although the last two papers I've written were widely discredited.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're so much more than just brains! You're sweet, and kind, and funny...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And sexy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok well give her a chance to see all of that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, you're right, thanks Pheebs, I'm gonna go find her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good for you! And hey, I thought your paper on punctuated equilibrium in the Devonian era was top notch!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Stop going through my stuff (walks away)!
(Rachel approaches Monica)Rachel: (to Monica) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just wanted to let you know I've changed my mind: I'm gonna do it, I'm gonna kiss Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, you can't! Friends hooking up is a bad idea.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please, what about you and Chandler?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's different! I was drunk and stupid!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well hello (points to herself)!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What about all the guys that you've got the phone numbers from? Why don't you just kiss one of them?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I could, I could but I don't want to! I want to kiss Joey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright (shrugs). I think it's a big mistake but it's your decision.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (pause) I'm gonna do it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And I can't stop you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No.
(Rachel goes look for Joey. She sees him and Charlie kissing passionately.)Ross: (to Rachel) Hey Rach, have you seen Charlie anywhere?
(Rachel just stands there staring at Joey and Charlie in silence. After a while, Ross turns around and sees them.)Ross: I'm smarter than him!

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's so weird, how did Joey end up kissing Charlie last night?
I thought you'd end up kissing Charlie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I thought I'd end up kissing Charlie too ok? But SURPRISE!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I missed most of the party (pause) Charlie's a girl, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, she is this new professor of my department that I did
not kiss.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know why Joey had to kiss her! I mean, of all the girls
at the party, GOD!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why do you care so much?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes Rachel, why do you care so much?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (worried) Be-cause Ross is the father of my child! You know...
and I... want him to hook up with lots of women! (pause) I just... All I'm saying
is... I don't think that Joey and Charlie have anything in common.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I don't know, they seem to have a shared interest in each
other's tonsils...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, Joey and a professor! Can you imagine if they had kids
and if the kids got her intelligence and Joey's raw sexual magnetism... Oh,
those nerds will get laaaaaid!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, so... Ross, you're ok with all this? I mean...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, it's no big deal. I mean, I just met her and I'm fine with
it...
(Joey and Charlie enter. Ross looks at her)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, God. I forgot how hot she was!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm gonna get some more coffee.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, you know what? I'll come with you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok. (they both go)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) So, a professor, uh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! She is cool, and she's so smart! Her mind is totally acrimonious
(which, being Joey, he mispronounces "amonious"). (pause) That's not
how she used it...?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: (talking to Ross) I feel like I owe you an explanation. I don't
ordinarily go around kissing guys at parties. I'm... well, I'm kind of embarrassed.
I really hope you don't think less of me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhm no! Think less of you! No, I don't think less of you. I mean,
you saw someone you liked and you kissed them. I mean, those people who like
someone and don't kiss them... those-those people are stupid, I hate those people.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: You know, actually I'm a little surprised to myself. I mean,
Joey is so different from the guys I usually date. I mean, they're all professors,
and intellectuals, and paleontologists mostly, you
know, very cerebral...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I know the type.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, if you wanna grab a bite before work we'd better get acrimonious.
No? Am I getting close?
Opening credits

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey you guys! Look what I just got. (she shows them a pair of
slippers)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, OH! Wow, I love those! Where did you get them?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I bought them off Ebay! They used to belong to the late Shania
Twain.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (after a pause) Phoebe, Shania Twain is still alive!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh... then I overpaid. (she goes to the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, what's this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it's a gift certificate to this new SPA in SOHO.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you can't show Phoebe this! She hates those corporate massage
chains.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, why, now I can't get a massage? There are so many things
that she disapproves of! I can't eat veal, I can't wear fur, I can't go hunting...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you wanna go hunting?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I would like to have the option!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (coming back from the bathroom) What's up? (she sees the gift
certificate in Rachel's hands) Hey, Rachel!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, you can't go there! You know how I feel about these "big
massage places"! They're putting people like me out of business!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And she wants to go hunting, too!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, come on, I don't wanna waste it! It would be like throwing
away a hundred bucks!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, this is not about the MONEY, ok? It's about... it's
about corporate greed destroying our hearts and leaving us... the hollow shells.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't care about any of that!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, do you care about friendship?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I feel really strongly about this, Rachel. Please, don't use
this gift certificate. I'm asking you as a friend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, not as a friend, Phoebe!! Fine, I won't use it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Promise?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you. (she tears up the gift certificate)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I am going hunting!!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering) Hey honey! I missed you today!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. (they kiss) What d'you wanna do tonight?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, well... Maybe we could... (he sweeps the stuff off the
table and wordlessly invites Monica to have sex on it)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, trying to turn me on by making a mess? Know your audience!
Besides, tomorrow we're doing those fertility tests and until then you need
to keep your tadpoles in the tank.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We really need to take those tests?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey, we've been trying to have a baby for over a year. I think
it's a good idea to find out if everything's ok. Just a few routine tests.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But I don't wanna do it in a cup!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is the big deal?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's weird! In a doctor's office?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's not ok to do it in a doctor's office but it is ok to do
it in a parked car behind a Taco Bell?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (embarrassed) I cannot believe Ross told you that! (pause)
And in my defense, it was a Wendy's!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, I don't wanna do this test either, but I really do think
it's a good idea!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, ok. I'm sure that doctor's office can't be worst than
on a class trip to the Hershey's factory!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (really embarrassed) OH!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah! RACHEL TALKS TOO!

scenes.location: Joey's apartment

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sipping red wine from a glass) Who says that wine has to cost
more than milk!
(somebody knocks the door, Joey opens and it's Charlie)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Heeey!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on in, how are ya?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I'm good!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Can I offer you a drink?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Please, I've been crazed all day! I had a meeting with
the Dean, and my syllabus for summer school is due and I'm writing the Foreword
for a friend's book...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-oh. I hade a pretty hectic day at work too, today I had to
open a door and go (looking scared) ohhhh!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: So I am just so excited to be
here. And I can't wait to start exploring the city!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, if you need a tour guide... (point to himself)

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, you mean it? That would be so fun!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, definitely, definitely. Ok, what do you wanna see first?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, well, we can go see the Chronos Quartet at the Avery Fisher
Hall.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking puzzled and nodding) Ok!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: And there is a collection of Walt Whitman letters on display
at the public library.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, yeah!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: And first, I have to see the MET!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, let me stop you right there. The Mets suck, ok? You wanna
see the Yankees.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: No, no, no, not the Mets, the MET, singular!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Which one, they all suck!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: The museum!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking puzzled) I don't think so.

scenes.location: SPA massage center, Rachel enters

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to the receptionist) Hi there!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: (in an affected tone) Hello, welcome to Lavender Day Spa
SPA. How may I help you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hi. I have a massage appointment under Rachel Green, and
here is my gift certificate.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: This has been torn up.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And... taped back together.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Ok well, I'll call you as
soon as your massage therapist is ready.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Have a seat through the glass doors.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (imitating the receptionist's tone) through the glass doors.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Through the glass doors.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright-y then.
(Phoebe enters the hall)

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Phoebe, your next client's in the waiting room.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok. Do we have to talk like that then they're not around? (She
sees Rachel) Oh, no, no! Listen, is there someone
who can fill in for me?

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Sorry, everyone is booked!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But that woman can't know I work
here. She's a friend of mine and I made this big stink about how awful this
massage chains are.

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Then why you work here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: 'Cause it's good money! But that doesn't change the fact that
this is an evil blood sucking corporate machine!

lines.speaker: Receptionist
lines.text: Well, I think this is a great place to work!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (watching around and whispering) Ok, are they listening?

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.text: (Joey walks in and moves towards Ross, who's sitting of the sofa)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I need to talk to you about Charlie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (annoyed) Oh, do you, do you really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I'm... I'm kind of having a little problem.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, if you don't know what the word "acrimonious"
means, just don't use it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, look, you know Charlie, right? She's cool, she's funny, her
body is soo...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Get to the problem!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes. It's just that she's so much smarter than all the girls I've
ever dated! Combined! I don't want her to think I'm stupid!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking down) Are you wearing two belts?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (checking) EH, what do you know!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You were saying you didn't want to seem stupid.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right, right, right, well, she wants to go to all this cultural
places and I don't know how to talk about that stuff. You gotta help me out!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, I really don't want to
get involved in you guy's relationship.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Please, c'mon, you're the smartest person I know and I really
like this girl, ok, I don't wanna lose her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (after a short hesitation) Fine.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok. Let's see. Oh, you should take her to the MET!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The Metsss!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no! The MET! The Metropolitan Museum of Art.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (realizing) Oh, that's what she meant! (pause) You know, if they're
gonna shorten it, they should call it the MUSE! You know, short for museum,
and avoid all the confusion!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, most of it it's a place packed with confused angry
baseball fans!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, all right, so I'll take her to the MET.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, uh, uh, ok, there's this great rare bookstore
on Madison Avenue. You know what? She loves architecture,
you know what you should do? You should take a walk down fifth to the
Saint Patrick's Cathedral and there there's this great little pastry shop that
she'd love.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Geez, sounds like you should be going on this date!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But I'm not! (pause). You know what if you're in the mood for
Thai food...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Slow down, you go way too
fast. Ok? Just go back to the MET, ok?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got to tell me exactly what to do there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, when you walk in the museum, take the right, that's the antiquities
wing. Ancient Egypt, Mesopotamia, up to the Byzantine Empire.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! So, I walk in the door and make
the right (and he bends his arm to the left. Ross then bends Joey's arm to the
right and Joey nods)

scenes.location: doctor's waiting room

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have a weird feeling about this place. (pause) How do I
know that they are not gonna secretly videotape me and put it all over the internet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because, honey, I mean this in the sweetest way possible, nobody
is gonna wanna watch that.
(a nurse walks in)

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Mr. Bing? (Chandler jumps up) Here you are! You'll go into that
room and deposit your specimen into the container.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Deposit my specimen? You know,
usually I have to call a 900 number for that kind
of talk. Thanks, got it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, honey, my test is down the hall, are you sure you're going
to be ok?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I guess!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know this is embarrassing, but nobody cares! No one here even
knows you!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: OH MY GOD!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, Come on!
Commercial Break

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Ah ahahahhahaa! How great is this!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, we're probably fertile, let's go home!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Well, Sid and I are trying again and we had trouble last time
because apparently we...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Heaven) No no no... I mean, why? why is
she here??

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh! Someone's a little cranky today cuz
they have to do it in a cup! (laughs) Oh! They gave you the kiddy size (looking
at the cup in his hand).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What!?
(Janice does her "Janice Laugh")

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This was fun! But I've got an invasive vaginal exam to get to!
(leaves)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'd love to stay, but I have eh... (points at the cup) got
a hot date... (starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Please... go! (Then shouts after him) Just let me know if you
need a hand!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (disgusted) I think it just fell off. (Leaves)

scenes.location: At the Spa, Phoebe is at the half-opened door

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (In a strange heavy accent) Hello "ja", it's time
for your massage, ja! Put your face in the hole.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, a Swedish massage from a real Swedish person. (Puts her
head in the hole and Phoebe enters)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, then I'm Swedish...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, what's your name?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's a normal Swedish name... Ikea...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... what an interesting name.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ja!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know I... (lifts her head and tries to look in Phoebe's
direction)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (pushes her head back down) Time for your scalp massage!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Sees Phoebe's slippers through the hole) Wow... I really love
your... (startled as she realizes those are Phoebe's slippers)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it's just that uhm... it feels so good... Ikea... (pause)
Yeah, say hey, you'll know this, what's the capital of Sweden?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Thinks for a few moments) Uhm... Stockholm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Damn! I wish I knew if that was right!
[Scene: Joey's apartment, Joey and Ross in the living room,
rehearsing what Joey will say to Charlie in the Museum]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (gesturing at an imaginary painting) Note the painterly
lines and subtle impasto on this canvas. Monet painted quickly and usually outdoors
as his elusive subject was light itself.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Now, do you have any idea what you just said?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shaking his head as if to say: of course not!) No, no, my mouth
says the words, my brain is thinking monster trucks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok now, remember, when you get to the museum, Monet is not spelt
M-O-N-A-Y. I just... I wrote that out phonetically for you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Phonetically? (Looks confused)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah that means... you know? We just... we don't have time
for this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, but you know what? I gotta say,
I'm really impressed that you were able to memorize all this so quickly!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah! I'm an actor! I can memorize anything! Last week on "Days"
I had to say "Frontal temporal zygomatic craniotomy".

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow. What does that mean?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No idea! But the guy I said it to dies in the next scene so I
guess it means "you're gonna get eaten by a bear".

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok! So let's move on to the Renaissance?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, Caravaggio uses chiaroscuro here to highlight the anguish
of the central figure. Touch it, it's really bumpy! (Reaches out to touch the
imaginary painting).

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nah ah! Nah ah! (stops him form doing so) No no no! No ad-libbing
and dude, you can't touch the paintings.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on! you... (reaches out to touch the imaginary painting again)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! (Slaps his hand)

scenes.location: The Fertility Clinic; Chandler walks out one of the rooms

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To the nurse at the nurses' station) My specimen is in the
room and I just want to thank whoever knocked on the door while I was in there.
Really helped speed the process along! (walks towards the common area and sees
Janice is still there) Janice! You're not... gone?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh! Sid is still in his room. I don't allow porn at home so
this is like a vacation for him. So did you do it? Did you make your deposit?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah! yeah... The hard part is over!

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: That's not the hard part honey! The hard part is what comes
next, I mean aren't you worried about the results?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I haven't... I haven't even thought about the results yet...
I just assumed that everything was gonna be ok.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh! Well, you know what? It probably is.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Slightly panicky) Yeah, but what if it's not? What if there
is a reason why we can't have a baby?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, Chandler, look. You and Monica are meant to have children.
I am sure it's gonna be just fine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiling again) oh, oh, yeah, ok, thanks. I can't believe
I didn't even think of that. I guess I was just so worried about having to...
come here and do... 'that'...

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: What, you can do it in the parking lot of a Taco Bell, but you
can't do it at a doctor's office?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stares at her intently, then yells) It was a "Wendy's!!
"
[Scene: Phoebe and Rachel at the Spa. Phoebe is still massaging
Rachel]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Singing) "Ipan Stripan, Glupi Glabi! " And that is
the Swedish National Anthem! Thank you for asking! (looks annoyed)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, Ikea... what a rich culture. Uhm, you know what? I have
a friend who is a masseuse.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Ja! Ja!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yah! She's... uhm... not very good though... (Phoebe looks devastated)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uhu, uhu... and why do you think that is?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know... maybe it's because she has got such callousy
fingers from playing crummy guitar...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or... maybe she has trouble loosening your knots because you're
such a high maintenance tight ass!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (now lifts her head) Phoebe!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know it's me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: For like a half an hour! Man, you can lie about Sweden!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How can you come here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How could you not tell me you worked here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't have to tell you everything!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes you do, if you're going to make me feel guilty for getting
a free massage!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Tips not included.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Phoebe, why did you lie to me about working here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because I was ashamed ok? I sold out for the cash! And then
they give me benefits like medical, and dental, and a 401K. But you know...
you pay a price. Now I'm this Corporate stooge and punching a clock and Ugh!
paying taxes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, honey, if you hate it so much, you should walk out there
right now and quit! Be true to what you believe in! Honey, you have principles
and I so admire that! I don't have any!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know what? You are right. I am gonna quit. It's time
I took my life back!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good for you Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay (walks out and closes the door behind her, looks up and
whispers) If you guys have microphones in there too, I didn't mean any
of that. I love you.
[Scene: Central Perk. Ross is playing some shoot'em up game on
his laptop]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Haha! Got ya! Die, die, die!
(Charlie walks in.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (recovers his composure and starts typing) Respectfully, professor
R. Geller. (hits <return>, closes the laptop and joins Charlie on the
sofa) Hey!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, how was the Met?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: The museum was amazing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Joey really knows his art, huh?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Not so much, no. He had clearly memorized all the stuff to
say, and some of it didn't even make any sense.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Well, for one, he was talking about paintings that were nowhere
around.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (perplexed for a moment) Wait a minute... when you guys walked
into the Met, did you go to the right?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: No, we went to the left.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shaking head) Oh Joey, Joey! But still, I mean, it seems like
you guys are having a great time together.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yeah, it's fun (hesitating).

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Actually, you know, Joey is your friend, and you don't really
know me that well; it would be weird.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What, I mean, a little, but no, what, go on.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Well... I'm just thinking that maybe he's not the right guy
to be with right now, maybe I should be with someone... I have more in common
with. You know what I mean?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (slowly) Yeah. But you know what? I think you should give Joey
a chance. I mean, he's a great guy, and sure he doesn't know that much about
art but you know, you can always talk about that with someone else.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yeah, I guess that's true.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And if you think about it, I mean the reason he memorized all
that stuff is because he thought it was important to you. You
know, that's the kind of guy Joey is.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: He is very sweet. Plus he's hot!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That was going to be my next argument.
(Joey walks in)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Charlie) You're ready?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yeah, let's go. (stands up and kisses Joey) (to Ross) Thanks
Ross.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (aside, to Ross) Hey Ross! That art stuff worked, you hooked me
up.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Glad I could help man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Although some of that stuff wasn't where you said it was gonna
be, but... (confidently) I made it work.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's. Chandler is sitting on the sofa,
reading the newspaper.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (picking up a plastic cup similar to the one he deposited
his specimen in) It is not okay that I'm aroused by this now.
(phone rings)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello? Oh hi, Doctor Connelly. (pause) No, she's not here
but, you know, I can tell her. Should I be sitting down for this? (his smile
fades as he hears the answer) Oh. (pause) Well, so what does that mean? (pause)
Ok. Ok, thank you. Thanks. (hangs up)
(Monica walks in)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey sweetie.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Doctor Connelly just called.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: With good news? (very quickly and wringing hands) Of course
it is not good news, you just said (deadpan) "Doctor Connelly just called".
If it was good news you would have said (excitedly) "Doctor Connelly just
called! " But so what is it? Is there a problem, uh? Is there a problem
with me or with you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually it's both of us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Apparently my sperm have low motility and you have an inhospitable
environment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh... what does that mean?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It means that my guys won't get off their barcaloungers
and you have a uterus that is prepared to kill the ones that do. (pause) It
means...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (seriously) It means that we can keep trying, but there's
a good chance this may never happen for us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (weeping) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry too.
(they hug)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, we're gonna... we're gonna figure this out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (still weeping) I know.

lines.text: Friends - 922 - The one with the donor

scenes.location: Central Perk. Charlie, Joey and Rachel are on the couches

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: (while Joey's giving her a massage) Oh! That feels sooo good!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (speaking to herself and reading Cosmopolitan) Oh, lucky me! Coffee and a live sex show!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I'm sorry, what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... Oh, I'm sorry! I'm not... I was just-I was just reading to Emma.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: From... Cosmo??

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, yeah... It's... "climax your way to better skin".

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: (to Joey) So, I have to go shopping today, which is my least favourite thing, I'm soo bad at picking out clothes!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you need someone who knows fashion, to tell you what looks good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (hiding herself behind the magazine and whispering) Not me, not me, not me, not me, not me!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe you could take Charlie shopping.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I'm sure you have better things to do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you kidding? Rachel loves to shop! And she has great taste! Yeah, she's the one who taught me, you don't wear white after labour day and that you always, always, always have to put on underwear when you're trying on clothes.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: If you have the time, I'd really appreciate the help.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, uh-uh... Let's-Let's shop!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Charlie) Ok, you're gonna come back with some very classy clothes... (aside to Rachel)... and some slutty lingerie, SLUTTY!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (entering and talking on mobile phone) Ok, great! All right, bye! (she hangs up) Pain in the ass!! (she looks at the others, then back at the phone) That's off, right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's the matter, Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh... Mike's sister just invited me to a party tonight, he's gonna be there. And she was like "Oh, don't worry! I asked him. He's totally ok with seeing you!". So now I have to go so he'll think that I'm totally ok with seeing him!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Which you're not, because you've totally hung up on him!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Exactly!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And you're gonna want him to eat his heart out so you're gonna have to look fabulous!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (after a short pause) I didn't even think about that! (pause) Aaargh, sexual politics!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, I'm-I'm taking Charlie shopping, why don't you come and I'll help you find something.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, that'll be great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, ain't that nice? The three of you trying on slutty lingerie together.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's not what we're gonna do!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why would you ruin it, who was that hurtin'?
Opening credits[Scene: Doctor Connelly's office]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking at the picture of the female reproductive system) Wow! Fortunately she has a very pretty face!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I so can't believe this! My uterus is an inhospitable environment? I was trying so hard to be a good hostess!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I can't believe my sperm have low motility because, let me tell you, when I was growing up they sure seem to be in a hurry to get places!!

lines.speaker: Doctor Connelly
lines.text: (entering) Hi there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Doctor Connelly
lines.text: I'm sorry there wasn't better news from your test last week but I wanted to talk to you about your options.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Doctor Connelly
lines.text: Above all, even though your chances of conceiving through natural means aren't great, you never know! So, keep having sex on a regular basis.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, DAMN IT!
(Dr. Connelly glares at Chandler)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't worry, after a while he'll tune it out.

lines.speaker: Doctor Connelly
lines.text: Ok, given your situation, the options with the greatest chances for success would be surrogacy, or insemination using a sperm donor.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (long pause) Ok.

lines.speaker: Doctor Connelly
lines.text: And, of course, if you feel that neither of those is right for you, you can always adopt.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is that a hint? Because we love you Doctor Connelly but we don't think we'd want you to be our child! (Dr. Connelly glares at him) Wow, talking about an inhospitable environment!

scenes.location: Central Perk. Joey and Charlie on the couch. Rachel enters

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Ok, you're ready to go pick up Phoebe and go shopping?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Let's do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Charlie) Alright, have a good time. (they kiss)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Not gonna find any clothes in there!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey, you guys!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Guess who's up for keynote speaker at the National Paleontology Conference?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Umh... Kurts Baley?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, right! What was last time he met a submission deadline for an abstract (he and Charlie laugh, then Joey starts laughing too without any reason) Well, why are you laughing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just... seeing what it'd be like to be a paleontologist... it's fun, yeah!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: So you're up for keynote speaker! Who's making the decisions?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Professor Sherman, yeah. I've a meeting with him today.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: He's a pretty tough guy to impress.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well... I think I know how to dazzle him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... you're not gonna do a magic trick, are ya?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Tsz... NO! (he goes to sit down, dropping a multicoloured silk streamer off his sleeve).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, you guys. Oh, I wanna ask you something. I-I I may get to speak at this paleontology convention and if I do, I'd love for you guys to come and hear me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think I can safely say that we all have family issues, work stuff and/or are sick.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's in Barbados.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But you come first!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm there!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: We'll see you, guys! (she goes)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bye, see ya. (she goes)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sitting down on the couch) Ok.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, so. How did it go at the fertility clinic?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not as much fun as last time. Apparently you only get porn if you're giving a sperm sample.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So-so what did the doctor say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well... there's surrogacy, but Monica has dreamt her whole life of carrying a child, she has felt that watching a surrogate would be... too hard for her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So you're ruling out surrogacy?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, I don't have to learn what that means?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aside from adoption the only other choice is insemination, so... we're talking about sperm donors.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Enough said, I'm there for you man. Where is she, upstairs?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stopping Joey) ah-ha!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How do you feel about all this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I wish there was an easier way for us to have a child but I don't think there is one.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on Ross, be a good guy. Step up and do it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (puzzled) What?
(Joey moves close to Ross and whispers something in his ear)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking astonished) What? NO! I am not going to give them Ben!

scenes.location: Professor Sherman's office, Ross is relating to Professor Sherman

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The data we are receiving from MRI scans and DNA testing of these fossils are - are staggering.

lines.speaker: Professor Sherman
lines.text: Mmm-mm.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (reading from a notepad) I mean, we've been accepting Leakey's dates as a given, but if they're off by even a hundred thousand years or so then you can - you can just throw most of our assumptions, you know, right in the trash. (he throws the notepad in the waste bin) So-so what I am saying is - is is that (he picks the notepad back from the waste bin) is that the repercussions could be huge! I mean, not just in palaeontology, but if-if you think about it, in evolutionary biology, uh, genetics, geology, uh, I mean, truly the mind boggles!
(Turns to look at Professor Sherman, only to discover that he is sleeping)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, that's not what you want...

scenes.location: Shop, Rachel, Charlie and Phoebe walk in

lines.speaker: Shop assistant
lines.text: (to a girl) Incentive For Men?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I'll take some of that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Pheebs, that's for men!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I know, this way when I go to the party later Mike will know I am over him cause I'm gonna smell like another guy. (to the shop assistant) Yeah.
(The shop assistant sprays the perfume on Phoebe's neck)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok. Oh good, I'm dating a Russian cab driver. (to the shop assistant). Seriously does anyone buy this? I smell like beets!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: (to Rachel) So, you know what, I really like those jackets with the shoulder pads on them. Where do you think those would be?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: On Melanie Griffith in "Working girl". I think what you want is over here.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: See, I told you I needed someone! Oh, you know, by the way, as a "thank you", I would really love to take you out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yeah! Actually Joey and I are going to the movies tonight, wanna come?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I can't. Because I-I've seen them.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: You've seen all the movies...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! I'm a big fan! Of the movies, you know. Motion pictures. The Talkies!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (picks up a dress) Hey Rach, will you come with me to a dressing room?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Wha, you know, maybe we can do something else!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know that depends on what it is! I've done a lot of stuff.
(Phoebe and Rachel go off to the dressing rooms. They enter one and close the curtain.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So what were you doing out there, do you not like Charlie?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She's ok, I just don't get a really good vibe from her!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't know, you know, just the way she waltzed in here all smart, and tall! You know, and just swept Joey off his feet... I mean, nobody else has a chance!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who else?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Anybody! You, me, you know, Monica's mom...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You like Joey?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shhhhh! Phoebe! All right, look. I have a little thing for him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (whispering) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's just physical and I have it totally under control! Ok? It's just, when I see them together, sometimes I just get a little jealous!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh, wow! Isn't it ironic that he liked you and now you like him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (annoyed) Oh, I get it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh well, as long as it is under control, you know, you can't do anything about it, he's already dating her, and she is a nice person, that wouldn't be right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I know, so it is just not a big deal.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So can we keep this between us?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, great, because I gotta get out of here, the smell of beets is killing me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.
(Rachel opens the curtains and sees Charlie coming out from the dressing room just next to theirs)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Any chance Charlie has a deaf twin?

scenes.location: Monica's apartment, Chandler walks in with a friend of his while Monica is putting fruit in a bowl.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi honey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Look I brought a friend for dinner, this is Zack, from work!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, of course, it's so nice to see you again, Zack!

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: (shaking Monica's hand) You too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You guys haven't actually met before, but, boy! You're both polite! (pause) Go to have a seat Zack, and I'll get you a beer.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I got it.

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Mon) So, Zack's pretty nice, uh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I guess.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, how would you like to have a baby that's half yours and half his!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (turns around and she's quite shocked) Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, we're talking about sperm donors and Zack may be the guy! I mean, look, he's intelligent, he's healthy, he's athletic, I mean, he is "spermtastic"!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, this is crazy! What did you even say to him! "Come up, meet my wife! Give us your sperm"!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I invited him to dinner so you could get a chance to get to know him! I mean, if we go through a sperm bank you never meet the guy, get to check him out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm telling you, he's great! I mean, even if my sperm worked fine, I'd think he'd be the way to go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm not going to be a part of this! You can't just bring some random guy at home and expect him to be our sperm donor!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (bringing the beer to Zack) Zack!

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: Thanks! Do you have a coaster? I don't wanna make a ring.
(Monica hears that and is suddenly very interested in Zack)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Tell me about yourself, Zack!

scenes.location: Shop, Phoebe and Rachel are talking in front of the dressing room

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, God, do you think she heard? It would be so bad if she heard!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, maybe she didn't hear! Ok I'm gonna go into that dressing room, you stay in here and I'll talk and see if you can hear me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, great!
(Phoebe moves in the dressing room from which Charlie went out)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, thank God I can't hear a word that you're saying!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sticks her head out) I didn't say anything yet!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sticks her head out too) Well, get back in there and talk!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (goes back in) I'm Rachel. It's so annoying when I put Emma on the phone to talk with my friends.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (comes out again) What!?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (comes out too) Well, some things are just hard to say to your face.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok well, I heard that! Which means that she heard it too!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! We have a problem.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! What are we gonna do?
(A strange woman sticks her head out from a third changing cubicle to the far right)

lines.speaker: Stranger
lines.text: Just be honest with her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Stranger
lines.text: And it is annoying when parents put their baby on the phone...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (yelling at the stranger) Alright! Enough out of you!

scenes.location: Joey's apartment. Joey is sitting on his bed and the phone rings

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey! Hey, I need to talk to Charlie. Is she there?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. no... eh... she went shopping with Rachel. Why? What's up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm meeting with professor Sherman about my being the keynote speaker...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! How's it going?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It could be better! He, uhm... he fell asleep!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What!? But I already bought my ticket to Bermuda!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Barbados.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine, I'll rent a car and drive...! Ross, you have to get that job!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What am I supposed to do? He's out cold! In fact he was just talking in his sleep before and evidently he wants someone named Fran to spank him harder.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, just wake him up!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't! If he realizes that I'm the one that put him to sleep, I won't get the job!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh! That's a tough one. Oh! Wait a minute, this happened to me before! Yeah, I was auditioning for a play and the producer fell asleep and... (pause) no wait a minute... it was me who fell asleep... Yeah I mean hey, Shakespeare, how about a chase scene once in a while!?

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartement. Chandler and the guest are in the living room, Monica in the kitchen

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey guys! Dinner's ready!

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: Oh! I'm gonna go wash up first. (Chandler points him the bathroom) Thanks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So what do you think? I want that guys genes for my kid! Those eyes, those cheeckbones!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, there's enthusiastic and there's just plain gay!!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don't like him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think he is fine! It's just that we don't know anything real about him... we should get more information.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright! Just follow my lead!
(Zack comes out of the bathroom. They all sit down at the table.)

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: You guys have such a great place here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh! Thanks, I'm crazy about our place. Hey! speaking of crazy... do you have a history of mental illness in the family?

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: Uhm... no. Although I did have an uncle who voted for
Dukakis.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (very seriously) That's really not the kind of thing we are looking for Zack.

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: (looking very puzzled) Okaaay... so eh... so tell me, how did you guys meet.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, friends first, drunk in London, you know the story. I've got a better question for you: Do you or any of your blood relatives have diabetes?

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: (after a pause, very confused) No...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Eh... Heart Disease, Alzheimers, gout?

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: You guys don't have people for dinner a lot, huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're just making conversation. (Chandler makes an agreeing-sound)

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: Ok. I heard a joke today. It's pretty funny...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know what's not funny? Male Pattern Baldness (Monica stretches her neck to look behind Zack's head and then gives Chandler an "ok" sign)

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: Ok listen, you guys have shown a lot of interest in me tonight and I'm flattered and... and quite frankly a little frightened. Can we just talk about something else?

lines.speaker: Monica & Chandler
lines.text: Sure! Alright...

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: Ravioli's delicious!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I noticed you were enjoying that Ravioli with a beautiful set of teeth. Did you have braces as a child?

lines.speaker: Zack
lines.text: No I didn't.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yess!! (M & C high-five and Zack looks confused again)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Proceeding with his dinner) We're teeth people Zack!
