lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (caresses the wall with his finger) Bye!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, uhm... Hey, you guys seen Joey anywhere?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He's probably in his room with his current girlfriend
Charlie. That's the situation as we know it... (walks to Phoebe and Monica)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, if you see him could you please tell
him I'm looking for him?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You got it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks! (walks out of the room and starts hugging the
wall) Thank you! (closes the door)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Other wall, people! Other wall!
(they rush to the wall to Rachel and Joey's, and we move to that room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (knocks on door) Rach, you there? (Joey and Rachel
both get up from the bed)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God, it's Ross. What are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, ju-ju-just stay calm. Just be calm. For all he
knows we're just hanging out together. Right? Just be nonchalant. (Joey like
stands at attention with his chest forward and his hands on his sides, looking
up at the ceiling with his lips pouted.) That's not nonchalant!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No idea what it means.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... okay, just hide!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (knocks) Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Coming! Try under the bed, try under the bed!
(When Rachel
starts to look under the bed if Joey would fit under there, Chandler opens
the door inbetween the rooms, grabs Joey by his shirt and drags him to his
room, and closes the door again)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: There's no room under the bed. (looks around because
she can't find Joey anymore)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah... (still looking to see where Joey went, and
opens the door)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know where Joey is?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...I really don't... (looks around again)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can I talk to you for a minute?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, sure... (looks outside into the corridor if
Joey is there)
(Monica and Chandler's room. Phoebe, Monica and Chandler have their ears pressed
against the wall, and Joey looks at them)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't believe this... Have you guys been...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Shhh... This is the listening side of the
wall.
(Now Joey also wants to listen, and wants to press his ears against the door,
which has a big mirror on it, he hesitates seeing himself in the mirror, but
still puts his ear against it. We move again to Rachel's room.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And then she told me that she and Joey had broken up,
and that part of the reason was that she had feelings for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (clearly not listening and still trying to find out
where Joey went) Uh-huh... right... yeah...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And you know I wanted to ask Charlie out since the
day I met her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (still searching) Oh, I know... I know it's been
really hard for you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Anyway, one thing lead to another, and... oh... before
you know it, we were kissing. I mean, how angry do you think Joey is gonna
be?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (now looking up at the ceiling) That is hard to say,
Ross. That is hard to say.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, I gotta go find him. He's gotta be here someplace.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You would think!
(Ross leaves the room)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is he gone?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (still can't find him) How are you doing this?
(Joey now enters the room through the door, Monica, Chandler and Phoebe are
following him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Pssst...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How... wha... Hey! What are you... What is this?
Have you guys been listening this entire time?
Monica, Chandler and Phoebe: YE-AH!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Now, what is this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, what is this? Well, lets see, we kissed for ten
minutes and now we're talking to our friends about it, so I guess this is sixth
grade!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no... Have you thought about it how complicated
this could get? What about Ross?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, he's with Charlie now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but he wants to talk to you before anything
really happens with her. And as his friend, I mean, don't you think
he deserves the same from you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (long pause and he twitches a bit) You're a pain in
my ass, Geller!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, look you guys... Look, we appreciate all
the advice, but this is between Joey and me and I think we can handle it...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, well we'll go back in there, but will you
do one thing for us? The people that care about you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sure...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Enunciate!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Get out!
(They leave and Rachel locks the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are they right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Probably, yeah... I mean, maybe we should... hold off
until we talk to Ross.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah... Yeah, we can wait, we don't have
to do anything tonight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I think that'd be best... So, so I'm gonna...
I'm gonna take off...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Joey walks to the door) Although...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (turns around very fast) I like although!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean, you know... Ross and I haven't dated in like...
six years...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Six years? Wow... It's almost as long as highschool...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Plus, you know, he is with Charlie now.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Absolutely! He's not thinking about you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm thinking about you...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Let's forget about Ross...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Forgotten.
(They want to kiss, but just before their lips touch, Rachel pulls back quickly,
gasping)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing...
Joey's voice, but she sees Ross: Seriously... What is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing... It's really... It's nothing... Come here,
come here...
(again, just before their lips touch, she pulls back, gasping)
Joey's voice/Ross: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sorry, I just uhm... I can't seem to get Ross out
of my head...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, maybe I can help. (he grabs her head passionately,
closes his eyes and kisses... Ross in Rachel's dress! He realises it too late,
and when he does, pushes Ross's/Rachel's head away)
Rachel/Ross: Ooh, your lips are so soft... Do
that again... (and she/he moves in for another kiss. Joey, pushes her head
away again...)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah... we really need to talk to Ross...

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: Yeah
COMMERCIAL BREAK
[Scene: Chandler and Monica's room. Chandler is packing when Ross knocks on
the door and enters...]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You guys ready to go?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not quite. Monica's still at the salon, and I'm
just finishing packing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude! You're not taking your Bible?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're not supposed to take that. Besides, it's
a New Testament, what are you gonna do with it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Learn about Jesus...
(Charlie now also enters the room, Chandler walks to the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: So, did you talk to Joey?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, no... no. I couldn't find him. I'm just gonna talk
to him on the plane.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yeah, sounds like a good idea... Dr. Geller!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Stop it!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: PHD

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're filthy!
(Phoebe enters)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, have you guys seen Monica?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, actually I think she went to the salon.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah, oh, she went to the salon alright...
(Monica enters, with her hair braided and little shells at the end)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Check it out!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Who's day just got better? CHANDLER!
(Chandler enters from the bathroom)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!... aaaaaahhhh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you think?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think.... I think I can see your scalp.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don't you just love it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ye... Yeah... Yeah... You got shellfish in your head.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: It's so... something... You go girlfriend!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You've never said that in your life, have you?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Not once.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I thought so.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And listen to this... (shakes her body so the shells
tingle)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What d'ya know... It's a treat for the eyes and the
ears.

scenes.location: Boarding the plane.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoo, whoo. Wow, it's uhm... kinda weird that I'm sitting
next to Charlie after we broke up.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, it's almost if Air Barbados doesn't care
about your social life.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, does someone mind switching to sit with Charlie?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I uh, I mean, I... dude, I spent the whole conference
with Charlie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I understand...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I'll do it. (he quickly grabs Joey's boarding pass
and gives Joey his one.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wish I could switch with someone. I really don't
wanna sit with Allen Iverson over there.
(Switch to Phoebe and Mike, who are kissing)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uhm... You know, once we're in the air and the captain
turns off the seatbelt sign... you feel free to roam about my cabin...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You should be careful when checking your overhead bins,
'cause items may shift during...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Aaah... you're not good at this...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You don't have to go home tonight, do you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I think I can come over. It's Saturday, right?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Uhm... I can't do anything tonight.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I have a date.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You have a... You have a date? With who?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh, it's... my girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (lets go of his hand) You have... have a girlfriend?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah... Well, when... you and I broke up I started
seeing someone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: For how long?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Three months.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Three months? Okay... This is probably none of my
business, but uhm, how long do you think you're gonna keep seeing her?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I'll tell her that it's over tonight at dinner. I
promise.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay... good. You do that. And then when you
get home, maybe there'll be a special delivery package waiting for you.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Maybe I'll sign for it. Tear it open. Pull out the
packing material...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know what, we're gonna have sex. Let's just leave
it there.
(cut to Charlie and Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right, I'm gonna go talk to Joey. I think this is the
right time. He's always in a good mood after the flight attendant says "duty
free".

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Okay... Good luck.
(Ross gets up and gestures to Rachel, we cut to Joey and Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross is coming over. I think now would be a really
good time to talk to him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I guess so. I'm just... really nervous.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well keep in mind that by the time you're done,
they'll probably be serving dinner.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Still nervous?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm gonna get the lasagna.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Rach...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you mind if I sit here for a sec.?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, yeah sure! Yeah! (mouths "Good luck" to
Joey and gets up from her seat)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, I uhm... kinda need to talk to you about Charlie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, last night after you guys broke up... so sorry
to hear about that, by the way... Well, Charlie and I were talking, and...,
well...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You kissed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha... (gasps) What? What would give you that idea?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I saw you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, we kissed, but... nothing else... nothing else
happened, okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, Ross, Ross... It's okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's okay. You know, I totally understand,
alright? You guys, make way more sense than her and I ever did, you know. And...
I want you to be happy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah... Now I have something...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am speachless... I mean the fact that you would put
my happiness first like that. I mean, you're an incredible friend, you know
that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh... uh... look... before you...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I mean it. You are so loyal man, and selfless,
and generous...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I am those things, yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what? I know Chandler longer, so I always
think of him as my best friend, but now... I may have to rethink some
stuff...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, if there is ever, anything I can do for you...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't think of anything.
(They both hug, and Rachel, who was in the back of the plane, sees this and
smiles.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.
(Ross walks to the back of the plane, where Rachel is.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So you eh, you talked to Joey?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, yeah. We had a really good talk.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! That's great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, so everything's okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no, it's great. It's great. He is... He is an amazing
guy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah... Well, obviously I think so too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I'm so excited about this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really? Excited?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you kidding? I have had some very dirty dreams
about this...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me! (and she walks back to Joey, who is still
looking very impressed about what Ross said to him. Rachel looks at him and
hits him.) You didn't tell him, did you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I couldn't. He was saying all these really nice things
about me. I didn't want him to get mad and take 'em all back. I'm on a edge
on Chandler.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God! Alright, fine. You know what Joey, forget
it. When we go back to New York, I will tell him.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you. Yeah, I appreciate that.
(Chandler walks by and Joey lets out an evil "muhahaho".)
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Mike's apartment. Phoebe's there and the phone rings.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi, Mike's place.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey, it's Mike.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, that was fast.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh, err... no, she's not here yet. You know, I think
I'm just gonna take off and break up with her over the phone...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you can't do that! Oh, come on Mike, strap
on a pair.Why don't you just tell her that we got back together. You know,
women appreciate honesty. We also appreciate gentle spanking once in a while.
Just F.Y.I.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: One more thing... There... might be a picture of Precious
on my coffee table.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Her name is Precious? Is she a purebreed or did you
pick her up at the pound?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Anyway, I just wanna give you a heads up.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, oh and you know, if she gets upset, just scratch
her tummy and give her a liver snout. (laughs and hangs up the phone)
(there's knocking on the door which Phoebe opens)

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: Hi, I'm Precious, who are you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (stunned) I... I'm Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: Phoebe? Mike's ex-girlfriend Phoebe, the love of
his life? That Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Enchanté (she holds out her hand, and they shake
hands)
[Scene: Chandler and Monica's apartment. Monica's carrying the laundry hamper
to their coffee table.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I can't wait for everyone at work to see these...
(plays with her hair to make the shells tingle again) Ow!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You go back to work tomorrow night, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So if you want people to see them, then by definition
you're not having them taken out... say, at the break of dawn?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, if I had them taken out, then I wouldn't be
able to do this. (she pushes Chandler on the couch and brushes her
hair and shells against Chandler's chest) You like that, right? (again, she
brushes her hair against his chest and hums...)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What are you singing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's "Bolero" from "10".

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's "Ride of the Valkyries" from "Apocalypse
Now"...
See, here's the thing: The corn rose were really a solution to your frizzy
hair problem. And now that we're home, we don't have that problem anymore,
so if you think about it... I hate them!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You what? You said you liked them.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did I? Let's refresh. I believe what I said was
that I could see your scalp.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Fine, so you don't like them. Everybody else does.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Again, let's journey back... As I recall what Rachel
said, was she had never notice the shape of your skull before. And Joey...
Well, Joey didn't realise that there was anything different.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what? I don't care. I like it like this,
and I'm gonna keep it. You're just jealous because your hair can't do this...
(and she shakes her head more violently) OUCH!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hit yourself in the tooth?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And the eye!
[Scene: Ross's apartment.Someone's knocking on the door. Ross rushes to the
door and it's Rachel with Emma.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (gasps) Hi... There she is. Hi Emma. Oh my God, I missed
you. (kisses her) Oh Emma, I missed you so much. Hey... Did you have
a good time with grandma Green? Huh? Did she give you a bottle of anti-depressants
again to use as a rattle? (to Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That was one time, Ross, and they were only like
5 milligrams.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ooh hey, Emma, daddy has some presents for you okay?
Okay? I want you to wait right here. Come here sweetie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aaah... Ross, actually there's something that I really
need to talk to you about.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (unpacking his bag) Okay, shoot!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, uhm... alright, here's the deal.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (gasps) OH NO!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What is it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, major shampoo explosion!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, look Ross, this really isn't easy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, it's all over everything. Why?
Why me? (looks up)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because you took three hundred bottles of shampoo?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry. You were saying?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, yeah... Okay, look it's about me and...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, not another one! Oh my G... And this is moisturiser.
It's even harder to clean! Why? Why do bad things happen to good people?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Well, clearly this is not a good time.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Duh, you think? (enters the kitchen)

scenes.location: Mike's place. Phoebe is on the phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, bye. Alright, so Mike's on his way over. See,
you thought you guys were meeting here, and he thought you were meeting at
the restaurant, so you know... Doesn't really matter who's right or wrong.
Point is... I'm gonna take off.

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: I'm not letting you leave until you tell me what's
going on here. I mean, are you guys getting back together or something?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright... Susie, can I call you Susie?

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: My name is Precious.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I can't say that. uhm... Susie, I'm gonna be
straight with you... Mike and I are back together... and uhm... unfortunately
that effectively ends your relationship with him. And he's very sorry about
that and wishes you the best of luck in all your endeavours.

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: I just can't believe this... Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I don't...

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: Oh, why would he do this? I mean, what's wrong
with me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nothing, there's nothing wrong with you.

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: I mean, what the hell am I supposed to do now?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Damn it woman, pull yourself together! Have
some pride, for the love of God.
(Precious starts crying)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, not a fan of the tough love.

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: I just can't believe that Mike didn't give me any
warning.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But he didn't really know, you know. He wasn't planning
on coming to Barbados and proposing to me...

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: He proposed to you? This is the worst birthday ever.
(she starts to cry again)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, Precious... Mike's not worth this.
You're an attractive, intelligent woman and let's face it, Mike's kind of a
wang. I mean, he proposed to me while he was still seeing you... He was gonna
break-up with you on your birthday? And, I don't like to kiss-and-tell,
but he cheated on you a lot this weekend.

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: Oh, my God, maybe you're right. Maybe I don't need
him. I deserve to be treated with respect.
(Mike enters the apartment.)

lines.speaker: Precious
lines.text: Screw you, Mike. You're a coward and a bastard,
and I hope you rot in hell.
(she slaps him in the face, Mike looks like he
doesn't believe what just happened. Precious leaves, and he turns to Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're welcome!
[Scene: Chandler and Monica's. Only Chandler is in the living room and walks
to the bathroom.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, you've been in there for a long time...
Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Not really.
(Chandler enters the bathroom, and Monica is standing there in a towel, with
her hair stuck in the shower curtain.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I have a problem.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? What happened?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I was dancing around, and singing "No Woman,
No Cry" and I got stuck.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can't move at all?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, well, I can move... (she moves back and forth
the shower curtain rail, opening and closing the shower curtain with her hair
as she goes)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If I untangle you, will you please get rid of the
corn rose?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking disappointed) I guess so...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (trying to untangle her) Some of these look a little
frayed.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I tried to gnaw myself free.

scenes.location: Rachel and Joey's apartment. Joey enters.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, did you err... did you tell Ross?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I tried, but then he had a shampoo related
emergency. So I guess now it's your turn again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no... I think it's better
if you tell him, you know. It's easier for a woman. That way, you know, if
he gets mad, all you have to do is go... I didn't mean it. I'm so so--ooory. (he
pushes his breasts together from the side)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, 'cause that's what we do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, alright, okay, uhm... How 'bout this, how
about this? Tomorrow... tomorrow we'll both go and we'll tell him together.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, that sounds fair. It just means that once again
we can't...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, I know..., but that's okay. I mean, we can
control ourselves, we're not animals.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No! Of course we can wait. Alright, so I guess that
means good night then?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Good night! (they give each other a small kiss
on the mouth, and stare at each other for a while)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Goo--ood night!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good night! (they give each other a kiss again, but
this time it lasts longer)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Seriously, good night!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Stop saying good night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
(Now they kiss passionately... and then Ross enters with Emma. They freeze,
pull away and look at Ross who looks like he just can't believe what he's seeing.
Joey straightens his shirt, and Rachel says I'm so-oo sorry, and
presses her breasts together, just like Joey did before.)
COMMERCIAL BREAK
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's. Monica walks in with one of those knitted Rasta
hats.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look what I found in the drawer... (Chandler looks
up from his book.) And you said I'd never wear this...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now that I untangled you, how 'bout you doing a
little something for me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure, what do you have in mind?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think you know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? I don't really feel like it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is what I want to do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I just don't get why you like it so much.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Picks up the "Miss Congeniality" DVD) She's an
FBI agent, posing as a beauty contestant.
THE END

title: The One Where Ross Is Fine

lines.text: [Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment. The scene starts where we took off in
the last episode with Ross seeing Joey and Rachel kissing. Rosss tares at them.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, Ross, I realise that you didn't expect to walk in and see that, but.. Let me explain, okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We weren't doing anything!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rach, he just saw us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shhh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But what you saw, that is the extent of it, okay? One kiss.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, come on, that is a lie. We also kissed in Barbados.
Joey (to Rachel): Dude, chill! (to Ross) Okay, we also kissed in Barbados,
but we didn't plan it, okay? And the only reason that that happened was because
I saw you kissing Charlie.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, you started it! I've got to chill.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, we probably should have talked to you about this before it ever happened, but..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We feel so terrible about this, Ross.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but it did happen, so...
(Ross looks shocked and says nothing.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross? (to Joey) Can we just close the door?
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment. Continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, say something. Anything.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So you two are..?

lines.speaker: Joey and Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And have you .. ed?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, no!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But if I hadn't walked in here, would you..?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Probably.
(Rachel looks at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, this is not how we wanted you to find out about this. You have every right to go nuts.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm not going nuts. Do you see me go nuts?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, but you know what I mean.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, hey, hey... If you two are happy, then I'm happy for you. (Squeaky.) I'm fine!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Absolutely. (Very Squeaky.) I'm fine! Totally fine. I don't know why
it's coming out all loud and squeaky, 'cause really, (deep voice) I'm fine.
I'm not saying I wasn't a little surprised to see you guys kissing. I mean,
at first I was like.. (Screams.) But now that I've had time to absorb it; Lovin'
this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross..

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's all working out! Me & Charlie, and you two. You know what
we should do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Calm ourselves?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. We should all have dinner. Yes, we'll do it tomorrow night.
I'll cook!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, don't you think that will be a little weird?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Weird? What? What's weird? The only thing weird would be if
someone didn't like Mexican food, because I'm making fajitas!! (Storms
off.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I do like fajitas.
[Scene: Central Perk. Monica and Chandler are there. They have lots of
brochures about adoption in front of them.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God, this adoption stuff is so overwhelming. There's
inter-country adoption, dependency adoption.. There are so many ways
to go, and this is like the biggest decision of our lives.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There's a hair in my coffee.
(Phoebe enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, have you seen Frank Jr., 'cause he's meeting me here with
the triplets.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, it's funny. Every time you say "triplets," I
immediately think of three hot blonde 19-year olds.
(Monica glares at him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's sweet. Drink your hair.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, what's all this stuff?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, they're brochures from different adoption agencies.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, babies! Oh, this one is so cute, get this one!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's not really how it works.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, how does it work?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if you're having a hard time, you should talk to my
friends, Bill and Colleen. They adopted a kid. I'm sure they'd help
you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks, that would be great. Hey, honey, wouldn't that be
great?
(Chandler looks like he did the time he swallowed the toy in 605 TOW
Joey's Porsche. It's the hair in his coffee.)
(Frank Jr. and the triplets enter.)

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Alright, alright, alright. Remember what we talked about.
When we're in a public place, there are certain rules.
(The triplets scream and run amok in the coffeehouse.)

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: That's not what we talked about!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good to see you.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Good to see you, too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi Frank.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Hi, how you doin'?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, my goodness, they've all gotten so big!
(Little Chandler is pulling Chandler's sweater, while Leslie is
throwing bagels at him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Which one is which again?

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Oh, that's Frank Jr. Jr. pulling the tampons out of the
lady's purse. And that's Chandler climbing on Chandler, and that's
Leslie throwing bagels at him.
Monica (reads a form in her lap): "Willing to adopt triplets?" No!
[Scene: The hallway in Ross's building. Joey and Rachel are on their
way to Ross's dinner.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, can I just say I know we're doing this for Ross, and that's
cool, but if it was up to me, this is not what we'd be doing on our
first date.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what would we be doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'd take you out for a romantic night. Some champagne, fancy
dinner, feel you up on the carriage ride home...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Feel me up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: In a carriage!
(Charlie walks up to them.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Charlie!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Hi, hi. So.. Dreading this?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you bet.
(Joey sees that she's carrying a small red bag.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, did you bring a little something for Ross?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Actually.. It's stuff you left at my apartment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh. Oh, thanks.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: And you know, you can just give me my stuff whenever you
want.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I didn't throw any of that out..
(They enter Ross's apartment. Ross is already quite hyper.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I thought I heard voices! Hi Charlie! (Kisses her.) Hi Joey.
(Hugs him.) And.. Oh! You're gonna have to introduce me to your new
girlfriend. (Laughs.) I'm just kidding, I know Rachel, I know. (He
squeezes her hand.) Come, please come in. Come in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, well, we brought you some wine.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! That is so thoughtful. (To Joey.) She's a keeper. And what
did you bring me? (Grabs the bag that Charlie brought for Joey.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, actually, that's..

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Underwear, a toothbrush, and Van Halen CD. I can use all these
things!!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Gosh, Ross, you know, you seem a little...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Fine? Because I am! Aren't you? Aren't you? Aren't you?
You see? Who else is fine?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, listen, hey, Ross. Why don't you try to relax, okay? Maybe
have a drink.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what? That is a very good idea. I'm gonna go make a
pitcher of Margaritas.
(Does a Mexican dancing-thing before going to the kitchen.)
[Scene: Central Perk. Frank Jr., Phoebe and the triplets are there.
The triplets are now sleeping on top of each other on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, god. So adorable. Look at them sleeping there like angels.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Yeah, I really cherish these moments, 'cause before you
know it, they're gonna be awake again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, they may be a handful, but they're so cute.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, god, the last time I babysat them, they did the funniest
thing..

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: I haven't slept in four years!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's a, that's a long time.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: You just don't know how hard it is, Phoebe. There's just so
many of them. You know, two I can handle. Two's great. You just hold
one in each hand, but what do I do when the third one runs at me with
his bike helmet on. I've got no more hands to protect my area! There's
three of them, Phoebe, three!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I know, Frank. I counted them when they were coming out
of my area.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Sometimes I think that.. Oh, no, no, no, I can't say it,
it's too horrible. No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: No, I can't.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my god, Frank, are you thinking of leaving? Because I
didn't have those triplets so you could just run out on them!

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Oh, no! I would never do that. No. I just was thinking
that, you know, maybe you could take one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?! You can't separate them! That's terrible. Which one?

scenes.location: Bill and Colleen's apartment. Chandler and Monica enter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you so much for seeing us. Phoebe has told us such great
things about you guys.

lines.speaker: Colleen
lines.text: Oh, please, we're happy to help.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.text: We went through the same thing when we were adopting.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, a lot of malfunctioning wee-wees and hoo-hoos in this
room, huh?
(Bill and Colleen look shocked.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I mean, you have a lovely home.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, we appreciate anything you can tell us.

lines.speaker: Colleen
lines.text: Well, actually, I think this might help.
(She gives Monica a big binder that's perfectly in order.)

lines.speaker: Colleen
lines.text: It's pretty much all the information you need.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god!

lines.speaker: Colleen
lines.text: Everything is broken down into categories, and then
cross-referenced, and then colour-coded to correspond with the forms
in the back.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you. (To Chandler.) I think I just had a tiny orgasm.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.text: I know the process is frustrating, but it's so worth it.
Adopting Owen was the best thing that ever happened to us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's great. (To Monica.) Can I see the book?
(Monica looks at him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You want me to wash my hands first, don't you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's.. It's just so pretty and white.

lines.speaker: Colleen
lines.text: The bathroom is down the hall, to your left.
(Chandler leaves.)

lines.speaker: Colleen
lines.text: I would have told him to do it too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can I adopt you?
(Cut to the hall. Owen is wearing his scout-uniform and is looking
through a box when Chandler walks up to him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you must be Owen.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm Chandler. Hey, I was in the scouts too.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: You were?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, in fact my father was a den-mother.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know how to use a compass?

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: I have a badge in it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You do? That's fantastic!

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: You wanna see it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'd love to, but I gotta get back to talking to your
parents. They're telling us all about how they adopted you.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: What?!?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: I'm adopted?
(Chandler tries to come up with a good answer.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I got nothing.
[Scene: Ross's apartment. Ross is totally wasted, but he's still
drinking all the margaritas.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The first batch of margaritas was not so great, but the second
batch is gooooood.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, maybe the next batch, we could all get some.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, guys, this is fun, isn't it? You know? Just the four of us.
Just hangin'.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, are you okay? And when are the fajitas gonna be ready?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm fine! Hey, I'm great! I'm just.. I'm just proud of us.
There's no weirdness, no tension.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No awareness.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We make a great foursome. We should do more stuff together. Ooh!
Let's take a trip. Okay, where do you think we - we can go?
(The oven timer pings in the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My fajitas!!
(He runs off to the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, Charlie, I just want you to know. Ross is just having a
little trouble adjusting to the thought of Joey and me. You know, he
normally doesn't drink like this.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, you know what? This is nothing. My father is a raging
alcoholic.
(Joey and Rachel don't know how to respond to that.)

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, have I made this evening uncomfortable?
(Ross enters carrying a frying pan with fajitas - without any oven
mitts.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fajitas! Be careful, very hot plate, very hot plate!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, you don't even have oven mitts on!
(Ross laughs.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That is gonna hurt tomorrow!
[Scene: Central Perk. Frank Jr., Phoebe and the triplets are there.
Continued from earlier.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well, this is crazy. Can't seriously be talking about me
taking one of your kids, can we?

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: No, of course we're not.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Insane.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alice would never go for it, right?

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Oh, I don't know, she's pretty tired, too, I think we've
got her onboard.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, just you know, for argument's sake, you know,
hypothetically. Which one would you be willing to give up?

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Frank Jr.Jr.?

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Oh, you'd be getting a really good one. I mean, you know,
he's really funny. Like, the other day he made up this joke.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: What's green and says "hey, I'm a frog"? A talking frog!
(Laughs.) Oh, no, you can't have him, he's too funny.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, alright, that's fine. What about Leslie?

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Oh, no, no. Not Leslie. No, she's, she's the only one that
knows how to burp the alphabet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, so that leaves Chandler.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Oh, no, no, you can't have Chandler, no. No, no. She's my
little genius. I got big hopes for her. She's gonna be a doctor or a
realtor..

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, Frank. I think we just ran out of kids.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: Oh, I think you're right. Oh, wow. Phoebe, I don't think I
can give one of them up. I mean, you know, they drive me crazy, but
they're my babies.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry, Frank. I didn't realise things were so bad. You
know, I'll help out more. I can - I can babysit any time you want. You
name the day, and I'll be there.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: How about tomorrow?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, that's not good. But you know, I can move some stuff
around, and I'll be there. You and Alice just take the whole day
together.

lines.speaker: Frank Jr.
lines.text: You'd do that for us?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you kidding? That's what sisters are for.
Frank Jr. (looks at the triplets): Look at them! Aw. I love you so
much. (Strokes Leslie's hair, and she moves a little.) Oh crap, don't
wake up, don't wake up!
[Scene: Bill and Colleen's apartment. Chandler comes running into the
living room. Monica is the only one there.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where are Bill and Colleen?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They're in the kitchen getting something to eat. Can you
believe how nice they are?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We have to leave!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why? What did you do in the bathroom?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn't get to the bathroom. I bumped into Owen on the way,
and he didn't know he was adopted. And there's a slight chance I may
have told him.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my god, where's my purse? No, you know what? I can replace
everything in there. Get that binder, and let's go!
(Bill and Colleen enter.)

lines.speaker: Colleen
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.text: Some little snacks for everybody. Oh, you don't have to eat the
sour worms. Those are for Owen.

lines.speaker: Colleen
lines.text: I'll go get him in a second. By the way, you should know we
haven't told him he's adopted yet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But kids are so intuitive. Don't you think on some level he
already knows?
(Owen comes running in.)

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: I'm adopted?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: See? Intuitive!

lines.speaker: Bill
lines.text: What? Where did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: He told me! And he paid me 50 dollars not to tell.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Which technically now you should give back!

lines.speaker: Colleen
lines.text: You told him he's adopted?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm so sorry, but you should have a sign out there or
something. Or at least whisper it to people when they come in the
door. "Owen doesn't know he's adopted, and he also thinks that Santa
is real."

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: He isn't?!
Chandler (to Monica): We have to get out of here, baby!
[Scene: Ross's apartment. Rachel, Joey and Charlie are eating fajitas
when Ross enters from the kitchen.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Everyone? I would like to make a toast to Rachel and Joey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And to love. Ah, love. L-O-V-E, love. L is for life. And what is
life without love?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my god, are we supposed to answer?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: O is for "oh, wow!" The V is for this very surprising turn
of
events, which I'm still fine with by the way. E is for how extremely
normal I find it. That you two are together. And now one day you might
get married and have children of your own.
(Ross chokes up and pauses. Rachel and Joey look at him.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, are you okay?

lines.text: Totally.

lines.text: Ross, you don't seem okay.

entertaining. I think everyone would feel better if we had some flan.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Wait, Ross. Ross. I - I have to take off.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I'm sorry, I have a really early class in the morning, but
this has been lovely.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wasn't it? And you thought it would be awkward with Joey and
that you never really liked Rachel.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: You're on fire! I'll call you in the morning, okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Alright.
(Ross goes to the kitchen.)

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: God, Rachel, what Ross just said that is just so..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that's okay, girls tend not to like me.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Bye.
(Ross enters from the kitchen with three plates with flan.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, I guess it's just flan for three! Hey, hey, that rhymed!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what, Ross? I think we're gonna take off too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, oh. Of course. God, I'm so stupid. You guys are a couple

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, it's just that it's getting late...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, hey, it's fine. It's totally fine. We've got plenty of

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't even know what that's for.
(He goes back to the kitchen.)

lines.text: You know what? I think I'm gonna stay here and make sure he's
okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, that's probably a good idea.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. I'll see you in the morning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh. Okay. You know what, Joey, I don't think he's ever
gonna be okay with this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It doesn't look good, does it?
(They kiss each other on the cheek, and Rachel leaves.)
[Scene: Ross's apartment the next morning. Ross is very hung-over on

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Morning. Here you go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks. Did you stay here all night?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So you took off my pants and shoes?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no. You actually did that when you were dancing to the

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, she and I said from the beginning that we weren't gonna do
anything unless you were okay with it. And clearly..

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what are you talking about? I'm fine!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's okay, Ross, alright? I totally understand. Of course you're
not fine. You're.. You're Ross and Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Except we're not. I mean, we haven't been a couple in like, six
years. Oh my god, is that right? Has it been that long?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's what I hear, yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is crazy. I mean, six years? And because of me you guys
aren't gonna be together? Can I ask you something? Really, what is
this thing with you and Rachel?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on, I mean, you know me, you know...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm crazy about her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And she feels the same way?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, then, maybe it's time we all moved on.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but, Ross, I mean, you're not okay with it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, but I wanna be. Hey, I will be. Besides, I'm with Charlie,
right? Oh my god, I'm still with Charlie, aren't I? I mean, she didn't
see the dance, did she?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no, no, that was - that was just for me. Are you sure
about this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I'm sure.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And we're okay?
(Ross smiles and holds up his hand for a high-five, but he has

ENDING CREDITS

(The triplets stare at him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm gonna go tell Emma she was an accident. (Runs off.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well...kinda.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh My God!

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Oh! Bugger. Should I not have said that? I feel like
a perfect arse!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah well, in America you're just an "ass".
(Monica's mobile starts ringing. She picks it up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Into the phone) Hello? Chandler,
what's wrong? (She listens) Oh my God, are you alright? (listens some more)
Yeah, I'll be right there. (She hangs up and speaks to Amanda) I'm so sorry,
but Chandler was in a car accident. (She gets up)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Also gets up and starts taking her purse) Oh my
God. Was Mike with him?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nope! (She turns and leaves)

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment.

lines.text: (Joey comes running in.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Rachel) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey! Got champagne?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yes ma'am, ready to Power through!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excellent! Stick it in the ice bucket, the phone
is off the hook, and in the interest of powering through (Starts to remove
her bra from under her clothes)...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh! (When she's done she throws her bra at him)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok (starts to light some candles) Sexy, sexy, very
sexy, sexy. (Claps her hands and jumps at Joey, clearly very excited) Alright!
Lets do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, you're scaring me a little bit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Get over it soldier, we've gotta do this! (She
pulls him towards her and throws him onto the barcalounger) Ok. Aha! You like
that huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You like that? (She climbs on the barcalounger seductively,
putting her knees next to Joey's hips.) Let's take this into high gear (She
pulls the barcalounger lever and seat reclines. She puts one of her knees between
his legs and begins to kiss his neck.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: uh uh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah baby, I'll show you how we do it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no! You kneed me in my misters!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Oh my God! I'm so sorry. Joey? Are you ok?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (He just sits there, legs very close together with
a painful look on his face) Soldier down!
[Monica and Chandlers apartment.]
(Chandler is sitting on the couch reading. Monica walks in.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We are not friends with Phoebe anymore.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If she asks, I protested a little, but ok!
(Phoebe and Amanda walk in)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Chandler! Thank God you're alive. Monica, can
I talk to you outside for a minute?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I have nothing to say to
you.

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: (announces more to herself than anyone else) Wow,
my flat is twice this size!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Please, Monica? In the hall?
(They both walk to the door and enter the hallway.)

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Ooh, that accident must have been terrible. You look
positively ghastly.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, aren't you a treat.

scenes.location: The hallway

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe you tried to cut
me out. Why Phoebe, why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It was right after we were living together and you
were driving me crazy, okay? You were really controlling and compulsive and
shrill.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm still all those things!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're also so generous and kind and scrappy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (starts smiling) I am scrappy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Exactly! Look, no matter what I tried to do, I couldn't
keep you out of my life. Of all the people I have cut out, you were the only
one who ever clawed her way back in.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's because I'm scrappy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you are. And I'm so glad that you fought your
way back in, because I don't know what I would do without you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I won't know what I would do without
you.
(They hug)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I guess we should go back
in. When you gave me another chance, I guess we should do the same for Amanda.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I guess you're right.
(They both enter the apartment again, where Amanda is "dancing" for
Chandler, but she's really terrible at it)

lines.speaker: Amanda
lines.text: Can you believe it. I've never had any professional
dance training.
(Monica and Phoebe look at each other and leave the apartment again)

scenes.location: A different spray-on tan center

lines.text: (Glenda, who works here, and Ross are walking to the room with the spray-on tan
booth.)

lines.speaker: Glenda
lines.text: Now, let me explain how this works. You go into the
booth, and...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm gonna stop you right there, Glenda. Okay? Does
it look like this is my first time, huh? Now I want 4 two's... and I want them
all on my back.

lines.speaker: Glenda
lines.text: (quietly) Okay...
(Ross enters the room, takes off his robe and enters the booth. He stands
with his back to the nozzles and then realises that this booth has nozzles
at both sides of the wall)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, there's two sets of nozzles, which one
is it?
(He turns around frantically from side to side.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Which... which... which... Which one is it?
(He then stops turning, facing one of the nozzles, which starts spraying in
this face and front again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OH! SON OF A BITCH!
(He now turns to the other side, which also starts spraying his face and front.)

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's

lines.text: (Joey and Rachel are both sitting on the couch. Joey keeping his knees pressed
against each other)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is the matter with us?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, I know what's the matter with me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I mean with us, you know. I mean, is it supposed
to be this... difficult?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know.
(Chandler enters the apartment)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That fake British woman is a real bitch, but she
sure can dance... Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Hey, listen, can we ask you a question? When
you and Monica first hooked up, was it weird going from friends to... more
than that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kinda... you know, sneaking around, having to hide
from you guys...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, no... No, I mean... se-x-u-ally...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, was there a part of you that... felt like it
was... really wrong?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually, no. No, it felt right. You know, it felt
like uhm... I can't believe we haven't been doing this the whole time.
(Rachel and Joey are still looking at Chandler, slowly letting his words get
to them)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can tell from your expressions that that's the
good news you were hoping for... Well, I'm gonna go continue to... spread the
joy.(Chandler leaves the apartment. Joey sighs)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, just because it happened that way for them
doesn't mean it has to happen that way for us.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah... Absolutely. I mean, just because something's
difficult doesn't mean that you quit.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Right, totally.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, so we just keep trying and trying until we...
do it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, and if doesn't work, then we'll be just one
of those couples that never have sex.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's a... pla-an.
(They both stare for a while, and then look at each other)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sighs) Wow... I did not see this coming.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't get it. I mean, I was so sure this was what
I wanted.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmmm... Me too...
(She puts her head on Joey's shoulder and Joey kisses her on her head.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I wonder how Monica and Chandler could do it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I guess they weren't as good friends as we are.
(Lifts her head from Joey's shoulder)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aah... I bet you're right.
(They look at each other for a while)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I love ya.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Love you too... Alright, I'm going to bed.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, me too.
(Rachel gets up, and Joey tries to get up, but halfway up he sits down again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh, yeah, I'm not going anywhere for a while.
(Joey takes the ice-bucket with the champagne bottle in it and puts it on
his sore spot)
ENDING CREDITS

scenes.location: Ross's apartment.

lines.text: (Ross is reading a National Geographic on his sofa when Chandler knocks on the
door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dude, it's Chandler. Let me in.
(Ross's face is now a VERY dark shade of brown.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Go away! I don't want to see anybody.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, I went to the tanning place and the same
thing happened to me. You have to let me in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? Did you count Mississipily?
(Ross walks to the door and opens it.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude, you're not tanned.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I just had to get a picture of this.
(Chandler holds up a camera and takes Ross's picture.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I see you later!
(Ross closes the door)
end

title: The One with the Cake

lines.text: Friends - 1004 - The One With The Cake
Friends
1004 - The One With The Cake

lines.speaker: Written by
lines.text: Dana Klein

lines.speaker: Produced by
lines.text: Robert Carlock and Wendy Knoller

lines.speaker: Transcribed by
lines.text: Coffee Mug, Eleonora, Sebastiano & Vanessa

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (she enters) Hey guys!
Ross, Rachel and Chandler: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, I got us that room at the Woodford Inn this weekend.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That place in Vermont? You can take
a hint!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, you can't go away this weekend! It's Emma's birthday!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We're having a party.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, can't you just have the party when we get back?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No,
that day... that won't be her real birthday!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Gee if only she were one and had no idea what the hell a birthday
was!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mon you guys, this is really important to us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I'm sorry, but Chandler and I could really use a weekend away.
You know, to reconnect... emotionally.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There's this thing I really want us to do. I read about it in Maxim...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, can't you just go to Vermont the next day?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, we want everyone to be there. As much as I hate to delay your doing
weird sex stuff to my little sister.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I mean, you know, you guys... This is a big deal. I mean, how can
we have her first birthday party without her aunt and her uncle!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, we'll stay. We can just drive up after the party.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine, but if we end up not doing this Maxim thing because of this
party...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Believe me, that is not why we won't
be doing that!
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Rachel and Joey's apartment

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know Pheebs, when I was little, on my birthday, my daddy would
hide a present in every room of the house, and then he would draw a treasure
map to help me find 'em all.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oooh, I love family traditions like that. When uhm...
when Ursula and I were kids, on our birthday, our stepdad would sell his blood
to buy us food!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he enters) Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Rachel and Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I brought the camera for Emma's video.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, good, good! We had this idea to make a birthday video for Emma
and we'll give it to her when she is 18.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, COOL!! Wow, it's like a time capsule!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, just think... she's gonna be watching that video on a TV that hasn't
even been invented yet! With friends who right now are just like babies! And
they'll be living in a floating city that the humans built to escape the ant
people!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's the hope! So, is Emma awake yet?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no, it's still nap time. But she'll be up soon.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ah, and where is Joey?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I said it's still nap time.
(Joey comes out from his room, yawning)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (taping Joey with the cam) Hey, there is uncle Joey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, say something to Emma on her 18th birthday!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: 18, uh? (starts to prepare himself to say his "How You Doin'"
line)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, NO!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What, what!? it's for her hot friends!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: When they see this you'll be 52!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And starting to think about settling down!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Joey, will you please set this up for people to put Emma's presents
on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'd love to! Yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Phoebe) We were supposed to bring presents?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! I wrote Emma a song.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah! How was I supposed to know?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, it's a birthday party.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, but for a one-year-old. What's the point... the other day she laughed
for like an hour at a cup. Just a cup with a picture of Elmo on it dressed as
a farmer. And he's standing next to this cow and the cow says "El-moo"!
(Joey starts laughing) Yeah... that's a funny cup!
(Monica and Chandler enter)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey hey! Where's the birthday girl?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, she's still napping

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, sure, she was probably up all night, excited about the party
she knows is happening.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, I know that you guys really want to get to Vermont and this isn't
a really big deal to you, but it really is to us, ok? Emma will never have a
first birthday again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right... you're right. We're sorry. Now let's wake up Emma and
get the fun time started!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No really, she didn't sleep well last night, so we can't wake her up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you freaking kidding me, Green?
(someone knocks on the door. Rachel goes to open it)

lines.speaker: Jack and Judy
lines.text: HI!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (points the camcorder towards them to record their entrance) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So glad you came!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: I can't believe Emma is already one!

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: (to Monica) I remember your first birthday! Ross was jealous of all the
attention we were giving you. He pulled on his testicles so hard! We had to
take him to the emergency room!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pointing the camcorder at himself) There's something you didn't know
about your dad!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Mr. and Mrs. Geller! Let me help you with that.

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh man, this is great, uh? The three of us together again! You know what
would be fun? If we gave this present to Emma from all of us!

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: Which one are you?
(Time lapse)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe Emma is still asleep!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, what are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I've got a plan. I've got a plan. I'm going to ram this platter really
hard into your ribs. You're gonna scream out and that'll wake her up!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not going to Vermont with this Monica!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, you know what? I was thinking... since you wrote a song,
maybe I could do something for Emma using my talents!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you’re gonna... hit on her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no! My talents as an actor!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know, I could like maybe... I could do a dramatic reading of one
of her books!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or you could stick a fork in an apple!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I think Emma might like it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Emma might like what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Um, my present!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What did you get her?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Actually we prepared performances.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Separate performances.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But equally real!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, this sounds like fun! Well, you know what? Actually? People are
getting a little antsy waiting Emma to wake up from her nap, so would you mind
performing them once now?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure, yeah!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (unconfidently) O K.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to everybody) All right, let’s get this party started, huh?
Joey and Phoebe are gonna perform a little something for us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Joey) Are you gonna be embarrassed going up there having nothing
prepared?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I do it every week with three cameras pointed at me and a whole
crew waiting!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, Joey, what are you gonna do for us?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I will be doing a dramatic reading of one of Emma’s books.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, ok, which one?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, why, it’s a... (he picks a book up) one of her favorites, uh,
(he reads the title of the book) “Riding the Storm Out. Coping with post-partum
depression” eesh! (he puts the book back and picks up another) “Love
you forever”. Love you forever. By Robert Munsch. Published by Firefly
books. Printed (he pauses and changes the tone to a dramatic one) in Mexico.
A mother held her new baby and very slowly rocked him back and forth, back and
forth, back and forth, and while she held him she sang “I’ll love
you forever, I’ll like you for always, as long as I'm living, my baby
you’ll be”. (the picture fades and Joey is now finishing the book).
And while he rocked her, he sang “I’ll love you forever, I’ll
like you for always, as long as I'm living, my baby you’ll be”.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (crying) Wow! That was amazing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you so much for that gift!
Chandler (nearly weeping): I was not ready for this today!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Amazing... amazing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Phoebe, I’m sorry! Phoebe has prepared something as well.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s right, I've prepared a song for Emma. From my heart to
hers. For there’s no greater gift, than the gift of music. (she starts
singing) Emma! Your name poses a dilemma. 'Cause not much else rhymes with Emma!
Maybe the actor Richard Crenna, he played the commanding officer in Rambo. Happy
birthday Emma!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Is that it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, of course not! I also, you know, prepared a reading (she picks
up a book). “Sex and the single mother. (pause) Finding your G-spot.

lines.speaker: Everybody
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no!

scenes.location: Joey’s Apartment. Ross is filming his parents

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: Hello Emma. Happy eighteenth birthday.

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: Right now that seems so far away, seventeen years.

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: Yes, you’ll be all grown up by then. We’ll be... Well your
grandfather and I might not be here.

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: That’s true! This message could becoming to you from beyond the
grave, Emma!

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: After all, my parents died very young.

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: And my cholesterol’s off the charts!

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: Remember, Emma, heart disease kills women too!
Ross (stops recording): Ok, cut! Great. That was... that was
just... yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, um, don’t forget to get a shot of Emma’s cake. It’s
in a box in the fridge.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you're gonna love this cake. I got it from a bakery in New Jersey,
Corino’s.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, that place has the creamiest frosting! I use to hitchhike
there when I was a kid.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, anyway, they make these great novelty cakes, in all different
shapes, and if you give them a photo, they’ll copy it in icing!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, did you do a picture of Emma?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! On a cake shaped like a bunny.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, Rach? Does this bakery by any chance also bake erotic cakes? Say
for bachelorette parties?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, what are you talking about? (she sees the cake) oh! Oh my God!
They put my baby’s face on a penis!
Phoebe (sees the cake): oh! Now it’s a party!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why you guys this isn't funny, all right? If I wanted this cake to
be a disaster I would have baked it myself!
Joey (staring at the cake): Uh.. is it ok that I still think it looks delicious?

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: (to Jack) Jack, look at this.

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: I know what you're thinking Judy, the resemblance is uncanny!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am this close to tugging on my testicles again.
Rachel (on the phone): No, no, this is not what I ordered.
Ok? I went all the way to New Jersey so that I could have the perfect cake for
my daughter’s birthday and I need a bunny cake, right now!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ask them if it would be faster if we cut the baby’s face off the
penis, so we can put it on the bunny. (pause). That is a weird sentence!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Believe you me! I am going to bring this cake back, I don't even
want it in my home... (Turns towards the cake and sees Joey trying to take a
piece and yells at him) Joey, don't touch it!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm so confused!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (speaking to the person on the phone again) Yes, yes. I still want
my daughters picture, but on a bunny cake. Yellow cake, chocolate frosting with
nuts!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: To be fair this one does have nuts.
(Time lapse)
(Ross, Chandler and Monica are in the kitchen area)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Mon, that was really nice of you to loan Rachel your car so she could
go and get the cake.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh. So nice of her to pull my hair, 'till I dropped the key!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, you know what? While we're waiting, you guys could tape your message
to Emma for her 18th birthday, huh? (takes the camcorder and points it at Monica
and Chandler) Ok!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi Emma! It's the year 2020. Are you still enjoying your nap?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're Aunt Monica and uncle Chandler, by the way.
You may not recognize us, because we haven't spoken to your parents in seventeen years!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We used to be married, but then we missed a weekend away together
and things kind of unraveled. Because of you! Happy Birthday. (Ross looks disappointed
and switches the camcorder off)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, Rachel promised it would be over by now. We seriously have to
go, if we want to get to Vermont. I called them and the last train leaves in
a half hour.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And you know, I have a massage client soon.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You guys, just please.. a little bit longer. I promise, Rachel will be
back with the cake any minute. Monica, remember.. the frosting? huh?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, 5 more minutes.
(The phone rings, Ross picks up)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Into receiver) Hello? (listens) Oh no! What happened? (listens some
more) Ok ok, where are you? (Grabs a pen and starts writing). Ok, I'll be right
there. (Puts the phone down)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Was that Emma? Is she up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, Rachel got pulled over for speeding. She forgot
her licence so now I have to bring it to her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if you're leaving, I'm definitely gonna
go.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Wait! If anybody gets to go.. it's us (Points at herself and Chandler)
We've been complaining the longest!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, wait ! You guys, no, no, you can't leave! Rachel already feels bad
that the cake's messed up. How do you think she's gonna feel when she comes
back here and all you guys are gone?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know! You'll tell us on Monday!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey! You're in charge, ok? You make sure nobody leaves! (leaves)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Got it! (Goes towards the front door
and stands with his back to it) Hey hey hey! (to Chandler) Where do you think you're going?

lines.speaker: Chandler
