lines.text: To the bathroom!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, well the rest of you get comfortable, ok, because we're gonna
be here for a li...(stops and thinks) Wait a minute, there is a window in there!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no! He's not getting away that easy! (Phoebe and Joey run towards
the bathroom and enter)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Yelling) What are you doing? Get the hell out of here! (Phoebe and
Joey come out looking shocked)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, that one did not have Emma's face on it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it did not.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: Well, we better get going, it's late. Jack's not allowed to drive at
night anymore. He has trouble staying in his lane.

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.text: Last winter I went up on a church lawn and drove right through a manger
scene. The papers thought it was a hate crime.

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: Anyway, it was lovely seeing you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok! (Opens the door for them)

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: Bye... Bye dear.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nighty-night!

lines.speaker: Judy
lines.text: Nighty-night!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Bye, bye.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey? How could you just let them leave?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, hey, hey, hey! I'm not gonna mess with Jack, he's a great man, he
fought for our country.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, he didn't! He pretended to be a Quaker to get out of Korea.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Shocked) Oh! Well that's it! He's the last one to go. I'm locking you
guys in. (turns the bolts of the door, thereby locking it)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You do know, I can just turn them the other way around, right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! I forgot you used to live here!
(The phone rings, Joey picks up)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: (on the other side of the line) Joey! It's Estelle!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! (smiles)

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: So, how did your audition go today?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smile fades) What audition?

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: The one I told you about last week?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? You never said anything about an audition!

lines.speaker: Estelle
lines.text: (Looks confused) Let me start over. I just got a call about an audition.
I think you can still make it. It's down at the Astor Theatre and you need to
have a monologue prepared.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A monologue? I don't have.. (sees the book he was reading before for
his "dramatic reading") I got it. (hangs up) (announces to the room)
Aah! so... I'm gonna take off!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wh.. what? No wait, you don't get to leave! I've got a massage client
waiting outside my door any minute!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, and we've paid for a room, that we're supposed to be in right
now!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, oh, ok now... Only one of us has to stay with Emma. Ok, and as
the person who realized that, I get to go!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! no! Let's figure out a fair way to decide who's staying.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! I got it! Ok, everyone pick a number from one to ten. Alright? Whoever
gets the highest number gets to go first.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (She gives Joey a you-are-so-stupid-look) Ok, ten.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, Monica picks ten, I call nine! Anyone else?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, lets just draw straws.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Or.. we could flip a coin, and then multiply the..

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm begging you stop.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, how about this: We got wind up toys for Emma for her birthday.
We can make them race, and whoever comes in last, stays!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Visibly excited) Yeah!! Let's do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Also very excited) That sounds more fun than the thing we were going
to do in Vermont!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Everybody get your toys! (They all run toward the table with toys)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok! I want the dolphin!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thats a bear.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm too excited!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe, you get the bear, uhm, Joey, you get the robot, and Chandler
and I get the dog. Ok, and the race is going to go (Takes two cups and marks
the start and finish lines with them) from here to here. Now the one who comes
in last, stays!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, ladies and gentlemen, wind your toys! (they do so)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, on your mark... Get set... GO!!!
(Monica, Phoebe and Joey release their wind-up toys.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Go! Go!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on robot!
(Phoebe's bear takes the lead, followed by Joey's robot, and far behind is
Chandler and Monica's dog, which walks a few paces, stops and starts barking,
sits, walks again, and so on... )

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the dog) What are you barking at?
(While Phoebe's bear is still in the lead, it is now closely followed by Joey's
robot. Chandler and Monica's dog however, sits down, barking... and does a backflip.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wha... How the hell is that gonna help?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I bought you. How did I forget that that's all you do?
(Meanwhile the race has been won by Phoebe's bear, followed by Joey's robot)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Way to go robot!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good job Alan!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, good race you guys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, see you later!
(Joey and Phoebe leave for the door)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! No, no... wait! We didn't lose. (turns to Chandler) The rules clearly
stated that the last one to cross the finish line was the loser. Well, our dog
never crossed the finish line, so technically...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They left.
(Monica turns to see the closed door.)
[ Scene: The freeway. Rachel is driving Monica's Porsche, while
using her mobile phone. Ross is sitting next to her.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (into the phone) No, there isn't time to go to the bakery. We're just
gonna come home... Everybody left? Alright, well just tell Emma we're gonna
be there as soon as we can. (emotionally) Bye...
(She hangs up, closes her phone, turns around and puts it in her bag which
is in the back of the car. While doing this and not looking at the road, she
turns the steering wheel by accident, which makes the car swerve.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: RACHEL!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OOH! God! Sorry!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastically) I can't believe they gave you a ticket. You're such a
good driver.
(Ross fastens his seat belt.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Emma's awake.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't believe this. This is her first birthday. She's awake. We're
not even there. Everybody left. We still have this stupid obscene cake.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, maybe I can fix that, you know. Try to turn it into something else.
(he opens the box)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, why do you even bother? I already ruined her first birthday...
And do you know how important these early experiences are Ross? Very! According
to the back cover of that book that you gave me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, she's not going to remember this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shakes her head) I guess... Oh, I just had such an idea of what this
day would be like, you know? Emma laughing and everybody gathered around her
cake singing "Happy Birthday". Then we would all go into... HEY GET
OUT OF THE ROAD YOU STUPID STUDENT DRIVER!!! (honks furiously, and Ross looks
at her in disbelief and Rachel looks at him.) They have to learn!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looks back at the cake) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's not bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she looks at the cake) Oh my God! Look what... you made it into a
bunny. How did you do that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I just made these two things uhm... cheeks. And then I split this
to make ears.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I'm very impressed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Some can sing, some can dance. I apparently can turn phallic cakes into
woodland creatures.
[ Scene: Rachel and Joey's apartment. Chandler, Monica and Emma
are sitting on the floor, and Emma's stuffed animals are lined up in front of
them.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now another way to organise your stuffed animals, is by size.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry, is this a game for Emma or for Monica?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Game?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Emma, you even know it's your birthday today? You're one! One-year-old,
that's little.
(With his index finger he shows her how old she is. Emma also points her finger
and babbles...)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh! That's my girl!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's how old you are.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did I teach her that? Did I just... impart wisdom?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (embraces Emma tightly) Ooh, I want one...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me too...
(There's a couple of seconds of silence. Then Chandler looks around...)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: There's no-one around. Why don't we just take this one?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: ...and head to Canada!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was kidding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I wasn't. Let's get going!
(Phoebe enters the apartment again.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, are Ross and Rachel back?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, not yet.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh good, I didn't miss the party.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What about your massage client?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I just felt so bad, missing this. So I just slipped him a little something,
you know. As long as I'm back in five or six hours, it will be alright.
(Joey comes running into the apartment, out of breath.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, if Ross and Rachel ask, I've been here the whole time. THE WHOLE
TIME!
(Ross and Rachel enter.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross and Rachel) I've been here the whole time!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, we just saw you come in. You ran past us on the stairs.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't care that you left. I'm just glad that you're here. Thanks
you guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, guys! Come on! You gotta see what Emma just did.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Emma, how old are you? How old are you today? (holds up his index
finger again)

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Wo-ish. (and holds up her finger)
(Ross and Rachel gasp)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Emma, that's right! You're that many!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! Our daughter's a genius! Rach, this means...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (angrily) NO, no science camp!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damnit! I'll put a candle on the cake.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!... Oh and Emma, look at your stuffed animals lined up so neatly!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, here we go! Emma's first birthday cake... Well hey... well, blow
out the candle. Come on Emma.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let's do it, come on!
(Rachel wipes away some tears.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's wrong? Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah, nothing! These are happy tears! This is just what I wanted.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (pointing at cake) Hey, you made it into a bunny.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What is wrong with me. It looked more delicious when it
was a penis.
ENDING CREDITS
[Scene: Rachel and Joey's apartment. It's just Ross and Rachel.
They put the camera on a tripod in the kitchen and they are standing in front
of the camera.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, you ready?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A-a-and... record.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. (they both look into the camera, and Ross waves.) Hi Emma. Well,
your first birthday is over, and it was really...
(There's a lot of yelling and screaming coming from the hallway, and they get
up to look at what's the noise all about. In the hallway, Monica, Chandler,
Joey and Phoebe are having another wind-up animal race, yelling and screaming
fanatically.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (yelling at the top of her voice) Go, go, go Alan! Run you, hairy bastard!
end

title: The One Where Rachel's Sister Babysits

lines.text: Friends - 10.05 The One Where Rachel's Sister Baby-sits
Friends
1005 - The One Where Rachel's Sister Baby-sits

lines.speaker: Written by
lines.text: Dana Klein

lines.speaker: Produced by
lines.text: Robert Carlock and Wendy Knoller

lines.speaker: Transcribed by
lines.text: Coffee Mug, Eleonora, Sebastiano & Vanessa

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know, I'm thinking about letting Emma have her
first cookie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Her first cookie? She has cookies all the time!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I've never given her a cookie. Have you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No! No... and, for the record, I've also never given her a frosting from
a can!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Rach, the adoption agency needs letters of recommendation and we
were wondering if you would write one for us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Of course, I'd be honored!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you!
(Joey looks at them, disappointed about their decision)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: U-U-Um, I think there's been an oversight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey, we would've asked you, we just thought you wouldn't be interested.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, it's just we don't think of you as really being so much "with
the words".

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoo-weh hey weh-hey whoo hey!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Clearly we were wrong.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I gotta a lot of nice stuff to say about you guys, ok? And I know how
much you wanna have a baby, you know, and I would love to help you get one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know what? Then, Joey, we want you to do it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you! Alright, let me see how I'm gonna start... "Dear baby
adoption decider people..."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So excited about your letter!
(Phoebe enters)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! Don't you look nice?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, I do! Today is Mike and my one-year anniversary.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: OH! What's it the anniversary of? Your first date, your first kiss,
first time you had sex...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: YEAH!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So you must be going to somewhere fancy to celebrate?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-uh. Ehm, a Knicks game.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhm... Aren't you a little overdressed?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, you know what, I've never had a one-year anniversary before, so
no matter where we go, I'm wearing something fancy pants, and... I'm gonna put
on my finest jewelry and we're gonna have sex in a public rest room.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You guys do that? Chandler won't even have sex in
our bathroom!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's where people make number two!!
OPENING CREDITS
[Scene: Ross' apartment. Ross is grading papers. Charlie approaches
him.]

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Hey! (They kiss and cuddle a little)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey...

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: So, you know... I have a little time. If you... if you want to...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (surprised) Oh... (he pauses) (sounds disappointed) Ohh... I'd love to
but I really have to grade these papers.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Fine, it's fine... (she whispers) I'll just shower by myself...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Writing on the papers) B, B, B, B, B!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh, Ross, you gave a B to a Pottery Barn catalogue.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, it had some good ideas, take off your shirt.
(they start kissing but someone knocks at the door)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damnit!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: (yelling from outside) Rachel!! Open up!! It's your sister!! (she knocks
on the door again) I have to talk to you!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he opens the door) Hi Amy!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You're not Rachel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Still sharp as a tack!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Um... Charlie, this is Rachel's sister Amy. Amy, this is Charlie.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: H-Hi!!(to Ross) And you are...?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pause) Ross? I... I grew up on your block! We had Thanksgiving together
last year... I had a baby with your sister!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: (looks confused) N-no... uhm... did I buy a falafel from you yesterday?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (gives up) Yes, yes, you did.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment

lines.text: (Ross enters the apartment with Amy)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi Rachel! Here's your sister Amy! She thinks I need
pec implants!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Amy! Hi! Oh-oh-hoh! (they hug) Wow! You remember Joey?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Yeah! Hey, sure! The "Days of Our Lives" guy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's right, yeah.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You're not good!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Always nice to meet a fan!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So now, what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Well, I have huge news.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Emma starts crying in the other room) Oh sorry, hold on. Let me just
check on the baby!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Wait, this is important! Can Ella wait? (Rachel goes to Emma)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ehm... Her name is Emma.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Why did you change it, Ella was so much prettier!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What do I know? I just sell Middle Eastern food from a cart!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hey, your English is getting better!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, she may be the hottest girl I've ever hated.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What... what you working on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (using a laptop) Oh, Monica and Chandler's recommendation. I want it
to sound smart but.. I don't know any big words or anything, so...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why don't you use your Thesaurus?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What did I just say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Watch. (he takes the laptop) Here, you ehm... You highlight the word
you want to change.
Go under Tools and the Thesaurus generates... 'gives'... 'gives' a whole list
of choices. You can pick the word that sounds smartest.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God, that's great! I'm smart!! No, no, I'm... (he uses the Thesaurus)
"brainy, bright, clever", I love this thing! Look out ladies, Joey
Tribbiani's got the whole package!!
[Scene: Rachel's room. Rachel is attending to Emma. Amy is standing
behind her.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: God!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: So beautiful.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I know, isn't she?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: No, I was talking about your bedding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. What's your news, Amy?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh! Um... Well... I'm getting married.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Oh my God! To who?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: This guy! He has a killer apartment.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A-And??

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: A-And it's on Fifth. And the elevator opens up right into the living room.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, what's he like?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh! He's ok. Do you remember my old boyfriend Mark?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: It's his dad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh... wow, so he's gotta be...

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Old? Yeah! But he travels a lot, so he's hardly ever there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sweety, I gotta tell ya... it sounds a little bit like you like the
apartment more than you like...

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Myron. Hmm... I told you he was old!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... sit down, sit down. Oh, honey, you know, I once also almost married
somebody that I didn’t love. Do you remember Barry?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Humpf, remember him? How we used to make out all the time after you went
to sleep.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sometimes just nodding is ok. (pause) Uhm, so but
anyway, listen, not marrying Barry was the best decision that I ever, ever
made. Honey, you deserve
true love. Your soulmate is out there, somewhere. Someone that is your age,
that is smart, that is fun and that you care about!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: (thinks about it) You’re right, you’re right! I’m gonna
do it!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I’m gonna marry Myron and keep looking
for Mr
Right.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, let’s keep talking.
[Scene: Madison Square Garden. Mike and Phoebe are walking to
their seats.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Excuse me, anniversary. Excuse me, anniversary. (looking
at her ticket). Uhm, sir, could you move your nachos... they’re in my
seat. It's my anniversary. (to Mike) Here we are! (Mike nods). Can’t believe
it's been a whole year!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I know. This has been the best year... (the crowd starts cheering so
he starts yelling) THIS HAS BEEN THE BEST YEAR OF MY LIFE!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ME TOO! I NEVER THOUGHT I COULD LOVE SOMEONE THIS MUCH!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I FEEL THE SAME WAY!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: YOU’RE SO GENEROUS AND KIND AND (crowd stops cheering) YOU'RE
AMAZING IN BED (everyone hears it and stare at them.) (to everybody) IT’S
OUR ANNIVERSARY!

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Knicks fans, please turn your attention to the
big screen on the score board. Someone has a special question to ask. (on the
screen there’s written ‘Julie, will you marry me?’ and goes
on to show a guy kneeling down in front of a girl holding out a ring to her)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh how lame... oh, it’s so tacky, and impersonal.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it’s the worst way to propose!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (looks strangely shocked) Excuse me... (he leaves, then Phoebe realizes
what she did).

scenes.location: Monica’s apartment. Joey enters the room

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, finished my recommendation. (he hands it over to
Chandler) Here. And I think you’ll be very, very happy. It’s the
longest I ever spent on a computer without looking at porn.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (reading) I don’t... uh... understand.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sounding very proud of himself) Some of the words are a little too sophisticated
for ya?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (also reading it) It doesn’t make any sense.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course it does! It’s smart! I used the the-saurus!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: On every word?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, what was this sentence originally? (shows the sentence to
Joey)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, ‘They are warm, nice, people with big hearts’.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And that became ‘they are humid prepossessing Homo Sapiens
with full sized aortic pumps...?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah and hey, I really mean it, dude.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Joey, I don’t think we can use this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, because you signed it baby kangaroo Tribbiani (Joey makes a 'and-what’s-wrong-with-that'
look). Hey, why don’t you stop worrying about sounding smart and just
be yourself!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know what? You don’t need a thesaurus, just write from
here, (points at his own heart) your full sized aortic pump.
[Scene: The corridor. Amy knocks Joey’s door and Rachel
opens the door.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Amy, hi!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I took your advice, I left Myron.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, good for you!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I know! I'm Erin Brockovich!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes you are! Oh, I am so proud of you!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Thank you! So, can I stay with you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But Erin Brockovich had her own house.
(Joey comes out of Monica’s apartment and sees Rachel and Amy but does
not notice the huge amount of bags)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, look who’s back! (he sees the bags) Why do you have bags? RACH,
WHY DOES SHE HAVE BAGS?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Well, I’m staying with you guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: We’re gonna be roomies! (she snaps her finger and points at Joey,
snaps her fingers again and points to the bags) Come on!
[Scene: Joey’s apartment. Rachel is in the living room
and Joey comes out of his room.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You slept out here?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah... Amy kept kicking me in her sleep yelling ‘Myron, get

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But uhm, we're getting rid of her, right? Rach, please tell me we’re
getting rid of her.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, I can’t do that!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, come on! Last night I was finishing off a pizza and she said (aping
Amy badly) "Uoh oh oh, a moment on the lips, forever on the hips!"
I don’t need that kind of talk in my house!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well Joey, uhm look, I know that she’s difficult, but I think
it’s really good that she’s here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: 'Cause we will appreciate it more when she’s gone?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it's just... look, you know, when I first moved to the city I was
a lot like her! I was spoiled, self-centered and you guys really took care of
me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, Monica made us!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, uhm... whatever, I have really appreciated it, 'cause I don’t
think I would be the person that I am today if it wasn’t for you guys.
See, I wanna help Amy the way you guys helped me. And I know it’s gonna
take patience, but that’s ok.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Good morning.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeaah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Amy, that’s what I was supposed to wear today, that’s why
I hung it on the door.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh, sweety, you can’t pull this off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Amy, you know what? I was thinking that maybe now it'd be a good time
for us to sit down and, you know, talk about your future.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh, I can’t, honey. I’m gonna go get my eyebrows shaped. (points
at her eyebrows) I am not happy. (to Joey who has a pizza box in his hands)
Oh... sure you wanna eat that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (yelling at her) I’M CURVY, AND I LIKE IT!
[Scene: Monica’s Apartment. Rachel, Ross, Monica and Chandler
are there, Phoebe enters the room]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi. I just had the worst anniversary ever.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I doubt that! Tell her about us last
year.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, well, I bought Chandler a five hundred dollar watch and he wrote
me a rap song.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Seriously?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Word!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, mine was worse than that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, what happened?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We were at the game, and this guy proposed to his girlfriend on the
big screen thing...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that is so tacky.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, that’s what I said, but it turns out, Mike was planning
on proposing to me that same way last night!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, Mike was gonna propose?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, that’s huge!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, do you wanna marry him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I really do! Yes, but, after I dumped on the way he was gonna
propose to me, I don’t think he’s ever gonna ask again! I mean,
I said no in Barbados and now this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She's right! If I were a guy and... (stops himself
mid-sentence...everyone stares at him) Did I just say if I were a
guy..?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe you don't need him to propose to you, maybe you can propose to
him!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I don't know, I don't know, isn't that a little desperate?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I proposed to Chandler! (Phoebe stops herself from laughing) Alright,
moving on...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I don't think it was desperate, I think it was amazing!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Rachel and Ross) Well, do you think
I should propose?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think it could be kind of great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Absolutely! You'll love the feeling! There's nothing like it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, ok, so how should I do it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How about at a game, on the big screen?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Sarcastically) Uuuh!! How about at a Footlocker? (claps her hands
together, faking excitement)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? what? He obviously thinks that's a nice way to be proposed to,
plus he'd never suspect it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, that does make sense. Ok, now, would... would you two (points
to Ross and Chandler) like that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sounds good to me... but what would a guy think?
(Amy walks in carrying a phone handset)

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: (To Rachel) Nana is on the phone (Hands the phone over to Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Takes the phone) Oh! That's interesting, since she died seven years
ago!!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: She did? Who got her condo in Boca?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Into the phone) Hello? (announces to Amy) Oh, it's our nanny! (goes
back to the phone conversation) Hi! Oh... God! I hope you feel better! Ok, bye!
(Hangs up) (To Ross) That's Molly, she's sick. Can you watch Emma today?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I can't. I have back-to-back classes. Did Molly say what she had?
Because my throat's been hurting?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Menstrual cramps.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't think that's what this is.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Monica, Chandler and Phoebe) Can any of you watch Emma?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, sorry sweety..

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, I've got work and then I'm proposing..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Ross) Great, shoot, what are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Well, I can do it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Thinks for a moment) Well, actually...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (He interrupts her immediately, and drags her by her arm to the other
side of the room) Well, can I talk to you for a sec.?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Um, I do not want her baby-sitting our child.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, for one thing, she keeps calling her Ella!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Defends Amy) Wha.. well, Ella's a nice name!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, we'll call the next one Ella.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Shocked) Wha... the next one?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (a little confused) Okay, um... I don't want her watching our baby.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I am trying to help her become a better person. This is a huge
breakthrough for her! She just offered to do something for another human being!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I... I don't know..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, I'm telling you, she's giving up getting her eyebrows (points
at her own to emphasize the word) shaped to do this alright? Do you understand
how important that is in our world?
(Amy approaches from behind)

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: um... listen, I couldn't help but overhear... 'cause I was trying to...
Listen, let me do this alright? I really wanna help you guys out, and plus Rachel's
been so wonderful to me... (looks at hem pleadingly)
(Rachel looks at Ross and her agrees silently)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Absolutely.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: (very excited) Oh! Great! So how much does it pay? (Ross just gives up
and leaves)
[Scene: Central Perk. Joey is inside, Chandler and Monica walk
in.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Joe! How's the second draft of the letter coming?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great, I'm finished! In fact, I just dropped it off at the agency.
(Chandler and Monica look shocked)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You dropped it off?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can we read it? Can you print out another copy?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No can do amigo. No, I didn't use the computer. Felt more personal to
hand-write it. (Chandler and Monica look even more shocked)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You hand-wrote it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, and don't worry. I didn't try to sound smart at
all! See ya later! (Leaves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, oh my God, that letter is gonna go in our
file! We're never gonna get a kid. No, we're gonna be one of those old couples
that collects orchids or has a lot of birds!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's ok, it's ok. You know what? (Takes out his mobile) I'll just
call the agency and tell them to throw out the letter. (starts dialing)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (on the phone) Hello, this is Chandler Bing. Somebody just dropped
off a handwritten recommendation letter, and.. (listens) Uh-huh... Uh-huh...
okay... thank you. Good-bye. (hangs up looking very confused).

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ugh, we're screwed, aren't we? You know what? Just tell me on the way
to the bird store.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Still looks confused) They loved it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: They thought it was very smart of us to have a
child write the recommendation letter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (surprised) They thought Joey was a child?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She guessed 8, 9, based on his drawings.
(Amy comes in with Emma in a stroller)

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, what did you guys do today?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Ella wanted to go out, so we went shopping and got some sushi.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That sounds like fun.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Yeah, not really. Babies are dull.
(Rachel comes in, sees Amy and Emma)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (To Emma) Hey! Hi, how's my girl?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I'm fine! And, I got you a present for letting me stay with you. Ready?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sounds excited) Yeah!
(Amy takes off Emma's hat)

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Ta-daaa!
(Rachel looks at Emma)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (not excited anymore) You pierced her ears!?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: (Very excited about it) Doesn't it make her nose look smaller?
(Rachel looks very shocked)
COMMERCIAL BREAK

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You pierced her ears? How could you do this without telling me?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Well, if I had told you, then it wouldn't have been surprise, now would
it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think she looks cute. (Rachel turns around and stares at him angrily)
... but I am wrong!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, Oh my God, here comes Ross. He's gonna flip out.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Why, did something happen to his falafel cart?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh. (takes the hat and covers Emma's head and half her face with it)
(Ross enters)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey guys.

lines.speaker: Monica and Chandler
lines.text: Hi Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Emma. Oh, why is she wearing her hat so low? She can barely see.
(Wants to take the hat off, but Rachel tries to stop him).

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nah, I don't really want her to see.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because there are so many terrible sights in this world.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Like war. Or that thing in Joey's refrigerator. Remember? It was
in a milk carton but it looked like meat?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come here (Removes Emma's hat) Oh! There she is! Hi!
(Rachel looks worried)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sees how strangely Monica, Chandler and Rachel are looking at him) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Back to Emma) Hi! (Looks at her) What... (Moves the stroller away from
him so he can get a better look at her. He looks at her confused. Finally he
realizes the difference and gasps). Please tell me those are clip-ons.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, they're real!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did she (points at Amy) do this to her? I told you we shouldn't have
left Emma with her!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, I know, and you were right Ross. (To Amy)
You are soo irresponsible
I am never letting you baby-sit ever again!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hey you know what, this kid needs me, okay? She needs
to have a cool fun aunt!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm a cool, fun aunt!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: (Sarcastically) O-Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! Monica can be cool and fun at organized indoor projects!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't believe this. All I wanted to do was help you try to figure
out what to do with your life and this is how you repay me?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Well, I don't need you to help me, because I already know what I'm going
to do with my life.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh yeah? Since when?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Since today... I am going to be a baby stylist.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looks at Ross and then at Amy again in disbelief) What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's not a thing!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Well, it should be. I'm gonna help babies learn how to accessorize, what
colors to wear, what clothes are slimming...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (shouting) Babies don't care if they're slim.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Enter Amy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (very angry) Amy, I ju... I just... I just wanna...

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: What? What are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (pointing at Amy, shouting) No more falafel for you!
(Amy looks at Ross, angrily. Rachel clearly doesn't understand what he meant
and looks at Ross who gestures "later".)
[Scene: Madison Square Garden. Phoebe and Mike are watching the
game. There's cheering, but Phoebe seems distracted.]

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Great game, huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uhuh, uhuh... (seems distracted)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Why do you keep looking at the screen?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm not. I'm praying. (looking up) Please let the Knicks win... Thank
you Thor! (Mike is standing up) Where... where are you going?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Going go to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I think you should wait.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, if you don't... if you don't hold it in, you don't get all the
nutrients.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Knicks fans, please turn your attention to the
big screen on the scoreboard. Someone has a special question to ask.
(We see the screen where it says: "Mike will you marry me?" and then
we see Phoebe and Mike on the screen. Phoebe stands up and kneels in front of
Mike.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mike Hannigan... will you marry me? (Mike looks bewildered)

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Get a load of this... She's proposing
to him. Guess we know who wears the pants in that family.
(people are laughing, while
Mike still seems bewildered)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's not very enlightened!
(There's booing around them, and Mike sinks in his chair, holding his hand
in above his eyes, hoping no-one would recognize him)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, hey! (shouting) Boo us? Boo you!
[Scene: Rachel and Joey's. Joey is in the kitchen and the telephone
rings.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (picks up the phone) Hello? Yeah, this is Joey Tribbiani...
Oh, hi! Well, I'm glad you liked my letter... No my mommy and daddy aren't home
right now... (looks puzzled) Okay, bye bye. (hangs up) (to himself) She was
nice!
(Rachel and Amy enter)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, get Amy's bags, she is moving out!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Whoo-hoo! (and leaves for Rachel's room)

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You're kicking me out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You put holes in my baby's ears!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Yeah well, at least now people will know she is a girl!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) I can't believe I ever even tried to help
you. You are so beyond help.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You know what? Ever since I got here, you have been nothing but negative.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You didn't want me to marry the old guy with the great apartment. Then,
I tried to help your daughter to de-emphasize her flaws (frantically pointing
at her nose) And suddenly I am the bad guy?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (yelling) Joey, where are those bags?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Yelling from Rachel's room) She has a lot of crap!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You know what? When I moved in here I thought: This is gonna be so great.
Just us sisters, back together again like when we were kids, except without
that stupid Jill... Oh! Who has gotten fat by the way...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (doesn't believe what she's hearing) Seriously?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: hm-mmm... Mom said she gained like fifteen pounds.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hips or thighs?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Ass and face.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Oh! Oh my God! I thought she was on Atkins.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: She was. Carbs found her... See, this is what I wanted. Two sisters, talking
about real stuff.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (embarrassed) Oh, I can give you that.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You can?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. I just, I kept trying to make you a better person, but you're...
you're already a pretty perfect version of what you are.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: (touched) Thank you. I've got to admit, Emma does look
cute.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did you just say Emma?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Ugh, I'm sorry... Ella.

scenes.location: Mike and Phoebe at a restaurant.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That woman at the game didn't know what she was talking
about. Mike, obviously you have balls.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: But please, let's just forget the whole thing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (the waiter puts a piece of cake on the table) I would love it. Consider
it forgotten... But just so you know... however and whenever you decide to propose,
I promise I'll say yes. Whether... whether, you know, it is in a basketball
game, or in sky writing, or you know, like some lame guy in a cheesy movie who
hides it in the cake.
(Mike's face changes from happy to sad, and he looks at the cake, disappointed.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's in the cake, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (puts on a fake smile) Where else would lame Mr. No Balls hide it? (he
takes the ring from the cake, and cleans it with a napkin)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What's the matter with me? How do I keep ruining this? I'm sorry, I'm
sorry!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No! It's my fault. I keep trying to propose in these stupid ways and
all I wanna do is tell you that I love you and I want to spend the rest of my
life with you.
(Phoebe has this weird, anxious, nervous look on her face)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I'm gonna do this now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God!
(Mike starts to kneel in front of Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Phoebe, I...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait! Oh wait! (she takes off a ring that was already on her left ring
finger. After that Mike starts to kneel again, but then...) Oh no! (She was
wearing rings on all her fingers and her thumb, and takes all of these off.)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Ready?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh! (and now Mike kneels properly)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Phoebe, I love you. There's no-one else in the world I would ask to marry
me... three times. But I wanna take care of you, have babies with you, and grow
old with you... Phoebe Buffay, will you marry me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes!
(Mike puts the ring on her finger)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I love you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I love you more!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Not possible! (they kiss, and then Mike says proudly...) She's gonna
be Mrs. No Balls.
(They kiss again, and Phoebe looks at the ring.)
COMMERCIAL BREAK
[Scene: The street in front of Central Perk. Rachel and Amy are
walking on the sidewalk.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So how is the uhm... baby styling business going?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Not that great. It's almost if people don't want to hear that their babies
are ugly.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's shocking!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Oh! It's Ross... Hey Ross! (She says hey to the guy at the falafel stand,
whose only similarity with Ross would be his black hair.) Hello-oo Ross! (to
Rachel) He's rude!
THE END

title: The One with Ross's Grant

lines.text: Friends - 10.06 - The One With Ross' Grant
Friends
1006 - The One With Ross' Grant

lines.speaker: Written by
lines.text: Sebastian Jones

lines.speaker: Produced by
lines.text: Robert Carlock and Wendy Knoller

lines.speaker: Transcribed by
lines.text: Coffee Mug, Eleonora, Sebastiano & Vanessa
Final check by
Kim

scenes.location: Central Perk, everyone except Phoebe is there

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (she enters) Hey...

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Pheebs, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I'm just so exhausted from dragging around this...
(she shows her ring) HUGE engagement ring!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: OH!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Congratulations! Wow!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, did he get on one knee, did he have a speech prepared,
or (in a tender way) did he cry? (the guys look at him) Yeah, big surprise,
I like proposals!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, it was really sweet, and like the
most romantic thing ever.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, hey! Well... (he takes his mug to toast Phoebe)
Here's to Phoebe, who's found the greatest guy in the world! To Phoebe and...
(a bit uncertain) I wanna say Mike? (pause) To Phoebe and Mike!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Whoo!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you! (to Rachel) Oh, and I have something for
you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mmh-mmh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's, yes, my little black book. It's got the numbers
of all the guys I've dated.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Pheebs, baby, that's nice but, you know what,
I think I'm ok. Why don't you give it to one of your other single girlfriends?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I would, but you're the last one.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (angrily) GIVE ME THE BOOK! (she takes it and start
reading) Pablo Diaz, Brady Smith, huh, "Guy-in-van"?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, my first love!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What does the red X next to Bob Greenmore's name mean?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Dead. (everyone is a bit upset) Oh, it's OK, no,
he was old, yeah! And he lived a full life, he was in the first wave
at Omaha Beach.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, I'm sorry, I should have given you guys my
black book when I got married! Although it wasn't so much a book as a... napkin.
With Janice's phone number on it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, isn't Jethro Tull a band?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (proud of herself) Oh yes, they are.
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartment

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (he enters) Hey honey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Looking inside the fridge, and we only see his back.
Then he closes the door, and we see it's Joey.) Hi sweetie!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is Monica not here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, then I'll tell you. My agency was bidding for
a big account and they got it! It's my first national commercial!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Cool!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, and I don't wanna brag but a lot of the ideas
were mine! (silence) Hell, you weren't there? All the ideas were
mine!!!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's great! Hey, can you cast me in it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh... I don't know, I really don't think you're
right for the part.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What do you mean? I can do anything, I'm a chameleon!
Huh? (he mimes an old man with a beard) I'm old! (then he yawns) I'm tired!
(then he mimes someone who's hot...) Hey, I'm hot (...and cold) I'm cold!! Huh??
Come on! What can't I do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: First of all. Bravo. Uh, but I really don't think
you're right for this. The part calls for a stuffy college professor.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can do that! (in a deeper voice) "Hello, I'm
your professor. When I'm not busy thinking of important things or... professing.
I like to use..." Oh, what's the product?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Software that facilitates inter-business networking
e-solutions?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (after a long pause he starts miming again) I'm cold!
[Scene: Central Perk. Charlie is sitting on the couch and Ross
enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Charlie) Hey!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Guess who's a finalist for a huge research
grant! I'll give you a hint, he's looking right at you.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Ah, well, unless it's the creepy guy with his hand
up his kilt, I'm gonna say congratulations!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I'm so excited, I mean, apparently I beat out hundreds
of other applicants, included five guys I went to graduate school with. Not
that I'm keeping score or anything... five!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Wow, that's great! So, tell me about the grant!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, ok, it's for 25 thousand dollars. And if I get
it, I'll finally be able to complete my field research! And there
will be an article about me in the "Paleontology Review"! Yeah!
That'll be the first time my name is in there, without people raising serious
questions
about my work!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Wait. Are you talking about the Dewar grant?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Why?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Benjamin Hobart is administering that grant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Your ex-boyfriend?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, your ex-boyfriend is gonna determine if your new
boyfriend gets this grant? Wow, your new boyfriend is screwed!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: No, no, we ended up in great terms. I mean, if anything,
I think this could help you. You know what? Why don't we all go out to dinner
together, and I can introduce you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, if you think it would help.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yes, absolutely. I'll call him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, now, is there anything I can do to... you know,
butter him up? Anything he really likes?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Mmh... he does have a pretty serious latex fetish.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We'll see how dinner goes.

scenes.location: Phoebe's apartment. She is packing a few tings into boxes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looking at Monica entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, you wanna go to see a movie?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I told you I had to spend all the day clearing
out stuff, so Mike could move in.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, well. Now that I'm here I might as well help you
with the cleaning and organizing! Just happen to have my label maker!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it's so hard to get rid of stuff! Did
you and Chandler have to make compromises when you first moved in together?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, Chandler did! What does he want you to give up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A bunch of stuff. And the worst one... he wants me
to get rid of Gladys.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who's Gladys? (Phoebe shows her a horrific painting
with a half-a-body girl dummy coming out of the frame. Monica's frightened and
she gasps.) Oh! What a tragic loss!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. I really hate to give her up. Oh,
I know!! Oh, you should take her!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (faking happiness) Well, I-I-I-I... I don't know...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why, you don't like her?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, of course I do. What's not to like! I'll
take her in a minute! But, you know, I think that you're giving up too
easy, honey. I think that you need to fight for her!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? You think?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Absolutely! Yes, you say to him "I'm sorry
Mike I can't live without her, she means too much to me!"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, I'll fight for her. Ok! Oh, wait, oh I just
realized... if I do that, that means you don't get her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Damn it, I did not think this through!

scenes.location: Central Perk. Rachel, Joey and Emma are there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey you guys.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! Any word on casting yet?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joe, I told you, you're just not right for
the part.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What do you mean? Rach, don't I seem like a professor
you'd buy some kind of e-crap from?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm sorry, this sounds like something I'm never gonna
be interested in.
Joey (to Chandler): Look, c'mon, please? It's
not like I'm asking for some crazy favour. This is what I do for a living. I
am a professional actor! (he glances at his watch and sees the time) Oh, man,
I'm two hours late for work! (he stands, ready to go). Look, here's a
copy of my reels. It's got all the commercials that I've been in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joe...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just watch it, and if you don't like it, you don't
pass it on to your bosses!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you. (he sits down)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Work, Joe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damn it! (he leaves)
Chandler (to Rachel): What am I gonna do now?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just pass it to your boss!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He's not right for the part. So if I suggest
him, my bosses are gonna think I'm an idiot! And that's something they should
learn on their own!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just tell Joey that you watched the tape and you liked
it, but your bosses didn't. Then that way, you're the good guy and
they're the bad guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's good! I liked it, they didn't.
(he sees Joey out of the window hitting on a girl) Joey, for God's sake,
go to work! (Joey runs away).
[Scene: A restaurant. Ross and Charlie are waiting for her ex-boyfriend,
Benjamin Hobart]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe I'm about to meet Benjamin Hobart.
I've always thought of him as one of the people I'd invite to my fantasy dinner
party. Do you think there's any chance he'll bring Christie Brinkley
or C3PO?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: (glances over Ross' shoulder) Sorry, looks
like it's just him.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Charlie! My God, you look absolutely stunning!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I... I am having a good hair day.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: So good to see you.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Me too. (she and Benjamin are hugging for very long
and Ross starts pretending to clear his throat, until they stop)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm ok.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I'm sorry... (introduces them to each other) Ross
Geller... Benjamin Hobart.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's an honor to meet you. I can't tell
you how long I've been an admirer of your work, I mean, that Nobel prize,
(he thumbs up) whoooo! I mean, I have to tell you that, you're one of
the reasons I got into the field.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Oh, well, likewise. Actually, not likewise. I've
never heard of you until this morning, but, it's nice to be nice!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Shall we? (they sit down and Benjamin takes Ross'
chair).

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: (to Ross) Thank you! (to Charlie). I can't
believe that you chose this restaurant! Do you remember the night?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh my God, I completely forgot! (they laugh) Oh
my God! I can't believe they let us back in this place! (they laugh
more, and Ross start laughing too).
Benjamin (to Ross): You weren't there!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, but, it's, you know, it's just a funny image,
you know, the two of you, in this restaurant, with... (laughs nervously)tzz-zzz,
mmm.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Ross, why don't you tell Benji about your proposal,
while I go to the ladies room?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: So, tell me about it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok well, I would like to do a dig in the painted desert.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: M-m.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: See, there are still several areas that haven't
been fully excavated.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Break up with Charlie!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did you just say "break up with Charlie"?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Well, yes, and now. Yes I did say it, and no, I
didn't not say it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Kind of inappropriate, don't you think?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: I'm sorry. I just haven't seen her for so
long! All these feelings are rushing back! I'm starting to realize how much
I missed her, and I'm gonna need you to break up with her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: If you say yes then I'm serious, if you say no then
I'm joking!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Joking it is!

scenes.location: Monica's apartment. Phoebe enters the room.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi! Sorry, I'm late.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, how did it go with Mike, is he gonna let you
keep the painting?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, he really hates it. But he's gonna let me
keep my box of human hair! So you got to pick your battles. But the good news
is, Gladys is yours!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow, what's the bad news!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who's Gladys?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, she's that work of art I made, you know,
with the woman coming out of the frame.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh, and Monica gets to keep her?
In her house? I am so jealous!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I didn't know you wanted her too!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Huh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I mean, sure, of course. But... you already
gave that to Monica, so...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know, I would give her up, for you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I couldn't let you do that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But I want to.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I don't want you to.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But I insist!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I insist harder!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Girls, girls, stop, ok? We'll flip a coin. Heads,
she's Rachel's, tails she's Monica's. (she flips the
coin). Tails! Monica, she's yours!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, that landed in your food!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastic) No, no, that's ok. You won fair
and square. I'm so sad!

scenes.location: Chandler walks into Joey's apartment

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Joe!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's up?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bad news. I watched the tape and passed it along
to my bosses and they weren't interested.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sounds disappointed) Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Hands the tape back to him) I'm sorry man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looks at him suspiciously) But, ehm... you watched
the tape?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sounds nervous) Yeah! I... I... I liked it! (Joey
continues to look at him suspiciously) But, ehm... my bosses didn't go for it.
Stupid sons of bitches!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sounds confident) You didn't watch the tape.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks surprised) What!? Of course I did!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, it's one thing not to cast me, but to lie to me?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not lying to you, I watched it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, you lied again! (Rachel comes out of her room
and is observing the conversation)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I watched it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Keep going Pinocchio!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (now yelling) (pretending to look shocked) I did!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (yelling back) No you didn't! (turns and goes towards
his room)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (following him) I'm telling you, I watched the tape.
(Reaches Joey's room and Joey slams the door in his face)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did you watch the tape?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (In a sarcastic "of course not"!-tone)
No!
[Scene: Interview room. Ross and two other professors (one man,
one woman) are sitting on one side of a long desk. Benjamin Hobart is sitting
on the other side]

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: The selection committee has chosen the three of
you as our finalists today. The ultimate decision will be based upon the answers
you give to the questions I ask here. I'm gonna start with Dr. Li. Dr. Li, you
claim the field is too reliant on the Linnaean taxonomic system. How do you
propose to correct this problem?

lines.speaker: Dr. Li
lines.text: Well, I believe that the answers lie in the osteological
evidence. I plan to begin there.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: (nods) Interesting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Rolls his eyes) I guess!

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Dr. Biely, your proposal includes some field work.
Where might that take place?

lines.speaker: Dr. Biely
lines.text: Primarily in the Pierre Shale region of South Dakota.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Certainly. Very well. And Dr. Geller, when is my
birthday?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (shocked and confused by the question) What? I... I...
(Benjamin looks at him as if to say "What's wrong? Answer the question")

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Care to venture a guess?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (annoyed) May 12th?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: (looks surprised and un-impressed) That's not even
kinda close! (Ross looks around confused) Dr. Li, how many graduate students
you'd be needing?

lines.speaker: Dr. Li
lines.text: Half a dozen.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: I see, and Dr. Biely?

lines.speaker: Dr. Biely
lines.text: Three for excavation and two for analysis.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Certainly. Dr. Geller, which 1965 Shirelles hit
was later covered by a popular British invasion band?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (even more shocked) Wha..? I need 6 graduate students.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: No! I'm sorry, we were looking for "Baby It's
You". Baby It's You.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha...? Wait, wait, wait, just a minute. None of my
questions have anything to do with Paleontology.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: You're right, I apologize. Scratch the last question.
Spell "Boscodictiasaur".

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (annoyed) um... I've never heard of a "Boscodictiasaur".

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Yeah, I just made it up. Spell it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stares at him angrily) Ok. (determined to spell it
correctly) B - O - S ...

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: No, it starts with a silent "M".

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh come on!!
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment. Chandler and Rachel are
talking.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe Joey. I hate being called a liar!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But you are a liar.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What did I just say?
(Joey comes out of his room)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You still here?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, and I have to say, I am not just hurt. I am
insulted. When I tell somebody I did something...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok whoah-hey... Let me just stop you right there, ok?
First, you lied, right? Then, you lied about lying, ok? Then you lied about
lying about lying, ok? So before you lie about lying about lying about lying
about... lying... (loses count and begins to count the number of 'lyings' in
the air but gives up.) (yelling) Stop lying!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why are you so sure I didn't watch this tape?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (very angry) You wanna know wh...? You wanna know why?
(goes back into his room)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, this is going well. (Chandler looks worried)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (comes out holding the tape) Here's how I know you didn't
watch the tape, ok? (puts it into the vcr) If you had seen what was on this
tape, believe me, you would have some comments. Alright, now remember, I
got paid a lot of money for this and it only aired in Japan. (presses play
and he appears on the TV screen and a TV commercial begins)
(The commercial:
Joey says "Ichiban". It displays a few girls dancing around and Joey
fills most of the screen, he puts something blue on his lips and smacks them
saying "Lipstick For Men!" It goes on to show him playing a guitar
and putting on more blue lipstick. In the end he says seductively "Ichiban...
Lipstick For Men" and "Sahiko" and it ends. Chandler and Rachel
are speechless.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Yelling at Chandler) And that's how I know you
didn't watch the tape! (goes back to his room and slams the door).
(Silence)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He really is a chameleon.
[Scene: Monica's apartment. Phoebe enters carrying the horrific
'painting' of Gladys. Monica and Rachel are sitting on the couch.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (smiling from ear to ear) Well, Gladys say hello to
your new home! (she holds out the 'painting')

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (faking happiness) Oh, my!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (surprised by how ugly it is) Wow! (sarcastic) Oh,
she's so nice and big! Oh, Monica, where are you going to display Gladys oh
so proudly? (looks around for a spot)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sounds desperate, knowing what Rachel is trying to
do) I haven't really settled on a spot yet!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, hey! How about right above the TV? (Points to
the spot where her famous French poster is hanging). That way, it will be
the first thing that you see when you walk in the door!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (genuinely excited about it) Yeah, yeah! And you can
get rid of that French poster.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (offended) I like that poster!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really? It doesn't have anything coming out of it.
Or maybe there is some place for her in your bedroom?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (jumps at the chance to make that happen) Oh! There's
nothing above your bed!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Impatient with Rachel) Are you still here?

scenes.location: Ross' office. Ross is pacing and Benjamin enters

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh hi! Hello! Uh, have you come to ask me some more paleontology
related questions? Uhm... your grandmother's nickname, perhaps? (Now yelling)
Aunt Margaret's pants size?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: I've come here to apologize. I think I may have
let my feelings for Charlie interfere with the interview process.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Sarcastic) No! Stop!

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Anyway, I've decided to offer you the grant.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Skeptical) Really?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Well... there is just one small... stipulation...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have to break up with Charlie?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Hey, you got one right!
(Ross shakes his head)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're crazy.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Crazy, or... romantic?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Crazy!

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Ooor...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Yelling) Get out! (Benjamin leaves)

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment.

lines.text: (Rachel enters, checking the mail, then looks up and sees Gladys placed on
the barcalounger.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: O-oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (enters from his bedroom) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, what... is... this...thing... doing here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I got it from Monica. She sold it to me for a very
reasonable price.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey, we're not keeping this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But it's an original Buffay...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, fine. You can keep it. As long as you don't
mind that she's haunted.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey? what? what? wey! whoo! what? what!?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, legend has it Joey, that... she comes alive
when you're asleep.
(Joey's eyes are twice their size now, and looks nervously from Rachel to Gladys
and back.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She climbs out of the frame, and then drags her half-a-body
across the floor, just looking for legs to steal. (in a spooky, slow voice)
And then with her one good hand, she slo-o-owly re-e-a-aches up and turns your
doorknob.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: GET THAT LEGLESS WITCH OUT OF HERE!
(Joey leaves for his bedroom, and Rachel grins. She then takes Gladys and enters
Monica's apartment.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! I sold that to Joey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, why I told him it's haunted. Two can play at
this game. (gives Gladys to Monica)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, too late. You can't give it back! (she pushes
the painting back to Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes I can! (pushes her back again)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No you can't. She's yours!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She's yours!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: SHE'S YOURS!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She's yours!
(While they are both pushing the painting towards each other, Phoebe enters)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! (there's a pause)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She's mine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's m-i-i-ne!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She's mine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's mine!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys! You guys! You don't have to fight over her
anymore. (she goes out into the hallway and enters with an even more hideous
painting/collage. One of those faceles mannequins heads wearing a blueish dress
and orange gloves reaching out into the room. Around the head 3 small dolls
are hovering.) Whoever doesn't get Gladys gets Glynnis. (Rachel and Monica are
gasping for air at the sight of this monstrous piece of art.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I want Gladys!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's mine!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She's mine!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's mine!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She's mine!
[Scene: Rachel and Joey's. Joey's home alone, reading a Sports
Illustrated magazine when Chandler enters.]

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, I'm sorry I didn't give them your tape. And
I promise, next time to submit you whether I think you are right for the part
or not.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's not the point Chandler. The point is that you
lied.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know. You're right. What's it gonna take for you
to forgive me?

scenes.location: Central Perk. Monica, Phoebe and Rachel are on the couch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!
(we see Joey and Chandler standing there, and Chandler is wearing the blue
Ichiban lipstick!)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Excellent!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now, what do you say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Lying is wrong!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And?... AND?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm a pretty little girl.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I knew it!
[Scene: Central Perk. Some time later that day. The group has
left and Charlie is there when Ross enters.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Your ex-boyfriend is insane.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Did you get the grant?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No I didn't, and you want to know why? Because your
ex-boyfriend is still in love with you.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. He wouldn't give me the grant, because I wouldn't
give you up.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Benji isn't in love with me. I mean, he broke up
with me. And besides, he's a very ethical man.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? Is it ethical to ask someone in a grant review,
who was the voice of "Underdog"?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I'm sure he was just joking, Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: If you don't believe me, let's go talk to him, okay?
I'm telling you, he didn't ask me one paleontological question.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Seriously?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, no. He did ask me one. Uhm... How do
you spell Mboscodictiosaur?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Well, if it's like the lake Mbosco in Congo, then

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damnit!

scenes.location: Benjamin's office. Ross and Charlie are entering.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Dr. Geller...? Charlie... What are you... what are
you doing here?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I want you to tell her everything. About the deal you
tried to make with me, about the crazy questions you... Wally Cox! That's the
voice of Underdog!

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Like I tried to tell you in the interview Ross,
this grant is not based on your knowledge of pretty useless trivia.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no. Don't do that! I want you to look her in
the eyes, and tell her the truth.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Benji?

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Alright, it's true. I behaved horribly. But it's
only because I still love you. And I would do anything to have you back in
my life.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Too little, too late, Benji!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I can't believe this.

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: I never should have broken up with you. I think
about you all the time. I mean, do you ever still think about me?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (indignant) No!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I don't know what to say, Benji. This is all so....
romantic.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: or...

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: Listen, I know, I may be way out of bounds here,
but is there any chance you will take me back?

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Maybe...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sweetie, this conversation is starting to make me a
little uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: Oh God! I am so sorry, but... (she puts her hand
on Ross's cheek) I mean it's... there's so much history between us, you know...

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: (puts his hand on Ross's other cheek) I'm sorry
too...
(Charlie and Benji both let their hands slide down Ross's face, until their
hands meet, and they hold hands.)

lines.speaker: Benjamin
lines.text: I love you!

lines.speaker: Charlie
lines.text: I love you too! (and they start to kiss)

lines.speaker: Ross
