lines.text: Okay, that's it. WE ARE SEEING OTHER PEOPLE!
COMMERCIAL BREAK
[Scene: Joey's bedroom. Joey's asleep with Hugsy, the penguin
right next to him.]
(There are scratching and squeaking noises coming from the living room, and
Joey wakes up, terrified. He pulls his blanket higher. The doorknob is turning.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Gladys?
(The door opens, and there is Gladys, still in her frame though. Joey panics
and moves frantically, screaming. Then there is laughing, and the painting is
lowered. It was Rachel holding Gladys.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ha ha ha, third time this week. Man, this does not
get old.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You're mean!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, don't be such a baby!
(She closes his door again, and turns around. Then she starts screaming, terrified.
There is Glynnis... And Monica holding her up, laughing.)
end

title: The One with the Home Study

lines.text: Friends - 10.07 The One With The Home Study
Friends
1007 - The One With The Home Study

lines.speaker: Written by
lines.text: Mark Kunerth

lines.speaker: Produced by
lines.text: Robert Carlock and Wendy Knoller

lines.speaker: Transcribed by
lines.text: Coffee Mug, Eleonora, Sebastiano & Vanessa
Final check by Kim

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.text: (Joey and Ross enter. Phoebe and Mike are sitting on the couch, reading a magazine.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey you guys!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh, figuring out our wedding plans.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's funny, we were doing the same thing!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's really crazy! The hall, the dress, the food... I-I had no idea
how expensive this stuff was!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah it is really pricey. I mean, I freaked when I first heard the
numbers.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So what did you two do about it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It was pretty simple actually, I came up with a couple of cost-cutting
solutions, wrote out a list and Monica told me to go to hell.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There's no way around it Pheebs, you just gonna have to accept the fact
that this is gonna cost you a lot of money.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I heard that weddings are like a 40 billion dollar a year industry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, and I'm responsible for just like half of that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But really, it does seem like this money could be put to better use?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Now, how would you feel if we gave all the wedding money to charity
and we just got married at City Hall?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I think it would make me wanna marry you even more. (he kisses her)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I've got to say you guys, that's an incredible gesture!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) Maybe you do that next time you get married!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no. The next time it's gonna be a Hawaii at sunset. [pause] But
maybe the time after that!
Opening Credits

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment

lines.text: (Monica is cleaning the table, Chandler is sitting on the sofa. Joey enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Our adoption social worker is coming by today so we are cleaning
the apartment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sarcastically) We?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know you don't want me to help. You can't have it both ways!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, is this person who decides whether or not you... get a baby?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kind of. She's coming by to interview us and see where we live.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And it has to go perfectly, because if she doesn't like something about
us she can keep us off every adoption list in the state.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, maybe I should stop by! She could be a soap opera fan! It's very
impressive when the little people know a celebrity.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (pointing at himself) Little people?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pointing at himself) Celebrity.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, so I think I'm just about done here, unless you have any bad stuff
hidden somewhere, like... porn or cigarettes?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What...? NO!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (he stands up and he feels very offended) I don't, and I'm offended
by the insinuation!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, so there's not a magazine under the couch, or a pack of cigarettes
taped to the back of the toilet tank, or a filthy video in the VCR?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'll admit to the cigarettes and the magazine, but that tape is not
mine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It isn't mine!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (going out with the VCR in his hand) Well, I guess we'll never know whose
it is!

scenes.location: The New York City Children's fund hallway.

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: May I help you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. We're here to make a rather sizeable donation to the children.

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Well, any contribution, large or small, is always appreciated.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I think you're gonna appreciate it the crap out of this one (she
gives him a check)

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Well, this is very generous!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And we don't want any recognition. This is completely anonymous.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Completely anonymous. From two kind strangers.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mr. X and Phoebe Buffay.

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Well if you like, we can include your names in our newsletter.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Not necessary.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Buffay is spelled B-U-F-F-A-Y.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: And "X" is spelled uhm... "Mike Hannigan".

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Right. Well, on behalf of the children: thank you both very much.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure, I so glad we did this. It feels so good!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: It does. It feels really good!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, look! And we get these free t-shirts! (she takes a t-shirt which
was on the counter)

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Oh, actually, that's the shirt I wore to the gym.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mhm... it's moist.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he enters) Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Emma will be up in a minute!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, good!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh hey Ross... Listen, I heard about you and Charlie. I'm really sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, that's OK. I'm sure there are tons of other beautiful paleontologists
out there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Absolutely.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There was one! She's it! All the rest look like they should live under
a bridge!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, uhm... what are you gonna do today?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I was thinking of taking Emma to the playground!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God, what!?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Like I said I was thinking of taking Emma to the museum of knives and
fire!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, look, Ross. I do not want Emma going to the playground.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Be-caaauuuse...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (upset) All right, well, if you must know... I had a traumatic... swing
incident... when I was little.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Seriously?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, I was 4 years old and I was on the swing and then all of a sudden
my hair got tangled in the chain. And to get me out my mom had to-had to cut
a big chunk of my hair! (crying) And it was uneven for weeks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastic) And you made it through that? I wonder who's gonna play you
in the movie!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, fine! You can make fun of me. I do not want Emma going there. And
I was thinking Claire Danes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I'm sorry to hear about your tragedy, ok? But the swings are perfectly
safe, and besides Emma loves them. You know what, you should come with us and
you'll see!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, those things go like 40 miles an hour! Ok? When you're... and
there is that moment when you are at the top, when you just don't know if you're
gonna return back to earth!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Space is filled with orbiting children. (pause) Look, please, just come
on, you know, when you’ll see the look on Emma’s face, I swear you
won’t regret it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good, you don’t want to be one of those mothers who pass on their
irrational fears on their children, do you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Irrational, huh? All right, well, I’ll remember that the next
time you freak out about a spider in your apartment!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah, that’s the same, I am sure there are thirty different
species of poisonous swings!

scenes.location: Monica’s apartment. Somebody knocks the door

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, the adoption lady is early!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok, ok, here we go.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here we go. Stand up straight. (smiling) Big smile. (opens the door
and both are smiling exaggeratedly)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hello, is this the creepy residence?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We’re waiting for the adoption lady, but, hey, I’m glad
you’re here. I was cleaning this morning and I found this (she puts a
box on the table and opens it). I don’t know if you wanna use it, but…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Awe, this is so sweet of you! But you know what? I won’t be needing
a veil, I actually won’t be wearing a dress at all!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I told you! I am not coming to a naked wedding!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, no, we’re not having a big reception, we took the money
we were gonna spend on a wedding and we donate them to the children charity.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s crazy! (Phoebe looks bewildered). I am sorry. I just can’t
imagine giving up my one wedding day like that!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We, you know, we’re different! We don’t care about having
a huge party. (She picks up the veil) This is really nice for you, but, oh,
please, I put this on? (she puts it on) And, ow, I look (she looks her reflex
image on a toaster), why, well, radiant. (pause) All right, well, who cares,
I don’t need a pretty veil and a fancy dress.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s right. You’re making a commitment and that’s
the same, whether you do that at the Plaza or, where are you gonna do it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: City Hall.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ow! (Chandler slaps her on her back) Oh, that sounds nice! I am just
there for jury duty. They really spruce that place up!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s ok, it’s ok. I made my decision. What I really want
is a great big wedding (she covers her mouth)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But you already gave all your money to charity!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I’ll just ask for it back!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t think you can do that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not! This is her wedding day, this is way more important than some
stupid kids!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That’s sweet, honey, but save something for the adoption Lady.
[Scene: The playground. Ross put Emma on the swing and they’re
ready to play]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, careful.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Careful, watch her hair. WATCH HER HAIR!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, she’s got like three hairs!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know (she touches Emma’s head) but they’re just so beautiful!
Oh, my God, I just pulled one out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I promise you she’s safe! No watch how much she loves this.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok.
Ross (to Emma): Ready sweety?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here we go! (He starts pushing Emma)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, careful, ok. (Emma giggles) Oh, she’s smiling! Oh my God,
she does like it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: See, I told you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Awe! (Emma laughs) Oh my God! Looks, she’s a little dare-devil!
Oh, let me push, can I push?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, absolutely!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok. Oh God. (To Ross) Get the camera, it’s in the diaper bag.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok! (he takes the camera and walks backwards to take a shot) See? Scared
of swings, I bet you feel pretty silly (a swinging boy knocks him down) Ow!

scenes.location: The New York City Children's fund

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: We’re seriously asking for our money back?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It’s for our wedding day! Right, now, is this guy gay or straight,
because one of us gonna have to start flirting.

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Wow! Are you here to make another donation the same day? I don’t
think that that’s ever happened before.
Phoebe (to Mike): Gay, go.
Mike (to the charity guy): Oh my God, I love your shirt!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The donation we made earlier, we k…, we w…, we want it
back.

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. See, that money was for a big wedding, that we thought we didn’t
want, but it turns out we do.

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: So you’re asking us to refund your donation to the children?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah! This feels really good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I am sorry. I am, but this wedding is just really important to me.

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Hey, it’s not my business, (he takes their check from a
drawer) besides it’s probably a good thing. We really would have been
spoiling the children, all those food, and warm clothing…

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, that’s not fair! A person’s wedding is important!
And especially to me! Ok? I didn’t have a graduation party! And I didn’t
go to Prom. And I spent my sweet sixteen being chased round a tire yard by an
escaped mental patient who is his own words wanted to “kill me”
or whatever. So I deserve a real celebration and I am not gonna let some sweaty
little man make me feel badly about it.( She storms out)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: She could have been talking about either one of us.

scenes.location: Monica’s apartment. Somebody knocks the door

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Hi, I am Laura, I am here for your adoption interview.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, I am Monica and this is Chandler. Please come in.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Would you like something to drink?

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Oh, water would be fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok. Great. I am so glad that you are here. We’re really excited
about getting this process started.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, because we love kids. Love ‘em to death.Well, not actually
to death, that's just a figure of speech - we love kids the appropriate amount...
as allowed by law.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Your place is just lovely.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ah, thank you. This building does have a wholesome family feel to it.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: You know, I... I feel like I've been here before. Are any other couples
in the
building adopting?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is that that couple on the first floor? Because we should get a baby
before
them. Yeah! That guy tried to sell me drugs. (Laura looks shocked)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But other than that... wholesome, wholesome building.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: I just realized why I remember this place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really? What is it?

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing. I went on a date with a guy who lived in this building
and it
didn't end very well.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohh... that wouldn't by any chance be... Joey Tribbiani?

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Of course it was!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Yeah, we had a really great night and in the morning he promised he
would call
me and he didn't.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: RAT BASTARD!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: So you're not friends with him?

lines.speaker: Monica and Chandler
lines.text: OH GOD NO! Nope, no, no, no. No! No, no. Nope! No, no,
no, no, no, no, no, no, no. NO! (finally Monica concludes) No!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Well, I'm sorry I brought it up. So, are either one of you planning
on staying at
home with your child... (someone knocks on the door)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (form the other side of the door) Hellooo? Anybody in there order a celebrity?
(He starts to enter the apartment and Chandler runs to the door and shuts it
back in
his face) OW!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it's just some crazy guy who roams the halls here. He's great
with
kids though.
[Scene: Ross and Rachel are at the playground with Emma. Rachel
in putting her back in the stroller and Ross is tending to his wound]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, oh Ross, oh my God, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: SON OF A BITCH! (turns to his right to see three kids staring at him)
(To the
kids) Oh relax! I didn't say the 'F' word! (They go away)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, see! I told you, those swings are evil! Alright, that is it.
That is
the last time Emma is getting on one of those things for her entire life.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No, no, no, no, okay, it wasn't the swing's fault. It was my fault
and kind
of that (point to the kid that kicked him) kids fault. Who is still laughing.
Nice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, c'mon, please. Can we just get out of here, before somebody else
gets
hurt?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No wait, okay, okay, I have an idea. I want you to get on the swing,
okay? And
you'll see that there's nothing to be afraid of.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looks at him suspiciously) I know what this is all about... You've
always been
jealous of my hair.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I just think you're an adult, okay? And you should get over your
silly
fears.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright fine. I'll do it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: If you hold a spider.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (He freaks out and starts jumping around brushing his sweater) WHAT?
WHERE? WHERE?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: IF you hold a spider.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know. (Rachel bends down to Emma and Ross looks over his shoulder again,
afraid)
[Scene: Chandler and Monica's apartment. Chandler is still leaning
against the door, keeping Joey out, who is still banging and shouting on the
other side.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Guys? Everything ok? It's me, Joe...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Screams to interrupt Joey) AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA......AAAaaa-doption!!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, just like I said. That crazy... Bert... roaming the halls. (Joey
bangs on
the door again)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Guys!?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Keep on roaming Bert! We don't want any crazy today!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: WE'LL TALK TO YOU LATER, BERT. EVERYTHNG'S FINE!!
(cut to Joey on the other side, who finally leaves the door and goes to his
apartment)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Everything doesn't sound fine!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Is he alright out there by himself?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah! He has a caretaker. His older brother... Ernie.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Bert and Ernie!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (nervous smile) You can't make this stuff up!

scenes.location: Central Perk. Phoebe and Mike enter

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You never told me about that guy on your sweet sixteen. Oh, ugh. I'm
sorry about
that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Lightly) Oh! It ended okay. One of my friends shot him.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Well, hey, at least you're getting a proper wedding. I mean, you really
deserve that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I really do. You know, I had nothing growing up. (thinks for
a few
seconds) Just like the kids I took the money from.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No! No, no. I see where this is going. Don't make me go back there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Look, I can't have a wedding with this money now. It's tainted.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Alright, fine. We'll give the money back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And if that guy at the charity gives us a hard time, my friend hasn't
shot
anyone in a really long time.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's. They are preparing
to show Laura around. Laura is standing with her back to the window, Chandler
and Monica are standing on either side of her, facing each other.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Well, I must say, this seems like a lovely environment to raise a child
in.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, by the way, you are more than welcome to look under any of the
furniture,
because, believe me, you won't find any porn or cigarettes under there!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Oh! Well, actually, before we look around, let me make sure I have everything
I need
up to here...
(She starts checking her form. Chandler sees movement near the window from
the corner of his eye and when he looks he spots Joey climbing up the fire escape
and
onto their balcony. He warns Monica silently.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Pulls Laura into the spare room) Why don't I show you the baby's room?
(Joey enters through the side window and jogs towards the kitchen holding a
baseball bat)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What the hell are you doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, you wouldn't let me in, so I thought you were in trouble.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, we're not.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But you called me 'Bert'!? That's our code word for danger!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We don't have a code word.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We don't? We really should. From now on, 'Bert' will be our code word
for danger.
(Monica talks loudly in the baby's room)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So that was the baby's room. (They come out and Chandler throws Joey
behind
the couch and puts his foot on him. Monica looks at Chandler)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Chandler) What room should we see next?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Any room that isn't behind this couch! (laughs nervously)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (laughs nervously as well, Laura looks confused) (To Laura) Some people
don't
get him, but I think he's really funny! (She takes Laura to their own bedroom).
(Joey gets up and look annoyed)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (quivering with anger) I did not care for that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (escorting Joey to the door) You have to get out of here. You slept
with
our social worker and you never called her back and she is still pissed, so
she can't
see you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, ok! (He leaves)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok!
(Joey leaves and closes the door behind him. Chandler walks towards the living
room, but then Joey enters again.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I forgot my bat.
(He picks up his bat and holds it up, but then Monica and Laura enter the living
room again. When Laura sees Joey, she freezes...)

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And for the last time, we do not want to be friends with you! And
we don't want to buy your bat! (Joey lowers his bat)

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Chandler) Bert! Bert! Bert! Bert!

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Are you friends with him?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can explain... Joey...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhm... ok... uhm... Well, yeah... You have got some nerve, coming back
here. I can't believe you never called me.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh... yeah... Probably you don't even remember my name. It's Joey, by
the way. And don't bother telling me yours, because I totally remember it...
lady. Yeah! I waited weeks for you to call me.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: I gave you my number, you never called me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no! Don't try to turn this around on me, ok? I'm not some kind of...
social work, ok, that you can just... do.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: (embarrassed towards Chandler and Monica) Well, I'm pretty sure I gave
you my number.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? Think about it. Come on! You're a beautiful woman, smart, funny,
we had a really good time, huh? If I had your number, why wouldn't I call you?

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: I don't know... Well, maybe I'm wrong... I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, hey, no! Too late for apologies... ok? You broke my heart. You
know how many women I had to sleep with to get over you? (and he leaves the
apartment, leaving her shocked)

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Joey, wait!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (acting sad) NO! I waited a long time, I can't wait anymore... (and closes
the door behind him)

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: (laughing nervously) I'm sorry that you had to see that. I'm so embarrassed...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, that's really ok.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, that we totally understand. Dating is hard.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Boy, you people are nice... And I've got to say... I think you're going
to make excellent parents.
(Chandler and Monica hug each other, and then Joey enters the apartment again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: LAURA! (and points to her, very confident)
[Scene: The New York City Children's Fund building. Phoebe and
Mike are entering.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to the Charity guy) We're back!

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Are you here to take more money? Because, I think what you're
looking for is an ATM.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No, no, we're here to give the money back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, because you know what, it's... it's all about the children.
(the Charity guy smiles wanting to take the check, but Phoebe pulls it back
again. His smile fades.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Although... it's also about the wedding... Ugh, alright... here. (she
gives the check and pulls it back again) No... Oh God... Oh!

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: If I haven't said so already sir, (sarcastically pointing to Phoebe)
congratulations!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (takes the check from Phoebe) Ok, look! Enough! Alright? I'm stepping
in. I'm putting my foot down! As your future husband I'm going to make this
decision for us. (thinking) Now... what do you think we should do?

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: You know what? It's not your decision anymore.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: On behalf of the Children of New York, I reject your money.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But... but... but we're giving you this!

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Yeah... And I'm giving it back to you... Come on! Consider it
a contribution. (gives the check to Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looks at the amount on the check, and gasps) Well, this is very generous!

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Please, take the check, go have a great wedding and a wonderful
life together.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Well, I mean... It sounds good to me. And that way we can save up, come
back in a few years and make an even bigger donation.

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: Absolutely! And when you do, make sure you ask for Brian.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, is that you?

lines.speaker: Charity guy
lines.text: No!
[Scene: Chandler and Monica's apartment. They are sitting in
their living room when the phone rings.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello...? Oh hi... Oh my God...! Really...? I can't wait to tell Chandler...
Ok, goodbye. (hangs up)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wrong number?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It was Laura... She gave us a great report and we are officially on
the waiting list.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now we just have to wait for a call and... and someone tells us there's
a baby waiting for us. Oh...
(Chandler and Monica hug and after a while the telephone rings again... Monica's
eyes get bigger. Chandler answers.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello...? Have you seen Joey's bat?
COMMERCIAL BREAK
[Scene: The playground. Ross, Rachel and Emma are still there.
Rachel comes walking to Ross and Emma with something between her hands.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok... I got a spider. There were two, I picked the bigger one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (nervously) Ok...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok... (and passes the spider to Ross who holds it in between his hands)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Gasps and speaks at a higher pitch) This feels perfectly normal. Ok,
get on the swing!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (reluctantly) Ok... O-k...
(She slowly grabs the chains of the swing, swings her hair back, and sits down.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (more confident) Ok...
(She slowly walks forward and backward, to gain speed...)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: whoo... ok... wow... ok... OH!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: A-alright! I can do this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There you go! Good for you! And you know what, I'm actually getting used
to this little guy. I don't really even feel him in here anymore.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's because he's on your neck.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well... (realizes, screaming like a little girl, trying to get rid of
the spider) Whaa... aaah... aaahhh...
(Ross is now preoccupied with the spider, and forgets that Rachel is still
using the swing. While trying to get rid of the spider, he stands in front of
Rachel, who bumps into him, throwing him on the ground again.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ROSS!
(Rachel tries to stop mid-swing, and the swing starts to turn from side to
side)
end

title: The One with the Late Thanksgiving

lines.text: Friends - 10.08 The One With The Late Thanksgiving
Friends
1008 - The One With The Late Thanksgiving

lines.speaker: Written by
lines.text: Shana Goldberg-Meehan

lines.speaker: Produced by
lines.text: Robert Carlock & Wendy Knoller

lines.speaker: Transcribed by
lines.text: Coffee Mug, Eleonora, Sebastiano & Vanessa
Final check by Kim

scenes.location: Central Perk. Monica and Chandler enter, the others are sitting on the couch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey guys!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We need to talk to you about something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. We don't feel like we can host Thanksgiving this year.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you kidding?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it's just with uhm, work and the stress of adoption, we just don't feel like we have the energy. Plus, we don't think it's fair that every year the burden falls on us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (skeptical) That doesn't sound like you... That's Monica talking!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no! We made this decision together.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She's putting words in your mouth!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Don't you put words in people's mouths, you put turkey in people's mouths!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can't believe this! This is Emma's first Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, it's not!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's not? (whispering to Ross) When was she born?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, personally I think it's great you're giving yourself a break.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you, Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure. It's just as well... I mean, last year wasn't very good. I think she's losing her touch.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? You are way off, lady!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Am I? Really? Am I? Well, why don't you cook Thanksgiving dinner and prove me wrong! Well, think about it, think about it, you'll be trying to top than you did last year. You'd be in competition... with yourself.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's my favourite kind! Okay, we are doing this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don't let yourself get manipulated this way!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, stay out of this, Chandler! This is between me... and ME!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We are supposed to make these decisions together! Did you not watch the Doctor Phil I taped for you?
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment. Rachel and Monica are in there, and Phoebe enters

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Happy Thanksgiving!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, yeah, happy needless-turkey-murder day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You guys, I ordered some chocolate pies from that bakery on Bleecker. Could you pick them up for me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're not making the pies yourself?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, no, no, I don't make chocolate pies. When I was younger I-I enter in this pie-eating contest. I ate so many that just the thought of them made me sick.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Did you at least win the contest?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: 2 minutes, 12 pies and a part of one tin! Okay, I see you guys at 4.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can't wait!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This dinner is gonna be so great! In your face, last year "me"!
(Monica leaves)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Rach.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What's Emma doing today?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, let's see... uh... I know that she has a meeting with her lawyer and then she has to make a very big poop. Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I wanna enter her in a baby beauty pageant.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! That's the creepiest thing I've ever heard!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, but, well, before you say no, my friend Susanne is entering her kid and compared to Emma she's a real dog!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Phoebe, all babies are beautiful!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh... okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, just the idea of pitting one baby against another, I mean, you know, and judging who's cuter just for a trophy...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And a thousand dollars.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...is something I'm very interested in! Oh please, do not tell Ross. He still believes that (in a deep voice, mocking Ross) what's in the inside is important...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, oh, and Emma needs a cowgirl outfit for the competition.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Where am I gonna get a cowgirl outfit on Thanksgiving?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I was thinking...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, take the clothes of Joey's Cabbage Patch Kid.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Chandler is watching TV and Monica is cooking

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Chandler's laughing) Did someone drop the baton again?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why come all the way from Kansas to do that?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (she tastes what she has cooked) I don't get older. I just get better!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know what just occurred to me? This could be our last Thanksgiving just the two of us. I mean, we could be getting a baby soon!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You don't know that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Somebody is gonna pick us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but we haven't heard a thing from the adoption agency and it has been weeks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm telling ya! It's gonna happen. Next year it's gonna be you, me and the little Hemingway Bing. (pause) What, he's my favourite author!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Name one of his books.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (after a long pause) "The Firm"?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, let's see... uhm, okay, the turkey is in the oven, the stuffing is ready...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, you always cook this meal all by yourself. Let me help this year.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, Chandler, that's sweet. But you don't have to do everything Doctor Phil tells you to do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm serious, let me do something, just not the turkey or the stuffing, nothing "high profile".

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, let's see... Oh, the cranberry sauce, it is easy to make and no-one really cares about it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tell me more.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I'm gonna go check on something across the hall. You start by washing these (she gives Chandler a bowl with cranberries. Then, while she's going outside, she sees him with a bottle of soap in his hands) Not with soap!! (she leaves)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You obviously haven't tasted my Palmolive potatoes!
(Ross and Joey enter)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Hey, guess what Joey has!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Three tickets to today's Rangers game!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Dude, I wanted him to guess.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, they're great seats too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Guess where they are?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Center ice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did I do something to you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hmm, the game's at one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dinner is at four, we'll never gonna make it back.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So we'll leave before it's over, we'll be back in time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You say that now, but it could take us a long time to get back home. Plus Joey could get lost and and they could have to page us to go pick him up.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, two times that happened!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, Monica has been working hard all day, she didn't wanna host this thing in the first place, we shouldn't go!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He's right, man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right, I guess. Alright, so see you at four.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay. (pause) And get ready to taste my very special cranberries. Or should I say... chanberries!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's some gentle comedy, dude. (he and Ross leave)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We're still going at the game, right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

scenes.location: Baby beauty contest

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: This is contestant number sixteen, Rebecca...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Phoebe, listen. Well, I think we gotta go. This place is really freaking me out. I've been watching this guy over there, I don't think he came with a kid!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We can't leave now! There was this one baby, Haley, who was favourite to win and she got croup, so she had to stay home! This competition just blew wide open, folks!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, I think... It's just too weird, I just saw a one year old running around with pantyhose on!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I know, we should have been more prepared. (she looks around) It's okay. Now, the way I see it, our real competition now is Cameron. Oh my God, they just took her sweater off. Look at those arms! Hello Michelin Man.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Phoebe! Come on! You know what, it's already three o'clock and they haven't even gotten to Emma's group yet. We gotta go, we got dinner!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (panicking) But Emma's got what it takes, she could go all the way!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe, you have to calm down.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. Rachel, the hottest babies in the Tri-State Area are in this room right now! I overheard one of the judges say that not one of them holds a candle to Emma!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You heard them say that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right, okay. Alright, let's give to these babies something to cry about!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good! Oh yay! Let's get down to business! Emma needs some makeup!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, she's gonna look all washed out next to the other contestants!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Phoebe, I am not letting you put makeup on my baby!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why not!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because I already did!

scenes.location: Madison Square Garden

lines.text: (there's a lot of shouting and yelling)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, Bob, get off the guy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! What a game, huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know, yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe Chandler is missing this!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. I am sorry he's not here too, but I got to say, (takes some nachos from a plate on the seat where Chandler should have been) I am really enjoying Nacho Chair.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I'd probably enjoy it more if you didn't keep batting my hand away.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohhhh! These seats are great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, I know! When I was here for Holidays on Ice (Joey looks around worried hoping no one heard that) I was sitting so far away Michelle Kwan couldn't read my banner!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looks at the time) Wow, hey, we'd better get going. If we don't leave right now, we'll be late for dinner.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, but it's a kind game! So we're a little late, you know, the girls will be there, let's stay just for one more goal.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't know...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: One more fight!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Where is everybody? They're forty-five minutes late!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can't believe they are not here! I slave and I slave for what? They've ruined cranberry day!

scenes.location: The corridor. Ross and Joey have just arrived.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How late are we?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Forty-five minutes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wow (He opens his apartment door and throws their stuff in.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (handing him his coat) Here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Rachel and Phoebe are already there, okay? So they probably started without us. We could just slip in and no-one needs to know where we were! (he raises his hands and on his right one there's a Rangers foam finger)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You may want to lose the foam finger!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, no, no, no, no, no. You just want to put it on your hand!
(Rachel, Phoebe and Emma arrive)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You are not at Thanksgiving?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, we're late!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What are you doing here!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We're late too! (Rachel screams)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We figured we could be late because you guys were gonna be on time (he points the foam finger at the girls)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Don't point that thing at me, Tribbiani!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, nobody's here? Monica's gonna kill us!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, where were you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, what's with the trophy!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh, we were at the Spelling Bee!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And I won!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You won an adult Thanksgiving day spelling bee.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! (spells it) Y-E-S. Yes!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let me see this... (he takes the trophy from Rachel's hands) Grand Supreme Little Darling, New York Division.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. That's me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You entered Emma into a Beauty Pageant?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And it looks like she put makeup on her!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait a second, wait a second, where have I seen that cowgirl outfit before...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe this, she's our daughter! That you would treat her like some kind of showdog is inexcusable!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: She won a thousand dollars!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So this is an annual thing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (realizing) Oh! That's Alicia Mae Emory's outfit!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys, there are people in there who are not getting any happier!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. What are we gonna do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I don't know, you guys figure it out, I got to put Emma down for a nap.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right. Hey Rach, while you're in there, throw something on Alicia Mae.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, what are we gonna say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ooh, we'll say that we were mugged! You can't get mad at someone who's been mugged!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, good, that's good, but you don't look like you were mugged!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No. Here (he tears off the pocket from Ross' shirt, and tears off everything below that as well.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) HEY!

scenes.location: Monica's apartment.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you hear something? (Chandlers stands up and goes to the door to look out from the peephole)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (peeping) They're out there!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ohhh! Let me see! Oh God, I can't believe this! They're an hour late and they're just staying out there, talking!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (peeping) Everything is so distorted! Looks like Joey has a giant hand! Which says "Rangers" on it. They went to the game!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (gasps) Oooh! They are in for a world of pain!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking through the peephole again) Ross' shirt is torn.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! They're late and they're sloppy!
[Cut to the hall]
(Rachel comes out of her apartment}

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, Emma is napping... (then to Ross) what happened to your shirt?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I got mugged. And they stole my pocket.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We're just... we're trying to figure out an excuse. Hey! Ooh! How about this: We can say that Monica told us 5 o'clock, not 4 o'clock. That way we're right on time! (Others start to agree but she continues) OR... or, we can plant PCP in the apartment and call the cops on her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastic) That would be a good way to get rid of all the PCP we have lying around.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what, we just say that she said it was 5 o'clock. We'll just act casual. We're not late, we're right on time. (When she finishes talking, a note is pushed from under Monica's and Chandler's door, into the hall. Ross picks it up and reads it out loud)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Reading the note) We know you're out there. (Rachel gasps)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (whispering) Who do you think its from?
[time lapse – they are still in the hall]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, God. This is bad. This is so bad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, let's just go in there and face them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I'm not going in first. I bet that vein on Monica's forehead is popping like crazy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I hate that thing, it's like a... bolt of lightning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, hey, I have an idea. Why don't we play rock-paper-scissors, and whoever loses goes in first. (they all agree) Ready? (they do the rock-paper-scissor thing with they hands and Rachel has paper, Phoebe and Ross both have rock, while Joey is doing a strange upward wiggling with his fingers. They all look a him confused).

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling from ear to ear) Ah-haah! I win!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's fire. Beats everything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, really? Does it beat water balloon? (She places her hand over his "fire" and mimics a bursting water balloon, thus putting the fire out).

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh! Well played, Phoebe Buffay, well played.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, enough, enough, come on. Let's just all go in at the same time.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Alright, okay. (Phoebe reaches for the door, and tries to open it but it's locked)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's locked.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wha...? Oh sure, now they lock it, but when they're having sex on the couch, its like: "Come on in, my butt is surprisingly hairy".

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, come on... (starts to knock on the door) Alright, you guys. We're so sorry we're late. Please let us in, so we can have dinner together.
[cut to Monica and Chandler]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No! Everything's cold. The turkey's dried out and the... the stuffing is all soggy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, and there's a bowl of cranberry sauce that... (speaking lower to Monica) what happens to cranberry sauce?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Rolling her eyes) Nothing. It's fine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (relieved) Oh thank God!
[cut to the hall]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on you guys, we're sorry, alri...? Our subway broke down.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking through the peephole) That's a lie, you went to the game, I can see Joey's hand.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey, who is wearing a blue, 3 foot hand) FOR THE LOVE OF GOD TAKE IT OFF!! (takes it off his hand and throws it on the floor)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys, come on, it doesn't matter why we're late. We're all here now, please let us in so we can have some of your delicious turkey. (A slice of turkey on a piece of aluminum foil is slid under door)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I had a dream once about a fax machine that did that. (Ross picks it up)
[cut to Monica and Chandler]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's all the turkey you're gonna get.
[cut to the hall]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How are we gonna decide who gets this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (holds his fist up) WATER BALLOON! (he stuffs the slice in is mouth and gives the foil back to Ross)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are we gonna do? I'm starving.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (gasps) Oh, I just remembered. We do have something to eat. Monica put something in our oven this morning.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah!
[cut to Monica and Chandler]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, you touch that and you will be sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Guys, I'd listen to her. The vein is bigger than I've ever seen it. (Monica looks at Chandler)
[cut to the hall]
(Rachel comes out of the apartment holding a pot. Joey holds in anticipation and Rachel opens it)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Huh... OH MY GOD IT'S BRUSSELS SPROUTS. (they all look appalled)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's worse than no food.
[cut to Monica and Chandler]
(Monica looks insulted)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: HA-HA! All you got was Monica's stinky Brussels sprouts!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Stinky?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Please let me stay on this side of the door.
[cut to hall]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I know... I still have my old key! (She goes in to get it and comes back with her keys) We can just unlock the door.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I don't know if that's such a good idea. They clearly don't want to be with us.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what? I don't want to be with them either, but it's Thanksgiving and we should not want to be together, together. (Goes to unlock the door)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross) Just get in there and make a face to face apology, you know? Look them in the eye. I know I can get them to forgive us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm telling ya... (his eyes open wide and he looks like his eyes are about to pop out. He stares at Ross like this without blinking) I can do it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (Staring back, and then breaks off) (To Phoebe and Rachel) Yeah, he can do it!
(Rachel finally manages to open the door, but the door chain is on.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!
(Joey sticks his head through the gap. Monica and Chandler are now sitting at the dinner table. There is another smaller table full of food standing in front of the front door)
(Monica and Chandler do not look amused by Joeys head in the door)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! It all looks so beautiful: the turkey, the stuffing...
(Monica is now smiling)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The cranberries...?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! Enough! A monkey could have made 'em!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (still with his door wedged in the door gap, now opens his eyes wide and stares at Monica and Chandler as he did with Ross earlier in the hall) Hey listen guys, we feel really terrible.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: He's doing that weird eye contact thing. Don't look at him, don't look at him! (They both look away)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on you guys, we want you to know we're (His eye widen even more) very very sorry. (Monica and Chandler are now covering their eyes with their hands) (then to the others in the hall) Right guys?
(Ross head appears above Joey's, Rachel's below Joey's and Phoebe's at the bottom)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I feel terrible.

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Rachel
lines.text: So, so sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (smiling) Now let's not ruin this day. You worked so hard. Let's move past this and try to have a nice meal all together, huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The floating heads do make a good point.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, they do seem to feel pretty bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So bad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So bad.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So bad.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Gets up) Okay, okay. You two (to Phoebe and Rachel) go get the dessert. And I'll let you in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Dessert?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I asked you and Phoebe to pick up the pies. You did remember, right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Pies, oh, we thought you said priiiize (goes to the hall and comes back with Emma's trophy in her hand). Here! (gives it to Monica).
(Monica takes it and reads the label)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Grand Supreme Little Darling?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Congratulatioooons!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! YOU FORGOT THE PIES? Well, I cannot believe this. You force me to make dinner, then you're an hour late and you forget the one little thing that I asked you to do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really girls, not cool.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you manheads aren't any better. You lied about going to the game. You knew it would make you late, and you still went anyway.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! I'm getting a little tired of this okay? We said we're sorry. It's Thanksgiving for Pete's sakes! A day of forgiveness!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's a day to be thankful.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Ross, mouthing) Don't make me come up there!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's too late for apologies.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fine! Let's just go. I don't need your stupid dinner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That would be a lot more convincing if you weren't drooling.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ewww, is that what that is?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sorry!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on you guys, let's just do our own Thanksgiving.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! I'll cook!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Let's go out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! You three have a nice Thanksgiving.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The three of us?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! You, Chan, and the vein!
(Monica gasps and holds her forehead. Phoebe, Rachel and Ross pull back their heads)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ha!
(When Joey tries to pull back his head, he notices he is stuck)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-oh! I'm stuck!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, that is not gonna work.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No seriously... I'm really wedged in here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'll pull you through.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in agony) aaw-ahhh-aaahhh STOP! STOP! I'm worried about damaging my head.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A little late for that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright, hurry up, you gotta do something.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, well, this does not change anything. (to Chandler) Okay, we need to get something to grease the sides of his face.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhm, we've got turkey grease.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bring it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I just wanna say that I'm sorry I referred to the vein as a seperate person...
(Chandler gives Monica a footlong "eye dropper" with the turkey grease in it)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here you go!
(She squirts some of the grease along Joey's face.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, that smells good!
(And he starts licking the grease which trickles down his face. Monica also squirts some on the other side of his face, and his tongue follows her movements.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, try it.
(Joey tries to pull back at all his might.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It isn't working.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, we're gonna have to unscrew the chain.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well hurry, I can't feel my ears!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Can you ever feel your ears?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Interesting...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, where are your tools?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sarcastically) Oh, I left them on my bulldozer... I don't have tools!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I do, but Rachel borrowed them.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I lent them to Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I gave them to Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I left them at the park.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking at Joey's butt) I'm finding it really hard not to mess with him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I've already stuffed a bunch of Brussel sprouts down his pants.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nice!
(The phone rings in Chandler and Monica's apartment)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, I have to get that. Now when I get back, I want you and your friends to be gone. Thanksgiving is over. The Vein has spoken.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's really starting to hurt.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, look, I'm gonna pull on the door and you guys push as hard as you can. Maybe we can get enough room to wiggle him out, okay? Okay, so PUSH!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just a sec., we're kind in the middle of something here.
(Rachel, Ross and Phoebe have their hands full and are stuffing all kinds of things down Joeys pants.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh! Stop putting things down my pants!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Come on guys, PUSH!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah! Come on!

lines.speaker: Joey and Chandler
lines.text: PUSH! PUSH! PUSH!

(The chain breaks loose from the wall, and because Joey was pushing with all his might, he propells into the kitchen, towards the table with all the food. This table has wheels underneath it, and when Joey falls on this table, he rides into the living room, with all the food falling off, until finally Joey also falls off... Joey gets up quickly, a bit agitated, and acting as nothing happened. He is covered in food stains.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: My cranberries!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking at himself) Man, I've got food all over me.
(He licks his fingers, liking it. He offers Chandler a taste.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Argh! I can't believe what you did. Monica's gonna kill you!
(Monica enters from the spare bedroom.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Monica) Look! Look! Look what the... Look what... Look what the floating heads did!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (very emotional) I don't care.
(Chandler can't believe what he's hearing. He looks at Monica, then at the others, then back at Monica.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That was the adoption agency...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: WE'RE GETTING A BABY!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Are you serious? (they hug)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There's a pregnant woman in Ohio, and she picked us!
(They all cheer and Rachel, Ross and Phoebe join in for a group hug. Joey also joins, but he stands back a bit, because he is all sticky of the food on him)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm so happy for you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This Thanksgiving kicks last Thanksgiving's ass!
(They all cheer and hug again, but Joey's eating the food off his shirt)
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartment. The table is set, and there's food on the tables again. They're all there, toasting.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: To Monica and Chandler... and that knocked up girl in Ohio.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm just so happy you guys are finally getting a kid.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know. Have you considered pageanting?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe they called, and we're actually getting a baby. (she kisses Chandler)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, I know how you feel...
(Monica and Chandler are looking curiously at Joey.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure. I went through the exact same thing with Alicia Mae Emory... The waiting, the wandering... Then one day... I get that call from Toys "R" Us... She was in stock!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is the exact same thing.
THE END
