scenes.location: Central Perk. Everyone's sitting on the couch.Monica and Chandler enter

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We're just here to say goodbye, we're off to Ohio.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, right! Your adoption interview!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yep, we're gonna meet the lady who could be carrying our baby.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't believe it. When you guys come back, you're gonna have a baby! That is so weird!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And so incorrect!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's only a couple of months pregnant. She liked our application but who knows if she's gonna like us.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, she's gonna love you guys!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uhm, thank you, but we're really trying not to get our hopes up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And a lot could still get in our way.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. I mean, this girl could decide against adoption or she could like another couple better..

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you gonna name the baby?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I can develop a condition in which I talk and talk and no one hears a word.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But just think, ok? What if everything goes right? What if this woman does pick you guys?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God. She's gonna pick us!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So we're standing firm on the 'not getting our hopes up'?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know, I know that things could still go wrong but if they don't? If this works out, we're gonna have a baby Chandler, a baby!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, but...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, it's gonna WORK! We're gonna make it work! I'm gonna be a mummy and (to Chandler) you're gonna be a daddy! All right, I'll see you suckers. I'm gonna get me... A BABY! {she leaves)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, screw it, I'm gonna be a daddy!!
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Central Perk. Phoebe's speaking to a girl.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Joey) Hey, who's Phoebe with?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm gonna say someone I'm gonna have sex with. (the girl leaves and Phoebe goes toward the couch) (to Phoebe) Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So... who's your friend?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, that's Sarah. No, no. Don't you get any ideas, ok? No, I'm not setting you up with any more of my friends!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: OW, why, why, why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because you'll date her once, sleep with her and then forget she exists!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, name one friend of yours that I did that with.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Mandy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mandy, uh? Uh... really hot blonde, big boobs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I know why I don't remember her, huh? (he winks at Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Do you think I'm someone else?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, I may not have treated your friends well in the past, but I have grown up a lot, really. Honest, Rach?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, believe it or not, it's true. When Joey and I were together, he was wonderful. He was thoughtful and mature. And for the one week that we went out, he didn't sleep with anybody else!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (pointing at himself) Growth!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine, I'll give you her number.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok, thank you. And I promise you I will not forget this one. (he starts writing on his hand) Mandy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: SARAH!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Saraaah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey you guys, I need some fashion advice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he takes a baby blue beret out of a shopping box and puts it on) How does this look?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it's a little low... pick up a little... (Ross picks it up) a little bit more... (he picks it up again) a little bit more... (he takes it off) There you go! (pause) Now throw it away!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mon! This looks good!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, please, trust me. I buy 30 fashion magazines a month. Now, I don't know who's running for president or who that... NATO guy is, but I do know that you have to get as far away as you can from that hat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damnit! I have this date tomorrow night and I have to look cool!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, you know, if you want fashion help, Rachel and I are going shopping tomorrow. You're more than welcome to come with us, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really? That would be great. I mean, I have to do something, she kinda teased me about how I dress.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can see why, nice shirt!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're wearing the same shirt.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Stupid Gap on every corner!

scenes.location: The Adoption Agency in Ohio. Monica and Chandler are entering with a man.

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: Please, make yourself comfortable and I will back in a moment with Erica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, thank you.(the man leaves) Uh, well this is it. Are you OK?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. Just weird, you know. It's like: "Hi, I'm Chandler. May I have the human growing inside you?"

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, we're gonna be great.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're gonna be great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well... obviously!

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: (he enters with Erica) Monica, Chandler. I'd like you to meet Erica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi. It is so, so nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: (whispering) Hi...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you so much for agreeing to see us.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: I'll let you get acquainted.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: So, it's Monica and Chandler. I only know you as file 0W33815-D.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's what our friends call us.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Gosh, you know, you're just such an amazing couple. It's... kind of intimidating.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know about that.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: You're kidding me? I mean, it's enough that you are a doctor. But on top of it, you're married to a reverend?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (astonished) I don't think that's exactly...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (overlapping) Let her finish, doctor.

scenes.location: Central Perk

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, my friend Sarah had a great time last night.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! So you're gonna call this one back?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you talking about? Sarah's great!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, really? You know what your great friend did? We're out to dinner, ok? (he starts talking about the date and we can see what happened through a flashback video) We're getting along, having a really nice time. I was thinking she was really cool. And then, out of nowhere...
(Sarah picks up some fries from Joey’s plate and Joey looks very angry. Then we’re back to Central Perk and Joey does a you-see-what-I-mean look to Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s it? That’s why you won’t go out with her again? So, she took some fries, big deal!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, hey, look! It’s not about a few fries... it’s about what the fries represent.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: ALL FOOD!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m sorry, I can’t believe I set you up with such a MONSTER!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, hey, hey, hey. Look. I take a girl out, she can order whatever she wants! The more, the better! All right? Just don’t order a Garden salad and then eat my food! That’s a good way to lose some fingers!
(Rachel enters from the main door)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Rachel) Oh

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank God you’re here. Listen to this!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: what?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey and my friend were out last night and having dinner and she reaches over and takes a few of his fries...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Oh, no!
(Joey looks satisfied)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? You know about the plate thing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Joey doesn’t share food. I mean, just last week we were having breakfast and he had a couple of grapes on his plate and ...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Joey) You wouldn’t let her have a grape?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh no! Not me! Emma!
(Phoebe looks horrified and she turns to watch Joey)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (mad and pointing a finger to himself) JOEY DOESN’T SHARE FOOD!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I still think that it’s a stupid reason not to call someone again. You are calling her! And if you need to, just get an extra plate of fries for the table!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (he thinks a little, considering the option and seems to be quite satisfied) I like that! A sharing buffer! Yeah! I’ll order some extra fries! Maybe a plate of onion rings. Yeah. And a shrimp cocktail. And some buffalo wings. Maybe an individual pizza, uh? And some mozzarella sticks. (he looks absorbed in his food thoughts) What were we talking about?

scenes.location: A clothes store. Ross and Phoebe are shopping

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Ross) This place is awesome!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, we should just go, I’m not gonna find anything here! This stuff is ridiculous!
(Rachel arrives with a lot of clothes)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, this place is great!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, come on, I’m not gonna wear any of this! (he picks up a shirt) Nothing silver. (Rachel sighs). Ok? Nothing with hair! (Rachel sighs again) And nothing with padlocks on it! (Rachel heaves a long disappointing sigh).

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, look, I know that some of this stuff is out there, but I mean, come on, look at this, look at this sweater! (she picks up a blue sweater). I mean, this is just beautiful!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (feeling the fabric) Wow, this is really soft (he looks the price). Three hundred and fifty dollars?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, down from seven hundred, you are saving like two hundred bucks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Both logic and math are taking a serious hit today.
Phoebe (walking to Ross carrying a black leather jacket): Hey, check this out! It’s totally you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah!
(Ross wears the jackets and look at himself in the mirror)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Actually this looks like pretty good! Yeah!(he turns and watches his back and there’s a sign on the back of the jacket, “boys will be boys”) Boys will be boys?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? They will be!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, that’s it, I’m getting out of here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, no, no! Ross, wait! Come on! You know, there’s other stuff. Here’s a nice shirt, look at these nice pants...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, actually these might look pretty good on me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, they will! You know what you should do? Just go take a walk, all right? I know your size and I’m... I’m gonna pick up some really good stuff for you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes! And I know what looks sexy on guys. Please, just wear what I suggest, and she’s gonna go nuts for you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, you’re saying, uh, if I wear these pants I might be getting into hers?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Why do men keep talking to me like this?

scenes.location: The Adoption Agency in Ohio. Monica and Chandler are still talking with Erica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, the fact that I am a doctor, and my wife’s a reverend, that’s important to you?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Yeah, I read some great applications, but then I thought “who better then a minister to raise a child!”

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Amen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Plus I thought the baby would be in good hands with a doctor!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, good hands. (she holds Chandler hands) Healing hands.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Reverend, can I ask? Does the bible say anything about adoption?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It says “Do it!”. And behold she did adopt onto them a baby. And it was good.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, wow.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I was wondering you both have such serious jobs. (to Monica) Would you have time to take care of a baby and your flock?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you know, my flock is good, I mean, yeah, my flock pretty much takes care of themselves at this point. Good flock. Flock, flock, flock.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: (to Chandler) Being a doctor must take up a lot of time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No-ot for me it doesn’t.
(The agency guy enters the room)

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: So, how’s everything going in here?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: We’re great, I think I may have asked all my questions.

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: Do you have any question for Erica?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, actually. So, you read a file that you liked and you gave the agency the serial number and they contacted us?

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: Yes, our system assures total anonimity. We’re very proud of it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You should be. You’re really on top of stuff..

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: (to Erica) Well, then if there’s nothing else, then the two of us should talk.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Actually, I don’t think we have to.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We don’t?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Yeah, when I read about you two, I was pretty sure I wanted you, but I just thought we should meet face to face. (to the agency guy). I've made my decision. I choose them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God, this is great! This is so great! (to Chandler, who looks bewildered). Did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I did.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Erica) Hey, thank you. Thank you so much. (they hugs). You are SO going to Heaven!

scenes.location: Joey’s apartment. Rachel and Phoebe walk in, loaded with bags.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: We got some really great stuff!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, yeah but I am not sure about some of the bra's I got.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Really? Do you wanna try some of them on for me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! okay. Wait, are we in Joey's imagination?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (looking into one of her shopping bags) Oh no! I took one of Ross' bags by
mistake, and one of mine is missing.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: oh, well, Ross probably has it, you can get it from him later.

scenes.location: Ross walks into Central Perk, wearing a pink and white ladies shirt. Joey is on the couch

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) So? What do you think? (Shows himself - Joey observes him with a strange look on his face.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I think were not wearing the same shirt anymore!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (not getting it) Yeah! Yeah! Rachel picked it out for me. She told me to trust her and you know what? I'm glad I did! I turned quite a few heads on my way over here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (now laughing a little) Dude, I really don't think you should be wearing that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I see, somebody is afraid of a little competition with the ladies?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (looking a little agitated now) Looks like someone IS the ladies!!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're just jealous because you couldn't pull this off. Yeah, now if you'll excuse me (getting up and taking his coat) I have a date. (As he is walking out, everyone turns and stares at him) See? (To Joey) ALL eyes on ME!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's hotel room. They enter.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We are NOT signing those papers.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's wrong. They made a mistake. They think we're somebody else.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God works in mysterious ways.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You have gotta stop!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But she liked us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: She likes Doctor Chandler and Reverend Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, if you think about it, I am kind of like a Reverend. I mean, as a chef, I serve God, by feeing the hungry and poor. (looks very convinced about what she just said)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Your Veal Chop is $34,95!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: C'mon Chandler, I think we have been given an opportunity. I mean, the mistake has already been made. They are writing up the paper right now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But we are not the one she chose! How can you feel okay about this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (very emotional) Because... We may not be who she thinks we are but no-one will ever love that baby more than us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know..

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I mean, who knows how long it's gonna take for someone else to give us a baby? What if, what if no one ever picks us?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: oh, honey..

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Almost crying) Please.. please, we are so close.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica, I want a baby too, but this woman is giving away her child. She deserves to know who it's going to.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (realizes Chandler is right. She's almost crying) okay, right. (They hug)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, we'll tell the truth and who knows, maybe she'll like us for us.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (sniffing) Maybe she will. Uh! Why couldn't I have been a Reverend?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're Jewish.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Technicality!

scenes.location: A restaurant. Joey is on his date with Phoebe’s friend, Sarah. They are sitting opposite each other on a table for two. Their waiter approaches with two plates.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: A garden salad for the lady (sets the plate down)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, that looks great! Good ordering!

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Seafood platter for the gentleman and extra fries. Enjoy!

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Mmmh, those fries look delicious.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: oh, I didn't know you liked French fries. Help yourself! What's mine is yours. (Sarah reaches over and takes a few fries)

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: (looks over at Joey's platter) Oh wow, are those stuffed clams?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uuuh.. yes, they are my stuffed clams.
(Sarah, is grinning and starts to reach over to Joey's plate to take a few clams)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: How about those fries though, huh? (Holds the plate between Sarah’s fingers and his plate, thus blocking her from reaching his)

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: They are delicious (takes a few from the plate, puts one in her mouth and places the rest on her plate, then starts to reach over to Joey's platter again)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Spotting her movements takes her hand into his own) You are beautiful, you know that?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Oh, that is so sweet..

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh (grinning, trying to hold in his impatience with her) okay.. (she takes her hand back)

(Then she reaches over again and Joey moves his plate a little to the left, and she misses, then she reaches out again, and he moves his plate to the right , so she misses again. She tries a third time and this time, Joey pushes his plate so far to the left, it drops off the edge of the table)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Visibly annoyed) NOW look what you did!!

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: What? what is the matter with you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't like it when people take food off of my plate, okay?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: But you just said "What's mine is yours"?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: WELL, I DIDN'T MEAN IT!

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Fine, I'm sorry, I didn't think it was that big a deal.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm overreacting. Okay, It's just when it comes to food, I have certain rules, okay, I mean (bends down and with his plate and his hands, scrapes the dropped dinner back onto the plate and puts it back on the table) There are things you do..and you now, things.. (takes something from the plate and blows it a little) that you don't do (He takes a bite from it).
(Sarah looks a little disgusted)

scenes.location: Ross and his date walk into a lobby. They are both wearing their jackets

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Wow, this place looks great.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh! You are gonna love it! (The girl is looking in the other direction as Ross is taking off his own coat, revealing the pink and white ladies shirt) and I'm so glad, we're finally doing this.

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Me too! (starts to take her coat off)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here (gets behind her to help. When the coat comes off we see she is wearing the exact same shirt Ross is wearing. They look at each other, shocked. They abruptly put their coat back on) So this was fun! (They leave the room and head into opposite directions)

scenes.location: Back at the restaurant with Joey and Sarah. Joey is holding Sarah's hands

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I really am sorry about, you know..before. I just want to make sure you know that I really do like you.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Sure (smiling) Just not as much as clams.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (Jokingly) Well, stuffed clams.
(The waiter arrives with their deserts)

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Chocolate Torte for the lady, cheesecake for the gentleman.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, excuse me sir, there seems to be some sort of red crap on my cheesecake.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Yes, that's Raspberry coule.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (More to himself than anyone else) So stupid, ordering cheesecake, trying to
be healthy. (pushes it aside)

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: (tasting hers) Oh my God! (Looks at the waiter and then to Joey)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, all right, I'll just have what she's having instead.

lines.speaker: Waiter
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry sir, that was our last piece.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Mmmm! Mmm!
(Sarah's beeper starts bleeping)

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Oh, no! This is work. I should call in. Can you excuse me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh yeah, sure. No problem.
(Joey's looking at Sarah's dessert, and takes her plate.)

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: What are you doing? I thought you don't share food.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure I do. (holding up his own dessert) Coule?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: (laughing) No. If I can't have your clams, you can't have my dessert. This is a two way street.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (laughing) Really?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Really! Now this all better be here when I come back. (puts her plate back at her side of the table)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, of course. I can control myself. (laughs uneasily and Sarah leaves the room)
(Joey sits sideways on his chair, looking at Sarah's chocolate torte, and then looking away from it, nervously playing with his fork, drumming with it on the table every now and then.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to the torte) Stop staring at me!
(He then straightens himself, and looks at the torte)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why, just a tiny little...
(He takes a little piece of Sarah's dessert. At first he doesn't think it's that special, but then...)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh-oh!
TIME LAPSE
(Sarah enters the room again, and stops when she sees her dessert is missing. Joey has emptied her plate, and has a chocolate covered mouth, just like a kid.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm not even sorry.

scenes.location: The Adoption Agency in Ohio. Monica and Chandler are entering.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Adoption Agency guy
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: So, these are the preliminary forms for an open adoption. There's a lot to go over, but I'll explain everything as we go through it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (pointing to a picture on the table) I-Is... Is that a picture?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Yeah. It's a sonogram they took of the baby last week. I thought you might want to see it. (gives it to Monica, who looks at it for a long time, and then shows it to Chandler)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, doctor!
(Chandler takes Monica's hand, and gets serious) Look, before we sign anything we really have to talk...(pause) We're not who you think we are.

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: I don't understand.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The agency must have made some mistake. My wife is not a reverend and I'm not a doctor.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: That's impossible.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I could perform an operation on you and prove it if you'd like.

lines.speaker: Agency guy
lines.text: I'll go check your file. Excuse me.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: So who are you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, our names really are Monica and Chandler. We're from New York.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but the important thing to know about us, is how much we would care for this little baby. (holds up the sonogram)

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: So you lied to me before?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, we... (makes quotation signs in the air) "bore false witness"... See I could be a reverend.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I can't believe this.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But we were hoping that since we told you the truth that you still might consider...

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Giving you my baby? You think I'd give you my child after this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, you don't have to decide right now, but if you could just look at our file...

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I don't want to look at your file! This is over.
(She leaves the room, but Chandler runs after her. They meet in the hallway.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Erica wait!

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I've nothing to say to you. (walks a few paces)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You have every reason to be upset. We did lie. But only because we've been waiting and trying to have a baby for so long. Now we don't know how long it's gonna be before we can get another chance again.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Why don't you ask the reverend to pray on it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Erica, please. Just consider us. Ask them to see our file. Our last name's Bing. My wife's a chef and I'm in advertising.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Oh yeah. I actually liked you guys. But it doesn't matter, because what you did was wrong. (walks away again, but Chandler catches up with her again)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But you did like us. And you should. My wife's an incredible woman. She's loving and devoted and caring. And don't tell her I said this but the woman's always right... I love my wife more than anything in this world. And I... It kills me that I can't give her a baby... I really want a kid. And when that day finally comes, I'll learn how to be a good dad. But my wife... she's already there. She's a mother... without a baby... Please?
(They look at each other. We switch back to Monica. Chandler opens the door and she turns to look at him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You still want that baby?
(Monica plays those words back in her mind and then smiles and runs to Chandler, who is twisting with joy. They hug.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: God bless you Chandler Bing!
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Central Perk. Joey's on the couch when Ross walks to him, with his jacket closed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Turns out this sweater is made for a woman.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (nods) So, why are you still wearing it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because it's soft... Hey, so how was your date?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ooh... Not so good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, looks like it's just the two of us tonight, huh old buddy?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, and you know what? We could do a lot worse.
(they shake hands the way friends would. There's a muffin on the table, and Ross breaks off a piece and wants to put it in his mouth.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shouting to Ross) JOEY DOESN'T SHARE FOOD!
(Ross puts the piece back on the plate)
end

Friends

scenes.location: Central Perk. Everybody's sitting on the couch and Monica is eating a chunk of cake.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (really excited) Mmh... this cake is amazing!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My God, get a room!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I would get a room with this cake. I think I could show this cake a good time!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If you had to, what would you give up, food or sex?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (with no hesitation) Sex!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looking at her) Seriously, answer faster!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry honey, you know, but when she said "sex" I wasn't thinking about "sex with you"!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Phoebe) It's like a giant hug.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, how about you. What would you give up, sex or food?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Food.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, how about... uhm... sex or dinosaurs?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God. It's like Sophie's Choice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God. What about you, Joe? What would you give up, sex or food?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhm... oh... I don't know, it's too hard.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, you gotta pick one!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh... food. No, sex. Food! Sex! Food! Se-I don't know! Good God, I don't know, I want girls on bread!
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Central Perk. Rachel and Phoebe are looking at some photos and they're sitting next to the window.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You gotta see these latest pictures of Emma.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, how cute!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, she looks just like a little doll!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, no, no. That is a doll.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, thank God, 'cause that thing's really creepy! (looking outside the window) Look, there's Chandler. (he's on the street, talking to a woman)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh. Who is the blonde, she's pretty.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: OH! He's having an affair.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He's not having an affair!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, I'm always right about these things.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, you're not! Last week you thought Ross was trying to kill you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I'm sorry but it's hard to believe that anyone would tell a story that dull just to tell it! (looking outside) See, there's something going on with them. Look, he's getting into the car with her!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that doesn't mean anything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah? Well, let's see. (she takes her mobile phone) Ok, duck down. (they both get down to hide themselves. Phoebe calls Chandler)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (picking up the phone) Hello.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hi Chandler. It's Phoebe. Uhm... I know that Monica is working today so...(back to Central Perk) ...I was wondering if you want to come to the movies with me and Rachel.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, uhm... I have to work too. Yeah, I'm stuck at the office all day.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (shocked) Oh, well, it's a shame that you-that you miss the movie 'cause we were gonna see, you know, either "Liar, Liar" or "Betrayal", or... "An Affair To Remember".

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Those are all really old!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, then maybe it'll be, uhm...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (whispering) "Dude, Where's My Car?"

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (glancing at her) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They're in a caaar...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Chandler at the phone) Okay, we-we'll talk to you later. Okay, bye.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Geez!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok. Quick. We gotta find a cab and follow them.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah, ok. Let me just grab my night vision goggles and my stun gun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (patting her bag) I got them!

scenes.location: Monica’s apartment. Chandler enters the door.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! You smell like perfume and cigarettes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I was in the car with Nancy all day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nancy doesn’t smoke!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, at least the perfume is not mine, be thankful for that!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So? What do you think of the house?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It’s perfect. It’s everything we’ve been looking for.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Isn’t it? Then what about the amazing wainscotting and the crown molding and the dormer windows in the attic?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And the wiggle wharms and the zip zorps? (pause) What were the things you said?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Don’t you love the huge yard?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And the fireplace in the bedroom.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And Nancy said that it's really under price, because the guy lost his job and has to move in with his parents!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is bringing out a lovely color in you!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So? Do you think we should get it?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know. What do you think?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think we should.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I do too.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is huge!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How bad you wanna smoke, right now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don’t know what you mean, giant talking cigarette! Oh, by the way, Phoebe called just as I was getting into Nancy’s car, so if she asks you, I was at work all day.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Gotcha. When do we tell them about this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We don’t. Not until it's a hundred percent. I mean, why upset everybody over nothing.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. Right. Oh my God that is gonna be so hard.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know. Gooooood luck with it.

scenes.location: Joey’s apartment. Everybody except Monica and Chandler is there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just can’t see Chandler cheating!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I’m telling you guys, we followed them out to a house in Westchester, the went in for like forty-five minutes and then they came out looking pretty happy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler? Forty-five minutes? Well, something is not right. I just can’t believe he would do this to Monica!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, and with the baby coming?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, should we tell her?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don’t know. Phoebe, if one of us saw Mike with another woman would you want us to tell you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why? Who’d you seen him with?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No one, I’m just saying if... (Phoebe starts pinching him in his neck)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: TELL ME WHAT YOU KNOW!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (yelling in pain) I know nothing! Mike’s a great guy, it was hypothetical!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right. (she releases him). He is a good guy. You’re right, he wouldn’t cheat.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Believe me, if I did see with someone, there’s no way I... (Phoebe starts pinching him again)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: WHO DID YOU SEE HIM WITH?

scenes.location: Monica’s apartment. Monica is cleaning with a vacuum and then she cleans it with a dust buster. The guys enter the room.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, look at her, so happy!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: If only there were a smaller one to clean this one!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, is uhm... is Chandler here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, he’s picking up dinner, why, what’s up?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, look, whatever happens, we’re here for you and we love you.
Monica (puzzled): All right...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We think Chandler might be having an affair.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe and I saw Chandler with a blonde woman today outside on the street and then we followed them to a house in Westchester.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: They went in together. So sorry.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Oh my God that’s awful! What did you think of the house?
(they all look confused and sorry for her)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (walking towards her to hold her and support her) Monica, you understand what we are saying, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, sure... uhm, I'm devastated, obviously... (to the rest) Did you think the neighborhood was homey? (Chandler enters)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Chandler) You son of a bitch!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is it me, or have the greetings gone downhill around here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (goes to Chandler) Phoebe and Rachel saw you with Nancy today and... em... they think you're having an affair.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who's Nancy?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (turns to them) Ok, alright, you guys, you'd better sit down, this is pretty big.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah (motions them to sit and they do) I'm not having an affair. Nancy is our realtor.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I knew he couldn't be with a woman for 45 minutes!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why do you have a realtor?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uhm, she has been showing us houses outside of the city.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (clearly shocked) What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When we found out that we're gonna get this baby, Chandler and I started talking and we decided that we didn't want to raise a kid in the city.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So you're gonna move?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shouldn't we all vote on stuff like this?!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What is wrong with raising a kid in the city? I'm doing it, Ross is doing it, Sarah Jessica Parker is doing it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And that's great for you guys, but we want a lawn and a swingset...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ...and a street where our kids can ride their bikes and maybe an ice-cream truck can go by.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (sarcastic) So you wanna buy a house in the 50's?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Have you thought about what you would be giving up? You can't move out of the city, what if you want Chinese food at 5am? Or a fake Rolex that breaks as soon as it rains or an Asian hooker sent right to your door?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what, if you wanna look for a house, that's okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, it's not, don't listen to him! (to Ross) I'm gonna thump you! (points his fist at him)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) It's ok, because they have to get it out of their system, okay (back to Mon and Chan), but you're going to realize, this is the only place, you wanna be.
(pause before Monica and Chandler speak, they look like they are looking for the right words)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Actually, we already found a house we love.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And about an hour ago, we made an offer.
(All the friends looked shocked and confused. There is a long silence.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bet you wish I was having an affair now, huh?
TIME LAPSE

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You put an offer on a house?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (smiling) It's so sweet. It really is. It has this big yard that leads down to this stream and then there's these old maple trees... (gets cut off)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wha..? Again with the nature, what are you? Beavers?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know this is really hard and we're really sorry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Is this because I come over here without knocking and eat your food? (Walks towards the fridge) Because I can stop doing that, (looks at the fridge) I really, really think I can!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (goes towards Joey) You know that's not the reason Joe. (Joey hugs him and after, he takes something from the fridge and puts it in his mouth. He goes back to where he was standing before)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We think if you saw it, you'd understand. I mean you guys were there. (Points to Rachel and Phoebe) It is beautiful, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah it is.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What the hell are you doin'?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, it is, all right? When we were out there today, all I kept thinking was: I can't believe Chandler is screwing this woman, but MAN this would be a nice place to live!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, but so is this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I mean, if you moved there, you have to leave here. I mean, how can you leave this place?
[We fade to some flashback scenes.]
(from 1.01 - "The One Where Monica Gets a New Roommate - The Pilot")

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (talking on the phone) C'mon Daddy, listen to me! All of my life, everyone has always told me, 'You're a shoe! You're a shoe, you're a shoe, you're a shoe!'. And today I just stopped and I said, 'What if I don't wanna be a shoe? What if I wanna be a- a purse, y'know? Or a- or a hat! No, I don't want you to buy me a hat, I'm saying that I am a ha- It's a metaphor, Daddy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can see where he'd have trouble.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well maybe I'll just stay here with Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I guess we've established who's staying here with Monica...
(from 1.18 - "The One With All the Poker")

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That money is mine, Green!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You're fly is open, Geller!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You guys, you know what I just realized? 'Joker' is 'poker' with a 'J.' Coincidence?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, that's...'joincidence' with a 'C'!
(from 1.07 - "The One With The Blackout")

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: [looking outside the window] Eww, look. Ugly Naked Guy lit a bunch of candles.
[They all look at the window, grossed out, then flinch in pain.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow, that had to hurt!
(from 3.09 - "The One With All the Football")

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, it’s your Thanksgiving too, y'know, instead of watching football, you could help.

lines.speaker: The Guys
lines.text: We will. (they don’t move)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Rachel, you wanna put the marshmallows in concentric circles.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No Mon, you want to put them in concentric circles. I want to do this.
(Rachel sticks a marshmallow into Monica’s nose. Monica takes it out of her nose by closing one nostril, and blowing.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Every year.
(from 5.08 - "The One With the Thanksgiving Flashbacks")

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (he has a turkey on his head) It's stuck!!!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (walks him to the kitchen) Easy. Step. How did it get on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I put it on to scare Chandler!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God! Monica's gonna totally freak out!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It smells really bad in here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, of course it smells really bad. You have your head inside a turkey's ass!
(They hear Monica trying to unlock the door. So Phoebe quickly pushes his head down onto the table to make it look like the turkey is just sitting on a platter and not stuck on Joey's head.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, did you get the turkey bast-Oh my God! Oh my God! (She sees someone is stuck in the turkey.) Who is that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's Joey.
(from 4.12 - "The one With the Embryos")

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I got it! How about, if we win, they have to get rid of the rooster?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oooohh that’s interesting.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: If you win, we give up the birds.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (shocked) Dah!! (Chandler motions for him to calm down.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: But if we win, we get your apartment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oooooh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Deal!
TIME LAPSE

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What was Monica’s nickname when she was a field hockey goalie?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Big fat goalie.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Correct. Rachel claims this is her favorite movie…

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Dangerous Liaisons.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Correct. Her actual favorite movie is...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Weekend at Bernie’s.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica categorizes her towels. How many categories are there?
(They both confer)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Everyday use.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fancy.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Guest.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fancy guest.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Two seconds...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uhh, 11!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 11, unbelievable, 11 is correct. (The guys celebrate.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to the girls) Chandler was how old when he first touched a girl’s breast?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thanks man.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey had an imaginary childhood friend. His name was?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maurice.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Correct, his profession was?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Space cowboy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Correct! What is Chandler Bing’s job?
(The girls are stumped)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ow...Oh Gosh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: 10 seconds, you need this or you lose the game.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It’s umm, it has something to do with transponding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh-oh-oh, he’s a transponce—transpondster!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That’s not even a word!
(Ross stops the clock, signifying the end of the lightning round.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: NOOOOOOOOO!!!!!
TIME LAPSE
(The door opens and Joey and Chandler ride in on the big, fake dog in triumph)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Y’know what, you are mean boys, who are just being mean!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, don’t get mad at us! No one forced you to raise the stakes!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That is not true. She did! She forced me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, we would still be living here if hadn’t gotten the question wrong!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well it stupid, unfair question!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don’t blame the questions!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Would you all stop yelling in our apartment! You are ruining moving day for us!
(from 5.15 - "The One With The Girl Who Hits Joey")

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler!!! Chandler!!! (He opens the door to the apartment but is stopped by the chain; Chandler and Monica quickly stop making out and try to get dressed.) Chandler, I saw what you were doing through the window! Chandler, I saw what you were doing to my sister! Now get out here!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Wow! Listen, we had a good run. You know, what was it? Four? Five months? I mean, that's more than most people have in a lifetime! So, good-bye, take care, bye-bye then! (He kisses her and starts to climb out the balcony window)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (She opens the door.) Hey Ross. What's up bro?
(Ross spots Chandler and starts chasing him around the kitchen table. Chandler runs and hides behind Monica.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What the hell are doing?!!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (running from the guy's apartment with Joey in tow) Hey, what's-what's going on?!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I think, I think Ross knows about me and Monica.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (panicking) Dude! He's right there!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) I thought you were my best friend, this is my sister! My best friend and my sister! I-I cannot believe this!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, we're not just messing around! I love her. Okay, I'm in love with her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm so sorry that you had to find out this way. I'm sorry, but iit-t's true, I love him too.
(There's a brief pause.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (happily) My best friend and my sister! I cannot believe this. (He hugs them both.)
(from 6.06 - "The One On The Last Night")

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, this is the last box of your clothes. I’m just gonna label it, "What were you thinking?"

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Funny, because I was just gonna go across the hall and write that on Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, you guys, I don’t mean to make things worse, but umm, I don’t want to live with Rachel anymore.

lines.speaker: Monica and Rachel
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You’re just so mean to each other! And I don’t want to end up like that with Rachel. I still like you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Phoebe that’s fine because I’m not moving.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa, Phoebe you gotta take her! Y’know, I-I-I said some really bad stuff about her, but y’know Rachel has some good qualities that make her a good roommate. She gets tons of catalogs and umm, she’ll fold down the pages of the things she thinks that I’d like.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What else?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When I take a shower, she leaves me little notes on the mirror.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, I do. I-I do, do that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That’s nice. I like having things to read in the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: When I fall asleep on the couch after reading, she covers me over with a blanket.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well y’know, I don’t want you to be cold.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And when I told her that I was gonna be moving in with Chandler, she was really supportive. (To Rachel) (Starts to cry) You were so great. You made it so easy. And now you have to leave. And I have to live with a boy!! (They both break down in tears.)
TIME LAPSE
(Monica closes the door and slowly walks into Rachel’s old and now empty room.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (entering) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She really left.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know. (He kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No problem roomie. (She turns around and hugs him.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Can I ask you a question?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What the hell is that dog doing here?! (She notices the dog sitting in the living room.)
(from 1.09 - "The One Where Underdog Gets Away")

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Little toast here. I know this isn't exactly the kind of Thanksgiving that all of you all planned, but for me, this has been really great, you know, I think because it didn't involve divorce or projectile vomiting. Anyway, I was just thinking, I mean, if you'd gone to Vail, and if you guys'd been with your family, if you didn't have syphilis and stuff, we wouldn't be all together, you know? So I guess what I'm trying to say is that I'm very thankful that all of your Thanksgivings sucked.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: That's so sweet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And hey, here's to a lousy Christmas.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And a crappy New Year.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Here, here!

scenes.location: We're back to the present. Chandler and Monica's. They're all still at the kitchen table.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You can't move. You just... you just can't.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Rachel's right. This is where you guys belong.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you don't wanna live in Westchester. That's like the worst of the Chesters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, sometimes when I'm alone in my apartment, I look over here and you guys... are just having dinner or... watching TV or something, but... it makes me feel better. And now when I look over, who am I gonna see? The Gottliebs, the Yangs? They don't make me feel so good. (Joey pats Ross on his back)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. So don't move, okay? Just stay here and... (nods towards Ross) maybe close your blinds at night.
(The phone rings and Chandler goes to get it)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hello? It's Nancy, they responded to our offer.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And?
(Chandler listens to what Nancy says)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Nancy) Okay, thanks... (to Monica) They passed. They said they wouldn't go a penny under the asking price.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We can't afford that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, there you go.
(Chandler and Monica hug)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm really sorry you guys.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. I'm sorry too. I'm even more sorry that that phone call didn't come before I told you about looking through the window.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, we're gonna let you be alone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Monica) You're gonna be okay?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, we'll be okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Love you guys. (he kisses Monica, he, Rachel and Phoebe leave.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know, I'm really sorry I wasn't more supportive before.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's okay, we understand.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And about this Nancy thing... If you're not sleeping with her, should I?
(Chandler gives Joey her business card, which he eagerly grabs and he leaves.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know there'll be other houses, but it's just so... I love that one so much.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah... Well, it's a good thing we got it then.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We got the house.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I just didn't want to tell you in front of them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! My God! We've got the house !?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We're getting the house. (they hug) We're getting the house.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And a baby...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We're growing up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We sure are.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So who's gonna tell them?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (quickly) Not it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not it! Damn it!
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Central Perk. The entire gang is there, and Chandler and Monica are handing out presents.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel, this is yours.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aah! Why? What are these for?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You'll see.

lines.speaker: Monica

(they all tear off the wrapping paper)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh! Oh wow this is so beautiful. (she got a scarf)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! These are the ones I was looking at in the store. (she got earrings)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I love this. (he got a sweater)

lines.text: A meatball Sub? Thanks! (he got a meatball sandwich)

lines.speaker: Ross

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I didn't know how to tell you before, but... We got the house.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Enjoy!
(they both run off, leaving Ross, Phoebe and Rachel stunned.)

lines.text: (speaking with his mouth full, enjoying his sandwich) What did they say?
THE END

lines.text: Well, look - it's not my fault if you're too uptight to appreciate the male form in all it's glory.

lines.text: (walks towards Phoebe and the stripper) Uh, look, officer... uhm Sir...

scenes.location: At Pyramid. Joey is with the woman now.

lines.text: Oh, then pass. (Next word: "Joint session", but time's up, Joey acts very disappointed)

lines.speaker: Donny
lines.text: O-kay... Henrietta, you didn't get all the points you needed, so that means Gene, you are going to the winners circle to try for ten thousand dollars! (Gene is clapping his hands looking very happy and so is Joey) And you're gonna be going there with Joey Tribbiani (Both of their smiles fade away instantly)

scenes.location: Class of '91 reunion. Ross is walking angrily towards Chandler, who is talking to two other guys.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Chandler) You made out with Missy Goldberg. How could you do that, after you promised me?
(Chandler looks at the other two guys, embarrassed)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to the two guys) Excuse me. (Chandler and Ross move away from them). That didn't make us sound gay at all!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You broke the pact!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ross, that was 16 years ago!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That doesn't matter! We're talking about the foundation of our friendship.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I believe the foundation of our friendship was unfortunate hair. (Ross just stares at him) All right, look, if we're really gonna do this... it's not like you never broke one of the pacts.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I didn't.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh really!?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: NO!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: ADRIENNE TURNER!! (A girl behind them turns around)

lines.speaker: Adrienne
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Chandler and Ross
lines.text: Hey! Hey Adrienne. (They move away from her)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I never did anything with Adrienne Turner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh please, and you knew how much I liked her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know what... you're talking about.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really?
[Flashback scene: 80's College party.]

lines.speaker: Present Chandler's voice
lines.text: Remember that big party? Freshman year? A week before Christmas vacation? I do. You had some visitors.
(An 80's Rachel and fat Monica walk into the party room. Both with funny hair-do's and clothes)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I can't believe we are at a real college party! (Rachel laughs excitedly) I have to pee so bad!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This is so awesome! College guys are so cute!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, you've got a boyfriend!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. But if some guy who looks like Corey Haim wants to kiss me tonight, I'm sooo gonna let them! (They spot Chandler)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Look, there's Chandler. You knew, that stupid friend of Ross'. Said I'm fat. You know I've already lost 4 pounds!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It... You can so totally tell.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I KNOW!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well lets see. Maybe he knows where Ross is. (They walk towards Chandler) Hey, how's it going (tries to look as un-interested in him as possible - checking out her nails).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aren't you...?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, Rachel. And this (points to Monica) is Ross' sister, Monica. We met at Thanksgiving. (looks around the room as if searching for something more interesting to do).

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiling at Monica) Right. (to Rachel) So how're you doing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Bitchin'

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi Monica.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi Chandler. It's really nice to see you (rolls her eyes) NOT. (she and Rachel giggle a little and Chandler looks unimpressed)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: O-kay. I'll see if I can find Ross. (Goes off to find Ross.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God Rach. Bean bag chairs.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do NOT let me sit in one of those. We'll be here for days.
(Cut to Chandler. He's walking around looking for Ross. He sees him kissing a girl next to a vending machine)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen Adrienne, you can't tell Chandler about this.

lines.speaker: Adrienne
lines.text: Oh believe me, Ross, I won't be telling anybody about this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Cool! (They start kissing again and Chandler looks shocked)

scenes.location: We cut back to the present. The reunion where Chandler and Ross are talking.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I didn't know you knew about that.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I did and it hurt. (they walk towards the bar) That's when I wrote the song: "Betrayal In The Common Room".

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looks disappointed in himself) Man... I... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look (hands him a drink) it was a lo-o-ong time ago.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, eh. I made out with Adrienne and you made out with Missy. Well I guess we're even.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiling a little nervously) Hmm mmmhm..

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We are even, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (sighs) Just one more thing. I was so pissed at you that night that I wanted to get back at you. So I thought, who does Ross like the more than anybody?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (thinks about it for a few seconds) What did you do to my mom?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Not her!
[Flashback scene: We cut back to the 80's party. Rachel and Monica are "dancing".]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I am sooo drunk.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's weird. I've had the same number of beers as you and I don't feel anything at all. (Chandler approaches)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Soo... you girls having fun?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: For your information, ass munch, I've lost four pounds. Maybe even five with all the dancing. (A guy enters holding a pizza box)

lines.speaker: Pizza guy
lines.text: SOMEBODY ORDER A PIZZA?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh THATS ME! (she runs to the pizza guy)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (finishing the last of her drink) I am soo not going to do good on my SATs tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well maybe if you go to school here next year we can totally hang out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh yeah. There is a plan! Why don't I just start taking my smart pills now?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, maybe you can get in on a beauty scholarship.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (blushing) Oh, what a line. (walks towards the drinks table with her back towards Chandler and whispers "Oh my God!")

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So where are you applying to?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh well, You know, I think it's kinda really important that I go somewhere where there's sun, so I'm sort of... (Chandler leans in an kisses her) (She pulls away) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm in college and I'm in a band.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (She considers it for a second) Yeah okay. (She puts her hands around his neck and they start kissing again)

scenes.location: Monica's apartment. The stripper is sitting at the kitchen table. Monica, Rachel and Phoebe are standing around him

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: What's the matter? You never saw a 50 year old stripper cry before?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, it's fine. We'll pay you.

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: No, no, you're right. Who am I kidding? I should have hung up that breakaway jockstrap years ago. What am I gonna do? I mean, this has been my life for thirty two years. Taking my clothes off in front of people is all I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, wait. No there's gotta be something else that you can do. I mean, what skills do you have?

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: I don't know... I can make my pecs dance... I can pick up a dollar bill with my butt cheeks... I can go to that special place inside me where I feel no shame.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So maybe something in an office.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Or you could teach stripping. You know, share your gift, pass the torch.

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: You know, actually that's not a bad idea. I can do it out of my apartment. I don't think my mom would mind.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There you go. Okay, do you think you're gonna be okay?

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah... This is so weird. I mean, you never know when it's gonna be your last dance. And I didn't even get a chance to finish it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (after a pause) Finish it!

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Your last dance. Do it for us.

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. He deserves to do the thing he loves one last time.

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: Okay, all right... Get ready ladies!

(they sit down and Roy plays "You Make Me Feel" by Sylvester on his boom box, and starts... With his back towards the girls, he starts waving his hands, then backs towards the girls slapping his butt, then swings it around, and makes thrusting pelvic movements in front of Phoebe. He dances around the tables in between all the girls, and gets back into the kitchen part of the room. He then tears off one of his sleeves and throws it towards Monica and Rachel, who fight over who gets it. He then tears off his other sleeve and moves it back and forth between his legs, getting closer to Phoebe.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh this is so ho-o-ot!
(Roy then sits on Phoebe's lap, looking exhausted)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, no, no, don't stop!

lines.speaker: Roy
lines.text: (out of breath) Have to...

scenes.location: The game show studio. Joey and Gene are sitting in the winner circle.

lines.speaker: Donny
lines.text: Well, welcome to the Winner Circle. Joey and Gene, you guys ready?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (nervously) Yeah...

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: (irritable) Sure. (Joey gets even more nervous)

lines.speaker: Donny
lines.text: Okay. Give me sixty seconds on the clock please... Ready, GO! (runs off)
(the screen says "6 to win" and "types of trees")

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: Oak, maple, elm, birch...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I-I-I don't know. Types of trees?
(Joey hears the bell which means his answer is correct and is surprised. The screen now says "5 to win" and "Spanish words")

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: Uhm... Buenos días, enchilada, por favor...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (sympathetic) Oh, I'm so sorry. I don't know any Spanish words.
(There's the next bell, and the correct answer. The screen changes to "4 to win" and "things that burn". Gene now realizes that he got two correct answers and gets up in his seat.)

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: A match, a candle...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Things that go "tssst" when you put them out.

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: A torch, a bonfire... (Joey seems lost) uhm, your pee...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Things that burn.
(and another bell for the correct answer. "3 to win" and "What a dog might say")

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: "I'd like to go for a walk", uhm "scratch my belly".

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, dude! I think you're losing it.

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: Uhm, "I have fur", "I like to bark".

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, oh, oh... What a dog says.
(the bell sounds again, "2 to win" and "pizza toppings")

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: Pepperoni...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (instantly) Pizza toppings, next!
(there's 10 seconds left, "1 to win" and "Supermodels")

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: Cindy Crawford, Christie Brinkley, Heidi Klum, Claudia Schiffer...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, oh, oh... (5 seconds left)

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: Christie Turlington, Kate Moss...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Girls Chandler could never get?

lines.speaker: Gene
lines.text: (irritated) Supermodels!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Where? (looking around)

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartment. Monica's there and Ross and Chandler walk in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, where's Rachel?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She and Phoebe took the stripper to the hospital.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did you know Chandler kissed Rachel?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? When was this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nineteen Eighty Seven. The weekend you guys visited me at school.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! That's wild!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, but it was like a million years ago, so it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, it matters to me.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because... the night you kissed Rachel was the night I kissed Rachel for the very first time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You kissed her that night too?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Two guys in one night? Wow, I thought she became a slut after she got her nose fixed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Seriously, where did this happen?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, after you told me she was passed out in our room, I went in there to make sure she was all right. She was lying on my bed, all buried in peoples coats. Well, I went to kiss her on the forehead, you know. But it was so dark, I accidentally got her lips. I started to pull away, but then I felt her start to kiss me back. It was only for a second, but... it was amazing. And now, now I find out that you kissed her first.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh wait... What bed did you say she was on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm pretty sure I put her on my bed.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, she was definitely on my bed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why would I kiss a girl, and then put her on your bed?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, then who was on my bed?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (screeching) OH! Oh, oh! (holding her hand in front of her mouth)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (realizing) NO! No, no!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: YES! (Chandler gets an "oh no!" look on his face)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You were under the pile of coats?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I was the pile of coats!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: OH MY GOD!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You were my Midnight Mystery Kisser?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You were my first kiss with Rachel?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You were my first kiss ever?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What did I marry into?
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Back at the party in 1987. People are dancing to "Disco Inferno" by The Trammps.

lines.text: (Monica is dancing. At first she seems insecure and moves slowly, but then gets into the groove and swings her hips from side to side while holding her hands up. She then eats the last piece of pizza she was holding and again moves her hips from side to side, pushing her hands in the air in beat with the music. Her moves get more wildly while she's snapping her fingers. She loses balance and falls back onto a pink bean bag.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, crap!
THE END

lines.text: Friends - 10.12 - The One With Phoebe's Wedding

1012 - The One With Phoebe's Wedding
