scenes.location: Central Perk. Joey's sitting on the couch and Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, hey Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Listen, I need to ask you something. Ok, you know how my step dad's in prison.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (afraid) Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. Well, uhm... listen he was supposed to get a weekend furlough, so he'd come to the wedding tomorrow, but he just called and... uhm... well, apparently stabbing Iceman in the exercise yard just couldn't wait till Monday.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So he can't come?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, and so there's no one to walk me down the aisle and... well, I would just really love it if you would do it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Seriously?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you've... you know, sort of been like a dad to me. I mean, you've always, you know, looked out for me and shared your wisdom...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I am pretty wisdomous.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So... what do you say?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Are you kidding? Phoebe, I would be honored. (they hug)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, thank you. I hope... I hope you know how much you mean to me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (takes her hand) Listen, I hope... that you know... (has difficulty saying it) I don't want you to see your father cry, GO TO YOUR ROOM!
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Central Perk. Phoebe and Joey are sitting on the couch. A waitress brings a coffee and Phoebe wants to pay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh no, no, no, let your dad get this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (her mobile phone rings) Oh, it's my wedding planner. She's driving me crazy! (she answers) Hello... Hey, ok, stop screaming! Ok? So, halibut. All right, so salmon, either way. I don't-I don't... it doesn't matter to me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (she enters with a headset on and she's speaking into the microphone) Well, it matters to me!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I don't care, so you pick!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Did you just hung up on me? (she hangs up too) All right, look, I need you at the rehearsal dinner tonight at 1800 hours.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-uh. Ok. What time is that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You don't know military time?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why, I must have been in missile training the day they taught that.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just subtract twelve.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, so... 1800 minus twelve is... one thousand, seven hundred and...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (screaming) Six o'clock!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok. Hold on. (her mobile phone rings) Geller here! No! I said it has to be there by 4 o'clock. Goodbye. (she hangs up) Oh, how hard it is to make an ice sculpture?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ice sculpture? That sounds really fancy! I told you I just want a simple wedding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Please... honey, leave the details to me. Now I wanna make this day as special for you as I can. Now, ok, I was thinking that the harpist should wear white.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What harpist? My friend Marjorie is playing the steel drums.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooh... she backed out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She did? Why?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I made her. (Phoebe looks shocked) Steel drums don't really say "elegant wedding". Nor does Marjorie's overwhelming scent.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (looking angry) Hey! She will shower when Tibet is free.

scenes.location: The wedding rehearsal dinner.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You look great. I'm so glad we're having this rehearsal dinner, you know, I so rarely get to practice my meals before I eat them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, what did we say was your one gift to us?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No stupid jokes. I thought that was for the actual wedding.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rehearse it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi! (he kisses Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Thanks for coming you guys.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, (he goes towards Mike in order to shake hands but Mike hugs him) hey, oh... I... I was-I was going for a hand shake.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Is that why your hand is pressed against my crotch?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That is why!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So Rach.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where is Emma?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Monica made me send her to my mother's. Apparently babies and weddings don't mix.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (coming) Are you still crying about your damn baby? Pheebs, you gotta keep the line moving, remember, 20 seconds per person. Your see these clowns all the time! (she takes off)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you're Mike's parents, right?

lines.speaker: Mike's mother
lines.text: Yes, we are.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah, our little ones are growing up fast, uh?

lines.speaker: Mike's father
lines.text: How's that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know, on the one hand you're happy for them, but on the other hand it's hard to let go.

lines.speaker: Mike's father
lines.text: Who in God's name are you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, I'm not that fond of you either, ok buddy? But I'm just trying to be nice for the kids!
(cut to Ross, Chandler and Rachel)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Rachel) You know what I just realized? We have no idea what we're doing in the wedding tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I thought we'd be groomsmen, but wouldn't they have asked us by now? When did they ask you to be their bridesmaid?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh... November?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I wanna say it's not looking good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Pheebs...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What's up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uhm... you haven't told these guys what they're doing in the wedding yet.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Heh.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uhm... well, they're not in the wedding.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? (Ross and Chandler don't know what to say, so there's an embarrassing long pause)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, this is really awkward (staring at the floor) Oh, and I can leave!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry you guys but, you know, Mike's got his brother and his friends from school so... you know, you were-you were... if it helps you, you were next in line, you just-you just missed the cut.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, man!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is like figure skating team all over again. (Phoebe and Ross glare at him astonished) I mean synchronized swimming. (they continue to glare) I mean- I mean the balance beam. (to Ross) Help me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: FOOTBALL!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looking at Phoebe eating something) Pheebs, spit that out, that has pork in it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! I though the pot stickers were supposed to be vegetarian!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I changed them. I-I sent you a fax about it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't have a fax machine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ah, well then there are gonna be a few surprises!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe we're gonna be the only people that aren't in this wedding.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, I hate being left out of things.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And it's a wedding! It'd be weird if I'm not in it...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey guys, how is it going?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Fine. We're just sitting here. Alone. Doing nothing. It's our rehearsal for tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah look, about tomorrow, I... I've got a question for ya. I just found out that one of my groomsmen had had an emergency and can't make it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who cares, AND?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: ...and I was wondering if... you know, maybe one of you guys... (Ross stands up)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll do it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (standing up too) M-Me-me-me!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You both wanna do it? Uhm... there's only room for one.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pick me, I look great in a tux and I will not steal focus.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, Mike, no, no. You wanna pick me, I mean... watch! (he mimics the groommens way of walking down the aisle with a bridesmaid) Huh?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You know, I really don't feel very comfortable making this decision. You know, Phoebe knows you better, I'm gonna let her choose. (he leaves)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Chandler) Well, if Phoebe's choosing, then say hello to Mike's next groomsman.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, I will. But I will need a mirror... as he is me!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please, you're going down!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You are going downer!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is that what they say on the Figure Skating Team?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (almost crying) I wouldn't know, I didn't make it! (they hug)

scenes.location: Wedding rehearsal dinner. Joey and Mike are talking.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, you know I'm filling in for Phoebe's step dad, tomorrow, right?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Hey, thanks for doing that.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey, my pleasure. (he suddenly becomes very serious) So what are your intentions with my Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I intend to marry her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, a wiseacre. (Mike looks bewildered). No, no, no, I understand you plan to support your wife by playing the piano? Isn't that kind of unstable?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No more so than acting.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Strike two!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You're right. She probably will support me. Hey, unless we move in with you, dad?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Strike three! You only get one more, Mike!
(Cut to Chandler and Ross. Phoebe comes out of the ladies room and they run toward her.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, what did you decide?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I decided to pee.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mike didn't tell you? You have to chose one of us to be in your wedding. One of his groomsmen fell out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh no, no. I can't choose between you two! I love you both so much!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Just not enough to put us in the original wedding party.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I don't wanna choose! It's (Rachel is walking by). Oh okay, wait. Rach! Listen I have a very special bridesmaid task for you today.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (excited and clapping her hands in front of her face) Goody, what is it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, there's a spot open for only one groomsman and you have to choose between Ross and Chandler. So good luck with that.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What, what, what, no, I don't wanna do that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I guess I'll have to find a new bridesmaid.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll do it! (Monica approaches)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, it's 2100 hours. (to Phoebe) Time for your toast. (Mike appears)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Do I have a minute to go to the bathroom?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You had a bathroom break at 2030. Pee on your own time, Mike! (to Phoebe and Mike). Now, in regard to the toast, okay, you wanna keep them short, nothing kills a rehearsal dinner like long speeches. Okay. You just get in, do your thing and get out!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Is that what you say to Chandler?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (very serious) It's 2101 and I am not amused. (pause). Ok, the bride and groom have a few words they'd like to say. (Everyone sits and Phoebe gets up)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok. Hello everyone and thank you all for being here tonight. So tomorrow's the big event and some of you might not know, but Mike and I didn't get off to the best start. (she reads a note). My friend Joey and I decided to fix each other up with friends so I, I... (Monica is twirling her hands in order to make Phoebe speed up her speech) oh I... hum... I gave it a lot of thought and I fixed him up with my friend Mary Ellen who couldn't be here tonight because... (Monica is tapping her watch with her finger) it's not important... she is in rehab. Anyway, so, ok, Joey said that he was fixing me up with his friend Mike, only he didn't have a friend Mike so he just brought, uhm, my Mike and, and (Monica clears her throat) but despite, you know... it got... it got good. Ok, I wanna take a moment to mention my mother, who couldn't be here...
Monica (rolling her eyes): oh God.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And... moment's over! (Rachel, Joey and Chandler all turn and look disapprovingly towards Monica but she just shrugs it off) So, ok, uh, I can forget that. I can forget that and uhm... (she's flipping cards skipping half of them) Oh this is funny! Oh, but you need to know that to... that, to... Oh, ok, well, uhm, I (Monica is miming CUT). Ok, ok, I, ok, I.... MONICA I CAN'T DO IT LIKE THIS! THIS IS MY WEDDING! OKAY, I DON'T WANT THIS (she mimes Monica's when she was twirling her hands) OR THIS (she taps her watch) OR THIS (she mimes CUT) OK? I JUST WANTED A SIMPLE WEDDING! WHERE MY FIANCEE CAN GO TO THE BATHROOM ANYTIME HE WANTS! (pause) You know what? You're done.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: YOU'RE FIRED! (mimes the CUT again) (pause and she raises her glass) Cheers! (Chandler raises his, smiling and Monica stares at him and he puts down his glass.)

scenes.location: Joey's apartment. Joey's having breakfast; Phoebe enters the room carrying her wedding dress.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Happy wedding day!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, happy my wedding day to you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok-dokey, Joey, listen. This is gonna be bridesmaid central, all right? We're gonna have hair and make-up going on in the bathroom and oh, I had to move a couple of things in the fridge to make room for the corsages.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, man! I wouldn't have had breakfast if I knew there was going to be corsages!
(Monica enters the room)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi. About last night... I know you are under a lot of stress and even though the things you said hurt me a little bit... My point is, uh, well, I'm willing to take my job back.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, well that's ok. I think you and I will do much better if you're just... here as a bridesmaid.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, is that so? Ok. If that's really what you want, then here... I give you the headset. Well, I don't really want to give you the headset. Well I guess if you're taking over, you should probably return these messages. (hands her a stack of papers with messages and calls to return)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, this is a lot!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh-huh, but I'm sure you can handle this. I mean, I have won awards for my organizational skills, but, uh, I'm sure you'll do fine.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You won awards?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mm-mh. I printed them out on my computer.
(Ross enters the room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Where's Rach?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She's in her room, why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I have to talk to her about this groomsman situation, ok? I'm not gonna watch Chandler up there while I'm sitting in the seats like some chump! (he goes to Rachel's room, knocks the door and enters the room). (very fake gasp) Oh! My God! You're breathtaking!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What d'you want?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You haven't by any chance chosen a groomsman yet, have you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Ross, c'mon, please! Don't make this harder than it already is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm not! I'm making it easier! Pick me!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, Chandler said that it's really important to him too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Listen, listen. Whoever you pick is gonna walk down the aisle with you! Now, I promise I won't say a word, but if you pick Chandler he's gonna be whispering stupid jokes in your ear the whole time!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you are the lesser of two evils!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (waving his fist in the air in triumph) YES, YES!

scenes.location: Joey's apartment. Phoebe is talking at the phone, Monica is listening amused.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sven I don't understand what you're saying! What is wrong with the flowers? Lorkins? What the hell are lorkins?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.
(Mike enters the room).

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Listen, Mike, if you were Swedish and you were saying the word "lorkins" what flowers would that be?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (thinks a moment) Orchids?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Right there! That's why I'm marrying you!
(Joey comes out from his room)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Mike) Hello Michael.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Joseph.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: May I have a word with you, please?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (looking around the room) This is... great...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Have a seat. (Mike sits on his bed, and Joey towers over him. He starts talking in an Italian godfather-type voice) Last night, I tried to welcome you into my family... and instead, you disrespect me... (shakes his head) I cannot allow this.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (not amused) Are you rehearsing for some really bad mafia movie?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: More back talk. And yes, I may be borrowing a few lines from my recent unsuccessful audition for "Family Honor 2: Thissa Time Itsa Personal."

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Joey, I kinda have a lot to do today, what do you want?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I want you to take this seriously! Phoebe is very very important to me, ok? And I wanna make sure that you are gonna take care of her.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (gets up) Joe, I love Phoebe. She's the single most important thing in my life. I'd die before I let anything happen to her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (very satisfied and smiling) That's what I wanted to hear! Because she's family, ok, and now you're gonna be family, and there is nothing more important in the whole world, than family.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: That must have been one lousy movie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (almost crying) That was ME!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Chandler is pacing and Rachel walks in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, can I talk to you about this groomsman thing? If you pick Ross, he'll walk you down the isle just fine. But if you choose me, you'll be getting some comedy!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Even so, I think I'm gonna pick Ross.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me tell you why you need to pick me. (Goes to sit on the couch facing backwards to the kitchen. Rachel gets a chair and sits opposite him) See, when I was a kid, I was always left out of everything, you know, and it really made me feel... insecure. You know, I was always picked last in gym. Even behind that big fat exchange student who didn't even know the rules to baseball. I mean, this guy would strike out and then run to third. Anyway, If I'm the only one left out of this wedding, I just know that all those feelings are gonna come rushing back.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right fine, I pick you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (Getting up and raising his fist in victory) Y-Y-YEEESSS! Make "groom" for Chandler.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (not amused by his pun but forcing a smile anyway) Oh my...

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment. Phoebe is on the phone and Monica is nonchalantly "minding her own business".

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No! We're gonna do it my way. (listens) Because your way is stupid! Alright I gotta go, I have another call, Reverend. (switches calls) Hello?
(Mike and Joey come out of Joey's room)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm glad we had this little talk.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yes. Yeah and thanks for all the wedding night advice. (walks away) That didn't make me uncomfortable at all! Alright, so I'll see everybody tonight?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Bye.
(Mike opens the door and there is a gigantic ice sculpture standing in the doorway)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Uhm, did you guys know that there is a giant ice sculpture in the hall?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh my God, what's it doing here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Obviously enjoying this setback) Ugh, I guess it got sent to the billing address as opposed to the shipping address. (by now she can barely keep herself from smiling) Uh! What a pickle.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (starting to panic) Oh my God, everything is such a mess. Why is this happening to me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (staring at the ice sculpture) How bad do you want to stick your tongue on that? (They all glare at him)

scenes.location: Central Perk. Ross is getting coffee at the counter. Chandler walks in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How's it going?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (smiling to himself) Good. I'm just getting some coffee. So I'm alert for the wedding.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiling to himself too) That's what I was doing too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (barely containing himself at this point) Well, you have fun tonight.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I will.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Me too.
(They walk passed each other, Ross towards the door, Chandler towards the counter, suddenly they turn around to face each other)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wait a minute, I know why I'm being such an ass, why are you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not supposed to tell you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm not supposed to tell you!
(Cut to Joey and Rachel's apartment. Chandler and Ross storm in looking very unhappy)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You told us both we could be in the wedding? (they both stare at Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, in my defense, you were not supposed to tell each other.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel, only one of us can do it, you have to choose. You and me together again. (he winks at her and Rachel looks disgusted)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Rach, Rach, knock knock.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Who's there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'll tell you at the wedding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh.
(Mike walks in.)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey, I forgot my scarf.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what, I can't do this. I don't know which one of you guys to pick.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh, you haven't picked yet. Oh good, 'cause I had an idea. I thought it would be fun if the third groomsman was my family dog. Chappy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? A dog? No! Rachel gets to choose.
(all eyes turn to Rachel)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastic) Wow, this is a tough one. I think I'm gonna have to go with the dog.
(Ross and Chandler look shocked)
(Cut to Phoebe who is in the living room, still on the phone.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alright, wait, so what you're saying is that the chef is at the Hamilton Club, but the food is not and the drinks are there, but the bartender is not? Are you, are you FREAKING KIDDING ME!?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (enjoying what she's seeing) How's it going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Monica) Help me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I want you to be Crazy Bitch again.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Sounds moved) Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Nearly in tears) Please?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You really want me to come back?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: More than I wanna get married.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok people, we are back in business! (Gets her headset out of her purse) Oh God, we've missed you soo much! (takes all the notes from Phoebe) Ok, go and get your hair and make-up done, and I'll take care of everything.
(Joey walks in)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, what are you guys gonna do?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (sounds scared already) About what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: The blizzard. I just saw on the news, it's like the worst snow storm in 20 years! They already closed all the bridges and tunnels. (Opens the curtains to reveal a snow storm outside)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ooh! But the band and the photographer are coming all the way in from New Jersey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don't think they are.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Rachel) Haha! Looks like you're not going to be in the wedding either. (Looks at Phoebe) So sorry Pheebs.

scenes.location: Monica's apartment. They are all sitting around.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Putting down her phone) Well, the club lost it's power.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah according to the news, most of the city did.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Since when do you watch the news?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, for your information, since they hired a very hot weather girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (To Phoebe and Mike) I can't believe you guys aren't going to be able to get married today.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow, you know, it's so beautiful out there. You always wanted to get married outside. Why don't you guys just do it on the street?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, look, it's hardly snowing anymore. I mean you couldn't ask for a more romantic setting. This could be the simple wedding you've always wanted!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Turning to Mike) What do you think?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I think I wanna get married to you today.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Me too! (turning to Monica) Monica, do you think we could do it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (thinking) AFFIRMATIVE!

scenes.location: Outside. They are a bunch of people arranging chairs, shoveling snow and making other preparations.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (walking around with her headset still on) OK LET'S GET THESE CHAIRS OUT HERE! Gunther, hit the Christmas lights. (He does so and the lights above the chairs light up. Monica looks satisfied) Okay, who left the ice sculpture (picks up a piece of ice from the ground) ON THE STEAM GRATE? (nobody answers)

lines.speaker: Mike's mom
lines.text: Michael!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey! You made it. Great! Chappy! Hi! (kisses his dad) Hi! (kisses his mom) Mom, I know getting married in the street isn't something you approve of...

lines.speaker: Mike's mom
lines.text: No... It's lovely. The lights and the snow. I could look at them forever.

lines.speaker: Mike's dad
lines.text: (leans in towards Mike) I crushed a pill and put it in her drink... (to his wife) Come on, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (to Chandler and Ross) You know, Chappy's too small to handle all this snow. Someone's gonna have to walk him down the aisle.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So technically, would this person be in the wedding?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I guess.

lines.speaker: Chandler and Ross
lines.text: I'll do it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, but Chandler, hello... Aren't you scared of dogs?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm not scared. (moves towards Mike and Chappy) I'll just take little Chappy and... (he backs out) HE CAN SENSE MY FEAR. MY THROAT IS EXPOSED.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (takes Chappy from Mike) Well, I guess I'm in the wedding then. Ha haaa... (smells Chappy) He stinks!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Level 1 alert. I repeat, level 1. This is not a drill. Okay we've got a situation. The minister just called. He's snowed in. He can't make it.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh, no!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh hey, don't worry. I'm still ordained from your wedding.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you'd think I'd give up being a minister and start paying to ride the subway? Huhuh...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhm, ministers don't ride the subway for free.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I had to read the Bible pretty carefully, but... yeah we do.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, if Joey does the ceremony, then we have to find someone else to walk Phoebe down the isle.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (quickly) I'll do it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Ross) Na ha ha... (to Chappy) Ne he he... (Ross moves Chappy to Chandler, who quickly backs away) Ah ah...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Mike and Joey, get in position. Chandler, come with me. (they walk off, Ross looks down to Chappy, who he's holding and he gets a whiff of the dog's smell. He is clearly disgusted by it.)
(Cut to inside Central Perk where Rachel is helping Phoebe. Chandler and Monica enter.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, Joey's doing the ceremony and Chandler's giving you away.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, okay. Hi new dad. (Chandler waves)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So, you're ready to do this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uhuh, uhuh... Oh my God! This is really happening.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Phoebe, I'm so happy for you honey. (she gives her a kiss)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you. (Phoebe leans in to kiss her.) Oh, wait, wait, wait! No hugs. The dresses... Oh what the hell. (the girls hug)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I love you guys.

lines.speaker: Rachel and Monica
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay. (in her microphone) It's zero hour. All teams execute on my count. (to all) Let's get this bad boy on the road.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Monica) Is it okay that I want you to wear that head set in bed tonight?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (checking her clipboard) I have you scheduled for nudity at 2300 hours.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah! (Monica walks outside)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay Marjorie, hit it.

(A woman with a steel drum and a guy with a xylophone start playing an instrumental version of "Can't Help Falling In Love" by Elvis Presley. A bridesmaid and a groomsman walk down the isle. Next are Rachel and Ross, who carries Chappy in his arms.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Geez Ross, you could have showered.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's the dog.
(we cut to Monica)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Groomsman, groomsman, why are you just standing there, where is your bridesmaid? (into microphone) We've got a broken arrow. Bridesmaid down! (realizes) Oh, that's me.
(She walks down the aisle with the groomsman. We cut to inside Central Perk, where Phoebe and Chandler are waiting.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ready?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (nervously) Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh wait, oh no. Wait.

(She takes off the coat she was wearing over her wedding dress, which is violet and has a darker shade petticoat underneath which shows at one side where the dress is lifted up to about the height of her hip and connected to the petticoat. She's wearing a veil over her curly hair and a low cut top with straps only just hanging over her shoulders.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow! Aren't you gonna be cold?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't care... I'll be my something blue.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You look beautiful.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you.

(They start to leave Central Perk. The band starts to play "Here, There and Everywhere" by the Beatles. The crowd rises from their seats. Phoebe and Chandler walk down the aisle. Phoebe really glows with happiness. So does Mike who watches her walk down the isle. When Phoebe and Chandler arrive, they kiss and Phoebe walks to her bridesmaids.)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: My God! Aren't you freezing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Na-ah.
(the music ends)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Friends, family, dog... Thank you all for being here to witness this blessed event. The cold has now spread to my special place... so I'm gonna do the short version of this. Phoebe and Mike are perfect for each other. And I know I speak for every one here... when I wish them a lifetime of happiness. Who has the rings?
(one of the groomsmen gives the rings to Joey)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (whispering to Phoebe) Okay...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: When I was growing up, I didn't have a normal mom and dad, or a regular family like everybody else, and I always knew that something was missing. But now I'm standing here today, knowing that I have everything I'm ever gonna need... You are my family. (She puts the ring on Mikes finger)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Phoebe you're so beautiful. You're so kind, you're so generous. You're so wonderfully weird. Every day with you is an adventure, and I can't believe how lucky I am, and I can't wait to share my life with you forever. (He puts the ring on Phoebe's finger.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh wait, oh I forgot... and uhm... I love you... and you have nice eyes.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I love you too.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh Joey...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chappy's heart rate has slowed way down.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, okay. Phoebe, do you take this man to be your husband?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I do.
(Joey has a "Yeah you do" smile on his face)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mike, do you take this woman to be your wife?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I now pronounce you... husband and wife.
(Phoebe and Mike kiss)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I got married! (everyone applauds) Could someone get me a coat, I'm freaking freezing.
(Mike takes off his coat to give to Phoebe and the steel band plays "The Wedding Song")
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: The hallway between the two apartments. Chandler and Joey are walking up the stairs.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That really was an incredible wedding.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It was, yeah. I kind of don't want it to end. Hey, you wanna come in for a drink and a bite of corsage?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'd love to, but it's 2300 hours and I'm about to have the most organized sex anyone's ever had.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Nice. Oh hey, what about Ross?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know. Maybe he hooked up with that hot girl he was talking to.
(cut to the street in front of Central Perk where Ross is walking Chappy. He has a plastic bag in his hand.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on Chappy, do your business. MAKE! MA-AKE! I did not sign on for this.
THE END

scenes.location: Central Perk. Everyone's sitting on the couch and Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey! Hi!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: How was the honeymoon?
Phoebe; Oh, incredible! Oh! Champagne, candle-lit dinners, moonlight walks on the beach, it was sooo ro-man-tic!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, where's Mike?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, he's at the doctor, he didn't poop the whole time we were there!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well anyway, I'm glad you're back, I really need your help.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, why? What's up?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I have an audition for this play and for some of it I have to speak French. Which, according to my résumé, I'm fluent in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Joey, you shouldn't lie on your résumé.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, you really shouldn't. (to Ross, sarcastically) By the way, how was that year-long dig in Cairo?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (whispering) It was ok...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did not know you spoke French.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oui, bien sur je parle Français! Qu'est-ce que tu penses alors?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... you're so sexy!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, so, will you help me? I really wanna be in this play.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Sure! Tout le plaisir est pour moi, mon ami.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Seriously stop it, or I'm gonna jump on ya.
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why are you wearing my apron?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm making cookies for Erica. And oh, by the way, we have to leave for the airport soon, her plane comes in about an hour.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, hey, when she gets here, is it ok if I introduce you two as "my wife" and "the woman who's carrying my child"? (she's not amused) No? Divorce?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he enters) Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You guys know where Rachel is?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, we haven't seen her since this morning.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So unbelievable. She was supposed to meet me half an hour ago with Emma. (he tries to take a cookie but Monica slaps his hand)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: These are for Erica!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? She's gonna eat all those cookies?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I want he baby to come out all cute and fat!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, why is Erica coming to visit?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, because we want to get to know her better and she's never been to New York so she wants to see all the tourists' spots... you know, Statue of Liberty, Empire State Building...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, those places! There's always so many people, their being corralled like cattle, and... you know, there's always some idiot who goes "Mooooo"!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, if it annoys you so much, then why do you do it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (looking at Rachel entering with Emma) Oh, hi! Hi! Thanks for showing you up thirty minutes late!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no, I'm sure you have a great excuse, wh-was it a hair appointment, a mani-pedi or was there a sale at Barney's?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: My father had an heart attack... (crying) ...while I was at Barney’s.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Honey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm so sorry...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is-is he ok?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, they said he's gonna be fine, but he's still heavily sedated.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, ok. I'm gonna come out to Long Island with you, I mean, you can't be alone right now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, come on, I'm totally ok. (hugging him) I don't need you to come! I can totally handle this on my own.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Still-still, let me come... for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok. If you really need to.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I bet someone could use one of Monica's freshly baked cookies.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, I really could.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ohh... (Ross mouths HA-HA at Monica and takes two cookies and she looks at him angrily)

scenes.location: Central Perk. Phoebe's trying to teach Joey French, so she's sitting in front of him with the script in her hands.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, it seems pretty simple. Your first line is "My name is Claude", so, just repeat after me. "Je m'appelle Claude".

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Je de coup Clow.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, just... let's try it again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Je m'appelle Claude.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Je depli mblue.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh. It's not... quite what I'm saying.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really? It sounds exactly the same to me.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It does, really?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, let just try it again. Really listen.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (slowly) Je m'appelle Claude.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Je te flouppe Fli.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, mon Dieu!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, de fuff!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (entering with Erica and Chandler) Hey you guys.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I want you to meet someone really special. Phoebe, this is Erica. And this is the baby!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey. Erica, baby!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Everyone. Erica, baby!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica. Calm, self.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Thank you. It's really nice to meet you guys, I can't believe I'm here!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Welcome to New York City! Or should I say "ghe deu flooff New York City"?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why would you say that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok. What are you gonna be doing today?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I wanna see everything! Times Square, Coney Island, Rockefeller Center...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you know what you should do? You should walk all the way at the top of Statue of Liberty.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Oh yeah, let's do that!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Great! (to Monica) This baby'd better to be really good.

scenes.location: Hospital.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (stopping a nurse who's coming out of a room) Oh, uhm, excuse me, I'm here to see my father. My name is Rachel Green.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And I'm Doctor Ross Geller.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, please, this is a hospital, ok? That actually means something here.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can somebody please go in?

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Absolutely.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, I think I'm gonna wait out here, because my throat is feeling a little scratchy, I don't want to infect him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, please, don't be so scared of him!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm not scared of him, I'm really sick!

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: He's under sedation, so he's pretty much out.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm feeling better.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! (They enter. Rachel sees his father, lying on a bed, with tubes, drip and everything) Oh! Oh my God! Ohhh, ohhh, wow, that ear and nose hair trimmer I got him was just money down the drain, huh?

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Miss Green, your father's doctor is on the phone if you'd like to speak to him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, great, Are you gonna be ok?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He's unconscious, I think we'll be just fine!
Rachel (leaving): Ok.

(Ross goes into the room where Dr. Green is laying unconscious. He turns on the TV, puts his feet on the bed and starts watching a dinosaur movie where the dinosaur is caught by two cowboys. Dr. Geller awakes.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Did the TV wake you?

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: No, when you put your feet up in my bed, you tugged on my catheter.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ouchy.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: What are you doing here, Geller?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, I came with Rachel, who should be back any second! (pause) So what's new?

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: Ooh, I have a little heart attack.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right, is it painful?

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: What, the heart attack or sitting here talking to you?
Ross (he buzzes for the nurse) Let's see if we can get that Rachel back here.

lines.speaker: Dr. Green
lines.text: So what's new with you, uh, knocked up any more of my daughters lately?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nope, just the one. RACH!

scenes.location: Joey's apartment. Phoebe is trying to teach Joey French.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Je m'appelle Claude.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Je do call blue!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Noooo! Ok, maybe if we just break it down. Ok, let's try at one syllable at a time. Ok? So repeat after me. "je".

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: je.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: m'ap

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: mah

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: pelle

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: pel.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great, ok faster! "je"

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: je.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: m'ap

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: mah

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: pelle

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: pel.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Je m'appelle!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me pooh pooh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok, it's too hard, I can't teach you!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I, I have to go before I put your head through a wall. (she leaves)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (he goes out calling her) Don't move! Don't go! I need you! My audition is tomorrow! Shah blue blah! Me lah peeh! Ombrah! (he gives up). Pooh.

scenes.location: Green's mansion. Rachel's Room. Rachel's is combing her hair; Ross's coming into the room

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I was gonna make us some dinner but all I found in your dad's fridge was bacon and heavy cream. (pause) I think we solved the mystery of the heart attack.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh. (pause) Did you call your parents?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Emma's doing great.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just can't believe I'm in Rachel Green's room.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What do you mean? You've been in my room before!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, sure, right! Like I've ever been in Rachel Green's room.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok I gotta tell ya, it's really weird when you use my whole name.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry. (Rachel sits on her bed). You ok?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You had a rough day, uh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, just so weird seeing him like that, you know? I mean he is a doctor, you don't expect doctors to get sick!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But we do! (pause) It's gonna be ok, Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (she's sad) Ow. I don't want him to wake up alone! I should go to the hospital!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? No, no! Hey, hey, hey look...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They gave him a lot of medication, ok? He wouldn't even know if you were there. Look, we'll go see him first thing in the morning, ok?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Really, I shouldn't feel guilty?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, God! Hey, Rach, you've been an amazing daughter, ok? Right now you just need to get some rest.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok, maybe you're right.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (he kisses her on her forehead) Good night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait, wait. Would you stay here with me for a little while?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok. (She sits on the bed and Ross sits near her) Thank you for coming with me today.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, of course...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Rachel Green is very happy you're in her room!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Me too. Come here. (They hug)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just don't want to be alone tonight.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok, well, uh, I can maybe grab a sleeping bag, or...(There's one of those moments. They're staring at each other, no word uttered, and then she leans toward him in order to kiss him, but he ducks and avoids her more than once.) Oh, oh. (he then hugs her and when she tries to kiss him again, he stands up and she falls down on the bed). No, Rach! I'm sorry, I just don't think this, this, this is a good idea.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, we won't know that until we do it, will we?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, look, uh. You are upset about your father and you're feeling vulnerable and I just don't feel it would be right, I'd feel like I'd be, you know, taking advantage of you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Taking advantage? I'm giving you the advantage, enjoy!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, I'm sure it would be great, but I-I think one of us has to be thinking clearly, so, I'm gonna go!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow. Ok.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll see you in the morning (he leaves).

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mhm-mh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (outside her room, talking by himself) Haven't had sex in four months, I should get a medal for that!

scenes.location: Monica's apartment. Monica and Erica have just arrived.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Thanks so much for taking me to all those places. I had a great time.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I'm glad. Listen, I want to apologize about Chandler, though. I just did not see this coming.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (enters the room wearing an "I love New York" t-shirt, a "Statue of Liberty" hat and carrying bags) New York is awesome!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What is with you?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I've been to these places before, but I've never really seen them, you know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, you miss alot, when you're moo-ing.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Thanks so much for showing me around.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! It was our pleasure. We are so much enjoying getting to know you.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Well, if there is anything else you wanna know... (Monica and Chandler look at each other)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, uhm, okay, uhm, do you mind if we ask you some questions about the father?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Oh, sure. Yeah, well, he was my high school boyfriend. Captain of the football team, really cute and he got a scholarship and went off to college. (Monica and Chandler are smiling from ear to ear)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's great.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Yeah... it's almost definitely him. (Monica and Chandler look confused now)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How's that now?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Well, there is a chance it's another guy. I mean, I have only ever been with two guys, but they sorta overlapped.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, what does the other guy do? Does he go to college too?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: No, he's in prison. (More shocked looks from Monica and Chandler)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Was he falsely accused of something? (They look hopeful)

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: No... he killed his father with a shovel. (Monica and Chandler's jaws drop) But other than that, he's a great guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'll bet his dad doesn't think so.
(Time lapse. Chandler and Monica are in bed now)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you awake?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Of course I'm awake. Assume from now on that I'm always awake! (He turns the light on)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, we don't know that it's him. I mean, it could be the football guy.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, it's us. Of course it's the shovel-killer.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, lets say that it is him, would we not want the baby? No! Would we treat him any differently?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'd keep an eye on him! We have to find out which one the father is.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I dunno, aren't there tests for these things, right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, but maybe we're just over-reacting.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pff, easy for you to say, he's a father killer. He probably loves him mommy. He's probably got a tattoo that says "mom" on his shovel-wielding arm!

scenes.location: Joey's apartment. He is sitting on the barcalounger holding a French study book and listening to a French learning tape.

lines.speaker: Tape
lines.text: We will now count from one to five. Un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh, un, blu, bla, flu, flenk!

lines.speaker: Tape
lines.text: Good job.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you.
(Phoebe enters)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Listen, I feel really badly about yesterday and I thought about it a lot and, and I know, I was too impatient. SO lets try it again.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, no, that's okay, I don't need your help. I worked on it myself and I gotta say, I am pretty good!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Really, can I hear some of it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, sure. Ok, (clears his throat and starts to read from his script. He starts talking in a fake French accent, making gestures with his hands) "Bleu de la bleu, de la blu bla bleu" (Phoebe looks astonished, annoyed and disgusted, Joey seems very proud though) See?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, you're not, (she tries to smile and contain her anger, but loses it) You're not... you're not... again, you're not SPEAKING FRENCH!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (offended) Oh well I think I am, yeah and I think I'm definitely gonna get the part.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How could you possibly think that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: For one thing, the guy on the tape said I was doing a good job!

scenes.location: The hospital. Rachel is pouring her self a cup of coffee. Ross approaches from behind.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Rach, can you grab me a cup of coffee?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (She turns around very slowly, looks at him for a second and then turns back to her coffee) Sure. (She gives him the cup she was pouring for herself without looking at him)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You've been quiet all morning. Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hmm-hmm. (starts to pour herself a cup of coffee, never looking at Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You sure you're alright?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (coldly) Yep.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (knowing she's not alright) O-kay. Well, I'm gonna go grab us some breakfast. (He starts to leave)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: FYI..

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (knew this was coming) There it is... (he comes back)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: In the future, when a girl asks for some ill-advised sympathy sex... just do it. (she smiles fakely at him)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (half amused) Wait, wait, (looks around a little) You're mad at me about last night? I was just trying to do the right thing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastically) Really? Well, it seems to me if you'd done the right thing, I would not have woken up today feeling stupid and embarrassed, I would have woken up feeling comforted and satisfied!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (acknowledging the last part of her sentence) Well...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh stop that!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I can't believe this. I was just being a good guy. I treated you with respect and understanding.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (sarcastic) Oh, that is so hot. She walks around him to the other side)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I was looking out for you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, really, well Ross, you know what? I am a big girl. I don't need someone telling me what is best for me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I gotta say, I have not had sex a lot of times before, this is the worst ever.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, really, really? Well, it wasn't very good for me either. (She turns to leave and Ross over takes her and stands infront on her, his back to the row of doors leading to the hospital rooms)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey you know what? You know what? To avoid this little thing in the future, let's just say, you and me, never having sex again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's right, sex is off the table. (The door starts to open behind him and Dr. Green emerges) I am never having sex with you again. (Rachel stays quiet and after a few moments Ross realizes what has happened. He turns abruptly) Dr. Green, are you feeling better? (Rachel's dad glares at him with a deadly look)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Monica and Erica enter, Chandler is in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! How was lunch?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: (To Chandler) We had a good time. By the way, I wanted to ask you something. It would really mean a lot to me, if the baby was a boy, that you name him after my father, Jiminy Billy Bob (Monica smiles at Chandler and his he looks shocked and scared, getting no support from his wife)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (struggling) Oh, really?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: No! (To Monica) You we're right, that was fun! I'm gonna go finish packing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: O-okay. (steps closer to Monica and speaks softly) So, is she gonna take the test?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nope, she doesn't have to, I found out who the father is.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh God. It's shovely-Joe, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (smiling) No it's not.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How do you know?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Well, it turns out that Erica didn't pay much attention in Sex Ed class, because the thing she did with that prison guy... it'd be pretty hard to make a baby that way.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh God! What was it? The thing that we hardly ever do or the thing we never do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: The thing we never do.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (nods in appreciation) Shovely Joe!

scenes.location: The theatre where Joey is auditioning. Phoebe enters when Joey's on stage and she sits down. He hasn't seen her.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Whenever you're ready Joey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right. (clears his throat) Dja bu bu Claude. Uh, c'est la pu les la lu blah bloo.

lines.speaker: Casting assistant
lines.text: I'm sorry, what's going on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, come on! French it u-up!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: Joey, do you speak French?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Toutes la smore! Bu blu-ay bloo blah ooh! Pfoof!

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: You know what. I think this audition is over. (Joey looks disappointed, but understands.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (in a French accent) Uh, excuse me. Uh, I am Reginé Philange. I was passing by when I heard this man speaking the regional dialect of my French town of Estée Lauder.

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: You really think this man is speaking French?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sa-sa-saw!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Écoutez, je vais vous dire la vérité. C'est mon petit frère. Il est un peu retardé. (Translation: Listen, I will tell you the truth. He's my little bother. He's a bit retarded.)
(The director looks at Joey and he nods.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Alors, si vous pouviez jouer le jeu avec lui... (Translation: So, would you please just humor him?)

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: (to Joey) Good job, little buddy. That was some really good French. But I think we're gonna go with someone else for the part.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah. All right. But my French was good?

lines.speaker: Director
lines.text: It was great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Oh-hoh! Ha-hah! See!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to the director) Merci. Au revoir. (Translation: Thanks, goodbye.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah-hah. Toute-de-le-fruit.

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment. Rachel is sitting at the kitchen counter and Ross enters from Rachel and Emma's room.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emma's down for the night.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So uh... I guess I wanna take off.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay... Hey listen, just before you go I-I again, I just wanna say "thank you" for coming with me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no problem.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: And also, you know I uh, I was thinking about what you said, you know, about the whole sex thing and... it's probably not a great idea to go down that road again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thank you. I'm glad you agree.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's a shame though, I mean, when we did it, it was pretty good.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah... Yeah, that's true.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey uhm, do you remember that one really great time...?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, ye-ah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know it was you're uhm... birthday...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...Valentine's day...

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: (long pause, they realize) Oh yeah!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I guess that's all in the past, now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hmmm-mmmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (after a pause) Not even one more time?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not even once.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No matter how much we want it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Even if we want it really bad.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: That's what we decided.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhm, right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...It's kinda hard though!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know, when two people have a connection, you know, that's... just seems like such a... waste.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...I hate waste.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: ...Ross?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Just so you know... With us... it's never off the table. (she enters her room and closes the door.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Damn it. It's never off the table. (he leaves the apartment)
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's apartment. Phoebe and Joey are "updating" Joey's resumé.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, can you really tapdance?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's off the resumé. (she strikes it through with a pencil)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Archery?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Horseback riding?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Would fall off a lot.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You can drink a gallon of milk in 10 seconds?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That I can do.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Come on! You can drink a gallon of milk in 10 seconds?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, watch me! (he takes a full container of milk from the fridge) Okay, you time me. Ready?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ready... GO!

(Joey takes the plastic container to his mouth and starts to drink. Most of the milk gushes from the bottle down his chin and over his clothes to the floor. He keeps "drinking" and all of a sudden he lifts it up and half the bottle of milk pours out in an instant. He then continues to drink the rest. He then puts the empty container down on the counter.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (checking her watch) You did it!
THE END

title: The One with Princess Consuela

lines.text: Friends - 10.14 - The One With Princess Consuela
Friends
1014 - The One With Princess Consuela

lines.speaker: Teleplay by
lines.text: Tracy Reilly

lines.speaker: Story by
lines.text: Robert Carlock

lines.speaker: Produced by
lines.text: Robert Carlock & Wendy Knoller

lines.text: Coffee Mug, Eleonora, Sebastiano & Vanessa
Final check by Kim

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartment. They are having a diner party with Phoebe and Mike.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (raising his glass) Thank you guys for having us over.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh! Yeah, this is fun, couples night.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I don't know why we hang out with married couples more often.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, because every time we do, you make jokes about swinging and scare them away.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You mean that Portuguese couple? Yeah, like you wouldn't have done it. (she shrugs)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (entering) Hey, you guys... I have great news.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross, we're kind of in the middle of diner here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, well, er, I already ate, but sure...! (they all look at each other when Ross grabs a plate) Guess what happened at work today...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: A dinosaur died a million years ago?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Try sixty-five million years ago, and then try sssshhhhhh.... My tenure review board met today and I hear it's looking really good.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah. Do you have any idea what this means in academic circles, uh? I am gonna get laid.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (while entering) Hi you guys.

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, Italian! (she also grabs a plate)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No one wanted seconds, right?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no. I-I'm good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey you guys... You're never gonna believe it. This headhunter called me. I have a meeting tomorrow with Gucci. Gucci wants me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm up for tenure.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You too! What are the odds?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh! (they hug)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (enters) Guess what? (they all look expectantly at him) I finally got that seed out of my teeth.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I don't know who I'm happiest for...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I do, he's been working on that all day! (looking at Joey)
OPENING CREDITS

scenes.location: Central Perk. Phoebe, Monica and Chandler on their couch.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Mon? Was it weird changing your name to Geller-Bing?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, no. It felt nice to acknowledge this. (pats Chandler on his leg)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where did you go to do it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uhm the... the ministry... of names... bureau...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: YOU NEVER DID IT!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's just the idea of being an official Bing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey! I will have you know that... aah, who am I kidding. Let's call the kid Geller and let Bing die with me.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (walks to the couch with coffee for Phoebe) Here you go.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thanks! Honey, would you want me to take your name?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh, it's just... It's up to you. It's your name. You've got to live with it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, let's see, call me mrs Hannigan.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mrs Hannigan?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? Can't you see I'm in the middle of something? Ooh, I like it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (enters) Hey guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Joe! We've got a couple of things we've got to check out at the new house. You want to come with us?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, thank you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right. I know you're not happy about us moving, but you're the only one who hasn't seen the house.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, come with us. You'll see how close it is to the city.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But no, it's not close. You said it was in escrow? I couldn't even find it on the map.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, please come. It would mean so much to us.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know what? You are my friends, I wanna be supportive, I will come with you. SHOTGUN!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Damn it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See you guys later.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Joey) I'll pick you up at eleven. So glad you're coming.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good for you. That was really mature.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? No, the only reason I'm going to their stupid new house, is so I can point out everything that's wrong with it, so they don't move. I'm gonna make them stay here.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You're a strange kind of grown-up.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Joey, you can't make someone do something they don't want to do. Believe me, there's something I've been trying to get Mike to do in bed and there's... he's just...

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Woo-wo-hey-hey-hey... Can we not talk about that right now?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, prude... Look, Monica and Chandler really love this house. You are not gonna talk them into staying here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, hey... I can convince people to do anything, you know. I bet I can even get Mike to do that "thing". What is it?
(Phoebe whispers something in Joey's ear, but after hearing it he jumps up, shocked)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I AM NOT GONNA HELP YOU DO THAT! Goodbye! (he leaves)

scenes.location: A restaurant. Rachel enters.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to maitre d') Hi, I'm here to see mr Campbell... with Gucci. The reservation is probably under Gucci. It's spelled like Gukki, which could be confusing.

lines.speaker: Maitre d'
lines.text: Mr Campbell's not here yet. Let me show you to his table.
(They walk to the table, but Rachel suddenly gasps. Sitting there is mr Zellner, her boss from her current job at Ralph Lauren.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! That's my boss. You have to seat us somewhere else.

lines.speaker: Maitre d'
lines.text: I'm sorry. That's always mr Campbell's table.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But my... but my boss cannot see me. I'm interviewing for another job.

lines.speaker: Maitre d'
lines.text: I know. With Gukki

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sssshhhh!

lines.speaker: Mr Zellner
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi... I'm on a date...

lines.speaker: Mr Zellner
lines.text: (confused) That's great!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, it is. Yeah, you know, it's tough. Single mom, career... You gotta get out there.

lines.speaker: Mr Zellner
lines.text: Well, you got uhm... good energy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, hi!

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: James Campbell...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! (to mr Zellner) Excuse us.

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: Please... (shows her to sit)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Oh, yeah... (whispering to mr Zellner) Oh he's cute!

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: So... your resumé is quite impressive. (Mr Zellner who sits behind Rachel shrugs)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wha... My resumé? I wouldn't... I wouldn't call my online dating profile a resumé.

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: Dating profile? I-I-I'm talking about the work resumé.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starts singing la la la la) Whatever happened to just singing for no reason? Huh?

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: Maybe people... found it weird.... So, why do you want to leave Ralph Lauren?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? I-I don't.

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: You don't?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I-I-I love it there.

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: Well, if you don't want to leave, why are we having this lunch?
(Rachel mimes and mouths to mr Campbell "That is my boss", pointing to mr Zellner)

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: What?
(Rachel now silently whispers "That's my boss".)

lines.speaker: Mr Campbell
lines.text: That's Hugo Boss?
(Rachel holds her hand in order to support her head. Mr Zellner obviously overheard the conversation.)

scenes.location: A counter at a government building. Phoebe's waiting in line.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to the woman behind her) This place is so depressing. If I had to work here I'd kill myself. (she turns around and the clerk behind the counter heard her.) But you obviously haven't.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I need to change my name, please. See, I need to change it because I'm-I'm hiding from the law. (the clerk shows no change in expression whatsoever) You're fun.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: You need to fill out this form. (motions for the next person in line)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, well, I just don't, I don't know how it works exactly. See, my name is Buffay and my husband's name is Hannigan, so is it supposed to be Buffay-Hannigan or Hannigan-Buffay?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: It can be anything you want.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, not anything, I mean...

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Yeah... anything.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, this could take a while.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Get out of my line.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.

scenes.location: Central Perk. Chandler and Monica are there when Phoebe enters.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Pheebs.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, not anymore. I changed it today.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry, mrs Hannigan.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wrong again! Apparently you can change it to anything you want. So I thought, all right, here's an opportunity to be creative. So meet Princess Consuela Banana Hammock.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's what we were gonna name the baby.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Phoebe!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh! Princess Consuela.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You seriously changed your name to that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, so from now on we have to call you Princess Consuela?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uhm, no. I'm gonna have my friends call me Valerie.
(Rachel enters, looking depressed)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, how'd the interview go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! It's not good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, I always feel that way after an interview. I'll bet it went better than you think.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I didn't get the job at Gucci and I got fired from Ralph Lauren.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is a bad interview.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What are you, what are you talking about? How did this happen?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, my boss was at the same restaurant where I was having my interview and he heard everything. So later he calls me to his office and he tells me that he's gonna have to let me go, because I'm not a team player. And I said "Wait a minute! Yes I am." and I had to sit there for 45 minutes while he proved that that in fact... was true.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God. I'm so sorry.
(Ross enters with a bottle in his hand)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey! Wha-hoo! What's this? (showing the bottle) Well it's a, it's a bottle of champagne. Why is this here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I guess it's here because I GOT TENURE!
All (except Rachel): Congratulations! (Rachel looks devastated)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is the single greatest day of my professional career. Gunther, six glasses!

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Six? You want me to join you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I thought Joey was here. Five is good. (Gunther leaves, hurt) Well, I'm gonna have a loogie in my coffee tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh! Israeli champagne. And it's vanilla!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I got tenure. I didn't win the lottery... Hey Rach, so uh... how did your thing go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh it... good! Yeah, but I'm not gonna hear from that for a couple of days.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, you know what? You're gonna get it. I-I-I-I can feel it.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Can you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah, all right. Here's to Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And-and to years of hard work finally paying off.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
