lines.text: And to knowing that your career doesn't mean everything. (Rachel mouths "aah")

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: But also knowing it means a lot.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But more importantly to full well-rounded lives.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: ...that center around work.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: To Ross!
All (except Rachel): Ross!
(they all drink from the champagne, but clearly dislike the taste of it)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what the best part about this is? I can never be fired.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No seriously. I have job security for life. You know, I never have to worry. (Rachel starts crying) Oh, look at you. Look how happy you are for me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (crying) No, it's not that. I got fired today. And I didn't get the other job.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach, I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great. I feel like an idiot.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, it's okay, you didn't know.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh... (to the others) Little heads-up would have been nice.

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's future house. They enter the living room with the realtor and Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thank you for letting us see the house again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And thank you for explaining to us what escrow means... I've already forgotten what you said, but thank you.

lines.speaker: Realtor
lines.text: Take as long as you want. Just let me know when you're through. (she leaves the room)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ah, so glad you decided to come.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Me too. Yeah, this place is great. I'm so happy for you guys. Although, you know, I hope you like fungus.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Fungus! Yeah. Place is full of it.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No it's not. We had an inspection and they didn't find anything.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Then I guess I have dry eyes and a scratchy throat for no reason.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe because it's you hung your head out of the window like a dog the whole ride here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe. So this is the living room huh? Ooh, it's pretty dark. (starts feeling around him like he's in a completely dark room, touching Chandler, who backs out and hits him)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No it's not!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (squinting his eyes) Are you kiddin'? I think I just saw a bat in the corner!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: When your head was hanging out the window, it didn't hit a mailbox, did it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (glares at him for a moment, then admits grudgingly) Maybe. Well, I just think you guys can do better than this house, you know? Or any other house for that matter.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh Joey, look, we know you're having a hard time with this, but we really, we love it here.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: FINE, ok, if you love this house so much, then you should just live here, okay? I just hope you get used to that weird humming sound. (He turns his back to them and starts humming) Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmm...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, we know that's you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: no... hmmmmm... it's not... hmmmmmmmmmm

scenes.location: Phoebe is at Central Perk. Mike enters.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey (He kisses Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Welcome back!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Ah! I missed you

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, me too!

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: So, what's new?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I'm no longer Phoebe Buffay.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: That's great! You changed you name?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes I did! Meet: Princess Consuela Banana Hammock! (She smiles from ear to ear)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (afraid) You're kidding right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: You really did that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah, but you can't do that.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Why? It's fun, it's different, no-one else has a name like it.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (looks at her astonished) Alright, then I'm gonna change my name.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Great, okay, what are you gonna change it to?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Crap Bag.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (not amused) Mike Crap Bag?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: No, no Mike, just Crap Bag. First name Crap, last name Bag.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're not serious, right?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Yeah, I'm serious. (sarcastic) It's fun, it's different and no-one else has a name like that!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uhu, uhu, well, then, great. If you love it, I love it.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: I do love it, and I love your name. I love Princess Consuela.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: And I love Crap.

scenes.location: Joey is in Monica and Chandler's future house, sitting in a child's bedroom, looking at a quiz card which has "5+10=" printed on one side.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (turns the card around, obviously had the wrong answer) Ow!
(A young girl enters)

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hi, I'm Joey. My stupid friends are buying this house. Who are you?

lines.speaker: Girl
lines.text: I'm Mackenzie. My stupid parents are selling this house.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (understanding) Oh.

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: (sighs) I hate my parents.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I hate my friends. (They shake on it as if they just made a pact) Alright, look. There's gotta be a way that we can stop this from happening.

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (thinking) Uhm... oh! Okay. You come with me, and you tell them that the house is haunted!

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: What are you? Eight?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Woah, uh! Okay, let's hear your great idea.

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: I don't have any great ideas. I am eight.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (frustrated) Ahh! There's gotta be a way. I mean, you know, if Monica and Chandler move out here and now Phoebe is married to Mike. That just leaves me and Ross and Rach, you know what I mean?

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: I really don't.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What am I gonna do, I feel like I'm losing my friends.

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: My parents say I'm gonna make new friends.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah, sure, easy for you, you're young. Me, I'm set in my ways.

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: This is what my mom was talking about. Whiners are wieners. (Joey glares at her angrily) Look, you want your friends to be happy, right?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I guess.

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: Well, if moving here is gonna make them happy, don't you want them to do it?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (having difficulty admitting it) Yeah, maybe.

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: Then you gotta let them go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (In near tears, realizes she is right) I hate to admit it, but you're probably right. How did you get to be so smart?

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: I read a lot.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (his mood changes instantly) Just when I thought we could be friends. (he leaves the room)

scenes.location: Outside Ralph Lauren building. Rachel just walked out carrying a box of her stuff, and a strange man approaches her.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hey Rach, I just heard. I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, thank you... (looks at his face trying to remember his name)

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: You still don't know my name, do you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (Is embarrassed for a moment, but it quickly passes) Well, now I don't have to. (The man leaves instantly)
(In the meantime, Ross is trying to squeeze and push a rather large chair through the revolving doors of the Ralph Lauren building.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (annoyed) Ross, what is taking you so long?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (stares at her through the door and starts pushing the chair harder, looking very annoyed. He finally manages) (sarcastic) I'm sorry, it's almost as if this wasn't built for a quick getaway!
(Mark, approaches from behind and recognizes her)

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (turns around) Mark? Oh my God! (puts the box on the chair and they hug each other)

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: How've you been?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm fantastic. You remember Ross?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Sure, sure. (To Ross) What's with the chair. (Rachel signals him not to mention she's been fired)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, you know, you can't always get a seat on the subway, so... (laughs stupidly)

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Clever. (back to Rachel) So how are you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well, (looks at her box and chair) you're not catching me on my best day.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Yeah, a box full of your desk stuff doesn't exactly say big promotion.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, but it's good, you know, I'm gonna take some time off and do some charity work.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Are you sure, because we may have something at Louis Vuitton.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, screw charity work. What've you got?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Why don't we have dinner tonight and talk about it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Great! I'll call ya!

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: (shakes Ross' hand) Nice to see you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! yeah, I got tenure! (Mark looks at him strangely and walks off)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (very excited) Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: See? I told you something good would come along. And he seemed really nice. I've met him before?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross! That's Mark. From Bloomingdales? You were insanely jealous of him.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (realizing) That is Mark?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I hate that guy.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, NO, you cannot go to dinner with him.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? You don't want me to get a job?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh yeah, I'm sure he's gonna give you a job. Maybe make you his SEXretary.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm serious. I just don't trust that guy, okay?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross, you know what? (looks over to the door and sees security staring at them) Okay, let's talk about it later, there comes security. (Takes her box and leaves. Ross follows her and then returns for the chair. He stands for a moment, then pushes it quickly in the general direction Rachel went into, and out of the camera's view, and then nonchalantly walks away)

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's new house. Sitting near the window, they look at the neighborhood.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I love this street. The trees, the big front yards, the actual picket fences.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Man, those two dogs are going at it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering) Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, where have you been?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, just er... you know, looking around. But you know what? This house... is great.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? What changed your mind?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh well, the little girl who lives here made me feel a lot better about the whole thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey, there was a little girl who lived here, but she died like 30 years ago.
(Joey's eyes double in size)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (frightened) What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ha! I'm just messing with you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That's not funny! You know I'm afraid of little girl ghosts!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, now that you're okay with the house, do you wanna go see your room?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? I get my own room?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You don't think we'd buy a house and not have a Joey room do you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God! (they all hug) Oh! Hey, can I have an aquarium? And a sex swing?

lines.speaker: Chandler and Monica
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not? I'll keep the tank clean.

scenes.location: Central Perk. Phoebe and Mike are leaving.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: After you, miss Banana Hammock.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you, mister Bag.
(a woman enters and recognizes Phoebe)

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh hey, how are you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh hi Rita! Good! (to Mike) Oh, Rita's a massage client.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh! Why don't you introduce me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (shrugs) Er, Rita, this is my husband.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Oh! (they shake hands)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Why don't you tell her my name?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (without moving her lips, wearing a fake smile) Okay, I will. (to Rita) This is my husband Crap Bag.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Crap Bag?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: If you need an easy way to remember it, just think of a bag of crap.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Okay. Excuse me...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah... Ogh... Okay, fine. You made your point. Can you please just be Mike Hannigan again?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Only if you'll be Phoebe Buffay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How about uhm... How about Buffay-Hannigan?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah. I'm Phoebe Buffay-Hannigan Banana Hammock.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Do you even know what a banana hammock is?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's a funny word.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: It's a Speedo.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ...Oh crap!

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Ross enters.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, is Rachel here?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She's still at dinner?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I guess. Why? Who's she with?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That guy Mark. From Bloomingdale's... She thinks he's just being nice to her. But I know he really wants to sleep with her.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's seven years ago. (he looks surprised) My time machine works!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: We ran into him on the street today and he said he might have a job for her. But I know he just wants to get into her pants.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So what if he wants to sleep with her? I mean, she's single and he's cute.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh please! Yesterday on the subway? You couldn't stop staring at that woman with the big breasts the whole time.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: For your information, I was staring at her baby. We're about to be parents.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, sorry!

(She looks at Ross, a bit ashamed. Chandler mimes "big breasts" to Ross and lip syncs "Wow". Ross looks at him, astonished and then Monica looks at Chandler again. A little too late he changes the "big breasts" mime into "rocking a baby". When he realizes Monica might have seen it he also strokes his imaginary baby's head.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (entering) Hi you guys!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, so uhm... How was dinner?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, it was great. Mark is so sweet.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (speaking without pause, agitated) Oh yeah? Yeah? I wonder why? What could that smarmy letch possibly want?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh Ross, come on. He's happily married. His wife just had twins.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Should we send something?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How did the job stuff go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He offered me one.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Congratulations!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, it's amazing. It's amazing. It's so much better than what I had at Ralph Lauren. The money is great...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Can we, can we just stop for a second? Who said something better would come along, huh? You didn't believe me. I told you everything was gonna work out. (gasps) You know what? This calls for a bottle of Israels finest.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The job is in Paris. (they all stare at each other)
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Joey and Rachel's. Joey's on the phone.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I mean, this soap opera is a great gig, but... am I missing opportunities? You know, I've always thought of myself as a serious actor. I mean, should I be trying to do more independent movies?

lines.speaker: Mackenzie
lines.text: (at the other end of the line) I don't know... You know what? I'm gonna put you on with my bear. Hold on. (she puts the phone at the bears ear)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey bear, I need some career advice.
THE END

title: The One Where Estelle Dies

lines.text: Friends - 10.15- The One Where Estelle Dies
Friends
1015 - The One Where Estelle Dies

lines.speaker: Teleplay by
lines.text: Tracy Reilly

lines.speaker: Written by
lines.text: Andrew Reich & Ted Cohen

lines.speaker: Produced by
lines.text: Robert Carlock & Wendy Knoller

lines.speaker: Transcribed by
lines.text: Coffee Mug, Sebastiano & Vanessa
[Flashback scene from last week, Monica and Chandler's kitchen,
Rachel, Ross, Monica and Chandler are there.]

lines.speaker: Jennifer
lines.text: Previously on Friends...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How did the job stuff go?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: He offered me one.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (gasps) You know what? This calls for a bottle of Israels finest.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: The job is in Paris. (we see Ross stare in disbelief)
FADE OUT

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, God! Please, somebody say something.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So if you take this job you'll be moving to Paris?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Or facing a bitch of a commute.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know, it's huge, and it's scary, and it's... really far, far away
from you guys, but this is such an incredible opportunity for me. And I've already
talked to them about our situation with Emma, and they said they'll do whatever
we need to make us feel comfortable.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I mean, I'll fly back and forth, they'll fly you out...
Anything we want.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: My boss said I might be getting a new lamp in my cubicle. (Monica
looks at him and can't really place what he just said)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: All right, we'll work it out.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you! Thank you!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah! (they hug) You sure this is what you want?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think it is. (Ross looks very sad. Phoebe
and Joey enter.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, what's going on?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I got a really incredible job offer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, great! All right!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good for you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's in Paris.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What? No, no, no! No, no... no... no, no... No, too much is changing,
okay? First, Phoebe getting married (to Phoebe) Congratulations! (pointing to
Monica and Chandler)... and then these two move into a stupid house in the stupid
suburbs...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, this afternoon you said you'd be supportive...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, it comes and goes. I wouldn't trust it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look, you guys... this is really, really important to me. And it means
a lot if you could try to get on board.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Of course we can. Congratulations. (they hug, but Joey shakes his head.)
Yay! (she gestures Joey to come and join in) Joey...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no. My hugs are reserved for people STAYING IN AMERICA.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (walking towards Joey) Joey, it would mean so...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! No! Get your France-going-arms away from me. (He walks out, and
Rachel follows him)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Joey...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You okay with this?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it makes me feel sad, but...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Talking to Ross.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, Rachel moving to another country? Not being able to see her every
day. How can I be okay with this?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, but what are we gonna do? She really needs this job.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you think if the Ralph Lauren people offered her her old job back,
she would take it?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How is that gonna happen?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is this the best way to use one of your three magic wishes?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know. I could talk to her boss. Yeah! I met him at that Christmas
party. We really hit it off.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You mean the guy who kept calling you Ron?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I didn't say we were brothers.
OPENING CREDITS
[Scene: Central Perk. Phoebe's reading a newspaper. Chandler
and Monica walk in.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Phoebe. Hey, tell me what you think. All right. The house next
door to the one that we're buying in Westchester? Just went on the market. I wanna
take a look at it, but Chandler doesn't.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We close escrow tomorrow, so seeing another house can only confuse
us, and we're easily confused. We're not very bright.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But what if it is better than ours? Should we at least look?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What do you think Pheebs?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I think that shirt makes you look like you should work at a Baskin
Robbins... Anyway... Hey, isn't Joey's agent Estelle Leonard?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She died.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're kidding!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's terrible!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, last Saturday. Wow! She was the first black man to fly solo across
the Atlantic. (Chandler and Monica look puzzled) Oh, wait a minute, I read the
wrong one.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, she was just an agent.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey's gonna be *so* upset.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know. *He* always wanted to be the first black man to cross the
Atlantic.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, we cannot tell Joey about this. He's already flipping out about
everything that's changing. This will push him over the edge.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Seriously, you don't think we should tell him?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, not for a little while. Let's just give him a few days to get
used to everything else.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What if he reads it in the paper?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Unless Snoopy says it to Charlie Brown, I think we're okay.
[Scene: Ralph Lauren. Mr Zelner's office. Ross knocks on the
door and enters.]

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: May I help you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I'm a friend of Rachel Green's. Uhm, actually we met at the Christmas
party about two years ago.

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: Oh right, uhm, Don?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Close. Ron. (shakes hands)

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: Uh... What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhm, well... I'm here to see if you'll give Rachel her job back.

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: Ah, did she ask you to come here and do this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, no. At first I have to get you to agree. Then we'll
see if she wants to come back.

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: Wow, that is tempting.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, she loved her job here. And let's face
it: you're not gonna find anyone who did it as well as she did it. Isn't that
true?

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: She is good!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (surprised) Huh, I took a shot there.

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: But I'm sorry. There's nothing I can do... Ah,
it's not true, there is... nothing I want to do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I see... Thanks very much. (he gets up and walks to the door. On his
way out he looks at the photographs Mr Zelner has near his door. He picks one
up.) Is this your son?

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: Yeah, his name is Ross. (Ross looks very surprised) What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, nothing, it’s just, it’s close to Ron. Does he.. Does
little Ross like dinosaurs by any chance?

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: Yeah, they're all he talks about, why?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: How would he like to come with me to the Museum of Natural History after
everyone else has left, just the two of us, and he can touch anything he wants.
(Mr. Zellner looks shocked). I just heard it as you must have heard it and that’s
not good. Let me start again. I’m a paleontologist, you’ll be there
with us and the touching refers only to bones… fossils!

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: You can really arrange that?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You let Rachel come back, and it’s done.

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: Well, I guess having Rachel back wouldn’t be the worst thing
in the world.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah! Yes! Thank you! This is great. Thank you so much. And I swear,
your kid is going to have the time of his life.

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: That’s great. I worry about little Ross. He’s always
reading, he's collecting rocks and he’s obsessed with dinosaurs.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He’ll be fine.
[Scene: Central Perk. Phoebe’s reading, Joey has just entered
the room]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey. Everything ok?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m just mad at my agent.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Estelle? Why?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: There’s a part in a TV movie that I would be perfect for and I
didn’t even be put up for it! She’d better have a good reason.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I’m guessing she does.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well (taking his cell phone out of a pocket) I’m wanna hear it,
because she keeps doing this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, no, no, wait, wait, wait. All right, I gotta go. Just listen. Promise me, that you
will wait a minute before you call her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ok. Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because a promise between friends means never having to give a reason.
(she leaves)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I love that saying!
(Phoebe is outside, taking her cell phone out of her bag and making a call.
Joey is inside, and his mobile phone starts ringing).

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hello?
Phoebe (doing Estelle): Joey, it’s Estelle.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I was just gonna call you! That’s weird.
Phoebe-Estelle: It’s a little coincidental, but believable.
(Joey nods in agreement). Listen, I’m sure you’re wondering why
I didn’t get you an audition for that TV movie.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, actually I am!
Phoebe-Estelle: I guess I dropped the ball there. Whoopsie!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That’s it? You know, it seems all you do lately is drop the ball.
Phoebe-Estelle: Don’t take that tone with me. Who you
think you are? Alan Lemond, the first black man to fly solo across the Atlantic?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, look. All I’m saying is that you’re my agent, ok?
And you’re not getting me into any auditions and I’m tired of it.
Phoebe-Estelle: What are you saying?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I’m saying that… (pause). This isn't working for me
anymore, ok? Estelle, you’re fired. Goodbye. (he hangs up the phone).

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Man, tough week for Estelle!
[Scene: Joey’s apartment. Rachel’s there and Ross
enters the room with a stuffed dinosaur]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Emma left her stuffed t-rex at my house. You know she can’t sleep
without it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well, she’s asleep now. Stop forcing that thing on her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you’re not gonna believe what happened to me today! Ralph
Lauren called, and gave me my job back!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nooo!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yee. I mean, it was so weirdest thing. They fired me and then out
of nowhere they just hire me back! I mean, that place must have been falling
apart without me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, you’re not going to Paris.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, I’m still going.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: When the Louis Vuitton people found out that Ralph Lauren wanted me back,
the offered me more money! Isn’t that great?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeeeah! (They high-five)
[Scene: house next to the one the Bings are moving into. Chandler
and Monica knock, a lady opens the door.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi. We’re buying the house next door, and we were wondering if we
could just take a look around.

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: Oh, sure. I’m showing it to someone else right now,
but please, look around.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It feels like we’re cheating on our house.
And if we’re gonna cheat, shouldn’t it be with like a hot, younger house,
that does stuff that our house won’t do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ours is so much better! This living room is smaller, the dining room looks
like a cave! What a hole!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: So? What do you think?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Love it!

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: Well, we already have one offer on it, and I think the lady
upstairs is goning to make another one.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: They could be our neighbors, what are they like?

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: Oh, the woman upstairs is very nice. She and her husband have two kids,
he's on Wall Street and she…

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh my God!
(Chandler and Monica are speechless).
Chandler (to Monica): Sure.
[Scene: Joey’s apartment. He’s there and Phoebe comes
in.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey Joey, want come with me to… are you ok?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I just… I just feel bad about firing Estelle. This is got to be
killing her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, that wouldn’t kill her. Ordinary embolism might.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I don’t know. She’s got to be taking it hard, I was like
her only client. Except for this guy who eats paper. And I’m guessing
he eats more money than he makes. Look, I know she’s not a great agent, but
she did stick with me for ten years. I’m gonna call her and hire her again.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, no, no! Don't call her! You wait for her to call
you (Joey considers it)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Because patience is the road to understanding (she thinks) which ...
is the key... to a happy heart.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (impressed) You blow me away.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (picking up her bag) All right, so promise you're gonna wait for her
to call you?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I promise. And that means, never having to give a reason. (Phoebe stops
herself from laughing and leaves)
[Scene: The house Monica and Chandler are viewing. Janice comes
down the stairs.]

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: What a small world!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And yet I never run into Beyonce!

lines.speaker: Realtor
lines.text: You two know each other?

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, we go way back. Before Monica made an honest man
out of him, Chandler used to be my little love muffin! (does her irritating
laugh). So? Are you guys thinking of getting this house too? Ooh! Are we gonna
have a bidding war? I'd better warn you, I'm a toughie (playfully punches Chandler,
who tries to get away from her)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (at Janice's punching) Don't, don't! (looks disgusted)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, actually, we're buying the house next door. (Janice gasps)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica and with bulging eyes) Why!?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (looks confused and scared) I don't know
why.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Ooh, that decides it then. I was on the fence.
But knowing that you two would be our neighbors? Ah! now we have to
get it! (Chandler and Monica are utterly shocked) Ellen, we're going to talk
numbers. (Grabs Ellen by her elbow and pulls her outside)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This can not be happening!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, the realtor said another couple made an offer.
Maybe the Janice's won't get it! Maybe the other couple will.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The only way that that is going to happen, is if the other couple
are the Hitlers.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (Thinks a little more) Okay, Okay, (clapping her hands)
All right. What if we got both houses? Huh? We can turn this house
into a guest house.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is a great idea! And by the way, I don't mean to sound distasteful,
but when did you start crapping money!?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, you come up with an idea.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright alright, we still have three hours till escrow closes on
our house. We can still get out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: But we love our house.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Will we love it so much with her next door? And she's gonna be louder
out here too. Just the crickets and (apes Janice's voice) "Oh My God"!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, but if we don't get this house, she's stil gonna show up wherever
we go! I mean, at least if she's here, it eliminates the element of suprise.
I mean, never again will you have to hear the three words that make your balls
jump back up inside your body. (She shows this with her index finger, mimicking
it pushing something up)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (looks afraid, but at the same time, knows she's right) Well, we
have to do something. We can't have her living next door. (Janice's laughs loudly
outside) Oh, that does it too. (Motions with his index finger like Monica did)

scenes.location: Mr. Zellner's office. There is a knock on the door.

lines.text: r Zelner: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (enters) It's me. Ron. (Mr. Zellner looks annoyed)
Look, I um, I now Rachel turned you down but I think there is a way you might
be able to get her to come back.

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: This may surprise you, but re-hiring fired employees,
is not my main job.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Just hear me out. How would you feel about offering her a raise? (looks
hopeful)

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: (obviously amused) Not good, Ron.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Perhaps I can persuade you. What if you can give your son this (Takes
a huge egg out of his back) genuine pterodactyl egg (whispers) replica.

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: (Takes a long look at the egg while he considers it) Wow, that's
pretty cool (Takes the egg from Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh? So? We have a deal?

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: Okay, you got it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes! yes!

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: This is gonna make me very popular.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, (grins) Believe me, the ladies, they love it!

lines.speaker: Mr Zelner
lines.text: (looks at Ross, for a long moment, confused) I meant with my son.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good, 'cause the ladies, not so much. (shakes his head, give him a thumbs
up and leaves)
[Scene: Joey's apartment. He walks in reading his mail, and plays
back his messages on the answering machine]

lines.speaker: Answering machine
lines.text: Joey, this is Al T. Booker, (Looks annoyed
that he called him) the guy who eats paper. I'm sure you've heard that Estelle
passed away. (Looks shocked) I wanted to let you know there's a memorial for her
at the Westside chapel, tomorrow at ten. Hope you can make it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God. (Still in shock when his mobile rings, he picks it up) Hello?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (on the other side of the line, still pretending to be Estelle) Joey,
it's Estelle. (Joey's eyes bulge up, he looks afraid)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Estelle?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I wanted to call and tell you that there's no hard feelings for
firing me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (still scared) Ok-ay. I just, I can't believe you're calling me?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I didn't think I should just drop by...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, no, no! (Starts looking around the room, terrified) Don't drop by,
don't drop by!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Anyway, you did what you had to do. I'm okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Can I ask you something? Uhm, what's it like there?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (Looks around) It's alright. Look kiddo, I gotta go. Good luck with
the career. You're gonna be huge.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks for everything Estelle. Bye. (Hangs up and reads the phone display)
"out of area". Boy, I'll say.
[Scene: The house next door to Chandler and Monica's new house.
Chandler is pacing worriedly through the living room when Janice enters.]

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Well... I just talked to Sid, we are definitely putting in an offer on
the house... a-a-and I'll bet we get it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: The Hitlers will be so disappointed.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: All right, I got to run. Tell Monica I say goodbye. And... I'll see
you later, neighbor. (Janice laugh)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wait! I just want you to know that... I'm so happy you're going to
be here.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh, me too... (laughs)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Because... that way... we can pick up where we left off.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I never stopped loving you.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Oh... my...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah! I want you... I need you... I must have you Janice
Litman Goralnik Neihosenstein.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Chandler, what are you talking about?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Now that you live next door, we can be together every day. Sid and
Monica never have to know a thing.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: I don't know what to say... I mean, you know, obviously we have this...
heat between us.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (stunned) Obviously.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: But I love my husband. And I know you love your wife. Now, I don't
think we should get this house now.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don't say that. Don't tangle the dream and take it away.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Chandler, one of us has got to be strong.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: Janice
lines.text: Although, maybe just... one last moment of weakness... (she kisses
Chandler flat on the mouth. Chandler squirms. When she's finished, he looks
at her lovingly but uneasily.) Goodbye Chandler Bing. (She leaves)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (speaking as in pain) They're never coming down now.
[Scene: Ross's apartment. Ross is working on his laptop when
Rachel enters with Emma.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You are never going to believe what happened to me today.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ralph Lauren called again and they offered
me more money.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: They did?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah. It was the weirdest thing. Zelner called me and he said we'll
do everything we can to get you back. And that I should thank some Ron... I
don't even know what department that guy's in.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So, what are you gonna do?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I took it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's great! So you're staying in New York!

lines.speaker: Both
lines.text: YAY! WHOO! YAY!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You're excited, right?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (hesitant) Ye-ah. Yeah! You know, the money's great.
It's certainly the easier choice...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, you know, was I looking forward to going to
Paris? Sure. You know, was I excited about working in the fashion capital
of the world? Ooh, absolutely... Oh...! Yeah, but you know, this is... it's
fine. I'm fine going back to a job where I've pretty much gotten everything out of
that I possibly can... (she sits down, and Ross who is stunned to hear all this
follows her example)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uhm, I hadn't no you... I had no idea you were so excited about Paris.
Uhm, I mean, you said you were scared.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well yeah, but I mean, it was good scared though, you know? Like when
I-moved-to-New-York scared. Or uhm, when I-found-out-I-was-gonna-have-Emma scared...
But this is... fine. This is gonna be good. (they both stare around)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (after a long pause) You should go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It's what you want. You should go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You really think so?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I really do.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: But I already told Zelner that I would come back...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (picks up a skull of some carnivore from his side table and puts it in
the same bag in which he brought the pterodactyl egg to Zelner) I'm sure he'll
understand.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. ALL RIGHT! I'm gonna do it. I'm gonna go to Paris.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah! I'm going to Paris. Thank you, Ross!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, oh! (They hug)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Oh, I'm so happy.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Then I'm happy too. (They're still hugging - fade out)
COMMERCIAL BREAK
[Scene: Estelle's memorial service. Joey is giving a speech.
Next to him is a blown op photograph of Estelle behind her desk and there's
a man standing next to him.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thank you all for coming. We're here today to pay respects
to a wonderful agent and a beautiful woman... (Joey looks at the photograph)
..inside. As Estelle's only two clients we would like to say a few words. (Joey
looks for his notes. The man next to him is chewing something.) Dude, where's
my speech? (the man swallows something and looks at Joey.) That is
entertaining. Al Zebooker everybody. (he applauds and Al shows that there's
nothing left in his mouth.)
THE END

title: The One with Rachel's Going Away Party

lines.text: Friends - 10.16 - The One With Rachel's Going Away Party
Friends
1016 - The One With Rachel's Going Away Party

lines.speaker: Written by
lines.text: Andrew Reich & Ted Cohen

lines.speaker: Produced by
lines.text: Robert Carlock & Wendy Knoller

lines.speaker: Transcribed by
lines.text: Coffee Mug, Eleonora, Sebastiano & Vanessa
Final check by Kim

scenes.location: Joey's place. Rachel and Joey are talking

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, all right, all right, let's play one more time, ok? And remember, if I win you do not move to Paris.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok! Can't believe I'm risking this again, but you're on! All right Joe, you remember the rules! Heads I win, tails you lose.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just flip!
Rachel (she flips the coin): Ha, tails!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damnit!
(Chandler and Monica enter the room)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So we thought we'd throw you little going away party around seven.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that sounds good!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey, Rach, you're leaving tomorrow, shouldn't you be packing?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It's all done!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, yeah, right! And after I took a shower this morning I just threw my towel on the floor! Oh God, it hurts to even joke about it.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know... Honey, seriously, I did it all. The luggage that I'm taking is in the bedroom, this is Emma's Paris stuff, these are the boxes that I'm having shipped, and that's the sandwich that I made for the plane...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ok, so you've done some good work! (pause) What about your carry-ons?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, well. Everything that I need (she takes her bag) is in here and my travel documents are on the counter organized in the order that I will be needing them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! I have nothing left to teach you! (they hug)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where's your passport?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It should be right next to my plane ticket.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it's not.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Maybe I put it in here (she opens her bag). Oh, oh, it's not in there! Oh, no! I must have packed it in one of these boxes!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Here, let me help you. (they both start opening boxes)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shoot. Oh, I can't believe I did this!
Chandler (to Joey): At what point did it stop being funny that I took her passport?
OPENING SEQUENCE

scenes.location: Monica's apartment. Monica and Erica are talking about the baby, and Monica is rubbing Erica's tummy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, wow, can you believe you're like three weeks away?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You don't mind me touching your belly, do you?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: No, I don't mind you touching my belly, but right now your hand is kind of blocking the part where the baby is gonna come out.
(She takes her hand off Erica. Ross enters the room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey Erica, welcome back to town! (pause) Wow, look how big you've gotten.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: That's because I'm pregnant!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right, no, I understand.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Oh, ok. I'm just always afraid that people think I'm just fat with big breasts.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, I knew (he stares at her breasts).
Monica (to Ross): Okay, well, stop staring at them.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: She brought them up! (pause) I didn't realize you were coming back so soon!

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Hey, well, in a couple of weeks I won't be able to travel.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, and I wanted her to get to know the doctors and get settled into the hotel.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hotel? Why isn't she staying with you guys?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Because we're moving in a couple of days and it just didn't make sense.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Plus hotels are fun! My room has this little fridge full of free snacks!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Erica, those things aren't free. In fact they have one of the highest mark-ups of any consumer product...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Ross! She's giving us her baby. She can eat you if she wants.
Erica (standing up): I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh man, I can't believe you guys are leaving this place.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I know. I know. Hey, you know, you can take it if you want! The lease is still in Nana's name.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no. This will always be your place. It would be too sad. Plus, how much a month does it cost to feed Joey?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, it takes two incomes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, is Chandler here? We talked about catching a movie.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, no. He doesn't have time for that. But if you want, you can go help him and Joey pack up the guest room.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mhm, (he balance things) packing - sexy cheerleader comedy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Mhm, helpful brother - creepy loner at teen movie.
(Ross takes the tape roll she's handing him and walks to the guest room while mocking Monica's voice)

scenes.location: Guest room. Joey has his head wrapped in bubbled wrap and Chandler is punching him. Ross enters the room.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What are you guys doing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Try it, I can't feel a thing! (Ross starts punching him too)
Monica (enters the room): Are, are you kidding? This is packing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We're taking a break!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: From?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Jumping on the bed?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, Rachel's party is in a couple of hours and there's a lot to do. Now, Ross, you got Geller blood, you're in charge of these yahoos!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You got it! (Monica leaves, Ross closes the door). All right, she's right, we gotta get serious. (He grabs a bag of styrofoam peanuts) Let's put styrofoam peanuts down his pants and kick him!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no, guys. She's right. We should get to work. I'll take stuff out of the closet, Joey you pack 'em and Ross you re-pack whatever Joey packs.
(Joey takes the bubble wrap off his head)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You guys hear a ringing?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (holding a pair of furry handcuffs) What the hell is this?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey! Handcuffs! And fur line, nice! I didn't know you guys had it in ya!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Chandler, you don't have a sister so you can't understand how much this bums me out.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I didn't know Monica had these!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Mhm, maybe she used them with another boyfriend. Maybe Richard!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why would she use them with Richard and not me? I can be kinky! I once did a naked dance for her... with scarves!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Bumming hard, guys, bumming hard.

scenes.location: Monica's apartment. Phoebe and Ross enter the room.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Where's Mike?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, he has a gig. I kinda like being married to a rock star, you know. My husband has a gig.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah? Yeah, where is it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, he's playing organ for a children's roller-skating party.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rock on!
Phoebe (watching the food on the table): Wow, this is quite a spread! (pause) What is all this stuff?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I thought this would be a great opportunity to use up all the food that I don't want to move to the new house with me! So, enjoy: smoke oyster casserole with a breakfast cereal crust, kidney beans in their own juices, and for dessert, a questionable orange.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (entering the room) Hey.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, where's Rach?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, she's putting Emma down, she'll be over in a second.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Now it just hit her that she's leaving and she's kind of emotional so no one say anything to set her off, ok?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah.
(Rachel enters the room)

lines.speaker: Everybody
lines.text: Hey Rach, hey you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Here she is!
Rachel (crying): Hi you guys!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What did I just say?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, no, no. It's ok. I'm gonna be fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Come here, I'll make you a drink.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, man! I can't believe she's actually leaving. How am I gonna say goodbye to Rachel?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know, she's been such a big part of my life. And it feels like when Melrose Place got cancelled. (Ross and Joey looks puzzled) I mean... oh, forget it. I miss Melrose Place!
Joey (to Ross): You know, I had a chance to stop her too!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who loses fifty seven coin tosses in a row? Head she wins, tails I lose. (he stops and starts realizing something) Wait a minute...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I forgot to pick up my dry cleaning!
Phoebe (to Rachel): You doing ok?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I've been better.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh-hmm.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You guys are gonna come and visit me, right?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes! You know, in six months the Statute of Limitations runs out and I can travel internationally again!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm gonna miss you so much.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what? Uhm, I have some goodbye stuff that I wanted to say to each of you and I was gonna save it until the end of the night, but come here (they go into the guest room).

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, what do you think they're doing in there?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Huh, if I had to guess I'd say Rachel is putting on the bubble wrap and Phoebe is doing the punching.

scenes.location: Guest room. Rachel and Phoebe are sitting on the bed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, Pheebs, I don't even know where to start.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok well, before you do, I know we weren't supposed to get you going away presents, (she takes something out from her pocket) but I do have something for you.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, oh. (she's holding the present, a transparent bag with a white stick in it). What is this?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's a cotton swab with a bit of my saliva on it, so that if they perfect the cloning process while you are over there, you can use the DNA to create your own Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm gonna throw this away, but thank you so much for the gesture!

scenes.location: Monica's apartment. The living room.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler? I was just in our bedroom and I found these (she holds the furry handcuffs) on my pillow.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yes. I decided to leave these out for you in case Richard stops by and you wanna engage on a little light bondage and moustache play!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What are you talking about? These aren't mine.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh yeah, right! Good luck getting another scarf dance from me!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That would be a terrible punishment. But, I'm serious, I've never seen these before.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? Then what are they doing in our guestroom?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel used to live in that room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Rachel... with handcuffs! Interesting! (he looks excited)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey's bare ass!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (he doesn't look excited anymore). Well played.
(Phoebe and Rachel enter the living room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I love you Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I love you too. (they hug) Please don't... Don't turn into... you know... French bitch! (they hug again)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: All right. Well, if I gonna do this, I'd better keep going.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ok.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ok. Monica?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Can you come here with me for a minute?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (to Monica) Are you wearing waterproof mascara?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, you're so screwed. (Monica goes into the guest room)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Phoebe) Hey. What was that all about?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She's gonna say goodbye to each of us individually.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are you kidding? Oh my God...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, I know, it's gonna be even worse for you... God... Ross, get ready to do some serious crying.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, man, I'm not going to be able to handle this. (pause) Now I know how my students feel at the end of each year. And why they act out by giving me such bad evaluations.

scenes.location: The guest bedroom. Rachel and Monica are talking to each other.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Mon... Okay... I've gotta... just say what it is I'm gonna say... None of the amazing things that have happened to me in the last ten years, would have happened if it wasn't for you. No-one has been more like a sister to me...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know what you mean. You're like a sister to me too.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (starts crying and speaking at the same time, making it almost impossible to understand what she's saying) I wouldn't know what I'm gonna do without you...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (having the same problem) You're the best friend I ever had.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (says something that cannot be understood)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I... I... I... (again saying something that cannot be understood)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That is so sweet. (they hug)

scenes.location: Back to the living room. Monica and Rachel enter and hug each other. The guys see this.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (to Joey) Oh no, she took down Monica... And I'm the crier in the family. Oh God! I could be next. Maybe she won't talk with me if it looks like we're deep in converstation. Oh, so that thing you said about the thing. It really made me think about that other thing.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh, Rach?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well it's okay. Chandler is talking to her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I really made you think about that thing uh?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Rachel) Uh, Rach... I think I have something that belongs to you. (shows her the cuffs)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (laughs) Oh, I'm sure gonna miss pretending to laugh at your weird jokes that I don't get.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, no, no... They're really yours. We... found them in your old room.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, these aren't mine. Maybe Monica used to use them with...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Don't say Richard! Well, if they're not Monica's and they're not yours, then whose are they?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I think you're forgetting the kinkiest former resident of that room.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Pheebs!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (from the other side of the room) Yeah!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think these are yours.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: These are not mine... Look how flimsy they are, come on! Good God! You try to hang a guy from a waterpipe with these, they'll snap like a piece of licorice.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (to Chandler) Can I talk to you alone for a minute?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure. (to Phoebe) You don't really handcuff guys to waterpipes do you?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Where do you think Mike really is? (she giggles, Chandler looks aghast)

scenes.location: The guest bedroom. Chandler and Rachel.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh honey...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Let me just say something... Because once we get into this, I'm gonna get all uncomfortable and probably make some stupid joke... I just want to say that I... I love you... And, I'm gonna miss you. And I'm so sad that you're leaving.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (all mushy) Oh, you know what? Let's not say anything else. I love you. (they hug)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, not so tight... (blows raspberry, and the hug ends) I'm sorry, just give me one more chance.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. Oh...
(Chandler blows raspberry again)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sor... Just go. Just go. I can't, I can't.

scenes.location: Monica's living room. We look outside to the balcony where Rachel is saying goodbye to Joey.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Ross) So, I guess you're next. You're ready?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, you're definately not. I haven't cried like that in years.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You cried yesterday at the six o'clock news.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That old woman was being scammed by her mechanic.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: God! I can't believe she saved me for last. (looking out to the balcony) Why are they taking so long?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't know. But, God, Joey seems to be handling it suprisingly well.
(Rachel and Joey hug, and Rachel turns to enter the apartment through the side window again. At that moment Joey tries to climb over the edge of the balcony.)

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: No, no, no, no!
(Rachel rushes back and pulls Joey back onto the balcony, and takes him inside.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, here we go...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... (holding Ross's shoulder) Well...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I think I'm gonna take off. (pats Ross on his back, but he looks very surprised)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you guys. This was an amazing night. Thank you so much. I love you. Good night.
(She leaves the apartment and they all stare at Ross)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? I don't get a goodbye?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (still very emotional) Lucky bastard!

scenes.location: Monica's apartment continued... Phoebe, Chandler, Monica and Joey are sitting down and Ross is pacing up and down.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Unbelievable. She says goodbye to everyone but me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, maybe she thought that with all of your history it could be, you know, implicit.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Well, it needs to be plicit.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, let's think about this. I mean, there's got to be an explanation. Uh... did you do anything to make her mad?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, I don't think so.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You know, maybe she was just really spent from our talk. It was pretty intense.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. Mine too.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Mine was a humdinger

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (annoyed) O-kay... I mean, don't I deserve anything? I mean, a few tears, a cursory hug? (Joey gives Ross a hug) NOT FROM YOU! (Joey lets go)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, if you're this upset, you should go and talk to her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And say what? "You owe me a goodbye", I mean, he's got more pride than that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: THE HELL I DO!
(Ross takes big steps leaving for Joey and Rachel's apartment, where Rachel is going through her papers.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't get a goodbye?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (talking agitated and angry) Everyone gets a goodbye but me? What have I got to do to get a goodbye, huh? Be best friends with you? Uh, go out with you? Have a baby with you? Oh wait a minute, wait a minute, I did all those things.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ross...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh no, maybe it's me, I'm just not giving you enough credit. Uh, I mean it is difficult to say goodbye to five people. Uh, goodbye, goodbye, goodbye, goodbye, good... (makes choking noises) IT'S PHYSICALLY IMPOSSIBLE. You know what? After all we've been through, I can't believe this is how you want to leave things between us. Have a, have a good time in Paris. (He leaves the apartment. Rachel looks kind of desperate.)

scenes.location: Monica and Chandler's apartment. The others are still there.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I hope Ross isn't too upset.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm sure he's not more bummed out than I am.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Tell me about it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, you can't say we don't know how to throw a party.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, I think I'm gonna head out.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Uh, where do you think you're going?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I thought I was going home to go to bed, but I'm sensing there's something less fun for me to do here.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We're moving in a couple of days and we've got a lot of packing to do. It would be great if you guys could pitch in.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey and I can finish up in the guest room.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, yeah, yeah, good idea. (he mimes hitting his head with his fist)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh no! You and Phoebe are gonna help me in here.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to Joey) You couldn't be cool. (he goes to the guest bedroom)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, we're gonna start in the kitchen. Plates get put into plate protectors and stacked ten to a box. The silverware gets bundled in rubber bands and then bubble wrapped. Got it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe and Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Good! Now I need you to be careful and efficient. And remember, if I am harsh with you, it is only because you are doing it wrong.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey Mon, I think I figured out whose handcuffs they are.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You did? How?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I was cleaning out the closet and I found some pictures of them... being used.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Let me see. (they all look at the pictures)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who's that dirty old lady?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica's grandmother.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Nana liked it rough!
(Erica, the pregnant girl, enters)

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Come on here, have a seat.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How was your night?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Oh, it was okay. I went to a movie with my cousin and then out for dinner. We went to this place that had... Ooh... (she looks likes she is in pain, holding her belly) Hoo... ooh... Anyway, they had these really amazing cheeseburgers.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Erica, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Yeah, you know, maybe I ate too much. I keep getting these stomach aches. They come and go like every few minutes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Relax! We just get her some antacids.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She doesn't have a stomach ache, she's in labor.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, you got to get to the hospital.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, Chandler get the coats. Erica let's go. Phoebe and Joey, keep packing! Oh my God we're gonna have a baby. All right. We're gonna have a baby! OH MY GOD, WE'RE GONNA HAVE A BABY! Oh God, oh God, I got to sit down, I got to sit down. Ooh! (she's hyperventilating)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Honey, it's gonna be okay.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: You can do this. Just breathe.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, okay... Okay, I feel a little better.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: (in pain) Ooh! Are you sure?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh... Yes, I'm sure. Oh honey, let's go. Okay bye everyone.
(there's a lot of supportive cheers from all. Erica, Monica and Chandler leave.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Chandler, wait, wait, wait...

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: If you get a second, find out where she got that cheeseburger.

scenes.location: Ross's apartment. Rachel bursts in.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You really think I didn't say goodbye to you because I don't care?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's what it seemed like.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I cannot believe that after ten years, you do not know ONE thing about me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, then why didn't you say something?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Because it is too damn hard Ross. I can't even begin to explain to you how much I'm gonna miss you. When I think about not seeing you every day, it makes me not want to go... Okay, so if you think that I didn't say goodbye to you because you don't mean as much to me as everybody else, you're wrong. It's because you mean more to me. So there, all right, there's your goodbye... Oh!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You keep, you keep... You can't...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: WHAT?
(Ross walks over to her and starts to kiss her passionately. After a while Rachel backs out. She thinks a while and starts kissing him back.)
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: Chandler and Monica's apartment.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A little more.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay. (she starts to stuff styrofoam peanuts down the front of Joey's pants.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: A little more, a little more. (she stuffs some more down his pants and Joey's assesses the how many there already are in there.) A little more... All right. Okay, all right, let's do this.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, ready?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. All right, now give me your best shot.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, here it goes...
(she knees him in the crotch. He jumps up a bit)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (in pain) Doesn't work... (he falls down on on his knees with his head on the floor)
THE END

title: The Last One

lines.text: Friends - 10.17-10.18 - The Last One
Friends
1017-1018 - The Last One

lines.speaker: Written by
lines.text: Marta Kauffman & David Crane

lines.speaker: Directed by
lines.text: Kevin Bright

lines.speaker: Transcribed by
lines.text: Kreidy
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. It's a scene from 1016 TOW
Rachel's Going Away Party.]
Jennifer Aniston (V.O.): Previously on Friends.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Erica, are you okay?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Yeah, you know, maybe I ate too much. I keep getting these
stomach-aches. They come and go like every few minutes.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Relax! We'll just get her some antacids.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: She doesn't have a stomach-ache. She's in labor!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!
[Cut to Ross's apartment. Ross and Rachel are there. It's another
scene from 1016 TOW Rachel's Going Away Party.]

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So if you think I didn't say goodbye to you because you don't
mean as much to me as everybody else, you're wrong. It's because you
mean more to me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rach!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?!
(He walks over and kisses her. They pull back, Rachel looks at him,
and they kiss again.)
[Scene: Ross's bedroom. Rachel is putting on her shoes as Ross shows
up from underneath the covers.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Shh.. Go back to sleep. I have to go home.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. This was amazing.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: It really was. You've learned some new moves!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, well, this guy at work gave me "Sex for Dummies" as a
joke.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Who's laughing now?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know!
(They kiss.)
OPENING CREDITS
[Scene: The delivery room at the hospital. Monica, Chandler and Erica
are there. Erica is in labor, and she is breathing heavily.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Breathe, breathe, breathe... Good.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Next time, can I say breathe?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No, last time you said it like Dracula, and it scared her! Can
I get you anything? You want some more ice chips?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: No, I'm okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: To use the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You can't leave me alone with her.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: This is exactly the kind of social situation that I am not
comfortable with!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What kind of social situation are you comfortable with?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's just that we've never spent any time, you know, alone
together.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You'll be fine. Nah, you won't, but I'll be back in two
minutes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.
(Monica leaves, and Chandler closes the door. Erica just looks at
him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: So, ah... Any plans for the summer?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I don't know. Maybe church-camp?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hah. May not wanna mention this. So, you ever wonder which
is worse, you know; going through labor or getting kicked in the nuts?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, it's just interesting. You know, because no one will
ever know, because no one can experience both.
(Erica just looks at him like he's crazy.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: One of life's great, unanswerable questions. I mean, who
knows? Maybe there's something even more painful than those things?
Like this.
[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment. Joey is there as Phoebe enters.
Joey is holding a baby duck.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Morning.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What's that?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's my house-warming present for Monica and Chandler.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: It's a baby chick and duck!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh-huh. And I named them Chick Jr. and Duck Jr.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I did not see that coming.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I figure they'll love it at the new house, you know? It
has that big backyard. And then, when they get old, they can go to
that special farm that Chandler took the other chick and duck to.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. It's a shame people can't visit there.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That is the rule, though.
(Ross enters.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Guess what? You're almost an uncle!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, Erica went into labor last night. Monica and Chandler are
at the hospital right now!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, and I have a definite feeling it's gonna be a girl.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, you were sure Ben was gonna be a girl.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Have you seen him throw a ball?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is Rachel here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, I think she's still asleep. Hey, hey, how did it go with you
guys last night? She seemed pretty pissed at you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, we, y'know, we worked things out.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What's that smile? Did something happen with you two?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I'm not one to kiss and tell, but I'm also not one to have
sex and shut up. We totally did it!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God. You and Rachel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, it's pretty great.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So what does that mean? Are you guys getting back together?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh, I.. I don't know. We didn't really get to talk.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But do you wanna get back together?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know. It was incredible. I mean, it just felt so right.
When I was holding her, I mean, I never wanted to let her go. You know
what? Yeah, I do. I wanna be together.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (screaming) YAY!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Shhh!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (quietly) Yay!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So, so is she still going to Paris?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow, I hadn't thought of that. I hope not.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, this is like the best day ever. Ever! You guys might get
back together, Monica and Chandler are getting their baby, there are
chicks and ducks in the world again! Oh, I feel like I'm in a musical!
(Singing) "Daa - raa... When the sun comes up, bright and beaming! And
the moon comes..."
(Rachel enters from her room.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Morning!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Guess we'll never know how it ends.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.
