lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey. How did you sleep?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Good. You?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I bet you did!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh. Would you guys mind giving us a minute?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Sure, yeah. Will you just keep an eye on the chick and the duck?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Chick and the duck? Didn't they die...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (interrupting) Dive. Yeah, they dove head-first into fun on
the farm.
(Joey and Phoebe leave.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So...
(He kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Morning.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You too. Last night was just wonderful.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: It really was.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I woke up today with the biggest smile on my face.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, me too. It was... You know, it was like one of those
things you think is never gonna happen, and then it does, and it's
everything you want it to be.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh-huh. I know. It was just, it was just the perfect way to say goodbye. (She hugs him, and Ross looks crushed.)
[Scene: The Hospital. Erica is moaning and about to give birth.
Monica, Chandler, a nurse and a doctor are there with her.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's just a little bit more, honey.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Help me! This hurts!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Is it really that bad?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Uh-huh! I think it's time to kick you in the nuts and see which
is worse!
(Monica gives Chandler a look.)

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: The baby's head is crowning.
(Monica walks down to Erica's legs to watch the birth.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh! Oh my God! That is the most beautiful top of a head I have
ever seen! Chandler, you have to see this!
(Chandler is standing by Erica's head.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, you don't wanna miss this. This is the birth of your
child! It's the miracle of life!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright. Wow, that is one disgusting miracle.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Start pushing. Here we go. Here come the shoulders...
(The baby starts crying, and the doctor holds it up.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: It's a... It's a boy!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Is he okay?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: He's just fine.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, you did it!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (emotional) It's a baby! A beautiful little baby! And some
other stuff I'm gonna pretend I don't see.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Would you like to cut the umbilical cord?
(A nurse gives Monica a pair of scissors. Monica gives it to Chandler,
and they cut it together.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, that's spongy.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to her son) Oh, hey handsome! Oh, I'm gonna love you so much
that no woman is ever gonna be good enough for you! (To Chandler, on
the verge of tears) Oh, we are so lucky!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know. He has your eyes.
(Monica looks at him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I mean, I know that's not possible, but he does.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: We'll just get him cleaned up a bit.
(The doctor hands the boy to the nurse, and she walks over to another
part of the room with him.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (To Erica) Oh my God, he's beautiful. Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I'm really happy for you guys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How do you feel?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I'm tired!

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Well, you don't have that much time to relax. The other one
will be along in a minute.
(Chandler stares at the doctor, completely shocked. Monica just
freezes and turns around slowly.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I... I'm sorry, who should be along in a what now?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: The next baby should be along in a minute.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We only ordered one!

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: You know it's twins, right?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, yeah! These are the faces of two people in the know!
COMMERCIAL BREAK

scenes.location: The hospital. Continued from earlier.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: I can't believe you didn't know it's twins! This has never
happened before.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, gosh. That makes me feel so special and good.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to the doctor) Wait, did you know it was twins?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Yeah, it's here in the paperwork we got from the clinic in
Ohio.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (to Erica) Anybody tell you?

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: I don't think so. Although, they did mention something about
two heartbeats. But I thought that was just mine and the baby's. They
kept saying both heartbeats are really strong, and I thought well,
that's good 'cause I'm having a baby.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: This is unbelievable.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Twins actually run in my family.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Interesting! (To Monica) Can I see you for a second?
(They walk over to the door.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What do we do?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What do you mean "what do we do"?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (panicking) Twins! Twins!!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Chandler, you're panicking!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Uh-huh! Join me, won't you?! Okay, what do you say we keep
one, and then just like have an option on the other one?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We can't split them up!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Why not? We could give each of them half a medallion, and
then years later, they'll find each other and be reunited. I mean,
that's a great day for everybody.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, what if the person who adopts the other one is horrible?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What if they're not? What if it's adopted by a king?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, because I hear the king is looking to adopt.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Monica, we are not ready to have two babies!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That doesn't matter! We have waited so long for this. I don't
care if it's two babies. I don't care if it's three babies! I don't
care if the entire cast of "Eight is Enough" comes out of there! We
are taking them home, because they are our children!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (smiles) Okay. Shhh...
(He hugs her.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: It looks like we're about ready over here.
(Monica and Chandler run back to Erica's bed.)

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Come on, Erica, start pushing again now.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Ow!
(Erica screams.)

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Here she comes!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (shocked) She? It's a girl?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (To Monica) Well, now we have one of each! (To the doctor)
And that's enough!

scenes.location: Central Perk. Ross, Phoebe and Joey are there.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: And then she said it was the perfect way to say goodbye.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God! What did you say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Nothing! What do you say to that?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, you've got to tell her how you feel!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You can't just give up! Is that what a dinosaur would do?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Dude, I'm just trying to speak your language.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, Rachel doesn't know that you wanna get back together. If
she did, she might feel differently. She might not even go.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You really think so?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm telling you! Oh, okay! This is the part of the musical
where there'd be a really good convincing song. (Singing) "Bam-bam,
don't take no for an answer. Bam-bam, don't let love fly away.
Bam-bam-bam-bam..."
(Rachel enters and interrupts Phoebe's song.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Can't a girl finish a song around here?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! So I just dropped Emma off at my mom's.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you're not taking her with you tonight?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, we decided that I would go ahead and set up first, and
then my mom would bring Emma to Paris on Sunday.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wow, eight hour flight with a one-year old? Good luck, mom.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you kidding? Eight hours with my mother talking about
Atkins? Good luck, Emma!
(Rachel walks up to the counter.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, you know what? You're right. I should at least tell her
how I feel.
(He stands up.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, wait!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Could you get me a muffin?
(Ross walks up to Rachel, but Gunther gets there first.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I... I know you're leaving tonight, but I just have to tell
you. I love you.
(Ross is shocked.)

lines.speaker: Gunther
lines.text: I... I don't know if that changes your plans at all, but I
thought you should know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (touched) Gunther... Oh... I love you too. Probably not in the
same way, but I do. And, and when I'm in a café, having coffee, or I
see a man with hair brighter than the sun, I'll think of you. Aw.
(She kisses him on the cheek and looks over at the others.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh... Bye guys.
(Rachel leaves.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Unbelievable!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, you know what might help?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm not getting you a muffin!
[Scene: The hospital. Monica and Chandler are holding the twins, while
two nurses are taking care of Erica.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Do you think they recognize each other from in there?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Maybe. Unless they're like two people who have lived in
apartments next to each other for years, and then one day they're
pushed through a vagina and they meet.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: We're going to take Erica to recovery now.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There's something that we wanna tell you. We decided to name
the girl-baby Erica.

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Oh my God, that's just like my name!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Son of a gun, it is!

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Anyway, I'm gonna go and get some rest. I'm really glad I
picked you guys. You're gonna make great parents. Even Chandler.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, well, bye!

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Bye!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We'll call you!

lines.speaker: Erica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Have fun at church-camp!
(The nurses take Erica to the recovery room. Monica and Chandler smile
at each other.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, look at these little bunnies!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know! You ready to trade?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright, let's see..
(They start trying to trade babies while holding one each. They have
no idea how to do it, so they just shift the babies around in their
arms. They give up pretty quickly.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We could trade later.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, I'm good.
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Joey and Phoebe are there.
There is a white crib decorated with balloons in the middle of the
apartment. Also, there are boxes all over the apartment. Joey is
working on something on the coffee table.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, what are you working on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It's a... It's a "welcome home" sign for the baby.
(He holds up a white poster with huge red letters. It reads, "Welcome
Home Baby." There is also a huge red stain on the left of the poster.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How sweet! Oh, is that the baby?
(She points at the stain.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: No, I sat in the paint.
(Ross enters with a gift for the baby.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey. So, did you talk to Rachel?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, and I'm not going to.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Because she's just going to shoot me down. You guys saw what
happened with Gunther. That did not look like fun.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: How can you compare yourself to Gunther? I mean, sure, he's
sexy in a more obvious way. You have a relationship with her, you
slept together last night.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, and she still wants to go! It's pretty clear where she is.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I know what you mean. I mean, sometimes...
(He sits down in the wet paint again.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh, Joe?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Damn it!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Look, even if I were gonna tell her, I don't have to do it now.
Okay? I'll be seeing her again. We've got time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, you don't! She's going to Paris! She is going to meet
somebody. Do you know how many hot guys there are in Paris? It's...
It's a city of Gunthers!
(Mike enters with a roll of paper in his hand.)

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey! What do you have there?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Oh, I made a little something. If I had more time to work on it,
it'd be better, but..
(He shows them a beautiful banner he has made. It reads, "Welcome to
the World, Baby Bing.")

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God! You did that yourself?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Honey, that's gorgeous!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You know, the baby can't read, Mike!
(Rachel enters.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! You guys, the car-service just got here. I can't believe
they're not home yet! I have to catch my stupid plane. I wanna see the
baby!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Monica just called from the cab. She said they should be here
any minute. And apparently, there's some big surprise.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, did she sound happy about it? 'Cause my friend Ethel's
baby was born with a teeny, tiny beard.
(Monica enters carrying her son.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!
(They all walk over to see the baby.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi! Oh my gosh!
(Chandler enters carrying his daughter.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey.
(Everybody turns around.)
Phoebe, Ross, Rachel: Hey.
(They turn back around to see the baby Monica's carrying, but then
they realise what the surprise is. Ross, Mike, Phoebe and Rachel gasp
and stare at Chandler and his baby. Joey hasn't figured it out yet.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (To Monica) Hey, so what is the big surprise?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.
(Joey stares at Chandler and Monica and finally puts two and two
together. He gasps.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What... What...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, okay, awkward question. The hospital knows you took two,
right?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes, it's twins!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, they're so cute! Now, what, what kinds are they?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (points at the baby she's holding) This is a boy, (points at
the baby Chandler is holding) and that's a girl.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Her name is Erica.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Aw..

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, that pregnant girl's name was Erica.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah. It's a shame you two didn't get to spend more time
together.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, we named the boy Jack after dad.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Aw, he's gonna be so happy.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, Jack Bing. I love that. Ooh, it sounds like a '40s
newspaper guy, you know? "Jack Bing, Morning Gazette. I'm gonna blow
this story wide open!"
(Chandler and Monica carry Erica and Jack over to the crib and put
them down carefully.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my gosh. Wow, so beautiful.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: (To Phoebe) I want one.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh yeah? Well, tell me which one, and I'll try slip it in my
coat.

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Seriously. Wanna make one of those?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: One? How about a whole bunch?

lines.speaker: Mike
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah! Ooh, we could teach them to sing, and we can be like the
Von Trapp family! Only without the Nazis. Although that sounds kinda
dull.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, you guys, I can't believe this. But I'll leave now, or I'm
gonna miss my plane.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm just so glad you got to see the babies.
(They hug.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Me too. Oh, I'm just sorry I'm not gonna be around to watch
you two attempt to handle this! Alright, I can't say goodbye to you
guys again. I love you all so much.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Call us when you get there.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I will. Ross, come here.
(She pulls him over to the door.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I just want you to know.. Last night.. I'll never forget it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Neither will I.
(They hug as Phoebe and Joey stare at the two of them.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, now I really have to go. Okay. Au revoir! Oh, they're
gonna really hate me over there.
(She leaves.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, you just let her go?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, maybe that's for the best.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. You know? You just... Look, you gotta... You gotta think
about last night the way she does, okay? Maybe, maybe sleeping
together was the perfect way to say goodbye?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But now she'll never know how he feels!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe that's okay. You know? Maybe, maybe it is better this way?
I mean, now, now you can move on. I mean, you've been trying to for so
long, maybe now that you're on different continents.. (Looks at
Phoebe) Right?
(Phoebe nods.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Maybe now you can actually do it. You know? You can finally get
over her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, that's true. Except I don't wanna get over her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't! I wanna be with her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah, I'm gonna go after her.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you are!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Woo!
(Monica and Chandler look shocked as Ross goes to leave.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, wait! Get your coat! Get your coat!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: My coat...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This is so cool!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have no idea what's going on, but I am excited!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: But Ross, Ross. What do you, what do you think she's going to
say?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't know, but I.. Look, even if she shoots me down, at least
I won't spend the rest of my life wondering what would have happened.
Where - where is my coat?!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You didn't bring one! My cab's downstairs, I'll drive you to
the airport.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, guys, wish me luck.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hurry!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Good luck, good luck!
(Phoebe and Ross leave.)
[Scene: The street right in front of Central Perk. Phoebe's cab is
there. Ross and Phoebe run over and jump in.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There's no seatbelt!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: That's okay. If - if we hit anything, the engine will explode,
so you know, it's better if you're thrown from the car.
(Ross looks terrified.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Alright, alright, let's do this!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay!
(A guy comes up and gets into the backseat of the cab.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: 18th and East End.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I - I don't take passengers.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hey! The law says you have to accept any fare.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, you don't understand. This isn't a real cab.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Alright, I gotta report you. What's your medallion number?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: My medallion number is, "Get out of the cab!"

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: (screaming) Get out of the cab!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Get out of the cab!
(The man jumps out, obviously a little scared. Phoebe drives off.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Monica, Chandler and Joey are
there, packing the last boxes.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, hey, hey, can I give you guys your house-warming present
now?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now, that you can do.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright!
(Cut to Joey's apartment. Joey looks inside the cardboard box that
used to be the home of Chick Jr. and Duck Jr., but they have
disappeared.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ah... Chick Jr.? Duck Jr.? Don't hide from mama!
[Scene: Phoebe's cab. Phoebe is driving very fast, and a terrified
Ross has closed his eyes.]

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You can open your eyes now.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Are we off the bridge?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Is the old woman on the bicycle still alive?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes, she jumped right back up.
(Ross opens his eyes.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God, Phoebe, slow down!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Do you wanna get to Rachel in time?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, but I don't wanna die in your cab!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You should have thought of that before you got in!
(They drive up to a toll-booth.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Toll-booth.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (screaming) Toll-booth! Four bucks. There are quarters in the
glove compartment.
(Ross tries to open a plastic bag filled with quarters, but he's quite
slow.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hurry!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay.
(Phoebe tries to throw some quarters out the window, but she has
forgotten to open the window, and she and Ross scream.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Damn, that window is clean.

scenes.location: Joey's apartment. Joey is still looking for the birds.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Quack, quack, tweet, tweet, quack, quack, tweet, tweet, quack,
quack, tweet, tweet, quack, quack, tweet, tweet, quack, tweet, quack...
(Monica and Chandler enter.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We were wondering what was taking so long with the gift, but
now we understand you were doing this.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, I wanted to surprise you, but for your house-warming gift,
I got you a baby-chick and a baby-duck!
(Chandler grins, while Monica is less enthusiastic.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Really? You got us a chick and a duck?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, great! Just what you want for a new house with infants.
Bird feces.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, they must have jumped off the table, 'cause now
they're gone!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, don't worry, we'll find them.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Actually, I'm gonna go check on the twins.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright.
(Monica turns around and is about to leave when she steps on
something.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God! What did I just step on?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's okay, it's just an egg roll.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh..

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You stepped on my egg roll?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I'm sorry, I didn't know to look for Chinese food on the
floor.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Just put it on a plate and leave.
(She does so.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, let's find these birds.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright.
(Suddenly, they hear the birds.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait, wait. Do you hear that?
(They realise that the birds are in the foosball table.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh! They're in the table!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, that can't be good!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: We gotta get them out of there!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, oh! Maybe we can lure them out. You know any birdcalls?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, tons, I'm quite the woodsman.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Well, maybe we can just tip the table a little.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Joey, wait! The ball!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh!
(The ball rolls into one of the goals, and Chandler and Joey listen in
horror as the ball makes its way inside the table. Finally, they can
hear the birds again.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh God! So what do we do?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know. Maybe we can open this up somehow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No... It's all glued together.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Does that mean we have to bust it open?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know. Maybe.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I know! It's.. It's the foosball table.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: All right, you know what? We don't have a choice. It's like I would
have said in that sci-fi movie if I'd gotten the part. "Those are our
men in there, we have to get them out! Even if I have to sacrifice the
most important thing in my life; my time-machine."

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did that movie ever get made?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: It did not.

scenes.location: The airport. Ross and Phoebe run in.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ross, where are you going?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: To talk to Rachel, isn't that why we took a ride in the
death-cab?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What? What are you just gonna walk up to her at the gate? Have
you never chased anyone through the airport before?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Not since my cop-show got cancelled.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You have to get a ticket to get past security.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? We're never gonna make it!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Not with that attitude! Now, haul ass!
(They run to the ticket counter, but they get stuck behind a group of
old people who are walking very slowly.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, if you could all walk slower, that'd be great.
[Scene: The gate. Rachel walks up to the man at the gate and gives him
her passport.]
Gate attendant #1: (with a French accent) Madame, your passport
please?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God! I was so afraid I wasn't gonna remember any of my
high-school French, but I understood every word you just said!
Gate attendant #1: Your boarding pass, please.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh.
(She starts looking through her purse, but she can't find it.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, shoot. I had it. Oh, I can't believe this.
Gate attendant #1: Madame, if you don't have your boarding pass...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I have it, I have it, I have it. Oh, okay, I can't find it,
but I remember that I was in seat 32C, because that's my bra-size.
Gate attendant #1: Madame, you must have your boarding pass..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, fine! But you know what? If I was in 36D, we would not
be having this problem.

scenes.location: The ticket-counter. Ross and Phoebe come running.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, I need a ticket.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just one? I drive you all the way down here, and I don't get
to see how it works out?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Fine, two tickets, I need two tickets.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: We're on our honeymoon.

lines.speaker: Ticket agent
lines.text: And the destination?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't care. Whatever is the cheapest.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm so lucky I married you.

scenes.location: The gate. Rachel is still searching for her boarding pass.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh! Shoot! Damn it! Where is it? Oh! Oh! I found it! I found
it!
(She runs up to the gate and the gate attendant standing there.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hah! I found it! I told you I would find it! In your face!
You're a different person.
[Scene: The ticket-counter. Ross and Phoebe have their tickets and
start looking at the screens in order to find the gate.]

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, flight 421 to Paris. I don't see it, do you see it?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, did we miss it?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no. That's impossible. It doesn't leave for another 20
minutes.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Maybe we have the flight-number wrong. God.
(Phoebe picks up her cell-phone and calls Monica. Monica is still packing in her apartment.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, it's me. Here's Ross.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What? Hey, hey, listen..
(Monica is standing by the crib, and she's looking at her babies.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God! Ross, you wouldn't believe the cute little noises
the twins are making. Listen.
(She holds the phone down to the twins.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica? Monica, Monica, Monica, Monica..?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Shoot, they were doing it before.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That's alright. Listen, listen.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, wait, wait, wait! Here they go again.
(She holds down the phone to the twins again.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Monica? Monica, Monica, Monica, Monica..?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Isn't that cute?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That is precious! Listen! I need Rachel's flight information.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, okay. Alright, it's flight 421. Leaves at 8:40.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yes, that's what I have. It's not on the board.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's what it says here. Flight 421, leaves at 8:40, Newark
airport.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Newark airport. Why, where are you?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: JFK.
(Ross sadly hangs up the phone, while Phoebe looks at him. Cut to Rachel at the gate. She gives her boarding pass to the gate
attendant, and she goes onboard. The gate attendant closes the door
and locks it.)
[Scene: Joey's apartment. Joey and Chandler are still trying to get
the birds out of the foosball-table.]

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: (yelling) Don't worry, you guys, we're gonna get you out of
there.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And we're also gonna buy you tiny, bird hearing-aids.
(Joey picks up a hammer and a crowbar and gets ready to destroy the
table.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Here goes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I need to say goodbye to the table first.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay. Table, you have given us so many great times. And you
guys, Jordan, Victor, Joel... All of you guys. What can I say? You
guys make us look good. You wanna say anything?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I don't know. Except that, for one last time... (he touches
the players as he says the following) Good game, good game, good game,
good game, good game, good game, good game.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Okay, here we go. I can't do it.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, I can't do it either.
(Monica enters.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey! Did you find them?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, they're stuck inside the table!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: We have to bust it open, but neither of us can do it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, well sure. This gotta be so hard. I'll do it. Gimme!
(Monica grabs the hammer and the crowbar and gets ready to bust it
open.)

scenes.location: Phoebe's cab. She's driving faster than ever before.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe! Wow! No, no, no!
(Phoebe screams.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Well, I've never gone this fast before.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Phoebe, forget it, okay? Newark is - is like an hour away.
There's no way we're gonna make it in time.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: She's got her cell, you could call her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I am not doing this over the phone.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You don't have any other choice!
(She lets go of the steering wheel to get her cell-phone from her
purse. Ross screams and reaches over in order to hold onto the wheel. Cut to the plane. Rachel is sitting in her seat when her cell-phone
rings.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rachel? Oh, good. Hey, by the way, did you just get on the
plane?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (To Ross) For what it's worth, we would have caught her if we were at the right airport.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh, Rach, hang on.
(Phoebe tries to give her phone to Ross, but he won't take it. He
mouths "no.")

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Phoebe? Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uhm, actually no. No, you've... You have to get off the plane.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I have this feeling that something's wrong with it. Something
is wrong with the left Philange.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, honey, I'm sure there's nothing wrong with the plane.
(The passenger in the seat next to Rachel looks at her and seems a
little nervous.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Alright, look, I have to go. I love you, and I will call you
the minute I get to Paris.
(Rachel hangs up.)
Passenger #1: Uhm, what was that?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, that was just my crazy friend. She told me I should get
off the plane, because she had a feeling that there was something
wrong with the left Philange.
Passenger #1: Okay, that doesn't sound good.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I wouldn't worry about it. She's always coming up with stuff
like this, and you know what? She's almost never right.
Passenger #1: But she is sometimes.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well...
(The passenger stands up and gets his suitcase from the overhead
compartment.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wait, what are you doing?
Passenger #1: Well, I can't take this plane now.

lines.speaker: Air stewardess
lines.text: Excuse me, sir, where are you going?
Passenger #1: I have to get off this plane, okay? Her friend has a
feeling something's wrong with the left Philange.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Could I get some peanuts?
Passenger #2: What's wrong with the plane?

lines.speaker: Air stewardess
lines.text: There's nothing wrong with the plane.
Passenger #1: Yeah! The left Philange!

lines.speaker: Air stewardess
lines.text: There is no Philange!
Passenger #1: Oh my God. This plane doesn't even have a Philange!
Passenger #2: I'm not flying on it!

lines.speaker: Air stewardess
lines.text: Ma'am, please sit down!
Passenger #3: What's going on?
Passenger #1: We're all getting off. There is no Philange!
(Everybody walks out of the plane.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: This is ridiculous! I...
(She notices that everybody is leaving.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, okay.
(Rachel leaves as well.)
[Scene: Joey's apartment. Monica has completely destroyed the
foosball-table, and Chandler and Joey are holding the birds.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Alright. My job here is done.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That was... Impressive.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, you didn't even use the tools for most of it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, they were just slowing me down. Alright, I have to get
back to the babies. I'll see you girls later.
(Monica leaves.)

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sorry about the table, man.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You gonna buy a new one?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Probably not. Nah. I don't know how much I'm gonna wanna play
after you go.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Well, at least we got these little guys out.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Aww, we were worried about you! Hm. I guess I better get
used to things crapping in my hand, huh?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm gonna miss these little guys. It was nice having birds
around again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hey, you know what? Maybe we should keep them here with you.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yeah, I mean we've got a lot going on right now. And, plus,
here they'd have their own room.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I could get a goose!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, I - I think you're set with the poultry.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Thanks man. Did you hear that, you guys? You're gonna get to
stay here! And, and it's good, you know, 'cause, 'cause now you have a
reason to come visit.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I think there may be another reason. So, awkward hug or lame
cool guy handshake?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Uh, lame cool guy handshake, yeah.
(They do the lame cool guy handshake. They look at each other, and
then they hug.)
[Scene: The gate at the airport. The passengers are standing in line,
and they're about to board the plane again.]
Gate attendant #2: Ma'am, I assure you, the plane is fine.
Passenger #2: And you fixed the Philange?
Gate attendant #2: Yes, the Philange is fixed. As a matter of fact, we
put a whole lot of extra Philanges onboard, just in case.
(Rachel walks up to the gate. Cut to Ross and Phoebe who come running up to the gate.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Where is she?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't see her.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel! Rachel Green!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: There she is!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel! Rachel!
Gate attendant #2: Wow, excuse me, sir, do you have a boarding pass?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, I just have to talk to someone.
Gate attendant #2: I'm sorry, you cannot go any further without a
boarding pass.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no, no, but...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: (screaming) RACHEL!!
(Rachel comes back to the gate.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God... What.. What are you guys doing here?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Okay, you're on.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What? What? Ross, you're scaring me. What's going on?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, the thing is..

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don't go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Please, please stay with me. I am so in love with you. Please,
don't go.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh my God.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I know, I know. I shouldn't have waited 'till now to say it, but
I'm.. That was stupid, okay? I'm sorry, but I'm telling you now. I
love you. Do not get on this plane.
Gate attendant #2: Miss? Are you boarding the plane?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hey, hey. I know you love me. I know you do.
Gate attendant #2: Miss?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I - I have to get on the plane.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, you don't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, you don't.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They're waiting for me, Ross. I can't do this right now, I'm
sorry. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Rachel?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm so sorry.
(She boards the plane.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I really thought she'd stay.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm sorry.
(Phoebe hugs Ross.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Joey, Chandler, Monica and
the twins are there. Everything has been put into boxes.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, that's it. Everything's packed.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Wow, this is weird.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. Uh, does this mean there's nothing to eat?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I put three lasagnas in your freezer.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I love you!
(He hugs her. Phoebe enters.)

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: So did you guys make it in time?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, he talked to her, but she got on the plane anyway.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Where's Ross?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: He went home. He didn't want to see anybody.

scenes.location: Ross's apartment. Ross enters and checks his messages.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the answering machine) Ross, hi. It's me. I just got back
on the plane. And I just feel awful. That is so not how I wanted
things to end with us. It's just that I wasn't expecting to see you,
and all of a sudden you're there and saying these things... And... And
now I'm just sitting here and thinking of all the stuff I should have
said, and I didn't. I mean, I didn't even get to tell you that I love
you too. Because of course I do. I love you. I love you. I love you.
What am I doing? I love you! Oh, I've gotta see you. I've gotta get
off this plane.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh my God!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the answering machine) Excuse me?

lines.speaker: Air stewardess
lines.text: (on the answering machine) Miss? Please, sit down!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the answering machine) I'm sorry. I'm really sorry, but I
need to get off the plane, okay? I need to tell someone that I love
love them.

lines.speaker: Air stewardess
lines.text: (on the answering machine) Miss, I can't let you off
the plane.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Let her off the plane!

lines.speaker: Air stewardess
lines.text: (on the answering machine) I am afraid you are gonna
have to take a seat.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the answering machine) Oh, please, miss, you don't
understand!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Try to understand!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (on the answering machine) Oh, come on, miss, isn't there any
way that you can just let me off...
(The message is finished. Ross jumps over to the answering machine.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No! No! Oh my God. Did she get off the plane? Did she get off
the plane?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I got off the plane.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You got off the plane.
(He walks over and kisses her.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I do love you.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I love you too, and I'm never letting you go again.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. 'Cause this is where I wanna be, okay? No more messing
around. I don't wanna mess this up again.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Me neither, okay? We are - we're done being stupid.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay. You and me, alright? This is it.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This is it. Unless we're on a break.
(Rachel gives him a look.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Don't make jokes now.
(They kiss again.)
[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartment. Chandler and Monica are
holding the twins. Joey and Phoebe are sitting by the window, while
Ross and Rachel are standing together. The apartment is completely
empty. Two men are carrying a large dresser.]

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, please be careful with that. It was my grandmother's. Be
careful.
(Two other men are rolling the big white dog out of the apartment.)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: If that falls off the truck, it wouldn't be the worst thing.
(She slips them some money.)

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know. It seems smaller somehow.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Has it always been purple?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: (to his children) Look around, you guys. This was your first
home. And it was a happy place, filled with love and laughter. But
more important, because of rent control, it was a friggin' steal!
(Monica and Chandler put Jack and Erica in their stroller.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hey, do you realise that at one time or another we all lived
in this apartment?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, yeah, that's true.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Uh, I haven't.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wait a minute. What about that summer during college that you
lived with grandma, and you tried to make it as a dancer?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Do you realise we almost made it ten years without that coming
up?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, honey, I forgot. I promised Treeger that we'd leave our
keys.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, okay.
(Chandler and Monica walk over to the kitchen-counter and leave their
keys. Then the other four pick out their keys and leave them as well.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So, I guess this is it.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah. I guess so.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: (crying) This is harder than I thought it would be.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, it's gonna be okay.
(Chandler hugs her. Monica hugs Ross and Rachel as Chandler gets the stroller with the
twins.)

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: (crying) Do you guys have to go to the new house right away,
or do you have some time?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We got some time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay, should we get some coffee?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sure. Where?
(They all leave the apartment. Joey helps Chandler with the stroller
in the hallway, while Monica and Rachel have their arms around each
other. Everybody walks downstairs to Central Perk. The camera goes
inside the apartment again, and it pans around. We see the keys on the
counter, and the final shot is of the frame around the peephole. The
screen fades to black.)
THE END
